lunyoro: Baitu omu Kristo Yesu okusarwa tikunyina mani, nobukwakuba okutasarwa; baitu muikiriza okurukukora omu kugonza.

lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibarya, yagamba ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omu halinywe arangobeza, nuwe omu halibo.

lunyoro: Munage okutuntura kwanyu kwona haruwe, baitu nabitaho omutima ebigambo byanyu.

lunyoro: Nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Omuntu owokubanza Adamu akaforwa obwomezi obwommera. Adamu owahanyuma akafoka Omwoyo ogwomeza.

lunyoro: ha musana, amalembo asatu; kandi ha mukono ogwoburyo, amaomero asatu.; kandi ha buguru, amafumo asatu: kandi ha buso obwemoso, amafumu asatu.

lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Tikuli kwanyu okumanya obusumi nobubyakuba ebiro Isitwe ebiyataire omu busobozibwe wenka.

lunyoro: (le) aleke okugobeza mwene wabu nobukwakuba okumusobeza omu kigambo eki: baitu Mukama nuwe muhozi wenzigu obwebi byona, nkokutwabandize okubahabura nokubamanyisiza kimu.

lunyoro: Nokufa nokuzimu byanagwa omunyanja yomu'ro. Kunu nukwo kufa okwakabiri, niyo nyanja yomu'.

english: When we were saved, we knew that the island was called Martha.
lunyoro: Kandi obutwamazire okujunwa, nubwo twamanyire ngu izinga niryetwa Merita.

lunyoro: Musaba kandi timurukuhabwa, baitu musaba kubi, okubikoza okwegomba kwanyu.

lunyoro: Baitu inywe mukehakana ogu Arukwera, Ahikirire, numusaba okuhebwa omuzinzi:

lunyoro: Baitu ekindukukora nikyo ndikora, ntabaha omwanya abase'ra omwanya; nukwo barorwe nka itwe omu kigambo ekibenyumirizamu.

lunyoro: Baitu bakagamba ngu Kitaba ha kiro kyobugenyi, hatabaho okuimuki'ra omu Bantu.

lunyoro: Kandi akokuro'raho akakoto kakarorwa omu iguru; omukazi ajwaire izoba, nokwezi omunda yebigerebye, kandi ha mutwegwe ekondo yenyunyuzi ikumi naibiri;

english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
lunyoro: owa Mereki, owa Adi, owa Kosamu, owa Erimadamu, owa Eri,

english: The seeds that fell among thorn bushes fell among thorn bushes, and as soon as they heard the seeds sprout, they left them for the sake of fellowship, riches, and pleasures of this life, and they did not achieve anything good.
lunyoro: Kandi mbali abasigirwe nambere ahali amahwa, abo obubahu'ra bagendera, batangwa habwokutabana, nitungo nebyokwesemeza ebyomubwomezi bunu, kandi tibahikiriza byana ebisemire.

english: They asked Jesus, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
lunyoro: bamukaguza nibagamba ngu Tata, ntwenda okurora Yesu.

lunyoro: Yabatuma okutebeza obukama bwa Ruhanga, nokukiza abarwaaire.

lunyoro: Kandi omu saha eyomwenda Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto ati Eroi Eroi, rama sabakasani? Ekimanisibwa ngu Ruhanga wange Ruhanga waitu, kiki ekikundekeseze/

english: We live in the body at all times, because the death of Jesus has been shown in our bodies.
lunyoro: tukoraki ebiro byona omu mubiri okufa kwa Yesu bwolekwe omu mubiri gwaitu.

english: But the chief priests took some of the money and said, “This is not against the Law to put it in the Temple treasury, but to put it in the Most Holy Place.
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru batwara ebicweka ebyefeza, nibagamba ngu Tikiri kyebiragiro okubita omu ryahu'ro rya Ruhanga, baitu muhendo gwesagama.

english: While he was still in his father's house, Isaac met him.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba akiri omu nda ya isenkuru, Merekizedeka obuyamuitiraine.

lunyoro: Agulipa yagambira Pauro ati Nyikirize iwe okwegambira wenka. Nubwo Pauro yago'ra omukonogwe, nayetonganira ati:

english: The beast that was once alive, but is not. It is the eighth king who is one of the seven, and he goes out to fight.
lunyoro: Ekibatana ekikaba kiroho,kandi tikiroho, nuwe mukama owomunana kandi ali omu hali abo omusanju, nauwe agenda omu kuhwereke'ra.

english: After a few days the younger son gathered all his belongings and left home to live in a foreign country. He ended up doing what was evil.
lunyoro: Kandi hanyuma yebiro ebitali bingi, ogu omwana omuto, akasoroza ebye byona, yagenda omu nsi ya hara; yararangiza oku ebintubye omu ngeso ezibihire.

english: They must be quiet, they must be quiet, because they are the ones who go from house to house to teach what is not right in the sight of God's people.

english: They had a large basket of plantains, and their wine was like a scroll.

lunyoro: Nikyo mukigumize omu mitima yanyu okutabanzaga okutekereza okumuragarukamu:

lunyoro: Bamujuma, nibagamba ngu Iwe oli mwegeswawe: baitu itwe tuli begeswa ba Musa.

lunyoro: Onesimo, akaba atarukukugasira ira, baitu hati bunu nakugasira iwe nanyowe:

english: When evening came, his disciples came to him and said, “It is already late in the day, and now the time is almost over.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba bwa'sa kuira, abegeswabe baija namberali, nibagamba ngu Hanu irungu, kandi obuire bwa'se kuira:

english: You are witnesses, then, and believe in the deeds of your ancestors. They are the ones who killed them, and you build their tombs.
lunyoro: Nukwo muli bakaiso, numuikiriza engeso zabasenkuru inywe: baitu nibo babaisire, nainywe mwombeka ebituro byabu.

english: For false Messiahs and false prophets will appear, and they will perform great miracles and wonders. They will be deceived and turn away from their sins, if possible.
lunyoro: babegesa, nibagamba ngu Kristo webisuba nabanabi bebisuba bakiimuka, balikora ebyokuro'raho obukuru nebyamahano: bahabise nabakome, kuba nikisoboka.

english: But if he does not know it, he will be a murderer and will give him back to his master and to the traitors, and there he will cry and gnash his teeth.
lunyoro: kandi obwalireka atamanyire alimucwamu habiri, alimuha omugabogwe hamu nabagobya; nuho haliba oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: And your brother Elizabeth is also the father of a son who is one of his ancestors. And so his sixth mother was called a tax collector.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, Erisabesi mwene wanyu, nauwe ali nenda yomwana omwojo omu bakaikurubwe: kandi kunu nukwo kwezikwe okwomukaga ayayetwaga engumba.

english: But they kept shouting, “Crucify him!”
lunyoro: baitu bayeyongera muno okutoka nibagamba ngu Abambwe.

english: A brother will give death to his brother, and a father will give him a son. Children will be obedient to their parents, and they will be put to death.
lunyoro: Mwene wabu alihayo omugenziwe okumuisa, na ise alihayo omwana;abana baryemera babazaire, balibaisa.

english: So he left Nazareth and went to live in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Galilee.
lunyoro: yaruga Nazalesi, yaija yaikara Kaperenaumu, enyakuli ha nyanja, omu mutano eya

english: But God said, “The world is passing away and so is its desire, but the world is passing away and so is its desire. And how little faith you have!
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga obwagamba ati Ensi ehwaho nokwegomba kwayo: dora, ensi ehwaho nokusisa kwayo! Rundi inywe abanyina okuikiriza okuke!

english: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
lunyoro: Baitu tikisoboka esagama eyente enimi nembuzi okuihaho ebibi.]

english: Because of your patient endurance and your stubborn heart, you have heard God's own anger on the Day of His anger and the coming of God's righteous judgment.
lunyoro: kandi obwokugumangana nomutima gwawe ogutarurwegarukamu, buli oyeyahulire wenka ekiniga hali ekiro ekyekiniga, nokusuku'rwa okwomusango ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga,

english: Love one another, and this is what you have done to all your friends in Macedonia. We beg you, my friends, to add more and more to your help.
lunyoro: gonzangana; kandi nukwo mukozire mali halibene banyu bona abomu Makedoni yona. Baitu tubesengerize bene baitu okweyongera nokusaga;

english: But after he offered one sacrifice for sins forever, he sat down at the right side of God.
lunyoro: baitu ogu obuyamazire okuhonga ebyonzira kimu obwebibi okumara ebiro byona, yaika'ra ha mukono gwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga:

english: He went down with them and came to Nazareth. He looked straight at them, and his mother kept all these things in her heart.
lunyoro: Kandi akasirimuka hamu nabo, yaija Nazalesi; yabacule'ra: nyina yayerinda ebigambo ebi byona omu mutimagwe.

english: They answered, "We don't have any more than five loaves and two fish, and we will go and buy food for all these people.
lunyoro: Bagamba ngu Titunyinabyo hanu, rundi emigati etano nencu ibiri; rundi turagenda tugu'le ebyokurya abantu banu bona.

english: “My son,” he said, “go and work in the vineyard today.”
lunyoro: yagambire ati Mwana wange, genda okole emirimo hati omu rugonjo orwemizabibu.

english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”'
lunyoro: Okuhikya obundifora abanyanzigwa bawe akatebe akebigere byawe.

english: They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their teaching. They did not want their lives to be destroyed.
lunyoro: kandi bamusingura obwesagama Yomwana Gwentama, nobwekigambo kyokugamba kwabu; kunu batagonze obwomezi bwabu okuhikya okufa.

english: offer your gift in front of the altar, and come back and make peace with your brother, and offer your gift.
lunyoro: oti oiheyo ekihongwa kyawe omu maiso gekyoto, ogarukeyo, obanze omale okuteraana na mwene wanyu, ogwire ohonge ekihonga kyawe.

english: The dust from your city that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you. But you know that the Kingdom of God is near.
lunyoro: Ecucu eyomu rubuga rwa nyu, erukukwatira omu bigere byaitu, nayo tugibaragalize inywe: baitu mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga buirire haihi.

english: Again he went away, cried, and spoke the same thing, and so he went back home.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okurugayo, yaaba, nagamba ebigambo bimu na biri, Kandi yagaruka

english: become wise, and be self-controlled; be self-controlled, and have reverence for God;
lunyoro: hakurukira amagezi; hamu nokwerinda mwongereho okumangana; hamu nokutina Ruhanga;

english: They began to proclaim God's message to the people in Damascus and to the people in Jerusalem, and to the whole province of Judea and Gentiles and to repent of their sins and do what is right in God's sight.
lunyoro: baitu nabanza okubatebeza abomu Damasiko, kandi nabomu Yerusalemu, nokuhikya ensi yona eya Buyudaya, Nabamahanga, nabo begarukemu, bahindukire Ruhanga, nibakora engeso ezisemerire okwegarukamu.

english: He could not perform all the miracles, but placed his hands on a few sick people.
lunyoro: kandi atasobole kuko'ra oku ekyamani kyona, rundi akataho emikonoye ha barwaire bake,

english: If any widow have children or grandchildren, they must learn to be self-controlled in their homes and to be a good example for their parents. This is acceptable in God's sight.
lunyoro: Kandi omufakati wena obwaba nabana rundi abaijukuru, babanze okwega okwerinda hali abo abali omu nju zowabu, nokuma'ra kurungi ababazaire: baitu kinu kisemire omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: So then, whoever speaks in strange tongues should pray for help.
lunyoro: Nukwo anyakugamba orulimi asabege okuduma.

english: For to one person is given by the Spirit the word of knowledge by the Spirit.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu omu ahabwa omu Mwoyo ogu, ekigambo ekyokumanya omu mwoyo ogu.

english: All who were sitting in the Council saw him face-to-face, as an angel.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abakaba baikalire omu rukurato bamugumyaho amaiso nibamurora amaisoge nigasisana nkagamaraika.

english: Through faith you are saved, who are being saved through the coming of the great day of God the Almighty.
lunyoro: inywe abalinzirwe amani ga Ruhanga obwokuikiriza, hali okujunwa okwomulingo ogwoburyo ogwa ha kiro ekya Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona.

english: Every tree that grows in me will bear fruit; every tree that bears figs will make it grow and bear fruit.
lunyoro: Itini ryona eriri omuli nyowe eritana byana aliriihaho: na itagi ryona erinyakwana ebyana, alisemeza, likanye okwana.

english: I was not afraid to tell you any good and beautiful teaching in your homes or in your homes.
lunyoro: sikanga okubatebeza ekigambo kyona ekisemre nokubegesa bwerebwere, nomu nju emuemu,

english: So Jesus went and began to do in the Temple what Jesus had done for him, and all the people were amazed.
lunyoro: Yesu yagenda, yabanza okuhikaniza omu Dekapoli okubiri ebikuru Yesu ebiyamukolire: abantu bona bahuni'ra.

english: My persecutions and suffering brought me to Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. The Lord saved me out of everything.
lunyoro: okurwana kwange, nokusalirwa kwange: ebyambaireho amo Antyokiya, nomu Ikonio, nomu Rusitira, okuhiganizibwa okunahiganizibwe okukuli: kandi Mukama waitu akanjuna omu byona.

english: Remember that our brother Timothy has been set free. But if he comes soon, I will see you with him.
lunyoro: Mumanye nga mugenzi waitu Timiseo akalekerwa: rundi obwaliija mpora, nanyowe ndi borora hamu nauwe.

english: This happened in order to fulfill what the prophet Isaiah had said: “He himself took our sickness and carried away our diseases.
lunyoro: ekigambo kihiki'le ekyagamberwe Isaya nabi, nagamba ati Uwe wenka akatwara obugara bwaitu, nayetweka endwara zaitu.

english: May God's mercy and mercy be upon all who follow this way of life.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abalikurutira omulingo gunu, haikalege okuganyirwa nokuganyirwa.

english: But when the righteous man stayed with them, he saw and heard them weeping all day long because of their evil deeds.
lunyoro: (baitu omusaija ogu ahikirire obuyaikaraga omulibo narora nahu'ra yabonabonaga obukyabukya omu mutimagwe oguhikirire obwengeso zabu ezokwema).

english: In the past we have been tempted in doing what the Gentiles want to do, in order to live immorally, in order to get drunk, in the habit of drinking wine, in the habit of drinking immorality, and in the worship of idols.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebyahinguitrho nibisobora okutumara okukora Abamahanga ebibagonza, nokugendera omu busihani, nokwegomba, nokusomasoma amarwa, nebyokubandwa, nobutamizi, nokuramya ebisisani okurukunugwa:

english: His disciples asked him, “Teacher, whose sin caused him to be born blind?”
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamukaguza nibagamba ngu, Rabi noha yasisire, onu rundi abamuzaire, nikyo kyamuzalize, omufuwamaiso?

english: But you follow my teaching, my conduct, my conduct, my faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.
lunyoro: baitu iwe okukuratira okwegesa kwange, nengeso zange, nokuhikira kwange nokuikiriza kwange nokugonza kwange nokubungi kwange;

english: But you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
lunyoro: Baitu mukafa, kandi obwomezi bwanyu buserekerwe hamu na Kristo omu Ruhanga.

english: It would have been better for that servant to have a large millstone tied around his neck and be thrown into the sea, than for him to have one of these little ones thrown into the sea.
lunyoro: hakire ogu okubohwa orubengo ha bikya nokunagwa omu nyanja, okukira okutabaijura omu omuli abo abato.

english: I was dead, but now I am alive forever. I have the power to die and have the breath of life.
lunyoro: kandi Omwomezi; kandi nkaba nfire, baitu dora, nyomire okuhikya ebiro nebiro, kandi nyina ebisumuruzo ebyokufa nokuzimu.

english: Jesus answered, “The hour is coming when people will not remember you, but will see the light of this world.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Esaha eza nyamusana tatabaijuka, baitu zirirora omusana ogwensi enu.

english: who gave himself for our sins, so that we might be saved through the present evil age, just as our Father, God, is our Savior.
lunyoro: yayehaireyo wenka habwebibi byaitu, atujune omu businge obubi obwebiro binu, nka Ruhanga waitu Isitwe

english: And so his heart is in you. He remembers how all of you listened to him with fear and trembling, as he remembers you all.
lunyoro: Kandi nomutimagwe guli halinywe muno muno muno, obuyaijukire okuhu'ra kwanyu inywena, nkokumwamuirize omu kutina nomu kutukumira.

english: “How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You hypocrites! You make the Kingdom of heaven appear to people, but you don't go in, nor do you allow those who are in the city to enter!
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abahandiki Nabafalisayo abagobya! Baitu mukinga obukama obwomuiguru omu maiso ga Bantu; baitu inywe timubutahamu, nabo abanyakutahahamu.

english: Then the other disciple, who was going to the tomb, went in and saw and believed.
lunyoro: Kandi nomwegeswa ogu ondi ayabandize okuija ha kituro, yatahamu, yarora, yaikiriza.

english: A Samaritan woman came to draw water, and Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
lunyoro: Haizire omukazi Omusamaliya okutaha amaizi: Yesu yamugambira ati Mpa nywe.

english: A priest was going down that road, but he did not know where he was going. When he saw him, he went on the other side of the road and went on.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omu akaba nasirimuka omu muhanda ogu atakimanyireho: obuyamuboine yamuhinguraho ha rubaju, yagenda.

english: Our ancestors brought us together with them and with them Jonah, who brought the land of the nations into the presence of our ancestors until the time of David.
lunyoro: Ibaisenkuru itwe nabo eyibalesere hamu na Yonabo eyiyabalesere ensi zamahanga, Ruhanga agayabingire omu maiso gabaisenkuruitwe, okuhikya ebiro bya Daudi;

english: For he who made me a servant in Peter's house made me a servant of the Gentiles.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ayakolire omu Petero obukwenda hali abokutasarwa, nuwe yakolire omuli nyowe obukwenda halli Abamahanga.

english: You see, then, that being put right with God is not the result of faith alone.
lunyoro: Murole ngo Obwokukora omuntu aihibwaho omusango, kunu tibuli obwokuikiriza kwonka.

english: On the day of his resurrection, whose wife will she be? All seven of them had married her.”
lunyoro: Nukwo, omu kuhumbuka, alika muka oha hali abo? Baitu bona omusanju bakamuswera.

english: For if after they have escaped from the corrupting forces of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again caught in sin and are destroyed, their future is worse than the beginning.
lunyoro: Baitu rundi obubamara okuiruka obugwagwa obwensi obwokumanya kwa Mukama kandi Omujuni waitu Yesu Kristo, obubagaruka okwetaba omwebi nokusingurwa, ebyahanyuma byabu nibikira obubi ebyokubanza.

english: With all humility, kindness, and patience, as well as by your love for one another.
lunyoro: hamu nobuculezi bwona, nembabazi, nokkugumisiriza, numukunirangana omu kugonzangana,

english: He will reward those who are seeking glory, honor, and immortality, to those who are eager to do what is good, and he will reward them with eternal life.
lunyoro: abo abase'ra okusimwa nekitinisa nobutajunda obwokwekamba omu mulimo omurungi, aliga'ra obwomezi obwebiro nebiro:

english: When they heard this, they got up and ran to the other side of the city and took Jesus to the hill country where they had built their city and lowered him to the ground.
lunyoro: obubahulire ebi; baimuka, bamunaga heru yorubuga, bamutwara hakihanga kyorusozi orubayombekereho orubuga rwabu, bamunage hansi.

english: At once the whole crowd saw him, and they were completely amazed. So they ran to him and greeted him.
lunyoro: Ahonaho ekitebe kyona, obubamuboine, bahuni'ra muno,bairuka nibaija namberali, bamuramukya.

english: Jesus said to her, “You are a woman of great faith! May it happen to you just as you wish!” From that very moment on her daughter was healed.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Iwe mukazi, okuikiriza kwawe kwingi: kibe namberoli nkokworukugonza. Omuisikiwe akakira okuruga ha kasumi ako.

english: This happened in Bethany on the east side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi bikakorwa Besaniya nseri ya Yorudani,Yohana nambere akaba nabatiza.

english: At that time you were far away from Christ, and you were slaves of the people of Israel and of the Gentiles to the covenant that God made with you. You were without hope, and you did not have any hope, and you did not have God in the world.
lunyoro: Kandi mukaba muli hara omu biro ebi ebyaira, muli hara na Kristo, muli basuhuki hali oruganda rwa Isaleri, kandi na banyaihanga hali ekiragano ekyomurago, kandi mutanyina okunihira, kandi mutali na amani, kandi Mutanyina Ruhanga omu nsi.

english: Then he sent other servants and said to them, “Tell the guests, ‘I have prepared my dinner! My cattle and my oxen are killed, and everything is ready! Come to the wedding feast!”
lunyoro: Yatuma abairu rubale abandi, nagamba ati Mubagambire abeserww ngu Dora, ncumbire obugenyi bwange: ente zange nezebisajwa zisirwe, na byona bitekanize; muije ha bugenyi obwobugole.

english: I assure you that wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will be told in memory of her.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Enjuli nambere erakagambwaga hona oomu nsi zona, nakyo omukazi onu ekyakozire kiragambwahoga okumuijukyaga.

english: That is why I said, ‘The man who first came after me has come after me, because he was the one who was the first of all with me.’
lunyoro: Nuwogu ounagambireho nti Enyuma yange haija omuntu ambandize: baitu akabali wokubanza nanyowe.

english: As they were walking along, some of the guards went to the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibagenda dora abalinzi abamu bakaija ha rubuga nibagambira banyakatagara abakuru byona ebyabaireho.

english: He did not do all the work because of their lack of faith.
lunyoro: kandi atakoleyo ebyamani bingi, obwokutairiza kwabu.

english: They are trying to convince me that Christ is real, not based on truth, but on love. They think that I will be raised from death to life in my chains.
lunyoro: baitu bali nibatebeza Kristo obwokukungana, hatali omu mazima, nibatekereza okunyimukiza omuhito omu nsengo zange.

english: And now, not I, but the sin that lives in me.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu tali nyowe ndukukora eki, baitu ekibi ekirukuikara omuli nyowe.

english: For the one who made this request in the name of the other tribe did not come from where anyone would work at the altar.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ayagambirweho ebigambo ebi woruganda orundi, nambere hatarugiremu omuntu okuhereza ha kyoto.

english: The Jews joined in the accusation against him and believed that this was true.
lunyoro: Nabayudaya bakaterana hamu okumulega, nibaikiriza ngu nukwo biri biti.

english: You tolerate anyone who looks down on you like a fool, looks down on you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you, looks at you,
lunyoro: Baitu mugumisiriza omuntu obwabatunga nkabairu, obwabamira, obwahabamba, obwayena engeso ezitasemire.

english: This is what love means—not that we love God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as the means by which we are made the descendants of God.
lunyoro: Dobi nukwo kugonza, tikuli itwe okugonza Ruhanga, baitu uwe okugonzaga itwe, nokutuma omwanawe okuba ekicunguro obwebibi byaitu.

english: Then he will go out to deceive the nations scattered over the whole earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together for battle. Their number is like the grains of sand on the seashore.
lunyoro: alirugayo nagenda okubihabiha amahanga agali omu mbaju ina ezensi, Gogi na Magogi, okubasoroza okurwana: omuhendo gwabu guli nkomusenyi ogwenyanja.

english: When Jesus saw the colt, he took him by the hand, as the scripture says,
lunyoro: Kandi yesu, obuyaboine omwana gwenkaina yagutemba; nkokukyahandikirwe ngu;

english: Then Jesus reached out and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, looked straight, and looked at the man.
lunyoro: Yago'ra omukonogwe, nagambira omuntu ogu ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagugo'ra, gwakira kimu.

english: But if any of you think that you haven't treated your husband properly, because you are too old and in good health, then you should do as you wish, not pay back, and you should marry.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwaraba natekereza tamukozire kurungi omuharawe, obwaba ahinguireho obukuru, kandi kiraba kisemire kiti, akole nkokwagonza, tasisa; baswerangabe.

english: The master of the house will get up and close the door, and you will begin to stand outside and to knock at the door. ‘Open the door,’ you will say, ‘our Lord!’ and he will answer you, ‘I don't know where you come from.’
lunyoro: Mukama wenju obwalikamara okuimuka, nokukingaho oruigi, nainywe numubanza okweme'ra aheru, nokweranga ha ruigi, numugamba ngu Mukama waitu otukingu'leho; nauwe aligarukamu nabagambira ati Timbamanyire, nambere murugire;

english: But Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone about it.
lunyoro: baitu akabatere'ra naragira batagambiraho muntu eki;

english: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If you eat this bread, you will live forever. The bread that I will give you is my flesh, because the world is alive.”
lunyoro: Ninyowe byokurya ebyomire ebyarugire omu iguru: omuntu wena obwarya ha byokuryaga ebi, aryomera ebiro nebiro: ego, nebyokurya ebindihayo nugwo mubiri gwange, obwobwomezi Bwensi.

english: It was Jesus of Nazareth, whom God poured out on him by the power of the Holy Spirit. He went and performed good deeds and healed all who were under the power of Satan, because God was with him.
lunyoro: ndi Yesu owa Nazalesi, Ruhanga okuyamusesereho Omwoyo Ogurukwera namani: ayagendagendaga, nakora okurungi, nakiza bona abayenderezibwe Setani; baitu Ruhanga akaba ali nauwe.

english: Pilate was surprised when he died. He called the officer and asked him if he had been dead before.
lunyoro: Pirato yahuni'ra okwafire bwango: yayeta nambereri omunyakihanda, yamukaguza okwafirege kara.

english: From now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right side of God's power.
lunyoro: Baitu okuruga hati Omwana womuntu araika'raga ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwamani gwa Ruhanga.

english: Repent, then, for if you do not turn from your sins, I will come to you soon, and I will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
lunyoro: Nukwo oyegarukemu: baitu obwotaryegarukamu ndiija namberoli bwango, kandi ndirwana nabo nempirima yomu kanwa kange.

english: After the uproar had subsided, they arrived at Gennesaret,
lunyoro: Obubamazire okwambuka, bahika ha mugongo ogwa Genezalesi.

english: Mary said to the angel, “What does this mean? I don't know the man!”
lunyoro: Maryamu yagambira maraika ati Eki kiriba kita, baitu nyowe timanyire musaija?

english: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are selfish and prided over the angels; instead, be proud of what you have seen and seen; instead, be proud of your body.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena aleke okubasekereza inywe omu kwebundaza okwayenzire wenka, nokuramya bamaraika, aikaire omwebi ebyaboine, nayenyumirirza busa omu magezi gomubirigwe,

english: The crowd was filled with pity, and Jesus said to them, “Get out of the way, because the girl has not died, but is asleep.” They made fun of him.
lunyoro: ekitebe nibatera empamo, yabagambira ati Murugeho, baitu omuisiki tafire, agwijagire. Bamusekereza muno.

english: And to godliness add love to your brotherly affection, and to to the brotherly affection add love.
lunyoro: Kandi hali okutina Ruhanga mwongereho okugonzaga bene banyu; kandi hali okugonza bene banyu mweyongereho okugonza.

english: Jesus answered, “I tell you, there are some here who will not die until they see the Kingdom of God come with power.”
lunyoro: ba nagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Hali banu abemerire hanu, haroho abandi abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhikya obubalirora obukama bwa Ruhanga nubuija namani.

english: I should have the same concern for you all, because I myself am with you in my darkness, and you are all here with me in my grace, in my trials, and in the preaching of the Good News and building up yourselves.
lunyoro: nkokukihikirire nyowe okutekereza nti habwanyu inywena, baitu ndi nainywe omu tima gwange, kandi nainywena numuterana nanyowe omu mbabazi, omu nsengo zange nomu kutonganira njiri nokugigumya.

english: For in Jerusalem is the city where God's people worship.
lunyoro: Baitu Yerusalemu orwomu iguru rwobugabe, nuwe nyina itwe.

english: Peter said to them, “Can anyone say that the Holy Spirit is like ours?
lunyoro: Petero yabagambira ati Omuntu nasobora okuima amaizi, Omwoyo Ogurukwera nka itwe?

english: If you have widows in your homes, take care of them, and do not let the church go without help. In this way you will be able to help widows who are in need.
lunyoro: Omukazi wena arukuikiriza obwaba anyina abafakati, abakonyerege, kandi ekanisa ereke okulemerwa; nukwo ekonyere abakwenda mali mali mali.

english: The women who had followed him from Galilee also saw the tomb and the body taken away.
lunyoro: Nabakazi abarugire Galiraya hamu nauwe bakuratira enyuma, barora ekituro nomutumbi okugwatairweho.

english: But they thought that he would turn from their sins and then fall dead. But when they were still waiting for him, they did not see the sin that had been committed by him, so they changed their minds and said, “He is a sinner!”
lunyoro: Baitu batekereza ngu arazimba, rundi aragwa bwango afire, baitu obubaikaireho okurole'ra, kandi tibabona kibi ekyamubaireho, bahinduka nibagamba ngu mucwezi.

english: His disciples came to him and begged him, “Send him away, because he is leaving us!”
lunyoro: Abegeswabe baija nibamwesengereza, nibagamba ngu Mwohereze; baitu natutokera enyuma.

english: But some of the people there were angry and said to one another, “Why are you sleeping like this?”
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abamu abahihirwe bonka, bibagamba ngu Amagita gafire ki gati?

english: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and he gave him to his mother.
lunyoro: Nauwe akaba afire yaika'ra, yabanza okubaza. Yamuha nyina.

english: So Jesus got up and gave the water to the wind, and he said to the sea, “Let the wind be hot, and there will be a great calm!”
lunyoro: Yasisimuka, yacomera ekiyaga, nagambira enyanja ati Leka, culera.Ekiyaga kyahwaho, habaho okuculera kwinngi.

english: Nor will that servant go out with me in the darkness outside, where he will cry and gnash his teeth.
lunyoro: Nomuiru ogu rubale atarukugasa mumu nage omu mwirima ogwa aheeru; nambere haliba mu oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: The Spirit told me to go with them, but they could not. The six brothers also went with me, and we went into the man's house.
lunyoro: Kandi Omwoyo yandagira okugenda nabo, okutasoboramu. Na bene baitu banu mukaga bagenda nanyowe; twataha omu nju yomusaija ogu:

english: But who is greater, the one who sits down to eat or the one who serves? The one who sits down to eat? For I am among you as one who serves.
lunyoro: Baitu arukukira araha? Ogu anyakuikalire ha byokurya, rundi ogu anyakuhereza? Tinuwogu anyakuika'ra ha Byokurya? Baitu nyowe hagati yanyu ninsisana nkanyakuherezamu.

english: It deceived the people living on earth by means of the miracles that he was allowed to perform in the presence of the beast. It deceived the people of the earth to make them look like wild animals with feathers that were full of feathers, and they were alive.
lunyoro: Kandi kibihabiha abarukuikara hansi obwokuro'raho obuyahairwe okukora omu maiso gekisoro; nikibagambira abarukuikaramu ensi bako'le ekisoro ekisisani, ekiyina emputa yempirima, kandi kyaba kyomezi.

english: and all the people who belonged to him, son of David.
lunyoro: nebitebe byona byanuwe Mwana wa daudi?

english: They are the ones who hear the message with their whole heart, good and firm, and sound like a baby.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo bahu'ra ekigambo omu mitima esemire, emirungi, bakigumya, bekamba okwana ebyana ebirungi.

english: “Come and follow me,” he told them, “and I will make you leaders of people.”
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Muije, munkuratire, nanyowe ndibafora abasohi babantu.

english: So they took a stick and went to meet Jesus and shouted, “Praise God! God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
lunyoro: Batwara enkindo, bagenda okumutangi'ra nibagambira haiguru ngu Hosana: ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama, nuwe Mukama wa Isareri.

english: But now we have been set free from the Law when we died to that which was ours; so that we may be slaves of the Spirit and not of the old books.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu tukasumu'rwa okuruga omu biragiro, obutwafire hali eki ekikaba kitutungire; itwe tuikalege abairu, omu buhyaka obwomwoyo, hatali omu nyuguta ezaira.

english: As they were untying and bowed down to the ground, they asked them, “Why are you looking for a living among the dead?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibekanga, bainamire amaiso gabu hansi, babagambira ngu Mara kiki ekirukubaseruza omwomezi omu bafu?

english: and cried out to the one who lives forever and ever, who created heaven, earth, and the sea, and the living;
lunyoro: yayami'ra ogu anyakuikara omwomezi ebiro nebiro, ayahangire iguru na byona ebirumu, nensi nebirumu, ati

english: Do not be afraid of one another; instead, be on your guard that you will not turn back to Satan for help.
lunyoro: Mutaimangana, rundi obumuba muragaine akacu, Setani aleke okubahya obwokutetanga kwanyu.

english: I assure you that this age will not pass away unless all these things happen.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Obusinge bunu tibulihwaho, rundi ebi byona bimazire kuhiki'ra

english: That is why his parents said, “He is a great man.”
lunyoro: Nikyo abamuzaire bagambire ngu Mukuru ogu

english: But if someone is taught, let him be taught by the teaching of Christ.
lunyoro: Omurungi anyakwegesa, ayekambe omu kwegesakwe:

english: But God chose the weak things of the world to be ashamed of the good things of the world,
lunyoro: baitu Ruhanga akakomamu ebyokubutami ebyensi, akwase ensoni abamagezi:

english: If it is proper for me to go with you, they will go with me.
lunyoro: Kandi obukiraba nikinseme'ra nanyowe okugenda, bo baligenda nanye.

english: When Jesus came into the house, the blind man saw him. “Yes, Lord,” they answered, “how can you believe?”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahire omu nju, abafu bamaiso baija namberali: Yesu yabagambira ati Nimuikiriza ninsobora okukora kinu? Bamugambira ngu Ego, Mukama waitu.

english: “I have brought glory to you,” a voice said from heaven.
lunyoro: Isenyowe nyumiza ibara ryawe. Kandi iraka ryaruga omu iguru ngu Nkalinyumiza.

english: The beast that you saw was alive, but is not. It is like this. It is like this. It is like this. It is like this. It is like this. It is like this. Those who live on earth, whose names have not been written in the book of the living, will be amazed when they see the beast that was alive; it does not exist, and it will be, and it will be.
lunyoro: Ekibatana ekyoboine kikaba kiroho, kandi tikiroho, nikisisana okuruga omu kina ekirukusisana nkeki; kandi abanyakurara hansi balitangara, abatarahandikirwe amabara gabu omukitabu kyobwomezi, obubalirora ekisoro nkekyomezi, kandi kikaba kiroho; kandi tikiriho, kandi kiribaho.

english: I was a stranger, but you would not take me in. I was naked, but you would not clothe me; I was sick, but you would not clothe me; I was in prison, and you would not clothe me.
lunyoro: omunyaihanga mutangonyese; nkaba ndi busa mutanjweke, nkaba ndwaire, omunkomo, mutansule.

english: Do not be fooled by everything you say. It will not happen unless there is a division among you, and when the Son of Man is revealed, then he will be revealed.
lunyoro: omuntu wena aleke okubabihabiha omu kigambo kyona kyona: baitu tikirihika, rundi okwahukana obukulikamara okubaho, kadi omuntu oli owokusisa obwalikamara okusuku'rwa, omwana wokuhwereke'ra,

english: You will be given the end result of your faith, so that your salvation will be complete with God.
lunyoro: Muhabwe empero eyokuikirizibwa kwanyu, nukwo kujunwa kwemyoyo yanyu.

english: Then the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple, dressed in clean linen and wearing gold sashes around their chests.
lunyoro: haruga omu yekaru bamaraika musanju, abakaba bayina emihito omusanju, bajwaire amabale amarungi agarukwangasana, kandi betegere omu kifuba nemyeko ya zabu.

english: It is not like this. The seeds that fell on good soil stand for faith, and they bear fruit thirty times, sixty times, and a hundred.
lunyoro: Kandi mbali abasigirwe nambere ahali itaka erisemire, nibakiikiriza; abakukwana ebyana, emirundi amakumi asatu, nenkaga, nekikumi.

english: They worshiped God's eternal presence, like the likeness of the four living creatures, reptiles, and wild animals.
lunyoro: kandi bakahingisa ekitinisa kya Ruhanga atahwaho omu kisisani ekyomuntu arukuhwaho, okukisisaniza nkekyebinyakuku'ruka nekyebinyina amaguru ana nekyekinyakweku'ra.

english: For no one can produce different races unless he has been chosen, namely, Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho asobora okusimbamu emiganda endi, rundi egi aysimbirwe, nuwe Yesu Kristo.

english: For the heavens and the earth that are now are being burned up because of the one thing that God has said about them, which he will do until the day of judgment and of the destruction of three godless people.
lunyoro: baitu iguru erya hati bunu nensi habwekigambo ekimu neki byahulirwe omu'ro, nibirindwa okuhikya ha kiro kyomusango nokuhwerekerezebwa okwabantu abatantu abatarukutina Ruhanga.

english: Nor does anyone pour new wine into used wineskins, because new wine must pour out fresh wineskins, and both are ruined by the wine; instead, new wine must be poured into fresh wineskins.”
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga enkuru: kiraba kitalikyo, amarwa gahulikya endyanga, namarwa gaseseka, nendyanga zisisikara; baitu amarwa agakora emirwa emihyaka omundyanga empyaka.

english: For we do not want you to lose your faith in me, but we will first come to you with the Good News about Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukukunukiriza okutahika mali halinywe: baitu tukabanza okuhika halinyowe omu njiri ya Kristo:

english: So when they had fasted and prayed and placed their hands on them, they sent them away.
lunyoro: Nukwo, obubamazire okusiba nokusaba nokubataho emikono, babatuma.

english: The sword that burns in your heart is the sword that has conquered many hearts.
lunyoro: Kandi na iwe empirima erikucumita omu mutima ebitekerezo ebyomu mitima mingi bisukurwe.

english: Respect your father and your mother—this is the first commandment which God has commanded you.
lunyoro: 'So na nyoko obatinege' ( nikyo kiragiro kyokubanza ekinyakuroho omurago),

english: I am running away to the end, where I will run for the prize of the eternal life which God has called to serve in union with Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: ndihamira okuhika kuli, nambere hali empera eyokweta kwa Ruhanga okwahaiguru enyakuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: If you do not speak in strange tongues, how can you tell what is being said? You will speak in strange tongues.
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe obumutagamba omu ndimi ebigambo ebirukuhu'rwa bwango, kirimanywa kita ekigambwa? baitu muliba numugambira omu mwanya.

english: He did not have any ancestors; he did not have the first day or the end of his earthly life; he was like God's Son, who lives as a priest forever.
lunyoro: atanyina baisenkuru, atanyina ekiro ekiyabandizeho, nobwekuba empero yobwomezi, baitu akasisanizibwa Nkomwana wa Ruhanga) aikara nyakatagara ebiro byona.

english: One of the criminals hanging there hurled insults at Jesus and said, “Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!”
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abo abakozire kubi abahanikirwe, akamute'ra enaku nagamba ati Tiniwe Kristo? Oyejune wenka, ojune naitwe.

english: Then the demons came out of the man and entered the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the side of the cliff into the lake and died down the water.
lunyoro: Emizimu yaruga omu muntu, yataha omu mpunu: igana ryajumbutuka nirikonkomoka ekinana, zataha omu nyanja, zafa amaizi.

english: I do not say this because I am afraid, but because I am afraid that as long as I live, that is what will happen to me.
lunyoro: Tindukugamba obwokutaga: baitu nkega nti nkokundi ebiro byona, nukwo 'nihege.

english: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but does what is pleasing to God and is willing to obey him.
lunyoro: Tumanyire ngu Ruhanga tahu'ra basisis: baitu omuntu wena obwakora Ruhanga ebyagonza, ogu amuhu'ra.

english: At times you have become like a hiding place for the wind and the waves; at other times you have been like those who have been helped by these things.
lunyoro: kandi obundi obumwafokere ekyokusunga obwebijumu nemihito, obundi abumwateraine hamu nabo abakozirwe ebi.

english: Greetings to Apollos, who is highly respected in Christ.
lunyoro: aramukye Apere asimirwe omu Kristo.

english: Those who saw it told them that he had the power to heal the demons.
lunyoro: Abo abakiboine babatebeza akaba aroho emizimu okuyakizibwe.

english: In the same way, you must teach your children to be self-controlled.
lunyoro: We abalize abana bawe okwerindaga:

english: He is the Spirit who reveals the truth, but the Spirit is the truth.
lunyoro: Kandi nuwe Mwoyo arukumanyisa, baitu Omwoyo nigo mazima.

english: There is one body, and there is one Spirit, just as you are called by one hope to be called.
lunyoro: Omubiri gumu, Nomwoyo omu, kandi nka inywe okumwayeserwe omu kunihira kumu okwokwetwa kwanyu:

english: Or when we are clothed, we are not alone.
lunyoro: kandi obutulijwekwa tutasangwa tuli kwonka.

english: So when they met here, I did not stay here any longer, but the next day I sat down in the judgment court and ordered the man to be brought before me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, obubaso'rokainire hanu ntaikaleho na kake, baitu na kiro ekyakabiri naika'ra ha kitebe ekicwerwaho emisango, nindagira okuleta omusaija.

english: For new wine must be poured into fresh wineskins, and new wine must be poured into fresh wineskins.”
lunyoro: Baitu kihiki'ra amarwa agomutara'ra okugata omu ndyanga empyaka.

english: They answered, “We have not heard unless the Holy Spirit comes upon us.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Nangwa, nokuhu'ra titukahu'raga rundi haroho Omwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: So he ran to Simon Peter and the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken the Lord to the tomb, and we do not know where they have put him!”
lunyoro: Yairuka yaija hali Simoni petero na hali omwegeswa ogu ondi Yesu owakaba nagonza, yabagambira ati Baihiremu Mukama waitu omu kituro, kandi titurukumanya nambere bamutaire.

english: The blood of all the prophets, which has been kept secret since the creation of the world, has been poured out into the hands of God's enemies for this world's sake.
lunyoro: Esagama ya banabi bona, eyasesekere okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi, ejunanizibwe abobusinge bunu:

english: The whole city was filled with fear, and all these things were done through the whole hill country of Judea.
lunyoro: Okutina kwabakwata bona abakaba bahe'raine; kandi ebugambo ebi byona byaranganwa okuhika omu nsi yona eyensozi eya Buyudaya.

english: and will punish all those who live in the world forever because they are afraid of death.
lunyoro: kandi ajune abo bona abaikara omu buiru ebiro byona ebyobwomezi bwabu obwokutina okufa.

english: Simon Peter had a sword, and he drew it and struck the High Priest's slave, cutting off his right ear. The servant's name was Mark.
lunyoro: Simon Petero akabanyina empirima, yagisomora, yatemaomuiru rubale wa nyakatagara omukuru wabu, namucwaho okutu okwoburyo. Na ibara ryomuiru Rubale nuwe Maliko.

english: So he sent the people away, got into a boat, and went into the territory of Magadan.
lunyoro: Yayohereza ebitebe, yagwe'ra omu bwato,yataha omu mitano eya magadani.

english: I do not want to be ashamed of anything, but to be proud of my body, whether it is by life or death, as I hope to.
lunyoro: Mahano! Baitu okunihira kwange nukwo kutalikunkwatwa ensoni omu kigambo kyona, baitu nindamya omu mubiri gwange nomu bumanzi bwona, rundi obwomwomezi rundi obwokufa.

english: They made sure that they had told him not to eat any bread, but to teach the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
lunyoro: Nubwo bakengere ngu tagambire okwerinda ekitumbisa ekyemigati, baitu okwegesa okwa Bafalisayo Nabasadukayo.

english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered, “Aren't you the only visitor in Jerusalem who doesn't know what has happened to you these days?”
lunyoro: Omu hali abo, ibararye Kuleopa, yagarukamu namugambira ati Iwe norara wenka Yerusalemu, otarukumanya bigambo ebyabaireyo ebiro binu?

english: His neighbors and his neighbors saw that he was crying and saying, “Isn't this the man who used to sit and beg?”
lunyoro: Kandi abatahibe nabamuroraga ira aikalire nalega, bagamba ngu Tinuwogu ayaika'raga nalega?

english: The rest of the scripture says, “The Lord will reward me on that Day, not only myself, but also all those who love to appear before him.”
lunyoro: Kagaruka okubaho, Mukama waitu okwalimpera ha kiro eki, tali nyowe nyenka, baitu na bona abagondeze okubonekakwe.

english: There are many different kinds of different kinds of work, but there is only one God, who uses everything in order to do it.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho emiringo nyingi eyemirimo, baitu Ruhanga ali omu, anyakukoza byona omu byona.

english: Nicodemus answered him, “Can a man be born without having children be born? Can he go to another country for a second time into the country where his mother and his brothers were born?”
lunyoro: Nikodemo yamugabira ati Omuntu nasobora ata okuzarwa obwaba akuzire? Nasobora okutaha obwakabiri omu nsi yowabu nambere yazarirwe?

english: Greetings to the church in their homes. Greetings to the older men in the province of Asia, to the Christians in Achaia.
lunyoro: nokuramukya ekanisa eyomu nju yabu. Muramukye Asiya yona, ekinyakuro'raho omu Kristo.

english: Jesus said to him, “Have you seen how much this great and mysterious work will be done? The stone that will be left here will not be thrown down, and it will not be thrown down.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Oboine okwombekwa kunu okwingi? Tihalisigara hanu ibale erinyakuli ha ibale, eritalinagwa hansi.

english: “What does this man have to say to you?” they asked. “Tale! Who, then, can forgive sins, or who can forgive sins against God alone?”
lunyoro: Omuntu onu kiki ekimugambisize kiti? Majuma: noha asobora okuihaho ebib, rundi omu, nuwe Ruhanga?

english: If I drive out demons because Beelzebul, who is going to drive them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: “Father Abraham,” he begged, “give me a drink of water, and send Lazarus to dip his finger in the water and cool off my tongue, because I am in great pain in this fire.
lunyoro: Yayami'ra nagamba ati Tata Iburahimu, nganyira, otume Razaro, aibike ensonga yorukumurwe omu maizi, afukirize orulimi rwange; baitu nimpu'rwa omu mu'ro gunu.

english: For who has known the mind of the Lord? It is we who have the mind of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu noha akaba amanyire amagezi ga Mukama, okumwegesa? Baitu itwe tuyina amagezi ga Kristo.

english: He will put away the godlessness of Jacob.
lunyoro: Ariihaho okutatina Ruhanga ha Yakobo:

english: If I speak in strange tongues to people and to the angels, but do not have love, then I will become like a licentious plant that grows up and becomes like a branch that does not bear fruit.
lunyoro: Obundaba ningamba nendimi zabantu neza bamaraika, kunu ntanyina kugonza, buli nfokere nkomulinga ogugamba, nenjogera ezisara.

english: For the pain we feel now is much greater than the pain we feel for the eternal glory that we have.
lunyoro: Baitu omuhito gwaitu ogwa hati ogutalemera muno nugugarukira obutosa okutuko'ra ekitinisa kingi ekyebiro nebiro:

english: Then Peter and the other disciple went out to the tomb.
lunyoro: Kandi petero yaturuka, nomwegeswa ogu ondi, bagenda ha kituro.

english: But Peter and the other apostles answered, “We must obey God as ruler rather than men.
lunyoro: Baitu Petero nabakwenda bagarukamu nibagamba ngu Kituhikirire okuhu'ra Ruhanga okukira abantu.

english: It is hard for a person to die for the sake of the good or for the evil to die for the good.
lunyoro: Baitu nikirema omuntu okufera nowokuhiki'ra: baitu habwomurungi rundi omuntu yakugumire okumufera.

english: A man must give to his wife what she wants, and a woman must also give to him as a husband.
lunyoro: Omusaija amuhege mukazi ekimusemerire: nukwo nomukazi amuhe ati omusaija.

english: That is why I did this in Jerusalem, and I was put in prison by many of the holy ones, and when I was given authority over the chief priests, and they were put to death, I also put faith in them.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo nakolire Yerusalemu, kandi naboha omu nju zenkomo abarukwera baingi,obunahairwe obusobozi hali banyakatagara abakuru, kandi obubaisirwe, nanyowe nkaikiriza okubaita.

english: He went out about twelve o'clock in the afternoon and found some other men still standing there. "Why are you here doing nothing but what are you doing?" he asked them.
lunyoro: Yaturuka esaha zihikire ikumi nemu, yasanga abandi bemerire; yabagambira ati Kikyekibemerize hanu okiza obuire, mutaroho ekimurukukora?

english: We have seen a man who is evil; he is misleading the Jews all over the world, and he is the leader of the party of the Nazarenes.
lunyoro: Baitu tukabona omusaija omu mubi muno, kandi owokwemesa Abayudaya bona abali omunsi zona, kandi omukuru owekicweka kya Banazalesi:

english: The man who had been sick for a long time married her, and she died. The third said,
lunyoro: Kandi owakabirir yamuswera, yafa. Nowakasatu nukwo ati:

english: He was amazed, and all who were with him, at the many fish that they had caught.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba ahunirire, na bona abakaba bali nauwe, obwencu enyingi ezibakwasire;

english: And so I said, ‘Lord, they know very well that I am in prison and that they are in all the synagogues who believe in you.
lunyoro: nagamba nti Mukama wange bo bamanyire bonka ngu nyowe nabataga omu nju zenkomo, kandi nabateraga omu maso'rokaniro gona abakuikirize:

english: He believed and looked for someone who was not in the crowd.
lunyoro: Yaikiriza, yase'ra akabali, ha kitebe kitali.

english: But even Titus was with me, not to be called upon to be circumcised, because he was an apostle.
lunyoro: Baitu na Tito akabali hamu nanyowe atahambirizibwe okusarwa, obwokuba

lunyoro: Kandi obumurahu'raga obulemu nokuranganwa okwobulemu, mutalituntura: bihikirire okubaho; baitu emperor etaakabaireho.

english: They will kill him, and the third day he will be raised to life.” So they were very angry.
lunyoro: bamutera balimuita: naha kiro ekyakasatu alihumburwa. Baganya muno.

english: Whoever gives one of these little ones too much water in the name of a disciple will certainly drink too much water, because his reward will never be paid.”
lunyoro: Na wena alimuha okunywa omu hali banu abake eyugi eyamaizi agarukufuka, omu ibara ryomwegeswa, mazimakwo nimbagambira nti emperaye teriuburaho na kake.

english: And so all who want to live in godly devotion in union with Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
lunyoro: Kandi mazimakwo bona abarukwendfa okukwata engeso ezokutina Ruhanga omu Kristo Yesu balihiganizibwa.

english: The crowd rebuked them and said, “Son of David! Have mercy on us, sir!”
lunyoro: Ekitebe kyabahana baculere; baitu abo bagarukira muno okutokera ha iguru, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu, otuganyire iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: For if we have sinned against God, we are sinning against him; if we do not take care of our sins, we are sinning against you.
lunyoro: Baitu turaba tugwire iraro Ruhanga, turaba ntwerinda, twerinzire halinywe.

english: I fast two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all my income.
lunyoro: Nsiba emirundi ebiri ebiro musanju; mpayo ekicweka kiikumi kya byona ebintunga.

english: No one will listen to his voice in the streets.
lunyoro: kandi busaho muntu alihu'ra irakarye omu makute.

english: This is better seen than any other priest who has ever lived, because he is like Melchizedek.
lunyoro: Ebi ebiturukugamba nibikira okumanyisibwa, rundi nyakatagara ondi obwaimuka nkekisisani ekya Merekizedeka okukiri,

english: But he is at my right side, and I will not be a burden to them.
lunyoro: Baitu ali ha mukono gwange obwoburyo, ntatabatabana:

english: But Jesus said to him, “Don't be afraid of him, for whoever is not against you is for you.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamugambira ati Mutamutanga; baitu atali munyanzigwa wanyu, buli ali habwanyu.

english: In Joppa there was a certain disciple named Tabitha named Dorcas. She was full of good deeds and gifts.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho, omu Yopa omwegeswa omu, ibararye Tabisa, okumanyisibw kwaryo ayetwa Dolika: omukazi ogu akaba aijuire engeso enungi nezokugaba eziyakoraga.

english: So they offered a burnt offering and a sacrifice to make the sacrifice for the Gentiles.
lunyoro: Basoroma ebihongwa ebyokeze ebihikirire, nebicumbirwe ebihanga:

english: Which one of the three was going to lose?
lunyoro: Araha hali abo abasatu akaba nayenda okufeerwa?

english: Peter remembered what had happened and said to Jesus, “Look! The fig tree you cursed has died!”
lunyoro: Petero yaijuka yamugambira ati Dora, omutini oguwakyenere gwomere.

english: For we are not like the people who speak God's word, but in the truth, who belong to God and belong to God. We say that we belong to Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu tituli nkabo abarukuhambiriza ekigambo kya Ruhanga, baitu obwamazima, nka Ruhanga okuyagondeze, nukwo tugamba tuti omu Kristo.

english: After they had dismissed Jason and the others, they took them with them.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okubesimbira Yasoni nabandi, babaleta.

english: Be merciful, as your Father is merciful.
lunyoro: Inywe muikalege nembabazi, nka Isinywe okwayina embabazi.

english: In the synagogue there was a man who had an evil spirit in him who had a paralyzed man.
lunyoro: Kandi omu iso'rokaniro hakaba harumu omuntu akabaroho omuzimu omubi ayarugire:

english: A little while later the men who were standing there again said to Peter, “You know that you belong to them.”
lunyoro: kandi akacu kake obukahinguireho abakaba bemerire haihi bagaruka okugambira Petero ngu Mananukwo oli wowabu;

english: After gathering all the chief priests and the teachers of the Law together, he asked them where the Messiah would be born.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okusoroza ahamu banyakatagara abakuru bona nabahandiki babantu, yabakaguza Kristo nambere arukugenda kuzarwa.

english: The beast was taken away, and the false prophet was with him. He performed miracles in the presence of the angel, and he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image. They both lived in the lake of fire, burning with sulfur.
lunyoro: Ekibatana bakagitwara hamu na nabi webisuba, ayakozire obwokuro'raho omu maiso gakyo, nabi ogu mubihabiha abo abahairwe enkojo yebisoro, nabo abaramyaga ekisisani kyakyo; nabo bombi nibasihana omu nyanja yomu'ro ogurukwaka nekiberiti:

english: If, then, you are to be put to death by God's chosen people, how can you be condemned? I tell you, then, to be put to shame.
lunyoro: Nukwo muraba numuba nokucwa eyobwomezi bunu, abarukugayibwa omu kanisa nibo mutaho okucwa emisango? Ningamba okubakwasa ensoni.

english: Send them out of the city, and they stone him, leaving their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul.
lunyoro: kandi obubatumire aheru yorubuga, bamutera amabale, basiga ebyokujwara byabu ha bigere byomusigazi, ibararye Sauro.

english: The workers must marry only one woman, and they must have children and families in good health.
lunyoro: Abahereza babege abasaija bokuswera omukazi omu, nibalema kurungi abana babu nenju zabu banka.

english: Now that I have told you, it has not yet come true, so that when it is done, you will believe me.
lunyoro: Hati bunu mbagambire kitakahikire, obukirikahika munyikirize.

english: But when you have purified yourselves from sin by obeying the truth, love your brothers without hypocrisy, and love one another with all your heart and love one another with all your heart.
lunyoro: baitu obumumazire okweza obwomezi bwanyu omu kuhu'ra kwanyu ebyamazima okugonzaga bene banyu hataroho bugobya, mugonzangane omu mutima nokugonza kwingi:

english: But if you do what is evil, then you are a servant of God, because you do not carry it out. You are God's slave, and you are a shield for those who do evil.
lunyoro: baitu nuwe mukwenda wa Ruhanga haliwe obwoburungi. Baitu oraba nokora ekibihire, tina; baitu takwatira busa empirima: baitu nukwo akugambira ati Ruhanga, omuhozi wenzigu hali anyakukora obubi.

english: The king was angry, but because of his plans and the people who were with him to eat the bread he ordered Jesus to be handed over to them.
lunyoro: Omukama yasalirwa; baitu habwebirahirobye, na habwabu abakaba baikalire nauwe ha byokurya, yaragira okugumuha;

english: Through one faith we have brought praise to God, and so we boast about our hope in God's glory.
lunyoro: nitwenyumiriza omu kuikiriza kumu hali Ruhanga, nukwo twenyumirize obwokunihira ekitnisa kya Ruhanga.

english: “Sir,” he begged, “my servant who is sitting in my house has fallen asleep and is very upset.
lunyoro: namwesengereza, nagamba ati Mukama wange, omuiru wange abyamire omunju azingamire, nahu'rwa muno.

english: The Holy Spirit says, “I am sick and thirsty, but I do not want to touch my heart.”
lunyoro: Omwoyo Ogurukwera, ngu ninsasa muno kandi nintuntura okutaikya omu mutima gwange

english: But if a woman does not commit adultery, she is guilty of committing adultery. But if it is shameful for a woman to have a baby, she must be covered with a covering.
lunyoro: Baitu omukazi obwatesweke'ra, hakire eyemwe: kandi obukiraba kiri kyensoni hali omukazi okusarwa isoke, rundi okwemwa, ayesweke.

english: As they went to buy some food, the bridegroom arrived; and as they went to buy some food, the bridegroom came; and the others who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba bagenzire okugura, omuswezi yaija; nabo obubakaba nagenda okugulira, omukwe yaija: nabo abakaba batekanize bahingura nauwe omubugenyi obwobugole.

english: The rest of the beast remains once more, which indicates that the beast was destroyed and that the beast was destroyed, and so those things that are not yet destroyed.
lunyoro: Kandi kinungu Hasigaireho omurundi gumu, nikimanyisa okuihibwaho kwebi ebitengesebwa, nibyo byahangirwe, nukwo ebi ebitaruku

english: Just as the weeds are gathered up and burned in the fire, so the same will be true at the end of the age.
lunyoro: Nkemberya okuzisorozebwa okwokebwa omu mu'ro; nukwo kiriba kiti hampero yensi.

english: He is the one who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we may be able to help those who are in all kinds of troubles and receive God's help.
lunyoro: nuwe arukutuhumuza omu muhito gwaitu gwona, nukwo tusobole okuhumuza abo abali omu mihito yona, nokuhumura okutuhumuzibwa Ruhanga.

english: In the same way, I am encouraged by your faith and by yours.
lunyoro: nukwo nyowe okuhumuzibwa hamu nainywe itwembi habwokuikiriza okwanyu nokwange.

english: He did not know the chief priests of this world, but knew that they had not crucified the Lord of glory.
lunyoro: igi abana abobusinge bunu batakimanyirehoga: baitu kuba bamanyire tibakubambire ha muti Mukama wekitinisa:

english: And it is not just as we were invited, but first they gave themselves to the Lord, as he pleased.
lunyoro: Kandi tikuli kwonka nka itwe okutwanihire baitu okubanza bakehayo bonka hali Mukama waitu nkokuyagondeze

english: heal the sick who are in prison, and say to them, ‘The Kingdom of God has come near you.’
lunyoro: mukizege abarwaire abanyakuli omu, mubagambirege ngu Obukama bwa Ruhanga bubairire haihi.

english: So they went and brought the sick man to Jesus, and when they had brought him four.
lunyoro: Baija, nibaleta omurwaire azingamire, bamuhimbire bana.

english: But they left because of God, and they were not given anything to the Gentiles.
lunyoro: baitu bakaturuka habwa Ibara, batarukuhabwa ekintu kyona Abamahanga.

english: Do you want to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
lunyoro: orukugonza okunyita nyowe nkokuwaisire ijo Omumisiri?

english: When Jesus went into the house and left the crowd, his disciples asked him about the parable.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahire omu nju, arugire omu kitebe, abegeswabe bamukaguza orufumo oru.

english: But you do not know what will happen tomorrow. What will be the purpose of your life? For you are a light that will show for a little while and then disappear.
lunyoro: baitu timurukumanya ekiribaho ijo. Obwomezi bwanyu kiki? Baitu muli ekiho ekinyakurorwa akacu kake nikihwaho.

english: After Jesus had gone out, he took the bread and had the bread; he ate and talked with them a little while later, and when he came back, he left.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okutemba nokucwa omugati, nokurya, nokubaza nabo ekicu ekikoto, okukisa obuire, yarugayo.

english: When the disciples saw this, they were completely amazed and asked, “How soon must the fig tree be dried up?”
lunyoro: Abegeswabe obubaboine bahuni'ra, nibagamba ngu Omutini gwomere guta bwango?

english: In this way love will be made perfect for us, so that we may have courage on the Judgment Day, and so that we may live in the world as we are.
lunyoro: Dobi numwo okugonza kuhikirizibwa halitwe, tube nobumanzi ha kiro kyomusango, kandi nkokwali naitwe nukwo tuli omu nsi munu.

english: You must not be called ‘Teacher,’ but ‘Leader,’ because your teaching is one.
lunyoro: baitu inywe mutaryetwa Rabi; baitu omwegesa wanyu ali omu,

english: I want you to be sure that this is true, and so I want you to be united in this matter so that those who believe in God may remember to give their minds and hearts to what is good.
lunyoro: Ekigambo kinu kyokwesiga, kandi hali ebi ningonza iwe okugumiza kimu, nukwo abo abaikirize Ruhanga baijukege okutaho emitima ha ngeso enungi. Ebigambo ebi birungi,

english: Jesus asked them, “Whose food do you have?
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati muyina emigati ingaha?

english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
lunyoro: Iguru nensi birihwaho: baitu ebigambo byange tibirihwaho.

english: Pray also for us, that God will make us preach the Good News about the secret of Christ, and so that someone else may be put right with us.
lunyoro: kandi numusabira naitwe, Ruhanga atukungu'raho oruigi orwekigambo, okugamba ekyensita kya kristo, ekindi omunsita:

english: You do not have his message in you, but you do not believe in him whom he sent.
lunyoro: Kandi timunyina ebigambobye ebiikara omulinywe; baitu ogu ouyatumire timurukumuikiriza.

english: as unknown, but we are known by God; as though we were dead, but now we live; as punished we suffer, but not killed we.
lunyoro: nkabo abatarukumanywa, baitu tumanyirwe: nkabanyakufa, baitu dora, twomire; nkababonabonesebwa, baitu tituisirwe;

english: He stayed in Joppa for a long time in the home of Simon the tanner of leather.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika yaikarayo ebiro bingi omu Yopa, omu nju ya Simoni omuhazi wempu.

english: So Alexander was handed over to the crowd, and the Jews seized him. Alexander motioned with his hand and tried to get ready for the people.
lunyoro: Kandi baiha Alegezanda omu kitebe, Abayudaya nibamucumiriza. Kandi Alegezandu yabaculeza nomukono, nayenda okwetonganira hali abantu.

english: Some of them preached Christ to them out of love and compassion, and others also spoke out of his grace.
lunyoro: Abandi nibatebeza Kristo obwihali nokukungana; nabandi nibatebezangana obwembabazi:

english: Jesus said to him, “Go and call your father and come back here.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Genda, oyete baro, ogaruke oije hanu.

english: But get up and go to the city, where you will be told what you must do.”
lunyoro: baitu imuka, otahe omu rubuga, oragambirwa ebikuhikirire okukora.

english: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said to them, “Why are you arguing with one another?
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamanya empaka zabu, yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nimute'ra ki empaka omu mitima yanyu?

english: I want you to know that Christ is the head of every man, but the head of Christ is God.
lunyoro: Kandi ningonza inywe mumanye ngu Kristo nuwe mutwe gwomusaija wena; baitu omutwe ogwa Kristo Ruhanga.

english: He really believed what we were talking about, and because he was very eager to go to you, he sent me.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo akaikiriza okugambi'ra kwaitu; kandi obwakaba anyina okwekamba kwingi, akaimukya okugenda namberemuli;

english: You have good conduct among the Gentiles, and you have turned them away from the evil of your doings, because your good deeds will bring glory to God on the Day of your being saved.
lunyoro: mugenderege kurungi omuli Abamahanga; kandi nobubabageya nkabakozi bobubi, baitu obwengeso zanyu enungi ezibarora, banyumize Ruhanga ha kiro kyokubungirwamu.

english: All these people are dedicated to him because of the gifts they have received. For the person who is faithful in everything he has given them, in order to possess all that he has.
lunyoro: Baitu banu bona mbanagagiremuga hali ebisembo ebibasagirire: baitu ogu omu masegege anagiremu byona ebyanyinabyo, niryo itungorye ryona.

english: As Jesus left that place, the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees began to criticize him bitterly and make fun of him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyarugireyo, abahandiki Nabafalisayo bakabanza okumufunza muno, nokumwohya okugamba ebigambo bingi;

english: The next Sabbath they went up to the city with the crowd to hear the word of God.
lunyoro: Ha Sabiti eyakabiri bakagomera hamu nkorubuga rwona, okuhu'ra ekigambo kya Ruhanga.

english: Take away the old yeast, and be new in your way, just as you are without a yeast. For even Christ died for us,
lunyoro: Muihemu ekitumbisa ekyaira, mufoke ekiihuro ekihyaka, nkokumutalimu ekitumbisasano. Baitu Nokuhingungurwaho kwaitu kukaitwa, nuwe Kristo:

english: We ourselves will be found to be like witnesses against God, because we testify about God that he raised the Messiah from death, if it were not for the dead that they had not been raised to life.
lunyoro: Kandi naitwe tuzokere nkabakaiso abebisuba aba Ruhanga; baitu tukatebeza ebya Ruhanga ngu akahumbura Kristo owatarahumbuire, rundi abafu obubaraba batahumburwa.

english: I know that after I leave, wild animals will come into you, and you will not judge the people.
lunyoro: manyire obundikamara okurugaho, enyamaiswa ezirukuruma rritaha omulinywe ezitalinganyira igana;

english: But if I tell you this, I will not tell you, you will not always reap the harvest of evil, but gather the grapes of evil.
lunyoro: Baitu obumbaragira ekigambo kinu tindukubasima, nti timwesoroza hamu obwebi ebikira oburungi, baitu obwebibi ebikira obubi.

english: After saying this, Jesus went on ahead and went to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okubaza ati yabebembera natemba okugenda Yerusalemu.

english: But you will be punished, and you will be condemned, just as you are, and so you will be condemned.
lunyoro: Baitu omusango ogumucwa, nainywe muligucwerwa: nendengo eyimulengeramu, nainye muligirengerwamu.

english: Jesus answered them, “How hard it is for you people to believe! How long will I be with you? How long will I have to put up with you? Bring him to me!”
lunyoro: Yabagarukamu nagamba ati Inywe abobusinge obutarukuikiriza ndihikya nkaha okuikara nainywe? Ndihikya Nkaha okubagumisiriza? Mumundetere.

english: When he said this, all his enemies were put to shame. The whole crowd rejoiced over all the wonderful things that had happened to him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyagambire ebi abanyanzigwabe bona bakwatwa ensoni: ekitebe kyona kyasemere'rwa ebigambo byona ebyekitinisa ebyakozirwe uwe.

english: So then, language is not an eye for those who believe, but for those who do not believe. It is not for those who do not believe that the message is an eye for those who do not believe.
lunyoro: Nukwo endimi tibuli bwokuro'raho hali abarukuikiriza, baitu hali abtarukuikiriza: baitu okutebeza tikali kokuro'raga hali abatarukiriza.

english: But I know you; if I say that I don't know him, I do not know him as you do, but you know him, and you obey his teaching.
lunyoro: ba ndimumanya; obundaba ningamba nti tindukumumanyandasisana nkainywe, omubihi baitu numumanya, kandi niwe nkwata ekigambokye.

english: So then, it is not God's will that you want or that you want to run away, but God's will that you do.
lunyoro: Nukwo tikiri kyogu anyakwenda, nobwakuba anyakuiruka, baitu kya Ruhanga arukuganyira.

english: Peter spoke up and said to Jesus, “Explain to us this parable.”
lunyoro: Petero yagarukamu namugambira ati otusobo'le orufumo runu.

english: If someone is called, isn't it? Don't be circumcised.
lunyoro: Haroho omuntu ayayeserwe atasazirwe? Aleke okusarwa.

english: And now I tell you, withdraw from these men and do not let them go. If this counsel or this work comes from the people, it will be overthrown.
lunyoro: hati bunu nimbagambira nti Mubarugeho abantu banu, mubaleke: baitu amagezi ganu nomulimo gunu biraba birugire omu bantu, birihwereke'ra:

english: For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see, but they could not, and to hear what you hear, but they could not.
lunyoro: baitu nimbagambira nti Banabi nabakama baingi bakagonza okurora ebimurukurora, tibabibona; nokuhu'ra ebimurukuhura tibabihu'ra.

english: About three hours later his wife went in, and she did not know what had happened.
lunyoro: Kandi esaha nkisatu zihinguireho mukaziwe yatahamu, atamanyire ebyabaireho.

english: But if your brother sins against you because you are not eating, do not let him go through with your food, because you are no longer sad. Do not destroy the one who died for you.
lunyoro: Baitu mugnzi wawe rundi aliba natuntura obwebyokurya, iwe tokyagendera omu kugonza. Otamuhwerekereza nebyokurya byawe ogu Kristo ouyaferire.

english: At that very moment he healed many people of sickness, death, and evil spirits; and he opened their eyes to the blind.
lunyoro: Mu kicu eki akakiza baingi endwara norufu nemizimu emibi; nabafu bamaiso akabaigura amaiso.

english: So the other disciple went over to the tomb and began to wash his face.
lunyoro: Kandi nomwegeswa ogu ondi yahinguraho Petero, yabanza okuhika ha kituro:

english: Jesus said to them, “I am telling you the truth: Moses gave you not the bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yabagambira ati Mali mali nimbagambira nti Tali Musa yabahaire ebyokurya ebyarugire omu iguru; rundi Isenyowe nuwe abaha ebyokulya ebyamananu ebiruga Omu iguru.

english: At once he went back to the king and prayed, “I want a man here in the kitchen, the head of John the Baptist!”
lunyoro: ahonaho yarahuka naija hali omukama, yasaba, nagamba ati Ninyenda ompere bunu bunu bunu omurucuba, omutwe gwa Yahana Omubatizi.

english: As the sailors were about to run away from the ship, they lowered the ship into the sea, trying to carry the anchors from the front of the ship.
lunyoro: Kandi abalimba obubakaba nibagonza okuiruka omu kyombo, bamazire okuta obwato ha nyanja, nibasisana okwenda okunaga ebinyakusibika ha mutwe gwekyombo,

english: I am glad about you, too, because I was not there, so believe, for we are going to him.
lunyoro: Nanyowe mpirirwe habwanyu, baitu nkaba ntaroho, muikirize; baitu tugende namberali.

english: Then the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask Jesus to set them free.
lunyoro: Baitu banyakatagara abakuru nabakuru bakagambi'ra ebitebe okusaba baraba, bahwerekereze Yesu.

english: For this reason the Wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute.’
lunyoro: Amagezi ga Ruhanga nikyo gambire ngu Ndituma nambere bali banabi nabakwenda; abamu hali abo balibaita, balibahiga;

english: The king said to him, “You are a good servant; you are a faithful servant. You have been faithful in few things, and I will leave you. Come and share your king's joy.”
lunyoro: Omukamawe yamugambira Okozire iwe omuiru rubale omurungi; owokwesiga; okaba oli wokwesiga omu bike ndakusigira bingi. Taha mukusemererwa okwomukama wawe.

english: For we have been saved through hope, but not by a hope that is seen. For the hope that is seen is not hope that is seen, but is hope that is seen. For who hopes for what he sees?
lunyoro: Baitu tukajunwa omu kunihira: baitu okunihira okurukurorwa tikuli kunihirwa: baitu kunihiraga okurukuboine tikuli kuti; baitu noha anihira ekyarukurora?

english: So then, if anyone disobeys one of these little ones and teaches others to do the same, he will be put right with God through the Kingdom of heaven; but whoever obeys and teaches others will be called great in the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: nukwo omuntu wena alisisa ekimu ekyomubiragiro binu ebike, nayegesa ati abantu, aryetwa muke mali omu bukama obwomu iguru: kandi wena alibikwata nabyegesa, ogu aryetwa mukuru omu bukAMA obwomu Iguru.

english: The children of your brother's trusted friend welcomed you.
lunyoro: Abana bomugenzi wawe akomerwemu bakuramukize.

english: And I am eager to remain innocent before God and his people at all times.
