english: “Teacher,” they said, “this woman was caught in the very act of committing adultery with her.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Omwegesa, omukazi onu bamukwasire nasihana, bamusangire.

english: But when what is right comes, then what is partial will disappear.”
lunyoro: baitu ebihikirire obubiriija, ebi ebyekicweka birirugaho.

english: I will take you to Babylon.
lunyoro: Kandi ndibatwara enyuma ya Baburoni.

english: But Paul chose Silas and left, leaving the favor of the Lord.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro yokomamu Sira, yarugayo, bene babu obubamazire okumusigira embabazi za Mukama waitu.

english: A certain rich man named Lazarus was buried in the tomb, full of sores.
lunyoro: baitu omulegi omu, ibararye Razaro, bamubyamyaga ha iremborye, aijuire ebihoya,

english: My friends, you know that from the very beginning God chose you to be his witness to the Gentiles to hear the Good News from my own lips and to believe.
lunyoro: Bene baitu, inywe mumanyire ngu okuruga omu biro byaira, Ruhanga akakomamu halinywe, Abamahanga bahu'le omuk kanwa kange ekigambo ekyenjiri, kandi baikirize.

english: The chief priests met together to fight against the Lord and Christ.
lunyoro: Ibara erikuru likarangana ahamu, okurwana na Mukama na Kristowe:

english: God raised him from death, and he gave him the power to die. But we cannot arrest him at all.
lunyoro: Yoowe Ruhanga akamuhumbura obuyabohoroire okuhu'rwa okwokufa: baitu tutasobole kumukwatira kimu.

english: I do not think that I am the least bit inferior to those of the elders in charge of me.
lunyoro: Baitu nintekereza nti timbuzirweho na kake nabakwenda abakuru mali.

english: Everything you do, both in word and in deed, in the name of the Lord Jesus, should be done in order to give thanks to God the Father through him.
lunyoro: Kandi ekimurakakoranga kyona, rundi omu kigambo rundi omulinywe, mubikolege byona omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu, numusima Ruhanga Isitwe omuruwe.

english: Speak evil of one another, and pray for one another, in order that you may be healed. The prayer of a good person and the power of prayer may do it.
lunyoro: Mugambanganege ebyokusisa byanyu inywenka nainywenka, kandi musabiranganege, nukwo mukizibwe. Okusaba kwomuntu ahikirire nokusobora muno omu kukora kwakwo.

english: let your light shine before men, so that they may see how good and how good it is for you to live in heaven with your Father.
lunyoro: Omusana gwaanyu nukwo gwakege guti omu maiso gabantu, barole engeso zanyu ezisemire, nukwo bakugize Isinywe ali omu iguru.

english: Do not be afraid of one another in this matter of persecution, for you know that we are in danger of being killed.
lunyoro: Muleke okutuntuzana omu kusalizibwa kunu; baitu inywe mumanyire ngu nukwo twaterirweho.

english: But now there are many parts, but one body.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu ebicweka bingi, baitu omubiri gumu.

english: John was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came to be baptized.
lunyoro: Kandi Yohana akaba nabatiza omu Enoni haihi na Salimu, baitu nuho hakaba hali amaizi maingi: baija babatizibwa.

english: I preached to the Jews and Gentiles that they should turn from their sins to God and believe in our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: nimbabatebeza Nabayudaya Nabayonani, okwegarukamu hali Ruhanga, nokuikiriza Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo,

english: When he finds it, I tell you, he is happy about it being healed of nine plagues that never happened.
lunyoro: Kandi obwaba agizoire, mananukwo nimbagambira nti agisemere'rwa egi okugikiza ziri ekyenda mu mwenda ezitabuzireho.

english: The traitor had given him a signal: “The man I kiss is the one you want, so arrest him!”
lunyoro: Kandi ogu akaba namugobeza akabaha akokuro'raho, nabagambira ati Oundanywegera, nuwogu; mumukwate.

english: So now there is no condemnation to those who belong to Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Nukwo hati bunu busaho kucwera omusango hali abo abali omu Kristo Yesu.

english: Sell anything you have bought in the market before you buy it.
lunyoro: Kyona ekinyakugurwa omu katale mukirye, mutakaguise kigambo ebwomutima;

english: They were not the ones who had been condemned for forty years; were they not the ones who sinned? Their bodies were thrown into the desert.
lunyoro: Kandi nibaha abayabihirirwe emyaka amakumi ana? tinibo abasisire? emitumbi yabu eyagwire omu irungu?

english: It is written in the Law: ‘I will speak to these people in strange tongues, but they will not listen to me,’ the Lord has said.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu biragiro ngu Omu ndimi ezindi nomu minwa yabandi ndigambira abantu banu; kandi tibalimpu'ra, nukwo Mukama agambire ati.

english: For the one who preaches God's message tells people what to do, what to take care of, what to take care of, and what to take care of.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakutebeza agambira abantu ebyokwombeka nebyokuhumuza nebyokuiruki'ra.

english: When the sun is setting, it finds that the sun is setting, but it does not shine.
lunyoro: Kandi obugumara kuija, gugisanga esingolire, etarumu.

english: Do not look for food that will last; instead, work for the food that will last for eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For God, the Father, has put his mark on you.
lunyoro: Mutakole'ra byakurya ebihwaho, rundi mukole're ebyokurya ebikiikaraho okuhika obwomezi obutahwaho, Omwana womuntu ebyalibaha: baitu Isitwe, nuwe Ruhanga, amutaireho ogu akokuro'raho.

english: But because of your knowledge, the weak one will be destroyed, and the brother of Christ will die.
lunyoro: Baitu obwokumanya kwawe ogu atanyina amani ahwereke'ra, mwene waitu Kristo ouyaferire.

english: I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repent.
lunyoro: Ntaije okweta abahikirire, baitu abasisi okwegarukamu.

english: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti Mugonzege abanyanzigwa banyu, musabirege abanyakubahiga,

english: The child grew and became strong. He was full of wisdom, and God's grace was upon him.
lunyoro: Kandi omwana akakura, yafoka wamani, yaijura amagezi: embabazi za Ruhanga niziikara haruwe.

english: These are the ones who were shown to be not for their own good, but for your own good. They have done what you are now told by the messengers of the Good News, who received the Good News from the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. They are the very things that angels want to see.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo basukulirwe ngu tihali habwabu bonka,baitu habwanyu, bakahereza ebi ebimwagambirwe hati omuli ebo ababatebize enjiri omu Mwoyo Ogurukwera, ayatumirwe naruga omu iguru; nibyo bamaraika barukwegomba okuroramu.

english: Jesus said to them, “Fellow fools and weakhearted people do not believe everything the prophets said.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe abatanyina magezi, abobugara omu mitima okutaikiriza byona banabi ebibagambire!

english: Their destruction will be complete, because God is their dwelling place, and their glory will be in their shame, and they will think about the things that belong to the world.
lunyoro: ihwaho ryabu nibo Ruhanga wabu, nekitinisa kyabu kirir omu nsoni zabu, nibo barukutekereza ebya hansi.

english: He is the means by which the whole universe is made perfect.
lunyoro: ndi mubirigwe, okuhiki'ra kwogu arukuhikiriza byona omu byona.

english: Judah was the father of Perez by Hezron. Hezron was the father of Aram.
lunyoro: Yuda akazara Perezi akazara herezoni; Herezoni akazara Ramu;

english: No one touched me at first, but they all left me. I beg you, then, not to save them.
lunyoro: Omu kwetonganira kwange okwokubanza busaho ayankonyire, baitu bona bakampemukaho: ninsaba baleke okujunwa eki.

english: And now the tree is cut down to the roots of the tree, so that it will be cut down and thrown into the fire, so that every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down.
lunyoro: Na hati bunu ebdyamiti etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire bagutema, bagunaga mu mu'ro.

english: After Jesus left, he said, “Now the Son of Man has been revealed to God and now God has been revealed through him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okuturuka Yesu yagamba ati Hati bunu Omwana womuntu anyumizibwe, na Ruhanga anyumizibwa omuruwe;

english: And since then, God has revealed his message of repentance and forgiveness to all the nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: kandi okwegarukamu nokuihibwaho ebibi btebezebwe omu ibararye hali amahanga gona, okubandiza Yerusalemu.

english: For we know that all creation keeps under control and continues to this very day.
lunyoro: Baitu tumanyire ngu ebihangirwe byona nibisinda nibisasira hamu okuhikya na hati.

english: So then, if the whole church meets together and everyone starts speaking in strange tongues, how can it be that some people who do not believe or who do not believe in the gospel enter the city and say, “You are crazy!”
lunyoro: Nukwo ekanisa yona obweba eso'rokaine hamu, kandi bona nibagamba endimi, kandi abantu abatamanyire, rundi abatarukuikiriza obubaliba nibatahamu, tibaligamba ngu Mugwire iraro?

english: Two blind men sitting on the road heard that Jesus was passing by, and they were shouting, “Son of David! Have mercy on us, Lord!”
lunyoro: Baitu abafu bamaiso babiri abakaba baikalire ha muhanda obubahulire ngu Yesu nahinguraho batokera ha iguru, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu otuganyire, iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: and the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day or night, who worship the beast and its image, and all who believe in the image of the beast are destroyed.
lunyoro: nomuika ogwokubonabonesebwa kwabu nugucuka ebiro nebiro, kunu tibayina okuhumura nyamusana nekiro, abaramya ekisoro nekisisani kyakyo, na bona abaikiriza enkojo yibara ryakyo.

english: You were bought with a price, so that you might do God's work in your bodies.
lunyoro: baitu mukagurwa nomuhendo: nukwo mukugize Ruhanga omu mubiri gwanyu.

english: If they had been in that country, they would have had the chance to go back home.
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba babaire nibaijuka ensi egi nambere barugire, bakubaire nomwanya okugarukayo.

english: There is no one in Zion who will be a great and glorious rock, but whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.
lunyoro: Haho omu Sayuni ibale erikomerwemu, eryomuhendo mwingi: Kandi arukumuikiriza talikwatwa ensoni.

english: When the disciples heard this, they came and took his body and buried it.
lunyoro: Bene babu obubahulire, baija, batwara omutumbigwe, baguta omu kituro.

english: Jesus answered, “I have done one work, and you all are amazed!
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nkakora omulimu gumu, nanywe inywena mwahuni'ra.

english: But the righteousness that is of faith says to you, ‘Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will go down into heaven?’—that is, to bring Christ down from death.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: When the woman saw that she had not been hidden, she came trembling and fell face downward and told everyone what had happened to her, and how she was healed at once.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi obuyaboine okwataserekerwe, yaija natukumira, yainama omu maisoge natebeza omu amaiso gabantu bona ekyamumukolezeho, kandi okuyakizibwe bwango.

english: When Jesus saw the crowd rushing in with him, he said to the evil spirit, “You dumb and deaf spirit! I have told you to come out of the man and never come back to him!”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyaboine ekitebe nikiiruka nikigoma namberali hamu, yacomera omuzimu omubi, nagugambira ati Iwe omuzimu ogutarukugamba, omufu wamatu, nyowe nkuragire omurugeho, otalimugarukira na kake.

english: All who heard it heard him say to themselves, “What kind of child will this child be?” But the Lord's power stayed with him.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ababihulire bakabyeyahu'ra omu mitima yabu, nibagamba ngu Mara, omwana ogu aliba ki? Baitu omukono gwa Mukama gwaikaraga hamu nauwe.

english: And now you know what it is that is happening, so that it may be revealed through the miracles that you are doing.
lunyoro: kandi hati bunu ekirukutanga mukimanyire, nukwo asuku'rwe omu mpikoze.

english: “Teacher,” they answered, “and where do you live?”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Rabi, orara nkaha?

english: They had taken many spears and were kept safe by the jailers.
lunyoro: Obubabatire emiigo nyingi, babacumiriza omu nju yenkomo, nibaragira omulinzi okubalinda muno:

english: That is why I will send the younger widows to me, and they will have children. They will build houses and have no more enemies give them time to speak;
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukwendera abakyali abato baswerwe, bazale abana, baleme enju zabu, baleke okuha omunyanzigwa omwanya ogwokumujuma:

english: Just as a man who left his house and lived in a foreign country gave orders to his servants to do their work for one another, so he told the doorkeeper to keep watch.
lunyoro: nkomuntu ayasigire enjuye,narara omu nsi endi, amazire okuragira abairube rubale, nokubaha emirimu yabu omuomu, naragira omukurmirizi okurora.

english: But others said, “Leave him alone! Let's see if Elijah is coming to save him!”
lunyoro: Baitu abandi bagamba ngu Leka; turole rundi Eriya araija okumujuna.

english: Then he said to them, “Go back to the vineyard, and I will pay you what is right.”
lunyoro: nabagambira ati Nainywe mugende omu rugonjo orwemizabibu, nanyowe ndabahera ekiraseme'ra.

english: When the fourteenth night came, we were driven across the lake at the lakeside of Aduliya, where false people thought that they were about to come near the lake.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro kya ikumi na bina obukyahikire, obutwabingabingirwe honahona omu nyanja ya Aduliya, omu itumbi abalimba bakatekereza ngu bamalize okui'ra haihi nensi;

english: I will come soon, and you must not take anything out of me, so that anyone will take away your coat.
lunyoro: Nkaija bwango: kwatira kimu ekyoyinakyo, omuntu wena aleke okunyaga ekondo yawe.

english: This is what his Son, who was born in the family of David, spoke of as a human being.
lunyoro: nibyo bigambo Byomwanawe ayazairwe omu baijukuru ba Daudi, omu mubiri:

english: if I go to Spain, I hope to see you again and be helped by you there, if at all possible.
lunyoro: obundiba ningenda Sapaniya, (baitu ninihira okubarora obundihinguraho, nokusengekerezebwa inywe okumpikya oku, rundi obundikamara okumbonaho nokubanihaho kake):-

english: And so I want to preach the Good News to you who are in Rome as much as I can.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo ngondeze okutebeza enjiri hali inywe abomu Rumi nkokunsobora.

english: He listened to the crowd, and when his wife recognized him, he took a piece of meat and put it on the apostles' feet.
lunyoro: aizire hali ekitebe, na mukaziwe nauwe akimanyire, yaletaho ekicweka kyagwo, yakita ha bigere byabakwenda.

english: In union with Christ you were made perfect, without the power of human hands, and so full of the power of Christ's will.
lunyoro: Kandi omuruwe mukasarwa nokusara okutakozirwe nemikono,okujura omuntu wena ebyokusara, kandi muijuire ekitinisa ekyomu ngesoze.

english: So then, when the end comes, he will give the Kingdom to God and the Father; when he will have put an end to all power, power, and might.
lunyoro: Nukwo emperor ehika, obwalihayo obukama hali Ruhanga, kandi Isitwe; obwalimaraho okulema kwona, nobusobozi bwona, namani gona.

english: They wanted to take him aboard a boat, so at once the boat reached the coast where they were heading.
lunyoro: bagonza okumutahya omu bwato: ahonaho obwoto bwahika ha musa nambere bakaba nibagenda.

english: Hagar is Mount Sinai, in Arabia, and she is like Jerusalem today, because she is pregnant with her children.
lunyoro: Hagara ogu nurwo rusozo Sinai omu nsi ya Bwarabu,nainganaingana na Yerusalemu orwebiro binu: baitu ali omu buiru hamu nabanabe.

english: They said to him, “We will go with you.” So they went off and got into the boat, but that night they did not catch a thing.
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Naitwe ntugenda naiwe. Bagenda nibagwe'ra omu bwato; kandi ha kiro eki batakwate kintu.

english: God, who gives hope, will fill you with all joy and peace by means of your faith, and you will share in the hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga owokunihira alibaijuza inywe okusemererwa kwona nobusinge bwona omu kuikiriza, inywe musaganege omu kunihira, omu mani Agomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: For this reason we do not work for one another; instead, we work for the living God, who is the Savior of all people and especially of those who believe.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo tuko'ra emirimo ntutalibana, baitu tukanihira Ruhanga omwomezi, nuwe Mujuni wabantu bona, nokukira muno wabo abaikiriza.

english: When they heard this, they were filled with anger and started shouting, “Great is Artemis of Ephesus!”
lunyoro: Obubahulire ebi, baijura ekiniga, batokera haiguru, nibagamba ngu Atemi Wabefeso mukuru.

english: Nor does anyone pour new wine into used wineskins, because the wine will burst the skins, the wine will pour out, and the skins will be ruined; instead, new wine will pour out, and all will be ruined.”
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga enkuru: kiraba kitalikyo, amarwa gahulikya endyanga zakusisikaire, namarwa gaseseka, nendyanga zisisikara; baitu amarwa agakutamu amarwa agarukwaka, byona byomera.

english: Come near to the Lord, and if we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
lunyoro: Nukwo turaba ntuikaraho, rundi obutuliifa, tuliba Mukama waitu.

english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to talk with other languages, just as the Spirit had told them to.
lunyoro: Bona baijura Omwoyo Ogurukwera, nibabanza okubaza engambo ezindi nezindi, Nkomwoyo okuyabahaire okuzigamba.

english: When he arrived in Galilee, the people there welcomed him and saw all the things he had done in Jerusalem for the Passover Festival.
lunyoro: Nukwo obuyaizire Galiraya, Abagaliraya bamutangi'ra obubaboine ebigambo byona ebiyakolire Yerusalemu ha bugenyi: baitu nabo bakagenda ha Bugenyi.

english: But get up and go with them, and do not be afraid; for I have sent them.
lunyoro: Baitu imuka, osirimuke ogende nabo, otarukugurukyagurukya: baitu ninyowe nabatumire.

english: But now you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, and you have the full measure of your blessings and the life to come.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu muhairwe obugabe okuruga omu kibi, kandi mufokere abairu hali Ruhanga, muyina ebyana byanyu hali okwezebwa, nempero bwomezi obutahwaho.

english: You killed the chief of human beings, but God raised him from death. We are witnesses to this.
lunyoro: mwita Omukuru wobwomezi; Ruhanga ouyahumbuire omu bafu: itwe tuli bakaisobe.

english: This is what God has commanded: we believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and we love one another, just as he commanded us.
lunyoro: Kandi kinu nikyo kiragirokye, itwe tuikirize ibara ryomwanawe Yesu Kristo, kandi tugonzanganege, nkauwe okuyatuhaire ekiragiro.

english: I have great joy and am filled with joy because of your love, but the hearts of the holy ones have been refreshed by you, my brother.
lunyoro: Baitu nkabanyina okusemererwa kwingi nokuhumizibwa obwokugonza kwawe, baitu emitima yabarukwera ekahumuzibwa obwawe, mwene waitu.

english: The next day Peter got up and went with them. Some of the believers from Joppa went with him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obubwakire nyenkya Petero akaimuka yagenda hamu nabo, na bene babu abamu, abarugire Yopa, nibagenda nauwe.

english: But they all shouted, “Crucify him! Set Barabbas free for us!”
lunyoro: Baitu bona bakatokera haiguru ngu Omuiheho omuntu onu, otuleke'le Baraba:

english: This was known to all the people in Jerusalem, and the name of the man in their language was Akeldama, which means “Field of Blood.”)
lunyoro: Kigambo eki kikamanyawa hali abo bona abaha Yerusalemu; nomusiri ogu omu rulimi rwabu gwayetwaga Akeridama, nukwo kugamba ngu Omusiri gwesagama.)

english: He got up early and started walking with them in the Temple. He went back home and praised God.
lunyoro: Kandi yaimuka bwango yayeme'ra, yataha nabo omu yekaru, nagenda, nagaruka, nakugiza Ruhanga.

english: Then another one fell on good ground, and he sowed grain, another one hundred grains, and the other sixty, and the other thirty.
lunyoro: ndi yagwa ha itaka erisemire, yayana ebyana, endi kikumi. Endi enkaga, endi amakumi asatu.

english: If your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away! It is much better for you to lose one of your body than to have your whole body thrown into hell.
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwawe ogwoburyo guraba nugukutabaijura, ogutemaho, ogunage hara, baitu nikyo kurukukira oburungi ekicweka kyawe ekimu okubura, omubiri gwawe gwona gutanagwa omu Gehena.

english: So then, listen to the parable of the sower.
lunyoro: Nukwo inywe muhu're orufumo orwomusigi.

english: Jesus said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukujunire; genda nobusinge.

english: He does not look for its good, does not look for its own interests; he does not keep account of the evil and does not keep account of the evil.
lunyoro: Tukisera ebirungi, tikuse'ra ebyakwo kwonka, tikubihirwa, tikutunoba obubi:

english: Out of his mouth comes a sharp sword, which will shake the nations together. He will shake them off, and he will shake them off by the power of the sword. He will shake the bow and the spear into the great anger of Almighty God.
lunyoro: Omu kanwake harugamu empirima yobwogi, agitemese amahanga: kandi alibalemesa amahanga; kandi alibabalemesa omuigo gwekyoma: kandi asamba endeba yamarwa eyekiniga ekingi ekya Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona.

english: He will be great, and he will be called the Son of the Most High God. The Lord God will give him the tribe of David his father.”
lunyoro: Azoba mukuru, kandi aryetwa Omwana wogu anyakuli haiguru muno: kandi Mukama Ruhanga alimuha ekitebe kya Daudi isenkuruwe.

english: The great dragon was thrown down, the ancient serpent, named the Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole world. The dragon and his angels were thrown down to the earth, and they will be thrown down to the earth.
lunyoro: Darakoni enkoto yanagwa, enjoka eyaira, enyakwetwa Diaboro kandi Setani, arukubihabiha ensi zona: yanagwa hansi nabamaraikabe banagwa hamu nauwe.

english: But if a woman has a long hair, she is a glory to God, because her hair has been given to her to be covered with covering.
lunyoro: Baitu omukazi obwaba anyina isoke eriraihire, kiba kitinisakye: baitu isokerye limuhairwe okuba kyokwesweke'ra.

english: But Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said to them, “Why are you trying to trap me? Bring a silver coin, and let me see.” They brought it.
lunyoro: Baitu obuyamanyire obugobya bwabu, yabagambira ati Nimunyoheza ki? Mundetere edinali,ngirole.bagireta.

english: I am telling you the truth: whoever does not enter the sheep pen and climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Ataraba omu irebo ntaha omu isibiko ryentama, baitu atemba ahandi, ogu nuwe musuma nomunyagi.

english: and he will send out his angels with a great trumpet sound, and they will gather together his chosen people from one end of the world to the other.

english: My friends, I have been told about you in Chloe's family that there is a division among you.
lunyoro: Baitu nkamanyisibwa ebyanyu bagenzi bange, abomu nju ya Keroe, ngu haroho empaka omulinywe.

english: For even if we live in the flesh, we do not fight according to our human nature;
lunyoro: Baitu nobuturukugenda omu mubiri, titurukurwana ntukuratira omubiri,

english: Another horse came out, a red one, and he was given the power to take peace away from the earth and to fight against his own people. He was given a large sword.
lunyoro: Harugayo embarasi endi rugaju: nogu akaba aikalireho yahabwa obusobozi okuihaho obusinge ha nsi, baitangane bonka: kandi yahabwa busitama enkoto.

english: The traitor is the one who was kept secret by their deceitful brother Timothy, who came to us in private to take away our freedom in union with Christ Jesus, so that we might be led into error.
lunyoro: baitu habwa bene babu abebisuba abatahibwemu omu nsita, abaizire omulitwe omu nseta okutata obugabe bwaitu obutunyinabwo omu kristo Yesu, nukwo batukwase omu buiru:

english: Through his grace and through the obedience of his own people, he has brought us into being through his faith in all the nations.
lunyoro: niyo yatuheriremu embabazi nobukwenda obwokuhu'ra okurukuruga omu kuikiriza, omuli Amahanga gona habwibararye:

english: Many of those who heard the message believed, and the number of the men was about five thousand.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi hali abo abahulire ekigambo bakaikiriza; omuhendo gwabasaija gukaba guli nkenkumi itano.

english: I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. I order this one, ‘Come!’ and tell my slave, ‘Do this,’ and he will do it.
lunyoro: Baitu na nyowe ndi muntu omulemwa, nyina baserikale abadama: kandi ngambira onu nti Ija; nomuiru wange rubale nti Kora kinu, akikora.

english: But the Son of Man will be condemned more than all the others.”
lunyoro: Baitu abana bogu ayangirwe baingi okukira bogu ali naibi.

english: To be circumcised is not a matter of being circumcised, nor of being circumcised; it is a matter of obeying God's commands.
lunyoro: Okusarwa tukuli kigambo, nokutasarwa tikuli kuzarwa, baitu okukwata ebiragiro bya Ruhanga.

english: For this is how we love God, that we may obey his commands. And his commands are not hard for you.
lunyoro: Baitu kunu nukwo kugonza Ruhanga, itwe tukwate ebiragirobye: kandi ebirobye tibirukulemera.

english: The young man said to him, “I have kept all these things, and where did they come from?”
lunyoro: Omusigazi yamugambira ati Ebi byona nkabihikiriza, kandi ekimbuzireho kiraha?

english: We sailed from there to Philippi, a city of the first district of Macedonia. We lived in that city for a while.
lunyoro: dugayo okuhika Firipi, nurwo rubuga orwa Makedoni, orubandizibwaho omu mbaju ezi; orwayombekerwe Abarumi: twaikara omu rubuga oru ebiro ebimu.

english: If he were to pray to God for the Gentiles who have received the word of God, and what the Scriptures say cannot be shaken out.
lunyoro: Obwaraba yabesere abo abaruhanga abaizirwe ekigambo kya Ruhanga ( kandi Ebyahandikirwe tibisobora okuhwaho)

english: For we have not lived in the past of our human nature, as you know, nor did we live in the age of deceit. God is the witness that we are in the past.
lunyoro: Baitu titukabaga omu kigambo kyokutebora nkokumumanyire, nobukyakuba ekisweke'ra obugobya, Ruhanga nuwe kaiso:

english: Then two men were crucified with him, one on his right and the other on his left.
lunyoro: kandi ahamu nauwe bakabambira ha muti abanyagi babiri; omu ha muronogwe ogwoburyo, nondi ha gwemoso.

english: Then he sent Peter and John with these instructions: “Go and get the Passover meal ready for us to eat.”
lunyoro: Kandi uwe akatuma Petero na Yohana nagamba ati Mugende mututekanirize Okuhingurwaho, turye.

english: Those who drink milk do not know the full meaning of what is right, because they are children.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa amata, tamanyire kurungi ekigambo kyokuhiki'ra; baitu ali mwana muto.

english: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and persecuted us. They are not acceptable to God, and they are enemies to all people.
lunyoro: abaisire Mukama waitu Yesu nabanabi, kandi abatubingire, kunu tibarukusimwa Ruhanga, kandi bali banyanzigwa babantu bona;

english: We had the opportunity to die in our behalf, so that we would not trust ourselves, but God, who raises the dead.
lunyoro: tukatunga okugarukamu okwokufa omu nda yaitu, nukwo tuleke okweyesiga itwenka, baitu Ruhanga arukuhumbura abafu:

english: Paul called to him one of the officials and said, “Take this young man to the commander, because he has something to tell him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yayeta namberali omu hali abanyakihanda, nagamba ati Twara omusigazi onu hali engabwa enkuru: baitu ayina ekyokumutebeza.

english: For I delight in God's law when I am young.
lunyoro: baitu ninsemere'rwa ebiragiro bya Ruhanga omu muntu womunda:

english: So then, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat meat that my brother has left me; I will not go up against him.
lunyoro: Nukwo ebyokurya biraba nibitabaijura mugenzi wange, tindirya enyama ebiro byona, ndeke okutabaijuru mugenzi wange.

english: For whoever obeys his word has been made perfect in union with Christ through Christ. This is how we know that we are in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakukwata ekigambokye buli ahikirizebwe omu Krtisto. Nuho turukumanyira ngu tuli omuruwe:

english: He will receive a hundred times more houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and fields, with persecutions; and in the coming age to come he will receive a hundred times more and will receive a hundred times more.
lunyoro: baitu alihebwa emirundi kikumi omu biro binu ebya hati, enju, ha bene babu, na banyanya, nabanyina, nabana, nobutaka, hamu nokuhiganizibwa; kandi omu businge oburukugenda kuija

english: The Jews stirred up the leading women and the leading men of the city against Paul and Barnabas, and they threw them out of their region.
lunyoro: Baitu Abayudaya bakahere'ra abakazi abekengi ebikitinisa, nabakuru abomu rubuga, bahigana Pauro na Baranaba, bababinga omu mitano yabu.

english: the son of Joseph, the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
lunyoro: owa Perezi, owa Yakobo, owa Isaka, owa Iburahimu, owa Tera, owa Nahora,

english: How terrible for those who suffer from dreaded skin diseases and dreaded skin diseases in those days! For there will be great distress and anguish in this people's hearts.
lunyoro: Ziribabona abaliba nenda, nabanyakwonkya omu biro ebi: baitu haliba hansi omuhito omwingi nekiniga hali abantu banu.

english: Father, I want you to be with me while they are with me. See how great is my glory that you gave me, because you loved me before the world was made.
lunyoro: Isenyowe, abawampaire, ningonza namberendi nabo baikaleyoga nanyowe; barole ekitinisa kyange ekiwampairege: baitu okagonza nyowe ensi etakahangirwe.

english: They hate the gospel because of you, because they love what is good and love what is bad for their ancestors.
lunyoro: Kandi ebyenjiri, bali banyanzigwa habwanyu: baitu ebyokukomwamu, nibagonzebwa habwa baisenkurubo.

english: Whoever says, ‘You know that I don't follow his commands,’ is a liar; and the truth is not in him.
lunyoro: anyakugamba ati mumanyire, kunu takwata ebiragirobye, ogu mubihi, kunu amazima tigali omuruwe.

english: At once Jesus spoke to them and said, “Turn away from your sins. I am he. Don't be afraid!”
lunyoro: Ahonaho Yesu yabaza nabo, nagamba ati Mugarukemu omu mutima; ninyowe onu; mutatina.

english: There is no one who is immoral or does not fear God, just as Esau, who sold his rights as the son, sold his rights as the son; and he ate the food at the proper time.
lunyoro: Kandi hatabaho omusihani wena, rundi atarukutina Ruhanga, nka Esau ayaguzire obugwetwa bwe wenka obwakaihuro ankamu akabyokurya.

english: John answered them all, “I don't need to wash my feet, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
lunyoro: Yohana yagarukamu nabagambira bona ati Mananukwo nyowe, orukoba rwenkaitoze tinsukuseme'ra okuruboho'ra; ogu alibabatiza Nomwyo Ogurukwera nomu'ro:

english: God chose the weak things of the world to be ashamed of them, and he chose the weak things of the world, the glory of the heavenly bodies, and of the heavenly bodies, so that he might bring to nothing the living.
lunyoro: kandi ebyobugara ebyensi Ruhanga akabikomamu, akwase ensoni ebyamani: kandi nebitali byekitinisa ebyensiya nebigayibwa Ruhanga akabikwataho, kandi nebitaroho, nukwo aburanganize ebiroho:

english: You have commanded these things, so that no one will be condemned.
lunyoro: kandi nebi obaragire, baleke okubaho ekyokuhanwa.

english: preach the message, proclaim it at the right time, and teach it at the right time. Teach and teach with all patience and patience.
lunyoro: otebezege ekigambo: ogambi'lege omu biro ebisemeriremu nebitasemeriremu; otere'lege, ohanege, oyesengerezege omu kugumisiriza kwona nokwegesa:

english: Be on your guard! Look! I have told you everything that happened before it happened.
lunyoro: Baitu mwerindege inywe: dora, mbagambire byona bitakabaireho.

english: As soon as they saw him, they did not see him any more, but only Jesus with them.
lunyoro: Obubahindukire bwango okurora, tibabona muntu kandi, rundi Yesu wenka hamu nabo.

english: But those who lived in Jerusalem and their leaders did not know this man or that the angels of the prophets had been read every Sabbath, so they judged him.
lunyoro: baitu abo abaikara Yerusalemu, nabalemi babu, obwokutamanya ogu nobugakuba amaraika ga banabi agasomwa Sabiti zona, nikyo bagahikiririze obubamucwerire omusango.

english: Men of Athens, I see that in all circumstances you are very religious.
lunyoro: Inywe abasaija Abasene, mboine omu byona numutina muno abacwezi.

english: He was the Son of Man, who was willing to suffer the punishments of the Evil One.
lunyoro: kandi nobwakaba ali Omwana akegera okworoba omwebi ebiyabonabonesibwe:

english: This secret is of great value, because I speak about Christ and the church.
lunyoro: Ekyensita kinu kikoto mali: baitu ningamba ha Kristo nekanisa.

english: When the seeds sprout, they sprout and bear fruit, because the harvest is ready to complete.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyana obubyera, ahonaho aleta orugeso, baitu okugesa kuhikire.

english: We have learned to endure, who are eager to hold firmly to the hope that God has placed before us.
lunyoro: nitwehabura okugumisiriza, itwe abakwasire okukwatira kimu okunihira okututairweho omu maiso gaitu;

english: I baptized with Stephen's house, but I did not know whether I had baptized anyone else.
lunyoro: Nabatiza nenju ya Sitefano: kandi timanyire rundi nkabatiza omuntu wena ondi.

english: For Christ is real in me, so that no one in all the world will keep me from boasting about my glory.
lunyoro: Nkamazima ga Kristo okugali omuli nyowe, omuntu wena atalintanga okwenyumiza kwange kunu omu nsi zona eza Akaya.

english: But the army officer heard the commander and the commander more than Paul said.
lunyoro: Baitu omunyakihanda yahu'ra omugoyi nomukama wekyombo okukira Pauro ebiyagambire.

english: For God is my witness, and he knows that I love you very much in the Kingdom of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga niwe kaiso wange, amanyire okundikubagonza muno omu kuganja kwa Kristo Yesu.

english: I am John, your brother, and my brother and partner with you in the sufferings of the Kingdom and in the persecutions which come with you on the island of Patmos for the testimony of God and of Jesus.
lunyoro: nyowe Yohana, nwene wanyu, kandi aterana nainywe omu muhito, nobukama, nokuguisiriza, nkabandi omu izinga eryetwa Patimo, obwekambo kya Ruhanga nobwokumanyisa Yesu.

english: He revealed the secret of all the evil things that he wanted, just as he had promised, as he had promised in his Son.
lunyoro: obuyatumanyisize ensita zebi ebiyagondeze, nkokuyasimire wenka, - nkokuyamalirire ira omuruwe, -

english: In the same way, we are truthful and speak well of God, as well as highly respected and respected.
lunyoro: nukwo tube bamazima, abahirwe kurungi, abokwesiga, abarukusimwa;

english: But he denied it in front of them all, saying, “I don't know what you are talking about.”
lunyoro: baitu akehakana omu maiso ga bona,nagamba ati Ekyogambire tinkimanyire.

english: But God, who is rich in mercy, who loves us so much that he gave his great love for us.
lunyoro: baitu Ruhanga anyakuli owobuguda omu mbabazi, obwokugonzakwe kwingi okuyatugondeze itwe,

english: For we have not lived in a way that is hidden from him; we do not live in error or in a way that brings God's message to nothing. Instead, we live in a way that brings us into the light of truth and makes us pure in the sight of God.
lunyoro: baitu tukafuruka ebyensoni ebiserekerwe, kunu titurukugendera omu bugobya, nobukwakuba okuhabisa ekigambo kya Ruhanga; baitu obwokwoleka amazima, ntwesimisa intwenka hali emitima yona eyabantu omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: Go quickly and tell his disciples that he has been raised from death, and now he is going ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see him, and now I have told you.”
lunyoro: Genda bwango, mutebeze abegeswabe ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu; kandi dora, nabebembera okugeda Galiraya; nuho mulimuro'ra: dora mbagambire.

english: In all humility and obedience, a woman learns to obey God's commands.
lunyoro: Omukazi ayegege omu buculezi nomu kuhu'ra kwona.

english: But Jesus said, “Someone touched me, but I could not heal him.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yagamba ati Omuntu ankozireho: baitu mpulirege amani nigandugamu.

english: The crowd was sitting around Jesus, and they said to him, “Look, your mother and your brothers are outside looking for you.”
lunyoro: ekitebe kikaba kiikalire bamwehingulirize;bamugambira ngu Dora, nyoko na bene banyu bali aheru, nibakuse'ra.

english: We went aboard and arrived at a place called the Good News about Jesus, which is far away in the city of Lasea.
lunyoro: kandi obutwahinguireyo namani twahika omu kiikaro ekimu, ekyetwa Emyogo Emirungi, ekiherire orubuga Rasaya.

english: I came from the Father, and I am coming into the world. And the world hates me, because I am going to the Father.
lunyoro: Nkaruga hali Isenyowe, ninyija omu nsi. Kandi ensi ningirugamu, ningenda hali Isitwe.

english: I beg you, then, to give up the gift that God has given you, because my hands have been placed on you.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukukuijikiza okucumamu ekisembo ekya Ruhanga ekiri omuliwe obwokutebwaho emikono yange.

english: These are the rules which apply only to bodily matters, eating, drinking, and the like. These are the rules which apply to the new age.
lunyoro: nibiragiro ebiragirwa ebiragano byonka ebyomubiri kwonka, (hamu nezokurya, nezokunywa, nebyokwegesa okwemiringo nyingi) ebiriho okuhikya ebiro ebyokusemerezamu obuhyaka.

english: Jesus said to them a third time, “I know that you have done this man's crime. I do not know where he is going, so I will punish him and let him go.”
lunyoro: Kale yabagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuruwe orugendakwe runu; nikyo ndamute'ra, 'mulekere.

english: and the seven had no children. Last of all, the woman died also.
lunyoro: kandi bona omusanju batasigeho bana. Hanyuma bona bahoireho, nomukazi yafa.

english: But Jesus said, “How happy are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ati Okukira, banyina omugisa abarukuhu'ra ekigambo kya Ruhanga nibakikwata.

english: He saved him out of all his troubles and gave him wisdom and knowledge in the presence of the king of Egypt, who made him governor over Egypt and all his family.
lunyoro: yamujuna omu bujunebwe bwona, yamuha okuganja namagezi omu maiso ga Faraho, omuka wa Misiri; yamufora omulemi omu Misiri nomunjuye yona.

english: The apostles and the rest of them were all witnesses to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and so were all the others.
lunyoro: Kandi namani maingi abakwenda bakatebeza, bali bakaiso bokuhumbuka kwa Mukama waitu Yesu: nembabazi nyingi zaikaraga halibo bona.

english: They were looking for Jesus and said to one another, “What do you think? He will not come to the festival?”
lunyoro: Kandi base'ra Yesu nibagambiragana, bemerire omu yekaru ngu Nimutekereza muta? Tarukuija ha bugenyi?

english: If the stars fall from heaven, and the powers in heaven are destroyed.
lunyoro: nyunyuzi ziriba nizigwa okuruga omu iguru, nobusobozi obunyakuli haiguru bulitengesebwa.

english: May peace be with all of you who are in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Obusinge bube halinywe inywena abali omu Kristo.

english: He went into the synagogue with the Jews and the Gentiles, and the Council and all those who were with him.
lunyoro: Kandi yahakana omu iso'rokaniro hamu Nabayudaya nabantu abekengi, kandi nomu katale hamu nabo abamuitiraine.

english: My Father is praised in this way, so that you will have many children, and you will be my disciples.
lunyoro: Ha kinu Isenyowe anyumizibwa, inywe mwane ebyana bingi: kandi muliba begeswa bange.

english: They have given their lives for my sake, not for my own sake, but for the whole church of Gentiles.
lunyoro: abahaireyo ebikya byabu habwobwomezi bwange: abo tali nyowe nyenka mbasimire, rundi nekanisa zona eza Bamahanga:

english: Mary stayed with him for three months, and she turned back to them.
lunyoro: Kandi Maryamu akaikara nauwe amezi asatu, yagarukayo owabu.

english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for I have nothing to boast about, but whether I preach the Good News, or whether I preach it.
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nintebeza enjiri, tinyina kyokwenyumiza nyenka; baitu okuhambirizibwa kundi nyowe: baitu zirimbona obumpikiririza enjiri.

english: For I tell you, anyone who sins against another Christian will be put to death; and whoever says to his brother, ‘Fellow down and let me go,’ must be thrown into the fire of hell.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nimbagagambira nti Omuntu wena anyakubihi'rwa mwene wabu, aligwe'rwaho omusango; nauwe anyakugambira mwene wabu ati Mugwagwa, buli amalize kunagwa omu Gehena eyomu'ro.

english: When Jesus saw him, he was moved with pity for him, and for the Jews who were with him, and for the Gentiles who were weeping.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamuboine natera empamo, Nabayudaya abaizire nauwe nibatera enaku, yasinda omu mutima nayunyura,

english: We hope that when your faith grows, we will be proud of you, just as we were about to buy and pass by.
lunyoro: kunihira ngu okuikiriza kwanyu obukulikanya, itwe tulinyumizibwa omulinywe nkomutano gwaitu okuguli nokuhingurana,

english: The evil spirit answered, “You know Jesus, and you know Paul, but who are you?”
lunyoro: Kandi omuzimu omubi gwagarukamu nugubagambira ngu Yesu mumumanyire, na Pauro mumanyire, baitu inywe muli boha?

english: I must go on my own journey today and tomorrow and tomorrow, because the prophet will not be able to go out of Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu kimpikirire okwegendera nyenka hati na nyenkya na ijweri: baitu tikisoboka nabi okuhwereke'ra aheru ya Yerusalemu.

english: The scripture says, “Is this true?”
lunyoro: Kandi birahiki'ra bita ebyahandikirwe ngu Kisemire okuba kiti?

english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of an uncircumcised city. Please let me speak to the people.”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya, owa Taruso orwa Kirikiya, owomu rubuga orutali rwokugayibwa: kandi nkwesengerize leka ngambire abantu.

english: For if the message given to the angels had proved true, and the punishment for sin and disobedience would have been given to them, they would have received a just reward.
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo ekyagambirwe bamaraika obukiraba kyagumireho, kandi nekyokusisa kyona nobutahu'ra bwona biraba byahairwe empera yoburyo;

english: “Why did you ask me? Didn't you know that I must remain in the Father's word?”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Mukanseru'ra ki? Mutamanye ngu kimpikirire okuikara omu bigambo bya Isenyowe?

english: The Lord said, “Who is this faithful and wise servant? He will leave his master and his family in charge of the house and give them their food at the proper time.
lunyoro: Mukama waitu yagamba ati Araha ogu omuketo owokwesiga owamagezi, omukama we owalisigira abomu njuye, okubaha ebyokurya byabu omu kasumi kabu?

english: The third part of the creatures which were in the sea, which are alive, died, and the third part of the ship was destroyed.
lunyoro: kandi ekicweka ekyakasatu kyebinyakuhangirwe ebiri omu nyanja, ebiyina obwomezi, kyafa; nekicweka ekyalingani ekyekyombo kyahwerekerezebwa.

english: You are the children of your father, the Devil, and you want to obey your father's desires. From the very beginning he was a murderer. He did not stay in the darkness, but in the light of truth in union with Christ. If he does what is evil, he speaks evil of his own body, but he is the father of the lie.
lunyoro: Inywe muli ba isinywe Setani, kandi numugonza okukora okwegomba kwa isnywe,Ogu okuruga kara na kara akabali muisi; takaikaraha omu muirima, baitu amananu busamu omuruwe. Obwabiha ebisuba buli agamba ebye, baitu ogu mubihi.

english: Jesus loved Martha, his sister, and Lazarus.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akagonza Maliza nomanyina na Razaro.

english: The next day the horsemen returned to the fort.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obuwakire nyenkya baleka abahambarasi okugenda nauwe bo bagarukayo omu rukomero:

english: And so I tell you that the Law that God made four hundred and thirty years ago did not allow to break the covenant or break it.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndukugamba nti Ekiragano Ruhanga ekiyagumize kara, ebiragiro ebyakurutire emyaka bikumi bina mwasatu ehinguireho, tibikiihaho amani, nobukwakuba okuburanganiza omurago.

english: If I want to be with you, then I will be with you in prison for the Good News.
lunyoro: kandi nyowe oumbaire ningonza aikale nanyowe, ampereze omu kiikaro kyawe omu nsengo zenjiri:

english: He who speaks on his own authority is truthful, but he who wants to honor the one who sent him is truthful, and there is no difference between him and him.
lunyoro: Arukugamba omu magezige wenka:baitu anyakuse'ra ekirinisa kyogu ayamutumire, nuwe wa mananu, kandi obutahiki'ra busamu omuruwe.

english: At that very moment some Pharisees came to him and said, “You must get out of here and go somewhere else, because Herod wants to kill you.”
lunyoro: Omu kasumi ako nubwo baizire Abafalisayo abamu, nibamugambira ngu Ruga hanu oyegendere: baitu Herode nase'ra okukuita.

english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near that carriage and join me in that carriage.”
lunyoro: Omwoyo yagambira Firipo ati I'ra haihi, oterane negali egi.

english: They stood up in fear of his punishment, and said, “How terrible for that great city Babylon! In just one hour you will be punished!”
lunyoro: batukumira obwokutina okubonabonesebwakwe, nibagamba ngu Ziruboine, Baburoni orubuga rwamani! baitu omu saha emu okucwerwa omusango kwawe kuhikire.

english: The tempter came to him and said, “If you are the Son of God, order these stones to turn into bread.”
lunyoro: Omwohi yaija yamugambira ati Obworaboli Mwana wa Ruhanga, gambira amabale ganu gafoke ebyokurya.

lunyoro: Guwe kimuhikirire okukura, baitu nyowe okufoka omuto.

english: The servant answered, ‘Sir, I have kept this whole year from being in prison until I could pay you back my debt.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Mukama wange, guleke nomwaka gunu, obundikahikya okugwombera nokugulimamu obusa:

english: I do not call you ‘ brothers,’ because my slave man does not know what his master is doing. Instead, I call you friends, because I have told you all that I have heard from my Father.
lunyoro: Tinkyeta bagenzi baitu omuiru rubale tamanya mukamawe ebyakora. Baitu mbesere enganjani; baitu byona ebinahulire hali Isenyowe, mbibagambire inywe.

english: They recognized him, who was sitting on the highest point of the Temple, and they were completely amazed and marveled at what had happened to him.
lunyoro: bamumanyi'ra nuwe ogu ayaikara'raga ha ruigi Orurungi orwa yekaru okulega, kandi baijura okuhuni'ra nokutangara obweki ekyamubaireho.

english: He is speaking like a human being, wearing a robe that is on his feet and wearing a gold ring on his chest.
lunyoro: nabaza omu arukusisana nkomwana womuntu, ajwaire okuhikya ebigere, kandi ayetegere ha kifuba nomweko gwa zabu.

english: For if what is done away is done away with, what remains is done away with.
lunyoro: Baitu ekinyakuhwaho obukiraba kiri ekitahwaho kiba kyekitnisa.

english: Simon himself believed, and after he had been baptized, he stayed with Philip. Seeing the miracles and great miracles were performed, he was amazed.
lunyoro: Simon nauwe yaikirizaa: obuyamazire okubatizibwa yaikara hamu na Firipo; kandi obuyaboine obwokuro'raho nebyamahano ebikuru bikozirwe, yatangara.

english: I would like that men everywhere should pray and reach out for God's holy will, so that there will be no disorder and every kind of argument.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukugondeza nti abasaija basabege omu biikaro byona, nibaimukya emikono erukwera, hataroho okubihirwa nokutera empaka.

english: For our sake, who are judged to be right, we are believers in the one who raised Jesus our Lord from death.
lunyoro: baitu habwaitu naitwe, abalitekerezebwaho okuhiki'ra, itwe abarukukuikiriza ogu ayahumbuire Yesu Mukama waitu omu bafu,

english: Jesus asked them, “What is your faith? The people were amazed and said to one another, “Who is this man? He commands the winds and the waves to obey him!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Okuikiriza kwanyu kuraha? Batina nibahuni'ra bagambirangana bonka ngu Mara ogu noha, baitu aragira nomuyaga namaizi, bimuhu'ra?

english: All the people judged him worthy of death.
lunyoro: Ibo bona bamucwera omusango ngu asemerire okufa.

english: Jesus knew that the Father had given him everything in His hands. He said that he was from God and was going to God.
lunyoro: Yesu obuyamanyire Ise amuhaire byona omu Mikonoye, kandi ngu akaruga hali Ruhanga, kandi nagenda hali Ruhanaga

english: The scripture came true: “Abraham believed God, and God accepted him as righteous, and his name was called ‘God's friend.’
lunyoro: Kandi ekyahandikirwe kikahiki'ra ekirukugamba ngu Kandi Iburahimu akaikiriza Ruhanga, kandi kukamutekerezebwaho okuba okuhiki'rakwe, kandi aketwa enganjani ya Ruhanga.

english: They could not find any way to arrest Jesus in front of the crowd, so they threw him out of the Temple and threw him out of the public square. They raised him up in front of Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubataraboine mwanya ogwokumurabyamu obwekitebe ekingi, batemba ha ruguru yenju, bamurabya omu byase, bamusirimukiza ha kitabu hagati yabu omu maiso ga Yesu.

english: Immediately after Jesus was baptized, he came down from the water. Suddenly heaven opened his eyes. He saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and lighting on him.
lunyoro: Kandi yesu, obuyamazire kubatizibwa, ahonaho yaruga omu maizi, dora, iguru likamwesuku'ra, yarora Omwoyo gwa Ruhanga nugusirimuka nkeriba, nugutaha haruwe;

english: Who will be judged? Christ Jesus died, yes, and even more, and was raised to life at the right side of God, who has given himself to us, and has prepared for us.
lunyoro: ha alicwa omusango? Kristo Yesu nuwe yafire, ego nokukira, akahumburwa omu bafur, anyakuliha mukono ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga, kandi natutonganira.

english: Jesus said to the man who was teaching in the Temple, “You know where I came from, and I did not come on my own authority, but he who sent me is truthful, and you do not know him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagambira haiguiru omu yekaru nayegesa, nagamba ati Nyowe mu'manyire, kandi mumanyire nambere narugire: nanyowe ntaije habwange nyenka, baitu ogu ayantumire nuwe wa mananu, oumutamanyire inywe.

english: I write these things to you because of those who want to deceive you.
lunyoro: Ebi mbibahandikire habwabo abarukugonza okubahabisa.

english: When you read this letter, you will read it also in the church in Laodicea. And so you will read it also, which comes from Laodicea.
lunyoro: Ebaruha enu obwerikamara okusomwa omulinywe, kandi mugisomese nomu kanisa eyabaraodikiya. Kandi nainywe musome egi eriruga omu raodikiya..

english: Why, then, do you not judge for yourselves what is right?
lunyoro: Kandi kiki ekibatangire inywenka okucwa eyoburyo?

english: But many who had deceived him rejected him, and their stories did not agree.
lunyoro: baingi abamuhambirize ebyebisuba, kandi okuhambiriza kwabu kukaba kutalikumu.

english: “My son is sick, but he is suffering terribly, because he is in great pain. Many tears have been poured out in the fire, and many tears have been poured out in the water.”
lunyoro: Omwana wange abyamire; baitu agwa ensimbo, zimucanza muno: baitu enkanjaiga enyingi agwa omu mu'ro, kandi emirundi nyingi agwa omu maizi.

english: The city gate had twelve gates, and there were twelve gates in it, in which the twelve apostles of the Lamb were gathered.
lunyoro: na muhuruzi yorubuga ekaba eyina emiganda ikumi naibiri, kandi haroho amalembo ikumi nabiri, agabakwenda ikumi nababiri Abomwana Gwentama.

english: He made a covenant with Abraham. Abraham was the father of Isaac, and on the eighth day Isaac was the father of Jacob, and Jacob was the father of twelve sons.
lunyoro: kandi akamuha ekiragano ekyokusara: kandi Iburahimu yazara Isaka, yamusara ha kiro ekyomunana, na Isaka akazara Yakobo, na Yakobo akazara abana ikumi nababiri.

english: Then Peter went down to the men and said, “Look, I am the one you are looking for! Why have you come?”
lunyoro: Petero yasirimuk hali abasaija, yabagambira ati Dora, ninyowe onu oumurukuse'ra: kiki ekibalesere?

english: And now we have the courage to ask him for anything he wants from us.
lunyoro: Kandi bunu nubwo bumanzi obutunyina namberali ngu obutusaba ekintu kyona nkokwagonza,

english: In this way the blessing of Abraham reached the nations through Christ Jesus, and we are the ones who are promised by the Spirit through faith.
lunyoro: nukwo omugisa gwa Iburahimu guhike hali Abamahanga omu Kristo Yesu, naitwe tuhabwe omurago Ogwomwoyo obwokuikiriza.

english: Those who believe in him have no proof that he is the God of truth.
lunyoro: Anyakuikirize ebigambobye, buli ataireho akokuro'rahoke ngu Ruhanga wa Mananu.

english: And God raised the Lord from death, and he will raise us from death.
lunyoro: kandi Ruhanga akahumbura Mukama waitu, kandi alihumbura naitwe omu manige.

english: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Peace be with you!” They came at once and took hold of his feet and worshiped him.
lunyoro: Ahonaho Yesu yabaitirana, nagamba ati Mirembe! Baija bamukwata ebigere, nibamuramya.

english: They brought the lame man to Jesus and were happy.
lunyoro: kandi baleta omwojo ayomire, basemererwa muno.

english: In the same way, God bless those who believe, together with Abraham, who through faith believed.
lunyoro: Nukwo nabokkuikiriza bahairwe omugisa hamu na Iburahimu owokuikiriza.

english: Pilate asked him again, “Aren't you sure? Look at two things they are accusing you of!”
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato yagaruka okumukaguza ati Torukwanukuea na Kigambo? Dora ebigambo okubiri ebingi ebibarukukuhambiriza.

english: The men who had been crucified with Jesus also made fun of him.
lunyoro: Kandi abanyagi abakaba babambirwe nauwe ha miti, nabo nukwo bamujumire bati.

english: But there was no one else who was willing to join them, because the people were boasting about them.
lunyoro: Baitu hali abandi busaho nomu ayagumire okuterana nabo: baitu abantu bakabanyumiza;

english: Tell them, then, that the tomb was kept for a day until the third day his disciples could not go and steal him. Then they told the people, “He has been raised from death, and the last one is worse than the first!”
lunyoro: Nukwo oragire balindire kimu ekituro, okuhika ha kiro ekyakasatu, abegeswabe, rundi baleke kuija okumuiba, nibagambira abantu ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu: kandi omuhaba okwenyuma kulikira obubi okwokubanza.

english: The soldiers came and began to salute Jesus, the one who had been crucified with him.
lunyoro: Baserikale baija, babandiza hali omu nibamuhenda amaguru, nondi ayabambirwe nauwe:

english: Jesus said to him, “Salvation has now come to this house, for it is the Son of Abraham.
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Hati okujunwa nubwo kuizire omu nju enu, baitu nauwe mwana wa Iburahimu.

english: It would have been better for the people who troubled you to separate themselves from others.
lunyoro: Kikaba kiri kirungi abo abatuntuza inywe bahukanemu bonka.

english: When the disciples saw him walking on the water, they were terrified and said, “It is a ghost!” He was afraid.
lunyoro: Abegeswa obubamuboine nage ndera ha nyanja, batuntura, nibagamba ngu Muzimu! Byanuza obwokutina.

english: You, too, must be poured out into the Holy One's presence, and you will know everything.
lunyoro: Nainywe muyina okuseswaho amagita hali ogu arukwera, kandi mumanyire byona.

english: But if we have food and clothes, that will be enough for us.”
lunyoro: baitu obutunyina ebyokurya nebyokujwara, ebi bitumale.

english: Jesus said to her, “Don't touch me, for I have not yet gone to heaven to my Father. But go to my brothers and tell them that I am going to the Father, and your Father, and God, and your God.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Otankwataho; baitu tinkatembere omu iguru hali Isenyowe: baitu genda hali bene baitu obagambire ngu Nintamba omu igara hali Isinye kandi Isinywe, hali Ruhanga wange kandi Ruhanga wanyu.

english: Jesus answered the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees, “Does the Law allow healing on the Sabbath or not?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagambira abebiragiro Nabafalisayo ati Kyebiragiro okukiza ha Sabiti nandiki tikirikyo?

english: When Peter arrived, he went with them. They took him to a room in the upstairs, where all the widows were weeping and showing him the clothes and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was with them.
lunyoro: Petero yaimuka yagenda nabo. Kandi obuyahikire, bamutwara omu kisika ekya haiguru; nabafakati bona bakaba bemerire haihi nauwe, niba'ra niboleka ebyesomeko nebyokujwara Dolika ebiyakozire, obwakaba ali nabo.

english: They grabbed him, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
lunyoro: Bamukwata, bamuita, bamubinga omu rugonjo orwemizabibu.

english: Jesus went and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish did the same.
lunyoro: Yesu yaija, yakwata omugati, yabaha, nencu ati.

english: And I hope in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
lunyoro: kandi ninihira omu Mukama waitu nti nanyowe nyenka ndiija mpora.

english: Again they shouted, “Crucify him!”
lunyoro: Baitu yagaruka okutoka muno ati Mubambe ha muti.

english: Jesus said to the Roman army officer, “You will go; as you wish, that is what happened to you.” At that very moment the servant got well.
lunyoro: Yesu yagambira omunyoro owekihanda Omurumi ati Irokogende: nkokwoikireze, nukwo kibe kiti namberoli. Omuiru akakira omu kasumi ako.

english: Nor do you think that it would be better for you to die for the sake of the people, so that no one should be destroyed by the whole nation.
lunyoro: kandi timurukutekereza ngu Kibasemerire omuntu omu afe habwa bant, ihanga ryona lireke okuhwereke'ra.

english: For the wisdom that comes from above is first of all pure, then peaceful, gentle, and humble, full of compassion and good qualities, without any distinction or hypocrisy.
lunyoro: Baitu amagezi aganyakuruga haiguru, okubanza gaba agasemire, kandi agobusinge, amaculezi, agarahuka okwesengerezebwa, agaijuire okuganyira nebyana ebisemire, agatanyina okubaganizibwamu nobukwenda.

english: Matthew, Thomas, James the father of Alphaeus, and Simon, who was called the Patriot,
lunyoro: Matayo na Tomasi, na Yakobo owa Alifayo, na Simoni ayayetwaga Zerote,

english: The commander came near, arrested Jesus, and ordered him to be bound with two chains. “Who is this man, and what has he done?” he asked.
lunyoro: engabwa enkuru yai'ra haihi, yamukwata, naragira okumutamu enjegere ibiri, nakaguza ati Noha, kandi ekyakozire kiki?

english: It was said to him, ‘Your mother and your brothers are standing outside looking for you.’
lunyoro: Kyamugambirwa ngu Nyoko nabagenzi bawe bemerire aheru, nibase'ra okukurora.

english: All of us are saved and come off victorious in this world's evil evil and godless desires, so that we may live in the world now, in order to be safe and sound in the fear of God.
lunyoro: abantu bonajunwe, niziugmbi'ra okwanga obutatina Ruhanga nokwegomba okwomunsi, nukwo tube bomezi mubusinge bwa hati bunu mukwerinda nokuhiki'ra nokutina Ruhnaga;

english: and cried out in a loud voice: “The Lamb who was killed has been worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, and honor.
lunyoro: kandi nibagamba niraka erihango ngu Omwana Gwentama ayaisirwe asemerire okuhabwa obusobozi, nobuguda, namagezi, namani, nokutinwa, nekitinisa, nokusimwa.

english: For God said, "Out of darkness the light will shine, and he has shone on our hearts to bring the light of the glory of God in the presence of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nuwe yagambire ati Omusana gulijwa omu muirima, kandi nuwe yajwire omu mitima yaitu, okuleta omusana owokumnaya ekitinisa kya Ruhanga omu maiso ga Yesu Kristo.

english: There is no one in heaven or on earth or on earth who has the power to open the scroll or to keep it open.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omu iguru, nobuhokuba hansi yensi, ayasoboire okusuku'ra ekitabu nobukwakuba okukiroraho.

english: and you will have joy and gladness, and many will be happy to be born again.
lunyoro: Kandi iwe olitunga okusemererwa nokuhi'ra; kandi baingi abalisemere'rwa okuzarwakwe.

english: God is faithful, who has called you into fellowship with his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
lunyoro: Ruhanga wokwesiga, ayabeseze okutaha omu kuterana Okwomwanawe Yesu Kristo Mukama waitu.

english: For we, the Spirit, wait for God to give us the faith that is eager to obey.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe Obwomwoyo ntutegereze omu kuikiriza okunihira okuhu'ra.

english: I have given you milk, not bread; you have not been able to do it, and no longer have you.
lunyoro: Nkabanywisa amata, kunu tibiribyokurya: baitu mukaba mutasoboire: na hati hona timurukusobora:

english: So then, you are no longer foreigners and foreigners, but are members of the same holy nation and of God's chosen people.
lunyoro: Nukwo timukyali banyaihanga nabahinguzi, baitu muli boruganda rumu babarukwera, kandi muli bomungu ya Ruhanga,

english: For while we were with you, we told you beforehand that we will be persecuted; and that is exactly what you know.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo obutukaba tuli hamu nainywe, tukabatebeza kara ngu ntugende okusalizibwa; kandi nukwo kihikirire kiti nkokumumanyire.

english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, blessed is you! Not even flesh and blood can reveal this, but my Father in heaven.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Oyina omugisa Simono Wayona, baitu omubiri nesagama tibikusukulire eki, rundi Isenyowe ali omu iguru.

english: “My grace is enough,” I said. “My power is being made perfect in weakness. And so I will be glad, then, to boast about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may be with me.
lunyoro: Kandi yangambira ati Embabazi zange nizikumara: baitu amani gange nigahiki'ra omu bagara. Nukwo nokusemererwa kwingi ndayenyumiriza ebyobugara bwange, amani ga Kristo gaikale hali nyowe.

english: For we have heard that some men who went out from us have troubled you with words and brought you back to your senses.
lunyoro: baitu tuhulire ngu abantu abarugire omulitwe bakabatuntuza nebigambo, nibaga'ra enyuma emitima yanyu;

english: For the overseer must be a source of encouragement to you, just as God is a source of encouragement. He is not slow, slow, and stubborn; he does not lie to the wine but does not lie to the wine.
lunyoro: baitu omurolerezi kimuhikirire kubataho ekyokuhanwa, nkomukeeto wa Ruhanga; atali wobwereme, atali wekiniga, atarukukunganira ha marwa, atatera atali mwegombi wamagoba,

english: He will change the body of our ancestors and make it like the body of his glorious Servant, in order to bring us all under his authority.
lunyoro: Ogu alihindura omubiri ogwokundazibwa kwaitu, nagusisaniza nomubiri ogwekitinisakye, nkomubiri ogwobutamibwe okuguli, nkokukora oku okukuli okurukumusoboza okuta ebintu byona hansiye.

english: Then he spat on the wine and threw it out of the Temple with the sheep and the goats. Then he broke down the silver coins that were being sold and rolled them up.
lunyoro: Yataho omuguha ogwobuguha, yabinga zona omu yekaru, nentama nente; yasesa efeza ezabakaba nizbazihingisa, yajumika ebyase byabu;

english: Some of them began to spit on him, and some of them began to spit on him, and they would spit on him, and they would say, “He is a god!” The guards took him and beat him.
lunyoro: Nabandi bakabanza okumucwera amacwanta, nokumusweke'ra amaiso, noku mutera, nokumugambira ngu Rugura: nabahereza bamutwara nibamutera empi.

english: Just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him your husband, so you are his children if you do what is right, and do not be afraid of anything that will save you.
lunyoro: nka Sara okuyahu'raga Iburahimu namweta mukamwawe: nainywe muli banabe obumuraba numukora kurungi, kandi mutarukutinisibwa enkize yyona.

english: Those who want to save their own life will lose it, but those who lose their own life will save it.
lunyoro: Gamba ati Wena anyakwenda okukiza obwomezibwe nuwe alibubuza; baitu wena anyakubuza obwomezi bwe nuwe alibukiza.

english: But if you do not obey my teaching, you will not be condemned by me, because you are to save the world.
lunyoro: Kandi anyakuhu'ra ebigambo byange atarukubikwata, nyowe timucwera omusango: baitu okujuna ensi.

english: I am sure that your love and faith for the Lord Jesus and for all the holy people of God will grow.
lunyoro: Obumpu'ra okugonza kwawe nokuikiriza kwawe okwonyinakwo hali Mukama waitu Yesu, na hali abarukwera bona,

english: They were told that you were the one who taught the Jews to reject Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or to walk in these customs.
lunyoro: kandi bakagambirwa ebigambobyawe nguiwe oyegese Abayudayabonabali omu Bamahanga okulekayo Musa, nobagambira baleke okusara abana babu, nobukwakuba okugenda omu ngeso ezi.

english: It is much less than any plant, but it is much more important than the whole plant. It becomes a tree, and the birds of the air come and live in its branches.”
lunyoro: no kake okukira embibo yona, baituobukanyeta kaba kakoto okukira obunyansi bwona, kafoka omuti, enyonyi ezomu mwanya ziija ziikara omu matagi gagwo.

english: His feet were like drops of water in a flood, and he was tossed about by the fire, and his voice was like the drops of water.
lunyoro: Ibigerebye nibisisana nkomulinga gwomuhe'le, ogusemezibwe omu mu'ro; nirakarye liri nkiraka ryamaizi amaingi.

english: The jailer woke up and saw that many of the prisoners had escaped, so he drew his sword and tried to kill himself, pretending that the prisoners had escaped.
lunyoro: Kandi omulinzi owenju yenkomo, obuyasisimukire, yabona ebitebe bingi ebyenkomo nibairuka, yasomora empirimaye nayenda okweyita, atekerize abanyankommo bacwire.

english: Jesus got up and followed him. While he was eating in that house, many tax collectors and other outcasts stayed with Jesus and the disciples, because there were many who had followed him.
lunyoro: Yasisimuka, yamukuratira.Kandi obwakaba aikalire omu nju yogu narya, abahoza baingi nabasisi baika'ra hamu na Yesu nabegeswade; baitu bakaba bali baingi abamukuratire.

english: The next day we arrived in Sidon. Julius sent Paul a message of peace and received him as a friend and a friend.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri twahika Sidoni: kandi Yuryo yamugira Pauro, kurungi, namuikiriza okubungira enganjanize, nokuhumura.

english: On the night of the Jewish Passover meal and the tomb was near, they handed Jesus over to Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro obwokuba kya Kutekaniza kwabayudaya, kandi ekituro obwokuba haihi, nuho bamutaire Yesu.

english: The apostles and the believers in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
lunyoro: Kandi abakwenda na bene babu abakaba bali omu Buyudaya, bakahu'ra ngu Abamahanga nabo bakahebwa ekigambo kya Ruhanga.

english: The officer saw him and began to say to the people there, “This man belongs to them!”
lunyoro: Kandi omuzana ogu yamurora, yabanza okugambira abakaba bemerireho ati Onu wowabu.

english: I am reminded of the sincere faith that you have—the faith that is based on your faith in me—and this was the very beginning of the long ago of your grandmother Lois and your grandmother Eunice—and I am sure that she is with you.
lunyoro: obunaijukizibwe okuikiriza okutali kwobugobya okuliomuliwe, kandi nukwo kwabandize ira omu nyokwenkuru Roi, nomu nyoko Unike; kandi nyeteherize mali nti kuli nomuliwe.

english: Jesus said to his disciples, “There is nothing that will make you sad, but you will find the one who will betray you!
lunyoro: Yagambira abegeswabe ati Tikisoboka ebitabaijura okutaija: baitu dora, arukugobeza numumuzora.

english: But I do not want you to give me an answer to this question again, so I beg you to give us some information about your mercy.
lunyoro: Baitu ndeke okugarukira kwokukujwahya ninkwesengereza okutuhu'ra ebigambo bike obwembabazi zawe.

english: Then we, the rest of the human race, will be taken with them for a thousand years to worship the Lord. And so we will always be with the Lord.
lunyoro: nubwo naitwe abomezi abasigaraho tulitwarwa hamu nabo omu bicu, okutangi'ra Mukama waitu omu mwanya: kandi nukwo tuliikara tuti na Mukama Waitu Omu mwanya:

english: For the sake of the chosen ones, I endure everything with patience, and so do those who have been saved in union with Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukugumisiriza byona habwabakome, kandi nabo batunge okujunwa okuli omu Kristo Yesu, hamu nekitinisa ekyebiro nebiro.

english: For Christ was faithful as a Son in his house, and we are his own. We hold firmly to our confidence and to the pride we have in our hope firm to the end.
