lunyoro: Kandi banyakatagara abakuru nabahandiki bakeme'ra nibamuhambiriza muno.

english: Many will say to me on that Day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not speak in your name? We did not drive out demons in your name, and we did not see many miracles in your name.’
lunyoro: Mubiro biri baingi balingambira ngu Mukama waitu, Mukamawaitu, tutagambire omu ibara ryawe? Tutabinge mizimu omu ibara ryawe? Tutakole byamahano bingi omu ibara lyawe?

english: and always give their support to them.
lunyoro: kandi obainamyege omugongo gwabu ebiro byona.

english: I assure you that you will never give up, nor will you do anything else in heaven; instead, you will be a large crowd.
lunyoro: kandi nyowe nimbagambira nti otalirahira na kake, noburyakuba iguru, baitu nikyo kitebe ekya

english: Jesus said to them first, “Watch out, and do not let anyone fool you.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yabanza okubagambira ati Mwerinde omuntu wena alekege okubahabisa.

english: The eternal and invisible King of all peace, is the only God, the one who worships and worships him forever and ever. Amen.
lunyoro: Kandi Omukama owobusinge bwona, atahwaho, atarukurorwa, Ruhanga omu, ekitinisa nokukugiza bibe haruwe ebiro nebiro.Amina.

english: But to keep yourselves from the sins of the people who belong to us in this day and in the world, so that none of you will be able to stand firm in the faith and keep on sinning.
lunyoro: kyonka mwolekege okwerindaga omu biro binu ebyetwa bya hati; omuntu wena omulinywe aleke okugumangana obwebisuba kyekibi:

english: Herod wanted to see him, so he killed him, and had the guards whipped and ordered him to be put to death. So he left Judea and went to Caesarea, where he stayed.
lunyoro: Kandi Herode obuyamuseruire, yamubura, yakwasa ensengo abalinzi, yaragira okubaita. Kandi yasirimuka okuruga Buyudaya okugenda Kaisaliya, yaikara oku.

english: No one can buy or sell anything you have but the mark of the beast or the number of the beast.
lunyoro: kandi omuntu wena aleke okusobora okugura, nobukwakuba okuguza, rundi ebiyina enkojo, niryo ibara ryekisoro, nomuhendo gwibara ryakyo.

english: They had breastplates like breastplates, and the breastplates of a breastplate were made of many horsemen coming up against the battlements.
lunyoro: kandi zikaba ziyina ebyahakifuba nkebyoma; nokuhi'ra kwamagali, okwembarasi nyingi ezijumbutukira okurwana.

english: If Christ has been revealed to us, then you and all others will be shown with him in glory.
lunyoro: Kristo, obwomezi bwaitu, obwaryolekwa, nubwo nainywe hamu nauwe mulimanyisibwa omu kitinisa..

english: The people started shouting about a man who was lame. They tried to arrest him and put him in front of them.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, abantu bakaletera ha kitabu omuntu akaba azingamire: nibase'ra okumutahyamu, nokumubyamisa omu maisoge.

english: When all things have been placed under Christ's rule, then the Son himself will be put under God's authority, who placed all things under him, and God himself will be put under him.
lunyoro: Kandi ebintu byona obubalitebwa hansiye, nubwo Nomwana wenka aryatebwa hansi yogu ayataire byona hansiye; nuwko Ruhanga aikaleho omu wenka.

english: How terrible for you teachers of the Law! You have taken a solemn vow to keep watch. You yourselves have not made it your own, and you have kept watch over those who went in.
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abegesa ebiragiro! Baitu mukaihaho ekisumuruzo ekyokwetegereza: mutatahemu inywenka, kandi abo abakaba nibatahamu mukabatanga.

english: Jesus endured their wicked deeds in the desert for forty years.
lunyoro: kandi yagumisirizaga engeso zabu omu irungu emyaka nkamakumi ana.

english: I know your love, your faith, your service, and your patience—and your endurance—and the last days will be much more important than your beginning.
lunyoro: Manyire emirimo yawe, nokugonza, nokuikiriza, nokuhereza, nokugumisiriza kwawe, nemirom yawe eyahanyuma okuba nyingi okukira eyokubanza.

english: For Christ is at work in you and in you, and you will share in the work of God's service.
lunyoro: Kristo nakora omulinywe, okuterana kwanyu nukwo kurukugumibwa Ruhanga.

english: Go, then, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Mugende, muhindule amahanga gona abegeswa, numubabatiza okutaha omu ibara rya Isitwe Nomwana Nomwoyo Ogurukwera:

english: Demas left and loved the present life, and went to Thessalonica. Her sister conceived a vision and went to Galatia, where Titus went to Dalmatia.
lunyoro: baitu Dema akansiga, agondeze obusinge bwa hati bunu, yagenda Sesaronika; Keereseke yagenda Garatiya, Tito yagenda Daramatiya.

english: And where these things are done, there is no longer any sacrifice for sins.
lunyoro: Kandi nambere ebi biihibwaho, tihakyali okuhonga ebyonzira obwebibi.

english: The one whom I have brought back to you is my own dear friend.
lunyoro: oyo nakuimukize namberoli, nuwe mutima gwange mali mali:

english: So Jesus left and followed him, because he did not know what the angel had done, but thought he could see a vision.
lunyoro: Kandi yaturuka namukuratira; baitu atamanye byamananu maraika ebiyakozire, baitu akatekereza aboine okwolekwa.

english: When we are tempted, we make a request to God for help, and we are like the world's garbage heap, where everything is destroyed until this very day.
lunyoro: Otusaba Ruhanga obutuhangi'rwa: tukafoka nkehunda eyensi, nebiragazibwaho bya byona nokuhikya hati.

english: For by means of their faith they will be saved, because they are the children of faith; they will be put to death, but they will be put to death with the promise that God made through Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu alijunwa habwokuzara abana obubaliikara omu kuikiriza, nomu kuganza, nomu kwezebwa hamu nokwerinda.

english: He did not speak to them in public, but in private. He was able to help his own disciples in all kinds of ways.
lunyoro: atabaza nabo ha rufumo rutali:baitu yasobo'raga abegeswabe wenka byona omusita.

english: “Watch out,” he said, “and do not be fooled. Many will come to my authority and say, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time has come!’ but do not follow them.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Mwerindege mutahabisibwa: baitu baingi abaliija omu ibvara ryange nibagamba ngu Ninyowogu; kandi ngu Akasumu kamalize kuhika: mutalibakuratira.

english: Jesus concluded this parable by saying to the people who were self-controlled, self-controlled, self-controlled, and self-controlled.
lunyoro: Kandi akacwera orufumo runu abamu abakaba nibesiga bonka ngu bahikirire, nibagaya abandi bona:

english: But Jesus healed many people, and all who were sick followed him.
lunyoro: baitu akakiza baingi; kandi abarwaire bamugote'ra bamukoleho, bona abakaba bayina endwara.

english: For we are certain that he will defend Israel. And so it is with all these things that the third time this happened.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe tukanihira ngu Nuwe alicungura Isaleri. Nukwo na ha binu byona, hati nikyo kyakasatu, ebigambo binu bikaba kubaho.

english: But if a person goes on a certain road during the night, he will not remember them, because the light is not in him.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu obwagenda ekiro atabaijuka, baitu omusana tiguli omuruwe.

english: He went on his way through the towns and villages to teach and to go to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi akagenda omu muhandagwe omu mbuga nomu makanayegesa, nagenda hali Yerusalemu.

english: Moses said, “I am afraid that I will speak up.”
lunyoro: Kandi Musa akagamba ati Ntinire muno nintukumira.

english: Just as the living Father sent me, so I live because of the Father. Whoever loves me will also live because of me.
lunyoro: Nk'Isenyowe omwomezi okkuyantumire, nanyowe nkokundukwomera habwa Isenyowe; nukwo ati anyakundya, nuwe aryomera habwange.

english: Through the power of the Spirit, we receive God's message and are entrusted with the blood of Jesus Christ. May God's grace and peace be with you.
lunyoro: hati omu kwezebwa Okwomwoyo hali okuhu'ra nokumisirwa okwesagama ya Yesu Kristo: embabazi nobusinge bikanyizibwe halinywe.

english: That is why I write this, so that when I come, I will not be troubled by those who are good at cheering me up; but I will trust all of you, in the same way, that all of you may have my joy.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo mpandikire, nukwo obundiija ndeke okuba nobujune hali abo abakihikirire okunsemeza, baitu ninyesiga inywe inywena nukwo okusemererwa kwange nukwo kwanyu inywena.

english: In your stomach you will have to eat or have to drink anything else, whether it is a piece of bread or a piece of bread or a piece of bread or a piece of bread or a piece of bread; but whoever does what is good should be given his food.
lunyoro: Nobwekuba endyanga, nobubyakuba ebyesomeko bibiri, nobuzakuba nkaito, nobugwakuba omuigo, baitu anyakukora emirimo naseme'ra okuhebwa ebyokuryabye.

english: Whoever gives to you the Spirit and works in you to do what the Law requires or to obey the Law by obeying the Law.
lunyoro: Kandi ogu anyakubaha Omwoyo nako'ra omulinywe ebyamani, abikora obwemirimo yebiragiro? Rundi obwokkuhu'ra okwokuikiriza?

english: Blind Pharisee! First you must throw dust and ashes into the fire, and then you will be clean.”
lunyoro: Iwe omufalisayo afire amaiso, banza oyogye omunda nokutamira, bikasemezebwa omu kwoga.

english: So do not forget anything before the right time comes. The Lord will reveal to you the secrets of the darkness and reveal the thoughts of the heart. Then they will be given the full measure of gratitude to God.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutacwa kigambo kyona akasumi katakahikire, okuhika Mukama waitu obwaliija alimulikya ensita ezomuirima, kandi aryoleka okutekereza okwomu mitima: nubwo balihabwa okusimwa omuomu hali Ruhanga.

english: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him, because Mary stayed at home.
lunyoro: Nukwo, Maliza obuyahulire ati Yesu naija, yagenda okumutangi'ra: baitu Maryamu yaikara omu nju.

english: But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again; and whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will by no means be thirsty; and whoever drinks from the water will be thirsty and will come back to life eternal.”
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa ha maizi agandimuha talikwatwa iroho ebiro Kwahumbura abafu nabaha obwomezi, nukwo Nomwana abaha ati obwomezi abayenda okuha. Nebiro; baitu amaizi agambamuha galifoka omundaye iziba ryamaizi nigadubuka hali obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: They cannot now bear witness to what they have done to you.
lunyoro: Kandi tibarukusobora okugumya omu maiso gawe ebigambo ebibarukundega hati bunu.

english: Jesus said, “He indicated by what death he was about to die to bring glory to God.” After he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
lunyoro: akagamba ati, nayoleka okufa okwagenda kufa okunyumiza Ruhanga.obuyamazire okugama ati yamugambira ati Nkuratira.

english: and he will speak about it to you. For the Holy Spirit will teach you what you must say.”
lunyoro: Gamba ati Ego; baitu Omwoyo Ogurukwera nubwo alibegesa ekibasemerire okugamba.

english: If you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even tax collectors do the same.
lunyoro: Baitu obumuraba numugonza abo abanyakubagonza, muyina empera ki? Nabazinisa tinukwo bakora bati?

english: The next day we left and went to Caesarea. We went to the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the seven of them, and stayed with him.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri twarugayo, twahika Kaisaliya: twataha onu nju ya Firipo omugambizi owenjiri omu hali abo omusanju, twaikara nauwe.

english: He called everyone to his master and asked the first one, ‘Sir, why are you persecuting me?’
lunyoro: Yayeta namberali wena akaba natongwa mukamawe, yagambira owokubanza ati Mukama wange nakutonga ki?

english: When the disciples heard this, they were terrified and became afraid.
lunyoro: Abegeswa obubahulire, bagwa bajumaire, batinire muno.

english: But he denied it, saying, “I don't know what you are talking about or understand what you are talking about.” So he went out to the entrance of the courtyard, and a rooster crowed.
lunyoro: Baitu yayehakana nagamba ati Tindukumanya, nobukwakuba okwetegereza ekyorukugamba: yagenda aheru omu kiti kyomuryango; enkoko yakoka.

english: And those who live should live, not on bread alone, but only on wheat or barley or other sins.
lunyoro: Kandi abantu baleke okwomera nebyokurya byonka, baitu begarege engano, nobwekuba sayani, nobugwakuba ekibi kyona.

english: The crowd with him was so large that he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from death, and they began to proclaim the message.
lunyoro: Kandi ekitebe ekikaba kiri nauwe, obuyayesere Razaro okuruga omu kituro, namuhumbura omu bafu, batebeza.

english: But Paul said to them, “We were put right with God before the people before the Roman authorities before we were put to death; and now we are put in prison. How can they not put us in prison? Not at all! Instead, they came here and let us be put in prison!”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Nangwa, mananukwo; baitu baije bonka batuturukye.

english: He did not fail to notice what happened, but he did what was right, and he gave you rain from heaven and showers upon you during the time when you would eat food and enjoy yourselves.
lunyoro: Baitu atebuzeho kaiso, baitu akakora kurungi, nabanagira enjura okuruga omu iguru, nebiro ebyokwerezamu ebyokurya, naigusa emitima yanyu ebyokuryaga.

english: I write this not to make you sad, but to make you sad, like my dear children.
lunyoro: Tindukuhandika ebigambo binu okubaswaza, baitu okubahabura nkabana bange abarukugonzebwa.

english: At once his disciples came to him and were amazed, because he was talking with the woman. Nobody said, “What are you looking for?” or “What are you talking with her?”
lunyoro: Ahonaho abegeswabe baija; bahuni'ra baitu akab nabaza nomukazi; baitu busaho muntu ayagambire ati Nose'ra ki/ rundi ngu Kiki obaza nauwe?

english: See, then, the goodness and endurance of God. To those who are weak it is to you that the goodness of God, if you live in his goodness, will be to you as though you did not remain.
lunyoro: Nukwo orole oburungi nokugumisiriza ebya Ruhanga. Hali abo abagwire obugara, nubwo burungi bwa Ruhanga, obwoliba noikara omu burungibwe: nubwo olitemwa okutaikara:

english: For if you love God, you know him.
lunyoro: baitu wena obwaba nagonza Ruhanga, nuwe amanyirwe ogu.

english: Nor is it by human hands that they are put to death, as though they were nothing. Instead, they are the only ones who give life, life, life, and all things.
lunyoro: kandi tikikorwa emikono yabantu nkanyakuburaho ekintu, baitu nuwe wenka abaha bona obwomezi, nokuikya orwoya, nebintu byona;

english: When they heard this, they were so happy that they made plans to kill him. Jesus wanted to see how long he would have to give up.
lunyoro: Kandi obubahulire, basemererwa, bamuraganiza okukmuha erupiya. Yase'ra obwararora akasumi okumuhayo.

english: For everyone who asks receives, and anyone who seeks, will find; and whoever knocks on the door will be opened to him.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwasaba, ahebwa; obwase'ra azora; anyakeranga alikingu'rwaho.

english: For the giving of this service not only meets the needs of the holy ones but also meets with all kinds of giving thanks to God.
lunyoro: Baitu okugaba okwokuhereza kunu tikurukuijuza kwonka ekirengo kyamasege gabarukwera, baitu nukuhingurana obwebyokusima bingi hali Ruhanga;

english: When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write a letter. I heard him say, “Don't write down the meaning of the seven thunders which the seven thunders have said,” and he told me.
lunyoro: Ebidongo omusanju obubyagambire, nkaba ningenda okuhandika: nahu'ra gamba ngu Bohesa emanyikirizo ebi ebi ebihindukirwemu, otabihandika.

english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, “It was right for us to speak to you first of the word of God. But since you have sinned against God and are trying to turn you from your sins to eternal life, we shall be turned to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro na Baranaba bagamba nobumanzi ngu Kikaniki'ra okubanza okubagambira inywe ekigambo kya Ruhanga. Baitu muraba mukicumire kuli, nimwetegereza okutaseme'ra obwomezi obutahwaho, dora, ntuhindukira Abamahanga.

english: In the same way you also married and were raised to life with him through faith in the active power of God, who raised him from death.
lunyoro: kandi mukazibwa, kandi nukwo mwahumbukiremu hamu nauwe obwokuikiriza okukora kwa Ruhanga ayamuhumbuire omu bafu.

english: Jesus healed them, and the people were amazed when they saw the dumb speaking, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. They praised the God of Israel.
lunyoro: kandi yabakiza: nukwo nebitebe okuhuni'ra byahuni'la, obubaboine abafu bakanwa nibabza, nabaramaire nibagenda, nabafu bamaiso nibarora: bakugiza Ruhanga wa Isaleri.

english: The commander ordered him to be brought into the fort and be whipped, so that he could find out why they had made fun of him.
lunyoro: engabwa enkuru yaragira okumuleta omu rukomero, nagamba okumukaguliriza nenkoba, nukwo amanye ebyabatokeseze haruwe.

english: For I tell you, there are some here who will not die until they have seen the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira mali nti Haroho omuli abo abemerire hanu abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhika obubalirira obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: Jesus said to them, “Did you not know that the Scriptures say that Jesus is the power of God?
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Tinikyo muhabira, okutamanya Ebyahandikirwe, nobugakuba amani ga Ruhanga?

english: “That is right,” they answered, “and you are wrong.”
lunyoro: Baitu yabagambira ati Abojo, muyina ekyokurya? Bamugambira ngu Maraikawe.

english: Come near to the Lord with great joy, then, and be on your guard against those who do not obey him.
lunyoro: Nukwo mumulize haihi omu Mukama waitu nokusemererwa kwingi, kandi abanyakusisa bati mubatinege:

english: “Go away from here,” Jesus told me, “but I will send you far away to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Yangambira ati Ruga hanu; baitu nyowe ndikutuma hara hali Abamahanga.

english: The chief priests answered, “There is no other king but the Emperor!”
lunyoro: Banyakatagara abakuru bagarukamu ngu Titinyina omukama ondi, rundi Kaisali.

english: Love is patient and is kind; love does not brag, does not get puffed up, does not behave indecently,
lunyoro: Okugonza nukugumisiriza, kuba nembabazi; okugonza tikwenyumiza kwonka, tikwehemba, tikukora ebitasemire,

english: Jesus answered, “I have told you from the beginning.”
lunyoro: Nauwe yagamba ati Nkaha Mukama wange? Yesu yabagambira ati Nkokunabagambire okuruga kara na kara.

english: Be ready to pray, because I hope that you will be given the opportunity to see me when I pray.
lunyoro: Kandi ontekanirize hokurara: baitu ninihira nti obwokusaba kwanyu mulihabwa okumbona.

english: This became clear to all. Stephanas, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, Philip, Porchora, Nicanoleum, Timonius, and Phoenicia, and the Antiochite named Luke,
lunyoro: Ekigambo eki kyasemera hali ekitebe kyona: bakomamu Sitefano omuntu aijuire okuikiriza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera, na Firipo, na Porokoro, na Nikanoli, na Timoni, na Pamena, na Ruka omuhinduki owa Antyokiya:

english: When it was getting late, the twelve disciples came to him and said, “Send the people away, and let them go to the villages and farms around here and find some food, because we are here in the desert.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba nubu'sana kuira; ikumi nababiri bakaija, nibamugambira ngu Yohereza abekitebe, bagende omu maka nensi enyakuhe'raine bagonye, basake ebyokurya; baitu hanu tuli omu irungu kwonka.

english: He said to them, “You yourselves know very well that a Jew is not allowed to join a Gentile or come to him because God has shown me that I should not call anyone who is a Gentile or a sinner.
lunyoro: yabatebeza, yabagambira ati Inywe mumanyire kyomuziro omuntu Omuyudaya okuterana nomunyaihanga, nobukwakuba okuija namberali; baitu Ruhanga akanyoleka ndeke okweta omuntu wena wensi, nobwakuba omubi:

english: You are eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the inner prison.
lunyoro: nimwekamba okwerinda obumu Obwomwoyo omu nsengo zobusinge.

english: We are ready to punish anyone who will not listen when your response is put to the test.
lunyoro: kandi twetekanize okuhora enzigu hakutahu'ra kwona, okuhu'rwa kwanyu obukulikahiki'ra.

english: For a person who is weak does not fight, but does not need something.
lunyoro: Baitu omuculezi atarwana, ategomba ebintu:

english: I am happy that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come to you, because they have done what they have already done for you.
lunyoro: Kandi ninsemererwa obwakuija kwa Sitefana na Forutunata na Akaiko: baitu ebyabuzireho habwanyu nibo babihikize.

english: This is the judgment that has come into the world, and people love the darkness rather than the light, because their deeds were evil.
lunyoro: Kandi gunu nugwo musango, omusana guizire omu Nsi, abantu nibagonza omuirima okukira omusana; baitu engeso zabu Zikaba zibihire.

english: which he promised through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures,
lunyoro: eyiyaraganize ira omu banabibe omu Byahandikirwe ebirukwera

english: So then, follow the straight path, so that anyone who walks in the path will not be led astray, and they will be lost.
lunyoro: kandi muhendere ebigere byanyu empenda eziterekerire, anyakusenjura aleke okuhabisibwa, bai

english: Jesus answered, “I am he, the one you are talking with.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Ninyowonu arukubaza naiwe.

english: And there will be others who will be first, and there will be some who will be last.
lunyoro: Baitu dora, haroho abenyuma abaliba abokubanza, kandi haroho abokuma abalibaho abokubiruka.

english: But I do not want you to do anything, but you do not know that your grace is an expression of God's love, so that your love may not be tested.
lunyoro: baitu ntagonza okukora ekigambo kyona, iwe otakimanyire; embabazi zawe zireke okuba omu kuhambirizibwa, baitu omu kugonza.

english: We conclude, then, that a person is put right with God by faith, not by doing what the Law requires.
lunyoro: nukwo tutekererize ngu omuntu aihibwaho omusango obwokuikiriza hatali emirimo eyebiragiro.

english: to be buried, be raised to life with glory, be raised to life with power, and be raised to life with power.
lunyoro: zikwa nokuganyibwa; guhumburwa nekitinisa: gwumbuka nobugara; gwemerwa namani:

english: Jesus said to them, “Moses allowed you to divorce your wives because you are so hard to deal with. And before that, it was not like that.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Obwokugumangana okwomu mitima yanyu Musa nikyo yaikiririze okubinga bakazi banyu; kandi kara na kara kikaba kitali kiti.

english: and like newborn babies, feed the pure and pure spiritual milk of Christ's disciples until they are saved.
lunyoro: kandi nkabana abenkerembe mwegombe amata agomwoyo agatarumu bugobya, nukwo gabakuze okuhikya okujunwa;

english: Jesus answered him, “Didn't I tell you that if you believed, you would see God's glory?
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Tinkugambire nti Okworaba noikiriza orarora ekitinisa kya Ruhanga?

english: Do not be called ‘kings,’ because your Leader is one, the Messiah.

lunyoro: Yesu yabagarukamu ati Tininyowe nabekomure inywe ikumi nababiri, kandi omu halinywe wa Setani?

lunyoro: Yago'ra omukonogwe yamukoraho, nagamba ati Ningonza: semezebwa. Ahonaho ebigengebye bikasemezebwa.

lunyoro: baitu bona banagiremu ebibasagirire; baitu ogu omu masegege anagiremu byona ebyanyinabyo, niryo itungorye ryona.

lunyoro: Baitu nukwo emirago ya Ruhanga esisaine eti omuruwe: nukwo nomuruwe harumu Amina, hali ekitinisa kya Ruhanga omulitwe.

lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda ki? Yamugambira ati Ocwire kurungi.

lunyoro: Kandi mutaganyisa Omwoyo Ogurukwera Ruhanga, oumwatererweho akokuro'raho hali ekiro ekyokucungurwa.

lunyoro: Abo bona ababandize bakaba bali basuma nabanyagi: baitu entama zitabahu'le.

lunyoro: Yangambira ati Dora, otakora oti: ndi muiru mutahi wawe nabagenzi bawe banabi, nabo abakwata ebigambo ebyomu kitabu kinu: ramya Ruhanga.

lunyoro: Nauwe obuyahulire, yamatuka yagenda anamberali.

lunyoro: Kandi nekiragano ekyokubanza kikaba kiyina engeso ezaragirwe ezokuramyaga Ruhanga, nekiikaro ekirukwera ekikaba kiri kyensi enu.

lunyoro: ekinsita eki ekyaserekerwe okuruga ebiro byona nobusinge bwona: baitu hati bunu kimanyisibwe hali abarukwerabe,

lunyoro: Ebihongwa ebyokeze ebihikirire, nebyonzira obwebibi otabisime:

lunyoro: baitu inywe mugamba ngu Omuntu obwaraba nagambira ise rundi nyina ati Kyona ekinkukuhaire okukugasira niyo Korobani, nukwo kugamba ngu Ekyokuhongera Ruhanga:

lunyoro: Kandi yaraba omu Busuli na Kirikiya, nagumya ekanisa.

english: And so I will send you to Macedonia, and from Macedonia I will come to you and make you go to Judea.
lunyoro: kandi nokuraba omulinywe okuhika Makedoni, kandi nokuruga Makedoni okuija namberemuli, kandi nokubohererwa inywe okugenda Buyudaya.

english: They will throw them out of the synagogues, and the time will come when they will think and serve God.
lunyoro: Balibabinga omu maso'rokaniro: ego, akasumi nikaija, anyakubaita wena alitekereza nahereza Ruhanga.

english: Jesus looked around at those who were sitting around him and said, “Look! Here are my mother and my brothers!
lunyoro: Yababungyamu amaiso abakaba baikalire hambaju zona bamwezigolize, nagamba ati Dora, mau nagagenzi bange.

english: Simon Peter was standing there warming himself. "You are one of his disciples, too!" he denied it and answered.
lunyoro: Kandi Simoni Petero akaba ayemerire nayota omu'ro.Kandi uwe yayehakana nagamba ati Naiwe oli womu begeswabe?

english: But a certain silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis, sold many silver coins and sold them.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu omu, ibararye Demeterio, omuhesi wefeza, ayakoraga amabandiro agefeza aga Atemi, yatungisaga abahesi amagoba maingi;

english: “Teacher,” he said, “you have the same wisdom and truth as the Law commands.
lunyoro: yegesa, oyina okusisana kwamagezi nokwamazima omu biragiro:

english: Because of his message, we have proclaimed his message of truth, so that we may be like the first commandment of the Law of Moses.
lunyoro: Obwokuhanurakwe okatuzaza ekigambokye ekyamazima, tube nkomuganuro ogwokubanza ogwebi ebiyahangire.

english: To him be the might forever and ever. Amen.
lunyoro: Kandi obusobozi bube haruwe ebiro nebiro Amina.

english: Jesus said to them, “The harvest is great, but few workers are needed. Pray that the master of the harvest will send out workers into his harvest.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Okugesa kwingi, baitu abakozi bake: nukwo musabe mukama wokugesa, acume abakozi omu kugesakwe.

english: He wanted to buy a gold coin from the rich man's table, but even the dogs would come and lick his sores.
lunyoro: kandi ekegomba okuiguta oburagalika obwaragaraga ha meza yomuguda; ego, nembwa nazo zaijaga nizikomba ebihoyabye.

english: Jesus answered, “My friends are those who hear the word of God and do it.
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Maunabagenzi bange nibo banu abahu'ra ekigambo kya Ruhanga nibakikora.

english: Every high priest chosen by human beings is appointed to serve in the priestly order of God. He must offer sacrifices and offerings for sins.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omukuru wena anyakukomwa omu bantu, atebwaho habwabantu omu bigambo ebya ha Ruhanga; ahongege ebisembo nebyonzira obwebibi:

english: For the Son of Man will be revealed to those who do not know him, because they did what they wanted to.
lunyoro: Baitu batamumanye, baitu bakamukora nkokubayenzire. Nukwo ati Omwana womuntu alisalizibwa bo.

english: They were the only ones who did not know when the time came to build the ark, when only a few people, that is, eight, were saved by the water.
lunyoro: nibo batarahulire ira obukwaikaire omu biro bya Nuha, obwato obubukaba nubutegekebwa, nambere abake, nugwo munana, bajunirwemu omumaizi:

english: A woman named Lydia, who was a dealer in purple cloth, from Thyatira, worshiped God and listened to us. The Lord opened her heart to pay attention to what Paul said.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi omu, ibararye Rudiya, omuguzi worugoye orurukugajuka, owomu rubuga Suatira, ayaramyaga Ruhanga, yatuhu'ra; kandi Mukama waitu yaigura omutimagwe okuhwituka ebigambo Pauro ebiyabalize.

english: I was able to preach the Good News in the territory of the Gentiles, but secretly among those who were put to death by the power of the authorities, or by being put to death by God's power.
lunyoro: Kandi nkatemba okutebeza enjiri omu Bamahanga, baitu omu nsita hali abo abatairweho okuba abakuru, rundi okuba 'mazire okuirukira busa.

english: But he began to curse and to curse, saying, “I don't know who you are talking about!”
lunyoro: baitu yabanza okukyena, nokurahira ati Timanyire omuntu ogu oumugambire.

english: But Jesus paid no attention to what was said, so he told the commander, “Don't be afraid; only believe!”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu atakiteho mutima ekigambo ekyagambirwe, yagambira omukuru wiso'rokaniro ati Otatina, ikiriza kwonka.

english: His fellow servant fell to the ground and begged him, “Be patient with me, and I will pay you back!”
lunyoro: Kandi omuiru mutahiwe yagwa ahansi namwesengereza nagamba ati Ntonga mpora nanyowe ndikuma'ra.

english: There is no difference between Jews and Gentiles, between slaves and free, between men and women, and between you and Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Tinyina Muyudaya nobwakuba Omuyonani, nobukwakuba omuiru rubale, nobubwakuba owobugabe, nomusaija nomukazi; baitu inywena muli omu omu Kristo Yesu.

english: Paul said, “I have prayed to God that he will not only for you and for many times more, but also for all those who hear me now, so that they may be like me—unless there are such charges!”
lunyoro: Pauro yagamba ati Nakusabire Ruhanga, rundi nokuhambirizibwa okutaito rundi nokwingi, tali iwe wenka, baitu nabo bona abampulire hati, bafoke nka nyowe, batayina ensengo zinu.

english: After they had spoken the message in Perga, they went to Attalia.
lunyoro: kandi obubamazire okugamba ekigambo omu Perega, basirimuka Ataliya;

english: Jesus spoke to them at once, “Courage!” He said to them, “It is I, so be not afraid.”
lunyoro: Baitu ahonaho yabaza nabo, nabagambira ati Mugume emitima; ninyowonu; matatina.

english: For he will be handed over to those who are his own, and to the people who are his own, until the time comes when the Son will be handed over to his Father.”
lunyoro: baitu alemwa abakuza nabaketo okuhikya akasumi akatairweho ise.

english: You will hear the roar of battles and the roar of battles. Be on your guard that you will not be troubled, because the end has not come.
lunyoro: Mulihu'ra obulemu, nokuranganwa okwobulemu; mwerinde mutalituntura; baitu tibirireka kuija; baitu empero etakahikire.

english: After Jesus said this, there was a division between the Pharisees and the Sadducees. The Council was divided.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, hakabaho okukungana omu Bafalisayo na Basadukayo: orukurato rwabaganizibwamu.

english: There was a lot of weeping. Some of the teachers of the Law who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and began to argue, “We find no reason to condemn him! What if an angel spoke to him by the power of the Spirit or an angel?”
lunyoro: Kandi hakabaho okutera obwogo bwingi: abahandiki abamu abomu kicweka Kyabafalisayo bayeme'ra, nibatera empaka nibagamba ngu Tituboine kibi ha muntu ogu: kandi kiraba kita omwoyo rundi maraika obwaraba amugambire?

english: Then he placed him in his hands and praised God, saying,
lunyoro: Baitu okweri, yamukwata omu mikonoye, nakugiza Ruhanga nagamba ati

english: At once Jesus knew that power had gone out of him, so he went back into the crowd and asked him, “Who touched my clothes?”
lunyoro: Ahonaho Yesu obuyamanyire omundaye amani gamurugiremu, yahinduka omu kitebe yagamba ati Noha akozireho ebyokujwara byange?

english: I assure you, then, that whatever you ask and ask for, believe that you have received it, and you will receive it.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukubagambi'ra nti Ebigambo ebimurakasabaga byona nokwesengereza, muikirizege ngu mubihairwe, kandi murabihebwaga.

english: I know that you are in union with the Lord Jesus, and I know that nothing is of value to you in the beginning. But to him who considers anything unclean, it is of no use at all.
lunyoro: manyire, kandi nyetegerize mali omu Mukama waitu Yesu nti busaho kintu kyomuziro omu kuhangwa kwayo: rundi hali ogu anyakutekereza ekintu okuba ekyomuzirzo, hali ogu kiba kyoburo.

english: Everyone who walks in the same way will be able to do it.
lunyoro: Kandi wena alikugendesa namani emairo emu,

english: But Jesus answered, “I am not here, not because the lost sheep of the people of Israel.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nagamba ati Ntatumwe, rundi hahi entama ezabuzire ezomu nju ya Usareri.

english: Don't you say, 'There are four months to come,' and then ‘Get up,’ and ‘Get up,’ and look at the fields, which are ready to be harvested?
lunyoro: Timurukugamba ngu Hasigaireho amezi ana, okugesa kuije? dora nimbagambira nti Muimukye amaiso ganyu, murole emisiri, emazire okwera okugeswa.

english: After they had appointed elders in all the churches and had prayed and made their prayers known to the Lord, they gave them the believers.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okutaho abakuru omu kanisa zona, nokusaba nokusiba, babasigira Mukama waitu, oubaikirize.

english: John answered, “No one can be given anything unless God has sent him from heaven.
lunyoro: Yohana yagarukamu nagamba ati Omuntu tasobora kuhebwa ekigambo, rundi kimuherirwe okuruga omu iguru.

english: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather be afraid of the one who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
lunyoro: Baitu mutalitina abaita omubiri, baitu tibasobora kuitamwoyo: hakire mutinege ogu arukusobora okuhwerekereza omwoyo nomubiri omu Gehena.

english: You know this: if you are a servant, you know that while you are still in the dark, you will not let your family go hungry.
lunyoro: Kandi kinu mukimanye ngu kuba nyineka,yamanyire ekiro ekyomuirima okukiri omwirima,akuikirize enjuye okulimwa;

english: For I am sure that neither death nor life nor angels nor rulers nor the present nor the present nor things to come shall ever happen.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nyetegererize kimu nti nobukwakuba okufa, nobubwakuba obwomezi, nobubyakuba bamaraika, nobukyakuba abobusobozi, nobwekuba ebiroho, nobwakuba ebirukugenda okubaho, nobugwakuba obusobozi,

english: While he was in Galilee, the men who followed him followed him and sent him to Jerusalem, with many other women who had come with him to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: obwakaba ali omu Galiraya nibo bamuhonderaga, nibamuherez; nabakazi abandi baingi abatembere nauwe ha Yerusalemu.

english: and a son, the son of a she-in-law.
lunyoro: Na mwene wabu, nuwe Mwana womuzana.

english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to go into the Temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels had come to an end.
lunyoro: Yekaru yaijura omuika oguruga omu kitinisa kya Ruhanga, nomu manige; kandi busaho ayasoboire okutaha omu yekaru, okuhikya emihito omusanju ya bamaraika omusanja obwerihikirizibwa.

english: Many of the voyages were dangerous to rivers, dangers from robbers, and dangers to my own people; dangers from the city, dangers from the darkness, dangers from the sea, and dangers from false friends.
lunyoro: hati omu ngendo nyingi, omu kabi kebyambu,omu kabi kabazinzi, omubibiiha hali abomu ruganda rwange, omu bubi omu rubuga, omu mbibo omu irungu, omu kubiha omu nyanja, omu kibi hali bagenzi bange abebisuba:

english: Suddenly a violent storm came down from heaven, like a strong wind blowing against them, and a large number of houses was filled with smoke from the sky.
lunyoro: Ahonaho okuhi'ra kukaruga ha iguru, nkekiyaga okukih'ra namani, kwaijuliza kimu enju habakaba baikalire.

english: And we preach the Good News in twos far away than you, not in the group of others, so that we may not boast about the things that are being prepared.
lunyoro: kandi nokutebeza enjiri omu biikaro ebiri hara okukira inywe, okukira ababandi, tuleke okwenyumiriza ebitekanize.

english: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so they reject the truth. They are people whose minds are corrupted by their faith and have no faith.
lunyoro: Kandi nka Yane na Yambere okubatangire Musa, nukwo nabo batanga bati amazima, abantu abasisiskaire omu magezi gabu, abatarukusimwa omu kuikiriza.

english: Jesus said to her, “Let the children come to you and kill him, because it is not right to take the children's food and throw it to the dogs.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati leka abana bamale okuiguta: baitu tikiri kirungi okukwata ebyokurya byabana, okubinagira obubwa.

english: But if any of you are hearing the word and are not doing it, this man will be seen by everyone.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwaba omuhulizi wekigambo, kunu atali mukozi, ogu ndolerwamu:

english: Jesus answered, “Your sins are forgiven.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Ebibi byawe bikuihirweho.

english: So Jesus went and took her by the hand and helped her up. The fever left her and began to wait on them.
lunyoro: Yaija yamukwata ha Mukono yamuimukya; omusuija gwamurugaho, kandi yabahereza.

english: Some of them were sentenced to death by chains, chains, and chains. Some were put in chains, others were put in chains.
lunyoro: ndi nabandi bakalengwa nibate'rwa enaku, nibaterwa enkoba, kandi nokubohebwa nokutebwa omu nkomo:

english: So then, whether it is I or others, let us preach, then, and let you believe.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo, rundi nyowe rundi abandi, mmukwo tutebeze tuti, nukwo mwaikirize muti.

english: “We don't celebrate the festival,” they answered, “but people wouldn't get up and wake up.”
lunyoro: Baitu bakagamba ngu Kitaba omu biro byobugenyi, abantu baleke kuimuki'ra.

english: On that very night an angel of the Lord opened the prison gates and drove them out and said, “Go away!
lunyoro: Baitu ekiro maraika wa Mukama yakinguraho enyigi ezenju yenkomo, yabaturukya aheru nagamba ati Mugende,

english: Through the miracles and wonders of the Spirit God made himself known to you through all patience and miracles.
lunyoro: Kandi obwokuro'raho obwomukwenda tukakorwa omulinywe omu kugumisiriza kwona, omu bwokuroraho nebyamahano nebyamani.

english: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
lunyoro: Kambanu omuti ogusemire tigusobora kwana ebyana ebibihire, kandi omuti ogubi tiguinsoboravana byana ebisemire.

english: They were afraid that the stones would be broken, so they lowered four anchors from their front to the front, and wished they could find some way to get there.
lunyoro: Kandi obubatinire okunagwa ha mabale, banaga ebinyakusibika bina ha kiso, nibegomba obuire okukya.

english: They said to one another, “Weren't our hearts burning within us, as he was speaking to us on the road, and he explained to us the Scriptures?”
lunyoro: Nabo bagambirangana bonka ngu Omutima gwaitu tigusarairege omunda yaitu, obwabaire nabaza naitwe omu muhanda natusuku'ra ebyahandikirwe?

english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. ‘No, Lord,’ he said, ‘that would never happen to you!’
lunyoro: Petero yamutwara yabanza okumuhana, namugambira ati Nangwa, Mukama wange: eki tikirikuizira na kake.

english: They said to him, “What shall we do, then, if we are going to do the work of God's servants?”
lunyoro: Kandi bamugambira ngu Turagira tuta okukora emirimo ya Ruhanga?

english: And so we are eager to see God's glory revealed through us, so that we may praise him for his great and glorious salvation.
lunyoro: kandi obwokunihira kwomugisa, nokwolekwa kwekitinisakye,

english: If you refuse to listen to them, speak to the church, and if you refuse to listen to the church, be on your guard as foreigners and as foreigners.
lunyoro: Obwayanga okuhu'ra abo, ogambire ekanisa, kandi obwayanga kuhu'ra nekanisa, aikale namberoli nkomunyaihanga, nomuzinisa.

english: In the past you were like a branch of the spiritual seed that grows up and contains the seeds that grow in the soil.
lunyoro: omu bigambo ebyengeso ezaira, inywe okujur omunt owaira arukujunda obwokwegomba okwebisuba:

english: Jesus turned to them and said, “Women of Jerusalem, do not look for me, but for yourselves and your children.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu akabahindukira nagamba ati Abaisiki ba Yerusalemu, mutansi'ra nyowe, baitu mweriri'le inywenka nabana banyu.

english: The soldiers took Paul, as the Law required, and on the night they took him to Antipatris.
lunyoro: Kandi abaserikale nkokubaragirwe nukwo batwaire Pauro, bamuleta ekiro okuhika Antipatiri.

english: and said to them, “Whoever welcomes this child in my name receives me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For the one who is least among you all is the greatest.”
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Wena aliikiriza omwana onu omuto omu ibara rya nge buli aikirize nyowe: nawena aliikiriza nyowogu ayantumire: baitu anyakuli omuto omulinywe, nuwe mukuru.

english: They are those whom God has commanded: “They will not enter into his rest, except those who have not heard.”
lunyoro: Kandi nibaha abayarahirire ati Batalitaha omu kuhumurakwe, rundi abo abatarahulire?

english: “Yes, Lord,” answered Jesus, “you know that I love you.”
lunyoro: Yamuagambira ati Nukwo, Mukama wange; iwe omanyire ninkungoza.

english: For this is how it will be for all those who live on earth.”
lunyoro: Baitu nukwo kiribaizira kiti bona abanyakurara hansi yona.

english: But if you live according to your human nature, you will die; but if you live according to your human nature, you will live by the Spirit.
lunyoro: baitu omuburaba nimwomera habwomubiri, mwagenda okufa: baitu muraba numusa omwoyo engeso ezomubiri, muryomera.

english: Then he went out about three o'clock in the morning and did the same thing.
lunyoro: Yaturuka esaha zihakire isatu, nakora ati.

english: That is wisdom. Whoever has the mark of the beast must count the number of the beast, because it is the number of a man; and its number is 666.
lunyoro: Nuho hali amagezi. Anyakuina okwetegereza abale omuhendo gwekisoro; baitu nugwo muhendo gwomuntu: nomuhendo wakyo Rukaga mwenkaga mu mukaga.

english: For if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the Law.
lunyoro: baitu obumuraba numuterekerezebwa Omwoyo timurukulemwa ebiragiro.

english: They do not look for fault or fault, but try to show that they are always good and faithful; in order to bring glory to the teaching of our Savior and Savior in all things.
lunyoro: tahambirizibwa, baitu okwoleka okkkwesigwa kwona okurungi; nukwo bakuteho ekitinisa okwegesa Okwomujuni waitu Ruhang omubyona

english: This was the first miracle that Jesus performed in Cana in Galilee, and he revealed his glory, and his disciples believed in him.
lunyoro: Kanu niko kokuro'raho Yesu akayabandize okukora omu Kana eya Galiraya, nasukura ekitinisakye; abegeswabe nibamuikiriza.

english: That is why I am telling you, my friends, that the time has not yet come for those who have wives to be in need.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo ngambire, bene baitu, nti Ebiro bisigaire bike okuruga hati abanyakunyina abakazi babe nkabatanyina;

english: He did not suffer in the faith, but thought that his own body would die. He was about a hundred years old.
lunyoro: Kandi atakwatwe obugara omu kuikiriza obuyatekerize omubirigwe wenka gubaire gufire. (baitu akaba amazire emyaka nkekikumi)

english: And my teaching and preaching were not based on human wisdom, but on the Spirit's power.
lunyoro: Nekigambo kyange nokutebeza kwange bikaba bitali omu bigambo ebyamagezi ebyokuhambiriza, baitu omu kwoleka Omwoyo namani:

english: For he who welcomes strangers in, loves what is good, is a good shepherd, is righteous, is holy, and is a humble person.
lunyoro: mugenzi wamakune, agonza oburungi omwerinzi, ahikirire, arukwera, omwekengi

english: If Demetrius and his workers have a message for everyone, then the authorities have the right to decide what will happen to them.
lunyoro: Nukwo, Demeterio nabahesi abali nauwe obubaraba bayina ekigambo ha muntu wena, ebibira biroho, mabamasaza baroho:balengangane.

english: And the prayer of faith will save the sick, and the Lord will raise him up. And if he has committed sins, he will be put to death.
lunyoro: nokusaba okwokuikiriza kulimujuna arwaire, kandi Mukama alimuimukya: kandi obwaraba akozire ebibi birimuihibwaho.

english: If a person is guilty of sin, then he must be punished the first time and then the second time.
lunyoro: Omuntu arukusisa obwamara okumuhana omurundi ogwokubanza nogwakabiri o

english: When they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go to Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not allow them.
lunyoro: kandi obubahikire haihi na Misiya, bakaba nibenda okugenda Bituniya: Nomwoyo gwa Yesu atabaikirize;

english: But now you, too, must put away all wickedness, all kinds of evil, all kinds of evil, and all kinds of evil, and all these evil things, and they will be destroyed in your words.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu nainywe muiheho byona, okubihirwa, nekiniga, nobubi, nokujuma, nokubanza ebyensoni omu kanwa kanyu:

english: But Peter said, “Man, I am not!”
lunyoro: Nauwe yagamba ati Noha ankozireho? Baitu Petero yagamba ati Omusaija tindi wamu.

english: Do not let anyone look down on him. Keep him in good health, so that he will come to me, for you are waiting to come with my friends.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena aleke okumugaya. Mumubohe'le nobusinge, nukwo aije namberendi: baitu numutegereza okuija hamu na bene baitu.

english: If you are invited, then, you must go and live in the same way as you are invited.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena omu kwetwa okuyayetirwemu, nuho aikalege.

english: All the blood that has been poured out on the earth has been poured out for you, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the Temple and the altar.
lunyoro: Halinywe haije esagama yona eyokuhiki'ra eyasesekire hansi, okubandize ha sagama ya Aberi, ogu ahikirire, okuhika ha sagma ya Zakaliya omwana wa Barakiya, owumwaisire hagati ya yekaru

english: When they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some of the believers before the city authorities and shouted, “These men have come here to destroy the world!
lunyoro: Kandi obubatarababoine, bacundira Yasoni na bene babu abamu omu maiso gabalemi borubuga, nibagambira haiguru ngu Banu abajumikire ensi baizire na hanu;

english: In a large pot I was helped by a scroll being rolled up and rolled up by his hands.
lunyoro: Kandi nkahabwa omu kicweka ekikoto omunsita, omuzingo gwenkuratana ogukaba gugumire omu mikonoye:

english: My son, be strong in the grace that is given you through Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Omwana wange, oikale wamani omu mbabazi eziri omu kristo Yesu.

english: Jesus said, “There was once a man who had two sons.
lunyoro: Kandi akagamba ati Omuntu omu akaba ayina abana babiri:

english: I do not say that you will judge, but I say that you are in our hearts—either to die with us or to live with us.
lunyoro: Tingambire okucwa omusango: baitu 'mazire okugamba nti inywe muli omu mitima yaitu, rundi okufera hamu naitwe, kandi rundi okwemera hamu natwe.

english: In this way he will be able to save only those who come to God through him, because he lives forever to set them free.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo asobora ati okubajunira kimu abanyakuija hali Ruhanga omuruwe, baitu aikara omwomezi ebiro byona okubatonganiriraga.

english: They will proclaim God's message in the same way that we ourselves are. I am with you among them, so that they may be one. The world knows that you sent me and that you love them just as you love me.

lunyoro: na Yuda Isikaryota, nuwe yamugobize.
