lunyoro: ahonaho hakaba haroho omusisa omwingi, nemiganda eyenju yenkomo yatengesebwa: kandi ahonaho enyigi zona zakinguka; kandi ensengo za bona zasumu'ruka.

english: But Peter was standing outside. The other disciple, known as the High Priest, came out and spoke to the servant girl, and she took Peter in.
lunyoro: baitu Petero akaba ayemerire aheru ha ruigi. Kandi omwegeswa ogu ondi akaba amanyirwe nyakatagara omukuru wabu, yaturuka yabaza nomuisiki ogu omukumirizi, yatahyamu Petero.

english: For the sake of kings and all the elders, so that we may be clothed with peace and peace, as well as peace and calm, in our lives, in order to bring glory and honor to God.
lunyoro: habwabakama nabakuru bona; nukwo tuikalege nobusinge nokuhumura omu hiro byaitu, omu kutina Ruhanga kwona nomu kwerinda.

english: Jesus said to them, “The secret thoughts of the Kingdom of God have been given to you, because they are foreign to you. All things are covered up in parables.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe mukahebwa ensita ezobukama bwa Ruhanga: baitu bali abaheru, byona bibacwerwa omu nfumo:

english: Let us, then, go back to him outside the camp and bury his own body.
lunyoro: Nukwo itwe tuturuke okugenda namberali aheru yorukande, twetwekere ekijumukye.

english: For the time will come when your enemies will build around you a fort and will surround you and surround you from every side.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro birikuizira abanyanzigwa bawe obubalikwombekeraho orukomera, nibakwehinguliriza, nibakufunza embaju zona.;

english: Christ, the King of Israel, now comes down from the cross. We see and believe.” The believers who were crucified with him also denied him.
lunyoro: Kristo, Omukama wa Isaleri, aruge hati bunu ha muti. Itwe turole, tuikirize.kandi ababambirwe ahamu nauwe nabo bakamujuma.

english: There are many different kinds of angels in the world, yet none of them has ever been able to do so.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho omunsi emiringo nyingi eyamaraka, kandi busaho eritanyina okusobo'rwa.

english: After they had taken the ship, they took the ship aboard and sailed away. They were afraid that they would fall on the island of Libya, so they lowered the sail and lowered the ship's sail.
lunyoro: kandi obubamazire okubihimba, batwara emiguha, nibagizingiza ha kyombo; kandi obubatinire okunagwa ha Suruti, baihayo ebyahaiguru, nukwo batwara kwonka.

english: Jesus went back into the village and asked Jesus, “Who are you?” But Jesus would not answer him.
lunyoro: yagaruka nataha omu kibira, yagambira Yesu ati Oli wa Nkaha?Baitu Yesu atamugarukemu.

english: This is the stone which was set at nought for you builders, which has become the biggest of the stones.
lunyoro: Ogu niryo ibale eryagayirwe inywe abombeki, niryo ryafokere erikuru erya ha karugu.

english: so that none of you will be discouraged or troubled by your thinking or be troubled by the spiritual or the spiritual truths or by the message or by the likes of our lives, because the Day of the Lord has come.
lunyoro: hakire okutabatabana omu magezi ganyu, nobukwakuba okutuntuzibwa, nobuhokuba omu bigambo ebyomwoyo, nobubwakuba omu kugamba, nobubyakuba ebigambo ebiruga omulitwe, ngu ekiro kya Mukama waitu kihikire:

english: I have given them what you gave me, and they have come to believe in it, and they know that I came from you and believe that you sent me.
lunyoro: baitu ebigambo ebiwampaire mbibahaire: babiikiriza, nibamanya mananukwo nkaruga haliwe, nibaikiriza niwe wantumire.

english: and by the power of miracles and wonders, by the power of the Holy Spirit. So I went from Jerusalem and from there to Illyricum, where I preached the Good News about Christ.
lunyoro: mu ngeso, omu mani gobwakuro'raho nebyamahano, omu ngeso Zowomwoyo Ogurukwera; nukwo okuruga Yerusalemu nokwehinguliriza okuhika Iruliko, nkahikya enjiri ya Kristo;

english: So he left Barabbas to them, but Jesus took him aside and handed him over to be crucified.
lunyoro: Nubwo yabalekerire Baraba; baitu Yesu yamutera enkoba, yamuhayo okubambwa ha muti.

english: He is not one of everyone, but of the witnesses who have been put right with God. We are the ones who ate and drank with him after he rose from death.
lunyoro: hati omu bantu bona, baitu hali abakaiso abakomerwe ira Ruhanga, nitwe abalire, kandi abanywire hamu nauwe obuyamazire okuhumbuka omu bafu.

english: But you have kept my command to endure, and I will also keep you safe in the time of the end, which will come upon the whole world of people and punish those who live on earth.
lunyoro: Baitu iwe okerinda ekigambo kyokugumisiriza kwange, nanyowe ndikulinda omu kasumi kokwehebwa, akarukugenda okuija hali ensi zona ezabantu, okulenga abarukuikara ha nsi.

english: Those who call on God in heaven swear that they worship him and that they are his children.
lunyoro: Kandi anyakurahira iguru buli arahire ibararye, kandi ngu ali mwanawe.

english: Simon Peter, Thomas (called the Twin), Nathanael (the son of Cana in Galilee), the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples of Jesus were together.
lunyoro: bakaba bali hamu Simoni Petero, na Tomasi ayetwa Didumo, na Nasaneri owa Kana orwa Galiraya, nabana ba Zebedayo nabegeswabe abandi babiri.

english: You bring new truths into our minds, and we want to know the meaning of these things.
lunyoro: Baitu noleta ebigambo ebihyaka omu matu gaitu: nikyo turukwendera okumanya amakuru gebigambo binu.

english: The one who testifies these things says, ‘Yes, I will come soon.’ Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!
lunyoro: Arukumanyisa ebigambo binu nagamba ati Nukwo; ninyija bwango. Amina: ija Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: For our message is not of legends or of legends or of legends or of legends.
lunyoro: Baitu okugambi'ra kwaitu tikuli kwebisuba, nobuhokuba kwokutasemera;

english: Some of the other disciples went into the boat, not far from land, not far from land, not far from land, not far from land, not far from land, not far from land. They also carried a large bag full of fish.
lunyoro: Baitu abegeswa abandi baija omu bwato obuke ( baitu bakaba batali hara nomusa, rundi emikono nkebikumi bibiri), nibacunda ekisoha ekirumu encu.

english: To this very day we are hungry, thirsty, and thirsty; we are thirsty, but we are thirsty; we are thirsty, but we have no food.
lunyoro: Na hati hona nturumwa enjara, ntukwatwa iroho, tuli kwonka, ntuterwa entomi, titunyina owaitu:

english: While Jesus was sitting in the judgment hall, his wife sent him a message: “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, because I have suffered much in a dream for him.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaikalire ha ntebe eyomusango, mukaziwe yamutumira nagamba ati Omutu ogu ahikirire, otamukora kigambo na kake; baitu hati nsalirwe bingi omu kiroto hali uwe.

english: I heard the angel of the waters say, “You are right, O Holy One who lives there, because you have judged this way.
lunyoro: Kandi nahu'ra maraika owamaizi nagamba ati Ohikirire iwe anyakuroho, kandi akabaroho, niwe Arukwera, baitu okacwa omusango oti:

english: You are still human beings, but at one time you have doubts about what you are doing, yet you no longer belong to human nature. You are like human beings.
lunyoro: mukyali abomubiri: baitu obuharumu omulinywe ihali nempaka, timukyali bomubiri? Timurukugenda nkabantu kwonka?

english: Jesus said to them, “There is nothing left that will destroy you; you give them something to eat.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Busaho ekirikubabinga; inywe mubahe ebyokurya.

english: But many deceivers have gone out of the world and have not believed that Jesus Christ came as a human being. He is the deceiver and the Enemy of Christ.
lunyoro: baitu abagobya baingi bakaturukira omu nsi, nibo batarukwatura ngu Yesu Kristo aizira omu mubiri. Ogu nuwe nugobya noomunyanzigwa wa Kristo.

english: The king sent a soldier to arrest him, and he ordered him to be brought before his head. So he went off and cut the head off in prison.
lunyoro: Mukama yatuma serikale owomubaduma, naragira okuleta omutwegwe; yagenda yamucwaho omutwe omu nju yenkomo,

english: Then the twelve disciples called the crowd to Jesus and said, “We must not neglect the preaching of God's word in order to handle finances.”
lunyoro: Kandi ikumi nababiri baketa namberebali ekitebe ekyabegeswa, nibagamba ntu Tikisemera itwe okuleka ekigambo kya Ruhanga okuhereza emeza.

english: But if some of those who do not believe invite you to go, and you want to go, eat everything that is set before you, without asking questions about the truth.
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abo abtarukuikiriza obwaba nabeta, nainywe obumwenda okugenda, kandi inywe numugonza okugenda, murye byona ebitairwe omu maiso ganyu, mutarukukaguza ekigambo obwomutima.

english: The servant who had received two thousand coins came and said, ‘Sir, you have deposited two thousand coins. Here I have earned two thousand other coins.’
lunyoro: Yaija nogu ayahairwe etaranta ibiri, yagamba ati Mukama wange okansigira etaranta bibiri; dora nkagobamu etaranta zibiri ezindi.

english: For this reason a woman should be able to be a sign of authority on her head because of the angels.
lunyoro: habwa kinu kisemerire omukazi okuba nakokuro'raho akamani ha mutwe habwa bamaraika.

english: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering this against Jesus, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bahu'ra ebitebe nibagambirangana bati haruwe; banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo batuma abaduma okumukwata.

english: They threw the robe on Jesus' head and placed a crown on him in his right hand. They threw their hands on him and kissed him, saying, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: Baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: The army officer said to himself, ‘What shall I do, because my master has come to dismiss me? I am not strong enough to dig around, and I am ashamed to beg.’
lunyoro: Yagamba omu ndaye ati Ndakora nta, baitu omukama wange anyakire obuketo? Tinyina mani gokulima; kandi nkwatwa ensoni okulega.

english: But when I boast about him in all I have done, I am not ashamed of him. As we have told you all the truth, so our boasting in Titus about the truth has been based on truth.
lunyoro: Baitu obunayenyumize omu kigambo kyona habwanyu haruwe, ntakwate ensoni; baitu nkokutwabagambire inywe byona omu mazima, nukwo nokwenyumiza kwaitu hali Tito kukaba kuli kwa mazima.

english: But whoever will not betray one of these little ones who believe in me should be put in prison for a large millstone tied around his neck and be drowned in the deep sea.
lunyoro: Baitu wena alitabaijura omu hali banu abato abarukunyikiriza, hakire bamubohe omu bikya orubengo orukoto, bamunage omu nziha yenyanja.

english: Two women will be grinding grain, one will be taken away, the other will be left behind.”
lunyoro: Abakazi baliba babiri nibasahamu; omu alitwarwa, ondi alisingwa.

english: The Pharisees said to one another, “Look how weak he is! He is not good at all! Look! The whole world is following him!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bagambirangana ngu Murole okumutarukusobora na kake; dora, ensi yona nemukuratira.

english: That is why I left you in Crete, so that you might make everything else beautiful and appoint elders in every town.
lunyoro: Ekyo nakulekire omu Kulete osemeze ebyasigalire, kandi oteho abakuru omu mbuga zoona,

english: The priest of Zeus, who was in front of the city, brought oxen and oxen on the gates, and tried to kill the people with the sword.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara wa Zeu akaba ali omu maiso gorubuga akaleta ente nemikako eyebyakyo ha malembo nayenda okusara ekyonzira hamu nebitebe.

english: They tried to find out what had happened to the twelve apostles, but soon afterward they returned and found about five thousand men.
lunyoro: Kandi obubagarukire okurora nibarora ebifuna amakumi abiri: kandi obwahinguireho kakaito bagaruka okulenga ebifuba ikumi na bitano.

english: But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and to let him remain under guard until I send him to the Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: You know that after his death he wanted to receive a blessing from God, because he did not see him repent, and he went back home and wept bitterly.
lunyoro: Baitu mu manyire ngu hanyuma obuyagondeze okugwetwa omugisa akangwe, ( baitu atabone hokwegarukiramu) nobuyaguseruire noku'ra muno.

english: He first found his brother Simon and said to him, “We have found the Messiah.” (This is what it means to say that Jesus is the Messiah.)
lunyoro: Yabona okubanza mugenziwe Simoni, yamugambira ati Tuzoire Masiya ( nukwo kugamba obukimanyisibwa ngu Kristo)

english: Leave all my belongings to the poor, and go to the streets. During the time of harvest I will tell the servants to gather first the wheat and put it in order to get the wheat for themselves, because the harvest is ready for me to harvest.
lunyoro: Muleke binyete byona, bihike ha magesa: omu biro ebyokugesa ndigambira abagesi nti Mubanze musoroze emberya, muzibohe enganda bazokye: baitu oburo mubuhunike oku maguli gange.

english: Jesus said to them, “My soul is deeply troubled, and it will be very hot for me. Stay here and keep watch.”
lunyoro: Kandi yabagambira ati Omutima gwange gunyina obujune bwingi, bibuija okunyita: muikalege hanu, murole.

english: They have authority to shut up the sky so that no rain can come down during the time of their preaching. They have authority over the springs of water to turn the earth into blood, and to make the earth and all the heavenly bodies suffer, as often as they wish.
lunyoro: Banu bayina obusobozi okuiga'ra iguru, enjura ereke okugwa omu biro byokugamba kwabu: kandi bayinaobusobozi ha maizi okugafora esagama, nokutuntuza ensi nemihito yona, emirundi mingi nkokubaragonzaga.

english: There are so many things we have to say to you, which are hard to tell, but you have become dull of hearing.
lunyoro: Tunyina ebigambo bingi okumugambaho, kandi ebirukulemera okubimanyisa, baitu inywe mufokere abafu bamatu.

english: He had been seen for a long time by those who were with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now witnesses to the people.
lunyoro: kandi yarorwa ebiro bingi abo abatembere nauwe, okuruga Galiraya okuhika Yerusalemu,nibo bakaisobe hati bunu hali abantu.

english: But some of the churches there stirred up discussions with Stephen.
lunyoro: baitu hakaimuka abamu abomu iso'rokaniro erinyakwetwa Eryabalibetini Nabakulene Nabalegezanderiya, Neryabakirikiya, naba Asiya, batera empaka na Sitefano.

english: I will never fail to thank you, and I will remember you in my prayers.
lunyoro: sireka okusima habwanyu, nimbaijuka omu kusaba kwange:

english: So then, even though I am being put right with God, I am not alone, but I am with the Father, who sent me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nobundaba nincwa omusango, omusango gwange tiguli gwange nyenka, baitu tuli hamu na Isenyowe ayantumire.

english: He left the prison and went off to the prison, where he had been put to death. But Jesus gave him over to them to do what they wanted him to do.
lunyoro: Yasumu'ra ogu ayanagirwe omu nju yenkomo okuita, obuyamuhaireyo okuko'ra nkokubayenzire.

english: Moses commanded you to circumcise a boy, not Moses, but your ancestors; and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.
lunyoro: Moses nikyo yabaherire okusara ( tukuli kwa Musa, baitu nukwo kwa baisenkuru inywe); kandi ha Sabiti musara omuntu.

english: While Jesus was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream. “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife, because what is in her is the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba natekereza ebi, dora, maraika wa Mukama Yamubonekera omu kiroto, nagamba ati Yusufu, omwana wa Daudi, otatina okutwara Maryamu mukazi wawe, baitu ekiri omundaye Kyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: Believe me, then, that I am in the Father, and the Father is in me; and you believe me only because of what I do.
lunyoro: Munyikirize ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, na isenyowe omuli nyowe: rundi munyikirize habwemirimo yonka.

english: When the Roman army officer saw what had happened, he praised God, saying, “I know that this man was a good man.”
lunyoro: Kandi omunyakihanda Omurumi obuyaboine ebyabaireho, yanyumiza Ruhanga nagamba ati Mananukwo onu abaire omuntu ahikirire.

english: The next day Cornelius was waiting for them, so he gathered his relatives and his friends and friends together.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri Koruneryo akaba nabategereza, amazire okusoroza aborugandarwe nabakaba abri enganjanize.

english: “You are worthy, Lord our God, to receive glory and honor and power. You have created all things and have come down to life, just as you pleased.
lunyoro: Osemire, ai Mukama Ruhanga waitu, okuhabwa ekitinisa nokutinwa nobusobozi: baitu niwe wahangire byona, kandi nkokuwagondeze bikabaho, kandi bikahangwa.

english: Try to enter the closed door, because many people will try to enter, but they will not be able.
lunyoro: Mwekambe okutaha omu irembo erifunzire: baitu nimbagambira nti Baingi abalise'ra okutahamu, tibalisobora.

english: The apostles and the others who followed them spoke up, “Praise God! God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord!
lunyoro: Nabakaba bebembire, nabali abakuratire, bagambire nabali abo, bagambira haiguru ngu Hosana; Ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: But if you have something, you will receive it; but if you do not, you will have it, and you will have it.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuina, nuwe alihebwa: akandi atanyina, aliihibwaho nakyo ekyanyinakyo.

english: These are the things that are like these in these modern times. They are like sweet-smelling incense and sweet-smelling incense offered to God, who is the source of all praise.
lunyoro: eki nikyo kisisani omu biro bya hati bunu: nikyo bahongera ebisembo nebyonzira ebitarukusobora okuhikiriza arukuramya omu bigambo byona:

english: I was so happy about you, sir, that you now have thought about me and lost all time.
lunyoro: Baitu nkasemererwa muno omu Mukama waitu, baitu hata bunu mugarukire okutekereza mukatekereza mali, kyonka mubuzirweho omwanya.

english: That is why you should give money to the poor, and I should receive it back with interest when I came.
lunyoro: kandi nikyo kyakuhikirire okuha abaguzi efeza yange, nanyowe obunakuizire nakuhairwe eyange namagoba gayo.

english: The one who sent me is what he wanted: ‘Do not lose anything he gave me, but I will raise him to life on the last day.’”
lunyoro: Ayantumire ekyagonza nikyo kinu ngu Ha kyona ekyampaire haleke okuburaho na kake, baitu nkiimukye ha kiro kya hampero.

english: You gave him authority over all people, so that he might give eternal life to all those you gave him.
lunyoro: nkokuwamuhaire obusobozi ha banyakuina omubiri bona, bona abamuhaire, abahe obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: In this way we will celebrate the Passover, not with bread made from the heart and the mouth of evil, but with things that will not be offered to idols nor to the truth.
lunyoro: nukwo tucumbe obugenyi, hatali nekititumbisa ekiitima nobubi, baitu nebitatumbisibwa ebyobutagobya namazima.

english: Then he poured out water into a pot and began to wash the disciples' feet and to wipe them with the bread that Jesus had prepared for them.
lunyoro: Kandi yasesa amaizi omu kanabiro, yabanza kubanabisa ebigere abegeswa, nokubisisiriza ekikoba ekyakaba ayetegeseze.

english: Luke, the highly respected teacher, and Demas, who helped them.
lunyoro: Ruka, omufumu arukugonzebwa, na Dema babaramukize.

english: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all his house.
lunyoro: yayesigwa hali ogu ayamutaireho, nka Musa okwakabali owokwesiga omu njuye yona.

english: The owner praised that dishonest manager for his wisdom. The people of this world are much more shrewd than the people of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi mukamawe akanyumiza omuketo ogu atali wokuhiki'ra, baitu akagira amagezi: baitu abana abensi enu, omu businge bwabu, nibakira amagezi abana abomusana.

english: and the power of God. He is at the right and the left, fighting for what is right.
lunyoro: hati omu mani ga Ruhanga: obwebyokurwanisa ebyokuhiki'ra ha mukono ogwoburyo, nomukono ogwemoso,

english: Listen, my dear friends! God has not given the world's poor people the rich in faith, and the rich in the Kingdom has promised to those who love him.
lunyoro: Muhu'le bene baitu abarukugonzabwa; Ruhanga atako nemu abanaku abensi okubaabaguda obwokuikiriza? nabagwetwa abobukama obuyaraganize abo abanyakumugonza?

english: While they were in Samaria, they proclaimed God's message in the synagogues of the Jews, and they were with John the Baptist, a priest for them.
lunyoro: Obukaba bali Saramini, batebeza ekigambo kya Ruhanga omu maso'rokaniro Gabayudaya: kandi bakaba bali na Yohana, omuhereza wabu.

english: If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have been with them in the blood of the prophets.
lunyoro: Kakuba tukaba turoho omubiro bya baisenkuruitwe, titwakuteraine hamu nabo omu sagama eya banabi.

english: But they did not do it, because they put heavy loads on the shoulders and put them on the shoulders, but did not want to put them on the shoulders with a finger to help them.
lunyoro: Baitu baboha enketo ezirukulemera, bazita ha mabega; baitu bo tibenda kuzitweka nomu.

english: Blind people and those who are foolish do not love one another, and do not despise one another.
lunyoro: abasisa ebi baragana, abatagonzangana, abatayina kuganyira:

english: The whole church and all who heard these things was filled with fear.
lunyoro: Nokutina kwingi kukakwata ekanisa yona na bona abahulire ebi.

english: But if you believed Moses, you would also believe me, because he wrote this for me.
lunyoro: Kakuba muikirize Musa, nanyowe mwakunyikirize; baitu akahandikira nyowe.

english: They will run away from the Devil's trap, after which he will lead you into doing what he wants you to do.
lunyoro: kandi balitami'ruka okuruga omu ndubatira ya Setani, ogu obuyamazire okubahamba okukora nkoli okuyagondeze.

english: I remembered what the Lord had said: “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi naijuka ekigambo kya Mukama waitu nkokuyagambire ati Mananukwo Yohana akabatiza namaizi; baitu inywe mulibatizibwa Nomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: For in the same way at that time God made the Son of Man, who was born as a human being, and is now the source of the Spirit.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro biri nkogu ayazairwe omubiri okuyahairwe Omwana womuntu, nukwo nukwo na hati bunu abalize omu Mwoyo.

english: The voice spoke again from heaven, “Do not consider anything unclean that God has declared unclean.”
lunyoro: Baitu iraka ryangarukamu omurundi ogwakabiri, niriruga omu iguru liti Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora ebyomuziro iwe.

english: When Jesus saw her, he loved her, and said to her, “You have only one left. Go and sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamurozire yamugonza, yamugambira ati Obuzirerweho kimu; genda, ogule byona ebyonyinabyo, ogabire abasege, kandi iwe olitunga itungao omu iguru:

english: For a man must not cover his head, but he is a copy of God's glory. For a woman is a man's glory.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo omusaija tikimusemerire okwesweke'ra omutwe, baitu nuwe kisisani nekitinisa kya Ruhanga: baitu omukazi kiba kitinisa kyomusaija.

english: For the first time he must suffer much and be rejected by the people of this world.
lunyoro: Baitu okubanza kimuhikirire okusalizibwa bingi nokuhakanwa abobusinge bunu.

english: All the people on earth will worship it, except those whose names have not been written in the book of the living which belongs to the Lamb who has been killed since the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abaikara hansi balikiramya, wena atahandikirwe ibararyeomukitabu kyobwomezi Ekyokwana Gwentama ayaisirwe okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi.

english: The servants were so angry that they came to him and said, “Sir, don't you put a fine robe in your name, because it wasn't right for us to have any bread?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale banyineka baija nibamugambira ngu Tata, otasige mbibo esemire omu ruharo rwawe, baitu ekaba eta okubamu emberya?

english: But what does it mean to say that your sins have been forgiven or to say, “Get up and walk?”
lunyoro: Baitu ekirahuka kiraha? Okugamba nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho, rundi okkugamba nti Imuka ogende?

english: He will not go into anything that is unclean, nor commit adultery with a woman. Instead, they will be written in the Lamb's book of the living.
lunyoro: kandi tihalitahamu na kake ekintu kyona ekitali kisemeri, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyomuziro nebisuba: rundi abo bonka bahandikwa omu kitabu ekyobwomezi Ekyomwana Gwentama.

english: Out of the same mouth come forth cursing and cursing. My friends, these things ought not to happen to you.
lunyoro: Omu kanwa kamu numwo harugamu okukugia nokukyena. Bene baitu ebi tibisemerire okuikara biti.

english: Jesus answered, “If I were to boast about myself, my glory would not be destroyed. It is my Father who makes me great. You have said that I am your God, and you do not know him.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Obundaba ninyenyumiza nyenka, okwenyumiza kwange kubakwa busa: Isenyowe nuwe a'nyumiza: inywe oumugambire ngu nuwe Ruhanga wanyu kandi timukamumanyaga,

english: When Apollos was in Corinth, Paul went to Ephesus and found some of his disciples.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika Aporo obwakaba ali Kolinso, Pauro obuyarabire omunsi ezeruguru yahika Efeso, nasanga abegeswa abamu:

english: The official answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself or about someone else?”
lunyoro: Omukonwa yagarukamu Firipo nagamba ati Nkwesengerize, nabi akagamba hali oha ebigambo binu? bye wenka, rundi byomuntu ondi?

english: always give thanks to God the Father for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: musima ebiro byona obwa byona, omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo hali Ruhanga, kansi Isitwe;

english: Some time later King Agrippa and Bernice arrived in Caesarea and greeted Festus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubyahinguireho ebiro ebimu, Agulipa omukama na Berenike bakahika Kaisaliya, baramukya Fesito.

english: Philip answered him, “For two hundred silver coins he did not need to pay you, and for a little while we all did.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ari Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: So Jesus left and saw a large crowd; he was moved with pity for them, and healed their sick.
lunyoro: Yarugayo, yarora ekitebe kingi, yabaganyira, nakiza abarwaire babu,

english: We heard a voice from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
lunyoro: kandi iraka eri itwe tukalihu'ra niriruga omu iguru, obutukaba tuli hamu nauwe harusozi orurukwera.

english: He has entrusted us with everything that he has entrusted to us in all his wisdom and insight.
lunyoro: eziyasigisize namberetuli omu magezi gona nokwetegereza kwona,

english: Instead, each one of you should be able to carry out his own work, and then you should boast about yourself, because no one else is there.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena ayerengere omulimogwe wenka, kandi nukwo abe nokwenyumizakwe habwe wenkaga, kunu tihali habwondi.

english: so that they may open their eyes and turn from their sins and turn from the darkness to the light and from the power of Satan to God, so that they may be put right with God and be put right with God by those who are his people, believing in me.
lunyoro: azi'le amaiso gabu, baruge omu muirima okuhindukira omusana, nokuruga omu busoboza bwa Setani okuhindukire Ruhanga, bahebwe okuihibwaho ebibi, nobuwetwa omuli abo abanyakwezibwe obwokuikiriza nyowe.

english: For this is what God has promised: ‘At the right time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.’”
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nugwo murago ngu Nkebiro binu okubiri, nubwo ndiija, kandi Sara aliba nomwana.

english: Two or three prophets told each other and others told them what had happened.
lunyoro: Banabi batebezege rundi babiri rundi basatu, nabandi bategereze.

english: Jesus said to them, “I would like to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nokwegomba nyegombere okulira hamu nainywe Okuhingurwaho kunu ntakasalizibwe:

english: One night he came to Jesus and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a teacher sent by God. No one can perform miracles unless God lives with him.
lunyoro: ogu akaija namberali ekiro, namugambira ati Rabi, tumanyire iwoli mwegesa ayarugire hali Ruhanga: baitu busaho muntu asobora okukora obwokuro'raho obwokora, rundi Ruhanga obwaikara nauwe.

english: After saying this, Jesus went away and called Mary privately, "The Teacher is here and is calling you.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati Omwegesa aizire, nakweta.

english: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. But they had already decided that if anyone said that he was the Messiah, he would be expelled from the synagogue.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire nikyo bagambire ebi obwokutina Abayudaya:baitu Abayuuda bakaba bamazire kuhanura ngu Omuntu wena obwaramugambagambaga ati nuwe Kristo abingi bwege omu iso'rokaniro.

english: I do not refuse to confess God's grace, because if by the Law the Messiah had been put to death, he would have died.
lunyoro: Tindukuburanganiza embabazi za Ruhanga: baitu kuba okuhiki'ra kwabaireho obwebiragiro, Kristo yakuferire busa.

english: The Son of Man will send out his angels and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that will not be destroyed.
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu alituma bamaraikabe, kandi baliiha omu bukamabwe byona ebitabaijura,

english: He himself gave himself as a ransom for all, and the message will be preached in all its forms.
lunyoro: yayehaireyo wenka okubaekicunguro ekya bona; okumanisa kulibaho omu mpiko zakwo:

english: Jesus answered, “There are ten who are not good, but eight who are good.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Ikumi tibasemezibwege, baitu munana.

english: After they had eaten a meal, they took him down to the bed where the paralyzed man was lying.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okugisesa, bamusirirmu'ra ha kitabu ekyakaba abyamireho anyakuzingamire.

english: When the angel who talked with Jesus went on to meet him, he called two of his family members together and said, “Be on your guard against those who will persecute you.
lunyoro: Kandi maraika ayabalize nauwe obuyagenzire, yayeta abairube babiri abomu nju, na muserukale omwerinzi hali abo abamuherezaga obutosa;

english: You are our glory and our joy.
lunyoro: Baitu ninywe kitinisa kyaitu nokusemererwa kwaitu.

english: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where people should worship.
lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe baramyaga ha rusozi runu; nainywe mugamba ngu Ha Yerusalemu nuho Kisemereire abantu okuramizaga.

english: That is why I did not consider myself worthy to come to you, so that my servant will get well.
lunyoro: ndi nikyo ntayetekererize nyenka okuseme'ra okuija nambo kwonka, omwojo wange arakira.

english: “Sir,” she answered, “I believe,” and she healed him.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Mukama wange ninyikiriza. Yamuramya.

english: and teach them to obey all that I have commanded you. And I am with you always, to the end of the age.
lunyoro: nibaegesa okukwata byona ebinabaragire; kandi dora, nyowe ndi hamu nainywe ebiro byona, okuhikya obusinge bunu obubulihwaho.

english: Two other men who had committed a crime were also taken along with Jesus to be put to death.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho abandi babiri abakozire kubi, abatwairwe hamu nauwe okuitwa.

english: For I tell you the Gentiles. As long as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I honor my own self-will.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe Abamahanga. Nukwo nyowe obumba ndi omukwenda hali Abamahanga, ninyumiza obukwenda bwange:

english: But you, my friends, don't let them do good.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe bene baitu mutajwaha okukora kurungi.

english: He threw himself down at Jesus' feet and thanked him, and he was a Samaritan.
lunyoro: yayeme'ra ha bigerebye, namusima: nogu akabali Musamaliya.

english: Those who think about the night should think about the Lord, and those who eat the Lord's Supper should eat the Lord's Supper, because they give thanks to God. Those who do not eat the Lord's Supper do not eat the Lord's Supper, and those who do not eat the Lord's Supper do not eat the Lord's Supper.
lunyoro: Anyakutekereza ekiro, akitekereza habwa Mukama waitu: kandi anyakurya, arya habwa mukama waitu, baitu asima Ruhanga; kandi atarukurya, tarya habwomukama waitu kandi asima.

english: Here the dead will be given a tenth, but there will be given to those who are told that they are alive.
lunyoro: Kandi hanu abantu abafa bahabwa ebicweka biikumi, baitu kuli abihabwa arukumanyisibwa ngu ali mwomezi.

english: I know him, and I know that he has been raised from death, and I am like him.
lunyoro: manyire okwarukusisana, nomu kuhumbuka kwabafu, kandi ninsisanizibwa nauwe:

english: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell on his knees before Jesus and said, “I am leaving, because I am a man who has my Lord's sins forgiven.”
lunyoro: Kandi Simon Petero obuyakiboine, yainama ha maju ga Yesu, nagamba ati Ndugaho; baitu ndimuntu anyakuina ebibi Mukama wange.

english: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to receive from them his share of the harvest. But the tenants beat him and sent him back without a thing.
lunyoro: Kandi omwaka obugukaba gumalize okuhika, yatuma omuiru rubale hali abalimi bamuhe ha byana ebyorugonjo rwemizabibu: baitu abalimi bakamutera, bamubinga atakwasire kintu.

english: Jesus answered him, “Lord, do you believe?”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Mukama wange araba muikiriza?

english: Three days later Festus went to Jerusalem and left Caesarea.
lunyoro: Nubwo Fesito obuyahikire omu isaza, ebiro bisatu bihinguireho yatemba Yerusalemu, arugire Kaisaliya.

english: Actually, there is no gospel except the Good News; there are some who make you sad and want to change the gospel of Christ.
lunyoro: enjiri endi teriyo, baitu haroho abandi abarukubatuntuza,nibagonza okuhindura kubi enjiri ya Kristo.

english: For we are no longer proud of you, but we have given you a chance to boast about ourselves, so that you may have an answer for those who boast about things that are above, but not on your conscience.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukugaruka okwenyumiza itwenka halinywe, baitu tubahaire inywe omwanya gwokwenyumiza habwaitu, nukwo mube nekyokugarukamu abo abanyakwenyumiriza ebyaharuguru, kunu tihali omu mutima.

english: My dear friend is always doing a faithful and faithful work in every way possible for the believers and the guests.
lunyoro: Arukugonzebwa nokora omulimo ogwokwesiga omu byona ebyokora habwabu bene baitu kandi abagenyi:

english: “No one in your group is called by that name,” they answered.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Busaho omuli bene banyu ayetwa ibara eri.

english: You have brought these men here who have not broken the walls or robbed our master's wife.
lunyoro: Baitu mulesere abantu banu, abatanyagire ebyomu mabandiro, nobukwakuba okujuma omucwezi waitu omukazi.

english: But to those who do what is good, praise and glory, honor and peace, it is the first time that a Jew or a Gentile is circumcised.
lunyoro: baitu okusimwa nekitinisa nobusinge hali wena arukukora okurungi, okubanza Omuyudaya, kandi Nomuyonani:

english: There was no excuse for you, not even for everyone else, but for God, who is faithful and will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. For with God's help you will be able to endure, so that you will be able to endure.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho ekyohyo ekikaba kibakwasire inywe, ekitali kyabantu bona; baitu Ruhanga wokwesiga, atalibaleka okwohebwa okukira ekimusobora; baitu hamu nokwohebwa alitaho hokuirukira, nukwo musobole okuguma.

english: So then, the overseer must be without fault, as a husband who is not his wife; he must be a husband who is not his wife; he must be a humble, hospitable, and hospitable; he must be a good leader and a good teacher. He must not be a drunkard or a glutton;
lunyoro: Nukwo kihikirire omurolerezi okutabaho ekyokuhanwa, abe musaija womukazi omu, atali mutamizi, omwerinzi, akunira abagenyi, wamagezi okwegesa; atakunganira amarwa, atatera;

english: So Joseph went from Galilee to Nazareth and went to Judea to the town of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was a guest in the house.
lunyoro: Yusufu akaruga omu Galiya natabara, arugire omu rubuga rwa Nazalesi, nataha omu Buyudaya hali orubuga rwa Baudi orwetwa Beterehemu, baitu akaba ali womu nju, kandi

english: Put on the complete suit of armor from God, a worker who is not ashamed of his work, who is able to handle the word of truth correctly.
lunyoro: Jwara kurungi omu maiso ga Ruhanga, omukozi atarukukwatwa ensoni, anyakusobo'ra kurungi ekigambo kyamazima.

english: And now the weeds are gathered at the roots of the trees. So every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu empango etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire guratemwa, guranagwa omu mu'ro.

english: Then Jesus began to say to the crowds about John, “Why did you go out into the desert to see if the time for the burning bush had not been prepared for you?”
lunyoro: Kandi abakwenda okugenda, Yabanza okugambira ebitebe ha Yohana ati Mukagenderayo ki omu irungu okurora? Orume orurukutengesebwa embeho?

english: But they did not welcome him, because he had seen him in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu batamutangi'le baitu amaisoge gakaba garozire Yerusalemu.

english: Publius' father was sick with a fever. Paul went in to him, prayed, placed his hands on him, and buried him.
lunyoro: Kandi ise Pubulio akaba abyamire arwaire omusuija nensese: Pauro yataha nemberali, yasaba, namutaho emikonoye, yamuzika.

english: Do not be like children who are disobedient; instead, do not be like those who have no desire to marry, because they do not know God.
lunyoro: nkabana abokuhu'ra mutarukwesaniza nkokwegomba kwanyu okwaira okukuli, omu kutamanya kwanya:

english: Jesus said, “Let those who have authority in you go to me and accuse that man of any sin he has committed.”
lunyoro: Abalemi omulinywe basirimuke nanyowe, kandi obwaraba omusaija ogu aroho ekibi kyona, bamulege.

english: He was changed in front of them, and his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became dazzling as the light.
lunyoro: yaye yahindurwa omu maiso gabu: amaisoge nigamulikana nkizoba, nebyokujwarabye nibyera nkomusana.

english: Then come out of the cross, and come on out of the cross.
lunyoro: Rubata ha muti oye june wenka.

english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, because he was about to die.
lunyoro: Obuyahulire ngu Yesu arugire omu Buyudaya, aizire galiraya yagenda namberali, yamwesengereza asirimuke, akize omwanawe; baitu akaba amalize okufa.

english: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John, they recognized that they were ordinary people who did not know what they were reading or were not taught, and they were surprised to know that they were with Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine obumanzi bwa Petero na Yohana, babamanyire okuba bantu abatamanyire okusoma, kandi abatakegesebwaga, batangara; babamanyi'ra nibo baikaraga na Yesu.

english: There was a man named Zacchaeus, who was rich and rich.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, hakaba haroho omusaija ibararye Zakayo; akabali omuhoza omukuru, kandi omuguda.

english: A man who was lame from birth had been carried by his mother, and the next day they threw him out of the Temple treasury, which is called the Holy Place, to tell the people who had come to the Temple to be punished.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akabali omulema okuruga omu nda ya nyina akaba bamuhimbire, oubabyamyaga obukyabukya ha ruigi orwa yekaru orurukwetwa Orurungi, okulega ebyokuganyira hali abo atahaga omu yekaru.

english: I was in Joppa praying, and I saw something coming down that looked like a large sheet being lowered from heaven and coming down to me.
lunyoro: Nkaba ndi omu harubuga Yopa ninsaba: omutima gwange gukahingisibwa, narora omu kwolekwa ekintu nikisirimuka, ekisisana nkorugoye orukoto orutebwa okuruga haiguru, kandi kyaizira nyowe:

english: “Lord,” Peter asked, “does this parable apply to us, or should it affect everyone?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero yagamba ati Mukama waitu orufumo runu norutucwera itwe, nandiki bona?

english: “Sir,” they answered, “give us this bread and this water!”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Mukama waitu otuhege obutosa ebyokurya ebi.

english: For the poor always have theirs, but the always have no place in me.
lunyoro: Baitu abamasege nibo munyinabo ebiro byona; baitu timunyina nyowe ebiro byona

english: Jesus knew that they were going to ask him questions, so he said to them, “Why do you ask one another, ‘ Why did you say that it was only a little while ago, and you will not see it, and then a little while later you will see it?’
lunyoro: Yesu yamanya nibenda okumukaguza, yabagambira ati Nimukaguzangana inywenka habweki ekingambire nti Hasigaireho akacu kake, timundole, kandi halibaho akacu kike, mulindora?

english: For there are some who are saved by the power of their mothers, and others who have been made by human beings; others who have been saved by the Kingdom of heaven. Those who can believe and believe will receive it.
lunyoro: Baitu haroho abakonerwe abazairwe bai okuruga omu nda za banyinabo: haroho abakuzibwe abantu: harho abakonerwemu abayekonere bonka obwobukama obwomu iguru. Anyakusobora okukiikiriza akiikirize.

english: We ourselves boast about you in the churches of God because of your endurance and faith, and because of all your trials and sufferings.
lunyoro: naitwe itwenka ntwenyumiriza omulinywe omu kanisa za ruhanga, obwokugumisiriza kwanyu nokuikiriza, omu kuhigwa kwanyu kwona nomuhito ebimucule'ra:

english: For the saying is true, ‘Someone will leave and others will praise you.’
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nukwo kya mananu ngu Ondi asiga, Ondi agesa.

english: And you say, ‘Whoever tells his father or mother, ‘All you have given me is for God's sake.’
lunyoro: Kandi inywe mugamba ngu Wena obwaligambira ise rundi nyina ati Kyona ekinakukuhaire okukugasira nkihongire Ruhanga,

english: And so I tell you that many will come from the east and the west and sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: Nanyowe nimbagambira nti Baingi abaliruga burugaizoba na bugwaizoba, baliika'ra hamu na Iburahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, omu bukama obwomu iguru:

english: In the same way, to those who now have been forgiven by God for your sins, they too have been forgiven.
lunyoro: nukwo nabo hati bunu kuganyirwa okumwahairwe inywe, bo bahebwe okuganyirwa

english: In the same way, in the past God's holy women who served God stirred up their passions for themselves and treated them with contempt.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro byaira nukwo nabakazi abarukwera abanihiraga Ruhanga bayecumaga bati, nibarobera abaibabu bonka:

english: Whoever has this hope in him will be glad just as he is happy.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena anyakuina okunihira oku haruwe ayesemeza nkauwe okwasemezibwe.

english: When Jesus came in, he asked them, “Why are you screaming and saying evil things? The child is not dead, but only asleep.”
lunyoro: kandi obuyatahiremu yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubanziza nekirukubaliza? Omuisiki tafire, agwijagire kwonka.

english: We found a ship sailing back to Phoenicia, where we sailed and got on.
lunyoro: kandi obutwasangire ekyombo. nikyambuka okugenda Foiniki, twakigwe'ramu, twahanika amaberu.

english: For I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife or marries another woman commits adultery. But whoever marries a woman commits adultery against her commits adultery against her.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti omuntu wena anyakubinga omukaziwe, rundi obwokusihana, buli amusihanize: nogu anyakumuswera abingirwe, buli asihaine.

english: For I have not spoken on my own behalf, but the Father who sent me has given me the authority to speak and to speak.
lunyoro: baitu ntagambe habwange, rundi Isenyowe ayanyumire, nuwe yandagire okungamba, kandi okumbaza.

english: The woman left her water jar and went back home and told the people,
lunyoro: kandi omukazi yasiga omunagagwe, yagenda omu kika, yagambira abantu ati,

english: Then Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone about him.
lunyoro: kandi yabatere'ra batagambiraho muntu haruwe.

english: He was like a god in his own likeness, who firmly establishs all things and the word of his power. After he has put away sin, he sits down at the right side of the heavenly Kingdom.
lunyoro: ndi ogu obwakaba ali okwangasana okwekitinisakye, nekisisanikye mali nkokwali, kandi nuwe arukugumyaho ebintu byona nekigambo kyobusobozibwe, obuyamazire okukora ekyokwegyaho ebibi, yaika'ra ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwobukuru obwahaiguru;

english: Those who believe in me, as the scripture says, will come out of their source of life.
lunyoro: Anyakuikiriza nyowe, nkekyahandikire okukugamba, omundaye nuho halituruka ebyambu ebyamaizi agomire.

english: Or perhaps you will say to your brother, ‘Please let me take that speck out of your eye,’ and, ‘Look, here is the log in your own eye.’
lunyoro: Rundi olimugambira ota mutahi wawe ngu Kanyiheho akantu akali haliso ryawe; kandi, dora enyomyo ikaire ha liso ryawe?

english: “Why, then, do you ask, ‘Why are you going to punish someone else? Who is going to decide for himself what you want me to do?’
lunyoro: Nukwo oragambira oti Kiki ekirukumuhanisa kandi? Baitu noha ayemera ebyagonza?

english: “Look! The reward for those who work hard is what you gave them to do, because you have kept them from speaking up; and their reward, which they gave to the poor, has come to the ears of the Lord of lords.”
lunyoro: Dora, empera yabakozi abatemere emisiri yanyu, eyimwabaimire negambira haiguru: nempamo yabu abagesere etahire omu matu Mukama owamahe.

english: Those who give up their way are the ones who have already heard; then the Devil comes and takes away the message from their hearts, so that they will not believe and be saved.

english: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
lunyoro: Obutugamba ngu titukasisaga, tumufora omubihi webisuba, kandi ekigambokye tikiri omulitwe.

english: The commander said, “I have been given this Kingdom with many things!” But Paul answered, “But I have been born that way.”
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Nyowe nkatunga Oburumi bunu nebintu bingi. Kandi Pauro yagamba ati Baitu nyowe nukwo nazairwe.

english: He trusts in God, and he is saved now and he loves him. For he said, “I am the Son of God.”
lunyoro: Akesiga Ruhanga; amujune hati bunu, araba namugonza: baitu akagamba ati Ninyowe Mwana wa Ruhanga.

english: For we who have died are in Christ's death, in order that the life of Jesus may be made perfect through our mortal bodies.
lunyoro: Kandi itwe abomire tuhebwayo obutosa hali okufa habwa Yesu: nukwo obwomezi bwa Yesu bwolekwe omu mibiri yaitu eyokufa.

english: For those days will be troubled, when God was a father of the nations that were before them; and it will not be.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebi biriba byobujune, ebitakabahoga biti Ruhanga akaba okuhanga ebyahangirwe, na hati hona, kandi tibiribaho.

english: “Why did you go out into the desert to weep? A man dressed in fancy clothes? Look! The men who have worn the robe are in palaces!
lunyoro: baitu mukagenderayo ki omu irungu okurra? Omusaija ajwaire engoye ezirukworoba? Dora, abo abajwara engoye ziri omu maju gabakama.

english: Jesus said to them, “I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are the first to enter the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati mananukwo nimbagambira nti Abahoza nabasihani nibabanza inywe okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: For God has put everyone in danger of being put right with him, in order to bring him back to their senses.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga okaboha bona omu kutahu'ra, agaruke aganyire bona.

english: But Peter and John answered, “If it is good, God will make sure that you obey him,” and said to them, “do not consider yourselves superior to God.
lunyoro: Baitu Petero na Yohana bagarukamu nibabagambira ngu Obukiraba kiri kirungi,omu maiso ga Ruhanga okuhu'ra inywe okukira Ruhanga mutekereze:

english: But he did not answer a single word, and the governor was completely amazed.
lunyoro: Baitu atagarukemu kigambo na kimu: nukwo nomulemi yahuni'ra muno.

english: But Jesus turned around and rebuked them, saying, “You don't know where you are going, because the Son of Man did not come to destroy the lives of the people, but to save them!”
lunyoro: Baitu yahinduka, yabahana [nagamba ati Timurukumanya mutima okuguli ogumunyinagwo. Baitu Omwana womuntu ataije okuhwerekereza obwomezi bwabantu, baitu okubujuna.]

english: In this way I will be saved from those who do not obey the Jewish authorities, and my service in Jerusalem is a blessing to the holy ones.
lunyoro: nukwo njunwe hali abo abatarukuhu'ra abomu Buyudaya, kandi okuhereza kwange okurukuntwara Yerusalemu kusimwe abarukwera;

english: Jesus healed many people who were sick with various diseases and drove out many demons. But he would not let the demons speak, because he knew him.
lunyoro: Yakiza baingi abakaba barwaire endwara ezindi nezindi, nabinga emizimu mingi: kandi ataikirize mizimu okugamba, baitu ekamumanya.

english: Jesus went in and said to him, “Peace be with you, Lord! You have been richly blessed!”
lunyoro: kandi obuyatahire omunju yamugambira ati Mirembe, iwe anyakuhairwe muno omugisa, Mukama (ali) naiwe.

english: Do not be lazy, and do not be filled with the Spirit. Serve the Lord.
lunyoro: hati omu kwekamba; mutagate omu mwoyo; muko'le Mukama;

english: The sick were brought to Jesus by the cloths of his body, and the evil spirits came out of them.
lunyoro: kandi baleta abarwaire ebikoba nebyatairwe ha mubirigwe, nemizimu emibi yabarugaho.

english: When the time came to gather together in the church, they met together and taught many people. The believers in Antioch began to call themselves Christians.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika, bakahikya omwaka gumu, bakesoroza hamu nabekanisa, nibegesa abantu baingi; kandi abegesebwa bakabandiza Antyokiya okwetwa Abakristayo.

english: Philip and Bartholomew, Thomas and Matthew the tax collector, James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus,
lunyoro: Firipo na Batoromayo; Tomasi na Matayo omuzinisa; Yakobo omwana wa Alifayo, na Sadayo;

english: After he had greeted them, he told them in a loud voice what God had done for the Gentiles through his service.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okubaramukya, yabagambira kimukimu Ruhanga ebiyakozire hali Abamahanga omu kuherezakwe.

english: And so you will be able to see that Christ's time for us is complete, not complete, but complete, with the Spirit of the living God, not only on stone stones but also on human hearts.
lunyoro: kandi mwolekerwe muli baruha ya Kristo, itwe eyitwaherize, etarahandikirwe nabwino, baitu Nomwoyo ogwa Ruhanga omwomezi, hatali ha mabale kwonka, baitu ha mabbale agemitima yomubiri.

english: God's people obey God's words, but do not obey them, because they belong to God.
lunyoro: Owa Ruhanga ahu'ra ebigambo bya Ruhanga: nikyo mutarukuhuli'ra baitu timuli ba ruhanga.

english: and heard his voice, and they went away. Those who have done good will be raised to life, and those who have done evil will be raised to life, and those who have done evil will be brought to life.
lunyoro: kandi obubalihuli'ramu irararye, balirugamu; abo abakozire okurungi hali okuhumbuka okwobwomezi; nabo abakolire okubi hali oku humbuka okwomusango; nabo abakukozire okubi hali okwenyuma.

english: Jesus spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Look! The man who sowed the seed is the one who will receive the harvest.
lunyoro: Yabaza nabo bingi omu nfumo, nagamba ati Dora, omusigi akatura okusiga;

english: “All the people were first given to drinking the good wine, and when the people drank from it, they went back and told him, ‘You have kept what was good until now.’
lunyoro: kandi abantu bona babanza okutaho amarwa amarungi: kandi abantu obubaiguta, bagaruka nibataho agabihire: iwe oyahuire amarungi okuhika hati bunu.

english: Mary Magdalene, and John, and Mary the mother of James; and the other women who were with them told these things to the apostles.
lunyoro: Maryamu Magasalene, na Yoana, na Maryamu nyina Yakobo: nabakazi abandi abakaba balinabo, bakatebeza abakwenda ebigambo ebi.

english: For God does not hold you responsible for the wrongs that people do, but in the same way he does.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokutahikira tibiri byokuhanwa omu maiso ga Ruhanga; Ruhanga taterwa enaku obwokusisa okutahikira.

english: When one of the young women saw him sitting there, there was a fire. She looked straight at him and said, “This man was with Jesus!”
lunyoro: Kandi omuisiki omu obuyamuboine aikalire nambere omu'ro gwakire, yamugumiza amaiso, nagamba ati Nonu abaire ali nauwe.

english: For those who want riches will fall into temptation and are caught in the trap of harmful habits, in order to make people lose their faith and give up.
lunyoro: Baitu abanyakugonza okutunga itungo bagwa omu kwohebwa nendubatira nokwegomba kwingi okwobutami okwakabi okurukusisa, okuibika abantu omu kubura nokuhwereke'ra

english: My God will supply you with everything you need, according to his riches in glory through Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga wange alihikiriza byona ebimutaga, nkobugudabwe okubuli omu kitinisa omu Kristo Yesu.

english: These will fight against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings. Those who are with him will overcome, called, and chosen, and faithful.
lunyoro: Banu balirwana Nomwana Gwentama, kandi Omwana Gwentu alibasingura, baitu nuwe Mulemi wabanyoro., kandi Omukama wabakama; nabo abali hamu nauwe balisingura, nibo bayeserwe, abakomerwemu, abokwesiga.

english: Whoever hates me has my Father also.
lunyoro: Anyakunoba nyowe, anoba na Isenyowe.

english: But Jesus turned around and said, “Who are the servants who will get my father's hired workers and give me enough food to feed me? I will die here!
lunyoro: Baituobuyayegarukiremu yagamba ati Abairu baingaha abakolereza empera aba isenyowe abaiguta ebyokurya nibibalema, kunu nyowe ninfera hanu enjara?

english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent him to the Jewish authorities and asked him to come and save his servant.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyahulire ha Yesu, yamutumira abakuru Babayudaya, namusaba okuija okujuna omuiruwe rubale.

english: They called out and asked, “Is there a guest here named Simon Peter?”
lunyoro: nibabaza rundi Simoni, ibararye eryakabiri Petero, agonyere omu.

english: “Sir,” he answered, “Have you come to the house where I was without clothes?” He went off and fell asleep.
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Mutahi wange, otahire ota hanu otanyina kyokujwara ekyobugenyi? Yaculera kwonka.

english: And if God wanted to withdraw his curse from the people of the covenant, as the scripture says, "This is impossible," then he put it in the middle of the altar.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga obwakaba nayenda okwokekera kimu hali abagwetwa abomurago okuhanurakwe nkokutasobora okutabatabana, nukwo yataireho hagati ekirahiro:

english: Five times I was whipped by the Jewish authorities, and thirty-nine prisoners were put in prison.
lunyoro: Ha Baguda emirundi etano nkaterwa enkoba amakumi asatu mumwenda.

english: The crowd gathered around them, and the Jewish judges had to put on their cloaks and ordered them to be crucified.
lunyoro: Kandi ekitebe kikabaimuki'ra ahamu:kandi abacwi bemisango batemu'ra ebyokujwara byabu, nibaragira okubatera nemiigo.

english: Peter remembered what Jesus had said, “Before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me.” So he went out and wept bitterly.
lunyoro: Petero yaijuka ekigambo Yesu ekiyagambire ati Enkoko eraba etakakokere emirundi esatu. Yaturuka eheru, na'ra muno.

english: Jesus said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was sitting, and they stayed with him that very day. It was about three o'clock in the morning.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Muije murarorayo. Baija barora nambere yaraire; baikara nauwe ekiro eki: obuire bukaba buli nkesaha ya ikumi.

english: The other one fell on good ground, and he sowed grain, grew up, and bore grain. He bore much in his field thirty-six grains, and in his harvest a hundred grains.
lunyoro: ndi yagwa ha itaka erisemire, yayana ebyana; nibikura, nibikanya; yayana ekouhikya amakumi asatu mu mukaga, kandi okuhikya ekikumi.

english: For while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
lunyoro: Baitu obutukaba tukyali abasisi, Kristo akutufera:

english: Jesus cried out in a loud voice, and his spirit became filled with power.
lunyoro: Nauwe yayamuza iraka likoto, nahayo omwoyogwe.

english: Then Jesus sent two of his disciples out to the other disciples and said to them, “Push out into the city, and let the man in the water be made clean.
lunyoro: Yatuma babiri hali abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mutahe omu rubuga, nuho muratangana omusaija ayetwekere omunaga gwamaizi:

english: But Jesus built and destroyed that city, which belongs to the tribes that belong to God.
lunyoro: baitu akanihira orubuga oru orunyakuyina emiganda Ruhanga oruyarangaine narwombeka.

english: They have something like fear of God, but they have rejected its power. And you must put them to the test.
lunyoro: bagira okusisana nkokutina Ruhanga, baitu amani gakwo bagehakaine: kandi nibo oterege amabega.

english: They appeared with great fear and spoke about the way Jesus was going to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: babonekera natina, nibabaza ha kufakwe okwakaba nagenda okuhikiririza Yerusalemu.

english: He sent me to you for this purpose, so that you will know what I am going to say and how he has helped you.
lunyoro: oyantumire namberemuli obwekigambo kinu, nukwo mumanye ebigambo byange, kandi ahumuze emituma yanyu.

english: and he will separate people one from another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
lunyoro: kandi alibacwanganizamu, nko mulisa okwa cwanganiza entaama ne mbura buzi;

english: He was sitting there, as if it were a jasper, clear as crystal, clear as crystal, clear as crystal, clear as crystal, and clear as crystal.
lunyoro: kandi ogu akaba aikalire nasisana nkibale erya yasepi nerya sadio okurorwa: nomuhanganzima gukaba gwehingulirize ekitebe kyobukama.

english: The soldiers took him into the house in the place called the Pavement, and they gathered the whole way.
lunyoro: Sosikale bamutwara omu nju, erukwetwa Peraitolio; basoroza hamu ekihanda kyona.

english: Many people have never wrote a report about the things that have happened to us.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi abatandikire okuhandika amakuru gebigambo ebi ebyahikizibwe omulitwe.

english: For you and my mother are mine, and I am their glory.
lunyoro: Baitu bawe, nebyawe byange: nanyowe nyumizibwa omubo.

english: Jesus said to them, “The Spirit gives David a good name with the Lord.
lunyoro: yagambira ati Nukwo Daudi omu mwoyo kikiekimwesa mukamawe, nagamba ati

english: The angel said to him, “Take your mat and put on your sandals.” He did this. “ Take your cloak and follow me,” he told him.
lunyoro: Na maraika yamugambira ati Wetege, ojwale enkaito zawe. Yakora ati. Yamugambira kandi ati Jwara ekyokujwara kyawe, onkuratire.

english: But on the third day there was a cry: “Here is the bridegroom! Come and meet him!”
lunyoro: Baitu ekiro omu itumbi haroho obwogo ngu Dora omuswezi naija muturuke okumutangi'ra.

english: But if you proclaim God's message to all people, and a person who does not believe or does not understand what you are reading, you will be punished everyone and be put right with God.
lunyoro: Baitu bona obubatebeza, kandi omuntu atarukuikiriza rundi atamanyire okusoma obwatahamu, alihanwa bona, kandi alicwerwa bona omusango:

english: They were pleased with him, saying, “These last men have worked only one hour, and we have agreed with you, who have been made clean and without spot from the sun.
lunyoro: bamuramya, nibagamba ngu banu abenyuma bakozire esaha emu yonka, nabainganainganiza naitwe abaruhire omuihangwe, nomusana nugutwokya.

english: But they said, “There is a evil spirit in him.”
lunyoro: Baitu bakagamba ngu Aroho omuzimu omubi.

english: But a man named Ananias and Sapphira sold their property as a slave.
lunyoro: Baitu omusaija, ibararye Ananiya, na Safira, mukaziwe, akagura obutakabwe,

english: Jesus said to them, “Don't be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee, where they will see me.”
lunyoro: Nubwo Yesu yabagambira ati Mutatina: mugende mugambire bagenzi bange bagende Galiraya, nuho balindo'ra.

english: The Gentiles and the Jews, together with their leaders, wanted to please them.
lunyoro: Abamahanga Nabayudaya hamu nabalemi babu, obubasesire okubagiza,

english: They did not know the time when the flood would come and take them all away, so it would be that the coming of the Son of Man might happen.
lunyoro: kandi batamanye kusandara kwamaizi obukwaizire, nukutwara boona; nukwo kuliba kuti okwija kwomwana womuntu.

english: and you will stretch out your hand to heal; and miracles and wonders will be performed through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
lunyoro: niheho omukono gwawe okukiza; nobwokuro'raho nebyamahano bikorwe habwibara Ryomwana wawe arukwera Yesu.

english: And if there is no longer any kindness, there is no work. If there is no poverty, there is no kindness.
lunyoro: Kandi obukuraba kuli kwembabazi, tikukiri kwemimo: kuba kitalikyo, embabazi tizakubaire embabazi.

english: For there will not be any doubt in you, and the good things that happen to you will be revealed to you.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokuhabisa tibirireka okubaho omulinywe, nukwo abasemire bamanyisibwe halinywe.

english: He saw a fig tree by the side of the road, and when he came to it, he found nothing on it but leaves. Then he said to the tree, “You will never again bear fruit.” At once the fig tree dried up.
lunyoro: Yabona omutini gumu ha muhanda rubaju, yaguhikaho nasanga busaho kintu,rundi amababi masa:yagugambira ati Otaryana byana ebiro nebiro. Ahonaho omutini gwayoma.

english: At one time Judas appeared and claimed to be the greatest. About four hundred people joined him. He was killed, and all who heard him were scattered over the cliff.
lunyoro: Baitu omubiro ebya kara Syuda akaimuka nayegamba okuba mukuru; nabantu baingi nkebikumi bina, bakaterana nauwe: ogu akaitwa; na bona abamuhulire bakararanga nibaburangana.

english: Leave the outer courts and do not touch any food. The Holy City will be destroyed for forty-two months.
lunyoro: Eka inneruguru ya yekaru ogireke aheru, kunu otagirenga; norubuga orurukwera balirulibatira amezi amakumi ana mwabiri.

english: Let all your things be done with love.
lunyoro: Ebyanyu byona bokorwege omu kugonzangana.

english: and all the nations who have been called by my name.
lunyoro: Nabamahanga bona abanyakweserwe ibara ryange,

english: Jesus ordered them to give food to anyone who did not know it.
lunyoro: Yabatere'ra muno omuntu wena atakimanya eki:yaragira okumuha ebyokurya.

english: You must say, ‘If the Lord wants us to live, we will live and do this or that.’
lunyoro: Baitu kibahikirire okugamba ngu Mukama waitu obwaligonza tuliba bomezi, kandi tulikora tuti, rundi tuti.

english: Keep on holding to the word of life, and on the day of Christ I will be able to boast about it. I have not lost faith, and I have not done nothing.
lunyoro: mugumye ekigambo kyobwomezi; nyowe ntunge ekyokwenyumirizaho omu kiro kya kristo ngu ntairukire busa, kunu ntako'le busa.

english: Many of the people of Israel will turn to the Lord their God.
lunyoro: Kandi baingi hali abana ba Isaleri alibahindura hali Mukama Ruhanga wabu.

english: Is it easier to say to someone who is convinced that your sins have been forgiven? Or to say, ‘Get up and pick up your mat and walk’?
lunyoro: Ekirahuka kiraha, okugambira anyakuzingamira nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho; rundi okugamba nti Imuka oyetweke ekitabu kyawe, ogende?

english: They brought the donkey and the colt, placed their cloaks over them, and Jesus sat over them.
lunyoro: baleta enkaina nomwana gwayo, bazitaho ebyokujwara byabu; yabiika'raho.

english: God, the source of your love.
lunyoro: Ai Ruhanga itungo ry'okugonza kwawe.

english: Jesus answered, “I am telling you the truth: everyone who sins is a slave of sin.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagarukamu ati Mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuntu wena obwakora ekibi, nuwe muiru rubale wekibi.

english: Do not be fooled by what is evil, but by what is evil for good.
lunyoro: Otasingwa obubi, baitu singura obubi obwomurungi.

english: Jesus took him aside, threw him out of the vineyard, and buried him in a tomb that had been dug out of solid rock before anyone could put it to death.
lunyoro: Yaguhanura, yagukuba omu rugoye orwa bafuta, yamuta omu kituro ekyalimirwe omu mwandara, ekitakatebwamuga muntu.

english: Be on your guard, my friends, that you will not have a wicked heart that does not believe from the living God.
lunyoro: Bene baitu mwerinde, rundi hataba omu muntu wana halinywe omutima omubi ogwokutaikiriza, okuruga ha Ruhanga omwomezi:

english: As the scripture says, “Everyone will be taught by God.” And so everyone who hears the Father and learns from him comes to me.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu banabi ngu Na bona baryegesebwa Ruhanga. Omuntu wena amazire okuhu'ra hali Isenyowe nayega, aija namberendi.

english: David called him ‘Lord’; how can he have a son? The crowd gladly listened to him.
lunyoro: Daudi wenka amweta Mukamawe; aba ata omwanawe? Kandi ebekitebe bamuhu'raga nokusemererwa.

english: Those who eat my flesh and drink my blood live in me and I in them.
lunyoro: Anyakurya omubiri gwange nanywa esagama yange buli aikaire omuli nyowe nanyowe omuruwe.

english: What did you go out to see? A man dressed in fancy clothes? Look! Those who dress like that and eat the good food are sitting in the king's house.
lunyoro: baitu mukagenderayo ki okurora? Omusaija ajwaire engoye ezirukworoba? Dora abo abajwara engoye ezekirokworoba, nibarya ebyokurya ebirungi, baikara omu zigati ezabakama.

english: They went into the house, and when they saw the child with Mary his mother, they greeted him, threw their cloaks over his head, and gave him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
lunyoro: Bataha omu nju, barora omwana na Maryamu nyina; bainama nibamuramya baboho'ra ebikwato byabu, bamuha ebisembo, ebya zabu, nenkwasi, nomugaju.

english: The field is the world; the good seed is the children of the Kingdom; the weeds are the people who belong to the Evil One.
lunyoro: oruharo niyo ensi; nembibo esemire, abo nibo bana bobukama; emberya nibo ba bumubi;

english: He took it and ate in front of them.
lunyoro: akikwata yalira omu maiso gabu.

english: Are they serving Christ? I am speaking as a messenger of God, and I am even more bold; I am even more bold in going into prison, even more than I have many times before, in prison.
lunyoro: Bali bahereza ba Kristo? (ningamba nkomuguiraro), nyowe nimbakira; om,u kutalibana nimbakira, omu kubohebwa omu nju zenkomo nimbakira bingi, omu kuterwa enkoba nimbakira muno, omu kufa emirundi nyingi.

english: Jesus said to him, “For a long time I have been with you all these days, yet you did not know me, Philip. Whoever has seen me has seen the Father also. Why, then, do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Nakaba kuikaraho nainywe, ebiro bingi biti, kandi tokamanyaga nyowe Firipo? Anyakundozire nyowe, buli alizire Isenyowe. kiki ekirukugambisa iwe ngu Twoleke Isitwe.

english: For if this first covenant had been faultless, then there would have been no need for a second one to be made.
lunyoro: Baitu ekiragano eki ekyokubanza kuba kitaroho ekyokukunganira, tihakuseruirwe omwanya ogwekyakabiri.

english: He called you to possess the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Ogu ayabetire inywe hali okuhiki'ra ekitinisa kya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: What will you give me, and I will give it to you?” They paid him thirty silver coins.
lunyoro: Mungaru'ra ki, nanyowe ndamuhayo nambere muli? Bamulengera ebicwaka ebyefeza amakumi asatu.

english: and said to me, “You must speak again to many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
lunyoro: Kandi bakangambira ngu Kikuhikirire okugaruka okuragura hali abantu, namahanga, nendimi, nabakama baingi.

english: and preach about the Kingdom of God. He teaches the words of our Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without prejudice to anyone.
lunyoro: kandi natebeza xobukama bwa Ruhanga, nayegesa ebigambo bya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo nobumanzi bwona, atatangwe omuntu wena.

english: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power of your name, which you gave me. I beg you, then, that you would not kill any of them except the Son of Man, and the Scriptures must come true.
lunyoro: obunkabandi nabo, nyowe nkabalinda omu ibara ryawe abawampaire: nimbasemba tihakaburaga muntu hali bo, rundi omwana owokuhwereke'ra; ebyahandikirwe bihiki'le.
