lunyoro: baitu omufakati onu obwokunyita kubi, nikyo ndimuramu'ra, aleke okuija mpora na kake.

english: They all wept and mourned for him, but Jesus said, “Don't cry, but don't cry; she has not died.”
lunyoro: Bamuseka muno bona: baitu yagamba ati Muta'ra, baitu tafire.

english: and a voice came from heaven, “You are my own dear Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
lunyoro: raka ryaturuka omu iguru ngu Niwe mwana wange oungonza, nkukyanganukire muno.

english: They will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and spit on, and crucify him. On the third day he will be raised to life.”
lunyoro: kandi balimuhayo hali Abamahanga okumute'ra enaku, nukumutera, nokumubamba ha muti; kandi ha kiro kyakasatu alihumburwa.

english: But if he does not listen, two or three witnesses will say everything to you.
lunyoro: baitu obwatahu'ra, omu kanwa ka bakaiso babiri rundi basatu ebigambo byona bigumeho.

english: But he said to the man, ‘Sir, let me go back and bury my father.’
lunyoro: Baitu ogu yamugambira ati Mukama wange, leka'male okugenda okuzika isenyowe.

english: For what I am doing I will do, so that I will not give up any time of time for those who are trying to find fault with them. In the same way, they will do to us in the way they please us.
lunyoro: Baitu ekindukukora nikyo ndikora, ntabaha omwanya abase'ra omwanya; nukwo barorwe nka itwe omu kigambo ekibenyumirizamu.

english: He said, “The Jews joined him in requesting that Paul be brought before the Council the next day, as though he were trying to find out more about what Paul was talking about.”
lunyoro: Yagamba at Abayudaya bateraine hamu okukwesengereza okusirimura Pauro nyenkya hali orukurato, nosisana noyenda okugaruka okumukaguza amananu agebigambobye.

english: This is what the prophet Isaiah said: “He himself took our sickness and carried away our diseases.”
lunyoro: ekigambo kihiki'le ekyagamberwe Isaya nabi, nagamba ati Uwe wenka akatwara obugara bwaitu, nayetweka endwara zaitu.

english: But when they did not agree among themselves, Paul went on to say, "The Holy Spirit spoke boldly to your ancestors by means of the prophet.
lunyoro: Kandi obubataraterine bonka bagenda, Pauro obuyamazire okugamba ekigambo kimu ati omwoyo Ogurukwera akagambira kurungi baisexnkuru inywe omu nabi

english: When the master of the house comes up, knocks the door, and you begin to stand outside and knock at the door. ‘Open the door,’ you will say, ‘our Lord!’ and he will answer you, ‘I don't know where you come from.’
lunyoro: Mukama wenju obwalikamara okuimuka, nokukingaho oruigi, nainywe numubanza okweme'ra aheru, nokweranga ha ruigi, numugamba ngu Mukama waitu otukingu'leho; nauwe aligarukamu nabagambira ati Timbamanyire, nambere murugire;

english: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats this bread, he will live forever. The bread that I will give you is my flesh, because the world is alive.”
lunyoro: Ninyowe byokurya ebyomire ebyarugire omu iguru: omuntu wena obwarya ha byokuryaga ebi, aryomera ebiro nebiro: ego, nebyokurya ebindihayo nugwo mubiri gwange, obwobwomezi Bwensi.

english: But some of the people there were angry and said to one another, “Why are the olive trees so late?”
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abamu abahihirwe bonka, bibagamba ngu Amagita gafire ki gati?

english: Nor will that servant do anything with me in the darkness outside, where he will cry and gnash his teeth.
lunyoro: Nomuiru ogu rubale atarukugasa mumu nage omu mwirima ogwa aheeru; nambere haliba mu oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: “I have brought glory to you,” a voice from heaven said.
lunyoro: Isenyowe nyumiza ibara ryawe. Kandi iraka ryaruga omu iguru ngu Nkalinyumiza.

english: You must fear your father and your mother—this is the first commandment which God has commanded you.
lunyoro: So na nyoko obatinege ( nikyo kiragiro kyokubanza ekinyakuroho omurago),

english: “Don't be afraid of Paul,” they said. “You must stand before the Emperor. And God has given you over to all those who are going with you.”
lunyoro: nagamba ati Otatina Pauro; kikuhikirire okweme'ra omu maiso ga Kaisali: kandi dora, Ruhanga akuhaire abo bona abarukugenda naiwe.

english: His neighbors and his neighbors saw that he was crying and saying, “Isn't he the one who sat at the table?”
lunyoro: Kandi abatahibe nabamuroraga ira aikalire nalega, bagamba ngu Tinuwogu ayaika'raga nalega?

english: And whatever you ask for, believing, you will receive it.
lunyoro: Na byona byona ebimurase'raga numusaba numuikiriza, mulibihebwa.

english: Isn't this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon? Aren't our relatives here with us?”
lunyoro: Tinuwogu omubazi? Omwana wa Maryamu, mugenzi wa Yakobo, na Yose, na Yuda, na Simoni? Nabanyanya titunyinabo hanu owaitu?

english: Felix was very afraid, so he said, “I will call you soon.”
lunyoro: Ferekisi yatina muno, yagarukamu ait nomwanya ndikweta.

english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by me by Silas and Timothy, did not come with a kiss, but with a kiss of peace.
lunyoro: Baitu Omwana wa Ruhanga Yesu Kristo, outwabatebize inywe, nyowe na Sirwano na Timoseo, tali ego na nangwa, baitu omuruwe harumu ego.

english: They made fun of him and said, “Stay with us, because the day is almost over and it is getting dark.” So he went in to stay with them.
lunyoro: Bamuhambiriza nubagamba ngu Ikara naitwe: baitu hati kairirizi, nobuire bwa'sa kuira. Yatahamu okuikara nabo.

english: Jesus said to his disciples, “There was once a rich man who had a manager's bag. The rich man was told that he should sell his house and buy some money.
lunyoro: Kandi akagambira abegeswa ati Hakaba haroho omugunda omu, akaba ayina omuketo; ogu bakamunyege'ra haruwe okurarangize itungorye.

english: Ananias went into the house and placed his hands on him. “Brother Saul,” he said, “Jesus, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road where you came from, has sent me, so that you may receive the Holy Spirit and be filled with power.”
lunyoro: Ananiya yagenda yataha omu nju; kandi obuyamutaireho emikono yagamba ati Mwene waitu Sauro, Mukama waitu, nuwe Yesu, ayakubonekire omu muhanda ogwoturukiremu, antumire oiguke, oijule Omwoyo Ogurukwara.

english: And why should we not say that we have done what is good and right? (This is what others have told us to do, and this is what others have told us to say). They are to be judged according to what they have done.
lunyoro: Kandi kiki ekitutangire okugamba ngu Tukolege ekibi ekirungi kiike? (Nkokubatuhangirire, kandi abandi nkokubatebize ngu nukwo tugamba tuti), abo okucwerwa omusango kwoburyo.

english: Whoever gives one of these little ones too much water in the name of a disciple will certainly drink too much water, and I tell you that his reward will never be paid.”
lunyoro: Na wena alimuha okunywa omu hali banu abake eyugi eyamaizi agarukufuka, omu ibara ryomwegeswa, mazimakwo nimbagambira nti emperaye teriuburaho na kake.

english: There was a certain disciple in Joppa named Dorcas, who was a believer in the city of Dorcas. She was filled with good deeds and gifts.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho, omu Yopa omwegeswa omu, ibararye Tabisa, okumanyisibw kwaryo ayetwa Dolika: omukazi ogu akaba aijuire engeso enungi nezokugaba eziyakoraga.

english: If I fought with animals in Ephesus, how can I help them? If the dead are not raised, then let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.
lunyoro: Obundaba narwanire Efeso nenyamaiswa, nkabantu okubagira nikingasira ki? Abafu obubatahumbuka turye, tunywe, baitu turafa nyenkya.

english: Peter spoke up and said to him, “You can tell us this parable.”
lunyoro: Petero yagarukamu namugambira ati otusobo're orufumo runu.

english: Jesus said to them, “I have been with the crowd for three days now, but they have not enough food to eat.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Ninganyira ebitebe, baitu hati bunu ebiro bisatu baikaire nanyowe, kandi tibanyina byokurya:

english: I came to set you on earth a fire, and if it is already kindled, what do I want?’
lunyoro: Nkaija okubaga omu'ro hansi; kandi obuguraba gwakire hati nyowe ninyenda ki?

english: The angel said to her, “Don't be afraid, Mary! God has been gracious to us!”
lunyoro: Marakaika yamugambira ati Otatina, Maryamu: baituoboine embabazi hali Ruhanga.

english: When evening came, his disciples came to him and said, “It is already late in the day, and the rooster crows. Send the people away, and let them go to the villages to buy food for themselves.”
lunyoro: Obuire obubwaizire, abegeswa bakaija namberali, nibagamba ngu Hanu irungu, obuire bwasa kwira; oyohereze abantu, bagende omu maka, begu'ra ebyokurya.

english: A Canaanite woman from that region cried out in a loud voice, “Son of David! Have mercy on me, sir! My daughter has a demon in her heart!”
lunyoro: Kandi dora, omukazi Omukanani akaruga omu mitano egi, yayamio'ra haiguru nagmba ati Onganyire, ai Mukama wange, iwe Omwana wa Daudi: omuisiki wange akwasirwe muno omuzimu.

english: He cried out in a loud voice, “Stand up straight on your feet!” Again he went away.
lunyoro: Yagamba niraka erihango ati Imuka oyeme're nebigere byawe. Yagaruka yagenda.

english: Whoever comes after me and my servant does not deserve to receive anything from me.
lunyoro: Nuwogu arukuija enyuma yange norukoba rwenkaitoye tindukuseme'ra okurubiho'ra.

english: The voice came to him a second time, “Do not consider anything unclean that God has declared unclean!”
lunyoro: Rundi iraka ryamuizira, omurundi ogwakabiri liti, Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora iwe ebyomuziro.

english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me and told him to deceive the people. I have brought him here with you before you all, and I have not found any fault with the man you accuse him of.
lunyoro: oti Mundetirege omuntu onu ngu Ahabisa abantu: kandi dora nyowe obu'mukagulirizege muno omu maiso ganyu, timboine musango ha muntu onu omwebi ebimumulegere:

english: “Tell us when will these things be?” the man asked. “What will be the sign when the time will come for all these things to take place?”
lunyoro: otugambire, ebigambo ebi biribaho li? Kandi akokuro'raho karaha akebi obubiri'sana okuhiki'ra byona?

english: Jesus said to him, “You will believe because you see me, so that you will have good news for those who believe and will not see me.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Obwokudora, nikyo oikiririze; bayina omugosa abanyakuikirizi, bataroho ekibaboine.

english: But an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get ready and go to the place where you are going, and then go on to the other side of the road that goes down from Jerusalem to the desert.”
lunyoro: Baitu maraika wa Mukama akagambira Firipo ati Imuka, ogende obukizi obwoburyo okuhika omu muhanda ogusirimuka, okuruga Yerusalemu okuhika Gaza: ogu irungu.

english: Never take revenge on yourselves, my friends, but take revenge on yourselves! For the scripture says, “I will repay,” says the Lord.
lunyoro: Muteho'ra inywenka enzigu, inywe abarukugonzebwa, baitu hakire muhigize ekiniga: baitu kikahandikwa ngu Okuhora enzigu kwange; nyowe ndigaru'ra, nukwo agamba Mukama.

english: My friends, you know that from the very beginning God made his message to you, so that the Gentiles heard the Good News from my mouth and believed.
lunyoro: Bene baitu, inywe mumanyire ngu okuruga omu biro byaira, Ruhanga akakomamu halinywe, Abamahanga bahu'le omuk kanwa kange ekigambo ekyenjiri, kandi baikirize.

english: and the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, who worship the beast and its image, and all who believe in the image of the beast.
lunyoro: nomuika ogwokubonabonesebwa kwabu nugucuka ebiro nebiro, kunu tibayina okuhumura nyamusana nekiro, abaramya ekisoro nekisisani kyakyo, na bona abaikiriza enkojo yibara ryakyo.

english: But the scripture says, “You must not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up into heaven?” (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat with him.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew that he was the Lord.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muije murye. Kandi busaho hali abegeswa ayasoboire okumukaguza ati Niwoha? Bamanyire nuwe Mukama waitu.

english: Another one said, “I have married a woman, but I cannot come.”
lunyoro: Nondi yagamba ati Nswire omukazi, nikyo ntarukusobo'ra kuija.

english: He will bring forth a son who is to be born Jesus, who will save his people from their sins.
lunyoro: Kandi alizara Omwana omwojo; kandi olimuruka ibararye Yesu; nuwe alijuna abantube omu bibi byabu.

english: Jesus answered, “If they will not obey Moses and the prophets, they will not obey even if someone has been raised from death.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Obubaraba batarukuhu'ra Musa na banabi, tibalihu'raga nobwakubaire omuntu ahumbukire omu bafu.

english: Jesus called the crowd to him once more and said to them, “Listen to me, all of you, and understand. Nothing is beyond human beings.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okweta ekitebe namberali, yabagambira ati Mumpu're inywena, mwetegereze; busaho kintu ekyaheru yomuntu

english: Jesus answered, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going to wake him up.
lunyoro: Nukwo yagambire ati: yagaruka nabagambira ati Enganjani yaitu razaro agwijagire: baitu ningenda okumusisimura.

english: Pilate said to him, “Are you the king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. I was born, and I came into the world, and I have become a fool. Whoever obeys my voice will obey me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu'ra iraka ryange.

english: Jesus went near the man and touched the man's ear, so the women stood still. “I tell you,” he said, “Get up!”
lunyoro: Aira haihi, yakora ha ruhinyo, abetweki bayeme'ra. Yagamba ati Omwojo, ninkugambira nti Imuka.

english: Then Paul called one of the officials and said, “Take this young man to the commander, for he has something to tell him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yayeta namberali omu hali abanyakihanda, nagamba ati Twara omusigazi onu hali engabwa enkuru: baitu ayina ekyokumutebeza.

english: Go quickly and tell his disciples that he has been raised from death, and now I am going to Galilee. There you will see him, because I told you.”
lunyoro: Genda bwango, mutebeze abegeswabe ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu; kandi dora, nabebembera okugeda Galiraya; nuho mulimuro'ra: dora mbagambire.

english: Jesus said to them the third time, “I know that you have done this man's crime. I do not see him guilty of killing. I will accuse him and let him go.”
lunyoro: Yabagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuruwe musango ogwokufa: nikyo ndamute'ra, 'mulekere.

english: They started looking for Jesus and said to one another, “What do you think? He will not come to the festival?”
lunyoro: Kandi base'ra Yesu nibagambiragana, bemerire omu yekaru ngu Nimutekereza muta? Tarukuija ha bugenyi?

english: At that time some Pharisees came to him and said, “You must get out of here and go somewhere else, because Herod wants to kill you.”
lunyoro: Omu kasumi ako nubwo baizire Abafalisayo abamu, nibamugambira ngu Ruga hanu oyegendere: baitu Herode nase'ra okukuita.

english: When Peter saw the people, he said to them, “Fellow Israelites, why did you not believe me? Why are you trying to convince us that our own power or the worship of our God has made you follow him?
lunyoro: Petero obuyaboine yagarukamu abantu ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, kiki ekibatangalize omuna? Rundi numutugumizaho ki amaiso okutekereza ngu amani gaitu itwenka, rundi okutina Ruhanga okwaitu, nibyo bimugendeseze ogu?

english: But this: Do not commit adultery; do not commit murder; do not steal; do not desire what is not mine; instead, have love for one another, just as you love yourselves.
lunyoro: Baitu kinu ngu Otalisihana, otaliita, Otaliiba, otaryegomba, kandi ekirukukiraho kiri nti Gonza mutahi wawe nkokwoyegonza wenka.

english: But you will be silent until the day when these things happen, because you did not believe my message, which will come true at the right time.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, oliculera, okutasobora okugamba, okuhika ha kiro eki ebigambo binu obubirikahiki'ra, baitu toikirize bigambo byange, ebirihikiri'ra omu mpiko zabyo.

english: Jesus called his disciples together and said to them, “I tell you that this poor widow put in more than all the others who were going to the marketplace;
lunyoro: Kandi yayeta abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omufakati onu owamasege anagiremu bingi okukira bona abarukunaga omu ryahu'ro;

english: But when you give to the poor, do not throw their burden on them; instead, when you give them to the poor, you will have to pay back what they have earned; instead, you will have to pay what they have earned.
lunyoro: Baitu obworagabiraga abasege, otalitera engwara omu maiso gawe, noruhana rwawe ruba hakuguru, nkorugoye orururkrutukura okuguli.

english: And so it will be with you: you will find a colt tied up in its place and lying in a manger.
lunyoro: Kinu kokuro'raho namberemuli ngu Murazora omwana gwenkaina bagusibikire omu nju yenkoko, bagwijagire omu nju yenta.

english: The Holy Spirit came down upon him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came from heaven, “You are my own dear Son. I am so happy!”
lunyoro: Roho Ogurukwera yasirimuka haruwe omu kisisani kyomubiri nkeriba, niraka ryaruga omu irungu ngu Niwe mwana wange oundukugonza; nkusemererirwe muno.

english: For the righteousness of God is revealed in me, from faith to faith. As the scripture says, “The purified person will live by faith.”
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga nukusuku'rwa omu nyowe, okuruga omu kuikiriza okuhika ha kuikiriza: nkoku kyahandikirwe ngu Anyakuhukilire arayomeraga obwokuikiriza.

english: Jesus answered, "I have no demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Tinyina muzimu, baitu nyowe 'nyumiza Isenyowe, nainywe timunyumiza nyowe.

english: Jesus said to them, “What is your faith? The people were amazed and said to one another, “Who is this man? He commands the winds and the waves to obey him!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Okuikiriza kwanyu kuraha? Batina nibahuni'ra bagambirangana bonka ngu Mara ogu noha, baitu aragira nomuyaga namaizi, bimuhu'ra?

english: Jesus said to the man who was teaching in the Temple, “I know where I am from, and you know where I am from. I have not come on my own authority, but he who sent me is truthful, and you do not know him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagambira haiguiru omu yekaru nayegesa, nagamba ati Nyowe mu'manyire, kandi mumanyire nambere narugire: nanyowe ntaije habwange nyenka, baitu ogu ayantumire nuwe wa mananu, oumutamanyire inywe.

english: “My son is sick, but he is suffering terribly, because he is suffering terribly from dreaded skin diseases, because he is in the fire and often from water.
lunyoro: Omwana wange abyamire, baitu amugara muno: baitu enkanjaiga enyingi agwa omu mu'ro, kandi emirundi mingi agwa omu maizi.

english: When the people came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, “This man is worthy for you to do this.”
lunyoro: Abo obubaizire hali Yesu bamwesengereza muno ngu Asemerire okuko'rwa kinu:

english: Whenever you go into a town or village, look for someone who is willing to help you, and stay there until you leave that place.
lunyoro: Orubuga rwona nambere murakatahamuga, rundi ekika kyona, muse'lege noha omuli abo asemera; nuho mulira'ra okuhikya obumulirugayo.

english: But Jesus denied it, saying, “I don't know what you are talking about or understand what you are talking about.” So he went out to the entrance of the courtyard, and a rooster crowed.
lunyoro: Baitu yayehakana nagamba ati Tindukumanya, nobukwakuba okwetegereza ekyorukugamba: yagenda aheru omu kiti kyomuryango; enkoko yakoka.

english: But Paul said to them, “We have been put right with God before the people before the Roman authorities and have been put in prison. How can it be that they are now bound in chains? They have come here and let us out!”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Baije bonka batuturukye.

english: He did not fail to notice what happened, but he did what was right, and he gave you rain from heaven and showers upon you during the festival, and he has filled your hearts with food and fills you with gladness.
lunyoro: Baitu atebuzeho kaiso, baitu akakora kurungi, nabanagira enjura okuruga omu iguru, nebiro ebyokwerezamu ebyokurya, naigusa emitima yanyu ebyokuryaga nokusemererwa.

english: As the scripture says, “I have made you father of many nations.” He is the God who gives life to all people and calls into practice what is not natural.
lunyoro: nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Nkufoire isenkuru wamahanga maingi. Obwogu anyakwomeza abantu, nayeta ebitaroho nkebinyakuroho,

english: The Lord said, “Listen to the judge who is not guilty of breaking God's law!”
lunyoro: Kandi Mukama waitu akagamba ati Muhu're omucwi wemisango owokutahikir'a okwagamba.

english: Jesus stood still and said, “Get up!” They called the blind man. “Cheer up!” they said. “Get up, and let him go.”
lunyoro: Yesu yame'raho, nagamba ati mumwete. Bayeta omufu wamaiso, nibamugambira ngu Guma omutima: imuka, nakutanga.

english: “I am the vine, and you are the branches. Those who remain in me, and I in them, will bear much fruit; but you will not bear fruit unless you do what I tell you.”
lunyoro: Ninyowe muzabibu, ninywe matagi: anyakuikara omuli nyowe, nanyowe omuruwe, nuwe ayana bingi: baitu ha nyowe ntali timuroho ekimurukusobora okukora.

english: eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of horses, and the flesh of horses and their riders, the flesh of all people, the flesh of free people, the flesh of slaves, the flesh of slaves, and the flesh of all people.
lunyoro: enyama yabakama, nenyama yembarasi, nabo abazitemba, nengabwa yabu bona, abobugabe nabairu rubale, abato nabakuru.

english: He did not stay in the city of Nazareth, because what the prophets had said came true: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
lunyoro: yataire omu rubuga ibara ryarwo Nazalesi: ekigambo banabi ekibagambire kihiki're ngu Aryetwa Munazarayo.

english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Look, a prophet does not come from Galilee.”
lunyoro: Bagarukamu Nibamugambira ngu Naiwe oli wa Galiraya? Se'ra orole nabi taruga omu Galiraya.

english: When an evil spirit comes out of a man, he will go into the place where no water is kept, and he will seek to take rest. But if he does not find you, he says, ‘Go back to my house,’ and ‘I have come out of the way.’

lunyoro: numutegereza nimwegomba muno okuija kwekiro ekya Ruhanga, nambere iguru liryaga nirihya, nebyobuhangwa biryaga nokwokebwa kwingi.

english: Do not be quick to criticize or criticize your brother in this matter, because the Lord is the master of all evil, just as we at first accuse you and prove it to you.
lunyoro: aleke okugobeza mwene wabu nobukwakuba okumusobeza omu kigambo eki: baitu Mukama nuwe muhozi wenzigu obwebi byona, nkokutwabandize okubahabura nokubamanyisiza kimu.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] How, then, can you believe? Do you want to honor yourselves by your own standards, and do not seek the glory that comes from God alone?
lunyoro: Nimusobora muta okuikiriza, inywe abarukwenda kuhebwa ekitinisa inywenka nainywenka, nekitinisa ekiruga hali Ruhanga omu wenka timurukukise'ra?

english: Remember what I told you: ‘A slave is not greater than his master.’ If they have persecuted me, they will persecute you also; if they have observed my teaching, they too will obey yours.
lunyoro: Muijuke ekigambo ekinabagambire nti Omuiru rubale takira mukamawe. Baraba bahigire nyowe, nainywe balibahiga; baraba bakwasire ekigambo kyange, nekyanyu balikikwata.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GOVERNMENT] These are the ones who know that if we obey his commands, we do not know them.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo turukumanyira ngu timumanyire, obuturaba ntukwata ebiragirobye.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Nor do you ask for more, but ask for what you want.
lunyoro: Kandi musaba mutahabwa, baitu musaba kubi, okubikoza okwegomba kwanyu.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] For the good things we have do not need, but the God who made us together with the body has given us much more honor than the body that has been destroyed.
lunyoro: baitu ebicweka byaitu ebirungi tibirukutaga: baitu Ruhanga akateraniza hamu omubiri naha ekitinisa ekingi hali ekicweka ekibuzirweho;

english: I have told you this because I have pity on you. It is not because I tell you the truth, but because I do good and you have sent the Lord without fault.
lunyoro: kandi eki nkigambire obwokubagasira inywenka; tibuli obwokubanagira ekisuli, baitu obwebirungi, nainywe muherezege Mukama waitu mutarukutabatabana.

english: the son of Melchi, the son Of Addi, the father of Cosam, the mother of Elmodam,
lunyoro: owa Mereki, owa Adi, owa Kosamu, owa Erimadamu,

english: He went from Bethsaida in Galilee and asked Jesus, “Sir, I want to see Jesus.”
lunyoro: yaruga besesaida eyomu Galiraya, yamukaguza nagamba ati Tata, ntwenda okurora Yesu.

english: [REDUCATION] [GENERAL] We live in the flesh at all times, because the death of Jesus has been made manifest in our bodies.
lunyoro: ebiro byona tuhimbira omu mubiri okufa kwa Yesu bwolekwe omu mubiri gwaitu.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] But the chief priests took some of the money and said, “This is not against the Law to put it in the Temple treasury, but to put its value on blood.”
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru batwara ebicweka ebyefeza, nibagamba ngu Tikiri kyebiragiro okubita omu ryahu'ro rya Ruhanga, baitu muhendo gwesagama.

english: But if these things are yours and they are your own, then they will be yours; but if they do not bear children, then the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ will be theirs.
lunyoro: Baitu ebigambo ebi obubiraba biri byanyu kandi nibasaga, bibafora okuba abatali bagara, baitu abanyakwana ebyana hali okumanyira kimu Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: Some of you were like this. You were like them; you were dedicated to God, but you were put right with God through the power of our Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
lunyoro: Kandi abamu omulinywe nukwo mwasisaine muti: baitu mukoga, baitu mukezebwa, baitu mukaihibwaho omusango omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, nomu Mwoyo ogwa Ruhanga waitu.

english: So then, if anyone is in union with Christ, let him be in a new creation. The old things have passed away; but now they are all new.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wena araba ali omu Kristo, buli afokere ekihangirwe ekihyaka: ebyaira bihoireho, dora, byona bihyaka.

english: For if the Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from death, lives in you, then he who raised Christ Jesus from dead will also give life to your mortal bodies by his Spirit who lives in all of you.
lunyoro: Baitu omwoyo gwogu ayahumbuire Yesu omu bafu guraba guikaire omulinywe ogu ayahumbuire Kristo Yesu omubafu aryomeza nemibiri yanyu erukufa, Obwomwoyogwe oguikara omulinywa.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] For just as you have not heard God's voice, so now you have been given mercy because of their disobedience.
lunyoro: Baitu nka inywe obumutarahulire ira Ruhanga, baitu hati bunu muhairwe okuganyirwa obwokutahu'ra kwabu,

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) He was very poor, and his prosperity was like a large bundle of flour, and he fell down from heaven on people. The people were insulting God for the noise of a stone, because it was such a terrible plague.
lunyoro: Orukoba, akabale kamu obulemezi bwako nketaranta emu, rwagwa okuruga omu iguru ha bantu: abantu nibajuma Ruhanga habwomuhito gworukoba; baitu omuhito gwarwo mwingi muno.

english: And so we will do if God allows.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo tulikora Ruhanga obwaligonza.

english: One of the High Priest's servants, whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn't I see you in the garden with him?”
lunyoro: Omu hali abairu rubale ba nyakatagara omukuru wabu, oworuganda rwogu Petero ouyacwireho okutu, yagamba ati Nyowe tinkuboine nauwe, omu rugonjo?

english: [REDUCATION] [GENERAL] Jesus Christ himself gave himself for us in order to redeem us from all wickedness and make us his own people, which is the means by which he has called you to do good.
lunyoro: Yesu Kristo ayayehaireyo wenka habwaitu nukwo atucungule omu kutahiki'ra kwona kandi ayesemereze wenka ihanga okuba rye wenka, erirukwekambira engeso enungi.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] When we see that no one is judged by the deeds of the Law, but by the faith of Christ Jesus, we are put right with God by faith in Christ Jesus and by the works of the law. For no one will be condemned by the things that are done by the Law.
lunyoro: baitu obutuboine ngu omuntu taihibwaho omusango obwemirimo yebiragiro, bitu obwokuikiriza Kristo Yesu, tuihibweho omusango obwokuiriza Kristo, kunu tubuli obwengeso zebiragiro: baitu omuntu wean atalihibwaaho omusango obwebiragiro.

english: He poured out his perfume on her, mixed the wine with oil, and poured it on her. Then he took her to the inn, kissed her, and kissed her.
lunyoro: kandi yasemba emputaze nasesemu amagita nomubazi; yamutembya ensoroye wenka, yamuleta omu nju yabagonyi, yamurwaza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] Jesus said, “The Jews joined him in requesting that Paul be brought before the Council the next day, as though he were trying to find out more about what Paul was talking about.
lunyoro: Yagamba at Abayudaya bateraine hamu okukwesengereza okusirimura Pauro nyenkya hali orukurato, nosisana noyenda okugaruka okumukaguza amananu agebigambobye.

english: But many in the crowd believed in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he will perform even more miracles than this man has done!”
lunyoro: Baitu baingi abomukitebe bakamuikiriza; nibagamba ngu Kristo obwaliija alikora ebyamahano bingi okukira ogu ebyakozire?

english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave thanks to it, broke them, and handed them to the disciples to distribute to the people.
lunyoro: Yakwata emigati etano nencu ibiri, yarora haiguru omu iguru, yabisimira; yabicwamu, yaha abegeswa okubita omu maiso gekitebe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He who has seen it has spoken, and he also has seen the truth. He knows that he speaks with all his heart, and you will believe.
lunyoro: Nauwe ayaboine akatebeza, nokutebezakwe kwamananu: kandi ogu amanyire agamba amananu, nainywe muikirize.

english: It is like a mustard seed, which a man planted in his field and sowed in his ground; it grew up to be a tree, and the birds ate up in its branches.
lunyoro: Kisisisana nkakajuma ka karadali, omuntu akayakwasire yakanaga omu musirigwe; kamera kafoka omuti; enyonyi ezahagati zarara omu matagi gagwo.

english: If David were to call him ‘Lord,’ how could he not have children?
lunyoro: Nukwo Daudi obwaraba na mweta Mukamawe aba ata mwanawe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] The next day Jesus came to them and went on the water.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro, omu kisissimuka ekyakana, akaija namberebali, nagendera ha nyanja.

english: So even though you write this letter, I wrote it not for the sake of the one who sinned or the one whose sins were forgiven, but for the one whom you have seen for the good that he did in your presence before God.
lunyoro: Nukwo nobunabahandikire, ntahandikire habwogu ayasisire, nobukwakuba habwomuntu ayasisirwe, baitu okwekamba kwanyu habwanyu kwolekwe omulinywe omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) For love is my request only, because I am like Paul, who is a shepherd and is now a prisoner of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu obwokugonza ninyesengereza kwonka, baitu ninsisana nkokundi Pauro omugurusi, kandi hati bunu omunyankomo wa Kristo Yesu:

english: When he arrived there, he said to them, “Pray that you will not fall into temptation.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyahikire oku, yabagambira ati Musabe mutataha omu kwohebwa.

english: Then the demons came out of many people and began to shout, “Great is the Son of God!” He cried out to those who would not believe, because he knew that he was the Messiah.
lunyoro: Emizimu nayo ekaruga omu baingi, neyamuza negamba ngu baingi: nekamujuma nayamuza atarukugiikiriza okugamba, baitu ekamumanya nuwe Kristo.

english: Jesus looked around and saw a large crowd coming to him. “Where do you want us to buy some bread, and these will eat?” he asked Philip.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yaimukya amaiso, yarora ekitebe kingi nikiija namberali, yagambira Firipo ati Turagura nkaha emigati, banu egibararya?

english: Jesus answered, “If I were a sinner, I would not know the same thing: I would rather die than be put to death.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu ati Okwarabali musis timanyire ekigambo kimu eki manyire ngu Nkabandi omufu wa maiso baitu hat nimpweza.

english: [REpute] [reLIGIAL] But take your part in the work of the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not let your minds be troubled by the desires of the flesh.
lunyoro: Baitu, mujwale Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, kunu mutatekereza okukora ebyomubiri omu kwegomba kwagwo.

english: But his disciples went on to the other side of the lake, because the boat had come from Tiberias near where they were eating the bread, after which the Lord had given thanks.
lunyoro: baitu abegeswabe bagenzire bonka ( baitu obwato bwaijaga nuburuga Tiberiya haihi nikiikaro nambere balire emigati, Mukama waitu obuyamazire kusima):

english: The Lord's servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, a teacher and patient.
lunyoro: Kandi omuiru wa Mukama waitu tikimuhikirire okurwana, baitu okuba omuculezi hali bona, omwegesa, omugumisiriza,

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] They are God's servants, the rich, the poor, and the humble; they are God-fearing; they do not listen to their parents.
lunyoro: abarukunoba Ruhanga, abasisa, abemyehembo, abanyakwekunika, abahyangya ebigambo ebibi, abatarukuhu'ra ababazaire,

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] With all our heart we judge, because God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
lunyoro: omu byona omutima gwaitu ebigurutucweramu omusango: baitu Ruhanga nakira obukuru emitima yaitu, kandi amanyire byona.

english: For false christs and false prophets will appear, and they will perform great miracles and wonders. They will be deceived and turn away from their sins, if possible.
lunyoro: babegamba bonka ngu Kristo webisuba nabanabi abebisuba bakiimuka, balikora ebyokuro'raho obukuru nebyamahano: bahabise nabakome, kuba nikisoboka.

english: For the one whom God sent speaks the words of God, because the Spirit is God's gift.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu Ruhanga ouyatimire agamba ebigambo bya Ruhanga: baitu tagabira Mwoyo omu ndengo.

english: He saw two angels dressed in white, sitting at the right side of the throne, and Jesus' body being placed on the left.
lunyoro: yarora bamaraika babiri bajwaire ebirukwera, baikalire, omu ha musago, ondi ha mirambi, omutumbi gwa Yesu nambere gukaba gutairwe.

english: For the law of the Spirit, which gives life in union with Christ Jesus, has set me free from the law that leads to death.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiragiro Ebyomwoyo ogwobwomezi omu Kristo Yesu bikandekera omu biragiro ebyekibinebyokufa.

english: But God said, “The world is passing away and so is its desire, but the world is asleep; and tomorrow they will see you. Won't it be enough for you, then, to put on your complete suit of faith?”
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga obwagamba ati Ensi ehwaho nokwegomba kwayo, erumu ekiniga, kandi nyenkya barole omuntu: ago tigali mugara enyuma okuikiriza kwanyu?

english: Keep your minds fixed on the things above, not on the world.
lunyoro: Mutekerezege ebyagaiguru, kunu tibiri bya hansi.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) Because of your patient endurance and your stubborn heart, you have heard God's own anger on the Day of His anger and the result of his righteous judgment.
lunyoro: kandi obwokugumangana nomutima gwawe ogutarurwegarukamu, buli oyeyahulire wenka ekiniga hali ekiro ekyekiniga, nokusuku'rwa okwomusango ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga,

english: But Jesus himself got up and went to the desert and prayed.
lunyoro: Baitu uwe yayesororamu wenka, yagenda omu irungu, yasaba.

english: [REERAL] The dust from your city that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you, because you know that the Kingdom of God has come near you.
lunyoro: Necucu eyomu rubuga rwa nyu, erukukwatira omu bigere byaitu, nayo tugibaragalize inywe: baitu mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga buirire haihi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Again he went away, wept, and spoke the same thing, and so he went back home.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okurugayo, yaaba, nagamba ebigambo bimu na biri, Kandi yagaruka

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] increase your knowledge, and increase your self-control; increase your peace, and reverence for God;
lunyoro: hakur tomanyire? Hakur to?hakurto? Hakururato? Hakusima? Hakutina Ruhanga? Hakukuratira Obusinge?

english: When the teachers of the Law saw Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors, they said to his disciples, “He is eating and drinking with tax collectors and sinners!”
lunyoro: Abahandiki abomu Bafalisayo, obubamuboine narya hamu nabasisi nabahoza, bagambira abegeswabe ngu Narya kandi nanywa hamu nabazoza nabasisi.

english: They began to proclaim God's message to the people in Damascus and to the rest of Jerusalem, until all the country of Judea and Gentiles and to turn to God and do what is right.
lunyoro: baitu nabanza okubatebeza abomu Damasiko, kandi nabomu Yerusalemu, nokuhikya ensi yona eya Buyudaya, Nabamahanga, nabo begarukemu, bahindukire Ruhanga, nibakora engeso ezisemerire okwegarukamu.

english: For to one person is given by the Spirit the word of knowledge through the Spirit.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu omu ahabwa omu Mwoyo ogu, ekigambo ekyokumanya omu mwoyo ogu;

english: Jesus cried with a loud cry, and gave him life.
lunyoro: Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto, yahayo obwomezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All who were in the Council saw him face-to-face, as an angel.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abakaba baikalire omu rukurato bamugumyaho amaiso nibamurora amaisoge nigasisana nkagamaraika.

english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You have been lost much.”
lunyoro: Tali Ruhanga wabafu, baitu wabomezi: muhabire muno.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I was not afraid to tell you anything that would be right, and to teach you publicly and from house to house.
lunyoro: kandi ntaratanga okubatebeza ekigambo kyona ekisemre nokubegesa bwerebwere, nomu nju emuemu,

english: My persecutions and the persecutions which I endured in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. My persecution has been brought about by the Lord in all things.
lunyoro: nokukorwa kwange, nokusalirwa kwange: ebyambaireho amo Antyokiya, nomu Ikonio, nomu Rusitira, okuhiganizibwa okunahiganizibwe okukuli: kandi Mukama waitu akanjuna omu byona.

english: Jesus looked around at them all and said, “Stretch out your hand.” He said, "Your power is being healed.”
lunyoro: Kandi yababungyamu bona amaiso, yamugambira ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagira ati: omukonogwe gwakira.

english: This happened in order to make come true what the prophet Isaiah had said: “He himself took our sickness and carried away our diseases.
lunyoro: ekigambo kihiki'le ekyagamberwe Isaya nabi, nagamba ati Uwe wenka akatwara obugara bwaitu, nayetweka endwara zaitu.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) May peace be with all those who follow it, and peace be upon them, and mercy, and toward the people of God.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abalikurutira omulingo gunu, obusinge bube halibo, nokuganyirwa, na hali Isaleri owa Ruhanga.

english: For God said, ‘Respect your father and your mother,’ and whoever curses your father or your mother will die in the same way.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga akagamba ati Otinege 'so na nyoko:kandi Anyakujuma ise rundi nyina, afere kimu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Elymas the sorcerer (for this is his name of being known) rebelled against them and tried to deceive the older men by faith.
lunyoro: Baitu Erima omurogo (baitu niryo ibararye okulimanyisibwa) yahakana nabo nagonza okuhabisa owisaza omu kuikiriza.

english: Jesus ordered him, “Get out of here and go away!”
lunyoro: Yesu yagucomera nagamba ati Huna, murugeho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I was dead, but now I am alive forever. I have the power to die and have the breath of life.
lunyoro: kandi Omwomezi; kandi nkaba nfire, baitu dora, nyomire okuhikya ebiro nebiro, kandi nyina ebisumuruzo ebyokufa nokuzimu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] His heart is very large for you, just as he remembers all of you, because you believed in him with fear and trembling.
lunyoro: Embabazize halinywe nyigi muno muno, obuyaijukire okuhu'ra kwanyu inywena, nkokumwamuirize omu kutina nomu kutukumira.

english: “How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You make the Kingdom of heaven appear to people, but you don't go in, nor do you allow those who go in.”
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abahandiki Nabafalisayo abagobya! Baitu mukinga obukama obwomuiguru omu maiso ga Bantu; baitu inywe timubutahamu, nabo abanyakutahahamu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] A certain priest was going down that road, but he did not know where he was going. When he saw him, he went on the other side of the road and went on.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omu akaba nasirimuka omu muhanda ogu atakimanyireho: obuyamuboine yamuhinguraho ha rubaju, yagenda.

english: [REGENERAL] Our ancestors brought them with them to their death with them and with them Jonah, who brought the land of the nations into the presence of our ancestors until the time of David.
lunyoro: Ibaisenkuru itwe nabo eyibalesere hamu na Yonabo ebiyalesere ensi zamahanga, Ruhanga agayabingire omu maiso gabaisenkuruitwe, okuhikya ebiro bya Daudi;

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] At once they all saw him, and they were completely amazed. They ran to him and greeted him.
lunyoro: Ahonaho ekitebe kyona, obubamuboine, bahuni'ra muno,bairuka nibaija namberali, bamuramukya.

english: Jesus answered her, “You are a woman of great faith! May it happen to you just as you wish!” From that very moment on her daughter was healed.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Iwe mukazi, okuikiriza kwawe kwingi: kibe namberoli nkokworukugonza. Omuisikiwe akakira okuruga ha kasumi ako.

english: After being persecuted, Jesus appeared to them with many miracles and wonders, and for forty days he was seen speaking about the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okusalizibwa, yayeyoleka ayomire hali abo nobwokuro'raho bwingi, kandi yarorwaga abo ebiro amakumi ana, nagamba ebyobukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: At that time you were apart from Christ, living as foreigners in the land of Israel and as foreigners to the covenant that God made with the Gentiles. You did not have to wait, and you did not hope, and there is no one in the world who has no God.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe omu biro ebi ebyaira mukaba muli hara na Kristo, muli basuhuki hali oruganda rwa Isaleri, kandi na banyaihanga hali ekiragano ekyomurago, kandi mutanyina okunihira, kandi mutatunga kunihira,, kandi mutaroho Ruhanga omu nsi.

english: As they were going along, some of the guards went to the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibagenda dora abalinzi abamu bakaija ha rubuga nibagambira banyakatagara abakuru byona ebyabaireho.

english: They are trying to convince me that Christ is the Messiah, not the truth, but the truth. They think that I will be raised from death to life in my chains.
lunyoro: baitu bali nibatebeza Kristo obwokukungana, hatali omu mazima, nibatekereza okunyimukiza omuhito omu nsengo zange.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] This is what love means, not that we love God, but that he loves us and sent his Son as the means by which we are made the descendants of God.
lunyoro: Dobi nukwo kugonza, tikuli itwe okugonza Ruhanga, baitu uwe okugonzaga itwe, nokutuma omwanawe okuba ekicunguro obwebibi byaitu.

english: Jesus reached out and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, looked straight, and looked at the man.
lunyoro: Yamuza nomukono nagamba ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagugo'ra, nugusisana nkogwakabiri.

english: For the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord comes, there is freedom.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu nuwe Mwoyo: kandi nambere hali Omwoyo gwa Mukama waitatwe, nuho hali obugabe.

english: He was Jesus of Nazareth, whom God had poured out on him by means of the Holy Spirit and power. He went and performed good deeds and healed all who were under the power of Satan, because God was with him.
lunyoro: ndi Yesu owa Nazalesi, Ruhanga okuyamusesereho Omwoyo Ogurukwera namani: ayagendagendaga, nakora okurungi, nakiza bona abayenderezibwe Setani; baitu Ruhanga akaba ali nauwe.

english: But if Christ had been told that he had been raised from death, some of you would have said, “He has been raised to life.”
lunyoro: baitu Kristo obwaraba natebezebwa ngu Akahumburwa omu bafu, abamu omulinywe nibagamba bata ngu Busaho kuhumbuka omu bafu?

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] They sold the potter's field, and the Lord had given me what the Lord wanted.
lunyoro: ndigulire omusiri ogwomubumbi; Mukama nko kuyandagire.

english: Jesus answered, “I tell you that there are some here who will not die until they see the Kingdom of God come with power.”
lunyoro: ba nagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Hali banu abemerire hanu, haroho abandi abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhikya obubalirora obukama bwa Ruhanga nubuija namani.

english: Peter said to them, “Can anyone say that the Holy Spirit is just as real as we are?”
lunyoro: Petero yabagambira ati Omuntu nasobora okuima amaizi, Omwoyo Ogurukwera nka itwe?

english: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law became so angry that they said to one another, “He saved others, but he cannot save himself!”
lunyoro: nabegeswabe bahyema muno, nibagambirangana hamu nabahandiki ngu akajuna abandi, tarukusobora kwejuna wenka.

english: Jesus answered, “This is the work that God has sent you to believe in him.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Gunu nugwo mulimo gwa Ruhanga, okuikiriza ogu ouyatumire.

english: When Moses saw it, he was amazed at what he had seen. As soon as he came near to see them, the Lord's voice came to him,
lunyoro: Kandi Musa obuyaboine, yahuni'ra ekiyarozire: obuyabairire haihi okurora, iraka rya Mukama likaija liti

english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you leaders of the people.”
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Muije, munkuratire, nanyowe ndibafora abasohi babantu.

english: [REERAL] Do not be afraid of one another; instead, be on your guard that you will not turn back to Satan for help.
lunyoro: Mutaimangana, rundi obumuba muragaine akacu, Setani aleke okubahya obwokutetanga kwanyu.

lunyoro: Ibura iraka ryaruga omu iguru ngu Nkalinyumiza.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] I am being given the end of your faith, so that your salvation may be complete with God.
lunyoro: Kandi nimhabwa empero eyokuikirizibwa kwanyu, nukwo kujunwa kwemyoyo yanyu.

english: For the heavens and the earth that are now are stored up for the same purpose and which have been heard by the fire which has been prepared for the Day of Judgment and for the destruction of three godless people.
lunyoro: iguru erya hati bunu nensi habwekigambo ekimu neki byahulirwe omu'ro, nibirindwa okuhikya ha kiro kyomusango nokuhwerekerezebwa okwabantu abatantu abatarukutina Ruhanga.

english: Nor does anyone pour new wine into used wineskins, because new wine must pour out fresh wineskins, and both are ruined by the wine; instead, new wine will pour out into fresh wineskins.”
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga enkuru: kiraba kitalikyo, amarwa gahulikya endyanga, namarwa gaseseka, nendyanga zisisikara; baitu amarwa agakora emirwa emihyaka.

english: [GOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Respect your father and your mother, which is the first commandment of the covenant.
lunyoro: "So na nyoko obatinege" ( nikyo kiragiro kyokubanza ekinyakuroho omurago),

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) I am going on to you, to the reward of the call of God in union with Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: nimpondera okuhika kuli, nambere hali empera eyokweta kwa Ruhanga okwahaiguru enyakuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: Then he sent messengers to the villages of Samaria to get ready for him.
lunyoro: kandi yatuma abakwenda omu kika ekya Babsamaliya okumutekaniriza.

english: He did not have any ancestors; he did not own the first day or the end of his earthly life; he was like God's Son, who lives as a priest forever.
lunyoro: atanyina baisenkuru, atanyina ekiro ekiyabandizeho, nobwekuba empero yobwomezi, baitu akasisanizibwa Nkomwana wa Ruhanga) aikara nyakatagara ebiro byona.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] One body, one Spirit, just as you have been called in the same hope that you have.
lunyoro: Omubiri gumu, Nomwoyo omu, kandi nka inywe okumwayeserwe omu kunihira kumu okwokwetwa kwanyu:

lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Nangwa, nokuhu'ra titukahu'raga rundi haroho Omwoyo Ogurukwera:

lunyoro: Yairuka yaija hali Simoni petero na hali omwegeswa ogu ondi Yesu owakaba nagonza, yabagambira ati Baihiremu Mukama waitu omu kituro, kandi titurukumanya nambere bamutaire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the one who makes himself clean and the one whom God has made holy has commanded all of God's people to be holy. He is not ashamed of them to be called ‘Friends.’
lunyoro: Baitu ogu arukweza nabo abarukwezebwa bona barugire hali omu: nikyo atakwaitirwa ensoni okubeta bagenzi, nagamba ati

english: “Go, then, and tell his disciples and Peter, ‘I am going ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’”
lunyoro: Baitu mugende, mutebeze abegeswabe na Petero ngu Nabebembera okugenda Galiraya: nuho mulimurora, nkokuyabagambire.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] To the one who has been given the power to believe in the Spirit, and to the other who has received the gift of the Spirit to heal diseases by the Spirit.
lunyoro: Ondi ahabwa okuikiriza omu Omwoyo ogu, ondi atunga ekisembo ekyokukiza endwara omu mwoyo ogu,

english: As I hope and wait for him, I will not be ashamed of anything. Instead, as always, Christ will be proud of me with all my strength, whether in life or in death.
lunyoro: nkokutegereza kwange nokunihira kwange okukuli ngu tindikwatwa ensoni omu kigambo kyona, baitu nkebiro byona na hati bunu, Kristo aranyumizibwaga omu mubiri gwange omu bumanzi bwona, rundi omu bwomezi nomu kufa.

english: If you destroy God's temple, God will destroy you; but if you destroy it, you are his temple.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwahwerekereza yekaru ya Ruanha, ogu Ruhanga alimuhwerekereza: baitu enju ya Ruhanga ninywe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [EDUCATION] They made sure that they had told him not to keep the bread from the yeast, but to teach the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
lunyoro: Nubwo bakengere ngu tagambire okwerinda ekitumbisa ekyemigati, baitu okwegesa okwa Bafalisayo Nabasadukayo.

english: He is the one who does what is right, just as he is righteous; he who does evil is the Devil's. For this reason the Son of God was made manifest and exposed to the Devil’s power.
lunyoro: ogu arukukora ebyokuhiki'ra nuwe ahikirire; nyakukora ekibi nuwe wa Setani: nikyo Omwana wa Ruhanga yayolekirwe, ahwerekereze emirimo ya Setani.

english: There are many different forms of service, but there is only one God, who uses everything in order to do it.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho emiringo nyingi eyemirimo, baitu Ruhanga ali omu, anyakukoza byona omu byona.

english: and send greetings to the church in their homes. Greetings to Epaenetus, my dear friend, who is the first in Asia for Christ.
lunyoro: kandi muramukye nekanisa eyomu nju yabu. Muramukye Epaineto, oundukugonza, nuwe kyana ekyokubanza, ogu akabali kyokubanza ekyomu Asiya hali Kristo.

english: Jesus said to him, “Have you seen how much this great and mysterious work will be done? The stone that will be left here will not be thrown down, and it will be thrown to the earth.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Oboine okwombekwa kunu okwingi? Tihalisigara hanu ibale erinyakuli ha ibale, eritalinagwa hansi.

english: “What does this man have to say to you?” they asked. “He is a liar! Who, then, can forgive sins against God alone?”
lunyoro: Omuntu onu kiki ekimugambisize kiti? Majuma: noha asobora okuihaho ebib, rundi omu, nuwe Ruhanga?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] And if I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They began to criticize him, saying, “We found this man misleading our people, and he is trying to gain favor with the Emperor. He claims to be the Messiah, the King!”
lunyoro: Babanza okumulega nibagamba ngu Tukarora omuntu onu nahabisa ihanga ryaitu: nabatanga okuzinira Kaisali, nayegamba wenka okuba Kristo, Omukama.

english: [GENERAL] I am telling you only about the weakness of your flesh, but now that you have put aside your parts for shameful purposes and have put them to shame. In the same way, you must now surrender your bodies to the body to be holy and holy.
lunyoro: Ngamba ebyomuntu kwonka obwobugara obwomubiri gwanyu: baitu nkokumwahayoga ebicweka byanyu hali ebyensoni, nokwema hali okwena, nukwo hati bunu mweheyo ebicwekabinywe okuba bairu hali okuhiki'ra nokwezebwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] “My name is Lagani,” he answered, “because we are many.”
lunyoro: Yamuagambira ati Ibara ryange ninyowe Legioni;baitu tuli naingi.

english: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? For we have the minds of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu noha akaba amanyire amagezi ga Mukama, okumwegesa? Baitu itwe tuyina amagezi ga Kristo.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] He will put away the fear of God in Jacob.
lunyoro: Ariihaho okutatina Ruhanga ha Yakobo:

english: [REDUCATION] [GENERAL] Jesus told them many other things, and he said to them, “Save yourselves from this wicked world!”
lunyoro: Kandi akabatebeza omu bigambo bindi ebingi, nabagambi'ra ati Mwejune omu businge bunu obuhabire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] That is why I did this in Jerusalem, and I was put in prison by many of the holy ones, who were given authority over the chief priests, and when they were put to death, I also believed in killing them.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo nakolire Yerusalemu, kandi naboha omu nju zenkomo abarukwera baingi,obunahairwe obusobozi hali banyakatagara abakuru, kandi obubaisirwe, nanyowe nkaikiriza okubaita.

english: For God is the one who made you love and do what he himself wants you to do.
lunyoro: baitu Ruhanga nuwe akoza omulinywe okugonza nokukora, nkokwasima wenka.

english: “Lord,” I answered, “they know very well that I am in prison and that they are in all the synagogues who believe in you.
lunyoro: Ndagamba nti Mukama wange bo bamanyire bonka ngu nyowe nabataga omu nju zenkomo, kandi nabateraga omu maso'rokaniro gona abakuikirize:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] He looked up and said, “I make people look like trees walking about.”
lunyoro: Rora haiguru nagamba ati Nimpweza abantu; baitu nindora nibasisana nkemiti nibagenda.

english: In union with Christ you too must be built together in union with him as God's throne by the Spirit.

lunyoro: kandi tikiri eki kyonka, baitu akasomwamu ekanisa okugenda naitwe omu kigambo kinu ekyembabazi, itwe ekiturukuhereza hali ekitinisa ekya Mukama waitu, nokwoleka okwekamba kwaitu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] He stood up in front of her, and sent the man away; and he got up and began to wait on them.

lunyoro: Kandi obwokuro'raho bunu buligenda nabo abaliikiriza: omu ibara ryange numwo balibinga emizimu; balibaza omu ngambo empyaka:

english: When the old man saw what had happened, he believed, and I was completely amazed at the teaching of the Lord.

lunyoro: Baitu i nywe muizire hali orusozi Sayuni, na hali orubuga rwa Ruhanga omwomezi, Yerusalemu orwomu iguru, na halli bamaraika

lunyoro: Baitu amazima ga Ruhanga obugasagire obwebisuba byange okuleta okukugizibwakwe nyowe nincwe'rwa ki omusango nkomusisi?
