english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] So then, do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord wants you to do.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutaliba badomadoma, baitu mumanye eki Mukama waitu ekyarukugonza.

english: One of the teachers of the Law answered, “Teacher, when you say this, you are right with us.”
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abegesa ebiragiro yagarukamu namugambira ati Omwegesa obwogamba eki buli ojumire naitwe.

english: At that very moment Jesus said to her, “Your son lives.” She and all her family believed.
lunyoro: Kandi nuhomu kasumi ako Yesu akayamugambiremu ati Omwana wawe ayomire: uwe yaikiriza nenjuye yona.

english: The Lord was angry with him, and he gave him over to the tenants, until he might pay back everything to the owner of the house.
lunyoro: Mukamawe yabihirwa yamuhayo hali abaduma, obwalikahikya okumara ibanja ryona.

english: What is our hope? It is joy or gladness or a great feeling of pride. It is not you who stand before the Lord Jesus when he comes.
lunyoro: Baitu okunihira kwaitu kiki? Rundi okusemererwa, rundi ekondo eyokwenyumiza? Tininywe omu maiso ga Mukama waitu Yesu obwaliija?

english: Show mercy to one another and forgive one another whenever there is a difference between you and the other. Do the same, as Christ has forgiven you.
lunyoro: mucule'ranganege, kandi numuganyirangana inywenka, rundi haroho wena anyina ekigambo hali mutahiwe: nka Kristo nauwe okuyaganyire inywe nukwo nainywe mukole muti:

english: Jesus said, “Father, you know what they are doing, but they do not know what to do.” So they divided his clothes among themselves and threw dust on him.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagamba ati Isenyowe obaganyire; baitu tibamanyire ekibarukukora. Kandi bakabagana ebyokujwarabye, nibatoma.

english: They shouted in a loud voice, “How long, then, will you be the Holy One, the one who is truthful and true, to judge the people on earth by our blood?
lunyoro: Basima niraka erihango nibagamba ngu Olihikya nkaha Mukuru waitu, arukwera, owamazima okutacwa omusango nokuhora enzigu obwesagama yaitu hali abo abarukuikara hansi?

english: He has poured out his own blood on us through his blood, so that our sins may be forgiven as much as the abundant riches of his grace.
lunyoro: we ayatuhaisize okucungurwa kwaitu obwesagamaye, nukwo kuihibwaho ebyokusisa byaitu, nkobuguda obwembabazize okubuli,

english: This is how we can be sure that God gave us eternal life, and that life is in union with his Son.
lunyoro: Kandi kunu nukwo kumanyisa ngu Ruhanga akatuha obwomezi obutahwaho. Nobwomezi obuli obubuli omu Mwanawe.

english: But Jesus answered him, “Who is my mother and my brothers?”
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nagambira ogu ayamutibize ati Mau araha, nabagezi bange barah?

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the Devil himself is divided, his kingdom will last forever. You say that I drive out demons because Beelzebul.
lunyoro: Kandi Setani nauwe obwabaganizibwamu wenka, obukamabwe buliikaraho buta Baitu inywe numugamba ngu Nyowe mbinga emizimu habwa Beerezebuli.

english: Whoever finds his own life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena anyakuzora obwomezibwe bulimuburaho; nauwe anyakubuza obwemezibwe habwange alibuzora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] They sat down all the way to the house, and as they were walking, Jesus acted as if he were going to pass by.
lunyoro: Kandi bakai'ra haihi nekika, hakaba nibagenda: uwe nasisana nkayenzire okuhinguraho.

english: We pray to God that you will do no wrong. We are not the ones who deserve praise, but instead that you have done what is good and seem to be failures.
lunyoro: Kandi ntusaba Ruhanga inywe mutakora kibi nekimu; tibuli itwe obwokurtorwa nkabarukusimwa, baitu inywe obwebi, baitu ekirungi, nobutusisaine nkabatarukusisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He has made his word come true through all the nations of the earth, and he has fixed the times and the limits of the places where they live.
lunyoro: ndi ogu ayasalire amahanga gona agabantu okuikara hansi embaju zona, obuyaragire okubateraho ebiro, nemitano eyebiikaro byabu;

english: I saw that woman, whose blood had not been poured out, was purified by the blood of the holy ones and by the faith of Jesus' witnesses. When I saw her, I was completely amazed.
lunyoro: Kandi nkarora omukazi ogu atamire esagama yabarukwera, nesagama yabakaiso ba Yesu. Obunamuboine natangara nokutangara okwingi.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) Look! Your house is abandoned to you, and I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord.’
lunyoro: Dora, enju yanyu abasigirwe kifuka, kandi nimbagambira nti Timulindora, okuhikya obumuligamba ngu Ahairwe omugida arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama.

english: [ELIGIOUS] [GENERAL] When anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not go into your homes or greet him.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaraijaga namberemuli, atrukuleta okwegesa kunu, Mutalimuiriza omu nju yanyu, kunu mutalimuramukta:

english: Those who believe will never die, but will receive eternal life; those who do not believe in the Son will not see life, because God's anger is upon them.
lunyoro: Anyakuikiriza obutahwaho; baitu ataikirize Mwana talibona bwomezi, baitu ekiniga kya Ruhanga kiikaire haruwe.

english: For just as Christ suffered for us, so our consolation in union with Christ has been shaken.
lunyoro: Baitu nkokubonabona kwa Kristo okukwasagire muno halitwe, nukwo nokuhumuzibwa kwaitu omu Kristo kwasagire kuti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But they turned away from the truth and said, “The resurrection has already taken place, and some of them are convinced of their faith.”
lunyoro: baitu bakahaba omu mazima, nibagamba ngu okuhumbuka kukamara okubaho, nibajumikira abamu okuikiriza kwabu.

english: [Glaw] Take them and sit down with them, and pay them their taxes. They will all know that what they have said to you is true, but you yourself obey and obey the Law.
lunyoro: batwara, oyeyeze hamu nabo, obahe efeza, bemwe emitwe yabu: bona balimanya ngu tibiri byamani ebigambo ebibagambirwe haliwe; baitu naiwe wenka oyerinda nokwata ebiragiro.

english: In the same way, when you receive the gifts of the Spirit, you too must work hard to build up the church.
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe, obumwegombere ebisembo ebyomwoyo, muse'lege okusagya obwokwombeka ekanisa.

english: We have brought praise to his glory, and we have brought hope into union with Christ.
lunyoro: nitwe tukugiza ekitinisakye, itwe abayebingire omu Kristo:

english: This is how we know that the Spirit of God is God's Spirit. Whoever acknowledges that Jesus Christ came as a human being comes from God.
lunyoro: Nuho turukumanyira Omwoyo gwa Ruhanga: omwoyo gwona oguyakwtura ngu Yesu Kristo akaija omu mubiri, nugwo gwa Ruhanaga:

english: Suddenly there was a violent earthquake, but an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and rolled the stone away and sat down.
lunyoro: Baitu dora, hakabaho omusisa omukoto: baitu maraika wa Mukama akaruga omu iguru, yaija yakumbya ibale okuliihaho, yaliika'raho.

english: “God was in union with Christ, and he made his world through him to be united to himself, not to separate them from their wrongs, and has united us in this fellowship.
lunyoro: kuba Ruhanga akabali omu Krtisto, nateraniza ensi hamu nauwe wenka, okutabajunaniza ebyokusisa byabu, kandi yatwahuza itwe ekigambo ekyokuterana oku.

english: What I say is not what I say in the Lord, but what I speak in order to win the victory over you.
lunyoro: Ekindukugamba tingambire omu Mukama waitu, baitu rundi omu butami, omu kuguma kunu okwokwenyumiza.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] For what will we give thanks to God for you? All the joy we have in you before our God!
lunyoro: Baitu tuligaru'ra Ruhanga okusima ki habwanyu? Obwokusemererwa kwona okutunyina habwanyu omu maiso ga Ruhanga waitu;

english: Jesus said to them, “How can the children of the bridegroom be without a wedding feast, and how can the bridegroom with them be with them? The day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Abana abobugenyi obwobugole basobora bata okusiba, omuswezi obwabalinabo? Baitu ebiro biriija omuswezi ebyalibaihi'rwamu, omu biro ebi numwo balisibira.

english: Jesus said to him, “Well, then, the children are free.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Nukwo abana nibo bobugabe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] He took a cup, gave thanks to God, and said, “Take this and share it among yourselves.”
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, obuyamazire okusima yagamba ati Mukwate enu mugibagane inywenka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They could not convince him that he was speaking in public, so they were surprised that he had turned back and said good-bye to them.
lunyoro: Kandi batasobole kumuhambiriza obwekigambo eki omu maiso gabantu: nibahuni'ra obwokugarukamukwe, nibaculera kwonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [EDUCATION] You too are the ones to whom God has poured out his Spirit and who lives in you. You do not force anyone to teach you, but the truth that comes from him is not in you; you must remain in union with him and remain in Christ.
lunyoro: Nainywe okuseswaho amagita okumwahairwe haruwe nukuikara omulinywe, kandi timurukutanga omuntu wena okubegesa: baitu nkokusesakwe oku okukuli kwa mazima kunu tikuli kwebisuba, kandi nkokukwabegeseze, nukwo muikalege omuruwe.

english: [REERAL] That is why I write these things while I am away. If I do not live, I will not suffer the punishment that the Lord has given me for his building, not for breaking it.
lunyoro: Nikyo mpandikirire binu ntaroho, obundibaho ndeke okubonabonesa nkosobozi okubuli Mukama waitu obuyampaire obwokwombeka, kunu tibuli obwokusesa.

english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money.
lunyoro: Baitu Petero yamugambira ati Efeza yawe ebule naiwe, biatu otekerize okutunga ekisembo kya Ruhanga nerupiya.

english: Worship God, then, and fight the Devil, and he will flee from you.
lunyoro: Nukwo mucule'le Ruhanga, baitu murwane na Setani, kandi alibairuka.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) In the same way, God's righteousness, by means of his faithfulness through Jesus Christ, is perfect for all those who believe. For there is no difference.
lunyoro: nukwo kuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga obwokwesigwaakwe obwokukora omu Yesu Kristo, hali bona abarukuikiriza; baitu busaho kwahuramu:

english: For the word of God is alive and active, and it is much more powerful than any two-edged sword. It is opposed to life, soul, and body, and strength, and cannot understand the thoughts and the consciences of the heart.
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kya Ruhanga kyomezi, kyamani, kyobwogi bwingi okukira empirima yona eyobwogi bubiri, kandi nikiraba nikibaganizamu obwomezi nomwoyo, nengiga nomusoina, kandi kisobora okumanya ebitekerezo nokuhanura ebyomu mutima.

english: Be on your guard that your enemy, the Devil, will be like a roaring lion, walking about looking for someone to devour.
lunyoro: Mwerindege, murolege omunyanzigwa wanyu Setani nkentale erukububura negendagenda nase'ra owararya:

english: [REERAL] Do what you have heard and seen and heard and saw: do what you hear and understand, and the God of peace will be with you.
lunyoro: Kuko'ra byona ebimwategere nebimmwahairwe nebimwahulire nebimwaboine namberendi. Kandi Ruhanga owobusinge araikaraga nainywe.

english: As they traveled through the whole island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet named Bar-Jesus, a Jew.
lunyoro: Kandi obubarabire omu izinga ryona okuhika Pafo, basanga omuntu omurogo, nabi owebisuba Omuyudaya, ibararye Balisa;

english: I saw three unclean spirits coming out of the mouth of the dragon, the mouth and the mouths of the beast, and the words of the false prophet. Three evil spirits looked like frogs.
lunyoro: Kandi narora emizimu emibi esatu neruga omu kanwa kekijoka, nomu kanwa kekisoro, nomumaiso ga nabi webisuba, emizima emibi isatu erukusisana nkebikere:

english: While Jesus was trying to kill him, he was afraid of the people, because they considered him to be a prophet.
lunyoro: Obwakaba nayenda okumuita, yatina abantu, baitu bakaba nibamutekereza okuba nabi.

english: Greetings to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work in the Lord's service. Greetingly to Persis, who has done so much work in our Lord.
lunyoro: Muramukye Turufaina na Turufosa abakozire emirimo omu Mukama waitu. Muuramukye Peresi arukugonzebwa, ayakolire emirimo mingi omu Mukama Waitu.

english: Again Jesus sent another slave, and they beat him and threw him out of the way.
lunyoro: Yagaruka natuma owakasatu: nogu bamusasangura nibamubingira aheru.

english: Those who do not love God do not know God, but love God.
lunyoro: Atarukugonza tamanyire Ruhanga: baitu Ruhanga nukwo kugonza.

english: They started discussing among themselves, “What shall we say? If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, and why, then, did you not believe in him?
lunyoro: Bakaguzangana bonka, nibagamba ngu Obuturaba ntugamba ngu Kukaruga omu iguru; aragamba ati kandi kiki ekyabahinzire okumuikiriza?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] Give to the one who asks you, and to the other who wants to borrow money do not rob you of your life.
lunyoro: omuntu anyakusaba, omuhe: omuntu anyakwenda okukwohoza otalimutera mabega.

english: Whoever gives one of these little ones too much water in the name of a disciple will certainly drink too much, because his reward will never be paid.”
lunyoro: Na wena alimuha okunywa omu hali banu abake eyugi eyamaizi agarukufuka, omu ibara ryomwegeswa, mazimakwo nimbagambira nti emperaye teriuburaho na kake.

english: [RE knees] [GENERAL] And all those who want to live in godly devotion in union with Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
lunyoro: Kandi mazimakwo bona abarukwendfa okukwata engeso ezokutina Ruhanga omu Kristo Yesu balihiganizibwa.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] For if we have sinned against God, we are sinning against him; if we do not take care of our sins, we have been kept safe from you.
lunyoro: Baitu turaba tugwire iraro, tugwine iraro hali Ruhanga; turaba ntwerinda, twerinzire halinywe.

english: The Lord said to him, “Get up, and go to a place called Lydda, because you have brought a man named Saul of Tarsus back to the house of Judas. He is praying,
lunyoro: Mukama wange. Mukama waitu yamugambira ati Imuka ogende omu ikute eryetwa Literekerire, okagulirize omu nju ya Yuda omuntu, ibararye Sauro, owa Taruso: baitu dora, nasaba;

english: In union with Christ Jesus, then, I have the boast I have in Christ Jesus of God, who is wicked and wicked.
lunyoro: Nukwo nyina okwenyumiza okwange omu Kristo Yesu, omwebi ebya Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] This is better seen than any other priest who has been raised from death to life in the likeness of Melchizedek.
lunyoro: Ebi ebiturukugamba nibikira okumanyisibwa, rundi nyakatagara ondi obwaimuka nkekisisani ekya Merekizedeka okukiri,

english: For we are not like those who are more important than the others, who make God's word come true; but we speak in the presence of God and of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu tituli nkabo abakira obwingi, abahingisa ekigambo kya Ruhanga, baitu obwamazima, nka Ruhanga omu maiso ga Kristo, nukwo tugamba tuti.

english: [GOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] But when the people of Israel obeyed the Law of Moses, they did not obey these commandments.
lunyoro: baitu Isaleri, obubakuratire ebiragiro ebyokuhiki'ra batahike hali ebiragiro ebi.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] But they did not understand God's righteousness, and wanted to know for themselves that they had not heard the righteousness of God.
lunyoro: Baitu obubataramanyire okuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga kandi nibase'ra okumanya okwabu bonka, batacule'le oku kuhiki'ra okwa Ruhanga

english: After gathering all the chief priests and the teachers of the Law together, Paul asked them, “Where is the Messiah to be born?”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okusoroza ahamu banyakatagara abakuru bona nabahandiki babantu, yabakaguza Kristo nambere arukugenda kuzarwa.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] If, then, you have to be put to death by God's chosen people in the church, how can you be put right with God? I tell you, then.
lunyoro: Nukwo muraba numuba nokucwa eyobwomezi bunu, abarukugayibwa omu kanisa nibo mutaho okucwa emisango? Ningamba okubakwasa ensoni.

english: For I am the least of the apostles, but I persecuted the church of God.
lunyoro: Baitu ninyowe muto owabakwenda, baitu nkahiga ekanisa ya Ruhanga.

english: Jesus said to the chief priests, the guards, and the officers of the Temple guard who had come to him, “Did you come with swords and clubs to keep me from coming with swords or clubs?
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira abanyakatagara abakuru nabalinzi abeyekaru, nabakuru obubamuizirire ati Munyizirire nkokumuizira ati Munyizire nkomunyagi nempirima nemiigo?

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] For if you do what is evil, you are a servant of God. But if you commit a sin, you must not commit a crime. You must not take a sword for the sword, because you are God's servant, a shield for the one who does evil.
lunyoro: Baitu nuwe mukwenda wa Ruhanga haliwe obwoburungi. Baitu oraba nokora ekibihire, tina: baitu takwatira busa empirima: baitu nukwo akukondera Ruhanga, omuhozi wenzigu hali anyakukora obubi.

english: The Holy Spirit says, “I am so sorry that I am not sad until I make my mind over.”
lunyoro: Omwoyo Ogurukwera, ngu ninsasa muno kandi nintuntura okutaikya omu mutima gwange.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] He did not know the chief priests of this world, but knew that they had not crucified the Lord of glory.
lunyoro: igi abana abomu businge bunu obubatamanyire: baitu kuba bamanyire tibakubambire ha muti Mukama wekitinisa:

english: [RELECT] [GENERAL] Others have this right over you, but we are not greater than they are. We do not have this authority, but endure everything and do not respect the Good News about Christ.
lunyoro: Abandi baraba banyina obusobozi bunu balinywe, naitwe titurukukira? Baitu itwe tutakwate obusobozi obu, baitu ntugumisiriza byona, tutaleta ekitinisa enjiri ya Kristo.

english: Do you want to kill me, just as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
lunyoro: orukugonza okunyita nyowe nkokuwaisire ijo Omumisiri?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] After Jesus had gone away, he took the bread and had the bread; he ate and talked with them a little while later, and when he came back, he left.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okutemba nokucwa omugati, nokurya, nokubaza nabo ekicu ekikoto, okukisa obuire, yarugayo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [EDUCATION] But do not be called ‘Teacher,’ for your teaching is one.
lunyoro: baitu inywe mutaryetwa Rabi; baitu omwegesa wanyu ali omu,

english: [REGOVERNMENT] I want you to be sure that this is true, and so I want to make sure that you remain united in this matter, so that those who believe in God may remember to give their minds and hearts to what is good.
lunyoro: Ekigambo kinu kyokwesiga, kandi hali ebi ningonza iwe okugumiza kimu, nukwo abo abaikirize Ruhanga baijukege okutaho emitima ha ngeso enungi. Ebigambo ebi birungi.

english: [REERAL] Pray also for us, that God will make us preach the Good News about the secret of Christ, and so that someone else may be a prisoner for it.
lunyoro: Kandi numusabira naitwe, Ruhanga atukungu'raho oruigi orwekigambo, okugamba ekyensita kya kristo, ekindi omunyankomo habwakyo:

english: I want you to know that Christ is the head of every man, but he is the leader of Christ God.
lunyoro: Kandi ningonza inywe mumanye ngu Kristo nuwe mutwe gwomusaija wena; baitu omutwe ogwa Kristo Ruhanga.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] You have good conduct among the Gentiles, and you have turned them away from the evil of your doings, because they have seen your good deeds and have praised God on the Day of your being saved.
lunyoro: mugenderege Omu ngeso zanyu ezisemire omuli Abamahanga; kandi nobubabageya nkabakozi bobubi, baitu obwengeso Zanyu enungi ezibarora, banyumize Ruhanga ha kiro kyokubungirwamu.

english: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
lunyoro: OKUBANZA okwenjiri ya Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga.

english: When Jesus left that place, the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees began to criticize him bitterly and make fun of him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyarugireyo, abahandiki Nabafalisayo bakabanza okumufunza muno, nokumwohya okugamba ebigambo bingi;

english: Take away the old yeast, and then be new in your way, just as you are without a yeast. For even Christ died for us,
lunyoro: Muihemu ekitumbisa ekyaira, mufoke ekiihuro ekihyaka, nkokumutalimu ekitumbisasso. Baitu Nokuhingungurwaho kwaitu kukaitwa, nuwe Kristo:

english: We ourselves will be found to be like witnesses against God, because we testify about God that he raised the Messiah from death, if the dead are not raised to life.
lunyoro: Kandi naitwe tuzokere nkabakaiso abebisuba aba Ruhanga; baitu tukatebeza ebya Ruhanga ngu akahumbura Kristo owatarahumbuire, rundi abafu obubaraba batahumburwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After saying this, Jesus got up and went to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okubaza ati yabebembera natemba okugenda Yerusalemu.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] They were singing in the Temple and praising God with all their heart.
lunyoro: kandi baikaraga obutosa omu yekaru nibakugiza Ruhanga.

english: Jesus answered them, “How hard it is for you people to believe! How long will I be with you? How long do I have to put up with you! Bring him to me!”
lunyoro: Yabagarukamu nagamba ati Inywe abobusinge obutarukuikiriza ndihikya nkaha okuikara nainywe? Ndihikya Nkaha okubagumisiriza? Mumundetere.

english: So then, it is not God's will that you want or run away; it belongs to God who accepts you.
lunyoro: Nukwo tikiri kyogu anyakwenda, nobwakuba anyakuiruka, baitu kya Ruhanga arukuganyira.

english: For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see, but they could not, and to hear what you hear, but did not hear.
lunyoro: baitu mananukwo nimbagambira nti Banabi nabakama baingi bakagonza okurora ebimurukurora, tibabibona; nokuhu'ra ebimurukuhura tibabihu'ra.

english: The woman said to him, “I know that the Messiah will come—called the Messiah—and when he comes, he will tell us everything.”
lunyoro: Omukazi yamugambira ati manyire nti Masiya naija ( ayetwa kristo): obwaliija alitusobo'ra ebigambo byona.

english: But if your brother sins against you because you are not eating, do not let him go through with your food, because you have no love for him. Do not destroy the one who died for you.
lunyoro: Baitu mugnzi wawe rundi aliba natuntura obwebyokurya, iwe tokyagendera omu kugonza. Otamuhwerekereza na kake ogu ayafire habwawe.

english: They both left, and the other disciple went over to the tomb first.
lunyoro: Basirimuka bombi hamu: nomwegeswa ogu ondi yahinguraho Petero, yabanza okuhika ha kituro:

english: Jesus said to them, “I am telling you the truth: Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread from above.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yabagambira ati Mali mali nimbagambira nti Tali Musa yabahaire ebyokurya ebyarugire omu iguru; rundi Isenyowe nuwe abaha ebyokulya ebyamananu ebiruga Omu iguru.

english: The chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask Jesus to set them free.
lunyoro: Baitu banyakatagara abakuru nabakuru bakagambi'ra ebitebe okusaba baraba, bahwerekereze Yesu.

english: And in this matter I am eager to remain innocent before God and his people forever.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe nyekamba omu kigambo kinu, okuikara nomutima ogutaroho musango hali Ruhanga na hali abantu ebiro byona.

english: If your eye causes you to lose sight of you, take it out of your heart. It is better for you to enter the Kingdom of God than for you have one eye to be thrown into hell,
lunyoro: Kandi eriso ryawe obulikwesitaza, oliihemuga; hakire iwe okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga oyina eriso limu, okukira okunagwa omu Gehene, oyina amaiso gombi;

english: For if Abraham were put to the test by works, he would have done well in this respect, because he did not have God's approval.

lunyoro: baitu kiraba kiri kyoburyo hali Ruhanga okugaru'ra omuhito abo abatuntuza inywe;

english: As he announced through his holy prophets, who lived in the world before him.
lunyoro: Nkokuyagambire omu kanwa ka banabibe abarukwera, abakaba baroho ensi ekaba okubaho,

english: [RELIGIOUS] [EDUCATION] Because of the hope you have heard from him in heaven, you have already heard the message of the truth of the Good News.
lunyoro: obwokunihira okwabahulirwe omu iguru, nukwo mwahulireho kara omu kigambo kyamazima agenjiri,

english: [GENRELIGIOUS] After Jesus had arrested him, he put him in prison and handed him over to be kept under guard to the eleven soldiers. He wanted to bring him before the people during the Passover Festival.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okumukwata, yamuta omu nju yenkomo, namuhayo hali baiserikale ikumi na mukaga okumulinda muno, nayenda okumuleta omu maiso gabantu Okuhingurwaho kuhoireho.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] Do you boast about the Law, sin, and the Law? Do you dishonor God?
lunyoro: iwe anyakwenyumirizamu omu biragiro, omu kusisa ebiragiro, omu oihaho Ruhanga ekitinisakye?

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Peter stood up with the eleven disciples and began to raise his voice and say to them, “Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem know this, so that you may understand what I say.”
lunyoro: Baitu Petero akaimuka hamu nabo ikumi nomu, yagambira haiguru nabatebeza ati Inywe abasaija Abayudaya, nainywe inywena abarukuikara Yerusalemu, kinu mukimanye, mutege amatu hali ebigambo byange.

english: Do not be afraid of the enemy in all that you do, but of the one who opposes you, who is the one whom God has commanded you to be saved.
lunyoro: mutagwa ensazi hali abanyanzigwa omu kigambo kyona kyona, baitu obwebi ekimurukugumibwa, kinu kibe kyobumanzi halinywe, nukwo kurugire hali Ruhanga,

english: [REERAL] Who, then, is to be shown by the Lord's power?
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwa Mukama gukasuku'rwa oha?

english: Those who believe in him will not be judged, but will believe that he has been judged, because they do not believe in the name of the Son of God, who was born on their own authority.
lunyoro: Anyakumuikiriza tacwerwa musango, baitu aturukuikiriza amazire okucwerwa, baitu taikirize ibara Ryomwana wa Ruhanga ayazairwe omu wenka.

english: He opened the way for Moses and for all the prophets, and he explained to them in all the Scriptures the truth about himself.
lunyoro: Yabandiza ha Musa na banabi bona, yabasobo'ra omu byahandikirwe byona ebyamuhandikirwe wenka.

english: Do you have houses to live and drink? Do you despise God's church, and do you dishonor those who do not have houses? What shall I tell you? Why should I praise you? I will not praise you.
lunyoro: Rundi timunyina enju zokuliramu nokunyweramu? Rundi numugaya ekanisa ya Ruhanga, kandi numukwasa ensoni abatanyina enju? Ndabagambira ki? Ndabasima habweki? Tindukubasima.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Those whom he has accepted as righteous he has called, and those whom he calls he has judged. Those whom God has judged he has given honor to.
lunyoro: kandi abayayahuire ira, nibo yayesere: kandi abayayesere, nibo yacwire omusango: kandi abayaihireho omusango, nibo yataireho ekitinisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When evening came, Jesus left and went to a place where no one could find him. The crowds came to him and tried to keep him from leaving them.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obubwakire yarugayo, yagenda omu kiikaro nambere hatarumu bantu: abebitebe bamuse'ra, nibaija namberali, nibenda okumutanga, atabarugaho.

english: Some time later Felix went with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jew. He called Paul and listened to him about the faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebimu obubyahinguireho Ferikisi yaija na mukaziwe Durusira, akabali Omuyudaya, yayeta Pauro, yamuhu'ra ebyokuikiriza okuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: [Glaws] [GENERAL] For the Law has not yet come into force, and the Law of Moses has given us the better hope.
lunyoro: baitu ebiragiro bitahikirize nekimu, nokuletamu okunihira okurukukira oburungi:

english: Jesus answered, “The man I will use is the one you will give me.” So he took a stick and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Oundakoleza entonge ningimuha nuwogu. Obuyakoleze entonge yahikwata yagimuha Yuda omwana wa Simoni Isikaryota.

english: The next day we sailed from there and arrived at Chios and arrived in Samos. The next morning we reached Miletus.
lunyoro: kandi twahanika amaberu okurugayo, ha kiro ekyakabiri twahika okurole'ra Kio, kandi ha kyakana twahikya Samo; ha kyakasatu twahikaho Mireto.

english: There will be no more night; they will not need sunlight or sunlight, because the Lord God will give them light, and they will rule as kings forever and ever.
lunyoro: Tihalibayo ekiro bwakabiri; kunu tibataga omusana gwetabaza, nomusana gwizoba, baitu Mukama Ruhanga alibaha omusana: kandi balirema ebiro nebiro.

english: For those who wanted me to be put right with Christ for my sake, my friends, who belong to my body.
lunyoro: Baitu naba ngondeze nyowe nyenka okuihwaho omusango gwa Kristo habwa bagenzi bange, abomu ruganda rwange omu mubiri:

english: Some of the disciples said to him, “We have seen the Lord.” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the scars of a scorpion's eye and put my finger on his side, I will not believe.”
lunyoro: Abegeswa abandi bamugambira ngu Tukarora Mukama waitu. Baitu yabagambira ati Obuntalirora omu biganjabye enkoju zempindo, nintaho orukumu rwange ha nkoju zimpindo, ninyikiriza nambere ziri.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) We pray today for you, then, that our God will make sure that you will be put right with him and that he will make perfect in every way that you want to do what is good and to do the work of faith.
lunyoro: nukwo tusabira ebiro byano habwanyu, nukwo Ruhanga waitu abatekereze musemerire okwezebwa uwe, kandi ahikirize namani kyona ekimugonza ekyoburungi nomulimo ogwokuikiriza;

english: [RE knees] [GENERAL] He is not the only one to be a nation, but he is the one who gathers together into one body the children of God, who do not have children.
lunyoro: kandi tiririr ihanga eri ryonka, baitu asoroza ahamu abana ba Ruhanga abatabaine.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] They were eager to increase the number of men and women of the Lord.
lunyoro: kandi bayekamba muno okwehongera Mukama waitu abasaija nabakazi baingi;

english: For this reason I tell you, every one of you says, ‘I follow Paul,’ ‘I live in Apollos,’ and ‘I belong to Cephas,’ “I follow Christ.’”
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo ngambire nti omuntu wena omulinywe agamba ati Nyowe wa Pauro: kandi nyowe wa Aporo: kandi Nyowe owa Kefa: kandinyowe wa Kristo.

english: [REGENERAL] [GENERal] In the sixth month of the year, the angel Gabriel was sent to the city of Galilee, whose name was “The Word of God.”
lunyoro: Kandi omu kwezi okwomukaga maraika Gabiryeri akatumibwa Ruhanga hali orubuga orwomu Galiraya, ibara ryarwo

english: Jesus answered, “If they will not obey Moses and the prophets, they will never obey even if someone has been raised from death.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Obubaraba batarukuhu'ra Musa na banabi, tibalihu'raga nobwakubaire omuntu ahumbukire omu bafu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Peter followed from a distance and went into the courtyard of the High Priest's house. He sat down with the guards and saw the things that were going to happen to him.
lunyoro: Baitu Petero yamukuratira enyuma hara, okutaha omu zigati ya nyakatagara omukuru wabu, yahungira omunda yaika'ra hamu nabahereza, arorre ebyahanyuma.

english: I always pray with joy in my prayers for you.
lunyoro: Mu kusaba kwange ebiro byona habwanyu ninsaba nokusemererwa.

english: So then, my dear friends, keep your balance. Keep busy always in the Lord's work, because you know that your work in the Master's service is not in vain.
lunyoro: Nukwo bagenzi bange abarukugonzebwa, mugume okutatabana, mwekambege obutosa omu mirimo ya Mukama, baitu mumanyire ngu Omulimo gwanyu tiguli gwa busa omu Mukama waitu.

english: [GENRICULTURE] So he got up and took the child with him by night and went to Egypt.
lunyoro: Yaimuka, yatwara omwana na nyina ekiro, yagenda Misiri;

english: As they were eating, Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, how good it is that we are here! Let us make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” But he did not know what Jesus was talking about.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika, obubakaba nibamuraga, Petero yagambira Yesu ati Mukama wange, kisemire itwe okuikara hanu: twombeke obiju busatu; akamu kawe, akndi ka Musa, nakandi ka Eriya: atamanyire ekyarukugamba.

english: When he thought that he was going back to Achaia, his brothers stirred him up and wrote letters to the believers to welcome him. When he arrived, he was very kind to those who believed.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatekerize okwambuka okuhika Akaya, bene babu bamwekambisa, nibahandikira abegeswa okumutangi'ra: obuyahikire yabakonyera muno abakaba baikirize obwembabazi:

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Go on walking in love, just as Christ loved you and gave himself for us as a sacrifice and a sacrifice to God for a good sacrifice.
lunyoro: kandi mugendege omu kugonzangana, nka Kristo nauwe okuyagondeze inywe, kandi yayehayo wenka habwaitu, nkekihongwa nekyonzira hali Ruhanga okuba ekisorokoko ekirungi.

english: Watch and pray, so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
lunyoro: Murole, musabe, muleke okutaha omu kwohebwa. Omutima nugwo gururkugonza, baitu omubiri mugara.

english: And if they abandon their unbelief, they will be put to death; but God is able to give them up a second time.
lunyoro: kandi nabo obubalireka okutaikiriza kwabu balisimbwamu: baitu Ruhanga wamani okubasimbamu obwakabiri.

english: And among those who do not believe in the God of this world, the light of the Good News about the glory of Christ, which is an image of God, will shine on you.
lunyoro: kandi omuli abo ruhanga owobusinge bunu taikiriza, nukwo omusana ogwenjiri eyekitinisa ekya Kristo, nuwe kisisani kya Ruhanga, gutabajwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Pray that your flight will not be in the winter!
lunyoro: Musabe okwiruka kwanyu kutaba omubiro ebyembeho

english: So they left and went to the tomb, where they saw a fire of coals there, fish tied up, and bread.
lunyoro: baburugayo, nibahika ha musa, barora omu'ro ogwamakara, nencu zitairweho, nomugati.

english: the son of Eliezer, the son Of Jorim, the father of Matthat, the mother of Levi,
lunyoro: owa Yesu, owa Eryeza, owa Yolimu, owa Matati, owa Levi,

english: They brought the sick man to Jesus, who was sitting on the bed. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Courage, my son! Your sins are forgiven!”
lunyoro: Kandi, dora, bakamuletera omurwaire azingamire, abyamire ha kitabu: kandi Yesu obuyaboine okuikiriza kwabu yamugambira azingisa ati Mwana wange, guma omutima, ebibi byawe bikuihirweho.

english: As the scripture says in the law of the Lord, “Every altar that is holy to the Lord will be called ‘holy to the Holy One.’”
lunyoro: nkokunyahandikirwe omu biragiro bya Mukama, ngu Ekisaija kyona ekizigaijo kirayetwa ekirukwera hali Mukama

english: [REGOVERNMENT] For the Law could not do that, because it was weak in human nature. It was God who sent his own Son into the likeness of sinful human beings, and sin condemned sin in the body.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiragiro ekibitarasoboire okukora, baitu bikaba biri bigara obwomubiri, Ruhanga obuyatumire Omwanawe wenka omu kisisani kyomubiri ogwekibi, kandi obwekibi akacwera ekibi omusango omu mubiri:

english: Do not forget to do good and to help one another, because God is pleased with such sacrifices.
lunyoro: Kandi mutebwa okukora kurangi nokuterana hamu: baitu ebyonzira ebirukusisana biti Ruhanga nabisima muno.

english: Let no one deceive you about things that are not true, because God's anger burns up the wicked.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena aleke okubabiha obwebigambo ebitarumu: baitu obwebi ekiniga kya Ruhanga nikizira abana abokutahu'ra.

english: Jesus said to them, “Take care, then, and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeasts of Herod.”
lunyoro: Yabatere'ra ati murole're, ekitumbisa kya Bafalisayo nekitumbisa ekya Herode.

english: But their minds were made firm. To this very day the veil still covers the reading of the old covenant, which has not yet been removed. This has been removed through Christ.
lunyoro: baitu ebitekerezo byabu bikagumangana: baitu nokuhikya hati ekyokwesweke'ra eki kiikaire obubasoma ekiragano ekyaira, kinu tikikaihibweho: baitu eki kiihibwaho omu Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The men who had been taking care of him ran away and ate in the house and told what had happened to the people who had had been possessed by demons.
lunyoro: Abakaba nibazirisa, bairuka, bagya omu maka, nebigambo ebyabaireho abakwasirwe emizimu.

english: For I have not been given to anyone, but to him who has been given me, because he has been raised from death to life by the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ntagihabwe muntu, kunu ntegesebwe, baitu nkagihabwa obwokusuku'rwa kwa Yesu Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] He begged him, “Send us out to the pigs, and let us go into them.”
lunyoro: egi yamwesengereza negamba ngu Tusindike omu mpunu.

english: Then Jesus took him into the inner court, threw his head at the tomb, spat on him, spashed on him with a stick, and made him speak in strange tongues.
lunyoro: Yamuleta omu kitebe omunsita, yamuta enkumu omu matuge, yacwa amacwanta, yamukoraho orulimi, yagamba ebigambo bingi.

english: You know this: neither a fornicator nor a greedy person nor an idolater will inherit the Kingdom of Christ and of God.
lunyoro: Baitu kinu mukimanyire ngu nobwakuba omusihani, nobwakubaba omuntu omwekuniki, nobuhokuba muramyi webisisani, tibaligwetwa obukama bwa Kristo na Ruhanga.

english: Jesus had not yet come into the house, but was still in the place where Martha met him.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akaba atakatahire omu kika baitu akaba akiri omu kiikaro nambere Maliza yamusangire.

english: So Jesus said to them again, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going to wake him up.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagambire ati: yagaruka nabagambira ati Enganjani yaitu razaro agwijagire: baitu ningenda okumusisimura.

english: When the evil spirit comes out of a man, it travels through dry waters, looking for a place to rest, where it will not find it.
lunyoro: Kandi omuzimu omubi obuguruga omu muntu, gugenda omu byeya ebyomere, nuguse'ra hokuhumura, gutarukuzora.

english: I saw a holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband to eat.
lunyoro: Kandi narora orubuga orurukwera, nurwo Yerusalemu oruhyaka, nurusirimuka okuruga omu iguru hali Ruhanga, rutekanize nkomugole ayecumire iba.

english: For those who do what is evil come to the light, and their deeds are made openly, because they have been done in God's sight.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakukora ebyamananu aija hali omusana, engesoze zisukurwe, baitu zikakorwa omu Ruhanga.

english: In this way your fellowship in the work of preaching the Good News about Christ will strengthen your faith.
lunyoro: nukwo okuterana kwokuikiriza kwawe kugase okukora omulimo omu kumanyira kimu ekigambo kyona ekirungi, ekiri omulinywe habwa Kristo.

english: Then the angel shook the earth, threw the vine of the earth and threw it into the sea of God's anger.
lunyoro: Marakaika yanaga akagesoke hansi, yanoga omuzabibu ogwensi, yagunaga omu ndeba enkoto eyekiniga kya Ruhanga.

english: Everyone ate some spiritual food.
lunyoro: kandi bona baryaga ebyokurya ebimu ebyomwoyo.

english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You want to make me a Christian by your conduct.”
lunyoro: Agulipa yagambira Pauro ati Nokuhambiriza okutaito nogonza okunfora Omukristayo.

english: It was written for our sake, but it is necessary for a farmer to plant and to reap, and for his harvest he must plant, and he must wait for it to sprout.
lunyoro: Kandi kikahandikwa habwaitu, baitu kihikirire omulimi okulima nanihira, kandi nanyakuhura kimuhikirire okuhura nanihira okuhabwaho.

english: His disciples asked him, “Do you see the crowd crowd crowding you and saying, ‘Who touched me?’
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamugambira ngu Oboine ekitebe okubarukukufunza, nogamba ngu Noha ankozireho?

english: [RELIGIOUS] and to keep them safe from the evil spirits.
lunyoro: kandi nokuikara nobusobuzi okubingaga emizimu:

english: Sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have no need for riches; the rich will pass away, and the poor will have nothing to lose.
lunyoro: Gura ebimuyinabyo, mugabe ebyokuganyira; mweko'le emyeko etarukukura, itungo eryomu iguru eritahwaho, nabarukuseseka tibalibona.

english: Jesus said to them, “Did you ask me, ‘Is it the Sabbath law for me to do good or to do evil? To save lives or to destroy it?’
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Nimbakaguza nti Kyebiragiro ha Sabiti okukora okurungi nandiki okukora okubi? Okukiza obwomezi, nandiki oku buhwerekereza?

english: [GOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] The one who sets the law and judges the same is the one who can save and destroy it. But who are you to judge the same one of you?
lunyoro: Ayataireho ebiragiro nacwa emisango ali omu, nuwe ogu arukusobora okujuna nokuhwerekereza: baitu iwe arukucwera omusango mutahi wawe niwoha?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] For I beg you, then, that your faith may not give out; and you, when you repent, you will strengthen your brothers.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nkesengereza habwawe, okuikiriza kwawe kutahwaho; naiwe obwolikagaruka okuhinduka, oligumya bene banyu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus left and went with the chief priests and the soldiers, who were able to hand him over to them.
lunyoro: Nauwe akarugayo yagenda yahanura hamu na banyakatagara abakuru nabaserikale, okwarasobora okumuhayo nambere bali.

english: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and by the power of the Spirit predicted that a great famine would come over the whole world. This happened in the days of Claudius.
lunyoro: Kandi hakeme'ra omu hali abo, ibararye Agabo, naragura Habwomwoyo ati Haliba ekiihekingi omu nsi zona: eki kyabaho omu biro bya Karaudio.

english: These are the people who cause divisions, who do not have the Spirit.
lunyoro: Abo nibo baleta okubaganizamu, abomubiri, aatanyina Omwoyo.

english: But if you forgive others, I forgive them also. And if I forgive others for your sins in the presence of Christ, I too will forgive you.
lunyoro: Baitu wena oumuganyira, nanyowe 'muganyira: nanyoho ekinganyira, obundaba ninganyira, (nkiganyire) habwanyu omu maiso ga Kristo:

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) Do you see this? Do not be afraid that anyone who does not receive God's grace will lose his faith, and that many will lose their faith and their sadness.
lunyoro: muboine kurungi omuntu wena atarukukukika omu mbabazi za Ruhanga; noba kireke okumera nokubatuntuza, na baingi nibisisikara;

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Pilate said to him, “Are you the king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. I was born, and I came into the world to speak, and now I have become a fool. Whoever obeys my voice will obey me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu'ra iraka ryange.

english: For this is what God wants, who wants you to be holy, and to keep yourselves from sexual immorality.
lunyoro: Baitu kinu nikyo Ruhanga agonza, inywe okwezebwa, mulekere kimu obusihani,

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] But some men did not come from James, and he ate with the Gentiles. When they arrived, he was kind to them and settled them in his house, so that he would be a source of encouragement to those who were being persecuted.
lunyoro: baitu ira, abantu abamu batakaizire okuruga owa Yakobo, yaryaga Nabamahanga: baitu abo obubaizire yayehinya nayesororamu, atinire abo abokusarwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] That very night he took them and washed their wounds, and at once he and all his family were baptized.
lunyoro: kandi yabatwara omu kasumi ako ekiro, yabanabisa ebitutumbuli byabu ebyemiigo; kandi yabatizibwa, uwe nenjuye yona ahonaho.

english: [REGENERAL] [GENERal] For the sake of the false brothers who have come into us in the dark has taken away our sins by means of Christ Jesus, so that they may lead us into error.
lunyoro: mukugaru'ra bene babu abebisuba, abaizire omu nsita omulitwe omunsita okutata obugabe bwaitu obutunyinabwo omu Kristo Yesu, nukwo batukwase omu buiru:

english: He has poured out his abundant grace and love on us through his faith in him through all the nations.
lunyoro: yatuhaisize embabazi nobukwenda obwokuikiriza, omuli Amahanga gona habwibararye:

english: Being circumcised is not a matter of being circumcised, nor of being uncircumcised; it is of obeying God's commands.
lunyoro: Okusarwa tukuli kigambo, nokutasarwa tikuli kugambo, baitu okukwata ebiragiro bya Ruhanga.

english: For we have not lived in the past of our human nature, as you know, nor did we live in the age of deceit. God is our witness.
lunyoro: Baitu titukabaga omu kigambo kyokutebora nkokumumanyire, nobukyakuba ekisweke'ra obugobya, Ruhanga nuwe kaiso:

english: But Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nagamba ati Ekibyawe kyona Isenyowe owomu iguru ekyatarabyaire kiryomberwamu.

english: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and persecuted us. They are no longer acceptable to God, and they are enemies to all people.
lunyoro: abaisire Mukama waitu Yesu nabanabi, kandi abatubingire, kunu tibarukusimwa Ruhanga, kandi bali banyanzigwa babantu bona;

english: Greetings to the household of the Nazarene, who belong to the Lord.
lunyoro: Muramukye abomu nju ya Narakiso, abali omu Mukama waitu.

english: For whoever obeys his word has the love of God made perfect in him. And so we know that we belong to him.
lunyoro: baitu wena anyakukwata ekigambokye, mazimakwo omuruwe okugonza kwa Ruhanga kukahikirizibwa. Nuho turukumanyira ngu tuli omuruuwe:

english: Again Jesus left them, went away, prayed the third time, and said the same thing.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okubasiga, yagenda, yasaba obwakasatu, nagamba ebigambo bimu na biri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [EDUCATION] But the chief priests and the Pharisees had already said, “If anyone knows where this man is, he will say this and be taken away from him.”
lunyoro: Baitu Banyukatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo bakaba baragire ngu Omuntu wena araba amanyire namberali, agambe, bamukwate.

english: But Jesus denied it, saying, “Woman, I don't know you!”
lunyoro: Baitu yayehakana nagamba ati Omukazi ti'mumanyire.

english: But if we say, ‘From human beings,’ they are afraid of the people, because they all thought that John was a prophet.
lunyoro: Baitu obuturagamba ngu Omu Bantu_ bakatina abantu: baitu bona bakatekereza mali Yohana okuba nabi.

english: I Tertius, who wrote this letter, send greetings to you in the Lord.
lunyoro: nyowe Teretio anyakuhandikire ebaruha enu, mbaramukize omu Mukama waitu.

english: Father, I want you to be with me while they are with me. See how great is my glory that you gave me, for you loved me before the world was made.
lunyoro: Isenyowe, abawampaire, ningonza namberendi nabo baikaleyoga nanyowe; barole ekitinisa kyange ekiwampairege: baitu okagonza nyowe ensi etakahangirwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] They hate the gospel because of you, because they love what is good and love what belongs to their ancestors.
lunyoro: Kandi ebyenjiri, bali banyanzigwa habwanyu: baitu ebyokukomwamu, nibagonzebwa habwa baisenkurubo.

english: Whoever says to you, ‘You know that I don't follow his commands,’ is a liar; the truth is not in him.
lunyoro: anyakugamba ati mumanyire, kunu takwata ebiragirobye, ogu mubihi, kunu amazima tigali omuruwe.

english: There is no one who is immoral or does not fear God, just as Esau sold his rights as the son; and he ate the food at the proper time.
lunyoro: Kandi hatabaho omusihani wena, rundi atarukutina Ruhanga, nka Esau ayaguzire obugwetwa bwe wenka obwakaihuro ankamu akabyokurya.

english: [REsurrected] [GENERAL] God chose the weak things of the world to be ashamed of them, and he chose the glory of the heavenly bodies and of the earthly bodies, so that he might bring to nothing the living.
lunyoro: kandi ebyobugara ebyensi Ruhanga akabikomamu, akwase ensoni ebyamani: kandi nebitali byekitinisa ebyahansi nebigayibwa Ruhanga akabikwataho, kandi nebitaroho, nukwo aburanganize ebiroho:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [EDUCATION] Speak the word, speak at the right time and at the left; be obedient, ready, ready to pray, and eager to teach.
lunyoro: hatebeza ekigambo: ogambi'lege omu biro ebisemeriremu nebitasemeriremu; otere'lege, ohanege, oyesengerezege omu kugumisiriza kwona nokwegesa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] If you stand firm in the faith and do not be divided, and donot be discouraged by the hope you have heard from me, which was proclaimed in all creation that is under heaven. I, Paul, am the one who was made a servant of Christ.
lunyoro: obumuliba numuikara omu kuikiriza, mugumire kandi mutarukutabatabana, kandi mutaganyebwa omu kunihira okwenjiri eyimwahulire, eyatebezibwe omuli ebyahangirwe byona hansi yiguru, nyowe Pauro eyinafolirwe omuhereza wayo.

english: As soon as they saw him, they did not see anyone else, but only Jesus with them.
lunyoro: Obubahindukire bwango okurora, tibabona muntu kandi, rundi Yesu wenka hamu nabo.

english: But Jesus called them to him and said, “Let the little children come to me and do not stop them, because the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabeta namberali nagamba ati Muikirize abana abato baija namberendi, mutabatanga, baitu abanyakuli nkabo obukama bwa Ruhanga bwabu.

english: Those who lived in Jerusalem and their leaders did not know this man or that the angels of the prophets had been read every Sabbath, so they judged him.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abaikara Yerusalemu, nabalemi babu, obwokutamanya ogu nobugakuba amaraika ga banabi agasomwa Sabiti zona, nikyo bagahikiririze obubamucwerire omusango.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) For two things that cannot be broken, which cannot be removed, God has not given us the power to do them, so that we, who are ready to obey, may have the hope set before us.
lunyoro: Obwebigambo bibiri ebitarukusobora okutabatabana, Ruhanga ebiyasimirwe bigumireho omu mpikoze, itwe abayebingire, tutunge okunihira okututairweho omu maiso gaitu;

english: He came to me, stood by me, and said to me: ‘Brother Saul, repent!’ At that very moment I saw him again.
lunyoro: aizire hali nyowe, yayeme'ra namberendi, nangambira ati Mwene waitu Sauro, iguka. Kandi omu kasumi ako nubwo nahwereze okumurora.

english: For as the truth of Christ remains in me, no one in all the world will keep me from boasting about my glory.
lunyoro: Nkamazima ga Kristo okugali omuli nyowe, omuntu wena atalintanga okwenyumiza kwange kunu omu nsi zona eza Abafalisayo.

english: and love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all all your soul, with everything your mind, and with all his strength.
lunyoro: kandi ogonzege Mukama Ruhanga wawe numutima gwawe gwona, nobwomezi bwawe bwona, namagezi gawe gona, namani gawe gona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] He revealed the secret of the evil things that he wanted, just as he had promised in his own Son.
lunyoro: obuyatumanyisize ensita zebi ebiyagondeze, nkokuyasimire wenka, nkokwayetirege wenka omuruwe,

english: For God, who is rich in mercy, who loves us so much that he gave his great love for us.
lunyoro: baitu Ruhanga anyakuli owobuguda omu mbabazi, obwokugonzakwe kwingi okuyatugondeze itwe,

english: For we have not lived in the past of our human nature; we do not live in error or in a way that brings God's message to nothing. Instead, we live in a life that brings us into the light of truth and makes us pure in the sight of God.
lunyoro: baitu tukafuruka ebyensoni enyakuhingura, kunu titurukugendera omu bugobya, nobukwakuba okuhabisa ekigambo kya Ruhanga; baitu obwokwoleka amazima, ntwesimisa intwenka hali emitima yona eyabantu omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: Go quickly and tell his disciples that he has been raised from death, and now he is going ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see him, because I told you.”
lunyoro: Genda bwango, mutebeze abegeswabe ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu; kandi dora, nabebembera okugeda Galiraya; nuho mulimuro'ra: dora mbagambire.

english: [ELIGIOUS] [GENERAL] The woman learns in all her ways and obeys all her orders.
lunyoro: Omukazi ayegege omu buculezi nomu kuhu'ra kwona.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) That is why I make you commit a sin by being put right with God by being placed right with him.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukukuijikiza okutaikiranganiza naiwe, obwokuhereza kwawe okurukwera.

english: [ELIGIOUS] [GENERAL] But some of the teachers of the Law were sitting there, thinking in their hearts.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abahandiki abamu baikalire, nibatekereza omu mitima yabu

english: Jesus said to them the third time, “I know what sin this man has committed. I do not see in him the penalty for death. I will punish him and let him go.”
lunyoro: Kale yabagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuruwe musango ogwokufa: nikyo ndamute'ra, 'mulekere.

english: I told Titus, and I sent my brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Didn't we go on walking by the same Spirit? Didn`t we walk on these feet?
lunyoro: Nkagambi'ra Tito. Kandi nkatuma mwene waitu hamu nauwe. Rundi Tito akabasagisamu amagoba? Tutagendere omu Mwoyo omu? Tutagende omu bigere binu?

english: Judas and Silas, who were also prophets, encouraged the believers with many words and strengthened them.
lunyoro: Kandi Yuda na Sira, baitu nabo bakaba bali banabi, bakekambisa bene babu nebigambo bingi, nibabagumya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] He went into the synagogue with the Jews and the Gentiles, and the Council and all those who were with him.
lunyoro: Kandi yahakana omu iso'rokaniro hamu Nabayudaya nabantu abekengi, kandi nomu katale hamu nabo abamuitiraine.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; but whether I preach it, I myself or not, I will see it as if I did not preach the gospel.
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nintebeza enjiri, tinyina kyokwenyumiza nyenka; baitu zirimbona obundihu'ra, rundi ndihwaho enjiri.

english: Again he bent over and wrote on the ground.
lunyoro: Yagaruka yainama nahandika norukumu ha itaka.

english: We heard him say, “I will tear down this Temple which has been made by my hands, and three days later I will build it which has not been made with hands.”
lunyoro: Itwe tukamuhu'ra nagamba ati Ndisesa yekaru enu enyakukozirwe nemikono, kandi ebiro bisatu numwo ndyombekeramu endi etarukukorwa nemikooto.

english: When Jesus saw him, he was moved with pity for him, and for the Jews who had come with him, who were weeping and wailing for him.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamuboine natera empamo, Nabayudaya abaizire nauwe nibatera enaku, yasinda omu mutima nayunyura,

english: I must go on my own trip today and tomorrow and then tomorrow, because the prophet will not be able to go out of Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu kimpikirire okwegendera nyenka hati na nyenkya na ijweri: baitu tikisoboka nabi okuhwereke'ra aheru ya Yerusalemu.

english: “Why did you ask me? Didn't you know that I must remain in my Father's word?” he asked them.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mukanseru'ra ki? Mutamanye ngu kimpikirire okuikara omu bigambo bya Isenyowe?

english: The Lord said, “Who is this faithful and wise slave, whom his master will appoint over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?”
lunyoro: Mukama waitu yagamba ati Araha ogu omuketo owokwesiga owamagezi, omukamawe ouyasigire abomukaye, okubaha ebyokurya byabu omu kasumi kabu?

english: Jesus loved Martha, his mother, and Lazarus.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akagonza Maliza nomanyina na Razaro.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] I tell you, then, that the Law that God made four hundred and thirty years ago will not allow or cause to break a covenant.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndukugamba nti Ekiragano Ruhanga ekiyagumize kara, ebiragiro ebyakurutire emyaka bikumi bina mwasatu ehinguireho, tibikiihaho amani, nobukwakuba okuburanganiza omurago.

english: [RELIGIOUS] If I want to be with you, then I will be with him in your place in the preaching of the Good News.
lunyoro: ooyandaire aikale nanyowe, ampereze omu kiikaro kyawe omu nsengo zenjiri:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] That very day some Pharisees came to him and said, “You must get out of here and go away, because Herod wants to kill you.”
lunyoro: Omu kasumi ako nubwo baizire Abafalisayo abamu, nibamugambira ngu Ruga hanu oyegendere: baitu Herode nase'ra okukuita.

english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, order these stones to turn into bread.”
lunyoro: Omwohi yaija yamugambira ati Obworaboli Mwana wa Ruhanga, gambira amabale ganu gafoke ebyokurya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] “Don't let anyone fool you or accuse you of evil,” he told them. “You will get your share of the reward.”
lunyoro: Mutaligiza mani omuntu wena, nobukwakuba okutonga okubi; munihege empera yanyu.

english: I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Moses got up early and could not see.
lunyoro: Ninyowe Ruhanga owa Iburahimu, owa Isaka, owa Yakobo. Musa yatukumira kandi atarukuguma okurora.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] So then, the Sabbath rest has been made a source of great joy for God's people.
lunyoro: Nukwo hasigaireho okuhumura okwa Sabiti hali abantu ba Ruhanga.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) For food will not improve our relation with God. Even if we do not eat, we will not lose it; nor will we lose it if we eat it.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokurya tibirukutusimisa hali Ruhanga: baitu nobwakubaire tutarukurya titubuzirweho; kandi nobwakurya titukizire.

english: Jesus said to them, “Don't you understand this parable? You will understand all that he says.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Timurukumanya rufumo runu? Kandi mulimanya muta enfumo zona

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) He said, “Do everything according to the pattern you had seen in the mountain.”
lunyoro: akagamba ati Dora, okole byona nkekyokuro'raho okukiri ekyakwolekirwe ha rusozi.

english: When Peter saw the people, he said to them, “Fellow Israelites, why are you surprised at this? Why are you trying to convince us that our own power or the worship of our God has made you unclean?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obuyaboine yagarukamu abantu ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, kiki ekibatangalize omuna? Rundi numutugumizaho ki amaiso okutekereza ngu amani gaitu itwenka, rundi okutina Ruhanga okwaitu, nibyo bimugendeseze ogu?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] When he heard Peter's voice, he did not leave the room for joy, but went in and told Peter that he was standing outside.
lunyoro: Obuyamanyirire iraka rya Petero, atakinguleho oruigi obwokusemererwa, baitu yatahamu bwango nagamba Petero ayemerire aheru ha ruigi.

english: He wants to be mistreated with God's people rather than to enjoy the temporary suffering of sin.
lunyoro: yayegomboze okukorwa kubi hamu nabantu ba Ruhanga, okukira okuba nokwesemeza okwebibi okurukuhwaho bwango:

english: So then, you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if you are God's children, you will be his children.
lunyoro: Nukwo tokyali muiru rubale, baitu omwana; kandi obwaraba oli mwana oli mugwetwa habwa Ruhanga.

english: [REGENERAL] For Christ has come near to death, not fearing the things that belong to him, but only what has happened to him by your service to me.
lunyoro: baitu habwemirimo ya Kristo akai'ra haihi nokufa, obwataratinirire obwomwzibwe, nokwo ahikye ebyabuzireho omu kuhereza Kwanyu namberendi.

english: This means eternal life. To know that you are God, the only true God, and the one whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Bu nubwo bwomezi obutahwaho. Okumanya iwe Ruhanga omu owamananu, nogu ouwayumire, Yesu Kristo.

english: But on the day Lot left Sodom fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
lunyoro: baitu ha kiro Ruta ekiyarugire omu Sodomu omu'ro nekibiriti bikagwa okuruga omu iguru nibahwerekereza bona:

english: [Glaw] [GENERAL] In the Law, I could say that everything is purified by blood, and no blood can cover sins.
lunyoro: Kandi omu biragiro rundi mbaire ninsobora okugamba nti ebintu byona byogibwa esagama, kandi hatali okusesa esagama busaho okulekera ebibi.]

english: I want to boast about you, my friends, about the fact that you have in your life in union with Christ Jesus our Lord.
lunyoro: Nindahi'ra okwenyumiza oku habwanyu bene baitu okunyinakwo omu Kristo Yesu Mukama waitu nfa obukyabukya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the time came to gather the grapes, he sat down with his disciples
lunyoro: Kandi akasumi obukahikirire, yaika'ra nabakwenda hamu na uwe

english: [RELIGIOUS] The chief priests, the teachers, and the elders made fun of him.
lunyoro: Antebe abakuru, nibahandiki, nabakuru nukwo bamuterire enaku.

english: When the chief priests and the guards heard these words, they were filled with jealousy.
lunyoro: Antebe abakuru nabalinzi obubahulire ebigambo ebi, bagurukyagurukya muno.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Or do we take revenge on the Lord? Or are we stronger than he?
lunyoro: Rundi tumukwasa ihali Mukama waitu? rundi tuli bamani okukira uwe?

english: Then Jesus called his disciples together and said to them, “I tell you that this poor widow put in more than all the others who were going to the synagogue.
lunyoro: Kandi yayeta abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omufakati onu owamasege anagiremu bingi okukira bona abarukunaga omu ryahu'ro;

english: [RELIGIOUS] He called for authority and power, and he made them obey his own purpose, and so he set them free from it.
lunyoro: kandi obuyayetuire okulema nobusobozi, yabifora byokusunga kwonka, obuyabisinguire hagwo.

english: So he left and went into the house of a certain man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and whose home was next to the synagogue.
lunyoro: Yarugayo,yataha omu nju yomuntu omu, ibararye Tito Yusito, ayaramyaga Ruhanga, nenjuye ekaba eherire iso'rokaniro.

english: As Peter talked about this, the Holy Spirit came down on all those who heard the message.
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obwakaba nabaza ebigambo ebi, Omwoyo Ogurukwera yabagwaho, bona abahulire ekigambo.

english: Come near to him, as the Lord wants you to be holy, and help him in all that he wants you. For he himself was a friend to many people, and he was to me as my own help.
lunyoro: mulimuhereza haihi omu Mukama waitu nkokukisemerire abarukwera, kandi mumukonyere omu kigambo kyona ekyalise'ra. Baitu nauwe wenyini akabali mukonyezi wabaingi, kandi owange nyenka.

english: For I do not really know the meaning of the word, but it is not that I am being judged; it is the Lord who will judge me.
lunyoro: Baitu tinyemanyireho nyenka ekigambo, baitu tikiri nikyo kinyihaho omusango: baitu Mukama waitu nuwe ancwera omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] So Jesus went back home and found a child lying on the bed, and the spirit came out of him.
lunyoro: Yagarukayo omu njuye, yasanga omwana abyamibwe ha kitabu, nomuzimu gumurugireho.

english: And so it will be with you: you will see a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.
lunyoro: Kinu kokuro'raho namberemuli ngu Murazora omwana wenkerembe aswekerwe omu ngoye ezobwana bwenkerembe, abyamire omu nju yenta.

english: We reject any doubts and every thought that brings glory to God's wisdom, and we reject any thought to hear it.
lunyoro: nituihaho empaka nekitekerezo kyona ekyokwenyumiza ekinyakwehembera amagezi ga Ruhanga, kandi ntuhamba ekitekerezo kyoona okukihuliza;

english: so that you will be able to keep watch over the things that will happen to you and to all the holy ones, including the things you proclaim, the things which belong to you, the truths that you have learned, and the truths you have followed.
lunyoro: Muikalege namani okwetegereza hamu nabarukwera bona okugaliha, nokuraiha, nokuhama, nebintu byona ebibasemerirweho, nobwekuba okwegesa okubiri.

english: We do this not only in the presence of the Lord but also in the sight of others.
lunyoro: twetinege kurungi, hatali omu maiso ga Mukama waitu honka, baitu nomuli abantu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Follow him, and he went everywhere. “The Teacher says to the Teacher, ‘Who is the guest room where my disciples and I will eat the Passover meal?”
lunyoro: mugende nuwogu; harakataha hona, mugambire nyineka ngu Omwegesa agambire ati Enju eraha eyindaliramu Okuhingurwaho nabegeswa bange?

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] They did not find the one who had come back, and they did not see the one whom God had sent back to give thanks to God for this foreigner?
lunyoro: Taaboine abagarukire okugaruka?Saha? Omunyaihanga onu ouyatumire okukugiza Ruhanga?

english: [REbuke] It happened in the past that he spoke to our ancestors, in many ways and in many other ways through the prophets.
lunyoro: Kara, Ruhanga obuyagambiraga baisenkuru itwe, omu bicweka bingi nemiringo nyingi omu banabi.

english: [GENICAL] The first beast looked like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and it had a face like a human face, and its fourth beast looked as a flying eagle.
lunyoro: Ekyomezi ekyokubanza kikasisana nkentale, nekyomezi ekyakabiri nkenyana, kandi kikaba kinyina amaiso nkomuntu, kandi ekyomezi ekyakana nikisisana nkisamba erihu'ruka.

english: If there is any difference between Christ and Christ, there is no difference between the joy of love and the fullness of the Spirit and the love of God.
lunyoro: Nukwo haraba haroho okuiruki'rwa kwona omu Kristo, haraba haliyo okusemeza kwona okwokugonza, haroho okuteraba kwona Kwomwoyo, haroo enyikiriza yona eyamazima?

english: Cornelius said, “I was praying the next day until the ninth hour of the day, and I heard a man standing before me dressed in fancy clothes.
lunyoro: Koruneryo yagamba ati Hati ekiro ekyakana nkaba, ninsaba, okuhikya akasumi kanu akesah eyomwenda eyokusaba, omu nju yange; kandi dora, omuntu akeme'ra omu maiso gange, ajwaire engoye ezirukwangasana,

english: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me and do not stop them, because the Kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yagamba ati Mubaleke abana abato, mutabatanga okuija namberendi; baitu abanyakuli nkabo obukama obwomu iguru bwabu.

english: When I come, then, I will remember what I have done and say and say evil things. It will not be for him, but it will not for him alone, for he will not listen to our brothers and to those who want to obey them and be shepherds and set them free from the church.
lunyoro: Nikyo obundiija ndijukya engesoze ezakora, natujuma nebigambo ebibi: kandi nabyo tibirukumumara, baitu nauwe wenka tarukuiriza bene baitu, nabo abarukugonza okubairiza abatanga, nababinga omu kanisa.

english: Pilate wrote a notice and put it on the cross. “Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews,” he wrote.
lunyoro: Napirato yahandika ebaruha, yagata ha muti ehandikirwe ngu YESU OWA NAZALESI OMUKAMA WABAYUDAYA.

english: You help us by means of your prayers, in order that the many blessings we receive may be ours.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe numukonyera hamu naitwe omu kwesengereza: nukwo ekisembo ekitwahairwe obwabantu baingi obwalitunga habwaitu kiike.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] “I will give you all these things,” he said to him, “if you will make me clean.”
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Ebi byona ndabikuha, obworantereza amaju okundamya.

english: They went from Jerusalem and saw some of his disciples eating their food with unwashed hands.
lunyoro: barugire Yerusalemu, kandi bakarora abegeswabe abamu nibarya ebyokurya byabu nebyara ebibihire, nibyo bitanabire.

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) Did you not know what the Scriptures say about Elijah? He was reconciled to God by Israel and said to the people, “Sir, they killed your prophets and buried your dead on earth.
lunyoro: Timumanyire ebyahandikirwe okubigamba hali Eriya? Okuyatongaine na Isaleri hali Ruhanga, nagamba ha Baisaleri ati Mukama, bakaita banabi bawe, bakanaga hansi ebyoto byawe:

english: [REGOVERNMENT] There is no High Priest who rules God's Temple.
lunyoro: taba na nyakatagara omukuru arukulema enju ya Ruhanga;

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Food is to be enjoyed everywhere, and food is to eat. But God will take away both. The body is not to be used for sexual immorality, but to serve the Lord and the Lord as a body.
lunyoro: Ebyokurya bisemerire enda, kandi enda esemerire ebyokurya: baitu Ruhanga alibiihaho byombi. Kandi omubiri tiguli obwokusihana, baitu obwa Mukama waitu, kandi Mukama waitutonga okuba omubiri:

english: [RE knees] [GENERAL] And every tongue is unique to God.
lunyoro: Kandi orulimi rwona ruryeranga hali Ruhanga.

english: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the path.
lunyoro: Kandi abantu baingi abomukitebe baka'ra ebyokujwara byabu omu muhanda; abandi nibatema amatagi gemiti, nibaga'ra omu mumuhanda.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] You see that faith worked with him, and by faith faith he was made perfect.
lunyoro: Oboine ngu okuikiriza kukakora hamu nokukorakwe, kandi obwokukora okuikiriza kukahikirizibwa:

lunyoro: nabagambira ati Kikahandikwa ngu Nenju yange eraikaraga enju eyokusabiramuga: baitu inywe mukagifora obuingira bwabanyagi.

english: Paul placed his hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them; they spoke in strange tongues and prophesied.
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro obuyabataireho emikono, Omwoyo Ogurukwera yabaijaho; babaza endimi nibaragura.

english: The seven stars that I saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands. The seven lampstands are the angels of the seven churches, and the other lampstands belong to the seven church.
lunyoro: nyunyuzi musanju ezoboine omu mukono gwange ogwoburyo, netabaza omusanju eza zabu. Enyunyuzi Omusanju nibo bamaraika bekanisa musanju: kandi etabaza Omusanja nizo kanisa musanju.

english: All of us who were baptized into union with Christ Jesus have been baptized into his death.
lunyoro: Itwena abanyakubatizibwe okutaha omu Kristo Yesu, tukabatizibwa okutahaomu kufakwe?

lunyoro: Baitu Petero yamugambira ati Kiki kinu, inywe okuterana hamu okulenga Omwoyo gwa Mukama? Dora, ebigere byabu abazikire baro biri ha ruigi, barakuturukya naiwe.

english: Their minds and minds were made known to the darkness, and they were separated from the life of God, because of the insensibility of their minds.

english: And whatever we ask from him will be given to him, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.

lunyoro: kiki abegeswa bawe ekibasisisa engeso ezitwahairwe hali abakuru? Baitu tibanaba omu ngaro obubarya ebyokurya.

lunyoro: nobwakuba okuhu'ra enganikyo nebigambo byokuzarangana ebitahwaho ebireta empaka, kunu tibuli buketo bwa Ruhanga obuli omu kuikiriza: nukwo ndukukora nti nahati bunu.

lunyoro: Yesu akakimanya yagamba ati inywe abanyina okuikiriza okuke kiki ekirukubateza empaka inywenka obwokutaba nemigati.?

lunyoro: Ekinyakuzarwa omubiri guba mubiri; nekinyakuzibwa Omwoyo guba mwoyo.

lunyoro: Baitu abo abanyakwebemberwa Omwoyo gwa Ruhanga, nibo bana ba Ruhanga.

lunyoro: Mutalituntura na kake, baitu omu kusaba kwona nokwesengereza hamu nokusima mumanyisege ebimuse'ra hali Ruhanga.

lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndikusabanti okugonza kwanyu kweyongereyo ngerege okusaba omu kumanya

lunyoro: Pauro yagamba ati Nakusabire Ruhanga rundi nokuhambirizibwa okutaito rundi nokwingi, tali iwe wenka, baitu nabo bona abampulire hati bafoke nka nyowe, rundi batayina ensengo zinu.

lunyoro: Baitu ahonaho yabaza nabo, nabagambira ati Mugume emitima; ninyowonu; matatina.
