lunyoro: Abafalisayo bahu'ra ebitebe nibagambirangana bati haruwe; banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo batuma abaduma okumukwata.

english: [ELIGIOUS] We are going up to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law, and they will condemn him to death.
lunyoro: itutemba hali Yerusalemu; Omwana womuntu alihebwayo hali banyakatagara abakuru nabahandiki; nabo balimucwera omusango okumuita,

english: They threw a crown on Jesus' head and placed it in his right hand. They threw their hands on him and kissed him, saying, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: Baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: But if you have ten thousand teachers in Christ, you have few fathers; but I have become your father through Christ Jesus in the gospel.
lunyoro: Baitu nobumuraba munyina abesegesa kakumi omu Kristo, timunyina baisinywe baingi: baitu ninyowe nabazaire omu Kristo Yesu omu njiri.

english: He first found his brother Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah.” (This is what it means to say that Jesus is the Messiah.)
lunyoro: Yabona okubanza mugenziwe Simoni, yamugambira ati Tuzoire Masiya ( nukwo kugamba obukimanyisibwa ngu Kristo)

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] But some of the churches there stirred up discussions with Stephen.
lunyoro: baitu hakaimuka abamu abomu iso'rokaniro erinyakwetwa Eryabalibetini Nabakulene Nabalegezanderiya, Neryabakirikiya, naba Asiya, batera empaka na Sitefano.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] The purity of the heart, the knowledge, the strength, and the grace of the Holy Spirit, and of the love of money, and to love the truth.
lunyoro: obumanzi bwomutima, namagezi, namani, nomu mbabazi, nomu Mwoyo Ogurukwera, nomu kugonza okutali kwobugobya, nomu kigambo kyamazima

english: He left the man in prison for murder and murder, and prayed for him, because Jesus had given him over to them to do what they wanted him to do.
lunyoro: Yamulekera ogu ayanagirwe omu nju yenkomo obwokusaba nokuita; baitu Yesu akamuhayo halibo okumukora nkokubayenzire.

english: While Jesus was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife, because the Holy Spirit is in her.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba natekereza ebi, dora, maraika wa Mukama Yamubonekera omu kiroto, nagamba ati Yusufu, omwana wa Daudi, otatina okutwara Maryamu mukazi wawe, baitu ekiri omundaye Kyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] You Capernaum, who are highly respected by God, will you be raised to life by the power of the Spirit?
lunyoro: Naiwe Kaperenaumu, olinyumizibwa haiguru muno? Olisirimurwa okuhika okuzimu.

english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, thanked God and broke the loaves. Then he gave thanks to God, broke them, and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people; and he divided the two small fish among them all.
lunyoro: Yakwata emigati etano nencu ibiri, yarora haiguru omu iguru, nasima, nacwamu emigati; yaha abegeswabe bagite omu maiso gabali; nencu ebbiri yazibagabira bona.

english: When the Roman army officer saw what had happened, he praised God, saying, “Certainly this man was a good man!”
lunyoro: Kandi omunyakihanda Omurumi obuyaboine ebyabaireho, yanyumiza Ruhanga nagamba ati Mananukwo onu abaire omuntu ahikirire.

english: For the Lord will make his word come true on earth and make it come true and last.
lunyoro: baitu Mukama alihikya ekigambokye hali ensi, nakihikiriza kandi nakimara.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] It is good to give glory, honor, and power to you, Lord our God. You have created all things, and just as you wanted them to be, they existed and were given as you pleased.
lunyoro: Osemire, ai Mukama Ruhanga waitu, okuhabwa ekitinisa nokutinwa nobusobozi: baitu niwe wahangire byona, kandi nkokuwagondeze bikabaho, kandi bikahangwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees answered, “How did he do to you?”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo babagarukamu ngu Kandi ahabisize nainywe?

english: For I tell you, then, that the Gentiles are more important than the Gentiles, and they are more than God's people. I do not want you to be like foreigners.
lunyoro: Baitu ningamba nti ebi Abamahanga ebibahonga, babihongera abacwezi, kunu tihali Ruhanga: kandi tindukugonza inywe okuterana nabacwezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] But they did not recognize him, so he put on his clothes and said to them, “You must put your own blood on your own heads. I am not guilty. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Kandi obubamutangire nibajuma, yakunkumura ebyokujwarabye, nabagambira ati Esagama yanyu ikale ha mitwe yanyu enywenka; nyowe tindoho musango: okubanza hati ndagendaga hali Abamahanga.

english: I was so happy about you, sir, that you now have thought about me, but you have lost all time.
lunyoro: Baitu nkasemererwa muno omu Mukama waitu, baitu hata bunu mugarukire okutekereza mukatekereza mali, kyonka mubuzirweho omwanya.

english: Then he poured water into a pot and began to wash the disciples' feet and to wipe them with the bread that Jesus had prepared for them.
lunyoro: Kandi yasesa amaizi omu kanabiro, yabanza kubanabisa ebigere abegeswa, nokubisisiriza ekikoba ekyakaba ayetegeseze.

english: [REERAL] The more believers in the Lord, the more bold they were to speak the word of God without fear.
lunyoro: kandi abo abakira obwingi omu Mukama waitu bakatunga obumanzi obwensengo zange, nibeyongera okuguma muno okugamba ekigambo kya Ruhanga okutatina.

english: But now in union with Christ Jesus you who have been far away have come near to the blood of Christ.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu omu Kristo Yesu, inywe abakaba bali hara ira muirizibwe haihi omu sagama ya Kristo.

english: But if you have said in your heart that Jesus is the Lord, and believe in your hearts that God raised him from death, you will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu obworaba oyatuire omu kanwa kawe ngu Yesu nuwe Mukama, kandi oraba oikirize omu mutima gwawe ngu Ruhanga akamuhumbura omu bafu, olijunwa:

english: But Barnabas took him aside and brought him to the apostles. He explained to them how he had seen the Lord on the road and how he spoke to him and how boldly he spoke in the name of Jesus in Damascus.
lunyoro: Baitu Baranaba yamutwara, yamuleta hali abakwenda, yabasobo'ra okuyaboine Mukama waitu omu muhanda, kandi ngu akagamba nauwe, kandi nkokuyagambire Damasiko nobumanzi omu ibara rya Yesu.

english: the son of Methuselah, the son Of Enoch, the father of Jared, the mother of Mahalaleel,
lunyoro: owa Mesusera owa Enoka, owa Yaleda, owa Maharaleri,

english: Listen, my dear friends! God has not appointed the poor of the world to be rich in faith, and the rich in the Kingdom has promised to those who love him.
lunyoro: Muhu'le bene baitu abarukugonzabwa; Ruhanga atako nemu abanaku abensi okubaabaguda obwokuikiriza? nabagwetwa abobukama obuyaraganize abo abanyakumugonza?

english: While they were in Samaria, they proclaimed God's message in the synagogues of the Jews, and they were with John, who was their apostle.
lunyoro: Obukaba bali Saramini, batebeza ekigambo kya Ruhanga omu maso'rokaniro Gabayudaya: kandi bakaba bali na Yohana, omuhereza wabu.

english: “If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have been with them in the blood of the prophets.”
lunyoro: mugambire ngu Kuba tukaba turoho omubiro bya baisenkuruitwe, titwakuteraine hamu nabo omu sagama eya banabi.

english: So he left and went to Tarsus to look for Saul. When he saw him, he took him to Antioch.
lunyoro: Kandi yarugayo okugenda Taruso, okuse'ra Sauro: obuyamuboine, yamuleta Antyokiya.

english: [GOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] To be honest, self-controlled, and self-control. There is no law against such things as these.
lunyoro: okwesigwa obuculezi, okwerinda: hali ebirukusisa biti busaho kiragiro.

english: The voice spoke again from heaven, “Do not consider anything unclean that God has declared unclean!”
lunyoro: Baitu iraka ryangarukamu omurundi ogwakabiri, niriruga omu iguru liti Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora ebyomuziro iwe.

english: When Jesus saw her, he loved her, and said to her, “You have only one thing to eat. Go and sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamurozire yamugonza, yamugambira ati Obuzirerweho kimu; genda, ogule byona ebyonyinabyo, ogabire abasege, kandi iwe olitunga itungao omu iguru:

english: [REGOVERNMENT] For a man must not cover his head, but he is a copy of God's glory. For a woman is a man's honor.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo omusaija tikimusemerire okwesweke'ra omutwe, baitu nuwe kisisani nekitinisa kya Ruhanga: baitu omukazi kiba kitinisa kyomusaija.

english: And so it is with us who are the ones who have the Spirit's first place in us. We do not want to be like children, but to be free from our human nature.
lunyoro: Kandi tikuli nukwo kwonka, baitu naitwe abanyina ebyokubanza Ebyomwonyo, ntusinda omunda yaitu, ntutagonza okuforwa abana, nukwo kucungurwa omubiri gwaitu.

english: What shall I say? Is there anything or anything I can use to make an idol?”
lunyoro: Nukwo ngambire ki? Nti ekinyakuhongirwe ekisisani kiri kintu? rundi ekisirwe kitaroho kintu?

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Where did this come from, my mother, my Lord?
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe ekigambo kinu kyaruga nkaha, nyina Mukama wange okuija namberendi?

english: When Apollos was in Corinth, Paul went to Ephesus and found some disciples.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika Aporo obwakaba ali Kolinso, Pauro obuyarabire omunsi ezeruguru yahika Efeso, nasanga abegeswa abamu:

english: so that they may open their eyes and turn from their sins and turn away from the darkness to the light, and from the power of Satan to God, so that their sins may be forgiven and they may be put right with God through faith in me.
lunyoro: aziihe amaiso gabu, baruge omu muirima okuhindukira omusana, nokuruga omu busoboza bwa Setani okuhinduka Ruhanga, bahebwe okuihibwaho ebibi, nobuwetwa omulibo obwokuikiriza nyowe.

english: Last night he came to Jesus and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a teacher sent by God. No one can perform miracles unless God lives with him.”
lunyoro: ogu akaija namberali ekiro, namugambira ati Rabi, tumanyire iwoli mwegesa ayarugire hali Ruhanga: baitu busaho muntu asobora okukora obwokuro'raho obwokora, rundi Ruhanga obwaikara nauwe.

english: [ELIGIOUS] After saying this, Jesus went away and called Mary privately, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati Omwegesa aizire, nakweta.

english: [RELIGIOUS] His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. But they had already decided that if anyone said that he was the Messiah, he would be expelled from the synagogue.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire nikyo bagambire ebi obwokutina Abayudaya:baitu Abayuuda bakaba bamazire kuhanura ngu Omuntu wena obwaramugambagambaga ati nuwe Kristo abingi bwege omu iso'rokaniro.

english: I do not show mercy to you, but by means of the Law Christ died for you.
lunyoro: Tindukuburanganiza embabazi za Ruhanga: baitu kuba okuhiki'ra kwabaireho obwebiragiro, Kristo yakuferire busa.

english: [Glaw] [GENERAL] For each one of you has obeyed all the commandments and has done them one thing, and you have been condemned in all things.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwakwata ebiragiro byona, kandi nako'ra ekigambo kimu, buli agwerirwe omusango gwa byona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He himself gave himself as a ransom for all, and the message will be preached in all creation.
lunyoro: oyayehaireyo wenka okubaekicunguro ekya bona; okumanisa kulibaho omu mpiko zakwo:

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] But they did not see his body, and came to him and said, “He is alive!”
lunyoro: kandi obubatazoire mutumbigwe, baija nibagamba ngu baboine nokwolekwa okwa bamaraika abagambire ngu Ayomire.

english: Jesus answered, “The ten were not happy, but where are the eight?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Ikumi tibasemezibwege? Baitu omwenda bali nkaha?

english: Those who think of the night should think about the Lord, and those who eat the Lord's Supper should eat the same bread, because they give thanks to God. Those who do not eat the bread do not serve the Lord and praise God.
lunyoro: Anyakutekereza ekiro, akitekereza habwa Mukama waitu: kandi anyakurya, arya habwa mukama waitu, baitu asima Ruhanga; kandi atarukurya, tarya habwomukama waitu kandi asima ruhanga.

english: For to us there is God, the Father, who is the Creator of all things, and we are on him. And our Lord Jesus Christ, who removed all things from us and gave himself to us.
lunyoro: baitu halitwe haroho Ruhanga omu Isitwe, nambere haruga byona, kandi naitwe tuli haruwe: na Mukama waitu omu Yesu Kristo, kandi aikazaho byona, naitwe tukaikara haruwe.

english: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell at Jesus' feet and said, “I am leaving, because I am a man who has my Lord's sins forgiven.”
lunyoro: Kandi Simon Petero obuyakiboine, yainama ha maju ga Yesu, nagamba ati Ndugaho; baitu ndimuntu anyakuina ebibi Mukama wange.

english: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to receive from them his share of the harvest. The tenants beat him and sent him back without a thing.
lunyoro: Kandi omwaka obugukaba gumalize okuhika, yatuma omuiru rubale hali abalimi bamuhe ha byana ebyorugonjo rwemizabibu: baitu abalimi bakamutera, bamubinga atakwasire kintu.

english: I am telling you the truth: no slave is greater than his master, and no one is greater as a slave than the one who sent him.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuiru takira obukuru mukamawe, kandi omukwenda takira obwingi ogu ayamutumire.

english: There is nothing that has ever been given to you except to make you completely different from everyone else. But God is faithful, and he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. For with him you will be able to endure, and you will have the strength to endure.
lunyoro: Kuli busaho ekyohyo ekikaba kibakwasire inywe, ekitali kyabantu bona. Baitu Ruhanga wokwesiga, atalibaleka okwohebwa okukira ekimusobora; baitu hamu nokwohebwa alitaho hokuirukira, nukwo musobole okuguma.

english: [REDUCATION] [GENERAL] Put on the complete suit of armor from God, a worker who is not ashamed of him, who is able to speak the truth with all his heart.
lunyoro: Foka mukonyezi wa Ruhanga, omukozi atarukukwatwa ensoni, anyakusobo'ra kurungi ekigambo kyamazima.

english: Then Jesus began to say to the crowds about John, “What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed shaken by the wind?”
lunyoro: Yabanza okugambira ebitebe ha Yohana ati Mukagenderayo ki omu irungu okurora? Orubingo orurukutengesebwa embeho?

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] So he said, “Let those who have authority in you go to me and accuse that man of any sin he has committed.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagamba ati; Abayina obusobozi omulinywe, basirimuke nanyowe, kandi obwaraba omusaija ogu aroho ekibi kyona, bamulege.

english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him to heal his son, because he was about to die.
lunyoro: Obuyahulire ngu Yesu arugire omu Buyudaya, aizire galiraya yagenda namberali, yamwesengereza asirimuke, akize omwanawe; baitu akaba amalize okufa.

english: When they saw the boldness of Peter and John, they recognized that they were ordinary people who did not know what they were reading or were not taught, and they were surprised to know that they had been with Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine obumanzi bwa Petero na Yohana, babamanyire okuba bantu abatamanyire okusoma, kandi abatakegesebwaga, batangara; babamanyi'ra nibo baikaraga na Yesu.

english: “Lord,” Peter asked, “does this parable apply to us or to everyone?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero yagamba ati Mukama waitu orufumo runu norutucwera itwe, nandiki bona?

english: Jesus knew that they were going to ask him questions, so he said to them, “Why do you ask one another, ‘ Why did you say that it was only a little while ago, and you will not see it, and then a little longer later you will see it?’
lunyoro: Yesu yamanya nibenda okumukaguza, yabagambira ati Nimukaguzangana inywenka habweki ekingambire nti Hasigaireho akacu kake, timundole, kandi halibaho akacu kike, mulindora?

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] If we have put you in prison by means of the Spirit, how can we show that we care for your physical needs?
lunyoro: Obuturaba itwe twabasigiremu ebyomwoyo, kyamahano obutuligesa ebyanyu ebyomubiri?

english: and said, “The time has come for the Kingdom of God to come upon you. Turn away from your sins and believe the Good News.”
lunyoro: yagamba ati Akasumi kahikira, obukamabwa Ruhanga bumalize okuhika: mwegarukemu, muikirirze enjiri.

english: “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ,” they answered, “and you will be saved, you and your family.”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Ikiiriza Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, nukwo orajunwa iwe nenju yawe.

english: He was in the church in the desert, together with the angel who talked with him on Mount Sinai and with our ancestors. He was given the living words to give to us.
lunyoro: Gunu nuwe ogu akabali omu kanisa omu irungu, hamu namaraika eyabalize nauwe ha rusozi Sinai, kandi hamu na baisenkuru itwe: ayahairwe ebigambo ebyobwomezi okutuha itwe;

english: And you say, ‘Whoever tells his father or mother, ‘All you have given me is for God's good.’
lunyoro: Kandi inywe mugamba ngu Wena obwaligambira ise rundi nyina ati Kyona ekinakukuhaire okukugasira nkihongire Ruhanga,

english: In the same way in those days, God's holy women who were waiting for God stirred up their passions and looked at their husbands.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro byaira nukwo nabakazi abarukwera abanihiraga Ruhanga bayecumaga bati, nibarobera abaibabu bonka:

english: When Jesus came in, he asked them, “Why are you screaming and saying evil things? The girl is not dead, but only asleep.”
lunyoro: kandi obuyatahiremu yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubanziza nekirukubaliza? Omuisiki tafire, agwijagire kwonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] [GENerAL] And if I have repented afterward, my heart will not be glad in him.
lunyoro: Kandi obwayehinya enyuma, omutima gwange tigurukusemererwa omuruwe.

english: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in union with Christ. We are weak, but ye are strong in glory, but we are despised.
lunyoro: Itwe tuli badomadoma habwa Kristo, baitu inywe muli bamagezi omu Kristo: itwetuli bagara, baitu ninywe bamani bekitinisa, baitu itwe tuli bokugayibwa.

english: [GENRELIGIOUS] The woman left her water jar and went home and told the people,
lunyoro: kandi omukazi yasiga omunagagwe, yagenda omu kika, yagambira abantu ati

english: [REERAL] [GENERAL) Look! The reward of those who work hard for the things that you have not seen is that you stand up and proclaim them. And their reward, which they have done, is great in the sight of the Almighty.
lunyoro: Dora, empera yabakozi abatemere emisiri yanyu, eyimwabaimire negambira haiguru: nempamo yabu abagesere etahire omu matu Mukama owamahe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who are trying to lead the way are the ones who have already heard. Then the Devil comes and takes away the message from their hearts, so that they will not believe and be saved.
lunyoro: Abo abaha muhanda rubaju nibo bamara kuhu'ra; nubwo Setani aija, naihamu ekigambo omu mitima yabu, baleke okuikiriza nokujunwa.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] They have cheered up my spirit and yours, and you have put faith in those who are like them.
lunyoro: Baitu bakahumuza omwoyo gwange nogwanyu: baitu abanyakuli nkabo mubaikirize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Let us draw near to God with all our heart and with all your faith. Let us have a heart set on sinning against the evil spirit, and let us be filled with good water.
lunyoro: tui'le haihi nomutima ogwamazima, omu kuikiriza kwona, tuyina emitima yaitu emisirweho okuihamu omwoyo omubi, kandi nomubiri gwaitu gwogibwe amaizi amarungi:

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] God gave them the power to be ashamed of them, because their wives had purified themselves from the sexual immorality that belongs to them.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga akabahayo hali okukwatwa okwensoni: baitu abakazi babu bakahingisa eki omubiri ekiguzalirwa omu eki ekitanyina amani,

english: He came to us and took Paul's belt, tied it up with his own hands, and said, “This is what the Holy Spirit says: ‘The Jews in Jerusalem will arrest the man who owns this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
lunyoro: Ogu akaija nambetuli, yakwata omweko gwa Pauro, yayeboha ebigerebye nemikonoye wenka, nagamba ati Nukwo agambire Omwoyo Ogurukwera ati Abayudaya abomu Yerusalemu nukwo baliboha bati omusaija mukama womweko gunu, balimuhayo omu mikono Yabamahanga.

english: Jesus also told them this parable: “There was once a man who was lame and had a long time to pray.
lunyoro: Kandi akabacwera orufumo ati Hakaba haroho omuntu omu emisirye neyera bingi:

english: [REpute] [GENERAL] There is difference between a wife and her son. The unmarried woman is anxious for the things of the Lord, so that she may be physically and spiritually married. But the married woman is sad over the things in the world, so she will please her husband.
lunyoro: kandi haroho okubaganizamu omukazi aswirwe nomuhara. Omukazi ataswirwe atuntu'ra ebya Mukama waitu, nukwo ayerege nomu mubiri nomu mwoyo: baitu anyakuswirwe ategarukamu ebyensi, okwarasemezaga omusaijawe.

english: Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Father, into your hands I entrust my spirit!” At the same time he breathed his last and died.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyayamirire niraka erihango yagamba ati Isenyowe, omu mikono yawe mpaireyo omwoyo gwange: kandi obuyamazire okugamba eki yahayo obwomezi.

english: If I drive out demons for Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: [REERAL] For I am sure that all things are made plain by the abundant knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord. I consider all things to be loss, and I consider them to be prayers.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimkwo nintekereza byona bifire, obwoburungi obwingi obwokumanya Kristo Yesu Mukama wange: ounaferirwe byona, kandi nimbitekereza okuba nkesabu,

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] Large crowds gathered around him, but they could not find one or the other at the door, and he told them the message.
lunyoro: Baso'rokana baingi, kandi bakaba batarukusobora kuhikamu, nobuhokuba omu muryango: yabatebeza ekigambo.

english: [REGOVERNMENT] [GENERAL] For he has given all those who believe in him authority to become God's children, if they believe in his name.
lunyoro: Baitu bona abamukirize, akabaha obusobozi okufoka abana baruhanga,niba barukuikiriza ibararye:

english: The Devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where there was a wild animal and a false prophet. Day and night they were tormented day and night forever and ever.

english: [GENERAL) I do not want you to be ignorant about spiritual matters, my friends
lunyoro: Bene baitu, tindukugonza inywe okutamanya ebyomwoyo.

english: [GENERAL) I want to see God for myself, so that I can change what we preach to others
lunyoro: ngonza kuroora Ruhanga omuli nyowe nyenka, kinkonyera kuhindura nkoku ntwaaza abantu

english: [GENERAL) I thank my God always with all my heart in prayer
lunyoro: Ninsima Ruhanga wange ebiro byona ninkuijuka obutosa omu kusaba kwange kwona

english: [GENERAL) The cry "Hurry and you know that I am God" is at the door of my grave and I see it every day
lunyoro: Iraka "Humura kandi omanye ninyowe Ruhanga" liri haigura yekituuro kyange kandi ndirora buli kiro

english: [GENERAL) God's consolations are not enough for you with the words that he spoke to you
lunyoro: Okuhumuza kwa Ruhanga kuke tikururkukumara nekigambo ekyabaza empora naiwe

english: [GENERAL) I want to see you so much that you will give me one of the gifts of the Spirit and be patient with me
lunyoro: Baitu ningonza muno okubarora mbahe ha kisembo ekimu ekyomwoyo mugumibwe

english: [GENERAL) It is by the blood of Christ that you have purified yourselves from sin and have poured out the Spirit of holiness before God. It is much more important for you to wash your hearts from dead deeds to serve the living God
lunyoro: Esagama ya Kristo ayayahaireyo wenka, ataroho kamogo, Obwomwoyo ogurukwera hali Ruhanga, terikira muno okwogya emitima yanyu omu ngeso ezifire okuhereza Ruhanga omwomezi?

english: [GENERAL) We pray today for you, then, that our God will make sure that you will be put right with him and that he will make perfect in every way that you want to do what is good and to do the work of faith
lunyoro: Nikyo tusabira ebiro byano habwanyu, nukwo Ruhanga waitu abatekereze musemerire okwetakwe, kandi ahikirize namani kyona ekimugonza ekyoburungi nomulimo ogwokuikiriza;

english: [GENERAL) Immediately Jesus was baptized and came out of the water and the sky opened to him and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove on him
lunyoro: Kandi yesu obuyamazire kubatizibwa ahonaho yaruga omu maizi dora iguru likamwesuku'ra yarora Omwoyo gwa Ruhanga nugusirimuka nkeriba nugutaha haruwe

english: [REERAL) [GENerAL) We bless the bread and the wine in the faith, so that it may be more important
lunyoro: Tuha omugisa omugati na vino omukwikiriza bifooke ekintu ekirukukiraho

english: [GENERAL) The seeds that fell among thorn bushes are strong and tall and have many seeds/seeds
lunyoro: Embibo zirumu amaani kandi ziina ebirimwa bingi

english: [GENERAL) Did you not know what the Scriptures say about Elijah? He was reconciled to God by Israel and said to the people, "Sir, they killed your prophets and buried your dead on earth
lunyoro: Timumanyire ebyahandikirwe okubigamba hali Eriya? Okuyatongaine na Isaleri hali Ruhanga, nagamba ha Baisaleri ati Mukama, bakaita banabi bawe, bakanaga hansi ebyoto byawe:

english: [GENERAL) Look! Take what is left of you and of the things that were left of him, which were the last to die. I have not seen your work done in the presence of my God
lunyoro: Gumya ebisigaireho, ebikaba bimalize okufa: baitu timboine omulimo gwawe guhikire omu maiso ga Ruhanga wange.

english: [GENERAL) In the same way, God's righteousness, by means of his faithfulness through Jesus Christ, is perfect for all those who believe. For there is no difference
lunyoro: nukwo kuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga obwokwesigwaakwe obwokukora habwa Yesu Kristo, hali bona abarukuikiriza; baitu busaho kwahuramu:

english: [GENERAL) For it was very sin that it was a crime to be punished by the judges
lunyoro: Baitu eki kyakubaire ekibi ekikoto muno Ego kyakubaire ekyokusisa ekyokubonabonesebwa abacwi bemisango

english: [GENERAL) I thank God for the help I have received from all the others when they left me
lunyoro: Nimusiima Ruhanga habwempumuzo eziyahairwe abandi boona obubagenzire

english: [GENERAL) and we proclaim the hope of the great and glorious God who gives us life
lunyoro: kandi nitutegeeza okunihira kwomugisa, nokwolekwa kwekitinisa kya Ruhanga omukuru kandi omujuni

english: [GENERAL) Look! Your house is abandoned to you, and I tell you, you will not see me until you say, 'God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord.'
lunyoro: Dora, enju yanyu abasigirwe kifuka, kandi nimbagambira nti Timulindora, okuhikya obumuligamba ngu Ahairwe omugida arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama.

english: [GENERAL) If, then, God had given them this gift just as he had given us, we would have believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who I am, and would have kept his promise to God
lunyoro: Nukwo, Ruhanga obwaraba yabahaire ekisembo eki nkokuyatuhaire itwe, obutwaikirize Mukama waitu Yesu Krsito, nyowe nkabandi oha, ayakusoboire okutanga Ruhanga?

english: [GENERAL) When I do not pray, I am filled with confidence that God knows my heart
lunyoro: Obumba ntana ekyokusaba Ruhanga amanyire omutima gwange

english: [GENERAL) Which one of you is sick? Call on the elders of the church, and ask them to help him, so that they may pour oil on him in the name of the Lord
lunyoro: Haroho omulinywe omuntu arwaire? ayete abakuru bekanisa, kandi bamusabire, nibamusigaho amagita omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: [GENERAL) When I preach the Good News, my first thought is "Be God."
lunyoro: Obumpurra amakuru amarungi ekitekerezo kyange kyokubanza ngamba "webale Ruhanga."

english: [GENERAL) For food will not improve our relation with God. Even if we do not eat, we will not lose it; nor will we lose it if we eat it
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokurya tibirukutusimisa hali Ruhanga: baitu nobwakubaire tutarukurya titubuzirweho; kandi nobwakurya titukizire.

english: [GENERAL) So listen to me, you men of understanding Far be it from God to do evil and the Almighty to do wrong
lunyoro: Nukwo muhule nyowe inywe abasaija abokwetegereza Kimuli hara Ruhanga okukora kubi Kandi Owobusobozi bwona okukora okutahikira

english: I don't hawk or peddle
lunyoro: Tindoga ensimbi nobukwakuba okutunda ebintu by'okutunda

english: I don't expose someone's lies
lunyoro: Let me expose someone's lies

english: I don't express oneself idiomatically
lunyoro: Let me express myself idiomatically

english: I don't gather before rain
lunyoro: Timba enjura enkire enjura etakagwire

english: I have fold paper, clothed
lunyoro: Nina ebihandiko ebigomirwe (fold papyrus), ebindagirwe

english: I have forge documents, moneyed
lunyoro: Mazire empapura zobutami, nsangire efeza

english: I make someone pass something
lunyoro: Nindolera omuntu weena akampa ekintu

english: I don't help or assist
lunyoro: Tinkaba ninkonyera busa Timbakonyera na kake

english: I don't compesate oneself. see:okukeita
lunyoro: Nkekeita (Don't compense me. see:okukeita)

english: I don't remind oneself. see:okwijuka
lunyoro: m not remind oneself. see:okwijuka

lunyoro: Nikyo ntahimbisa omuntu weena. see:okuhimbisa

english: I have loot or plundered
lunyoro: Mbaire nsabire ebintu rundi mbiihiire

english: I have slap someone heavillied
lunyoro: Mpaire omuntu enkoba nyingi muno

english: I have ooze, usually blooded
lunyoro: Mpuzire obusaasi, obwingi nsoha esagama

lunyoro: Nahasire s. to flow gentry

english: I don't sw. to flow gently
lunyoro: Don't s. to flow gentry

lunyoro: Don't sw. to be pleasant

lunyoro: Don't s. to be open

lunyoro: Don't s. to spring again

english: I don't sw. to be numb
lunyoro: Don't s. to be numb

english: I have sw. to enlarged
lunyoro: Naataireho omwana wange ow 'okubanza

english: I don't sw. to make noise
lunyoro: Don't s. to make noise

english: I have harvest rain watered
lunyoro: Ai bambi nkanywisire enjura y'okugesa

english: I don't see: okwigira. learning
lunyoro: Don't I see: okwigira. learning

english: They started discussing among themselves, “Why, then, will he ask us, ‘Why did you not believe John?’
lunyoro: Bakaguzangana bonka, nibagamba ngu Obuturaba ntugamba ngu Mara kiki ekyabatangire okumuikiriza?

english: For Christ suffered for the sins of the first human pair and was raised to God by the power of the Spirit. He died as a human being, but was raised to life by the Spirit.
lunyoro: Baitu na Kristo akabonabonesebwa obwebibi omurundi ogumu, ahikirire habwa abatali bahikirire, obuyamazire okufa omu mubiri, baitu yayomezebwa omu Mwoyo;

english: On the next day the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered against Pilate,
lunyoro: Kandi nyenkya, nikyo kiro ekirukukuratira Ekyokutekaniza, banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo bakesoroza hali Pirato,

english: For if I have eaten and given thanks, why, then, do I have to boast about it?
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nindyaho nokusima, kiki ekinjumisa obweki ekinsimira.

english: I assure you that whoever does not receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Wena ataliikiriza obukama bwa Ruhanga nkomwana omuto, atalibutahamu na kake.

english: After he had told them everything, he sent them to Joppa.
lunyoro: obuyamazire okubamanyisa ebigambo byona, yabatuma Yopa.

english: One of the crowd answered, “Teacher, I saw a spirit in you who doesn't speak;
lunyoro: Omumu hali ekitebe yamugarukamu ati Omwegesa, ndesere haliwe omwana wange aroho omuzimu ogutarukugamba;

english: But if you give thanks to the Spirit, those who sit in your place say no “Amen” to you, because you do not know what they are saying.
lunyoro: Baitu oraba nosima omu mwoyo, anyakuikalire omu kiikaro kyabatamanyire aragamba ata Amina, obwomara okusima, baitu tamanyire ekyogamba?

english: Happy is that servant if his master finds him doing this when he comes.
lunyoro: Mugisa ogu omuiru rubale, mukamawe obwaliija owalisanga nakora ati.

english: They were all amazed and started shouting, “What is this?”
lunyoro: Baitu bona batangara nibagurukyagurukya nibagambangana bonka ngu Mara kinu kiki?

english: I am telling you the truth: this is what I am telling you.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi mbagambira nkiri nainywe.

english: Do not be drunk with wine, which can cause divisions; instead, be filled with the Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi mutalitamira amarwa agorumu okwesisa, baitu muijule Omwoyo;

english: And if you give up your head, you will never lose sight of it.
lunyoro: Kandi nakasoke akamu akaha mitwe yanyu tikalibura na kake.

english: At once he got into a boat with his disciples and went to the territory of Dalmanutha.
lunyoro: ahonaho yagwe'ra omu bwato nabegeswabe, yaija omu nsi eya Daramanusa.

english: When Jesus heard this, he said to them, “People who are well do not need a doctor, but only those who are sick. I have not come to call the people who are good, but outcasts.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyahulire, yabagambira ati Abomire tibarukuse'ra mufumu, rundi abarwaire: ntaije okweta abahikirire, abaitu abasisi.

english: The seventy-two disciples were filled with joy and said, “Lord, with the demons we hear and hear in your name.”
lunyoro: Kandi ensanju bakagaruka nokusemererwa, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu, nemizimu nayo netuhu'ra omu ibara ryawe.

english: Suddenly an angel of the Lord stood there, and a light shone in the cell. He threw Peter in the cell and woke him up. “Hurry up,” he said. “I am ready to be raised from death!”
lunyoro: Kandi dora, maraika wa Mukama yayeme'ra namberali, nomusana gwajwa omu kisika: kandi yatera Petero omu mbaju, yamusisimura nagamba ati Imuka bwango. Enjegereze zaragara okuruga ha mikonoye.

english: He went on, cried, and was healed, and he was told how he would get well.
lunyoro: kandi ayarugireyo, na'ra, narumwa, kandi nahururwa okuzara.

english: He had only one daughter, who was twelve years old, and she was going to die. As he was going in, the crowd crowded around him.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba ayina omuisiki omu wenka, akaba ahikize emyaka ikumi nebiri, kandi ogu akaba amalize okufa. Baitu obwakaba nagenda ebitebe bikamufunza.

english: The whole group was about twelve.
lunyoro: Kandi abantu bona bakaba bali nka ikumi nababiri.

english: In the same way, those who reject your good conduct in union with Christ may be ashamed of what they say.
lunyoro: nukwo obwebi ebibabagambaho okubibo bakwatwe ensoni abarukujuma engeso zanyu enungi ezomu Kristo.

english: and they will say to them, ‘Look at this place! Look! Don't go away or follow them!
lunyoro: Kandi balibagambira ngu Dora hali! Dora hanu! Mutalirugaho nobukwakuba okubahondera:

english: He rose up and began to spit on the book, and he went out to them all. They were all amazed and praised God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
lunyoro: yayeme'ra, yayetweka bwango ekitabu, yaturuka omu maiso gabu bona; kandi bahuni'ra bona, bakugiza Ruhanga, Nibagamaba ngu Titukabonaga tuti.

english: He had a servant sold his money and brought the money back, and he placed it at the bank.
lunyoro: kandi obwakaba ayina omusiri yagugura, yaleta erupiya, yazita ha bigere byabakwenda.

english: So then, those who plant and water do not reap the harvest, nor do they gather the grapes, but God feeds them.
lunyoro: Nukwo anyakubyara talikintu, nobwakuba anyakuiti'ra amaizi, baitu Ruhanga anyakwanisa.

english: If you have something to say in my name, what will I do?
lunyoro: obumurasanaga ekigambo omu ibara ryange, ekindikikora.

english: For if the dead are not raised, neither has Christ been raised.
lunyoro: ba abafu batahumburwa, na Kristo atahumburwe:

english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is deeply troubled; it is very sorrowful. He has come to kill me. Stay here and keep watch with me.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yabagambire ati Omutima gwange gunyina obujune obwingi, bwaija kunyita; muikalege hanu, murole nanyowe.

english: But now Christ our Lord has been born for you in the town of David the Savior.
lunyoro: baitu hati hazairwe habwanyu omu rubuga rwa Daudi Omujuni, nuwe Kristo Mukama waitu.

english: Whoever serves Christ is acceptable to God, and in this matter people are acceptable to him.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuko'ra Kristo buli asemire hali Ruhanga, kandi omu kigambo kinu asimirwe abantu.

english: Those who live in the earthly world cannot please God.
lunyoro: kandi abali omu mubiri tibarukusobora okusemeza Ruhanga.

english: and said to him, “God in your country and among your relatives, come to a country that I will show you.”
lunyoro: kandi yamugambira ati Ruhanga omu nsi yowanyu nomu bene banyu, oije omu nsi eyindikwoleka.

english: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “This is impossible for human beings, but not for God, because everything is possible for God.”
lunyoro: Yesu yabarole'ra nabagambira ati Hali abantu tikisoboka, baitu tikirikyo hali Ruhanga: baitu byona bisoboka hali Ruhang.

english: The light shines in the darkness, but the darkness does not believe it.
lunyoro: Omusana gukajwa omu muirima; kandi omulima gutaguikirize

english: Or suppose a woman who has ten silver coins loses one of them and loses one of them in the house; she lights a lamp and sweeps away the house and looks carefully until she finds it.
lunyoro: Rundi mukazi ki anyakuina erupiya ikumi, atabakiriza etabaza, nasingo'ra omu nju, nayekamba okuse'ra okuhikya obwaligizora.

english: After this, Jesus appeared again to his disciples on the other side of the lake of Tiberias, where he had told them this.
lunyoro: Hanyuma yebi Yesu yagruka okweyoleka omu begeswabe ha nyanja eya Tiberiya;nukwo yayeyolekere ati.

english: All of them were shown to have faith, and they were not put right with the things that God had promised.
lunyoro: Kandi nabo bona obubamanyisibwe obwokuikiriza kwabu batahabwe ekyaraganizibwe,

english: He is able to help those who are ignorant and stumble, because he himself is troubled by sickness.
lunyoro: asobora okugira mpora abatamanyirwe nabanyakuhabire, baitu nauwe wenka nayehingulirizibwa obugara;

english: For to those who are called by God, both Jews and Gentiles, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu hali abo abanyakweserwe, rundi Abayudaya, kandi Nomuyonani, Kristo amani ga Ruhanga, kandi amagezi a Ruhanga.

english: By faith he lived in the land that God had promised him, and so he lived in tents with Isaac and Jacob, who were his partners.
lunyoro: Obwokuikiriza akagonya omu nsi eyiyaraganizibwe, nketali ye wenka, narara omu hema,na Isaka, na Yakobo,abagwetea hamu nauwe abomurago ogumu:

english: He gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, others to be evangelists, others to be pastors and teachers of the gospel.
lunyoro: Kandi nuwe yahaire abandi okuba abekwenda, nabandi banabi, na bandi abagambizi benjiri; nabandi abalisa nabegesa:

english: Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
lunyoro: Pirato yaturuka nagenda namberebali, yagamba ati Musango ki ogumurukumulega omuntu onu?

english: Then people will come from among you and talk deceitfully to you, to turn the disciples away after them.
lunyoro: kandi omulinywe inywenka halirugamu abantu, nibagamba ebigambo ebyokuhaba, okucunda abegeswa enyuma yabu.

english: So they left the crowd and took Jesus aboard into the boat, and the other boat was with Jesus.
lunyoro: Obubasigire ekitebe, bamutwara omu bwato, Kandi nobwato obundi bukaba buli nauwe.

english: “Teacher,” they asked him, “we know that you speak and teach well of all people, but we know that you teach the Way of God.
lunyoro: Bakamukaguza ngu Omwegesa, tumanyire iwe ogamba kandi oyegesa kurungi, okutasorara omu bantu, baitu mananukwo oyegese omuhanda ogwa Ruhanga:

english: But if our wrongdoing makes us lose courage about God's righteousness, how can we say that God does not deserve our suffering? (This is what only human beings can say.)
lunyoro: baitu okutahiki'ra kwaitu kuraba nukunyumizisa okuhiki'ra Kwa Ruhanga turagamba tuta? Ruhanga tanyina kuhiki'rakwe obwaleta ekiniga? (Ngambire nkomuntu kwonka.)

english: Do not say evil things in your own words, but do so in order to make peace with those who hear you.
lunyoro: Ekigambo kyona ekitasemire kitaliruga omu kanwa kanyu, rundi ekirungi kyona ekirungi obukibahoga bwona nkomutu okwataga, kiretere kiti embabazi abanyakuhu'ra.

english: Who can forgive sins but God alone?
lunyoro: Noha asobora okuihaho ebibi, rundi Ruhanga wenka?

english: We know, my friends, that God loves you very much.
lunyoro: tumanyire, bene baitu, abarukugonzebwa Ruhanga, okukomwamu kwanyu,

english: After the believers had gone to the festival, Jesus also went openly, not openly, but as he would kill him.
lunyoro: Baitu benebabu obubamazire okutemba ha bugenyi, nauwe yatemba, kandi atagende bwerebwere, rundi nkomusita.

english: We have not poured olive oil on my head, but he has poured oil on my feet and on my head.
lunyoro: Tosesereho magita ha mutwe gwange: baitu ogu ansigire ebigere byange namagita aobwotere.

english: See that no one pays back evil for wrong, but always do good to one another and to all others.
lunyoro: Murole omuntu wena aleke okuhora ekibi obwekibi; baitu ebiro byona mukuratirege ekirungi inywenka nainywenka, na hali bona.

english: As he loved us, so we are deeply grateful to him, because he has poured out his abundant grace on us and has poured out his love on us.
lunyoro: nkokuyagondeze nasima ati, ekitinisa kyembabazize kikkugizibwe, eziyatuherire obwokugonzakwe:

english: But the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the darkness, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.”
lunyoro: baitu abana abobukama balibingirwa omu muirima ogwaheru:halibayo oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he also had a sharp sickle.
lunyoro: Maraika ondi yaruga omu yekaru eyomu iguru, nauwe ayina akageso kobwogi.

english: When the people heard that Jesus was alive, and they saw him, they did not believe.
lunyoro: Kandi abo obubahulire ngu ayomire, kandi arozirwe ogu, bataikirize.

english: Do not harden your hearts as at the beginning of the creation.
lunyoro: Mutagumya emitima yanyu nkomu biro ebyokubihizibwa.

english: But they kept quiet, and he took him, healed him, and sent him away.
lunyoro: Baitu bakaculera kwonka. Yamukwata yamukiza yamwohereza.

english: The next day the Lord added to them those who were being saved.
lunyoro: Kandi Mukama yabongerahoga obukyabukya abakaba nibajunwa.

english: When I thought, then, how can I compare myself? Am I judging my actions according to what I am doing? Am I acting according to what my body wants? Am I acting like this? Am I acting like this? Am I acting like this? Am I acting like this?
lunyoro: Nukwo, obunatekerize nti, nkaragaraganiza? Rundi ebimpanuire, nimbihanura ninkuratira omubiri? Nyowe okuba nabyo nti ego, ego, rundi nangwa, nangwa?

english: After Jesus had said this to them, he stayed in Galilee.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire kubagambira ebi, yasigara Galiraya.

english: Who will harm you if you give them something good?
lunyoro: Kandi noha alibakora kubi obumwekambira ebirungi?

english: The time came for Elizabeth to have children, and she gave birth to a son.
lunyoro: Kandi ebiro bya Erisabesi ebyokuzara byahika; yazara omwana omwojo.

english: If we have something against someone else, how dare we take advantage of the weak and then take advantage of the other person?
lunyoro: Obuturaba anyina ekigambo hali ondi, tatina okutongana hali abatali bokuhiki'ra, kunu tatongana hali abahikirire?

english: May the God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ give you the Spirit of wisdom and revelation, so that you may know him.
lunyoro: Ruhanga wa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, Isitwe, abahe omwoyo ogwamagezi nogwokusuku'rwa omu kumanya uwe:

english: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law wanted to kill Jesus, but they were afraid of the people.
lunyoro: Banyakatagara abakuru nabahandiki bakaba nibase'ra okubaramuita, baitu bakatina abantu.

english: Let us go on walking in the same way as the people who live in the light—not in sexual immorality and loose conduct, but in the same way as those who live in the light of day.
lunyoro: Tugendege omu byembabazi nkabanyakugenda nyamusana; hatali omu kubandwa nobugenyi obwokutamira, hatali omubisisani nebyensoni, hataliba omu kukungana nihali.

english: “Where do you want us to prepare for it?” they asked him.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Noyenda tubutekanize nkaha?

english: But if one of you is opposed to another, take care not to fight one another.
lunyoro: Baituj obumurumangana numuryamana, mwerinde mutamiranganira kimu.

lunyoro: Saha! Dora hakabaho omusisa omukoto: baitu maraika wa Mukama akaruga omu iguru, yaija yakumbya ibale okuliihaho, yaliika'raho.

english: You know this first, that no prophecy of the scripture ever comes true by itself.
lunyoro: mumanyire kinu okubanza ngu busaho kigambo ekyabanabi ekyahandikirwe ekirukumanyisibwa omuntu wenka.

english: Do not quarrel among yourselves, and then become full-bodied judges of evil thoughts?
lunyoro: kandi timwebaganizemu omulinywe inywenka, numufoka abacwi bemisango abebitekerezo ebihihire?

english: The Jewish authorities said to one another, “Where is this man? We don't know where he is going; he is trying to go to those who belong to the Greek authorities and teach the Greeks.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagambirangana ngu Ogu nayenda kugenda nkaha, itwe nambere tutalimubona? Nayenda kugenda hali abo abatabanire omu bayonani, ayegese Abayonani?

english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
lunyoro: Anyakuina okutu, ahu're Omwoyo ekyagambira ekanisa.

english: What I say is not what I say in the Lord, but what I say in order to win the victory over you.
lunyoro: Ekindukugamba tingambire omu Mukama waitu, baitu rundi omu butami, omu kuguma kunu okwokwenyumiza.

english: What will we give to God for you? All the joy we have in your presence before our God!
lunyoro: Kandi tuligaru'ra Ruhanga okusima ki habwanyu? Obwokusemererwa kwona okutunyina habwanyu omu maiso ga Ruhanga waitu;

english: At that time Emperor Augustus ordered the census to be handed over to the whole world.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika omu biro ebi, ekiragiro kikaruga hali Kaisali Augusito, abensi zona okuhandikwa.

english: Peter and those who were in the room where Peter had been buried, when they saw him, they saw his glory and the two men who were standing there with him.
lunyoro: Kandi Petero nabo abakaba bali omu itumbi obubarozire, babona ekitinisakye nabantu ababiri abayemerire namberali.

english: Jesus said to them, “Do you expect the guests at the wedding party to go without food, because the bridegroom will be with them? But the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Abana bobugole nibasobora bata okusiba, omuswezi obwabalinabo? Baitu ebiro biriija omuswezi ebyalibaihi'rwamu, omu biro ebi numwo balisibira.

english: Jesus answered, “The man who sent me has told me to pull up your mat and walk.”
lunyoro: bagarukamu ati Ogu ankirize, nuwe angambire ati Wetweka ekirago kyawe ogende.

english: All of you, then, look for the best you can. And I will show you the best way in which you can go.
lunyoro: abantu bona, nibaduma? Baitu muse'le ebisembo ebirukukira oburungi. Kandi nanyowe nomboleka omuhanda ogwoburungi oburukukira muno.

english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
lunyoro: Yata nempirima Yakobo, mugenzi wa Yohana.

english: But they could not find any, even though many people could not find it. Last of all, two men came, one by one.
lunyoro: kandi batakibone, bakaiso abebisuba nobubaizire baingi. Baitu hanyuma hakaija babiri,

english: Jesus was kind to them and touched their eyes. At once they saw and followed him.
lunyoro: Yesu yakwatwa embabazi, nakora ha maiso gabu: ahonaho bakarora, bamukuratira.

english: Today Caiaphas is the one who advised the Jews that it would be better for one man to die for the people.
lunyoro: Lero Kayafa nuwogu ayabahaire Abayudaya amagezi ati Nikisemera, omuntu omu okufera abantu.

english: So then, submit yourselves to God, and fight the Devil, and he will run away from you.
lunyoro: Nukwo mucule'le Ruhanga, baitu murwane na Setani, kandi alibairuka.

english: So he went off with the man from that country, and he sent him into his room to feed the people.
lunyoro: Kandi yagenda naterana hamu nomusaija owomunsi egi; ogu yamutuma omu bwe'lebwe okulisa empunu.

english: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the father of Matthan. Matthan was the father of Jacob.
lunyoro: Eriudi akazara Eriezali; Eriezara akazara Matani; Matani akazara Ykobo;

english: Everyone will hate you for my name's sake, but whoever holds out to the end will be saved.
lunyoro: Nainywe mulinobwa abantu bona okkubajunana ibara ryange: kandi anyakuguma okkuhikya empero, nuwe alijunwa.

english: He bought a linen cloth, took a slave, and wrapped it in linen cloths, placed the body in a tomb which had been dug out of rock. Then he rolled a stone across the entrance to the tomb.
lunyoro: Kandi yagura orugoye orwa bafuta, yamuhanura, yamukumisa orugoyenjoye, yamuta omu kituro ekyalimirwe omu mwandara; yakumbya ibale ha kanwa kekituro.

english: He went to Jericho and was passing there.
lunyoro: Kandi akataha omu Yeriko yarabamu.

english: Those who come to me cannot be my disciples unless they love their own father, mother, wife, and children.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaija namberendi, atarukunoba ise wenka na nyina, na mukaziwe nabanabe, na bene babu na banyanya, nukwo nobukwakuba okuiba hawe wenka, tasobora okuba mwegeswa wange.

english: And now I stand here to be tried because of the hope I have in the promise that God made to our ancestors.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu nyemerire okucwerwa omusango obwokunihira omurago Ruhanga okuyaraganize baisenkuru itwe;

english: But if we enter into God's rest, we shall be content with what we have, just as God has been pleased with us.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakutaha omu kuhumurakwe buli ahumuire emirimoye, nka Ruhanga okuyahumuire eye.

english: Do what you hear and hear and see: do what you hear and understand, and the God of peace will be with you.
lunyoro: Mukole ebimuhulire nebimwaboine namberendi; kandi Ruhanga owobusinge araikaraga nainywe.

english: But give what is in your heart to God, and he will give you all that is good for you.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyomu mutima mubigabege okuba ebyokuganyira; kandi dora, byona bisemezibwe halinywe.

english: Jesus answered him, “You are a teacher in Israel, don't you understand these things?
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Niwe mwegesa wa Isareri, torukumanya ebigambo ebi?

english: This is the blood that seals God's covenant with you.
lunyoro: Enu niyo sagama eyekiragano Ruhanga ekiyabaraganize.

english: The next day the first day dawned.
lunyoro: Kandi nyenkya omu rukyakya ha kiro kyokubanza omu biro lirugireyo.

english: For we speak the truth with love, and we are always concerned with everything we do in union with Christ. This is the head, Christ.
lunyoro: baitu tugambe amazima omu kugonzangana, tuko'le omu byona haruwe, nugwo mutwe, Kristo:

english: At once the Pharisees left and made plans to kill Jesus.
lunyoro: Ahonaho Abafalisayo Baturuka nibamugambirana ensita okubaramuhwerekereza.

english: I saw three unclean spirits coming out of the mouth of the dragon, the mouth of the beast, and the mouth of the false prophet. Three evil spirits looked like frogs.
lunyoro: Kandi narora emizimu emibi esatu neruga omu kanwa kekijoka, nomu kanwa kekisoro, nomumu kanwa ka nabi webisuba, Emizimu mibi esatu erukusisana nkebikere:

english: I have told you this because I was sick or infirm. If anyone is patient, I will live in a widowhood.
lunyoro: Ngambire obwokuswara, rundi nkabafokere abagara. Omuntu wena ekyagumira, nyowe ngumusirize.

english: Greetings to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work in the Lord's service. Greetings to Persis, who has done so much work in the Lord.
lunyoro: Muramukye Turufaina na Turufosa abakozire emirimo omu Mukama waitu. Muuramukye Peresi arukugonzebwa, ayakolire emirimo mingi omu Mukama Waitu.

english: For the creation was made subject to decay, not by its own will but through God's will.
lunyoro: Baitu ebihangirwe bikatebwaho okutungwa ebitarumu, tibuli obwokugonza kwabyo byonka, baitu obwogu ayabitungisize,

english: In this way we have confidence in God through Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo twesigire tuti omu Kristo hali Ruhanga:

english: Again Jesus sent another slave, and the tenants beat him and threw him out.
lunyoro: Yagaruka natuma owakasatu: nogu bamusasangura nibamubingira aheru.

english: So then, even the first covenant was not made without blood.
lunyoro: Nukwo nekiragano ekyokubanza kitaraganizibwe hataroho sagama.

english: Pilate met with the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato yasoroza hamu banyakatagara abakuru nabalemi nabantu,

english: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
lunyoro: Atarukugonza tamanyire Ruhanga: baitu Ruhanga nukwo kugonza.

english: There was a man who owed him two thousand coins, one owed him five hundred silver coins, and the other owed him fifty.
lunyoro: Hakaba haroho omuntu ayayohoraga, akaba ayina abarukutonga babiri: omu akaba namutonga edinali bikumi bitano, nondi amakumi atano.

english: Why, then, do people understand this nonsense?
lunyoro: Kandi abantu nibatekerereza ki ekigambo ekitarumu?

english: They went and filled both boats, and the ship was going to shore.
lunyoro: baija, baijuza amato gombi, kandi gaija okundikira.

english: They grabbed him and grabbed a message from him.
lunyoro: kandi bamukwata, bakwate ekigambo ekiruga omu kanwake.

english: Give to the one who asks you, and to the one who wants to borrow money do not rob you of your life.
lunyoro: Ogu anyakusaba, omuhe: nogu anyakwenda okukwohoza otalimutera mabega.

english: There the demon stirred up his eyes, and he was healed. He saw where Abraham was, and Lazarus was lying on his bed.
lunyoro: Omukuzimu nuho yaimukize amaisoge, nahu'rwa, naleba hara Iburahimu, na Razaro ali ha kifubakye.

english: “Listen,” the Jewish authorities said, “he loves him!”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagamba ngu Dora, okuyamugondeze.

english: He went into Zechariah's house and greeted Elizabeth.
lunyoro: yataha omu nju ya Zakaliya, yaramukya Erisabesi.

english: The Lord said to him, “Get up, and go to a place called Straight Street, where you have a man named Saul of Tarsus called. He is praying,
lunyoro: Mukama wange. Mukama waitu yamugambira ati Imuka ogende omu ikute eryetwa Literekerire, okagulirize omu nju ya Damasiko omuntu, ibararye Sauro, owa Taruso: baitu dora, nasaba;

english: In union with Christ Jesus, then, I have the boast I have in Christ Jesus, who is the wicked one in God's sight.
lunyoro: Nukwo nyina okwenyumiza okwange omu Kristo Yesu, omwebi ebya Ruhanga.

english: At that time people will seek death, but will not find it; and they will long for death, and death will flee from them.
lunyoro: Kandi omu biro biri abantu balise'ra okufa, kunu tabalikubona; kandi baryegomba okufa, okufa kulibairuka.

english: No one has ever seen God, but the only Son, who is in the Father's side, has seen him.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu araboine Ruhanga bwonabwona; Omwana ayazairwe Omu wenka, anyakuli omu kifuba kya Isitwe, nuwe yamumanyisize.

english: How terrible for those who live in that time of trouble and trouble!
lunyoro: Baitu ziribabona abanyakuli nenda, nabarukwonkya omu biro ebi!

english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. He bent over and saw only the linen cloths lying around, and he went back home and told the things that had happened.
lunyoro: baitu Petero akaimuka, yairukira ekituro; yainama nalinguza narora ebikoba ebyabafuta, biri byonka; yagarukayo owe, ahanirire ebibaireho.

english: They did not understand God's righteousness, and they wanted to know for themselves that they were God's people, so they did not understand God's doings.
lunyoro: Baitu obubataramanyire okuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga kandi nibase'ra okumanya okwabu bonka, batacule'le oku kuhikirakwe okwa Ruhanga:

english: Jesus answered, “I tell you that I am he. If you are looking for me, let these go.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Mbagambire nti ninyowonu: obumuraba numunse'ra, muleke banu begendere:

english: The gates of the city will be closed at all times, because there will be no night there.
lunyoro: Namalembo garwo tigalikingwaho na kake nyamusana (baitu tihaliyo ekiro):

english: For the eyes of the Lord are on those who do evil.
lunyoro: Baitu obuso bwa Mukama buli hali abo abarukukora kubi.

english: I am the least of the apostles, but I persecuted the church of God.
lunyoro: Baitu ninyowe muto owabakwenda, baitu nkahiga ekanisa ya Ruhanga.

english: So then, my friends, continue to work at strengthening one another in your call and unity. But if you do these things, you will never remember them.
lunyoro: Nukwo bene baitu mweyongere okwekamba okugumiza kimu okwetwa kwanyu nokukomwamu kwanyu, baitu obumura ba numukora binu timulitabaijuka ebiro byona:

english: Jesus said to the chief priests, the guards, and the officers of the Temple guard who had come to him, “Did you come with swords and clubs to keep me from coming with swords and clubs?
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira abanyakatagara abakuru nabalinzi abeyekaru, nabakuru obubamuizirire ati Munyizirire nkokumuizira ati Munyizire nkomusuma, nempirima nemiigo?

english: But now, my friends, when I come to you speaking in strange tongues, how will it be with you if I do not talk with you in the way I preach or in which I preach or teach?
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu, bene baitu obundiija namberemuli ningamba endimi, kiribagasiraki, obuntalibaza nainywe omu kusuku'ra, rundi omu kutebeza, rundi omu kwegesa?

english: Jesus said to him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
lunyoro: Yesu yanugambira ati imuka, ohimbe ekirago kyawe, ogende.

english: The men who had eaten were four thousand men, women and children.
lunyoro: Nabo abalire bakaba bali abasaija enkumi ina, abakazi nabana bato okutabaraho.

english: Then the chief priests and the elders met in the palace of Caiaphas, the High Priest.
lunyoro: Nubwo banyakatagara abakuru, nabakuru babantu bayesoroza omu kibira kya nyakatagara omukuru wabu, ibararye Kayafa;

english: So then, God is not the God of the dead, but of the living, because they are all living through him.
lunyoro: Nukwo, tali Ruhanga wabafu, baitu wabomezi: baitu bona bomire habwe.

english: But Jesus taught his disciples and said to them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to the power of human rulers and will be killed. Three days later he will rise to life.”
lunyoro: Baitu akegesa abegeswabem, yabagambira ati Omwana womuntu yahebwayo omu mikono yabantu, balimuita; kandi obwalimara okuitwa, nebiro bisatu buhinguireho, alihumbuka.

english: “Sir,” they answered, “our eyes are open.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Mukama waitu, amaiso gaitu gaiguke.

english: Some people have this right over you, but we are not greater than they are. We do not have this right, but we endure everything and do not respect the gospel of Christ.
lunyoro: Abandi baraba banyina obusobozi bunu balinywe, naitwe titurukukira? Baitu itwe tutakwate obusobozi obu, baitu ntugumisiriza byona, tutaleta ekitinisa enjiri ya Kristo.

english: The boat was coming from the front of them.
lunyoro: Baitu obwato bukaba gubaturukire omu maiso.

english: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
lunyoro: Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo ziikale nainywe.

english: Why, then, do you now call on God to put right with us what our ancestors could not carry or take us?
lunyoro: Nukwo hati bunu numulengera ki Ruhanga, okuleta ekitikisobora okuhimburwa baisenkuru itwe, nobubakuba itwe?

english: But they did not understand this saying, and so they did not understand it. They were afraid to ask him about it.
lunyoro: Baitu batamanye kigambo eki, kikaba kibaserekerwe: batina okumukaguza ekigambo eki.

english: I saw on the road a light from the sky far brighter than the sun, shining around me and those traveling with me.
lunyoro: ha muhanda, nandora omusana ogwarugire ha iguru, okukira okwangasana kwa izoba, gugwire okunyehinguliriza nabo abakaba nibagenda nanyowe.

english: I am telling you the truth: whoever obeys my teaching will never die.
lunyoro: mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuntu obwakwata ekigambo kyange talibona kufa ebiro nebiro.

english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. What I say, then, is what the Father has told me.
lunyoro: Kandi manyire ebiragirobye nubwo bwomezi obutahwaho: ebigambo ebingamba nka Isenyowe okuyangambire, nukwo ngamba nti.

english: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell down. great Babylon was remembered in the sight of God, to make her fall and fall down at his great power.
lunyoro: Orubuga orukuru rwabaganizibwamu omu bickweka bisatu, nembuga zamahanga zagwa: na Baburoni orukuru rwaijukirwa omu maiso ga Ruhanga okuruha akatema akamarwa agekinigakye ekingi.

english: When the sun came up, it burned, but when it was still dark, it burned.
lunyoro: izoba oburyaturukire yahotoka, baitu ekaba etanyina mihama, yayoma.

english: Those who believed his message were baptized, and on that very day about three thousand people were added to the group.
lunyoro: abo abaikirize ekigambokye babatizibwa: kandi bakongerwaho ha kiro eki abantu nkenkumi isatu.

english: My dear children, I am so happy that I am still alive until Christ comes in you.
lunyoro: Abana bange abato abandukusali'rwa kandi, okuhikya Kristo obwalifokera omulinywe,

english: He must be well spoken of by those who are outside, so that he will not fall into the trap of the Devil and be the master of the Devil.
lunyoro: hakire okuba nokugambwa kurungi hali abo abaheru; aleke okugwa omu kujumwa nendubatira ebya Setani.

english: Large crowds came to him, bringing with them those who had ears, eyes, and lips, healed with their diseases, and many others, and threw them at Jesus' feet.
lunyoro: Ebitebw bingi bikaija namberali, balesere abarukusenjura, nabatu bamaiso, nabafu bakanwa, nabaramaire, nabandi baingi, nibabata ha bigerebye;

english: But the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus also,
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru bakacwa amagezii baite na Razaro;

english: But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring a better robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and shoes on his feet.
lunyoro: Baitu ise yagambira abairube rubale ati Mulete bwango ekyokujwara ekirukukira oburungi, mukimujweke; nakoma mukamujweke omu rukumu, nenkaito omu bigere:

english: The Good News about Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
lunyoro: ENjiri ya Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga.

english: All these things are done by the Spirit in whom we are made, and this is what the Spirit says to all of God's people according to his will.
lunyoro: baitu ebi byona Omwoyo omu nuwe abikora, nagambira bona omuomu nkokwagonza.

english: But whoever wants to save his own life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will save it.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakwenda okukiza obwomezibwe alibubuza: baitu wena anyakubuza obwemezibwe habwange, nuwe alibukiza.

english: They were able to give this perfume to the poor and to distribute it to the poor.
lunyoro: baitu amagita ganu bakusoboire okugaguramu edinali bikumi bisatu nokukiraho, nokukgabira abasege.

english: Respect your father and your mother. Love your neighbor as you love yourself.
lunyoro: otinege 'so na nyoko: gonza omutahi wawe nkokwoyegonza wenka.

english: They were singing in the Temple and praising God with all their heart.
lunyoro: kandi baikaraga obutosa omu yekaru nibakugiza Ruhanga.

english: That is what God has prepared for those who love him.
lunyoro: Kino nibyo Ruhanga yatekanirize abarukumugonza.

english: As they ate some of the bread offered to God, Satan picked up Judas Iscariot, who was the son of Simon Iscariot, in order to betray him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibarya ebyokurya byorwebagyo, Setani obuyamazire ira okwohya Yuda Isikaryota. Omwana wa simony, omu mutimagwe okumugobeza.

english: and asked him, “What right do you have to do with these things?”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Busabozi ki oburukukukoza binu?

english: If I fought with animals in Ephesus, how can I help them? If the dead are not raised, then we eat and drink, but tomorrow we die.
lunyoro: Obundaba narwanire Efeso nenyamaiswa, nkabantu okubagira nikingasira ki? Abafu obubatahumbuka turye, tunywe, baitu turafa nyenkya.

english: At once they left the boat and their father, who was following Jesus.
lunyoro: ahonaho basigaho obwato ona isebo, bamukuratira.

english: Blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the Temple dedicated to idols?
lunyoro: Inywe abadomadoma, abafu bamaiso; baitu ekirukukira, obukuru kiraha? Ezabu rundi yekaru erukweza ezabu?

english: Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord that none of these things you have said will happen to me.”
lunyoro: Simoni yagarukamu nagamba ati Inywe munsabire hali Mukama waitu, ebigambo ebi ebimugambire bireke okumbaho nekimu.

english: That is why the Jewish authorities made fun of him, because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya nikyo bamuhyemerire, baitu akagamba ati Ninyowe byokurya ebyarugire omu iguru.

english: Jesus said to her, “My daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Omuisiki, okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize, genda nobusinge.

english: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has poured out on those who obey him.
lunyoro: naitwe tuli bakaiso abebigambo ebi: kandi Nomwoyo Ogurukwera Ruhanga ouyabahaire abanyakumworobera.

english: Instead, seek first the Kingdom, and all these other things will be added to you.
lunyoro: Baitu inywemuse'le obukamabwe, nebi byona biribaga'rwaho.

english: The woman said to him, “I know that the Messiah will come, and when he comes, he will tell us everything.”
lunyoro: Omukazi yamugambira ati manyire nti Masiya naija ( ayetwa kristo): obwaliija alitusobo'ra ebigambo byona.

english: We are the ones whom he called not only Jews but also Gentiles?
lunyoro: nitwe abayayesere hatali omu Bayudaya bonka, baitu nomu Bamahanga?

english: I request you, not to take them out of the world, but to keep them safe from the Evil One.
lunyoro: Tindukusaba iwe okubaihamu omu nsi, baitu obalinde omu bubi.

english: But their eyes were kept open, and they did not recognize him.
lunyoro: Baitu amaiso gabu gatangwa batamumanyi'ra.

english: The rich man died and was buried.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika omulegi akafa, yazikwa.

english: Pilate said to him, “Don't you hear what these two men are accusing you of?”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati Torukuhu'ra bigambo binu ebibakuhambirize okubiri?

english: and asked them, “Is this your son? You say that he was born blind; now I can see.”
lunyoro: babakaguza nibagamba ngu Onu nuwe mwana wanyu oumugamba ngu Akazarwa omufu wamaiso? Hati bunu nahweza ata?

english: The thief comes, not to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they might have life, and that they might have life.
