lunyoro: Obuyamazire kugamba ebi yabaikiza orwoya, nabagambira ati Muhebwa Omwoyo Ogurukwera:

english: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in his power.
lunyoro: Isitwe nagonza Omwana, amuhaire byona omu mukonogwe.

english: Who, then, is to be shown by the Lord's power?
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwa Mukama gukasuku'rwa oha?

english: Then he explained to Moses and to all the prophets what God had said, and he explained to them all the Scriptures by quoting from their Scriptures.
lunyoro: Yabasobo'ra Musa na banabi bona ebyamuhandikirwe omu byahandikirwe byona.

english: If we confess our sins to God, he is faithful and must forgive us our sins and take away all our wrongdoing.
lunyoro: Omulinywe obutuyatura ebibibi byaitu nuwe wokwesiga, kandi ahikirire okutuganyira ebibi byaitu,nokutwogyaho ebyokutahiki'ra byona.

english: For the Lord will strengthen you and keep you safe from the Evil One.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu wokwesiga, alibagumya kandi alibalinda hali omubi.

english: Do you have houses to live and drink? Do you despise God's church? Do you insult people who have no homes? Tell them what? Why should I praise you? I will not praise you.
lunyoro: Rundi timunyina enju zokuliramu nokunyweramu? Rundi numugaya ekanisa ya Ruhanga, kandi numukwasa ensoni abatanyina enju? Ndabagambira ki? Ndabasima habweki? Tindukubasima.

english: And those whom God has accepted as righteous he has called, and those whom he called he has judged. And those whom he has judged he has given honor to.
lunyoro: kandi abayayahuire ira, nibo yayesere: kandi abayayesere, nibo yacwire omusango: kandi abayaihireho omusango, nibo yataireho ekitinisa.

english: I will tell you how I have lived! You have been richly blessed for many years! Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry!”
lunyoro: Kandi ndigambira obwomezi bwange nti Obwomezi, oyina itungo lingi ryahuirwe eryokumara emyaka mingi; humura, orye, onywe, osemererwe.

english: Some time later Felix went with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jew. He called Paul and listened to him as he talked about faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebimu obubyahinguireho Ferikisi yaija na mukaziwe Durusira, akabali Omuyudaya, yayeta Pauro, yamuhu'ra ebyokuikiriza okuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard: the blind are seeing, the lame are walking, the dumb are hearing, the dead are being raised to life, and the deaf are being told the good news.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati Mwegendere, mutebeze Yohana ebimuboine nebimuhulire; abafu bamaiso nibarora, abaramaire nibagenda, abagenge basemezibwe, abafu bamatu nibahu'ra, abafire bahumbuirwe, abasege batebezibwe ebigambo ebirungi.

english: because the truth remains in us, and it remains in us forever.
lunyoro: habwamazima agaikara omulitwe, kandi garaikaraga naitwe ebiro byona:

english: Jesus answered, “The man I will use is the man I will use.” So he took a stick and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Oundakoleza entonge ningimuha nuwogu. Obuyakoleze entonge yahikwata yagimuha Yuda omwana wa Simoni Isikaryota.

english: A descendant of David was the descendant of a young woman named Mary, who was a descendant of David.
lunyoro: ho omusaija ataramanyire musaija, akaba ajumbirwe omusaija ibararye Yusufu, owomu nju ya Daudi; nibara ryomuisiki Maryamu.

english: I am surprised that you have turned away from the grace of Christ and have followed him.
lunyoro: mihuni'ra baitu mufurukire bwango ogu ayabwesere omu mbabazi za Kristo, numugenda omu buguzibwe:

english: The man who had an evil spirit in him attacked them and beat them both. So they ran away from that house and were drowned.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akaba aroho omuzimu omubi yabagurukira, yabakira bombi, yabasingura: nukwo bairuka bus omunju egi, kandi bahutaire.

english: But Jesus went out and began to proclaim God's message until this very day. Jesus could not go back to that town, but he stayed out of the desert. They came to him and told him everywhere.
lunyoro: baitu yaturuka, yabanza okutebeza muno nokuhikya ekiihuro, kandi Yesu atasobole kugaruka omu rubuga bwerebwere, baitu yaikaraga aheru omu irungu: baijaga namberali, barugire hona hona.

english: But God, who raised him from death, did not see sleep.
lunyoro: baitu ogu Ruhanga ouyahimbuire, atabone okujunda.

english: But if any of you want to build a tower, sit down first and work hard to finish it, and then finish the job?
lunyoro: Baitu araha omulinywe obwaba nagonza okwombeka orukomera, atabanza okuika'ra nabali'ra ebyemirimo yarwo, okwayina ebyokurumara?

english: But when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?
lunyoro: Baitu omukama worugonjo orwemizabibu obwaliija alibakora ki abalimi abo?

english: Don't be afraid to walk on the rocks.
lunyoro: Otatina okubata ekigere kyawe ha ibale.

english: His parents answered, “We know that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire bagarukamu nibagamba ngu Tumanyire onu nuwe mwana waitu, kandi akazarwa omufu wamaiso:

english: I did not know the churches of Judea in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi nkaba ntamanyirwe ekanisa eza Buyudaya ezomu Kristo:

english: Jesus answered, “If they will not obey Moses and the prophets, they will not obey even if someone has been raised from death.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Obubaraba batarukuhu'ra Musa na banabi, tibalihu'raga nobwakubaire omuntu ahumbukire omu bafu.

english: Suppose a man who has one hundred sheep and one of them gets lost and loses one of them is going to the mountains and seek out the lost one.
lunyoro: Omuntu ki anyakuina entamaze kikumi, nentahi yazo emu ebuzire, tasiga ziri ekyenda mu mwenda, nagenda ha nsozi, nase'ra egi enyakubuzire?

english: “Let the Gentiles be persecuted together with the Jews and joined together in the work of preaching the Good News about Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Abamahanga okuba abagwetwa hamu,kandi abomubiri gumu, kandi abateraine ha bwomurago omu Kristo Yesu obwenjiri:

english: So then, my dear friends, keep your balance. Keep busy always in the Lord's work, because you know that your work in the Lord's service is not in vain.
lunyoro: Nukwo bagenzi bange abarukugonzebwa, mugume okutatabana, mwekambege obutosa omu mirimo ya Mukama, baitu mumanyire ngu Omulimo gwanyu tiguli gwa busa omu Mukama waitu.

english: But one of those standing there drew his sword and struck the High Priest's slave and cut off his ear.
lunyoro: Baitu omu hali abo abakaba bemerire haihi yasomora empirimaye, yatema omuiru rubale wa nyakatagara omukuru wabu yamucwaho okutu.

english: The next day they met in the Temple with one another and had bread in their homes. They ate their food with joy and a pure heart, and they praised God and were pleased with everyone.
lunyoro: Kandi obukyabukya bayekambaga nomutima gumu omu yekaru nibacwa omugati omu maka gabu, baryaga ebyokurya byabu nokusemererwa nomutima ogutayina bugobya, nibakugiza Ruhanga, basimirwe abantu bona.

english: Speak in such a way that what you say is true.
lunyoro: Gambi'ra omu mananu: ekigambo kyawe nigo mananu.

english: I think it would be better for me to rebuke you if I were to defend you in these circumstances.
lunyoro: Kandi nintekereza nti obunyikara omu nkande zinu, kirungi okubekambisaga nimbaijukya;

english: Philip went down to the town of Samaria and proclaimed Christ to them.
lunyoro: Firipo yasirimuka omu rubuga rwa Samaliya, yabadumira Kristo.

english: But who made you superior to them? What did you have that you did not receive? Why, then, do you boast like everyone else?
lunyoro: Baitu noha yakwahurainebo? Kandi onyina kintu ki ekyotarahairwe? Kandi oraba wahairwe, kiki oyenyumiza nkotahairwe na kake?

english: For your obedience has reached the ears of everyone. I am happy about you. I want you to be wise about what is good, and to be blind about what is evil.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhu'ra kwanyu kukahika hali abantu bona. Nikyo nsemererirwe halinywe: kandi ningonza inywe okuba bamagezi hali ekisemire, kandi abadomadoma hali ekibihire.

english: Our weapons are not material weapons, but spiritual weapons. They are powerful weapons in God's service, which can destroy strongholds.
lunyoro: Ebyokurwanisa ebyokulemu bwaitu tibiri byomubiri, baitu byamani omu Ruhanga okusesa enkomera:

english: But now I am going to the one who sent me, and none of you asks me, Where are you going?
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu nigenda hali ogu ayantumire; kandi busaho halinywe arukunkaguza ati Nogenda nkaha?

english: I tell you, then, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who do not need to repent.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Nukwo halibaho okusemererwa omu iguru obwomusisi omu anyakwegarakamu, okukira abahikirire kyenda mu mwenda abatase'ra okwegarukamu.

english: After they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okuhemba omu'ro omu zigati hagati, nokuika'ra hansi ahamu, Petero yai'ra hagati yabu.

english: When he decided to go back to Achaia, his brothers stirred him up and wrote to the believers to welcome him. When he arrived, he helped those who believed with kindness.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatekerize okwambuka okuhika Akaya, bene babu bamwekambisa, nibahandikira abegeswa okumutangi'ra: obuyahikire yabakonyera muno abakaba baikirize obwembabazi:

english: Your life must be controlled by love, just as Christ loved you and gave himself for us as a sacrifice and sacrifice to God for a good sacrifice.
lunyoro: kandi mugendege omu kugonzangana, nka Kristo nauwe okuyagondeze inywe, kandi yayehayo wenka habwaitu, nkekihongwa nekyonzira hali Ruhanga okuba ekisorokoko ekirungi.

english: The people who had invited him to come to him welcomed him. But he shouted, “Son of David! Have mercy on me!”
lunyoro: abo abakaba babembire bamutanga aculere: baitu yagarukira muno okwami'ra ati Iwe Omwana

english: Be on your guard against them, and be on your guard against them. They are not listening to the message, and that is why they have been helped.
lunyoro: Werinde abo, oterege amaiso ha kigambo, baitu tibakiteho mutima: nikyo baterirweho.

english: For we who live in the flesh do not please ourselves. We do not want to be persecuted, but to be put on the new self, in order that death may be swallowed up by life.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe abali omu mubiri ntusinda tulemerirwe: kunu titurukwenda okujurwa, baitu okujwekwa, nukwo okufa kumirwe obwomezi.

english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter!
lunyoro: Musabe okwiruka kwanyu kutaba omubiro ebyembeho

english: If possible, as far as it depends on you, be at peace with all people.
lunyoro: Kakuba nikisoboka, omu bigambo byanyu, muterane nobusinge nabantu bona.

english: He did not know what Jesus was saying, but was afraid.
lunyoro: Baitu atamanye ekyaragarukamu; baitu bakaba batinire muno.

english: When I was a child, I spoke like a child, and I knew what it was like to be a child. When I was young, I gave up everything I had.
lunyoro: Obunkaba ndi omuto nagambaga nkomuto, namanyaga nkomutito, natekerezaga nkwomuto: obunkuzire ndekereyo ebyobuto.

english: In every way you were rich in Christ, in everything and in all knowledge.
lunyoro: baitu omu bigambo byona mukaba muli nobuguda omuruwe, omu kigambo kyona nomu kumanya kwona;

english: But if someone in the field does not come back, take care of his outer garment.
lunyoro: Kandi anyakuli omunda, atagarukayo okkutaba'ra orugoyerwe.

english: the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
lunyoro: owa Yesu, owa Eryeza, owa Yolimu, owa Matati, owa Levi,

english: Do not be fooled, as some of them were. They were led by a spirit of violence.
lunyoro: Kunu mutahyema, nkabamu halibo okubahyemere, bahwerekerezebwa omuhwerekereza.

english: Jesus looked up and said, “Father, I thank you that you have seen me.”
lunyoro: Nauwe yagucwamu amaiso haiguru nagamba ati Isenyowe ninkusima, baitu okampu'ra.

english: Avoid immorality. Any sin a man commits is outside his body, but the man who is guilty of sexual immorality sins against his own body.
lunyoro: Furuka obusihani. Ekibi kyona omuntu ekyakora kiri aheru yomubiri: baitu anyakusihana asisire omubirigwe wenka.

english: Don't you think that I could ask my Father for more than twelve armies of angels to send me today?
lunyoro: Rundi notekereza oti Tindukusobora kwesengereza Isenyowe okumpa hati bunu bamaraika okukira legione ikumi nabiri?

english: So they left and ran away from the tomb; but they were terrified and filled with wonder.
lunyoro: Baturuka, bairuka ekituro; baitu okutukumira nokuhuni'ra kukaba kubakwasire:

english: so that you may live a good life and live a long time on earth.
lunyoro: nukwo oikale kurungi, oyomere ebiro bingi hansi.

english: In the name of Jesus every family in heaven and on earth will be set free.
lunyoro: nukwo omu ibara rya Yesu amaju gona gatezebwe, agebinyakuli omu iguru na gebinyakuli hansi, na gebyo hansi;

english: When he was twelve years old, they took him to a feast.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba ahikize emyaka ikumi nebiri, bakatemba nkengso yobugenyi okweri;

english: He begged Jesus, “Send us out to the pigs, and let us go into them.”
lunyoro: egi yamwesengereza negamba ngu Tusindike omu mpunu.

english: So then, if what is still alive is considered a prostitute, then someone else will marry; and if it is married, someone else will marry.
lunyoro: Nukwo iba obwaba ekyali mwomezi aryetwa omusihani obwaliswerwa ondi: kandi iba obwaliba aswirwe iba ondi.

english: Then the disciples went back into the house and asked Jesus about this matter.
lunyoro: Kandi omu nju abegeswa bagaruka okumukaguza ekigambo eki.

english: You know this: neither the immoral nor the greedy nor the greedy will possess the Kingdom of Christ, and they will not possess the Kingdom of Christ and of God.
lunyoro: Baitu kinu mukimanyire ngu nobwakuba omusihani, nobwakubakuba abegombi, nobwekuba omwegombi, tibaligwetwa obukama bwa Kristo na Ruhanga.

english: But this son of yours, who wasted his riches on prostitutes, came to rob you of the prize.
lunyoro: baitu omwana wawe ogu, ayalire obugud bwawe nabasihani, obwaizirege, omuitirege enyana eyebisajwa.

english: When the disciples saw this, they were terrified and asked, “Why is this waste?”
lunyoro: Baitu abegeswa obubaboine babihirwa nibagamba ngu Gafire ki ganu?

english: It is sown in bodily form, it is raised in spiritual beings. There is only one body, and there is also a spiritual body.
lunyoro: guzikwa omubiri kwonka; guhumburwa omubiri gwomwoyo. Haraba haroho omubiri, haroho nomubiri ogwomwoyo.

english: Then Jesus called the crowd to him once more and said to them, “Listen to me, all of you, and understand. Nothing is beyond human beings.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okweta ekitebe namberali, yabagambira ati Mumpu're inywena, mwetegereze; busaho kintu ekyaheru yomuntu

english: Jesus answered, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going to go and wake him up.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagambire ati: yagaruka nabagambira ati Enganjani yaitu razaro agwijagire: baitu ningenda okumusisimura.

english: You judge according to your human nature; I judge no one.
lunyoro: Inywe mucwa omusango nkomubiri okuguli; nyowe tincwera muntu omusango.

english: When you eat this bread and drink this cup, you will proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.”
lunyoro: Baitu obumurakaryaga ha mugati gunu, kandi numunywa ha mpwahwa, murayolekaga okufa kwa Mukama waitu okuhikya obwaliija.

english: I have not written to you because you know me, and no lie ever comes from the truth.
lunyoro: Ntabahandikire inywe obwokuramanya, kandi busaho ebisuba ebiruga omu mazima.

english: We know where Christ comes from, but when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he comes from.”
lunyoro: baitu tumanyire onu nambere aruga: baitu Kristo obwaliija, busaho alimanya nambere aroga.

english: The dragon was angry with the woman, and went out to fight against all the rest of her descendants who obey God's law and obey the instructions of Jesus. He stood on the shore of the sea.
lunyoro: Darakoni yayaka'ra omukazi, yagenda okurwana nabaijukurube abasigireho, abarukukwata ebiragiro bya Ruhanga, kandi abanyina okugamba kwa Yesu: yayeme'ra ha musenyi gwenyanja.

english: He was put to death for our sins, and he was raised to life for our sake.
lunyoro: oyo ayahairweho obwebyokusisa byaitu, kandi ayahumbuirwe obwokutuihaho omusango.

english: Everyone ate some spiritual food,
lunyoro: kandi bona baryaga ebyokurya ebimu ebyomwoyo:

english: Keep your gift secret, so that your Father who sees what you do in private will reward you.
lunyoro: So anyakurora omunsita alikuha empera.

english: What does the scripture say? Abraham believed God, and it was thought that he would be righteous.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe nobigamba bita? Ngu Iburahumu akaikiriza Ruhanga, kandi kikatekerezebwa haruwe okuba okuhiki'ra.

english: “It is better to heal on the Sabbath,” they asked him.
lunyoro: kandi bakamukaguza nibagamba ngu Kirungi okukiza omuntu ha kiro ekya Sabiti bamulege.

english: We saw Cyprus, and then we left for Syria by the right side of the ship. We went to the coast of Tyre, where the ship was about to unload its cargo.
lunyoro: kandi obutwarozire Kupuro, ntulireka ha mukono ogwemoso, twagenda Busuli, twahika ha musa Turo: baitu nuho ekyombo kyayezire okuihwamu ebintu.

english: The first Adam was of the world, the second Adam of heaven.
lunyoro: Omuntu owokubanza owomunsi nuwe wahansi. Omuntu owakabiri womuiguru.

english: If you want to be first among yourselves, you must be the slave of all.
lunyoro: kandi wena anyakwenda okuba owokubanza omulinywe aliba muiru wanyu rubale:

english: But now they have lost faith, hope, and love. These three are the things that are more important than these.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu baikaireho okuikiriza, okunihira, okugonza, nibyo bisatu; baitu ekirukukira hali ebi, kugonza.

english: For our city is in heaven, where we eagerly wait for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu orubuga rwaitu ruli omu iguru; nambere ntutegereza Omujuni okurugayo, nuwe Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: Jesus said to them again, “Peace be with you. As the Father sent me, so I send you.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagaruka okubagambira ati Obusinge bube halinywe: Nka isenyowe okuyatumire nyowe, nukwo nanyowe mbasindika nywe.

english: For the proof that I am being told is that we have come from human beings. I am telling you this, so that you may be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu okumanyisibwa okunyikiriza tukuruga omu bantu: baitu ningamba ebi, inywe mujunwe.

english: His disciples asked him, “Do you see the crowd crowd crowding you, or do you say, ‘Who touched me?’
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamugambira ngu Oboine ekitebe okubarukukufunza, nogamba ngu Noha ankozireho?

english: The soldiers made plans to kill the prisoners, but they did not let them escape.
lunyoro: Abaserikale bacwa amagezi okuita abanyankomo, bataziha okuiruka.

english: For we are God's fellow workers. You belong to God, but you belong to God's household.
lunyoro: Baitu tuli bakozi hamu na Ruhanga: inywe muli musiri gwa Ruhanga, muli enju ya Ruhanga.

english: Sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have no need for riches; the rich will pass away, and the poor will have no need to pay back what is earned.
lunyoro: Gura ebimuyinabyo, mugabe ebyokuganyira; mweko'le emyeko etarukukura, itungo eryomu iguru eritahwaho, nambere omusuma atai'ra haihi, nobwekuba enyenje okusisa.

english: Then he said to Thomas, ‘Put your finger here, and see my hands. Wash your hands, and put them in my side. Stop being unbelieving!’
lunyoro: Kandi Yagambira Tomasi ati Leta hanu orukumu twawe, orole ebiganja byange: kandi omale nomukono gwawe, ogutahye omu rubaju rwange: oleke kuba atarukuikiriza.

english: The Father and I are one.”
lunyoro: nyowe na Isenyowe tuli omu.

english: Jesus said to them, “Did you ask me, ‘Is it the Sabbath law for me to do good or to do evil? Or is it against the Law of Moses and against the Law of Moses?
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Nimbakaguza nti Kyebiragiro ha Sabiti okukora okurungi nandiki okukora okubi? Okukora okubi nandiki okukiza obwomezi?

english: The one who sets the law and judges the same is the one who can save and destroy it. Who are you to judge the other?
lunyoro: Ayataireho ebiragiro nacwa emisango ali omu, nuwe ogu arukusobora okujuna nokuhwerekereza: baitu iwe arukucwera omusango mutahi wawe niwoha?

english: I beg you, then, that your faith may not give out; and when you repent, you will strengthen your brothers.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe nkesengereza habwawe, okuikiriza kwawe kutahwaho; naiwe obwolikagaruka okuhinduka, oligumya bene banyu.

english: So he left and went with the chief priests and the soldiers, who were able to hand Jesus over to them.
lunyoro: Uwe akarugayo yagenda yahanura hamu na banyakatagara abakuru nabaserikale, okwarasobora okumuhayo nambere bali.

english: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and by the power of the Spirit predicted that a great famine would come over the whole world. This happened in the time of Claudius.
lunyoro: Kandi hakeme'ra omu hali abo, ibararye Agabo, naragura Habwomwoyo ati Haliba ekiihekingi omu nsi zona: eki kyabaho omu biro bya Karaudio.

english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way; your faith has made you well.” At once he saw and followed Jesus on the road.
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Genda; okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize. Ahonaho yahweza, yamukuratira omu muhanda.

english: I was hungry, but you would not feed me; I was thirsty, but you would not drink.
lunyoro: Baitu nkaba nyine enjara mutampe ebyokurya; nkaba nnyine iroho mutanywise;

english: All that you have said in the dark will be heard in broad daylight, and all that you have said on the housetops will be exposed on the housetops.
lunyoro: Kandi byona ebimwagambire omu muirima kirihuli'rwa omu musana; neki ekimwagambirire omu kutu ha kaifo, kiridumirwa eruguru ha nju.

english: They all wept bitterly and fell down before Paul.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ba'ra muno, nibamugwa omu bikya Pauro,

english: “You fool! If you turn away from your sins, you will not be able to escape the punishment of death.
lunyoro: Omudomadoma iwe, egi eyosiga wenka, tayaruka omu kufa.

english: He was not the light, but came to reveal the light.
lunyoro: Ogu akabatali musana, baitu akaija kuranga obwomusana.

english: But a soldier shook the spear into the side of the ship, and at once blood and water came out.
lunyoro: baitu serikale omu yamucumita amu rubaju nicumu, ahonaho harugamu esagama namaizi.

english: At that time Jesus was sick and died. After they had healed him, they buried him in a large upstairs room.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika omu biro ebi akarwara, yafa: obubamazire okumwogya, bamuzika omu kisaka ekya haiguru.

english: Stephen, full of compassion and power, performed great miracles and wonders among the people.
lunyoro: Kandi Sitefano, aijuire embabazi namani, yakoraga ebyamahano nobwokuro'raho ebikuru omu bantu.

english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
lunyoro: bona abamuhulire bahuni'ra obwokwetegerezakwe nokugarukamukwe.

english: And he sent Jesus, who was chosen for you.
lunyoro: kandi atume Kristo ayatairweho habwanyu, nuwe Yesu:

english: For God's grace has come to an end and brings salvation to all people.
lunyoro: baitu embabazi za Ruhanga zizokere, niziretera abantu

english: He followed Paul and us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They have spoken to you about the way in which you should be saved!”
lunyoro: Ogu akakuratira Pauro naitwe, nagambira haiguru muno, ababatebeza omuhanda ogwokujwa.

english: You know that he has been chosen to be the father of the Good News and of the Son, who was preached among you through the gospel.
lunyoro: Kandi mumumanyire okuyasimirwe ngu akahereza hamu nanyowe habwenjiri nkomwana hali ise.

english: They must do their best to be rich in good works, to be rich in good deeds, to be ready to share, ready to share,
lunyoro: kandi bakolege kurungi baikale abaguda omu ngeso enungi, babeabaguda hali engeso ezisemire, betekanizege okugaba, bateranege hamu:

english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the Temple, left, and went off.
lunyoro: Yanaga hansi ebicweka byefeza omu yekaru, yarugayo, yagenda yayehanika.

english: There is something else that is needed in the task of being trusted.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho ekindi, nikise'rwa omu baketo omuntu azorwe owokwesiga.

english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who has existed from the beginning. I write to you, young people, because you are strong and the word of God remains in you, and you have defeated the Evil One.
lunyoro: Nkabahandikira inywe abaisebo baitu mumanyire ogu ayabaireho okuruga karanakara. Nkabahandabira inywe abasigazi baitu muyina amani, nekigambo kya Ruhanga nikiikara omulinywe, kandi musinguire omubi.

english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we no longer carry anything out.
lunyoro: baitu tutalete kintu omu nsi, kandi tikisoboka okuihamu ekintu;

english: We call you happy because you endured. You have heard of Job's patience, and you have seen the Lord's patience, his mercy, and his mercy.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, ntubeta abomugisa abagumisiriza: mukahu'ra kuguma kwa Yobu, kandi mukarora empero ya Mukama, Mukama okwali wembabazi nyingi nokuganyira.

english: When the angels went away from them to heaven, the shepherds said to one another, “Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us.”
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika, bamaraika obubabarugireho okugenda omu iguru, abalisa bakagambirangana ngu Tugende hati bunu Beterehemu, turole ekigambo kinu ekihikire, Mukama ekyatumanyisize,

english: Just as you sent me into the world, I also send you into the world.
lunyoro: Nkokuwantumire omu nsi, nukwo nyowe mbatuma omu nsi.

english: When he heard these things, he became very sad, because he was very rich.
lunyoro: baitu obuyahulire ebi yatuntura muno; baitu akabali muguda mali.

english: But he did not receive a share of the property from their brothers, so he circumcised Abraham and blessed him greatly.
lunyoro: baitu ogu atarukubalirwa omu ruganda rwabu, akazinisa Iburahimu ebicweka biikumi, namusabira omugisa ogu akaba anyina emirago.

english: Then the chief priests and the elders came to Paul and said, “We have taken a solemn vow not to consider anything this thing until we have killed Paul.
lunyoro: Nubwo baija hali banyakatagara abakuru nabakuru, nibagamba ngu Turahire ekirahiro kikoto okutaroza ha kantu kona, okuhikya obutalikaita Pauro.

english: At once Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them, “Why are you thinking such things?
lunyoro: Ahonaho Yesu, obuyamanyire omumutimagwe nibatekereza bati omunda yabu, yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubatekerezesa ebi omu mitima yanyu?

english: But if a person does not know how to manage his own house, how can he care for God's church?
lunyoro: baitu omuntu wena obwatamanya okulema enjuye wenka, aralinda ata ekanisa ya Ruhanga?

english: Jesus said to him, “Take the five cities and make them sit down with you.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira nauwe ati Naiwe olemege embuga itano.

english: He came to you, just as he was in the habit of doing. He is coming from all over the world with his abundant wealth and all his abundant wealth, and he has been with you all the time, beginning with the day when you heard about the grace of God in truth.
lunyoro: oyo, nkokweri; omu nsi zona, neyana ebyana nekanya, kandi nkomulinywe, okubanza ekiro ekimwahuliremu numumanya embabazi za Ruhanga omu mazima,

english: For the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
lunyoro: Baitu obutami bwa Ruhanga bwamagezi okukira abantu: kandi obugara bwa Ruhanaga bwamani okukira Abantu.

english: For from the heart come evil ideas, sexual immorality, immorality, orgies, drunkenness, and lasciviousness.
lunyoro: Baitu omu mutima, numwo haruga ebitekerezo ebibi, obuisi, obusihani, orwanju, obusuma, okuhangi'ra, okujuma;

english: and do not cooperate with the deeds of the darkness, which does not fight; instead, forgive them.
lunyoro: kandi mutaliterana hamu nemirimo eyomuirima etarukwana, baitu hakire mugihanege.

english: The High Priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omukuru wabu yakaguza Yesu hali abegeswabe, na hali okwegesakwe.

english: He was taught in the Way of the Lord. He was filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke about Jesus. He knew only the baptism of John,
lunyoro: Ogu akaba ayegesibwe omuhanda ogwa Mukama waitu; nayekamba omu mwoyo, yagamba bya Yesu, amanyire okubatiza okwa Yohana, kwonka:

english: You are witnesses of these things.
lunyoro: Iwe muli bakaiso habwebigambo ebi.

english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they said, ‘He has a friend who is a glutton and a drunkard and a friend of tax collectors!’ But wisdom is measured by what they do.
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu akaija narya nanywa, nibagamba ngu Ayina omukoijo, mutamizi, nganjani yabahoza nabasis. Kandi amagezi gaihwaho omusango obwemirimo yago.

english: He cried out in a loud voice, “She has fallen! Great Babylon has fallen! She has become a place of worship for demons and has made her drink the poison of all kinds of evil birds!”
lunyoro: Yagambira haiguru niraka erihango ati Rugwire, rugwire, Baburoni orukuru, rufokere ekiikaro ekyabacwezi kandi obubingira obwemizimu yona emibi, obuingira obwempungu zona ezibihire ezinobwa.

english: But if the righteous person fails to be saved, how will the godless man escape?
lunyoro: Kandi anyakuhikirire obwalemererwa okujunwa, ogu omusisi atarukutina Ruhanga alizoka nkaha?

english: The people who heard him asked, “Who, then, can be saved?”
lunyoro: abo abahulire bagamba ngu Mara baraha abalisobora okujunwa?

english: But as soon as the sun was setting, it was red, and the weather was red too.
lunyoro: baitu obubwayarukire bwango yahotoka, nembeho yayoma.

english: He who opposes and exalts himself above anything that is called God or that is worshiped; he who opposes God's temple says he is God himself.
lunyoro: orukutanga nayenyumiza wenka okukira kyona ekirukwetwa Ruhanga, rundi ekiramibwa; kandi okuika'ra omu yekaru ya Ruhanga nayegamba wenka okuba Ruhanga.

english: Judge for yourselves. Is it proper for a woman to pray to God that she will not wear a head covering?
lunyoro: Cumitekereze inywenka: kisemire omukazi okusaba Ruhanga ateswekerire omutwegwe?

english: The Spirit brings life, but the human body is of no use at all. The words that I have spoken to you are life.
lunyoro: Omwoyo nugwo guleta obwomezi; omubiri tigunyina mugaso: ebigambo ebimbagambire nubwo bwomezi.

english: “All we have here are five loaves and two fish,” they answered.
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Titunyinabyo hanu rundi emigati etano nencu ibiri.

english: Afterward Jesus found him in the Temple and said to him, “You are well. Do not let anything worse happen to you unless you give up on yourself.”
lunyoro: Hanyuma Yesu yamuzora omu yekaru, yamugambira ati Dora, oyomire: otalisisa obundi, rundi ekigambo ekirukukira obubi kireke kukuhikaho.

english: He is a guest in the home of a tanner of leather named Simon, whose home is by the sea.
lunyoro: ogu agonyere omba Simoni, omuhazi wempu, nenjuye eherire enyanja.

english: No one does anything secret, but only those who want to be clearly seen. If you do these things, show yourselves to the world.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho akora ekigambo omunsita, nauwe wenka nayenda kurorwa bwerebwere. Obworaba nokora ebi, weyoleke hali Ensi.

english: He stayed there until Herod died. This is what the Lord had said through the prophet, “I called my son out of Egypt.”
lunyoro: kandi yaikarayo okuhikya okufa kwa herode: ekigambo kihiki're Mukama ekiyagambire omu nabi ati Nketa omwana wange okuruga omu Misiri.

english: It was not right for the earth or the sea to be quiet. They were sitting outside. Listen, then, if anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
lunyoro: Tikisemesire itaka, noburwakuba orubungo: bakinaga aheru. Anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra, ahu'le.

english: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amos. Amos was the father of Josiah.
lunyoro: Hezekiya akazara Manase; Manase akazara Amoni; Amoni akazara Yosiya;

english: Some of the seed fell on rocky ground, and as soon as it grew up, it dried up because of lack of water.
lunyoro: ndi yagwa ha mwansara; obuyayarukire yahotoka bwango, obwokutaba namaizi.

english: So when I was ready to receive help from God, I stood up to this very day to tell the people and the elders, not saying a word, but what the people of Moses had said:
lunyoro: Nukwo, obunatungirwe okukonyerwa okuruga hali Ruhanga, nyemerire okuhikya ekiro kinu nintebeza abato nabakuru, okutagamba kigambo kyona, urndi babani ba Musa ebibagambire nibigamba ngu

english: Come near to God, and he will draw near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners! Untie your hearts, you hypocrites!
lunyoro: Mui'le haihi Ruhanga, nauwe alibai'ra haihi. Munabe omu ngaro zanyu, inywe abasisi; kandi musemeze emitima yanyu, inywena abanyina emitima ebiri.

english: All the believers who are with me in the churches of Galatia:
lunyoro: na bene baitu bona abali hamu nanyowe, hali ekanisa eza Galitiya:

english: As he has commanded us, before the world was made, we must be holy and without spot from our eyes by love.
lunyoro: Nkokuyatukomeremu omuruwe, ensi zona zitakabaireho, itwe tufoke abarukwera, abataroho kamogo omu maisoge omu kugonza:

english: Stand firm in union with Christ, and be firm in the faith, just as you were taught, so that you may be filled with thanksgiving.
lunyoro: kandi mwombekerwe omuruwe,kandi mugumire omu kuikiriza,nkokumwayegesibwe, nukwo musage muti omukusima.

english: When he saw the crowds, he was moved with pity for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd.
lunyoro: Baitu obuyaboine ebitebe, yabakwatirwa embabazi, baitu bakaba bajwahire nibararanga nkentama ezitanyina mulisa.

english: and said, “Praise be to the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory to him!”
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Ahairwe omugisa Omukama arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama: obusinge omu iguru, nekitinisa haiguru muno.

english: How terrible for you! You are like unmarked graves which people walk in and do not know!
lunyoro: Ziribabona! Baitu numusisana nkebituro ebitarorwa, kandi abantu ababiribataho tibamanya.

english: His disciples had gone to the villages to buy food.
lunyoro: Baitu abegeswabe bakaba begenzire omu maka okugura ebyokurya.

english: And we ourselves are good, because we have been paid in proportion to our actions; but this man has not sinned.”
lunyoro: Naitwe tugusemerire; baitu tuhairwe empera esemerire engeso zaitu: baitu omuntu onu takasisaga.

english: So then, if you know what is good and do not do it, it is bad for you.
lunyoro: nukwo arukumanya okukora kurungi, kandi atarukukora, eki kiba kibi haruwe.

english: The guards were afraid and started shouting,
lunyoro: kandi abalinzi okutina bakatina muno nibatukumira,

english: But thanks be to God! You were slaves of sin, and you obeyed with all your heart the teaching you received.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga ayebazibwe, baitu mukaba muli bairu bekibi, kandi mwahwituka omu mutima omulingo ogwokwegesebwa ogumwahairwe;

english: Jesus answered, “I am telling you the truth: no one can see the Kingdom of God without being born again.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati, Mali mali ninkugambira nti Omuntu obwatazarwa bwakabiri, tasobora kubona obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: Life is much more important than food, and the body is much more important than clothes.
lunyoro: Baitu obwomezi nubukira ebyokurya, nomubiri nugukira ebyokujwara.

english: Don't you know that the five loaves for the five thousand men were yours? How many baskets did you fill?
lunyoro: kandi timukamanyire nobukwakuba okwijuka emigati etano hali abo enkumi itano, nebigega okubikaba biri ebimwasolize.?

english: You will look for me, but you will not find me, and you will not be able to go there.
lunyoro: Mulinse'ra timulinzora: kandi namberendi, inywe timusobora kuijayo.

english: They had seen Trophimus from Ephesus with Paul in the city, and they thought that Paul had brought him into the Temple.
lunyoro: Baitu bakaba baboine Turofimo Omunyefeso hamu nauwe omu rubuga, nibatekereza Pauro amulesere omu yekaru.

english: And so I make my glory come to you, and you have made yourselves holy by means of them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe ninyeyeza habwabu, nabo bonka bayezebwe omu mananu.

english: For our God is a destroying fire.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga waitu nugwo mu'ro ogwokya.

english: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “What human beings can never do, but God can do anything.”
lunyoro: Yesu yabarole'ra nabagambira ati Omu Bantu ekitikisoboka, baitu Ruhanga nasobora byona.

english: A woman does not live apart from a husband; neither does a man live apart from a woman in union with the Lord.
lunyoro: Kandi nomukazi taikaraho hatali musaija, kunu nomusaija taikara haihi nomukazi omu Mukama waitu.

english: The priest who serves in the Most Holy Place and the true tent is the one whom the Lord has appointed, not man.
lunyoro: omuhereza webirukwera na hema yamazima, Mukama eyiyasimbire, kunu tali muntu.

english: I solemnly command you before God, Christ Jesus, and the holy angels, so that you will keep yourselves from doing this before God and stop doing the work of loving one another.
lunyoro: Ninkutere'ra omu maiso ga Ruhanga na kristo Yesu nabamaraika abakome, olindege ebi hatali okucwere'ra omusango, kandi oleke okukora ekigambo kyona obwengonzi.

english: He confirms the message of hope that is as we teach it, so that he may speak boldly to those who reject it.
lunyoro: asagike ekigambo ekyokwesiga ekiri nkokwegesa kwaitu okukuli, nukwo asobole okwegambi'ra omubyokwegesa abarukuhakana.

english: My friends, I tell you, do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot afterward do anything else.
lunyoro: Kandi nimbagambira inywe enganjani zange nti Mutatini abo abanyakuita omubiri, hanyuma tibanyina kindi ekibasobora okukora.

english: Three months later we left the ship that was in Alexandria, that is, in the island that was on the island, ready to sail.
lunyoro: Kand amezi asatu obugahingureho, twarugayo omu kyombo ekya Alegezanderiya, kikaba kiri omu izinga omu biro ebyembeho, akokuro'raho kakyo

english: Why are you anxious about clothes? Look at the things that are in the field, as the plants grow. They don't work or make clothes for themselves.
lunyoro: Kandi kiki ekibatuntuliza ebyokujwa? Murole ebyakyo ebyomu kisaka, nkokubimera: tibikora mirimo, nobukwakuba okwongosa orugoye:

english: When he comes, he will prove to the world that sin and righteousness are right;
lunyoro: Ogu obwaliija aryomereza ensi habwekibi na habwokuhiki'ra na habwomusango:

english: Help him to remain firm in the faith, and be sure that God will put an end to suffering for the sake of his friends in the world.
lunyoro: kandi mumutangege numuguma omu kuikiriza kwanyu, mumanyire ngu okubonabonesebwa oku kuhikirire ha batahi hanyu abali omu nsi.

english: Pilate answered, “I am a Jew, but your people and the chief priests have killed me. What have you done?”
lunyoro: Pirato yagaruramu ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya? Abaihanga ryanyu na Banyakatagara abakuru nibo bakundetire: okozire ki?

english: I have brought glory to the world, but I have finished the work you gave me to do.
lunyoro: nyowe nkunyumize ha nsi, baitu omulimo oguwampaire okukora nguhikirize.

english: While I was with you, I did not take any advantage of anyone. The believers from Macedonia helped me carry my burdens, and in all circumstances I can help them.
lunyoro: kandi obunkaba ndi hamu nainywe ninsega, ntajwahye omuntu nomu; baitu bene baitu abarugire Makedoni nibo bahikirize ebinabuzirweho; kandi omu byona nkerinda nyenka okutabajwahya, kandi nukwo ndayerindaga.

english: Whenever you go into a house, first say, ‘Peace be with this house.’
lunyoro: Kandi enju yona eyimurakatahamuga, mubanze mugambe ngu Obusinge buikale omu nju enu.

english: In the same way you will be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
lunyoro: Nukwo inywe mulihiki'ra nka Isenywe ali omu iguru okwahikirire.

english: In the same way you will know that the Kingdom of God is near.
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe, mulimanya ngu Obukama bwa Ruhanga buli haihi.

english: We love because he first loved us.
lunyoro: Itwe ntugonza baitu uwe akabanza okutugonza itwe.

english: As they shouted from the sky, they threw their cloaks over them and threw dust on them.
lunyoro: Obukaba nibagambira haiguru, nibanaga ebyokujwara byabu, nibarahiza ecucu haiguru

english: But some of them were filled with anger and said, “These have taken away the unspiritual wine!”
lunyoro: Baitu abandi bakatera enaku nibagamba ngu Baijuire amarwa agomutara'ra.

english: When this happened, some of the sick in that town came and were insulted, and they treated us with the greatest respect.
lunyoro: Kandi eki obukyakozirwe, nabandi abarwaire abomukubuga oru baija, batulema: kandi abo batuha ekitinisa kingi:

english: You will eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom, and you will sit on thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
lunyoro: murye munywe ha meza yange omu bukama bwange; kandi muliika'ra ha ntebe ezekitinisa, numucwera omusango enganda Ezabaisaleri ikumi naibiri.

english: Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord with many others.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro na Baranaba bakaikarayo omu Antyokiya, nibegesa, nibatebeza ekigambo kya Mukama waitu, hamu nabandi baingi.

english: Jesus answered, “If I tell you evil, forgive me; for what good do you expect?”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugarukamu ati Obundaba ngambire kubi, onyomereze ekibi: baitu kiraba kiri kirungi nonte'ra ki?

english: He took the cup, gave thanks to God, and handed it to them; and they all drank from it.
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, kandi obuyamazire okusima, yabaha: baginywaho bona.

english: But to this very day, when Moses was read everything, the veil still covers their minds.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhikya hati, Musa obwasomebwa bwona, ekyokwesweke'ra kiikaire ha mutima gwabu.

english: For as God is faithful, our message to you is not without effect.
lunyoro: Baitu nka Ruhanga okwali wokwesiga, ekigambo kyaitu halinywe tikiri ego na nangwa.

english: I assure you that on the Judgment Day God will show more mercy to Sodom than to you.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira nti ha kiro kyomusango ensi ya Sodomu okubonabonesebwa kwayo kuliba nokuganyirwa okukira okwawe.

english: The beast that you saw was like a leopard, with feet like a bear's feet, and a mouth like a lion's mouth. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and his vast authority.
lunyoro: Ekibatana ekyoboine kikaba nikisisana nkengo, nebigere byakyo nkebya dubu, nakanwa kakyo nkakanwa kentale: kandi ekijoka kikakiha amani gakyo, nekitebe kyakyo, nobusobozi bwingi.

english: For I have the baptism to be baptized with, and I am glad that it is already time for me to be baptized.
lunyoro: Baitu nyina okubatizibwa okudibatizibwamu; nanyowe nsalirwa okuhika obukulikahiki'ra.

english: Sin will not be your master; you are not under the Law, but under God's grace.
lunyoro: Baitu ekibi tikiribatunga: baitu timurukulemwa ebiragiro, baitu embamazi.

english: After this, Judas, who was a Galilean, stood up during the time of the census and persuaded some people to follow him. The man was killed, and all who heard him were scattered.
lunyoro: Hanyuma yogu, Yuda owa Galiraya akaimuka omu biro ebyokuhandika abantu, nacunda abamu okumukuratira: nogu akabura; na bona abamuhulire bakararanga.

english: Because of the terrible troubles they endured, they were extremely joyful and filled with joy, because they were deeply loved by their God-given wealth.
lunyoro: Baitu omu muhito ogwabalengere muno, okusemererwa kwabu okwingi muno, namasege gabu amaingi, bikasagi'ra hali obuguda obwokugaba kwab.

english: For I used to make my body fit for the Kingdom of God, even though it was only after I preached to others. I myself would not be approved by God.
lunyoro: baitu nyesaliza nyenka omubiri gwange, nimbalema, rundi obundikamara okutebeza abandi, nyowe nyenka ntaba atarukusimwa.

english: Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who have been blessed by my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Nubwo omukama alibagambira abaha mukonogwe ogwoburyo ati muije, inywe isenyowe abayahaire omugisa, mugwetwe obukama obwabatekanirizibwe okuruga ahakuhangwa kwensi;

english: and said to those who sold the pigeons, ‘Take these things out of here! Stop making my Father's house a marketplace!’
lunyoro: yagambira abakaba nibagura amaiba ati Muiheho binu; mutafora enju ya Isenyowe enju yokuhingisamu.

english: For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, and wrong. We were slaves of passions and pleasures of all kinds, and we were slaves of human nature.
lunyoro: hati naitwe tukaba tuli abadomadoma kara, abatarukuhu'ra, ababihibwa, nituhereza okwegomba nokwesemeza okwemiringo nyingi, kandi nituikaraho nkabairu rubale owomubiri:

english: The first two disciples went over to the other side of the lake, where they had just heard the voice say to them. They left, went out, and came out of the boat, and untie the man from the other side of the lake. At once an angel came out of him.
lunyoro: Obubahinguire ha balinzi abokubanza nabakabiri, bahika ha ruigi orwekyoma, orurukabakingukiraho rwonka; kandi baturuka, bahingura omu ikute baturuka; kandi dora, maraika yamurugaho bwango.

english: But they did not understand what the scripture says: “He must rise from death.”
lunyoro: baitu bakaba bataketegerize ekyahandikirwe ngu Kimuhikirire okuhumbuka omu bafu.

english: If you hear his voice today,
lunyoro: Hati bunu obumuraba numuhu'ra irakarye,

lunyoro: Ruhanga owa baisenkuru itwe akahumbura Yesu, oumwaisire, inywe numumuhanika ha muti.

lunyoro: Kandi nobusinge bwa Ruhanga oburukukira okumanywa kwona bulirinda emitima yanyu nebitekarazo bayanyu omu Kristo Yesu.

lunyoro: Kandi tikuli nukwo kwonka, baitu naitwe abanyina ebyokubanza Ebyomwonyo, ntusinda ntutegereza okuforwa abana, nukwo kucungurwa kwomubiri gwaitu.

english: What shall I say then? Is there anything or anything I can use to make an idol?”
lunyoro: Nukwo ngambire ki? Nti ekinyakuhongirwe ekisisani kiri kintu? rundi ekisirwe kitaroho kintu?

lunyoro: Omukama worugonjo yagamba ati Ndagira nta? Ndituma omwana wange oundukugonza; rundi balimutina.

english: Where did this come from, my mother, my Lord?
lunyoro: kandi nyowe ekigambo kinu kyaruga nkaha, nyina Mukama wange okuija namberendi?

lunyoro: Nukwo omuti gwona ogusemire gwana ebyana ebisemire, baitu omuti ogubiole gwana ebitarumu.

lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda nta? Yamugambira ati Nukwo ogambire.

lunyoro: Baitu batagume kumukaguza kigambo kindi kyona.

english: He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and chained him in chains for a thousand years.
lunyoro: Yakwata ekijoka, enjoka eyaira, nuwe Diaboro kandi Setani, yamuboha okuhikya emyaka rukumi,

lunyoro: Ogu anyakubeta wokwesiga, kandi nuwe alikora.

lunyoro: kandi omu maiso gekitebe kyobukama enyanja yendo'rwamu erukusisana nka kurusitaro; na hagati yekitebe ekyobukama ebyomezi bina ebiijuire amaiso omu buso nenyuma.

english: For to us there is God, the Father, who is the Creator of all things, and we are on his side. And our Lord Jesus Christ, who removed all things from us and gave himself to us.
lunyoro: baitu halitwe haroho Ruhanga omu Isitwe, nambere haruga byona, naitwe tuli haruwe: na Mukama waitu omu Yesu Kristo, kandi aikazaho byona, kandi aikara halitwe.

english: For the name of God is being declared among the Gentiles because of you, as the scripture says.
lunyoro: baitu ibara rya Ruhanga niriswazibwa omu Bamahanga habwanyu nkokukyahandikirwe.

english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubahulire eki, babatizibwa okutaha omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu.

lunyoro: Mukama waitu akagambira Pauro ekiro omu kwolekwa ati Otatina, baitu gamba, otaculera:

english: I thank God that I speak in strange tongues more than any of you.
lunyoro: Ninsima Ruhanga, nimbakira inywena okugamba endimi.

english: Jesus said to him, “Watch out, and do not tell anyone; then come back and show the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a witness to them.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Werinde, oleke kugambiraho muntu; kandi garukayo, weyoleke hali nyakatagara, ohouge ekisembo Musa ekiyaragire, kibe kaiso habali.

english: How happy and happy it must be to hear this! Your brother was dead, but now he is alive; he was lost, but now he has been found.
lunyoro: Baitu okukyanganuka nokusemererwa kisemire: baitu mugenzi wawe ogu akaba afire, kandi ayomire, akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: I am telling you the truth: no slave is greater than his master, and no one is greater than the one who sent him.
lunyoro: mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuiru takira obukuru mukamawe, kandi omukwenda takira obwingi ogu ayamutumire.

english: But what you have heard from the beginning must remain in you, and what you have heard from the beginning will remain in you and in the Son and the Father.
lunyoro: baitu inywe ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara, nikyo kiikalege omulinywe. Ekimwahulirire okuruga Karanakara obukiraba nikiikara namberemuli, nainywe muraikaraga omu Mwana nomu Isitwe.

english: “Why are you frightened,” Jesus asked them. “Have you no faith?”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubatinisa? Timukatungire kuikiriza?

english: I tell you that he will soon take care of them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Alibaramu'ra bwango. Baitu Omwana womuntu obwaliija alisanga okuikiriza hansi?

english: Nor does anyone pour new wine into old wineskins, because the wine will burst the skins, and the wine will burst the skins.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga enkuru: kakuba agira ati amarwa gahulikya endyanga zakusisikaire.

lunyoro: Embeho ehuha nambere egonza, naiwe ohu'ra okuhi'ra kwayo, baitu tomanya nambere eruga, nobuhokuba nambere egenda; nukwo aba ati wena anyakuzarwa Omwoyo.

english: But you always have them, because you don't always have me.
lunyoro: Baitu basege munyinabo ebiro byona; baitu timunyina nyowe ebiro byona.

lunyoro: Kakuba ebicweka byona bibaire ekicweka kimu, omubiri gwakubaire nkaha?

lunyoro: Nukwo, busaho owamagezi omulinywe bene babu omusango?

lunyoro: Kandi ekitebe obukyamazireho okubingwamu, yahinguramu, yamukwata Mukono; omuisiki yaimuka.

lunyoro: Yagamba ati Niwoha, Mukama wange? Mukama waitu yagamba ati Ninyowe Yesu, oworukuhigana iwe:

lunyoro: Omukazi akaba ajwaire ebirukunanata nebirukutukura, kandi atoire ebya zabu, namabale agomuhendo, neruru, ayina omu mukonogwe empwahwa ya zabu ijuire ebinugwa, nibyo byobusihanibwe ebitasemire,

lunyoro: Kikahandikwa ngu Ruhanga ali naitwe.

lunyoro: Mutahora omuntu obubi obwobubi. Mwtekanize okugira ebirungi omu maiso gabantu bona.

lunyoro: twahukanizibwe, baitu titurukuhemukirwa; tulekerwe hansi, baitu tituli bokukungana;

lunyoro: Omulinywe wena asemezege mutahiwe omu burungi obwokwekambisa.

lunyoro: Yamarayo omu irungu ebiro amakumi ana, nayohebwa setani; yaikara hamu nenyamaiswa; bamaraika nibamuhereza.

english: They have brought God's truth into the dark, and have worshiped and served the purposes of the Most High God, who is always good. Amen.
lunyoro: baitu bakahingisa amazima ga Ruhanga omu bisuba, kandi bakaramya nibahereza ebyahangirwe okukira Omuhangi, orukusimwa ebiro byona. Amina.

english: He had not yet come to them, but had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu akaba atakabaizireho nomu: baitu bakabatizibwa okubatizibwa kwonka, okutaha omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: But he denied it, saying, “I am not the Messiah!”
lunyoro: Yagamba, atarukwehakana, nagamba ati nyowe tindi Kristo.

english: Adam was the first Adam to be created, then Eve.
lunyoro: Baitu Adamu nuwe yabandize okuhangwa, hanyuma Hawa;

english: It is a terrifying thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
lunyoro: Kiba kigambo kyokutina muno okugwa omu mikono ya Ruhanga omwomezi.

english: Don't you know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit, who lives in you and who lives in you by God's power? Not it is for yourselves.
lunyoro: Kandi timumanyire ngu omubiri gwanyu niyo yekaru Yomwoyo Ogurukwera omulinywe, ogumunyinagwo hali Ruhanga? Kandi timuli habwanyu inywenka:

english: There was a garden in the place where Jesus had been crucified, and there was a new tomb where no one had ever been buried.
lunyoro: Kandi omu kiikaro ekiyabambirwemu ha muti hakaba harumu orugonjo: kandi omu rugonjo: nihaliyo ekituro ekihyaka ekitakazikwamuga muntu.

english: All of you, too, want to be free from all passions and passions, so that you will be able to wait for one hope to end.
lunyoro: Naitwe ntugoza muno inywe inywena mwolekege okwekamba oku hali okwetegereza kimu okunihira okuhika ha mpero:

english: “Father,” he prayed, “if you have faith, take it away from me; it is not what I want, but what you want.”
lunyoro: yasaba ati Isenyowe obworaba noikiriza, onyiheho obworaba empwahwa enu: baitu kitaba nka nyowe okundukugonza, rundi nka Iwe okworukugondeza nukwo kikorwe.

english: For the scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox when you are using it to thresh grain.” And “Workers deserve their reward.”
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe nibigamba ngu Otaliboha akanwa kente obweribatira engano. Kandi ngu Omukozi asemerire emperaye.

english: For who among you knows the things of a human being or the spirit of a human being? It does not belong to God, nor does it affect God's Spirit.
lunyoro: Baitu muntu ki amanyire ebyomuntu, rundi omwoyo ogwomuntu oguli omuruwe? nukwo busaho amanyire Ebya Ruhanga, nobwakuba Omwoyo ga Ruhanga.

lunyoro: Busaho muntu asobora okuija namberendi, Isenyowe ayantumire obwatamucundar nanyowe ndimuimukya ha kiro kya hampero

lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Omulingo gunu tigurukusobora kurugaho obwekigambo, baitu obwokusaba.

lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu aratembere omu iguru, rundi ogu ayasirimukire okuruga omu Iguru, nuwe Mwana womuntu aliomu iguru.

lunyoro: baitu oli, obwokuikaraho okuhikya obusinge bwona, anyina obunyakatagara obutahwaho.

lunyoro: Yesu uagarukamu ati Kinu okigambire habwawe, wenka, rundi abandi bakugambire ebigambo byange?

english: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.
lunyoro: Omukazi ogu owoboine nurwo rubuga orukuru orurukulema abakama bensi.

lunyoro: Nauwe obwahu'ra ebigambo byange binu atarukubikora, alisisana nomuntu omudomadoma ayayombekere enjuye ha musenyi:

lunyoro: baitu abo, obubamuboine nangendera ha nyanja, nibatekereza ngu muzimu, bayamuza:

english: We have this command from him, ‘Whoever loves God must love his brother as himself.’
lunyoro: Kandi tuyina ekiragiro kinu kyarugire ahaliwe ngu Anyakugonza Ruhanga, agonzege na Mugenziwe.

english: The throne was around the throne, and twelve elders were sitting there, dressed in white, and on their heads were crowns of gold.
lunyoro: Kandi nentebe ezobukama zikaba zehingulirize ekitebe ekyobukama amakumi abiri naina: kandi ha ntebe hakaba haroho abakuru ikumi nababiri baikalire, bajwaire engoye ezirukwera; na ha mitwe yabu ekondo eza zabu.

english: Everyone went to register, in their homes.
lunyoro: Kandi bona bakagenda okwehandika, omu omu omu maka gabu bonka.

english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to me, and you will sit down with me.
lunyoro: Kandi obundaba ningenda okubatekaniriza ekiikaro, ndigaruka hanu,okubatwara namberendi; nywo namberenyowe muikaleyoga.

english: So then, encourage one another and build each other up, just as you do.
lunyoro: Nukwo muhumuzanganege inywenka, kandi mwombekege inywena, omuntu wena omutahiwe, nkokumurukukora kandi.

english: For whoever opposes me in the presence of men will be condemned in the presence of the angels of God.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakunyehakana omu maiso gabantu, nuwe alihakanwa omu maaso gabamaraika ba Ruhanga.

english: But when they read this letter to you, they praised God for his great love for you, because you listened to the Good News about Christ, and did not give up on them all.
lunyoro: baitu oubabalenga inywe omu kuhereza kunu, bakukugiza Ruhanga obwokuhu'ra okwokuranga kwanyu hali enjiri ya Kristo, nobwokutaima okwokubagana kwanyu nabo bona;

english: Which king, if he tries to fight another king, will he not sit down first and speak up? Or will he be able to fight against you two thousand men who fight him?
lunyoro: Kandi mukama ki obwaba naramaga okurwana nomukama ondi, atabanza okuika'ra nahanura ebigambo, rundi arasobora nakakumi okutangana oli arukumuramagira nobukumi bubiri?

english: In every way I may give you an example of how to do your work, so that you may be able to help the sick and remember the words of the Lord Jesus, who himself said: “It was better for him to suffer than to be given.”
lunyoro: Mu byona nkabaha ekyokuro'raho, okukibahikirire okukora muti emirimo, nukwo mukonyerege abagara, nokuijukaga ebigambo bya Mukama waitu Yesu, okuyagambire wenka ati Okugaba kwomuigisa okukira okuhebwa.

english: There are many rooms in my Father's house. If it isn't so, I will tell you, because I am going to prepare a place for you.
lunyoro: Omunju ya Isenyowe harumu ebiikaro bingi ebyokuikaramu. Kakuba kitalikyo, nakubagambire; baitu ningenda okubatekaniriza ekiikaro.

english: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple who loved him standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold your son!
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyaboine nyina nomwegeswa owakaba nagonza ayemerire haihi, yagambira nyina ati Omukazi, dora Omwana wawe!

english: I have the gift of prophesying, and I know all secrets and all knowledge. And if I have all the faith to remove mountains, I have no love, but nothing.
lunyoro: Kandi obundaba nyina ekisembo kyokuragura, kandi manyire ensita zona namagezi gona; kandi obundiba nyina okuikiriza kwona okuihaho ensozi, kunu ntanyina kugonza, tindi kintu.

english: Many Samaritans in that town believed in him because of the woman's message, who said, “He told me everything I have done.”
lunyoro: Kandi hali abomu kika eki Abasamaliya baingi bakamuikiriza habwekigambo kyomukazi, ayagambire ati Angambire ebinakozire byona.

english: The words of the prophets are like these, and the words of the prophets are like these.
lunyoro: Ebigambo bya banabi nibiterana nabyo; nkokukyahandikirwe ngu

english: After he had put up a curse on himself, he was put right with God by the Law and was put right with God by means of him. In the same way, he made himself both a new and a new one, in order to bring peace.
lunyoro: obuyafokere omu mubirigwe wenka ekiragiro ekyokuhiki'ra, nibyo biragiro ebyaragirwe: nukwo ahangire omuruwe wenka abo bombi okuba omuntu omu omuhyaka, okuleta obusinge:

english: Jesus said to him, “I am telling you the truth: you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God began shouting and coming down on the Son of Man.
lunyoro: Akamugambira ati Mali mali nimbagambira ati Mulirora iguru lisukuirwe, bamaraika ba Ruhanga nibatemba nibasirimuka ha Mwana womuntu.

english: Elijah was not sent to them, but to only Zarephath in the land of Sidon, to a widow in a widow's house.
lunyoro: Kandi Eriya atatumwe halibo, rundi hali Zalefasi yonka, omu nsi ya Sidoni, hali omukazi omu fakati.

english: But do not make your head look hard, but you will not be able to make a distinction between the Holy One and the living.
lunyoro: Baitu otalirahira mutwe gwawe, baitu torukkusobora kuhindura akasoke kamu konka rundi okwera.

english: You are the children of God, and you have defeated them, because the greatest one of you is the one who lives in the world.
lunyoro: Inywe muli ba Ruhanga abana bange abato, kandi mubasinguire: baitu anyakuli omulinywe nakira obukuru ogu ali omu nsi.

english: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps are going out.’
lunyoro: Abadomadoma bagambira abamagezi ngu Mutuhe amagita ganyu; baitu etabaza Zaitu zazima.

english: You reject the Law of God and obey human nature.
lunyoro: Inywe muleka ekiragiro kya Ruhanga, numukwata engeso zabantu.

english: Many people came to him at night and saw that he was coming to them, and he explained the Kingdom of God to them and believed in the Law of Moses and the prophets from morning till sunrise.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamutaireho ekiro bakaija baingi namberali omu kigonyokye, yabasobo'ra, na manyisa obukama bwa Ruhanga, nabaikirizasa obwebigambo bya Yesu, omu biragiro bya Musa nomu byabanabi, okuruga nyenkya okuiza obuire.

english: They gave him to drink wine mixed with myrrh, but when he saw it, he would not drink it.
lunyoro: bamuhereza amarwa okunywa agajwanganizibwemu nendurwe; baitu obuyarolezeho yayanga okunywa.

english: For the Temple was built, and there was a lampstand, a lampstand, a table, and a show bread. There was a holy place.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba hakozirwe hema, nambere hakaba harumu ekikondo kyetabaza, nemeza, nemigati eyokwoleka; nuho hayeserwe barukwera.

english: Those who do not obey me and do not obey my words have a judge who will judge them. The words that I have spoken will judge them on the last day.
lunyoro: Atarukuikiriza nyowe, atarukuikiriza bigambo byange, ayina arukumucwera omusango: ebigambo ebinagambire nibyo birimucwera omusango ha kiro kya hampero.

english: The Jewish authorities made fun of him, and they came to him, not because of Jesus alone. They saw that Lazarus had been raised from death.
lunyoro: Abayudaya abakuru baseka muno: baija, tihali habwa Yesu wenka. Kandi barole na Razaro ouyahumbuire omu bafu.

english: So then, since I do not wash you, you are no longer clean; and I will not wash you and you will not wash me in my mouth.
lunyoro: Nukwo obwokutagata koyakoya, kunu torukufuka kandi torukutagata ningenda okukutanaka omu kanwa kange.

english: He will put the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on his left.
lunyoro: azita ha mukonogwe ogwobuliryo, baitu emburabuzi hamukono ogwemoso.

english: When I was with you in the Temple on the day that I was with you, you did not stretch out your hands to arrest me, but this is your day and the power of darkness.
lunyoro: Biro byona obunkaba ndi nainywe omu yekaru, mutago're mikono yanyu okunkwata: baitu kanu niko kasumi kanyu nobusobozi obwomuirima.

english: But you were once born a second time, not in a form that is impossible, but in a way that is impossible, because the word of God remains in you.
lunyoro: baitu mukamara okuzarwa obwakabiri hatabri omu mbibo erukujunda, baitu omu kizimba ekizigaijo, obwekigambo kya Ruhanga ekyomire ekyokuikaraho.

english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who curse you.
lunyoro: musabire omugisa abanyakubakyena, musabirege abanyakubagira okubi.

english: Many Jews read this passage, because the place where Jesus was talking to was near the city. It was written in Hebrew, in Roman, and in Greek.
lunyoro: Ebaruha egi baingi hali Abayudaya bakagisoma:baitu ekiikaro ekibabambiremu Yesu kikaba kiri haihi norubuga: kandi ekahandikwa omu Ruheburaniya, nomu Rurumi, nomu Ruyonani.

english: So they went back home and let them go, because they did not see them suffer for the sake of the people, because they were all praising God for what he had done.
lunyoro: Kandi obubagarukire okubareka, batabone okubarababonabonesa obwabantu; baitu bona bakaba nibakugiza Ruhanga obweki ekyakozirwe.

english: I tell you the truth: it is better for you to go away than for me to go. But if I do not go, the Helper will not come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nimbagambira amananu; kibaseme'ra inywe nyowe okugenda; baitu obundaba ntarukugenda Omuhumuza taliija namberemuli; baitu obundigenda, ndimuituma halinywe.

english: In the same way, those who worship the beast and all that is in them will worship it.
lunyoro: Kandi anyakunamira ekisoro, na byona ebiroho, alikiramya.

english: When they heard this, they entered the Temple early in the morning and left him. The High Priest went with the other servants and gathered the Council together with all the elders of Israel, and sent them to the prison to be brought to them.
lunyoro: Obubahulire bataha omu yekaru omu rukyakya, bayesiga. Baitu nyakatagara omukuru wabu akaija nabakaba bali nauwe, yasoroza ahamu orukurato nabakuru bona ababana Baisaleri, yatuma hali enju yenkomo okubaleta.

english: Jesus commanded them to gather all the people together, as a small group.
lunyoro: kandi yabaragira okusoroza bona, bitebe bitebe ha bunyansi obuto.

english: His mother answered, “Yes, but he will be called John.”
lunyoro: Nyina yagarukamu nagamba ati Nangwa; baitu arayetwaga Yohana.

english: But we do not want you to be afraid of them, so that you will go down to the sea and pick up the fish that will come up and kill them. When you open your mouth, you will find a donkey tied up. Take it and give it to me and you.”
lunyoro: baitu itwe tutabatabaijura, ogende ha nyanja, onage ekisoha, oihemu encu erabana okuibu'ruka; obworakasamya akanwa kayo, orazoramu esitateri: niyo otwale, ogibahe habwange na habwawe.

english: But when the two anchors arrived at the front of the ship, it was broken, and the ship's head stood still in the wind, so that it would not move, because the wind was blowing against it.
lunyoro: Baitu obubahikire omu kiikaro ebingonzi bibiri nambere byateranire, byacweka embeho; kandi omutwe gwekyombo gwagumaho omu musenyi, okutatengeta, baitu ekiso kyabanza okucwekacweka obwamani gebingonzi.

english: Jesus answered, “I don't know what you are asking for. Can you drink the cup that I am about to drink?” They answered, “We cannot.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Timumanyire ekimurukusaba.Nimusobora okunywa ha mpwahwa nyowe eyingenda okunywaho? Bamugambira ngu Ntusobora.

english: For I do not want to boast about myself, but about the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, because the world hates me and I live in the world.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe tindukugonza okwenyumiza, rundi omu muti gwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, habwogu ensi ebambirwe ha muti namberendi, nanyowe hali ensi.

english: When he arrived that very day, he thanked God and told his message to all who were waiting for Jerusalem's deliverance.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaizire omu kasumi ako yasima Ruhanga, yatebeza ebigambobye hali bona abakaba nibategereza okucungurwa kwa Yerusalemu.

english: If that person were not from God, he could not do a thing.
lunyoro: Kakuba omuntu ogu atali wa Ruhanga takusoboire kukora kigambo.

english: I am afraid of you or of you.
lunyoro: Kandi obunakuikirize tinukugurukyagurukya, rundi nyine ihali omulinywe.

english: When the kings of the earth had made sexual immorality with him, the kings of the earth and the people who live in the world had drunk the wine of her sexual immorality.
lunyoro: bakama bensi obubasihaine nauwe, nabo abarukuikara omunsi bakatamira amarwa agobusihanibwe.

english: But if someone comes to you and proclaims to you the Good News about Jesus, you will be patient with him, not only because you did not believe him, but because you did not believe him.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo anyakuija obwatebeza Yesu ondi oututaratebize, rundi enjiri endi eyimutaraikirize, mumugumisiriza ogu kurungi mali.

english: We believe in him at all times and in every place, in the name of his great and glorious name.
lunyoro: tuikirize ebiro byona, nomu biikaro byona, okukugiza ibararye erikuru nirirukugizibwa.

english: But if you do not believe what the Scriptures say, will you believe my words?
lunyoro: Baitu obu mutaikiriza ebiyahandikire, mulikiriiza muta ebigambo byange?

english: In union with Christ, then, you have every reason to do what is right.
lunyoro: Nukwo nobunyina obumanzi bwona omu Kristo okukukometereza ebisemire,

english: We know that we have been raised from death to life, but we love our brothers. He does not want you to die.
lunyoro: Itwe tumanyire ngu tukaruga omu kufa okutaha omu bwomezi, baitu ntugonza bene baitu. Atarukugonza inywe omu kufa.

english: We trust in the Lord that you will do what we order, and so you will do.
lunyoro: Kandi twesigire Mukama waitu habwanyu ngu ebituragira nibyo murukukora, kandi mulibikora.

english: His disciples asked him about this parable.
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamukaguza orufumo oru okuruli.

english: So Jacob went down into Egypt and died, he, and our ancestors.
lunyoro: Yakobo yasirimuka omu Misiri, yafa, uwe nabaisenkuru itwe;

english: When he was put out of the house of Pharaoh, he took him and killed him as your own son.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyanagirwe aheru, Faraho yamutwara namulera nkomwanawe wenka.

english: But Jesus said to them, “Even if I tell you, you will not believe;
lunyoro: Baitu yabagambira ati Nobwakubaire nimbatebeza timuikirize:

english: For the mind of the flesh is opposed to God, but the mind of the Spirit is opposed to the law of God, and it cannot be shaken from its way.
lunyoro: baitu okutekereza okwomubiri nubwo bunyanzigwa hali Ruhanga; baitu tikurukutungwa ebiragiro bya Ruhanga, kunu tikurukusobora:

english: They wanted to make fun of me, but there was no reason for me to do so.
lunyoro: abo obumazire okunkaguliriza bagonza okunsumu'ra, baitu busaho musango hair nyowe.

english: Send them away, and let them go to the other side of the country and to the rest of the country, where they will buy food.
lunyoro: Sindika, bagende omu nsi nomu maka agahe'raine begu'le ebyokurya.

english: And we are thankful to God for the Lord Jesus Christ, who has brought us together now.
lunyoro: kandi tusima Ruhanga habwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, anyakutuhaisize hati bunu okuterana oku.

english: Jesus said to them, “The bridegroom cannot be in a room where the bridegroom is to be with the bridegroom, because the bridegroom cannot be with the bridegroom.
lunyoro: Nauwe yabagambira ati Abana bobugole nibasobora bata okusiba, omuswezi tibasoboramu?

english: The hour has come, and it has already come. I will leave you alone, because I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
lunyoro: Dora, akasumi nikaija, kandi kahikire, akamurararangiramu omuomu omu bye wenka, numunsiga nyenka: baitu tindi nyenka, baitu Isenyowe ali hamu nanyowe.

english: “What do we need to see with our own eyes? We ourselves have heard with our own ears!” they asked.
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Ntuseru'ra ki bakaiso abandi? Baitu itwe tuhulire omu kanwake wenka.

english: And it was he who was told this by means of Isaac that your descendants will be called.
lunyoro: kandi nuwe ogu ayagambirwe ogu Omu Isaka abaijukuru bawe numwo baryeterwa:

english: Those who belong to him will be called ‘my children,’ and I will be their God.
lunyoro: Anyakusingura aligwetwa omwana wange, kandi ndiba Ruhangawe.

english: Whoever disowns me before men, I will reject him before my Father in heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi wena alinyehakana omu maiso gabantu, uwe ndimwehakana omumaiso ga isenyowe ali omu iguru.

english: The High Priest Ananias ordered the men who were standing there to strike him on the mouth.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omukuru wabu Ananiya yaragira abamwemerire haihi okumutera omunwa.

english: For he was sick nearly to death, but God was merciful to him, and not only to me but also to me, so that his distress would not increase.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo akarwara mali haihi nikufa: baitu Ruhanga aramuganyira; kandi tali uwe wenka, baitu nanyowe, obujune obunyinabwo buleke okunyongeraho.

english: At once he got up. When all the people who were living in Lydda and Sharon saw him, they turned to the Lord.
lunyoro: ahonaho yaimuka. Bona abakaba nibaikara omu Ruda nomu Saroni, obubamuiboine, bahindukira Mukama waitu.

english: When I arrive, I will send those who thank you to Jerusalem to receive your grace.
lunyoro: Kandi obundiija, abo abamulisima omu baruha ndibatuma okutweka ebyembabazi byanyu Yerusalemu.

english: We know that you are willing to help me, and I am happy about you among the people of Macedonia, because the work has been done for you in a year. And many of you have been able to help them.
lunyoro: baitu'manyire okwekamba kwanyu, okundukwenyumirizamu hali abo abomu Makedoni habwanyu, baitu Akaya emazire omwaka gumu okwetekaniza; kandi nihali ryanyu likaimukya baingi omulibo.

english: They were put right with God, but they did not stop their first faith.
lunyoro: baihirweho omusango, baitu balekereyo okuikiriza kwabu okwokubanza.

english: For who knew the mind of the Lord, or who was his prophet?
lunyoro: Gamba ngu Noha amanyire amagezi ga Mukama? Rundi noha akaba afokere omuhanuziwe?

english: Peter said to him, “Even if I die with you, I will not deny you at all.” All the disciples said the same thing.
lunyoro: Petero yamugambira ati Nobundaba ninfera ahamu naiwe, tinkwehakane na kake. Nabegeswa bona nukwo bagambire bati.

english: But because of the evil that this woman has done to me, I will wait on her, so that she will not cry for help until the day when she comes.
lunyoro: baitu omufakati onu obwokunyita kubi, nikyo ndimuramu'ra, aleke oku'naga ensazi naija obukyabukya.

english: People fall because of fear and expectation of the things coming on the earth, because the power that God gives in heaven will be shaken.
lunyoro: abantu nibagwa ensazi obwokutina, nobwokutegereza ebirukuija hansi: baitu amani agaha iguru galitengesebwa.

english: So then, if the Son gives you free, you will be free from sin.
lunyoro: Nukwo Omwana obwalibafora abobugabe muliba bobugabe mali.

english: Your boasting in me may be based on Christ Jesus, who appeared to you once more.
lunyoro: Okwenyumiza kwanyu nukwo kusage kuti omu Kristo Yesu habwange, obwokuija kwange obundi namberemuli.

english: They all wept and mourned for him, but Jesus said, “Don't cry, but don't cry; he has not died.
lunyoro: Bamuseka muno bona: baitu yagamba ati Muta'ra, baitu tafire;

english: They thanked the Father for wanting to run away from him.
lunyoro: Kandi basima ise, okwarukwenda okumuruka.

english: They told him the word of the Lord, and all who were in his house.
lunyoro: kandi bamugambira ekigambo kya Mukama waitu, na bona abakaba bali omu njuye.

english: For we who believe in Gentiles write that we have been judged to keep them from the things that are offered to idols, blood, and the sexual immorality.
lunyoro: Kandi Abamahanga, abaikirize tukahandika, tucwire omusango, ngu berindege hali ebintu ebihongirwe ebisisani, nesagama nebinigirwe, nobusihani.

english: For it is right for me to go to my Father, and you do not see me either.
lunyoro: baitu habwokuhiki'ra, ningenda hali Isenyowe, kandi nainywe timukindora;

english: They began to ask him to turn from their sins.
lunyoro: Kandi babanza okumwesengereza aruge omu mitana yabu.

english: The traitor had given him a signal, and he said, “This is the one I want you to arrest. Arrest him, and take us away from prison.”
lunyoro: kandi ogu akaba namugobeza akabaha akokuro'raho, nagamba ati Oundanywegera, nuwogu; mumukwate, muutwale aboherwe.

english: Stay with me, and I with you. I am afraid that you will not be able to bear children unless you remain in the vineyard, and you will not be able to remain in me.
lunyoro: Muikale omuli nyowe, nayowe omulinywe. Rundi timulisobora okwana ebyana obulitaikara omu muzabibu, kandi namberendi timusobora.

english: They teach customs that are not for us to live or to do, but for us to live in Rome.
lunyoro: nibegesa engeso ezitangirwe itwe okuzikwata, nobukwakuba okuzikora, baitu tuli Barumi.

english: Elijah wants to come. Listen, then, to the one who has ears to hear.
lunyoro: Eriya arukwenda kuija. Anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra ahu'le.

english: This was the first letter written in the province of Syria.
lunyoro: Oku nukwo kuhandikwa okwabandizeho Kulenio obwakaba nalema Busuli.

english: There were six stone lampstands, which were described as the Jewish ritual baths, from which two or three pools of water were dug.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haliyo entugiro ezamabale mukaga, ezatairweyo nkengeso Ezabayudaya ezokweza okuziri, nambere harugamu, entugio emuemu, amaizi agensuha ibiri rundi isatu.

english: A voice came out of heaven, “You are my Son, the beloved; I have been deeply troubled.”
lunyoro: raka ryaturuka omu iguru ngu Niwe mwana wange oungonza, nkukyanganukire muno.

english: But you have few names in Sardis who did not wash their robes. They will go with me in his holy garments, because they are worthy.
lunyoro: Baitu oyina amabara make omu Sadi abatarasisire ebyokujwara byabu: kandi baligendera hamu nanyowe omu ngoye ezirukwera, baitu basemerire.

english: But Jesus was deeply upset by this saying, and he thought about the glory that was going to happen to him.
lunyoro: Baitu uwe yatuntura muno obwekigambo eki, netekerezxa okuramukya oku okukuli.

english: For there is no word that comes from God, and no power is given to it.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho kigambo ekiruga hali Ruhanga ekiriburwa amani.

english: We have the prophetic word that is more faithful than any other prophet. Do what is good to hear, as the scripture says, “Before the mountains are settled, you will be filled with courage.”
