lunyoro: Kandi akokuro'raho akakoto kakarorwa omu iguru; omukazi ajwaire izoba, nokwezi omunda yebigerebye, kandi ha mutwegwe enyunyuzi ikumi naibiri;

english: Those who hear this and obey it will go on walking, being led astray by the desires, riches, and pleasures of this life, and will not achieve anything good.
lunyoro: Kandi abahu'ra basirimuka, batangwa habwokutabana, nitungo nebyokwesemeza ebyomubwomezi bunu, kandi tibahikiriza byana ebirungi.

english: So he left the territory of Galilee and asked them, “Sir, I want to see Jesus.”
lunyoro: Yabasengereza nagamba ati Tata, ntwenda okurora Yesu.

english: After spending a long time there, we reached Cnidus, where the wind was not coming on us, and we crossed over on the island of Crete in front of Salmon.
lunyoro: Obutwagenzire mpora ebiro bingi, tuhikire namani omu maiso ga Kinido, nomuyaga gututangire okuhikayo, twahingura ha rubaju rwa Kerete omu maingo ga Saramone;

english: At about nine o'clock Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloiro, Eloi! Why are you persecuting me, my God!
lunyoro: Kandi omu saha eyomwenda Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto ati Eroi Eroi, rama sabakasani? Ekimanisibwa ngu Ruhanga wange Ruhhanga wange, kiki ekikundekeseze/

english: Jesus said to the twelve, “Do you want to go also?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagambira ikumi nababiri ati Kandi nainywe nimwenda okwegendera?

english: We live in the flesh at all times, because the death of Jesus has been made manifest in our bodies.
lunyoro: ebiro byona tuhimbira omu mubiri okufa kwa Yesu bwolekwe omu mubiri gwaitu.

english: The chief priests took some of the money and said, “This is not against the Law to put it in the Temple of God, but to put it in the Most Holy Place.
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru batwara ebicweka ebyefeza, nibagamba ngu Tikiri kyebiragiro okubita omu ryahu'ro rya Ruhanga, baitu muhendo gwesagama.

english: While Jesus was still in the house, Melchizedek met him.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba akiri omu nda ya Isaleri, Merekizedeka obuyamuitiraine.

english: While Agrippa said to Paul, “You must speak on your own behalf.” Then Paul stretched out his hand and began to speak up.
lunyoro: Agulipa yagambira Pauro ati Nyikirize iwe okwegambira wenka. Nubwo Pauro yago'ra omukonogwe, nayetonganira ati:

english: The beast that was, and is not, is the eighth king and is one of seven, and he goes out to fight.
lunyoro: Ekisoro ekikaba kiroho,kandi tikiroho, nuwe mukama owomunana kandi ali omu hali abo omusanju, nauwe agenda omu kuhwereke'ra.

english: For if these things are yours and you live, they will not be yours; but if they do bear children, they will know only the truth about our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ebigambo ebi obubiraba biri byanyu kandi nibasaga, bibafora okuba abatali bagara, baitu abanyakwana ebyana hali okumanyira kimu Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: Some of you have done this to others, but you have done it, because you have been put right with God through the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
lunyoro: Kandi abamu omulinywe nukwo mwasisaine muti: baitu mukoga, baitu mukezebwa, baitu mukaihibwaho omusango omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, nomu Mwoyo ogwa Ruhanga waitu.

english: And God will exalt him by his own power, and he will bow down to him at once.
lunyoro: kandi Ruhanga alimunyumiza omuruwe wenka, kandi bwango aramunumiza.

english: So then, if anyone is in union with Christ, let him be in a new creation. The old things have passed away. Look! new things have passed away.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wena araba ali omu Kristo, buli afokere ekihangirwe ekihyaka: ebyaira bihoireho, dora, byona bihyaka.

english: But Jesus said to him, “Who is my neighbor?”
lunyoro: Baitu ogu akaba nayenda okweyihaho omusango, yagambira Yesu ati Kandi omutahi wange araha?

english: For the Spirit who raised Jesus from death must remain in you, who raised Jesus Christ from death and gave life to your mortal bodies by means of his Spirit who lives in you.
lunyoro: Baitu omwoyo gwogu ayahumbuire Yesu omu bafu guraba guikaire omulinywe ogu ayahumbuire Kristo Yesu omubafu alihaayo obwomezi ha mibiri yanyu erukufa, Obwomwoyogwe oguikara namberemuli.

english: For just as you have not heard God's voice, so now you have been given mercy because of their disobedience.
lunyoro: baitu nka inywe obumutarahulire ira Ruhanga, baitu hati bunu muhairwe okuganyirwa obwokutahu'ra kwabu,

english: He was greatly troubled by the pain of his thorn bush, and he fell down from heaven on people. The people worshiped God because of the pain of the rock, but his pain was so great.
lunyoro: ekisato ekikoto, obwoki bwenjoka ekikooto, kikagwa okuruga omu iguru ha bantu: abantu nibajuma Ruhanga habwokubonabonesebwakwe: baitu okusasa kwayo kukaba kuli kwingi muno.

english: It is enough for you that you will be like his disciples, and that you will be like his master. If you call out to his father in law at Beelzebul, how will they not answer him?
lunyoro: Kimazire omwegeswa abe nkomwegesawe. Obubaraba besere nyineka Beerezebuli, tibalikizaho abo abali omunju?

english: After a few days, the young child gathered all his belongings and went to a nearby country, where he ended up doing what was bad.
lunyoro: Kandi hanyuma yebiro ebitali bingi, ogu omwana omuto, akasoroza ebye byona, yagenda omu nsi ya hara; yararangiza oku ebintubye omu ngeso ezibihire.

english: They must be quiet, but they must be quiet; they must go into houses and teach what is not right in their own sight.
lunyoro: Kandi basemerire kuboha akanwa; baitu nibo bajumikira kimu amaju, nibegesa ebitahikirire obwamagoba go

english: They told him by love that they had seen that I had not done anything wrong with the gospel.
lunyoro: kandi banu nibatebeza obwokugonza, baboine ngu ntaireho okutonganira enjiri:

english: And so we will do if God wishes.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo tulikora Ruhanga obwaligonza.

english: We are saved from the ignorant and the wicked, but faith is not a possession of all people.
lunyoro: kandi tujunwe hali abantu abatanyina amagezi, ababi: baitu okuikiriza tikuli na bona.

english: They had a scarlet robe, and their hair was like a robe.
lunyoro: kandi zikaba ziyina isoke nkisoke ryabakazi, namaino gazo gali nketale.

english: He did not try to force anyone to tell him about the things that happened to him, but he himself knew what was in human beings.
lunyoro: kandi atase'le muntu wena okumumanyisa ebyabantu; baitu uwe wenka akamanya ebikaba biri omu Bantu.

english: So then, be patient with him before you think you will answer him.
lunyoro: Nikyo mukigumize omu mitima yanyu okutabanzaga okutekereza okumuragarukamu:

english: Give to the one who is sinning against the body of the Lord Jesus, so that the Spirit may be saved by the Day of our Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: muheyo ogu arukusisa ati omubiri gughwereke'le, nukwo omwoyo gujunwe ha kiro kya Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: So then, do not look at one another in your own words, but at the same time look at one another.
lunyoro: nukwo mutarora omu ha bigambo byanyu inywenka, baitu inywena murole nebyabandi.

english: Jesus Christ himself gave himself for us, in order that he might redeem us from all sin and make us his own people, which is the means by which he has called you to do good.
lunyoro: Kristo Yesu ayayehaireyo wenka habwaitu nukwo atucungule omu kutahiki'ra kwona kandi ayesemereze wenka ihanga okuba rye wenka, erirukwekambira engeso enungi.

english: For if we have become partners in union with Christ, we are sure that we will remain in union with him until the end.
lunyoro: baitu obututerana omu Kristo tutekerize ngu ntuikaraho okuhikya ha mpero:

english: They went back to the mountains, where the birds came up and did not come up or go in, to take anything out of their houses.
lunyoro: Baitu obubahinguire ha nsozi, nambere enyonyi ezahagati zarugire, tizirugiremu, nobukwakuba okutahamu, okuihamu ekintu omu nju yabu.

english: So then, he makes it clear to you that you are going to be sorry, and he makes it clear to you who are going to be sorry.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo aganyira ati owayenda okuganyira, kandi agumanganiza owagumanganiza.

english: When we see that no one is judged by the deeds of the Law, but by the faith of Christ Jesus, we are put right with God by faith in Christ Jesus, and we are made by the deeds of the Law. For no one is condemned by the deeds of the Law.
lunyoro: baitu obutuboine ngu omuntu taihibwaho omusango obwemirimo yebiragiro, bitu obwokuikiriza Kristo Yesu, tuihibweho omusango obwokuiriza Kristo, kunu tubuli obwengeso zebiragiro: baitu omuntu wean atalihibwaaho omusango obwebiragiro.

english: The king will reply, ‘I tell you, just as you did among my younger brothers, so you have done to me.’
lunyoro: Omukama aligarukamu alibagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambiranti nkoku mwakolire omu hali abo bagenzi bange abarukukira obuto, buli mukakikoora nyowe.

english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and by these means the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
lunyoro: Baitu nikirema omuntu okufera nowokuhiki'ra: baitu obwebi byona buhwerekera busa.

english: Let us, then, be on our guard against being deceived by the outward appearance of this world.
lunyoro: Kandi twekambege tutahe omu kuhumura oku, omuntu wena atagwa omu kutahu'ra okwomulingo ogu.

english: Why should you buy these oil for three hundred silver coins to be sold to the poor?
lunyoro: Kiki ekihinzire okugura amagita ganu okugaihamu edinali bikumu bisatu, okugabira abamasege?

english: Moses was faithful in all his house, as he was willing to speak, and he was faithful in all his house.
lunyoro: Kandi Musa akabali owokwesiga mali omu njuye yona nkomukozi owakaba ali owokusobo'ra ebikaba nibigenda okugambwa.

english: He poured out his bowl into the cup, mixed the wine with oil, and gave thanks to God, broke it, and gave him to God, and took him into his house. He healed him.
lunyoro: kandi yasemba emputaze nasesemu amagita nomubazi; yamutembya ensoroye wenka, yamuleta omu nju yabagonyi, yamurwaza.

english: Jesus said, “The Jews joined him in requesting that Paul be brought before the Council the next day, just as he wanted to ask him to speak on his behalf again.
lunyoro: Yagamba at Abayudaya bateraine hamu okukwesengereza okusirimura Pauro nyenkya hali orukurato, nosisana noyenda okugaruka okumukaguza amananu agebigambobye.

english: But many of the crowd believed in him, saying, “When the Messiah comes, he will perform more miracles than this man has done!”
lunyoro: Baitu baingi abomukitebe bakamuikiriza; nibagamba ngu Kristo obwaliija alikora ebyamahano bingi okukira ogu ebyakozire?

english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave them to the people, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set them before the people.
lunyoro: Yakwata emigati etano nencu ibiri, yarora haiguru omu iguru, yabisimira; yabicwamu, yaha abegeswa okubita omu maiso gekitebe.

english: He who has seen it has seen it, and he also has seen it with his own eyes. He knows that he speaks with his mind, and you believe.
lunyoro: kandi ogu ayaboine akakora, nainywe mukwateho:kandi amanyire agamba amananu, nainyowe muikirize.

english: They begged him to do the same to him, because they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: kandi bamwesengereza rundi bakoleho kwonka ha mukugiro ogwenkasenzuye:

english: Again Jesus went away and prayed, “My Father, if this little while you can't take away from me, what you want will happen to me.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okurugayo, yasaba, nagamba ati Ai bambi Isenyowe, kinu kiraba kitarukusobora kundugaho rundi, nyowe nkinywe, ekyorukugonza nikyo kikorwe.

english: Suddenly the spirit seized him, and he began to speak with a loud voice. He cried with a loud cry, but he did not hear.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, omuzimu gumukwata, ahonaho ayamuza, nakunga muno, kandi atarukuhu'ra.

english: For by means of the great and glorious blood of Christ, you have been redeemed, as though you were a lamb without a shepherd.
lunyoro: baitu mukacungurwa nesagama eyomuhendo mwingi nkeyomwana gwentama ogutaroho bulema nobukakuba akamogo, niyo ya Kristo:

english: But whoever has the world's means for peace and sexual immorality and has kept himself safe from God's wrath.
lunyoro: Baitu wena nyakwenyumirizamu owomunsi, kandi nabomuzigobyawe, kandi nobwokuro'raho bwanyu kuraba kuli, ayesigire wenka ekiniga kingi,

english: Jesus said to them, “I have seen many good things that have happened to you from my Father. What work do you do to stone me?”
lunyoro: Yesu yabarugakamu ati Emirimo mingi esemire eyarugire hali Isenyowe nkagiboleka inywe; mulimo ki hali egi ogurukubanteza amabale?

english: Let us consider first the love that God has for one another and the love that is good for one another.
lunyoro: kandi tutekerezege okwakambi okwehambisangana okugonzangana, nokukora engeso ezisemire:

english: Look at my hands and my feet, and I am the only one. Keep watch and see! The spirit doesn't have flesh and bones, as you see I have.
lunyoro: Murole engaro zange nebigere byange, ninyowomu nyenka: mukwateho, murole; baitu omuzimu tiguyina nyama namagufa nkokumuboine nyowe okunyina.

english: You said to the servant whom my Father has chosen to send into the world, ‘You have chosen, but I have said that I am the Son of God.’
lunyoro: mubagambire muta ogu Isenyowe ouyayereze namutuma omu nsi ngu Ojumire; baitu ngambire nti Ninyowe Mwana wa Ruhanga?

english: I have gone through the religion of the Jews more than many of my own people, and I have a greater share in the deeds that my ancestors performed.
lunyoro: kandi nkahingurana omu dini Yabayudaya okukira baingi abomu ihanga ryange abanakuzire nabo, nyina ihali erirukukira obwingi habwengeso ezinahairwe baisenkuru nyowe.

english: When they left, they asked for these things on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaturukire, bayesengereza ebigambo binu bibagambirwe ha Sabiti eyakabiri.

english: If David were to call him Lord, how could he not be called your son?
lunyoro: Nukwo Daudi obwaraba na mweta Mukamawe aba ata mwanawe?

english: The next day Jesus went back to them and walked on the beach.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro, omu kisissimuka ekyakana, akaija namberebali, nagendera ha nyanja.

english: Even though I wrote this, I did not write it for the sake of the one who sinned or for the one who was made weak, but for the one who was made perfect in God's sight.
lunyoro: Nobahandikire nobwakubaire nsisire, kunu tali habwogu ayasisire, nobukyakuba obwomuntu ayasisirwe, baitu okwekamba kwanyu habwaitu kwolekwe omulinywe omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: So the spirit came down from many people and said to him, “You are the Son of God,” and he did not believe, because he knew that he was the Messiah.
lunyoro: Emizimu nayo ekaruga omu baingi, neyamuza negamba ngu Baitu niwe Mwana wa Ruhanga. Yagitanga atarukugiikiriza okugamba, baitu ekamumanya nuwe Kristo.

english: Jesus heard that they had put him out of the way, and he found him and asked, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
lunyoro: Yesu yahu'ra bamubingire aheru; yamuzora nagamba ati Iwe noikiriza Omwana wa ruhanga?

english: All our righteousness is sin, and there is a sin that does not lead to death.
lunyoro: Obutuhiki'ra byona kiba kibi; kandi haroho ekibi ekitali ekyokufa.

english: For it is God who makes us, together with you, by means of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nuwe agumya itwe hamu nainywe omu Kristo,

english: The crowds said, “This is the prophet Jesus, who came from Nazareth in Galilee.”
lunyoro: Ebitebe byagamba ngu Ogu nuwe nabi, Yesu ayarugire omu Nazaresi eya Galiraya.

english: No one puts on a new coat of clothing, but what is put on it is covered with a new coat, and the ear can be healed.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu abazira ekiremu ekikyaka oku kyokujwara ekikkuzire, baitu eki ekibazirwemu kitemura ekyokubazirwemu, nekihuru kiukanya okugaliha.

english: But if I make you sad, who will make you glad, or who will make you sad?
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nimbatuntuza, noha arukunsemeza, rundi ogu arukufuntizibwa nyowe?

english: They came to him and woke him up and said, “Save us, Lord!”
lunyoro: Baija namberali nibamusisimura, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu, juna, twafa.

english: Now I beg you, woman, not to write a new commandment, but to love one another.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu nkwesengerize mukazi, tikuli okukuhandikira ekiragiro ekihyaka, baitu rundi eki ekitwahairwe ngu Tugonzanganege.

english: Then you will sit down at the right side of the tree, where its branches will be broken and its branches will be broken to pieces, and you will know that the summer is near.
lunyoro: Kandi mwegere hali omutini orufumo rwagwo; itagi ryagwo obulinyeta, amababi nigarokera, buli mumanyire omwaka guli haihi;

english: So then, go on walking in a good way toward the outside, so that you will not be discouraged at all.
lunyoro: mugendege omu ngeso enungi hali abaheru, nukwo mutabuzirweho na kake.

english: How terrible for the world to see you because of what you do not know! It will not let you go, but it will see the man who brings you into the world and does not forgive you!
lunyoro: Ziribabona ensi obwebigambo ebyokutabaijura, baitu tibirireka okuija; baitu zirimubona ogu arukuleta ekitabaijuru.

english: Why, then, did you at that time look down on the things that will make you ashamed of your words today? For the end of sin is death.
lunyoro: Kandi byana ki ebimukaba muyinabyo omu biro ebi ebyebigambo ebirukubabakwasa ensoni hati bunu? Baitu emperor yebi kufa.

english: Jesus looked around and saw a great crowd coming to him. “Where do you want us to buy some bread, and these will eat?” he asked Philip.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yaimukya amaiso, yarora ekitebe kingi nikiija namberali, yagambira Firipo ati Turagura nkaha emigati, banu egibararya?

english: Jesus answered, “If you had been a sinner, you would not have known that I am the one who will betray me.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu ati Okwarabali musis timanyire ekigambo kimu eki manyire ngu Nkabandi omufu wa mahano.

english: The king of the north will come on the next day, but he will not wait on it.
lunyoro: Omukama womwiru ogu rubale alija hakiro ekya tategerezamu, nakasumi

english: But marry the Lord Jesus Christ, so that you do not think that you will do the things that are of the flesh by his will.
lunyoro: Baitu, mujwale Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, kunu mutatekereza okukora ebyomubiri omu kwegomba kwagwo.

english: So the crowds went out to meet him, but they heard that he had done this miracle.
lunyoro: Nikyo abekitebe bagendire okumutangi'ra, baitu bakahu'ra ngu akakora akokuro'raho kanu.

english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people have been led astray from the faith and have stabbed themselves all over with many pains.
lunyoro: Baitu okwegomba erupiya nikyo kikoro ekyobubi bwona: haroho abantu abakunukirire ebi, kandi bahabisibwa okuruga omu kuikiriza, kandi nibecumita bonka nobujune bwingi.

english: But his disciples went on to the other side of the lake, where the boat had come down from Tiberias and sat down to eat the Lord's Passover meal.
lunyoro: baitu abegeswabe bagenzire bonka ( baitu obwato bwaijaga nuburuga Tiberiya haihi nikiikaro nambere balire emigati, Mukama waitu obuyamazire kurya):

english: You blind fools! Which is the greatest, the most holy, the most holy, the gift?
lunyoro: Inywe abafu bamaiso; baitu ekirukukira obukuru kiraha? Ekisembo, rundi ekisembo?

english: The Master of the harvest must not fight, but be gentle toward all, a teacher and a patient one.
lunyoro: Kandi mukama womuntu tikimuhikirire okurwana, baitu okuba omuculezi hali bona, omwegesa, omugumisiriza,

english: But Jesus kept quiet and did not say a word. Again the High Priest questioned him, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed?”
lunyoro: baitu yaculera kwonka okutagarukamu kigambo. Nyakatagara omukuru wabu nyagaruka okumukaguza, namugambira ati Niwe kristo, Omwana wogu Ahairwe omugisa?

english: They are God's servants, the rich, the poor, and the humble; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they are God's servants; they do not listen to their parents.
lunyoro: abarukunoba Ruhanga, aba'ruma, abemyehembo, abanyakwekunika, abahyangya ebigambo ebibi, abatarukuhu'ra ababazaire,
