lunyoro: Baitu omwogo obwokutaseme'ra okuikaramu okwomuziro, abandi baingi bakagamba ngu Oturugeho, orugeho okuhika Foiniki, okuikarayo omu musiiri ogwokerererwa, oguli hagati ya Kerete, nambere hasobora okuikara nobusinge.

english: Afterward Jesus said to his disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
lunyoro: Kandi hanyuma yambagambira abegeswabe ati Tugaruke okugenda omu Buyudaya.

english: But now they are going to Jerusalem and serve the holy ones.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu nibagenda Yerusalemu nimpereza abarukwera.

english: Do not drink only water, but also a little wine because of your lack of water and your sickness.
lunyoro: Leka okunywa amazi gonka, baitu onywege amarwa make obwenda yawe, kandi obwokurwararwara

english: There was a man named Barabbas, who was bound with those who had been killed by the power of that cross.
lunyoro: kandi hakaba baroho omu ayetwa Baraba, aboherwe ahamu nabo abaimukirire, abakaba baisire abantu omu kuimuki'ra oku.

english: But when they recognized that he was a Jew, they shouted at him for two hours: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
lunyoro: Baitu obubamumanyirire ali Muyudaya, bo na batokera haiguru niraka limu nkesaha ibiri ngu Atemi Wabafeso mukuru.

english: “Do these things in your hearts,” he said, “but the Son of Man will be handed over to the power of human beings.”
lunyoro: ebigambo binu mubite omu matu ganyu: baitu Omwana womuntu alihebwayo omumikono yabantu.

english: With all our heart we judge, because God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
lunyoro: baitu omu byona omutima gwaitu ebigurutucweramu omusango: baitu Ruhanga nakira obukuru emitima yaitu, kandi amanyire byona.

english: In the same way, wives should be in subjection to their husbands, who are faithful in all things.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo nabakazi kibahikirire okuba tatamira, abokwesiga omu bigambo byona.

english: Jesus called them to him and said to them in parables, “How can Satan not deceive you?”
lunyoro: Yabeta namberali, nabagambira omu nfumo ati Setani nasobora ata okubinga Setani?

english: But the travelers who had come did not find him in the villages.
lunyoro: Kandi abagenyi abagenzire batasange omu nju yenkomo:

english: The last enemy to be destroyed will be death.
lunyoro: Omunyanzigwa owa ha mpero aliihibwaho nukwo kufa.

english: Watch, then, and keep watch, then, because the light that is in you is not darkness.
lunyoro: Nukwo oyerinde, omusana ogunyakuli omulinywe gutaba muirima.

english: Everyone who fears the Son as the Father does. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him.
lunyoro: Omwana wena amutinege, nkokkuyatinire Isenyowe. Aturukutina Mwana tarukutina Isitwe ayamutumire.

english: It is much better for the angels to be chosen than for them.
lunyoro: kandi nakira ati oburungu bamaraika obwekugwetwa okukira bo.

english: I have something to say to you, but you have shown your love for me first.
lunyoro: kandi nyina ekigambo haliwe, baitu okaleka okugonza kwawe okwokubanza.

english: Onesimus was not a slave to me, but now I am a slave to you and to me.
lunyoro: Onesimo, akaba atarukukugasira ira, baitu hati bunu nakugasira iwe nanyowe:

english: When evening came, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is desert, and the time is already over.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba bwa'sa kuira, abegeswabe baija namberali, nibagamba ngu Hanu irungu, kandi obuire bwa'se kuira:

english: You are witnesses, then, and believe in the deeds of your ancestors. They are the ones who died, and you build their tombs.
lunyoro: Nukwo muli bakaiso, numuikiriza engeso zabasenkuru inywe: baitu nibo babaisire, nainywe mwombeka ebituro byabu.

english: But if he does not know it, he will be destroyed by a second, and he will be given to his husband and to the other servants, and there will be weeping and gnashing.
lunyoro: kandi obwatalimanya alimucwamu habiri, alimuha omugabogwe hamu nabagobya; nuho haliba oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: And here is your brother Elizabeth, who is the father of a son in law among his ancestors. And so his sixth son was called the firstborn.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, Erisabesi mwene wanyu, nauwe ali nenda yomwana omwojo omu bakaikurubwe: kandi kunu nukwo kwezikwe okwomukaga ayayetwaga engumba.

english: But Jesus said, “What sin she has committed?” But they kept shouting, “Crucify her!”
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ati Mara kibi ki ekiyakozire? Baitu bayeyongera muno okutoka nibagamba ngu Abambwe.

english: For the one whom God sent speaks the words of God, because the Holy Spirit is God's gift.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu Ruhanga ouyatimire agamba ebigambo bya Ruhanga: baitu tagabira Mwoyo omu ndengo.

english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the Kingdom of God!
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yabungyamu amaiso, yagambira abegeswabe ati Nikiremera abanyakuina itungo okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: and he will answer you, the one who was invited to be with us, when the Lord and his mighty angels will be revealed from heaven.
lunyoro: kandi nokugaru'ra inywe abatubtuzibwa hamu naitwe, Mukama waitu obwalimanyisibwa okuruga omu iguru hamu nabamaraika abamanige,

english: I tell you, then, that he will set you free from everything you have.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukubagambi'ra nti alimwahuza byona ebyayinabyo.

english: Some Pharisees in the crowd said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo abamu hali ekitebe bamugambira ngu Omwegesa, tanga abegeswa bawe.

english: A brother will give up his brother to death, and the father will give him the child. Children will be the children of their parents, and they will be the children of their mother.
lunyoro: Mwene wabu alihayo omugenziwe okuitwa, na ise alihayo omwana;abana baryemera babazaire, balibaisa.

english: He left Nazareth and went to live in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Galilee.
lunyoro: yaruga Nazalesi, yaija yaikara Kaperenaumu, enyakuli ha nyanja, omu mutano eya

english: They left the house and went to him.
lunyoro: Baruga omu kika nibaija namberali.

english: He saw two angels who had received the Holy Spirit and were sitting at the right side of the throne and at the left.
lunyoro: yarora bamaraika babiri bajwaire ebyokurya bingi, baikalire, omu ha musago, ondi ha mirambi, omu kiikaro kyobukama:

english: For the law of the Spirit of life in union with Christ Jesus has set me free from the law of sin and of death.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiragiro Ebyomwoyo ogwobwomezi omu Kristo Yesu bikandekera omu biragiro ebyekibinebyokufa.

english: For God has prepared a sun, where the sun is, and the moon is, and the stars are waiting for it. How little faith you have!
lunyoro: Kandi mazimakwo Ruhanga akabataho ekiro, nokwezi, nenyunyuzi okuzirora enyunyuzi. Inywe abokuikiriza okuke muno!

english: They took Jesus to the High Priest, where all the chief priests, the elders, and the teachers of the Law met.
lunyoro: Kandi batwara Yesu hali nyakatagara omukuru wabu: hamuso'rokaniraho banyakatagara abakuru bona, nabakuru, nabahandiki.

english: And by your endurance and by your faith you have obeyed God's mercy and have been revealed to everyone by the power of his own will.
lunyoro: kandi obwokugumangana nomutima gwawe ogutarurwegarukamu oyeyahulire wenka ekiniga hali ekitebe ekyembabazi, nikimanyisibwa abantu bona okuruga omu mani agokwekamba:

english: love one another, and so you have done to all your friends in all Macedonia. We beg you, my friends, to increase and increase.
lunyoro: mugonzangane; kandi nukwo mukozire mali halibene banyu bona abomu Makedoni yona. Baitu tubesengerize bene baitu okweyongera nokusaga;

english: But when the man had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, he sat down at the right side of God.
lunyoro: baitu ogu obuyamazire okuhonga ebyonzira kimu obwebibi okumara ebiro byona, yaika'ra ha mukono gwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga:

english: I tell you, I will never again drink any wine until the day I drink a new wine in the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: mazire okugamba nti Tindinywa kandi ha byana byomuzabibu, okuhukya ekiro eki obundigunywa omuhyaka omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: He went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was looking for them, and his mother kept all these things in her heart.
lunyoro: Kandi akasirimuka hamu nabo, yaija Nazalesi; yabacule'ra: nyina yayerinda ebigambo ebi byona omu mutimagwe.

english: Pilate went back into the village and called Jesus and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato yagaruka okutaha omu kibira, yayeta Yesu yamugambira ati Niwe omukama Wabayudaya?

english: “We don't have five loaves and two fish,” they answered. “We will go and buy food for all these people.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Titunyinabyo, rundi emigati etano nencu ibiri; rundi turagenda tugu'le ebyokurya abantu banu bona.

english: “Son,” he said, “go and work in the vineyard today.”
lunyoro: kandi akagamba ati Mwana wange, genda okole emirimo hati omu rugonjo orwemizabibu.

english: When he saw Peter and John going into the Temple, he prayed that God would forgive them.
lunyoro: Ogu obuyaboine Petero na Yohana nibagenda okutaha omu yekaru, yasaba okuganyirwa.

english: But Jesus himself got up and went into the desert and prayed.
lunyoro: Baitu uwe yayesororamu wenka, yagenda omu irungu, yasaba.

english: They had already purified themselves by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of his message. They did not want to die for them.
lunyoro: Kandi bamweza esagama Yomwana Gwentama, nekigambo kyokugamba kwabu; kunu batagonze obwomezi bwabu okuhikya okufa.

english: offer your gift in front of the altar, and go back and offer your gift to God.
lunyoro: oti, osigeyo ekihongwa kyawe omu maiso gekyoto, ogarukeyo, obanze omale okuteraana na mwene wanyu, ogende ohonge ekisembo kyawe.

english: The very dust of your city, which holds you in our feet, will be forgiven you too. You know that the Kingdom of God is near.
lunyoro: Necucu eyomu rubuga rwa nyu, erukukwatira omu bigere byaitu, nayo tugibaragalize inywe: baitu mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga buirire haihi.

english: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
lunyoro: Maliza yagambira Yesu ati Mukama wange, kakuba okaboli hanu, munyanya nyowe tiyakufire.

english: When they heard these things, they were filled with wonder and praised God, saying, “God has given the Gentiles to repent of their sins.”
lunyoro: Kandi obubahulire ebi, baculera nibakugiza Ruhanga, nibagamba ngu Nukwo Ruhanga ahaire Nabamahanga okwegarukamu okutaha omu bwomezi.

english: Again he went away, wept, and said a little, and then spoke again,
lunyoro: Yagaruka okurugayo, yaaba, nagamba ebigambo bimu na biri, Kandi yagaruka,

english: increase your knowledge, and increase your self-control; increase your self-control; and increase your reverence for God;
lunyoro: kukira muno okumanya; kandi hali okumanya mwongereho okwerinda; kandi halinywe haroho okumangana kwingi: kandi hali okugumangana muryongereho okutina Ruhanga;

english: But they began to proclaim to the people in Damascus and to the people in Jerusalem, and to the whole province of Judea and Gentiles and to turn to God and do what is right in order to repent.
lunyoro: babandize okugambira abomu Damasiko, kandi nabomu Yerusalemu, nokuhikya ensi yona eya Buyudaya, Nabamahanga, nabo begarukemu, bahindukire Ruhanga, nibakora engeso ezisemerire okwegarukamu.

english: If any woman has children or grandchildren, then she must learn to be self-controlled in her home and to be a good example for those who have taken care of her. This is acceptable in the sight of God.
lunyoro: Kandi omufakati wena obwaba nabana rundi abaijukuru, babanze okwega okwerinda hali abo abali omunju yabu, nokuma'ra kurungi ababazaire: baitu kinu kisemire omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: So then, whoever speaks in strange tongues asks for help.
lunyoro: Nukwo anyakugamba orulimi asabege okuduma.

english: Jesus cried out with a loud cry, and gave him life.
lunyoro: Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto, yahayo obwomezi.

english: All who were in the Council saw him face to face, as an angel does.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abakaba baikalire omu rukurato bamugumyaho amaiso nibamurora amaisoge nigasisana nkagamaraika.

english: When they arrived at the place where Jesus was going, they did not recognize him.
lunyoro: kandi obubahikire ha musa nambere yagendaga, batamumanyire,

english: You who have been saved by the power of God through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last days.
lunyoro: inywe abalinzirwe amani ga Ruhanga obwokuikiriza, hali okujunwa okurukusisana okusuku'rwa omu biro bya hampero.

english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You have lost much.
lunyoro: Tali Ruhanga wabafu, baitu wabomezi: muhabire muno.

english: Every tree that grows in me will bear fruit, and every tree that bears figs will bring forth its fruit. It will bring forth its fruit and bear it.
lunyoro: Itini ryona eriri omuli nyowe eritana byana aliriihaho: na itagi ryona erinyakwana ebyana, alisemeza, likanye okwana.

english: As they were going out, they brought to Jesus a demon-born boy.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibarugayo, dora, bamuletera ekifa munwa akwasirwe omuzimu.

english: He wore a white robe, and they ate and drank the word of God.
lunyoro: kandi ajwaire ekyokujwara ekimisirwe esagama: kandi baika'ra ha byokurya, nibaramukya ekigambo kya Ruhanga.

english: I have not been afraid to tell you anything that is good, and to teach you publicly and from house to house.
lunyoro: kokubatanga okubatebeza ekigambo kyona ekisemre nokubegesa bwerebwere, nomu nju emuemu,

english: My persecutions and the persecutions which I endured in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. My persecutions have been brought about by the Lord in all things.
lunyoro: nokuhiganizibwa kwange, nokusalirwa kwange: ebyambaireho amo Antyokiya, nomu Ikonio, nomu Rusitira, okuhiganizi okwabaire nanyowe: kandi Mukama waitu akanjuna omu byona.

english: Jesus looked around at them all, and said to him, “Stretch out your hand.” He said, “Your power is being healed.”
lunyoro: Kandi yababungyamu bona amaiso, yamugambira ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagira ati: omukonogwe gwakira.

english: You yourselves know that our brother Timothy was circumcised, but when he comes in the morning, I will see him with him.
lunyoro: Mumanye nga mugenzi waitu Timiseo akalekerwa: rundi obwaliija mpora, nanyowe ndi borora hamu nauwe.

english: So then, then, let each one of you please his neighbor in what he does.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wena aleke okwenyumiriza omu bagenzibe.

english: The word that Isaiah the prophet said was true: “He himself took away our sickness and healed us of our diseases.
lunyoro: ekigambo kihiki'le ekyagambirwe nabi Isaya ati Uwe wenka akatwara obugara bwaitu, nayetweka endwara zaitu.

english: So then, if you are happy and have been sad for a little while for a long time now, then you will have to be tempted in many ways,
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo musemererirwe muno, nobumuraba numubihirwa hati bunu akacu kake omu bwohebwa okwemiringo nyingi, kiruni kiti

english: May peace be upon all who follow this way of life, and peace be upon them, and mercy, and toward the people of God.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abalikurutira omulingo gunu, obusinge bube halibo, nokuganyirwa, na hali Isaleri owa Ruhanga.

english: But when the righteous man stayed among them, he saw and heard them and saw that they had seen and heard in his heart what they were doing.
lunyoro: baitu omusaija ogu ahikirire obuyaikaraga omulibo narora nahu'ra yabonabonaga engeso zabu ezokwema.

english: In the past, however, it can be dangerous to do what the Gentiles want, to walk in the ways of immorality, desires, and passions, pleasures, sexual immorality, and the worship of idols.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebyahinguitrho nibisobora okutumara okukora Abamahanga ebibagonza, nokugendera omu busihani, nokwegomba, nokusomasoma, nebyokubandwa, nobutamizi, nokuramya ebisisani okurukunugwa:

english: For if we have been joined to God by the death of his Son, we are still his enemies, even more so, and his fellowship with us is saved by his life.
lunyoro: Baitu obuturaba twateranizibwe na Ruhanga obwokufa Kwomwanawe tukyali banyanzigwabe, okukira muno, obututeranizibwe tulijunwa obwobwomezibwe:

english: Which one of you, then, will give him the stone if he asks for bread?
lunyoro: Rundi muntu ki omulinywe, omwanawe obwalimusaba omugati alimuha ibale?

english: His disciples asked him, “Teacher, whose sin did you commit against him or against his parents?”
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamukaguza nibagamba ngu, Rabi noha yasisire, onu rundi abamuzaire, nikyo kyamuzalize, omufuwamaiso?

english: But when the dragon tried to kill him, did he ever try to kill him?
lunyoro: Baitu nengwaea obwereta iraka eritegeka okurwana?

english: But you must obey my teaching, my conduct, my teaching, my faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.
lunyoro: baitu iwe okukuratira okwegesa kwange, nengeso zange, nokuhanura kwange nokuikiriza kwange nokugumisiriza kwange namani gange nokugonza kwange

english: But Elymas the father of the covenant, who is the one whom God has chosen to be his witnesses, is eager to deceive the older men by their faith.
lunyoro: Baitu Erima omurogo, ayetwa okugumibwa, yayesereke'ra okuhabisa owisaza omu kuikiriza.

english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
lunyoro: Baitu mukafa, kandi obwomezi bwanyu buserekerwe hamu na Kristo omu Ruhanga.

english: Jesus said to him, “Get out of the way, and come out of the way.”
lunyoro: Yesu yanugambira ati Huna, murugeho.

english: It would have been better for him to have a millstone tied around his neck and be thrown into the sea, than for him to have one of these little ones thrown into the sea.
lunyoro: hakire ogu okubohwa orubengo ha bikya nokunagwa omu nyanja, okukira okutabaijura omu omuli abo abato.

english: Jesus said, “Do you not understand? Even now you yourselves do not understand.
lunyoro: Nauwe yagamba ati Randi nainywe na hati hona timuyina magezi?

english: I was dead, but now I am alive forever. I have the keys of death and of the Spirit.
lunyoro: kandi Omwomezi; kandi nkaba nfire, baitu dora, nyomire okuhikya ebiro nebiro, kandi nyina ebisumuruzo ebyokufa nokuzimu.

english: Jesus answered, “The time has not come for you to remember the light of this world, but for the light of this world.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Esaha eza nyamusana tatabaijuka, baitu arora omusana ogwensi enu.

english: It was the day of the Passover, the Sabbath, and the sun.
lunyoro: Kandi kikaba kiri kiro Kyokutekaniza, Sabiti ne'sana okukya.

english: who gave himself for our sins, so that we might be saved through the present evil age, just as our Father is with us.
lunyoro: yayehaireyo wenka habwebibi byaitu, atujune omu businge obubi obwebiro binu, nka Isitwe

english: His heart is very large for you, just as he remembers all of you, just as he has promised you.
lunyoro: Kandi nomutimagwe guli halinywe muno muno muno, obuyaijukire okuhu'ra kwanyu inywena, nkokumwamuirize wenka.

english: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You make the Kingdom of heaven appear to people, but you do not go in, and those who do not obey you will go in.
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abahandiki Nabafalisayo abagobya! Baitu mukinga obukama obwomuiguru omu maiso ga Bantu; baitu inywe timubutahamu, nabo abanyakutahahamu.

english: The other disciple, who was going to the tomb, went in and saw and believed.
lunyoro: Kandi nomwegeswa ogu ondi ayabandize okuija ha kituro, yatahamu, yarora, yaikiriza.

english: The same thing happened to our ancestors and to their descendants, who lived in the land that God had promised to them by the time of David.
lunyoro: ndi baisenkuru itwe eyibalesere hamu nabaijukuru baitu, omu biikaro ebyabahulirwe ira, Ruhanga ebiyabaraganize okuhikya ebiro bya Daudi;

english: For he who did the same thing in Peter's case among the people of the circumcision, the one who did the same thing with me, the one who did the same, the one who did not.
lunyoro: baitu ogu ayakolire omu Petero obukwenda hali abokkusarwa, nuwe yakolire omuli nyowe obukwenda halli abokutasarwa.

english: You see that being put right with God is not the result of faith alone.
lunyoro: Mubone ngu obwokukora omuntu aihibwaho omusango, kunu tibuli obwokuikiriza kwonka.

english: When they had finished speaking, James answered,
lunyoro: Kandi obubaculire, Yakobo yagarukamu nagamba ati

english: But I tell you, do not be afraid of the Evil One, but of the One who calls you by the right side and by the left.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti Mutalitanga omubi, baitu wena anyakukutera orusaya orwoburyo omuhimdu'le norwemoso.

english: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? All seven of them had married her.”
lunyoro: Nukwo, omu kuhumbuka, alika muka oha hali abo? Baitu bona omusanju bakamuswera.

english: For if after they have escaped from the corrupting forces of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again guilty of sexual immorality and loose conduct, then their future is worse than the beginning.
lunyoro: Baitu rundi obubamara okuiruka obugwagwa obwensi obwokumanya kwa Mukama kandi Omujuni waitu Yesu Kristo, obubagaruka okwetaba omwebi nokusingurwa, ebyahanyuma byabu nibikira obubi ebyokubanza.

english: With all humility, kindness, and patience, in order to help one another in love.
lunyoro: hamu nobuculezi bwona, nembabazi, nokkugumisiriza, numucule'rangana omu kugonzangana,

english: He will reward those who are seeking glory and honor for their lack of faith in a good deed, and he will reward them with eternal life.
lunyoro: abo abase'ra okusimwa nekitinisa nobutajunda obwokwekamba omu mulimo omurungi, aliga'ra obwomezi obwebiro nebiro:

english: When they heard this, they got up and went out of the city and took him to the hill country where they had built their city and lowered him to the ground.
lunyoro: obubahulire ebi; baimuka, bamunaga heru yorubuga, bamutwara hakihanga kyorusozi orubayombekereho orubuga rwabu, bamunage hansi.

english: For what will it profit a man if he loses his whole world but loses his own faith?
lunyoro: Baitu kirimugasira ki omuntu obwalitunga ensi yona, nauwe abuzire, rundi ahwerekerire wenka.

english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, your faith has made you well. Have faith in me, just as you love me.” She has been happier since that very day.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Iwe mukazi, okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize; nkokworukugonza nukwo kikorwe. Omuisikiwe akakira okuruga ha kasumi ako.

english: These words were performed by John in Bethany on the other side of the Jordan River.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi bikakorwa Besaniya nseri ya Yorudani, Yohana nambere akaba nabatiza.

english: You were slaves of Christ in the past, but you were slaves of the tribe of Israel and of the Gentiles to the covenant that God made with you. You did not have to wait, and you did not have to wait, and you did not have God in the world.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe omu biro ebi ebyaira mukaba muli hara na Kristo, muli basuhuki hali oruganda rwa Isaleri, kandi na banyaihanga hali ekiragano ekyomurago, kandi mutanyina okunihira, kandi mutatungaga Ruhanga omu nsi.

english: Then he sent other servants ahead of him and said, “Tell the servants that I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my oxen are killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding feast.”
lunyoro: Yatuma abairu rubale abandi, nagamba ati Mubagambire abeserww ngu Dora, ncumbire obugenyi bwange: ente zange nezebisajwa zisirwe, na byona bitekanize; muije ha bugenyi obwobugole.

english: I tell you that the Good News about Jesus has been preached everywhere in the world, and what she has done will be told to remind her of it.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Enjuli nambere erakagambwaga hona oomu nsi zona, nakyo omukazi onu ekyakozire kiragambwahoga okumuijukyaga.

english: He did not do much because of their lack of faith.
lunyoro: kandi atakoleyo ebyamani bingi, obwokutairiza kwabu.

english: They are trying to convince me that Christ is the one who loves me, not the truth, but the one who wants to set me free from sin.
lunyoro: baitu bakaba nibatebeza Kristo obwokukungana, hatali omu mazima, nibatekereza okunyimukiza omuhito omu nsengo zange.

english: And now I do this, not as though I were doing it, but because of the sin that is in me.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu tali nyowe ndukukora eki, baitu ekibi ekirukuikara omuli nyowe.

english: They came to Jesus, and saw that he had a spirit with a demon in him, and he was healed by the power of the Spirit. He was afraid.
lunyoro: Kandi bahika Yesu namberali, bamurora akabaroho emizimu aikalire, anyina amagezige, ogu akaba roho legioni: batina.

english: Then he took me up to a holy mountain by the power of the Spirit, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
lunyoro: Yantwara omu Mwoyo hali orusozi orukoto oruraihire, yanyoleka orubuga orurukwera Yerusalemu, nurusirimuka okuruga omu iguru hali Ruhanga,

english: For the one who was made known to the other was not allowed to go into the field.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ayagambirweho ebigambo ebi woruganda orundi, nambere hatarugiremu omuntu okuhereza ha kyoto.

english: The Jews joined in trying to trap him, believing that this was true.
lunyoro: Nabayudaya bakaterana hamu okumulega, nibaikiriza ngu nukwo biri biti.

english: You tolerate anyone who looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you, looks down on you,
lunyoro: Baitu mugumisiriza omuntu obwabatunga nkabairu, obwabamira, obwahabamba, obwayena engeso ezisemire.

english: In this way love is not that we love God, but that he loves us and sent his Son as the means by which we are made.
lunyoro: Dobi nukwo kugonza, tikuli itwe okugonza Ruhanga, baitu uwe okugonzaga itwe, nokutuma omwanawe okuba ekicunguro obwebibi byaitu.

english: Then he will go out and deceive the nations that are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gather them together to battle. Their number is like the grains of sand on the seashore.
lunyoro: alirugayo nagenda okubihabiha amahanga agali omu mbaju ina ezensi, Gogi na Magogi, okubasoroza okurwana: omuhendo gwabu guli nkomusenyi ogwenyanja.

english: But the chief priests made fun of the crowd and said, “How right it is for the apostles to divorce one another!”
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru batere'ra ekitebe ngu hakire abaleke.

english: When Jesus saw the colt, he was moved with pity for him, as the scripture says,
lunyoro: Kandi yesu, obuyaboine omwana gwenkaina yagutemba; nkokukyahandikirwe ngu;

english: Again he said to the man, ‘Stretch out your hand.’ He stretched it out, looked straight, and looked at it, and looked at it a second time.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okugambira omuntu ogu ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagugo'ra, gwakira, nugusisana nkogwakabiri.

english: Stay in the world and be glad. On the Day of your death you will be filled with joy.
lunyoro: Mukarara omu nsi, mukesemeza; mukaiguta emitima yanyu omu kiro kyokuita.

english: But when they did not agree among themselves, Paul went on to say the same thing: "The Holy Spirit spoke boldly to your ancestors by means of the prophet
lunyoro: Kandi obubataraterine bonka bagenda, Pauro obuyamazire okugamba ekigambo kimu ati omwoyo Ogurukwera akagambira kurungi baisexnkuru inywe omu nabi

english: But if anyone thinks that he has not treated his wife properly, if he has already advanced in years, and if he has done so, he should do what he wants, and then he should not do it; they should marry.
lunyoro: baitu omuntu wena obwaraba natekereza tamukozire kurungi omuharawe, obwaba ahinguireho obukuru, kandi kiraba kisemire kiti, akole nkokwagonza, tasisa; baswerangabe.

english: You will be hated by all of you for my sake.
lunyoro: Nainywe muranobwaga abantu bona habwibara ryange.

english: Another one came and said, ‘Sir, here is your gold coin I have kept ready for the exchange.
lunyoro: Ndi akaija nagamba ati Mukama wange kanginu erateri yawe, eyinayahuire ekubirwe omu kikoba:

english: When the master of the house comes up, and knocks down, you will first stand up and knock at the door, saying, ‘The Master's house will be opened,’ and he will answer you, ‘I don't know where you come from.’
lunyoro: Obuyalikamara okuimuka, nokingaho oruigi, nainywe numubanza okweme'ra aheru, nokweranga ha ruigi, numugamba ngu Mukama waitu otukingu'leho; nauwe aligarukamu nabagambira ati Timbamanyire, nambere murugire;

english: Festus wanted to gain favor with the Jews, so he said to Paul, “Do you want to bring this accusation against Jerusalem before four witnesses?”
lunyoro: Baitu Fesito obuyagondeze okusimwa Abayudaya, yagarukamu Pauro nagamba ati Noyenda okutemba Yerusalemu ocwerweyo omusango owebigambo binu omu maiso gane?

english: Simon Peter thanked him and said, “Tell us what you are talking about.”
lunyoro: Simon petero yamusima ogu namugambira ati Tugambire owagambireho okwali.

english: Can a fig tree, my friends, bear olive branches or a vine figs? Or can a spring produce figs?
lunyoro: Omutini nugusobora bene baitu okwana zeituni rundi omuzabibu okwana etini? nobugakuba amaizi agekisura, tigasobora okurugamu amarungi.

english: But Jesus rebuked them and commanded them not to tell anyone this.
lunyoro: baitu akabatere'ra naragira batagambiraho muntu eki;

english: I am the bread that came down from heaven. Everyone who eats this bread will live forever. Yes, the bread that I will give is my flesh, because the life of the world belongs to me.
lunyoro: Ninyowe byokurya ebyomire ebyarugire omu iguru: omuntu wena obwarya ha Byokurya ebi, aryomera ebiro nebiro: ego, nebyokurya ebindihayo nugwo mubiri gwange, obwobwomezi Bwensi.

english: It was Jesus of Nazareth, whom God had poured out on him by means of the Holy Spirit and power. He went on walking and doing good and healing all who had followed him, because God was with him.
lunyoro: ndi Yesu owa Nazalesi, Ruhanga okuyamusesereho Omwoyo Ogurukwera namani: ayagendagendaga, nakora okurungi, nakiza bona abamukuratiraga; baitu Ruhanga akaba ali nauwe.

english: Pilate was surprised when he died. So he called the Roman officer and asked him, “Do you want me to die before you die?”
lunyoro: Pirato yahuni'ra okwafire bwango: yayeta nambereri omunyakihanda, yamukaguza okwafirege kara.

english: The sick don't cry, but the sick do.
lunyoro: Abomire tibataga mufumu; baitu abarwaire.

english: Repent, then, for if you do not turn from your sins, I will come to you soon, and I will fight against them with the sword in my mouth.
lunyoro: Nukwo oyegarukemu: baitu obwotaryegarukamu ndiija namberoli bwango, kandi ndirwana nabo nempirima yomu kanwa kange.

english: After their resurrection, they arrived at the city of Gennesaret.
lunyoro: Obubamazire okwambuka, bahika ha mugongo ogwa Genezalesi.

english: But if Christ had been told that he had been raised from death, some of you would have said, “There is no one who can be raised from death.”
lunyoro: baitu Kristo obwaraba natebezebwa ngu Akahumburwa omu bafu, abamu omulinywe nibagamba bata ngu Busaho kuhumbuka omu bafu?

english: If we have been asked to do good to the weak and believe in him,
lunyoro: Kandi obuturaba tukasendekerezebwa okukora kurungi abanyakubugara, twaragamu tuti omu kuikiriza:

english: Mary said to the angel, “What is this, because I don't know the man?”
lunyoro: Maryamu yagambira maraika ati Eki kiriba kita, baitu nyowe timanyire musaija?

english: Let no one rob you of your prize by means of selfish ambition or pride of the angels, who live as a wicked person, who boasts of his own body.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena aleke okubanyanga empera yanyu omu kwebundaza okwayenzire wenka, nokuramya bamaraika, aikaire omwebi ebyaboine, nayenyumirirza busa omu magezi gomubirigwe:

english: For the tax collectors do the same.
lunyoro: Baitu nabasisi nukwo bakora bati.

english: The crowd was filled with pity, and Jesus said to them, “Get out of her, because the girl has not died, but has been raised from death.” They made fun of him.
lunyoro: ekitebe nibatera empamo, yabagambira ati Murugeho, baitu omuisiki tafire, agwijagire. Bamusekereza muno.

english: They sold the potter's field, and the Lord had given me what the Lord had promised.
lunyoro: ndigulire omusiri ogwomubumbi; Mukama nko kuyandagire.

english: And to the fear of God increase your love for your brothers, and to the love of your brothers increase.
lunyoro: Kandi hali okutina Ruhanga mwongereho okugonzaga bene banyu; kandi hali okugonza bene banyu mwongehemu okurukugonza.

english: Obed the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon,
lunyoro: Obeda, owa Boazi, owa Salimoni,

english: Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he left Barabbas for them and handed Jesus over to be crucified.
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato obwakaba nagonza okusemeza ekitebe, yabaleke'ra Baraba, yahayo Yesu, amalire okubambwa ha muti.

english: “I tell you, ” Jesus answered, “that some of these people here will not die until they see the Kingdom of God come with power.
lunyoro: baagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Hali banu abemerire hanu, haroho abandi abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhikya obubalirora obukama bwa Ruhanga nubuija namani.

english: No soldier has ever sat down to talk about this life, so happy is the one who has been sent as a soldier.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho murwani obwaramaga ayetaba nebigambo byobwomezi bunu; nukwo asimwe ogu anyamuhandikire okuba omurwani.

english: I should have the same concern for you all, because I am with you all in my darkness, and you are all with me in my trials and in order to make the Good News come to an end.
lunyoro: Kikaniki'ra nyowe okutekereza nti habwanyu inywena, baitu ndi nainywe inywena omu tima gwange, kandi nainywena numuterana nanyowe omu nsengo zange, nomu kutonganira njiri nokugigumya.

english: There was much doubt in the crowd about him, and some people said, “He is a good man,” and others said, “No, he is a good man.”
lunyoro: Hakabaho empaka nyingi omu bitebe haruwe: abandi nibagamba ngu Murungi; abandi nibagaya ngu Nangwa

english: If we say that we are with him, we are walking in the darkness, and we do not do the truth,
lunyoro: Obutugamba ngu ntuterana nauwe ntugendera omu muirima,tubiha ebisuba, kunu titurukukora mazima:

english: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibasibu'ra omwana gwenkaina, bakama bagwo babagambira ngu Nimuiburu'ra ki omwana gwendo?

english: There was so much confusion that Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus.
lunyoro: kandi hakabaho empaka nyingi, nikyo bayahukaniremu, Baranaba yatwara Maraka hamu nauwe, yahanika amaberu okugenda Kupuro,

english: If any woman who believes that she has a wife should marry, then she must not be a burden to the church. In this way she will be a source of encouragement to the widows.
lunyoro: Omukazi wena arukuikiriza obwaba anyina abakazi, ekanisa ereke okulemerwa; nukwo ekonyere abafakati mali mali.

english: Jesus came to them and touched them and said, “Get up, and do not be afraid.”
lunyoro: Yesu yaija yabakoraho, nagamba ati Muimuke, mutatina.

english: “What, then, will you do with your life? We will see that you believe!” they asked him.
lunyoro: Kandi bamugambira ngu Nukwo, kokkuro'raho ki iwe akokora, itwe turole tukkuikirize?

english: But they thought that he would die or that he would soon be destroyed. But when they stayed long waiting for him, they did not see what had happened to him, and they turned around and said, “He is a sinner!”
lunyoro: Baitu batekereza ngu arazimba, rundi aragwa bwango afire, baitu obubaikaireho muno okurole'ra, kandi tibabona kibi ekyamubaireho, bahinduka nibagamba ngu mucwezi.

english: They brought a paralyzed man to him, who was dumb and dumb. They begged him to put his hand on him.
lunyoro: Baleta namberali omufu wamatu, atarukugamba kurungi; bamwesengereza okumutaho omukonogwe.

english: But some people were so angry that they asked, “Why are the olive trees so late?”
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abamu abahihirwe bonka, bibagamba ngu Amagita gafire ki gati?

english: The world is passing away and so is its desire, but you will see me, because I am alive, and you will live also.
lunyoro: Hasigaire akacu akake, ensi okutandora obundi; baitu inywe mundora: obwokwomera nyowe, nukow nainywe muliba bomezi.

english: He sat down and began to talk, and he gave him to his mother.
lunyoro: Yataha yaika'ra, yabanza okubaza. Yamuha nyina.

english: They were standing there, warming themselves and saying, “Jesus, Lord! Have mercy on us!”
lunyoro: Basisimuka nibagamba ngu Yesu, Mukama waitu, otuganyire.

english: He got up and began to sink down into the sea and said to the sea, “Hurry up!” The wind blew away, and there was a great calm.
lunyoro: Yasisimuka, yacomera ekiyaga, nagambira enyanja ati Leka, culera.Ekiyaga kyahwaho, habaho okuculera kwinngi.

english: Nor does this servant look down on me in the darkness outside, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
lunyoro: Nomuiru ogu rubale atarukugasa mumu nage omu mwirima ogwa aheeru; nambere haliba mu oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: The Spirit told me to go with them, but they could not. The six brothers also went with me. We went into the man's house.
lunyoro: Kandi Omwoyo yandagira okugenda nabo, okutasoboramu. Na bene baitu banu mukaga bagenda nanyowe; twataha omu nju yomusaija ogu:

english: Jesus came to them and said, “All authority has been given me in heaven and on earth.”
lunyoro: Yesu yaija yabaza nabo nagamba ati Mpairwe obusobozi bwona omu iguru na hansi.

english: and all the tribes of your people, son of David?
lunyoro: nebitebe byona byanuwe Mwana wa daudi?

english: On the good soil, they hear the word with their whole heart, good and firm, and love the children.
lunyoro: Kandi ha itaka erisemire, nibo bahu'ra ekigambo omu mitima esemire, emirungi, bakigumya, bekamba okwana ebyana.

english: And who is this man who was going through the world, except Jesus, who is the one who believes that Jesus is the one who belongs to God?
lunyoro: Kandi noha asingura ensi, rundi ogu nyakuikiriza ngu Yesu nuwe wa Ruhanga?

english: When Moses saw it, he was amazed at what he saw. As soon as he saw them, the Lord's voice came to him,
lunyoro: Moses obuyaboine, yahuni'ra ekiyarozire: obuyabairire haihi okurora, iraka rya Mukama likaija liti

english: So they took a crown and went to meet Jesus and said to him in a loud voice, “Praise the King of Israel! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”
lunyoro: Batwara enkindo, bagenda okumutangi'ra nibagambira haiguru ngu Hosana: ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama, nuwe Mukama wa Isareri.

english: For now we are set free from the Law, and by the same rule we have died for the things that were sold to us. Let us be slaves of the new Spirit and not of the old writings.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu tukasumu'rwa okuruga omu biragiro, obutwafire hali eki ekikaba kitutungire; itwe tuikalege abairu, omu buhyaka obwomwoyo, hatali omu nyuguta ezaira.

english: As they were untying and bowed down to the earth, they asked, “What does this mean for you to die?”
lunyoro: kandi obubakaba nibekanga, bainamire amaiso gabu hansi, babagambira ngu Mara kiki ekirukubaseruza okufa?

english: I tell you that this age will not pass away unless all these things happen.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Obusinge bunu tibulihwaho, rundi ebi byona bimazire kuhiki'ra.

english: His parents said, “He is the elder!”
lunyoro: Nikyo abamuzaire bagambire ngu Mukuru ogu.

english: But if anyone is a teacher, let him be a teacher of the truth in his teaching.
lunyoro: rundi anyakwegesa, ayekambe omu kwegesakwe:

english: The believers immediately sent Paul off to the sea, and Silas and Timothy stayed there.
lunyoro: Nubwo bwango bene babu basindika Pauro okugenda okuhika ha nyanja: kandi Sira na Timoseo basigara oku.

english: Show honor to all. Love your brothers. Respect the King.
lunyoro: Mutemu ekitinisa abantu bona. Mugonze bene banyu. Mutine Ruhanga. Mutemu Ekitinisa Omukama.

english: For God has spoken through all the prophets that Christ will be revealed, and he has done this.
lunyoro: Baitu ebigambo Ruhanga ebiyaraguire omu kanwa kabanabi bona ngu Kristowe alisalizibwa, nukwo yabihikirize ati.

english: For God chose the kingdoms of the world to be the glory of the wise.
lunyoro: baitu Ruhanga akakomamu ebyokubutami ebyensi, akwase ensoni abamagezi:

english: Take Mark and bring him with you, for I am ready to go with you.
lunyoro: Leta marako aije hamu naiwe, baitu nangasira obwokuhereza.

english: And if it is proper for me to go with you, then they will go with me.
lunyoro: Kandi obukiraba nikinseme'ra nanyowe okugenda, bo baligenda nanye.

english: When Jesus came into the house, the blind man saw him and said to them, “Believe me, Lord!” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahire omu nju, abafu bamaiso baija namberali: Yesu yabagambira ati Nimuikiriza ninsobora okukora kinu? Bamugambira ngu Ego, Mukama waitu.

english: For in that way we will remember sins every year.
lunyoro: Baitu omubyo harumu okuijukya ebibi omwaka nomwaka.

english: A voice came from heaven, “I have glorified you, Father!”
lunyoro: Kandi iraka ryaruga omu iguru ngu Nkalinyumiza.

english: Do not be afraid of foreigners. I was naked, but you were sick, and you were in prison, and you did not wash.
lunyoro: omunyaihanga mutangonyese; nkaba ndi busa mutanjweke, nkaba ndwaire, omunkomo, mutansule.

english: Let no one deceive you in any way, because it is not possible for you to separate yourself from the one who is misleading you from the one who is misleading you. But the one who is misleading will be revealed, the one who is misleading the son of the one who is misleading.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena aleke okubabihabiha omu kigambo kyona kyona:baitu tikirihika, rundi okwahukana obukulikamara okubaho, kadi omuntu oli owokusisa obwalikamara okusuku'rwa, omwana wokuhwereke'ra,

english: I am being given the end of your faith, in order to be saved by your Spirit.
lunyoro: Nubwo mpairwe empero eyokuikirizibwa kwanyu, nukwo kujunwa kwemyoyo yanyu.

english: Or did these people ever say a sin that they had seen? If I stood before the Council, or if I were to say this,
lunyoro: Rundi bantu banu bonka bagambe ekibi ekibaboine, obunayemerire omu maiso gorukurato, rundi obunayesere ekigambo kinu,

english: Then the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the Temple and took away the seven bowls full of the money and threw them into the treasury and the money in their sacks.
lunyoro: haruyemo bamaraika musanju, abakaba bayina emihito omusanju, nibatwara ebindi musanju ebiijuire efeza, babibika omu kifuba nomunda zemiringa.

english: I turned around to see the voice that spoke with me. When I turned around, I saw seven gold lampstands.
lunyoro: Nahinduka okurora iraka eryabalize nanyowe. Kandi obunahindukire nkarora etabaza musanju eza zabu;

english: It is not like this; and the seeds that fell on a good soil believe, and they bear children thirty times, sixty times, and a hundred.
lunyoro: Kandi mbali abasigirwe nambere ahali itaka erisemire, nibakiikiriza; abakukwana ebyana, emirundi amakumi asatu, nenkaga, nekikumi.

english: They worshiped God's eternal presence in the likeness of a man who is to be destroyed, just as the four living creatures with their feet and feet stand on the altar.
lunyoro: kandi bakahingisa ekitinisa kya Ruhanga atahwaho omu kisisani ekyomuntu arukuhwaho, okukisisaniza nkekyebinyakuku'ruka nekyebinyina amaguru ana nekyekinyakweku'ra.

english: For no one can produce other races except Jesus Christ, who is the one who has been chosen.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho asobora okusimbamu emiganda endi, rundi egi aysimbirwe, nuwe Yesu Kristo.

english: When we put the horsemen in his mouths, we will throw them into the sea, where they will throw us into the sea, and they will throw us into the sea.
lunyoro: Kandi obututa ebyoma ebyembarasi omu minwa yayo zitworobere, tuhinudurahindura emibiri yazo yona.

english: No one has put new wine into old wineskins, and new wine will burst the skins, and new wine will pour out into fresh wineskins.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga ezikuzire: kiraba kitalikyo, amarwa gahulikya endyanga, namarwa gaseseka, nendyanga zisisikara.

english: So then, my friends, we are not children of a free people, but of a free people.
lunyoro: Nukwo, bene baitu, tituli bana bomuzana, baitu bowobugabe.

english: For we do not want you to be put right with us, but first to be brought before you in the Good News about Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukukunukiriza okutahika mali halinywe: baitu tukabanza okuhika halinyowe omu njiri ya Kristo:

english: So after they had fasted and prayed and placed their hands on them, they sent them away.
lunyoro: Nukwo, obubamazire okusiba nokusaba nokubataho emikono, babatuma.

english: The sword that crushes you in your heart has been made known to many hearts.
lunyoro: Kandi na iwe empirima erikucumita omu mutima ebitekerezo ebyomu mitima mingi bisukurwe.

english: I am looking forward to the prize of the high calling of God through Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: ndi mahano nimpondera okuhika kuli, nambere hali empera eyokweta kwa Ruhanga okwahaiguru enyakuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: If you do not speak in strange tongues, how can you know what is being said? For you will speak in strange tongues.
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe obumutagamba omu ndimi ebigambo ebirukuhu'rwa bwango, kirimanywa kita ekigambwa? baitu muliba numugambira omu mwanya.

english: He sent messengers to the villages of Samaria to prepare for him.
lunyoro: yatuma abakwenda omu kika ekya Babsamaliya okumutekaniriza.

english: One of the criminals who had been condemned made fun of him and said, “Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and us!”
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abo abakozire kubi abahanikirwe, akamute'ra enaku nagamba ati Tiniwe Kristo? Oyejune wenka, ojune naitwe.

english: I do not speak in fear, but in order that I may be filled with awe and may be filled with joy.
lunyoro: Tindukugamba obwokutaga: baitu nkega nti nkokundi ebiro byona, nukwo 'nihege.

english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish that you have just caught.”
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Mulete ha ncu ezimukwasire hati bunu.

english: But the news about him spread even further, and many people were gathered together to hear and to be healed of their diseases.
lunyoro: Baitu okuranganwakwe kukeyongera muno okuhika honahona: nebitebe bingi byaso'rokana okuhu'ra nokukizibwa endwara zabu.

english: We know that God is looking for sinners, but whoever fears God and does the will of God listens to him.
lunyoro: Itwe tumanyire ngu Ruhanga tahu'ra basisis: baitu omuntu wena obwatina Ruhanga, nakora ebyagonza, ogu amuhu'ra.

english: You have become like a branch of thorn bushes and weeds, and you have joined those who have done these things.
lunyoro: hakire obumwafokere ekyokusunga obwebijumu nemihito; obumwagirikize nabo abakozirwe ebi.

english: His eyes were like a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, but no one knew of him.
lunyoro: Namaisoge gasisana nkomu'ro ogwaka, kandi ha mutwegwe ekondo nyingi; kandi ayina ibara erihandikirwe, omuntu wena eryatamanyire rundi uwe wenka.

english: Or do you despise riches, kindness, and patience? Don't you know that God's goodness brings you back to life?
lunyoro: Rundi nogaya obuguda obwembabazize> nobuculezi nokugumisiriza? Kunu torukumanaya ngu oburungi bwa Ruhanga nobukuleta omu kwegarukamu?

english: When God saw that we were far from being made, they would not be made perfect apart from us.
lunyoro: Ruhanga obuyatubonire hara ekigambo ekirukukira oburungi, bo baleke okuhikirizibwa hatali itwe.

english: One body, one Spirit, just as you have been made perfect in the hope of your being saved.
lunyoro: Omubiri gumu, Nomwoyo omu, kandi nka inywe okumwayeserwe omu kunihira kumu okwokwetwa kwanyu:

english: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to receive them a share of the harvest.
lunyoro: Kandi omwaka obugukaba gumalize okuhika, ebyana okwenga, yatuma omuiru rubale hali abalimi, bamuhe ha byana ebyorugonjo rwemizabibu.

english: When they arrived here, I did not stay there for a while, but on the next day I sat down in the judgment seat, and I told the man to bring me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, obubaso'rokainire hanu ntaikaleho na kake, baitu na kiro ekyakabiri naika'ra ha kitebe ekicwerwaho emisango, nindagira okuleta omusaija.

english: and teach the Teacher, the greatest commandment in the Law
lunyoro: egesa, ekirairo ekikuru omu biragiro ki

english: For it is necessary to put on the new wine, which will not be mixed with new wine.
lunyoro: Baitu kihiki'ra amarwa agomutara'ra okugata omu ndyanga empyaka.

english: “Yes,” they answered, “and we have not heard unless the Holy Spirit comes upon us.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Nangwa, nokuhu'ra titukahu'raga rundi haroho Omwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: So he went out to Simon Peter and the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken the Lord to death, and we do not know where they have put him!”
lunyoro: Yairuka yaija hali Simoni petero na hali omwegeswa ogu ondi Yesu owakaba nagonza, yabagambira ati Baihiremu Mukama waitu omu kiso, kandi titurukumanya nambere bamutaire.

english: “Don't be afraid of Paul,” he said. “You must stand before the Emperor,” he said. “God has given you over to all those who are with you.”
lunyoro: yagamba ati Otatina Pauro; kikuhikirire okweme'ra omu maiso ga Kaisali: kandi dora, Ruhanga akuhaire abo bona abarukugenda naiwe.

english: See that I have written to you with my own hand.
lunyoro: Murole okumopandikire inywe nenyuguta enkoto nomukono gwange nyenka.

english: The blood of all the prophets, which has been kept secret since the creation of the world, has been poured out into the hands of the prophets.
lunyoro: Esagama ya banabi bona, eyasesekere okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi, ejunanizibwe bene babu bona:

english: For the one who makes himself holy and the one who is made holy has been commanded by the one who is holy to be holy. So then, do not be ashamed to call your brothers and say,
lunyoro: Baitu ogu arukweza nabo abarukwezebwa bona barugire hali omu: nikyo atakwaitirwa ensoni okubeta bagenzi, nagamba ati

english: The fear of them all began to fall on all who were scattered about, and all these things were spread through all the hill country of Judea.
lunyoro: Okutina kwabakwata bona abakaba bahe'raine; kandi ebugambo ebi byona byaranganwa okuhika omu nsi yona eyensozi eya Buyudaya.

english: He will save all those who live in prison forever because they are afraid of death.
lunyoro: kandi ajune abo bona abaikara omu buiru ebiro byona ebyobwomezi bwabu obwokutina okufa.

english: So he sent the crowd away, got into the boat, and went into the other side of the lake.
lunyoro: Yayohereza ebitebe, yagwe'ra omu bwato,yataha omu mitano eya

english: While Jesus was still with them, he told them not to leave Jerusalem, but to wait for his Father's promise and say, “Listen to me!
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba agomere hamu nabo, yabaragira bataruga Yerusalemu, baitu bategereze omurogo ogwa Isitwe nagamba ati ogumwahulire hali nyowe:

english: To the one who has been given the power to believe in the Spirit, and to the other who has been given the gift of the Spirit to heal the sickness of the Spirit.
lunyoro: Ondi ahabwa okuikiriza omu Omwoyo ogu, ondi atunga ekisembo ekyokukiza endwara omu mwoyo ogu,

english: As I hope and wait for him, I will not be ashamed of anything, but, as always, of him who has been raised from death to life and life.
lunyoro: nkokutegereza kwange nokunihira kwange okukuli ngu tindikwatwa ensoni omu kigambo kyona, baitu nkebiro byona na hati bunu, nyowe nyumizibwaga hali ogu omu kufa nokuhumbuka.

english: If anyone destroys the temple of God, God will destroy him; but if he destroys the temple of God, then you are the one who is holy.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwahwerekereza yekaru ya Ruanha, ogu Ruhanga alimuhwerekereza: baitu yekar ya Ruhanga neyera, ninywe.

english: They made sure that he would not stop them from the bread but at the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
lunyoro: Nubwo bakengere ngu tagambire okwerinda ekitumbisa ekyemigati, baitu okwegesa okwa Bafalisayo Nabasadukayo.

english: Let us not become children of God, as though we were slaves of sin. We are carried off by the wind of teaching, by the power of human beings, by the power of the world's wisdom.
lunyoro: tusineseke okuikaraga abana abato, ntubungwabingwa, ntutwarwa omuyaga gwona ogwokwegesa, omu kubihabiha kwabantu, nomu budupe, obwokukuratira amagezi agebisuba:

english: Whoever does what is right is righteous, and whoever does evil is evil is the one who is of the Devil, because the Devil has been cursed from the very beginning. That is why the Son of God has been revealed and revealed to the Devil what he has done.
lunyoro: Anyakukora ebyokuhiki'ra nuwe ahikirire; nkauwe okwahikirire. Anyakukora ekibi nuwe wa Setani; baitu Setani asisa okuruga karanakara. Nikyo Omwana wa Ruhanga yayolekirwe, ahwerekereze emirimo ya Setani.

english: They cursed the God of heaven for the sake of their obedience and of their sins, because they did not turn from their sins.
lunyoro: kandi bayeruma endimi zabu obwokuhu'ra, nibajuma Ruhanga owomu iguru obwokuhururwa kwabu; baitu bategarukemu omu ngeso zabu.

english: “Tell us,” they said, “that his disciples came to him by night and stole him away.
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Mugambe muti Abegeswabe baizirege ekiro bamuiba,

english: His neighbors saw him eating and drinking, and they said, “Isn't this the one who sat at the table?”
lunyoro: Kandi abatahibe nabamuroraga ira aikalire nalega, bagamba ngu Tinuwogu ayaika'raga nalega?

english: There are many different forms of work, but there is only one God who makes all things work.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho emiringo nyingi eyemirimo, baitu Ruhanga ali omu, anyakukoza byona omu byona.

english: Nicodemus said to him, “Can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb and be born?”
lunyoro: Nikodemo yamugabira ati Omuntu nasobora ata okuzarwa obwaba akuzire? Nasobora okutaha obwakabiri omu nda ya nyina nokuzarwa?

english: Greetings to the church in their homes. Greetings to Epaphroditus, my dear friend, who is the first in Asia for Christ.
lunyoro: kandi muramukye nekanisa eyomu nju yabu. Muramukye Epaineto, oundukugonza, nuwe kyana ekyokubanza ekyomu Asiya hali Kristo.

english: Jesus said to him, “Have you seen this great and glorious work? It will not be left here until the stone is rolled up and thrown down.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Oboine okwombekwa kunu okwingi? Tihalisigara hanu ibale erinyakuli ha ibale, eritalinagwa hansi.

english: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, Peter, John, and Andrew asked him,
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba aikalire ha rusozi orwa Zeituni nalisirimuka Petero na Yohana na Andereya bakamukaguza

english: And if I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: Blessed be God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga asimwe arukutusinguza omu Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: They began to reject him and said, “We found this man misleading our people, and he is trying to gain favor with the Emperor. He claims to be the Messiah, the King!”
lunyoro: Babanza okumulega nibagamba ngu Tukarora omuntu onu nahabisa ihanga ryaitu: nabatanga okuzinira Kaisali, nayegamba wenka okuba Kristo, Omukama.

english: In the same way, what God has joined together cannot be divided.
lunyoro: nukwo ruhanga ekiyateranize hamu, omuntu atali baganizamu.

english: “Father Abraham,” he cried out, “I have a drink of water, and I am going to send Lazarus to dip his finger in the water and cool my tongue, because I am in this fire.
lunyoro: Yayami'ra nagamba ati Tata Iburahimu, nganyira, otume Razaro, aibike ensonga yorukumurwe omu maizi, afukirize orulimi rwange; baitu nimpu'rwa omu mu'ro gunu.

english: I tell you the truth about human weakness, but just as you have put away your parts of shame and anger from you, so you must now give your bodies to the people for the sake of righteousness and of holiness.
lunyoro: Ngamba habwobugara obwomubiri gwanyu: baitu nkokumwahayoga ebicweka byanyu hali ebyensoni, nokwema hali okwena, nukwo hati bunu mweheyo ebitekerezo byanyu okuba bairu hali okuhiki'ra nokwezebwa.

english: “What is your name,” he answered, “and I am a liar, because we have many things in common.”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Ibara ryawe niwoha? Yamugambira ati Niwe kaiso wange, baitu tuli naingi.

english: For who knew the mind of the Lord, that he might instruct him? For we have the mind of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu noha akaba amanyire amagezi ga Mukama, okumwegesa? Baitu itwe tuyina amagezi ga Kristo.

english: Jesus told them many other things, and he said to them, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation.”
lunyoro: Kandi akabatebeza omu bigambo bindi ebingi, nabagambi'ra ati Mwejune omu businge bunu obuhabire.

english: They threw themselves down at the feet of the apostles, and at their feet they gave the same thing to each other.
lunyoro: babita ha bigere byabakwenda; babagabira omuomu nkokubasegere.

english: If I speak in the languages of men and of angels, but do not have love, then I will become like a licentious plant that grows up and becomes like a branch that does not bear fruit.
lunyoro: Obundaba ningamba nendimi zabantu neza bamaraika, kunu ntanyina kugonza, buli nfokere nkomulinga ogugamba, nenjogera ezisara.

english: May Christ remain in your hearts by means of your faith. If you have your hearts full of love,
lunyoro: Kristo aikalege omu mitima yanyu obwokuikiriza: inywe obumunyina emihama yanyu, kandi obumugumibwa muno omu kugonza,

english: For our weak state, now that we are weak, is stronger than the moment we are made perfect in the hope of eternal glory.
lunyoro: Baitu omuhito gwaitu ogwa hati ogutalemera muno nugugarukira obutosa okutuko'ra ekitinisa kingi ekyebiro nebiro:

english: You can see that the time has not yet come for me to build Jerusalem a place of worship.
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu ebiro tibikahinguireho ikumi na bibiri nkaba kutemba Yerusalemu okuramya:

english: The roof was broken down, the rivers gushed out, the wind blew down, and that house was broken down. The roof was broken down, and the roof was broken down.
lunyoro: kandi nenjuye yagwa, nemigezi yagera, nekiyaga kyatera, nibitera enju egi: nokugwa kwayo kukaba kuli kwingi.

english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil and evil. For the love of good is a root of all kinds of evil.
lunyoro: Baitu nikirema omuntu okufera nowokuhiki'ra: baitu habwomurungi rundi omuntu yakugumire okumufera.

english: He wanted to gather the wheat into his barn, but no one gave him anything.
lunyoro: yagondeze okusara ebisunga byebisajwa omu nguliye; baitu busaho muntu ayamuhaga.

english: The man must give to the woman what is good for her, and the woman must also give to the man.
lunyoro: Omusaija amuhege mukazi ekimusemerire: nukwo nomukazi amuhe ati omusaija.

english: That is why I asked you to see me and talk to me, because I am happy because of the hope that the people of Israel have.
lunyoro: Nikyo mbesengererize inywe okundora nokubaza na nyowe; baitu obwokunihira okwa Isareri nikyo mbohirwe

english: That is why I went to Jerusalem and took many of the holy ones into prison, where I was given authority over the chief priests and when they were put to death, I also believed in killing them.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo nakolire Yerusalemu, kandi naboha omu nju zenkomo abarukwera baingi,obunahairwe obusobozi hali banyakatagara abakuru, kandi obubaisirwe, nanyowe nkaikiriza okubaita.

english: He went out about twelve o'clock in the morning and found others standing there. “What are you doing here,” he asked them. “Don't you know what you are doing?”
lunyoro: Yaturuka esaha zihikire ikumi nemu, yasanga abandi bemerire; yabagambira ati Kikyekibemerize hanu okiza obuire, mutaroho ekimurukukora?

english: and think of yourself as a blind man.
lunyoro: kandi oyetekerize wenka okuba omumuiruma,

english: For we have seen a man who is a very wicked man, misleading everyone in all the world, and misleading the Jewish people of the rest of the world.
lunyoro: Baitu tukabona omusaija omu mubi muno, kandi owokwemesa Abayudaya bona abali omunsi zona, kandi omukuru owekicweka kya Banazalesi:

english: And I said, ‘The Lord himself knows that I am going to prison and will go into prison with all the churches who believe in you.’
lunyoro: nagamba nti Mukama wange nuwe amanyire wenka ngu nyowe nabataga omu nju zenkomo, kandi nabateraga omu maso'rokaniro gona abakuikirize:

english: Jesus said to them, “The Sabbath was made for the people, and not for the people on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Sabiti ekabaho habwabantu, kandi tibali Bantu habwa Sabiti:

english: He believed and looked for someone who was not a believer.
lunyoro: Yaikiriza, yase'ra akabali, ha kitebe kitali.

english: They have respect for you and speak well of you, so that whoever opposes you will be ashamed of you and have no excuse for sin.
lunyoro: nukwo ogu anyakuharana naiwe akwatwe ensoni, atanyina ekigambo ekibi oku

english: They heard that it was good in the future, so that they might keep alive now and live.
lunyoro: bahulirwe ekigambo ekisemire obwebiro ebirukugenda okuija, nukwo bakwate obwomezi obu, nubwo bwomezi bwa hati bunu.

english: But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from my Father, the Spirit of wisdom, who comes from my Father, he will reveal my things.
lunyoro: BAITU Omuhumuza obwaliija oundibatumira okuruga hali Isenyowe, Omwoyo owamananu, arukuruga hali Isitwe, ogu alimanyisa ebyange,

english: When Jesus left, two blind men followed him. They shouted, “Son of David! We have sinned!”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyarugireyo, abafu bamaiso babiri bakamukuratira. Nibatokera haiguru, nibagamba ngu Tuganyire. iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: It was not like the idols of this world, nor the merchants, nor the greedy, nor the drunkards, nor the prostitutes, who practiced sexual immorality. It was right for you to have one of these things come into the world.
lunyoro: wakuba abaramya ebisisani ebyensi enu, rundi abakuhyangya ebisuba: rundi abegombi, ebaruha, ebisisaniza, abasisi: baitu kyakubahikirire kiti okurugira kimu omu nsi:

english: For what will it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his life?
lunyoro: Baitu nikimugasira ki omuntu, okutunga ensi yona nokuburwa obwomezibwe?

english: When he saw the fig tree afar off, he came to it, or he saw something. When he came, he did not see it at all, but only at the right time.
lunyoro: obuyarozire hara omutini ogunyakuroho amababi, yaguhikaho, rundi azoleho kintu: kandi obuyaguhikireho, tiyabona kantu; baitu bikaba bitali biro bya itini; baitu bitakabaireho kasumi.

english: When I had eaten the seven thousand men, how many baskets full of fish did you take out of the jar?” They said to him, “Get up!”
lunyoro: Kandi obunacwerire enkumi ina omusanju, mwakoma ebigega bingaha ebiijuire oburagalika? Bamugambira ngu Musanju.

english: “Men of Israel,” Jesus told them, “Watch out for yourselves what you are about to do with these people.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, mwerinde inywenka hali abantu banu ekimugenda okukora.

english: For I do not want to see my own glory, but someone seeks and judges.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe tinse'ra kitinisa kyange nyenka: haroho ase'ra kandi acwa omusango.

english: For while we were still weak, Christ died for ungodly people by the power of God.
lunyoro: Baitu obutukabatukyali abagara, omu mpikoze Kristo akafera abatarukutina Ruhanga.

english: In union with Christ you too must be built up as God's throne by the Spirit.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe omuruwe mwombekerwe hamu okkuba ekiikaro ekyokuikaramu ekya Ruhanga omu Mwoyo.

english: Show him the money coin.” They brought the money to him.
lunyoro: Mwoleke efeza eyomusoro. Bamuletera edunali.

english: And this was not the only thing that the church was instructed to do with us in this letter of grace, which we send to the glory of our Lord and to show our faith.
lunyoro: kandi tikiri eki kyonka, baitu akasomwamu ekanisa okugenda naitwe omu kigambo kinu ekyembabazi, itwe ekiturukuhereza hali ekitinisa ekya Mukama waitu, nokwoleka okwekamba kwaitu:

english: So Jesus stood up with him and began to teach him, and he left him. At once he got up and sent them away.
lunyoro: Yayeme'ra namberali, yacomera omusaija; gwamurugaho: ahonaho yaimuka yabahereza.

english: Then Jesus stretched out his hand toward his disciples and said, “Look! Here is my mother and my brothers!
lunyoro: Yago'ra omukonogwe hali abegeswabe nagamba ati Dora, mau nagagenzi bange.

english: It is not like Moses, who hid his face, that the people of Israel should not look far to see the end of the age.
lunyoro: kandi tikuli nka Musa okuyaswekerire amaisoge, abana ba Isaleri baleke okuhweza muno emperor yeki ekihwaho:

english: When he opened the second seal, he heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
lunyoro: Obuyasumuruire emanyikirizo eyakabiri nahu'ra ekyomezi ekyakabiri nikigamba ngu Ija.

english: Just as the Word is in the world, so are the things that are in the world. Just as the heavens are in the world, they are the things that are in the world.
lunyoro: Nkokubali omwiguru, nukwo bali bati abomu iguru; nkogu owomunsi, nukw ali ati anyakuli womunsi.

english: He deceived our people and led them out of the way, so that their children would not be able to stand up.
lunyoro: Ogu akagobeza ihanga ryaitu, nabahambiriza okuruga omu kitebe, okubanagisa abana babu okwemera.

english: But when they had sailed from Perga, they went to Antioch in Pisidia, and on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and prayed.
lunyoro: Baitu bo, obubarabire okuruga Perega, bahika Antyokiya orwa Pisidia; kandi bakataha omu iso'rokaniro ha kiro kya Sabiti, baika'ra.

english: For what will it profit a man to eat the world and die for his life?
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu kirimugasira ki okurya ensi yona kandi aferirwe obwomezibwe?

english: He has appeared to us and saved us, not by the good deeds that we ourselves have done, but by the mercy that he has performed since the birth of the second child, and by the new birth of the Spirit.
lunyoro: yatukonyire, tibuli obwengeso zokuhiki'ra ezitwakozire itwe baitu obwokuganyirakwe obwokwogibwa obwo kuzarwa omurundi ogwakabiri, nokuforwa abahyaka omumwoyo.

english: Every tribe in heaven and on earth is named after its name.
lunyoro: abo abomu iguru nama hansi embaju zona abararuramya ibararye.,

english: “What do you want us to do with you, Son of God? Have you come here to punish us before the time comes?” they shouted.
lunyoro: Nabo batokera ha iguru, nibagamba ngu Tujunaine ki, itwe naiwe, Iwe Omwana wa Ruhanga? Oizire hanu okutucanza akasumi kaitu katakahikire?

english: But they did not give up, and they gave themselves over to selfish desires.
lunyoro: baitu abo bakalekayo okusalirwa, bayehayo bonka halitasemire omu kwegomba.

english: Happy is he who reads and those who hear the words of this prophecy and obey the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.
lunyoro: Ayina omugisa anyakusomamu, nabo abanyakuhu'ra ebigambo ebyokuragura kunu, nibakwata ebigambo ebihandikirwemu:baitu akasumi kali haihi.

english: This wisdom is not that comes down from heaven, but from the earth, which is the world, the Devil's children.
lunyoro: Amagezi ganu tigali ago agarukuruga haiguru, baitu ga hansi, gokuzarwa kwonka, ga Setani.

english: He begged Jesus to send them to the synagogues in Damascus to see the people there, both men and women, who had come to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: yamusaba ebaruha ezokugenda Damasiko, hali amaso'rokaniro, obwalibonayo abantu Abomuhanda ogu, rundi abasaija rundi Abakazi, ababoine abalete Yerusalemu.

english: But this son of mine was dead and has been raised to life, and he was lost, and he is asleep.
lunyoro: baitu omwana wange onu akaba afire, ahumbukire; akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: But if a person is persecuted as a Christian, let him not be ashamed of him, because he serves God in his own name.
lunyoro: baitu omuntu obwabonabonesebwa nka Mukristayo aleke okukwatwa ensoni; baitu akugize Ruhanga omu ibara eri.

english: We do not commit adultery, but we belong to one another, and in the same way, we are guilty of sin and are put to death by the power of two thousand three hundred.”
lunyoro: Tusisaine, baitu tukafuruka hamu, kandi nkabarukwera abatanyina musango, kandi bagwa hansi nkekyanda bibiri mu bikumi bisatu.

english: But Paul said, “I have never been in a better place than Festus, because I am telling you the truth and proving it by what you say.”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Tingwire iraro, Fesito omurungi muno; baitu ningamba ebigambo ebyamananu nokwekenga.

english: Don't you remember that I was still with you when I told you these things?
lunyoro: Lolekerwe ngu nobunkaba nkyali nainywe nkabatebeza ebi?

english: Think about the difficult conditions you are going to suffer, not to give up, nor to teach, but to have no need for tears or hands. God feeds you. Are you not worth much more than birds?
lunyoro: Mutekereze ebingora okubitasiga nobukwakuba okugesa; abitanyina mbiso nobwekuba enguli; kandi Ruhanga abirisa: inywe timurukukira muno omuhendo enyonyi?

english: I am sending you to the prophets, wise men, and teachers of the Law. Some of them you will kill, others you will stone, others you will stone in your synagogues, and others you will stone in every town.
