lunyoro: Kandi iwe obworagabiraga abasege, omukono gwawe ogwemoso guleke okumanya ogwoburo ebigukera:

english: Greet one another with the kiss of love. Do the same to one another—just as Christ has forgiven you.
lunyoro: muramukyangane inywenka nokunywegera okurukugumangana: nka Kristo nauwe okuyaganyire inywe nukwo nainywe mukole muti:

english: The work of everyone will be made known to you, because it will be revealed by the fire; and the fire itself will wash away everyone's work in order to destroy them.
lunyoro: omulimo gwabantu bona gulimanyisibwa:baitu ekiro eki kirigumanyisa, baitu gulisuku'rwa omu mu'ro: kandi nomu'ro nugwo girirenga omulimo gwomuntu wena okugurukusisa.

english: Again he sent another slave, and they killed him, many others; others beat them, and some killed them.
lunyoro: Yagaruka natuma ondi; nogu bamuita: nabandi baingi; abandi nibabatera, abandi nibabaita.

english: and said, “There was a judge in the city who did not fear God or listen to the people.
lunyoro: nagamba ati Omu rubuga hakaba harumu omucwi wemisango ataratinaga Ruhanga, nobukwakuba okuhu'ra abantu;

english: and said to them, “Whoever believes in me among these little ones also has come to believe in me, but whoever believes in me has not believed in me, because he sent me.”
lunyoro: nabagambira ati Omuntu wena aliikiriza omu hali abana abato abarukusisana nkonu, omu ibara ryange, buli aikirize nyowe; nomuntu wena arukuikiriza nyowe taikiriza nyowe, baitu ogu ayantumire.

english: They wanted to learn the message and sold themselves into their homes, but it was shameful for a woman to speak in the church.
lunyoro: kandi obubagonza okumanya ekigambo, babiguramu omu maka gabu bonka: baitu kyensoni omukazi okugamba omu kanisa.

english: “I will not lie to him,” he said, “but will not give up on him, nor will he give him anything he has to go out of the way?”
lunyoro: Akagamba ati tindimubohya, baitu talisobora okumuhayo, nobukwakuba okumuha ekintu ekyomuhendo?

english: Jesus said, “Father, you know what they are doing, but they do not know what they are doing.” So they cut off his clothes and threw him out.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagamba ati Isenyowe obaganyire; baitu tibamanyire ekibarukukora. Kandi bakabagana ebyokujwarabye, nibatoma.

english: They cried out in a loud voice, “How long, then, will you be the Holy One, the one who is truthful and true, to judge the people on earth by our blood?
lunyoro: Basima niraka erihango nibagamba ngu Olihikya nkaha Mukuru waitu, arukwera, owamazima okutacwa omusango nokuhora enzigu obwesagama yaitu hali abo abarukuikara hansi?

english: and said to the mountains and to the rocks, ‘Fall on us, then, and let us set the eyes of the one who sits on the throne of the Kingdom and of the Lamb.’
lunyoro: nibagambira ensozi namabale ngu Tugwere,tusereke hali amaiso gogu anyakuikalire ha kitebe ekyobukama na hali ekiniga Ekyomwana Gwentama;

english: But when Jesus came to the entrance of the gate, another girl saw him and said to the people there, “He was with Jesus the Nazarene!”
lunyoro: Baitu obuyaturukire okuhika omu kiti kyomuryango, Omuisiki ondi yamubona, nagambira abantu abakaba baroho ati Nonu akabali hamu na Yesu Munazarayo.

english: He has poured out his own blood on us by means of his own blood, in order that our sins may be forgiven according to the riches of his grace.
lunyoro: we ayatuhaisize okucungurwa kwaitu obwesagamaye, nukwo kuihibwaho ebyokusisa byaitu, nkobuguda obwembabazize okubuli,

english: I can do everything for the one who gives me power.
lunyoro: Ninsobora okukora byona habwogu arukumpa amani.

english: The baptism of John was from heaven or from human beings? Turn away from your sins.
lunyoro: Okubatiza kwa Yohana kukaruga omu iguru, nandiki omu Bantu? Mungarukemu.

english: This is how God indicated that God gave us eternal life, and this life is in union with his Son.
lunyoro: Kandi kunu nukwo kumanyisa ngu Ruhanga akatuha obwomezi obutahwaho. Nobwomezi obuli obubuli omu Mwanawe.

english: There is, then, a good deed that has been kept secret, and the things that are harmful cannot be hid from him.
lunyoro: Nukwo haroho engeso enungi ezirwa bwerebwere, kandi ebi ebirukusisa kundi tibisobora okuserekwa.

english: For I tell you these things, so that your hearts may be filled with pity.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe obwokubagambira ebigambo ebi, emitima yanyu ijuire okuganya.

english: He showed by his power that the only King of kings and Lord of lords is the only one who is respected.
lunyoro: okumanyisa omu mpiko zakwo, Omukama owobusobozi omu wenka arukusimwa, omukama wabakam, omulemi wa Banyoro;

english: Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek to be reconciled to one another. Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek a wife.
lunyoro: Ukaba ohandikirwe nomukazi? Otase'ra okubaganizibwamu. Okaba oli omuhara? Otasihana nomukazi.

english: And Satan himself will be destroyed when his kingdom is divided against itself. You say that I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul.
lunyoro: Kandi Setani nauwe obwabaganizibwamu wenka, obukamabwe buliikaraho buta Baitu inywe numugamba ngu Nyowe mbinga emizimu habwa Beerezebuli.

english: So he went to the second, and said the same thing to them. Again Jesus said, “Go away, Father,” but he did not go.
lunyoro: Yaija hali owakabiri yagamba kimu na kiri. Nauwe yagarukamu nagamba ati kangende tata: baitu atagende.

english: For you have been given the task of Christ, not only because you believed in him, but also because you were persecuted for his sake.
lunyoro: baitu inywe mukahabwa habwa Kristo, tikuli kumuikiriza kwonka, baitu nokusalirwa habwe:

english: Jesus said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘The good workers.’
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Abakama ababamahanga babalema; nabo ababatunga betwa Abakora okurungi.

english: The people were so angry that they gave up the name of God, who has authority over these plagues. But they did not turn from their sins and give him glory.
lunyoro: Abantu bayokebwa okwokya kwingi: bajuma ibara rya Ruhanga anyakuina obusobozi ha mihito enu; baitu nategarukemu, okumuha ekitinisa.

english: The disciples said to him, “Teacher, how did the Jews try to stone you, and you turn around?”
lunyoro: Abegeswa bamugambira ngu Rabi, Abayudaya bakaba nibase'ra okukutera amabale; kandi nogarukayo?

english: Or does a potter have authority over the clay to make one part of another into another, to make another part a dishonor or a dishonor? What, then, is it?
lunyoro: Rundi omubumbi tanyina obusobozi hali ibumba, omu kitonge ekimu okukora ekibindi ekimu ekyekitinisa, rundi nekindi ekyensoni? Kiki?

english: Those who look for their own life will lose it, and those who despise their own life for my sake will find it.
lunyoro: Anyakuzora obwomezibwe bulimuburaho; nauwe alibuza obwemezibwe habwange alibuzora.

english: When he came into the house, he did not allow anyone to go in with him, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and the mother of the child.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahire omu nju, ataikirize muntu wena okutahamu nauwe, rundi Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo na ise omuisiki na nyina.

english: They sat down all the way to the house, and as they walked, they saw that Jesus was passing by.
lunyoro: Kandi bakai'ra haihi nekika, hakaba nibagenda: obubaikaireho bamurora nahinguraho.

english: And we pray that you will not do the same thing, because we are not the ones who were made perfect by God, but because you are doing what is good and without our sins.
lunyoro: Kandi ntusaba inywe mutakora kibi nekimu; tibuli itwe obwokurtorwa nkabarukusimwa, baitu inywe obwebi obwokukora, baitu ekirungi, nobutusisaine nkabatarukusisa.

english: And he made out of all the nations of the earth to dwell on all the mountains, and he gave them the command to gather together for the time and to gather the grapes of their tents.
lunyoro: kandi akakora okuruga hali omu amahanga gona agabantu okuikara hansi embaju zona, obuyaragire okubateraho ebiro, nemitano eyebiikaro byabu;

english: In Jerusalem there was a pool called Besseda, which is in Hebrew.
lunyoro: Kandi omu yerusalemu hali irembo ryona haroho ekijongo, ekibeta omu Ruheburaniya ngu Beseseda, ekiroho obuju butano.

english: And so you will be able to answer me, ‘I tell my children.’
lunyoro: Kandi nainywe obwokungaru'ra muti (ningambira abana bange) mugalihe.

english: I saw that woman, whose blood had not been poured out, was purified by the blood of the holy ones and by the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. When I saw her, I was completely amazed.
lunyoro: Kandi nkarora omukazi ogu atamire esagama yabarukwera, nesagama yabakaiso ba Yesu. Obunamuboine natangara nokutangara okwingi.

english: Wisdom is judged by all these children.
lunyoro: Kandi amagezi gaihwaho omusango obwabana bago bona.

english: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. It was like a man who was a king who wanted to count him and his servants by his money.
lunyoro: Obukama obwomu iguru nukwo burukusisana nkomuntu akabali omukama ayagondeze okubara omuhendo nabairube rubale.

english: Look! Your house has been abandoned to you, and I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Praise to the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’
lunyoro: Dora, enju yanyu abasigirwe kifuka, kandi nimbagambira nti Timulindora, okuhikya obumuligamba ngu Ahairwe omugida arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama.

english: If the Son of Man is to be handed over to this world, your peace will remain with him. But if not, it will turn away from you.
lunyoro: Kandi omwana wobusinge obwalibali oku, obusinge bwanyu buliikara nauwe: baitu obukiriba kitalikyo, bulibagarukira inywe.

english: For the promise of God to be made must come true by means of the one who made it.
lunyoro: Baitu nambere hali ekiragano ekyobugwetwa, hahikirire okubaho okuhiki'ra.

english: For first of all, he must feed himself on his own food, and then someone else will be hungry and thirsty.
lunyoro: Baitu wena abanza omutahiwe okurya ebyokuryabye wenka omu kurya kwanyu: kandi ondi arumwa enjara nondi atamira.

english: I write these things to you, so that I may come to you soon.
lunyoro: Nkuhandikire binu ninihira okuija mpora namberoli:

english: When a man comes to you and brings you this teaching, do not go into your homes or greet him.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaraijaga namberemuli, atrukuleta okwegesa kunu, Mutalimuiriza omu nju yanyu, kunu mutalimuramukta:

english: Those who believe in him will never be saved, but will not see the Son, because God's grace has been poured out on him.
lunyoro: Anyakuikiriza obutahwaho; baitu ataikirize Mwana talibona bwomezi, baitu ekiniga kya Ruhanga kiikaire haruwe.

english: Jesus answered them, “I have told you, but you have not heard. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples?
lunyoro: Yabagarukamu ati Mazire okubagambira baitu timuhulire: kiki ekibagondeseze okuhu'ra obwakabiri? Kandi nainywe nimwenda okufoka abegeswabe?

english: They will bring you down to the ground with your children within you, and they will not leave a stone in you to stone you, because you did not know the time when you would be made well.
lunyoro: barakufunza na bana bawe bawe omunda yawe; tibalisiga ibale erinyakuliha ibale; baitu otamanye ebiro ebyokubungirwa kwawe.

english: They sold their possessions and goods and gave them to everyone according to the needs of the group.
lunyoro: bagura ebyobuguda byabu nebintu byabu nibabigabira bona nkokubasegere omuomu.

english: For it is not right for me to take you to court, but also to take you to court.
lunyoro: Baitu tiguli musango, nyowe ntabajwahye, baitu nkabandi mugobya.

english: They wanted to stay with him for a while, but they did not believe him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamugandeze okuikara nabo nebiro bindi, ataikirize;

english: For no longer do we have any more authority over my people, so that they will not speak in this name to anyone.
lunyoro: Baitu kitagaruka okuranganwa omubantu, okuruga hati baleke okugambira omuntu wena omu ibara linu.

english: He came to the gate of the city, and behold, the dead body of the city was outside, and the only son who was born to the woman was outside. Many people in that city were with him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyairire haihi nirembo ryorubuga, dora, omufu wamalere aheru, omwana ayazairwe omu wenka nyina, nogu akabali mufakati: kandi abantu baingi abomu rubuga bakaba bali nauwe.

english: But they denied the truth and said, “The resurrection has already taken place, and some of them are convinced that they have faith.”
lunyoro: baitu bakahaba omu mazima, nibagamba ngu okuhumbuka kukamara okubaho, nibajumikira abamu okuikiriza kwabu.

english: Ananias went into the house and placed his hands on him and said, “Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road where you came from, has sent him back and has sent him back to you, and he has come back with the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Ananiya yagenda yataha omu nju; kandi obuyamutaireho emikono yagamba ati Mwene waitu Sauro, Mukama waitu, nuwe Yesu, ayakubonekire omu muhanda ogwoturukiremu, antumire oijule Nomwoyo Ogurukwara.

english: When he arrived, he came to him and said, “Teacher,” and kissed him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyahikire, ahonaho yaija nambereli nagamba ati Rabi,yamunywegera muno.

english: For I know that what I am doing in my body is not good, but what I want is what I do, but what I do in what I do in what I do in what is good.
lunyoro: Baitu manyire nti omuli nyowe, omu mubiri gwange, tiharumu ekirungi: baitu okugonza kuroho namberendi, baitu okukora ekirungi tikuroho.

english: For the poor are the ones that will stay with them for a little while, and you will be able to do what you want to do for them, but you will not remain with me for a little while.
lunyoro: Baitu abasege nibo muikara nabo obutosa; kandi obumurakagonzaga bwona murasoboraga okubakora okurungi: baitu nyowe timuikara nanyowe obutosa.

english: For he must rule until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
lunyoro: Baitu kirimuhiki'ra okulema okuhikya obwalimara okuta abanyanzigwabe bona hansi yebigerebye.

english: For the ruler of this world has already been put right with God.
lunyoro: baitu omulemi wensi enu amazire okucwerwa omusango.

english: When they arrived in Iconium, they went together into the synagogue and believed in Greek.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika omu Ikonio, bakataha hamu omu iso'rokaniro Ryabayudaya Nabayonani baikiriza.

english: When the time came for the feast, he sent his servant to tell the invited guests, ‘Come,’ because all these things are ready.
lunyoro: Kandi akasumi akobugenyi obukahikire yatuma omuiruwe rubale okugambira abayeserwe ngu Muije; baitu bunu byona bitekanize.

english: So then, when you receive the gifts of the Spirit, you too must work hard to build up the church.
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe, obumwegombere ebisembo ebyomwoyo, muse'lege okusagya obwokwombeka ekanisa.

english: And what you have heard from me in many ways is that you have reached out to faithful people, who will be able to teach others.
lunyoro: Kandi ebi ebiwahulire namberendi omu bakaiso baingi, nibyo oyahuze abantu abokwesiga, abalisobora okwegesa abandi.

english: We have brought glory to God by means of Christ, who through Christ has given us the hope of salvation.
lunyoro: itwe tukugizise ekitinisakye, itwe abanihire ira omu Kristo:

english: You who say, ‘Do not commit adultery, and do not commit adultery? Do you steal from the marketplaces?’
lunyoro: Iwe anyakugamba ngu Otalisihana, osihana, oiba ebyomu mabandiro?

english: The sun will say, ‘Out of the way evil things happen, because the sky is red and dark.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.
lunyoro: Ibura nirigamba ngu Haruba ha muhanda ruba habi;baitu iguru niritukura, niribunda bunda.mumanyire okukenga iguru nkokulisisa, baitu timusobora akukenga obwoku ro'raho obwebiro.

english: Two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah.
lunyoro: Dora, abasaija babiri bakaba nibabaza nauwe, nibo Musa na Eriya;

english: Jesus said to them, “I saw Satan already fallen like lightning from heaven.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nkarora Swtani agwire okuruga omu iguru nkenkuba.

english: In this way we know that God's Spirit is God's Spirit, and every spirit who proclaims that Jesus Christ came into the human body is God's.
lunyoro: Nuho turukumanyira Omwoyo gwa Ruhanga: omwoyo gwona oguyakwtura ngu Yesu Kristo akaija omu mubiri, nugwo gwa Ruhanaga:

english: Pilate again asked them, “What shall I do with this man, whom you call the King of the Jews?”
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato Yagaruka okubagambira ati Mara kiki ekindakora ogu oumurukweta omukama wa Bayudaya?

english: His mother, Simon, was sick and suffering from a dreaded skin disease. At once they told him,
lunyoro: Kandi nyinazara Simoni akaba abyamire, arwaire omusuija; ahonaho bamutebeza okwali:

english: This also became evident in all the world.
lunyoro: Nebigambo binu bikaranganwa omu nsi ezi zona.

english: The work you do is not easy, nor is it by someone you say so much.
lunyoro: Omulimo ogumutalikiriza na kake, nobwaraba omuntu abagambire muno.

english: God was in union with Christ, and he made his world together with him, so that they would not be able to bear their sins, and he made this union with us.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga akabali omu Krtisto, nateraniza ensi hamu nauwe wenka, okutabajunaniza ebyokusisa byabu, kandi yatwahuza itwe ekigambo ekyokuterana oku.

english: But many of them were possessed by demons, and he expelled them and began to proclaim the Good News to the people. Many of the people were healed by the power of the Roman authorities.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi halibo, abakaba baroho emizimu emibi, ekabarugaho, neyamuza niraka erihango: kandi baingi abakaba bazingamire nabalema bakira.

english: You too are with them, and you are called to belong to Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe muli hamu nabo, mweserwe okuba ba Yesu Kristo:

english: Do you not agree among yourselves, so that you will be judges of the evil thoughts?
lunyoro: timwebaganizemu omulinywe inywenka, numufoka abacwi bemisango abebitekerezo ebihihire?

english: The Jewish authorities said to one another, “Where is he who wants to go, and where do we not find him? He wants to go to those who do not belong to the Greek Empire and teach the Greeks?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagambirangana ngu Ogu nayenda kugenda nkaha, itwe nambere tutalimubona? Nayenda kugenda hali abo abatabanire omu bayonani, ayegese Abayonani?

english: What I say is not what I say in the Lord, but what I say in order to boast about myself.
lunyoro: Ekindukugamba tingambire omu Mukama waitu, baitu rundi omu butami, omu kuguma kunu okwokwenyumiza.

english: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where that man came from.
lunyoro: Itwe tumanyire Ruhanga akabaza na Musa: baitu omuntu ogu titumanyire nambere yarugire.

english: They will look at my work for forty years.
lunyoro: Nibarora emirimo yange emyaka amakumi ana.

english: For what will we give thanks to God for you? All the joy we have in you before our God!
lunyoro: Baitu tuligaru'ra Ruhanga okusima ki habwanyu? Obwokusemererwa kwona okutunyina habwanyu omu maiso ga Ruhanga waitu;

english: At that time the decree came from Emperor Augustus, to be written in all the world.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika omu biro ebi, ekiragiro kikaruga hali Kaisali Augusito, abensi zona okuhandikwa.

english: The man went to Pilate and prayed for Jesus' body.
lunyoro: omuntu ogu akagenda hali Pirato, yasaba omutumbi gwa Yesu.

english: For we are happy when we are weak and you are strong. And that is why we ask you one question.
lunyoro: Baitu tusemererwa itwe obutufoka abobugara, inywe mubebamani: kandi nikyo turukusaba inywe muku'le kimu.

english: Jesus said to them, “How can the children of the bridegroom be without a wedding feast, and where will the bridegroom be with them? But when the bridegroom is taken away from them, at that time they will fast.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Abana abobugenyi obwobugole basobora bata okusiba, omuswezi obwabalinabo? Baitu ebiro biriija abasingirweho, omu biro ebi numwo balisibira.

english: But Jesus answered, “Whoever welcomes me receives him and says to me, ‘Take your mat and walk!’
lunyoro: Baitu yabagarukamu ati Ogu ankirize, nuwe angambire ati Wetweka ekirago kyawe ogende.

english: Jesus said to him, “The children are free, then.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamugambira ati Nukwo abana nibo bobugabe.

english: The servants asked him, “What shall we do with this?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale bamukaguza ngu Kandi turagira tuta?

english: He took the cup and gave thanks to God, and said, “Take this and share it among yourselves.”
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, obuyamazire okusima yagamba ati Mukwate enu mugibagane inywenka.

english: They did not see it, and so many blind and lame people came to him. But two men later came to him.
lunyoro: kandi batakibone, bakaiso abebisuba nobubaizire baingi. Baitu hanyuma hakaija babiri,

english: Today Caiaphas is the one who advised the Jews: “It is right for a man to die for the people.
lunyoro: Lero Kayafa nuwogu ayabahaire Abayudaya amagezi ati Nikisemera, omuntu omu okufera abantu.

english: You too are the ones who have been poured out into God's service and remain in union with him. You do not force anyone to teach you, but the truth that comes from him is not in you; rather, remain in union with him and remain in union with him.
lunyoro: Nainywe okuseswaho amagita okumwahairwe haruwe nukuikara omulinywe, kandi timurukutanga omuntu wena okubegesa: baitu nkokusesakwe oku okukuli kwa mazima kunu tikuli kwebisuba, kandi nkokukwabegeseze, nukwo muikalege omuruwe.

english: That is why I write these things while I am still alive, so that I will not be troubled by the power that the Lord has given me by means of his power, and not by his will.
lunyoro: Ekyo mpandikirire binu ntaroho, obundibaho ndeke okubonabonesa nkosobozi okubuli Mukama waitu obuyampaire obwokwombeka, kunu tibuli obwokusesa.

english: Jesus said, “Father, then, I beg you, send him to my Father.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Nukwo tata, nkwesengerize okumutuma omba isenyowe;

english: All these evil things come from within, and defile a person.
lunyoro: ebibihire ebi byana biruga omunda, kandi bimusisa omuntu.

english: So he went off with the man from that country, and he sent him into his house to feed the people.
lunyoro: Kandi yagenda naterana hamu nomusaija owomunsi egi; ogu yamutuma omu bwe'lebwe okulisa empunu.

english: You will be hated by all of you for my name's sake. Those who remain to the end will be saved.
lunyoro: Nainywe mulinobwa abantu bona okkubajunana ibara ryange: kandi anyakuguma okkuhikya empero, nuwe alijunwa.

lunyoro: nitusisana nkabanyakufa, baitu dora, twomire; ntuhigwa, baitu tituisirwe;

english: My little children, I am still under God's curse until the Messiah comes in you.
lunyoro: Abana bange abato abandukusali'rwa kandi, okuhikya Kristo obwalifokera omulinywe:

english: He must be well spoken of by those who are outside, so that he may not fall into the trap of the Devil and be the master of the Devil.
lunyoro: hakire okuba nokugambwa kurungi hali abo abaheru; aleke okugwa omu kujumwa nendubatira ebya Setani.

english: He stayed in Joppa for a long time in the home of Simon the tanner.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika yaikarayo ebiro bingi omu Yopa, omu nju ya Simoni omuhazi wempu.

english: Large crowds came to him, bringing they saw and heard him, and the blind, the lame, the sick, and many others; and they threw them at Jesus' feet.
lunyoro: Ebitebw bingi bikaija namberali, balesere abarukusenjura, nabatu bamaiso, nabafu bakanwa, nabaramaire, nabandi baingi, nibabata ha bigerebye;

english: They handed Alexander over to the crowd, and the Jews made fun of him. Alexander took them out of his hand and tried to prepare them for the people.
lunyoro: Kandi baiha Alegezanda omu kitebe, Abayudaya nibamucumiriza. Kandi Alegezandu yabaculeza nomukono, nayenda okwetonganira hali abantu.

english: Some of them preached Christ to them out of love and compassion, and others also told them about his grace.
lunyoro: Abandi nibatebeza Kristo obwihali nokukungana; nabandi nibatebezangana obwembabazi:

english: Jesus said to him, “Go and sit down at your feet and come back here.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Genda, oyete baro, ogaruke oije hanu.

english: But get up and take him to the city and be told what you must do.
lunyoro: baitu imuka, otahe omu rubuga, oragambirwa ebikuhikirire okukora.

english: But the father said to the servants, ‘Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his feet.’
lunyoro: Baitu ise yagambira abairube rubale ati Mulete bwango ekyokujwara ekirukukira oburungi, mukimujweke; nakoma mukamujweke omu rukumu, nenkaito omu bigere:

english: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he said to them, “Why are you trying to argue among yourselves?
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamanya empaka zabu, yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nimute'ra ki empaka omu mitima yanyu?

english: He really believed what we were talking about, and he got ready to go to the one who sent him.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo akaikiriza okugambi'ra kwaitu; obwakaba amalize okwombeka, akaimukya okugenda namberali.

english: You have good deeds among the Gentiles, and you have washed them like that of the evil ones. They have seen your good deeds and have praised God on the Day of your being saved.
lunyoro: muba nokorangana kurungi omuli Abamahanga; kandi nobubabageya nkabakozi bobubi, baitu obwengeso zanyu enungi ezibarora, banyumize Ruhanga ha kiro kyokubungirwamu.

english: For all these are the things that I tell you by what you have received. For the one who sowed all the things he has sown is the one who will receive the harvest.
lunyoro: Baitu banu bona mbanagagiremuga hali ebisembo ebibasagirire: baitu ogu omu masegege anagiremu byona ebyayinabyo, niryo itungorye ryona.

english: THE gospel about Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
lunyoro: ENjiri ya Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga.

english: When Jesus left, the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees began to rebuke him with many words.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyarugireyo, abahandiki Nabafalisayo bakabanza okumufunza muno, nokumwohya okugamba ebigambo bingi:

english: The next Sabbath they went out and preached the word of God to all the people.
lunyoro: Kandi ha Sabiti eyakabiri bakagomera hamu nkorubuga rwona.

english: Take away the old yeast, and then be new in your body, just as you are without a lot of yeast. For even Christ died for us,
lunyoro: Muihemu ekitumbisa ekyaira, mufoke ekiihuro ekihyaka, nkokumutalimu ekitumbisasano. Baitu Nokuhingungurwaho kwaitu kukaitwa, nuwe Kristo:

english: We ourselves will be like God's servants, who told us that he raised the dead to life, even though they were not raised to life.
lunyoro: Kandi naitwe tuzokere nkabakaiso abebisuba aba Ruhanga; baitu tukatebeza ebya Ruhanga ngu akahumbura abafu obubaraba batahumburwa.

english: But whoever wants to save his own life loses it, but whoever loses his own life for my sake will save it.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakwenda okukiza obwomezibwe alibubuza: baitu wena anyakubuza obwemezibwe habwange, nuwe alibukiza.

english: I know that after I leave, the wild animals will go into you, and you will not be able to keep watch over the crowd.
lunyoro: manyire obundikamara okurugaho, enyamaiswa ezirukuruma rritaha omulinywe ezitalinganyira igana;

english: They were able to give this wine to the poor and to distribute it to the poor.
lunyoro: baitu amagita ganu bakusoboire okugaguramu edinali bikumi bisatu nokukiraho, nokukgabira abasege.

english: But if I order this matter to you, I will not be happy with you; you will not be able to do the better, but the worse.
lunyoro: Baitu obumbaragira ekigambo kinu tindukubasima, nti timwesoroza hamu obwebi ebikira oburungi, baitu obwebibi ekikira obubi.

english: After saying this, Jesus got up and went to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okubaza ati yabebembera natemba okugenda Yerusalemu.

english: They were very slow in speaking in the Temple and praising God.
lunyoro: kandi baikaraga obutosa omu yekaru nibakugiza Ruhanga.

english: As they ate some of the bread of the Passover meal, Satan had already put an end to Judas Iscariot. Simon's son was trying to betray him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibarya ebyokurya byorwebagyo, Setani obuyamazire ira okwohya Yuda Isikaryota. Omwana wa simony, omu mutimagwe okumugobeza.

english: But you will be judged, and you will be put to death, just as you are in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu omusango ogumucwa, nainywe muligucwerwa: nendengo eyimulengeramu, nainye muligirengerwamu.

english: and asked him, “What are you doing doing with these things?”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Busabozi ki oburukukukoza binu?

english: If I fought with animals in Ephesus, what advantage do I have from them? If the dead are not raised, then we will eat and drink, but tomorrow we will die.
lunyoro: Obundaba narwanire Efeso nenyamaiswa, nkabantu okubagira nikingasira ki? Abafu obubatahumbuka turye, tunywe, baitu turafa nyenkya.

english: Jesus answered them, “How hard it is for you people to believe! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him to me!”
lunyoro: Yabagarukamu nagamba ati Inywe abobusinge obutarukuikiriza ndihikya nkaha okuikara nainywe? Ndihikya nka nkaha okugumisiriza? Mumulete namberendi.

english: When Jesus said this, all his enemies were put to shame. The whole crowd was filled with joy over all the wonderful things that had happened to him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyagambire ebi abanyanzigwabe bona bakwatwa ensoni: ekitebe kyona kyasemere'rwa ebigambo byona ebyekitinisa ebyakozirwe uwe.

english: You blind fools! You blind guides! Which is the greatest, the most glorious, the most glorious, the gold of the temple that is pure?
lunyoro: Inywe abadomadoma, abafu bamaiso; baitu ekirukukira obukuru kiraha? Ezabu rundi yekaru erukweza ezabu?

english: Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord that what he has said will not be done with you.
lunyoro: Simoni yagarukamu nagamba ati Inywe munsabire hali Mukama waitu, ebigambo ebi ebimugambire bireke okumbaho nekimu.

english: So then, language does not look for those who believe, but for those who do not believe. For the preaching of the gospel does not look for those who do not believe.
lunyoro: Nukwo endimi tibuli bwokuro'raho hali abarukuikiriza, baitu hali abatarukuikiriza: baitu okutebeza tikurukuro'raga hali abtarukuikiriza.

english: But I know you, because I tell you that I don't know him who is a sinner like you, but I know that you obey his teaching.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe numumanya; obundaba ningamba nti tindukumumanyandasisana nkainywe, omubihi baitu numumanya, kandi niwe nkwata ekigambokye.

english: So then, it is not God's will that you want or run away, but God's will that you do.
lunyoro: Nukwo tikiri kyogu anyakwenda, nobwakuba anyakuiruka, baitu kya Ruhanga arukuganyira.

english: Is there anyone who is invited to receive a share of the property? Let him not be invited.
lunyoro: Haroho omuntu ayayeserwe atasazirwe? Aleke okusarwa.

english: And now I tell you, withdraw from these people and stop them from doing this! For this wisdom and this work has come down from human beings and will lead them to destruction.
lunyoro: hati bunu nimbagambira nti Mubarugeho abantu banu, mubaleke: baitu amagezi ganu nomulimo gunu biraba birugire omu bantu, birihwereke'ra:

english: For I tell you, many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see, but they could not, and they would not hear what you hear.
lunyoro: baitu nimbagambira nti Banabi nabakama baingi bakagonza okurora ebimurukurora, tibabibona; nokuhu'ra ebimurukuhu'raga tibabihu'ra.

english: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.
lunyoro: naitwe tuli bakaiso abebigambo ebi: kandi Nomwoyo Ogurukwera Ruhanga ouyabahaire abanyakumworobera.

english: Keep on, then, seeking first the Kingdom, and all these other things will be added to you.
lunyoro: Baitu inywemuse'le obukamabwe, nebi byona biribaga'rwaho.

english: The woman said to him, “I know that the Messiah will come—called Christ—and when he comes, he will tell us everything.”
lunyoro: Omukazi yamugambira ati manyire nti Masiya naija ( ayetwa kristo): obwaliija alitusobo'ra ebigambo byona.

english: About three hours later his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
lunyoro: Kandi esaha nkisatu zihinguireho mukaziwe yatahamu, atamanyire ebyabaireho.

english: But if your brother sins against you by eating, you are not walking in love. Do not destroy him by your eating of the bread that belongs to the Messiah.
lunyoro: Baitu mugnzi wawe rundi aliba natuntura obwebyokurya, iwe tokyagendera omu kugonza. Otamuhwerekereza nebyokurya byawe ogu Kristo ouyahangire.

english: At that very moment he healed many people of sickness, death, and evil spirits; and he opened their eyes to them.
lunyoro: Mu kicu eki akakiza baingi endwara norufu nemizimu emibi; nabafu bamaiso akabaigura amaiso.

english: I request you, not to take them out of the world, but to watch over them because of the evil they do.
lunyoro: Tindukusaba iwe okubaihamu omu nsi, baitu obalinde omu bubi.

english: Jesus said to them, “I am telling you the truth: Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the bread from heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yabagambira ati Mali mali nimbagambira nti Tali Musa yabahaire ebyokurya ebyarugire omu iguru; rundi Isenyowe nuwe abaha ebyokulya ebyamananu ebiruga omu Iguru.

english: At once he went out to the king and prayed, “I want this cup in the head of John the Baptist!”
lunyoro: Ahonaho yarahuka naija hali omukama, yasaba, nagamba ati Ninyenda ompere bunu bunu omurucuba, omutwe gwa Yahana Omubatizi.

english: As the sailors were about to get out of the boat, they lowered the ship into the sea, and as they were trying to trap the ship's crew,
lunyoro: Kandi abalimba obubakaba nibagonza okuiruka omu kyombo, bamazire okuta obwato ha nyanja, nibasisana okwenda okunaga ekinyakusibika ha mutwe gwekyombo,

english: I am happy about you too, because I was not there, so believe, because we are going to him.
lunyoro: Nanyowe mpirirwe habwanyu, baitu nkaba ntaroho, muikirize; baitu tugende namberali.

english: The chief priests and the elders told the crowd to pray and to confess their sin to Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi banyakatagara abakuru nabakuru bakagambi'ra ebitebe okusaba baraba, bahwerekereze Yesu.

english: For this is what the wisdom of God has said: ‘I will send to you prophets and apostles, and some of them will kill and persecute them.’
lunyoro: Kandi Amagezi ga Ruhanga nikyo gambire ngu Ndituma nambere bali banabi nabakwenda; abamu hali abo balibaita, balibahiga;

english: The Lord said to him, ‘Well done, good servant! You faithful servant! You have been faithful even in little things, and I will leave you. Here is your king's joy.’
lunyoro: Mukamawe yamugambira Okozire iwe omuiru rubale omurungi; owokwesiga; okaba oli wokwesiga omu bike ndakusigira bingi. Taha mukusemererwa okwomukama wawe.

english: For we are saved by the hope that is seen, but not by the hope that is seen. For the hope that is seen is not hope that is seen, but hope that is seen by those who hope for what they see.
lunyoro: Baitu tukajunwa omu kunihira: baitu okunihira okurukurorwa tikuli kunihiraga: baitu omuntu obwarora, nuwe ayetegereza.

english: So then, everyone who disobeys one of these little ones will be put right with God and will be put right with God in the Kingdom of heaven. And everyone will obey him and teach him, who is the one who will be great in the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: nukwo omuntu wena alisisa ekimu ekyomubiragiro binu ebike, nuwe aryetwa muke mali omu bukama obwomu iguru: kandi wena alibikwata nabyegesa, ogu aryetwa mukuru omu bukAMA obwomu Iguru.

english: The children of your brother's wife have been welcomed by you.
lunyoro: Abana bomugenzi wawe akomerwemu bakuramukize.

english: In this matter I am eager to remain innocent before God and his people forever.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe nyekamba omu kigambo kinu, okuikara nomutima ogutaroho musango hali Ruhanga na hali abantu ebiro byona.

english: The man died, and the angels were gathered to Abraham's tomb. The rich man died and was buried.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika omulegi akafa, yahimbwa bamaraika hali ekifuba kya Iburahimu: omugunda nauwe akafa yazikwa.

english: The sower went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some seed fell along the path, and it was trodden down, and the birds ate it up.
lunyoro: Muhesi akatura okusiga embiboye: obwakaba nasiga, embibo emu yagwa ha muhanda rubaju; yalibatwa, enyonyi ezahagati zagisoma.

english: But I am with you, and no one will come to harm you, because I have many people in this city.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe ndi hamu naiwe, kandi busaho muntu arakuizira okukukora kubi: baitu ndina abantu baingi, omu rubuga runu.

english: Pilate said to him, “Don't you hear what these two men are saying to you?”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati Torukuhu'ra bigambo binu ebibakuhambirize okubiri?

english: “He is your son,” they asked. “He was born blind!” they asked. “Do you now see?” they asked.
lunyoro: barukukukaguza nibagamba ngu Onu nuwe mwana wanyu oumwazairwe omufu wamaiso? Hati bunu nahweza ata?

english: If your eye causes you to lose sight of you, you will be able to see it. It is better for you to enter the Kingdom of God than for you to have one eye thrown into hell,
lunyoro: Kandi eriso ryawe obulikwesitaza, oliihemuga; hakire iwe okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga oyina eriso limu, okukira okunagwa omu Gehene, oyina amaiso gombi;

english: From there we sailed around and arrived at Rhegium. The next day a south wind blew around, and on the next day we came to Puteoli.
lunyoro: Kandi okurugayo twayehinguliriza, twahika Legio: kandi ekiro kimu obukytahinguireho, embeho eyobukizi obwoburyo yatera, kandi na kiro ekyakabiri TWAHIKA Puteoli:

english: The thief will not come, but steal, kill, and steal. I came that they may have life, and may have it in abundance.
lunyoro: Omusuma taija, rundi okuiba, nokuita, nokuhwerekereza: Nyowe nkaija zibe nobwomezi, kandi zibe nabwo obwingi:

english: Do not waste your time doing the work of God's servants because of food. All is well, because it is bad for the person to eat and to drink.
lunyoro: Otasisa omulimo gwa Ruhanga habwebyokurya. Byona bisemire; baitu kiba kibi hali ogu anyakurya nagarukyagurukya.

english: There was also a document in his mouth that said, “He is the King of the Jews.”
lunyoro: Ha ruguruwe hakaba haroho nekihandiko ngu NUWONU MUKAMA WABAYUDAYA.

english: I tell you that there are some here who will not die until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira mali nti Haroho hali banu abemerire hanu abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhikya obubalirora Omwana womuntu naija omu bukamabwe.

english: When Jesus went into the house, he said to him first, “Simon, what do you think? The kings of the earth receive taxes or taxes from their children or from the Gentiles?”
lunyoro: Yataha omu nju, Yesu yamubanza okugamba ati Notekereza ota, Simoni? Abakama abensi nibahebwa ehozo rundi omusoro omu Bantu ki? omu bana babu, rundi omu banyaihanga?

english: For I have sent you, my friends, so that our boasting about you has not been lost in this matter. Be ready, just as I have told you.
lunyoro: Baitu nkatuma bene baitu, okwenyumiza kwaitu habwanyu kutaba kwabusa omu kigambo kinu: nkokunagambire, inywe mwetekanizege:

english: For if Abraham were to be put to the test by works, he would have to boast about the things he did, because he did not have God's approval.
lunyoro: Kakuba Iburahimu yaihibweho omusango obwemirimo, yakubaireho ebyokukwenyumiza; baitu tanyinakyo hali Ruhanga.

english: I tell you that all these things will happen to you because of this peace.
lunyoro: mazire okugamba nti Ebigambo binu byona biribahikaho habwobusinge bunu.

english: So then, those who are not God's people reject anyone, but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Nukwo arukwanga, tayanga omuntu, baitu Ruhanga, arukubaha inywe Omwoyogwe Ogurukwera.

english: And he commanded us to tell the people and to testify that he is the one whom God has appointed judge between the living and the dead.
lunyoro: Kandi akaturagira okutebeza abantu, nokub bakaiso ngu nuwogu Ruhanga ouyataireho okucwera omusango abomezi nabafu.

english: The earth helped the woman, the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the wine that had been poured out of her mouth.
lunyoro: ensi yakonyera omukazi, ensi yayasama akanwa kayo, yanywa ekyambu ekijoka ekikyatanakire omu kanwa kakyo.

english: The Son of Man will come in the same way as the Scriptures say he will, but how terrible for that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born!”
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu nagenda, nkokukyamuhandikirweho: baitu zirimubona omuntu ogu aragobeza Omwanawomuntu! kyakubaire kirungi hali omuntu ogu kakuba atarazairwe.

english: After spending some eight or ten days in Caesarea, Paul left, and the next day he sat down in the judgment hall and ordered Paul to be brought.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazireyo owabu ebiro ebitakizire munana rundi ikumi, yasirimuka Kaisaliya; kandi obuire obubwakire nyenkya yaika'ra ha kitebe ekicwerwaho emisango, yaragira okuleta pauro.

english: Jesus said to them, “I have been with the crowd for three days now, but they have not enough to eat.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Ninganyira ebitebe, baitu hati bunu ebiro bisatu baikaire nanyowe, kandi tibanyina byokurya:

english: I tell you, that Day two will be in one book, one will be taken away and the other will be lost.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Ha kiro eki baliba babiri ha kitabu kimu; omu alitwarwa, ondi alisigwa.

english: The Jewish authorities said to him, “Now we know that he has a demon, and Abraham died and the prophets. And you say that whoever obeys my teaching will never die.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bamugambira ngu Hati bunu twetegerize ngu aroho omuzimu, Iburahimu akafa nabanabi; naiwe nogamba oti omuntu obwakwata ekigambo kyange taliroza ha kufa ebiro nebiro.

english: You are the ones who belong to Christ, the descendants of Abraham. You are the ones who are called by the promise to buy.
lunyoro: Kandi muraba muli ba Kristo, muli muijukuru wa Iburahimu, nabagwetwa nkomurago okuguli.

english: Now you are God's people, but you have not been forgiven, but now you have been forgiven.
lunyoro: ira abakaba bataganyirwe, baitu hati bunu muli bantu ba Ruhanga:

english: Even if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot last.
lunyoro: Obukiraba enju ebaganizibwemu yonka, enju egi tesobora kuikaraho.

english: Jesus said to them, “Watch out, and do not let anyone know this.”
lunyoro: Yabatere'ra muno ati Mwerinde, omuntu wena aleke kukimanya.

english: Those who swear by the altar, swear by it, and do not swear by it, but by the gift that is in them.
lunyoro: kandi anyakurahira ekyoto, tikirikigambo; baitu anyakurahiza ekisembo ekiroho, buli agwerirwe omusango.

english: Jesus said to them, “Pay back to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor and to God.” They were very surprised at him.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muheyoga hali Kaisali ebya Kaisali, na Ruhanga ebya Ruhanga. Bamuhuni'ra muno.

english: But let the words of the youth come back to you, and you must seek righteousness, faith, love, and peace, with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
lunyoro: Baitu okwegamba okwomu busigazi okuirukege; baitu ohonderege okuhiki'ra, nokuikiriza, nokugonza, nobusinge, hamu nabo abakunga Mukama waitu omu mutima ogusemezibwe.

english: A large crowd of people was eating on the hillside, and he begged Jesus to send them into the pigs. So he sent them away.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho igana ryempunu enyingi nizirya ha rusozi: kandi ekamwesengereza agyohereze okuzitahamu. Yagyohereza

english: If anyone thinks he knows anything, he does not know it at all, just as he ought to know it.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaba nayetekereza amanyire ekigambo, tamanyire na kake, nkokukimusemerire okumanya;

english: With him we sent a brother who is highly respected in all the churches.
lunyoro: Kandi tukatuma hamu nauwe mwene waitu anyakusimwa omu kanisa zona;

english: You have condemned and killed the righteous one, and he will not fight against you.
lunyoro: Mukacwa omusango, mwaita ogu ahikirire; tarukurwana nainywe.

english: For through Christ Jesus you have become God's servants, who have been the ones who have become God's servants, the people who are righteous, the people who are made perfect, the people who are made alive, and the people who are being saved.
lunyoro: Baitu muli habwogu omu Kristo Yesu, ayafokere halitwe amagezi okuruga hali Ruhanga, nokuhiki'ra, nokusemezebwa, nokucungurwa:

english: For by his grace we all have been made perfect, and by his grace we have been brought into being.
lunyoro: Baitu okuijurakwe itwena nukwo twahairweho, nembabazi omu kiikaro kyembabazi.

english: I speak with all my heart about you and about my great boasting about you. I am filled with comfort and am filled with joy because I have been filled with all our troubles.
lunyoro: Ngamba nobumanzi bwingi halinywe, nokwenyumiza kwange kwingi habwanyu: nyijuire okuhumuzibwa nsagire muno, omu mihito yaitu yona.

english: For whoever has will be given away, and whoever has will be taken away away from him. But whoever has not seen, will be given away even what he has.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakuina alihebwa, kandi alisagisaho, baitu wena atanyina aliihwaho nekyanyinakyo.

english: One of the elders said to me, “Don't cry! Look! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the descendant of David, has opened the scroll and its seven seals.
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abakuru yangambira ati Ota'ra, dora, entale eyomu ruganda rwa Yuda, ekikoro kya Daudi, akasuku'ra ekitabu nemanyikirizo zakyo omusanju.

english: But if your eye causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away from you. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes thrown into the fire of hell.
lunyoro: Baitu eriso ryawe obuliriba nirikutabaijura, oliihemu, olinage hara: kikusemerire okutaha omu bwomezi onyina eriso limu, okukira okunagwa omu Gehena eyomu'ro namaiso abiri.

english: Pilate spoke again to them, trying to stop Jesus.
lunyoro: Pirato yagaruka okubagambira, nayenda okulekera Yesu;

english: They stoned Stephen to death and prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
lunyoro: Bamutera amabale Sitefano, uwe nasaba nagamba ati Mukama wange Yesu, twara omwoyo gwange.

english: They were all filled with rage, and they ate a meal with them.
lunyoro: Kandi bona baguma emitima, nabo bakwata ha byokurya.

english: Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
lunyoro: Kandi Musa na Eriya bakababonekera nibabaza nauwe.

english: But even though the angels were stronger and more powerful, they did not appear to you before the Lord.
lunyoro: baitu bamaraika nobubaraba nibakira amani nobusobozi tibarukubabiriki'ra omu maiso ga Mukama.

english: Even though the loaves were all four thousand, how many baskets did you take up?
lunyoro: Kandi emigati hali abo enkumi ina, nebigega okubikaba biri ebimwasolize.?

english: For by the sufferings of Christ you will be glad, and you will be glad with great joy in the revelation of his glory.
lunyoro: baitu obwokuterana omu kubonabonesebwa kwa Kristo, nukwo musemererwe; kandi ha kusuku'rwa kwekitinisakye inywe musemere'rwe nokukyanganuka kwingi muno.

english: How terrible for you, who are now hungry! How terrible for you who weep now! You will cry and cry!
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abaigusire hati bunu, baitu mulirumwa enjara. Ziribabona inywe abarukuseka hati bunu; baitu mubihirwa, muli'ra.

english: There was a large crowd of people eating there.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho igana ryempunu lingi nizirya.

english: God, who knows what is in their hearts, was watching them when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he gave us.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga, arukumanya omutima, akabali kaiso wabu obuyabahaire Omwoyo Ogurukwera, nkokuyatuhaire naitwe;

english: But if he divorces his wife, he cannot be free from her, nor can he go in to her. And a man must not divorce his wife.
lunyoro: baitu obwaryahukana aikalehoga okutaswerwa, rundi aterane niba; kandi omusaija atalireka mukaziwe.

english: And God, who by his grace has poured out his eternal glory into union with Christ, will bring you into being, he will make you firm, and strengthen you.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga owembabazi zona, ayabetire ekitinisakye ekyebiro nebiro omu Kristo, nuwe alibahikiriza, alibagumya, alibaha amani.

english: The Jewish authorities said, “We have no right to kill anyone.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagamba ngu Kitaturagirwe kuita muntu wena.

english: But many of them did not welcome God, because they were kept safe in the desert.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi halibo Ruhanga atabasime: baitu bakahwerekerexebwa omu irungu.

english: God was with them by means of a vision, visions, wonders, and the gifts of the Holy Spirit, just as he had promised.
lunyoro: hati Ruhanga nafoka kaiso hamu nabo omu kwolekwa, nebyamahano, nebyamani bingi, nomu bisembo Ebyomwoyo Ogurukwera nkokuyagondeze wenka.

english: The desires for this world, its passions, and its desires are clearly seen by the things in the world.
lunyoro: Kandi okwegomba okwomunsi, nokwegomba okundi, nibitangwa, binyoroza ebigambo ebinyakuli omunsi:

english: You fool! When you were made perfect by the Spirit, were you now made perfect by the Spirit?
lunyoro: Inu abantu abadomadoma, obumwabandize omu Mwoyo, hati bunu numuhikirizigwa omu mubiri?

english: But Paul was very upset, and he turned around and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ I order you to come out of her!” At that very moment Paul left her.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro obuyabihirwa muno, yahinduka nagambira omuzimu ati Ninkuragira omu ibara rya Yesu Kristo murugeho. Kandi gwamurugaho omu kasumi ako.

english: This temptation did not come from the one who prayed.
lunyoro: Okuhambirizibwa kunu kutaruge hali ogu ayabesere.

english: So then, if we are given the Kingdom that cannot be shaken by God's will, we must obey him with reverence and awe
lunyoro: Nukwo obutuhabwa obukama obukama obutalihwaho, Ruhanga nkokwagonza, tumuhu'lege omu kwerinda nokutina

english: Do not boast about the things you boast about, but be boast about them; instead, be proud, but be proud, not on your own authority, but on your own authority.
lunyoro: Muleke okwenyumiza inywenka, baitu hakire musimege: baitu oraba noyenyumiza, tali iwe ohimbire ekikoro, baitu ekikoro nikyo kihimbire iwe.

english: They left the tomb in fear and with great joy, and ran to tell the disciples.
lunyoro: Baruga ha kituro nokutina nokusemererwa okwingi, bairuka okutebeza abegeswabe.

english: While he was saying this, a man came to the commander of the synagogue and said, “Your daughter is dead.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba nakigamba, hakaija omu anyakurgire omba omukuru wiso'rokaniro nagamba ati Omuisiki wawe afire;

english: In what way can all of you be helped? The disciple is not above his master's authority, but only in his own proper order.
lunyoro: Omwegeswa takira obukuru omwegesawe, baitu wena obwalikahiki'ra, alisisana nomwegesawe.

english: After reading this, Jesus asked his mother, “Do you know that she is a Galilean?”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okusigisoma, yakaguza isazarye okuliri, obuyamumanyire okuba Omunyakirikiya, yagamba ati

english: Some of them started to argue, “I am not going to come to you.”
lunyoro: kandi abamu nibehemba nibatekereza ngu nyowe tindukugenda okuija namberemuli:

english: Jesus said to them, “How good it is to do evil on the Sabbath! To save lives or to kill?” But they did not give up.
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Kisemire ha kiro kya Sabiti okukora okubi? Okukiza obwomezi, nandiki okuita? Baitu bahuna kwanka.

english: The disciples said to him, “It is not right to marry unless the man and his wife first say the same thing.
lunyoro: Abegeswa bamugambira ngu Ebigambo ebyomusaija na mukaziwe biraha biri biti, tikiri kirungi okuswera.

english: I came to set fire to you on the earth, and if it is already kindled, what do I want?’
lunyoro: Nkaija okubaga omu'ro hansi; kandi obuguraba gwakire hati nyowe ninyenda ki?

english: If we died with Christ, we believe also that we shall also live with him.
lunyoro: Kandi turaba twafire hamu na Kristo, tuikirize kandi ngu Kristo, Kristo, kandi turyomera hamu nauwe:

english: A tree of life will bear fruit, and a tree that bears figs will bear fruit every month.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, omuti ogwobwomezi gukabyaramu ebyana byagwo, namababi gagwo buli kwezi.

english: In your endurance you have increased your lives.
lunyoro: Omu kuguma kwanyu numwo murakizaga obwomezi bwanyu.

english: For just as the Father has life in himself, he gave him life in himself.
lunyoro: baitu nka insenyowe okwanyina obwomezi omuruwe, nukwo yamuhaire ati Omwana okuba nobwemezi omwogu:

english: For the promise is to you, to your children and to all who are far away, all who are looking to the Lord our God.
lunyoro: Baitu omurago guli halinywe ha hali abana banyu na hali bona abali hara muno, nibo bona Mukama Ruhanga waitu abarayetaga.

english: Then Jesus said to them, “Pay back, then, to the Emperor what belongs to God.”
lunyoro: Yabatebeza ati Nukwo muheyoga hali Kaisali ebya Kaisali, na hali Ruhanga ebya Ruhanga.

english: He who says he remains in union with him is righteous also by himself to go as he has.
lunyoro: anyakugamba ati aikaire omuruwe kumuhikirire nauwe wenka okugendaga nkogu okuyagendaga.

english: When Mary came to Jesus and saw him, she fell at his feet and said to him, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
lunyoro: Maryamu obuyaizire Yesu namberali namubona, yagwa hansi ha bigerebye, namugambira ati Mukama wange, kakuba okaboli hanu munyany nyowe tiyakufire.

english: And that is why he saved them. I will tell you the things that I have told you, whether you have obeyed me properly or not.
lunyoro: kandi niyo yabahasize okujunwa; nimbamanyisa ebigambo ebinabatebize, rundi obumubikwata kurungi rundi muraba mwaikiririze busa.

english: While Gallio was a descendant of Achaia, the Jews stirred up Paul and brought him before the judgment court.
lunyoro: Baitu Galio obwakaba ali owisaza rya Akaya, Abayudaya baimuki'ra Pauro nomutima gumu, bamuleta hali ekitebe ekicwerwaho emisango,

english: They were the ones who told us about our coming to you, and when you turned from your sins to serve the living God,
lunyoro: Baitu nibo barukutebeza ebyaitu okutaha kwaitu namberemuli okukukaba kuli; kandi okumwahindukire Ruhanga numuleka ebisisani, okuko'raga Ruhanga omwomezi,

english: But they did not understand the meaning of the loaves, and their hearts were dull.
lunyoro: baitu ebyemigati batabyetegereze, kandi emitima yabu ekaba egumangaine.

english: When Paul wanted to go into the crowd, the disciples did not believe him.
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro obuyayenzire okutaha omu bantu, abegeswa batamuikirize.

english: and the graves were opened, and many bodies of the righteous who had been crucified were raised to life.
lunyoro: nituro zakingurwa: emitumbi mingi eyabahikirire abakaba bagwijagire yahumburwa;

english: But the tax collector standing at a distance did not want to raise his eyes to heaven, but cried out in a loud voice, “God has made me clean!”
lunyoro: Kandi omuzinisa, ayemerire hara, atagonze kuimukya amaisoge haiguru, baitu aketeratera omu kifuba nagamba ati Ruhanga onganyire nyowe omusisi.

english: They were all amazed and said to one another, “What is this? The new teaching!” He ordered power, the evil spirits, and they heard it.
lunyoro: Bahuni'ra bona, nibakaguzangana ngu Kiki kinu? Okwegesa kuhyaka! Naragira nobusobozi nemizimu emibi, nemuhu'ra!

english: “Sir,” they answered, “we remember that evil man who was alive said, “I will rise three days later.”
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Mukuru, tuijukire omubihi ogu akagamba, obwakaba ayomire, ati Ebiro obubirikahinguraho bisatu ndihumbuka.

english: You will be blessed, because they have nothing to give to take away from you, but you will be repaid for the resurrection of the righteous.
lunyoro: Kandi olihebwa omugisa; baitu tibanyina kyokukugaru'ra, baitu olirigaru'rwa ha humbuka kwabahikirire.

english: The woman had suffered from a flow of blood twelve years, and she had spent all her time with the guards, but could not be told anything.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi akaba arwaire ekyejwiso ekyesagama emyaka ikumi nebiri, ayamazire okuhayo itungorye ryona hali abafumo, kandi atasobole kutambirwa wena,

english: But if you have heard him and have been taught by him, you have the truth as found in Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu obumuraba mwamuhulire, kandi nimwegesebwa omuruwe, nkamazima okugali omu Yesu:

english: Jesus said to him, “What do you want me to do?” The blind man said to him, “Listen, I want to see again.”
lunyoro: Yamuagarukamu nagamba ati Noyenda nkukole ki?Yamugambira ati Raboni, ningonza mpweze.

english: The one who invited you and the one who invited you came and said to him, ‘Give thanks to this man!’ Then you will be embarrassed to take the last seat.
lunyoro: Kandi ogu ayesere iwe noli aija nakugambira ati Higiza onu; nubwo olibanza nensoni okukwata ekiikaro ekyenyuma.

english: For you must be the Messiah.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe mutege muti Kristo.

english: The tax collectors hated the tax collectors and the same was true of them.
lunyoro: Nabasisi bahora abasisi, nukwo nahebwe bati.

english: It is better for us to think about the things that he has heard or to stop them from being destroyed.
lunyoro: Itwe kituhikirire okukira muno okutekereza kimu ebi ebyahulirwe, rundi tuleke obubiihwaho.

english: It is good for a man to suffer many things.
lunyoro: Kisemire omuntu ogu okubonabonesebwa baingi;

english: For no one can separate himself from his own body, but he must keep himself safe, just as the Christ also did in the church.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho omuntu aranobere omubirigwe wenka, baitu agulisa nagulinda, nka Kristo nauwe okwagira ekanisa;

english: It is not because of lack of authority that we have given ourselves over to you, but because of the way you have seen us.
lunyoro: Tibuli obwokutaba nobusobozi, baitu tweheyo itwenka namberemuli nkekyokuro'raho, muhondere omulingo gwaitu.

english: They will see their ears open to the truth, and they will not follow their own stories.
lunyoro: baligara amatu gabu okulega amazima, balihaba okuhondera enganikyo kwonka.

english: He heard Paul speak, and so he fixed his eyes on him and saw that he had faith in him to be healed.
lunyoro: Ogu, akahu'ra Pauro nagamba: nauwe yamugumyaho amaiso, narora ayina okuikiriza okukizibwa,

english: Peter opened his mouth and saw what had happened. The men who had been sent to Cornelius asked him, “Where is Simon's house?” They stood at the door.
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obuyagurukizegulikize omundaye amakuru agokwolekwa okuyaboine, dora, abasaija abatumirwe Koruneryo obubamazire okukaguza enju ya Simoni eraha, bayeme'ra ha ruigi,

english: When the sun was setting, they brought to Jesus all the sick and the demons.
lunyoro: Orwebagyo, izoba ligwire, bakamuletera abarwaire bona, nabo abakaba baroho emizimu.

english: Jesus said to them, “What are you talking about? The people were sitting there with their eyes full of pity.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Bigambo ki binu ebimurukubaza numugenda? Bayeme'raho bayina amaiso agobujune.

english: The next day, however, he wanted to know more about what the Jewish authorities had told him, so he left him and told the chief priests and the whole Council to meet with him, and he took Paul aside and put him in front of them.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obubwakire nyenkya, obuyagondeze okumanya amananu ebigambo Abayudaya ebibamulegeseze, yamuboho'ra, yaragira banyakatagara abakuru nabomurukurato bona okugoma hamu, kandi yasirimura Pauro, yamutaomu maiso gabu.

english: So after Jesus had been raised from death, his disciples remembered that he had said this, and they believed what the Scriptures say and what Jesus had said.
lunyoro: Nukwo obuyamazire okuhumbuka omu bafu, abegeswabe baijuka akagamba eki; baikiriza ekyahandikirwe nekigambo Yesu ekiyagambire.

english: The next day a large crowd of people standing by the lake saw that there was no other boat, not even one, and Jesus did not go into the boat with his disciples.
lunyoro: obuire obubwakire nyenkya abekitebe abayemerire nseri yenyanja obubaboine ngu busaho bwato bundi, rundi bumu, kandi Yesu tagwerire omu bwato hamu nabegeswabe,

english: Do not give up the gift that has been given to you by the prophets and put your hands on the elders.
lunyoro: Otaleka ekisembo ekiri omuliwe ekyakuhairwe omu byabanabi hamu nokutaho emikono yabakuru.

english: I will tell you these things, just as I told you at the beginning, that those who do these things will not be put right with the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: mazire okubagambira inywe ebigambo binu, nkokunabandize okubahabura nti abakora ebirukusisa biti tibaligwetwa obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: The man who had been sick for a long time threw himself down to the ground, and the world was filled with violence.
lunyoro: Ogu akaba aikalire ha kicu, yanaga akagesoke hansi, ensi yageswa.

english: Jesus began to say to them, “The things that are written in this book will now be fulfilled in your hearts.”
lunyoro: Kandi yabanza okubagambira ati Hati ebyahandikirwe binu bihikirizibwe omu matu ganyu.

english: But listen to him, whether in heaven or on earth, whether by means of a snake or by birds or by birds or by birds;
lunyoro: Baitu kinu nikyo kinu, inywe mukimanye, nobumuraba numuculera iguru, rundi okunihira ente,

english: and he saw it and said to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not believe that you are talking about me.’
lunyoro: hangahire, oruge bwango Yerusalemu: baitu tibaliikiriza obwolitebeza ebyange.

english: But the king answered, ‘You are a good and healthy servant. You know what I do not do, and I will gather before I leave.’
lunyoro: Baitu omukamawe yagarukamu namugambira ati Oli muiru rubale omubi omugara, okamanya ngesa namber ntaratemire, nsoroza mbere ntarasigire;

english: Paul defended himself, “I have done nothing wrong with the Jewish Law, the Temple, and the Emperor.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yayetonganira ati Tinkasisaga na kake ebiragiro Byabayudaya, nobwekuba yekaru, nobwakuba Kaisali.

english: The disciples of John and the Jewish authorities started to argue about the matter of giving thanks to God.
lunyoro: Abegeswa ba Yohana bakatera empaka hamu Nomuyudaya omu bigambo byokusemeza.

english: Jesus said to him, “Don't be afraid of him, for no one will be able to stop him from doing what I am doing in my name.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamugambira ati Mutamutanga: baitu busaho muntu alikora ekyamani omu ibara ryange, alisobora bwango okunjuma.

english: But when he was being insulted, he did not insult, but committed himself to the one who judges the rights of others.
lunyoro: baitu obuyabonabonesibwe tiyakanga; baitu akehayo wenka hali ogu arukucwa omusango ogwoburyo:

english: Jesus said to them, “The time will come when you will drink, and then you will be baptized in the same way.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Nkaha nyowe? Yesu yabagambira ati Empwahwa nyowe eyindinywaho niyo muliginywaho; nokubatizibwa okumbatizibwamu nukwo mulibatizibwa:

english: Those who do not eat do not eat unless they wash their hands before eating, and those who do not eat do not follow, because God has accepted them.
lunyoro: Anyakurya aleke okuburanganiza atarukurya: kandi atarukuryaga aleke okuhende'ra anyakurya: baitu Ruhanga amuikirize.

english: In the same way, you too should think that you have died a sin, because you live with God through Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Nukwo nanywe mwetekerizege inywenka muferire kimu hali ekibi, baitu muli bomezi hali Ruhanga omu Kristo Yesu.

english: Go to the village ahead of you. As you go into the town, you will find a colt tied up and untie. Untie it, and bring it on.
lunyoro: Mugende omu kika ekiri omu maiso ganyu; obumurakataha omu murasanga omwana gwenkaina gusibikire, ogutakatembwahoga muntu: mugusibu're mugulete.

english: When we all came to the earth, I heard a voice saying in Hebrew, ‘Saul, Saul! Why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to whip me up on the cross.’
lunyoro: Kandi obutwagwire hansi itwena, nahu'ra iraka nirigambira omu rulimi Oruheburaniya liti Sauro, Sauro,, nompiganira ki? Nikikulemera iwe okusamba ha mihunda.

english: The messengers went back home and found a donkey tied up.
lunyoro: abo abatumirwe, obubagarukireyo omu nju, basanga omuiru rubale ayomire.

english: The woman fled from the desert, where she had a place prepared by God, so that she might be delivered to him for a thousand and sixty days.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi yairukira omu irungu, nambere ayina ekiikaro ekyatekanizibwe Ruhanga, nukwo bamulisizege oku ebiro rukumi mu bibiri mu nkaga.

english: For I said, ‘Yes, Lord!’ but no sin has ever entered my mouth.
lunyoro: Baitu nagamba nti Nangwa Mukama wange: baitu ekintu ekyomuziro tibikatahaga omu kanwa kange.

english: Jesus said to them, “I tell you this parable: you will save the king by your own power. All we have heard from Capernaum is done here and here in your country.”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mananukwo murancwera orufumo runu, Omufumu oyejune wenka: byona ebitwahulire bikolirwe Kaperenamu, obikolere na hanu omu nsi yowanyu.

english: So when the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples, they got into the boat and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi ebekitebe obubaboine Yesu taroho, nobubakuba abegeswabe, nabo bagwe'ra omu bwato baija Kaperenaumu nibase'ra Yesu.

english: Jesus spoke to them in a loud voice, as he was able to hear them.
lunyoro: Yagamba nabo ekigambo omunfumo nyingi nkezi, nkokubasoboraga okukihu'ra:

english: The secrets of his heart are revealed, and so he goes on to the earth and worships God, saying, “Surely God is with you.”
lunyoro: nsita ezomu mutimagwe zisuku'rwa, kandi nukwo ajumara hansi naramya Ruhanga, nayatura ati Mazimakwo Ruhanga ali omulinywe.

english: They kept this saying to themselves, “What will be the death of the dead?
lunyoro: Kandi bakalinda ekigambo eki, nibakaguzangana bonka ngu Okuhumbuka omu bafu kuliba kufa?

english: Have we ever seen you sick or come to see you?
lunyoro: kandi tukakuroradi orwaire, rundi omunkomo ntuija ntukurora?

english: Why didn't you give me my money to the poor, and when I arrived, they gave me back my money with money.
lunyoro: Kikaba kitalikyo okuhayo erupiya zange hali abasagisa, nanyowe obunkuizire bakumpaire eyange hamu namagoba.

english: A Canaanite woman came out of her house and cried out in a loud voice, “Son of David! Have mercy on me, Lord! My daughter has a demon!
lunyoro: Kandi dora, omukazi Omukanani akaruga omu mitano egi, yayamio'ra haiguru nagmba ati Onganyire, ai Mukama wange, iwe Omwana wa Daudi: omuisiki wange akwasirwe muno omuzimu.

english: For you are a great help, but no one else will be built up.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo iwe osima kurungi, baitu ondi tayombekwa.

english: But love your enemies and do good to them, so that you will be kept safe and do not let them lead you into temptation. Your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High, because he is kind toward the ungrateful and the wicked.
lunyoro: Baitu mugonzege abanyanzigwa banyu, mubagirege okurungi, muboholege, okutalekayo okunihira; empera yanyu eriba nyingi, nainywe muliba bana bogu anyakuli haiguru muno; baitu abagira kurungi abatasima nababihire.

english: The official who was standing there said, “I am the man who was the Son of God.”
lunyoro: Omunyakihanda akaba amwemerereho ati obwomezi, yagamba ati Mananukwo omuntu onu abaire Mwana wa Ruhanga.

english: In the same way I run, not as though I were a thief. In the same way, I tell you, not as a thief, but as a thief.
lunyoro: Nikyo nyiruka nti, tikuli nkanyakuhabahaba:nukwo ndwana nti, tukuli nkanyakutera masa:

english: But if you do good to him, you endure suffering for his sake, because God is pleased with you.
lunyoro: baituobumukora kurungi numubonabonesebwa numugumisiriza, nikyo kirukusimwa hali Ruhanga.

english: You have seen and heard that not only in Ephesus but also in all Asia, that Paul has turned away and turned many people away, saying, “They are not God's people, but those who are working with their hands.
lunyoro: Kandi muboine, muhulire tihali Efeso honka, baitu nkomu Asiya yona, Pauro ogu ahinduire, ahabisize abantu baingi, nagamba ati Tibali baruhanga, abakozirwe nemikono:

english: When the eleven o'clock arrived, they were given one silver coin.
lunyoro: Kandi abesaha eyaikumi nemu obubaizire, bakahebwa omuomu edinali emu.

english: But Jesus took her by the hand and said to the sky, “Get up, girl!”
lunyoro: Baitu uwe yamukwata ha Mukono nagambira haiguru ati Omuisiki, imuka.

english: The messengers went away and found what Jesus had said to them.
lunyoro: abo abatumirwe bagenda, basanga nkokuyabagambire.

english: But he said, ‘Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the leftovers of the kings.’
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ngu Nukwo, Mukama wange; baitu nobubwa burya oburagarkika oburagara omu rwemo orwa bakama babwo.

english: Jesus answered, “Do you not know the Scriptures or the power of God?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Muhabire, Obwokutamanya ebyahandikirwe nobugakuba amani ga Ruhanga.

english: For we see you in a way that you are able to do, because you are the ones who have been helped by your help and have been helped by your consolations, so that we may be able to endure your sufferings as we suffer.
lunyoro: Baitu tubona omuhito omulinywe, obwokuhumuzibwa okwanyu, nobwokuhumuzibwa kwanyu, okurukuleta okugumisiriza okubonabona naitwe nkokutubonabonesebwa:

english: He sent John to be led into prison
lunyoro: yatuma okucwaho Yohana omu nju yenkomo

english: The false teachers of the Law, who deceived them and turned away from the truth, thought that the way of riches was the way of the truth.
lunyoro: abantu abebisuba, abaihibweho amazima, nibatekereza ngu ogu nuwe muhanda gwitungo:

english: For we cannot stop speaking about the things that we have seen and heard.
lunyoro: baitu itwe titurukusobora okuleka okugamba ebitwaboine nebitwahulire.

english: You, the son of the Devil, are full of deceit and all deceit. You son of the Devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not let the ways of the Lord be lost?
lunyoro: iwe,aijuire obugobya bwona nokusisa kwona, iwe omwana wa Setani arukuzinda okuhiki'ra kwona, tolireka okuhabisa emihanda ya Mukama waitu eterekerire?

english: He has brought blessings to those who are blessed with minds and hearts.
lunyoro: Ahaire omugisa abahigwa omu kutekereza kwomu mutima gwabu.

english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be revealed.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagarukamu nagamba ati akasumi kahikire Omwana womuntu anyumizibwe.

english: But when you go out, pour oil on it
lunyoro: Baitu iwe obworasibaga, wesigege amagita ha

english: and become new in your minds,
lunyoro: kandi mufoke abahyaka omu mutima ogwebitekerezo byanyu,

english: For those who do not know my ways.
lunyoro: Baitu abo batamanye emihanda yange;

english: We preach and teach publicly and teach all people in all wisdom, in order to bring them into being righteous in union with Christ.
lunyoro: kandi nuwe tutebeza, ntuhabura abantu bona, kandi ntwegesa abantu bona omu magezi gona, nukwo tubarange omu omu ahikirire omu Kristo:

english: But Jesus saw it and was moved, and he said to them, “Let the little children come to me; do not try to stop them, because the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu obuyaboine, yabihirwa, yabagambira ati Muikirize abana abato, baije namberendi; mutabatanga: baitu abanyakuli nkabo obukama bwa Ruhanga bwabu.

english: It is God's will that you do it. And because of the insensibility of the grave,
lunyoro: hati, nikyo Ruhanga yagondeze. Kandi obwokutaburwaho ekirahiro

english: While Jesus was coming, the demon began to speak evil of him. But Jesus sent an evil spirit and healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
lunyoro: Obuyaba nagenda, omuzimu gukamutagura kubi. Baitu Yesu yacomera omuzimu omubi, yakiza omwojo, yamugaru'ra ise.

english: For he has given him glory and taken him to a human court.
lunyoro: Baitu akeyihaho ekitinisa, nattwara omu lingo gwomuntu;

english: But many who are going to the same place I have told them many times, and now I am telling you that they are enemies of the cross of Christ.
lunyoro: baitu baingi abarukugenda abanahatebizeho emirundi mingi, na hati bunu nimbatebeza nin'dra amaizi nti nibo nyanyanzigwa bomuti gwa Kristo:

english: So then, have the right to repent, and do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have a descendant of Abraham.’ For I tell you that God is able to raise up these stones to Abraham.
lunyoro: Nukwo mwane ebyana ebirukuseme'ra okwegarukamu, kandi mutabanza okugamba omu nda yanyu ngu Itwe tunyina isenkuruitwe Iburahimu: baitu nimbagambira nti Ruhanga nasobora okufora amabale ganu abana ba Iburahimu.

english: I tell you that Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.
lunyoro: kandi nimbagambiranti na Sulemani omu mutorogwe gwona atajwale nkekitahi kyabyo ekimu.

english: One of them said to him, “Sir, how few are the men who are saved?”
lunyoro: Kandi omu akamugambira ati Mukama wange, abanyakujunwa bake? Yabagambira ati

english: All of us have followed the desires of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the desires, and being the children of the day of wrath and of peace.
lunyoro: hati naitwe itwena twabagenderamuga ira omu kwegomba kwomubiiri gwaitu, ntukora omubiri nebitekerezo ebigonza, ntuikara obwokuzarwa kwaitu abana bekiniga, kandi nkabandi:

english: For it is much more important for you to remain in union with the body.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe okuikara omu mubiri nikyo kirukukira habwanyu.

english: I am telling you the truth: whenever you ask the Father for anything he will give you in my name, he will give it to you.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Obumulisaba Isenyowe ekigambo kyona, alikibaha omu ibara ryange.

english: Whenever you go into a house, go out.
lunyoro: Kandi enju yona eyimurakatahamuga, nuho muirugira.

english: For the flesh is against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; but these are opposed to each other. In this way you will be able to do what you want.
lunyoro: Baitu ---omubiri nugwegomba nugurwana Nomwoyo, kandi Nomwoyo nagurwana nomubiri, baitu ebi nibiuharana; nukwo mulemere muti okukora ebi ebimungonza.

english: Why did a man give you this life for a living?
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu yakuhaireyo ki okucungura obwomezibwe?

english: When I was a sinner, I found in the Temple a man who had no crowd or crowd of people. But there were some Jews who had come from Asia.
lunyoro: kandi obunkaba ndi omwebi, bansanga omu yekaru nyezibwe, ntanyina ekitebe nobukwakuba okutera obwogo: baitu hakaba haroho Abayudaya abamu abarugire omu Asiya,

english: My Father loves me, because I give my life for you and take it away from me.
lunyoro: Isenyowe nikyo angondeza, baitu nyowe mpayo obwomezi bwange, ngaruke mbutwale.

english: and riches will be destroyed because of the abundance of the chosen ones, because the scene of the world will be destroyed.
lunyoro: kandi nomuguda obwokubundazibwa: baitu alihwaho nkorwakyo rwobunyansi

english: But when the voice of your greeting came out of my mouth, the child cried out in my heart with joy.
lunyoro: Baitu dora, iraka eryokuramukya kwawe obulitahirege omu matu gange, omwana yagurukaguruka omu nda yange obwokusemererwa.

english: The people of Nineveh will stand up in judgment with this generation and will condemn it. But they repented of the words that Jonah preached, and, look! someone greater than Jonah is here!
lunyoro: Abantu aba Nineve baryeme'ra omu musango hamu nobobusinge bunu, nibabasingisa omusango: baitu bakegarukamu obwokutebeza kwa Yona; kandi dora, arukukira Yona ali hanu.

english: For the Son of Man will come as a thief, but how terrible for that man who betrays him!
lunyoro: Baitu mananukwo Omwana womuntu nagenda, nkokwali: baitu zirimubona amuntu ogu arukumugobeza!

english: Even now some of God's servants have been asked for mercy.
lunyoro: Nukwo na hati bunu haroho abasagireho, obwembabazi.

english: The Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will give them whatever I have told them.
lunyoro: Omuhumuza, Omwoyo Ogurukwera, Isenyowe owalituma omu ibara ryange., ogu alibegesabyona, alibaikukya byona ebinabagambire,

english: so they persuaded young women to love their husbands
lunyoro: hati abakazi abato okugonzaga baibabo

english: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. They should also be one flock, and they will hear my voice, and they will become one flock, one shepherd.
lunyoro: Kandi nyina entama ezindi ezitali zomu isibiko linu: nazo kinsemerire okuzireta, zirihu'ra iraka ryange; kandi ziriba igana limu; Omulisa omu.

english: For many people make their boast about their own bodies, and so do I.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi nibenyumiriza omu mubiri, nanyowe ninyenyumiza.

english: Those who do not want to obey me do not obey me, and the message that I hear from my Father is not mine.
lunyoro: Atangonza takwata bigambo byange: nekigambo ekimuhu'ra tikiri kyange, baitu kya Isenyowe ayantumire.

english: So then, if you think you are willing to join me, believe just as I am.
lunyoro: Nukwo obworaba notekereza okuterana nanyowe, omuikirize nka nyowe nyenka.

english: How terrible for you! You build the tombs of the prophets, and your ancestors killed them!
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe! Baitu mwombeka ebituro byabanabi, nabaisenkuru inywe bakabaita.

english: Then Jesus took him aside and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a little while.
lunyoro: Kandi yamutembya, yamwoleka obukama bwona obwomu nsi zona omu kike.

english: He led the people out of the city and killed them, and in the prison he had kept them safe.
lunyoro: kandi obuyabaturukize aheru yorubuga yabaitira omu nju yenkomo.

english: Jesus answered, “I will also ask you a question,
lunyoro: Nauwe yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nanyowe ndabakaguza ekigambo;

english: But after you have been invited, go and sit down in the lowest place. When the bridegroom comes, he says to you, ‘Friend, get up in the middle of the meal.’ Then you will have honor in front of all those who sit at the table with them.
lunyoro: Baitu obwoyetwa, ogende oika're omu kiikaro ekyenyuma; ayakwesere obwaija, akugambire ati Mugenzi wange I'ra kuli hagati: nubwo olitunga ekitinisa omu maiso gabu bona aboikalire nabo ha byokurya.

english: A certain teacher came to him and said, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”
lunyoro: Kandi, hakaija omuhandiki omu namugambira ati Omwegesa, ndakukuratiraga horakagenda hona.

english: They went around the upper room, where they were sitting; Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon Zelotes, and Judas son of James.
lunyoro: Kandi obubatahiremu batemba omu kisika ekya haiguru, nambere baikaraga; Petero na Yohana na Yakobo na Andereya, Firipo na Tomasi, Batoromayo na Matayo, Yakobo omwana a Alifayo, na Simoni Zerote, na Yuda omwana wa Yakobo.
