english: He ordered them to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor and to arrest Paul, and to have him brought to Felix.
lunyoro: kandi yaragira babeseru'le ensoro, batembyeho Pauro, kandi bamuhikye obusinge hali Ferikisi omulemi.

english: I tell you, it will not be so unless you all do what you do.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Tikirikyo: baitu obumute'ra muti inywena.

english: But if I do this that I may not be made perfect, and where I am going, then I have nothing to boast about.
lunyoro: Baitu kakuba ninkora okutahiki'ra, nakubaire nempera: baitu obumba ninyenda, tinyina kyokwenyumiza nyenka.

english: And now I beg you, be patient with me, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu nimbesengereza okuguma emitima:baitu tihalibaho omulinywe okubura obwomezi na kake, rundi ekyombo kyonka.

english: You believe that God is one. You have done well, and the demons believe and live.”
lunyoro: Oikirize ngu Ruhanga ali omu: okozire kurungi: kandi Nabasetani nibaikiriza nibatukumira.

english: So Joseph got up from the tomb and did as the angel of the Lord had told him, and he married his wife. He did not know until she had given birth to a son. He got up and worshiped Jesus.
lunyoro: Yusufu yasisimuka omu turotwe, yakora nka maraika wa Mukama okuyamuragire, yagabura mukaziwe; kandi atamumanye okuhikya obuyazaire omwana omwojo, nuwe Yesu.

english: I know that I will stay, and I will stay with you all for your progress and joy of faith.
lunyoro: Kandi obunyetegerize kinu, manyire nti ndiikaraho, kandi ndiikara hamu nainywe inywena obwokukura kwanyu nokusemererwa okwokuikiriza;

english: When the people heard this, they started shouting in their own words.
lunyoro: Kandi obubahulire eki, abekitebe bagoma hamu, nibesami'ra omuomu nibabaza engambo zabu bonka.

english: He touched the man's hand, and the fever left him. He got up and sent him away.
lunyoro: Yamukora ha Mukono, omusuija gwamurugaho, yaimuka, yamuhereza.

english: So Jesus said, “A certain official went into a country far away to pray for his own Kingdom, and he left.
lunyoro: Nikyo yagambire ati Omuntu omukuru omu akagenda omu nsi ya hara okwerira wenka obukama, agaruke.

english: But if it were so, would it be that God would judge the world without a judge?
lunyoro: Kakuba kiri kiti Ruhanga alicwera ata ensi omusango?

english: When he was alone, the people who were around him began to ask him about the parables.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakabali wenka, abo abakaba bamwehingulirize ikumi nababiri bamukaguza enfumo.

english: They left us, because they were not ours; they were ours, and they stayed with us. From there they were shown that not everyone belongs to us.
lunyoro: Bakaruga omulitwe, baitu bakaba batali bowaitu; baitu kaba babaire bowabu, bakuikaire hamu naitwe: baitu bakaturugamu bamanyisibwe okutaba bowabu bonka.

english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are much more concerned with sin than with everyone else.
lunyoro: Kakuba ntunihira omu Kristo omu bwomezi bunu bwonka, itwe twakubaire bokuganyirwa okukira abantu bona.

english: Be sad and weep bitterly, so that your laughter may turn into sadness and your joy may be turned into sadness.
lunyoro: Mutuntule, mutere empamo: mu'le okuseka kwanyu kufoke empamo, nokusemererwa kwanyu kuikale obujune.

english: They did not find him guilty of murder, and they asked Pilate to kill him.
lunyoro: Kandi nobubataraboine musango ogwokumuisa, bakasaba Pirato okumuita.

english: The desire, when it has become fertile, gives birth to sin; and when it has grown, gives birth to sin.
lunyoro: Okwegomba oku obukumara okutwara enda, kuzara okusisa: nokusisa oku obukulikahiki'ra kuzaara okutahiki'ra.

english: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, “Look! Your disciples have done a thing that is not lawful for you to do on the Sabbath.”
lunyoro: Kandi bafalisyo obubaboine bamugambira ngu Dora, abegeswabawe bakozire ekitali kyebiragiro okukora ha Sabiti.

english: Whoever comes to me and hears my words and does them, I will show you the same way.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena anyakuija namberendi, nahu'ra ebigambo byange, nabikora, ndabaleka owarukusisana:

english: Do not be quick to take advantage of anyone; instead, do not be quick to take offense at the sins of others. Instead, be self-controlled in your conduct.
lunyoro: Otaryanguhiriza okutaho omukono omuntu wena, kunu otaliterana nebibi byabantu abandi: werindege wenka omu kusemezebwa.

english: They brought the sick into the streets, and threw dust on their feet and on their feet, and Peter passed by, where some of them believed.
lunyoro: kandi baletaga nomu makute abarwaire, nibababyamya ha mikeka na ha mpinyo, Petero obwarahinguraho baikirize abamu.

english: He cried out in a loud voice, “Stand up straight with your feet!” Again he went away.
lunyoro: Yagamba niraka erihango ati Imuka oyeme're nebigere byawe. Yagaruka yagenda.

english: Oh that you knew the words of peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
lunyoro: Kakuba omanyire iwe na hati ebigambo ebyokubusinge! Baitu hati bunu biserekibwe hali amaiso gawe.

english: So Jesus came to the disciples and found them asleep and said to Peter, “How is it that you will not see me for a little while?”
lunyoro: Yaija hali abegeswa, yabasanga bagwijagire, yagambira Petero ati Rundi timurukusobora okurora nanyowe akacu kamu?

english: After spending forty days and nights, the hungry man was healed.
lunyoro: Amarayo ebiro amakumi ana nyamusana nekiro, enjara yamuruma.

english: My friends, we are now the children of the Spirit, and it has not yet been clearly seen. We know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, because we see him just as he is.
lunyoro: Bene baitu hati bunu tuli bana ba Ruhanga, kandi tikikamanyisibwaga okutuliba. Tumanyire ngu obwalimanyisibwa, tulisisana nkauwe, baitu tulimurora nkokwali.

english: For the good that I want is not what I do, but what I do not want is what I do.
lunyoro: Baitu ekirungi ekindukugonza tikitiri nikyo nkora: baitu ekibi ekintarukugondeza, nikyo ndukukora.

english: The one who comes after me and the one who is my own slave, I do not deserve to receive it.
lunyoro: Nuwogu arukuija enyuma yange norukoba rwenkaitoye tindukuseme'ra okurubiho'ra.

english: King Agrippa, I am going to make my defense before you now because of all the things that I am told by the Jews.
lunyoro: Mpirirwe,omukama Agulipa, baitu ningenda okwetonganira omu maiso gawe hati obwebigambo byona ebinalegerwe Abayudaya:

english: Jesus answered, “If anyone loves me, he will obey my teaching. And my Father will love him, and we will come to him and live with him.
lunyoro: Yesu ygarukamu namugambira ati Omuntu obwangonza alikwata ekigambo kyange: na Isenyowe alimugonza, kandi tuliija namberali, tuliikara nauwe.

english: The child said to him, ‘Sir, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am not fit to be called your son.’
lunyoro: Omwana yamugambira ati Tata, nsisire hali iguru nomu maiso gawe: tinkiseme'ra kwetwa omwana wawe.

english: And every woman who has an unbelieving husband and wants to live with her will not leave her husband.
lunyoro: kandi omukazi wena anyakuina omusaijawe atarukuikiriza, kandi ogu agonza okuikara nauwe, ataleka omusaija we.

english: Jesus said to the man who had the withered hand, “Stand up in the middle of the courtyard.”
lunyoro: Yagambira omuntu akabanyina omukono ogwomere ati Yeme'ra hagati kuli.

english: Then the nations will be shaken, and your anger will come down, the plagues of the judgment of the dead, and the plagues of your servants the prophets, the holy ones, and those who fear your name, the small ones, the great ones, and those who destroy the earth.
lunyoro: Nabamahanga babihirwa, nekiniga kyawe kyaija, nempiko ezokucweramu omusango gwabafu, nezokubaheramu abairu bawe banabi empera yabu, nabarukwera, na bona abarukutina ibara ryawe, abato na bakuru, nabo abahwerekereza ensi.

english: They could not answer him these things.
lunyoro: Kandi batasobole okugarukamu ebigambo ebi.

english: For the world is the Lord's, and its life is its work.
lunyoro: baitu ensi ya Mukama waitu nokuijura kwayo.

english: Those who do this will be given the opportunity to sit down with me and sit down with my Father on his throne.
lunyoro: Anyakusingura ndimuha okuikarra hamu nanyowe okunasinguire, kandi naika'ra hamu na Isenyowe ha kitebekye.

english: Just as Sodom, Gomorrah, and the cities around them were destroyed by the fire of eternal fire.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nka Sodomu na Gomora nembuga ezikaba zihe'raineho obuzayehaireyo omu ngeso zimu, hamu nabo omu busihani, nibakuratira Omubiri gundi, okuzatairweho okuba ekyokuro'raho, nizisalizibwa okubonabona okwomu'ro ogutahwaho.

english: For we speak the wisdom of God in secret, because it is hidden from God, who made the world clean before us.
lunyoro: Baitu ntugamba amagezi ga Ruhanga omu Kyensita, nigo gaserekerwe, Ruhanga agayataireho ira, ensi zona zitakabaireho, obwekitinisa kyaitu:

english: and said, “That is why a man will leave his father and mother and unite with his wife. The two will become one body.”
lunyoro: kandi yagamba ati Omusaija nikyo alirekera ise na nyina atarane na mukaziwe; nabo babiri baliba mubiri gumu?

english: to bring all things together in union with Christ, what is in heaven and what is in the earth.
lunyoro: nukwo asoroze ahamu byona hamu omu Kristo, ebinyakuli omu iguru nebinyakuli hansi;

english: They went into a lonely place in the middle of the night, where no one else could find them.
lunyoro: Bagenda omu bwato omunsita omu kiikaro nambere hatarumu Bantu.

english: The next day Jesus returned to the city and was hungry.
lunyoro: Kandi nyenkya obwakaba nagarukayo ha rubuga, akaba arumirwe enjara.

english: Some of them believed what Jesus had said, and others did not believe.
lunyoro: Nabandi bakaikiriza ebyagambirwe, nabandi bataikirize.

english: and put on the new man, who is being created according to God's will in true righteousness and holiness.
lunyoro: kandi mujwale omuhyaka arukuhangwa Ruhanga omu kuhiki'ra nokwera okwamazima.

english: Happy is the one who fears him and does what is right in all the earth.
lunyoro: baitu omu ihanga ryona ryona, anyakumutina nakora okuhiki'ra nuwe asimwa.

english: He is not a new convert. Instead, he must remain faithful and be put right with the Devil.
lunyoro: tali muhinduki omuhyaka, rundi aleke okwehemba nokugwa omu musango gwa Setani.

english: Then Jesus went out and said to his mother, “What shall I ask you to do?” She answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
lunyoro: Yaturuka yagambira nyina ati Ndasaba ki? Yagamba ati Omutwe gwa Yahana Omubatizi.

english: But if we live in the light as he lives in the light, we share in the blood of his Son, Jesus, who wipes out all sin.
lunyoro: baitu obutugendera omu musana nkauwe okwali omu muusana, tuterana hamu itwenka naitwenka nesagama ya Yesu Omwanawe etwogyaho ebibi byona.

english: It is better to do good on the Sabbath, than to follow a human nature.
lunyoro: Omuntu takira muno entama? Nikyo kirungi okukora okurungi ha kiro ekya Sabiti.

english: Sopater of Berea, the son of Porus, Aristarchus, Secundus, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and the rest of the province of Asia, Tychicus, and Trophimus.
lunyoro: Sofera owa Beroya mutabani wa Puro; Alisitako na Sekundo; na Gayo owa Derebe, na Timoseo, Nabasiya Tuliko na Tirofimo.

english: If I come again, my God will not keep me from being a burden to you, and I will forgive the many who have sinned in the past, so that they will not repent of the evil and the immoral and the good they have done.
lunyoro: kandi obundigaruka Ruhanga wange aleke okumbundaza omu maiso ganyu, nanyowe okuganya obwabaingi abasisire kara, kunu tibayegarukamu obubi nobusihani nokutetanga ebibakozire.

english: When Stephen saw your face, he was moved with pity for me, and I believed in him and saw the clothes of those who had put him to death.
lunyoro: kandi nesagama ya kaiso wawe Sitefano nayoleka okwekamba kwayo, nanyowe nkaba nyemerireho nyikirize, nindinda ebyokujwara byabu abamuisire.

english: Jesus said to them, “I am telling you the truth, and you will obey me.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nimwangira kimu ekiragiro kyange, mukwate engeso zange.

english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb. “You have done great and wonderful things, Lord God Almighty! You are the Holy King! Your ways are upright and true, and you are the Holy One!
lunyoro: Kandi bazina ekizina kya Musa omuiru wa Ruhanga, nekizina Kyomwana Gwentama, nibagamba ngu Ebiwakozire bikuru kandi byamahano, ai Mukama Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona; emihanda yawe ehikirire kandi yamazima, iwe Omukama owaira naira.

english: It forced all the people, the great and the small, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slaves, to be given a crown of honor at their right and at their left.
lunyoro: Kandi kihambiriza bona abato nabakuru, nabaguda nabasege, nabobugabe nabairu, bahabwe enkojo ha mukono gwabu ogwoburyo, rundi ha buso bwabu;

english: And now I am coming soon. Happy is the one who holds firmly to the things that are being told in this book.
lunyoro: Kandi dora ninyija bwango. Ayina omugisa arukukwata ebigambo ebyokuragura ebyomu kitabu kinu.

english: These are the stones which were kept safe by you during the time of your Festival of Unleavened Love, which will be with you. The shepherds send out their flocks without fear. The unripe branches of the water are carried away by the winds, and the unripe trees of the field are choked by the east wind.
lunyoro: Debere zanyu nizo zakubaireho ira omu bugenyi bwanyu obutarukucumitwa, abalisa obubatumira amagana gabu okutatina; amatagi agatarumu amaizi nigatwarwa embeho, nemiti yamatagi eterekerire erukuiragura,

english: The Lord has done this to me in the last days, in order to make me a sign of shame to the people.
lunyoro: Nukwo Mukama ankozire ati omu biro ebiyandoleriremu, okunyihaho ensoni omu bantu.

english: For I am so afraid that I do not know anything about you, because Jesus Christ is the one who was crucified.
lunyoro: Baitu nkamali'ra omu mutima gwange okutamanya kigambo kyona ommulinywe, baitu Yesu Kristo, kandi ogu ayabambirwe ha muti.

english: For the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that night.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro biriija; nomuswezi obwalibaihwaho, nubwo balisiba omu biro ebi.

english: For Christ has appeared in your hearts as Lord, and you have always been ready to answer everyone who asks you about the things that belong to you, for with humility and fear, you have a good conscience.
lunyoro: baitu mweze Kristo omu mitima yanyu okuba Mukama wanyu; mwetekanize ebiro byona okugarukamu omuntu wena anyakubakaguza ebyokyokunihira okuli omulinywe, baitu hamu nobuculezi nokutina: munyina omutima omurungi:

english: When the Jewish authorities saw that the crowd was large, they were filled with jealousy, and they denied what Paul was saying, and they heard it.
lunyoro: Baitu Abayudaya obubaboine ebitebe bingi, baijura ihali, kandi bahakana ebyagambirwe Pauro, nibabijuma.

english: If you know what this means, ‘I want mercy,’ then you have not condemned the blameless.
lunyoro: Kakuba mumanyire amakuru ga kinu ngu Ninyenda embabazi, tibiri byonzira, timwakuhenderire abataroho musango.

english: Some Pharisees who were with him heard this and said to him, “Are we blind too?”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo abandi abakaba bali nauwe nibahu'ra ebigamboebi, bamugambira ngu Naitwe tuli bafu bamaiso?

english: and he says, ‘This is my Son, whom I love very much.’
lunyoro: nirigamba ngu Ogu nuwe Mwana wange oundukugonza, ounsemererirwe muno.

english: I am crucified with Christ, but I live, not with myself, but with Christ. I have life in union with Christ, the Son of the living, who loved me and gave himself for me.
lunyoro: Nkabambwa ha muti hamu na Kristo; baitu nyomire, kunu tali nyowe, rundi Kristo ayomire omuli nyowe; kandi obwomezi obunyinabwo omu mubiri, nyinabwo omu Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanag, ayangondeze, ayayehaireyo wenka habwange.

english: He got up and saw nothing, so they grabbed hold of him by the hand and brought him to Damascus.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaimukire, atabone kintu, bamukwata ha Mukono, bamuleta Damasiko.

english: They were all amazed at all these things that had happened.
lunyoro: bahuni'ra bona obwebigambo ebi ebyabaireho.

english: And so we have done and teach that the Father has sent his Son as Savior of the world.
lunyoro: Naitwe tukakora kandi ntumanyisa ngu Isitwe akatuma Omwanawe okuba Omujuni wensi.

english: They cannot die any more, because they are the children of God, the children of the resurrection.
lunyoro: tikisobora okufa bwakabiri: baitu bainganaingaine nabamaraika; bali bana ba Ruhanga, nibo bana bokuhumbuka.

english: For everyone who asks receives, and whoever seeks will find; and whoever seeks will find; and whoever knocks will be opened.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwasaba, ahebwa; obwase'ra azora; anyakeranga alikingu'rwaho.

english: You are witnesses with God, that we were once holy and righteous before you, and you believed.
lunyoro: Inu muli bakaiso na Ruhanga obutukaba tuliu nokwera nokuhiki'ra hataroho kuhanwa halinywe barukuikiriza:

english: They were so afraid that they said to one another, “Who is this man? The wind and the sea obey him!”
lunyoro: Batina muno muno, nibagambiragana ngu Kandi ogu noha? Baitu ekiyaga nenyanja nibimuhu'ra.

english: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied plainly about you, saying,
lunyoro: Inywe abagobya, Isaya akaragura kurungi halinywe nagamba ati.

english: They were full of all kinds of evil, evil, greed, and greed; they were filled with anger, sexual immorality, greed, and selfishness; the people who gossiped about the Law and the Law were liars.
lunyoro: bajulire kimu okutahiki'ra kwona, nobubi, nomukoijo, nokunoba;baijuire ihali, nobuisi, nokukungana, nebisuba nitima;bagaya abantu ababaza ebihwa, nabageya,

english: For everything that God has born will pass away from the world, and our faith will be made perfect by the means of the end of the age.
lunyoro: Baitu kyona ekyazairwe Ruhanga kisingura ensi: kandi kunu nukwo kusingura okwasinguire ensi, okuikiriza kwaitu.

english: When the great and glorious Lamb is revealed, you will be given a crown of honor that will never fade away.
lunyoro: Kandi Omulisa omukuru obwaryolekwa mulihabwa ekondo eyekitinisa etarukuhotoka.

english: Herod said, “I have John to beheaded, but who is this man I hear these things from you?” He tried to see him.
lunyoro: Herode yagamba ati Yohana nkamucwaho omutwe; baitu ogu noha oundukuhu'raho ebigambo ebi? Kando yase'ra okumurora.

english: The master said to the servant, ‘Go out to the streets and lanes of the city, and invite them in, so that my house may be filled.’
lunyoro: Mukama we yagambira omuiru rubale ati Turuka ogender omu makute nemitano, obahambirize okutahamu, enju yange ijule.

english: But if you do not have the power to kill him, what comes out of him is that you kill him.
lunyoro: Kandi ebinyakuruga omu muntu obubitanyina amani, nibyo bimusisa omuntu.

english: and thought that the riches in Egypt were much more important than the riches in Egypt, because Christ gave up that reward.
lunyoro: atekereza ekijumu kya Kristo okuba obuguda bwingi okukira ebiitungo byomu Misiri: baitu akanihira empera egi.

english: But Jesus turned around and saw her, and he said, “My son, your faith has made you well.” The woman was much more patient than at the beginning.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu obuyahindukire namurora, yagamba ati Mwana wange guma omutima, okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukiriz. Omukazi yakira okwakabiri.

english: He will show you a large upper room furnished and ready.
lunyoro: Kandi araboleka wenka enju enkoto eyahaiguru eyalirwe etekanizebwe.

english: You teach others not to teach yourself. You proclaim, “Don't steal,” do you?
lunyoro: iwe arukwegesa ondi torukweyegesa wenka? iwe anyakutebeza ngu Otaliiba, oiba?

english: They shouted with a loud cry, “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
lunyoro: kandi nibarami'ra niraka erihango, nibagamba ngu Okujuna kube hali Ruhanga waitu, anyakuikalire ha kitebe kyobukama, na hali Omwana Gwentama.

english: Jesus said to him, “Teacher, I have kept all these things from my youth up.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Omwegese, ebi byona nkabikwata okuruga omu buto bwange.

english: At that time two men will be in the field, one will be taken along to the field.
lunyoro: Ha biro ebi abasaija babiri baliba omu musiri; omu alitwarwa omu alisigwa;

english: For God is able to give you all grace, so that you may have all you need at all times to finish your work of doing good.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nasobora okusagisa embabazi zona halinywe; nukwo inywe munyina byona ebimurukuse'ra ebiro byona, muhingurane omu mulimo gwona omurungi:

english: You are doing well in doing what the Lord wants you to do, and you have children in every good deed and know God.
lunyoro: mugenda kurungi nkokukisemerire Mukama waitu obwokusimwa Kwona, nimwana ebyana omu mulimo gwona omurungi, kandi numukanya omu kumanya Ruhanga:

english: Those who had not been found written in the book of the living were thrown into the lake of fire.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena atarazokere ahandikirwe omu kitabu kyobwomezi yanagwa omu nyanja eyomu'ro.

english: He got up and wept bitterly, and he began to wash his feet and to wipe them off with the hair of his head. He bent over his feet and poured oil on them.
lunyoro: yayeme'ra enyuma ha bigerebye na'ra, yabanza okunagaye, nokubisisiriza nisoke ryomutwegwe, namunywegera muno ebigerebye, nabisigaho amagita.

english: But how will they encourage him who did not believe? They will believe in him who did not hear, and they will hear without talking to him.
lunyoro: Baitu balimukunga bata oubatakaikirize? Kandi balimuikiriza bata oubitakahulire? Kandi balihu'ra bata homutebeza atali?

english: For those who are judged must go to that world and the resurrection of the dead, and they will not repent or be destroyed.
lunyoro: baitu abo abatekerezebwa basemerire okuhika omu nsi egi nomu kuhumbuka okwabafu, tibaswera nobukwakuba okujunda.

english: Jesus said to him, “If you can, you can do it! All things are possible for someone who has faith.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Obworaba nosobora! Byona bisoboka hali anyakuikiriza.

english: Don't five sparrows sell for two coins of small value, and not one of them falls to the ground before God?
lunyoro: Ebisirya bitano tibiguramu senti ibiri? Kandi nakatahi kamu konka tikeba omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: God said, “His children will be foreigners in a foreign country, and they will be slaves to them, and will punish them four hundred years.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga akagamba ati abanabe baliba banyaihanga omu nsi yabandi, balibafora abairu rubale, balibagira kubi emyaka bikumi bina.

english: For if the judgment were to be given by God, the judgment would be by means of a different honor.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhereza okwomusango obukuraba kwabaire kwekitinisa, okuhanura nukukira ekitinisa.

english: Jesus said to them, “Take away the man and tell him to be a friend of tax collectors and others. I have brought him to you before you, and I will not be guilty of the crime you accuse him of.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Mundetirege omuntu onu ngu Ahabisa abantu: kandi dora nyowe obu'mukagulirizege muno omu maiso ganyu, timboine musango ha muntu onu omwebi ebimumulegere:

english: If a person is saved, he will be lost, but he himself will be saved, because he has been thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwayekamba okujunwa aliferwa: baitu uwe wenka alijunwa; baitu nkanyakurabire omu mu'ro.

english: He cried out in a loud voice, and the voice came out of his mouth like a roaring lion.
lunyoro: yagambira haiguru muno, iraka likaruga omu kanwake nkentale okwebubura:

english: He found in the Temple those who sold cattle and sheep and cattle and trained them in the field, and they were sitting there.
lunyoro: Yasanga omu yekaru abaguzire ente nentama namiba, nabahingisa efeza baikalire.

english: So then, if I do not know the meaning of the message, I will be like a foreigner to the one who speaks; and if I tell the truth, I will be like a foreigner to me.
lunyoro: Nukwo obundaba ntarukumanya amakuru giraka, ndisisana nkomunyaihanga hali anyakugamba, kandi anyakwegesa aliba nkomunyamahanga namberendi.

english: So then, men and women, who have left the natural creation and have put themselves in the same condition as the woman who was put away by God, have put themselves in the same condition as the woman who was put right with God.
lunyoro: nukwo nabasaija bati obubalekereyo eki omukazi ekyazalirwa, bayaka hamu omu kwezebwa kwabu bonka:babiri omu kwasarwa kwabu, rundi omu kuganyirakwe, abasaija nabakazi baziraga:

english: But there are many who do not listen to those who speak without paying attention to what they say, and there are some who do not understand.
lunyoro: Baitu haliyo baingi abatarukuhu'ra ababaza ebitarumu, kandi abatarukumanya;

english: None of them lost anything, but all who had sold fields or houses and sold them and brought the money and the money.
lunyoro: Kandi omulibo busaho ayasegere kintu; baitu bona abakaba bantungire engonjo, rundi amaju, bakabigura, baleta omuhendo gwebi ebyaguzirwe,

english: For if we say, ‘From human beings,’ we are afraid of the crowd, because they all think that John was a prophet.
lunyoro: Baitu obuturagamba ngu Omu Bantu; ntutina ekitebe; baitu bona nibatekereza Yohana okuba nabi.

english: James became the father of Joseph, who was the father of Mary. He was the father of Jesus, who was called the Messiah.
lunyoro: Yakobo akazara Yusufu, iba Maryamu; ayazaire yesu, ayetwa Kristo.

english: But when they persecute you in one city, turn away from your sins. For I tell you that you will be able to see all the cities of Israel, and the Son of Man will come.
lunyoro: Baitu obubalibahiga omu rubuga rumu, muirukire orundi, baitu mazimakwo nimbagambira nti Tumulihika okuraba omu mbuga zona za Isaleri, Omwana womuntu bwalikaija.

english: The next day they did not recognize the land, because they saw the hand of the sea coming down on the beach and heard that they were able to take the boat away.
lunyoro: Kandi obubwakire nyenkya, batamanyi'le ensi: baitu babona omukono gwenyanja oguroho omwogo ogwomusenyi, kandi bahahura, rundi barasobora okuletayo ekyombo.

english: And my body will be ready for you.
lunyoro: Kandi omubiri gwange nagwo guraikaraga nugunihira:

english: Stand up in the Temple and tell the people all the things that belong to this life.
lunyoro: mweme'le omu yekaru mugambire abantu ebigambo byona ebyobwomezi bunu.

english: Jesus said, “If you try to kill the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I will not do it on my own authority, because the Father has taught me to do the same.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagamba ati obumulikamara okuhanika Omwana womuntu nubwo mulimanya ngu inyowogu, kandi nyowe tinkora habwange, baitu nka Isenyowe okuyanyegeseze nukwo ngamba ebi.

english: Jesus answered, “Neither has this man ever been a sinner to his parents, but God has shown him the work that God has revealed to him.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati onu atasise nobubakuba ba abamuzaire: rundi emirimo ya ruhanga eyolekebwa haruwe.

english: The blind man asked, “What is this? Which one of these three will you prove to be? Which one will be the right one to decide?”
lunyoro: Kandi omunsita ngu ebigambo ebi biribaho li? Kandi akokuro'raho karaha akebi obubiri'sana okuhiki'ra byona?

english: He rescued us from many deaths, and he will rescue us. We hope that he will continue to rescue us.
lunyoro: nuwe yatujunire omu kufa okwingi kuti, kandi alitujuna: nuwe turukunihira ngu aliikara natujuna;

english: The man wanted to go with him, and he took him and killed him, because the Jews in that country knew that he was a Greek father.
lunyoro: Ogu Pauro akamugonza okugenda nauwe; kandi yamutwara yamusara, Obwabayuda abakaba bali omu nsi egi: baitu bona bakamanya ngu ise Muyonani.

english: All these things are for the profit of all the nations of the world, but the Father knows that you need these things.
lunyoro: Baitu ebi byona amahanga hensi nibyo gase'ra: baitu Isinywe amanyire okumutaga ebintu ebi.

english: In the same way, you also must be a good citizen of God's people, who is the head of every nation of priests and priests.
lunyoro: hati nawe omuhikirire omuruwe wenka, anyakuli omutwe gwokulema kwona no-

english: I have seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and I have seen their prosperity. I have come to save them. Come now, and I will send you to Egypt.
lunyoro: Mpulire mali omuhito gwabantu, bange abali omu Misiri, nimpu'ra okusinda kwabu; nsirimukire okubajuna: nukwo oije hati bunu, ndakutuma omu Misiri.

english: So then, if a person boasts about these things, he will be a guest in his tent, which is worthy of the king's service, to prepare for every good deed.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu obwayesemezaho ebi aliba ekibindi ekyekitinisa, ekisemerire omukama wakyo obwokuhereza, ekitekanirize omulimo gwona omurungi.

english: Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David! Praise be to God!”
lunyoro: Buhairwe omugisa obukama obwaija, obwa Isenkuru itwe Daudi: Hosana haiguru muno.

english: When Jesus began to weep, they brought him to the owner of the vineyard.
lunyoro: Obuyabandize okubara, bamuletera omu ouyatongire etaranta kakumi.

english: God said to the sixth angel, “Rebuke the four angels who are bound in the abyss of Euphrates River!”
lunyoro: Ruhanga, nirigambira maraika owomukaga akaba ayina engwara ati Sumu'ra bamaraika abana ababoherwe ha kyambu ekikoto Furati.

english: When all the people were angry with him, Peter and those who were with him said, “Master, the crowds are making fun of you and are making fun of you.
lunyoro: Obubehakine bona, Petero nabakaba balinauwe bagamba ngu Mukama waitu, ebitebe nibikugote'ra nibikufunza.

english: In the way that he has redeemed us from sin, in order that is his flesh.
lunyoro: omuhanda oguyatucwerire, oguhingura omu nyigamo, nugwo mubirigwe;

english: For the grace of our Savior and his love for people is great.
lunyoro: baitu embabazi zomujuni waitu Ruhanga nokugonzakwe hali abantu bikaba biri bingi:

english: Unless the Lord had set the time for the end, no one would have been saved by the power of the whole body, but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he has chosen, he would have set a time for the end.
lunyoro: Kakuba Mukama ataraganizemu ebiro ebi,tihakujunirwe mubiri gwona: baitu habwabakome, abayakomeremu, akaleta ebiro.

english: Listen, men of Israel, to you who are God-fearing.
lunyoro: Nabasaija aba Isaleri, nainywe abarukutina Ruhanga, muhu'le.

english: John called two of his disciples together and sent them to the Lord and asked, “Are you the one who is coming, or are we to expect someone else?”
lunyoro: Yohanani yayeta namberali babiri hali abegeswabe, yabatuma hali Mukama waitu, nagamba ati Niwogu arukuija, nandiki tutegereza ondi?

english: Above all, you must love one another with all your heart, because love covers over many sins.
lunyoro: okukira byona muyina okugonzagana kwingi muno inywenka nainywenka: baitu okugonza nukusweke'ra ebibi bingi:

english: I have heard about the Kingdom, just as my Father has heard me.
lunyoro: kandi mbahulir obukama, nka isenyowe okuyanyahulire nyowe,

english: They left and said to one another, “This man did not deserve to die or be put in prison!”
lunyoro: obubarugireyo, bagambirangana ngu Omuntu onu takozire kigambo ekisemerire okumuisa nobukwakuba okumubohya.

english: Be patient with one another, be patient with one another, pray earnestly, and work with the holy ones in their homes.
lunyoro: mugumisirize omu bujune, musabege obutosa, muterane nabarukwera omu busege bwabu.

english: For we know what a part of it is, and we know what a part of it is.
lunyoro: Baitu tumanyireho ekicweka, kandi turaguraho ekicwa.

english: For I came to set apart for you a son, a son, a father, a daughter, a mother, a son, a son, a son, a son.
lunyoro: Baitu nkaija okubaganiza omwana na ise, omuisiki na nyina, mukomwana na nyinazara,

english: For it is by the word of God and by means of prayer that we are God's children.
lunyoro: baitu kyezebwa obwekigambo ekya Ruhanga, nokusaba.

english: Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to Jesus, “Now he has been raised from death, because he has been dead four days.”
lunyoro: Maliza, munyanya ogu ayafire yamugambira ati Hati bunu anunkire, baitu amzire ebiro bina okufa.

english: Keep your senses completely, be sober, sound in mind, without spot from the world, until the day of Christ.
lunyoro: hakirizege okusima kwona, musime, muikalege abatanyina kabi, okuhikya ekiro kya kristo:

english: They grabbed him and began to rebuke him, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: kandi babanza okumuramukya ngu Businge. Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: So some of them made fun of others, because the crowd was crowding together. Many of them did not know what they had done.
lunyoro: Kandi abandi batoka okundi nabandi; baitu ekitebe kikaba kyejwangajwanganizemu; kandi abandi baingi batamanye ekibayesorolize.

english: For I have five brothers, who will be able to see with their eyes and not come into this place to hear the message.
lunyoro: baitu nyina bagenzi bange batano; abe kaiso nambere bali, nabo bataija omu kiikaro kinu ekinyakurumu okuhu'rwa.

english: The Pharisees said to him, “Look! Why do you say that on the Sabbath they do not obey the Law?”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bamugambira ngu Dora, kiki ekibagirize ekitali kyebiragiro hakiro kya Sabiti?

english: Many people came to him and said, “John did not perform a miracle, but all that John said about this man was true.”
lunyoro: Baingi bakaija namberali: nibagamba ngu Mazimakwo Yohana atakole kokuro'raho: baitu byona Yohana ebiyagambire ha muntu onu bikaba biri byamananu.

english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature say, ‘Come!’
lunyoro: Obuyasumuruire emanyikirizo eyakana nahu'ra iraka eryekyomezi ekyana nirigamba ngu Ija.

english: And as David said about the blessings of a man who God had promised he would have a just and blameless life
