lunyoro: kandi okwegarukamu nokuihibwaho ebibi btebezebwe omu ibararye hali amahanga gona, okubandiza Yerusalemu.

english: So then, if the whole church is united, and everyone speaks in strange tongues, and people who do not believe or who do not believe in the gospel enter it, will not say, “You have been crucified!”
lunyoro: Nukwo ekanisa yona obweba eso'rokaine hamu, kandi bona nibagamba endimi, kandi abantu abatamanyire, rundi abatarukuikiriza obubaliba nibatahamu, tibaligamba ngu Mugwire iraro?

english: The High Priest said to him, “I publicly praise God the living God, who told us that you are the Messiah, the Son of God!”
lunyoro: nyakatagara omukuru wabu yamugambira ati Ninkurahiza Ruhanga omowmezi, otugambire obworaba ali Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga.

english: When the two blind men who had been sitting on the cross heard that Jesus was passing by, they fell down before him and said, “Son of David, have mercy on us, Lord!”
lunyoro: Baitu abafu bamaiso babiri abakaba baikalire ha muhanda rubaju, obubahulire ngu Yesu nahinguraho, batokera ha iguru, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu otuganyire, iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: and the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever; they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and its image, and all those who believe in the image of the beast.
lunyoro: ekiho ekyokubonabonesebwa kwabu nikimara ebiro nebiro, kunu tibayina okuhumura nyamusana nekiro, abaramya ekisoro nekisisani kyakyo, na bona abaikiriza enkojo yibara ryakyo.

english: For you were bought with a price. In the same way you were made with God in your body.
lunyoro: baitu mukagurwa nomuhendo: nukwo mukugize Ruhanga omu mubiri gwanyu.

english: They had come back to that country and had told them to go back home.
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba babaire nibaijuka ensi egi nambere barugire, babagambire bagaruke.

english: They sang a new song, saying, “You must take the book and expose its meaning; you have killed and redeemed God's people from every tribe, language, and nation.
lunyoro: Kandi bazina ekizina ekihyaka, nibagamba ngu Osemerire okutwara ekitabu, nokusumu'ra emanyikirizo zakyo: baitu okaitwa, kandi wabagu'ra Ruhanga obwesagama yawe omu ruganda rwona, norulimi, nabantu, nihanga,

english: I am coming to Zion for a very precious stone, and those who believe in him will not be disappointed.
lunyoro: Dora ninta omu Sayuni ibale erikomerwemu, eryomuhendo mwingi: Kandi arukumuikiriza talikwatwa ensoni.

english: When the disciples heard this, they went away and took the body away and buried it.
lunyoro: Nabegeswabe obubahulire, baija, batwara omutumbigwe, baguta omu kituro.

english: Whoever is born of God does not continue to do it, but remains in him; and whoever is born of God cannot sin.
lunyoro: abo abazairwe Ruhanga tibakora ki, baitu embiboye ikara omuruwe; kandi tasobora okukora kibi, baitu akazarwa Ruhanga.

english: All of us, together with our uncovered eyes, are changed from glory to glory by the Spirit, just as the Lord is with us.
lunyoro: Kandi naitwe itwena namaiso agataswekerirwe, obutwangasana nkendolerwamu ekitinisa kya Mukama waitu, tuhindurwa tuti okuruga omu kitinisa okuhika omu kitinisakye, nka habwa Mukama Waitu Omwoyo.

english: Jesus answered, “I have done one work, and you are all amazed.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nkakora omulimu gumu, nanywe inywena mwahuni'ra.

english: For the gift of God's grace and of his free will is beyond compare.
lunyoro: Baitu ebisembo ebyembabazi nokweta ebya Ruhanga tibirukuhindurwa.

english: For the truth is that you say, ‘Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: He did not spare the ancient world, but saved Noah and the seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of ungodly people.
lunyoro: Kandi ataganyire ensi eyaira, baitu akakiza Nuha nabandi omusanju, omudumi wokuhiki'ra, obuyalesere okusandara kwamaizi ha nsi eyabatarukutina Ruhanga;

english: When Jesus saw the crowd rushing in with him, he said to him, “You dumb and deaf spirit, I have told you, and you will never give up.”
lunyoro: Yesu obuyaboine ekitebe nikiiruka nikigoma namberali hamu, yaimukya nagamba ati Iwe omuzimu ogutarukugamba, omufu wamatu, nyowe nkuragire otaculera na kake?

english: We have become like Sodom, and we have been like Gomorrah.
lunyoro: Twakufokere nka Sodomu, twakusiaine nka Gomora.

english: All who heard it heard him and said in their hearts, “What will this child be?” But the hand of the Lord stayed with him.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ababihulire bakabyeyahu'ra omu mitima yabu, nibagamba ngu Mara, omwana ogu aliba ki? Baitu omukono gwa Mukama gwaikaraga hamu nauwe.

english: And now you know what it is that is happening, so that it may be revealed by your deeds.
lunyoro: kandi hati bunu ekirukutanga mukimanyire, nukwo asuku'rwe omu mpikoze.

english: In this way we will know that we are truthful and that we will establish our hearts straight ahead.
lunyoro: ha nukwo turukumanyira ngu tuli bamazima, kandi tuligumyaho omutima gwaitu omu maisoge,

english: Jesus left them and saw them following, and he said to them, “What are you looking for?” They answered, “Teacher,” (which means “Teacher”).
lunyoro: Yabarora nibakuratira, yabagambira ati Nimuse'ra ki? banugambira ngu Rabi, ( amakuru gakyo obukimanyisibwa ngu Omwegesa), Orara nkaha?

english: But consider this man, who was highly respected by the father of Abraham, who had ten hundred coins on his altar of self-control.
lunyoro: Baitu mutekereze omuntu ogu okwali omukuru muno, Iburahimu isenkuru ouyahaire ebicweka biikumi ha munyago ogwokwegomboza.

english: They had taken many spears and had them thrown into prison and ordered the jailer to keep them safe.
lunyoro: Obubabatire emiigo nyingi, babacumiriza omu nju yenkomo, nibaragira omulinzi okubalinda muno:

english: I will send the younger ones to you, and they will have children. They will build houses and have no need for the Kingdom of Heaven.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukwendera abakyali abato okuzara, bazale abana, baleme enju zabu, baleke okulema obukama obwomu iguru.

english: For I am afraid that, as the serpent deceived Eve in his lie, your minds will never be corrupted from the truth and the sacred things of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ntinire, nkenjoka okuyabihihire Hawa omu budupebwe, rundi ebitekerezo byanyu bitasisikara okuruga omu mazima nokwera ebiri hali Kristo.

english: Just as a man who left his house and lived in a foreign country, when he ordered his servants to build a tower, he ordered them to look straight ahead.
lunyoro: Kisisana nkomuntu ayasigire enjuye,narara omu nsi endi, amazire okuragira abairube rubale, nokubaha omwanya ogwokuhweza;

english: Others said, “Let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.”
lunyoro: Abandi bagamba ngu Leka; turole rundi Eriya araija okumujuna.

english: “What do you want?” they asked. “The Lord is looking for,” they answered.
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Mukama waitu naguse'ra.

english: But if anyone does not provide for himself and for his own family, he will not believe. And even worse is the evil one who does not believe.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwatalisa abe wenka, nokukira muno abomu njuye, buli ayehakaine okuikiriza. Nakira obubi atarukuikiriza.

english: These things happened to them as examples, but they were written for a warning to us who have died to the ends of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi binu bikabaho abo okuba ekyokuro'raho; baitu bikahandikwa obwokutuhabura itwe abaizirwe emperor zensi.

english: He got into the boat with them, and the wind came up, and they were very amazed among themselves.
lunyoro: Yatemba omu bwato nambere bali, omuyaga gwayamuka: bahuni'ra muno omunda yabu;

english: Jesus said to them, “Go and get the vineyard, and I will pay you what is right.”
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Nainywe mugende omu rugonjo orwemizabibu, nanyowe ndabahera ekiraseme'ra.

english: The fourteenth day of the same time we were driven across the lake of Aduliya, where false teachers thought that they were about to come down from the cross.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro kya ikumi na bina obukyahikire, obutwabingabingirwe honahona omu nyanja ya Aduliya, omu itumbi abalimba bakatekereza ngu bamalize okui'ra haihi nensi:

english: I will come quickly, and you will have to obey me, so that everyone will not take your coat away from me.
lunyoro: Nkaija bwango: kwatira kimu ekyoyinakyo, omuntu wena aleke okunyaga ekondo yawe.

english: The words of his Son, who was born among David's descendants, are the words of the flesh.
lunyoro: ebigambo Byomwanawe ayazairwe omu baijukuru ba Daudi, omu mubiri:

english: If I go to Spain, I will be glad to see you again and be persecuted for the sake of you to this very day, or else I will see you again and give you a little more time to live.
lunyoro: obundiba ningenda Sapaniya, (baitu ninihira okubarora obundihinguraho, nokusengekerezebwa inywe okumpikya oku, rundi obundikamara okubarorayo nokubanihaho kake):-

english: In this way I will tell you the Good News about the Roman Empire as much as I can.
lunyoro: kandi nukwo ngondeze okutebeza enjiri hali inywe abomu Rumi nkokunsobora.

english: “Turn away from your sins,” he said, “for the Kingdom of heaven has already come.
lunyoro: yagamba ati Mwegarukemu; baitu obukama obwomu iguru bumalize okuhika.

english: He listened to the crowd, and when his wife recognized him, he took a piece of wood and put it on the other servants' feet.
lunyoro: Yatega omutima ha kitebe, na mukaziwe nauwe akimanyire, yaletaho ekicweka kyagwo, yakita ha bigere byabakwenda.

english: Through him all the power of God's Spirit was made subject to him, without the use of his hands, to the full measure of the body, which is the measure of Christ's life.
lunyoro: kandi omuruwe haikaramu okulema kwona Okwomwoyo namani gona, hatali okukora nemikono, okujura omubiri ogwenyama, okurukuingana nobwomezi obwa Kristo:

english: With Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that has happened to you.
lunyoro: na Onesimo mwene waitu owokwesiga kandi arukugonzebwa, owowanyu. Balibamanisa byona bya munuka.

english: So then, when the end comes, he will give the Kingdom to God and the Father, and he will put an end to all power and all authority and power.
lunyoro: Nukwo emperor ehika, obwalihayo obukama hali Ruhanga, kandi Isitwe; obwalimaraho okulema kwona, nobusobozi bwona, namani gona.

english: How terrible for us! We who have died to sin, how could we live to sin?
lunyoro: Mahano! Itw abafire hali ekibi, ntukyasobora tuta okwome'ra omu kibi?

english: Jesus asked him many things, but he did not answer him.
lunyoro: yamukaguza ebigambo bingi: baitu uwe atagarukemu kigambo.

english: They wanted to throw him out of the boat, and the boat was going on.
lunyoro: bagonza okumutahya omu bwato: ahonaho obwoto bwaija.

english: And because of the raising of the dead, you did not read what God had said to you,
lunyoro: Kandi ebyokuhumbuka okwabafu, timukasomaga Ruhanga eki Ekiyabagambire inywe ati

english: They said to him, “We will go with you.” So they went off and got into the boat, but that night they did not catch anything.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Naitwe ntugenda naiwe. Bagenda nibagwe'ra omu bwato; kandi ha kiro eki batakwate kintu.

english: The waiting God will fill you with all joy and peace by means of your faith, and you will be filled with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga owokunihira alibaijuza inywe okusemererwa kwona nobusinge bwona omu kuikiriza, inywe musaganege omu kunihira, omu mani Agomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: For this is why we do not work together, but we worship the living God, who is the Savior of all people, and above all others who believe.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo tuko'ra emirimo ntutalibana, baitu tukanihira Ruhanga omwomezi, nuwe Mujuni wabantu bona, nokukira muno wabo abaikiriza.

english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look! A friend of tax collectors and prostitutes!’
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu akaija narya nanywa, nainywe mugamba ngu Dora omuntu omukoizi, omutamizi enganjani yabazinisa nabasisi.

english: The message he preached to the people of Israel was the Good News of peace through Jesus Christ, the Lord of all things.
lunyoro: Ekigambo ekiyatwekire abana ba Isaleri, natebeza enjiri eyobusinge habwa Yesu Kristo (nuwe Mukama wa byona,)

english: For whoever will receive the Holy Spirit without being condemned forever.
lunyoro: Baitu wena alijuma Omwoyo Ourukwera tanyina kuganyirirwe omusango ogwekibi ekyebiro nebiro:

english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who do you think you are?” They knew that he was the Lord.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muije murye. Kandi busaho hali abegeswa ayasoboire okumukaguza ati Niwoha? Bamanyire nuwe Mukama waitu.

english: Many will come in my name, and they will say, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many people.
lunyoro: Baingi abaliija omu ibara ryange, nibagamba ngu Ninyowogu; kandi balihabisa baingi.

english: When they heard this, they were filled with pity and cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
lunyoro: Obubahulire ebi, baijura ekiniga, batokera haiguru, nibagamba ngu Atemi Wabefeso mukuru.

english: Do not be drunk with wine, in which there is no room to drink, where is the wine that never goes into the cup; instead, the wine that does not pour into the new wine will burst, and all will be ruined.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu takahu'raga amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga enkuru; kuba bakora bati, endyanga ziba zitemuka, namarwa gaseseka, nendyanga zisisikara; kakuba agira ati, amarwa agakutema nigasisiskara endyangarya, byona byomera.

english: He looked around and saw the linen cloths lying there.
lunyoro: yataho amaiso, yarora engoye zekitani zitairwe aho;

english: Come to the Lord, then, if we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
lunyoro: Kandi obutusisimuka, rundi obutuliifa, tuliba Mukama waitu.

english: But you, woman, do you know whether you will save your husband? Or do you know whether you will save your wife?
lunyoro: Baitu iwe omukazi, omanyire ota rundi olijuna omusaija wawe? Rundi iwe omusaija, omanye ota runyina mukazi wawe?

english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with different tongues, just as the Spirit had told them.
lunyoro: Bona baijura Omwoyo Ogurukwera, nibabanza okubaza engambo ezindi nezindi, Nkomwoyo okuyabahaire okuzigamba.

english: But I will warn you whom you will fear. Be afraid of him who has the power to drive out of hell. Yes, I tell you, be afraid of him.
lunyoro: Baitu ndabahabura oumuratinaga: mutinege ogu obwamara okuita, ayina obusobozi okunaga omu Gehena; ego, nimbagambira nti Mutinege ogu.

english: For those who do good reap much more than the usual harvesters, because they have a good harvest in themselves by faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abamara okuhereza kurungi betungira bonka ekitinisa kingi, nobumanzi bwingi omu kuikiriza okuli omu kristo Yesu.

english: For he will be handed over to the Gentiles, and they will make fun of him, insult him, and spit on him.
lunyoro: Baitu alihebwayo hali abamahanga; balimute'ra enaku, balimugiza ensoni, balimucwera amacwanta:

english: In all these things love one another, because love is the root of all these things.
lunyoro: hali ebi byona mujwale nokugonzangana, baitu nukwo kurukugumya okuhiki'ra.

english: Large crowds followed him, and he told them this.
lunyoro: ebitebe bingi nibimukuratira; yabakiriza oku.

english: Death and the demon brought the dead to life, and they were judged according to their deeds.
lunyoro: Kandi okufa nokuzimu byaleta abafu abakaba barumu: bacwerwa omusango omu omu nkengeso zabu okuzikaba ziri.

english: When he arrived in Galilee, the people there welcomed him and saw everything he had done in Jerusalem for the Passover Festival.
lunyoro: Nukwo obuyaizire Galiraya, Abagaliraya bamutangi'ra obubaboine ebigambo byona ebiyakolire Yerusalemu ha bugenyi: baitu nabo bakagenda ha Bugenyi.

english: But get up and go with them, and do not be afraid; for I am with you.
lunyoro: Baitu imuka, osirimuke ogende nabo, otarukugurukyagurukya: baitu ninyowe.

english: “What does this mean, ‘There is only a few left,’” they asked. “We don't know what he was talking about,” they asked.
lunyoro: Kigambo kinu kiki ekyarukugamba ati Hasigaireho akacu kake? Titurukumanya ekyagambire.

english: You killed the chief of the living, the one whom God raised from death. We are sinners.
lunyoro: mwite Omukuru wobwomezi; Ruhanga ouyahumbuire omu bafu: itwe tuli bakaisobe.

english: Another one said, “I have married a woman, so I cannot come.”
lunyoro: Nondi yagamba ati Nswire omukazi, nikyo ntarukusobo'ra kuija.

english: This is what God commanded, so that we may believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.
lunyoro: Kandi kinu nikyo kiragirokye, itwe tuikirize ibara ryomwanawe Yesu Kristo, kandi tugonzanganege, nkauwe okuyatuhaire ekiragiro.

english: So then, we sent them Judas and Silas, who themselves preached with some things.
lunyoro: Nukwo, tutumire Yuda na Sira abalitebeza bonka nakanwa ebimu na bimu.

english: For I was so happy and encouraged because of your love, that the hearts of the holy ones have been refreshed by you, my brother.
lunyoro: Baitu nkabanyina okusemererwa kwingi nokuhumizibwa obwokugonza kwawe, baitu emitima yabarukwera ekahumuzibwa obwawe, mwene waitu.

english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you call me?
lunyoro: Iwe oli mukuru okukira isenkuru itwe Iburahimu ayafire? Nabanabi bakafa: weyeta oha?

english: It is a sign of great power and of fire that shakes the heavens and brings them down to human beings.
lunyoro: Kandi kikora obwokuro'raho obukuru nomu'ro kiguiha haiguru, kiguleta hansi omu maiso gabantu.

english: All the crowd wanted to do to him, but power came down from him and healed them all.
lunyoro: Nekitebe kyona kikase'ra okumukoraho: baitu amani gakaruga omuruwe, nigabakiza bona.

english: But they all shouted out in a loud voice, “Crucify this man and throw him out of Barabbas!
lunyoro: Baitu bona bakatokera haiguru ngu Omuiheho omuntu onu, otuleke'le Baraba:

english: He saw heaven open, and a certain thing was coming down on him, like a dove, like a dove. It was four things that fell on the ground.
lunyoro: yarora iguru lisukuirwe, nekintu nikimusirimukira ekisisana nkorugoye orukoto, orukwasirwe ha byebu bina, rwatebwa hansi:

english: This was known to all who were in Jerusalem, and a soldier in their language was called Akeldama, meaning “A deadly soldier.”)
lunyoro: kandi kikamanyawa hali abo bona abaha Yerusalemu; nomusiri ogu omu rulimi rwabu gwayetwaga Akeridama, nukwo kugamba ngu Omusiri gwesagama.)

english: If a man asks you about Titus, he is my partner and he was my fellow worker for you. If he asks about our brothers, they want to honor Christ.
lunyoro: Omuntu obwaraba nakaguza ebya Tito, nuwe ateraine nanyowe, kandi akabali mukozi omutahi wange habwanyu; rundi obubakaguza ebyomuganda waitu, bali bakwenda bekanisa, ekitinisa kya Kristo.

english: Peter said to them, “Turn away from your sins and receive the gift of the Holy Spirit through Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Petero yabagambira ati Mwegarukemu, mu ibara rya Yesu Kristo, okuihwaho ebibi byanyu, kandi mulehebwa ekisembo Ekyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: Another one fell on good ground, and he bore children, another one hundred, and the other sixty.
lunyoro: ndi yagwa ha itaka erisemire, yayana ebyana, endi kikumi. Endi enkaga, endi amakumi asatu.

english: That is why I sent Timothy to you, who is my own dear son in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways in union with Christ, just as I teach everywhere in the churches.
lunyoro: Nikyo natumire Timoseo halinywe, nuwe mwana wange oundukugonza omu Mukama waitu, alibaijukya emihanda yannge enyakuli omu Kristo, nkokunyegesa hona hona omu kanisa zona.

english: There is no difference between a Jew and a Gentile. There is no difference between the one Lord and the one rich among all who love him.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho kusorora omu Muyudaya Nomuyonani: Baitu Mukama owa bona Mukama omu, owobuguda hali bona abanyakumukunga:

english: And if your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away from you. It is better for you to lose one of your whole bodies than to go to hell.
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwawe ogwoburyo guraba nugukutabaijura, ogutemaho, ogunage hara, baitu nikyo kurukukira oburungi ekicweka kyawe ekimu okubura, omubiri gwawe gwona gutanagwa omu Gehena.

english: Listen, everyone who has ears to hear.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra, ahu'le.

english: He does not look for its own interests, does not keep account of the injury, does not keep account of the injury,
lunyoro: Tkikora ebitasemire, tikuse'ra ebyakwo kwonka, tikutekereza obubi:

english: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abida was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.
lunyoro: Zerubaberi akazara Abiuda; Abiuda akazara Eriakimu; Erakimu akazara Azoli;

english: I tell you that this age will not pass away until all these things happen.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Obusinge bunu tibulihwaho, okuhikya ebigambo ebi byona obubirikamara okuhiki'ra

english: Out of his mouth comes a sharp sword, which will shake the nations. He will shake the nations, and he will shake them off by the sword. He will shake the great anger of Almighty God.
lunyoro: Omu kanwake harugamu empirima yobwogi, agitemese amahanga: kandi alibalemesa amahanga; kandi alibabalemesa omuigo gwekyoma: kandi asamba endeba yamarwa eyekiniga ekingi ekya Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona.

english: He will be great, and he will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the tribe of David his father.
lunyoro: Azoba mukuru, kandi aryetwa Omwana wogu anyakuli haiguru muno: kandi Mukama Ruhanga alimuha ekitebe kya Daudi isenkuruwe.

english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this wicked world, because the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena alikwatwa ensoni habwange, na habwebigambo byange omu businge bunu obwobusihani obubihire, Nomwana womuntu nauwe alikwatwaensoni habwomuntu ogu, obwaliija omu kitinisa kya Ise, nabamaraika abarukwera.

english: Jesus answered him, “Because I tell you that I have seen you under the fig tree, do you believe? You will see even more important things.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Obwokukugambira nti Nkurozire hansi yomutini, nikyo oikiririze? Olirora ebikuru ebirukukira ebi.

english: But if a woman has a long hair, she will be a glory to her, because her hair has been given to her to be covered with covering.
lunyoro: Baitu omukazi obwaba anyina isoke eriraihire, kiba kitinisakye: baitu isokerye limuhairwe okuba kyokwesweke'ra.

english: But Jesus knew what they were doing, so he said to them, “Why are you trying to trap me? Bring me a coin, and I will see.” They brought it.
lunyoro: Baitu obuyamanyire obugobya bwabu, yabagambira ati Nimunyoheza ki? Mundetere edinali,ngirole.bagireta.

english: For the one who plants and waters will be the same, because everyone will receive his own reward according to his own work.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakubyara nanyakuiti'ra amaizi nikyo kimu: baitu wena alihabwa emperaye wenka nkomulimogwe wenka okuguli.

english: The servant's servant answered, ‘Sir, I do not want you to go into my house, but just say the word, and my servant will get well.’
lunyoro: Omunyoro womukama yagarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange, tindukusememe'ra iwe okutaha omunda yorusurwange, baitu gamba ekigambo kyonka, omuiru wange nukwo arakira.

english: The Jewish authorities wanted to see him at the festival and asked him, “Who is this man?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bamuse'ra ha bugenyi, nibagamba ngu Ogu alinkaha?

english: But Peter turned around and said, “Now I know that the Lord has sent an angel and delivered him into the hands of Herod and into the hands of the people of the Jews.”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obuyayegarukiremu wenka, yagamba ati Hati bunu manyire kimu nti Mukama waitu atumire maraikawe, anyihire omu mukono gwa Herode, nomu kunihira kwona okwa ihanga Ryabayudaya.

english: After Jesus had said this, he left and hid himself.
lunyoro: Yesu obuyamazire kugamba ebi, yarugayo yabesereka.

english: If someone tells you this, you will say, ‘The Lord is looking for me,’ and he will quickly forget it.
lunyoro: Omuntu obwarabagambira ekigambo, muragamba ngu Mukama waitu nazenda; arazitweka bwango.

english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why am I trying to follow you now? I will give you my life for you.”
lunyoro: Petero yamugambira ati Mukama wange, kii ekirukumpinda okukukuratira hati bunu? Ndahayo obwomezi bwange habwawe.

english: Pilate also condemned him, “This is what they are asking for.”
lunyoro: Na Pirato akacwa omusango ati Ekibasabire nikyo bakikole.

english: When he comes to be praised by his servants and be seen by those who believe, our testimony to you will be believed on that very day.
lunyoro: Obwaliija okukugizibwa omu baherezabe, nokuhunirirwa omu boa abarukuikiriza, (baitu okutebeza kwaitu halinywe kukaikirizibwa) ha kiro eki.

english: Philip found Nathanael, and he said to him, “We have found him by the Law of Moses and by the prophets, by whom I am writing.”
lunyoro: Firipo yazora Nasaneri, yamugambira ati Tumuzoire ogu, Musa omu biragiro, nabanabi oubahandikireho, nuwe wa Nazalesi.

english: For I am jealous over the Greeks and over the Gentiles, over the wise and the foolish.
lunyoro: Baitu nyina ibanja hali Abayonani na hali Abamahanga, hali abamagezi na hali abadomadoma:

english: Those to whom you gave me will believe, and they will be glad when they hear the message; and those who have no money will have little faith, and the time will come when they will be destroyed.
lunyoro: Kandi mbanu hali abo abawampaire, obubahu'ra baikiriza ekigambo, nokusemererwa: kandi abo tibanyina mihama nibo baikiriza ekicu kike; kandi akasumi akobujune nikaija.

english: The rest of the dead did not live until the thousand years were over. This was the first resurrection.
lunyoro: Abafu abandi batafoke bomezi, okuhikya emyaka orukumi okuhwaho. Kunu nukwo kuhumbuka okwokubanza.

english: If he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times he will say to you, ‘I repent,’ you will forgive him.
lunyoro: Kandi obwaraba nakusisa emirundi musanju ha kiro ekimu, kandi emirundi ensanju akuhindukira nagamba ati Nyegarukiremu; omuganyirege.

english: Jesus answered, “There was once a man who was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho who was caught in the edge of the sword; he was killed, and he was about to be put to death.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Omuntu omu akaba arugire Yerusalemu nasirimuka Yerisko yagwa omu bazinzi abamujuire ebyokujwara, bamutera, barugayo bamusigire na'sana okufa.

english: The other is given miracles, the other is given to explain the spirit, the one is given to speak in strange tongues, because these are the rules of the tongues.
lunyoro: ondi ahebwa okukora ebyamahano, ondi ahabwa okwahukanizamu emyoyo, onda ahabwa okuduma endimi: baitu ebi emiringo yendimi:

english: If you greet your own brothers only, how much more do you treat others? Even Gentiles do this!
lunyoro: Kandi obumuraba numuramukya bene banyu bonka, mulikira muta abandi?Nabamahanga tinukwo bakora bati?

english: But if I come, I will look at you as if I were not willing to, and I will be like you, just as you love me. There is jealousy, anger, jealousy, and selfishness, and they will be like you.
lunyoro: Baitu obundiija ndibasanga musisaine nkokuntagonza, nanyowe ndisisana halinywe nka inywe okumugasima; rundi okubayo okukungana, ihali, ekiniga, empaka, okubaza ebihwa,, okwekunika, okuimuki'ra'

english: Don't you know that the righteous will judge the world? And if the world hates you, why should you be put to the test by the way it is?
lunyoro: Timumanyire ngu Abahikirire nibo balicwera ensi omusango? Kandi ensi eraba necwerwa inywe omusango, timusemerire okucwa omusango ogwebike muno?

english: After the uproar had subsided, they left at Antioch, and after the uproar had subsided, they gave orders.
lunyoro: Kandi abo obuyoherezibwe basirimuka Antyokiya; kandi obubamazire okuhereza ekitebe, babaha ebaruha.

english: I want you to be sure that you will not be sad. If you do not, you will be sad for the Lord's sake, and you will be faithful to the Lord.
lunyoro: Kandi ningonza inywe okutatunturaga. Omuntu wena obwatabatunturaga, akatunturaga habwa Mukama waitu, okwarasemeraga hali Mukama.

english: For God has placed in their hearts what they have decided to do, and he has united them with his whole heart, and he has given them his kingdom over the beast, until the words of God come true.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga akakita omu mitima yabu okukora ebiyahanuire, nokuterana omu mutima gumu, nokuhayo obukama bwabu hali ekisoro, okuhikya ebigambo bya Ruhanga obubirihiki'ra.

english: At once Jesus stretched out his hand and grabbed hold of him and said to him, “What little faith you have! Why do you doubt?”
lunyoro: Ahonaho Yesu yagora omukono yamukwata namugambira ati Iwe ayina okuikiriza okuke kiki ekikugurukisagurukisa?

english: For when it has become so great, I will not be a burden to myself.
lunyoro: Baitu obwakwolekwa okuba kwingi muno, nyowe ndeke okwehemba.

english: But the one who was given one went away and dug a field and hid the king's money.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ayahairwe emu yagenda yarrima omwitaka nasereka efeza zomukamawe.

english: But if you are looking for something else, it will be taken away from you by the narrow gate.
lunyoro: Baitu obumuraba numuse'ra ebindi, biracwerwa omu rukurato oruikaraho obutosa.

english: When Pilate heard this, he led Jesus out and sat down in the judgment hall in the place called “The Stone Pavement,” which means “Gabbatha.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato obuyahulire ebigambo ebi, yaturukya Yesu aheru, yaika'ra ha ntebe eyemisango omu kiikaro ekyetwa amabale agalire, baitu omu Ruheburaniya, Gabasa.

english: He was trying to profane the Temple, and we arrested him, tried to put him to death according to our Law,
lunyoro: kandi akaba nayenda okusisa yekaru: twamukwata twayenda okumucwera omusango nkebiragiro byaitu okubiri,

english: Jesus answered, “How hard it is for you people to believe! How long will I be with you? Bring him here to me!”
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nagamba ati Inywe abobusinge obutarukuikiriza ndihikya nkaha okuikara nainywe? Mumundetere hanu.

english: The other one fell among thorn bushes, branches of thorn bushes, and figs of all kinds.
lunyoro: ndi yagwa nambere ahali amahwa, amahwa gamera, gaginyoroza,

english: Jesus also called a little child to him, and he gave him a name among them.
lunyoro: Nauwe yayeta namberali omwana omuto, yamwemerezahop hagati yabu,

english: These things became like dead men to them, and they would not believe them.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi byasisana omu maiso gabu nkebitarumu; bayanga okubaikiriza.

english: We are all under God's curse, but we are not troubled; we mourn, but not troubled at all.
lunyoro: twahukanizibwe, baitu titurukutabatabana; ntutuntura, baitu tituhigwa;

english: You are the ones who belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
lunyoro: kandi inywe muli ba Kristo: kandi Kristo ali wa Ruhanga.

english: The Holy Spirit also indicates that the way into the Holy Place has not yet been opened, the first tent to be built.
lunyoro: Omwoyo Ogurukwera namanyisa ati omuhanda ogwokutaha omu kiikaro ekirukwera tigukolekerwe, ehema eyokubanza ekyemerire;

english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. Listen, then, if anyone has ears to hear.
lunyoro: Nubwo abantu abahikirire baryengasana nkizoba omu bukama obwa Isebo. Anyakuina amatu, ahu'le.

english: But Jesus answered, “You will not see all these things? I tell you, there will not be left here a stone on the stone which will not be thrown down.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Timurukurora binu byona? Mananukwo nimbagambiranti Tiharliikaraho hanu ibale erinyakuli heruguru ha ibale, eri talinagwa hansi.

english: That is why, when the believers heard our message, they ordered us not to stay in the Market of Appius and Three Towns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God earnestly.
lunyoro: Kandi nuho benebaitu obubahulire ebigambo byaitu barugire, okututangire'ra omu Katale ka Apio, nomu Bigonyo Basatu: Pauro obuyababoine, yasima Ruhanga na guma omutima.

english: For whoever is tempted must be able to do his own will and be able to guard his own son.
lunyoro: baitu ogu ayangirwe, obwaba amanyire wenka okukora ebyagonza wenka, aleke okulema omwanawe wenka.

english: “I tell you, then, that unless you turn from your sins and become like children, you will by no means enter the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: sana nagamba ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Obumutahinduka numufoka nkabana abato, mutalitaha na kake omu bukama obwomu iguru.

english: They will fight against the one who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
lunyoro: nibo balitongana hali ogu anyakwetekanize okucwa omusango gwabomezi nabafu.

english: It is right for God to take revenge on those who make you sad.
lunyoro: baitu kiraba kiri kyoburyo hali Ruhanga okugaru'ra omuhito abo abatuntuza inywe;

english: He had been revealed by the Holy Spirit that he will never die until he has seen the Lord's Messiah.
lunyoro: Kandi ogu akaba asukulirwe Omwoyo Ogurukwera ngu talibona okufa, okuhikya obwalikarora Kristo wa Mukama.

english: Go, then, as children of light, for the children of light are in a good and just way.
lunyoro: mugenderege nkabana abomusana ( baitu ebyana ebyomusana biri omu burungi nokuhiki'ra namazima),

english: As he spoke through his holy prophets, who lived on earth.
lunyoro: Nkokuyagambire omu kanwa ka banabibe abarukwera, abakaba baroho ensi yona.

english: So then, if what the living say is true, whether it comes from a human being or from a human being, does it mean that the word of a wicked person is false or worthless?
lunyoro: Nukwo ebigambo ebyobwomezi obubiraba nibigamba, rundi omuntu rundi enyamulere, biraba bitarukwahukaniza ekigambo, /ekigambo kyomuntu rundi ekibi kiraba kitali kintu?

english: The disciples asked him, “Where can we find enough bread here in the desert to feed the great crowd?”
lunyoro: Abegeswa bamugambira ngu Turaiha nkaha emigati mingi eti omu irungu, okuigusa ekitebe ekingi ekirukwingana hanu?

english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you, ‘If anyone does not want to work, let him eat.’
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo obutukaba tuli namberemuli, nikyo twabaragire ngu Omuntu wena obwaraba atarukugonza okukora, aleke nokurya.

english: The hope that has been heard in heaven has been heard in this way by you in the truth of the Good News.
lunyoro: obwokunihira okwabahulirwe omu iguru, nukwo mwahulireho kara omu kigambo kyamazima agenjiri,

english: Do you boast about the Law, and sin of the Law, and do you dishonor God?
lunyoro: we anyakwenyumirizamu omu biragiro, omu kusisa ebiragiro, omu oihaho Ruhanga ekitinisakye?

english: Before this, they will lay their hands on you and persecute you and bring you before kings, rulers, and rulers for my sake.
lunyoro: Baitu ebi byona bitakabaireho balibataho emikono yabu, balibahiga, nibabahayo hali amaso'rokaniro na hali abalemi nabalemi habwibara ryange.

english: But Peter stood up with the eleven disciples and said to them in a loud voice, “You men of Judea and all you who live in Jerusalem, you yourselves know that this is what I am saying to you.
lunyoro: Baitu Petero akaimuka hamu nabo ikumi nomu, yagambira haiguru nabatebeza ati Inywe abasaija Abayudaya, nainywe inywena abarukuikara Yerusalemu, kinu mukimanye, mutege amatu hali ebigambo byange.

english: In order that God and his Father may establish your hearts to be holy, without blame for the coming of the Lord Jesus with all his followers.
lunyoro: nukwo agumye emitima yanyu omu kwera okutahanwa omu maiso ga Ruhanga waitu kandi Isitwe, omu kuija kwa Mukama waitu Yesu hamu nabarukwerabe bona.

english: The children of your Spirit will be taken away from you, and you will be given over to all the good and evil things that are going on in you. They will never see it again.
lunyoro: Abana bomwoyo gwawe baliihwaho, nebintu byona ebinura nebirungi birihwaho, kunu tibakyabibona na kake.

english: Do not be afraid of those who belong to their masters, but of your own brothers. Instead, do what is right for them, because they are the ones who share the blessing with you in the faith and love. Teach them to do the same.
lunyoro: Kandi abo abanyina bakama babu abarukuikiriza baleke okubagaya, baitu bene banyu; baitu hakire babako'lege, baitu abaterana omu mugisa nibaikiriza kandi nibagonzebwa.Yegesege okubako'ra.

english: After Jesus had said this, he breathed his last on them and said to them, “You have received the Holy Spirit!
lunyoro: Obuyamazire kugamba ebi yabaikiza orwoya, nabagambira ati Muhebwa Omwoyo Ogurukwera:

english: Do not be afraid of the enemy in all that you do, but of the one who opposes you, who is the one who has the mark of your salvation, which belongs to God.
lunyoro: mutarukukangwa abanyanzigwa omu kigambo kyona, baitu obwebigambo byanyu hali abo abanyakuko'ra empera, kinu kibe kyokwohebwa omulinywe, baitu okujunwa okuli hali Ruhanga:

english: I order you by the Lord to teach these things to all the people.
lunyoro: Nimbarahiza Mukama waitu okusomesa baruha enu bene baitu bona.

english: The hand of the Lord was revealed to whom?
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwa Mukama gukasuku'rwa oha?

english: Those who believe in him will not be judged, but will believe that he has been judged, because they do not believe in the name of the Son of God, who was born on their own behalf.
lunyoro: Anyakumuikiriza tacwerwa musango, baitu aturukuikiriza amazire okucwerwa, baitu taikirize ibara Ryomwana wa Ruhanga ayazairwe omu wenka.

english: If we confess our sins to him, he is faithful and must forgive us our sins and take away all our sins.
lunyoro: Bitu obutuyatura ebibi byaitu nuwe wokwesiga, kandi ahikirire okutuganyira ebyokusisa byaitu,nokutwogyaho ebyokutahiki'ra byona.

english: For the Lord, who is faithful, will strengthen them and keep them from the wicked.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu wokwesiga, alibagumya kandi alibalinda hali omubi.

english: Do you have houses to live and drink? Do you despise God's church, and do you dishonor those who do not have houses? What shall I tell you? Why should I give thanks to you? I will not give thanks to you.
lunyoro: Rundi timunyina enju zokuliramu nokunyweramu? Rundi numugaya ekanisa ya Ruhanga, kandi numukwasa ensoni abatanyina enju? Ndabagambira ki? Ndabasima habweki? Tindukubasima.

english: Those whom he has judged as righteous are the ones he has judged, and those whom he has judged he has given honor to.
lunyoro: kandi abayayahuire ira, nibo yayesere: kandi abayaihireho omusango, nibo yataireho ekitinisa:

english: When he came out, he went to a place where no one could find him. The crowds came to him and began looking for him, but he would not leave them.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obubwakire yarugayo, yagenda omu kiikaro nambere hatarumu bantu: abebitebe bamuse'ra, nibaija namberali, nibenda okumutanga, atabarugaho.

english: And I will tell you that you have a lot of money left over for many years. Get up, eat, and be satisfied.
lunyoro: kandi ndigambira obwomezi bwange nti Obwomezi, oyina itungo lingi ryahuirwe eryokumara emyaka mingi; humura, orye, onywe, osemererwe;

english: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. The blind are seeing, the lame are walking, the dumb are hearing, the dead are being raised to life, the poor are being told the good things.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati Mwegendere, mutebeze Yohana ebimuboine nebimuhulire; abafu bamaiso nibarora, abaramaire nibagenda, abagenge basemezibwe, abafire bahumbuirwe, abasege batebezibwe ebigambo ebirungi.

english: But they had some arguments about him about their own religion, and about the man who died for Jesus, whom Paul spoke about, was alive.
lunyoro: baine haruwe empaka ezimu ezedini yabu bonka, kandi hali omuntu Yesu ayafire, Pauro ouyagambireho ayomire.

english: For the truth that remains in us, and it remains in us forever.
lunyoro: habwamazima agaikara omulitwe, kandi garaikaraga naitwe ebiro byona:

english: Jesus answered, “I will give him to you the cross.” He took it and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Oundakoleza entonge ningimuha nuwogu. Obuyakoleze entonge yahikwata yagimuha Yuda omwana wa Simoni Isikaryota.

english: Nazareth, a descendant of David's son Mary, a descendant of David.
lunyoro: a Nazalesi, hali omuisiki ataramanyire musaija, akaba ajumbirwe omusaija ibararye Yusufu, owomu nju ya Daudi; nibara ryomuisiki Maryamu.

english: The next day we opened the gates and saw Chios, and the next day we came to Samos, and the next day we reached Miletus.
lunyoro: Nabwo, obutwahinguireyo amaberu okurugayo, ha kiro ekyakabiri twahika okurole'ra Kio, kandi ha kyakana twataha Samo; ha kyakasatu twaija Mireto.

english: Do not be afraid of them, for you have filled the earth with violence.
lunyoro: mutabihangana inywenka; baitu mukaijuza okubihi'rwa hansi.

english: There will be no more night, and they will not light the sun and the moon, but the Lord God will give them light, and they will shine forever and ever.
lunyoro: Kandi tihalibayo ekiro bwakabiri; kunu tibataga omusana gwetabaza, nomusana gwizoba, baitu Mukama Ruhanga alibaha omusana: kandi baliremera ebiro nebiro.

english: All perform miracles? All have the gift of healing; all have the same gift. All speak in strange tongues.
lunyoro: bubona bakora ebyamahano? Bona banyina ekisembo okukiza endwara? Bona nibagamba endimi?

english: “What do you say?” Jesus answered.
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda nkukole ki?

english: The disciples realized that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.
lunyoro: Abegeswa bayetegereza ngu akabaza nabo ebya Yohana Omubatizi.

english: He left the city in a basket of unrolled figs, and he sat down and gave up the sign, so that he would not deceive the nations until the thousand years were over. After that he must be released for a little while.
lunyoro: kandi yamunaga omu kina ekitanyina hokugarukira, yakiiga'ra, yakitaho emanyikirizo, aleke okubihabiha amahanga okuhikya emyaka orukumi obwerikahwaho; hanyuma yegi alihiki'ra okuboho'rwa akacu kake.

english: I am so sorry that you have turned away from the grace of Christ and have gone away to me
lunyoro: Ndabihirwa baitu mufurukire kimu, mulekere kimu embabazi za Kristo, mugende namberendi

english: A man who had an evil spirit had led them out of the way, led them both into the way, and led them out of the way. So they ran away from that house and hid themselves.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akaba aroho omuzimu omubi yabagurukira, yabakira bombi, yabasingura: nukwo bairuka bus omunju egi, kandi bahutaire.

english: But Jesus went out and began to proclaim the Good News until this very day. But Jesus could not go back to that town, but he stayed outside in the desert. They came to him and told him everywhere.
lunyoro: Baitu yaturuka, yabanza okutebeza muno nokuhikya ekiihuro, kandi Yesu atasobole kugaruka omu rubuga bwerebwere, baitu yaikaraga aheru omu irungu: baijaga namberali, barugire hona hona.

english: I wanted to know the meaning of what they had given me and to bring him back to their council.
lunyoro: Kandi obunagondeze okumanya ebigambo ebibamulegeseze namusirimura hali orukurato rwabu:

english: Some of the disciples said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Jesus said to them, “If you look at the birds of heaven and throw them out of his side, they will not believe.
lunyoro: Abegeswa abandi bamugambira ngu Tukarora Mukama waitu. Baitu yabagambira ati Obuntalirora omu biganjabye enkaito ezomuirima, nintaho orukumu ha hezobu, tindikiriza na kake.

english: But not all of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or a busybody in other people's affairs.
lunyoro: Baitu hataba wena omulinywe abonabonesebwa nkomuisi, nobukwakuba nkomusuma, nobubakuba nkomumutasi omu byabandi.

english: For this reason, we pray for you today, that our God will make sure that you have his approval, and that you will have the full strength to do what is good and to do what is good.
lunyoro: Nikyo tusabira ebiro byano habwanyu, nukwo Ruhanga waitu abatekereze musemerire okwetakwe, kandi ahikirize namani kyona ekimugonza okukora ekirungi nomulimo ogwokuikiriza;

english: He is not a single nation, but a group of God's chosen people.
lunyoro: kandi tiririr ihanga eri ryonka, baitu asoroza ahamu abana ba Ruhanga abatabaine.

english: When he saw this, he spoke ahead of time about the raising of Christ from death, not of the dead, nor of the living.
lunyoro: akegereza kara yagamba ha kuhumbuka kwa Krsito okwatalisigwa okuzimu, nobukwakuba omubirigwe okubona okunda.

english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and the books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to the Scriptures, according to what they had done. The sea brought those who were dead to life.
lunyoro: Kandi narora abafu, abakuru nabato, bemerire omu maiso gekitebe ekyobukama: nebitabu byasuku'rwa: nekitabu ekindi kyasukusurwa, nikyo kyobwomezi: abafu bacwerwa omusango obwebi ebyahandikirwe omu bitabu nkengeso zabu okuzikaba ziri. Nenyanja yaleta abafu abakaba barumu;

lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akaba atakatahire omu kika baitu akaba akiri omu kiikaro nambere Maliza yamusangire.

english: He gave him five thousand coins, and two thousand coins, and one thousand one according to his ability. He left.
lunyoro: Yamuha etaranta itano nondi ibiri nondi emu; omuomu nkobusobozi okubukaba buli; yagenda.

english: So Jesus said to them again, “The rooster crows and the rooster crows; but I am going to kill him.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagambire ati: yagaruka nabagambira ati Enganjani, ningenda okumusisimura.

english: For I tell you, to the rest of you who are left in Thyatira, who have not received this teaching, and who do not know the meaning of the Devil's plans, I will not set any other burden on you.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe abandi abasigaireho omu Suatira, inywena abatanyina okwegesa kunu, abatamanyire ebyokuhama bya Setani nkokubagamba, nti tindukubataho inywe enketo endi.

english: You judge according to your human nature, but I judge no one.
lunyoro: Inywe mucwa omusango nkomubiri okuguli; nyowe tincwera muntu omusango.

english: When they found him on the beach, they asked him, “Teacher, where did you come from?”
lunyoro: Obubamuzoire nseri yanyanja bamugambira ngu Rabi oizire di hanu?

english: Humble yourselves in the presence of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
lunyoro: Mwebundaze inywenka omu maiso ga Mukama, nauwe alibanyumiza.

english: But when you eat this bread and drink this cup, you will proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.
lunyoro: Baitu obumurakaryaga ha mugati gunu, kandi numunywa ha mpwahwa, murayolekaga okufa kwa Mukama waitu okuhikya obwaliija.

english: I have not written to you because you know me, and no lie has ever come from the truth.
lunyoro: Ntabahandikire inywe obwokuramanya, kandi busaho ebisuba ebiruga omu mazima.

english: I saw a holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
lunyoro: Kandi narora orubuga orurukwera, nurwo Yerusalemu oruhyaka, nurusirimuka okuruga omu iguru hali Ruhanga, rutekanize nkomugole ayecumire iba.

english: Again they said to the blind man, “He is a prophet!”
lunyoro: Bagaruka nibagambira omufu wamaiso ngu Nuwe nabi.

english: For we know where Christ comes from, but when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he comes from.
lunyoro: baitu tumanyire onu nambere aruga: baitu Kristo obwaliija, busaho alimanya nambere aroga.

english: The dragon was angry with the woman and went out to fight against her and her descendants who obey God's law and obey Jesus' instructions. It stood on the beach.
lunyoro: Darakoni yayaka hali omukazi, yagenda okurwana nabaijukurube, abarukukwata ebiragiro bya Ruhanga, kandi abanyina okugamba kwa Yesu: yayeme'ra ha musenyi gwenyanja.

english: Jesus thought that God could raise the dead from death, and that is why he was buried in the grave.
lunyoro: atekerize ngu Ruhanga nasobora okuhumbura nomu bafu: kandi numwo yamuherirwemu omu kisisani.

english: Many people believed, and few Greek women respected them, and many men believed.
lunyoro: Baingi halibo nikyo baikiririze, nabakazi Abayonani abekitinisa, nabasaija, tibali bake.

english: Simon Peter cut off the net and rolled it off, and the net was full of fish, about fifty-three; for there were so many, the net did not break.
lunyoro: Simon Petero yagwe'ramu nacundira ekisoga ha musa, kiijuire encu enkoto, kikumi mwatano mu isatu: baitu nobuzikaba ziri nyingi ziti, ekisoha kitacweke.

english: For those who practice what is evil come to the light, and their deeds are made openly, because they have been done in God's sight.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakukora ebyamananu aija hali omusana, engesoze zisukurwe, baitu zikakorwa omu Ruhanga.

english: It was right, then, that the scripture should be read and read, which the Holy Spirit spoke through David through Judas, who betrayed those who had seen Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi kikaseme'ra ekyahandikirwe okukihi'ra, Omwoyo Ogurukwera ekiyagambire ira omu kanwa ka Daudi, hali Yuda, ayayebembire abo abakwasire Yesu.

english: They will see him, and they will cry out to him for help.
lunyoro: Kandi balimurora amaisoge, nibararye liriba ha buso bwabu.

english: So then, your unity of faith has helped you to carry out your work in order to know what is good for you in union with Christ.
lunyoro: nukwo okuterana kwokuikiriza kwawe kugase okukora omulimo omu kumanyira kimu ekigambo kyona ekirungi, ekiri omulinywe habwa Kristo.

english: The angel poured out his bowl out and threw the vine of the earth and threw it out of the way as a seal of God's grace.
lunyoro: Maraika yanaga akagesoke hansi, yanoga omuzabibu ogwensi, yagunaga omu ndeba enkoto eyekiniga kya Ruhanga.

english: All ate the same spiritual food.
lunyoro: kandi bona baryaga ebyokurya ebimu ebyomwoyo:

english: But what does the scripture say? Abraham believed God, and it was thought that he was righteous.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe nobigamba bita? Ngu Iburahumu akaikiriza Ruhanga, kandi kikatekerezebwa haruwe okuba okuhiki'ra.

english: So he got up and went to his father. While he was still far away, his father saw him, and was moved with pity for him, and he ran away and fell on his knees and kissed him very much.
lunyoro: Kandi yaimuka, yaija hali ise. Kandi obwakaba akiri hara muno, ise yamuleba, yakwatwa embabazi, yairuka, yamugwa omunda, namunywegerea muno.

english: When we saw Cyprus, we left and went to Syria, where the ship was ready to sail.
lunyoro: kandi obutwarozire Kupuro, ntulireka ha mukono ogwemoso, twagenda Busuli, twahika ha musa Turo: baitu nuho ekyombo kyayezire okuhanika amaberu.

english: Salvation belongs to those who hate you, and to all who hate you.
lunyoro: Okujunwa omu mikono yabanyanzigwa baitu, nomu mukono gwabu bona abanyakutunoba;

english: But now they have lost their faith, hope, and love. Above all, love.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu baikaireho okuikiriza, okunihira, okugonza, nibyo bisatu; baitu ekirukukira hali ebi, kugonza.

english: For our city is in heaven, where we look for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu orubuga rwaitu ruli omu iguru; nambere ntutegereza Omujuni okurugayo, nuwe Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: Jesus answered, “Who are you looking for?” They answered, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nimuse'ra oha? Bagamba bgu Yesu owa Nazalesi.

english: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, even so I will send you.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagaruka okubagambira ati Obusinge bube halinywe: Nka isenyowe okuyatumire nyowe, nukwo nanyowe mbasindika nywe.

english: For the proof that I am being made is that we have come out of human beings. For I tell you this, then, that you will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu okumanyisibwa okunyikiriza tukuruga omu bantu: baitu ningamba ebi, inywe mujunwe.

english: His disciples asked him, “Do you see the crowd crowd crowding you, and he asked, “Who touched me?”
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamugambira ngu Oboine ekitebe okubarukukufunza, nogamba ngu Noha ankozireho?

english: The soldiers were about to kill the prisoners, but they would not let them go.
lunyoro: Abaserikale bacwa amagezi okuita abanyankomo, bataziha okuiruka.

english: For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's servants, and you belong to God's household.
lunyoro: Baitu tuli bakozi hamu na Ruhanga: inywe muli musiri gwa Ruhanga, muli enju ya Ruhanga.

english: and live in a way that allows for the worship of demons.
lunyoro: kandi nokuikara nobusobuzi okubingaga emizimu:

english: At the feast Jesus left a prisoner for them. When he had prayed,
lunyoro: Kandi ha bugenyi yabaleke'raga omunyankomo omu. Oubamusabire.

english: For your fellowship with the gospel has been kept from the first day until now.
lunyoro: obwokuterana kwanyu okwokuhikya enjiri, okuruga ha kiro ekyokubanza nokuhikya hati;

english: We belong to God, who knows God and who hears us; we know that God hears us. And so we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.
lunyoro: Itwe tuli ba Ruhanga: nyakumanya Ruhanga atuhu'ra Itwe. Nuho turukumanyira omwoyo ogwamazima nomwoyo ogwokuhabisa.

english: I and the Father are one.
lunyoro: nyowe na Isenyowe tuli omu.

english: Jesus said to them, “Did you ask me, ‘Is it the Law on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm? To save lives, or to destroy it?”
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Nimbakaguza nti Kyebiragiro ha Sabiti okukora okurungi nandiki okukora okubi? Okukiza obwomezi, nandiki oku buhwerekereza?

english: But I beg you, then, that your faith may not give out; and you, when you repent, you will strengthen your brothers.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nkesengereza habwawe, okuikiriza kwawe kutahwaho; naiwe obwolikagaruka okuhinduka, oligumya bene banyu.

english: So he left and went with the chief priests and the soldiers, where he was able to bring him before them.
lunyoro: Ogu akarugayo yagenda yahanura hamu na banyakatagara abakuru nabaserikale, okwarasobora okumuhayo nambere bali.

english: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and prophesied by the Spirit that a great famine would happen in all the world. This happened in the days of Claudius.
lunyoro: Kandi hakeme'ra omu hali abo, ibararye Agabo, naragura Habwomwoyo ati Haliba ekiihekingi omu nsi zona: eki kyabaho omu biro bya Karaudio.

english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way; your faith has made you well.” At once he saw and followed him on the way.
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Genda; okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize. Ahonaho yahweza, yamukuratira omu muhanda.

english: All who heard him were amazed at the things that the shepherds had told them.
lunyoro: Bona abahulire bakahuni'ra ebi abalisa ebibabatebize.

english: For I was hungry, but you did not give me food to eat; I was thirsty, but you did not drink.
lunyoro: Baitu nkaba nyine enjara mutampe ebyokurya; nkaba nnyine iroho mutanywise;

english: All that you say in the darkness will be heard in the light, and all that you say in the darkness will be exposed in the heavenly places.
lunyoro: Kandi byona ebimwagambire omu muirima kirihuli'rwa omu musana; neki ekimwagambirire omu kutu ha kaifo, kiridumirwa eruguru ha nju.

english: But now I write this letter not to cooperate with anyone who calls you a brother or a sister, a greedy person or an idolater or a drunkard or a drunkard or a glutton or a drunkard or a glutton or a drunkard or a glutton or a drunkard or a drunkard or a glutton or a glutton or a drunkard or a glutton or a drunkard or a glutton or a glutton or a drunkard or a drunkard or a glutton or a glutton or a glutton or a drunkard or a drunkard.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu mbahandikire okutaterana hamu nabo, rundi omuntu wena anyakweta mwene wanyu rundi mwiru mutahi we, nobukwakuba omwegombi webi ebisisani, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyokwegomba, nobubakuba omuntu arukunoba Ruhanga, nuwe muiru rubale wanyu:

english: The Son of Man, who was to come, will not come back to life until the time of his death.
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu arukwenda kuija, talibanza okuhumbuka rundi kuija obukyabukya.

english: But a Samaritan man came to him, and when he saw him, he was moved with pity for him, and he came to him.
lunyoro: Baitu Omusamaliya omu akabali omu rugendo akaija namberali: kandi obuyamuboine yamukwatirwa embabazi, yamuizira,

english: As I have told you, if a man is not judged, he has one wife and children who believe, and they will not be destroyed just as they were at the time.
lunyoro: Ngambire nkoku ntarukusisa, omusaija obwaba anyina omukazi omu, anyina abana abarukuikiriza, abatalegwa nka'abagu biraro binu.

english: For whoever sins against me and is forgiven by me, has also been forgiven by me. If I forgive, then I have forgiven for you in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu wena oumuganyira, nanyowe 'muganyira: nanyoho ekinganyira, obundaba ninganyira, (nkiganyire) habwanyu omu maiso ga Kristo:

english: So then, do not be afraid. You are worth much more than many sparrows.
lunyoro: Nikyo mutalitinira: inywe numukira muno ebisirya bingi.

english: Do you see this? Do not be afraid that anyone who does not receive God's grace will lose his faith, and that many will lose their faith.
lunyoro: Murole kurungi omuntu wena atarukukukika omu mbabazi za Ruhanga; noba kireke okumera nokubatuntuza, na baingi nibisisikara;

english: But the soldiers who had killed him on the cross threw him out of the cross, and at once blood and water came out.
lunyoro: baitu serikale omu yamucumita amu rubaju nicumu, ahonaho harugamu esagama namaizi.

english: Pilate said to him, “Are you the king?” Jesus answered, “You said that, because I am the king. I was born, and I came into the world, and I understand. Whoever has heard my voice has already come to me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu'ra iraka ryange.

english: Some of the believers in Cyprus and Cyrene arrived in Antioch and spoke to the Greeks and to them about the Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abamu hali abo Abakupuro Nabakulene, abo obubahikire Antyokiya, babaza Nabayonani nabo, nibatebeza Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: Blessed be God for his abundant grace.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga asimwe obwokusiba okwomuhendo.

english: If I tell you the truth, you will not understand my message.
lunyoro: Obundaba ningamba ebyamananu, okwegambi kwange tikuli kwa mananu.

english: Don't be afraid, daughter of Zion. Your King will come and gather the wheat for you.
lunyoro: Otatina omuisiki wa Sayuni: dora, Omukama wawe naija, atembere omugongo.

english: They will make a new song in front of the throne, and of the four living creatures and the elders. No one can learn the song except the four thousand kingdoms, who have been bought from the earth.
lunyoro: nibazina ekizina ekihyaka omu maiso gekitebe ekyobukama, nomu maiso bebyomezi ebina nabakuru: kunu busaho muntu asobora okwega ekizina, rundi akasirira mu bukumi buna mwenkumi ina, abaguzirwe okubaiha omu nsi.

english: Let the stealer steal no more, but rather let him do what is good work, so that he may have something to distribute to someone in need.
lunyoro: Omusuma aleke okuiba, baitu hakire atalibane nemikonoye nakora ebirungi, nukwo atunge ebyokugabira anyakusega.

english: If anyone builds on those foundation stones or gold or silver or stone, trees, or earth, or wood, or stone,
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena obwaba nayombekera ha miganda egi, rundi ezabu, ensimbi, amabale agomuhendo mwingi, emiti, obunyansi, embiba:

english: But if you have doubts, insults, and divisions in your hearts, do not be puffed up with pride and speaking the truth.
lunyoro: baitu obumuraba munyina ihali, nobuiko, nokukungana, omu mitiima yanyu, muleke okwenyumiza nokutanga amazima.

english: Be like men who wait for their master when he comes back from the wedding feast, and when he comes and knocks, they will meet him.
lunyoro: kandi muikalege nkabantu abategereza mukama wabu, obwaligaruka okuruga omu bugenyi bwobugole; obwaliija nayeranga bamukingu'leho.

english: For they are the spirits of demons, and they are the spirits of miracles. They come out of all the kings of the earth and gather them together to the battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
lunyoro: Baitu niyo mizimu yabacwezi, nekora obwokuro'raho: neturukira abakama abensi zona, okubasoroza hamu hali obulemu obwekiro ekikuru ekya Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona.

english: A widow came to him and gave him a half half of what she had.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaija omufakati omu owamasege, yanagamu obucweka bubiri, niyo kodorante.

english: Uncleanness, murder, sexual immorality, greed, greed, and the love of money.
lunyoro: Orwanju, okuiba,okuita, obusihani, okwegomba, ebisuba, okwanjuka,eriso eribi, okujuma, emyehembo, obudomadoma:

english: He cried out, and fell on his knees, and the women stood still. “I tell you,” he said.
lunyoro: Yatera amaju, yainama, abetweki bayeme'ra.Yagamba ati Omwojo, ninkugambira nti Imuka.

english: So then, if the people of Macedonia sit down with me and do not find me ready, then let us not be ashamed of this hope.
lunyoro: nukwo aba Makedoni rundi obubaliika hamu nanyowe batabasanga mutekanize, naitwe (okutagamba inywe) tuleke okukwatwa ensoni omu kunihira oku.

english: But some men did not come from James, and he ate with the Gentiles, because when they arrived, he was kind to them, and he was kind to them, showing honor to those who were circumcised.
lunyoro: Baitu ira, abantu abamu batakaizire okuruga owa Yakobo, yaryaga Nabamahanga: baitu abo obubaizire yayehinya nayesororamu, atinire abo abo abokusarwa.

english: For I was told about you, my friends, in the house of Chloe, that there is a division among you.
lunyoro: Baitu nkamanyisibwa ebyanyu bagenzi bange, abomu nju ya Keroe, ngu haroho empaka omulinywe.

english: On that very day Jesus took them and washed their robes, and at once he and his family were baptized.
lunyoro: Yabatwara omu kasumi ako ekiro, yabanabisa ebyokujwara byabu ebyemiigo; kandi yabatizibwa, uwe nenjuye yona ahonaho.

english: Even though we live in the flesh, we do not fight according to the flesh.
lunyoro: Baitu nobuturukugenda omu mubiri, titurukurwana ntukuratira omubiri,

english: Another one came out of the other horse, and he was given authority to take peace away from the earth and to deal with each other, and he was given a crown of thorns.
lunyoro: Harugayo embarasi endi rugaju: nogu akaba aikalireho yahabwa obusobozi okuihaho obusinge ha nsi, baitangane bonka: kandi yahabwa busitama enkoto.

english: For the sake of their false brothers who have come to us in the dark has taken away our sins by means of Christ Jesus, so that they may lead us into error.
lunyoro: Obwa bene babu abebisuba, abaizire omulitwe omu nsita okutata obugabe bwaitu obutunyinabwo omu Kristo Yesu, nukwo batukwase omu buiru:

english: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. I tell this one, ‘Come,’ and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he will do it.
lunyoro: Baitu na nyowe ndi muntu omulemwa, nyina baserikale abadama: kandi ngambira onu nti Ija; nomuiru wange rubale nti Kora kinu, akikora.

english: For the children of this age are much more precious than the children of sin.
lunyoro: Baitu abana bogu ayangirwe baingi okukira bogu ali naibi.

english: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not burdensome.
lunyoro: Baitu kunu nukwo kugonza Ruhanga, itwe tukwate ebiragirobye: kandi ebiragobye tibirukulemera.

english: The young man said to him, ‘I have kept all these things straight, and where did I come from?’
lunyoro: Omusigazi yamugambira ati Ebi byona nkabihikiriza, kandi ekimbuzireho kiraha?

english: We left for Philippi, a city in Macedonia that was the first to be built in these cities. We lived in that city for a few days.
lunyoro: duga Firipi, nurwo rubuga orwa Makedoni, orubandizibwaho omu mbaju ezi; orwayombekerwe Abarumi: twaikara omu rubuga oru ebiro ebimu.

english: If he had prayed for God's message to the Gentiles, and the Scriptures could not be removed.
lunyoro: Obwaraba yabesere abo abaruhanga okutebeza ekigambo kya Ruhanga ( kandi Ebyahandikirwe tibisobora okuhwaho)

english: For we did not live in the way that God knew us; nor did we live in the way that he knew us; nor did we live in the way that God had promised.
lunyoro: Baitu titukabaga omu kigambo kyokutebora nkokumumanyire, nobukyakuba ekisweke'ra obugobya, Ruhanga nuwe waitu;

english: And if I take away all my belongings, and give up my body to be burned, I will never be thirsty again.
lunyoro: nobundaba nindisa abasege ebinyinabyo byona, kandi obundaba nimpayo omubiri gwange okwokebwa omu'ro, kunu ntanyina kugonza, tikingasira na kake.

english: He sent Peter and John, “Go and prepare a Passover meal for us, and we will eat.”
lunyoro: Kandi uwe akatuma Petero na Yohana nagamba ati Mugende mututekanirize Okuhingurwaho, turye.

english: For those who drink milk do not know the word of righteousness, because they are children.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa amata, tamanyire kurungi ekigambo kyokuhiki'ra; baitu ali mwana muto.

english: They killed the Lord Jesus, the prophets, and the rest of us; they are no longer God's people, and they are enemies to all people.
lunyoro: ebiisire Mukama waitu Yesu nabanabi, kandi abatubingire, kunu tibarukusimwa Ruhanga, kandi bali banyanzigwa babantu bona;

english: We had the opportunity to die for us, so that we might not trust ourselves, but God, who raises the dead.
lunyoro: tukatunga okugarukamu okwokufa omu nda yaitu, nukwo tuleke okweyesiga itwenka, baitu Ruhanga arukuhumbura abafu:

english: They came to him and woke him up and said, “Sir, we are dead!” He got up and cried out with a loud cry, “Crucify him!” The wind stopped, and the wind died.
lunyoro: Baija namberali nibamusisimura, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu, nturafa. Yasisimuka, yayamuza niraka erihango ati Mara, mara akacu.Ekiyaga kyahwaho, kyaculera muno.

english: For your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
lunyoro: baitu Isenywe ali omu iguru amanyire nimwenda ebi byona.

english: Jesus said to her, “Because of this saying, you have gone away, the demon has gone out of your daughter.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Habwekigambo kinu oyegendere, omuzimu gurugire ha muisiki wawe.

english: Paul called to him one of the officials and said, “We have brought this young man to the commander's office, because he has something to tell him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yayeta namberali omu hali abanyakihanda, nagamba ati Twara omusigazi onu hali engabwa enkuru: baitu ayina ekyokumutebeza.

english: So then, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat flesh at all, that I may not make my brother stumble.
lunyoro: Nukwo ebyokurya biraba nibitabaijura mugenzi wange, tindirya enyama ebiro byona, ndeke okutabaijuru mugenzi wange.

english: For whoever obeys his word has the love of God made perfect through him. And so we know that we belong to him.
lunyoro: baitu wena anyakukwata ekigambokye, mazimakwo omuruwe okugonza kwa Ruhanga kukahikirizibwa. Nuho turukumanyira ngu tuli omuruuwe:

english: Joseph was a good man, but he did not want to make him ashamed, and he was trying to keep him safe.
lunyoro: Yusufu iba, baitu akabali muntu ahikirire, atagonze kumukwasa ensoni bwa, akaba natekereza okumuleka omunsita.

english: He will be handed over a hundred times over to the houses of his brothers, his brothers, his relatives, his mothers, his children, the land, and the land. He will be handed over to the power of the sun, and in the age to come,
lunyoro: Baitu alihebwa emirundi kikumi omu biro binu ebya hati, enju, ha bene babu, na banyanya, nabanyina, nabana, nobutaka, hamu nokuhigwa; kandi omu businge oburukugenda kuija,

english: And our hope for you is firm. We see that as you share in the sufferings, so you will share in the consolation.
