lunyoro: Arukugamba omu magezige wenka:baitu anyakuse'ra ekirinisa kyogu ayamutumire, nuwe wa mananu, kandi obutahiki'ra busamu omuruwe.

english: That very day some Pharisees came to him and said, “Go away! Herod is trying to kill you!”
lunyoro: Omu kasumi ako nubwo baizire Abafalisayo abamu, nibamugambira ngu Ruga hanu oyegendere: baitu Herode nase'ra okukuita.

english: They stood up in fear of his punishment, and said, “How terrible for that great city, Babylon! For in one hour your judgment has come!”
lunyoro: batukumira obwokutina okubonabonesebwakwe, nibagamba ngu Ziruboine, Baburoni orubuga rwamani! baitu omu saha emu okucwerwa omusango kwawe kuhikire.

english: They strengthened the disciples and encouraged them to remain firm in the faith, saying, “We must enter the Kingdom of God with great difficulty.”
lunyoro: bagumya emitima yabegeswa, nibagambi'ra okekambaga omukuikiriza, kandi ngu omu muhito omweingi kitruhikirire okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: If you divorce your wife, you will have to pay back your living.
lunyoro: Omukazi wena obwaryahukana naiwe aikaire naiwe omusango ogwokusisa.

english: If someone else sat down and had been revealed, the first one to speak would have told him.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu ondi anyakuikalire obwaba nasuku'rwa ekigambo, owokubanza aculere.

english: For we wanted to come to you, my servant Paul, the first time, the second time, and the Devil tempted us.
lunyoro: Baitu tukagonza okuija nambemuli, nyowe Pauro, omurundi ogwokubanza nogwakabiri; kandi Setani yatutanga.

english: “Don't let anyone fool you or accuse you of evil,” he told them. “You will get your reward.”
lunyoro: Mutaligiza mani omuntu wena, nobukwakuba okutonga okubi; munihege empera yanyu.

english: So then, the rest of the Sabbath was set aside for God's people.
lunyoro: Nukwo hasigaireho okuhumura okwa Sabiti hali abantu ba Ruhanga.

english: Another filled with wine was added to the jar, and the jar filled with water was poured over his mouth.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho entugiro endi ijuire omarwa agasalire: kandi bata ha hezobu ekijumankuba ekiijuire amaizi amarungi, bagita ha kanwake.

english: For food will not make us proud of God, but even if we don't eat, we will not be thirsty; and if we eat, we will not be thirsty.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokurya tibirukutusimisa hali Ruhanga: baitu nobwakubaire tutarukurya titubuzirweho; kandi nobwakuibaire nturya titukizire.

english: Those who make these two things appear to you as though they were a shadow of the heavenly things, just as Moses was led by God when he was going to see the tent. For he says, ‘Do everything according to what was seen on the mountain.’
lunyoro: nibo babahereza ebi ebiri nkekisisani nekiituro kyebyomu iguru,nka Musa okuyahabuirwe Ruhanga, obwakaba nagenda okurora hema: baitu agamba ati Dora, okole byona nkekyokuro'raho okukiri ekyakwolekirwe ha rusozi.

english: The army officer and those who were with him saw Jesus, who had seen the earthquake and the things that were happening. They were terrified and said, “Surely this man was the Son of God!”
lunyoro: Kandi omunyoro owekihanda, nabakaba bali nauwe, nibarole'ra Yesu, obababoine omusisa, nebigambo ebikaba babaireho, batina muno, nibagamba ngu Mazimakwo ogu abaire Mwana wa Ruhanga.

english: Paul said to the commander and to the soldiers, “Unless you are in the boat, you cannot be saved!”
lunyoro: Pauro yagambira omunyakihanda nabaserikale ati Abo obubataikale omu kyombo, inywe timusobole okujunwa.

english: Be careful with what you say, and do not let anything be said to you.
lunyoro: Mwekambe okutabaza kurungi abantu baleke okubagambira ekigambo kyona

english: Or did God's word come from you or did it come to you by yourself?
lunyoro: Rundi ekigambo kya Ruhanga kikaruga namberemuli? Rundi kikahika halinywe inywenka?

english: But if you suffer, you are all partners in union with Christ, and you are no longer children.
lunyoro: baitu obumuba numubonabonesebwa, bona okubaterana nakwo, muli bitwekano, kunu timuli bana.

english: The Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their trials and to keep the wicked under punishment until the Day of judgment.
lunyoro: Mukama amanyire okujuna abarukutina Ruhanga omu kwohebwa, nokwahura abatahikirire omu kubonabonesebwa kuhikya ha kiro kyomusango;

english: Watch, then, and remember that I have not done this to anyone, and I have not kept on drinking water in three days and nights.
lunyoro: Nukwo murole inywe, numuijuka ngu ntaleke okuhana bona,noku'ra amaizi, emyaka esatu nyamusana nekiro.

english: When Peter saw it, he said to the people, “What did you men of Israel not understand? Why did you make us think that our own power or the worship of our God has made you unclean?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obuyaboine yagarukamu abantu ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, kiki ekibatangalize omuna? Rundi numutugumizaho ki amaiso okutekereza ngu amani gaitu itwenka, rundi okutina Ruhanga okwaitu, nibyo bimugendeseze ogu?

english: They heard him say this because for a long time he was amazed at them and saw them.
lunyoro: kandi bamuhu'ra, baitu ebiro bingi yabatangazaga nokurogakwe.

english: His elder son was in the field. When he came home, he heard what had happened to him and how he had seen it.
lunyoro: Mutabaniwe omukuru akabali omu misiri; obuyaizire nai'ra haihi nenju, akahu'ra enyamulere nokuzina.

english: For I tell you, I will never eat until the Kingdom of God comes.
lunyoro: baitu nimbagambira nti Tindiburya na kake okuhikya obubulikahiki'ra omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: The master of the house called him and said to him, ‘You wicked and wicked servant! I forgave you all the time,
lunyoro: Yamuetera, yamugambira ati Iwe omuiru rubale, omubi, nkakuganyira ibanja ryona,

english: For it is my blood that makes me clean, and it is a drink that makes me clean.
lunyoro: baitu niyo sagama yange eyomuziro, eseseka habwaitu obwobugara.

english: In the same way, in the matter of greed, in the presence of others, in the presence of greed, in the presence of greed, in the presence of greed, in the presence of others, and in the presence of others.
lunyoro: hati omu bujune, omu kujaga'ra, omu kusiba, omu mbeho, omu kutukumira, omu kutalikusiba;

english: He knew Peter's voice, but not because he was happy. But Peter went in and said that Peter was standing outside.
lunyoro: Obuyamanyirire iraka rya Petero, atakinguleho oruigi obwokusemererwa, baitu yatahamu bwango nagamba Petero ayemerire aheru ha ruigi.

english: But now I come to you, and I tell you in the world that you will have my joy made perfect by means of them.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu ninyija namberoli; na binu nimbigamba omu nsi, babe nokusemererwa kwange, kuhikiri'le omubo.

english: But you know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins (he said to the paralyzed man)
lunyoro: baitu mumanye Omwana womuntu anyina obusobozi hansi okuihaho ebibi (akagambira anyakuzingamire ati )

english: But if I, my friends, teach you to be circumcised, why, then, do I have to boast about the shames of the cross—the disgrace of Christ has already disappeared.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe, bene baitu, obundaba ninkyayegesa okusarwa, ninkyahigirwa ki? Ensoni ezomutigwa Kristo buli ziihirweho.

english: They wanted to kill him, and they ordered that the bread that God had prepared would be taken away from them by means of those who believed and knew the truth.
lunyoro: kandi baragira okumuita, nibaragira okuleka emigati ya Ruhanga obwezikiriza, abo abaikiriza nokumanya kimu amazima.

english: But if a man with a gold coin comes into your meeting, he is clothed in purple, and a poor man in filthy clothing, and he is wearing a gold coin.
lunyoro: Baitu obwataha omu is'orokaniro ryanyu omuntu anyina empeta ya zabu, ajwaire ebyokwecuma, kandi nomuntu owamasege atahamu ajwairwe ebisemire, nauwe anyina empale eya zabu;

english: You have followed the Evil One from the very beginning.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe mwagenderaga omwebi kara obumukaba muli bomezi omubyo.

english: After they had eaten, they lightened the ship, throwing some of them into the sea.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okuiguta, ekyombo bakirahukya, nibanaga engano omu nyanja.

english: For now it has been made known to all the nations by means of the writings of the prophets, just as God commanded by means of the word of his will, for the obedience of his faith.
lunyoro: baitu hati eyolekerwe, kandi nemanyisibwa amahanga gona omu byahandikirwe banabi, nkekiragiro kya Ruhanga ekyokuikiriza kwabu okukuli,

english: His fame spread everywhere in Galilee.
lunyoro: Nebigambobye bikaranganwa bwango honahona, omu nsi zona eza Galiraya Ezihe'raine.

english: The wall was broken off from the city, and blood came out of the city, from the gates to the gates of the city, to a thousand miles [10 miles] away.
lunyoro: nesagama yaruga omu ndeba, okuhika ha nkoba zembarasi, okuhikya sitadyo rukumi mu rukaga.

english: I have done the same and have revealed that he is the Son of God.
lunyoro: Nayowe nkakora, ni'manyisa nti Ogu nuwe Mwana wa Ruhanga.

english: He came out of the tombs, and no one could arrest him, nor could anyone put him out of the way.
lunyoro: yarugire omu bituro: kandi busaho muntu ayasoboire okumuboha, nobuhokuba omu rujegere,

english: Then Jesus said, “Look! I have come to do your will.” So he left the first thing and fixed the second one.
lunyoro: Nukwo yagamba ati Dora, nyizire okukora ebyogonza. Aihaho ekyokubanza, agumye ekyakabiri.

english: He wants to be mistreated with God's people rather than to have the joy of being set free from sin.
lunyoro: yayegomboze okukorwa kubi hamu nabantu ba Ruhanga, okukira okuba nokwesemeza okwebibi okurukuhwaho bwango:

english: Jesus answered, “Before the rooster crows, you will never eat anything you have to eat.” The disciples wept.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nagugambira ati Okubanza hati omuntu atalirya ha byana byawe ebiro nebiro.Nabegeswa bakaku'ra.

english: They were all amazed at the gracious words that came out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn't this Joseph's son?”
lunyoro: nibahuni'ra bona obwebigambo bye mbabazi ebyarugire omu kanwake: nibagamba ngu Tinu onu mwana wa Yusufu?

english: and said to me, ‘No, but I will do it, because I don't have to obey my children.’
lunyoro: kandi nagamba nti Nsakora nta, baitu tinyina hokwahura ebyana byange?

english: Jesus saw her and said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter the Kingdom of God!
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yamurora nagamba ati Nikiremera abanyina obuguda okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: Some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found it just as the women had told them, because they had seen him.
lunyoro: Nabamu hali abo abakaba tuli nabo bakagenda hali ekituro basangayo nka bakazi okubagambire: baitu ogu bazira okumubona.

english: You will rest, but you will not be able to speak until the day that these things happen, because you did not believe my message, which will happen to you.”
lunyoro: Kandi dora, oliculera, okutasobora okugamba, okuhika ha kiro eki ebigambo binu obubirikahiki'ra, baitu toikirize bigambo byange, ebirihika ha mpiko zabyo.

english: So then, a slave is no longer a slave, but a son; and if you are a child, you are God's children.
lunyoro: Nukwo tokyali muiru rubale, baitu omwana; kandi obwaraba oli mwana oli mugwetwa habwa Ruhanga.

english: For Christ has come near to death, not fearing the things that belong to him, but only what has happened to him by your service to me.
lunyoro: baitu habwemirimo ya Kristo akai'ra haihi nokufa, obwataratinirire obwomwzibwe, nokwo ahikye ebyabuzireho omu kuhereza Kwanyu namberendi.

english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness is based on the righteousness of the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees, you will never enter the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira nti okuhiki'ra kwanyu obukutalikira okuhi'ra okwabahandiki Nabafalisayo, timulitaha na kake omu bukama obwomu iguru.

english: The woman, who had been sick for twelve years, came back and made a rule about her clothes.
lunyoro: Kandi, omukazi akaba arwaire ekyejwiso ekyesamaga emyakaikumi nebiri, yaija enyumaye, yamukoraho orugoye orwa bafuta,

english: In the presence of the churches, then, you have seen how much you love us and how we boast about you.
lunyoro: nukwo muboleke omu maiso gekanisa akokuro'raho akokugonza kwanyu, nokwenyumiza kwaitu habwanyu.

english: “No,” I tell you, “but if you do not turn from your sins, you will all be lost.”
lunyoro: ndabagambira nti Tikirikyo: baitu obumutegarukamu, nukwo mulihwereke'ra muti inywena.

english: This means eternal life. To know that you are God, the only true and the one whom you have chosen, Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Bunu nubwo bwomezi obutahwaho. Okumanya iwe Ruhanga omu owamananu, nogu ouwayumire, Yesu Kristo.

english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. The street of the city was pure gold, as if it were a jasper stone.
lunyoro: Amalembo ikumi nabiri ruru ikumi na ibiri: nikute eryorubuga zabu enungi, nkendo'rwamu erukurorana.

english: But on the day Lot left Sodom fire and sulfur and destroyed them all.
lunyoro: baitu ha kiro Ruta ekiyarugire omu Sodomu omu'ro nekibiriti bikagwa okuruga omu iguru nibahwerekereza bona:

english: One hour later another said, “I am a man with Jesus, but you are a Galilean.”
lunyoro: Kandi akasumi akesaha emu kahinguireho, ondi yagamba muno ati Mananukwo omusaija omu abaire ali hamu nauwe: baitu Mugaliraya.

english: For I see that you are in the power of an evil one.
lunyoro: Baitu mboine oli omu ndurwe erukusa'ra nomu nkomo eyobubi.

english: I want to be proud of you, my friends, of the fact that you have the life in union with Christ Jesus our Lord.
lunyoro: Nindahi'ra okwenyumiza oku habwanyu bene baitu okunyinakwo omu Kristo Yesu Mukama waitu nfa obukyabukya.

english: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sat down with the invited guests
lunyoro: Kandi akasumi obukahikirire yaika'ra nabakwenda hamu na uwe

english: But when the foolish took their lamps,
lunyoro: Baitu abadomadoma obubatwaire etabaza zabu,

english: The chief priests, the teachers, and the elders made fun of him
lunyoro: nabanyakatagara abakuru, nibahandiki, nabakuru nukwo bamuterire enaku

english: Or do we take revenge on the Lord or be stronger than he?
lunyoro: Rundi tumukwasa ihali Mukama waitu? rundi tuli bamani okukira uwe?

english: But I said to you, ‘You will see, but you will not believe.’
lunyoro: Baitu nkabagambira nti Mumboine, kunu timurukuikiriza.

english: Jesus called his disciples to him and said to them, “I tell you that this poor widow did more than all the others who were going to the synagogue.
lunyoro: Kandi yayeta abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omufakati onu owamasege anagiremu bingi okukira bona abarukunaga omu ryahu'ro;

english: When he called for authority and authority, he did it only after he had given it to them.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyayetuire okulema nobusobozi, yabifora byokusunga kwonka, obuyabisinguire hagwo.

english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. But if the light that is in you is darkness, how much more so will the darkness be!
lunyoro: Baitu eriso ryawe obuliraba libihire, omubiri gwawe gwona guliijura omuirima. Baitu omusana oguli omuliwe obuguraba guli muirima, omuiririma ogu guliingana nkaha obukoto!

english: Again they said, “We found a prison that is in good condition, and the guards standing there. But when we opened it, we found no one there.”
lunyoro: Ha nju yenkomo tugisangire eboherwe kurungi mali, nabalinzi bemerire ha nyigi: baitu obutukinguirehoga titusangiremu omuntu.

english: So then, the second and the third to the whole
lunyoro: Nowakabiri nowa kasatu nukwo bati nobwa bona.

english: Can't I do what I want? Or can't your eye do you harm, because I am good?
lunyoro: Kinu tindukusobora kukora ebyange nkokundukugonza? Rundi eriso ryawe libi, baitu nyowe ndi murungi?

english: He has done what he could. He has anointed my body to be holy.
lunyoro: Akozire nkokwasoboire: abandize okusesa amagita ha mubiri gwange okunzika.

english: So he left and went to a certain man named Titus, who was named Justus, who worshiped God and his house, which was ready to be destroyed.
lunyoro: Yarugayo,yataha omu nju yomuntu omu, ibararye Tito Yusito, ayaramyaga Ruhanga, nenjuye ekaba eherire iso'rokaniro.

english: If I had not done to them the work that no one else did, they would not have sinned; but now they have seen that I am with my Father.
lunyoro: Kakuba ntarakozire hali bo emirimo etarakozirwe ondi, tibakubaire nekibi; baitu hati bunu barozire nibanoba nyowe na Isenyowe.

english: But when you hand over your gift to the poor, do not be afraid of them; instead, I tell you that they have been given their reward.
lunyoro: Baitu obworagabiraga abasege, otalitera engwara omu maiso gawe, nkabagobya okubakora. Mananukwo nimbagambira nti bamazire kuhebwa empera yabu.

english: As Peter spoke these things, the Holy Spirit was poured out on all who heard the message.
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obwakaba nabaza ebigambo ebi, Omwoyo Ogurukwera yabagwaho, bona abahulire ekigambo.

english: Come near to him, as the Lord wants you to be holy, and help him in all that he wants you to do. For he himself was the Savior of many, and he was my own.
lunyoro: muirize haihi omu Mukama waitu nkokukisemerire abarukwera, kandi mumukonyere omu kigambo kyona ekyalise'ra. Baitu nauwe wenyini akabali mukonyezi wabaingi, kandi owange nyenka.

english: For I do not know the word of God at all, but it is not that I am the one who judges the Lord.
lunyoro: Baitu tinyemanyireho nyenka ekigambo, baitu tikiri nikyo kinyihaho omusango: baitu Mukama waitu nuwe ancwera omusango.

english: So Jesus went back home and found a child lying on the bed, and the spirit came out of him.
lunyoro: Yagarukayo omu njuye, yasanga omwana abyamibwe ha kitabu, nomuzimu gumurugireho.

english: At once three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stood before us.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, ahonaho abantu basatu bemerire omu maiso genju nambere tuli, abatumirwe namberendi okuruga Kaisaliya.

english: You will see and see a baby wrapped in cloths, lying in a manger.
lunyoro: Murole omwana wenkerembe aswekerwe omu ngoye ezobwana bwenkerembe, abyamire omu nju yenta.

english: The blind see, the sick go away, and the lame speak well of them.
lunyoro: abafu bamaiso nibarora, abaramaire bibagenda, nabagenge basemezibwe ebigambo ebirungi.

english: But how can their brother be reconciled to their brother and to the unbelievers?
lunyoro: Baitu mwene wabu atongana na mwene wabu, kandi nomu maiso gabatarukuikiriza?

english: Which authority has he given you to do these things? And who gave you this authority?
lunyoro: Loha okukuha obusobozi bunu? Kandi noha yakuhaire obusobozi obu?

english: What do you think of the Son of Man when he came to the ancient world?
lunyoro: Kandi kiriba kita obumulirora Omwana womuntu natemba nambere akabali kara na kara?

english: Jesus said to him, “Foxes have holes, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lie down and sleep.
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Eboha ziyina ebina byazo, nenyonyi ezahagati ziyina ebiju byazo; baitu Omwana womutnu tayina hokuta omutwegwe.

english: Whenever you go to a town and believe in them, take what they have to do with you.
lunyoro: Norubuga rwona orumurakatahamuga nibabaikiriza, muryege ebi ebibalita omu maiso ganyu:

english: I will gladly give it to you, and I will be given it because of your life. If you love me more, how much more will I love you?
lunyoro: Nukwo nokusemererwa kwingi ndihayo, kandi ndihebwayo habwobwomezi bwanyu. Obundaba nimbabagonza okukira muno, nyowe ningonzebwa kake?

english: Stand firm in the faith, with all the holy ones, ready to share in the work of preaching the Good News and making known to the people the good news.
lunyoro: kandi obumwombekerwe hamu nabarukwera bona, muikalege namani okuterana omu kuhereza nokwegesa;

english: If Satan had the Devil's mark, how would his kingdom last?
lunyoro: Kandi Setani obwaraba na binga setani abaganizibwamu wenka, obukamabwe buliikaraho buta?

english: But if you are unclean, you must not commit adultery; and if you are guilty of sin, you must not commit adultery; but if you are guilty of a sin, you must be free from sin; and if you are guilty of sin, you must be free from sin.
lunyoro: baitu oraba nosisa, aleke okusisa: kandi oraba nokwata ekiragiro, alekere asemezebwe.

english: and said, “This man made no difference between praising God and doing what the Law commands not to do.”
lunyoro: nibagamba ngu Omuntu onu nayohya abatu okuramya Ruhanga nkebiragiro okubitaragira.

english: They could not immediately find out how the crowd was looking for them.
lunyoro: kandi batasobole bwango okutanaga abekitebe okubarora.

english: We do this not only in the presence of the Lord but also in the presence of men.
lunyoro: tusima, tibuli obwomutima gwaitu gwonka, baitu obwa Mukama waitu nomu Bantu.

english: Follow him, and he went everywhere and said to the Teacher, “Who is the Teacher in the house where my disciples and I will eat the Passover meal?”
lunyoro: mugende, mumukuratire; mugambire nyineka ngu Omwegesa agambire ati Enju eraha eyindaliramu Okuhingurwaho nabegeswa bange?

english: The Holy Spirit came down upon him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came out of the cloud, “You are my Son, the one I want you to honor with me!”
lunyoro: Roho Ogurukwera yasirimuka haruwe omu kisisani kyomubiri nkeriba, niraka ryaruga omu irungu ngu Niwe mwana wange oundukugonza; nkusemererirwe muno.

english: They did not find the one who had come back, and they did not find the one who had come back to praise God or the one who was a Gentile.
lunyoro: Kandi tibazokire abagarukire okujuma Ruhanga? Rundi ogu owomuhanga, rundi ogu atali owa Isaleri?

english: And if anyone lives and believes in me, he will never die. Do you believe this?”
lunyoro: kandi omuntu wena obwayomera nakiriza nyowe, talifa ebiro nebiro. Noikiriza eki?

english: He is greater than ours, and he is greater than we who believe, just as he is able to do.
lunyoro: kandi nobukuru obukira muno obwamanige halitwe abarukuikiriza okubuli, nkobusobozi obwokukora okubukora,

english: They took the twelve baskets and filled them with the fish.
lunyoro: Kandi bakomaho oburagalika, nibaijuza ebigega ikumi nabibiri, nobwencu nabwo.

english: It happened in the past that he spoke to our ancestors, in many ways and in many ways through the prophets.
lunyoro: Kara, Ruhanga obuyagambiraga baisenkuru itwe, omu bicweka bingi nemiringo nyingi omu banabi.

english: In the same way, you yourselves are on the earth just as I was in the world, but you have filled the world with violence and the Kingdom.
lunyoro: Kandi nainywe nukwo muti haruguru numusisana nkabahikirire omu Bantu, baitu omunda mwijuire obugobya nobwemi.

english: After they had put them in the middle of the meal, they asked, “What is this name or name that will do to them?”

lunyoro: Kandi anyakuhu'ra ebigambo byange atarukubikwata, nyowe timucwera omusango: baitu okujuna ensi.

english: Your love and your faith in the Lord Jesus and in all the holy ones.
lunyoro: Gonza okugonza kwawe nokuikiriza kwawe okwonyinakwo hali Mukama waitu Yesu, na hali abarukwera bona;

lunyoro: Nukwo murolege inywe: baitu timurukumanya nyineka nambere aliizira, rundi obuire buizire, nobugwakuba omu maiso, nobwekuba omu nyenkya;

english: Jesus said this in a private meeting and taught in the Temple, but no one arrested him, because the rooster had not yet come.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi akabigamba omu ryahu'ro, nayegesa omu yekaru: kandi busaho ayamukwasire; baitu akasumike kakaba katakahikire.

english: They had iron spears like those of scorpions, and many horsemen were the ones who were going to fight.
lunyoro: kandi zikaba ziyina ebyahakifuba nkebyoma; nokuhi'ra kwamagali, okwembarasi nyingi ezijumbutukira okurwana.

english: How terrible for you Pharisees! You love the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts!
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe Abafalisayo! baitu numugonza entebe ezahagati omu maso'rokaniro, nokuramukibwa omu butale.

english: If Christ has been revealed to us, then you too will be shown by means of him in glory.
lunyoro: Kristo, obwomezi bwaitu, obwalimanyisibwa, nubwo nainywe hamu nauwe hamu nekitinisa.

english: The people shouted for a man who had not been healed, and they tried to trap him and put him in front of him.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, abantu bakaletera ha kitabu omuntu akaba azingamire: nibase'ra okumutahyamu, nokumubyamisa omu maisoge.

english: When all things have been placed under him, then the Son himself will be put under him, who placed all things under him, and God himself will be put under him.
lunyoro: Kandi ebintu byona obubalitebwa hansiye, nubwo Nomwana wenka alitebwa hansi yogu ayataire byona hansiye; nuwko Ruhanga aikaleho omu wenka.

english: He endured their deeds in the desert for forty years.
lunyoro: Yagumisirizaga engeso zabu omu irungu emyaka nkamakumi ana.

english: and said, “Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees until we have killed the servants of our God in their presence.”
lunyoro: nagamba ati Mutasisa ensi, nobwekuba enyanja, nobugwakuba emiti, okuhikya obutulibataho akokuro'raho abairu ba Ruhanga waitu ha buso bwabu.

english: I know your deeds, your love, your faith, and your service, and your endurance, and the last days of your life.
lunyoro: Manyire emirimo yawe, nokugonza, nokuikiriza, nokuhereza, nogumisiriza kwawe, nemirom yawe eyahanyuma okuba nyingi okukira eyokubanza.

english: Watch, my friends, as examples of suffering and of the patience of the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
lunyoro: Bene baitu mukwate nka ekyokuro'raho ekyokububonabonesebw nokugumisiriza banabi abagambaga omu ibara rya Mukama.

english: For in many things we all sin. If we do not sin by the words of the mouth, we are innocent and can save our whole body.
lunyoro: Baitu omu bingi tusobya itwena. Omuntu wena obwatasobya omu mukigambo kyorulimi, ogu nuwe muntu ahikirire, nasobora okutanga omubiri gwona.

english: Was Christ ever with you or was he with you when you believed in him and did not believe?
lunyoro: Kristo naterana ata na Beriali? Rundi arukuikiriza nabagana ata natarukuikiriza?

english: Go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Gende, muhindule amahanga gona abegeswa, numubabatiza okutaha omu ibara rya Isitwe Nomwana Nomwoyo Ogurukwera:

english: They were upset because they taught the people and proclaimed that Jesus had been raised from death.
lunyoro: babihirwa munu baitu bakegesa abantu, nibatebeza habwa Yesu okuhumbuka omu bafu.

english: And even though the birth itself is not the only thing to teach you, is it shameful for a man to have a sharp sickle?
lunyoro: Kandi nokuzarwa kwonka tikurukubegesa ngu omusaija obwaba anyina isoke eriraihire, kiba kyensoni haruwe?

english: But Demas left him, and loved the present life, and went to Thessalonica. So he went to Galatia, where Titus went to Dalmatia.
lunyoro: baitu Dema akansiga, agondeze obusinge bwa hati bunu, yagenda Sesaronika; Keereseke yagenda Garatiya, Tito yagenda Daramatiya.

english: And from where these things have been done, they will no longer offer sacrifices for sin.
lunyoro: Kandi nambere ebi biihibwaho, tihakyali okuhonga ebyonzira obwebibi.

english: May God, our Savior, give us grace, so that we may be the ones who will be saved by the hope of eternal life.
lunyoro: Kandi Omujuni waitu: nukwo obutwihibweho obwembabazize, tufoke abagwetwa omu kunihira obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: I have turned my back to you, my mother and my brothers, and I am pure in heart.
lunyoro: mperowe namberoli nkomutima ogusemezibwe, nuwe mutima gwange mali mali mali:

english: It does not rejoice over unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth.
lunyoro: Turukusemererwa okutahiki'ra, baitu tukusemere'rwa amazima;

english: So Jesus left and followed him, because he did not know what the angel had done, but thought he had seen a vision.
lunyoro: Kandi yaturuka namukuratira; baitu atamanye byamananu maraika ebiyakozire, baitu akatekereza aboine okwolekwa.

english: We pray for God's will to be done, so that we may be like the slaves of the world, who are the slaves of all things, and to this very day.
lunyoro: tukefora nkabairu rubale abomu nsi, nokuhambirizibwa ebintu byona nokuhikya hati.

english: For by means of their faith they will be saved, and by their faith they will be put to death.
lunyoro: Baitu alijunwa habwokuzara abana obubaliikara omu kuikiriza, nomu kuganza, nomu kwezebwa hamu nokwerinda.

english: For if I drive out demons by the power of God, the Kingdom of God will come upon them.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe obundaba nimbingisa emizimu orukumu rwa Ruhanga, nukwo obukama bwa Ruhanga bubaizirire.

english: Now I am happy, not because of your sadness, but because you are sad because of your repentance. You have made God sad, so that you will not lose everything for us.
lunyoro: hati bunu ninsemererwa; tibuli obwokutuntura kwanyu, baitu inywe obwokuganya hali okwegarukamu: baitu mukatuntura hali Ruhanga, nukwo mutaferwa kyona obwaitu.

english: You foolish ones, didn't he who made the heaven perform the same function?
lunyoro: Inywe abadomadoma, ogu ayakozire ha ruguru tinuwe yakozire nomunda?

english: “Watch out,” he said, “and do not be fooled. Many will come to my house and say, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time has come for the flood to come,’ but do not follow them.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Mwerindege mutahabisibwa: baitu baingi abaliija omu ibvara ryange nibagamba ngu Ninyowogu; kandi ngu Akasumu kamalize kuhika: mutalibakuratira.

english: “Teacher,” they asked him, “Moses wrote this to us: ‘If a man dies and leaves his wife but has no children, then his brother must marry his wife and raise children to his brother.’
lunyoro: bamukaguza ngu Omwegesa, Musa akatuhandikira ati Omugenzi womuntu obwafa nasiga mukaziwe atakazaire bana, mugenziwe aswerege mukaziwe aza'rege mugenyi abana.

english: Jesus concluded this parable by saying to some who were self-controlled, “All are righteous, and all others are righteous.”
lunyoro: Kandi akacwera orufumo runu abamu abakaba nibesiga bonka ngu bahikirire, nibagaya abandi bona:

english: When they saw him, they all became angry and said, “He has gone out to punish the man who is a sinner!”
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine bahyema bona nibagamba ngu Atahire okugonya omba omuntu omusisi.

english: And our Father, be praised forever and ever. Amen.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga waitu Isitwe ahabwege ekitinisa ebiro nebiro Amina.

english: For this reason you were called, because Christ also suffered for you and left you a model for you to follow his steps.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo mwayetirwe: baitu na Kristo nauwe akabonabonesebwa habwanyu, nabasigira ekyokuro'raho, nukwo mukuratire omu bigerebye:

english: So then, you should be glad to hear, not only because of your sadness, but also because of your heart's sadness.
lunyoro: nukwo kibahikirire okuhu'ra, tibuli obwekiniga kyonka, baitu obwokukenga okwomu mutima nakwo.

english: For we are saying that he will save Israel. And so it is with all these things, that the third time these things happened.
lunyoro: baitu itwe tukanihira ngu Nuwe alicungura Isaleri. Nukwo na ha binu byona, hati nikyo kyakasatu, ebigambo binu bikaba kubaho.

english: But if a person goes to night, he does not remember them, because the light is not in him.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu obwagenda ekiro atabaijuka, baitu omusana tiguli omuruwe.

english: He went on his way through the city with the teaching and went to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi akagenda omu muhandagwe omu mbuga nomu makanayegesa, nagenda hali Yerusalemu.

english: Watch yourself and obey your teaching. Keep yourself safe in these things, because when you do these things, you will save yourself and those who listen to you.
lunyoro: Werindege wenka nokwegesa kwawe. Oikalege omu bigambo binu; baitu obwokora binu oryejuna wenka, kandi oliijuna nabo abakuhu'ra.

english: The sight was so terrible that Moses said, “I am so afraid that I will cry to you.”
lunyoro: kandi nebyarozirwe bikaba biri byokutinisa biti, Musa akagamba ati Ntinire muno nintukumira.

english: Just as the Father sent me, even so I live because of the Father. Whoever wants to live only for me will live for me.
lunyoro: Nk'Isenyowe okkuyantumire, nanyowe nkokundukwomera habwa Isenyowe; nukwo ati anyakundya, nuwe aryomera habwange.

english: Through the power of the Spirit to obey and to be purified by the blood of Jesus Christ, grace and peace has been poured out on you.
lunyoro: omu kwezebwa Okwomwoyo hali okuhu'ra nokumisirwa okwesagama ya Yesu Kristo: embabazi nobusinge bikanyizibwe halinywe.

english: That is why I write this, so that when I come, I will not be troubled by those who are right to me, but by your faith I will be able to share my joy with all of you.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo mpandikire, nukwo obundiija ndeke okuba nobujune hali abo abakihikirire okunsemeza, baitu ninyesiga inywe inywena nukwo okusemererwa kwange nukwo kwanyu inywena.

english: In your heart there is nothing that can be eaten, nor eaten, nor taken away, nor did a piece of bread or a piece of wood or a piece of wood, but a man who does what he does should be given his food.
lunyoro: (le) omu myeko yanyu; nobwekuba endyanga, nobubyakuba ebyesomeko bibiri, nobuzakuba nkaito, nobugwakuba omuigo, baitu anyakukora emirimo naseme'ra okuhebwa ebyokuryabye.

english: Jesus said to them, “Where do you get the bread? Go and see.” When they knew it, they said, “Five, and two fish!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Muyina emigati ingaha? Mugende murole. Obubamanyire bagamba ngu Etano, nencu ibiri.

english: So then, whoever gives to you the Holy Spirit and gives you the power to do what the Law requires, does it by obeying the Law?
lunyoro: Nukwo ogu anyakubaha Omwoyo nako'ra omulinywe ebyamani, abikora obwemirimo yebiragiro? Rundi obwokkuhu'ra okwokuikiriza?

english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the dish, and then you inside the inside.
lunyoro: Iwe omufalisayo afire amaiso, banza oyogye omunda yakatema norucuba, haruguru naho hasemere.

english: So then, do not be afraid of anything that will happen, until the Lord comes he will reveal to you the secrets of the darkness and reveal the thoughts of the heart. Then they will be given thanks to God.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutacwa kigambo kyona, okuhika Mukama waitu obwaliija alimulikya ensita ezomuirima, kandi aryoleka okutekereza okwomu mitima: nubwo balihabwa okusimwa omuomu hali Ruhanga.

english: But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again; and whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will by no means drink from the water that I will give him will never again drink from the water that I will give him to drink from the water of life eternal.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa ha maizi agandimuha talikwatwa iroho ebiro Kwahumbura abafu nabaha obwomezi, nukwo Nomwana abaha ati obwomezi abayenda okuha. Nebiro; baitu amaizi agambamuha galifoka omundaye iziba ryamaizi nigadubuka hali obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: They cannot now bear witness to what they have already done.
lunyoro: Kandi tibarukusobora okugumya omu maiso gawe ebigambo ebibarukundega hati bunu.

english: Jesus said, “He indicated by what death he was about to die to honor God.” At the same time he said to him, “I will follow you.”
lunyoro: Akagamba ati, nayoleka okufa okwagenda kufa okunyumiza Ruhanga.obuyamazire okugama ati yamugambira ati Nkuratira.

english: I tell you, then, that the Holy Spirit will teach you what you must say.
lunyoro: baitu Omwoyo Ogurukwera nubwo alibegesa ekibasemerire okugamba.

english: But if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even tax collectors do the same.
lunyoro: Baitu obumuraba numugonza abo abanyakubagonza, muyina empera ki? Nabazinisa tinukwo bakora bati?

english: He called everyone to him, and when he was about to be taken away by his master, he said to the first one, ‘What do you want, sir?’
lunyoro: Yayeta namberali wena akaba natongwa mukamawe, yagambira owokubanza ati Mukama wange nakutonga ki?

english: Which Jew is there who is not a Jew who does not get a blessing? Or what profit is there in being circumcised?
lunyoro: NUKWO Omuyudaya nakiza ata omugisa? Rundi okusarwa nukugasa ki?

english: But Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said to them, “Any kingdom divided against itself falls apart, and every house divided against itself falls apart.”
lunyoro: baitu uwe yakenga ebitekerezo byabu, yabagambira ati Obukama bwona obububaganizibwamu bwonka buhwereke'ra; nenju obwebaganizibwa yonka egwa.

english: Those who do evil will be thrown into the fiery furnace, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.
lunyoro: kandi abanyakukora obubi balibanaga omu komi eyomu'ro; nambere halibamu oku'ra nokunema ensaya.

english: And if that which is left of you is not left to the body which will come, but only to the seeds, the weeds, and the other evil things.
lunyoro: kandi egi eyosiga, tosiga omubiri ogulibaho, baitu embibo kwonka, rundi eyengano rundi embibi endi:

english: As they traveled, he got into a boat, and the wind came down on the lake. The boat was about to sink, and they were in danger.
lunyoro: Baitu obubakaba nibagenda yagwijagira; kandi ihunga likatera ha nyanja; obwato bwa'sana okuijura amaizi,, nabo bakaba bali omu kabi.

english: The crowd with him was so large that he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from death, and they began to proclaim the Good News.
lunyoro: Kandi ekitebe ekikaba kiri nauwe, obuyayesere Razaro okuruga omu kituro, namuhumbura omu bafu, batebeza.

english: But Paul said to them, “Before the Roman authorities could find out, we were put in prison and now we have been put in prison. How can we be kept under guard? No, they did not. Instead, they came to us and told us the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Nangwa, mananukwo; baitu baije bonka batuturukye.

english: For just as the Father raised the dead from death and gave them life, so the Son also gives life to those who want to live.
lunyoro: Baitu nka insenyowe okwahumbura abafu nabaha obwomezi, nukwo Nomwana abaha ati obwomezi abayenda okuha.

english: He did not fail to notice that he was doing well and told them to come down from heaven and gather food for you, and he poured out your hearts to the hungry and the thirsty for joy.
lunyoro: Baitu atebuzeho kaiso, baitu akakora kurungi, nabanagira enjura okuruga omu iguru, nebiro ebyokwerezamu ebyokurya, naigusa emitima yanyu engeso enungi nokusemererwa.

english: I write this not to make you sad, but to make you sad, as my dear children.
lunyoro: Tindukuhandika ebigambo binu okubaswaza, baitu okubahabura nkabana bange abarukugonzebwa.

english: At once his disciples came to him and were amazed, because he was talking with the woman. But no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “What are you talking with her?”
lunyoro: Ahonaho abegeswabe baija; bahuni'ra baitu akab nabaza nomukazi; baitu busaho muntu ayagambire ati Nose'ra ki/ rundi ngu Kiki obaza nauwe?

english: So then, look for the good and the hard work of God's people, which he has given you to do. But if you remain in his goodness, you too will be saved.
lunyoro: Nukwo orole oburungi nokugumangana ebya Ruhanga: hali abo abagwire okugumangana: baitu haliwe obwoliba noikara omu burungibwe, nukwo orajunwa.

english: For if you love God, you know that he knows you.
lunyoro: baitu wena obwaba nagonza Ruhanga, nuwe amanyirwe ogu.

english: Nor is it by him that the hands of human beings are placed on you as though they were nothing. He is the only one who gives life, life, the breath, and all things.
lunyoro: nukwo atarukutebwaho emikono yabantu nkanyakuburaho ekintu, baitu nuwe wenka abaha bona obwomezi, nokuikya orwoya, nebintu byona.;-)

english: Who is this faithful servant, whom his master has appointed over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?
lunyoro: Araha omwiru ogu rubale owokwesiga, omukamawe ouyasigire abomukaye, okubaha ebyokurya byabu omu kasumi kabu?

english: You know that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ was rich, and he became poor for you, so that you might become rich because of his grace.
lunyoro: Baitu mumanyire embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo ngu akabali omuguda, yafoka omunaku habwanyu, nukwo inywe mufoke abaguda obwembabazize.

english: For whoever asks receives, and whoever seeks finds, finds; and whoever knocks on it will find it.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwasaba, ahebwa; obwase'ra azora; anyakeranga alikingu'rwaho.

english: For the offering of this service not only meets the physical needs of the holy ones but also brings great joy to each other because of the offerings made by God.
lunyoro: Baitu okugaba okwokuhereza oku tikurukuijuza kwonka ekirengo kyamasege gabarukwera, baitu nukuhingurana obwebyokusima bingi hali Ruhanga;

english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write a letter. I heard him say, ‘You must not write down the seven thunders that he has said.’
lunyoro: Kandi ebihinda omusanju obubyagambire, nkaba ningenda okuhandika: nahu'ra gamba ngu Bohesa emanyikirizo ebi ebihinda Omusanju ebibigambire; otabihandika.

english: Paul and Barnabas spoke boldly and said to them, “It is right for us to speak to you first of all the things that God has said to you. But if you have sinned against him, and are trying to make sure that we do not deserve eternal life, then we will turn to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro na Baranaba bagamba nobumanzi ngu Kikaniki'ra okubanza okubagambira inywe ekigambo kya Ruhanga. Baitu muraba mukicumire kuli, nimwetegereza okutaseme'ra obwomezi obutahwaho, dora, ntuhindukira Abamahanga.

english: But what do you say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart. It is the word of faith that we preach.
lunyoro: Baitu nukugamba kuta? Ngu Ekigambo kiri haihi naiwe, omu kanwa kawe, kandi omu mutima gwawe: nikyo kigambo kyokuikiriza ekituru kutebeza:

english: And so you were raised to life with him through faith in the power of God who raised him from death.
lunyoro: kandi nukwo mwahumbukiremu hamu nauwe obwokuikiriza okukora kwa Ruhanga ayamuhumbuire omu bafu.

english: But Jesus did not trust himself, but knew everyone.
lunyoro: baitu Yesu atabesige wenka, baitu akamanya abantu bona,

english: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Canaanite,
lunyoro: Andereya na Firipo, na Batoromayo na Matayo, na Tomasi, na Yakobo omwana wa Alifayo, na Sadayo na Simoni Omukananayo,

english: For just as death came through a man, in the same way the dead came back to life.
lunyoro: Baitu nkokufa okukwaizire obwomuntu, nukwo obwokomuntu okuhumbuka kwabafu kwaizire kuti.

english: They were all amazed and began to ask, “Isn't all these Galileans?
lunyoro: Bona bahuni'ra nibatangara nibagamba ngu Dora, banu bona abarukugamba tibali Bagaliraya?

english: Your faith has made you rich, and you have put yourself in God's presence. Happy is the one who does not judge you by what you should do.
lunyoro: Okwikiriza kwawe okwonyinakwo, oikale nakwo wenka omu maiso ga Ruhanga. Ayina omugisa ogu atarukwecwera omusango omweki ekyarusima.

english: He healed them all. The people were so amazed that they saw the dead speaking, the sick and the crippled, the blind seeing, and the blind seeing. They praised the God of Israel.
lunyoro: kandi akaihaho obwomezi: nukwo nebitebe okuhuni'ra byahunira, obubaboine abafu bakanwa nibabza, nabaramaire bomire, nabafu bamaiso nibarora: bakugiza Ruhanga wa Isaleri.

english: The commander ordered him to be brought into the judgment hall and be kept under guard, so that he might know what they had done to him.
lunyoro: engabwa enkuru yaragira okumuleta omu rukiko, nagamba okumukaguliriza nenkoba, nukwo amanye amakuru gebigambo ebibamucwerire.

english: I tell you that the punishment suffered by Sodom will be more terrible that day than that of this city.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Okubonabonesebwa okwa Sodomu kuliba nokuganyirwa ha kiro eki okukira okworubuga oru.

english: But their hearts were far away.
lunyoro: baitu emitima yabu endi hara.

english: For I tell you, there are some here who will not die until they see the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira mali nti Haroho omuli abo abemerire hanu abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhika obubalirira obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: Jesus said to them, “Did you not know that the Scriptures say that Jesus is the power of God?”
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Tinikyo muhabira, okutamanya Ebyahandikirwe, nobugakuba amani ga Ruhanga?

english: Nicodemus answered him, “What do these things mean?”
lunyoro: Nikodemo yagarukamu namugambira ati Ebigambo ebi bisoboka bita?

english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
lunyoro: Nukwo mfokere omunyanzigwa wanyu obwokubagambira amazima?

english: So then, draw near to the Lord with all your heart, and be filled with the joy of those who do wrong.
lunyoro: Nukwo mumulize haihi omu Mukama waitu nokusemererwa kwingi, kandi abanyakusisa bati mubatinege:

english: Jesus stood still and called them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
lunyoro: Yesu yayeme'ra nabeta, yabagambira ati Nimwenda mbakole ki?

english: You are my friends if you do what I am commanded.
lunyoro: Inywe muli nganjani zange, obumukora ebimbaragire.

english: “Get out of here,” he said to me, “because I will send you away to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Yangambira ati Ruga hanu; baitu nyowe ndikutuma hara hali Abamahanga.

english: Pilate said to them, “Do you want me to crucify you?” The chief priests answered, “There is no other king but the Emperor!”

lunyoro: yataire omu kina ekihyaka, ekyakaba alimire omu mwandara: yakumbya ibale erikoto, nalita ha muryango gwekituro, yagenda.

english: For the great and glorious order of the things written in heaven and of the God of heaven, the Creator of heaven and the Creator of heaven and earth, and the spirits of the righteous, and of Jesus.
lunyoro: (((a) Emiringo enkoto nekinisa eyemizigaijo abahandikiwe omu iguru na hali Ruhanga omucwi wemisa ngo ya bona, nambere haruga emyoyo ya bantu abahikirire, na hali Yesu. )

english: This is not because they are Abraham's descendants, but because they are all children. In Isaac are your descendants.
lunyoro: Kandi kunu tibuli obwokuba baijukuru ba Iburahimu, nukwo bali bana bona: baitu ngu Omu Isaka numwobaijukuru bawe baryeterwa.

english: They were there, standing before the cross of Jesus, his mother, his mother, his mother, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
lunyoro: Baitu bakaba bemerire aho, hali omuti gwa Yesu, nyina, nowanyina, Maryamu muka Kuropa, na Maryamu magadalene.

english: For it is not the one who boasts of himself that is proud, but the one who is thankful to the Lord.
lunyoro: Baitu tali ogu anyakwesimisa asimwa, baitu ogu Mukama waitu owasima.

english: I saw a pale horse, and he was there who was called Death. Death and Hades followed them. They were given authority over the fourth part of the earth to kill with the sword, with the sword, with the famine, with the famine, with the deadly sword, with the deadly sword, with the sword, with the sword, with the famine, with the deadly force of the wild animals.
lunyoro: Narora kandi dora, embarasi kisa: nogu akaba aikalireho ibararye Rufu: Okuzimu nemukuratira. Kandi bahabwa obusobozi hali ekicweka ekyakana ekyensi, okuita nempirima, nenjara, norufu, nenyamaiswa eza hansi.

english: Go your way, and then I will send you out like lambs among wolves.
lunyoro: Genda omu mihanda yanyu, dora nimbatuma nkebyana byentama hagati omu nagagya.

english: The whole city was filled with fear, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him outside the city. At once the chains were broken off.
lunyoro: Kandi orubuga rwona rwatengeta, nabantu bairuka okugoma hamu: kandi bakwata Pauro; bamucundira aheru yeyakaru: ahonaho enyigi zakingwaho.

english: But the king went out to see the guests. He saw a man who was not wearing wedding clothing.
lunyoro: Baitu omukama obuyahinguiremu okurora abagennyi. Yabonayo omuntu atajwaire kyokujwara ekyobugenyi:

english: But they will not pass over it, because their minds will be made known to all people, just as they were to all of them.
lunyoro: Baitu tibalibahingurabaho: baitu obudomadoma bwabu bulimanyisibwa abantu bona, nkobwa bali okubukaba buli.

english: But if you were to be handed over to an idol that was in the form of a snake by its birth, and you were to be settled in a good idol and not to follow its birth, would it not be better for you to be settled in its idol?
lunyoro: Baitu iwe, obworaba wacwirwe ha muzeituni ogukaba guli gwomu kisaka omu kuzarwa kwagwo, kandi wasimbibwa omu muzeitemuni omurungi, okutahondera okuza'rakwe: ago agali gokuza'rwaho tigalikira muno okusimbwa omu muzeitetuni gwago gonka?

english: The woman was a Greek woman who was a Gentile named a Gentile. She begged him to drive the demon out of her daughter.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi akabali Muyonani, ihangarye Musolifoiniki. Yamwesengereza abinge omuzimu ha muisikiwe.

english: He has placed his trust in the people of Moses, so that you will obey them and do everything they say. But do not act like them, because they do not do what they say.
lunyoro: baikaire ha kitebe kya Musa; nukwo ebigambo byona ebibabagambira mubikole, mubigumye: baitu mutalikora nkabo okubakora; baitu okugamba

english: You know that whatever good a person does will be repaid to the Lord, whether he is rich or poor.
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu ekigambo kyona ekirungi omuntu ekyakora nikyo aliherwa hali Mukama waitu, nobwaba ali muiru rubale, rundi owobugabe.

english: David was the father of Solomon by the wife of Uriah.
lunyoro: Daudi akazara Sulemani ha muka Uliya,

english: After reading the Law and the writings of the prophets, the men of the synagogue sent them out and said, “Teacher, if you have anything to say to the people, tell them.”
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okusoma ebiragiro nebyabanabi, abalemi abiso'rokaniro batumira nibagamba ngu Bene baitu, obumuraba muyina ekigambo ekyokugambira abantu mugamb.

english: At once the father of the child said to him, ‘I believe, and you will save me from my unbelief.’
lunyoro: Ahonaho ise omwana yayamuza nagamba ati Ninyikiriza; konyera obutaikiriza bwange.

english: They grabbed him and brought him to the Areopagus and asked him, “Do you want us to know about this new teaching?
lunyoro: Kandi bamukwata, bamuleta hali Aleopago, nibagamba ngu Turasobora okumanya okwegesa kunu okuhyaka okworukugamba okukuli?

english: But some of them live in houses and take foolish wives for themselves, who are bound by many sins, who are bound by many trials.
lunyoro: Baitu omuli abo harumu abesensera omu nju nibanyaga abakazi abadomadoma, abalemerirwe ebibi bingi, abatwarwa okwegomba okwemiringo nyingi,

english: Your gold and silver will be weighed down, and their rust will be seen by you, and you will eat your flesh like fire. You have increased your riches in the last days.
lunyoro: Ezabu yanyu nefeza zimomere, nokumoma kwazo kuliba kaiso namberemuli, kulirya embiri yanyu nkomu'ro. Musoroize itungo ryanyu omu biro bya ha mpero.

english: I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me.
lunyoro: nkaba ndi busa, nainywe mukanjweka, nkaba ndwaire nainye mukansura;

english: Another scripture says, “They will look at him whom they pierced.”
lunyoro: Kandi ekyahandikirwe ekindi nikigamba ngu Balimurora oubacumisire.

english: The altar of incense and the ark of the covenant covered with gold all around it. It was inside of the gold altar, between the person and the rod of Aaron, who had made a covenant with them.
lunyoro: ekihongwa ekyezabu, nesanduko eyekiragano enyakuswekerwe ezabu embaju zona; ekaba erumu ekibindi ekya zabu, nambere harumu emanu, nomuigo gwa Aroni ogwamezere, namabale agekiragano;

english: But Peter said, “Yes, Lord! I have never eaten anything that is unclean or defiled.”
lunyoro: Baitu Petero yagamba ati Nangwa. Mukama wange; baitu tinkaryaga kintu ekyomuziro nobukyakuba ekibi.

english: And take the helmet of salvation to the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
lunyoro: Kandi mutwale nenkonfira eyokujunwa nempirima yomwoyo nikyo kigambo kya ruhanga:

english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘The Master is with me,’ he will not come back; and he will begin to beat the poor and the crippled,
lunyoro: Baitu omuiru ogu rubale obwaligamba omu mutimagwe ati Mukama wange aikaireyo okutaija; kandi alibanza okutera abairu nabazana,

english: Some teachers of the Law said in their hearts, “This man is a liar against God.”
lunyoro: Baitu abahandiki abandi bakagambira omu mitima yabu omunda ngu Omuntu onu najuma Ruhanga.

english: They wanted us to tell the Gentiles about their salvation, and to make their sins come to an end. But the wrath has come upon them all at once.
lunyoro: batutanga okutebeza Abamahanga ebyokubajuna; okuhikiriza ebibi byabu ebiro byona: baitu ekiniga kibahikireho okuma'ra kimu.

english: He will come to the master of the house on a day when he does not know it, and he will cut off his wife and her husband, and they will not believe him.
lunyoro: omukama womuiru ogu rubale aliija hakiro ekyatategerezamu, omu kasumi akatamanyire, alimucwamu babiri, alimuha omugabogwe hamu nabataruikiriza.

english: For the sadness of God leads to salvation, but the pain of the world leads to death.
lunyoro: Baitu okutuntura hali Ruhanga nukuleta okwegarukamu hali okujunwa okuteyijukya: baitu okutuntu'ra okwo omu nsi nukuleta okufa.

english: In this way you will be given the opportunity to enter the Kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: baitu nukwo muliherwa kimu okutaha omu bukama obwebiro nebiro obwa Mukama waitu kandi omujuni waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: I tell you that every accusation that people make will be tried by them on the Day of Judgment.
lunyoro: kandi nimbagambira nti ekigambo kyona ekitarumu abantu ekibaligamba, balikitongana ha kiro kyomusango,

english: Do not be afraid of them, but of all the things that you ask for in prayer and in thanksgiving to God.
lunyoro: Mutalituntura, baitu omu kusaba kwona nokwesengereza hamu nokusima mumanyisege ebimuse'ra hali Ruhanga.

english: I am telling you the truth: whoever obeys my teaching and believes in him who sent me has eternal life, and will not go into judgment, because he has been raised from death to life.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Anyakuhu'ra ekigambo kyange, namuikiriza ayamuntumire, nuwe anyina obwomezi obutahwaho, kandi talitaha omu musango, baitu amazire okuruga omu kufa okutaha omu bwomezi.

english: He who eats the Lord Jesus our Lord will be blessed with you, and he will be with you through the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Heelrywe ogu alibaha omugisa nainywe obwebigambo bya Mukama waitu Yesu; nobwebigambo byanyu byokeze omulinywe nkembabazi za Ruhanga waitu na Mukama wa Yesu Kristo okuziri.

english: He will tear down his barns in his hand and burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
lunyoro: nasoroza orubugarwe omu mukonogwe, alisoroleza ebisungabye, alibyokya omu mu'ro ogutarukurara.

english: To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
lunyoro: Kandi ahabwege ekitinisa ebiro nebiro Amina.

english: When he heard this, he left us and said, ‘What the Lord has decided to do is what the Lord wants.’
lunyoro: kandi obuyakihulire yaturugamu, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu ekyagonza kikorwe.

english: Why, then, do you not be able to do more, and why do you not rather be filled with pity for others?
lunyoro: Kandi obumutasobora okukora ekirukukira obuke numutuntu'ra ki obwebindi?

english: The sower sows the word. The reapers of the road reap the harvest
lunyoro: Omusigi asiga ekigambo.Kambanu abomuhanda rubaju

english: And the Lord's love has been poured out on you and on all of you, just as we also are with you.
lunyoro: kandi Mukama waitu abakanyiseho nabongeraho okugonzangana inywenka na hali bona, nka itwe okutuli halinywe;

english: But you are all the children of the light, and the children of the light. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
lunyoro: baitu inywena muli bana bomusana, abana ba nyamusana: tituli bekiro, nobugwakuba omuirima;

english: You cannot drink at the table of the Lord or at the table of demons. You can be drinking at the table of the Lord and at the table of demons.
lunyoro: Timurukusobora okunywa ha meza ya Mukama waitu, nemeza yabacwezi:murukusobora okubagana ha emeza ya Mukama Waitu, nomu emeza Yabacwezi.

english: So then, do not be afraid of the reward that will come to you.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutalinaga obumanzi bwanyu obunyina empera nyingi.

english: In the same way, we are all one body in union with Christ, and we are all one body in union with Christ.
lunyoro: nukwo itwe abaingi tuba tuti omubiri gumu omu Kristo, kandi itwena tuteraine ahamu okuba ekicweka kimu.

english: If one part is broken, all the pieces are broken down together; but if the whole part is made glad, then all the other parts are made glad together.
lunyoro: Kandi ekicweka kimu obukiba nikisasa, ebicweka byona bisasira hamu; rundi ekicwekanukwo obukiriba nikisemererwa, ebindi byona bisemere'rwa hamu.

english: It was right in the presence of the apostles and the elders, together with the whole church, to send greetings to the men in their group and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. Judas, who is called Barsabbas and Silas, were the older men of the group.
lunyoro: Kandi kikaba kisemire omu maiso gabakwenda nabakuru hamu nekanisa yona, okukomamu abasaija, omu kitebe kyabu, nokubatuma Antyokiya, hamu na Pauro na Baranaba; Yuda, anyakwetwa Barasaba, na Sira abanyakatagara abakuru omu bene babu:

english: “Let us go and buy two hundred silver coins,” they answered.
lunyoro: Baitu yabagambira ati Inywe mubahe ebyokurya. Bamugambira ngu Tugende tugule emigati eyedinali bibiri tugibahe barye?

english: Then Jesus touched their eyes and said, “What you believe is the same as you do.”
lunyoro: Nubwo yakozire ha maiso gabu, nagamba ati Nkokuikiriza kwanyu okukuli nukwo kibe kiti namberemuli.

english: The next day Herod put on his royal clothes and sat down in the crowd and told them about this.
lunyoro: Kandi ha kiro ekiyataireho, Herode akajwara ebyokujwara ebyobukama, yaika'ra ha kitebe, yabagambira ebigambo ebikuru.

english: They saw him healing on the Sabbath, and they told him to be quiet.
lunyoro: bamurole'ra okwaramukiza ha kiro kya Sabiti, bamulege.

english: It has not yet been revealed to the human race by the power of God's Spirit to reveal it to his holy followers and to the prophets.
lunyoro: Ekitaramanyisibwa omu businge obwaira hali abana babantu, nkokukyoyasukulirwe hali abakwendabe abarukwera nabanabi omu Mwoyo:

english: Jesus said to her, “Martha, Mary turned around and said to him in Hebrew, ‘Teacher!’
lunyoro: Yamuagambira ati Maryamu Yahinduka yamugambira omu Leheburaniya ati Raboni; amakuru gakyo ngu Mwegesa.

english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamukaguza ati Niwe Omukama Wabayudaya? Yamugarukamu nagamba ati Nukwo ogambire.

english: Jesus said to him, “I tell you that tonight before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Mananukwo ninkugambira nti ha kiro kinu enkoko etakakokere, oranyehakana emirundi esatu.

english: Even though we were dead in our sinful state, he made us alive together with Christ (by his grace you have been saved).
lunyoro: nobutukaba tuli bafu omu byokusisa byaitu, akatwomeza hamu na Kristo (mukajunwa obwembabazi),

english: In the same way, when you see all these things, you will know that he is near at the doors.
lunyoro: nukwo nainywe, obumulirora ebigambo ebi byona mumanye ngu ali haihi, ali

english: But when the Jews laid hands on me, I was about to pay taxes to the Emperor, because I had no right to set free our nation.
lunyoro: baitu Abayuuda ya obubayangire, nahambirizibwa okuju'le Kaisali; nkaba ntayina kigambo okulega ihanga ryaitu.

english: But Jesus knew what they were saying, and he said, “Why are you trying to trap me, you hypocrites?”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu akakenga obubi bwabu, yagamba ati Nimunyoheza ki, inywe abagobya?

english: After spending some time in the province of Asia, they left and went to Troas.
lunyoro: kandi obubahingire ha Misiya, basirimuka Teroa.

english: But if we do not believe that we have been separated, we are separated from our brother or sister. God has called us together in peace.
lunyoro: baitu atarukuikiriza obwaba nayahukana, ayahukane: mwene wabu omusaija rundi omukazi taikara omu buiru. Baitu Ruhanga akatweta omu businge.

english: He did not stay in the city of Nazareth, because the prophetic word had already come to him: ‘He will be called a Nazarene.’
lunyoro: yataire omu rubuga ibara ryarwo Nazalesi: ekigambo banabi ekibagambire kihiki'le ngu Aryetwa Munazarayo.

english: So Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
lunyoro: Yusufu yatwara omutumbi, yagukuma omu bafuta erukwera,

english: For if anyone is to turn away from his faith, he is guilty of sin, not of faith, but of all the things that are not based on faith.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakugurukyagurukya obwaba naiya, buli agwerirwe omusango, baitu tibuli obwokuikiriza, baitu kyona ekitaruga omu kuikiriza nikyo kibi.

english: So then, the Father in heaven does not want any of these little ones to be destroyed.
lunyoro: Nukwo Isenyowe ali omu iguru tarukwenda omu hali banu abato okuhwereke'ra.

english: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father, and there is one who will accuse you, even Moses, on whom you have placed your hope.
lunyoro: Mutalitekereza ngu ndibanyege'ra hali Isenyowe: haroho omu abanyege'raga, nuwe Musa, oumurukunihira.

english: The Pharisee stood up and prayed in front of him, “God, I thank you that I am not like everyone else—a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector.
lunyoro: Omufalisayo akeme'ra nasaba omundaye ati Ruhanga, ninkusima nyowe okutasisana nkabantu abandi, abakatuzi, abasezi, abasihani, nobwakubaire nkomuzinisa onu.

english: Festus said in a loud voice, “Paul, you are asleep! Your great learning has made you well.”
lunyoro: Yagamba niraka erihango ati Pauro, ogwire iraro; okusoma kwawe okwingi kwakugwisa iraro.

english: For the scripture says to Pharaoh, “I have raised you up to show you my power, and my name will be proclaimed throughout the whole world.”
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe bagambira Faraho ngu Nikyo nakuimukize iwe, okwolekera omuliwe amani gange, kandi ibara ryange ligambirwe omu nsi zona.

english: They did not believe in him, and they did not want to put a spell on him, but to put it on him now, and more than all the rest in the house.
lunyoro: Kandi batakiikirize, kunu tibakigonza okutamulikya ha kyokujwarakye, baitu okukimulikya hati bunu, kandi okukira bona abali omunju.

english: And if we are children, we are his children; they are his children in union with Christ; and if we suffer together, we are his children, and so are his children.
lunyoro: Kandi obuturaba tuli bana, tuli bagwetwa; abagwetwa hamu na Kristo; rundi obutuliba ntubonabona hamu, nukwo tuherwe hamu ekitinisa.

english: After the believers had been led by the churches, they lived in Phoenicia and Samaria and were able to repent of the Gentiles. They were all filled with joy.
lunyoro: Nukwo abo obubamazire okusendekerezebwa abekanisa, baraba omu Foiniki na Samaliya, nibasobo'ra okuhinduka Kwabahanga: kandi bakasemereza okusemererwa kwingi bene babu bona.

english: Tell us, then, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor or not?
lunyoro: Nukwo otugambire, notekereza ota? Kisemire okuzinira kaisali omusoro, rundi tikirikyo?

english: Then Paul took the men with him, and on the next day he met them and took them into the Temple and told them the holy writings until the offering was offered for all of them.
lunyoro: Nubwo Pauro yatwara abasaija, kandi ha kiro ekyakabiri yaimuka hamu nabo, yataho omu yekaru, namanyisa empiko ezebiro ebyokwezebwamu okuziri, okuhikya ekihongwa obukirihongwa habwabu bona.

english: I do not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘You will see the Spirit come down upon him and remain on him, and he will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
lunyoro: Nanyowe ntamumanye; baitu ogu ayantumire okubatiza namaizi nuwe yangambire ati Owolirora Omwoyo nasirimika haruwe, namuikaraho, nuwe abatiza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: When you were set free from sin, you became slaves of righteousness.
lunyoro: kandi obumwahairwe obugabe okuruga omu kibi, mukafoka abairu abokuhiki'ra.

english: You have not yet resisted to the blood and have battled with sin.
lunyoro: Timukahakaine okuhikya esagama numurwana nekibi:

english: So then, by your faith you are able to win the prize of eternal life, which will be destroyed and thrown into the fire, to the glory and honor of the revelation of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo kulengwa kwokuikiriza kwanyu obukumara okuhwaho, obukulikahwa omu mu'ro, kuzoke hali okukugiza nekitinisa nokunyumizibwa ha kusuku'rwa kwa Yesu Kristo:

english: After Jesus had been put out of the way, he left, and it was already late.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okubingwamu, yarugayo: obuire bukaba buizire.

english: He told us that he saw an angel standing in his house, and he said, “Send him to Joppa, and call him Simon, whose name is Peter.
lunyoro: Kandi yatugambira okuyaboine maraika ayemerire omu njuye, nagamba ati Otume Yopa, oyeteyo Simoni ibararye eryakabiri Petero;

english: But I have told you these things, and when the time comes to gather the grapes, you will remember what I told you.” And I have not told you these things before, but I have been with you all.
lunyoro: Leki nikyo mbagambirire, Kandi akasumi obukalikahika, muliijuka nyowe nkabagambira. Kandi ebi ntabibagambire kara, baitu bkabandi hamu nainywe.

english: He is the Spirit who makes known to us the things that are God's children.
lunyoro: Nuwe Mwoyo ogu arukumanyisa nemyoyo yaitu okutuli abana ba Ruhanga:

english: As on the day when the sun is setting in the desert,
lunyoro: Nka ha kiro ekyokwohebwa omu irungu

english: They were silent and told no one at the time what they had seen.
lunyoro: kandi bakaculera kwonka, okutagambiraho muntu omu biro ebi ekigambo kyona ekibaboine.

english: For the secrets of God are made known to them, because God made known to them.
lunyoro: Baitu ebirukumanywa bya Ruhanga nibimanyisibwa omulibo: baitu Ruhanga akabimanyisa bo.

english: But if they do these things in the world, how can they do so unless they live in the world?
lunyoro: Baitu obubaraba nibakora binu omuti mubisi, balikora bata omuti gwomere?

english: For when they speak evil of the worthless things of the nations, they deceive themselves by the desires of the flesh and by the desires of the house, by the same as by the power of the light from the darkness of the day.
lunyoro: Baitu obubagamba ebigambo ebikoto ebihanga ebitarumu, babihabiha omu kwegomba kwomubiri, omu rwanju, abo aba'sana okubairuka abarukugenda omu kuhaba;

english: They poured out many demons, poured oil on many sick people, and healed them.
lunyoro: Babinga emizimu mingi, basiga amagita ha barwaire baingi, babakiza.

english: We tried to teach you in this name, and you came to Jerusalem with your teaching, and you wanted to present to us the blood of that man.
lunyoro: Tukabatanga muno okutegesa omu ibara eri: kandi dora, muijuze Yerusalemu okwegesa kwanyu, nimwenda okuleta halitwe esagama eyomuntu ogu.

english: Why, then, do you say, ‘I am not the eye, but the body?’ because of the weakness of the flesh.
lunyoro: Kandi ekigambo ekirukugamba ngu Nyowe tindi eriso, nukwo ntali ekicweka kyomubiri, kiki tikirukuhu'ra obweki ekirukumufora enyama?

english: And that is why I will bless you with increase in your love and pray in your knowledge
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndikusabanti okugonza kwanyu kweyongereyo ngerege okusaba omu kumanya

english: But many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu habwe baingi hali Abayaudaya bakagenda baikiriza Yesu.

english: Jesus said to them, “Why are you so afraid, you hypocrites? Then he got up and began to throw dust and the sea into the sea, and it was too late.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Kikyekibatinisa, inywe abagobya? Nubwo yaimuka yacomera embeho nenyanja: byaculera muno.

lunyoro: Mbahaire ekigambokyawe, kandi ensi ekabobaba, baitu tibuli bensi, nka nyowe okuntali wensi.

lunyoro: Naitwe itwena tukahabwa embabazi nkendengo eyekisembo kya Kristo okweri.

lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yayeme'ra nartagira bamulete namberali: obuyairire

english: Greetings to you, Pudens, Linus, Claudius, and all the rest of the believers.
lunyoro: Muramukye Pudente, na Lino, na Karaudio, na bene baitu bona.

lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe bakary7a emanu omu irungu; nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Akabaha ebyokurya ebyarugire omu iguru.

lunyoro: nukwo okukira muno, hati bunu obutuihibweho omusango omusagamaye, tuliijunwa hali ekiniga habwe.

english: After spending some time in Troas, we arrived in Ptolemais, where we greeted the believers and stayed with them for a day.
lunyoro: Naitwe obutwamazire orugendo rwaitu okuruga Turo, twahika Potolemai, kandi twaramukya bene baitu, twaikara nabo ekiro kimu.

english: Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
lunyoro: Tinuwogu omwana womubazi? nyina tinuwe ayetwa Maryamu, nabanyina tinibo Yakobo, na Yusufu, na Simoni, na Yuda?

english: But we, young people, keep on guard and put on the breastplate of faith and love and of a helmet to be saved.
lunyoro: baitu itwe abanyamasana twerindege, tujwaire ekya ha kifuba ekyokuikiriza ekyokugonza, nenkofira eyokunihira okujunwa.

english: Let us not now judge one another, for God has judged us, so that anyone should not accuse another, be guilty of a crime or of a crime against another, and be put to death.
lunyoro: Nukwo tuleke hati okucwerangana omusango: baitu haroho omusango ogu ayacwerire, omuntu wena aleke okuletera enkonge mugenziwe, rundi enkongo mugenzagwe.

english: But when Jesus heard it, he said to him, “Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
lunyoro: baitu Yesu obuyahulire yamugarukamu ati Otatina: ikiriza kwonka, arakizibwa.

lunyoro: Kandi omwoyo gona ogutayatura Yesu tiguli gwa Ruhanga: kandi nugwo mwoyo gomunyanzigwa wa Kristo ogwamara okuija, na hati gumazire kuhika omu nsi.

lunyoro: Yagaruka okuija obwakasatu, yabagambira ati Mugwijagire hati bunu, muhumule: kiramara; akasumi kahikire; dora, Omwana womuntu tahebwayo omu Mukono yabasisis.

english: He came to you, just as he is near to you. He is near all the world, with children and grandchildren, and he is near to you on the first day of his life, and he is eager to see you know the grace of God in truth.
