english: The people answered, “The blood of Jesus has been poured out for us for the sake of our children.”
lunyoro: Abantu bona bagarukamu, nibagamba ngu Esagamaye ikale halitwena ha bana baitu.

english: All of you, together with all the people of Israel, know that by means of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, you have been made a sign that God raised him from death, because he lives here before you.
lunyoro: Mumanye inywena, nabantu bona aba Isaleri ngu Omu ibara rya Yesu Kristo owa Nazalesi, inywe oumwabambire ha muti, Ruhanga ouyahumbuire omubafu, habwogu onu ayemerire omu bafu, habwanyu onu ayemerize hanu omu maiso ganyu ayomire.

english: and have put on the new man, who will be made new in the likeness of the one who created him.
lunyoro: kandi mujwaire omuhyaka arukuforwa omuhya obwokumanya omu kisisani kyogu ayamuhangire:

english: You have followed our teaching, and you have received the Lord's message with great joy by means of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi mwakuratira omulingo gwaitu, kandi ogwa Mukama waitu, obumwahairwe ekigambo hamu nokusemererwa Okwomwoyo Ogurukwera;

english: So then, those who are married to each other do well, but those who do not marry should do better.
lunyoro: Nukwo anyakusweza omuharawe akora kurungi, baitu ogu atamusweza akira okukora kurungi.

english: But as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to the Jews, “It was right for me to have you circumcised, you Jews.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro obwakaba nagenda okwasamya akanwake, Galio yagambira Abayudaya, kyakubaireho amananu ekigambo ekyokusobeza, rundi okusisa okusisa okubi, inywe Abayudayini;

english: They called out to him, “Do not speak at all or teach in the name of Jesus.”
lunyoro: Kandi babeta nibabatere'ra baleke okugamba na kake, nobukwakuba okwegesa omu ibara rya Yesu.

english: He knows that the Law has not been given to a righteous person, but to the wicked and the good and the defiled and the defiled and the defiled and the murderers of their fathers and their mothers.
lunyoro: yamanyire ngu ebiragiro bitaterweho omuntu ahikirire, baitu abatali bahikirire nabemi, abatarukutina Ruhanga, nabasisi, nabatarukwera, nabagaya, nabaita baisebo nabanyinabo,

english: They had a little fish, and he bent over and gave them a command to throw the fish before them.
lunyoro: Kandi bakaba banyina encu enke: yazisimira, naragira nazo bazite omu maiso gabu.

english: But Jesus knew from the beginning that some of you did not believe, and he wanted to betray him.
lunyoro: Baitu okuruga kara na kara Yesu akamanya abamu halinywe abataikirize, nogu akaba nayenda okumugobeza okwakabali.

english: They did not find him, and they went back to Jerusalem looking for him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubataramuzoire, bagarukayo Yerusalemu, nibamuse'ra.

english: For in this way we do not take care of ourselves. We want to be clothed with our house which comes down from heaven.
lunyoro: Baitu omuli enu ntusinda mali, ntugonza muno okujwekwa enju yaitu enyakuruga omu iguru:

english: You are a Samaritan, but you must go to the lost sheep of the people of Israel.
lunyoro: Orwabasamaliya, baitu hakire mugende hali entama ezibura ezomu nju Yabaisaleri.

english: The crowd was filled with jealousy, but they could not eat the bread.
lunyoro: Ekitebe kyagaruka okugoma baingi kandi batasobole nokurya ebyokurya.

english: Who are you to judge the master of others? To his own master he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made perfect, because the Lord is able to give him glory.
lunyoro: Iwe niwoha acwera omusango omuiru wabandi? Hali mukamawe wenka rundi ayemerire, rundi agwire. Ego, aryemerezebwa: baitu Mukama waitu ayina amani okumwemereza.

english: and cried out in a loud voice, “Honor God and give him glory! For the judgment has come on him! Save him who made heaven, earth, sea, and the springs of water!
lunyoro: yagambira haiguru niraka erihango ati Mutine Ruhanga, mumuhe ekitinisa, baitu akasango kahikire: mumuramye ayakozire iguru, nensi, nenyanja, nensoro zamaizi.

english: He, full of the Holy Spirit, looked straight up and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at God's right side.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu, aijuire Omwoyo Ogurukwera, yagumya amaiso haiguru, yarora ekitinisa kya Ruhanga, na Yesu ayemerire ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga;

english: The man went away and told the people there, “It is Jesus who has been raised from death.”
lunyoro: Omusaija ogu yagenda, yagambira abaydaya ati nuwe Yesu amukirize.

english: But if you had ever seen a man who does not know you, would you not have sat down to eat the bread of this age and of the power of his heart, and would not have been willing to eat the bread of idols?
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu rundi obwaba nakurora iwe anyakunyina okumanya, oikalire ha byokurya omu kibale kyarubanga, omutima gwogu, obwaba atanyina amani, tiguligumibwa okurya ebihongirwe ebisisani?

english: But if you are slaves of sin, you are slaves of sin, and you are slaves of righteousness.
lunyoro: baitu obumukaba mulibairu rubale abekibi, mukaba muli bobugabe hali okuhiki'ra.

english: God wanted you to make known to the people the riches of this secret secret, which belongs to Christ, in order to bring glory to God.
lunyoro: Ruhanga abagondeze okumanyisa obuguda obwekitinisa kyekyensita kinu okubuli omu bamahanga, eki nuwe Kristo, okunihira okwekitinisakye:

english: But when you pray, throw your burden on your back, so that you will not be able to lift up your voice and pray to your Father who is in secret; he will reward you.
lunyoro: Baitu iwe, obworasabaga, otahege omu kisika kyawe omunda, omalege okukingaho oruigi, osabege 'So ali omunsita, baitu 'So anyakurora ominsita, alikuha empera.

english: Three times I was driven by the wind, once by the stones, once by the wind and once by the wind.
lunyoro: Emirundi esatu nkaterwa emiigo, omurundi gumu nkatera amabale, omusana gumu nekiro kimu nkabandi omu nziha.

english: For I tell you the truth, but you do not believe me.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe obwokugamba ebya mananu, inywe timurukunyikiriza.

english: I tell you that whoever says to this mountain, ‘Get up,’ will be thrown into the sea; it will not be removed from his heart, but will believe that what he says will happen; he will be given it.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Wena aligambira orusozi runu ngu Sindukaho, onagwe omu myanja; atatabaijuka omu mutimagwe, baitu naikiriza ngu ekyarukugamba nikyo kirahiki'ra; nuwe alikihebwa.

english: He sent other servants ahead of the first, and they did the same to them.
lunyoro: Yatuma abairu rubale abandi baingi okukira ababandize; nukwo babakozire bati nabo.

english: Where, then, do I compare these people with these people? How do they compare?
lunyoro: Nukwo abantu abobusinge banu ndabasisaniza nkaha? Kandi nibasisana na ki?

english: But he was angry because of the saying, and he went away sad for a long time, because he was very rich.
lunyoro: kandi yagwerwa habwekigambo eki, yagenda atuntuire; baitu akabanyina itungo lingi.

english: They started discussing among themselves, saying, “This man is not the one we have brought with him.
lunyoro: Batezangana empaka, nibagamba ngu Baiyu titulesere migati.

english: For before the creation of the world he made them male and female.
lunyoro: Baitu kara na kara ensi ekaba kuhangwa, yabahangaga omusaija nomukazi.

english: For, as you have done in all your ways, in faith, in your words, and in your teaching, and in your love for us, so that you may be filled with these graces.
lunyoro: Baitu nkokumwasagire omu byona, omu kuikiriza, nomu kugamba, nomu kwekamba, nomukugonza kwanyu halitwe, nukwo musage muti omu mbabazi zinu.

english: They said to themselves, ‘Who is the promised Messiah? Our ancestors have already died, and everything has happened to us since the creation of the world.’
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Guraha omurago gwokuijakwe? Baitu nambere baisenkuru itwe bagwijagirire, byona biikaire itwe biti nkokubikaba biri okuruga ha kubanza kwokuhangwa.

english: You know what John preached about baptizing in all Judea, beginning in Galilee.
lunyoro: ekigambo eki inywe mukimanyire ekyadumirwe omu Buyuda bwona, okubandiza Galiraya, hanyuma yokutebeza kwa Yohana okwokubatiza;

english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or mother, ‘All I have given you is Corban,’ then he will say, ‘This is what God wills.’
lunyoro: baitu inywe mugamba ngu Omuntu obwaraba nagambira ise rundi nyina ati Kyona ekinkukuhaire okukugasira niyo Korobani, nukwo kugamba ngu Ekyokuhongera Ruhanga:

english: They spat on him with a loud voice, threw their ears at him, and made him cry with a loud cry.
lunyoro: Basesa iraka erihango, baigara amatu gabu, bamwesesaho nomutima gumu;

english: Jesus answered them, “I have told you, but you do not believe; the work I do in my Father's name has made known to me.”
lunyoro: Yesu yabagarukamu ati Nkabagambira, baitu timurukuikiriza: emirimo eyinkora omu ibara rya Isenyowe, niyo e'manyisize.

english: I was once a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, and a tax collector. I was sorry about what I did not do, but did not believe.
lunyoro: obunkaba ndi kara omujumi, nomuhiganizi, nomwekuniki: baitu nkaganyirwa obwokukora ntamanyire nomu kutaikiriza.

english: In the same way, those who are content with their own riches do not have God's approval.
lunyoro: nukwo asisana ati, anyakweyahu'ra wenka itungo, kunu tali muguda hali Ruhanga.

english: They know that God's command is that those who do these things should die, not only do them, but also be happy with those who do them.
lunyoro: kandi abo nobubamanya ekiragiro kya Ruhanga ngu Abagira ebi baserire okufa, tibabikora kwonka, baitu nibasemererwa nabo ababikora.

english: “The God of our ancestors has chosen you to know his will, and to see the righteous one and to hear the voice that comes from his mouth.”
lunyoro: Kandi yagamba ati Ruhanga wabaisenkuru itwe akakukoma okumanya ebi ebyagonza, nokurora Ogu Ahikirire nokuhu'ra iraka eriruga omu kanwak.

english: They ran around that country and began to bring the sick into the streets to hear it.
lunyoro: kandi bairuka nibehinguliriza ensi egi yona, nibabanza okuhimbira abarwaire ha bitabu nambere bahulire iraka.

english: No one could answer him a word, and no one ever since that very day has asked him any more questions.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu ayasoboire okumugarukamu kigambo, kandi okuruga ha kiro eki busaho ayamutemberire okumukaguza ekigambo kindi.

english: The first ones were baptized, and then they went away and did not repent.
lunyoro: Banza babatizibwe; nubwo batanga okwegarukamu.

english: For it is the will of the heart that makes a person acceptable to God, and it is the power that has given him the mouth to be saved.
lunyoro: baitu omutima nugwo guikirizisa omuntu hali okuhiki'ra; kandi akanwa niko kamwatuza hali okujunwa.

english: If anyone serves me, he will follow me. And if anyone serves me, the Father will honor him also.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaraba nampereza, ankuratire; kandi nyowe namberendi, omuhereza wange nauwe nuho aliikara oku: omuntu wena obwampereza, Isenyowe alimunyumiza.

english: And every day in the Temple and in their homes they do not stop teaching and preaching that Jesus is the Messiah.
lunyoro: Kandi ebiro byona omu yekaru nomu maka gabu tibayosaa okwegesa nokutebeza ngu Yesu nuwe Kristo.

english: If you give birth later, you will have to give birth; but if not, then you will have to give birth.
lunyoro: obuguliba nugwana ebyana hanyuma, nukwo; baitu kiriba kitalikyo, nubwo oligutema.

english: So then, they must either forgive him and comfort him, so that he may not be troubled more than many times.
lunyoro: nukwo kibahikirire rundi okumuganyira nokumuhumuza, ogu arukusisa ati aleke okumirwa okutuntura okurukukira obwingi.

english: When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to them and explained to him the Way of God more correctly.
lunyoro: baitu Pirisikira na Akura obubamuhulire, bamutwara nambere bali, bamusobo'ra muno omuhanda gwa Ruhanga.

english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one, God.
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Nonyetera ki omurungi? Busaho murungi, rundi omu, nuwe Ruhanga.

english: So then, do not be troubled by these things, saying, ‘What shall we eat? Or what shall we wear?’ For all these are the things the nations are looking for.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutalituntura, numugamba ngu Tulirya ki? rundi Tulijwara ki? baitu ebi byona abamahanga nibyo base'ra;

english: One of you said to them, ‘Go in peace, keep warm and well fed, but do not give the body what is good; what good is it?’
lunyoro: Kandi omu halinywe nabagambira ati Muhgende nobusinge, mutagate, muigute, baitu mutarukubaha omubiri ebigurukusega, nikigasa kita?

english: Don't you immoral women know that the world hates God? Whoever wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
lunyoro: Ibisuba inywe abakazi timumanyire ngu okuganjana okwensi nubwo bunyanzigwa na Ruhanga? Nukwo omuntu wena anyakugonza okuba enganjani yensi buli ayefoire omunyanigwa wa Ruhanga.

english: The servant fell to the ground and worshiped him. “Sir,” he said, “I will get up early, and I will finish everything.”
lunyoro: Omwiru ogu rubale yagwa ahansi, namuramya, nagamba ati Mukama wange ntonga mpora, nanyowe ndikuma'ra byona.

english: I tell you, you will by no means get up until you have paid the last penny.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Toliruga omu na kake, okuhika obwolikaliha senti eyahampero.

english: I want to see you, so that you will give me a gift of the Spirit and be patient with me.
lunyoro: Baitu ningonza muno okubarora, mbahe ha kisembo ekimu ekyomwoyo mugumibwe;

english: Let no one be told that a woman has been put to death for six years.
lunyoro: Akazi wena alekege okuhandikwa atakahikize emyaka enkaga, ayaswirwe omusaija omu,

english: For the power of the horse is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like those of scorpions, with heads on their heads, and they are like scorpions.
lunyoro: Baitu obusobozi bwembarasi buli omu minwa yazo, nomu mikira yazo: baitu emikira yazo nesisana nkenjoka, eyina emitwe: kandi niyo erumisa.

english: And, look! I have made a promise to you, just as my Father has promised. But stay in the city until you are put right with the power from heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, mbahaire omurago gwa Isenyowe; baitu muikalege ha rubuga, okuhikya obumulijwekwa amani agarukuruga ha iguru.

english: Jesus answered, “Believe now, because it is right for us to do this.” Then he believed in him.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Ikiriza hati bunu, baitu nukwo kituseme'ra kiti okuhikiriza okuhiki'ra kwona. Nubwo yamuikirize.

english: When you see the south wind blowing, you say, ‘There will be a great earthquake,’ and it happens.
lunyoro: Obumurora omuyaga nuguruga obukizi obwoburyo, mugamba ngu Harabaho okutagata kwingi; nukwo kihika.

english: This is not because of the evil that you have been revealed to the evil people, but because of the way you have seen the crowds.
lunyoro: hati bunu obwokwefora abanyoro omwebi ebimwayahuzibwe, baitu mukuratirege ekitebe.

english: And more important, you know all the customs and disputes that existed among the Jews. I beg you, then, to see me.
lunyoro: kandi okukira muno baitu omanyire kimu engeso zona nempaka zona eziri omu Bayudaya: nikyo nkwesengerize ogumisirize okumpu'ra.

english: This happened, and the prophetic message came to pass.
lunyoro: Kandi kinu kikahiki'ra, ekigambo kihiki'le nabi ekiyagambire ati

english: Mary, who anointed the Lord with oil, washed her feet with her feet, and was sick.
lunyoro: Maryamu ogu ayasigire Mukama waitu amagita, namusisiriza ebigere nisokerye, nuwe akabanyina omusaija ogu arwaire.

english: You have stayed with me through my service.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe mwaikaraga nanyowe omu kwohebwa kwange;

english: When he saw the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink down, he cried out, “Save me, Lord!”
lunyoro: baitu obuyoboine omuyaga yatina; nabanza okudikira, yayami'ra nagamba ati Mukama wange, njuna.

english: He was in Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the church.
lunyoro: Kandi yaraba omu Busuli na Kirikiya, nagumya ekanisa.

english: If you are going to Macedonia and from Macedonia come to you and are in prison for going to Judea.
lunyoro: kandi nokuraba omulinywe okuhika Makedoni, kandi nokuruga Makedoni okuija namberemuli, kandi nokubohererwa inywe okugenda Buyudaya.

english: They will throw them into the synagogues. The time will come when the time will come for them to kill them and persecute them and persecute them.
lunyoro: Balibabinga omu maso'rokaniro: ego, akasumi nikaija, anyakubaita wena alitekereza nahereza Ruhanga.

english: Jesus looked around at those who were sitting around him, and he said, “Look! Mother and my brothers!”
lunyoro: Yababungyamu amaiso abakaba baikalire hambaju zona bamwezigolize, nagamba ati Dora, mau nagagenzi bange.

english: Simon Peter was standing there warming himself. They said to him, “You are one of his disciples, too!” He denied it and said, “I am not one.”
lunyoro: Kandi Simoni Petero akaba ayemerire nayota omu'ro.Kandi bamugambira ngu Naiwe oli womu begeswabe? Uwe yayehakana nagamba ati Tindi wamu.

english: But a certain man named Demetrius, who was a silversmith, who made silver shrines for the goddess Artemis, sold many silver coins.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu omu, ibararye Demeterio, omuhesi wefeza, ayakoraga amabandiro agefeza aga Atemi, yatungisaga abahesi amagoba maingi;

english: For the food that God gives is for the food that comes down from heaven, which leads to life on earth.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokurya bya Ruhanga nibyebi ebiruga omu iguru, ebiretera Ensi obwomezi.

english: But Jesus said to them, “I will come back to you if God wishes, and set sail from Ephesus.”
lunyoro: baitu yabaraga nagamba ati Ndigaruka namberemuli, Ruhanga obwaligonza, yahanika amaberu okuruga Efeso.

english: A teacher of the foolish, a teacher of children, has the same wisdom and truth in the Law.
lunyoro: mwegesa wabagwagwa, omwegesa wabana abato, oyina okusisana kwamagezi nokwamazima omu biragiro:

english: Because of his counsel, we have proclaimed his message of truth, and we have become like the first of the evil things that came upon us.
lunyoro: Obwokuhanurakwe okatuzaza ekigambokye ekyamazima, tube nkomuganuro ogwokubanza ogwebi ebiyahangire.

english: His power is eternal. Amen.
lunyoro: Aine obusobozi ebiro nebiro Amina.

english: When they had gathered around him, Pilate said to them, “Who is this man who wants to kill you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called the Messiah?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubayesoroize, Pirato yabagambira ati Araha oumurukwenda, 'mubaleke're? Baraba, rundi Yesu ayetwa kristo?

english: But you know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. He said to the one who sent him, ‘Get up and pick up your mat and go to your house.’
lunyoro: Baitu mumanye Omwana womuntu ayina obusobozi hansi okuihaho ebibi (yagambira ogu ayazingamire ati) Yeme'ra ohimbe ekitabu kyawe, ogende omu nju yawe.

english: But if someone stronger attacks him and defeats him, he will take away all the weapons he has left and all that he has.
lunyoro: baitu anyakumukira amani obwalimuizira, namusingura, amuihaho ebyokurwanisabye byona ebiyayesigaga, nagaba ebintubye.

english: He wants to tear down the broken pieces that will be broken off by the edge of the sword, and the dogs will come and lick up his wounds.
lunyoro: yayegombozaga okuiguta oburagalika obwaragaraga ha nkaina: ego, nembwa nazo zaijaga nizikomba ebihoyabye.

english: Do not take any food, clothing, or shelter, and do not take anyone's place on the road.
lunyoro: Mutatwara ndyanga, nobugwakuba omweko, nobuzakuba enkaito: kandi mutaramukya muntu wena omu muhanda.

english: But Jesus knew that he was going to betray him, and he said, “You are not all clean.”
lunyoro: Baitu akamanya aranugobeza; nikyo yagambire ati Inywena timuli basemezibwe

english: Every high priest who is made king over humanity is appointed to be God's priest. He must offer sacrifices and offerings for sins.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omukuru wena anyakukomwa omu bantu, atebwaho habwabantu omu bigambo ebya ha Ruhanga; ahongege ebisembo nebyonzira obwebibi:

english: But they did not recognize him, because they did what they wanted. In the same way, the Son of Man will be handed over to them.
lunyoro: baitu batamumanye, baitu bakamukora nkokubayenzire. Nukwo ati Omwana womuntu alisalizibwa bo,

english: Pilate said to him, “Aren't you going to tell me? Don't you know that I have authority to stop you, and that I have authority to arrest you?”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati Torukungambira nyowe? Tomanyire ngu nyina obusobozi okukulekera, kandi nyina obusoboho okukubamba ha muti?

english: He has allowed all the nations to walk in his ways in a way that has not yet been made known to them.
lunyoro: alekere amahanga gona, omu businge obwahinguire, okugenderaga omu mihanda yago gonka.

english: Your clothes, your clothes, your gold, and your clothes will not be used to make you beautiful.
lunyoro: Okwecuma kwanyu kutaba kwokuzigisa isoke okwa haruguru, nokujwara, ebya zabu, nokujwaha engoye:

english: They were the ones who did not obey when the time came to build the ark, and then eight of them were saved by the water.
lunyoro: abo abatarahulire ira obukwaikaire omu biro bya Nuha, obwato obubukaba nubutegekebwa, nambere abake, nugwo munana, bajunirwemu omumaizi:

english: A woman named Lydia, who was a seller of purple, in Thyatira, worshiped God and listened to us. The Lord opened her heart to pay attention to what Paul had to say.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi omu, ibararye Rudiya, omuguzi worugoye orurukugajuka, owomu rubuga Suatira, ayaramyaga Ruhanga, yatuhu'ra; kandi Mukama waitu yaigura omutimagwe okuhwituka ebigambo Pauro ebiyabalize.

english: Others said, “He is himself, and others said, ‘No, but he is like him.’ He said, “I am he.”
lunyoro: Abandi bagamba ngu Nuwogu, abandi nibagamba ngu Nangwa, baitu nasisana nauwe.Uwe yagamba ati Ninyowonu.

english: I was helped by the revelation and by the power of the Good News preached among the Gentiles, but by the secret of those who were called by God to be great, and they were no longer dead.
lunyoro: Kandi nkatemba obwokusuku'rwa, kandi nabasobo'ra enjiri eyintebeza omuli Abamahanga, baitu omu nsita hali abo abatairweho okuba abakuru, rundi okuba'ra busa.

english: But Jesus began to rebuke him and to say, “I don't know the man you are talking about.”
lunyoro: baitu yabanza okukyena, nokurahira ati Timanyire omuntu ogu oumugambire.

english: His disciples answered, “Could anyone here who is blind ever feed these people?”
lunyoro: Abegeswabe bamugarukamu ngu Omuntu nasobora ata okuigusa abantu banu emigati hanu omui irungu?

english: For we are his work, which was made through Christ Jesus for a good deed, in order to walk in the things that God has prepared for us.
