lunyoro: Nogu anyakurahira iguru buli arahire entebe ya Ruhanga nogu arukwika'raho.

english: For you bring new words into our ears, and we want you to know the meaning of these words.
lunyoro: Baitu noleta ebigambo ebihyaka omu matu gaitu: nikyo turukwendera okumanya amakuru gebigambo binu.

english: He who testifies these things says, ‘Yes, I will come quickly.’ Amen! Come, Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: Arukumanyisa ebigambo binu nagamba ati Nukwo; ninyija bwango. Amina: ija Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: For now it is seen by the miracles of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who gave up death and brought life and immortality to the gospel.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu nibyolekwa obwokwolekwa okwomujuni waitu Kristo Yesu, ayaihireho okufa, namulikya obwomezi nokutafa omu njiri,

english: After Judas had been handed over to the chief priests and the Pharisees, he went there with chains, chains, and chains.
lunyoro: Yuda, abuyamazire okuhebwa ekihanda kya baserikale nabakuru babu hali banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo, yaijayo, ayina ebyokurwanisa namacumu.

english: But some of the disciples went into the boat, not far away, but by the hands of the one who was about two hundred men, and they lowered the net and threw it away.
lunyoro: Baitu abegeswa abandi baija omu bwato obuke ( baitu bakaba batali hara nomusa, rundi emikono nkebikumi bibiri), nibacunda ekisoha ekirumu ebisoha.

english: To this very day we are hungry, but we are thirsty; we are thirsty, but we are thirsty, and we have no food.
lunyoro: Na hati hona nturumwa enjara, ntukwatwa iroho, tuli kwonka, ntuterwa entomi, titunyina owaitu:

english: While Jesus was sitting in the judgment hall, his wife sent him a message: “Do not be afraid of him, for I have been very sad for him now.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaikalire ha ntebe eyomusango, mukaziwe yamutumira nagamba ati Omutu ogu ahikirire, otamukora kigambo na kake; baitu hati nsalirwe bingi omu kiroto hali uwe.

english: When Jesus was in the middle of the courtyard, he sat by himself.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba buli omu nziha hagati, uwe aikaire wenka ha mugongo.

english: I heard the angel of the waters say, “You are righteous, and you are holy, because you have judged this way.
lunyoro: Kandi nahu'ra maraika owamaizi nagamba ati Ohikirire iwe anyakuroho, kandi owaira, baitu okacwa omusango oti:

english: But you are still weak, yet you are still weak. Do you not live as human beings only?
lunyoro: baitu mukyali abomubiri: baitu obuharumu omulinywe ihali nempaka, timukyali bomubiri? Timurukugenda nkabantu kwonka?

english: But many deceivers have gone out of the world, and they do not claim that Jesus Christ is alive in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Enemy of Christ.
lunyoro: baitu abagobya baingi bakaturukira omu nsi, nibo batarukwatura ngu Yesu Kristo aizira omu mubiri. Ogu nuwe nugobya noomunyanzigwa wa Kristo.

english: Then the twelve disciples called the crowd to him and said, “It is not right for us to stop speaking the word of God and go on doing good.”
lunyoro: Kandi ikumi nababiri baketa namberebali ekitebe ekyabegeswa, nibagamba ntu Tikisemera itwe okuleka ekigambo kya Ruhanga okuhereza emeza.

english: Jesus answered, “My children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the Kingdom of God!
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yagarukamu, nabagambira ati Abana, nikiremera abanyakwesiga itungo okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga!

english: He went a little farther down the cliff and prayed, as soon as possible, leaving.
lunyoro: Yagendaho hake, yainama hansi, nasaba, kiraba nikisoboka, akacu kamurugeho.

english: If some of those who do not believe invite you to go with them, and you want to go with them, eat with them all that is set before you, without asking questions about the truth.
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abo abtarukuikiriza obwaba nabeta, nainywe obumwenda okugenda, kandi obumuragonza okugenda, murye byona ebitairwe omu maiso ganyu, mutarukukaguza ekigambo obwomutima.

english: The one who had received two thousand coins came and said, ‘Sir, I have left two thousand coins. Here I have lost two thousand other coins.’
lunyoro: Yaija nogu ayahairwe etaranta ibiri, nagamba ati Mukama wange okansigira etaranta bibiri; dora nkagobamu etaranta zibiri ezindi.

english: All those to whom the Father gives me will come to me; and whoever comes to me I will by no means throw him out of the way.
lunyoro: Bwona Isenyowe abampa baliija namberendi; anyakuija nambera nyowe tindimubingira aheru na kake.

english: For this reason a woman should have authority over her head because of the angels.
lunyoro: habwa kinu kisemerire omukazi okuba nakokuro'raho akamani ha mutwe habwa bamaraika.

english: The Pharisees heard this and said to one another, “The chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bahu'ra ebye, bagambirangana bati haruwe; banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo batuma abaduma okumukwata.

english: From your youth on, you have come to know the holy writings, which can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: kandi okuruga omu buto okamanya ebyahandikirwe ebirukwera, ebirukusobora okukuhaisa amagezi hali okujunwa, obwokuikiriza okuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: We are going to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law, and they will condemn him to death.
lunyoro: Tutemba hali Yerusalemu; Omwana womuntu alihebwayo hali banyakatagara abakuru nabahandiki; nabo balimucwera omusango okumuita,

english: They threw a crown on his head, and a crown was placed on him by his right hand. They threw the stone at him and made fun of him, saying, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: Baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: The rooster crowed and said in a loud voice, “Surely not! I will do it, because my master has come to sow seed! I am ashamed to beg you!”
lunyoro: Yagamba omu ndaye ati Ndakora nta, baitu omukama wange anyakire obuketo? Kandi nkwatwa ensoni okulega.

english: Even though you have ten teachers in Christ, you have few fathers. For in union with Christ Jesus you have few children.
lunyoro: Noba munyina abesegesa kakumi omu Kristo, timunyina baisinywe baingi: baitu ninyowe nabazaire omu Kristo Yesu.

english: But if I boast about him in all I do, I am not ashamed of him. For as we have told you all the truth, so our boasting in Titus was about the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu obunayenyumize omu kigambo kyona habwanyu haruwe, ntakwate ensoni; baitu nkokutwabagambire inywe byona omu mazima, nukwo nokwenyumiza kwaitu hali Tito kukaba kuli kwa mazima.

english: But not one of these little ones who believe in me should have taken him to the beach and thrown him out of the lake.
lunyoro: baitu wena alitabaijura omu hali banu abato abarukunyikiriza, hakire bamubohe omu bikya orubengo orukoto, bamunage omu nziha yenyanja.

english: Two women will be grinding at the hand mill, one will be taken away and the other will be taken away.
lunyoro: abakazi babiri baliba nibasa harubengo; omu alitwarwa, ondi alisigwa.

english: The Pharisees said to one another, “Look how weak he is! Look! The whole world is following him!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bagambirangana ngu Murole okumutarukusobora na kake; dora, ensi yona nemukuratira.

english: I have sent you to Crete to finish what I had left behind, and to appoint elders in all the cities.
lunyoro: Nikyo nakulekire omu Kulete osemeze ebyasigalire, kandi oteho abakuru omu mbuga zoona,

english: The priest of Zeus was in front of the city, and he brought oxen and oxen to the gates, and tried to kill the people with the sword.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara wa Zeu akaba ali omu maiso gorubuga, akaleta ente nemikako eyebyakyo ha malembo nayenda okusara ekyonzira hamu nebitebe.

english: For I am not afraid to tell you all the wisdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu ntatine okubagambira amagezi gona aga Ruhanga.

english: They were about to gather, and they saw what they had found twelve men, and at the right time they went back to the tomb and saw the fifteenth parts of it.
lunyoro: baiguta kandi barora ebifuna amakumi abiri: kandi obwahinguireho kakaito bagaruka okulenga, nibarora ebifuba ikumi na bitano.

english: But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and ordered him to be kept under guard until I could send him to the Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: So then, do not let your good be saved.
lunyoro: Nukwo ekirungi kyanyu kireke okujunwa:

english: But you know that afterward he wanted to be blessed by his own mouth, because he did not see it coming back to him, and he had seen it coming and drinking water.
lunyoro: Baitu mu manyire ngu hanyuma obuyagondeze okugwetwa omugisa ( baitu atabone hokwegarukiramu) nobuyaguseruire noku'ra amazi.

english: He first found his brother Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (that is, the Messiah)
lunyoro: Abanza okuzora mugenziwe Simoni, yamugambira ati Tuzoire Masiya ( nukwo kugamba obukimanyisibwa ngu Kristo)

english: Leave all my belongings to the poor, and go to the streets. On the day of teaching I will say to the teachers of the Law, ‘Take the bread first and throw it to the dogs, because you are the ones who will get it.’
lunyoro: Muleke binyete byona, bihike ha magesa: omu biro ebyokugesa ndigambira abagesi nti Mubanze musoroze emberya, muzibohe enganda bazokye: baitu oburo mubuhunike oku maguli gange.

english: Jesus said to them, “My soul is deeply troubled, and it will be very hot for me. Stay here and watch.”
lunyoro: Yabatebeza ati Omutima gwange gunyina obujune bwingi, bibuija okunyita: muikalege hanu, murole.

english: These have the power to tear down the sky, so that the rain does not fall on them in the same way at the same time. They have the power to pour out blood on the water, and to make the earth and all the things in it come to an end, just as I wish.
lunyoro: Banu bayina obusobozi okuiga'ra iguru, enjura ereke okugwa omu biro byabu: kandi bayinaobusobozi ha maizi okugafora esagama, nokutuntuza ensi nemihito yona, emirundi mingi nkokubaragonzaga.

english: We have many things to say to you, and you have many things to say, but you have become dull of hearing.
lunyoro: Tunyina ebingi okumugambaho nebigambo bingi, baitu inywe mufokere abafu bamatu.

english: I do not stop thanking you, and I remember you in my prayers.
lunyoro: sikara nokusima habwanyu, nimbaijuka omu kusaba kwange:

english: So then, if I do judge, my judgment is based on my own conscience, because I am not one, but with the Father who sent me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nobundaba nincwa omusango, okucwa kwange kwa mananu; baitu nyowe tindi omu, baitu ndi hamu na Isenyowe ayantumire.

english: “How, then, did your eyes look?” they asked him.
lunyoro: Kandi bamugambira ngu Nukwo amaiso gawe gakaiguka gata?

english: Jesus said, “Go!” Peter got out of the boat and went on to Jesus.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Ija. Petero yaruga omu bwato, yagendera ha maizi, okugenda hali Yesu.

english: Jesus asked him, “What is this under the Law?”
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Kikahansikwa kita omubiragiro?

english: That is why I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce children.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukubagambi'ra nti Obukama obwa ruhanga buryakwa inywe, bulihebwa ihanga erinyakwana ebyana byabwo.

english: Holy spirit, knowledge, and strength, grace, and the love of money;
lunyoro: hati omu Mwoyo Ogurukwera, nomu kumanya, nomu mani, nomu mbabazi, nomu kugonza okwingi:

english: For that is why you have to follow the example of the Nicolaitans, who belong to me.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo oyinakyo, onobere engeso za Banikoraiti, ezi'noba nyowe.

english: So he left the man who had been thrown into prison for murder and murder, and prayed for him, because Jesus had given him over to them to do the same to them.
lunyoro: Yaleka ogu ayanagirwe omu nju yenkomo obwokwema nokuita, oubabansabire; baitu Yesu akamuhayo nambere bali okumukora nkokubayenzire.

english: Jesus was going to Solomon's gate.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akaba nagenda omu kitikyomuryango ekyo Sulemani.

english: That is why Moses called you to serve him (as Moses was, but as your ancestors were your ancestors). On the Sabbath you made a vow to a man.
lunyoro: Moses nikyo yabaherire okusara ( tukuli kwa Musa, baitu nukwo kwa baisenkuru inywe); kandi ha Sabiti musara omuntu.

english: While Jesus was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife, because she is in the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba natekereza ebi, dora, maraika wa Mukama Yamubonekera omu kiroto, nagamba ati Yusufu, omwana wa Daudi, otatina okutwara Maryamu mukazi wawe, baitu ekiri omundaye Kyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: Believe me, then, that I am in the Father and the Father in me; and believe me only because of what I do.
lunyoro: Mundikirize ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, na isenyowe omuli nyowe: rundi Munyikirize habwemirimo yonka.

english: It gives me proof of what I am doing, and I don't want to come to you to have life.
lunyoro: Ibyo bimanyisa ebyange; kandi timurukwenda kuija namberendi mube nobwomezi.

english: Now we know that you know everything, and you do not want anyone to ask you. We believe you, then, and believe from God.
lunyoro: hati bunu tumanyire ngu omanyire byona, kandi torukuse'ra muntu wena okukukaguza; nikyo tuikiririze iwe; eki tukikirize okuruga hali Ruhanga.

english: You Capernaum, who are highly respected by you? You will be raised to life by the Spirit.
lunyoro: Naiwe Kaperenaumu, olinyumizibwa haiguru muno? Olisirimurwa okuhika okuzimu.

english: Jesus said to them, “Because of the hardness of your hearts, he wrote you this commandment.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Obwokugumangana okwemitima yanyu, nikyo yabahandikirire ekiragiro eki.

english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave thanks to God, broke the loaves, and gave thanks to God, and gave them to his disciples to sit down before them, and he gave thanks to them all.
lunyoro: Yakwata emigati etano nencu ibiri, yarora haiguru omu iguru, nasima, nacwamu emigati; yaha abegeswabe bagite omu maiso gabali; nencu ebbiri yazibagabira bona.

english: The next day they left for Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, waiting for them to gather the apostles and the other disciples.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri bataha Kaisaliya. Kandi Koruneryo akaba nabategereza, amazire okusoroza abegeswabe abandi.

english: Some of our women, who had recently come to the tomb, made fun of us.
lunyoro: Nabakazi abamu abowaitu batujumire, abazindukire okugenda hali ekituro;

english: Suddenly Jesus stood up in front of them and took what was lying on his feet and went home and praised God.
lunyoro: Ahonaho yaimuka omu maiso gabu, yahimba ekyakaba abyamireho, yagenda omukaye, nakugiza Ruhanga.

english: It is good to give glory, honor, and power to you, Lord our God. You have created all things, and just as you wanted them to be, they existed and were given as you wanted them to.
lunyoro: Osemire, ai Mukama Ruhanga waitu, okuhabwa ekitinisa nokutinwa nobusobozi: baitu niwe wahangire byona, kandi nkokuwagondeze bikabaho, kandi bikahangwa.

english: He heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?”
lunyoro: waija, yahu'ra iraka nirimugambira liti Sauro,Sauro, nompiganira ki?

english: Pray that you will enter the closed door, but I tell you that many will not be able to enter it.
lunyoro: Mwekambe okutaha omu irembo erifunzire: baitu nimbagambira nti Baingi abalise'ra okutahamu, tibalisobora.

english: But you were merciful to those in prison, and you endured with joy over your belongings. You know that you have a better and more permanent life.
lunyoro: Baitu mukaganyira abo abakaba bali omu nkomo, kandi mukagumisiriza nokusemererwa okunyagwaho ebiitungo ryanyu, mumanyire ngu inywe munyina itungo erirukukira oburungi, kandi erirukuikaraho.

english: The Pharisees answered, “How did he deceive you?
lunyoro: Abafalisayo babagarukamu ngu Kandi ahabisize nainywe?

english: Jesus asked them, “What do you want?
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nimwenda mbako'le ki?

english: Those who said to you and to those who followed you spoke up, “Praise God! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
lunyoro: abo abakaba babembire, nabali abakuratire, bagambire haiguru ngu Hosana; Ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: For I tell you, then, that the Gentiles are more important than the Gentiles, because they do not belong to God. And I do not want you to be like foreigners.
lunyoro: Baitu ningamba nti ebi Abamahanga ebibahonga, tibiri byamani: kandi tindukugonza inywe okuterana nabamahanga.

english: For whoever has will be given away, but whoever has not, also what he has will be taken away from him.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuina, nuwe arihebwa: akandi atanyina, aliihibwaho nakyo ekyanyinakyo.

english: These are the things that are like these in our time. They have increased the sacrifices and the sacrifices that cannot be made to serve the one who serves the one who gives them what is in their hearts.
lunyoro: eki nikyo kisisani omu biro bya hati bunu: nikyo bahongera ebisembo nebyonzira ebitarukusobora okuhikiriza arukuramya omu bigambo ebyomu mutima, baitu

english: Didn't Christ have to suffer all these things and to enter into his glory?
lunyoro: Kitikimusemerire Kristo okusalirwa ebi byona, nokutaha omu kitinisakye?

english: But they did not recognize him, so he put on his clothes and said to them, “You must put your own blood on your own heads. I am not guilty. At first I will go to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Baitu obubamutangire nibajuma, yakunkumura ebyokujwarabye, nabagambira ati Esagama yanyu ikale ha mitwe yanyu enywenka; nyowe tindoho musango: okubanza hati ndagendaga hali Abamahanga.

english: I was so happy about the Lord that now you have thought about me, and you have lost all time.
lunyoro: Baitu nkasemererwa muno omu Mukama waitu, baitu hata bunu mugarukire okutekereza mukatekereza mali, baitu hakire muleke.

english: The night is almost over, and the day is almost over. Let us, then, be full of the evil deeds of the darkness, and let us take up the weapons of the light.
lunyoro: Ekiro kihinguire muno, obuire nubu'sa okukya: nukwo tujule engeso ezomuirima, tujwale ebyokurwanisa ebyomusana.

english: That is why you must pay back my money to the poor, and I will pay back my debt and my taxes.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyakuhikirire okuha abaguzi efeza yange, nanyowe obunakuizire nakuhairwe eyange namagoba gayo.

english: When we heard this, we and the people in that place begged him not to go to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Itwe obutwahulire ebi, itwe nabantu abomu kiikaro eki, twamwesengereza aleke okutemba Yerusalemu.

english: You see, then, that these things cannot be done, but you must be quiet and do nothing by doing what you are willing to do.
lunyoro: Nukwo, muboine ebi tibisoboka okwangwa, kibahikirire inywe okuculera, okutakora kintu nimwanguhiriza.

english: He sent me this because of his will: ‘Do not be afraid of anything that he has told me to do, because I am coming to you on the last day.’
lunyoro: Kigambo eki ayantumire nikyo agondeze ati Ha kyona ekyampaire haleke okuburaho na kake, baitu nkiimukye ha kiro kya hampero.

english: Simon Peter went in and went into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there,
lunyoro: baitu atatahemu. Kandi na Simoni Petero, yaija omukuratire, yataha omu kituro; yarora engoye zekitani zitairwe aho,

english: Pilate said to them, “Take him down and crucify him, because I find no reason to condemn him!”
lunyoro: Pirato yabagambira ati Mumutwale inywe, mumubambe hamuti: baitu nyowe timboine musango haruwe.

english: As he has given him authority over all flesh, he gave him eternal life.
lunyoro: nkogu ouwamuhaire obusobozi ha banyakuina omubiri bona, abahe obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: In this way we will celebrate the Passover, not with a conscience or with an evil conscience, but with the truth.
lunyoro: nukwo tucumbe obugenyi, hatali nekititumbisa ekiitima nobubi, baitu nebitatumbisibwa ebyobutagobya namazima:

english: He poured out water into the prophets and began to teach them the good news about the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Yataho amaizi omu kanwa ka banabi, yabandiza nabaterera,

english: Luke, the highly respected teacher of the Law, and Demas, who was a good example for them.
lunyoro: Ruka, omufumu arukugonzebwa, na Dema babaramukize.

english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
lunyoro: baitu omusigazi obuyahulire ekigambo eki, yagenda atuntuire: baitu akabanyina itungo lingi.

english: I pray for them, not for the world, but for those who have given me.
lunyoro: Nsaba abo: tindukusabira nsi, rundi abo abawampaire

english: The king praised that dishonest accusation, but he was wise. For the children of this world are wiser than the children of the light in their own order.
lunyoro: Kandi mukamawe akanyumiza omuketo ogu atali wokuhiki'ra, baitu akagira amagezi: baitu abana abensi enu, omu businge bwabu, nibakira amagezi abana abomusana.

english: and the power of God. He is at the right and the left,
lunyoro: hati omu mani ga Ruhanga: obwebyokurwanisa ebyokuhiki'ra ha mukono ogwoburyo, nomukono ogwemoso,

english: The more believers in the Lord, the more bold they were to speak the word of God without fear.
lunyoro: kandi abo abakira obwingi omu Mukama waitu bakatunga obumanzi obwensengo zange, nibeyongera okuguma muno okugamba ekigambo kya Ruhanga okutatina.

english: Jesus looked around at them with pity, so that he was filled with pity for them, because they were so stubborn that he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and it became well.
lunyoro: Obuyababungizemu amaiso nekiniga, abihirwe obwokugumangana kwemitima yabu, yagambira omuntu ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagugo'ra: omukonogwe gwakira.

english: For now in union with Christ Jesus you who were far away have come to me through the blood of Christ.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu omu Kristo Yesu, inywe abakaba bali hara ira muirizibwe haihi omu sagama ya Kristo.

english: Barnabas took him along and brought him to the apostles. He saw them on the road and said, “He spoke to him, just as he had said to Damascus in the name of Jesus.”
lunyoro: Baitu Baranaba yamutwara, yamuleta hali abakwenda, yabasobo'ra okuyaboine omu muhanda, kandi ngu akagamba nauwe, kandi nkokuyagambire Damasiko nobumanzi omu ibara rya Yesu.

english: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from death, where you crucified him.
lunyoro: Ruhanga owa baisenkuru itwe akahumbura Yesu, oumwaisire, inywe numumuhanika ha muti.

english: The peace of God, which is greater than all knowledge, will guard your hearts and your mental powers by means of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi nobusinge bwa Ruhanga oburukukira okumanywa kwona bulirinda emitima yanyu nebitekarazo bayanyu omu Kristo Yesu.

english: It is not right for you to forgive your brother, just as I have forgiven you.
lunyoro: kikisemerire iwe okuganyira omuiru omutahi wawe, nka nyowe okunakuganyire iwe?

english: He believed him, and Paul stood up at the gates and began to speak to the people with a loud cry. After the uproar had subsided, he spoke in Hebrew to them,
lunyoro: Obuyamuikirize, Pauro yayeme'ra ha matembero, yabaza nabantu niraka erihango: obubamazire okuculera muno yabagambira omu rulimi Oruheburaniya nagamba ati.

english: They were in Thessalonica, where they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. They were with John, who was their apostle.
lunyoro: Obubakaba bali Saramini, batebeza ekigambo kya Ruhanga omu maso'rokaniro Gabayudaya: kandi bakaba bali na Yohana, omuhereza wabu.

english: and said, “If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have been with them in the blood of the prophets.”
lunyoro: mugamba ngu Kuba tukaba turoho omubiro bya baisenkuruitwe, titwakuteraine hamu nabo omu sagama eya banabi.

english: They will not do this, because they have taken away the broken and broken pieces and have put the people in chains, because they do not want to tear them down and throw them to pieces.
lunyoro: Baitu tibakora. Baitu baboha enketo ezirukulemera,ezitetweka, ba zitweka abantu ha mabega: baitu bo tibenda kuzitengesa ne kyara kyabu.

english: The foolish, the foolish, and the foolish, each other, do not love one another, and do not despise one another.
lunyoro: (Abafakati, abasisa ebi baragana, abatarukugonzangana, abatayina kuganyira):-

english: The whole church was filled with fear, and all who heard these things.
lunyoro: Nokutina kwingi kukakwata ekanisa yona na bona abahulire ebi.

english: But if you believed Moses, you would also believe me, because he wrote me.
lunyoro: Kakuba muikirize Musa, nanyowe mwakunyikirize; baitu akahandikira nyowe.

english: They will run away from the trap of the Devil, who has followed them in doing what he has wanted them to do.
lunyoro: kandi balitami'ruka okuruga omu ndubatira ya Setani, ogu obuyamazire okubahamba okukora nkoli okuyagondeze.

english: He remembered what the Lord had said, “I am John the Baptist, but you will be baptized by the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Kandi naijuka ekigambo kya Mukama waitu nkokuyagambire ati Mananukwo Yohana akabatiza omu Mwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: You are our witnesses, the one who knows what is being read.
lunyoro: Ninywe baruha yaitu, erukumanywa erukusomwa abantu bona;

english: For at that time it will be just as when a human being was born, and you have been born as a spiritual being, just as it is now.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro biri nkogu ayazairwe omubiri okuyahigire oli ayazalirwe obwomwoyo, nukwo nukwo na hati bunu.

english: The voice answered me the second time from heaven, ‘What God has promised, do not commit adultery.’
lunyoro: Baitu iraka ryangarukamu omurundi ogwakabiri, niriruga omu iguru liti Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora ebyomuziro iwe.

english: When Jesus saw her, he loved her, and said to her, “Go and sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamuboine yamugonza, yamugambira ati Gura byona ebyokuyinabyo, ogabire abasege, kandi iwe olitunga itungao omu iguru:

english: And so it is with us, who are the ones who have the spiritual beginning, not only in us, but also with us, who hope to be children, in order to be free from our human nature.
lunyoro: Kandi tikuli nukwo kwonka, baitu naitwe abanyina ebyokubanza Ebyomwoyo, ntunihira okufoka abana, nukwo kucungurwa kwomubiri gwaitu

english: All who live on earth will be made clean, and everyone who lives on earth will be clean, because the book of the living which was written in the Lamb's book of life has been lost since the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abaikara hansi balikiramya, wena atahandikirwe ibararyeomukitabu kyobwomezi Ekyokwana Gwentama ayaisirwe okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi.

english: The servants of the house started to meet him and said, “Sir, didn't you place a good stone in your vineyard, and at once you would have a field ready for harvesting?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale banyineka baija nibamugambira ngu Tata, otasige mbibo esemire omu ruharo rwawe, baitu ekaba etanyina byana?

english: What shall I say? Is the thing that the image is made up of nothing or of something?
lunyoro: Nukwo ngambire ki? Nti ekinyakuhongirwe ekisisani kiri kintu? rundi ekinyakwehingwirwe nikyo kintu?

english: The owner of the vineyard said, ‘No, I will do it! I will send my own son, and they will respect him.’
lunyoro: Omukama worugonjo yagamba ati Ndagira nta? Ndituma omwana wange oundukugonza; rundi balimutina.

english: Which one, then, will be the curse? If you say, ‘Get up,’ you will have your sins forgiven,’ or ‘Get up and walk’?
lunyoro: Baitu ekirahuka kiraha? Okugamba nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho, rundi okkugamba nti Imuka ogende?

english: He will not go into anything that is not good, nor will he go into anything that is unclean; instead, those who are dead will be written in the Lamb's book of life.
lunyoro: kataha nomu kake ekintu kyona ekitali kisemeri, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyomuziro nebisuba: rundi abo bonka bahandikwa omu kitabu ekyobwomezi Ekyomwana Gwentama.

english: Out of the mouth come forth blessing and cursing. My friends, these things ought not to happen to you.
lunyoro: Omu kanwa kamu numwo harugamu okukugia nokukyena. Bene baitu ebi tibisemerire okuikara biti.

english: The official answered, “I beg you, whom did the prophet say these things? About himself or about someone else?”
lunyoro: Omukonwa yagarukamu Firipo nagamba ati Nkwesengerize, nabi akagamba hali oha ebigambo binu? bye wenka, rundi byomuntu ondi?

english: always give thanks to God the Father, through our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: musima ebiro byona obwa byona, omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo hali Ruhanga, kansi Isitwe;

english: They refuse to give up, but they themselves are slaves of sin; but the person who has been redeemed is slaves of sin.
lunyoro: nibaraganiza okubaha obugabe, baitu bo bonka bali abairu rubale abokujunda; baitu omuntu ekyasingurwa, nikyo aba muiru rugabo wakyo.

english: Philip answered him, “He did not give you the bread of two hundred silver coins, but gave you all the money.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ali Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: So Jesus left and saw a great crowd, healed them, and healed their sick.
lunyoro: Yarugayo, yarora ekitebe kingi, yabaganyira, nakiza abarwaire babu,

english: The voice that came to us from heaven we heard when we were with him on the holy mountain.
lunyoro: kandi iraka eri itwe tukalihu'ra niriruga omu iguru, obutukaba tuli hamu nauwe harusozi orurukwera.

english: For each one will carry out his own work, and then he will have his own glory, because he is no more.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena ayerengere omulimogwe wenka, kandi nukwo abe nokwenyumizakwe habwe wenkaga, kunu tihali habwondi.

english: to open their eyes to the blind, to turn from the power of Satan to God, and to turn from their sins and to be put right with God by those who are his people because of my faith.
lunyoro: okuigura amaiso gabu, baruge omu muirima okuhindukira omuli Setani, bahindukire Ruhanga, bahebwe okuihibwaho ebibi, nobuwetwa omuli abo abanyakwezibwe obwokuikiriza nyowe.

english: These things we write down for our own good.
lunyoro: binu itwe tubihandikire okusemererwa kwaitu kuhiki'le.

english: For this is what God has promised: ‘At the right time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.’
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nugwo murago ngu Nkebiro binu okubiri, nubwo ndiija, kandi Sara aliba nomwana.

english: The prophets preached two or three or more messages, and others listened.
lunyoro: Nabanabi batebezege rundi babiri rundi basatu, nabandi bategereze.

english: But they did not dare to ask him any more questions.
lunyoro: Baitu batagume kumukaguza kigambo kindi kyona.

english: Jesus said to them, “I want to be with you before the Passover Festival is over.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nokwegomba nyegombere okulira hamu nainywe Okuhingurwaho kunu ntakasalizibwe:

english: Do not be fooled by the many new and strange teachings. It is good to be filled with pity and compassion. This is not because of the food that has not been eaten by those who have not followed them.
lunyoro: Mutahabisibwa ebyokwegesa ebyemitingo nyingi ebihyaka: Baitu kirungi omutima okugamibwa nembabazi: okunu okutagumibwa nengeso ezokurya ezitarangasire abo abazigendiremu,

english: Last night he came to Jesus and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a teacher sent by God, but no one can perform miracles unless God lives with him.”
lunyoro: ogu akaija namberali ekiro, namugambira ati Rabi, tumanyire iwoli mwegesa ayarugire hali Ruhanga: baitu busaho muntu asobora okukora obwokuro'raho obwokora, rundi Ruhanga obwaikara nauwe.

english: He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
lunyoro: Yakwata ekijoka, enjoka eyaira, nuwe Diaboro kandi Setani, yamuboha okuhikya emyaka rukumi,

english: The world cannot hate them, but it hates me, because I tell it that its deeds are evil.
lunyoro: Ensi tesobora kubanoba; baitu enobere nyowe, baitu nyowe nimanyisa ebyayo nti emirimo yayo ebihire.

english: After saying this, Jesus went away and called Mary, who had the secret, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati Omwegesa aizire, nakweta.

english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in all the world for a witness to all the nations, and then the end will come.
lunyoro: Enjiri enu eyobukama eritebezebwa omu nsi zona,okuba kaiso hali amahanga gona; nubwo empero erihika.

english: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews, but they had already decided that if anyone told him that he was the Messiah, he would be put right with the Council.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire nikyo bagambire ebi obwokutina Abayudaya:baitu Abayuuda bakaba bamazire kuhanura ngu Omuntu wena obwaramugambagambaga ati nuwe Kristo abingi bwege omu iso'rokaniro.

english: He who calls him faithful will do it.
lunyoro: arukubeta wokwesiga, kandi nuwe alikora.

english: They did not see his body, and came to him and said, “He is alive!”
lunyoro: kandi obubatazoire mutumbigwe, baija nibagamba ngu baboine nokwolekwa okwa bamaraika abagambire ngu Ayomire.

english: After they had broken the stone, they dragged him out of the book and led him away.
lunyoro: Bamara okugisesa, bamusirirmu'ra ha kitabu ekyakaba abyamireho anyakuzingamire.

english: When the angel went in with him, he called two of his family members to him and appointed a jailer over those who sent him to be the one who was in need.
lunyoro: Kandi maraika ayabalize nauwe obuyagenzire, yayeta abairube babiri abomu nju, na muserukale omwerinzi hali abo abamuherezaga obutosa;

english: For you are our glory and our joy.
lunyoro: Baitu ninywe kitinisa kyaitu nokusemererwa kwaitu.

english: Our ancestors ate on this mountain, and you say, ‘It is a good thing for people to celebrate in Jerusalem.’
lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe baryaga ha rusozi runu; nainywe mugamba ngu Ha Yerusalemu nuho Kisemereire abantu okuramizaga.

english: I did not think it proper for me to speak on my own behalf, but rather that my voice should be heard.
lunyoro: Nikyo ntayetekererize nyenka okuseme'ra okugamba ebyange nyenka, baitu okukira ira ekigambo kyange kihiki'le.

english: Who will separate us from the love of Christ? Salvation, trouble, persecution, poverty, or hunger or only poverty or danger?
lunyoro: Araha alitubaganiza omu kugonza kwa Kristo? Bujune? Rundi emihito? rundi okuhiganizibwa? rndi okubonabonesebwa? randi enjara?

english: “Sir,” she answered, “I believe,” and she worshiped him.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Mukama wange ninyikiriza. Yamuramya.

english: Teach them to obey all that I have commanded you. And now I am with you forever, until the present age of peace will come to an end.
lunyoro: kandi mubegese okukwata byona ebinabaragire; kandi dora, nyowe ndi hamu nainywe ebiro byona, okuhikya obusinge bunu obubulihwaho.

english: He called him and said to him, “What do you want me to do with you? Wait for the price of your coat, because you can't stay in the sack any longer!”
lunyoro: kamweta, yamugambira ati Kiki kinu ekindukuhu'ra haliwe? Bara omuhendo ogwobuketo bwawe; baitu tokyasobora kuikara omuketo.

english: For I tell you the Gentiles, that I am the least of the Gentiles, and that I may boast about my own will.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe Abamahanga. Nukwo nyowe obumba ndi omukwenda hali Abamahanga, ninyumiza obukwenda bwange:

english: But you, my friends, don't let them do good to you.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe bene baitu mutajwaha okukora kurungi.

english: He went down to his feet and thanked him, and he was also a Samaritan.
lunyoro: kandi akejumika hali ebigerebye, namusima: nogu akabali Musamaliya.

english: Those who dream about the night and think about the Lord, and those who eat the Lord's bread and drink the Lord's cup, do not eat the Lord's cup; those who do not eat the Lord's cup, and those who do not eat the Lord's cup, do not eat the Lord's cup.
lunyoro: Anyakutekereza ekiro, akitekereza habwa Mukama waitu. Kandi anyakurya, arya habwa mukama waitu: kandi atarukurya, atarukurya, tarya habwomukama waitu Yesu.

english: Before the throne of the kingdom of heaven was a sea of glass like crystal, and between the throne and the four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
lunyoro: kandi omu maiso gekitebe kyobukama enyanja yendo'rwamu erukusisana nka kurusitaro; na hagati yekitebe ekyobukama ebyomezi bina ebiijuire amaiso omu buso nenyuma.

english: Here the dead are given a tenth of all, but there are those who are told that they are alive.
lunyoro: Kandi hanu abantu abafa bahabwa ebicweka biikumi, baitu kuli abihabwa arukumanyisibwa ngu ali mwomezi.

english: For the name of God is being declared among the Gentiles because of you, just as the scripture says.
lunyoro: baitu ibara rya Ruhanga niriswazibwa omu Bamahanga habwanyu nkokukyahandikirwe.

english: So they went off and found a young donkey tied up in the back of the colt, and as they were untying it.
lunyoro: Sirimuka, basanga omwana gwenkaina bagusibikire ha irembo aheru omu ikute; bagusibura.

english: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to collect his share of the harvest. The tenants beat him and beat him without a thing.
lunyoro: Kandi omwaka obugukaba guhikire yatuma omuiru rubale hali abalimi bamuhe ha byana ebyorugonjo rwemizabibu: baitu abalimi bakamutera, bamubinga atakwasire kintu.

english: Jesus answered, “Do you believe, sir?
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange araba muikiriza?

english: The gospel is like this, but not the gospel; it is not the gospel that others are trying to make you sad, but the gospel of Christ is what they want to change.
lunyoro: Hebi, njuri ezisisana okundi; baitu teri enjiri endi, rundi haroho abandi abarukubatuntuza,nibagonza okuhindura kubi enjiri ya Kristo.

english: The Lord said to Paul on the night of the vision, “Don't be afraid, but be silent;
lunyoro: Mukama waitu akagambira Pauro ekiro omu kwolekwa ati Otatina, baitu gamba, otaculera:

english: For we do not want to boast about you, but for you we gave you the chance to boast about ourselves, so that you may have an answer for those who boast about things that are above, but not on your heart.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukugaruka okwenyumiza itwenka halinywe, baitu tubahaire inywe omwanya gwokwenyumiza habwaitu, nukwo mube nekyokugarukamu abo abanyakwenyumiriza ebyaharuguru, kunu tihali omu mutima.

english: I thank God that I am the best of all of you.
lunyoro: Nimukugiza Ruhanga, nimbakira inywena okukira inywena;

english: Jesus said to him, “Watch out and do not tell anyone; then come back and show the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a witness to them.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Werinde, oleke kugambiraho muntu; kandi garukayo, weyoleke hali nyakatagara, ohouge ekisembo Musa ekiyaragire, kibe kaiso habali.

english: He is loved and faithful in all his work in behalf of his friends and guests.
lunyoro: Arukugonzebwa nokora omulimo ogwokwesiga omu byona ebyokora habwabu bene baitu kandi abagenyi:

english: “No one of your brothers is called by that name,” they answered.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Busaho omuli bene banyu ayetwa ibara eri.

english: How happy and happy it must have been to hear that your brother was dead, and he was alive! He was lost, and now he has been raised to life.
lunyoro: Baitu okukyanganuka nokusemererwa kisemire: baitu mugenzi wawe ogu akaba afire, kandi ayomire, akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: But bring these people to me, who have not defiled the courts or defiled the widow's house.
lunyoro: Baitu mulete namberali abantu banu, abatanyagire ebyomu mabandiro, nobukwakuba okujuma omufakati webisuba.

english: But to everyone who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
lunyoro: baitu okusimwa nekitinisa nobusinge hali wena arukukora okurungi okubanza Omuyudaya kandi Nomuyonani:

english: I am telling you the truth: a slave is not greater than his master, and a slave is not greater than his master.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuiru takira obukuru mukamawe, kandi omukwenda takira obwingi ogu ayamutumire.

english: But what you have heard from the beginning remains in you, and you will remain in the Son and the Father.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara obukiraba nikiikara omulinywe, nainywe muraikaraga omu Mwana nomu Isitwe.

english: There is nothing that has happened to you that has not happened to you of all people, but to the God of hope, who will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. Instead, he will take away everything you have, so that you may be able to endure.
lunyoro: Tinkabaho okwohebwa kwindi halinywe, okutarukusobora abantu bona; baitu Ruhanga wokwesiga, atalibaleka okwohezebwa okukira ekimusobora; baitu hamu nokwohebwa alitaho hokuirukira, nukwo musobole okuguma.

english: Jesus said to them, “Why are you frightened? You have not yet found faith!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubatinisa? Timukatungire kuikiriza?

english: So Joseph left Galilee and did not go to Nazareth. He went to Judea to the town of Judas, which belongs to Bethlehem, because he was a guest in the house.
lunyoro: Yusufu akaruga omu Galiya natabara, arugire omu rubuga rwa Nazalesi, nataha omu Buyudaya hali orubuga rwa Baudi orwetwa Beterehemu, baitu akaba ali womu nju, kandi

english: I tell you, whoever does not believe in the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it.
lunyoro: mazire okugamba ati Omuntu wena ataliikiriza obukama bwa Ruhanga nkomwana omuto, talibutahamu na kake.

english: I tell you that soon the Son of Man will come and destroy them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Alibaramu'ra bwango. Baitu Omwana womuntu obwaliija alisanga okuikiriza hansi?

english: Show yourselves thankful to God, a servant of God who is not ashamed of him, who is able to speak the truth with all his heart.
lunyoro: Wekambe okweyoleka osimirwe hali Ruhanga, omukozi atarukukwatwa ensoni, anyakusobo'ra kurungi ekigambo kyamazima.

english: But now the weeds are gathered into the barn, and every tree that does not bear good fruit will be burned up and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: hati bunu empango etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire guratemwa, guranagwa omu mu'ro.

english: Jesus began to say to the crowds about John, “What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed shaken by the wind?”
lunyoro: Kandi abakwenda okugenda, Yabanza okugambira ebitebe ha Yohana ati Mukagenderayo ki omu irungu okurora? Orubingo orurukutengesebwa embeho?

english: No one puts the wine out of the skins, and no one tells it, ‘The wine that does not remain in the cup has been poured out for you.’
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga ezikuzire; kakuba agira ati amarwa agasandaire gakutemuire endyanga zakusisikaire.

english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its roar, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. In this way you will say, ‘Whoever is born of the Spirit.’
lunyoro: Embeho ehuha nambere egonza, naiwe ohu'ra okuhi'ra kwayo, baitu tomanya nambere eruga, nobuhokuba nambere egenda; nukwo aba ati wena anyakuzarwa Omwoyo.

english: But they did not recognize him, because their eyes had seen Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu batamutangi'le baitu amaisoge gakaba garozire Yerusalemu.

english: Publius, whose father was sick, was sick with a fever. Paul went in to him, prayed, placed his hands on him, and buried him.
lunyoro: Kandi ise Pubulio akaba abyamire arwaire omusuija nensese: Pauro yataha nemberali, yasaba, namutaho emikonoye, yamuzika.

english: Do not be like the foolish ones, who do not know what you are doing.
lunyoro: Kandi nkabana abokuhu'ra mutarukwesaniza nkokwetakwegomba, omu kutamanya kwanyu:

english: So Jesus said, “Let those who have authority among you go away with me, and if this man is a sinner, let him go ahead and kill him.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagamba ati; Abayina obusobozi omulinywe, basirimuke nanyowe, kandi obwaraba omusaija ogu aroho ekibi kyona, bamulege.

english: He was changed in front of them, and his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became like the light.
lunyoro: yaye yahindurwa omu maiso gabu: amaisoge nigamulikana nkizoba, nebyokujwarabye nibyera nkomusana.

english: He is the only one who comes from the cross.
lunyoro: Rundi oye june wenka, oruge ha muti.

english: When you are purified from your sins, you will know the hope that God has set before you, the hope that is placed before you, and the glorious riches that are brought into the presence of the holy ones.
lunyoro: obumurukumanya okunihira okumwahairwe, nobuguda obwekitinisa ekyobugwetwa omuli abarukwera,

english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea, he went to Galilee and begged him to heal his son, because he was about to die.
lunyoro: Obuyahulire ngu Yesu arugire omu Buyudaya, aizire galiraya yagenda namberali, yamwesengereza asirimuke, akize omwanawe; baitu akaba amalize okufa.

english: When they saw the wisdom of Peter and John, they recognized that they were ordinary people who did not know the truth and did not understand what they were learning, and they were surprised to know that they were with Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine obumanzi bwa Petero na Yohana, babamanyire okuba bantu abatamanyire okusoma, kandi abatakegesebwaga, batangara; babamanyi'ra nibo baikaraga na Yesu.

english: But if you have poured this perfume out of my body, you have done it because of the burial.
lunyoro: baitu obwoyaseserege amagita ganu ga mubiri gwange, akikozire obwokuzika.

english: A man who was lame from his mother's womb had been healed, and the next day they threw him out of the Temple treasury, which is called the Holy Place, to tell those who had come into the Temple to be punished.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akabali omulema okuruga omu nda ya nyina akaba bamuhimbire, oubabyamyaga obukyabukya ha ruigi orwa yekaru orurukwetwa Orurungi, okulega ebyokuganyira hali abo atahaga omu yekaru.

english: I was in Joppa praying, and my heart was made ready to see something coming up, like a dove coming down from heaven.
lunyoro: nyowe nkaba ndi omu harubuga Yopa ninsaba: omutima gwange gukahingisibwa, narora omu kwolekwa ekintu nikisirimuka, ekisisana nkorugoye orukoto orutebwa okuruga haiguru,

english: Peter said, “Lord, why are you trying to trap us all?
lunyoro: Petero yagamba ati Mukama waitu orufumo runu norutucwera itwe, nandiki bona?

english: They said to him, “Lord, give us this bread and this water.”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Mukama waitu otuhege obutosa ebyokurya ebi.

english: You will be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a witness to them and to the nations.
lunyoro: mulitwarwa hali abalemi nabakama okuajunana nyowe, okuba bakaiso hali abo, na hali abamahanga.

english: For the poor always have with them what they have, but the always do not have with me.
lunyoro: Baitu abamasege nibo munyinabo ebiro byona; baitu timunyina nyowe ebiro byona

english: Which one of you, then, will I raise to life?
lunyoro: Rundi kiikaro ki nambere ndihumu'ra?

english: Jesus knew that they were going to ask him, “Why did you ask one of them, ‘ Why did you say that there is only a little while, and you will not see me, and then a little while later you will see me?”
lunyoro: Yesu yamanya nibenda okumukaguza, yabagambira ati Nimukaguzangana inywenka habweki ekingambire nti Hasigaireho akacu kake, timundole, kandi halibaho akacu kike, mulindora?

english: If we have put you in prison by means of the Spirit, how can we rob you of your material riches?
lunyoro: Obuturaba itwe twabasigiremu ebyomwoyo, kyamahano obutuligesa ebyanyu ebyomubiri?

english: “The time has come for the Kingdom of God to come upon you,” he said. “Turn away, and believe in the Good News.”
lunyoro: yagamba ati Akasumi kahikira, obukamabwa Ruhanga bumalize okuhika: mwegarukemu, muikirirze enjiri.

english: For there are some who are saved by the power of their mothers, and others who have been saved by the power of the Kingdom of heaven. Those who can believe and believe in it will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu haroho abakonerwe abazairwe bai okuruga omu nda za banyinabo: haroho abakuonerwe abayekonere bonka obwobukama obwomu iguru. Anyakusobora okukiikiriza, akiikirize.

english: We ourselves boast about you in the churches of God, because you endure with endurance and faith, in all your trials and sufferings.
lunyoro: naitwe itwenka ntwenyumiriza omulinywe omu kanisa za ruhanga, obwokugumisiriza kwanyu nokuikiriza, omu kuhigwa kwanyu kwona nomuhito ebimucule'ra:

english: He was in the desert with the angel who talked with him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors. He was given the living words to give to us.
lunyoro: Gunu nuwe ogu akabali omu kanisa omu irungu, hamu namaraika eyabalize nauwe ha rusozi Sinai, kandi hamu na baisenkuru itwe: ayahairwe ebigambo ebyobwomezi okutuha itwe;

english: And you say, ‘Whoever tells his father or mother, ‘All that God has given him will be of no use to you.’
lunyoro: Kandi inywe mugamba ngu Wena obwaligambira ise rundi nyina ati Kyona ekinakukuhaire okukugasira nkihongire Ruhanga,

english: When they saw that a man was healed, they stood still with them, but they could not answer him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine omuntu akizibwege, ayemerire hamu nabo, batasobole kugarukamu.

english: I planted, Apollos watered, but God made it grow.
lunyoro: nyowe nkabyara, Aporo akaiti'ra amaizi: baitu Ruhanga nuwe yayanisize.

english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: kandi nimbagambira nti Baingi abaliruga burugaizoba na bugwaizoba, baliika'ra hamu na Iburahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, omu bukama obwomu iguru:

english: In the same way, now they too have been forgiven for their sin, and so have they been forgiven.
lunyoro: nukwo na hati bunu kuganyirwa bo, bo kuganyirwe.

english: In the same way, in the past, God's holy women who were waiting for God made fun of him and saw their own children.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro byaira nukwo nabakazi abarukwera abanihiraga Ruhanga bayecumaga bati, nibarobera abaibabu bonka:

english: Whoever has this hope in him will be happy just as he is pleased.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena anyakuina okunihira oku haruwe ayesemeza nkauwe okwasemezibwe.

english: When Jesus came in, he said to them, “What do you want me to do for you? The child is not dead, but only asleep.”
lunyoro: kandi obuyatahiremu yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubanziza nekirukubaliza? Omuisiki tafire, agwijagire kwonka.

english: They took counsel together to trap Jesus and kill him.
lunyoro: kandi bahanura ahamu okukwasa Yesu anamagezi, Bamuite.

english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who sent you.
lunyoro: Baitu tabali inywe mubaza, baitu Omwoyo ogwa Isinywe nuwe abaliza omulinywe.

english: For I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife or marries another commits adultery; and whoever marries a woman commits adultery.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti omuntu wena anyakubinga omukaziwe, rundi obwokusihana, buli amusihanize: nogu anyakumuswera abingirwe, buli asihaine.

english: Was it? Was it because he was in circumcision? Or was it in uncircumcision? Was it in circumcision, but in circumcision.
lunyoro: Kikaba kiri omukusarwa? Obwakaba ali omu kusarwa? Nandiki omu kutasarwa? Obwakasarwa, baitu omu kutukurwa:

english: Jesus had no excuse for not having a share in the harvest, so he left them both. Which one of them should love him?
lunyoro: Obubakaba batanyina kyokumara ibanja, yabalekera bombi. Noha hali abo alikira okumugonza?

english: For I do not speak of myself; but the Father who sent me has given me a commandment to tell and to speak.
lunyoro: baitu ntagambe habwange, rundi Isenyowe ayanyumire, nuwe yandagire okungamba, kandi okumbaza.

english: For Christ has not entered a holy place made with hands, which is a copy of the truth; but into heaven itself, now to appear before God for us.
lunyoro: Baitu Kristo atatahe omu kiikaro ekirukwera ekyakozirwe nemikono, ekirukusisana nkeki ekyamazima; baitu omu iguru honyini, okwolekwa hati bunu omu maiso ga Ruhanga habwaitu;

english: And if I have repented afterward, my heart will not be glad in him.
lunyoro: kandi obwayehinya enyuma, omutima gwange tigurukusemererwa omuruwe.

english: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in union with Christ. We are weak, but you are strong in glory, because we are weak.
lunyoro: Itwe tuli badomadoma habwa Kristo, baitu inywe muli bamagezi omu Kristo: itwetuli bagara, baitu ninywe bamani bekitinisa, baitu itwe tuli bokugayibwa.

english: They did not dare to speak to anyone about him.
lunyoro: Kandi batagume okugambiraho muntu haruwe.

english: So then, fulfill the promise made by your ancestors.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu muhikirize okuraganiza kwanyu,

english: Those who believe in me, as the scripture says, will come out of her, and she will drink of the boiling water.
lunyoro: Anyakuikiriza nyowe, nkekyahandikire okukugamba, omundaye nuho halituruka ebyambu ebyamaizi agomire.

english: Or will you say to your brother, ‘Please take away the speck out of your eye, and look at the speck out of your eye?’
lunyoro: Rundi, olimugambira ota mutahi wawe ngu Kanyiheho akantu akali haliso ryawe; kandi, dora enyomyo ikaire ha liso ryawe?

english: Then you will say, ‘What does he do to him again?’ But who is willing to do what he wants?
lunyoro: Nukwo oragambira oti Kiki ekirukumuhanisa kandi? Baitu noha ayemera ebyagonza?

english: Look! The reward of those who work hard for the things that you did not work for them is that you stood up and told them about them; and their reward is great in the eyes of the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth.
lunyoro: Dora, empera yabakozi abatemere emisiri yanyu, eyimwabaimire negambira haiguru: nempamo yabu abagesere etahire omu matu Mukama owamahe.

english: They learned to be self-controlled, but to be self-controlled, they went ahead and told others what they should not do.
lunyoro: Kandi bega okugira obugara bwonka, baitu bafoka abagambisibwa nakajanja, nibabaza ebitabasemerire.

english: But now they want something better for themselves than for heaven. God will not be ashamed of them to be called their God, because he has prepared for them a city.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu nibegomba erukukira oburungi, niyo yomuiguru: nikyo Ruhanga alekera okubakwatirwa ensoni okwetwa Ruhanga wabu: baitu akabatekaniriza orubuga.

english: They have refreshed my spirit and yours. You have put faith in those who are like them.
lunyoro: Baitu bakahumuza omwoyo gwange nogwanyu: omwoyo mubaikirize abanyakuli nkabo.

english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and the whole crowd believed and turned to the Lord.
lunyoro: Omukonogwe gwa Mukama waitu gukaba guli nabo; nekitebe kingi ekyabaikirize bahindukirra hali mukama waitu.

english: I wept bitterly, but no one could find any reason to open the book or to see it.
lunyoro: Kandi nka'ra muno, baitu busaho ayazokere asemerire okusuku'ra ekitabu, nobukwakuba okukiroraho.

english: But the wise ones answered, “If you don't, we will all go with you. You should go where they will buy food for yourselves.”
lunyoro: Baitu abamagezi bagarukamu nibagamba ngu Rundi tigatumale, itwena nainywe: hakire mugende haliabarukugura mwe gu'le

english: For I have given you an example, just as I also did to you.
lunyoro: Baitu mbahaire ekyokuro'raho, kandi nkokumbakozire nyowe, nukwo nainywe mukolege muti.

english: Let us draw near to God with all our heart and with all our faith, with all our heart, and with all our soul, and with all our mind, and with all our strength, we have been filled with good water.
lunyoro: tui'le haihi nomutima ogwamazima, omu kuikiriza kwona, tuyina emitima yaitu emisirweho okuihamu omwoyo omubi, kandi nomubiri gwaitu gwogibwe amaizi amarungi:

english: For just as the lightning from the east will happen, so the coming of the Son of Man will be.
lunyoro: Baitu nkenkuba okweruga burugaizoba; nukwo nukwo kuliba kuti okwija kwomwana

english: The Lord answered him, “Martha, Martha, you are deeply troubled and troubled by many things.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yagarukamu namugambira ati Maliza, Maliza iwe otuntuire notabana obwebigambo bingi:

english: God gave them the right to be ashamed of them, because their wives had purified themselves from the sexual immorality that belongs to them.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga akabahayo hali okukwatwa okwensoni: baitu abakazi babu bakahingisa eki omubiri ekiguzalirwa omu eki ekitanyina amani.

english: The man came to us and took Paul's belt, tied it up with his own hands, and said, “This is what the Holy Spirit says: ‘The Jews in Jerusalem will arrest the man who owns this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
lunyoro: Ogu akaija nambetuli, yakwata omweko gwa Pauro, yayeboha ebigerebye nemikonoye wenka, nagamba ati Nukwo agambire Omwoyo Ogurukwera ati Abayudaya abomu Yerusalemu nukwo baliboha bati omusaija mukama womweko gunu, balimuhayo omu mikono Yabamahanga.

english: The harvest of righteousness is sown in peace for those who do it.
lunyoro: Kandi ekyana ekyokuhiki'ra kibyarwa omu businge hali abo abarukuleta obusinge.

english: Send now to Joppa and call for one Simon, whose name is Peter.
lunyoro: Kandi nati bunu otume abantu Yopa, oyeteyo omuntu Simoni, ibararye eryakabiri Petero:

english: Put on all the armor that God gives you so that you will be able to stand firm against the Devil.
lunyoro: Ebyokurwanisa byona ebya Ruhanga, musobole okwemere'ra obusupe bwa Setani.

english: He raised us up together with him and seated us together in the heavenly places in union with Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: yatuhumbura hamu nauwe, yatuikaliza hamu omu biikaro ebyomu iguru omu Kristo Yesu:

english: The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the property where you belong.’
lunyoro: kandi omuto akagambira ise ati Tata mpa omugabo ogwebintu ogusemerire.

english: Jesus said to him, “Lord, I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who comes into the world.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Nukwo, Mukama wange, nyikirize niwe Kristo, omwana wa Ruhanga, aija omu nsi.

english: Jesus gave a parable to them, saying, “There was once a man who was one on the road, and he was one who was holy.
lunyoro: Kandi akabacwera orufumo ati Hakaba haroho omuntu omu emisirye neyera bingi:

english: They did this and were handed over to the chief priests by Barnabas and Saul.
lunyoro: kandi nukwo bakozire bati, nibabitwekera abakuru omu mukono gwa Baranaba na Sauro.

english: Jesus said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Look! Today I drive out demons and heal people, and the third day I am coming back to you.’
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mugende mugambire eboha egi muti Dora, hati na ijo nimbinga emizimu, ninkiza abantu, kandi ha kiro kyakasatu nimpiki'ra.

english: For we are the chosen ones who worship God in spirit and rejoice in Christ Jesus, who does not rely only on human nature.
lunyoro: baitu itwe tuli bokusarwa abarukuramya Ruhanga omu Mwoyo, kandi abarukwenyumiriza omu Kristo Yesu, abatarukwesiga omubiri kwonka:

english: Yes, Father, for so it was well with you.
lunyoro: Ego, isenyowe baitu nukwo kyasemire kiti omu maiso gawe.

english: The first came to him and said, ‘Sir, your gold earned ten thousand silver coins.’
lunyoro: Owokubanza akaija namberali nagamba ati Mukama wange, erateri yawe ekasagisamu erateri ikumi ezindi.

english: You are the ones who are the ones who are the ones who belong to the world. And do not call anyone your father on earth, for one is your Father, the Creator of heaven and earth.
lunyoro: kandi inywe mutaryeta muntu hansi isinywe; baitwe isinye ali omu,

english: There is difference between a wife and her husband. The unmarried woman is anxious for the things of the Lord, so that she may be physically and spiritually married. But the married woman is anxious for the things of the world, so that she may please her husband.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho okubaganizamu omukazi aswirwe nomuhara. Omukazi ataswirwe atuntu'ra ebya Mukama waitu, nukwo ayerege nomu mubiri nomu mwoyo: baitu anyakuswirwe ahanga ebya hansi, okwarasemezaga omusaijawe.

english: Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Father, into your hands I entrust my spirit!” At the same time he said this and gave me life.
lunyoro: Nauwe yagamba ati Isenyowe, omu mikono yawe mpaireyo omwoyo gwange. Obuyamazire okugamba eki yahayo obwomezi.

english: Let each one keep seeking, not his own advantage, but that of others.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena aleke okuse'ra ebye wenka, baitu ase'le ebyabandi.

english: I have made your name known to them, and I will make it known. The love you have for me will be in them, and I will be in them.
lunyoro: Kandi nkabamanyisa ibara ryawe, kandi ndirimanyisa; okugonza okuwagondeze nyowe kuikale omubo, nanyowe omubo.

english: When Lydda and Joppa heard that Peter was there, the disciples sent two men to ask him not to stay with us.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruda, obwokuba haihi na Yopa, abegeswa obubahulire Petero aliyo, bamutumira abantu babiri nibamwesengereza ngu Otaikara, otahi're halitwe.

english: and said, “You went in to the uncircumcised, and you ate with them.”
lunyoro: nibagamba ngu Okataha omu bantu abatasazirwe, kandi okarya nabo.

english: In this way he brings himself to the church for the sake of glory. He has no excuse, no pity, no pity, no shame, for nothing is like this. He must be holy, without being condemned.
lunyoro: nukwo agyeretere wenka ekanisa eyekitinisa, etanyina kamogo, nobugwakuba omugonya, nobukyakuba ekintu kyona ekirukusisana kiti, baitu ikalege erukwera etaroho musango.

english: If I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: For there is no one who has a conscience like that of Moses, who will understand your words.
lunyoro: Baitu tinyina ondi nomu anyina omutima okuingana nogu, alitaho omutima ebigambo byanyu.

english: I tell you, then, that many of his sins have been forgiven by him, because he has been forgiven by God for his abundant love, but only a little while has been forgiven by him.
lunyoro: Nikyo nkugambirire nti Ebibibye ebingi bimuihirweho; baitu okugonzakwe kwingi, baitu anyakuihwaho ebike, nuwe agonza kake.

english: He became a strong man of faith, giving thanks to God, and he knew that what he was about to do was what he had told him to do.
lunyoro: baitu akafoka wamani obwokuikiriza, nakugiza Ruhanga, kandi amanyire kimu ati ekiyaragire nikyo asobora okukora.

english: For I am sure that all things are dead, so that I may know the truth about Christ Jesus, my Lord. I know that I have died for all, and that I may pray for him.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimkwo nintekereza byona bifire, obwoburungi obwingi obwokumanya Kristo Yesu Mukama wange: ounaferirwe byona, kandi nimbitekereza okuba nkesabu,

english: Many of those who heard the message gathered their books together and burned them before all the people. They counted the price of them and saw the money they owed to the five kings.
lunyoro: Kandi baingi hali abo abahoraga ebyokuragura bakasoroza ahamu ebitabu byabu, babyokeza, omu maiso gabantu bona: kandi babara omuhendo gwabyo, bagurora bicweka byefeza bukumi butano.

english: For if I live in the flesh, I do not know what I want.
lunyoro: baitu okwemera omu mubiri, -kiraba nikyo kyana kyemirimo yange, nyowe timanyire ekindayegomboza.

english: Large crowds gathered around him, but they could not find one or the other at the door. He told them the message.
lunyoro: Baso'rokana baingi, kandi bakaba batarukusobora kuhikamu, nobuhokuba omu muryango: yabatebeza ekigambo.

english: For he has given all those who believe in him authority to become God's children, if they believe in him.
lunyoro: Baitu bona abamukirize, akabaha obusobozi okufoka abana baruhanga,niba barukuikiriza ibararye:

english: All of you can speak with one another, so that all may understand.
lunyoro: Baitu inywena numusobora okutebeza omu omu, nukwo bona betegereze,

english: The servant, who knows what his master wants him to do, is not ready to do what he wants.
lunyoro: Omwiru ogu rubale, ayamanyire mukamawe ebyagondeze, kandi atetekanize, nobukwakuba okukora nkokuyagondezibwe,

english: They handed him over to be tried by God, as he had instructed them. You crucified him with the power of the Evil One and killed him.
lunyoro: ogu obubamuhaireyo, nka Ruhanga okuyabandize okuhanura nokumanya, inywe mukamubamba ha muti nemikono yabantu ababi, mwamuita:

english: They spread out around the whole world and surrounded the camp of the holy ones and the city that belongs to them. fire came down from heaven and destroyed them all.
lunyoro: Baramaga okuhikya ensi zona, bayehinguliriza orukande orwabarukwera norubuga orurukogonzebwa: kandi omu'ro gwagwa okuruga omu iguru gwabokeza kimu.

english: When he found himself in fashion as a human being, he humbled himself and fell asleep in death, just as the death of a cross was.
lunyoro: kandi obuyazokere okusisana nomuntu yayebundaza wenka, naculera okuhikya ha kufa, nukwo kufa kwa ha muti.

english: May God's peace come upon you, when you are put right with one another in the same way, and be made alive.
lunyoro: Kandi obusinge bwa Ruhanga buramulege omu mitima yanyu, obumwayetirwe omulinywe omu mutima gumu; kandi musimege.

english: So then, we must tell those who are like them that we are their fellow workers in the truth.
lunyoro: nukwo kituhikiririre okubairiza abali nkabo, tube abakozi batahi babu hamu namazima.

english: But they all made mistakes, because they did not come to the glory of God.
lunyoro: baitu bona bakasisa, kunu tibahikire ha kitinisa kya Ruhanga:

english: One of the elders, named Jairus, came to the synagogue. When he saw him, he fell at his feet,
lunyoro: Kandi hakaija omu hali abakuru biso'rokaniro ibararye Yairo; obuyamuboine, yainama ha bigerebye,

english: and with all the tongues we proclaimed that Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of our Father, the Lord.
lunyoro: kandi nendimi zona zatule ngu Yesu kristo nuwe Mukama, Mukama, hali okukugizibwa kwa Ruhanga Isitwe.

english: All the Holy Ones of heaven and earth have been raised to life, and more than anyone else in the Roman Empire.
lunyoro: Abarukwera bona, abahansi noba haiguru, bahumuzibwa okukira omuntu wena owomubantu Abarumi.

english: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You are going about the sea with a little more noise, so that you will turn around, and you will be like the Son of Man more than two times!
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abahandiki Nabafalisayo abagobya! Baitu muhinguliriza omunyanja na'ha bwe'le, okuhindura omu; kandi obwa foka ati, mumufora omwana wa Gehena okukira inywe emirundi ebiri.

english: The world did not know you, but I knew you. These people knew that you sent me.
lunyoro: ensi tekakumanyaga, baitu nyowe nkakumanya; na banu bakamanya niwe wantumire:

english: So we sailed from Troas and sailed off to Samos and arrived in Neapolis the next day.
lunyoro: Kandi twahanika amaberu okuruga Teroa, twakwata omuhanda oguterekerire okuhika Samo, kandi ha kiro ekyakabiri twahika Neapoli:

english: Even though you give your gift to the holy one, you are the one who gives it to the poor.
lunyoro: Kandi obumuraba nimbaha abarukwera ekisembo kyanyu,

english: If it were not that it would not be for a sacrifice to be offered, how much more will it be for those who are guilty of sin to be put right with God!
lunyoro: Kakuba kitalikyo tibyakulekereyo okuhongwa? baitu abaramya obubamaire okwogibwa mali omurundi gumu, tibakubaire nokwemanyaho ebibi.

english: If you love him, you will not see him who is very happy and happy without being told the truth, filled with glory, or where you do not see him now.
lunyoro: Oumurukugonza mutakamuboine oumurukusemerwamu muno nokusemererwa okutarukugambwa, okuijuire ekitinisa, nobumuraba mutarukumurora hati.

english: What shall we say that our ancestor Abraham saw as a human being?
lunyoro: NUKWO kiki ekituragamba Iburahimu isenkuru itwe ekiyaboine nkomubiri okuguli?

english: Do not be afraid of the coming back of the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: hakire inywe okutaija enyuma omu kisembo kyona ekyembabazi nokwolekwa okwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo,

english: But in the same day when the seventh angel is about to blow the trumpet, God's secret will be made known, just as the Good News he preached to his servants.
