lunyoro: Kandi kitahandikwe habwogu wenka ngu okuhiki'ra kukamutekerezebwaho,

english: Do not be proud of the Jews, nor of the Gentiles, nor of the church of God.
lunyoro: Mutaletera enkonge Abayudaya, nobubakuba Abayonani, nobwekuba ekanisa ya Ruhanga:

english: They made known to him that they had told him the secret, and at once I was put in charge of him, and I order that those who should not put him out of your presence be put in front of you.
lunyoro: kandi obubanyolekere ngu bamugambiraine ensita omusaija ogu, ahonaho namutweka haliwe, kandi nindagira abamulegere okumulega omu maiso gawe.

english: Anyone who makes a show of his faith for the sake of the good news should be thrown into the sea, where he will be thrown into the sea.
lunyoro: Nauwe aliculera omu hali abo ababiri abasisire, hakire ogu okubohwa orubengo orukoto omu maiso gaitu, obwokunihira okwomusisi, obwomutima gwange, bikamuseme'ra okuhu'rwa omu nyanja.

english: who do not keep account of the evil and the weeds of the evil one; instead, they are the ones who pray for you, because you have been called by our name.
lunyoro: Abatarukugaru'rangana obubi obwobubi, nobukwakuba okujuma obwokujuma; baitu okundi nkabanyakusabira, baitu nikyo mwayetirwe.

english: So then, have the children to repent.
lunyoro: Nukwo mwane ebyana ebisemerire okwegarukamu:

english: Jesus answered them, “You have been given the knowledge of the secrets of the Kingdom of heaven, but they have not been given to him.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati Inywe muhairwe okumanya ebigambo byensita ebyobukama obwomu iguru, baitu abo tibahairwe;

english: For I love our nation, and I am the one who made us in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ningonza ihanga ryaitu, kandi ankwombekereho uwe.

english: But Saul, who is also the one who is Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, encouraged him and said,
lunyoro: Baitu Sauro, kandi nuwe Pauro, aijuire Omwoyo Ogurukwera, yamugumyahyo amaiso nagamba ati

english: They went over to Matthias, and he was handed over to them by the eleven disciples.
lunyoro: babatomera, kwahika ha Matiya; yaba'rarwa hamu nabakwenda ikumi nomu.

english: But you have done this to me, and I will set you free for the Passover meal. Do you want me to be handed over to the king of the Jews?”
lunyoro: Baitu muyina engeso, nyowe okubalekera omu ha Kuhingurwaho: nimwenda mbalekere omukama wa Bayudaya?

english: When it was time, Jesus called his disciples together, and he chose twelve men from among them whom he had chosen.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukire, yayeta abegeswabe; yakoma omulibo ikumi nababiri abayayesere abakwenda,

english: After spending a few days there, Paul arrived in Achaia.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazireyo ebiro tibiri bingi, yahika Buyonani,

english: He measured the city with the measure of each gate, according to its length. He measured the city with the measure of the wall, twenty thousand cubits, and the measure of the wall, and the measure of the city was twenty thousand cubits, and the measure of the wall, and the measure of the city was twenty thousand cubits, and the measure of the wall, and the measure of the city was twenty cubits.
lunyoro: Kandi orubuga nuruinganaingana embaju zona, obuhango bwarwo nkokugaliha. Yalengesa orubuga omuseke ati Esitadyo kakumi mwenkumi ibiri, nomuhendo gworuigi okuraiha nokuraiha.

english: Which one of you, then, will accuse me of sin? Why should I speak out of your heart to you? Why should you believe me?
lunyoro: Noha halinywe anyomereza ekibi? Obundaba ningamba ebyamananu kiki ekibahinzire okunyikiriza?

english: For if this part of us takes away the sin of the world and these things of death does not die, then what the Scriptures say will happen: “Death has been swallowed up.”
lunyoro: Baitu okujunda kunu obukulikajwara okutajunda, nebyokufa binu obubirijwara okufa, nukwo kirihiki'ra ekigambo ekyahandikirwe ngu Okufa kumizirwe okusingura.

english: Who is this man who wants to come, or should we wait for someone else?
lunyoro: Niwe ogu arukwenda kuija, rundi tutegereze ondi?

english: But you have rejected the merciful. Are not they the ones who judge you and the ones who judge you?
lunyoro: Baitu inywe mwagaya owamsege.Tinibo baguda abarukubahiga, nibabacunda?

english: When the crowd heard that it was passing by, he asked, “What is this?”
lunyoro: kandi obuyahulire ekitebe nikihinguraho yakaguza ati Kiki eki?

english: and said to them, “When you are invited to a wedding feast, do not sit in the middle of the room, unless someone else has something else in common.
lunyoro: kandi nabagambira ali Obwoyetwa omuntu wena hali obugenyi obwobugole, otaika'ra omu kiikaro ekya hagati; rundi hatabaho arukukukira ekitinisa ouyayesere,

english: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it is impossible for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: Yesu yagambira abegeswabe ati Munanukwo nimbagambira nti Nikiremera omuntu omutungi okutaha omu bukama obwomu iguru.

english: and anguish, sorrow, and anguish, for the heart of the wicked one, first of all, who is a Jew and a Gentile.
lunyoro: nobujune nemihito, hali omutima gwona ogwomuntu arukukora kubi, okubanza Omuyudaya, kandi Nomuyonani:

english: We have no right to take the Lord's sister with us.
lunyoro: Naitwe titunyina busobozi okutwara mukazi mwene waitu hamu naitwe?

english: For God is not unjust to be ashamed of your work and of the love you have shown toward him, in order to make you holy, and to make you acceptable to him.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga tali atahikirire okwebwa emirimo yanyu, nokugonza okumwayolekere hali ibararye, obumwaherize abarukwera, kandi numukyahereza.

english: Jesus said to him, “No one puts his hand back on a stone and looks back and looks at the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamugambira ati Busaho muntu obwata omukonogwe ha kyoma ekirima narora enyuma, asemerire obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: If the whole body were blind, where would the hearing be? Or if the ear were hearing, where would the rest be?”
lunyoro: Kakuba omubiri gwona guli eriso, okukehura kwakubaire nkaha? Rundi kakuba gubaire okuhu'ra, obukwakubaire buli hara?

english: But Paul's nephew heard about the plot and went into the Council and told Paul.
lunyoro: Baitu omwana wa munyanya Pauro yahu'ra okwesereke'ra kwabu, yaija yataha omu rukomero yagambira Pauro.

english: After spending a long time there, Festus told the king about Paul. “There is a man named Felix, who has been a prisoner,
lunyoro: Kandi obubaikaireyo ebiro bingi, Fesito yatebeza omukama ebya Pauro, nagamba ati Haroho omuntu omu, Ferekisi ouyasigire omunyankomo:

english: You will also testify about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe mumanyisa ebyange, baitu okuruga kara na kara mukaba muli nayowe.

english: If your foot causes you to stumble and to be broken, it is better for you to enter life with eternal life than to be thrown into hell.
lunyoro: Kakuba ekigere kyawe nikikutabaijura, okucwehoga, hakire iwe aokutaha omu bwomezi obuzirweho okuguru, okukira okunagwa omu Gehena oyina amaguru gombi.

english: I do everything in the Lord's service, with all humility, with all humility, with all my heart, with all my heart, with all my troubles, and with all the troubles that the Jews have brought me.
lunyoro: nkora Mukama waitu nobuculezi bwona, namaizi omu maiso, nemihito eyambaireho obwensita Zabayudaya:

english: But those who are made blind by these things will be blind, and they will see only the things that are far away, and they will be put right with him for the sake of the old things.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakubuzirweho ebigambo ebi buli afire amaiso, narora ebiri haihi byonka, aihibwaho ebi ebyaira.

english: When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for it was empty), and went off into the sea.
lunyoro: Simon Petero obuyahulire nuwe Mukama waitu, yayetega orugoye ( baitu akabali busa) yayesimba omu nyanja.

english: They drew near to him and were very afraid to grow up according to what he had said, “They will no longer see him.” So they made plans to get on the ship.
lunyoro: kandi bamunywegera, baganyire muno okukura byona obwekigambo ekiyagambire ati tibalibona amaisoge obundi. Kandi bamusenderezaho okuhika ha kyombo.

english: A good man brings good out of his treasure of good things, but a bad man brings bad out of his bad treasure of bad things.
lunyoro: Omuntu asemire, aiha ebisemire omu ryahu'rorye erisemire: omuntu omubi aiha ebibihire omu yahuro eribihire.

english: They will not hand me over to them, but they will hand me over to you. I am able to take it back, and I am able to take it back to you. This commandment has been given to me by my Father.
lunyoro: Tindihayo halibo, baitu balihayo hali nyowe. Ninsobora okugiha, kandi ninsobora okugigarayo. Ekiragiro eki nkakihebwa hali Isenyowe.

english: After spending some time there, Jesus left and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazireyo ebiro tibiri bingi, yarugayo, yaraba omu nsi za Garatiya na Furugiya emuemu, nagumya abegeswa bona.

english: But some of them said, “Could not this man, who opened the blind's eyes, have also been able to see with him and not die?”
lunyoro: Abandi bagamba ngu Omuntu onu ayaiguire amaiso gomufu wamaiso atasobora kutanga nogu okutafa?

english: Jesus was greatly upset and said, “Why do the people of this city look for you? I tell you, they will not be given a witness about this.
lunyoro: Nauwe yatuntura muno omu mutimagwe, nagamba ati Abobusinge bunu nibaseru'ra ki akokuroraho? Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Abobisinge bunu tibalihebwa kokuro'raho.

english: Jesus answered, “I tell you, this place will be destroyed by the stone if it remains.
lunyoro: Yagaruka nagamba ati Nimbagambira nti Kusangwa banu baculera amabale gaba gayami'ra.

english: He got up and ran into the house and explained to Paul and Silas the meaning of the passage, and they were afraid.
lunyoro: Kandi yayami'ra ekimuli, yairuka natahamu, yabatereza amaju Pauro na Sira, natukumira obwokutina;

english: Jesus answered, “If I tell you by what I say, then what I say is true. We know where I came from and where I am going, but you do not know where I came from or where I am going.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nobundaba ninyegamba nyenka, okwegamba kwange kwa mananu; baitu'manyire nambere narugire, na handigenda: baitu inywe timumanyire handuga, nobuhokuba nambere ndigenda.

english: When the accusers arrived, they did not bring charges against him, as I thought they were.
lunyoro: kandi abamulegere obubamukire, batalete musango ogwebibi nkokunkaba nintekereza:

english: But now we do not know him, and he opened his eyes and did not know it.
lunyoro: Kandi okwarukuhweza hati bunu titurukumanya: kandi ayaiguire amaiso titumanyire wenka.

english: All the Jews know that I have lived ever since I was young, the first time in my country and in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Engeso zange okuruga omu buto bwange, ezabandize okubaho omu ihanga ryaitu, na Yerusalemu, Abayudaya bona bazimanyire:

english: They will be blessed when they arrive in the second or third generation.
lunyoro: Kandi obwaliija omu kisisimuka ekyakabiri, rundi ekyakasatu, nabasanga bali bati, banyina omugisa abo.

english: So then, if I take these children from you, I will leave Spain to go to Spain.
lunyoro: Nukwo obundikabakwasa ebyana ebi, ndirugayo, okuraba owanyu, okugenda Sipaniya.

english: So the Jews seized me in the Temple and tried to kill me.
lunyoro: Nikyo Abayudaya bankwatire omu yekaru, nibase'ra okunyita.

english: He gathered them together with the workers who had done this work and said, “Sirs, you know that this work is the work that brings us rich.
lunyoro: abo ahamu, hamu nabakozi abakoraga emirimo egi, nagamba ati Abasaija, mumanyire ngu omulimo gunu nigwo gutuhaisa obuguda bwaitu.

english: After those days we left our belongings and went to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi hanyuma yebiro ebi twayetweka ebyaitu, twatemba Yerusalemu.

english: The angel said to them, “Don't be afraid, for I have brought you good news of great joy to all the people.
lunyoro: Marakaika yabagambira ati Mutatina; baitu dora, mbaletire ebigambo ebirungi ebyokusemererwa okwingi okuliba hali abantu bona:

english: He went out, looked at the fig tree, and saw the fig tree, but it was about to pass through.
lunyoro: yataha omu maisoge, yarora omutini ogunyakuroho amaizi: baitu akaba na'sana okuhinguraho.

english: Then Jesus placed his hands on him, and immediately he received his crown and gave thanks to God.
lunyoro: Yamutaho emikonoye: ahonaho ogu yego'rwa, yakugiza Ruhanga.

english: Each one of you should know how to possess his own body in holiness.
lunyoro: omuntu wena omulinywe amanye okulema omubirigwe wenka omu kwezebwa ekitinisa,

english: Jesus said to them, “Let us go somewhere else, and then I will tell you the truth, because I am asleep.”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Tugende ahandi, omu biikaro ebindi ntebeze noku; baitu nikyo naizirire.

english: Jesus said to him, “Simon son of John, do you want me to?” Peter was upset because he said the third time, “Do you want me to?” He said to him, “You know everything that I want to do with you.” Jesus said to him, “You know that I want to.”
lunyoro: Namugambira ati Simoni omwana wa Yohana, nongonza? Petero yatuntura, baitu akamugambira omurundi ogwakasatu ationgane nanyowe. Yamuagambira ati Mukama wange, omanyire ninkungoza byona. Yesu yamugam,ra ati Lisa abana bange.

english: A religion that does not belong to our God and the Father is the source of the evil things in their hearts, and to keep out of the way that has no place in the world.
lunyoro: Edini esemire etaroho okusisikara omu maisoge, okuruga hali Ruhanga waitu kandi Isitwe, nukwo kwerindaga okutabaho akamogo omu nsi,

english: The believers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Berea, where they also went into the synagogue.
lunyoro: Ahonaho bene babu bakasindika Pauro na Sira ekiro okugenda Beroya; nabo obubahikire oku, bataha omu iso'rokaniro Ryabayudaya.

english: They left some on rocky ground, others on rocky ground, others on rocky ground, others on rocky ground. So it was that everyone came to life at the right time.
lunyoro: Nabandi bakabiha ebikongoijo, nabandi ebisuba; kandi nukwo bona bahikire bati ha musa bomire.

english: For many have become defiled by the disobedience of the one person, so that by the obedience of the one person many will be righteous.
lunyoro: baitu nkabaingi okubafokere abasisi obwokutahu'ra okwomuntu omu, nukwo obwokuhura okwomu abaingi balifoka bati abahikirire.

english: One of its heads looked like this: the shadow of death was bright, and the whole world was heard behind the beast.
lunyoro: ogumu ogwomu mitwe yakyo gukasisana gucumisirwe okufa; ekihuta ekyokufa kyakira: nensi zona zahu'ra enyuma yekisoro;

english: But because he did not have anything to pay, the master of the house ordered him to be sold, his wife, his children, and all that he had, and even his property.
lunyoro: Baitu obwakaba atanyina kyokumuma'ra, mukamawe yaragira okumugura, na mukaziwe, nabanabe, nebintu byona ebyakabayinabyo, nokumara ibanja.

english: If the foot should say, ‘I am not the hand,’ then it would not be the body.
lunyoro: Ruguru obweraba nirigamba ngu Nyowe tindi omukono, nukwo ntali ekicweka kyomubiri,

english: When the whole crowd saw what had happened, they ran back into the boat.
lunyoro: Kandi ebitebe byona ebyagomere ahamu obubaboine ebyabaireho bagarukayo nibeteratera omu kifuba.

english: For I tell you, no one can break the covenant of a man unless he has already made it.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira nti Nekiragano ekyomuntu kwonka obukimara okugumibwa, busaho akiburanganiza nobukwakuba okukyenwa.

english: He will speak to you about the things that will save you and all your descendants.
lunyoro: nuwe alikugambira ebigambo ebirikujunisa iwe nabomuka yawe bona.

english: But if I go away and see what you are doing, then I will find a passage written in the scripture that says, ‘God does not know me.’ And so you will not know what I am saying to you.
lunyoro: Baitu obumbaire nimpingura, nindora emirimo yanyu, nasanga kandi ekyoto ekihandikirweho ngu Kya Ruhanga atarukumanywa. Nukwo, ekimurukugamba nti Timumanyire, ninyowe nikyo ndukubagambira.

english: Jesus said to them, “Take nothing away from you, whether you are hungry or thirsty or you are eating or eating or drinking, and do not have two tents.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Mutatwara kintu kyorugendo rwanyu, nobukwakuba okurumwa enjara, nobubakuba abekitebe, nobubyakuba ebyokurya, nobugwakuba obwokuiguta, nobwekuba erupiya; kandi mutaba nebyesomeko bibiri.

english: For in the past you were required to be teachers of the Law and to teach the people first of all the things that God has commanded you. You must be like people who love milk and do not eat solid food.
lunyoro: Baitu nobukibahikirire, obwebiro ebingi ebyahinguireho, okufoka abegesa, numukyataga omuntu okwegesa inywe ebyokubandizaho ebyomu bigambo ebya Ruhanga; kandi mufokere nkabo abarukwenda amata, okutarya ebyokurya ebigumire.

english: What then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the mind; I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the mind.
lunyoro: Nukwo kiki? Ndasabaga omu Mwoyo, kandi ndasabaga namagezi: ndazinaga omu mwoyo, kandi ndaziniraga namagezi.

english: Jesus said to those Jews who believed in him, “If you remain in my word, you are really my disciples.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagambira Abayudaya abo abamuikirize ati Obumuraba numuikara omu kigambo kyange, nukwo muli begeswa bange mali;

english: “Tell these two sons of mine to sit down at your right and at your left, in your Kingdom,” he answered.
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda ki? Yamugambira ati Ragira abana bange banu babiri baika'le, ondi ha Mukono gwawe ogwoburyo, nondi h Mukono Gwawe ogwemoso, omu bukama bwawe.

english: But Jesus said to him, “Let the dead bury their own dead, but go and live for the Kingdom of God.”
lunyoro: Baitu yamugambira ati Siga abafu bazike abafu babu; baitu iwe ogende ohikye honahona obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: Suddenly there was a violent storm, and the waves began to throw in the boat, so that the boat was about to sink.
lunyoro: Ahonaho ihunga eringi likaija, ebigonzi nibiseseka omu bwato, kandi obwato bukaba nubu'sana okuijura.

english: So they gathered the elders together and gave them counsel and paid them a large sum of money to the soldiers.
lunyoro: Obubayesoroize ahamu nabakuru, bahanura hamu, bahera baserikale erupiya enyingi,

english: But he who hears the message and does not do it will be like a man who built a house on earth without a brother or a sister, and at once it fell, and the roof was broken down.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ahu'ra atarukukora, nasisana nkomuntu ayayombekere enju ha itaka nambere omuganda gutali, kandi omugenzi gukagitera; ahonaho yagwa; nokugwa kwenju egi kukaba kuli kwingi.

english: But the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! All of you are tax collectors and all of you are tax collectors and sinners! On the Sabbath you will bring them to draw water for them.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yamugarukamu nagamba ati Inywe abagobya, inywena timusibu'ra omuntu wena enimiye, rundi enkainaye, ha kior kya Sabiti, numugitwara okugyesera amaizi?

english: It is not easy to do this, but it is by means of an angel of light.
lunyoro: Kandi tigali mahano; baitu nauwe ayefora maraika womusana.

english: So then, let the man of God not be destroyed by everything, and let him have all the good things entrusted to him.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wa Ruhanga aleke okuburwaho na kake, abe na byona ebyegomberwa ekirungi kyona.

english: But the Lord said to him, ‘Go away, for this is what will be more difficult for me to bear my name before the Gentiles, kings, and people of Israel.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yamugambira ati Genda: baitu ogu kibindi ekikomemu namberendi, okutwara ibara ryange omu maiso Gabamahanga nabakama nabana Baisaleri:

english: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law rejected God's teaching, and they did not get baptized.
lunyoro: bafalisayo nabegesa bebiragiro bakeyangira bonka okuhanura kwa Ruhanga, nibo batarabatizibwe uwe.

english: A man named Simeon was in Jerusalem, and the man was righteous and humble and waiting for the consolation of Israel. The Holy Spirit was on him.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, hakaba hali omu Yerusalemu omuntu ibararye Simeoni; kandi omuntu ogu akabali ahikirire, omwekengi, nategereza okuhumuzibwa kwa Isaleri: kandi Omwoyo Ogurukwera akaba aikale haruwe.

english: For we know this, that our holy servant has been made, in union with Christ, to put away the sin of the world, and so that we may not be put right with sin.
lunyoro: baitu tumanyire kinu ngu omuntu waitu owaira akabambibwa hamu nauwe okumaraho omubiri ogwekibi, naitwe tuleke okutungwaga ekibi;

english: Do not be afraid, but be on your guard against those who are caught in the trap of faith and of the firm hope.
lunyoro: mutaturumuka, baitu mukuratirege omulingo gwabo abagwetwa emirago obwokuikiriza nokuguma.

english: Those who forgive sins will be forgiven, and those who forgive sins will be forgiven.
lunyoro: Abo abamuliihaho ebibi, bibaihwaho; nabo abamulibohera ebibi bibaboherwa.

english: He left for Athens, where he went to Corinth.
lunyoro: HANYUMA yebi yaruga Asene, yahika Kolinso.

english: Jesus said to them, “I am telling you the truth: unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in yourselves.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Mali mali nimbagambira nti Obutarya mubiri gwa Mwana womuntu numunywa esagamaye, timuyina bwomezi omulinywe.

english: A father will be divided against his son, against his father, against his mother, against his daughter, against his mother, against his son, and against his mother-in-law.
lunyoro: Baitu alibaganizibwamu ise nomwanawe, nomuisiki na nyina; nyina nomuisikiwe, na mukomwana na nyinazara.

english: The woman died. Which one of the seven will you be when you get up?
lunyoro: mu kuhumbuka aliba mukoha hali abo musanju? Nukwo, omukazi yafa.

english: As we told you before, so I am telling you now that anyone will tell you the Good News about the Good News that you believe.
lunyoro: Nkokutwagambire kara, nukwo ngarukire hati bunu okugamba nti rundi omuntu wena obwalibatebeza enjiri eteri nkeyimwaikirize akyenwe.

english: For in great distress and anguish I write to you with many tears, not because you are sad, but because you know that you love me more than you love me.
lunyoro: Baitu omu muhito mwingi nokurumwa omutima ndabahandikira namaizi maingi omu maiso; tibuli obwokubatuntuza, baitu mumanye okugonza okunyinakwo halinywe okurukukira muno.

english: The scripture says in heaven, “The King of the Jews.”
lunyoro: Ha iguru hahandikirwe ngu OMUKAMA WABAYUDAYA.

english: When he heard about the raising of the dead, some of them started to cry, but others said, “We will hear you about this again!”
lunyoro: Kandi obubahulire ha kuhumbuka kwabafu, abamu baseka; baitu abandi bagamba ngu Tulikuhu'ra obundi obwekigambo eki.

english: They all grabbed the head of the synagogue and beat him before the crowd. But Gallio did not pay attention to these things at all.
lunyoro: Kandi bona bakwata Omukuru wisoro'kaniro, bamutera omu maiso gekitebe ekicwerwaho emisango. Kandi Galio atabiteho omutima ebigambo ebi nekimu.

english: I stand up to them and say, ‘I am being tried by you today because of the resurrection of the dead.’
lunyoro: Gambire haiguru nyemerire halibo nti Obwokuhumbuka okwabafu nincwerwa omusango omu maiso ganyu ha kiro kinu.

english: waiting does not bring shame, but God's will is poured out into our hearts by the power of the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.
lunyoro: kandi okunihira tikurukukwasa ensoni: baitu okugonza kwa Ruhanga kuseserwe omu mitima yaitu Habwomwoyo Ogurukwera outwahairwe.

english: For the love of God and of the love of the one man, Jesus Christ, has been poured out into the hearts of many, even though they have died by the same sin.
lunyoro: baitu abaingi obubaraba bafire obwokusisa kwomu, ekisembo kyembabazi kikasaga muno, nkomwenda gwembabazi okwomu, nuwe Yesu Kristo;

english: I am the one who was eager to teach you what you did not do. Others have done the work, and you have shared in their work.
lunyoro: nyowe nkabantuma okugesa ekimutarakolire mirimo: abandi bakakora emirimo, nainyowe mutahire omu mirimo yabu.

english: They are talking with the power of fire, they are fighting with greater power than the darkness, and they are fighting with greater power than the nations.
lunyoro: nibagamba amani gomu'ro, nibakira obwogi bwempirima, nibatunga amani okuruga omu bugara, nibasinga amahe gabamahanga.

english: In every way we have brought glory to ourselves by the patience, by the patience, and by our endurance, and by our hope in God.
lunyoro: nukwo omu byona twenyumizege itwenka, omu kugumisiriza kwingi, nomu kwetegereza okutunyumire hali Ruhanga,

english: We know and believe that we love God, because he also loves us and lives in union with him.
lunyoro: Kandi tumanyire, kandi tukaikiriza okugonza Ruhanga okwayina omulitwe. Ruhanga nukwo kugonza; nauwe anyakuikara omu Ruhanga naikara omuruwe.

english: He has also revealed his love for you by means of the Spirit.
lunyoro: kandi ayatumanyisize okugonza kwanyu omu Mwoyo.

english: In order to bring into being the righteousness of God by means of the work of the service of the apostles, to make up the body of Christ.
lunyoro: habwokuhikiriza emirimo yokuhereza, okwombeka omubiri gwa Kristo:

english: and they praised God in me.
lunyoro: kandi bakugiza Ruhanga omuli nyowe.

english: We are Jews by birth, not by birth
lunyoro: Itwe abali Abayudaya omu kuzarwa, okutaruga omu Bamahanga

english: What, then, will it be? I will be glad, then, that Christ is revealed in every way, whether by means of deceit or by truth.
lunyoro: Nukwo kiki? Baitu omu miringo yona, rundi omu kugobya, runda omu mazima, Kristo atebezebwa; kandi nsemererirwe eki, ego ndisemererwa.

english: While Paul was waiting for Athens, his heart was filled with pity for him, and he saw the city full of idols.
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro obwakaba nabategereza Asene, omutimagwe tukamusa'ra, obuyaboine orubuga ruijuire ebisisani.

english: The people there heard him say, “We have heard him speak blasphemy against Moses and against God.”
lunyoro: Bamuculeza abantu abagambire ngu Tukamuhu'ra nagamba ebigambo ebyokujuma Musa na Ruhanga.

english: There is someone else who tells me what I am talking about, and I know that what I am talking about is true.
lunyoro: Thereho ondi angambaho ebyange, kandi 'manyire nti ebyange ebyangambaho bya mananu.

english: I heard a voice saying, “Get up, Peter! Get up and eat!”
lunyoro: Kandi nahu'ra iraka nirigamba liti Imuka Petero; ita orye.

english: Everyone who swears by the Temple, swears by it, and by the one who sits at the same time.
lunyoro: Nauwe anyakurahira yekaru, buli arahire egi, nogu arukwikara omu.

english: The parents were amazed, but Jesus did not tell them what had happened.
lunyoro: Kandi abamuzaire bahuni'ra: baitu uwe yabatere'ra batagambiraho muntu ebibaireho.

english: But if a person is to eat that bread, he must himself drink that wine.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu ayerengege wenka, nukwo arye ati hamigati ogu, kandi anywe ati hampwahwa egi.

english: In the same way, when we were young, we were slaves of the world.
lunyoro: nukwo naitwe obutukaba tuli bato, twalemwaga nkabairu rubale ebyokubanza byomunsi:

english: We, my friends, are children of the promise, just as Isaac was.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe, bene baitu, tuli bana bomurago, nka Isaka.

english: In this way the children of God and the children of the Devil are put right with God. Those who do not do what is right are not of God, nor of those who do not love their fellow man.
lunyoro: Ha kinu abana ba Ruhanga balekirwe, kandi na bana ba Setani: wena atarukora ebyokuhiki'ra tali wa Ruhanga, nobwakuba ogu atarukugonza mugenziwe.

english: It was given to the power of the image of the beast to continue speaking, and to the image of the beast everyone did not worship.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahabwa okuhaisa okuikya orwoya ekisisani kyekisoro, kigambe, kandi kiise bona bataramya ekisani kyekintu.

english: While he was saying this, a cloud came and filled them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba nagamba ebi, ekicu kyaija nikibasikiriza; obubatahire omu kicu batina.

english: Jesus came and found them asleep. “Simon,” he said to Peter, “doesn't it? You haven't been able to watch one hour?”
lunyoro: Yataha, yabasanga bagwihagire, yagambira Petero ati Simoni, Ogwijagire? Obaire otanyina amani kurora nesaha emu?

english: They spat on the dragon, but the beast had his power over him. They worshiped the beast and asked, “Who is able to fight against it?”
lunyoro: baramya ekijoka, baitu kikahika ekisoro obusobozi bwakyo; kandi baramya ekisoro nibagamba ngu Noha asobora okurwana nakyo?

english: So then, when we see that some people are sitting in the same way, and some people who have been first told the good news will come in because of the disobedience of the others.
lunyoro: Nukwo obutuboine ngu kiikaire kiti abamu okutahamu, kandi abo ababandize okutebezebwa ebigambo ebirungi, batahamu obwokutahu'ra,

english: “Yes,” they answered, “we will go back to those who sent us.”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Niwaho? Itwe tubagarukemu abatutumire.

english: He will tear down his own house and open to his children the gates of all kinds of evil.
lunyoro: Ayasesa enjuye wenka, ahuliza abanabe hali okutahikira kwona.

english: I answered, “It is not Roman custom to pay taxes to anyone who has been set free and has not yet been put right with God and has not seen the need to pay taxes for what they have done to him.”
lunyoro: Nabagarukamu nti Teri engeso ya Barumi okuhayo omuntu wena anyakulegerwe atakabaire omu maiso gabarukumulega, kandi atakaboine kasumi kokwetongani'ramu obwebigambo ebibamulega.

english: For I know that you have been the judge of this people for many years, and I will defend you with a clear conscience.
lunyoro: Baitu manyire okuruga emyaka mingi iwe okacwa emisango yihanga linu, nikyo ndukwetongai'ra nyenka nomutima ogugumire:

english: He believed. Then the evil spirits went out and entered the pigs. The herd rushed down the cliff into the lake, about two thousand men.
lunyoro: Ahonaho emizimu emibi yarugamu, netaha omu mpunu: igana ryajumutuka nirisirimuka omukihanga, nirirtaha omu nyanja, zikaba ziri nkenkumi ibiri

english: Then he took the book out of the angel's hand and ate it up. He looked up at me like a dove, because it was after he had broken off my ear.
lunyoro: Obuyahairwe akatabu omu mukono gwa maraika nakamira; kandi kanulira omu kanwa kange nkobwoki bwenjoki: baitu obunamazire okukamira enda yange yasa'ra.

english: It happened that when the sun was setting, all the sick people who had diseases and diseases brought them to Jesus, and he placed his hands on them all, and healed them all.
lunyoro: Orwebagyo izoba obulikaba nirigwa abo bona abakaba banyina abarwaire, endwara ezindi nezindi babaleta namberali; yabataho emikono bona bona bona, nabakiza.

english: Zebulun and Naphtali, the words that Isaiah the prophet had spoken came true:
lunyoro: Zaburoni na Nafutali; ekigambo kihiki'le ekyagambirwe nabi Isaya ati,

english: In order that I may be the Messiah, and that I may be the one through whom I have no right to the Law, but that I may have a righteousness which comes from God through faith.
lunyoro: nukwo nzoke Kristo, ntanyina okuhiki'ra kwange nyenka okwebiragiro, baitu oku okuli omu kuikiriza, nukwo kuhiki'ra okurunga hali Ruhanga obwokuikiriza:

english: Solomon was the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz was the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed was the father of Jesse.
lunyoro: Sarumoni akazara Boazi omu Rahabu; Boazi akazara Obeda omu Rusi; Obeda akazara Yese;

english: neither Herod nor Herod, for he was the one who sent him back to us, and he did not deserve to have anything to kill him.
lunyoro: nangwa, nobwakuba Herode: baitu uwe amugaruirehoga hali itwe; kandi dora, takozire kintu ekisemerire okumuisa.

english: Jesus said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery; and whoever marries another commits adultery against her commits adultery against her.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Omuntu wena wena alibinga mukaziwe, naswera ondi, buli asihaine okumusisa; nauwe wenka obwaryanga iba,

english: Don't you know that those who are joined to idols belong to the same body? For he says, 'The two will become one body.'
lunyoro: Kandi timumanyire ngu Anyakuteranizibwa nomusihani nugwo mubiri gumu? Baitu agamba ati Bombi baliba mubiri gumu.

english: But if you do not obey God's commands, you will not obey them, because you do not fear God.
lunyoro: baitu iwe obwotalikiriza ebiragiro bya Ruhanga torukukora, baitu nikyo kyokutaho okutina Ruhanga.

english: I have said that we are wise and think that it is better for us not to be in the body but to be in the Lord.
lunyoro: kandi ngambire nti tunyina obumanzi, tutekerize ngu nikyo kirukukira oburungi okutaba omu mubiri, baitu okubaho hali Mukama waitu.

english: If anyone is hungry, let him eat at home; so that you will not judge. And the rest will be glad when I come.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaba arumirwe enjara, aryege omukaye: nukwo muleke okwesoroleza omusango. Kandi ebindi ebisigaireho ndibisemeza obunsikaija.

english: But Jesus said, “What human beings cannot do is for God.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ati Ebi ebitarukusoboka omu bantu, nibisoboka hali Ruhanga.

english: But when Peter arrived in Antioch, I met him face-to-face, because he had been judged.
lunyoro: Baitu Kefa obuyaizire Antyokiya nkamutanga omu maisoge, baitu akaba agwerirwe omusango.

english: In the same way, I tell you, now that you are ready to begin not only to do but also to do what you want to do.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo, ncwire nti, baitu kinu kibasemerire inywe abamazire omwaka gumu numubanza okutandika, okutakora kwonka baitu okukora numugonza.

english: Be kind to one another, compassionate, and freely forgive one another, just as God through Christ freely forgave you.
lunyoro: kandi mukoranganege kurungi inywenka nemitima yembabazi, numuganyirangana, kandi nka Ruhanga omu Kristo okuyaganyire inywe

english: You were running well. Who appointed you to see the truth?
lunyoro: Mukaba numuiruka kurungi; noha yabatangire okutorobera amazima?

english: But when evening came, Jesus stood still, because the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu obubukaba nubukya, Yesu yayeme'ra ha musa: baitu abegeswa batamanye nuwe Yesu.

english: Mary said, “Look! I am the descendant of the Lord, just as the angel had told me.” The angel left her.
lunyoro: Maryamu yagamba ati Dora nyowe, omuzana wa Mukama; kibe hali nyowe nkokwogambire. Kandi maraika yaruga namberali.

english: They said to themselves, “If we say, ‘From where did you not believe in him?’
lunyoro: Bakaguzangana bonka, nibagamba ngu Obuturaba ntugamba ngu Kukaruga omu ekibatangire okumuikiriza?

english: You will meet with him at a time when he is not ready, just as a thief goes and knocks on the door of your house, and you will see him.
lunyoro: We ndora omu saha etarukubali'rwaho, nkanyakusisismuka omu kisisimuka, kandi nkanyakusemererwa omu kasumi akokuro'raho.

english: But a woman who is a sinner is waiting for God, and she is eager to pray and pray day and night.
lunyoro: Kandi omufakati mali kandi anyakulekerwe anihira Ruhanga, kandi ayekamba omu kwesengereza nokusaba ekiro na nyamusana.

english: Do you know that those who work in the Temple and eat the bread from the altar will also be persecuted?
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu abarukukora emirimo eyemu yekaru, barya ha byomu yekaru? Nabo abahereza ekyoto babagana nekyoto?

english: For I am ready today to be an angel of God, who will give me whatever I need.
lunyoro: Baitu hayemerirege namberendi ekiro kinu maraika wa Ruhanga, arukukutunga kandi oumpereza.

english: That is why we were encouraged, and we were filled with joy by the joy that Titus gave us, because his heart was made firm in you all.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyatuhumuize: kandi omu kuhumuzibwa kwaitu tukakira muno okusemererwa, okwokusemererwa kwa Tito, baitu omutimagwe gukagumibwa inywe inywena.

english: Do not go along the paths of the nations, nor go into any town.
lunyoro: Mutaligenda omu mihanda eyabamahanga, nobukwakuba okutaha omu rubuga rwona

english: For you tolerate fools with joy, but you are wise.
lunyoro: Baitu numugumisiriza abadomadoma nokusemererwa, baitu inywe muli bamagezi.

english: God, who raised his Son from death, sent him to bless you and to turn you all from your sins.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe Ruhanga, obuyamazire okuhumbura Omwanawe, yamutuma okubaha omugisa, nabahindura inywena okuruga omu bibi byanyu.

english: For the people of Macedonia and Achaia were happy to have some of the holy ones in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu Abanyamakedoni Nabanyakaya bakasemerererwa okusoroleza ebintu abamasege abomu barukwera abanyakuli Yerusalemu.

english: Jesus rebuked him, and the spirit came out of him, and the spirit came out of him that day.
lunyoro: Yesua yamutanga; omuzimu gwamurugaho: omwojo akaira okuruga omu kasumi ako.

english: There will be great earthquakes that have not yet taken place on the Sabbath, and in those days there will be no more famine.
lunyoro: hobwoku halibaho omihito omwingi ogutakabahoga ensi ekaba kubaho nokuhikya hati, kandi tigulibaho obwokabiri.

english: It was better for us to join one another in sending greetings to the people and send them to you, together with the believers who love us, for Barnabas and Paul.
lunyoro: kikaba kisemeri omu maiso gaitu obutwateraine nomutima gumu, okukomamu abantu, nokubatuma namberemuli, hamu nabarukugonzebwa baitu Baranaba na Pauro,

english: They said, “We have not been given the right to speak about you from Judea, so that none of the believers who came here and told us or to tell us of the wrong things that happened to us.”
lunyoro: kandi ba mugambira ngu itwe titukahebwaga baruha ezebigambo byawe okuraga Buyadaya, kunu busaho hali bene baitu ayaizire hanu natutebeza, nobukwakuba okutugambira ekigambo ekibi

english: Or if he has planted branches that cannot bear, and cannot bear fruit, all who follow him will receive him first.
lunyoro: Rundi obwaliba amazire okusimba emiganda, atarukusobora kurumara, bona abasunga balibanza

english: There was a man who was sitting in front of the tomb in Mt.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho omusaija omu aikalire ha musa omu maiso gekituro.

english: The believers had sent him, saying, “Look! The one who loves the one who is sick is sick!”
lunyoro: Benebabu bamutumira, nibagamba ngu Dora,oworukugonza arwaire.

english: My mother has many things to say and condemn, but the one who sent me is truthful; and I have told the world what I have heard from him.
lunyoro: Nyina bingi ebyokubagambaho nokubacwera omusango: baitu ogu ayantumire nuwe wa mananu; nanyowe ebinahulire hali nibyo ngambire ensi.

english: Festus answered, “Paul was waiting for Caesarea, and he himself had the chance to go ahead of him.”
lunyoro: Baitu Fesita yagarukamu ati Pauro akalindirwa Kaisaliya, nauwe wenka akaba na'sana okugendayo mpora.

english: But Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? I have done a good thing.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Nimutuntuliza ki omukazi? Baitu ankozire ekigambo ekisemire.

english: and began to rebuke everyone, both young and old, and to say, “This man is the power of God, who is called great.”
lunyoro: ari bona, okuruga ha muto nokuhika ha mukuru, nibagamba ngu Omuntu onu nigo mani ga Ruhanga agarukwetwa Amaingi,

english: But you said, ‘I am rich, and I have gained riches, but I have nothing.’ But you did not know that you were miserable, blind, and blind.
lunyoro: Baitu ogambire ngu Ndi muguda, kandi ntungire bingi, kunu tindoho ekindukusega; kandi tomanyire ngu oli munaku, kandi wobujune, kandi wamasege, kandi omufu wamaiso, kandi oli kwonka:

english: And I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Kandi nimbagambira nti Nikirahuka engamira okuraba omu kanyindo kenkinzo, okukira omuguda okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: Jesus answered them, “Why do you also disobey the Law of God by the standards you have been given?”
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati nainywe kiki ekibasisissa ekiragiro ekya Ruhanga obwengeso ezimwahairwe?

english: You know that while you were among the Gentiles, you were handed over to idols which you did not speak, just as you were handed over to them everywhere.
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu Obumukaba muli Bamahanga, mwahabiraga hali ebisisani ebitarukugamba, nkokumwahabiraga hona.

english: But I am telling you, my friends, that the Good News that I preached is not for human beings.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbamanyisa, bene baitu,enjiri eyinatebize nti terinkeyomuntu.

english: But they were terrified and began to rebuke themselves and to rebuke Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu bakagwa iraro, nibahanura bonka okubaramuhwerekereza.

english: Jesus said to him, “Your brother will rise from death.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Munyanyako nagenda oku humbuka.

english: And not only so, but we ourselves will be saved, because we have seen the hope of salvation.
lunyoro: Kandi tikuli nukwo kwonka, baitu twenyumizege nomu bujune, nukwo tuikalege nobusinge:

english: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and did not come on my own authority, but he sent me.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Kakuba Ruhanga ali isinywe mwakugondeze nyowe; baitu nkaruga hali Ruhanga ninyija; kandi ntaije habwange nyenka, baitu ogu nuwe yantumire.

english: For from inside, from inside, out of the hearts of people, evil thoughts spring up.
lunyoro: Baitu omunda omu mitima yabantu nuho harugamu ebitekerezo ebibihire,

english: There is no fear in love, but love covers over fear, because fear is a sign of weakness. And those who are afraid do not believe in love.
lunyoro: Habaho okutina omu kugonza, baitu okugonza okuhikire kubingira aheru okutina, baitu okutina kuyina okubonabonesebwa; kandi anyakutina tahikirizibwe omu kugonzangana.

english: Which one of you, then, will have a hundred sheep left behind, and will not leave one ninety-nine in the desert and follow the lost one until you find it?
lunyoro: "Rundi muntu ki omulinywe anyakuina entama kikumi, obwaraba abuzirweho emu, atasiga ziri ekyenda mu mumwenda omu irungu, nakuratira eri enyakubuzire okuhikya obwaligizora?

english: Keep your senses completely, be on your guard, and let your progress be made known to all.
lunyoro: Hijura ebi byona; oikalege omuli ebi; okuhingurana kwawe kwolekwekwege hali bona.

english: They brought him to Jesus, and when he saw him, the spirit came down and began to drive him out.
lunyoro: Bamuleta namberali: kandi obuyamuboine, ahonaho omuzimu gwamutagura muno: yagwa hansi, nayekulingura,

english: I am coming from God, and I am sending you a new covenant, not a letter, but a letter from the Spirit. The letter is a letter that gives life.
lunyoro: kandi nikyo kiragano ekihyaka ekiruga hali nyowe.Tebi omu nyuguta, baitu omu Mwoyo: baitu enyuguta niziha obwomezi.

english: And now you will be sad, and I will see you again, and your hearts will be filled with joy, and no one will make you sad.
lunyoro: Kandi nainywe hati bunu muyina obujune: kandi ndigaruka okubarora, nemitima yanyu erisemererwa, kandi okusemererwa kwanyu, busaho muntu alikubaka.

english: If any of these things are shameful, immoral, and filthy, they are not good for you. Instead, be on your guard against them.
lunyoro: nobubyakuba ebyensoni nebigambo ebyobutami, nobubakuba ebyokuseka ebitali birungi, baitu hakire musimege.

english: But bring those enemies of mine who did not want me to be a burden, and bring them here and kill them before me.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abanyanzigwa bange, abatarayenzire nyowe okubalema, mubaleta hanu, mubaitire omu maiso gange.

english: When the believers arrived in Caesarea, they handed him over to the Roman governor and sent him a prisoner.
lunyoro: kandi abo obubahikire Kaisaliya, bamuha omulemi ebaruha, kandi bamurangira Pauro.

english: The chief priests and the elders made fun of him and put him to death by hanging him on a cross.
lunyoro: banyakatagara abakuru nabakuru nukwo bamuterire enaku, nibamubamba ha muti.

english: We sailed aboard the ship of Adramyttius, who was about to sail to the other side of the lake in Asia. We left, and Aristarchus was with us, a Macedonian from Thessalonica.
lunyoro: Kandi twagwe'ra omu kyombo ekya Aduramutio, ekikaba kimalize okugenda hali ebiikaro ebiri Asiya ha nyanja, twarugayo, na Alisitako akaba ali hamu naitwe, Omunyamakedoni owomu Sesaronika.

english: For I see that he has many things to do for you, including Laodicea and Hierapolis.
lunyoro: Baitu ndi kaisowe nti ayina emirimo mingi habwanyu, nabomu raodikiya, Nabomu Hierapoli.

english: I persecuted them many times in all the synagogues and led them to the cities of the Gentiles.
lunyoro: Kandi obunabonabonesaga emirundi mingi omu maso'rokaniro gona, nabahambirizaga okuhika omu mbuga zabanyaihanga.

english: He must be taken to heaven, and to the rest of the creation of the world, just as God had promised through his holy prophets.
lunyoro: kandi kimuhikirire okutwarwa omu iguru okuhikya ebiro ebyokuga'raho byona, Ruhanga ebiyagambireho omu kanwa kabanabibe abarukwera, abakaba baroho ensi ekaba okubaho.

english: After the uproar had subsided, Paul called the disciples together and told them to leave and go to Macedonia.
lunyoro: Aho obuimukirize okuimuki'ra, Pauro yayeta abegeswa yabekambisa, yabaraga yarugayo okugenda Makedoni.

english: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moths.

english: Why do we also stand in danger every day?
lunyoro: Kandi naitwe ntuika'ra ki omu kabi ebiro byona?

english: For it is not right to take revenge on anyone who does not repent, but to take revenge on those who do not.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhora enzigu tikurukuhanwa omuntu wena atarukwegarukamu, baitu okukora enzigu kurukuganyira omuntu ogu atarukuhinduka.

english: There were shepherds sitting in the field, waiting for their flocks by night.
lunyoro: Kandi omusni egi hakaba harumu abalisa abaikaire omu bwe'le nibalinda igana ryabu ekiro.

english: For those who want riches will be given away by the power of the evil one and by the desires of the wicked one, to put people to death and to be put to death.
lunyoro: baitu abanyakugonza okutunga itungo bagwa omu kwohebwa nendubatira nokwegomba kwingi okwobutami okwakabi okurukusisa, okuibika abantu omu kubura nokuhwereke'ra.

english: And my God will finish his work, just as he has promised in the glory of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga wange alihikiriza byona ebyokora, nkobugudabwe okubuli omu kitinisa omu Kristo Yesu.

english: Repent, then, and turn from your sins and pray to the Lord, or you will be filled with the thought of your heart.
lunyoro: Nukwo oyegarukemu obubi bwawe obu, osabe Mukama waitu rundi oliganyirwa obwekitekerezo ekyomu mutima gwawe.

english: But they insisted more strongly that he was teaching people and teaching all over Judea and that he was going to Galilee to this very day.
lunyoro: Baitu bagarukira muno okugamba ngu Ayemeseze abantu, nayegesa omu Buyudaya bwona, akabandiza Galiraya okuhika na hanu.

english: Even though he had performed many miracles in their presence, they did not believe in him.
lunyoro: Baitu nobwaraba yakozire obwokuro'raho bwingi obuingaine aho omu maiso gabu, batamuikirize:

english: When the Sabbath came, Jesus began to teach in the synagogue. Many people were amazed and asked, “Where did this man get these things? What wisdom has he received? With what similar miracles he performed in his hands!”
lunyoro: Kandi sabiti obuyahikire, yabanza okwegesa omu iso'rokaniro: abaingi obubamuhulire bahuni'ra, nibagamba ngu Onu akaiha nkaha ebigambo ebi? kandi ngu Magezi ki ganu onu agayahairwe? Nebyamani ebirukuingana aho ebikozirwe omu mikonoye?

english: I will pour out my Spirit on them and they will speak.
lunyoro: ndibasesera ha Mwoyo gwange, baliragura.

english: Do not let one of these men go with you, as some of them have told you, but let us go on walking on on our own feet, and then we will go on growing in numbers, just as you saw the day drawing near.
lunyoro: tukutaliterana hamu omu kigambo kyona, nkabamu okubali; baitu ntugambi'rangana itwenka, kandi okweyongera tweyongere tuti nkokumurora ekiro kiri haihi nokuhika.

english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent him to the Jewish elders and asked him to come and save his servant.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyahulire ha Yesu, yamutumira abakuru Babayudaya, namusaba okuija okujuna omuiruwe rubale.

english: Near that place was the island of Publius, the island of Publius, who has been with us for three days and a half.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho haihi nekiikaro eki engonjo ezomuntu omukuru wizinga, ibararye Pubulio; ogu akatuiriza haihi, naturanira ebiro bisatu nemitano.

english: They called out and asked, “Simon, whose name is Peter, he is the one he has chosen!”
lunyoro: babeta nibakaguza rundi Simoni, ibararye eryakabiri Petero, agonyere omu.

english: “Sir,” he said, “did you come here and put on your cloak and don't have the party clothes?” He cried.
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Mutahi wange, otahire ota hanu otanyina kyokujwara ekyobugenyi? Yaculera kwonka.

english: If God wanted to withdraw his curse from those who are under his curse, as he has promised, he would put them in the middle of the cloud.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga obwakaba nayenda okwokekera kimu hali abagwetwa abomurago okuhanurakwe nkokwasimaire, nukwo yataireho hagati ekirahiro:

english: The crowd was large among them, and the judges put on their cloaks and ordered them to be crucified.
lunyoro: Kandi ekitebe kikabaimuki'ra ahamu:kandi abacwi bemisango batemu'ra ebyokujwara byabu, nibaragira okubatera nemiigo.

english: There he found a man named Aeneas who had been dead for eight years, because he was still alive.
lunyoro: Hazo yasanga omuntu omu, ibararye Ainea, ayamazire ha kitabukye emyaka munana; baitu akaba azingamire.

english: The parts of the body which seem to be weaker are the parts which are more important to us, which are more important than the parts which are not good.
lunyoro: Kandi ebicweka ebyomubiri ebirukutekerezebwa okukira obugara, nibyo tutaho ekitinisa ekingi: nebicweka byaitu ebitali birungi, nibyo bikira okuba noburungi:

english: Peter remembered what Jesus had said: “Before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me.” So he went out and wept bitterly.
lunyoro: Petero yaijuka ekigambo Yesu ekiyagambire ati Enkoko eraba etakakokere emirundi esatu. Yaturuka eheru, na'ra muno.

english: And God will not answer his servants, who cry out to him day and night, and he will be patient with them all.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga taliramu'ra bakomebe, abamwami'ra anyamusana nekiro, kandi abagumisiriza muno?

english: If a wise man has his weapons and keeps his own bread, then his belongings will be safe.
lunyoro: Omusaija owemanzi obwayina ebyokurwanisabye nalinda ezigatiye wenka, ebintubye nubwo biikaraho nobusinge:

english: Jesus said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was sitting, and they stayed with him that night. It was about ten o'clock in the morning.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Muije murarorayo. Baija barora nambere yaraire; baikara nauwe ekiro eki: obuire bukaba buli nkesaha ya ikumi.

english: The other one fell on good ground, and he bore children, and he grew up to be a hundred and thirty and sixty.
lunyoro: ndi yagwa ha itaka erisemire, yayana ebyana; nibikura, nibikanya; yayana ekouhikya kikumi, kandi amakumi asatu, kandi enkaga, kandi endi.

english: For God, by means of his own will, gives glory to us, because we were still sinners, and Christ died for us.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nanyumisizisa okugonzakwe wenka halitwe, baitu obutukaba tukyali abasisi, Kristo akutufera:

english: Jesus cried out in a loud voice, and it was his spirit.
lunyoro: Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto, nahayo omwoyogwe.

english: Then Jesus sent two of his disciples out to meet him and said to them, “Put them in the city and meet the man who has been filled with the water.
lunyoro: Yatuma babiri hali abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mutahe omu rubuga, nuho muratangana omusaija ayetwekere omunaga gwamaizi:

english: For Christ did not send you to be baptized, but to preach the Good News. For Christ's sake, not in the wisdom of words, will not be destroyed.
lunyoro: Baitu Kristo atantume okubatiza, baitu okutebeza enjiri: hatali omu magezi gebigambo, omuti gwa Kristo gutaburaganizibwa.

english: But he built that city, which belongs to God's people, which is the same as the one who built it.
lunyoro: baitu akanihira orubuga oru orunyakuyina emiganda Ruhanga oruyarangaine narwombeka.

english: They have the same kind of fear that God has, but they have rejected its power. And they are the ones who put their feet in the stocks.
lunyoro: buyina okusisana nkokutina Ruhanga, baitu amani gakwo bagehakaine: kandi nibo balibata ebigere byabu omu nkomo.

english: And I tell you that whoever receives me before men, the Son of Man will also receive him into the presence of the angels of God.
lunyoro: Kandi nimbagambira nti Wena alinyikiriza omu maiso gabantu, nuwe Omwana womuntu aliikiriza omu Maiso gabamaraika ba Ruhanga:

english: But they made fun of him and begged him to touch a tree, and their cry for help went out.
lunyoro: Baitu barahuka namaraka amahango nibasaba okumubamba ha muti; namaraka gabu gasingura.

english: When Jesus saw what was going on in their hearts, he took the child and said to them,
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu obuyaboine empaka ezomu mitima yabu, yakwata omwana omuto,

english: Have we ever seen you a stranger or naked?
lunyoro: Roho tukakuroradi omunyaihanga, ntu ku gonyesa? rundi oli busa ntukujweka?

english: The foreigners did not welcome us, because they kindled a fire in all around us by the power of the storm and the waves.
lunyoro: Nabanyaihanga bakatukora embabazi ezitali zabantu bona: baitu bakahemba omu'ro batuiriza haihi itwena, obwenjura eyagwire, nobwembeho.

english: He has sent me to you for this reason, so that you will know my words and know that he has sent me to you.
lunyoro: yantumire namberemuli obwekigambo kinu, nukwo mumanye ebigambo byange, kandi ahumuze emituma yanyu.

english: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate them one from another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
lunyoro: namahanga goona galisorozebwa omu maisoge; nauwe alibacwanganizamu, nko mulisa okwa cwanganiza entaama ne mbura buzi;

english: But they shook off the dust off their feet and came to Iconium.
lunyoro: Baitu abo bakabakunkumu'ra ecucu eyomu bigere byabu, baija Ikonio.

english: He was sitting there, as if it were a jasper stone and a jasper stone, clear as crystal, clear as crystal, clear as crystal, clear as crystal.
lunyoro: kandi ogu akaba aikalire nasisana nkibale erya yasepi nerya sadio okurorwa: nomuhanganzima gukaba gwehingulirize ekitebe kyobukama.

english: “Go to the village that is ahead of you, and as you go into the town, you will find a colt tied up and untie it. Untie it, and bring it to you.”
lunyoro: mugende omu kika ekibali omu miso: kandi obumurakataha omu, ahonaho murasanga omwana gwenkaina bagusibikire, ogutakatembwahoga muntu: mugusibu're mugulete.

english: The soldiers took him into the house in the place of the commander, who is called the Barthelios, and gathered all the way together.
lunyoro: Soda bamutwara omu nju, erukwetwa Peraitolio; basoroza hamu ekihanda kyona.

english: As many people have done, they have not begun to write a report about these things that has happened to us.
lunyoro: Nkokubakaba bali baingi abatandikire okuhandika amakuru gebigambo ebi ebyahikizibwe omulitwe.

english: But you, and my mother, and I will be glorified by them.
lunyoro: Baitu bawe, nebyawe byange: nanyowe nyumizibwa omubo.

english: Jesus said to them, “It is by the Spirit that David his Lord said,
lunyoro: yagambira ati Nukwo Daudi omu mwoyo akagamba ata Mukamawe, nagamba ati

english: All who believed were together, and each one had everything in common.
lunyoro: Abo bona abaikirize bakaba bali hamu, nibakoba omuntu bintu byabu byona;

english: The angel said to him, “Take your sandals off and put on your sandals.” He did so. “ Take your cloak and follow me,” he said.
lunyoro: Na maraika yamugambira ati Wetege, ojwale enkaito zawe. Yakora ati. Yamugambi'ra ati Jwara ekyokujwara kyawe, onkuratire.

english: Suddenly in the middle of the night there was a cry, “Look! Here is the bridegroom! Come and let us meet him!”
lunyoro: Baitu ekiro omu itumbi haroho obwogo ngu Dora omuswezi naija muturuke okumutangi'ra.

english: But when he speaks to them all, and if he tells them not to believe or understand what he is reading, he will be judged by all, and he will be judged by all.
lunyoro: Baitu bona obubatebeza, kandi omuntu atarukuikiriza rundi atamanyire okusoma obwatahamu, alihanwa bona, kandi alicwerwa bona omusango:

english: They were pleased with him, and said, “These last have worked only one hour, and we have kept watch over the one who is lost in death.”
lunyoro: bahyemera nyineka nibagamba ngu banu abenyuma bakozire esaha emu yonka, nabainganainganiza naitwe abaruhire omuihangwe, nomusana nugutwokya.

english: Jesus said, “Make the people sit down.” There was a great earthquake in that place. The men sat down, numbering into five thousand.
lunyoro: Yesu yagamba ati Mubaikalize hansi abantu. Kandi hakaba haliyo obunyansi bwingi omu kiikaro eki. Abasaija baika'ra hansi, omuhendo gwabu nkenkumi itano.

english: Now there was a man named Ananias and Sapphira, his wife, who sold their property.
lunyoro: Kandi omusaija, ibararye Ananiya, na Safira, mukaziwe, akagura obutakabwe,

english: The Gentiles, and the Jews, and their rulers, did not give thanks to them
lunyoro: Abamahanga Nabayudaya hamu nabalemi babu, obubasesire okubagiza

english: You stretch out your hand to heal, and you will be able to see and understand because of the power of your holy Servant Jesus.
lunyoro: so'le omukono gwawe okukiza; nobwokuro'raho nebyamahano bikorwe habwibara Ryomwana wawe arukwera Yesu.

english: If there is no longer any grace, then there is no longer any work. If there is no longer any grace, then there will be no more grace.
lunyoro: Kandi obukuraba kuli kwembabazi, tikukiri kwemimo: kuba kitalikyo, embabazi tizakubaire embabazi.

english: For there will not be any divisions among you, so that the righteous may be made known to you.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokuhabisa tibirireka okubaho omulinywe, nukwo abasemire bamanyisibwe omulinywenka.

english: He saw a fig tree on the road and found it and found nothing on it, but leaves. “Don't eat it at all times,” he said. At once a fig tree withered away.
lunyoro: Yabona omutini gumu ha muhanda rubaju, yaguhikaho nasanga busaho kintu,rundi amababi masa:yagugambira ati Otaryana byana ebiro nebiro. Ahonaho omutini gwayoma.

english: At that time Judas appeared to be the greatest, and many people became his friends. He was the one who was killed, and all who heard him were scattered over the cliff.
lunyoro: Baitu omubiro bya kara Syuda akaimuka nayegamba okuba mukuru; nabantu baingi bakaterana nauwe: ogu akaitwa; na bona abamuhulire bakararanga nibaburangana.

english: Leave the outer garments that are outside of the Temple, and do not touch them. The holy city will be destroyed for forty-two months.
lunyoro: Ekaha eruguru ya yekaru ogireke aheru, kunu otagirenga; norubuga orurukwera balirulibatira amezi amakumi ana mwabiri.

english: He went everywhere, from house to house, from village to village, to the sick in the streets, and they begged him to do the work of washing the people's feet. And all who had done so were well.
lunyoro: Kandi nambere yagendaga hona, rundi omu bika, runyumaye, omu mbuga zona, babyamisaga abarwaire omu butale, nibamwesengereza bakole kwonka ha mukugiro gwekyokujwarakye: kandi bona abakorahoga bakira.

english: to go back to this place of worship and to the other side of the road, where Judas has committed a crime and has gone to his own place.
lunyoro: agaruke omu kiikaro ekyokuhereza kunu nobukwenda, Yuda ekiyasisire, agende omu kiikarokye wenka.

english: For if the sun were to set on him, as on the sun, it would be on him; and if the sun should rise on him, it would be on him, and the Son of Man would be on his side.
lunyoro: Baitu nkokweri okuruga ha rubaju orwekyambu okukiri, nukwo nukwo kiriba kiti nambereri.

english: Do all you have to do with love.
lunyoro: Ibyo byona mukorwege omu kugonzangana.

english: So God exalted him to a superior position and gave him the name that is above every other name.
lunyoro: Nukwo Ruhanga yamunyumize haiguru muno, kandi akamuha ibara eri erirukukira amabara gona:

english: All the nations whom I have chosen are my own.
lunyoro: Amahanga gona agabanobere ibara ryange,

english: Jesus rebuked them all but did not know this, so he ordered them to give him something to eat.
lunyoro: Yabatere'ra muno omuntu wena atakimanya eki:yaragira okumuha ebyokurya.

english: For they must say, ‘If the Lord wishes, we will live and do this or that.’
lunyoro: Baitu kibahikirire okugamba ngu Mukama waitu obwaligonza tuliba bomezi, kandi tulikora tuti, rundi tuti.

english: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is always thankful, knows that I will not lie to you.
lunyoro: Ruhanga Ise Mukama waitu Yesu, arukusimwa ebiro byona, amanyire tindukubiha.

english: You hold firmly to the word of life, and I am the one who will be glad in Christ's day that I did not lose my faith and did not give up.
lunyoro: kandi mukwatire kimu ekigambo kyobwomezi; nyowe ntunge ekyokwenyumirizaho omu kiro kya kristo ngu ntairukire busa, kunu ntako'le busa.

english: In the same way we all think about ourselves. If you think differently, God will reveal himself to you.
lunyoro: Naitwe itwena omulitekereza tuti: kandi obumuraba numutekereza okundi, nakyo Ruhanga alibasuku'ra:

english: Which of you, then, will dare to tell the one who convinces you that your sins have been forgiven? Or, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
lunyoro: Ekirahuka kiraha, okugambira anyakuzingamira nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho; rundi okugamba nti Imuka oyetweke ekitabu kyawe, ogende?

english: James, the son of Zebedee, and John, the brother of James, and he gave his name to Boanerges, according to the scripture: “Sons of Thunder!
lunyoro: na Yakobo Omwana wa zebedayo, na Yohana, mugenzi wa Yakobo; nabo yabaruka amabara Boanerege, amakuru garyo ngu Bana bokuhinda:

english: Do not be fooled by what is evil, but by what is good.
lunyoro: Otasingwa obubi, baitu singura obubi obwomurungi.

english: So Jesus took him aside, threw him out of the vineyard, and buried him in a tomb that had been dug out of rock before anyone could put it to death.
lunyoro: Yaguhanura, yagukuba omu rugoye orwa bafuta, yamuta omu kituro ekyalimirwe omu mwandara, ekitakatebwamuga muntu.

english: Be on your guard, my friends, that you do not have a wicked heart that does not believe from the living God.
lunyoro: Bene baitu mwerinde, rundi hataba omu muntu wana halinywe omutima omubi ogwokutaikiriza, okuruga ha Ruhanga omwomezi:

english: You know that the process of building your faith brings you endurance.
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu okulengwa kwokuikiriza kwanyu nukuleta okugumisiriza.

english: For the chosen ones, then, will be destroyed.
lunyoro: Baitu habwa abakome, ebiro ebi biricwibwaho.

english: It is written in the book of the prophets that everyone will be taught by God. Everyone who has heard from the Father and has learned will come to me.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu banabi ngu Na bona baryegesebwa Ruhanga. Omuntu wena amazire okuhu'ra hali Isenyowe nayega, aija namberendi.

english: David called him Lord, because he had no son. The crowd was filled with joy.
lunyoro: Daudi wenka amweta Mukamawe; aba ata mwanawe? Kandi ebekitebe bamuhu'raga nokusemererwa

english: The ten horns that you saw and the beast will hate the prostitute and leave her alone. They will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
lunyoro: Namahembe ikumi agoboine nekisoro, abo balinoba omusihani, balimulekesa ali kwonka, balirya enyamaye, balimwokeza kimu nomu'ro.

english: When he came home, he called his friends and his neighbors together and said to them, “How happy you are with me! I have found my sheep which has been lost!”
lunyoro: Kandi obwataha omuka, ayeta enganjanize nabatahibe,nabagambira ati Musemererwe nanyowe, baitu nzoire entama yange abaire ebuzire.

english: Pray that the Master of the harvest will send out workers into his harvest.
lunyoro: Nukwo musabege Omukama wokugesa, atume abakozi omu byokkugesabye.

english: But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fancy clothes? Look! Those who look at the clothes he sees and eat the good food and live in the king's palace.
lunyoro: baitu mukagenderayo ki okurora? Omusaija ajwaire engoye ezirukworoba? Dora abo abajwara engoye ezekiroto, nibarya ebyokurya ebirungi, baikara omu zigati ezabakama.

english: He is a hired hand, and the sheep are no longer.
lunyoro: We ogu anyakuhingura, entama taziroho.

english: God raised him from death on the third day and showed him clearly that he had been raised to life.
lunyoro: Ogu Ruhanga akamuhumbura ha kiro kyakasatu, namwoleka okumanyisibwa,

english: They went into the house and saw the child with Mary his mother, and they greeted him, threw their cloaks over his head, and gave him gifts, gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
lunyoro: Bataha omu nju, barora omwana na Maryamu nyina; bainama nibamuramya baboho'ra ebikwato byabu, bamuha ebisembo, ebya zabu, nenkwasi, nomugaju.

english: The harvest is the world, and the good seed is the children of the Kingdom; the harvest is the harvest of the evil one.
lunyoro: oruharo niyo ensi; nembibo esemire, abo nibo bana bobukama; emberya nibo ba bumubi;

english: He took it and wept before them.
lunyoro: Yakikwata yalira omu maiso gabu.

english: Jesus said to him, “I have been with you many days now, and you did not know me, Philip. Whoever has seen me has seen the Father also. Why do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Nakaba kuikaraho nainywe, ebiro bingi biti, kandi tokamanyaga nyowe Firipo? Anyakundozire nyowe, buli alizire Isenyowe. kiki ekirukugambisa iwe ngu Twoleke Isitwe.

english: For if this first covenant had not been made without an agreement, the second promise would not have been opened.
lunyoro: Baitu ekiragano eki ekyokubanza kuba kitaroho ekyokukunganira, tihakuseruirwe omwanya ogwekyakabiri.

english: What he did for you in our gospel is the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: eki ekiyakozire halinywe omu njiri yaitu, obwokutunga ekitinisa kya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: Lamum was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Solomon.
lunyoro: Ramu akazara Aminadabu; Amidabu akazara Nasoni; Nasoni akazara Sarumoni;

english: For many will be first, and the last will be first.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi abotabanza abaliba abenyuma; nabenyuma abaliba benyuma.

english: But whoever exalts himself will be a share of the Evil One.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakumuramukya buli ateraine omu kutahikira.

english: For everything that God has prepared for us is good, and there is no difference between what is good and what is bad.
lunyoro: Gamba ngu Ekihangirwe kyona ekya Ruhanga kirungi, kunu busaho kyokukiha ekitinisa nobukyakuba ekibi.

english: What do you believe? I will give him to you.” They weighed thirty silver coins.
lunyoro: Nimuikiriza okumpa ki, nanyowe ndamuhayo nambere muli? Bamulengera ebicwaka ebyefeza amakumi asatu.

english: They said to me, ‘You must speak again to many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.’
lunyoro: Kandi bakangambira ngu Kikuhikirire okugaruka okuragura hali abantu, namahanga, nendimi, nabakama baingi.

english: For the great and glorious city has fallen, and many who worship it have died.
lunyoro: baitu oruigi orukoto orwamani runkingukireho, kandi abarukuntanga baingi.

english: I am the least of all the seeds that fell on your head.

english: The blind man said, “What do we hear? Which one of these things will happen to you? Which one of you, then, will tell me exactly the right time?”
lunyoro: Kambanu ngu ebigambo ebi biribaho li? Kandi akokuro'raho karaha akebi obubiri'sana okuija?

english: For I have five brothers, who will be able to see with their eyes, and not come to this great meeting to be heard.
lunyoro: baitu nyina bagenzi bange batano; abe kaiso nambere bali, nabo bataija omu kiikaro kinu ekinyakurumu okuhu'rwa.

english: When we leave him, everyone will believe in him. The Romans will come and take away our country.
lunyoro: Obuturamulekaho tuti, bona baramuikiriza: Abarumi baliija, balituihaho ensi yaitu nihanga ryaitu.

english: For he has set a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by a man whom he has chosen, just as he had promised to believe in him when he raised him from death.
lunyoro: baitu akataho ekiro, ekyalicweramu omusango ogwoburyo ogwensi zona, omu muntu ouyakomeremu; nkokuyahaire bona ekyokuikirizisa, obuyamuhumbuire omu bafu.

english: So he turned around and said to Simon, “Do you have this woman? I have not come into your house and have no water for my feet; but she has washed my feet with her tears and wiped them with the tears, and I have put her under her feet.”
lunyoro: Yayegarukamu nagambira Simoni ati Obine omukazi onu? Ntahirege omu nju yawe, tompaire maizi agebigere byange: baitu ogu anabisize ebigere Byange namaizi agomumaiso, nabisisiriza nisokelye.

english: “Jesus of Nazareth,” he cried out in a loud voice, “What do you want us to do with you? Jesus of Nazareth! Have you come to destroy you? I know that you are the Holy One of God!”
lunyoro: yatabaza ati Mawe, tujunaine ki itwe naiwe, iwe Yesu owa Nazalesi? Oizire okutihwerekereza? Nkumanyire okwoli, niwe arukwera wa Ruhanga.

english: Jesus said to them, “I also will ask you one question, and I will answer you one by one, and I will tell you what this means.
lunyoro: Nauwe yabagambira ati Nanyowe ndabakaguza inywe ekigambo kimu, mungarukemu, nanyowe mbagambire inywe obusobozi okubuli oburukunkoza binu.

english: The angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up, and go on to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to the desert.”
lunyoro: Baitu maraika wa Mukama akagambira Firipo ati Imuka, ogende obukizi obwoburyo okuhika omu muhanda ogusirimuka, okuruga Yerusalemu okuhika Gaza: ogu irungu.

english: You yourselves know that from the very beginning God made his message come true for you. The Gentiles have heard the Good News from my mouth, and they have believed.
lunyoro: Bene baitu, inywe mumanyire ngu okuruga omu biro byaira, Ruhanga akakomamu halinywe, Abamahanga bahu'le omuk kanwa kange ekigambo ekyenjiri, kandi baikirize.

english: The traitor looked straight at him, and he said to them, “You are the one I have chosen; arrest him!”
lunyoro: Ogu akaba namugobeza akabaha akokuro'raho, nabagambira ati Oundanywegera, nuwogu; mumukwate.

english: It is written in the Law, ‘I will speak to these people in strange tongues, but they will not understand me,’ says the Lord.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu biragiro ngu Omu ndimi ezindi nomu minwa yabandi ndigambira abantu banu; kandi tibalimpu'ra, nukwo Mukama agambire ati.

english: The word of the scripture reached the ends of the world.
lunyoro: Iraka ryabyo likahikya ensi ha mpero yensi zabantu bona.

english: But the righteousness that is of righteousness says to you, ‘Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: All who heard it heard him and said in their hearts, “What will this child be?” But the Lord's power stayed with him.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ababihulire bakabyeyahu'ra omu mitima yabu, nibagamba ngu Mara, omwana ogu aliba ki? Baitu omukono gwa Mukama gwaikaraga hamu nauwe.

english: Jesus left them and saw them following, and he said to them, “What do you want?” They answered, “Teacher,” (which means “Teacher”).
lunyoro: Yabarora nibakuratira, yabagambira ati Nimuse'ra ki? banugambira ngu Rabi, ( amakuru gakyo obukimanyisibwa ngu Omwegesa), Orara nkaha?

english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat with him.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who do you think you are?” They knew that he was the Lord.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muije murye. Kandi busaho hali abegeswa ayasoboire okumukaguza ati Niwoha? Bamanyire nuwe Mukama waitu.

english: Peter said to them, “Turn away from your sins, and receive the gift of the Holy Spirit, in the name of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Petero yabagambira ati Mwegarukemu, mu ibara rya Yesu Kristo, okuihwaho ebibi byanyu, kandi mulehebwa ekisembo Ekyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: The servant's servant answered, ‘Sir, I do not want you to go into my house and just say the word, so that my master will do the same.’
lunyoro: Omunyoro owekihanda Omurumi yagarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange, tindukusememe'ra iwe okutaha omunda yorusurwange, baitu gamba ekigambo kyonka, omuiru wange nukwo arakira.

english: The Jews were looking for him at the Passover and asked, “Who is this man?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bamuse'ra ha bugenyi, nibagamba ngu Ogu alinkaha?

english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who stripped him of his cloak, and led him out to death.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Omuntu omu akaba arugire Yerusalemu nasirimuka Yerisko yagwa omu bazinzi abamujuire ebyokujwara, bamutera, barugayo bamusigire na'sana okufa.

english: But Jesus answered, “You will not see all these things. I tell you, there will no longer be a stone here on the stone which will not be thrown down.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Timurukurora binu byona? Mananukwo nimbagambiranti Tiharliikaraho hanu ibale erinyakuli heruguru ha ibale, eri talinagwa hansi.

english: The hand of the Lord has been revealed to whom?
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwa Mukama gukasuku'rwa oha?

english: And I will tell you that you have a great and glorious life for many years. Take your ease and enjoy yourself.
lunyoro: Kandi ndigambira obwomezi bwange nti Obwomezi, oyina itungo lingi ryahuirwe eryokumara emyaka mingi; humura, osemererwe,

english: He will give birth to a son, and you will come to know that Jesus was raised from death. For he will save his people from their sins.
lunyoro: . Kandi alizara Omwana omwojo; kandi olimuruka ibararye Yesu; baitu nuwe alijuna abantube omu bibi byabu.

english: For I tell you that each one of you says, ‘I belong to Paul,’ ‘I belong to Apollos,’ ‘I belong to Cephas,’ ‘I belong to Christ.’
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo ngambire nti omuntu wena omulinywe agamba ati Nyowe wa Pauro: kandi nyowe wa Aporo: kandi Nyowe owa Kefa: kandinyowe wa Kristo.

english: Suppose a man who has one hundred sheep and one of them gets lost and loses one of them is going to the mountains and looks for the lost one.
lunyoro: "Tini muntu anyakuina entamaze kikumi, nentahi yazo emu ebuzire, tasiga ziri ekyenda mu mwenda, nagenda ha nsozi, nase'ra egi enyakubuzire?

english: Jesus said to him, “Put your money back in the bank, and sit down and write fifty.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Kwata orupapura rwawe, oika're bwango, ohandike amakumi atano.

english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice came from heaven and said, “This is my Son, the one I want, with whom I am pleased.
lunyoro: Baitu akahabwa Ruhanga Isitwe ekitnisa nokutinwa, iraka oburyamuizire okuruga omu kitinisa ekirukwangasana, nirigamba ngu Onu nuwe Mwana wange oundukugonza, ounsemererirwe muno:

english: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said to them, “Listen! All of you, and understand. Nothing is beyond human beings.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okweta ekitebe namberali, yabagambira ati Mumpu're inywena, mwetegereze; busaho kintu ekyaheru yomuntu

english: So Jesus said to them again, “The bridegroom is already dead, but I am going to kill him.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagambire ati: yagaruka nabagambira ati Enganjani yange omuswezi aikaire: baitu ningenda okumusisimura.

english: Pilate said to him, “Are you the king?” Jesus answered, “You said that, because I am the king. I was born, and I came into the world, and I understand. Whoever hears my voice obeys me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu'ra iraka ryange.

english: Jesus said to them the third time, “I know what sin this man has done. I do not see in him the penalty for death. I will rebuke him and let him go.”
lunyoro: Kale yabagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuruwe musango ogwokufa: nikyo ndamute'ra, 'mulekere.

english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of a city that is not circumcised; and I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya, owa Taruso orwa Kirikiya, owomu rubuga orutali rwokugayibwa: kandi nkwesengerize leka ngambire abantu.

english: Paul said to the commander and to the soldiers, “Unless you are in the boat, you will not be able to be saved.”
lunyoro: Pauro yagambira omunyakihanda nabaserikale ati Abo obubataikale omu kyombo, inywe timusobole okujunwa.

english: When Peter saw it, he said to the people, “What did you men of Israel not want? Why did you make us think that our own power or the worship of our God has made you unclean?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obuyaboine yagarukamu abantu ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, kiki ekibatangalize omuna? Rundi numutugumizaho ki amaiso okutekereza ngu amani gaitu itwenka, rundi okutina Ruhanga okwaitu, nibyo bimugendeseze ogu?

english: His elder son was in the field. When he came home, he heard what had happened to him and how he had been crying.
lunyoro: Mutabaniwe omukuru akabali omu misiri; obuyaizire nai'ra haihi nenju, akahu'ra enyamulere nokuzina.

english: They all denied him, and were amazed at the gracious words that came out of his mouth. “Isn't this Joseph's son?” they asked.
lunyoro: Na bona bamuranga, nibahuni'ra obwebigambo bye mbabazi ebyarugire omu kanwake: nibagamba ngu Tinu onu mwana wa Yusufu?

english: You will rest, but you will not be able to speak until the day that these things happen, because you do not believe my words, which will happen in their proper order.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, oliculera, okutasobora okugamba, okuhika ha kiro eki ebigambo binu obubirikahiki'ra, baitu toikirize bigambo byange, ebirihiki'rwa omu mpiko zabyo.

english: Jesus called his disciples to him and said to them, “I tell you that this poor widow gave more than all the other poor who were going to the marketplace.
lunyoro: Yayeta abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omufakati onu owamasege anagiremu bingi okukira bona abarukunaga omu ryahu'ro;

english: I cannot do what I want, can't you? Your eye is evil, but I am good.
