lunyoro: Sirukusobora kukora ebyange nkokundukugonza? Rundi eriso ryawe libi, baitu nyowe ndi murungi?

english: The Holy Spirit came down upon him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came out of the cloud, “You are my Son, the one I want you to love me with. How happy I am!”
lunyoro: Roho Ogurukwera yasirimuka haruwe omu kisisani kyomubiri nkeriba, niraka ryaruga omu irungu ngu Niwe mwana wange oundukugonza; nkusemererirwe muno.

english: Jesus asked them, “What is your faith? The people were amazed and said to one another, “Who is this man? He commands the winds and the water to obey him?”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Okuikiriza kwanyu kuraha? Batina nibahuni'ra bagambirangana bonka ngu Mara ogu noha, baitu aragira nomuyaga namaizi, bimuhu'ra?

english: My son is sick, but he is suffering terribly, because many tears have been poured out by the fire, and many tears have been poured out by the water.
lunyoro: Omwana wange akwasirwe endwara, emucanza muno: baitu enkanjaiga enyingi agwa omu mu'ro, kandi emirundi nyingi agwa omu maizi.

english: They did not look for you by faith, but by doing what they did. They did not look for you on the stone that will not be destroyed.
lunyoro: Kandi batakuse'le omu kuikiriza, baitu omu mirimo. Bakatabaijuka ha ibale eririkutabaijurwaho;

english: And if you think that you should die for the sake of the people, then you should not let anyone go.
lunyoro: kandi obumuraba numutekereza ngu Kibasemerire omuntu omu afe habwa bant, hakire omuntu wena aleke okufa.

english: Some began to spit on him, and some of them began to spit on him, and they would spit on him, and said, “Crucify him!” The guards took him and beat him.
lunyoro: Nabandi bakabanza okumucwera amacwanta, nokumusweke'ra amaiso, noku mutera, nokumugambira ngu Rugura: nabahereza bamutwara nibamutera empi.

english: But if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink; but if he is thirsty, give him a drink; for by doing this you will heap fire on his head.
lunyoro: Baitu omunyanzigwa wawe obwarumwa enjara, omulise: obwakwatwa iroho, omunywise; baitu obwokora oti, buli omukumire Amanda gomu'ro ha mutwe.

english: What did he say? ‘I will look for him, but you will not find him,’ and ‘I will not be able to go to him?’
lunyoro: Kinu kiki ekyagambire ati Mulinse'ra timulimbona: kandi ati namberendi inywe timusobora kuijayo?

english: I beg you, then, to eat the bread; for this is why you will be saved, because you have not lost the piece of bread on your head and on your head.
lunyoro: Nikyo mbesengererize okurya ha byokurya; baitu nikyo kirabajuna: baitu tihabulie kasoke kamu ha mitwe yanyu nomu.

english: Whenever you go to a town or village to look for someone who is good, then you will wait for him until he comes from there.
lunyoro: Orubuga rwona nambere murakatahamuga, rundi ekika kyona, muse'rege noha omuli abo asemera; nuho mulira'ra okuhikya obumulirugayo.

english: In their hearts they said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will follow us.’ But we do not know what happened to this Moses, who led us out of Egypt.
lunyoro: nibagambira Aroni omu mitima yabu ngu Otuko'le baruhanga abalitwebembera: baitu Musa ogu, ayatuihire omu nsi ya Misiri, titumanyire okwabaire.

english: “Teacher, Moses wrote this to us: ‘A man's brother must die and leave his wife for his children, and the brother's brother must marry his wife and raise children for his brother.’
lunyoro: bamukaguza ngu Omwegesa, Musa akatuhandikira ati Omugenzi womuntu obwafa nasiga mukaziwe atakazaire bana, mugenziwe aswerege mukaziwe aza'rege mugengaye abana.

english: But Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said to them, “Any kingdom divided against itself falls, and every house divided against itself falls apart.”
lunyoro: baitu uwe yakenga ebitekerezo byabu, yabagambira ati Obukama bwona obububaganizibwamu bwonka buhwereke'ra; nenju obwebaganizibwa yonka egwa.

english: But Paul said to them, “Before being tried by the Roman authorities, we were put in prison and now we are put in prison. How can we be kept under guard? No, but they have come to us and have crucified us!”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Nangwa, mananukwo; baitu baije bonka batuturukye.

english: He did not fail to notice that he was doing well and told them to come down from heaven and gather food for you, and he poured out your hearts to the hungry and happy.
lunyoro: Baitu atebuzeho kaiso, baitu akakora kurungi, nabanagira enjura okuruga omu iguru, nebiro ebyokwerezamu ebyokurya, naigusa emitima yanyu engeso enungi nokusemererwa.

english: When it was late in the morning, the twelve men who had come with him came to him and said, “Send the crowd away, and let them go into the villages and farms around the lake and buy food for themselves, because we are here in the desert.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba nubu'sana kuira; ikumi nababiri bakaija, nibamugambira ngu Yohereza abekitebe, bagende omu maka nensi enyakuhe'raine bagonye, basake ebyokurya; baitu hanu tuli omu irungu kwonka.

english: So Paul went up and fell at him and touched him. “Don't be afraid,” he said, “because his life is in him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yasirimuka, yamugwera namubumbatira nagamba ati Mutatera empamo; baitu obwomezibwe burumu omunda.

english: But God said to him, “You fool! This night they will kill you, and whose riches you have heard will they give you?
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga akamugambira ati Iwe mudomadoma ekiro kinu nubwo barakuihaho obwomezi bwawe; nitungo eriwayahuire liriba ryoha?

english: Or perhaps he will say to him, ‘Take your meal and sit down and eat; then you will have enough to eat and drink; and afterward you will be yours.’
lunyoro: Rundi talimugambira ati Ihura ebyokurya, oyetege, ompereze, obundakamara okurya nokunywa; kandi hanyuma nubwo orye onywe?

english: I am the vine, and you are the branches. Those who remain in me and I in him are the ones who will bear much fruit, but you will not be able to do anything for me.
lunyoro: Ninyowe muzabibu, ninywe matagi: anyakuikara omuli nyowe, nanyowe omuruwe, nuwe ayana bingi: baitu ha nyowe ntali timuroho ekimurukusobora okukora.

english: You have obeyed your commands, and you have been condemned.
lunyoro: Osoroize omu bigambo byawe, Kandi okire obwocwerwa omusango.

english: This is not because they are Abraham's descendants, but because they are all children. In Isaac are your descendants, and by means of him you will be called.
lunyoro: Kandi tibuli obwokuba baijukuru ba Iburahimu, nukwo bali bana bona: baitu ngu Omu Isaka numwo baijakwe baryeterwa.

english: “Let us go and buy two hundred silver coins for them,” they answered.
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Inywe mubahe ebyokurya. Bamugambira ngu Tugende tugule emigati eyedinali bibiri tugibahe barye?

english: I do not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘You will see the Spirit come down upon you, and you will remain over him, who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
lunyoro: Nanyowe ntamumanye; baitu ogu ayantumire okubatiza namaizi nuwe yangambire ati Owolirora Omwoyo nasirimika haruwe, namuikaraho, nuwe abatiza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and turned around and said to the crowd who had followed him, “I tell you, I have never seen anyone in Israel before.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyahukrire ebi yamutanga'ra, yahinduka yagambira abekitebe abamuhondire ati Nimbagambira nti Tinkabonaga kuikiriza kwingi kuti, nobuhokuba omu Isareri.

english: Jesus went with them. While he was not far from the house, the official sent a message to the man who had been with him, “Don't bother to come in, my Lord!” But I don't deserve to be in my house.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagenda nabo. Kandi obwakaba atagiri hara enju, omunyoro owekihanda yatuma enganjanize namberali, nibamugambira ngu Mukama wange otegadya okuija: baitu tindukuseme'ra iwe okutaha omunda yorusurwange:

english: He followed Paul and us and cried out in a loud voice, “These men have told you the way to go!”
lunyoro: Ogu akakuratira Pauro naitwe, nagambira haiguru muno, ababatebeza omuhanda ogwokujwa.

english: I did not know him, but he was revealed to Israel by means of the water.
lunyoro: Nanyowe ntamumanye; baitu uwe asuku'rwe omu Isaleri, ninyeremeza omu maizi.

english: The chief priests and the elders came to Paul and said, “We have decided to set a trap for you not to consider this matter until you have killed Paul.”
lunyoro: Baija hali banyakatagara abakuru nabakuru, nibagamba ngu Turahire ekirahiro kikoto okutaroza ha kantu kona, okuhikya obutalikaita Pauro.

english: “Yes,” he said. “I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.”
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Nukwo ndakora: ndasesa enguli zange, ndyombeka ezikira obukoto; numwo ndayahu'ra oburo bwange nitungo ryange.

english: It was not right for the earth or the sea to be quiet. They were sitting outside. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
lunyoro: Tikisemesire itaka, noburwakuba orubungo: bakinaga aheru. Anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra, ahu'le.

english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and said to him, “Look! There is an Israelite here who does not belong to Israel!
lunyoro: Yesu yarora Nasalesi naija namberali, yamugambaho ati Dora Omuisareri mali atarumu bugabya!

english: Do not be like them, and they will be like God's servants. As the scripture says, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and they got up to meet you.”
lunyoro: Kandi mutaba abaramya ebisisani nkabahereza; nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Abantu bakaika'ra okurya nokunywa, baimuka okuzana.

english: Pilate answered, “I am a Jew, but your people and the chief priests have followed me. What have you done?”
lunyoro: Pirato yagaruramu ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya? Abaihanga ryanyu na Banyakatagara abakuru nibo bakundetire: okozire ki?

english: Jesus answered, “If I tell you the truth, forgive me; for what do you want me to do?”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugarukamu ati Obundaba ngambire kubi, onyomereze ekibi: baitu kiraba kiri kirungi nonte'ra ki?

english: But everyone told them what they had to say, because the one who did the work in the field told everything he had, and he was content with it.
lunyoro: Baitu bona banagiremu ebibasagirire; baitu ogu omu masegege anagiremu byona ebyanyinabyo, niryo itungorye ryona.

english: For the promises of God are like these: they are true in his sight, and so are the things that belong to him in his sight, and the glory of God in ours.
lunyoro: Baitu nukwo emirago ya Ruhanga esisaine eti, omuruwe harumu ego: kandi nukwo omuli ogu harumu Amina, hali ekitinisa kya Ruhanga omulitwe.

english: For if this thing is told by the governor, we will find out about it, and you will be put to death.
lunyoro: baitu ekigambo kinu obukiraba nikigambirwa omulemi, turamusobo'ra, nainywe turabaihaho omusango.

english: While Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “It was only right for me to do this for you, you Jews.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro obwakaba nagenda okwasamya akanwake, Galio yagambira Abayudaya, kyakubaireho amananu ekigambo ekyokusobeza, rundi okusisa okubi, inywe Abayudaya, kyobusobozi okucwerwa omusango okukira inywe:

english: Jesus said to them, “I have something to eat that you do not know.”
lunyoro: baagambira ati Nyina ebyokurya ebimutarukumanya.

english: But if you see a man who does not know you but does not know where you are going, and he is sitting on a bed, where his heart is not strong, and he is not able to eat the things that are offered to idols.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu rundi obwaba nakurora iwe anyakunyina okumanya, oikalire ha byokurya omu kibale kyarubanga, omutima gwogu, obwaba atanyina amani, tiguligumibwa okurya ebihongirwe ebisisani?

english: Jesus answered, “Believe now, because it is right for us to do this.” So he believed in him.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Ikiriza hati bunu, baitu nukwo kituseme'ra kiti okuhikiriza okuhiki'ra kwona. Nubwo yamuikirize.

english: When they had gathered around him, Pilate said to them, “Who is this man who wants you to arrest him? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called the Messiah?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubayesoroize, Pirato yabagambira ati Araha oumurukwenda, 'mubaleke'le? Baraba, rundi Yesu ayetwa kristo?

english: His fellow servant fell to the ground and begged him, “I want to, and you will get well.”
lunyoro: Kandi omuiru mutahiwe yagwa ahansi, namwesengereza, nagamba ati Ningonza, nanyowe ndikumara.

english: But the angel said to him, “Don't be afraid, Zechariah! Your prayers have been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will rise to life in order to see John.”
lunyoro: Baitu maraika akamugambira ati Otatina, Zakaliya; baitu okwesengereza kwawe kukahu'rwa, kandi mukazi wawe Erisabesi alikuza'ra omwana omwojo, kandi olimuruka ibararye Yohana.

english: Then Jesus took him aside and said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in my name receives me too, and whoever receives me receives him also that sent me. For whoever is least among you should be great.”
lunyoro: kamutwara, nabagambira ati Wena aliikiriza omwana onu omuto omu ibara rya nge buli aikirize nyowe: nawena aliikiriza nyowe; nawena alisiriza nyowe, buli aikirize ogu ayantumire: baitu anyakuli omuto omulinywe, nuwe mukuru.

english: “Teacher,” the official answered, “you are a member of the people of Israel.”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Rabi, niwe Mwana wa Isareri.

english: There was a woman in that town who came to him and said, “I will fight against my enemy!”
lunyoro: kandi hakaba haroho omufakati omu rubuga oru; ogu yaijaga hali emirundi mingi, nagamba ati Ndamura nomunyanzigwa wange.

english: Jesus said to the one who invited him, “When you give a lunch or a dinner dinner, don't invite your friends, your brothers, or your relatives or your relatives, or the rich neighbors, and they invite you back, and they will not invite you back.”
lunyoro: Kandi akagambira nogu ayamwesere ati Obworacumbaga ebyokurya ebyenyamusana rundi ebyorwebagyo, otaryeta enganjani zawe, nobubakuba bene banyu, nobwekuba abomu ruganda rwawe, nobubyakuba abatahi bawe abaguda; nabo batagaruka okukweta okukugaru'ra.

english: Jesus answered, “You don't know me or my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.
lunyoro: Kandi Bamugambira ngu 'So araha? Yesu yagarukamu ati Inywe timumanyire nyowe, nobwakuba Isenyowe: kakuba mumanyire Nyowe, mwakumanyire na isenyowe.

english: Jesus said to them, “Don't be amazed; you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has been raised from death. He is not here. Look! The place where they crucified him!
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mutahuni'ra: numuse'ra Yesu, Omunyanazalesi, ayabambirwe ha muti: ahumbukire: tali hanu: dora, ekiikaro nambere bamutaire.

english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
lunyoro: Nagwa hansi, nahu'ra iraka niringambira ngu Sauro, Sauro. Nonhiga ki?

english: Those who eat at the houses of widows and cry out with all their heart, and they will be judged more correctly than those who do.
lunyoro: abarya enju ezabafakati, nibagobya omu kusaba okwingi: abo balikira okucwerwa omusango.

english: Then he will reply, ‘I tell you, whenever you did not do what I did not, you did not do it to me.’
lunyoro: Nubwo ali bagarukamu ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti nkokumutarakolire omu hali abo abarukukira obuto, Buli mutakiko're nyowe.

english: They have a king who is an angel of the abyss. He who sits in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek is a pool.
lunyoro: Ziyina omukama wazo, maraika owekina ekitayina hokugarukira: ibararye omu Ruheburaniya nuwe Abadoni, kandi omu Ruyonani nuwe Aporuoni.

english: This is the stone that was set at nought of you builders, which has become the chief priests of the Law.
lunyoro: Ogu niryo ibale eryagayirwe inywe abombeki, niryo ryafokere erikuru erya ha karugu.

english: He saw a man named Ananias come in and lay his hands on him and change his mind.
lunyoro: kandi aboine omuntu, ibararye Ananiya, nataha namutaho emikono aiguke.

english: They threw a purple robe on Jesus, threw a crown on his head, and put a crown on him. They threw their hands on him and said, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: Kandi baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and to keep him under guard until I make him king over the Roman Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: While Jesus was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife, because what is in her is the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba natekereza ebi, dora, maraika wa Mukama Yamubonekera omu kiroto, nagamba ati Yusufu, omwana wa Daudi, otatina okutwara Maryamu mukazi wawe, baitu ekiri omundaye Kyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: The apostles and the others who followed them said to the apostles and them who had followed them, “Praise the name of the Lord! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
lunyoro: Kandi abakaba bebembire, nabali abakuratire, bagambira haiguru ngu Hosana; Ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: The voice answered again and again, “What God has promised, do not commit adultery!”
lunyoro: Rundi iraka ryangarukamu omurundi ogwakabiri liti Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora iwe ebyomuziro.

english: Philip answered him, “The bread that you gave me is the two hundred silver coins, and he did not let them go, all of them at once.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ari Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: There is no gospel except the Good News about Christ, and there are some who make you sad and want to change the gospel of Christ.
lunyoro: enjiri endi teriyo, rundi haroho abandi abarukubatuntuza,nibagonza okuhindura kubi enjiri ya Kristo.

english: The wind blows wherever it wants, and you hear its roar, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is that everyone who is born of the Spirit will be born.
lunyoro: Embeho ehuha nambere egonza, naiwe ohu'ra okuhi'ra kwayo, baitu tomanya nambere eruga, nobuhokuba nambere egenda; nukwo aba ati wena anyakuzarwa Omwoyo.

english: But if I make my case, my heart will not be glad in him.
lunyoro: Kandi obwayehinya enyuma, omutima gwange tigurukusemererwa omuruwe.

english: The man came to us and took Paul's belt, tied it up with his own hands, and said, “This is what the Holy Spirit said: ‘The Jews in Jerusalem will arrest the man who owns this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
lunyoro: Ogu akaija nambetuli, yakwata omweko gwa Pauro, yayeboha ebigerebye nemikonoye wenka, nagamba ati Nukwo agambire Omwoyo Ogurukwera ati Abayudaya abomu Yerusalemu nukwo baliboha bati omusaija mukama womweko gunu, balimuhayo omu mikono Yabamahanga.

english: Jesus gave a parable to them, saying, “There was a man who was one who was good and faithful.
lunyoro: Kandi akabacwera orufumo ati Hakaba haroho omuntu omu emisirye neyera bingi:

english: and said, “You went in to the uncircumcised and ate with them.”
lunyoro: nibagamba ngu Okataha omu bantu abatasazirwe, kandi okarya nabo.

english: For there were many who were called gods, heaven or earth, just as there were many gods, kings, and many kings.
lunyoro: Baitu nobubaraba baroho baingi abararukwetwa baruhanga, rundi haiguru, randi hansi; nkokubali baruhangi baingi nabakama baingi bakama baingaha;

english: Another one said, “I have bought five pigeons and am going to cover them. Please let me go!”
lunyoro: Ndi yagamba ati Nguzire enki'ri zente itano, ningenda okuzirenga: nkwesengerize, ndeka.

english: Jesus said to them, “Could you make the children of the bride look smart if the bridegroom is with them?
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Musobora okusibisa abana bobugole, omuswezi obwaba aroho nabo?

english: If anyone hears these words of mine and does not obey them, he will be like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena obwahu'ra ebigambo byange binu atarukubikora, alisisana nomuntu omudomadoma ayayombekere enjuye ha musenyi:

english: It was not written for his own sake that his righteousness was clearly seen by him.
lunyoro: Kandi kitahandikwe habwogu wenka ngu okuhiki'ra kukamutekerezebwaho,

english: For I love our nation, which is the one who made us.
lunyoro: Baitu nagonza ihanga ryaitu, kandi nuwe yalitwombekire.

english: After spending a long time there, Festus announced to the king about Paul, “There is one man here who has been released from prison by Felix.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaikaireyo ebiro bingi, Fesito yatebeza omukama ebya Pauro, nagamba ati Haroho omuntu omu, Ferekisi ouyasigire omunyankomo:

english: Jesus was greatly upset and said, “What do these people look for? I tell you, they will not be given a witness about this.
lunyoro: Yasinda muno omu mutimagwe, nagamba ati Abobusinge bunu nibaseru'ra ki akokuroraho? Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Abobisinge bunu tibalihebwa kokuro'raho.

english: “Tell me,” he answered, “and I will sit down with you on your right hand and on your left, in your Kingdom.”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda ki? Yamugambira ati Ragira mbahe okuika'ra, ondi ha Mukono gwawe ogwoburyo, nondi h Mukono Gwawe ogwemoso, omu bukama bwawe.

english: But the servant who listens to him and does not obey him is like a man who built a house on earth and does not have a brother. At that very moment he fell, and there was a lot of fall on that house.
lunyoro: Kandi ogu ahu'ra atarukukora, nasisana nkomuntu ayayombekere enju ha itaka nambere omuganda gutali, kandi omugenzi gukagitera; ahonaho yagwa; nokugwa kwenju egi kukaba kuli kwingi.

english: But the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! All of you are tax collectors and others like you, and you take them to drinking water on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yamugarukamu nagamba ati Inywe abagobya, inywena timusibu'ra omuntu wena enimiye, rundi enkainaye, ha kior kya Sabiti, numugitwara okugyesera amaizi?

english: The Lord said to him, ‘Go away, for this is what I am going to do with you to make my name known to the Gentiles, kings, and people of Israel.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yamugambira ati Genda: baitu ogu kibindi ekikomemu namberendi, okutwara ibara ryange omu maiso Gabamahanga nabakama nabana Baisareri:

english: I heard a voice saying, “Get up, Peter! Here is the one you are!
lunyoro: kandi nahu'ra iraka nirigamba liti Imuka Petero; ita orye.

english: Jesus said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery with her, and whoever marries her commits adultery with her commits adultery with her.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Omuntu wena wena alibinga mukaziwe, naswera ondi, buli asihaine okumusisa; nauwe wenka obwaryanga iba,

english: “Cornelius, a good and faithful servant of God, who is highly respected in all the Jewish people,” they answered, “and God has appointed an angel to invite you to his house and to hear what has happened to you.”
lunyoro: Bagamba ngu Koruneryo, omunyakihanda, omuntu ahikirire arukutina Ruhanga, arukusimwa omu ihanga ryona Eryabayudaya, akahaburwa Ruhanga maraika arukwera okukweta okuija omu njuye, ahu're ebigambo ebiruga haliwe.

english: But when the tenants saw the son, they said among themselves, ‘This is the owner of the vineyard. Come and kill him, and let us eat his harvest.’
lunyoro: Baitu abalimi obuboboine omwana, bagambirangana bonka ngu Omu nuwe Mugwetwa; muije tumuite, turye obugwetwabwe.

english: When you look for the Kingdom and the Kingdom, do not be afraid; these things must happen, but the end will not come at all.”
lunyoro: Kandi obumuligu'ra obulemu nobwemi mutaryekanga: baitu ebi bihikirire okumara okubaho; baitu emperor terukuhika bwango.

english: I have told you these things, so that my joy may be in you, and your joy may be made full.
lunyoro: Ebi mbibagambire, okusemererwa kwange kuikale omulinywe, kandi okusemererwa kwanyu kuhiki'le.

english: There was a rich man who was clothed in purple and fine linen, who was always dressed in fine linen.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho omuguda omu, ayajwaraga orugoye orurukutukura na bafuta esemire, ayaryaga okurungi ebiro byona:

english: Jesus said to them, “My time is right, but you will drink too much. It is not for me to sit at my right and at my left, but for those to whom the Father has given me.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Empwahwa yange niyo mulinywaho mali; baitu okuika'ra ha Mukono gwange ogwoburyo nogwemoso tali nyowe ngaba, baitu nukwo kwabu isenyowe abayakwahulire.

english: They saw him, and they were amazed. His mother said to him, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been looking for you all day long.
lunyoro: Nabo obubamuboine, bahuni'ra; nyina yamugambira ati Mwana wange, kiki ekikugirize kiti nambere tuli? Dora,'so nanyowe tukakuse'ra tutuntuire.

english: And I tell you that if two of you will share with the world in whatever they ask, my Father in heaven will reward them.
lunyoro: Kandi nimbagambira nti obubaliba babiri halinywe nibaterana hamu hansi obwekigambo kyona ekibalisaba, kiribako'rwa isenyowe ali omu iguru.

english: The chief priests and the Pharisees gathered together in the Law and said, “What shall we do? This man performs many miracles!”
lunyoro: Kandi banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo basoroza orukurato, nibagamba ngu Ntukora ki? baitu omuntu ogu nakora obwokuro'raho bwingi.

english: And this woman, son of Abraham, who had been taken by Satan for eighteen years, ought not this innocent man be put in prison on the Sabbath?”
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi onu, omwana wa Iburahimu, Stani ouyabohaga, dora, emyaka ikumi nomunana, tahikirire okuboho'rwa orusengo runu ha kiro kya Sabiti?

english: For in him we live and move and remain. As Jesus said to you, ‘We are his children, too.’
lunyoro: baitu omuruwe ntwomera, ntugenda, ntuikaraho; nkabamu abowanyu okubagambire ngu Baitu naitwe tuli banabe.

english: Then Paul answered, “What do you do to weep and gnash my teeth? I do not have to be alone in prison and in the name of the Lord Jesus.”
lunyoro: Nubwo Pauro yagarukamu ati Nimugira ki, oku'ra nokusaliza omutima gwange? Baitu nyowe tinye tegekere okubohebwa kwonka, kandi ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: Jesus said to him, “Go away!” So he left and went to the pigs. Suddenly all the crowd gathered around him to gather the whole herd of pigs into the sea and threw them into the water.
lunyoro: Yagigambira ati Mugende. Yarugamu, negenda omu mpunu: dora, igana ryona ryajumbutuka okukonkomoka ekihanga omu nyanja, nirihwereke'ra omu maizi.

english: Then Paul said to him, “God will take you to a holy place. You sit to judge me according to the Law and order me to be put under oath by the Law not to speak on the basis of what I say.”
lunyoro: Nubwo Pauro yamugambira ati Ruhanga alikureta iwe, ekisika ekisigirwe okwera: oikalire okuncwera omusango nkebiragiro okubiri, noragira okuntera nke biragiro okubitagamba?

english: For they speak with authority, but if he is alive, he also speaks with authority.
lunyoro: Baitu nibagamba mani, baitu obwaba aroho omubirigwe mugara, nebigambobye byokugayibwa.

english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Your house is ready to burn.”
lunyoro: Petero yamugambira ati Ainea, Yesu Kristo nakukiza: omuka oyeya're.

english: Jesus said to her, “The man who was healed did not need to be told the truth, but only to be told the truth. Happy are you, too, because not all of you are healed.
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Anyakwogibwe taroho ekyase'ra, rundi okunabisibwa ebigere byonka, baitu asemerezibwe kimu: nainywe muli basemezibwe, baitu timuli inywena.

english: Jesus said to the vinedresser, “For three years I will come looking for some fruit on this fig tree, but I will not see it. Be on your feet. Why, then, do you look at the fig tree?”
lunyoro: yagambira omulimi wemizabibu ati Dora, emyaka enu esatu nyija okuse'ra ebyana ha mutini gunu, ntarukubiboba; guteme; nugwema'raho ki ekibanja?

english: But you did not read in the book of Moses about Luke, which God said to him, “I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.”
lunyoro: Baitu ebyabafire, nokuhumburwa kwabu, timukasomaga omu kitabu kya Musa ha Rusaka, Ruhanga obuyamugambire, nagamba ati Ninyowe Ruhanga wa Ibarahimu, Ruhana wa Isaka, Ruhanaga wa Yakobo?

english: Pilate went back outside and said to them, “Look! I am going ahead of you and you will know that I find no reason to condemn him!”
lunyoro: Pirato yagaruka naturuka aheru yabagambira ati Dora, ni'muturukya aheru namberemuli, mumanye ngu timboine musango haruwe.

english: The one who is the one who hears the words of God, but does not obey them, because they belong to God.
lunyoro: Omuruwe ahu'ra ebigambo bya Ruhanga: nikyo mutarukuhuli'ra baitu timuli ba ruhanga.

english: When the Sabbath came, Jesus began to teach in the synagogue. Many people were amazed and asked, “Where did this man get these things? What wisdom has he received? With the same miracles that he performed in his hands!”
lunyoro: Kandi sabiti obuyahikire, yabanza okwegesa omu iso'rokaniro: abaingi obubamuhulire bahuni'ra, nibagamba ngu Onu akaiha nkaha ebigambo ebi? kandi ngu Magezi ki ganu onu agayahairwe? Nebyamani ebirukuingana aho ebikozirwe omu mikonoye?

english: But at night there was a cry from the sky, “Look! The bridegroom is coming, and we will meet him!”
lunyoro: Baitu ekiro omu itumbi haroho obwogo ngu Dora omuswezi naija muturuke okumutangi'ra.

english: Jesus said, “Let them sit down on the ground.” There was a great earthquake in that place. The men sat down, about five thousand.
lunyoro: Yesu yagamba ati Mubaikalize hansi abantu. Kandi hakaba haliyo obunyansi bwingi omu kiikaro eki. Abasaija baika'ra hansi, omuhendo gwabu nkenkumi itano.

english: You stretch out your hand to heal, and you will be able to see and understand because of the power of your holy Son Jesus.
lunyoro: nobumanzi, iwe nogo'ra omukono gwawe okukiza; nobwokuro'raho nebyamahano bikorwe habwibara Ryomwana wawe arukwera Yesu.

english: He saw a fig tree on the road and found it and found nothing on it but leaves. “Don't eat anything at all,” he said. At once a fig tree withered away.
lunyoro: Yabona omutini gumu ha muhanda rubaju, yaguhikaho nasanga busaho kintu,rundi amababi masa:yagugambira ati Otaryana byana ebiro nebiro. Ahonaho omutini gwayoma.

english: Jesus rebuked them all but did not know this, so he ordered them to give him food.
lunyoro: Yabatere'ra muno omuntu wena atakimanya eki:yaragira okumuha ebyokurya.

english: James, the son of Zebedee, and John, the brother of James, and he gave them the name Boanerges, which means “Sons of Thunder.”
lunyoro: na Yakobo Omwana wa zebedayo, na Yohana, mugenzi wa Yakobo; nabo yabaruka amabara Boanerege, amakuru garyo ngu Bana bokuhinda:

english: Many of them said, “He is a demon, and he has been kept under guard. Why do you listen to him?”
lunyoro: Baingi halibo nibagamba ngu Aroho muzimu, agwire iraro; mumuhuli'ra ki?

english: “From where did John get his baptism? From heaven or from human beings?” they asked one another. “From heaven,” they asked. “Why, then, did you not believe in him?” they said.
lunyoro: Okubatiza kwa Yohana kukaruga nkaha, omu iguru, nandiki omu Bantu? Bakaguzangana bonka, nibagamba ngu Omu iguru; aratugambira ati Mara kiki ekyabatangire okumuikiriza?

english: I am telling you the new commandment: love one another.
lunyoro: Ekiragiro ekihyaka nimbaha ngu Mugonzanganege.

english: The next day the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered against Pilate,
lunyoro: Kandi nyenkya, nikyo kiro ekirukukuratira Ekyokutekaniza, banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo bakesoroza hali Pirato,

english: For if I have eaten and given thanks, why, then, do I have to boast about what this means?
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nindyaho nokusima, kiki ekinjumisa obweki ekinsimira.

english: Before John preached the baptism of repentance for the whole people of Israel, he did not come.
lunyoro: Yohana obuyabandize okutebeza okubatizibwa okwokwegarukamu hali abantu bona aba Isaleri, uwe atakaizire.

english: I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will go in to him and eat with him and with me.
lunyoro: Dora, nyemerire ha ruigi ninyeranga: omuntu wena obwalihu'ra iraka ryange nakinguraho oruigi, nditaha namberali, kandi ndirya hamu nauwe, nauwe hamu nanyowe.

english: I am telling you the truth, just as I am with you.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi mbagambira nkiri nainywe.

english: But Jesus healed them all, took the child's father, mother, and all who were with him, and went in to them.
lunyoro: Baitu obuyabaturukize bona, yatwara ise omuisiki na nyina, nabo abakaba bali nauwe, yatahamu omuisiki namberakabali.

english: So I think it is better for a person to be as he is now to be sad as he has.
lunyoro: Nukwo ndukutekereza nti obwobujune obuyakuroho hati bunu, kirungi omuntu okuikaraho nkokwali:

english: For this reason he was required to offer sacrifices for sins for the sake of mankind and for himself.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo kimuhikirire, habwabantu na habwe wenka, okuhongaga obwebibi.

english: Jesus gave them a parable, and no one put a piece of new cloth on him, and he said, “Put on the new, and the new will not match the old.”
lunyoro: Kandi akabacera orufumo; busaho muntu acwaho akakoba ha kyokujwara ekikuzire; kakuba agira ati akutemuire ekihyaka, nekicweka kyekihyaka tikikuteraine ahamu nekinyakukuzire.

english: [GENERAL) and know the love of Christ which you do not know. So then, be filled with all the fullness of God.
lunyoro: nokumanya okugonza kwa Kristo okutarukumanywa. Nukwo muijule okuijura kwona okwa Ruhanga.

english: He is the one who is the source of the evil things in his heart. So I speak with all boldness, as I ought to say.
lunyoro: Kandi ningambira nobumanzi omu maisoge, nkokukimpikirire okugamba,

english: In the last days we have spoken about him to us in the name of his Son, whom he has appointed over all things and has given us all things.
lunyoro: hati omu biro binu ebyahanyuma atugambire itwe omu Mwanawe, ouyataireho okuba omugwetwa wa byona, kandi ouyahangisize ebintu byona;

english: Peter spoke up and said to him, “Lord, if it is you, order me to come to you on the water.”
lunyoro: Petero yamugarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange, obworaba oli iwe, ngambira nyije namberoli ha maizi.

english: For a man who had been performing this miracle for forty years had been healed.
lunyoro: Gamba ngu Omuntu ayaakolirwe ekyamahano eki ekyokukizibwa akaba ahinguraine emyaka amakumi ana.

english: Or suppose a woman who has ten silver coins loses one of them and loses one thing of the money; she lights a lamp and sweeps away the house and looks carefully until she finds it.
lunyoro: Rundi mukazi ki anyakuina erupiya ikumi, atabakiriza etabaza, nasingo'ra omu nju, nayekamba okuse'ra okuhikya obwaligizora.

english: All the islands fled, and the mountains did not find them.
lunyoro: Namazinga gona gairuka, nensozi zitazoke.

english: At that time a large crowd of people came to him, blind and lame, waiting for the water to pour out.
lunyoro: Omwobu nuho habyamamuga ekitebe kyabarwaire, abafu bamaiso, abaramaire [nibategereza amaizi okubimba:

english: All of them, together with the rest of them in their faith, have not been put right with God by the things that he has promised.
lunyoro: Kandi nabo bona obubamanyisibwe obwokuikiriza kwabu batahabwe ekyaraganizibwe,

english: The Lord turned around and saw Peter. Peter remembered what the Lord had said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will say three times that you do not know me.”
lunyoro: Mukama waitu yahinduka yarora Petero. Kandi Petero yaijuka akigambo kya Mukama we okwamugambirege ati Hati enkoko etakokere, oranyahakana emirundi esatu.

english: This is the promise that he made to us, the promise which he made for us to live forever.
lunyoro: Kandi gunu nugwo murago ogwayaturaganize obwomezi obwebiro nebiro.

english: To this very day you will think that we are ready for you. In the presence of God through Christ, we speak of you. All things, my friends, are for your own good.
lunyoro: Okuhikya hati mutekerize ngu ntwetonganira halinywe. Omu maiso ga Ruhanga omu Kristo nuho turukugamba. Baitu byona, abarukugonzebwa, byokubombeka inywe.

english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who has existed from the beginning. I write it to you young people, because it is the power of the Evil One. I have written it to make you know the Father.
lunyoro: Nbahandikira inywe abaisebo, baitu mumanyire ogu ayabaireho okuruga karanakara. Nbabahandikirainywe abasigazi, baitu musinguire omubi.Nbahandikire inywe abana abato, nukwo mumanye Isitwe.

english: So they left the crowd and took Jesus aboard into the boat, and the other boat was with him.
lunyoro: Obubasigire ekitebe, bamutwara omu bwato, Kandi nobwato obundi bukaba buli nauwe.

english: Who, then, can forgive sins but God alone?
lunyoro: Noha asobora okuihaho ebibi, rundi Ruhanga wenka?

english: Then all the virgins got up and trimmed themselves
lunyoro: Abaisiki boona nubwo baimukire basemeza

english: After the believers had gone to the festival, Jesus also went openly, as though he were killing him.
lunyoro: Baitu benebabu obubamazire okutemba ha bugenyi, nauwe yatemba, kandi atagende bwerebwere, rundi nkomusita.

english: But whoever hates his brother in the dark, and walks in the darkness, does not know where he is going, because the darkness has made him blind.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakunoba mugenziwe ali omu muirima, kandi nagendera omu muirirma, kandi tamanyire harukugenda, baitu omuirima gukamuita amaiso.

english: We have not poured olive oil on my head, but he has poured oil on me and on my feet.
lunyoro: Tosesereho magita ha mutwe gwange: baitu ogu ansigire ebigere byange namagita aobwotere.

english: They have no doubts about them, but for a while they live, and when the trouble or trouble comes because of the message, they do not remember it at once.
lunyoro: kandi tibanyina mihama omulibo, baitu baikaraho akacu kake; kandi obujune, rundi okuhigwa, obubibaho habwekigambo ahonaho batabaijuka.

english: I have sent you by means of this message, so that you will know what I am saying and be encouraged.
lunyoro: ounatumire namberemuli obwekigambo kinu mali, mumanye ebigambo byange, kandi ahumuze emitima yanyu;

english: As he loved us, so we are deeply grateful to him for his abundant grace, which he has poured out on us through the blood of his dear Son.
lunyoro: nkokuyagondeze nasima ati, ekitinisa kyembabazize kikkugizibwe, eziyatuherire busa omwogu arukugonzebwa:

english: For the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the darkness, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.
lunyoro: baitu abana abobukama balibingirwa omu muirima ogwaheru:halibayo oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, who had the same habit.
lunyoro: Maraika ondi yaruga omu yekaru eyomu iguru, nauwe ayina akageso kobwogi.

english: He looked up to heaven, bowed down and said to him, “Ephesus,” meaning “Be quiet.”
lunyoro: narora haiguru omu iguru, yasinda, yamugambira ati Efasa, nukwo kugamba ngu Iguka.

english: We wrote to them that they must not eat any food that has been offered to idols, sexual immorality, the disgusting thing, and the blood that has not been strangled.
lunyoro: baitu tubahandikire balekereyo kimu ebinugwa ebyebisisani, nobusihani, nebinigirwe, nesagama.

english: For the Jews I was a Jew, so that we might gain Jews. For those who were under the Law, I might have them as lawbreakers, and so that I might gain those who are under the law.
lunyoro: Nabayudaya nkaba ndi Nkomuyudaya, ntunge Abayudaya: hali abarukulemwa ebiragiro, nkabandi nkanyakuli omu biragiro, nyowe nobuntaroho ebiragiro, nukwo ntunge abali omu birigiro:

english: But they were silent. He took him, healed him, and sent him away.
lunyoro: Baitu bakaculera kwonka. Yamukwata yamukiza yamwohereza.

english: A wild animal and a large tree that contains good water and looks at it in the same way?
lunyoro: Ensoro emu negera amaizi amarungi nagarukusa'ra omu liso limu?

english: When I thought, then, how can I separate myself from others? Or do I follow my own flesh? Am I the right or the right, or am I the only one?
lunyoro: Nukwo, obunatekerize nti, nkaragaraganiza? Rundi ebimpanuire, nimbihanura ninkuratira omubiri? Nyowe okuba nabyo nti ego, ego, rundi nangwa?

english: Father! And now I am proud of you and of all the glory that I had with you before the world was made.
lunyoro: Ai Isenyowe, na hati bunu 'nyumiza nyowe hamu naiwe, omukitinisa eki ekinkabanyinanakyo hamu nauwe ensi etakabaireho.

english: Who will harm them if you give them something good?
lunyoro: Kandi noha alibakora kubi obumwekambira ebirungi?

english: If you have something to say to someone else, aren't you afraid to argue with the wrong person or to argue about the good person?
lunyoro: Kandi inywe obumunyina ekigambo hali ondi, timutina okutongana hali abatali bokuhiki'ra, rundi okuhakana hali abahikirire?

english: So then, those who think they are strong do not fall.
lunyoro: Nukwo anyakutekereza ayemertire, ayerinde atagwa.

english: Let us go on walking in the same way as the people who live in the light—not in sexual immorality and loose conduct, but in the love of money.
lunyoro: mugenderege omu byembabazi nkabanyakugenda nyamusana. hatali omu kubandwa nobugenyi obwokutamirarara nokubihirwa.

english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but one flesh of people, another of animals, another from birds, and another of fish.
lunyoro: Nyama yona teri nyama emu: haroho enyama emu eyabantu, nenyama endi yebisoro, nendi yenyonyi, nenddi eyencu.

english: Do you think that you will be punished because you killed the Son of God with the sword and because you thought about the blood of the covenant that was made with him to be holy and to offer him as a great sacrifice?
lunyoro: mulitekereza muta? okubonanabonesebwa okulimutekererezebwa, ogu ayalibasire nebigerebye Omwana wa Ruhanga, natekereza esagama eyekiragano eyiyayezibwe nayo okutaba erukwera, nayekunikira muno?

english: The throne was around the throne, and twenty-four elders were seated, dressed in white, and on their heads were crowns of gold.
lunyoro: Kandi nentebe ezobukama zikaba zehingulirize ekitebe ekyobukama amakumi abiri naina: kandi ha ntebe hakaba haroho abakuru amakumi ana nabatano baikalire, bajwaire engoye ezirukwera; na ha mitwe yabu ekondo eza zabu.

english: So then, encourage one another and build each other up, just as you are doing.
lunyoro: Nukwo muhumuzanganege inywenka, kandi mwombekege inywena, omuntu wena omutahiwe, nkokumurukukora kandi.

english: [GENERAL) But when they read this letter to you, they praised God for his great love for you, because they listened to your eagerness to the Good News about Christ and for your loyalty to them and to all.
lunyoro: baitu obwokugonza kunu, obubasoma ekigambo kinu, bakukugiza Ruhanga, baitu nibahu'ra okwekamba kwanyu hali enjiri ya Kristo, nobwokutaima okwokubagana kwanyu nabo na bona;

english: If a king goes out to fight another king, he will sit down first and decide whether he can fight two thousand men who fight him.
lunyoro: Kandi mukama ki obwaba naramaga okurwana nomukama ondi, atabanza okuika'ra nahanura ebigambo, rundi arasobora nakakumi okutangana oli arukumuramagira nobukumi bubiri?

english: Many Samaritans in that town believed in him because of the message about the woman, who said, “He told me everything I have ever done.”
lunyoro: Kandi hali abomu kika eki Abasamaliya baingi bakamuikiriza habwekigambo kyomukazi, ayagambire ati Angambire ebinakozire byona.

english: He removed his enmity from his human body by breaking the Law and its commandments. In the same way he made both Jews and Gentiles to be one new people, making peace.
lunyoro: obuyamazireho omu mubirigwe obunyanzigwa, nibyo biragiro ebyaragirwe nebyatairweho: nukwo ahangire omuruwe wenka abo bombi okuba omuntu omu omuhyaka, okuleta obusinge:

english: Elijah was not sent to them, but only to Zarephath, in the territory of Sidon, to a widow in a widow's house in the region of Asia.
lunyoro: Kandi Eriya atatumwe halibo, rundi hali Zalefasi yonka, omu nsi ya Sidoni, hali omukazi omu fakati.

english: But do not make your head look hard, because you cannot make one hair white or black.
lunyoro: Baitu otalirahira mutwe gwawe, baitu torukkusobora kuhindura akasoke kamu konka rundi okwera rundi okumara.

english: The first foundation of the Temple was laid, where there was a lampstand, incense, and show bread. There it was called the Holy Place.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba hakozirwe hema, niyo yokubandizamu, nambere hakaba harumu ekikondo kyetabaza, nemeza, nemigati eyokwoleka; nuho hayeserwe barukwera.

english: Those who reject me and do not believe my words have a judge who will judge them. The words that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
lunyoro: Anyakwanga nyowe, atarukuikiriza bigambo byange, ayina arukumucwera omusango: ebigambo ebinagambire nibyo birimucwera omusango ha kiro kya hampero.

english: So then, because I do not wash you, you are no longer clean; and you do not want me to wash you in my mouth.
lunyoro: Nukwo obwokutagata koyakoya, kunu torukufuka kandi torukutagata ningenda okukutanaka omu kanwa kange.

english: When I was with you in the Temple the next day, you did not stretch out your hands to arrest me, but this is your day and the power of darkness.
lunyoro: Obunaikaraga nainywe obukyabukya omu yekaru, mutago'le mikono yanyu okunkwata: baitu kanu niko kasumi kanyu nobusobozi obwomuirima.

english: They even tried to stop them, but they could not find any reason to punish them. They were all praising God for what had happened.
lunyoro: kandi obubaseruire okubakanga, batabone okubarababonabonesa obwebi ebiyakozire; baitu bona bakaba nibakugiza Ruhanga obweki ekyakozirwe.

english: I tell you the truth: it is better for you to go away than for me to go. But if I do not go, the Helper will not come to you. But when I go, I will send him to you.”
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nimbagambira amananu; kibaseme'ra inywe nyowe okugenda; baitu obundaba ntarukugenda Omuhumuza taliija namberemuli; baitu obundigenda, ndimutumira inywe.

english: In the same way, whoever swears by the altar, swears on it and by everything on it.
lunyoro: nukwo anyakurahira ekyoto, buli arahire byona ebiroho.

english: When they heard this, they entered the Temple early in the morning and believed in him. The High Priest went with his followers and gathered the Council and all the elders of the people of Israel together and sent them to the prison to be brought to them.
lunyoro: Obubahulire bataha omu yekaru omu rukyakya, bayesiga. Baitu nyakatagara omukuru wabu akaija nabakaba bali nauwe, yasoroza ahamu orukurato nabakuru bona ababana Baisaleri, yatuma hali enju yenkomo okubaleta.

english: His mother answered, “No, but he will be called John.”
lunyoro: Nyina yagarukamu nagamba ati Nangwa; baitu arayetwaga Yohana.

english: But when they arrived at the place where the two apostles were gathered, they hid the boat. The commander's commander was standing in the boat, so that he would not hold back, but that the front part of the ship was broken by the violence of the waves.
lunyoro: baitu obubahikire omu kiikaro ebingonzi bibiri nambere byateranire, bayanzika ekyombo; kandi omutwe gwekyombo gwagumaho omu musenyi, okutatengeta, baitu ekiso kyabanza okucwekacweka obwamani gebingonzi.

english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the ground, is less than all the seeds that grow in the world.
lunyoro: Nubusisana nkakajuma akakaradali, ako obukatemerwa ha itaka, nobukaraba kali kataito okukira embibo zona ezinyakuli omu nsi,

english: He is patient with you in all things, believes all things and hopes all things.
lunyoro: kugumisiriza byona, nukuikiriza byona, nukunihira byona.

english: When he was put out of the prison, the daughter of Pharaoh took him and killed him as her own son.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyanagirwe aheru omuhara wa Faraho yamutwara namulera nkomwanawe wenka.

english: Jesus answered, “Even if I tell you, you will not believe;
lunyoro: Baitu yabagambira ati Nobwakubaire nimbatebeza timuikirize:

english: It will go out and bring to the seven other spirits of the world, who are worse than itself. They will go in and live there. Last of all, the man is worse than the first.”
lunyoro: Kandi gugenda, guleta emizimu ensi musanju, ebihire muno okukira ogu; etaha ikara omu: kandi ebyahanyuma ebyomuntu ogu bikira obubi ebya kara.

english: They wanted to make fun of me, but there was no excuse for me.
lunyoro: abo obumazire okunkaguliriza bagonza okunsumu'ra, baitu busaho musango hair nyowe.

english: Jesus was kind to him, reached out and touched him, and said, “I want to. Be made clean.”
lunyoro: Yamukwatirwa embabazi yago'ra omukonogwe yamukoraho, namugambira ati, Ningonza; semezebwa

english: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him.”
lunyoro: Nkamuletera abegeswa bawe, tibasobora kumukiza.

english: We know that you are eager to help me, and I am happy about you to help the people of Macedonia. But a year has passed since Achaia was ready to go, and many of you have been able to help them.
lunyoro: baitu'manyire okwekamba kwanyu, okundukwenyumirizamu hali abo abomu Makedoni habwanyu, baitu Akaya emazire omwaka gumu okwetekaniza; kandi nihali ryanyu likaimukya baingi omulibo.

english: For who knew the mind of the Lord, or who became his adviser?
lunyoro: Gamba ngu Noha amanyire amagezi ga Mukama? Rundi noha akaba afokere omuhanuziwe?

english: People fall because of fear and expectation of the things coming on the world, because the power that God gives in heaven will be shaken.
lunyoro: abantu nibagwa ensazi obwokutina, nobwokutegereza ebirukuija hansi: baitu amani agaha iguru galitengesebwa.

english: So then, if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
lunyoro: Nukwo Omwana obwalibafora abobugabe muliba bobugabe mali.

english: We wrote to the Gentiles who believe and judged them to be innocent of the things that are offered to idols, blood, and sacred things, and of sexual immorality.
lunyoro: Kandi Abamahanga, abaikirize tukahandika, tucwire omusango, ngu berindege hali ebintu ebihongirwe ebisisani, nesagama nebinigirwe, nobusihani.

english: because I am going to the Father, and you do not see me, because I is right.
lunyoro: habwokuhiki'ra, baitu ningenda hali Isenyowe, kandi nainywe timukindora;

english: They began to ask him to leave their region.
lunyoro: Kandi babanza okumwesengereza aruge omu mitana yabu.

english: Stay with me, and I with you. As a branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine; so you cannot bear children unless you remain in me.
lunyoro: Muikale omuli nyowe, nayowe omulinywe. Nkitagi okulitasobora okwana ebyana ryonka obulitaikara omu muzabibu,nukwo nainywe timusobora obumutaikara omuli Nyowe.

english: At once he fell at his feet and died. The young men came in and found him dead, led him out, and buried him with the body.
lunyoro: Ahonaho yagwa hansi ha bigerebye, yakanguka:d abasigazi batahamu, bamusanga afire, bamuturukya aheru, bamuzika hamu naiba.

english: They teach customs that are not for our own good or for our benefit, but for Roman purposes.
lunyoro: nibegesa engeso ezitangirwe itwe okuzikwata, nobukwakuba okuzikora, baitu tuli Barumi.

english: Elijah wants to come. Listen, then, if anyone has ears to hear.
lunyoro: Eriya arukwenda kuija. Anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra ahu'le.

english: This was what happened when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
lunyoro: Ibyo bikaba kubaho Kulenio obwakaba nalema Busuli.

english: There were six stone lampstands, which were described as the Jewish ritual baths, from which came two or three gallons (two or three quarts) of water.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haliyo entugiro ezamabale mukaga, ezatairweyo nkengeso Ezabayudaya ezokweza okuziri, nambere harugamu, entuginyo emuemu, amaizi agensuha ibiri rundi isatu.

english: A voice came from heaven, “You are my own dear Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
lunyoro: raka ryaturuka omu iguru ngu Niwe mwana wange oungonza, nkukyanganukire muno.

english: You have few people in Sardis who did not wash their robes. They will walk with me in holy clothes, but they will be worthy to walk with you.
lunyoro: Baitu oyina amabara make omu Sadi abatarasisire ebyokujwara byabu: kandi baligendera hamu nanyowe omu ngoye ezirukwera, baitu basemerire.

english: But Jesus was deeply troubled by this saying and thought about the glory that was going to happen to him.
lunyoro: Baitu uwe yatuntura muno obwekigambo eki, netekerezxa okuramukya oku okukuli.

english: Some time later his wife Elizabeth was pregnant, and she hid herself five months later.
lunyoro: Kandi hanyuma yebiro ebi mukaziwe Erisabesi yaba nenda: yayesereka amezi atano, nagamba ati

english: Let us, then, approach the throne of grace with confidence, be given mercy, and receive the grace that is set free for us at all times.
lunyoro: Nukwo tui'lege haihi nobumanzi hali ekitebe ekyembabazi, tuhabwe okuganyirwa, tutungege embabazi ezokukonyerwa obuturatagaga bwona.

english: Then those who live in Judea will go up to the mountains, and they will go out; those who are in the field will not go in.
lunyoro: Nubwo abali mu buyudaya baliirukira omu nsozi; nabalituruka aheru; nabo abali omu nsi kwonka batalitahamu.

english: They will hand him over to the Gentiles to be punished by the sword, to kill him, and to crucify him. On the third day he will be raised to life.”
lunyoro: kandi balimuhayo hali Abamahanga okumutera enaku, nukumutera, nokumubamba ha muti; kandi ha kiro kyakasatu alihumburwa.

english: But when you meet in the church first, I hear that there is a division among you.
lunyoro: Baitu okubanza mali obumwesoroza omu kanisa, mpulire nti haroho okwebaganizamu ekicweka.

english: You are not closed to us, but you are closed to our people. We are closed up to you, but in your hearts.
lunyoro: Timufunzire omulitwe, baitu omu mutima gwanyu.

english: And as the scripture says, “There is no difference between God's gift and the sin that has been committed by one man's sins.” But there is no excuse for the sin of one man, but the sin which has been forgiven has been so many.
lunyoro: Kandi nkokukwaizire habwomu ayasisire, ekisembo tikulikwo: baitu omusango gukabaho obwomuntu omu okumusinga, baitu ekisembo kyembabazi kikabaho obwebyokusisa bingi okuihaho omusango.

english: But whoever does the will of God, the same is my brother, and I am my mother.
lunyoro: baitu omuntu wena wena anyakukora Runaganga ebyagonza, ogu nwwe mwene waitu, nuwe munyanya nyowe, nuwe mau.

english: But if he has not heard it, then two or three witnesses will say everything to you.
lunyoro: baitu obwatahu'ra, omu kanwa ka bakaiso babiri rundi basatu ebigambo byona bigumeho.

english: So he went on to teach, after he had given thanks to God, and he taught the people the truth.
lunyoro: nukwo yamalire okugesa, obuyamazire okugisemeza nayekambisa omu mananu.

english: Blessed is the one who has believed, for the things that the Lord has told him will come true.
lunyoro: Ahairwe omugisa nogu ayaikirize; baitu birihiki'ra ebi ebiyamugambirwe hali Mukama.

english: [GENERAL) Which one of you is sick? Call on the elders of the church, and ask them to help him, so that they may pour oil on him in the name of the Lord.
lunyoro: Haroho omulinywe omuntu arwaire? ayete abakuru bekanisa, kandi bamusabire, nibamusigaho amagita omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: But now we see in a vision things that seem to us not to be good; in the future we will see with our own eyes. Now I know only a little, and at the same time I will know exactly what you know.
lunyoro: hati bunu nturo'ra omu ndolerwamu ebitarukurorwa kurungi; omu biro biri tulirorangana na maiso: hati bunu manyireho ekicweka,omu biro biri ndimanyira kimu nkokunamanyirwe kimu.

english: Anyone who hears the message about the Kingdom without knowing it comes comes from the Evil One and takes away what is in his heart. This is the one who was sown on the road.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwahu'ra ekigambo ekyobukama atarukukimanya, omubi aija, nasahura ekinyakusigirwe omu mutimagwe. Ogu nuwe asigirwe ha muhanda rubaju.

english: For what comes out of the mouth comes out from the heart, and what comes forth from the mouth defiles a person.
lunyoro: Baitu ebituruka omu kanwa biruga omu mutima, nibyo bisisa omuntu.

english: But the Pharisees and all the Jewish people did not eat unless they washed their hands. They obeyed the Jewish authorities.
lunyoro: Baitu Abafalisayo Nabayudaya bona, obubatanabaga muno omu byara byabu, tibaryaga, baitu bakwataga engeso ezabakuru:

english: The bridegroom is the one who has the bride, but the bridegroom's friend is the man who stands up and listens to him with joy because of the bridegroom. This is how my joy is made complete.
lunyoro: Omugole anyakuina omugole nuwe muswezi: baitu enganjani yomuswezi ayeme'ra namuhu'ra asemererwa muno obwiraka ryomuswezi: okusemererwa kwange oku nukwo kuhuikirire.

english: But if he does not know it, then he will not know.
lunyoro: Kandi wena obwaliba atarukumanya aleke okumanya

english: The one who sits on the good soil is the one who hears the message and understands it. He is the only one who is the father of the children, the one that plants one hundred, the other sixty, and the other thirty.
lunyoro: Kandi ondi asigirwe ha itaka erisemire, nuwogu anyakuhu'ra ekigambo nakyetegereza: nuwe ayana mali ebyana, ondi aleta kikumi. Ondi enkaga, Ondi amakumi asatu.

english: [GENERAL) I thank my God always with all my heart in prayer.
lunyoro: Ninsima Ruhanga wange ebiro byona ninkuijuka obutosa omu kusaba kwange kwona,

english: When the sun was setting, they threw it on the earth, and sat down and gathered the good things in the tombs, but the sins were washed away.
lunyoro: obubagwire, bagunaga hansi, baika'ra ahansi, basororamu ebisemire omu bicunku, baitu ebibi babinaga.

english: Don't you see that whatever goes into your mouth goes into the inside and then goes out?
lunyoro: Timurukwetegereza ngu ekinyakutaha omu kanwa kigenda munda kinagwa aheru?

english: But you will be handed over to your brothers, your brothers and sisters, and to your friends. Some of you will kill them.”
lunyoro: Baitu mulihebwayo abakaikuru nabagenzi banyu, na bene banyu, nanganjani; nabamu halinywe balibaisa.

english: [GENERAL) For this very reason, your sadness toward God has made you very eager to help one another, to correct you, to do wrong, to be afraid, to have a good conscience, and to pay taxes! In all things show yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
lunyoro: Kandi dora eki, okutuntura kwanyu kunu hali Ruhanga kukaletera inywe okwekamba kwingi kuti, kandi nokwetonganira inywenka, kandi nokubihirwa, kandi nokutina, kandi nokusima okurungi, kandi nihali! Omu byona mukyeyoleka Inywenka okutabaho omusango omu kigambo eki.

english: who was made known to the Son of God through the power of God, in the Spirit of righteousness by the resurrection of the dead.”
lunyoro: ayolekerwe nuwe Mwana wa Ruhanga omu mani, omu mwoyo gwokuhiki'ra obwokuhumbuka kwabafu' Yesu Kristo Mukama waitu,

english: But he said to him, ‘Sir, let me go back and bury my father.’
lunyoro: Baitu ogu yamugambira ati Mukama wange, leka'male okugenda okuzika isenyowe.

english: On the first day of the week, every servant who listens to his house whenever possible, things will not be settled when I come.
lunyoro: Ha kiro kyokubanza omu biro musanju, omuntu wena ayahu'lege omukaye nkokwasobora, ebintu bitasorozebwa obundiija.

english: He had seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came out of his mouth. His face was as bright as the sun.
lunyoro: Kandi omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo akwasire enyunyuzi musanju: kandi omu kanwake hakarugamu empirima erukusara eyobwogi bubiri: nobusobwe buli nkizoba okulijwa omu mani garyo.

english: And if I do what I would not want, I will not do it. For the sin that remains in me is sin.
lunyoro: Kandi obundaba ninkora ekintarukugonza, tali nyowe ninkikora. Baitu ekibi ekirukuikara omuli nyowe.

english: There were seven brothers who had wives. The bridegroom got married and died without children, leaving his wife behind.
lunyoro: Nukwo, hakaba haroho abaisemu musanju; omu hali abo akasweera, yafa atanyina mwana, nasigira mugenziwe mukaziwe;

english: For nothing is hidden that will not be exposed; nor anything that will be hidden that may not be seen will be exposed.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho ekiswekerwe ekitalisukurwa; nobukyakuba ekyaserekibwe, ekitalirorwa bwere bwere.

english: But when they came back and asked him, he stood up and said to them, “Before the rooster crows, you will get up and stone him first.”
lunyoro: Baitu obubagarukire okumukaguza yayeme'ra nabagambira ati Omulinywe atakasisaga abanze okumutera ibale.

english: It will be three branches, and it will be one on the left, and three on the right, and the other on the other side of the tree.
lunyoro: ha musago, amalembo asatu; kandi ha mukono ogwoburyo, amafumo asatu, kandi ha butobwe, amacwanta asatu.

english: You endure suffering because you are God's children, but what son is your father who has not punished you?
lunyoro: Obwokubonabonesebwa numugumisiriza; Ruhanga nabakora nkabana: baitu mwana ki ise owatabonabonesa?

english: Which one of you, then, will give the son, and the son's son, will he give him the stone? Or will he ask the fish to give him a snake instead of the fish?
lunyoro: Kandi araha omulinywe ali ise omwana nomwana obwalimusaba omugati, alimuha ibale? Rundi obwalisaba encu, erimuha enjoka omu kiikaro kyencu?

english: All who heard him were amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who was going to Jerusalem to worship the High Priest?” That is why he also brought them here and handed them over to the chief priests.
lunyoro: Bona abamuhulire bakatangara, nibagamba ngu Tinuwe onu yangagaga omu Yerusalemu abo abakungaga ibara eri? Nikyo kyamulesere na hanu abatwale bahoherwe hali banyakatagara abakuru.

english: [GENERAL) You eagerly wait for God's Day, when the heavens will burn up, and the heavenly bodies will be burned up with fire.
lunyoro: numutegereza nimwegomba muno okuija kwekiro ekya Ruhanga, nambere iguru liryaga nirihya, nebyobuhangwa biryaga nokwokebwa kwingi.

english: For most of us have only one loaf of bread, and we don't have one body; for we don`t have that one loaf.
lunyoro: baitu itwe abaingi tulimugati gumu, omubiri gumu: baitu itwe tibagaine omu mugati ogu ogumu.

english: How, then, can you believe? Do you want to honor yourselves by your own standards, and do not seek the glory that comes from God alone?
lunyoro: Nimusobora muta okuikiriza, inywe abarukwenda kuhebwa ekitinisa inywenka nainywenka, nekitinisa ekiruga hali Ruhanga omu wenka timurukukise'ra?

english: These are the ones who know that if we obey his commands, we do not know them.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo turukumanyira ngu timumanyire, obuturaba ntukwata ebiragirobye.

english: After our salvation, we know that the island is called Martha.
lunyoro: Kandi obutwamazire okujunwa, nubwo twamanyire ngu izinga niryetwa Merita.

english: Nor do you ask for more, but ask for what you want.
lunyoro: Kandi musaba, kunu timurukuhabwa, baitu musaba numugonza.

english: The seeds that fell among thorn bushes fell among the people who heard the message and went on their way. They were caught in the trap of jealousy and riches and the pleasures of this life, and they did not achieve anything good.
lunyoro: Kandi mbali abasigirwe nambere ahali amahwa, abo obubahu'ra bagendera, batangwa habwokutabana, nitungo nebyokwesemeza ebyomubwomezi bunu, kandi tibahikiriza byana ebirungi.

english: But the chief priests took some of the money and said, “This is not against the Law to put it in the Temple treasury, but to put its value on blood.”
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru batwara ebicweka ebyefeza, nibagamba ngu Tikiri kyebiragiro okubita omu ryahu'ro rya Ruhanga, baitu muhendo gwesagama.

english: While Agrippa said to Paul, “You must speak on your own behalf.” Then Paul stretched out his hand and defended himself.
lunyoro: Agulipa yagambira Pauro ati Nyikirize iwe okwegambira wenka. Nubwo Pauro yago'ra omukonogwe, nayetonganira ati:

english: [GENERAL) He was very poor, and his prosperity was like a large bundle of flour, and he fell down from heaven on people. The people were insulting God for the noise of a stone, because it was such a terrible plague.
lunyoro: Orukoba, akabale kamu obulemezi bwako nketaranta emu, rwagwa okuruga omu iguru ha bantu: abantu nibajuma Ruhanga habwomuhito gworukoba: baitu omuhito gwarwo mwingi muno.

english: They must be quiet, but they must go into houses and teach what is not right in your teaching.
lunyoro: hakire kuboha akanwa; baitu nibo bajumikira kimu amaju, nibegesa ebitahikirire obwamagoba go

english: Do not look at one another in your own words, but at the same time look at others.
lunyoro: kandi mutarora omu omu ha bigambo byanyu inywenka, baitu inywena murole nebyabandi.

english: Jesus Christ himself gave himself for us in order to redeem us from all wickedness and make us his own people, which is the means by which he has called you to do good.
lunyoro: Kristo Yesu ayayehaireyo wenka habwaitu nukwo atucungule omu kutahiki'ra kwona kandi ayesemereze wenka ihanga okuba rye wenka, erirukwekambira engeso enungi.

english: So then, God forgives those who sin against him, and he strengthens those who do so.
lunyoro: Nukwo aganyira ati owayenda okuganyira, kandi agumanganiza owayenda okugumya.

english: When we see that no one is judged by the deeds of the Law, but by the faith of Christ Jesus, we are put right with God by faith in Christ Jesus and by the works of the law. For no one will be condemned by the things that are done by the Law.
lunyoro: baitu obutuboine ngu omuntu taihibwaho omusango obwemirimo yebiragiro, bitu obwokuikiriza Kristo Yesu, tuihibweho omusango obwokuiriza Kristo, kunu tubuli obwengeso zebiragiro: baitu omuntu wean atalihibwaaho omusango obwebiragiro.

english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil and evil, and by these means these things death will never die.
lunyoro: Baitu okujunda kunu kulijwara okutajunda, nebyokufa binu birijwara okutafa.

english: Why wasn't this perfume sold for three hundred silver coins and given to the poor?
lunyoro: Kiki ekihinzire okugura amagita ganu okugaihamu edinali bikumu bisatu, okugabira abamasege?

english: He who has seen it has spoken, and he also has seen the truth. He knows that he speaks with all his heart, and you will believe.
lunyoro: Nauwe ayaboine akatebeza, kandi ogu akagamba amananu, nainywe muikirize.

english: The second time Jesus went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup of suffering cannot be taken away unless I drink it, your will be done.”
lunyoro: Yagaruka okwija obwakabiri, yasaba, nagamba ati Ai bambi Isenyowe, kinu kiraba kitarukusobora kundugaho rundi, nyowe nkinywe, ekyorukugonza nikyo kikorwe.

english: You have been redeemed by the blood of Christ, who is the great and glorious Lamb, who has no power or dominion over us.
lunyoro: baitu mukacungurwa nesagama eyomuhendo mwingi nkeyomwana gwentama ogutaroho bulema nobukakuba akamogo, niyo ya Kristo:

english: But if you have riches and see your brother in need and take care of you, how much more should God's love be in you!
lunyoro: Baitu wena nyakuina ebintu ebyomunsi, kandi narora mugenziwe nasega, kandi namukingiraho okuganyirakwe, okugonza kwa Ruhanga nukuikara kuta omuruwe?

english: Let us consider first the love you should have for one another and the love that you should do for one other.
lunyoro: kandi tutekerezege okwakambi okwehambisangana okugonzangana, nokukora engeso ezisemire;

english: Afterward, I went to Syria and Cilicia.
lunyoro: Hanyuma nkagenda omu nsi eza Busuli neza Kirikiya.

english: The next day Jesus came to them and went on the water.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro, omu kisissimuka ekyakana, akaija namberebali, nagendera ha nyanja.

english: [GENERAL) For love is my request only, because I am like Paul, who is a shepherd and is now a prisoner of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu obwokugonza ninyesengereza kwonka, baitu ninsisana nkokundi Pauro omugurusi, kandi hati bunu omunyankomo wa Kristo Yesu:

english: For it is God himself who makes us, together with you, by means of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nuwe agumya itwe hamu nainywe omu Kristo,

english: No one takes a piece of new cloth out of old cloth, but what is put in it will be covered with a cloth, and the skins will be broken to pieces.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu abazira ekikoba ekyorugoye oruhyaka ha kyokujwara ekikuzire: kiraba kitalikyo, eki ekibazirwemu kitemura kiri,ekihuru kiukanya okugaliha.

english: But if I make you sad, who will make me glad, or who will take notice of me?
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nimbatuntuza, noha arukunsemeza, rundi ogu arukufuntizibwa nyowe?

english: And now I beg you, dear woman, not to write a new commandment, but the one that was given us from the beginning, ‘Love one another.’
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu nkwesengerize mukazi, tikuli okukuhandikira ekiragiro ekihyaka, baitu rundi eki ekitwahairwe okuruga karanakara, ngu Tugonzanganege.

english: Then you will sit down at the right side of the tree, where its branches will be broken and its branches fall down, and you will know that the summer is near.
lunyoro: Kandi mwegere hali omutini orufumo rwagwo; itagi ryagwo obulinyeta, amababi nigarokera, buli mumanyire omwaka guli haihi;

english: so that you will live a good life in the sight of the people of this day, and not lose anything.
lunyoro: nukwo mugenderege Omu ngeso enungi hali abaheru, mutabuzirweho na kake.

english: What did you gain back at that time when you were now ashamed of what you have said? The result of sin is death.
lunyoro: Kandi byana ki ebimukaba muyinabyo omu biro ebi ebyebigambo ebirukubabakwasa ensoni hati bunu? Baitu emperor yebi kufa.

english: The owner of that vineyard will come tomorrow, but he will not wait for it, and he will wait for a long time.
lunyoro: Omukama womwiru ogu rubale alija hakiro ekya tategerezamu, nakasumi

english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people have been led astray from the faith and have turned away from their sins with many sorrows.
lunyoro: Baitu okwegomba erupiya nikyo kikoro ekyobubi bwona: haroho abantu abakunukirire ebi, kandi bahabisibwa okuruga omu kuikiriza, kandi nibecumita bonka nobujune bwingi.

english: You blind fools! Which is the greatest, the most holy and the most sacred gift you can offer?
lunyoro: Inywe abafu bamaiso; baitu ekirukukira obukuru kiraha? Ekisembo, rundi ekyoto ekibohoire ekisembo?

english: They are God's servants, the rich, the poor, and the humble; they are God-fearing; they do not listen to their parents.
lunyoro: abarukunoba Ruhanga, abemyehembo, abanyakwekunika, abahyangya ebigambo ebibi, abatarukuhu'ra ababazaire,

english: But because of the unfair living conditions in the winter, many others have said good-bye to move from there to Phoenicia, which is a harbor in Crete. They will look at you between the south and the south, and between the north and the west.
lunyoro: Baitu omwogo obwokutaseme'ra okuikaramu omu biro ebyembeho, abandi baingi bagamba okurugayo, rundi balisobora okuhika Foiniki, okuikarayo omu biro ebyobujune, oguli irembo rya Kerete, erirukurora hagati yobukizi obwemoso noburugaizoba, na hagati bobukizi obwoburyo noburugaizooba.

english: There was a man named Barabbas, who was bound with those who had committed murder in the riot.
lunyoro: kandi hakaba baroho omu ayetwa Baraba, aboherwe ahamu nabo abaimukirire, abakaba baisire abantu omu kuimuki'ra oku.

english: Everyone who fears the Son as the Father does. Whoever does not honor the Son does not respect the Father who sent him.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena atine Omwana, nkokkuyatina Isenyowe. Aturukutina Mwana tarukutina Isitwe ayamutumire.

english: For I have something to say to you, because you did not choose your own love at first.
lunyoro: Baitu nyina ekigambo haliwe, baitu okaleka okugonza kwawe okwokubanza.

english: Onesimus was not happy with you for a long time, but now I am happy with him and with me.
lunyoro: Onesimo, akaba atarukukugasira ira, baitu hati bunu nakugasira iwe nanyowe:

english: You are witnesses, then, and believe in the deeds of your ancestors. They have killed them, and you build their tombs.
lunyoro: Nukwo muli bakaiso, numuikiriza engeso zabasenkuru inywe: baitu nibo babaisire, nainywe mwombeka ebituro byabu.

english: And your brother Elizabeth is also the father of a son in law among his ancestors. And so his sixth son was called the firstborn.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, Erisabesi mwene wanyu, nauwe ali nenda yomwana omwojo omu bakaikurubwe: kandi kunu nukwo kwezikwe okwomukaga ayayetwaga engumba.

english: Will the owner of the vineyard do anything? He will come and destroy the tenants, and the owner from the vineyard will give the vineyard to others.
lunyoro: Nukwo mukama worugonjo rwemizabibu aligira ata? Aliija alihwerekereza abalimi, orugonjo orwemizabibu aliruha abandi.

english: He left Nazareth and went to live in Capernaum, on the other side of the lake.
lunyoro: yaruga Nazalesi, yaija yaikara Kaperenaumu, enyakuli ha nyanja, omu mutano eya

english: What I tell you, then, is what I tell ya: keep watch.
lunyoro: Kandi ekindukubagambira inywe nikyo mbagambirabona nti, Murolege.

english: [GENERAL) Because of your patient endurance and your stubborn heart, you have heard God's own anger on the Day of His anger and the result of his righteous judgment.
lunyoro: kandi obwokugumangana nomutima gwawe ogutarurwegarukamu, buli oyeyahulire wenka ekiniga hali ekiro ekyekiniga, nokusuku'rwa okwomusango ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga,

english: Love one another, and this is what you have done to all your friends in Macedonia. We beg you, my friends, to increase and increase.
lunyoro: gonzangana; kandi nukwo mukozire mali halibene banyu bona abomu Makedoni yona. Baitu tubesengerize bene baitu okweyongera nokusaga;

english: They answered, “We don't have any more than five loaves and two fish, and we will go and buy food for all these people.”
lunyoro: Bagamba ngu Titunyinabyo, rundi emigati etano nencu ibiri; rundi turagenda tugu'le ebyokurya abantu banu bona.

english: offer your gift in front of the altar, and come back and make peace with your brother, and offer your offering again.
lunyoro: oti oiheyo ekihongwa kyawe omu maiso gekyoto, ogarukeyo, obanze omale okuteraana na mwene wanyu, omale okuhayo ekihonga kyawe.

english: The dust from your city that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you, because you know that the Kingdom of God has come near you.
lunyoro: Necucu eyomu rubuga rwa nyu, erukukwatira omu bigere byaitu, nayo tugibaragalize inywe: baitu mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga buirire haihi.

english: Again he went away, wept, and spoke the same thing, and so he went back home.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okurugayo, yaaba, nagamba ebigambo bimu na biri, Kandi yagaruka

english: increase your knowledge, and increase your self-control; increase your peace, and reverence for God;
lunyoro: kukira muno omu kumanya; kandi hali okumanya mwongereho okwerinda kwanyu: kandi hali okugumangana mwongereze okutina Ruhanga;

english: All who were in the Council saw him face-to-face, as an angel.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abakaba baikalire omu rukurato bamugumyaho amaiso nibamurora amaisoge nigasisana nkagamaraika.

english: I was not afraid to tell you anything that would be right, and to teach you publicly and from house to house.
lunyoro: kandi ntatine okubatebeza ekigambo kyona ekisemre nokubegesa bwerebwere, nomu nju emuemu,

english: [GENERAL) May peace be with all those who follow it, and peace be upon them, and mercy, and toward the people of God.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abalikurutira omulingo gunu, obusinge bube halibo, nokuganyirwa, na hali Isaleri owa Ruhanga.

english: But when the righteous man stayed among them, he saw and heard them and saw and had compassion on them all day long because of their wicked deeds.
lunyoro: baitu omusaija ogu ahikirire obuyaikaraga omulibo narora nahu'ra yabonabonaga obukyabukya omu mutimagwe oguhikirire obwengeso zabu ezokwema.

english: In the past we have been tempted in doing what the Gentiles want to do, in order to live immorally, in the habit of drinking wine, in love, in sexual immorality, and in the worship of idols.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebyahinguitrho nibisobora okutumara okukora Abamahanga ebibagonza, nokugendera omu busihani, nokwegomba, nokusomasoma amarwa, nebyokubandwa, nobutamizi, nokuramya ebisisani okurukunugwa:

english: But you must obey my teaching, my conduct, my teaching. My faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.
lunyoro: baitu iwe okukuratira okwegesa kwange, nengeso zange, nokuhanura kwange nokuikiriza kwange nokugumisiriza kwange namani gange nokugonza kwange

english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for this is his name of being known) rebelled against them and tried to deceive the older men by faith.
lunyoro: Baitu Erima omurogo (baitu niryo ibararye okulimanyisibwa) yahakana nabo nagonza okuhabisa owisaza omu kuikiriza.

english: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
lunyoro: Baitu mukafa, kandi obwomezi bwanyu buserekerwe hamu na Kristo omu Ruhanga.

english: It would have been better for that servant to have a large millstone tied around his neck and be thrown into the sea, than for him to have one of these little ones thrown into it.
lunyoro: hakire ogu okubohwa orubengo ha bikya nokunagwa omu nyanja, okukira okutabaijura omu omuli abo abato.

english: His heart is very large for you, just as he remembers all of you, because you believed in him with fear and trembling.
lunyoro: Kandi nomutimagwe guli halinywe muno muno muno, obuyaijukire okuhu'ra kwanyu inywena, nkokumwamuirize omu kutina nomu kutukumira.

english: A Samaritan woman came to draw some water, and Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink of water.”
lunyoro: Haizire omukazi Omusamaliya okutaha amaizi: Yesu yamugambira ati Mpa nywe.

english: A certain priest was going down that road, but he did not know where he was going. When he saw him, he went on the other side of the road and went on.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omu akaba nasirimuka omu muhanda ogu atakimanyireho: obuyamuboine yamuhinguraho ha rubaju, yagenda.

english: Our ancestors brought them with them to their death with them and with them Jonah, who brought the land of the nations into the presence of our ancestors until the time of David.
lunyoro: Ibaisenkuru itwe nabo eyibalesere hamu na Yonabo ebiyalesere ensi zamahanga, Ruhanga agayabingire omu maiso gabaisenkurwitwe, okuhikya ebiro bya Daudi;

english: For he who did the same thing in Peter's case among the people of the circumcision, the same one who did it with me, the one who was not circumcised.
lunyoro: baitu ogu ayakolire omu Petero obukwenda hali abokkusarwa, nuwe yakolire omuli nyowe obukwenda halli abokutasarwa.

english: Asaph was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the son of Joram.
