lunyoro: Asa akazara Yehosafati; Yrhosafati akazara Yoramu;

english: He will reward those who are seeking glory, honor, and immortality for their eagerness in doing good, and he will reward them with eternal life.
lunyoro: abo abase'ra okusimwa nekitinisa nobutajunda obwokwekamba omu mulimo omurungi, aliga'ra obwomezi obwebiro nebiro:

english: When they heard this, they got up and dragged him out of the city and led him off to the hill country where they had built their city and lowered him to the ground.
lunyoro: obubahulire ebi; baimuka, bamunaga heru yorubuga, bamutwara hakihanga kyorusozi orubayombekereho orubuga rwabu, bamunage hansi.

lunyoro: Yantwara omu Mwoyo hali orusozi orukoto oruraihire, yanyoleka orubuga orurukwera Yerusalemu, nurusirimuka okuruga omu iguru hali Ruhanga,

lunyoro: Kandi obubataraterine bonka bagenda, Pauro obuyamazire okugamba ekigambo kimu ati omwoyo Ogurukwera akagambira kurungi baisexnkuru inywe omu nabi

lunyoro: Mukama wenju obwalikamara okuimuka, nokukingaho oruigi, nainywe numubanza okweme'ra aheru, nokweranga ha ruigi, numugamba ngu Mukama waitu otukingu'leho; nauwe aligarukamu nabagambira ati Timbamanyire, nambere murugire;

english: Festus wanted to gain favor with the Jews, so he asked Paul, “Do you want to go to Jerusalem and be tried in the presence of four witnesses for these things?”
lunyoro: Baitu Fesito obuyagondeze okusimwa Abayudaya, yagarukamu Pauro nagamba ati Noyenda okutemba Yerusalemu ocwerweyo omusango owebigambo binu omu maiso gane?

lunyoro: Simon petero yamusima ogu namugambira ati Tugambire owagambireho okwali.

english: Can a fig tree, my friends, bear olive branches or a vine figs? Even if a spring bears figs, it can't bear figs.
lunyoro: Omutini nugusobora bene baitu okwana zeituni rundi omuzabibu okwana etini? nobugakuba amaizi agekisura, tigasobora okurugamu amarungi.

english: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread that I will give is my flesh, because the world is alive.”
lunyoro: Ninyowe byokurya ebyomire ebyarugire omu iguru: omuntu wena obwarya ha byokuryaga ebi, aryomera ebiro nebiro: ego, nebyokurya ebindihayo nugwo mubiri gwange, obwobwomezi Bwensi.

english: From now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right side of God's power.”
lunyoro: Baitu okuruga hati Omwana womuntu araika'raga ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwamani gwa Ruhanga.

english: After their resurrection, they arrived at the place called Gennesaret.
lunyoro: Obubamazire okwambuka, bahika ha mugongo ogwa Genezalesi.

english: Let no one rob you of your prize by boasting about what you have seen and boasting about the angels; instead, be proud of what you see and do not boast about what your bodies have seen.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena aleke okubanyanga empera yanyu omu kwebundaza okwayenzire wenka, nokuramya bamaraika, aikaire omwebi ebyaboine, nayenyumirirza busa omu magezi gomubirigwe,

english: They sold the potter's field, and the Lord had given me what the Lord wanted.
lunyoro: ensi yomubumbi; Mukama nko kuyandagire.

english: And to godliness add love to your affection for others, and to brotherly affection add love.
lunyoro: Kandi hali okutina Ruhanga mwongereho okugonzaga bene banyu; kandi hali okugonza bene banyu mwongeze okugonzangana.

english: the son of Boaz, the son in law of Salmon, the father of Obed, the mother of Boaz.
lunyoro: owa Boazi, owa Salimoni, owa Obeda,

english: No soldier has a belt around his waist to protect him from the edge of the sword. Happy is the one who wrote you as a soldier.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho murwani obwaramaga ayetaba nebigambo byobwomezi bunu; nukwo asimwe ogu anyamuhandikire okuba omurwani.

english: I should have the same concern for you all, because I myself am with you in my darkness, and you are all with me in my grace, in my trials, and in the preaching of the Good News and building up yourselves.
lunyoro: nkokukihikirire nyowe okutekereza nti habwanyu inywena, baitu ndi nainywe omu tima gwange, kandi nainywena numuterana nanyowe omu mbabazi, omu nsengo zange nomu kutonganira njiri nokugigumya.

english: For in Jerusalem is the free gift that comes down from God, our Father.
lunyoro: Baitu Yerusalemu orwomu iguru rwobugabe, nuwe nyina itwe.

lunyoro: Hakabaho empaka nyingi omu bitebe haruwe: abandi nibagamba ngu Murungi; abandi bagamba ngu Nangwa,

english: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, “Why are you untyling it?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibasibu'ra omwana gwenkaina, bakama bagwo babagambira ngu Nimuiburu'ra ki omwana gwendo?

english: The women who had followed him from Galilee saw the tomb and the body taken away.
lunyoro: Nabakazi abarugire Galiraya hamu nauwe bakuratira enyuma, barora ekituro nomutumbi okugwatairweho.

english: But they thought that he would betray them or that he was about to fall dead. But when they stayed long waiting for him, they did not see what had happened to him, so they changed their minds and said, “He is a sinner!”
lunyoro: Baitu batekereza ngu arazimba, rundi aragwa bwango afire, baitu obubaikaireho muno okurole'ra, kandi tibabona kibi ekyamubaireho, bahinduka nibagamba ngu mucwezi.

english: The world is passing away and so is its desire, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live also.
lunyoro: Hasigaire akacu akake, ensi okutandora obundi; baitu inywe mundora: obwokwomera nyowe, nukow nainywe muliba bomezi.

english: The dead man sat down and began to talk, and he gave him to his mother.
lunyoro: Nauwe akaba afire yaika'ra, yabanza okubaza. Yamuha nyina.

english: He got up and began to sink down in the water and said to the sea, “Hurry up!” The wind died down, and there was a great calm.
lunyoro: Yasisimuka, yacomera ekiyaga, nagambira enyanja ati Leka, culera.Ekiyaga kyahwaho, habaho okuculera kwinngi.

lunyoro: Baitu arukukira araha? Ogu anyakuikalire ha byokurya, rundi ogu anyakuhereza? Tinuwogu anyakuika'ra ha byokurya? Baitu nyowe hagati yanyu ninsisana nkanyakuli abahereza.

english: and all the people who belong to him, son of David.
lunyoro: nebitebe byona byanuwe Mwana wa daudi?

english: On the good soil, they are the ones who hear the message with their whole heart, good and firm, and sound like a baby.
lunyoro: Kandi ha itaka erisemire, nibo bahu'ra ekigambo omu mitima esemire, emirungi, bakigumya, bekamba okwana ebyana.

english: His parents said, “He is a great man.
lunyoro: Nikyo abamuzaire bagambire ngu Mukuru ogu;

english: or he who teaches must be humble in his teaching.
lunyoro: rundi anyakwegesa, ayekambe omu kwegesakwe:

english: For your words will be a curse to you, and your words of judgment will be forgiven.
lunyoro: Baitu ebigambo byawe nibyo birikuihaho omusango, nebigambo byawe ebyokuhanura nibyo birirkusingisa omusango.

english: the son of Cainan, the sonof Arphaxad, the father of Noah, the mother of Lamech,
lunyoro: owa Eber, owa Sera, owa Kainani, owa Apakisadi, owa Nuha, owa Rameka,

english: For in that way they will remind you of sins every year.
lunyoro: Baitu omubyo harumu okuijukya ebibi omwaka nomwaka.

english: I was a stranger, but you would not take me in. I was naked, but You would not clothe me; I was sick, but then you would fast and not wash me.
lunyoro: omunyaihanga mutangonyese; nkaba ndi busa mutanjweke, nkaba ndwaire, omunkomo, mutansule.

english: I am being given the end of your faith, so that your salvation may be complete with God.
lunyoro: Kandi numhabwa empero eyokuikirizibwa kwanyu, nukwo kujunwa kwemyoyo yanyu.

english: Then the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple, dressed in clean linen cloths and wearing gold sashes around their chests.
lunyoro: haruga omu yekaru bamaraika musanju, abakaba bayina emihito omusanju, bajwaire amabale amarungi agarukwangasana, kandi betegere omu kifuba nemyeko ya zabu.

english: I turned around to see the voice that spoke to me. As soon as I turned in, I saw seven gold lampstands,
lunyoro: Nahinduka okurora iraka eryabalize nanyowe. Kandi obunahindukire nkarora etabaza musanju eza zabu;

english: They worshiped God's eternal presence, like the likeness of birds, reptiles, and wild animals.
lunyoro: kandi bakahingisa ekitinisa kya Ruhanga atahwaho omu kisisani ekyomuntu arukuhwaho, okukisisaniza nkekyebinyakuku'ruka nekyebinyina amaguru ana nekyekinyakweku'ra.

english: Respect your father and your mother, which is the first commandment of the covenant.
lunyoro: So na nyoko obatinege ( nikyo kiragiro kyokubanza ekinyakuroho omurago),

lunyoro: Tindukugamba obwokutaga: baitu nkega nti nkokundi ebiro byona, nukwo 'nihege.

lunyoro: kandi owakabirir yamuswera, yafa, kandi nauwe atasigeho bana. Nowakasatu nukwo ati:

lunyoro: Baitu bo, obubarabire okuruga Perega, bahika Antyokiya orwa Pisidia; kandi bakataha omu iso'rokaniro ha kiro kya Sabiti, baika'ra.

lunyoro: Kakuba muli bensi, ensi yakugondeze abayo; baitu inywe obwokutaba ben nsi, rundi nyowe nkabakoma omu nsi, ensi nikyo ebanobera.

english: This wisdom is not that comes down from heaven, but comes down on the earth, and it is from the power of the Devil.
lunyoro: Amagezi ganu tigali ago agarukuruga haiguru, baitu ga hansi, gokuzarwa kwonka, ga Setani.

english: He begged them to go to the synagogues in Damascus to see the people on that road, both men and women, who had come to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ebaruha ezokugenda Damasiko, hali amaso'rokaniro, obwalibonayo abantu Abomuhanda ogu, rundi abasaija, Rundi abakazi, ababoine abalete Yerusalemu.

english: But this son of mine was dead and has been raised to life, and he was lost, but now he has been found.
lunyoro: baitu omwana wange onu akaba afire, ahumbukire; akaba azahire, azahukire.

lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Tingwire iraro, Fesito omurungi muno; baitu ningamba ebigambo ebyamananu nokwekenga.

english: But the Sadducees said, “There is no difference between a resurrection or an angel or a spirit; the Pharisees believe everything.”

english: “Sir,” I tell you, “when a young man is a slave, he is not greater than his master or master of all things.
lunyoro: Baitu ningamba nti omugwetwa obwaba akyali omuto takira na kake omuiru rubale, nobwaraba ali mukama wa byona;

english: The servants asked him, “Do you want us to go and find him?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale bamugambira ngu Noyenda tugende tuzomberemu?

english: When they see this, they will go with those who believe, and in my name they will drive out demons and speak in new words.
lunyoro: Kandi obwokuro'raho bunu buligenda nabo abaliikiriza: omu ibara ryange numwo balibinga emizimu; balibaza omu ngambo empyaka:

english: When he saw that the Jews were ready, he seized Peter again. This was during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaboine Abayudaya bakisimire, yagaruka okukwata na Petero. Ebi bikaba biri biro ebyemigati etatumbisibwe.

english: But Abraham said, ‘My son, remember that you were given your good things in the days of your life, and Lazarus was given the bad things. But now he has been made clean, and you will be made clean.’
lunyoro: Baitu Iburahimu yagamba ati Mwana wange, ijuka iwe okahebwa ebirungi byawe omu biro byobwomezi bwawe, na Razaro nukwo yahairwe ebibihire: baitu hati bunu ahumuzibwe hanuna, iwe nohu'rwa.

english: The Creator of the new covenant, together with the shed blood of his Son, speaks better than that of Abel.
lunyoro: Omutonganizi owekiregano ekihyaka, na hali esagama eoyokumisira, eru kugamba ebirungi okukira eya Aberi.

english: Many rebuked him, saying, “Son of David! Have mercy on me!” But he cried out in a loud voice, “You son of David!”
lunyoro: Baingi bamuhana, aculere: Baitu yagarukira okwami'ra muno ati iwe omwana wa daudi onganyire.

english: When they did this, a large crowd was gathered, and the weeds were broken off.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakozire bati bakwasa encunyingi muno: ebisoha nibi'sana okucweka;

english: And if I am glad about you and about your faith, I am happy with all of you.
lunyoro: Kandi nobundaba nimisirwa ha Kyonzira nokuhereza kwokuikiriza kwanyu, ninsemererwa, kandi ninsemere'rwa hamu nainywe inywena;

english: So then, when you make me proud in my presence, everything will be yours.
lunyoro: Nukwo obworandamya omu maiso gange, bwona buraba bwawe.

english: They made fun of him and said, “Stay with us, because now the rooster crows and the rooster is already crowed.” So he went in to stay with them.
lunyoro: Bamuhambiriza nubagamba ngu Ikara naitwe: baitu hati kairirizi, nobuire bwa'sa kuira. Yatahamu okuikara nabo.

english: I am telling you the truth: the trumpet will not sound unless it has already been blown in the near future, but if it has died and has been blown about a long time.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Akajuma kengano obukatagwa omu itakanikafa, kaikaraho konka; baitu obukaraba nikafa, kana ebyana bingi.

english: And we are not the only ones who came to him, but he has been refreshed by you, because he has told us how you longed for me and how you have helped me. And so I am even happier.
lunyoro: kandi tukuli kuijakwe kwonka, baitu nokuhumuzibwa okuyahumuzibwe omulinywe, obuyatutebize okwegomba kwanyu okuruga, nempamo zanyu, nihali ryanyu habwange; kandi nikyo nyeyongerire okusemererwa.

english: Moses also revealed the raising of the dead, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God Of Jacob.’
lunyoro: Kandi okuhumbuka okwabafu, na Musa akakwoleka ha Rusaka obuyayesere Mukama Ruhanga wa Iburahimu, na Ruhanga Isaka, na ruhanga wa Yakobo.

english: For nation will fight against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes.
lunyoro: baitu ihanga liriramagira ihanga, nomukama aliramagira omukama; halibaho ekiho nemisisa handi na handi.

english: His fame spread everywhere in the world around him.
lunyoro: Nebigambobye bikaranganwa omu biikaro byona ebyomunsi ezihe'raine.

english: When the whole body is joined together in perfect unity, it binds itself together in every order, as the whole part is spread by the work being done to make it possible for each other to be united in love.
lunyoro: baitu omubiri gwona obwokuteranizibwa kurungi, nugusumikanizibwa hamu engiga zona nizikonyerangana, nkomulimo ogurukulengerwa ebicweka byona okuguli, omubiri ngugweyongera okwombekwa omu kugonzangana.

english: There were seven sons, the sons of Sceva, the Jewish High Priest, who did this.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho abana musanju, aba Sikewa Omuyudaya nyakatagara omukuru, abakozire bati.

english: For I will show him how much he will suffer for my sake.
lunyoro: baitu ndimwoleka obujune obwingi obwalibona habwa ibara ryange.

english: Or how can you say to your brother, ‘Please, brother, let me take that speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself don't see the log in your own eye? First take the log out of his eye, and then you will see clearly to take away the speck out from your brother's eye.
lunyoro: Rundi nosobora ota okugambira mugenzi wawe ngu Mugenzi wange, kankuiheho akantu akali haliso ryawe, kandi naiwe torukurora nyomyo enyakuli ha liso ryawe? Mugobya iwe, banza oiheho enyomyo na liso ryawe, nukwo olihweza kulingi okuihaho akankalikali ha liso ryomugenzi wawe.

english: For the things that have not been seen since the creation of the world are seen by him, and they are seen only by the things he has made, namely, the eternal power that he has. They cannot judge themselves.
lunyoro: Baitu ebye ebitarukurorwa okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi, nibirolerwa kimu, nibimanyirwa hali ebi ebyahangirwe, nigo manige agatahwaho nobubwaruhangabwe; batasobora okweyihaho omusango:

english: If the work of every person is to be done, then he who built it will be repaid for it.
lunyoro: Omulimo ogwomuntu wena obuguliikaraho oguyayombekere, alihabwa empera.

english: When he saw them, he was afraid of them, because the wind was blowing against them, and on the next day he came to them and went on his way through the lake. He was about to pass them by,
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaboine nibatenekaniza okugoya, baitu omuyaga gukaba gubaturukire omu maiso, omu kisisimuka ekyakana ekyekiro yaija namberebali, nagendera ha nyanja; kandi akaba na'sana kubahinguraho:

english: The money is what we know: we speak what we do know, and we proclaim what we have seen; and you do not believe what we proclaim.
lunyoro: Itwe tugamba ebitumanyire, tutebeza ebitwaboine; nainywe timuikiriza ebyokutebeza byaitu.

english: But the time will come when they will not believe and will not obey sound doctrine, because they will turn their ears away from the truth and will turn away from their sins to the teachers of the Law.
lunyoro: baitu ebiro biriija obubataliikiriza okuhu'ra okwegesa okwomire; baitu amatu nigabanuli'ra baryetungira bonka abegesa:

english: They had heard only that he was the one who was the first to be killed, and now he is preaching the faith that he once tried to destroy.
lunyoro: bahulire kwonka ngu Ogu ayatuhigaga kara, hati bunu natebeza okuikiriza okuyahwerekerezaga;

english: They were all amazed and said to one another, “What is this? With authority and power he commands the evil spirits to come out of him!”
lunyoro: Okuhuni'ra kwabakwata bona, kandi bagambirangana bonka ngu Ekigambo kinu kiki? Baitu nobusobozi namani nukwo aragira emizimu emibi, erugamu.

english: When he came into one house, ten men with him drew near to him,
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahaire omu kika ekimu, bamuitirina abantu ikumi abe bigenge,

english: The south wind died down, and they thought that they had seen what they wanted. So they lowered the ship's anchor and sailed away to Crete.
lunyoro: Obumuyaga ogwobukizi bwoburyo obugwahoire mpora, batekereza ngu baboine ekibagondeze, bahimba ekinyakusibika ekyombo, bahinguraho Kerete, haihi nomusa.

english: Azor was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the son of Achim. Achim was the mother of Eliud.
lunyoro: Azoli akazara Sadoka; Sadoka akazara Akimu; Akimu akazara Eriudi;

english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: ‘I will never leave you and tell you that you have a chance to help me for your own good.’
lunyoro: nyowe Pauro mpandikire nomukono gwange nti nyowe ndikama'ra ndeke okukugambira nti onyina ibanja namberendi habwawe wenka.

english: The men in the boat praised Jesus, saying, “You really are the Son of God!”
lunyoro: Abakba bali omu bwato bamuramya, nibagamba ngu Mazimakwo niwe mwana wa Ruhanga.

english: But I know that he did not finish the job and that he himself would kill him, and when Emperor Augustus himself died, he was about to put him to death.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nkamanya atakoke kigambo ekihikirire okumuisa: kandi nauwe wenka obuyajulirire Augusito nacwa okumutwekayo.

english: He did not send him to you, and said, ‘Do not go into this house.’
lunyoro: Tamwohereza okugenda owe, nagamba ati Otataha nomu kika kinu.

english: The work of everyone will be made known to you, because on that very day you will be revealed by fire. And fire is the work of every man to destroy it.
lunyoro: omulimo gwabantu bona gulimanyisibwa:baitu ekiro eki kirigumanyisa, baitu gulisuku'rwa omu mu'ro: kandi nomu'ro nugwo girirenga omulimo gwomuntu wena okugurukusisa.

english: Then he sent another slave, and they killed him; many others, beating some, and killing others.
lunyoro: Yatuma ondi; nogu bamuita: nabandi baingi; abandi nibabatera, abandi nibabaita.

english: and said to them, “Whoever welcomes in my name one of these little ones also welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes not only me but also the one who sent me.”
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Omuntu wena aliikiriza omu hali abana abato abarukusisana nkonu, omu ibara ryange, buli aikirize nyowe: nomuntu wena arukuikiriza nyowe, taikiriza nyowe baitu ogu ayantumire.

english: “I enjoy all the food,” he answered.
lunyoro: yagambire ati Ninsemeza ebiribwa byona.

english: and will teach you the truth at all times, so that you will not be able to believe it at all.
lunyoro: kandi basege ebiro byona nibegesa, nukwo batahike omu kuikiriza kwona.

english: But when Jesus came to the entrance of the courtyard, another girl saw him and said to the people there, “He was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
lunyoro: Baitu obuyaturukire okuhika omu kiti kyomuryango, Omuisiki ondi yamubona, nagambira abantu abakaba baroho ati Nonu akabali hamu na Yesu Munazarayo.

english: Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek to be reconciled to one another. Are you reconciled to a woman? Don`t seek a wife.
lunyoro: Okaba okahwirwe nomukazi? Otase'ra okubaganizibwamu. Okaba onyina omukazi? Otalise'ra mukazi.

english: When the Devil himself is divided, his kingdom will last forever. You say that I drive out demons because Beelzebul.
lunyoro: Kandi Setani nauwe obwabaganizibwamu wenka, obukamabwe buliikaraho buta Baitu inywe numugamba ngu Nyowe mbinga emizimu habwa Beerezebuli.

english: So he went to the second, and said the same thing to them. Again the man said, “Go away, father,” but he did not go.
lunyoro: Yaija hali owakabiri yagamba kimu na kiri. Nauwe yagarukamu nagamba ati kangende tata: baitu atagende.

english: For I do not allow a woman to teach or to have authority over a man, but to be in silence.
lunyoro: Baitu tindukuikiriza omukazi okwegesa, nobukwakuba okulema omusaija, baitu okuikara omu baculezi.

english: They sat down all the way to the house, and as they were walking, Jesus acted as if he were going to pass by.
lunyoro: Kandi bakai'ra haihi nekika, hakaba nibagenda: uwe nasisana nkayenzire okuhinguraho.

english: He has made his word come true through all the nations of the earth, and he has fixed the times and the limits of the places where they live.
lunyoro: ndi ogu ayasalize ihanga ryona eriri hansi embaju zona, obuyaragire okubateraho ebiro, nemitano eyebiikaro byabu;

english: And so you will be sad because of the way I answer you, ‘I tell my children.’
lunyoro: Kandi nainywe obwokungaru'ra muti (ningambira abana bange) mugalihe.

english: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. Once there was a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
lunyoro: Obukama obwomu iguru nubusisanizibwa nkomuntu akabali omukama, ayagondeze okubara omuhendo nabairube rubale.

english: [GENERAL) Look! Your house is abandoned to you, and I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord.’
lunyoro: Dora, enju yanyu abasigirwe kifuka, kandi nimbagambira nti Timulindora, okuhikya obumuligamba ngu Ahairwe omugida arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama.

english: For first of all, you should take care of your own food in your eating, and then someone else will be hungry and others will be thirsty.
lunyoro: baitu wena abanza omutahiwe okukwata ha byokuryabye wenka omu kurya kwanyu: kandi ondi arumwa enjara nondi atamira.

english: I am happy to write this to you soon.
lunyoro: Ngondeze okuhandika binu mpora namberoli:

english: When anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not go into your homes or greet him.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaraijaga namberemuli, atrukuleta okwegesa kunu, Mutalimuiriza omu nju yanyu, kunu mutalimuramukta:

english: Jesus answered them, “I have already told you, but you have not heard. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you, too, want to be his disciples?”
lunyoro: Yabagarukamu ati Mazire okubagambira baitu timuhulire: kiki ekibagondeseze okuhu'ra obwakabiri? Kandi nainywe nimwenda okufoka abegeswabe?

english: They will throw you down and your children within you. They will not leave a stone in you, because you did not know the time when you would be made king.
lunyoro: barakutera hansi nabana bawe omunda yawe; tibalisiga ibale erinyakuliha ibale; baitu otamanye ebiro ebyokubungirwa kwawe.

english: They sold their possessions and goods and distributed them to all, according to the needs of the scattered people.
lunyoro: bagura ebyobuguda byabu nebintu byabu nibabigabira bona nkokubasegere omuomu.

english: For it is not right for me to take you to court, but also to put you in prison.
lunyoro: Baitu tiguli musango, nyowe ntabajwahye, baitu nkabandi mugobya.

english: From now on, however, I no longer want to tell anyone in this name.
lunyoro: Baitu kitagaruka okuranganwa omubantu tubakange, okuruga hati baleke okugambira omuntu wena omu ibara linu.

english: He came to the gate of the city, and behold, the dead body of the town was outside, and the only son who was born to the woman was outside. Many in the city were with him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyairire haihi nirembo ryorubuga, dora, omufu wamalere aheru, omwana ayazairwe omu wenka nyina, nogu akabali mufakati: kandi abantu baingi abomu rubuga bakaba bali nauwe.

english: For the poor are the ones who will always be with them, and you will always do what you want to do for them, but you will not always be able to do what I want you to do.
lunyoro: Baitu abasege nibo muikara nabo obutosa; kandi obumurakagonzaga bwona murasoboraga okubakora okurungi: baitu nyowe timuikara nanyowe obutosa.

english: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent his servant to tell the invited guests, ‘Come and get ready,’ because all these things are ready.
lunyoro: Kandi akasumi akobugenyi obukahikire yatuma omuiruwe rubale okugambira abayeserwe ngu Muije; baitu bunu byona bitekanize.

english: And what you have heard from me in many witnesses is that you have reached out to faithful people, who will be able to teach others.
lunyoro: Kandi ebi ebiwahulire namberendi omu bakaiso baingi, nibyo oyahuze abantu abokwesiga, abalisobora okwegesa abandi.

english: You say, ‘Do not commit adultery; do you commit adultery? Do you commit murder? Do not commit murder! Do you rob temples?’
lunyoro: Iwe anyakugamba ngu Otalisihana, osihana, oiba ebyomu mabandiro?

english: His mother's sister, Simon, was sick and suffering from a dreaded skin disease. At once they told him about her.
lunyoro: Kandi nyinazara Simoni akaba abyamire, arwaire omusuija; ahonaho bamutebeza okwali:

english: And this news was spread all over the world.
lunyoro: Nebigambo binu bikaranganwa omu nsi ezi zona.

english: The Jewish authorities said to one another, “Where is this man? We don't know where he is going; he wants to go to those who belong to the Greek Empire and teach the Greeks?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagambirangana ngu Ogu nayenda kugenda nkaha, itwe nambere tutalimubona? Nayenda kugenda hali abo abatabanire omu bayonani, ayegese Abayonani?

english: At that time Emperor Augustus ordered the census to be handed over to all the world.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika omu biro ebi, ekiragiro kikaruga hali Kaisali Augusito, abensi zona okuhandikwa.

english: For we are glad when we are weak and you are strong. And that is why we ask you one question.
lunyoro: Baitu tusemererwa itwe obutufoka abobugara, inywe mubebamani: kandi nikyo turukusaba inywe muku'le kimu.

english: He took a cup, gave thanks to God, and said, “Take this and share it among yourselves.”
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, obuyamazire okusima yagamba ati Mukwate enu mugibagane inywenka.

english: Many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.
lunyoro: Nabanabi baingi abebisuba abalija, balihabisa baingi.

english: They could not convince him that he was speaking in public, so they were surprised that he had turned back and said good-bye to them.
lunyoro: Kandi batasobole kumuhambiriza obwekigambo eki omu maiso gabantu: nibahuni'ra obwokugarukamukwe, nibaculera kwonka.

english: They did not see it, and so many blind and lame people came to him. But two men later came to Jesus.
lunyoro: kandi batakibone, bakaiso abebisuba nobubaizire baingi. Baitu hanyuma hakaija babiri,

english: You too are the ones to whom God has poured out his Spirit and who lives in you. You do not force anyone to teach you, but the truth that comes from him is not in you; you must remain in union with him and remain in Christ.
lunyoro: Nainywe okuseswaho amagita okumwahairwe haruwe nukuikara omulinywe, kandi timurukutanga omuntu wena okubegesa: baitu nkokusesakwe oku okukuli kwa mazima kunu tikuli kwebisuba, kandi nkokukwabegeseze, nukwo muikalege omuruwe.

english: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the mother of Matthan. Matthan was the son of Jacob.
lunyoro: Eriudi akazara Eryeza; Eryeza akazara Matani; Matani akazara Ykobo;

english: Everyone will hate you for my name's sake, and whoever holds out to the end will be saved.
lunyoro: Nainywe mulinobwa abantu bona okkubajunana ibara ryange: kandi anyakuguma okkuhikya empero, nuwe alijunwa.

english: So then, every descendant from Abraham to David is fourteen; every descendant is fourteen, from David to the exile in Babylon; every one from Babylon to the Messiah is fourteen.
lunyoro: Nukwo buti, obuijukuru bwona, okuruga ha Iburahimu okuhika ha Daudi, buijukuru ikumi nabana; kandi, okuraijukuru wa Daudi okuhikyaokutwarwa Baburoni, buijuka ikumi na ina; kandi,, okuruga hali okutwarwa Baburon okuhika hali Masiya, bui obukumi nabuna.

english: [GENERAL) In the same way, God's righteousness, by means of his faithfulness through Jesus Christ, is perfect for all those who believe. For there is no difference.
lunyoro: nukwo kuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga obwokwesigwaakwe obwokukora habwa Yesu Kristo, hali bona abarukuikiriza; baitu busaho kwahuramu:

english: Do what you have heard and seen and heard and saw: do what you hear and understand, and the God of peace will be with you.
lunyoro: Kuko'ra byona ebimwategere nebimmwahairwe nebimwahulire nebimwaboine namberendi. Kandi Ruhanga owobusinge araikaraga nainywe.

english: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices. That is why every High Priest must be appointed to serve, to offer offerings and offerings. That's why the High Priest has to have something to offer.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara omukuru wena atebwaho obwomulimo ogwokuhongaga ebisembo nebyonzira: nikyo kihikirire nyakatakara wena kutebwaho habwebi: nukwo kihiki'le nyina ekintu ekyokuhonga.

english: I heard the number of those who had been sealed: four thousand men, who were sealed with the seal of the covenant of the people of Israel.
lunyoro: Nabahu'ra omuhendo gwabu abatairweho akokuro'raho ngu kasirira mubukumi buna mwenkumi ina, abatairweyo omukono gwabu bona abana ba Isaleri, ekiragano.

english: The one who is sown in the field is the one who hears the word, does not the scene of the world, and the things that are sown in it do not bear fruit.
lunyoro: Nogu asigirwe omu mahwa nuwogu anyakuhu'ra ekigambo, nokutabana okwensi, nebisuba ebiitungo bihukya ekigambo, nauwe tayana.

english: And why not say, ‘Let us do what is good and good’—just as we have already done—and yet others have told us, ‘This is what we say.’—they will be put right with God.
lunyoro: Kandi kiki ekitutangire okugamba ngu Tukolege ekibi ekirungi kiike?Nkokubatuhangirire kandi abandi nkokubatebize ngu nukwo tugamba tuti; abo okucwerwa omusango kwoburyo.

english: There was a man who owed him two thousand coins, one owed him fifty silver coins, and the other owed him five thousand coins.
lunyoro: Hakaba haroho omuntu ayayohoraga, akaba ayina abarukutonga babiri: omu akaba namutonga edinali bikumi bitano, nondi amakumi atano.

english: They will kill him, and the third day he will be raised to life.” They were very sad.
lunyoro: bamutera balimuita: naha kiro ekyakasatu alihumburwa. Baganya muno.

english: Give to the one who asks you, and to the other who wants to borrow money do not rob you of your life.
lunyoro: Omusaija anyakusaba omuhe: nogu anyakwenda okukwohoza otalimutera mabega.

english: And all those who want to live in godly devotion in union with Christ Jesus will be persecuted.
lunyoro: Kandi mazimakwo bona abarukwendfa okukwata engeso ezokutina Ruhanga omu Kristo Yesu balihiganizibwa.

english: For if we have sinned against God, we are sinning against him; if we do not take care of our sins, we have been kept safe from you.
lunyoro: Obuturaba twagayire, tugayire hali Ruhanga: obuturaba ntwerinda, twerinzire halinywe.

english: No one will hear his voice in the streets.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu alihu'ra irakarye omu makute.

english: This is better seen than any other priest who has been raised from death to life in the likeness of Melchizedek.
lunyoro: Kandi ebi ebiturukugamba nibikira okumanyisibwa, rundi nyakatagara ondi obwaimuka nkekisisani ekya Merekizedeka okukiri,

english: So they took the money and sold it to the owner of the vineyard to be sold for a sum of money from the tenants.
lunyoro: Bahanura, babiguramu omusiri ogwomubumbi, okuzikamuga abanyaihanga.

english: But when the people of Israel obeyed the Law of Moses, they did not obey these commandments.
lunyoro: baitu Isaleri, obubakuratire ebiragiro ebyokuhiki'ra batahike hali ebiragiro ebi.

english: But they did not understand God's righteousness, and wanted to know for themselves that they had not heard the righteousness of God.
lunyoro: Kandi obubataramanyire okuhiki'ra kwa Ruhanga kandi nibase'ra okumanya okwabu bonka, batacule'le oku kuhiki'ra okwa Ruhanga

english: If, then, you have to be put to death by God's chosen people in the church, how can you be put right with God? I tell you, then.
lunyoro: Nukwo muraba numuba nokucwa eyobwomezi bunu, abarukugayibwa omu kanisa nibo mutaho okucwa emisango? Ningamba okubakwasa ensoni.

english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their cloaks at the feet of a young man named Saul.
lunyoro: bamuturukya aheru yorubuga, bamutera amabale, na bakaiso bata ebyokujwara byabu ha bigere byomusigazi, ibararye Sauro.

english: The apostles must be men of marriage to one wife and be well-controlled in their children and in their homes.
lunyoro: Kandi abakwenda babe musaija womukazi omu, nibalema kurungi abana babu nenju zabu banka.

english: But after you have purified yourselves from sin by obeying the truth, love your brothers without hypocrisy, and love one another with all your heart and with all all your mind.

english: For if you do what is evil, you are a servant of God. But if you commit a sin, you must not commit a crime. You must not take a sword for the sword, because you are God's servant, a shield for the one who does evil.
lunyoro: baitu nuwe mukwenda wa Ruhanga haliwe obwoburungi. Baitu oraba nokora ekibihire, tina: baitu takwatira busa empirima: baitu nukwo mukwendawa Ruhanga, omuhozi wenzigu hali anyakukora obubi.

english: The king was upset because of his plans and the people who were with him to eat the bread he ordered Jesus to be handed over to them.
lunyoro: Omukama yasalirwa; baitu habwebirahirobye, na habwabu abakaba baikalire nauwe ha byokurya, yaragira okugumuha;

english: As they went to buy some food, the bridegroom arrived; and as they went out, the servant went in; and the others who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast.
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba bagenzire okugura, omuswezi yaija; nabo obubakaba nibagenda, omuiru rubale yatahamu; nabo abakaba batekanize bahingura nauwe omubugenyi obwobugole.

english: The rest of the beast remains once more, which indicates that the beast was destroyed and that the things that are not yet destroyed.
lunyoro: Kandi kinungu Hasigaireho omurundi gumu, nikimanyisa okuihibwaho kwebi ebitaruku

english: Others have this right over you, but we are not greater than they are. We do not have this authority, but endure everything and do not respect the Good News about Christ.
lunyoro: Abandi baraba banyina obusobozi bunu balinywe, naitwe titurukukira? Baitu itwe tutakwate obusobozi obu, baitu ntugumisiriza byona, tutaleta ekitinisa enjiri ya Kristo.

english: heal the sick among you and say to them, ‘The Kingdom of God has come near you.’
lunyoro: mukizege abarwaire abanyakuli omu, mubagambirege ngu Obukama bwa Ruhanga bubairire haihi.

english: But they did not understand this saying, and it was hidden from them that they didnot understand it. They were afraid to ask him about it.
lunyoro: Baitu batamanye kigambo eki, kikaba kibaserekerwe, batakikenga: nibatina okumukaguza ekigambo eki.

english: When Jesus went into the house and left the crowd, his disciples asked him about this parable.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahire omu nju, arugire omu kitebe, abegeswabe bamukaguza orufumo oru.

english: After Jesus had gone away, he took the bread and had the bread; he ate and talked with them a little while later, and when he came back, he left.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okutemba nokucwa omugati, nokurya, nokubaza nabo ekicu ekikoto, okukisa obuire, yarugayo.

english: In this way love will be made perfect for us, so that we may have courage on the Judgment Day, and so that as he is for us in this world.
lunyoro: Dobi numwo okugonza kuhikirizibwa halitwe, tube nobumanzi ha kiro kyomusango, kandi nkokwali naitwe nukwo tuli omu nsi munu.

english: I saw on the road a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those traveling with me.
lunyoro: omu ihangwe, ai omukama, nkabona ha muhanda omusana ogwarugire ha iguru, okukira okwangasana kwa izoba, gugwire okunyehinguliriza nabo abakaba nibagenda nanyowe.

english: I want you to be sure that this is true, and so I want to make sure that you remain united in this matter, so that those who believe in God may remember to give their minds and hearts to what is good.
lunyoro: Ekigambo kinu kyokwesiga, kandi hali ebi ningonza iwe okugumiza kimu, nukwo abo abaikirize Ruhanga baijukege okutaho emitima ha ngeso enungi. Ebigambo ebi birungi,

english: When the sun was setting, it was red, but when it was still dark, it dried up.
lunyoro: izoba oburyaturukire yahotoka, baitu ekaba etanyina mihama, yayoma.

english: Pray also for us, that God will make us preach the Good News about the secret of Christ, and so that someone else may be a prisoner for it.
lunyoro: kandi numusabira naitwe, Ruhanga atukungu'raho oruigi orwekigambo, okugamba ekyensita kya kristo, ekindi omunyankomo habwakyo:

english: He must be well spoken of by those who are outside, so that he will not fall into the trap of the Devil and be the master of the evil things.
lunyoro: kandi nikimuhiki'ra okuba nokugambwa kurungi hali abo abaheru; aleke okugwa omu kujumwa nendubatira ebya Setani.

english: They handed Alexander over to the crowd, and the Jews seized him. Alexander motioned with his hand and tried to get ready for the people.
lunyoro: Kandi baiha Alegezanda omu kitebe, Abayudaya nibamucumiriza. Kandi Alegezandu yabaculeza nomukono, nayenda okwetonganira hali abantu.

english: But get up and go to the city and be told what you must do.
lunyoro: baitu imuka, otahe omu rubuga, oragambirwa ebikuhikirire okukora.

english: But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and shoes on his feet.
lunyoro: Baitu ise yagambira abairube rubale ati Mulete bwango ekyokujwara ekirukukira oburungi, mukimujweke; nakoma mukamujweke omu rukumu, nenkaito omu bigere:

english: You have good conduct among the Gentiles, and you have turned them away from the evil of your doings, because they have seen your good deeds and have praised God on the Day of your being saved.
lunyoro: mugenderege kurungi omuli Abamahanga; kandi nobubabageya nkabakozi bobubi, baitu obwengeso zanyu enungi ezibarora, banyumize Ruhanga ha kiro kyokubungirwamu.

english: For all these are the things that I tell you by what you have received. For the one who gave me everything I have received from the Father is the one that will give me everything he has.
lunyoro: baitu banu bona mbanagagiremuga hali ebisembo ebibasagirire: baitu ogu omu masegege anagiremu byona ebyayinabyo, niryo itungorye ryona.

english: The next Sabbath everyone in the city gathered to hear the word of God.
lunyoro: Kandi ha Sabiti eyakabiri bakagomera hamu nkorubuga rwona, okuhu'ra ekigambo kya Ruhanga.

english: But whoever wants to save his own life loses it, but whoever loses his life for my sake will save it.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakwenda okukiza obwomezibwe alibubuza: baitu wena anyakubuza obwemezibwe habwange, nuwe alibukiza.

english: They were able to give this perfume to the poor and to distribute it to the needy.
lunyoro: baitu amagita ganu bakusoboire okugaguramu edinali bikumi bisatu nokukiraho, nokukgabira abasege.

english: But you will be judged, and you will have the same judgment; you will also be put right with God, just as you are under God's curse.
lunyoro: Baitu omusango ogumucwa, nainywe muligucwerwa: nendengo eyimulengeramu, nainyowe muligirengerwamu.

english: “What right do you have to do these things?” they asked him.
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Busabozi ki oburukukukoza binu?

english: So then, language is not an eye for those who believe, but for those whose faith is not based on those who do not believe. It is not for those to proclaim the message that they do not accept.
lunyoro: Nukwo endimi tibuli bwokuro'raho hali abarukuikiriza, baitu hali abatarukuikiriza: baitu okutebeza tikurukuro'rwa abarukwemera.

english: But I know you, because I tell you that I don't know him as you do, but you know him, and you obey his teaching.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe numumanya;obundaba ningamba nti tindukumumanyandasisana nkainywe, omubihi baitu numumanya, kandi niwe nkwata ekigambokye.

english: Peter spoke up and said to him, “Explain this parable to us.”
lunyoro: Petero yagarukamu namugambira ati otusobo're orufumo runu.

english: The master said to him, ‘Well done, good servant! You faithful servant! I will leave you in few days. Come and share your king's joy.’
lunyoro: Omukamawe yamugambira Okozire iwe omuiru rubale omurungi; owokwesiga; okaba oli wokwesiga omu bike ndakusigira bingi. Taha mukusemererwa okwomukama wawe.

english: For we are saved by the hope that is seen, but not by the things that are seen. For the hope which is seen is not hope that has seen, for who hopes for what he sees?
lunyoro: Baitu tukajunwa omu kunihira: baitu okunihira okurukurorwa tikuli kunihirwa: baitu kunihiraga okurukuboine tikuli nokunihira. Baitu noha anihira ekyarukurora?

english: But I am with you, and no one will come to harm you. I have many people in this city.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe ndi hamu naiwe, kandi busaho muntu arakuizira okukukora kubi: baitu ndina abantu baingi, omu rubuga runu.

english: the fifth onyx, the sixth onym, the seventh onyin, the eighth onyi, the ninth onyu, the tenth onyon ony end, the eleventh onyra, and the twelfth onyir.
lunyoro: ogwakatano sadonukisi; ogwomukaga sadio; ogwomusanju kurusoliso; ogwalunana beruro; ogwamwenda topazi; ogwikumi na gumu hwakinso; ogwekikumi nebiri hwakinso.

english: From there we sailed around and arrived at Rhegium. One day a wind from the south died down, and on the next day we came to Puteoli.
lunyoro: Kandi okurugayo twayehinguliriza, twahika Legio: kandi ekiro kimu obukytahinguireho, embeho eyobukizi obwoburyo yatera, kandi na kiro ekyakabiri TWAHIKA Puteoli:

english: The thief comes, not to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they might have life, and that they may have life.
lunyoro: Omusuma taija, rundi okuiba, nokuita, nokuhwerekereza: Nyowe nkaija zibe nobwomezi, kandi zibe nabwo obwingi:

lunyoro: Ha ruguruwe hakaba haroho nekihandiko ngu NUWONU MUKAMA WABAYUDAYA.

english: Then he came and took the book to the right of the one who sat on the throne.
lunyoro: Kandi gukaija gwaiha ekitabu omu mukono ogwoburyo gwogu anyakuikalire ha kitebe kyobukama.

english: Those who swear by the altar, swear by it, and do not swear by him; but those who swear on the altar by the gift that is in them are guilty of breaking God's law.
lunyoro: Nauwe anyakurahira ekyoto, tikirikigambo; baitu anyakuhumbira ekisembo ekiroho, buli agwerirwe omusango.

english: When the sun was setting, it was red, and it was dark, so that the birds might live in its shadow.

english: A large crowd of people was eating on the hillside, and he begged Jesus to send them into them, and so he sent them away.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho igana ryempunu enyingi nizirya ha rusozi: kandi ekamwesengereza agyohereze okuzitahamu. Yagyohereza

english: and he will show you how much he has done to show his glory in other ways, in order to show mercy to those whom he has prepared for his glory.
lunyoro: kandi amanyise obuguda obwekinitinisakye hali ebindi ebyokuganyirwa ebiyatekanize hali ekitinisa,

english: I am so sure of you, and I am very happy about you. I am filled with courage, I am full of joy, and in all our troubles.
lunyoro: ningamba nobumanzi bwingi halinywe, nokwenyumiza kwange kwingi habwanyu: nyijuire okuhumuzibwa, muijuire okusemererwa nsagire, omu mihito yaitu yona.

english: For whoever has will be given away, and whoever has it will be taken away away from him. For without it he will have taken away everything he has.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakuina alihebwa, kandi alisagisaho, baitu wena atanyina aliihwaho nekyanyinakyo.

english: For if the angels were to be more powerful or more powerful, they would not be able to appear before the Lord.
lunyoro: baitu bamaraika nobubaraba nibakira amani nobusobozi tibarukubabiriki'ra omu maiso ga Mukama.

english: Do not boast about the stones alone, but be proud; instead, be on your guard that the festival is not for you.

english: The leaves of the tree are for the tree of life, which bears fruit for a whole month. The leaves from the tree stand for the healing of the nations.

english: You will be blessed, because they have nothing to give to take away from you, but you will be given back to life in the resurrection of the righteous.

english: The tax collectors beat the poor, and in the same way they were given.

lunyoro: Kandi abo abesaha eyaikumi nemu obubaizire, bakahebwa omuomu edinali emu.

lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ngu Nukwo, Mukama wange; baitu nobubwa burya oburagarkika oburagara omu rwemo orwa bakama babwo.

english: He has given them the children who are blessed by their minds and hearts.

english: and riches will be destroyed because of the abundance of the chosen ones, because the scene of the world will be shaken.

english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place. When the invited one comes, say to you, ‘Come, my friend, in the middle of the meal you will have a feast with all those sitting at the table.’ Then you will be honored in their presence.
lunyoro: Baitu obwoyetwa, ogende oika're omu kiikaro ekyenyuma; ayakwesere obwaija, akugambire ati Mugenzi wange I'ra kuli hagati: nubwo olitunga ekitinisa omu maiso gabu bona aboikalire nabo ha byokurya.

english: They went to a place called the highest place in the region where they lived: Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon Zelotes, and Judas son of James.
lunyoro: Kandi obubatahiremu batemba omu kisika ekya haiguru, nambere baikaraga; Petero na Yohana na Yakobo na Andereya, Firipo na Tomasi, Batoromayo na Matayo, Yakobo omwana a Alifayo, na Simoni Zerote, na Yuda omwana wa Yakobo.

english: For if I do this that I may not have to boast about what I am doing, or about what else I would have to give up, I have a chance to do it.
lunyoro: Obundaba ninkora okutahambirizibwa, nakubaire nempera.

english: I know that I will stay, and I will be with you all for your progress and joy in the faith.
lunyoro: Kandi obunyetegerize kinu, manyire nti ndiikaraho, kandi ndiikara hamu nainywe inywena obwokukura kwanyu nokusemererwa okwokuikiriza;

english: the son of Amminadab, the son Of Arni, the father of Hezron, the mother of Hezron.
lunyoro: owa Nahasoni, owa Aminadabu, owa Alini, owa Hezeroni

english: They left us, because they were not ours; for if they had belonged to ours, they would have stayed with us. But if they left, they could have been shown that not all of us.
lunyoro: Bakaruga omulitwe, baitu bakaba batali bowaitu; baitu kaba babaire bowaitwe, bakuikaire hamu naitwe: baitu bakaturugamu bamanyisibwe okutaba bowaaitu bona.

english: Once there is a natural desire, then, there is trouble. Once there has been a natural fall, there will be a death.
lunyoro: Kandi okwegomba oku obukumara okutwara enda, kuzara okusisa: nokusisa oku obukuzara kuzaara okufa.

english: Whoever comes to me and listens to my words and does them, I will show you the same way.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena anyakuija namberendi, nahu'ra ebigambo byange, nabikora, ndabaleka owarukusisana:

english: Do not be quick to take advantage of anyone; do not be like the sins of others. Instead, be self-controlled in your conduct.
lunyoro: Otaryanguhiriza okutaho omukono omuntu wena, kunu otaliterana nebibi byabantu abandi: werindege wenka omu kusemezebwa.

english: After spending forty days and nights in the field, Jesus was hungry.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire kusiba ebiro amakumi ana nyamusana nekiro, enjara yamuruma.

english: For the good that I want is not what I do, but what I don't want is what I am doing.
lunyoro: Baitu ekirungi ekindukugonza tikitiri nikyo nkora: baitu ekibi ekintarukugondeza, nikyo ndukukora.

english: King Agrippa! I am going to make my appeal before you now because of all the instructions I have been given to the Jews.
lunyoro: Mpirirwe,omukama Agulipa, baitu ningenda okwetonganira omu maiso gawe hati obwebigambo byona ebinalegerwe Abayudaya:

english: Those who do this will be given the opportunity to sit down with me and sit down at my Father's table.
lunyoro: Anyakusingura ndimuha okuikaraha hamu nanyowe okunasinguire, kandi naika'ra hamu na Isenyowe ha kitebekye.

english: Just as Sodom, Gomorrah, and the nearby towns were destroyed by the fire of eternal fire.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nka Sodomu na Gomora nembuga ezikaba zihe'raineho obuzayehaireyo omu ngeso zimu, hamu nabo omu busihani, nibakuratira Omubiri gundi, okuzatairweho okuba ekyokuro'raho, nizisalizibwa okubonabona okwomu'ro ogutahwaho.

english: A man is not greater than a sheep. It is better to do good on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Omuntu takira muno entama? Nikyo kirungi okukora okurungi ha kiro ekya Sabiti.

english: Sopater son of Berea, the son of Porus, and Aristarchus, Secundus, Gaius, Derbe, Timothy, and the rest of the province of Asia, Tychicus, and Trophimus.
lunyoro: Sofera owa Beroya mutabani wa Puro; Alisitako na Sekundo; na Gayo owa Derebe, na Timoseo, Nabasiya Tuliko na Tirofimo.

english: When Stephen was put to death, his face was covered with the blood of Stephen, and I had been put to the test by him to keep the cloaks of those who had put him to death.
lunyoro: kandi nesagama ya kaiso wawe Sitefano obuyasesekere, nanyowe nkaba nyemerireho nyikirize, nindinda ebyokujwara byabu abamuisire.

english: It forced all the people, the great and the small, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given a crown at their right hands or at their left.
lunyoro: Kandi kihambiriza bona abato nabakuru, nabaguda nabasege, nabobugabe nabairu, bahabwe enkojo ha mukono gwabu ogwoburyo, rundi ha buso bwabu;

english: These are the rocks hidden in your love for one another. The shepherds send out their flocks without fear, and they take away the unripe water from the winds, and the unquenchable trees with their leaves are cut down by the roots.
lunyoro: Abo nibo mabale agaserekerwe omu bugenyi bwanyu obwokugonzangana obubalirana nainywe: abalisa betuma abarukwerisa bonka okutatina, nibatwara amaizi agarukutagata nambere omuyaga guhingura, emiti eterekerire etanyina byana eyaihirwe nemihama:

english: For the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro biriija; nomuswezi obwalibaihwaho, nubwo balisiba omu biro ebi.

english: Some Pharisees who were with him heard this and said to him, “Aren't we blind too?”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo abandi abakaba bali nauwe nibahu'ra ebigamboebi, bamugambira ngu Naitwe tuli bafu bamaiso?

english: For everyone who asks receives, and anyone who seeks, will find; and whoever seeks will find. And whoever seeks, the one who knocks will be opened to him.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwasaba, ahebwa; obwase'ra azora; anyakeranga alikingu'rwaho.

english: You are witnesses with God that we were once holy and righteous before you, and you believed.
lunyoro: Muli bakaiso na Ruhanga obutukaba tuliu nokwera nokuhiki'ra hataroho kuhanwa halinywe barukuikiriza:

english: They were so afraid that they said to one another, “Who is this man? The wind and the waves obey him!”
lunyoro: Batina muno muno, nibagambiragana ngu Kandi ogu noha? Baitu ekiyaga nenyanja nibimuhu'ra.

english: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied this very thing to you:
lunyoro: Inywe abagobya, Isaya akaragura kurungi halinywe nagamba ati.

english: They have all kinds of evil, evil, greed, and greed; they have all drunk, sexual immorality, fighting, and malice; they speak evil of people, and they lie.
lunyoro: baijulire kimu okutahiki'ra kwona, nobubi, nomukoijo, nokunoba;baijura ihali, nobuisi, nokukungana, nebisuba nitima;hali, nabageya,

english: I thought that the riches in Egypt were much more important than the riches of Christ, because he gave up his reward.
lunyoro: natekereza ekijumu kya Kristo okuba obuguda bwingi okukira ebiitungo byomu Misiri: baitu akanihira empera egi.

english: But Jesus turned around and saw her, and he said, “My son, your faith has made you well.” The woman was healed from her very moment to the very moment.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu obuyahindukire namurora, yagamba ati Mwana wange guma omutima, okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukiriz. Omukazi yakira okuruga omu omu omu kasumiako.

english: At that time two men will be in the field, one will be taken along to the field and the other will be left behind.
lunyoro: Ha biro ebi abasaija babiri baliba omu musiri; omu alitwarwa omu alisigwa;

english: He stood at the feet and wept. He began to wash his feet, clean them with the hair of his head, kissed his feet around him, and poured oil on them.
lunyoro: yayeme'ra enyuma ha bigerebye na'ra, yabanza okutonyeza amaizi ha bigerobye, yabisisiriza nisoke ryomutwegwe, namunywegera muno ebigerebye, nabisigaho amagita.

english: But how will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him when they have heard him? How, then, will they hear without a preacher?
lunyoro: Baitu balimukunga bata oubatakaikirize? Kandi balimuikiriza bata oubakahulire? Kandi balihu'ra bata homutebeza atali?

english: “You brought this man to me and told him to deceive the people,” he said to them. “I have brought him to you before you all, and I have not found fault with the man you accuse him of.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Mundetirege omuntu onu ngu Ahabisa abantu: kandi dora nyowe obu'mukagulirizege muno omu maiso ganyu, timboine musango ha muntu onu omwebi ebimumulegere:

english: If a person's work is saved, he will be lost, but he himself will be saved, because he has been thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Omulimo ogwomuntu wena obuguryokebwa aliferwa: baitu uwe wenka alijunwa; baitu nkanyakurabire omu mu'ro.

english: He cried out in a loud voice, and the voice came from heaven like a roaring lion.
lunyoro: Yateza iraka likoto, iraka ryahu'rwa okuruga omu iguru nkomulinga ogwomuhe'le.

english: So then, if I do not know the language, I will be like a foreigner to the one who speaks; and if I speak, I shall become like a Gentile to me.
lunyoro: Nukwo obundaba ntarukumanya amakuru giraka, ndisisana nkomunyaihanga hali anyakumugambira, kandi anyakugamba aliba nkomuiru rubale namberendi.

english: In the same way, men and women who are like women who give up what they have for what they had been born, abandon their own desires and do what is not proper with them, and are given the same reward as they themselves deserve.
lunyoro: nukwo nabasaija bati obubalekereyo eki omukazi ekyazalirwa, bayaka hamu omu kwegomba kwabu, abasaija nabasaijja nibakorangana ebitarukusemera, kandi nibahabwa omulibo bonka empera egi esemerire okusisa kwabu.

english: But there are many who do not listen to those who speak without paying attention to what they say, and there are more who do it than they do.
lunyoro: Baitu haliyo baingi abatarukuhu'ra ababaza ebitarumu, abebisuba, kandi okukira abo

english: None of them could buy anything, but all who sold fields or houses and sold them and brought the money and returned the money.
lunyoro: Kandi omulibo busaho ayasegere kintu; baitu bona abakaba bantungire engonjo, rundi amaju, bakabigura, baleta omuhendo gwebi ebyaguzirwe

english: For as the body without the spirit is dead, faith without actions is dead.
lunyoro: Baitu nkomubiri hataroho mwoyo okuguba gufire, nukwo nokuikiriza hataroyo okukora kuba kufire.

english: But when they persecute you in one city, turn away from your sins. For I tell you that you will be able to see all the cities of Israel, and the Son of Man has come.
lunyoro: Baitu obubalibahiga omu rubuga rumu, muirukire orundi, baitu mazimakwo nimbagambira nti Tumulihika okuraba omu mbuga zona za Isaleri, Omwana womuntu bwalikaija.

english: “Tell us when will these things be?” the man asked. “What will be the sign when the time will come for all these things to happen?”
lunyoro: otugambire, ebigambo ebi biribaho li? Kandi akokuro'raho karaha akebi obubiri'sana okuhiki'ra byona?

english: All these things are for the profit of all the nations of the world, but your Father knows that you need these things.
lunyoro: Baitu ebi byona amahanga hensi nibyo gase'ra: baitu Isinywe amanyire okumutaga ebintu ebi.

english: I have seen the cruel suffering of my people in Egypt, and I have heard their groans. I have come down to save them. Come now, and let me send you to Egypt.”
lunyoro: Mbona omuhito gwabantu, bange abali omu Misiri, nimpu'ra okusinda kwabu; nsirimukire okubajuna: nukwo oije hati bunu, ndakutuma omu Misiri.

english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David! Praise be to God!”
lunyoro: Obukama buhairwe omugisa, obwa Isenkuru itwe Daudi: Hosana haiguru muno.

english: In the way that he has redeemed us from sin, in order that is his body.
lunyoro: omu muhanda oguyatucwerire, oguhingura omu nyigamo, nugwo mubirigwe;

english: For we know what a part of it is, and we know where it is from.
lunyoro: Baitu tumanyireho ekicweka, kandi turaguraho ekicwa,

english: For I came to set free my son, my father's son, his mother's daughter, his son, and his brothers' brothers.
lunyoro: Baitu nkaija okubaganiza omwana na ise, omuisiki na nyina, mukomwana na nyinazara,

english: So some of them started shouting one thing, others something else, because the crowd was crowding together, and many of them did not know why they were planning to do it.
lunyoro: Nukwo abandi batoka okundi, nabandi okundi: baitu ekitebe kikaba kyejwangajwanganizemu; kandi abandi baingi batamanye ekibayesorolize.

english: As David said about the blessing of a man whom God has accepted as righteous
lunyoro: Kandi nka Daudi okwagamba ha mugisa ogwomuntu Ruhanga owatekerezaho anyina okuhiki'ra hataroho mi

english: For he has fixed a day in which he will judge the ends of the earth by a man whom he has chosen, just as he had promised to believe in him when he raised him from death.
lunyoro: baitu akataho ekiro, ekyalicweramu omusango ogwoburyo ogwensi zona, omu muntu ouyakomeremu; nkokuyahaire bona ekyokuikirizisa, obuyamuhumbuire omu bafu.

english: But they did not understand the meaning of the words, and they didnot understand the things that were said.
lunyoro: baitu batakenge bigambo ebi na kimu; ekigambo eki kikaba kibaserekerwe, batarukweregereza ebigambo ebyagambirwe.

english: And now this world will be judged, and the ruler of this world is going to be put out of them.
lunyoro: hati bunu ensi enu necwerwa omusango; hati bunu omukuru wensi enu arabingirwa aheru.

english: Jesus answered, “The man who sowed the fine seed is the Son of Man;
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nagamba ati Ogu anyakusiga embibo esemire nuwe Mwana womuntu;

english: If the priesthood of Levi had been made perfect, (the people were given the Law at that time), why did not another priest go into Melchizedek's house and not be circumcised in Aaron's case?
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba okuhikirizibwa kwaleserwe obunyakatagara Obwalevi,, (baitu abantu bakahabwa ebiragiro omu biro byabwo) kiki ekyatagisize nyakatagara ondi okuija omu mulingo gwa Merekizedeka, otarukubali'rwa omu muringo gwa Aroni?

english: The bridegroom was filled with water, and he did not know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), so the bridegroom called the bridegroom,
lunyoro: Omugole obuyasomereho amaizi gafokere amarwa, atamanyire nambere garugire ( baitu abahereza abatahire amaizi bakamanya), omugaole yayeta omuswezi,

english: He went back and touched the edge of his cloak, and his outer garment was covered with dust.
lunyoro: akaija enyumaye, yakora ha mukugiro gwekyokujwarakye: ahanoha ekyejwisikye kyayoma.

english: For the false prophets and the prostitutes, the murderers, the immoral, the greedy, the drunkards, and the murderers will be thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur. The second death will be the lake that burns with fire and smoke.
lunyoro: Baitu abatini, nabatarukuikiriza, nabaisi, nabasihani, nabarogo,nabaramya ebisisani, nabebisuba bona, omugabo gwabu guliba omu nyanja erukwaka nomu'ro na kiberiti; nukwo kufa okwakabiri.

english: Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand? Don't you understand that whatever is outside, it will not shine on you.
lunyoro: sana ati Nukwo nainywe timunyina magezi? Timurukwetegereza ngu Kyona ekinyakuli aheru obukitaha omu muntu,

english: The army officer feared God with all his family, gave a lot of money to the people, and prayed to God earnestly.
lunyoro: Akatinaga Ruhanga hamu nabomukaye bona, ayagabaga ebintu bingi omu bantu, nasaba Ruhanga obutosa.

english: All these things must be done in order to be built up. If any of you speak in strange tongues, two or more will speak in different tongues, one will speak to the other, and the other will be healed.
lunyoro: Byona bikorwege obwokwombeka. Omuntu wena obwaba nagamba orulimi, bagambe babiri, rundi okutakira basatu kandi omu mbu; kandi omu adume:

english: The king was furious, and he gave up his seat and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.
lunyoro: Omukama yakwata ekiniga; yagaba iherye, yahwerekereza abazinzi abo, yayokya orubuga rwabu.

english: We are witnesses of everything he did and of the country of the Jews in Jerusalem and of what they killed and crucified.
lunyoro: Naitwe tuli bakaiso abebigambo byona ebiyakozire, nomu nsi Yabayudaya omu Yerusalemu kandi oubaisire nibamhanika ha muti.

english: But he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on anyone I wish, and I will have compassion on anyone for you.”
lunyoro: Baitu agambira Musa ati Ndimuganyira oundiganyira, kandi ndimukwatirwa mbabazi oundikwatirwa embabazi.

english: In the same way, the one who was given two thousand coins did away with another two thousand.
lunyoro: nukwo nogu ayahairwe etarata ibiri yazigobamu ibiri ezindi.

english: Again Jesus placed his hands on him, and he healed all.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okumutaho emikonoye: yabyona kurungi.

english: When he was told by his mother, he said, “Give me here in a basket the head of John the Baptist.”
lunyoro: kandi obuyaragirwe nyina, yagamba ati Mpera hanu omu rucuba omutwe gwa Yahana Omubatizi.

english: “Teacher,” they answered, “this woman was caught in the very act of committing adultery with her.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Omwegesa, omukazi onu bamukwasire nasihana, bamusangire.

english: But when what is right comes, then what is partial will disappear.
lunyoro: baitu ebihikirire obubiriija, ebi ebyekicweka birirugaho.

english: Now then, you and the Council have spoken to the commander, so that he will be brought before you before you. You want to know more about the meaning of his words. And if he has not come near us, we will be ready to convince him.
lunyoro: Nukwo hati bunu inywe hamu norukurato mugambire engabwa enkuru, amusirimule namberemuli numusisana nimwenda okumanyira kimu amananu agebigambobye: kandi nobwaraba atakairire haihi itwe twetekanize okumuzinda.

english: We do not look for things that are seen, but for things which are unseen. These things are seen by the things that will happen; but those things that cannot be seen will be seen by all the time.
lunyoro: itwe okutase'ra ebirukurorwa, baitu ebitarukurorwa: baitu ebi ebirukubaburwa nibirorwa bwerebwere; baitu ebitaburorwa byebiro byona.

english: They were not the ones who had been condemned for forty years; their bodies were thrown into the desert.
lunyoro: Nabo ababihirirwe emyaka amakumi ana? tinibo abasisire? emitumbi yabu eyagwire omu irungu?

english: It is written in the Law, ‘I will speak to these people in strange tongues, but they will not listen to me,’ says the Lord.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu biragiro ngu Omu ndimi ezindi nomu minwa yabandi ndigambira abantu banu; kandi tibalimpu'ra, nukwo Mukama agambire ati.

english: For the one who preaches God's message tells people what to do, what to take care of, what will happen to them.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakutebeza agambira abantu ebyokwombeka nebyokuhumuza nebyokuiruki'ra.

english: When the sun is setting, it finds that the sun has setting, but it does not shine.
lunyoro: Kandi obugumara kuija, gugisanga esingolire, etarumu.

english: But if someone tells you, ‘This food has been offered to idols,’ do not eat it; it is for the one who proclaims the message and the one whose heart is filled with it.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu obwaba nabagambira ati Kinu kihongirwe ebisisani, mutaryaho, habwogu anyakumanyisa ekigambo, kandi habwomutima:

english: So then, you will say, ‘This is why the branches are broken off, and I am made clean.’
lunyoro: Nukwo oragamba ngu Nikyo amatagi gacwerirweho, nyowe nsimbwemu.

english: Their destruction will be complete, because God is their share, and their glory will be in their shame, and they will think about the things on earth.
lunyoro: empero yabu kuhwereke'ra, Ruhanga wabu niyo enda yabu, nekitinisa kyabu kirir omu nsoni zabu, nibo barukutekereza ebya hansi.

english: He is the means by which the whole world is made perfect.
lunyoro: nuwe mubirigwe, okuhiki'ra kwogu arukuhikiriza byona omu byona.

english: No one has ever saved me from my first trials, but they have all left me. I beg you, then, not to save them.
lunyoro: Omu kwetonganira kwange okwokubanza busaho ayankonyire, baitu bona bakampemukaho: ninsaba baleke okujunwa eki.

english: Even now the tree is cut down to the ground, so that it will be cut down and thrown into the fire by every tree that does not bear good fruit.
lunyoro: Na hati bunu ebdyamiti etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire bagutema, bagunaga mu mu'ro.

english: I am coming to Zion for a very precious stone, which will be of great value. Those who believe in him will not be disappointed.
lunyoro: Dora ninta omu Sayuni ibale erikomerwemu, eryomuhendo mwingi: Kandi arukumuikiriza talikwatwa ensoni.

english: For the scripture says, “You must not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up into heaven?” (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: And now you know what it is that is happening, so that it may be revealed through your deeds.
lunyoro: kandi hati bunu ekirukutanga mukimanyire, nukwo asuku'rwe omu mpikoze.

english: This is how we know that we are truthful and that we will establish our hearts straight ahead.
lunyoro: Nuho turukumanyira ngu tuli bamazima, kandi tuligumyaho omutima gwaitu omu maisoge,

english: So I will send the younger widows to me, and they will have children. They will build houses and have no need for the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukwendera abakyali abato baswerwe, bazale abana, baleme enju zabu, baleke okulema obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: If someone asks you, 'Why are you looking for me?' then you will say, 'The Lord is looking for him!'
lunyoro: Omuntu obwarabakaguza ngu Nimugusiburu'ra ki? Nuko muragamba muti Mukama waitu naguse'ra.

english: So he got into the boat with them, and the wind died down, and they were very amazed in their boat.
lunyoro: Yatemba omu bwato nambere bali, omuyaga gwayamuka: bahuni'ra muno omunda yabu;

english: When the fourteenth night came, we were driven across the lake at the lakeside of Aduliya, where false teachers thought that they were about to come near the lake.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro kya ikumi na bina obukyahikire, obutwabingabingirwe honahona omu nyanja ya Aduliya, omu itumbi abalimba bakatekereza ngu bamalize okui'ra haihi nensi;

english: I will come soon. Keep what you have, and do not let anyone take your coat away from you.
lunyoro: Ninyija bwango: kwatira kimu ekyoyinakyo, omuntu wena aleke okunyaga ekondo yawe.

english: In every way, then, he must be like his fellow priest in order to offer sacrifices for the sins of the people.
lunyoro: nukwo kyamuhikirire okufoka nkabagenzibe omu bigambo byona, afoke nyakatagara omukuru wabu owembabazi owokwehangahanga obwebibi.

english: The Law came to mean much more sin, and where sin is, grace is abundant.
lunyoro: Kandi ebiragiro nabyo bikaija, okusisa kusage muno; kandi nambere okusisa kwasagire, nuho nembabazi zasagire muno.

english: If I go to Spain, I will be glad to see you again and be persecuted for a little while.
lunyoro: obundiba ningenda Sapaniya, (baitu ninihira okubarora obundihinguraho, nokusengekerezebwa inywe okumpikya oku, rundi obundikamara okubaroragaho nokubanihaho kake):-

english: “Turn away from your sins,” he said, “because the Kingdom of heaven has already come.
