english: But he did not know what Jesus was saying, because they were afraid.
lunyoro: Baitu atamanye ekyaragarukamu; baitu bakaba batinire muno.

english: When I was young, I spoke like a child, and I knew what it was like to be a child. When I arrived, I gave up everything I had.
lunyoro: Obunkaba ndi omuto nagambaga nkomuto, namanyaga nkomutito, natekerezaga nkwomuto: obunkuzire ndekereyo ebyobuto.

english: But Jesus answered them, “When the sun is setting, you say, ‘It will be better for us, because the sky is red.’
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati obuire buizire mugamba ngu buraba burungi;baitu iguru niritukura.

english: So they left and ran away from the tomb. The earthquake and the earthquake had taken them away, but they did not tell anyone, because they were afraid.
lunyoro: Baturuka, bairuka ekituro; baitu okutukumira nokuhuni'ra kukaba kubakwasire: kandi batagambioleho muntu wena; baitu bakatina.

english: When the people saw them walking about, many recognized them, and some of the people who had come from every town came to their village.
lunyoro: Kandi abantu nakabarora nibagenda, baingi babamanyi'ra, nabo abarugire omu mbuga zona bairukira ha bwe'le babatangisa oku.

english: Let endurance complete its work, so that you may be perfect and complete in all things, so as not to lose sight of anything.
lunyoro: Kandi muleke, okugumisiriza kuhikirize omulimo gwakwo, nukwo mube abahikirire, munyina byona, mutarukuburwa omu kigambo kyona.

english: The men who had been taking care of him ran away and ate in the house and told what had happened to the people who had had been possessed by demons.
lunyoro: kandi abakaba nibazirisa bairuka, bagya omu maka, nebigambo ebyabaireho abakwasirwe emizimu.

english: He begged him, “Send us out to the pigs, and let us go into them.”
lunyoro: egi yamwesengereza negamba ngu Tusindike omu mpunu.

english: For my friend is on the road, and I have nothing to put in front of him.
lunyoro: baitu enganjani yange anyizirire omu rugendorwe; kandi nyowe tinyina kyokuta omu maisoge.

english: So then, if what is still alive is considered a prostitute, then someone else will marry; and if it is married, someone else is.
lunyoro: Nukwo iba obwaba ekyali mwomezi aryetwa omusihani obwaliswerwa ondi: kandi iba obwaliba aswirwe iba ondi.

english: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and told him, “What are you going to do with this man?” But he was a Roman citizen.
lunyoro: Kandi omunyakihanda obuyakihulire yagenda hali engabwa enkuru, yamutebeza nagamba ati Nogenda kukoraki? baitu omuntu onu Murumi.

english: For if we judge ourselves, we judge.
lunyoro: Baitu kuba twecwera itwenka omusango.

english: But that son of yours, who wasted his riches on prostitutes, came to rob you of the prize.
lunyoro: baitu omwana wawe ogu, ayalire obugud bwawe nabasihani, obwaizirege, omuitirege enyana eyebisajwa.

english: He gave to each one according to his ability: to the other he gave five thousand coins, to the others two thousand, and to the rest he gave one thousand; to the one he gave according to the ability he had.
lunyoro: akamuha etaranta itano nondi ibiri nondi emu; omuomu nkobusobozi okubukaba buli;

english: For I tell you the rest of the people in Thyatira who have not followed this teaching, and who do not know what the Devil wants them to say—I will not put any other burden on you.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe abandi abasigaireho omu Suatira, inywena abatanyina okwegesa kunu, abatamanyire ebyokuhama bya Setani nkokubagamba, nti tindukubataho inywe enketo endi.

english: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, “Teacher, when did you come here?”
lunyoro: Obubamuzoire nseri yanyanja, bamugambira ngu Rabi oizire di hanu?

english: Simon Peter went down and sold the net on the net, full of fish full of money, one hundred and fifty-three; for even though there were so many, the net did not break.
lunyoro: Simon Petero yagwe'ramu nacundira ekisoga ha musa, kiijuire encu enkoto, kikumi mwatano mu isatu: baitu nobuzikaba ziri nyingi ziti, ekisoha kitacweke.

english: They will see him, and their cry will be in their presence.
lunyoro: Kandi balimurora amaisoge, nokurruma kwabu kuli ha buso bwabu.

english: Those who love their own life will lose it, but those who love God will keep it safe until they are destroyed.
lunyoro: Arukugonza obwomezibwe bumubura; baitu anyakunoba obwemezibwe nuwe alibulinda okuhika ha bwomezi obutahwaho.

english: So he got up and went to his father. While he was still far away, his father saw him, and was moved with pity for him, so he ran away, fell on his knees before him, kissed him very much.
lunyoro: Kandi yaimuka, yaija hali ise. Kandi obwakaba akiri hara muno, ise yamuleba, yakwatwa embabazi, yairuka, yamugwa omunda, namunywegerea muno.

english: Salvation belongs to those who hate you, and to all those who fear you.
lunyoro: Okujunwa omu mikono yabanyanzigwa baitu, nomu mukono gwabu bona abanyakutunoba;

english: But now they have lost faith, hope, and love. Above all, love.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu baikaireho okuikiriza, okunihira, okugonza, nibyo bisatu; baitu ekirukukira hali ebi, kugonza.

english: and to keep them safe from the evil spirits.
lunyoro: kandi nokuikara nobusobuzi okubingaga emizimu:

english: The one who sets the law and judges the same is the one who can save and destroy it. But who are you to judge the same one of you?
lunyoro: Ayataireho ebiragiro nacwa emisango ali omu, nuwe ogu arukusobora okujuna nokuhwerekereza: baitu iwe arukucwera omusango mutahi wawe niwoha?

english: For I beg you, then, that your faith may not give out; and you, when you repent, you will strengthen your brothers.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nkesengereza habwawe, okuikiriza kwawe kutahwaho; naiwe obwolikagaruka okuhinduka, oligumya bene banyu.

english: So Jesus left and went with the chief priests and the soldiers, who were able to hand him over to them.
lunyoro: Nauwe akarugayo yagenda yahanura hamu na banyakatagara abakuru nabaserikale, okwarasobora okumuhayo nambere bali.

english: All who heard were amazed at what the shepherds had told them.
lunyoro: bona abahulire bakahuni'ra ebi abalisa ebibabatebize.

english: All that you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light, and everything you have spoken in the ear on the housetops will be exposed on the roof.
lunyoro: Kandi byona ebimwagambire omu muirima kirihuli'rwa omu musana; neki ekimwagambirire omu kutu ha kaifo, kiridumirwa eruguru ha nju.

english: But now I write this as an excuse not to join me in any fellowship with anyone who calls me a brother who is a sinner or a greedy person or an idolater or a drunkard or a glutton or a violent man or a thief or a busybody in other people's affairs.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu mbahandikire okutaterana hamu nindya hamu nomuntu wena anyakweta mwene wanyu obwaba ali musihani, rundi omwegombi, eundi aramya ebisisani, eunu nuwe muramyi webisisani.

english: But a Samaritan man came to him and when he saw him, he was moved with pity for him and healed him.
lunyoro: Baitu Omusamaliya omu akabali omu rugendo akaija namberali: kandi obuyamuboine yamukwatirwa embabazi, yamuizira,

english: As I have told you, unless you judge, you have only one wife and children who believe, and they will not be destroyed just as they were at the beginning.
lunyoro: Nkokunakuragire ndakugambira, omuntu obwatabaho omusango, anyina omukazi omu, ayina abana abarukuikiriza, abatalegwa nka'abagu biraro byabu.

english: [GENERAL) Do you see this? Do not be afraid that anyone who does not receive God's grace will lose his faith, and that many will lose their faith and their sadness.
lunyoro: muboine kurungi omuntu wena atarukukukika omu mbabazi za Ruhanga; noba kireke okumera nokubatuntuza, na baingi nibisisikara;

english: Pilate said to him, “Are you the king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. I was born, and I came into the world to speak, and now I have become a fool. Whoever obeys my voice will obey me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu'ra iraka ryange.

english: They sang a new song in front of the throne, and of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except four thousand kingdoms, who were bought from the earth.
lunyoro: nibazina ekizina ekihyaka omu maiso gekitebe ekyobukama, nomu maiso bebyomezi ebina nabakuru: kunu busaho muntu asobora okwega ekizina, rundi akasirira mu bukumi buna mwenkumi ina, abaguzirwe okubaiha omu nsi.

english: If anyone builds on those foundation stones or gold or silver or precious stones, trees, or earth, or wood, or stone,
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena obwaba nayombekera ha miganda egi, rundi ezabu, ensimbi, amabale agomuhendo mwingi, emiti, obunyansi, embiba:

english: A poor widow came, and she gave him a half half of what she had.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaija omufakati omu owamasege, yanagamu obucweka bubiri, niyo kodorante.

english: Uncleanness, murder, sexual immorality, greed, and the love of money; jealousy, jealousy, selfishness, and selfishness;
lunyoro: Orwanju, okuiba,okuita, obusihani, okwegomba, ebyokusisa, ebisuba, okwanjuka,eriso eribi, okujuma, obudomadoma:

english: So then, if the people of Macedonia sit down with me and I have not found you ready, then let us not be ashamed of this hope.
lunyoro: nukwo aba Makedoni rundi obubaliika hamu nanyowe batabasanga mutekanize, naitwe (okutagamba inywe) tuleke okukwatwa ensoni omu kunihira oku.

english: But some men did not come from James, and he ate with the Gentiles. When they arrived, he was kind to them and settled them in his house, so that he would be a source of encouragement to those who were being persecuted.
lunyoro: baitu ira, abantu abamu batakaizire okuruga owa Yakobo, yaryaga Nabamahanga: baitu abo obubaizire yayehinya nayesororamu, atinire abo abo abokusarwa.

english: That very night he took them and washed their wounds, and at once he and all his family were baptized.
lunyoro: Yabatwara omu kasumi ako ekiro, yabanabisa ebitutumbuli byabu ebyemiigo; kandi yabatizibwa, uwe nenjuye yona ahonaho.

english: Another one came out of the other horse, and he was given authority to take peace away from the earth and to deal with each other. He was given a crown of thorns.
lunyoro: Harugayo embarasi endi rugaju: nogu akaba aikalireho yahabwa obusobozi okuihaho obusinge ha nsi, baitangane bonka: kandi yahabwa busitama enkoto.

english: For the sake of the false brothers who have come into us in the dark has taken away our sins by means of Christ Jesus, so that they may lead us into error.
lunyoro: Habwa bene babu abebisuba abatahibwemu omu nsita, abaizire omulitwe omunsita okutata obugabe bwaitu obutunyinabwo omu Kristo Yesu, nukwo batukwase omu buiru:

english: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. I order this one, ‘Come!’ and tell my slave, ‘Do this,’ and he will do it.
lunyoro: Baitu na nyowe ndi muntu omulemwa, nyina baserikale abadama: kandi ngambira onu nti Ija; nomuiru wange rubale nti Kora kinu, akikora.

english: For the Son of Man will be condemned more than the sin of this world.
lunyoro: Baitu abana bogu ayangirwe baingi okukira bogu ali naibi.

english: The young man said to him, “I have kept all these things ready, and where did they come from?”
lunyoro: Omusigazi yamugambira ati Ebi byona nkabihikiriza, kandi ekimbuzireho kiraha?

english: They were crucified with him, one on his right and the other on his left.
lunyoro: kandi ahamu nauwe bakabambira ha muti, ondi ha Mukono ogwoburyo, nondi ha gwemoso.

english: And if I take away all my belongings and give up my body to be burned, I will never be thirsty again.
lunyoro: nobundaba nindisa abasege ebinyinabyo byona, kandi obundaba nimpayo omubiri gwange okwokebwa omu'ro, kunu ntanyina kugonza, tikingasira na kake.

english: But those who drink milk do not know the full meaning of what is right, because they are children.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa amata, tamanyire kurungi ekigambo kyokuhiki'ra; baitu ali mwana muto.

english: So then, if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat flesh at all, that I may not cause him to stumble.
lunyoro: Nukwo ebyokurya biraba nibitabaijura mugenzi wange, tindirya enyama ebiro byona, ndeke okutabaijuru mugenzi wange.

english: Joseph was a good man, but he did not want to shame him very much. He was trying to keep him safe.
lunyoro: Yusufu iba, baitu akabali muntu ahikirire, atagonze kumukwasa ensoni bwa, akaba natekereza okumuleka omunsita.

english: He will be handed over a hundred times over to the houses of his brothers, his brothers' houses, his relatives, his mothers, his children, the land, and the land. He will receive him back in the coming age of peace.
lunyoro: Baitu alihebwa emirundi kikumi omu biro binu ebya hati, enju, ha bene babu, na banyanya, nabanyina, nabana, nobutaka, hamu nokuhigwa; kandi omu businge oburukugenda kuija,

english: And our hope for you is firm. And so we see that as you share in the sufferings, so you share the same hope of being helped.
lunyoro: kandi okunihira kwaitu habwanyu kugumireho: obutuboine ngu nkokumuteraine omu kubonabona, nukwo muterana muti omu kuhumuzibwa.

english: the son of Perez, the son that was born in Judah, the father of Isaac, the mother of Abraham, the husband of Terah, the child of Nahor,
lunyoro: owa Perezi, owa Yuda, owa Yakobo, owa Isaka, owa Iburahimu, owa Tera, owa Nahora,

english: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had already said, “If anyone knows where this man is, he will say this and be taken away from him.”
lunyoro: Baitu Banyukatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo bakaba baragire ngu Omuntu wena araba amanyire namberali, agambe, bamukwate.

english: How terrible for those who suffer from dreaded skin diseases and dreaded diseases in those days! For there will be great distress and anguish in this people's hearts.
lunyoro: Ziribabona abaliba nenda, nabanyakwonkya omu biro ebi: baitu haliba hansi omuhito omwingi nekiniga hali abantu banu.

english: Large crowds gathered around him, so he got into a boat and sat down. The whole crowd stood on the beach.
lunyoro: Ebitebe bingi byamuso'rokaniraho, yagwe'ra omu bwato, yaika'ra; ekitebe kyona kyemerire ha musa.

english: They hate the gospel because of you, because they love what is good and love what belongs to their ancestors.
lunyoro: Kandi ebyenjiri, bali banyanzigwa habwanyu: baitu ebyokukomwamu, nibagonzebwa habwa baisenkurubo.

english: and some of you have started discussing among yourselves about the matter.
lunyoro: kandi haroho abamu abatandikire okubaganizamu ebibagambirwe.

english: The Jews did not believe that he had been blind and could not see, so they called him their father and mother, whom they had received as an apostle.
lunyoro: Abayudaya bataikirize bigambobye bgu akabali mufu wamaiso, kandi yakira, rundi obubayesere abamuzaire ogu ayahairwe okuhweza,

english: God chose the weak things of the world to be ashamed of them, and he chose the glory of the heavenly bodies and of the earthly bodies, so that he might bring to nothing the living.
lunyoro: kandi ebyobugara ebyensi Ruhanga akabikomamu, akwase ensoni ebyamani: kandi nebitali byekitinisa ebya hansi nebigayibwa Ruhanga akabikoramu, kandi nebitaroho, nukwo aburanganize ebiroho:

english: He grows up and does not know anything, but wants doubts and disputes, disputes, insults, and evil suspicions.
lunyoro: akundi, kunu taroho ekyamanyire, baitu nayegomba ebyempaka, nambere haruga ihali, nokukungana, nebyokujuma, nebitekerezo ebibi,,

english: Speak the word, speak at the right time and at the left; be obedient, ready, ready to pray, and eager to teach.
lunyoro: hatebeza ekigambo: ogambi'lege omu biro ebisemeriremu nebitasemeriremu; otere'lege, ohanege, oyesengerezege omu kugumisiriza kwona nokwegesa.

english: If you stand firm in the faith and do not be divided, and donot be discouraged by the hope you have heard from me, which was proclaimed in all creation that is under heaven. I, Paul, am the one who was made a servant of Christ.
lunyoro: obumuliba numuikara omu kuikiriza, mugumire kandi mutarukutabatabana, kandi mutaganye omu kunihira okwenjiri eyimwahulire, eyatebezibwe omuli ebyahangirwe byona hansi yiguru, nyowe Pauro eyinafolirwe omuhereza wayo.

english: He was the Son of Man, who was willing to suffer the punishment of the Evil One.
lunyoro: Kandi nobwakaba ali Omwana akegera okworoba omwebi ebiyabonabonesibwe:

english: But when the seeds sprout, they sprout and bear fruit, because the harvest is ready to complete.
lunyoro: baitu ebyana obubyera, ahonaho aleta orugeso, baitu okugesa kuhikire.

english: [GENERAL) For two things that cannot be broken, which cannot be removed, God has not given us the power to do them, so that we, who are ready to obey, may have the hope set before us.
lunyoro: Obwebigambo bibiri ebitarukusobora okutabatabana, Ruhanga ebiyasimirwe bigumireho, itwe abayebingire, tutunge okunihira okututairweho omu maiso gaitu;

english: But the army officer and the commander of the ship heard what Paul had to say.
lunyoro: Baitu omunyakihanda yahu'ra omugoyi nomukama wekyombo okukira Pauro ebiyagambire.

english: I am John, your brother and partner in the sufferings of yours, in the Kingdom of Jesus, and in the persecutions which come upon you on the island of Patmos for the testimony of God and of Jesus.
lunyoro: nyowe Yohana, nwene wanyu, kandi aterana nainywe omu muhito, nobukama, nokuguisiriza omu Yesu, nkabandi omu izinga eryetwa Patimo, obwekambo kya Ruhanga nobwokumanyisa Yesu.

english: Your ancestor Abraham was happy to see me on the night, and he was glad to see it.
lunyoro: Iburahimu isekuru inywe akasemererwa okurora ekiro kyange; kandi akakirora nasemererwa,

english: He revealed the secret of the evil things that he wanted, just as he had promised in his own Son.
lunyoro: obuyatumanyisize ensita zebi ebiyagondeze, nkokuyasimire wenka, - nkokuyamalirire ira omuruwe,

english: The men who had been taking care of him ran away and spread the news in the city and among the farms. They went over to see what had happened.
lunyoro: kandi abakaba nibazirisa bairuka, bakitebeza omu rubuga, nomu maka. Baija okurora ebyabaireho okubiri.

english: The crowd was sitting around him, and they said to him, “Look, your mother and your brothers are outside looking for you.”
lunyoro: ekitebe kikaba kiikalire bamwehingulirize;bamugambira ngu Dora, nyoko na bene banyu bali aheru, nibakuse'ra.

english: I came from the Father, and I am coming into the world. And the world hates me, because I am going to the Father.”
lunyoro: Nkaruga hali Isenyowe, ninyija omu nsi. Kandi ensi ningirugamu, ningenda hali Isitwe.

english: [GENERAL) That is why I make you commit a sin by being put right with God by being placed right with him.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukukuijikiza okutaikiranganiza naiwe, obwokuhikirizibwa okukuli naiwe.

english: These are the rules which apply only to bodily matters, eating, drinking, and the like. These are all the rules that apply to the new age.
lunyoro: nibiragiro ebiragirwa ebiragano byonka ebyomubiri kwonka, (hamu nebibyokurya, nebyokunywa, nebindi nkebi) okuhikya ebiro ebyokusemerezamu obuhyaka.

english: But some of the teachers of the Law were sitting there, thinking in their hearts.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abahandiki abamu baikalire, nibatekereza omu mitima yabu

english: The seven had no children, and the seven had not yet left. Last of all the woman died also.
lunyoro: kandi bona omusanju batasigeho bana. Hanyuma bona bahoireho, nomukazi yafa.

english: He saved him out of all his troubles and gave him wisdom and knowledge in the presence of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his family.
lunyoro: yamujuna omu bujunebwe bwona, yamuha okuganja namagezi omu maiso ga Faraho, omuka wa Misiri; yamufora omulemi omu Misiri nomunjuye yona.

english: They stripped off the dust and loved the best places at feasts and the reserved seats in the synagogues.
lunyoro: bagonza ebikaro ebyahagati ha bugenyi, nentebe ezekitinisa omu maso'rokaniro

english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; but whether I preach it, I myself or not, I will see it as if I did not preach the gospel.
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nintebeza enjiri, tinyina kyokwenyumiza nyenka; baitu zirimbona obundihu'ra, rundi ndihwaho enjiri.

english: Do not boast about the deeds of others, which are much more important than ours. Instead, we hope that when your faith grows, we will be proud of you just as we were about to buy and pass by.
lunyoro: tukwenyumiriza emirimo yabandi, nukwo kukira ha rulengo rwaitu; baitu ntunihira ngu okuikiriza kwanyu obukulikanya, itwe tulinyumizibwa omulinywe nkomutano gwaitu okuguli nokuhingurana,

english: They were sad, but we are glad, because we are happy; we are rich, but many have riches; we have nothing, but all things.
lunyoro: nkabarukutuntura, baitu ntusemererwa; nkabasemererwa, baitu tufora baingi abaguda; nkabatanyina kintu, baitu tunyina byona.

english: They were taken to Shechem, where they were buried in the tomb which Abraham had bought for a sum of money from the sons of Hamor of Shechem.
lunyoro: batwarwa Sekemu, bazikwa omu kituro Iburahimu ekiyaguzire omu muhendo ogwefeza hali abana ba Hamora omu Sekemu.

english: For if the message given to the angels had proved true, and the punishment for sin and disobedience had been given to them, they would have received a just reward.
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo ekyagambirwe bamaraika obukiraba kyagumireho, kandi nekyokusisa kyona nobutahu'ra bwona biraba byahairwe empera yoburyo;

english: The third part of the creatures which were in the sea, which are alive, died, and the third part was destroyed.
lunyoro: kandi ekicweka ekyakasatu kyebinyakuhangirwe ebiri omu nyanja, ebiyina obwomezi, kyafa; nekicweka ekyokusatu ekyamato kyahwerekerezebwa.

english: You are the children of your father the Devil, and you want to obey your father's desires. From the very beginning he was a murderer. He did not stay in the darkness, but in union with Christ. When he has committed adultery, he tells lies about himself, but he is a liar, and the father of the lie.
lunyoro: Inywe muli ba isinywe Setani, kandi numugonza okukora okwegomba kwa isnywe,Ogu okuruga kara na kara akabali muisi; takaikaraha omu busitama, baitu amananu busamu omuruwe. Obwabiha ebisuba buli agamba ebye, baitu ogu mubihi, nuwe ise obugobya.

english: I tell you, then, that the Law that God made four hundred and thirty years ago will not allow or cause to break a covenant.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndukugamba nti Ekiragano Ruhanga ekiyagumize kara, ebiragiro ebyakurutire emyaka bikumi bina mwasatu ehinguireho, tibikiihaho amani, nobukwakuba okuburanganiza omurago.

english: If I want to be with you, then I will be with him in your place in the preaching of the Good News.

lunyoro: yataireho omundaye nagamba ati Nsakora nta, baitu tinyina hokwahura ebyana byange?

lunyoro: Tabazokere abagarukire okuija?Kambanu abataramanyire okukugiza Ruhanga, rundi omunyaihanga onu?

english: He is greater than we are, and he is greater in power than we who believe, just as he is able to do.

lunyoro: Ika'ra ha mukono gwange ogwoburyo,
