english: On his robe and on his thigh he has a name written that says, “The King of kings and Lord of lords.”
lunyoro: Ha kyokujwarakye na ha kiberokye ayina ibara erihandikirwe liti OMUKAMA WABAKAMA KANDI MULEMI WABANYORO.

english: Some of them began to spit on him, and some of them would spit on his face, and he would say, “He is a god!” The guards took him and beat him.
lunyoro: Nabamu bakagumya amaisoge, nibamucwera amaiso, nibamugambira ngu Rugura: nabahereza bamutwara nibamutera empi.

english: His feet were like drops of water in a flood, and he was tossed about by the fire, and his sweat was as drops of blood falling to the ground.
lunyoro: Ibigerebye nibisisana nkomulinga gwomuhe'le, ogusemezibwe omu mu'ro; nirakarye liri nkiraka ryamaizi amaingi.

english: The jailer woke up and saw that many prisoners had escaped. He saw his sword come down on him, and he wanted to kill him, so he thought that the prisoners had been killed.
lunyoro: Omusaija owenju yenkomo, obuyasisimukire, yabona enyingi zenju zenkomo zikingukire, yasomora empirimaye nayenda okweyita, atekerize abanyankommo bacwire.

english: Who is going to weep and gnash his teeth? Who ate the bread of grapes, but didn't eat the same bread? Who will feed the crowd, but not drink the wine of the crowd?”
lunyoro: Noha agenda okuramaga naramagya ebye wenka? Noha akaba abyaire orugonjo rwemizabibu, kunu tarya ha byana byomu? Kandi noha alias igana, kunu tanywa ha mata gigana?

english: to bring judgment on all, to condemn all those who do not obey God, because they have done evil in the past and have done the terrible things to those who are not godly.
lunyoro: okucwera bona omusango, nokuhambiriza omusango bona abatarukutina Ruhanga, obwengeso zabu zano ezobutatina Ruhnaga ezibakozire kubi: nobwebigambo byona ebigumangaine ebyababoine Ruhanga obwebigambo byabu ebibi.

english: I do not want to receive any gift, but I want those who play the flute for you.
lunyoro: Tini se'ra ekisembo nyowe; baitu ninse'ra abyana ebirukukanya namberemuli.

english: Here are seven heads of grain, the woman who sat on it.
lunyoro: Kinu nibyo mitwe musanju, omukazi ezaikalireho:

english: Then he took her to the tomb and gave her to a girl, and she gave him to her mother.
lunyoro: yatwara omutwegwe omu rucuba, yaguha omuisiki: omuisiki yaguletera nyina,

english: But when the sun is setting, it will not shine on it, and it will rise on it. And so its end will be cut off.
lunyoro: baitu obweyana amahwa namatojo eyangwa; kandi eri haihi nokukyenwa: empero yayo nukwo kwokebwa.

english: You worship what you do not know. We worship what we do not understand, because salvation comes from the Jews.
lunyoro: Inywe muramya ekimutarukumanya: itwe turamya ekiturukumanya; baitu okujunwa nukuruga omu Bayudaya.

english: Do you not believe me when I tell you about the things in the world? How, then, will you believe me if I tell others about the heavenly things?
lunyoro: Obumbagambire ebigambo ebyensi mutarukuikiriza, muliikiriza muta obundibagambira ebigambo ebyomu iguru?

english: When the whole crowd heard everything he had done, they came to him.
lunyoro: Lino abekitebe bona obubahulire ebiyakozire byona, baija namberali.

english: For those who do not have the Law do not break the Law of God, but are under the law of Christ. In order that we might be made lawbreakers.
lunyoro: Kandi hali abatanyina biragiro, tibali batasise ebiragiro bya Ruhanga, baitu owomu biragiro bya Kristo, nukwo ntunge abasisi.

english: “We would not have brought him to you if he had not committed a crime,” they answered.
lunyoro: Bagarukamu nibagamba ngu Omuntu onu kakuba atakozire kubi titwakumulesere namberoli.

english: But now you boast about your appearance, because all such boasting is bad.
lunyoro: hati bunu nimwenyumiza iywenka omu kwehamba kwanyu: okwenyumiza kwon okuli kuti kubi.

english: What did he mean? “I will look for you,” he said, “but you will not find me, and you will cannot go to me.”
lunyoro: Kinu kiki ekyagambire ati Mulinse'ra timulimbona: kandi ati namberendi inywe timusobora kuijayo?

english: Or will I stay with you or will I be with you forever? So take me in my path and walk.
lunyoro: kandi rundi ndiikara nainywe, rundi ndimarayo nebiro byembeho: nukwo mumbohe'le omu muhanda gwange handikagenda.

english: [GENERAL) May the Lord grant him mercy that very day. And you know very well all that I did in Ephesus.
lunyoro: ( Mukama waitu amuhe okubona okuganyirwa okuruga hali Mukama omu kiro eki); kandi ebi byona ebiyamperizemu Efezo omanyire kurungi mali.

english: This is what we can be sure of: if we have died with him, we shall also live with him.
lunyoro: Kigambo kinu kyokwesiga ngu Obuturaba twafire hamu nauwe, kandi turyomera hamu naitwe:

english: So then, when you have done everything that God has commanded you to do, say, ‘We are ordinary servants of God. We have done what we ought to do.’
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe, obumulikamara okukora byona ebimwaragirwe, mugambege ngu Tuli bairu rubale abatarukugasa; ebitukozire nibyo byatuhikirire okukora.

english: At that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you will be in my presence, and I in yours.
lunyoro: Ha kiro eki mulimanya ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, nainywe omu nyowe, nanyowe omulinywe.

english: The servant went in and told his master this. The master was furious and said to the servant, ‘Hurry out to the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
lunyoro: Nomuiru rubale yaija, yatebeza omukamawe ebigambo ebi. Kandi nyineka nubwo yakwasirwe ekiniga, yagambira omuiruwe rubale ati Turuka bwango, ogende omu makute nemihanda eyorubuga, otahye munu abesege nabaramaire nabafu bamaiso nabacumbagira.

english: In the same way that they do, their minds will be kept open, as if by a sword or a spear.
lunyoro: hati omu bugabya bwababiha ebisuba nibokebwa emitima yabu nkekyoma okukyokya

english: He was given a sign of circumcision, a seal of his circumcision, and a seal on his faith in Christ's life. He is the father of all those who believe in him in the light of their faith.
lunyoro: kandi akahebwa akokuro'raho akokusarwa, emanyikirizo eyokuserwa, emanyisa eyokuhiki'rakwe okwokuikiriza okuyayinakwo omu kutasarwa: nukwo abe isenkurubo bona abanyakuikiriza omu kubatekerezebwahoga:

english: The four angels were released, who had been prepared for the Day and Day of the Year, to kill up to one third of humanity.
lunyoro: Bamaraika abana basumu'rwa abakaba batekanizibwe obwesaha nekiro nokwezi nomwaka, okuita okuhikya ekicweka ekyakasatu ekyabantu.

english: Among them we are a source of life which brings life. And who can say this?
lunyoro: Baitu omuli abo tuli kisorokoko ekiruga omu bwomezi ekireta obwomezi. Kandi noha arukusobora ebigambo ebi?

english: You, then, are enemies of Christ, who want to be judged by the Law. You have turned away from your sins by means of God's grace.
lunyoro: Mubaganizibwemu na Kristo, inywe abarukugonza okuiibwaho omusango obwebiragiro; mugwire okuruga omu mbabazi.

english: You yourselves know very well that ever since I was with you in Asia the first day, I have been with you all the time.
lunyoro: Inywe mumanyire inywenka, okuruga ekiro ekinabandizemu okulibata ekigere kyange omu Asiya, okunkaba ndi nainywe ebiro byona,

english: For no human being will be put right with God by doing what the Law requires, but he will come to know sin by means of the Law.
lunyoro: baitu obwemirimo eyebiragiro busaho mubiri gwona guliihibwaho omusango omu maisoge: baitu omu biragiro nuho haruga okumanya ekibi.

english: Be happy with those who are happy, and join with those that weep.
lunyoro: Musemererwe hamu nabo abanyakusemererwa; mu'le hamu nabo abanyaku'ra.

english: If I can trust in the flesh, but if I can confidence in the other person, I will be even more bold.
lunyoro: Obundaba ninsobora okwesiga omubiri; omuntu ondi wena obwatekereza okwesigamira omubiri, nyowe nim8ukira:

english: The stars of heaven fell to the earth, just as a tree grows by the roots of its roots.
lunyoro: nyunyuzi azahaiguru zagwa hansi: nkomutini okugukunkumura ebitagi byagwo omwingi.

english: Those who learn to do good without being persecuted do not fight.
lunyoro: kandi aboege okukozaga emirimo yona emirungi obwebirukutagibwa, baleke okurwana.

english: But one of you says, ‘I follow Paul,’ and another, ‘Apolly,’ ‘You are no longer human beings.’
lunyoro: Baitu omu obwagamba ati Nyowe ndi wa Pauro: nondi ati nyowe wa Aporo: timukyalibantu kwonka?

english: In the same way you will be glad, and you will share my joy.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe nukwo mururkusemererwa muti, numusemere'rwa hamu nanyowe.

english: [GENERAL) It is by the blood of Christ that you have purified yourselves from sin and have poured out the Spirit of holiness before God. It is much more important for you to wash your hearts from dead deeds to serve the living God.
lunyoro: Esagama ya Kristo ayayahaireyo wenka, ataroho kamogo, Obwomwoyo Ogurukwera hali Ruhanga, terikira muno okwogya emitima yanyu omu ngeso ezifire okuhereza Ruhanga omwomezi?

english: and show great respect for their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
lunyoro: kandi nokubataho ekitinisa kingi muno obwemirimo yabu.Muikalege nobusinge omulinywe inywenka.

english: A large crowd followed him, because they saw how he had performed miracles for the sick.
lunyoro: ekitebe kingi nikimukuratira, baitu bakarora obwokuro'raho obuyakozire hali abarwaire.

english: You know that he was made known to take away sin, and in union with Christ there is no sin.
lunyoro: kandi mumanyire ngu ogu akamanyisibwa okuyihaho ebibi, kandi omuruwe tiharumu ekibi.

english: When Jesus saw her, he called her to him and said, “Woman, you are free from your sickness!”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamuboine, yamweta, yamugambira ati Omukazi, olekerwe endwara yawe.

english: Those who see me see him who sent me.
lunyoro: Kandi anyakurora nyowe, buli arozire ogu ayantumire.

english: They brought them to the judges of the city and said, “These men are Jews, and they are causing great trouble in our city.
lunyoro: kandi obubabalesere hali abacwi bemisango, bagamba ngu Abantu banu, baitu Bayudaya, nibatuntuza muno orubuga rwaitu,

english: Happy and holy is the person who has been raised from death to life; the second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will rule with him for a thousand years.
lunyoro: Anyakuina omugabo omu kuhumbuka okwokubanza nuwe ayina omugisa, kandi arukwera; okufa okwakabiri tikunyina obusobozi hali abo; baitu baliba banyakatagara ba Ruhanga na Kristo, kandi baliremera hamu nauwe emyaka rukumi.

english: Jerusalem, Judea, and all the surrounding country of the Jordan River went out to him,
lunyoro: Kandi, Yerusalemu na Buyudaya bwona nensi yona ehe'raine Yorudani barugayo, nibaija nambereri,

english: Jesus said, “We remember those who were taking care of us, because they were in the dark. He took the money away from us and took away what they had not taken away from him.
lunyoro: Akagamba ati, tukulikuijuka abaketo, baitu bakaba bali bakozi benaku; ayaihireho erupiya, naletaho ekibatarasigire.

english: The servant who had received five thousand coins came and brought another five thousand. ‘You gave me five thousand gold coins, sir,’ he said. ‘I have earned five thousand other coins!’
lunyoro: Ogu ayahairwe etaranta itano yaija naleta etarantalitano zindi,nagamba ati mukama wange okansigira etaranta etano; dora nkagobamu etaranta zitano zandi.

english: Many of the elders believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they did not say a thing, so that they would not be expelled from the synagogue.
lunyoro: Baitu omuli abakuru baingi bakamuikiriza: baitu habwa abafalisayo batakigambe, baleke okubingwa omu iso'rokaniro:

english: For he who has done this for us is God, who has given us the Spirit as a guarantee.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ayatukolire eki, nuwe Ruhanga, nuwe yatuhaire omukwatirizo Ogwomwoyo.

english: That is why I said to you, ‘You will die in your sins, but if you do not believe me, then you will die because of your sins.’
lunyoro: Nikyo mbagambirire nti Mulifera omu bibi byanyu: baitu obumutaikiriza Ninyowogu, mulifera omu bibi Byanyu.

english: Again Jesus returned and found them asleep, but their eyes were kept open.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okuija, yabasanga bagwijagire, baitu amaiso gabu gakaba nigahungira.

english: For those who are like wild animals, wild animals that are captured and killed, and reject what they do not know, will be destroyed by their destruction and be destroyed.
lunyoro: Baitu abo nkebyahangirwe ebitanyina amagezi, ebizarwa nkebisoro kwonka, ebyokukwata nokuitwa, nibajuma omu bigambo ebibatarukumanya, omu kuhwereke'ra kwabu balihwerekerezebwa mali,

english: They said to Aaron, “Make us gods who will lead us. We do not know what has happened to this Moses, who brought us out of Egypt.”
lunyoro: bagambira Aroni ngu Otuko'le baruhanga abalitwebembera: baitu Musa ogu, ayatuihire omu nsi ya Misiri, titumanyire okwabaire.

english: You have lived as the world around you before, in order to follow the ruler of this world, who is the Spirit who now controls the people who disobey God.
lunyoro: omu bigambo ebimwagenderamuga ira nkobusinge obwensi enu okubuli, okukuratira wobusobozi omu mwanya, omwoyo ogukoza hati bunu omu bana abatarukuhu'ra:

english: But no one can tame the tongue. The tongue, however, is full of violence, which can never be controlled.
lunyoro: baitu orulimi busaho muntu asobora okurulema; nubwo bubi obutarukutangwa, ruijuire obusegwe oburukuita.

english: “Aren't you that Egyptian? In the past he led four thousand armed terrorists into the desert?”
lunyoro: Tiniwe Mumisiri ogu, omu biro ebyahinguire ayayemeseze abantu enkumi ina abomu bazinzi, nabatwara omu irungu?

english: Again they shouted, “This is not Barabbas! He is Barabbas!” (Barabbas himself was a tax collector)
lunyoro: Kandi bagaruka okutoka ninagamba ngu Tali onu, baitu Baraba. Nogu Baraba akabali munyagi.

english: And I tell you, do not swear at all or by anyone else in heaven, for it is the people who belong to the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: kandi nyowe nimbagambira nti otalirahira na kake, noburyakuba iguru, baitu nikyo kitebe ekya

english: But to this very day you will have to speak to one another, so that none of you will be able to bear the sins of the others.
lunyoro: Baitu mugambi'ranganege inywenka ekiro kinu, omuntu wena omulinywe aleke okugumangana obwebisuba kyekibi:

english: When Herod saw him, he was killed, and he had the guards whipped and ordered him to be put to death. So he left Judea and went to Caesarea, where he stayed.
lunyoro: Kandi Herode obuyamuseruire, yamubura, yakwasa ensengo abalinzi, yaragira okubaita. Kandi yasirimuka okuruga Buyudaya okugenda Kaisaliya, yaikara oku.

english: He said this in a private meeting and taught in the Temple, and no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi akabigamba omu ryahu'ro, nayegesa omu yekaru: kandi busaho ayamukwasire; baitu akasumike kakaba katakahikire.

english: If Christ has been revealed to us, then you too will be shown with him in glory.
lunyoro: Kristo, obwomezi bwaitu, obwalimanyisibwa, nubwo nainywe hamu nauwe hamu nekitinisa.

english: The people started shouting about a man who was lame. They tried to arrest him and put him in front of him.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, abantu bakaletera ha kitabu omuntu akaba azingamire: nibase'ra okumutahyamu, nokumubyamisa omu maisoge.

english: How terrible for you teachers of the Law! You have put aside the key of knowledge. You yourselves did not go in, and you kept watch over those who went in.
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abegesa ebiragiro! Baitu mukaihaho ekisumuruzo ekyokwetegereza: mutatahemu inywenka, kandi abo abakaba nibatahamu mukabatanga.

english: I know your love, your faith, your service, and your patience—and your endurance—and the last days will be much more important than the first.
lunyoro: Manyire emirimo yawe, nokugonza, nokuikiriza, nokuhereza, nokugumisiriza kwawe, nemirom yawe eyahanyuma okuba nyingi okukira eyokubanza.

english: In many ways we all stumble. If we do not sin because of the language, we are innocent and can save the whole body.
lunyoro: Baitu omu bingi tusobya itwena. Omuntu wena obwatasobya omu mukigambo kyorulimi, ogu nuwe muntu ahikirire, nasobora okutanga omubiri gwona.

english: And even when you are born, doesn't it teach you that if a man has a sharp sickle, he will be ashamed of him?
lunyoro: Kandi nokuzarwa kwonka tikurukubegesa ngu omusaija obwaba anyina isoke eriraihire, kiba kyensoni haruwe?

english: But Demas left him, and loved the present life, and went to Thessalonica. Her sister conceived a vision and went back to Galatia, where Titus went to Dalmatia.
lunyoro: baitu Dema akansiga, agondeze obusinge bwa hati bunu, yagenda Sesaronika; Keereseke yagenda Garatiya, Tito yagenda Daramatiya.

english: And where these things have been done, they will no longer offer sacrifices for sin.
lunyoro: Kandi nambere ebi biihibwaho, tihakyali okuhonga ebyonzira obwebibi.

english: When we are prepared, we pray for it. We have become like the world's garbage heap, where everything is destroyed until this very day.
lunyoro: Obututebwaho ebibi tusabira: tukafoka nkehunda eyensi, nebiragazibwaho bya byona nokuhikya hati.

english: For by means of their faith they will be saved, because they have been put to death. They will be put to the test by faith, by their faith, and by their obedience.
lunyoro: Baitu alijunwa habwokuzara abana obubaliikara omu kuikiriza, nomu kuganza, nomu kwezebwa hamu nokwerinda.

english: That is why you should obey, not only because of your sadness, but also because of the conscience.
lunyoro: Nikyo kibasemererire okuhu'ra, tibuli obwekiniga kyonka, baitu obwokukenga okwomu mutima nakwo.

english: For we are certain that he will defend Israel. And so it is with all these things that the third time these things happened.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe tukanihira ngu Nuwe alicungura Isaleri. Nukwo na ha binu byona, hati nikyo kyakasatu, ebigambo binu bikaba kubaho.

english: Watch yourself with your teaching. Keep yourself safe in these things, for by doing this you will save yourself and those who listen to you.
lunyoro: Werindege wenka nokwegesa kwawe. Oikalege omu bigambo binu; baitu obwokora binu oryejuna wenka, kandi oliijuna nabo abakuhu'ra.

english: Just as the living Father sent me, so I live because of the Father. Whoever wants to live only for me will live for me.
lunyoro: Nk'Isenyowe omwomezi okkuyantumire, nanyowe nkokundukwomera habwa Isenyowe; nukwo ati anyakundya, nuwe aryomera habwange.

english: In your stomach you should eat food, whether it is fresh or old; but whoever does what is good should be given his food.
lunyoro: omu myeko yanyu; nobwekuba endyanga, nobubyakuba ebyesomeko bibiri, nobuzakuba nkaito, nobugwakuba omuigo, baitu anyakukora emirimo naseme'ra okuhebwa ebyokuryabye.

english: So do not break the word until the time comes when the Lord will reveal to you the secrets of the darkness and reveal the thoughts of the heart. Then they will be given the full measure of gratitude to God.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutacwa kigambo kyona akasumi katakahikire, okuhika Mukama waitu obwaliija alimulikya ensita ezomuirima, kandi aryoleka okutekereza okwomu mitima: nubwo balihabwa okusimwa omuomu hali Ruhanga.

english: But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again; and whoever drinks of the water which I will gives him will by no means be thirsty; and the water who I will send me will be in him a spring of water and will come out of him eternal life.”
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa ha maizi agandimuha talikwatwa iroho ebiro Kwahumbura abafu nabaha obwomezi, nukwo Nomwana abaha ati obwomezi abayenda okuha. Nebiro; baitu amaizi agandikuha galifoka omundaye iziba ryamaizi nigadubuka hali obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: And if that which is left of you is not left to the body which will be destroyed, but only to the seeds, the weeds, and the other evil things.
lunyoro: Kandi egi eyosiga, tosiga omubiri ogulibaho, baitu embibo kwonka, rundi eyengano, ebihwa ebindi ebiitungo;

english: But Paul said to them, “We were put right with God before the people before the Roman authorities before we were put to death and now we are put in prison. How can they not put us in prison? No, they themselves came here and let us out!”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Nangwa, mananukwo; baitu baije bonka batuturukye.

english: I write this not to make you sad, but to make them sad as my dear children.
lunyoro: Tindukuhandika ebigambo binu okubaswaza, baitu okubahabura nkabana bange abarukugonzebwa.

english: So then, look at the good and the hard work of God's people, which he has given you to do. But if you remain in his goodness, you too will be cut off from him.
lunyoro: Nukwo orole oburungi nokugumangana ebya Ruhanga: hali abo abagwire okugumangana: baitu haliwe obwoikara omu burungi, nubwo olitemwaho.

english: Nor is it by human hands that they are put to death, as though they were nothing. Instead, they are the only ones who give life, life, the breath, and all things.
lunyoro: kandi tikikorwa emikono yabantu nkanyakuburaho ekintu, baitu nuwe wenka abaha bona obwomezi, nokuikya orwoya, nebintu byona.;-

english: For whoever asks receives, and whoever seeks finds, finds; and whoever knocks on the door will be opened to him.
lunyoro: Baitu wena asaba nuwe ahebwa; nanyakuse'ra nuwe azora: nanyakweranga nuwe alikingu'rwaho.

english: When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write a letter. I heard him say, “Don't write down the meaning of the seven trumpet sounds like this.”
lunyoro: Ebidongo omusanju obubyagambire, nkaba ningenda okuhandika: nahu'ra gamba ngu Bohesa emanyikirizo ebi ebi ebihindukirwemu musanju, otabihandika.

english: Jesus said to me, “Get out of here, for I will send you far away to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Yangambira ati Ruga hanu; baitu nyowe ndikutuma hara hali Abamahanga.

english: How happy I was when my friends came to tell you about your truth as you walk in the truth!
lunyoro: Baitu nkasemererwa muno bene baitu, obubaizire nibamanyisa amazima gawe nkokworukugendera omu mazima.

english: When it was getting late, the twelve men who had come with him came to him and said, “Send the people away, and let them go to the villages and farms around here and find some food, because we are here in the desert.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba nubu'sana kuira; ikumi nababiri bakaija, nibamugambira ngu Yohereza abekitebe, bagende omu maka nensi enyakuhe'raine bagonye, basake ebyokurya; baitu hanu tuli omu irungu kwonka.

english: Jesus said to them, “You yourselves know very well that a Jew is not allowed to join a Gentile or come to him because God has shown me that I must not call anyone who is a Gentile nor a sinner.
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Inywe mumanyire kyomuziro omuntu Omuyudaya okuterana nomunyaihanga, nobukwakuba okuija namberali; baitu Ruhanga akanyoleka ndeke okweta omuntu wena owomuzigu, nobwakuba omubi:

english: We are ready to punish anyone who will not listen to you when your response is put to the test.
lunyoro: kandi twetekanize okuhora enzigu hakutahu'ra kwona, okuhu'rwa kwanyu obukulikahiki'ra.

english: Paul went down and fell at him and followed him. “Don't be afraid,” he said, “for his life is in danger.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yasirimuka, yamugwera namubumbatira nagamba ati Mutatera empamo; baitu obwomezibwe burumu omunda.

english: So then, follow the straight path, so that anyone who walks in the path will not be led astray, and they will not find fault with you.
lunyoro: kandi muhendere ebigere byanyu empenda eziterekerire, anyakusenjura aleke okuhabisibwa, bai

english: And there will be others who will be first, and there will also be some who will last.
lunyoro: Baitu dora, haroho abenyuma abaliba abokubanza, kandi haroho abokubanza abaliba abokuma.

english: But I do not want you to do anything, but you do not know that your grace is an expression of love.
lunyoro: Kandi ntagonza okukora ekigambo kyona, iwe otakimanyire; embabazi zawe zireke okuba omu kuhambirizibwa, baitu omu kugonza.

english: to be buried, be raised to life with glory, be buried with power, and be raised up with power.
lunyoro: zikwa nokuganyibwa; guhumburwa nekitinisa: zirizikwa nobugara; zihumburwa namani:

english: [GENERAL) And like newborn babies, feed the pure and pure spiritual milk of Christ's disciples until they are saved.
lunyoro: kandi nkabana abenkerembe mwegombe amata agomwoyo agatarumu bugobya, nukwo gabakuze okuhikya okujunwa;

english: Some of them were convinced that he had given them the power to do wrong.
lunyoro: kandi abamu obubahungukire bahabire omu bigambo ebitarumu;

english: He looked like a man who built his house on rock, planted a garden, and built a foundation on rock. When the flood hit that house, it could not shake, because it was well built.
lunyoro: asisana nkomuntu ayombeka enju, nalima okuhamya muno, nagumya emiganda ha mwandara: kandi omugenzi obugwatahire enju egi, gutasobole kugitengesa; baitu ekombekwa kurungi.

english: You yourselves are my witnesses that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah, but I have been sent to follow him.’
lunyoro: Inywe muli nakaiso bange okunagambire nti Nyowe tindi Kristo,, baitu nkatumibwa okumwebembera.

english: Mary chose the best of what she had to say, but her action was not based on what she was doing.
lunyoro: ga Maryamu ayegomboize omugabo ogu ogusemire, ogutalimuihwaho.

english: The year is near, and you will see how these things will happen, and then you will know that the time is near when the Son of Man will come.
lunyoro: Omwaka guli haihi; kandi nainywe nukwo obumulikarora ebigambo binu nibihiki'ra, mumanye ali haihi, ali ha nyigi.

english: The woman who is forced to bear children is sad, but the child who is born will not be remembered for the joy of being born in the world.
lunyoro: Omukazi obwarumwa okuzara atunturam, baitu omwana obwamara okuzarwa, takiijuka okuhururwa, habwokusemere'rwa omuntu okuzarwaa omu nsi.

english: So he left them and went back into the boat and got into the other side of the lake.
lunyoro: Yabasiga, yagaruka okugwe'ra omu bwato, yayambuka nseri.

english: If you love those who love you, why should you be angry? Even sinners love those you love.
lunyoro: Kandi obumuraba numugonza abarukugonza inywe, musimwa muta? Baitu nabasisi bagonza abo ababagonza.

english: I heard a voice from heaven that sounded like a roaring waterfall, like a loud cry from the sky. It sounded like such a voice that the shepherds were blowing their wings.
lunyoro: Nabahu'ra iraka eriruga omu iguru nkiraka eryamaizi amaingi, kandi nkiraka eryekigamba ekingi: kandi iraka eribihire nkeryabatezi benanga obubatera enanga zabu:

english: [GENERAL) Look! Take what is left of you and of the things that were left of him, which were the last to die. I have not seen your work done in the presence of my God.
lunyoro: Gumya ebisigaireho, ebikaba bimalize okufa: baitu timboine omulimo gwawe guhikire omu maiso ga Ruhanga wange.

english: After the Devil had finished tempting Jesus, he left him in the boat.
lunyoro: Kandi Setan obuyamazire ebyohyo byona, yamurugaho ekicu.

english: I want to know that you have been given the Spirit by the deeds of the Law or by the obedience of the faith.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo kyonka ngondeze okumanya Ruhanga obwemirimo yebiragiro? Rundi obwokuhu'ra okwokuikiriza?

english: The second one came and said, ‘Sir, I have earned five gold coins worth of gold.’
lunyoro: Wakabiri yaija namgamba ati Mukama wange, erateri yawe ekasagisamu erateri itano.

english: Jesus said to him, “You have already seen him, and he is talking with you.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Omuboine, kandi arukubaza naiwe nuwogu.

english: and he is the first of all the things that bind together in union with Christ.
lunyoro: kandi nuwe wokubanza wa byona nibikwatana hamu habwe.

english: Or perhaps he will say to him, ‘Take your meal and sit down and eat; then you will have enough to eat and drink; and afterward you will eat and indeed drink.’
lunyoro: Rundi talimugambira ati Ihura ebyokurya, oyetege, ompereze, obundakamara okurya nokunywa; kandi hanyuma nubwo orye onywe?

english: They will do these things, because they do not know him, because the Father does not know them, nor do they know me.
lunyoro: Ebi balibikora, baitu Isenyowe tibamumanyire, baitu isenyowe tibakamumanya, nibwakuba nyowe.

english: They reject everything they know, and when they are born like wild animals, the Evil One will leave them.
lunyoro: Abo bajuma byona ebibamanya: kandi ebibamanyire omu kuzarwa nkebisoro ebibatayina amagezi, omwebi bahwereke'ra:

english: But when the tenants saw him, they started making plans together and said, “This is the owner's son. Come on, let's kill him, because the property belongs to us!”
lunyoro: Baitu abalimi obubamuboine bahanura hamu bonka nibagamba ngu Nuwonu mugwetwa: timuite, obugwetwa bube bwaitu.

english: Take what I have told you, and be at peace with me. In the world there will be trouble for you. But be patient with me, because I have defeated the world.
lunyoro: Ebimbibagambire mube nobusinge omuli nyowe. Omu nsi muyina obujune: baitu mugume; nyowe nsinguire ensi.

english: Why, then, do you question me? Question the people who heard me; they know what I said when he said these things.
lunyoro: Kandi nogarukamu ki? kaguza abampulire, ebinabagambire: dora, nibo bamanyire ebinagambire Obuyagambire ebi,

english: the Holy Spirit, who has given us the task of keeping us from sinning in union with Jesus Christ
lunyoro: Omwoyo Ogurukwera oguyatusesire okutabali'ra omu Yesu Kristo

english: I did not go to Jerusalem to those who wanted to see the first ones, but to go to Arabia, and afterward I went back to Damascus.
lunyoro: kandi ntatembe Yerusalemu hali abakwenda abo: baitu nkagenda Arabu; kandi hanyuma nagarukayo Damasiko.

english: For the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in those days.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro biriija; nomuswezi obwalibaihwaho, nubwo balisiba omu biro ebi.

english: After they had done everything that the Scriptures say about him, they took him down from the cross and put him in a tomb.
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okuhikiriza byona ebyamuhandikirwe, bamuhanura ha muti, bamuta omu kina.

english: For rulers are not afraid of good, but of evil. Do you want to have no fear of authority? Do what is good, and you will have praise from him.
lunyoro: Abalemi tibali bokutinisa hali omulimo omurungi, baitu hali omubi. Kandi nogonza okutatina obulemi? Kora ekisemire, kandi olisimwa ogu:

english: “Get up, pick up your mat, and pick up the colt, and go to Israel, for those who were trying to kill the child are dead!”
lunyoro: kandi yagamba ati imuka, otwale omwana na nyina, ogende omunsi eya Isaleri, baitu abakaba nibase'ra omwana okumuita bafire.

english: Remember those who are taking the lead among you, and I myself will do this to you.
lunyoro: hakiri mubaijukege abakuru; kandi nanyowe nkabandi mwekambi okukora kinu.

english: Be bold and speak in front of all, so that others will be afraid.
lunyoro: Abarukusisa obakome, obahanege omu maiso ga bona, abandi babe nokutina.

english: For if I want to boast about myself, I will not be foolish. I will speak the truth, but I will run away from you, because no one thinks that you are worth much more than I am.
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba ningonza okwenyumiza, tindiba mudomadoma; baitu ndagamba amazima: baitu nindeka, omuntu wena atantekereza okukira byah'ra hali nyowe.

english: It was drunk in all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
lunyoro: Kandi kikamanywa omu Yopa yona; baingi baikiriza Mukama waitu.

english: Then the Devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in his glory.
lunyoro: Kandi Setani, akamutawara ha rusozi oruraihire muno, yamwoleka obukama bwona obwomunsi zona, nekitinisa kyabwo;

english: Peter spoke up and said to him, “Look! We have left everything and followed you. What will we have?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero yagarukamu namugambira ati Dora, itwe tukasiga byona, twakuratira Iwe: naitwe tulitunga ki?

english: For if those who live according to the Law were circumcised, faith is of no use at all, and the promise has been made.
lunyoro: Baitu abali omu biragiro obubaraba nibo bagwetwa, okuikiriza buli tikunyina omugaso, nomurago guburanganizibwe:

english: All suffering is not like the pain of today's age; it is like the birth of a child in peace for those who are being taught that way.
lunyoro: Okubonabonesebwa kwona omu biro bya hati bunu tikurukusisana okuba kwokusemererwa, baitu kwobujune: abo abanyakwegesebwa omukwo bahabwa obusinge:

english: [GENERAL) As they came down from the water, the Spirit of the Lord did not see them any more, because they went with joy on their way.
lunyoro: Obubarugire omu maizi, Omwoyo gwa Mukama atambone obundi, bitu akagenda nasemererwa

english: You yourselves know that these hands of mine were the ones who gave me what I wanted, and those who were with me.
lunyoro: Inywe mumanyire inywenka emikono enu niyo yampaisaga ebinase'raga, nabo abakaba bali nanyowe.

english: The twenty-four elders will sit down on the earth in front of the one who sits on the throne, and they will praise him who lives forever and ever, and bow down before the throne and say,
lunyoro: abakuru abo amakumi abiri mu bana baliinama hansi omu maiso gogu anyikuikalire ha kitebe kyobukama, kandi balimuramya anyakwomera okuhikya ebiro nebiro, kandi balinaga ekondo zabu omu mauso gekitebe kyobukizi, nibagamba ngu

english: I am the vine, and you are the branches. Those who remain in me, and I in him, will bear much fruit; for you can do nothing without me.
lunyoro: Ninyowe muzabibu, ninywe matagi: anyakuikara omuli nyowe, nanyowe omuruwe, nuwe ayana bingi: baitu ha nyowe ntali timuroho ekimurukusobora okukora.

english: and the other person was married, and everyone else was married.
lunyoro: kandi ondi akaswerwa, yafa; nabo bona bakamuswera.

english: When the Passover Festival was over, the Jewish Passover Festival had nearly come.
lunyoro: Kandi Okukhungurwaho, nubwo baugenyi Bwabayudaya, kukaba kumalize okuhika.

english: My dear friends, we think of you as something much better, and we talk about salvation and salvation.
lunyoro: Bene baitu, itwe tubatekerizeho ebigambo ebirukukira oburungi, kandi ebiri haihi nokujunwa, nobuturaba ntugamba tutu:

english: He ordered the carriage to stand still, and they both went down into the water, Philip and the official; and he baptized him.
lunyoro: Kandi yaragira egali okweme'raho: bombi basirimuka omu maizi, Firipo nomukonwa: yamubatiza.

english: What goes into your mouth is not what defiles you, but what comes out of your mouth, that defiles others.
lunyoro: Ekinyakutaha omu kanwa tikiri nikyo ekisisa omuntu; baitu ekiruga omu kanwa, nikyo kisisa omuntu.

english: But two years later Porcius Festus succeeded Felix, and Felix wanted to gain favor with the Jews, so he left Paul in prison.
lunyoro: Baitu obuyahikire emyaka ebiri, Porukio Fesito yagaruka omu kiikaro kya Ferikisi; kandi Ferikisi obuyagondeze okusimwa Abayudaya, yasiga Pauro aboherwe.

english: The man who was sitting on the throne said, “Look! I am making all things new!” He said, "Write down, because these words are true and come true.”
lunyoro: Nauwe akaba aikalire ha kitebe kyobukama yagamba ati Dora, ninfora byona ebihyaka. Yagamba ati Handika: baitu ebigambo binu byokwesiga, byamazima.

english: Jesus said to him, “Well done, good servant! You are a faithful servant of God, working with a large quantity of money to make ten cities.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Okozire, iwe omuiru rubale omurungi. Baitu okaboli wokwesiga hali akakaito, olemege embuga ikumi.

english: For the Father has given us all this life, so that we might live in union with him.
lunyoro: Baitu Isitwe akasima okuhiki'ra kwona kuikale omuruwe:

english: He did not even have his own Son set free for us all; he gave him as our Savior, did he not give us all things?
lunyoro: Ataraimire Omwanawe wenka, baitu akamuhayo habwaitu itwena, talituha nkomwenda ebintu byona hamu nauwe?

english: You too must pay attention to him, because he has taken very much of what we say.
lunyoro: naiwe omukenge ogu; baitu akatunga muno ebigambo byaitu.

english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn't come for me, but for you.”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Iraka linu tiriizire habwange, baitu habwanyu.

english: the history of human beings and the history and all other things related to sound doctrine.
lunyoro: hati nabararahi'ra busa, na byona ebirukusisana nkokwegesa okwomire okukuli:

english: I am telling you the truth: everyone who believes in me has believed in him who sent me.
lunyoro: mali mali nimbagambira nti Anyakuikiriza omuntu wena outuma, buli aikirize nyowe; kandi anyakuikiriza nyowe buli aikirize ogu ayantumire.

english: But if he does not know what he is doing and does what is right, he will receive a little more. And if he is given more, he shall receive much more; and if he obeys many, they will be much more than many.
lunyoro: Baitu ataramanyire nakora ebisemerire okumuteza, nuwe aliterwa kake. Kandi wena anyakuhebwa ebingi, ogu alitongwa bingi; nogu oubahuza ebingi balimuhebwa bingi.

english: Give to the poor, the needy, the respect, and the respect; to the respect and honor of those who are honored.
lunyoro: muheyoga hali abomusoro, omusoro; hali abehozo, ehozo: hali abokutinwa, okutina: hali ebikitinisa, ekitinisa.

english: You want, but you don't have to. You kill, but are under control, because you cannot get what you want. You have no excuse for not praying.
lunyoro: Mugonza, kunu timuyina: muita, kandi mukwatwa ihali, kunu timurukusobora okutunga: timunyina obwokutasaba.

english: Then he put in a new cloth, which had been wrapped in a sheet. He rolled a crown and put it on the door of the tomb, and went away.
lunyoro: kandi yaguta omu kina ekihyaka, ekyakaba alimire omu mwandara: yakumbya ibale erikoto, nalita ha muryango gwekituro, yagenda.

english: This is not because they are Abraham's descendants, but because they belong to him. In Isaac are your descendants, and by Isaac you will be called.”
lunyoro: kataba bali bana ba Iburahimu, nukwo bali bana bona: baitu ngu Omu Isaka numwo baijukuru bawe baryeterwa.

english: I saw a pale horse, and he was there who was named Death. Death and Hades followed. They were given authority over the fourth parts of the earth to kill with the sword, the famine, the death, and the animals of the world.
lunyoro: Narora kandi dora, embarasi kisa: nogu akaba aikalireho ibararye Rufu: Okuzimu nemukuratira. Kandi bahabwa obusobozi hali ekicweka ekyakana ekyensi, okuita nempirima, nenjara, norufu, nenyamaiswa eza hansi.

english: But the king went out to see the guests. He saw a man who was not wearing wedding clothes.
lunyoro: Baitu omukama obuyahinguiremu okurora abagennyi. Yabonayo omuntu atajwaire kyokujwara ekyobugenyi:

english: But if you were to receive a share of the property from a wild animal when it was born, and you were put in a good idol, yet you would not follow its birth. The person who was born that way would not have to be put right with his idol.
lunyoro: Kandi iwe, obworaba wacwirwe ha muzeituni ogukaba guli gwomu kisaka omu kuzarwa kwagwo, kandi wasimbibwa omu muzeitemuni omurungi, kunuatolekere okuhwereke'ra okwaziru, ago agali gokuza'rwaho tigalikira muno okusimbwa omu muzeitetuni gwago gonka?

english: He has placed his trust in the people of Moses, so that you will obey and obey everything they say. But do not act like them, because they do not do what they say.”
lunyoro: baikaire ha kitebe kya Musa; nukwo ebigambo byona ebibabagambira mubikole, mubigumye; baitu mutalikora nkabo okubakora; baitu okugamba

english: At once the father of the child said to him, ‘I believe; help me out of my lack of faith.’
lunyoro: Ahonaho ise omwana yayamuza nagamba ati Ninyikiriza; konyera obutaikiriza bwange.

english: They grabbed him and brought him to the Areopagus and asked him, “Do you want us to know about this new teaching? What do you say?”
lunyoro: Kandi bamukwata, bamuleta hali Aleopago, nibagamba ngu Turasobora okumanya okwegesa kunu okuhyaka okworukugamba okukuli?

english: But some of them live in houses where there is a woman who is a widow who has been burdened with many sins, who are subject to many trials.
lunyoro: Baitu omuli abo harumu abesensera omu nju nibanyaga abakazi abadomadoma, abalemerirwe ebibi bingi, abatwarwa okwegomba okwemiringo nyingi,

english: I was naked, but you clothed me; I was sick, and you took care of me. I was in prison, and You visited me.’
lunyoro: nkaba ndi busa, nainywe mukanjweka, nkaba ndwaire nainye mukansura; nkabandi omunkomo nainye mukaija mwandora.

english: The altar of gold and the ark of the covenant covered with gold all around it. It was on the other side of the gold altar, in which were the manna, Aaron's rod, and the tablets of the Law covenant.
lunyoro: ekihandiko ekyezabu, nesanduko eyekiragano enyakuswekerwe ezabu embaju zona; ekaba erumu ekibindi ekya zabu, nambere harumu emanu, nomuigo gwa Aroni ogwamezere, namabale agekiragano;

english: Eat the flesh of kings, the flesh that has been given to them, the bread that has escaped from them, and the flesh which has been kept for the birds, and all the flesh who has been taken away from them; the flesh is for the free, the free gift, the slave, the little ones, and those who have grown old.
lunyoro: , mulye enyama yabakama, nenyama eyengabwa, nenyama yabantu emanzi, nencu, nebindi nebindi; abobugabe nabairu rubale, abato nabakuru.

english: [GENERAL) And take the helmet of salvation to the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
lunyoro: Kandi mutwale nenkonfira eyokujunwa nempirima yomwoyo nikyo kigambo kya ruhanga:

english: They tried to stop us from preaching to the Gentiles about salvation, in order to make their sins come true all the time. But the wrath has come upon them all at once.
lunyoro: batutanga okutebeza Abamahanga ebyokubajuna; okuhikiriza ebibi byabu ebiro byona: baitu ekiniga kibahikireho okuma'ra kimu.

english: He will come to the master of the house on a day when he does not know it, and at a time when he is not aware of it, he will cut off his wife and give her to his husband, but they will not believe.
lunyoro: omukama womuiru ogu rubale aliija hakiro ekyatategerezamu, omu kasumi akatamanyire, alimucwamu babiri, alimuha omugabogwe hamu nabataruikiriza.

english: I tell you that every accusation that people make will be upheld by them on the Judgment Day.
lunyoro: kandi nimbagambira nti ekigambo kyona ekitarumu abantu ekibaligamba, balikitongana ha kiro kyomusango,

english: Do not be troubled at all, but in all your prayers and in all our prayers, together with thanksgiving, let your hope in God be made known to you.
lunyoro: Mutalituntura na kake, baitu omu kusaba kwona nokwesengereza hamu nokusima mumanyisege ebimuse'ra hali Ruhanga.

english: But they did not understand this saying, and they were afraid to ask him.
lunyoro: Baitu batamanye kigambo eki, batina okumukaguza

english: After spending a long time there, they were sent back to the apostles and greeted them in their greetings.
lunyoro: kandi obubamazireyo ebiro bingi, bayoherezebwa nobusinge bene babu, okugarukayo hali abo ababantumire.

english: The sower sows the word.
lunyoro: omusigi asiga ekigambo.Kambanu abomuhanda rubaju

english: All of you are children of the light, and all of you belong to the light. We do not belong to day or to darkness.
lunyoro: baitu inywena muli bana bomusana, abana ba nyamusana: tituli bekiro, nobugwakuba omuirima;

english: If one part is broken, all the pieces are ruined together; if the whole part is made glad, then all the other parts are made glad together.
lunyoro: Kandi ekicweka kimu obukiba nikisasa, ebicweka byona bisasira hamu; rundi ekicweeka obukyisenyumiriza, ebindi byona bisemere'rwa hamu.

english: It was right in the presence of the apostles and the elders and the whole church to choose men from their group and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. Judas, who is called Barsabbas and Silas, were the older men of the group.
lunyoro: Kandi kikaba kisemire omu maiso gabakwenda nabakuru hamu nekanisa yona, okukomamu abasaija, omu kitebe kyabu, nokubatuma Antyokiya, hamu na Pauro na Baranaba; Yuda, anyakwetwa Barasaba, na Sira abanyakatagara abakuru omu bene babu:

english: The next day Herod put on his royal clothes and sat down in the crowd and told them important things.
lunyoro: Kandi ha kiro ekiyataireho, Herode akajwara ebyokujwara ebyobukama, yaika'ra ha kitebe, yabagambira ebigambo ebikuru.

english: They watched him and told him to be quiet on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Bamurole'ra okwaramukiza ha kiro kya Sabiti.

english: But when the Jews opposed this, I was forced to appeal to the Emperor, because I did not have anything to do with our nation.
lunyoro: baitu Abayuuda ya obubayangire, nahambirizibwa okuju'le Kaisali; nkaba ntayina kigambo okulega ihanga ryaitu.

english: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father, and there is one who will accuse me about you, even Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
lunyoro: Mutalitekereza ngu ndibanyege'ra hali Isenyowe: haroho omu abanyege'raga, nuwe Musa, oumurukunihira.

english: For the scripture says to Pharaoh, “I raised you from death to life and showed you my power, and my name will be proclaimed throughout the whole world.”
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe bagambira Faraho ngu Nikyo nakuimukize iwe, okwolekera omuliwe amani gange, kandi ibara ryange ligambirwe omu nsi zona.

english: In this way your faith, which is much more precious than gold, will be tested by fire, and will bring glory, honor, and glory to God by the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Nukwo kulengwa kwokuikiriza kwanyu okurukukira omuhendo ezabu enyakuhwaho nobwerengwa omu mu'ro, kuzoke hali okukugiza nekitinisa nokunyumizibwa ha kusuku'rwa kwa Yesu Kristo:

english: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house. “Send someone to Joppa,” he said. “ Send someone to Simon, who is by the name of Peter.
lunyoro: Kandi yatugambira okuyaboine maraika ayemerire omu njuye, nagamba ati Otume Yopa, oyeteyo Simoni ibararye eryakabiri Petero;

english: I have told you these things, and when the time comes to gather the grapes, you will remember what I said to you. I have not told you them before, but I have been with you all.
lunyoro: Leki nikyo mbagambirire, Kandi akasumi obukalikahika, muliijuka nyowe nkabagambira. Kandi ebi ntabibagambire kara, baitu bkabandi hamu nainywe.

english: Listen to him, and Jesus saw that he was alone. At that very moment they all stopped up and told no one what they had seen.
lunyoro: muhulire Yesu ali wenka. Kandi bakaculera kwonka, okutagambiraho muntu omu biro ebi ekigambo kyona ekibaboine.

english: But if they do these things in the world, how can they do so unless they live in a tree?
lunyoro: Baitu obubaraba nibakora binu omuti mubisi, balikora bata omuti gwomere?

english: But when they speak evil of the worthless things of the nations, they deceive themselves by the desires of the flesh and by the desire of the house, by the same as by the power of the light from the darkness of the day.
lunyoro: Baitu obubagamba ebigambo ebikoto ebihanga ebitarumu, babihabiha omu kwegomba kwomubiri, omu rwanju, abo aba'sana okubairuka abairuka abarukugenda omu kuhaba;

english: After Jesus had said this, as they were looking up, he was taken up to heaven, and a cloud covered their eyes.
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ebi, bakaba nibarora, yatwarwa haiguru; ekicu kyamusereka hali amaiso gabu.

english: I will dedicate myself to you, then, so that your love may grow more and more through your knowledge
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndikusabanti okugonza kwanyu kweyongereyo ngerege okusaba omu kumanya

english: All things that are made plain by the light are made known, but all things that is made by the truth are made come out of light.
lunyoro: Baitu byona ebirukuhanwa omusana nibimanyisibwa: baitu kyona ekikumanyisibwamu guba musana.

english: So then, they left the Council and were glad that they had been judged worthy to be put to shame by the name of the Lord.
lunyoro: Nukwo baruga omu maiso gorukurato basemerirwe obwokutekerezebwa basemerire okugizibwa ensoni Habwibara.

english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to his Son.
lunyoro: Baitu na Isenyowe tacwera muntu omusango, baitu akamuha Omwana okucwa omusango gwona;

english: Jesus said to her, “My daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed from your trouble.”
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Omuisiki, okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize; oyegendere nobusinge, oki'le kimu endwara yawe.

english: “If someone hits you, you must change your mind; if someone takes away your coat and puts it on you, then you will not be able to pay back what you owe him.”
lunyoro: Ogu akutera orusaya omuhindu'lege norwakabiri: nogu akuihaho omwegereko gwawe, nekyesomeko kyawe otalikimuima.

english: It is not because of your lack of faith that you are working with one another in your joy, but because of the lack of it that your faith has made you strong.
lunyoro: Tini baitu tuli bakozi batahi banyu, omu kusemererwa kwanyu; baitu okuikiriza nukwo kubemerize.

english: He came a third time and said to them, “Get up, get up, and rest! The hour has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to the power of sinners.”
lunyoro: Yagaruka okuija obwakasatu, yabagambira ati Mugwijagire hati bunu, muhumule: kiramara; akasumi kahikire; dora, Omwana womuntu tahebwayo omu Mukono yabasisis.

english: You snakes! You can stop speaking what is good. For what is in your heart is what the mouth speaks.
lunyoro: Inywe abana benjoka, numusobora muta muihire okugamba ebugambo ebisemire. Baitu ebiijura omu mutima, akanwa nibyo kagamba.

english: When the officer heard this, he gave a complete report of the case to Joseph.
lunyoro: kandi obuyakihulire hali omunyakihanda, yaha Yusufu omutumbi.

english: [GENERAL) so that you will obey the word of God by your conduct, which you have been taught. And you will do many other things like this.
lunyoro: mumaraho ekigambo kya Ruhanga obwengeso zanyu, ezimwayegeseze inywe: kandi mukora ebindi bingi nkebi.

english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues everywhere; there will be terrible things and terrible things coming from heaven.
lunyoro: habaho emisisa emikoto, nebihe norufu biribaho ahandi nahandi; halibaho nebinyakukanga nobwokuro'raho obukuru oburuga haiguru.

english: If you call out to your Father, who judges people, and does not gather them together, according to the work each one does, then spend your days in fear.
lunyoro: Kandi obumuraba nimweta Isinywe ogu anyakucwa omusango hatali okusororamu abantu, nkomulimo gwomuntu wena okuguli, mumale ebiro byanyu obumugonya hansi omu kutina:

english: We have this hope as an anchor for the future, so that the hope of the truth will not fail, and the hope we have in the hope ahead will not be shaken.
lunyoro: tusigirege nkekyokusibika omutima, okunihira okwamazima okutatengeta tengeta, nokusibika ebigere byaitu;

english: That is why he has given us the very precious and precious clothes that he has entrusted to us, so that you may be his share in the work of God's service, in order to keep from living the world's passion for pleasure.
lunyoro: nuwe yatuheriremu emiragoye eyomuhendo mwingi, kandi emikoto muno, nukwo obwebi mufoke abarukuterana omu mulingo gwa Ruhanga, obumulikamara okuiruka okujunda okunyakuli omunsi obwokwegomba.

english: Jesus told them many other things and told them the good news.
lunyoro: Kandi yabagambi'raga ebindi bingi, natebeza abantu ebigambo ebirungi;

english: For just as Jonah became a sign for the people of Nineveh, so he did not see it.
lunyoro: Baitu nka Yona okuyafokere akokuro'raho hali Abanineve, nukwo

english: After he had finished doing all, there was a violent earthquake in that country, and he began to pray.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazireho byona, hakabaho ekihe kingi omu nsi egi; yabanza okusega.

english: After a few days the strong wind blew very fiercely on them, called “Northema.”
lunyoro: kandi hanyuma yebiro tibiri bingi, ihunga eringi likarugayo niriretera muno, eryetwa Eurakuro:

english: It is not reasonable for him to write a letter to the king, so send it to you. It is better that we, King Agrippa, have a letter with this letter after we have read it, and have received a written notice from him.
lunyoro: Tinyina kigambo haruwe ekyamananu okuhandikira omukama wange, Nikyo muletire namberemuli, kandi okukira omu maiso gawe, iwe omukama Agulipa, obuturakamara okumukaguliriza, ntunge ekigambo ekyokuhandika.

english: He himself has poured out our sins into his body on the cross, so that when we have died for sin, we might live a life of righteousness. And this is how he has accepted you.
lunyoro: uwe yayetwekere wenka ebibi byaitu omu mubirigwe ha muti, itwe obutumazire okufa ha bibi nukwo tuikalege abomezi hali okuhiki'ra: okuterwa kwogu nukwo kwabakirize.

english: The chief priests said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ because he said, ‘I am the king of the Jewish people.’”
lunyoro: Ibiro ebibyahikireho banyakatagara abakuru ababayudaya bagambira Pirato ngu Otahandika ngu Omukama Wabayudaya, baitu ngu ogu akagamba ati Ninyowe omukama wabayudu.

english: Stay in that same house, eating and drinking the things that I will give you. Workers should get their pay. Do not go from one house to another.
lunyoro: Kandi omu nju egi numwo muliikaramu, numurya numunywa ebi ebinalibaha: baitu omukozi asemerire emperaye. Mutaliruga omu nju emu okutaha omu nju endi.

english: He took a cup, gave thanks to God, and handed it to them. “Drink this to all of you,” he said.
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, yasima, yabaha, nagamba ati. Munywe ha enu inywena;

english: He followed Paul and us and cried out in a loud voice, “These men are telling you the way to go!”
lunyoro: Ogu akakuratira Pauro naitwe, nagambira haiguru muno, ababatebeza omuhanda ogwokujwa.

english: You know that he has been chosen to be the one who was chosen to share the Good News with me for the sake of the gospel, just as a son to his father.
lunyoro: Baitu mumumanyire okuyasimirwe ngu akahereza hamu nanyowe habwenjiri nkomwana hali ise.

english: Then Jesus took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once his feet and anklet became strong.
lunyoro: Yamukwata ha mukono ogwoburyo, yamuimukya: ahonaho ebigerebye nobukongoijobwe byatunga amani.

english: They must do their best to be rich in good deeds and to be strong in good works. They must be ready to give, ready to share.
lunyoro: kandi bakolege kurungi, babe abaguda omu ngeso enungi, abebembezi omu mulimo omurungi, betekanizege okugaba, bateranege hamu:

english: [GENERAL) We call you happy because you endured. You have heard of Job's patience, and you have seen the Lord's mercy and compassion.
lunyoro: Mahano! Dora, ntubeta abomugisa abagumisiriza: mukahu'ra kuguma kwa Yobu, kandi mukarora empero ya Mukama, Mukama okwali wembabazi nyingi nokuganyira.

english: For I will give you words and wisdom to all your enemies, so that they will not be able to stand up or accuse you.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe ndibaha akanwa namagezi abanyanzigwa banyu bona agabatalisobora okwemera nobukwakuba okuganga.

english: [GENERAL) If, then, God had given them this gift just as he had given us, we would have believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who I am, and would have kept his promise to God.
lunyoro: Nukwo, Ruhanga obwaraba yabahaire ekisembo eki nkokuyatuhaire itwe, obutwaikirize Mukama waitu Yesu Krsito, nyowe nkabandi oha, ayakusoboire okutanga Ruhanga?

english: They knew from the very beginning that I was a Pharisee, and they knew that I had been a Pharisee. I was an Pharisee, but as a matter of fact, I am a Pharisee.”
lunyoro: bamanyire okuruga kara, obubaraba nibenda okugamba, okunkaba ndi Omufalisayo, ninyerinda omu kicweka ekikira okulemesa ekyendini yaitu.

english: But get up and stand at your feet. I have appeared to you to make you a minister and a witness to the things I have seen and seen.
lunyoro: Baitu imuka, oyeme'le nebigere byawe: baitu nikyo nkobonekerire, okukutaho okuba muhereza na kaiso webigambo ebi ebyondoliremu, kandi owebi ebindikuro'rwamu:

english: When he heard these things, he was very sad, because he was rich.
lunyoro: baitu obuyahulire ebi yatuntura muno; baitu akabali muguda mali.

english: But if a person does not know how to manage his own house, how can he keep himself safe without God's church?
lunyoro: baitu omuntu wena obwatamanya okulema enjuye wenka, aralinda ata ekanisa ya Ruhanga?

english: For out of the heart come evil ideas, sexual immorality, immorality, orgies, drunkenness, and lasciviousness.
lunyoro: Baitu omu mutima, numwo haruga ebitekerezo ebibi, obuisi, obusihani, orwanju, obusuma, okuhangi'ra, okujuma;

english: He cried out in a loud voice, “She has fallen! Great Babylon has fallen!” She has become a place of worship for demons and has made her drink the poison of all kinds of evil birds.
lunyoro: Yagambira haiguru niraka erihango ati Rugwire, rugwire, Baburoni orukuru, rufokere ekiikaro ekyabacwezi kandi obubingira obwemizimu yona emibi, obuingira obwempungu zona ezibihire ezinobwa.

english: and love him with all your heart, with all our mind, with everything your strength, and love your neighbor as you love yourself.
lunyoro: kandi okumugonza nomutima gwona nokwetegereza kwona, namani gona, nokugonza omutahiwe nkokwayegonza wenka,

english: But if the righteous one is not ready to be saved, where will the wicked be left without fear of God?
lunyoro: Kandi anyakuhikirire obwalemererwa okujunwa, ogu omusisi atarukutina Ruhanga alizoka nkaha?

english: That is why I tell you the truth: when they see you, they will not see you; when they hear you, neither do they understand you.
lunyoro: Nikyo mbagambi'ra abo omu nfumo, baitu obubarora, tibarukurora, obubahu'ra tibarukuhweza, nokwakuba okwetegereza.

english: But when the sun was setting, it was red, and the sun shone on it.
lunyoro: baitu obubwayarukire, gwayaka muno, nomusana nugujwa.

english: Be self-controlled. Is it proper for a woman to pray to God that she will not wear a head covering?
lunyoro: Mwecwereinywenka amagezi: kisemire omukazi okusaba Ruhanga ateswekerire omutwegwe?

english: “We don't have any here,” they answered, “but five loaves and two fish.”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Titunyinabyo hanu, rundi emigati etano nencu ibiri.

english: They all ate and had enough, and the twelve baskets full of what was left over were left over.
lunyoro: barya nibaguta bona, kandi bakasoroza oburagalika obwasigaireho,ebigega ikumi na bibiri ebiijuire.

english: Yes, I want this glory to be shown by preaching the Good News, not by wearing any special robe or any special dress.
lunyoro: Ego, ninse'ra ekitinisa kinu, okutebeza enjiri, hatali nambere ibara ntombeka ha miganda yabandi.

english: No one does anything secret, but he himself wants to be clearly seen. If you do these things, show yourself to the world.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho akora ekigambo omunsita, nauwe wenka nayenda kurorwa bwerebwere. Obworaba nokora ebi, weyoleke hali Ensi.

english: He saw a Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, who was from Italy with his wife Priscilla. Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. So he went to them,
lunyoro: Kandi yabonayo omuntu Omuyudaya, ibararye Akura, ayazalirwe Ponto, akaba nubwo arugire Italiya, nomukaziwe Pirisikira. Baitu Kuraudio akaba aragire Abayudaya bona okuruga Rumi: kandi yaija nambere bali,

english: We are going to kill you, so that you will not be able to escape the great salvation that has already been told us by the Lord, and that has been proved to us by those who hear you.
lunyoro: tulikira tuta, obutulirekayo okujunwa okukuru okuingaine aho? okwabandize okugambwa Mukama waitu, kandi kwagumibwa halitwe abo abakuhulire,

english: It was not right for the earth or the sea to be quiet. They were sitting outside. Listen, then, if anyone has ears to hear!
lunyoro: Tikisemesire itaka, noburwakuba orubungo: bakinaga aheru. Anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra, ahu'le.

english: For those who are like them do not serve the Lord, but Christ. They do their own business, and because of good words and thanksgiving they deceive innocent people.
lunyoro: Baitu abanyakuli nkabo tibarukuko'ra Mukama waitu Kristo, baitu enda zabu bonka; kandi obwokubaza kurungi nokusima babihabiha emitima yabataroho musango.

english: He went on to see two other brothers, James son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with their father Zebedee. They were partners with him, and he called them.
lunyoro: Ahapireho omu maiso, yarora baisemu abandi babiri, Yakobo omwana wa Zebedayo, na Yohana mugenziwe, bali omu bwato hamu na isebo Zebedeo, nibasumukaniza ebisoha byabu: yabeta.

english: Jesus said to him, “Get up and go; your faith has made you well.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Imuka oyegendere: okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize.

english: In the same way, you also must respect those who are like them and for anyone who works with us in the same order.
lunyoro: nukwo nainywe mulemwege abanyakuli nkabo, nomuntu wena anyakukora hamu naitwe nakonyera.

english: So then, when I was ready to be saved from God, I stood up to this very day to tell the people and the elders, not to speak anything except what Moses said, and what they said was going to happen.
lunyoro: Nukwo, obunatungirwe okukonyerwa okuruga hali Ruhanga, nyemerire okuhikya ekiro kinu nintebeza abato nabakuru, okutagamba kigambo kyona, urndi babani ba Musa ebibagambire nibigenda okuija;

english: Jesus answered them, “I am telling you the truth: you do not need to see miracles, but to eat bread or to drink bread.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagarukamu nagamba ati Mali mali nimbaga mbira nti Timurukunse'ra obwokubona obwokuro'raho, baitu obwokurya ha migati, nobwokuiguta.

english: I will reply to them, “I did not know you. Get away from me, all you who do immoral things!”
lunyoro: Nubwo ndibagarukamu ningamba Tinkabamanyaga inywe: murugeho namberendi, inywena abakora ebyokwema.

english: The eye cannot say to the hand, ‘I don't need you,’ nor can the head to the feet, ‘You don'T need me.’
lunyoro: Kandi eriso tirirukusobora okugambira omukono ngu Tindukukutaga: rundi omutwe hali ebigere ngu Tindukubataga inywe.

english: For the Father himself loves you and loves you. Love me, and you will believe that I am with the Father.
lunyoro: baitu Isenyowe wenka nabagonza, baitu nugondeze nyowe,kandi muikirize ngu nkaraga hali IsenyoWe.

english: The father and mother were amazed at what Jesus had said.
lunyoro: Ise na nyina bakaba nibahuni'ra ebigambo ebi ebyamugambirweho;

english: They were amazed at this, and knew that there had been heavens from of old and earth made out of water and that the word of the Lamb had already come to them.
lunyoro: Baitu kinu bakyebwa bamanyire ngu hakaba haroho iguru okuruga kara, nensi eyakozirwe okuruga omu maizi, kandi ekaba eri hagati ya maizi habwekigambo kya Ruhang;

english: He is the one who came down from heaven, the one whom God sent out from heaven above, the Creator of all things.
lunyoro: Ayasirimukire nuwe omu nogu ayatembere haiguru muno, okukira iguru ryona, aijule byona.

english: How terrible for you! You are like unmarked graves, and the people who belong to them do not know it.
lunyoro: Ziribabona! Baitu numusisana nkebituro ebitarorwa, kandi abantu ababiribataho tibamanya.

english: We ourselves are good, but we have been paid in proportion to our actions, because this man has not sinned.”
lunyoro: Naitwe tugusemerire; baitu tuhairwe empera esemerire engeso zaitu: baitu omuntu onu takasisaga.

english: These people are selfish, angry, and follow their own desires (and speak evil of dignitaries), and join in their evil ways.
lunyoro: Abo bahyemi, ababihirwa, nibakuratira okwegomba kwabu ( nakanwa kabu nikagamba ebigambo ebikoto ebyokwekuza) nibasororamu abantu obwensagi zabu.

english: They are the people of Israel, who were given the privilege of being children of God, of being his children, of the Gentiles, of covenants, of fellowship with the Law, of giving glory to God, and of promises.
lunyoro: nibo Baisaleri; abahairwe okufoka abana, nekitinisa, nebiragano, nokwahuzibwa ebiragiro, nokuramya Ruhanga, nemirago;

english: But the sun will come out, and the wind will throw down the earth, and its beauty will be great on the earth. And so the rich will shine on his way.
lunyoro: Baitu izoba lituruka, nomuyaga ogurukwokyo guhotokya obunyansi; kandi orwakyo rwabwo ruragara hansi, noburungi obwekisisani kyabwo bubura: kandi omuguda nukwo alihotoka ati omu kugendakwe.

english: You will look for me, but you will not find me, and you will cannot go where I am going.
lunyoro: Mulinse'ra timulinzora: kandi namberendi, inywe timusobora kuijayo.

english: They had seen Trophimus from Ephesus with him in the city, and they thought that Paul had brought him into the Temple.
lunyoro: Baitu bakaba baboine Turofimo Omunyefeso hamu nauwe omu rubuga, nibatekereza Pauro amulesere omu yekaru.

english: I myself am the one who was made the one that was made perfect in union with Christ.
lunyoro: kandi nyowe ninyebwa habwabu, nabo bonka bayezebwe omu mananu.

english: But if I do, and you do not believe me, then you will believe what I am doing. And you will know that the Father is in me and that the Son is in union with me.
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba ningikora, nobumuraba mutarukuikiriza nyowe, muikirize emirimo: mumanye, mwetegereze ngu Isenyowe ali omuli nyowe.

english: Suddenly the boats and the boats were like this, and they were driven by a strong wind, and the boat was driven by the wind toward the wind.
lunyoro: Dora namato nobugaraba gali makoto gati, kandi nigatwarwa embeho yamani, nengahi enke muno gahindurwa hona hona nambere omurungiki arukwenda wenka.

english: On his cross a name written that says, “The Babylonian Empire is made up of idols and I have Gentiles and Gentiles of the world.”
lunyoro: Ha busobwe ibara lihandikirwe ngu EKYENSITA BABURONI NEBINUGWA NYINA ABASIHANI NEBINABA EBYENSI.

english: He was sitting in the middle of the courtyard. They woke him up and said to him, “Teacher, don't you care that we are about to die?”
lunyoro: Waraga omu kiso ha kisago: bamusisimura, bamugambira ngu Omwegesa, torukututaho mutima, twafa?

english: Look! I have given you authority to take up snakes and all kinds of evil things from your enemies. Nothing will hurt you at all.
lunyoro: Dora, mbahaire obusobozi obwokulibata enjoka, nenaku namani gona agomunyanzigwa: kunu busaho kintu ekiribakora kubi na kake.

english: Why are you anxious about clothes? Look at the things that are in the field, as the plants grow. They do not work or make clothes for themselves.
lunyoro: Kandi kiki ekibatuntuliza ebyokujwa? Murole ebyakyo ebyomu kisaka, nkokubimera: tibikora mirimo, nobukwakuba okwongosa orugoye:

english: He said this in the synagogue and taught Capernaum.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi akabigambira omu iso'rokaniro nayegesa Kaperenaumu.

english: The promises were given to Abraham and to his descendant. He did not say, ‘There are many ancestors,’ but, ‘Your ancestor is the Messiah.’
lunyoro: Kandi emirago ekagambirwa Iburahimu nomuijukuruwe. Tarukugamba ati Na hali abaijukuru, nka baingi, baitu nkomu ati Na halinywe nuwe Kristo.

english: Above him were the winged creatures of heaven and the wing of heaven. There is nothing we cannot say now.
lunyoro: kandi eruguru wayo bakerubi abekitinisa nibasikiriza entebe eyokuganyira; ebitutarukusobora okugamba hati bunu kimu kimu kimu;

english: They are eager to look for you, but it is not good for you. They want to keep you out of the way, so that you will be able to find them.
lunyoro: Begomba inywe, baitu tibirungi; baitu nibagonza okubakingira aheru, inywe mwekambe okkuse'ra bo.

english: While I was with you, I prayed that I would not take any of you with me; instead, the believers who have come from Macedonia have done what I have been told to do. In all circumstances I will keep them safe, and in this way I will be kept safe.
lunyoro: kandi obunkaba ndi hamu nainywe ninsega, ntajwahye omuntu nomu; baitu bene baitu abarugire Makedoni nibo bahikirize ebinabuzirweho; kandi omu byona nkerinda nyenka okutabajwahya, kandi nukwo ndayerindaga.

english: It happened, as he was doing the priestly duties in the presence of God.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika, obwakaba nokora emirimo eyoounyakatagara omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: For even if I have been sad for some time, I will not repent or turn away from my sins. I have seen that they have already turned from their sins and have seen what they have done to me.
lunyoro: Baitu nobundaba nabatuntuize omu baruha, tindukwegarukamu; baitu mboine ngu ebaruha egi ekabatuntuza, nobunabandize okwerinda.

english: A small bundle of flour is enough for the whole crop.
lunyoro: Ekitumbisa kike ----kitumbisa ekiihuro kyona.

english: As they shouted from heaven, they threw their cloaks over them and threw dust on them.

lunyoro: Muikalege omuntu wena omu kwetwa okuyayetirwemu.

lunyoro: Ego, halinywe haije esagama yona eyokuhiki'ra eyasesekire hansi, okubandize ha sagama ya Aberi, ogu ahikirire, okuhika ha sagma ya Zakaliya omwana wa Barakiya, owumwaisire hagati ya yekaru

lunyoro: Kandi nkajunwa habwokugamba kwenyamulere, na habwomukono gwomugole.

lunyoro: Inywe abebembezi abafwire amaiso, abasengijamu omubu, numumira engamira.

english: as good teachers of God's abundant grace, so that if any speak, they may obey the commands of God.

lunyoro: Kandi akagambira nogu ayamwesere ati Obworacumbaga ebyokurya ebyenyamusana rundi ebyorwebagyo, otaryeta enganjani zawe, nobubakuba bene banyu, nobwekuba abomu ruganda rwawe, nobubyakuba abatahi bawe abaguda; nabo batagaruka okukweta okukugaru'ra.

lunyoro: Petero yamugumyaho amaisoge, hamu na Yohana namugambira ati Role'ra itwe.

lunyoro: Kandi baburanganiza ekitebe nabalemi aborubuga, obubahulirire ebi.

lunyoro: baseruire omu maiso gawe, okundega obubaraba bayina ekigambo hali nyowe.
