lunyoro: ningumya ebiro byona omu kusaba kwange, rundi nsobole hati bunu okuletwa kurungi, Ruhanga obwaraba nagonza, okuija namberemuli.

english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything that will be known about it.
lunyoro: Baitu busaho ekiswekerwe ekitalisukurwa; nobukyakuba ekiserekibwe ekitalimanyisibwa.

english: They did not want to have God with their minds, but God gave them to a pure heart, to do what is not good.
lunyoro: Kandi nkokubatarayenzire okuba na Ruhanga omu magezi gabu, Ruhanga akabahayo hali omutima ogubihire, okukora ebi ebitarukusemera;

english: He stayed with them and went in and left.
lunyoro: Kandi yaikaraga hamu nabo, nataha naturuka

english: Then he will reply, ‘I tell you, whenever you did not do what one of the least of these little ones did not, you did it to me.’
lunyoro: Nubwo ali bagarukamu ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti nkokumutarakolire omu hali abo abarukukira obuto, Buli mutakiko're nyowe.

english: “What did he do to you?” they asked him. “How did he open your eyes?” they said.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Akakukora ata? Akaigura ata amaiso gawe?

english: We can say that Levi received the tenth from him, who through Abraham earned it.
lunyoro: Kandi ntusobora okugamba ngu na Levi arukuhambwa ebicweka biikumi; akabiherayo omu Iburahimu:

english: They entered the tomb and saw a young man sitting at the right side, wearing a white robe. They were amazed.
lunyoro: Bataha omu kituro, barora omusigazi aikalire ha rubaju orwoburyo, ajwaire orugoye orurukwera; bahuni'ra.

english: The king knows these things, and I am sure that he will speak boldly. I know that none of these things have ever been hidden from him, but this has not been done on the cross.”
lunyoro: Mukama amanyire ebigambo binu, nuwe ngambire nokuguma: baitu manyire kimu nti ebigambo binu tibimuserekerwe na kimu; baitu eki kitakorwe ha rubaju.

english: and become the father of those who are circumcised, not only of those whose faith is broken, but also of those in faith that our father Abraham lived before he was circumcised.
lunyoro: kandi abe isenkurubo abokuserwa, abatali bokusarwa kwonka, rundi nibagendera omu bigere byokuikiriza okwa Isenkuru itwe Iburahimu okwakaba ayinakwo omu kutasarwa.

english: But when I saw that they did not walk in the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter in front of them all, “If you are a Jew, you are following the Jewish customs, why do you try to force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?”
lunyoro: Baitu obunaboine nti tibagendera omu mazima agenjiri, nkagambira Kefa omu maiso gabu bona nti Iwe Omuyudaya obwaraba nokkuratira engeso zabayudaya, kiki iwe ohambiriza Abamahanga okukuratira engeso Zabayudaya?

english: In this vision I saw the horses and their riders took off from them what looked like torches, fires, and sulfur; the heads of horses were like lions' heads; and their mouths were like those of lions. Fire, smoke, and smoke came out of them.
lunyoro: Nukwo naboine nti embarasi omu kwolekwa kunu, nabo abaziikalireho, bajwaire ebyahakifua nkebyomu'ro, nebya huakinso nekiberiti: nemitwe yembarasi nkemitwe yentale: nomu minwa yazo harugamu omu'ro nomuika, nebika.

english: For just as you pray for God's people, you must be holy in all your conduct.
lunyoro: Baitu nkogu ayabesere okwarukwera, nukwo nainywe mube abarukwera omu ngeso zona;

english: You little children, I am with you a little while longer. You will seek me, just as I said to the Jews, ‘You cannot go where I am going.’ And so I tell you now.
lunyoro: Abana abato, ekicu kike nkiri hamu nainywe. Mulinse'ra: kandi nkokonagambire Abayudaya nti Handukugenda, inywe timusobora kuijayo; kandi na inywe nukwo ndukubagambira hati bunu.

english: They have a king who is an angel in charge of the abyss. He is a member of the party who lives in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek is a pool.
lunyoro: Ziyina omukama wazo, maraika owekina ekitayina hokugarukira: ibararye omu Ruheburaniya nuwe Abadoni, kandi omu Ruyonani nuwe Aporuoni.

english: But I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. ‘Go and let him go,’ you say to the one who sent me, ‘Come and come!’ and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he will do the same.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe ndi muntu omulemwa, nyina baserikale abadama: obungambira ogu nti Genda, agenda: nondi nti Ija, aija: nomuirui wange nti Gira oti, nukwo agira ati.

english: Do not be surprised at this, because the time is coming when all those in the graves will hear it.
lunyoro: Mutahuni'ra eki: baitu akasumi nikaija, bona abali omu bituro

english: He ordered the officer to guard him and give him the money; and he would not let any of his friends see him.
lunyoro: Kandi yaragira omunyakihanda okumulinda, kandi amuhe omwanya; nokutaganga enganjaniye wena okumurora.

english: At once the men who were going to question him left him. The commander was afraid, too, because he knew that he was a Roman citizen and that he had been whipped.
lunyoro: kandi ahonaho abo abakaba nibagenda okumukaguliriza bamurugaho: engabwa enkuru nauwe yatina, obuyamanyire ngu Murumi, kandi obwokumunoba.

english: So then, the Law has become our teaching to bring us to Christ, so that we may be put right with God through faith.
lunyoro: nukwo ebiragiro byafokere biti nkomwegesa waitu okutuleta hali Kristo, tuihibweho omusango obwokuikiriza.

english: We ourselves see Jesus, who is the one who was the one that was the servant of our faith, and who was faithful to him, because he endured the torture stake and lived on the right side of God's throne.
lunyoro: niturora ha Yesu wenka, omukozi wokuikiriza kwaitu, kandi omuhikiriza wakwo, obwokugumisiriza okwomuti, yaika'ra ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwekitebe kya Ruhanga.

english: so that people will not see a thief or a thief, but that they may see my Father who is unseen. Those who do such things will be my Father's, and he will reward you.
lunyoro: nukwo abantu baleke kukorora nosiba, rundi'So ali omunsita okurole:nukwo'So, anyakurora omu nsita, alikuha empera.

english: They did not take any oil, but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
lunyoro: baitu abagezi bakatwara amagita omunsale zabu hamu netabaza zabu.

english: For the gate is closed and the way is kept open for a few days, and for a little while those who find it.
lunyoro: Baitu irembo lifunzire nomuhanda ogutaha omu bwomezi muke, nabo abaguzora bake.

english: Christ, the King of Israel, has come down from the cross now. We see and believe.” The believers who were crucified with him also denied him.
lunyoro: Kristo, Omukama wa Isaleri, aruge hati bunu ha muti. Itwe turole, tuikirize.kandi ababambirwe ahamu nauwe nabo bakamujuma.

english: This is the stone that was set at nought of you builders, which has become the biggest of the stones.
lunyoro: Ogu niryo ibale eryagayirwe inywe abombeki, niryo ryafokere erikuru erya ha karugu.

english: But I have given them what you have given me. They believe in it, and they know that I came from you and believe that you sent me.
lunyoro: baitu ebigambo ebiwampaire mbibahaire: babiikiriza, nibamanya mananukwo nkaruga haliwe, nibaikiriza niwe wantumire.

english: But you have kept my command to endure, and I will also keep you safe in the time of the end, which will come upon the whole world of people to punish those who live on earth.
lunyoro: Baitu iwe okerinda ekigambo kyokugumisiriza kwange, nanyowe ndikulinda omu kasumi kokwehebwa, akarukugenda okuija hali ensi zona ezabantu, okulenga abarukuikara ha nsi.

english: Those who swear by heaven swear by God, and those who worship them.
lunyoro: Nogu anyakurahira iguru buli arahire entebe ya Ruhanga, nogu arukwika'raho.

english: You bring new truths into our minds, and we want you to know the meaning of these things.
lunyoro: Baitu noleta ebigambo ebihyaka omu matu gaitu: nikyo turukwendera okumanya amakuru gebigambo binu.

english: After Judas had been handed over to the chief priests and the Pharisees, the soldiers and the officers of the guard came to him with torches, torches, and torches.
lunyoro: Kandi Yuda, abuyamazire okuhebwa ekihanda kya baserikale nabakuru babu hali banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo, yaijayo, ayina etabaza nebimuli namacumu.

english: For our message is not of legends or of legends, nor of legends and legends.
lunyoro: Baitu okugambi'ra kwaitu tikuli kwebisuba, nobuhokuba kwokutasemera;

english: To this very day we are hungry, thirsty, and thirsty; we are thirsty, but we are naked, and we have no food.
lunyoro: Na hati hona nturumwa enjara, ntukwatwa iroho, tuli kwonka, ntuterwa entomi, titunyina owaitu:

english: While he was sitting in the judgment hall, his wife sent him a message: “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, because I have suffered much in a dream for him.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaikalire ha ntebe eyomusango, mukaziwe yamutumira nagamba ati Omutu ogu ahikirire, otamukora kigambo na kake; baitu hati nsalirwe bingi omu kiroto hali uwe.

english: You are still human beings, but at one time you have doubts about what you are doing, yet you no longer belong to your human nature. You are not the only ones who walk in the same way.
lunyoro: mukyali abomubiri? Baitu obuharumu omulinywe ihali nempaka, timukyali bomubiri? Timurukugenda nkabantu kwonka?

english: He went a little farther down the cliff and prayed, as soon as possible, leaving him for a while.
lunyoro: yagendaho hake, yasaba, kiraba nikisoboka, akacu kamurugeho.

english: But if some of those who do not believe invite you to go with them, and you want to go, eat everything that is set before you, without asking questions about the truth.
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abo abtarukuikiriza obwaba nabeta, nainywe obumwenda okugenda, kandi inywe nimugonza okugenda, murye byona ebitairwe omu maiso ganyu, mutarukukaguza ekigambo obwomutima.

english: The servant who had received two thousand coins came and said, ‘Sir, you have deposited two thousand silver coins. Here I have lost two thousand other coins.’
lunyoro: Yaija nogu ayahairwe etaranta ibiri,nagamba ati Mukama wange okansigira etaranta bibiri; dora nkagobamu etabiri ezindi.

english: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering this against him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bahu'ra ebitebe nibagambirangana bati haruwe; banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo batuma abaduma okumukwata.

english: But when I boast about him in all I do, I am not ashamed of him. As we have told you all the truth, so our boasting in Titus was about the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu obunayenyumize omu kigambo kyona habwanyu haruwe, ntakwate ensoni; baitu nkokutwabagambire inywe byona omu mazima, nukwo nokwenyumiza kwaitu hali Tito kukaba kuli kwa mazima.

english: The priest of Zeus was in front of the city, and he brought oxen and oxen on the gates, and tried to kill the people with the sword.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara wa Zeu akaba ali omu maiso gorubuga, akaleta ente nemikako eyebyakyo ha malembo nayenda okusara ekyonzira hamu nebitebe.

english: But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and to keep him under guard until I could send him to the Roman Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: But you know that afterward he wanted to receive a blessing from God, because he did not see him repent and turn away from drinking water.
lunyoro: Baitu mu manyire ngu hanyuma obuyagondeze okugwetwa omugisa akangwe, ( baitu atabone hokwegarukiramu) nobuyaguseruire noku'ra amazi.

english: Leave all my belongings to the poor, and go to the streets. During the time of harvest I will tell the teachers of the Law, ‘Take the bread first and throw it to the dogs, because you are the ones who will get it.’
lunyoro: Muleke binyete byona, bihike ha magesa: omu biro ebyokugesa ndigambira abagesi nti Mubanze musoroze emberya, muzibohe enganda bazokye: baitu oburo mubuhunike oku maguli gange.

english: They have authority to shut up the sky so that no rain can come down during the time of their preaching. They have power over the springs of water to turn the earth into blood, and to make the earth and all the heavenly bodies suffer, as often as they wish.
lunyoro: Banu bayina obusobozi okuiga'ra iguru, enjura ereke okugwa omu biro byokugamba kwabu: kandi bayinaobusobozi ha maizi okugafora esagama, nokutuntuza ensi nemihito yona, emirundi mingi nkokubaragonzaga.

english: We have many things to say to you, and you have many difficult things to tell you, but you have become dull of hearing.
lunyoro: Tunyina ebigambo bingi okumugambaho, kandi ebirukulemera okubimanyisa, baitu inywe mufokere abafu bamatu.

english: So then, if I do judge, my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but with the Father who sent me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nobundaba nincwa omusango, okucwa kwange kwa mananu; baitu nyowe tindi omu, baitu ndi hamu na Isenyowe ayantumire.

english: The purity of the heart, the knowledge, the strength, and the grace of the Holy Spirit, and of the love of money, and to love the truth.
lunyoro: hati omu kwera okwomutima, nomu kumanya, nomu kuguma, nomu mbabazi, nomu Mwoyo Ogurukwera, nomu kugonza okutali kwobugobya, nomu kigambo kyamazima,

english: That is why you have to follow the example of the Nicolaitans, who belong to me.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo oyinakyo, onobere engeso za Banikoraiti, ezi'noba nyowe.

english: That is why Moses ordered you to circumcise a boy, not Moses, but your ancestors; and on the Sabbath you circumcise a human being.
lunyoro: Moses nikyo yabaherire okusara ( tukuli kwa Musa, baitu nukwo kwa baisenkuru inywe); kandi ha Sabiti musara omuntu.

english: Believe me, then, that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; and you believe me only because of what I do.
lunyoro: Munyikirize ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, na isenyowe omuli nyowe: rundi munyikirize habwemirimo yonka.

english: It gives me proof of what I am doing, and I do not want to come to you to have life.
lunyoro: Ibyo bimanyisa ebyange; kandi timurukwenda kuija namberendi mube nobwomezi.

english: You Capernaum, who are highly respected by God, will you be raised to life by the power of the Spirit?
lunyoro: Naiwe Kaperenaumu, olinyumizibwa haiguru muno? Olisirimurwa okuhika okuzimu.

english: It is good to give glory, honor, and power to you, Lord our God. You have created all things, and just as you wanted them to be, they existed and were given as you pleased.
lunyoro: Osemire, ai Mukama Ruhanga waitu, okuhabwa ekitinisa nokutinwa nobusobozi: baitu niwe wahangire byona, kandi nkokuwagondeze bikabaho, kandi bikahangwa.

english: The Pharisees answered, “How did he do to you?”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo babagarukamu ngu Kandi ahabisize nainywe?

english: For those who have something will be given more, and those who don't have will have more than they have, and all that they have will be taken away from them.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuina, nuwe arihebwa: akandi atanyina, aliihibwaho nakyo ekyanyinakyo.

english: These are the things that are like these in these modern times. They have increased the sacrifices and the sacrifices that cannot be made to serve the one who serves the one whose heart is pure, but who boasts of what is in their hearts.
lunyoro: eki nikyo kisisani omu biro bya hati bunu: nikyo bahongera ebisembo nebyonzira ebitarukusobora okuhikiriza arukuramya omu bigambo ebyomu mutima, baitu

english: But they did not recognize him, so he put on his clothes and said to them, “You must put your own blood on your own heads. I am not guilty. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Baitu obubamutangire nibajuma, yakunkumura ebyokujwarabye, nabagambira ati Esagama yanyu ikale ha mitwe yanyu enywenka; nyowe tindoho musango: okubanza hati ndagendaga hali Abamahanga.

english: The night is almost over, and the day is almost here. Let us, then, be full of practices that please the darkness, and let us take up weapons for the light.
lunyoro: Ekiro kihinguire muno, obuire nubu'sa okukya: nukwo tujule engeso ezomuirima, tujwale ebyokurwanisa ebyomusana.

english: That is why you must give to the poor my money, and when I come, I will receive it back with interest.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyakuhikirire okuha abaguzi efeza yange, nanyowe obunakuizire nakuhairwe eyange namagoba gayo.

english: The one who sent me is what he wanted: ‘Do not lose anything he has given me, but I will raise him to life on the last day.’”
lunyoro: Ayantumire ekyagonza nikyo kinu ngu Ha kyona ekyampaire haleke okuburaho na kake, baitu nkiimukye ha kiro kya hampero.

english: As you have given him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all those you have handed him.
lunyoro: nkokumuhaire obusobozi ha banyakuina omubiri bona, bona abawamuhaire, abahe obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: In this way we will celebrate the Passover, not with a conscience or with an evil conscience, but with things that are not based on legends and legends.
lunyoro: nukwo tucumbe obugenyi, hatali nekititumbisa ekiitima nobubi, baitu nebitatumbisibwa ebyobutagobya namazima.

english: The king praised that dishonest accusation, but he was wise. The people of this world are much more shrewd than the people of the day in their own order.
lunyoro: Kandi mukamawe akanyumiza omuketo ogu atali wokuhiki'ra, baitu akagira amagezi: baitu abana abensi enu, omu businge bwabu, nibakira amagezi abana abomusana.

english: But they did not do it, because they put heavy loads on their shoulders and put them on the shoulders, but did not want to put them to the test by themselves.
lunyoro: Baitu baboha enketo ezirukulemera,ezitetweka, ba zitweka abantu ha mabega; baitu bo tibenda kuzitengesa ne kyara kyabu.

english: To be honest, self-controlled, and self-control. There is no law against such things as these.
lunyoro: okwesigwa obuculezi, okwerinda: hali ebirukusisa biti busaho kiragiro.

english: For a man must not cover his head, but he is a copy of God's glory. For a woman is a man's honor.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo omusaija tikimusemerire okwesweke'ra omutwe, baitu nuwe kisisani nekitinisa kya Ruhanga: baitu omukazi kiba kitinisa kyomusaija.

english: All those who live on earth will worship him, because the book of the living which was written in the Lamb's book of life has been lost since the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abaikara hansi balikiramya, wena atahandikirwe ibararyeomukitabu kyobwomezi Ekyokwana Gwentama ayaisirwe okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi.

english: But what does it mean to say that your sins have been forgiven or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
lunyoro: Baitu ekirahuka kiraha? Okugamba nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho, rundi okkugamba nti Imuka ogende?

english: He will not go into anything that is not good, nor will he go into the house of a thief or a robber. Instead, they will be written in the Lamb's book of the living.
lunyoro: kandi tihalitahamu na kake ekintu kyona ekitali kisemeri, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyomuziro nebisuba: rundi abo bonka bahandikwa omu kitabu ekyobwomezi Ekyomwana Gwentama.

english: Out of the mouth come forth cursing and cursing. My friends, these things ought not to happen to you.
lunyoro: Omu kanwa kamu numwo harugamu okukugia nokukyena. Bene baitu ebi tibisemerire okuikara biti.

english: They refuse to give up, because they themselves are slaves of sin; but the person who has been redeemed is slaves of that slave.
lunyoro: abo tibarukuikiriza okugaba, baitu bo bonka bali abairu rubale abokujunda; baitu omuntu ekyasingurwa, nikyo aba mukwenda wakyo.

english: For each one will prove himself faithful to his own work, and then he will have his own glory, not only for himself.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena ayerengere omulimogwe wenka, kandi nukwo abe nokwenyumizakwe habwe, kunu tihali habwondi.

english: And these things we write down for our own good.
lunyoro: nebbigambo binu itwe tubihandikire okusemererwa kwaitu kuhiki'le.

english: After saying this, Jesus went away and called Mary privately, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati Omwegesa aizire, nakweta.

english: He himself gave himself as a ransom for all, and the message will be preached in all creation.
lunyoro: oyayehaireyo wenka okubaekicunguro ekya bona; okumanisa kulibaho omu mpiko zakwo:

english: But they did not see his body, and came to him and said, “He is alive!”
lunyoro: kandi obubatazoire mutumbigwe, baija nibagamba ngu baboine nokwolekwa okwa bamaraika abagambire ngu Ayomire.

english: That is why I did not think it proper for me to speak on my own behalf, so that my servant will get well.
lunyoro: nukwo ntayetekererize nyenka okuseme'ra okugamba ebyange nyenka, omwojo wange arakira.

english: Who will separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, or troubles, or persecution or hunger or poverty or only poverty or danger?
lunyoro: Araha alitubaganiza omu kugonza kwa Kristo? Bujune? Rundi emihito? rundi okuhiganizibwa?

english: Teach them to obey all that I have commanded you. And I am with you always, to the end of the age.
lunyoro: kandi mubegese okukwata byona ebinabaragire; kandi dora, nyowe ndi hamu nainywe ebiro byona, okuhikya obusinge bunu obubulihwaho.

english: He called him and said to him, “What do you want me to do with you? Turn from your sins, because you cannot remain in the judgment any longer!”
lunyoro: kamweta, yamugambira ati Kiki kinu ekindukuhu'ra haliwe? Bara omuhendo ogwobuketo bwawe; baitu tokyasobora kuikara omuketo.

english: I know him, the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings. I am like him who died.
lunyoro: nuwe 'mumanye ogu, namani agokuhumbukakwe, nokuterana kwomu kubonabonakwe, ninsisanizibwa nokufakwe:

english: Jesus answered, “Lord, do you believe?”
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange araba muikiriza?

english: For we are no longer proud of you, but we have given you a chance to boast about ourselves, so that you may have an answer for those who boast about things that are above, but not on your heart.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukugaruka okwenyumiza itwenka halinywe, baitu tubahaire inywe omwanya gwokwenyumiza habwaitu, nukwo mube nekyokugarukamu abo abanyakwenyumiriza ebyaharuguru, kunu tihali omu mutima.

english: He is loved and works faithful in all he does for the believers and the guests.
lunyoro: Arukugonzebwa nokora omulimo ogwokwesiga omu byona ebyokora habwabu bene baitu kandi abagenyi:

english: How happy and happy it must have been to hear this! Your brother was dead, but now he is alive; he was lost, but asleep.
lunyoro: Baitu okukyanganuka nokusemererwa kisemire: baitu mugenzi wawe ogu akaba afire, kandi ayomire, akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: But you have brought these men here who have not broken the walls or robbed our master's wife.
lunyoro: Baitu mulesere abantu banu, abatanyagire ebyomu mabandiro, nobukwakuba okujuma omucwezi waitu omukazi.

english: But what you have heard from the beginning must remain in you. The things you have seen from the very beginning will remain in your hearts, and you will remain with the Son and the Father.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara, nikyo kiikalege omulinywe. Ekimwaherize okuruga Karanakara obukiraba nikiikara omuliinywe, nainywe muraikaraga omu Mwana nomu Isitwe.

english: So then, the overseer must be without fault, as a husband who is not his wife; he must be a husband without a husband; he should be a humble and hospitable; he will be a good shepherd; he cannot be a drunkard or a glutton;
lunyoro: Nukwo kihikirire omurolerezi okutabaho ekyokuhanwa, abe musaija womukazi omu, atali mutamizi, omwerinzi, akunira abagenyi, wamagezi okwegesa; atakunganira amarwa, atatera;

english: I tell you that soon the Son of Man will come and destroy them. But when the Son Of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?”
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Alibaramu'ra bwango. Baitu Omwana womuntu obwaliija alisanga okuikiriza hansi?

english: Put on the complete suit of armor from God, a worker who is not ashamed of him, who is able to speak the truth with all his heart.
lunyoro: Fundikira ekitinisa kya Ruhanga, omukozi atarukukwatwa ensoni, anyakusobo'ra kurungi ekigambo kyamazima.

english: Nor does anyone pour new wine into old wineskins, because the wine will burst the skins, and the skins will be ruined.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga ezikuzire; kakuba agira ati amarwa agarukumara gakutemuire endyanga zakusisikaire.

english: Publius' father was sick with fever and dysentery. Paul went in to him, prayed, placed his hands on him, and buried him.
lunyoro: Kandi ise Pubulio akaba abyamire arwaire omusuija nensese: Pauro yataha nemberali, yasaba, namutaho emikonoye, yamuzika.

english: So he said, “Let those who have authority in you go to me and accuse that man of any sin he has committed.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagamba ati; Abayina obusobozi omulinywe, basirimuke nanyowe, kandi obwaraba omusaija ogu aroho ekibi kyona, bamulege.

english: He was changed in front of them, and his face shone like the sun, and all his clothes became like the light.
lunyoro: yaye yahindurwa omu maiso gabu: amaisoge nigamulikana nkizoba, nebyokujwarabye nibyera nkomusana.

english: A man who was lame from birth had been carried by his mother, and the next day they threw him out of the Temple treasury, which is called the Holy Place, to tell those who had come into the Temple to be punished.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akabali omulema okuruga omu nda ya nyina akaba bamuhimbire, oubabyamyaga obukyabukya ha ruigi orwa yekaru orurukwetwa Orurungi, okulega ebyokuganyira hali abo atahaga omu yekaru.

english: If we have put you in prison by means of the Spirit, how can we show that we care for your physical needs?
lunyoro: Obuturaba itwe twabasigiremu ebyomwoyo, kyamahano obutuligesa ebyanyu ebyomubiri?

english: For there are some who are saved by the power of their mothers, and others who have been saved by God's power through the Kingdom of heaven. Those who can believe and believe in it will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu haroho abakonerwe abazairwe bai okuruga omu nda za banyinabo: haroho abakuonerwe abayekonere bonka obwobukama obwomu iguru. Anyakusobora okukiikiriza, akiikirize.

english: For I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife or marries another Christian commits adultery; and whoever marries a woman commits adultery against her commits adultery.
lunyoro: baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti omuntu wena anyakubinga omukaziwe, rundi obwokusihana, buli amusihanize: nogu anyakumuswera abingirwe, buli asihaine.

english: Was it before? Was it at the time when he was circumcised? Or was it at least at the beginning? Or wasn't at the end of his life, but at the right time.
lunyoro: Kikaba kiri omukusarwa? Obwakaba ali omu kusarwa? Nandiki omu kutasarwa? Obwakasarwa, baitu omutimagwe.

english: For I have not spoken on my own authority, but the Father who sent me has commanded me to speak and to speak.
lunyoro: baitu ntagambe habwange, rundi Isenyowe ayanyumire, nuwe yandagire okungamba, kandi okumbaza.

english: The woman left her water jar and went home and told the people,
lunyoro: kandi omukazi yasiga omunagagwe, yagenda omu kika, yagambira abantu ati,

english: “Why, then, do you ask, ‘Why are you being punished again? But who is willing to do what God wants?’
lunyoro: Nukwo oragambira oti Kiki ekirukumuhanisa kandi? Baitu noha ayemera ebyagonza?

english: [GENERAL) Look! The reward of those who work hard for the things that you have not seen is that you stand up and proclaim them. And their reward, which they have done, is great in the sight of the Almighty.
lunyoro: Dora, empera yabakozi abatemere emisiri yanyu, eyimwabaimire negambira haiguru: nempamo yabu abagesere etahire omu matu Mukama owamahe.

english: Those who are trying to lead the way are the ones who have already heard. Then the Devil comes and takes away the message from their hearts, so that they will not believe and be saved.
lunyoro: Aha muhanda rubaju nibo bamara kuhu'ra; nubwo Setani aija, naihamu ekigambo omu mitima yabu, baleke okuikiriza nokujunwa.

english: They have cheered up my spirit and yours, and you have put faith in those who are like them.
lunyoro: Baitu bakahumuza omwoyo gwange nogwanyu: omwoyo mubaikirize abanyakuli nkabo.

english: There is no one who is righteous, no one else.
lunyoro: Tihi na omu ahikirire, busaho nomu:

english: When Herod saw that the visitors had made fun of him, he was furious and sent to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its neighborhood, who were two years old and younger, just as he had told the visitors to the city to do.
lunyoro: Kandi herode obuyaboine abafumu bamuterire enaku, yabihirwa muno, yatuma okuita abana abojo bona abakaba bali beterehemu, nomu mitano yayo yona, abakaba bamazire emyaka ebiri, nabakaba batakahikize egi, nkebiro ebiyakagulizemu muno abafumu okubikaba biri.

english: For I have given you an example, just as I did to you. Do the same thing to you.”
lunyoro: Baitu mbahaire ekyokuro'raho, kandi nkokumbakozire nyowe, nukwo nainywe mukolege muti.

english: Let us draw near to God with all our heart and with all your faith. Let us have a heart set on sinning against the evil spirit, and let us be filled with good water.
lunyoro: tui'le haihi nomutima ogwamazima, omu kuikiriza kwona, tuyina emitima yaitu emisirweho okuihamu omwoyo omubi, kandi nomubiri gwaitu gwogibwe amaizi amarungi:

english: God gave them the power to be ashamed of them, because their wives had purified themselves from the sexual immorality that belongs to them.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga akabahayo hali okukwatwa okwensoni: baitu abakazi babu bakahingisa eki omubiri ekiguzalirwa omu eki ekitinisakye.

english: There is difference between a wife and her son. The unmarried woman is anxious for the things of the Lord, so that she may be physically and spiritually married. But the married woman is sad over the things in the world, so she will please her husband.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho okubaganizamu omukazi aswirwe nomuhara. Omukazi ataswirwe atuntu'ra ebya Mukama waitu, nukwo ayerege nomu mubiri nomu mwoyo: baitu anyakuswirwe ategarukamu ebyensi, okwarasemezaga omusaijawe.

english: I have made your name known to them, and I will make it known. The love you have for me will be in them, as I have in them.
lunyoro: Kandi nkabamanyisa ibara ryawe, kandi ndirimanyisa; okugonza okuwagondeze nyowe kuikale omubo, nanyowe omubo.

english: That is why I tell you, then, that many of his sins have been forgiven; but the person who is forgiven little is forgiven only little.
lunyoro: Nikyo nkugambirire nti Ebibibye ebingi bimuihirweho; baitu anyakuihwaho ebike, nuwe agonza kake.

english: Many of those who heard the message gathered their books together and burned them in front of everybody. They counted the money, and they counted the price of five kingdoms.
lunyoro: Kandi baingi hali abo abahoraga ebyokuragura bakasoroza ahamu ebitabu byabu, babyokeza, omu maiso gabantu bona: kandi babara omuhendo gwabyo, bagurora bicweka byefeza bukumi butano.

english: Large crowds gathered around him, but they could not find one or the other at the door, and he told them the message.
lunyoro: Baso'rokana baingi, kandi bakaba batarukusobora kuhikamu, nobuhokuba omu muryango: yabatebeza ekigambo.

english: For he has given all those who believe in him authority to become God's children, if they believe in his name.
lunyoro: Baitu bona abamukirize, akabaha obusobozi okufoka abana baruhanga,niba barukuikiriza ibararye:

english: When the chief priests and the teachers of the Law saw the wonderful things he had done, the children in heaven shouted, “Praise to David's Son!
lunyoro: Baitu banyakatagara bakuru nabahandiki obubaoine ebyamahano ebiyakozire, nabana nibagambira ha iguru omu yekaru, nibagamba ngu Hosana hali Omwana wa Daudi;

english: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” But others said, "No, he comes from Galilee.
lunyoro: Abandi bagamba ngu Onu nuwe Kristo. Baitu abandi bagamba ngu Nangwa, Kristo aruga omu galiraya?

english: For he does not deal with the angels, but with the descendants of Abraham.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo takonyera bamaraika, baitu akonyera abaijukuru ba Iburahimu.

english: But those who live according to the flesh in the desires of the flesh, together with the desires for the present, will be persecuted; they will not be afraid or be terrified, and they will be put to death.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abarukukuratira omubiri omu kwegomba kwobugwagwa nibahungurwa, tibatukumira omu kutina, kunu tibatalibaniza omu kuhwereke'ra:

english: If it were not that you would be willing to offer sacrifices, would it not be right for you to offer them? But after you have been baptized at once, you would not have known sin.
lunyoro: Kakuba kitalikyo tibyakulekereyo okuhongwa? baitu abaramya obubamaire okwogibwa mali omurundi gumu, tibakubaire nokwemanyaho ebibi.

english: If you love him, you will not see him who is very happy and happy without being told the truth, filled with glory, or where you do not see he now.
lunyoro: Ogu oumurukugonza mutakamuboine oumurukusemerwamu muno nokusemererwa okutarukugambwa, okuijuire ekitinisa, nobumuraba mutarukumurora hati.

english: Or do Barnabas and I have no right to stop doing work?
lunyoro: Rundi nitwe itwenka, nyowe na Baranaba tutanyina busobozi okuleka okukora emirimo?

english: save others by snatching them out of the fire, and bring them out to the edge of the sword.
lunyoro: bandi mubaganyire numubasahura omu mu'ro;

english: That is why he said to himself, ‘Surely not! I will bless you and rebuke you.’
lunyoro: nukwo yayerahirire wenka, nagamba ati Mazimakwo okukuha ndikuha omugisa, nokukanyisa ndikukanyisa.

english: They spat on him, spat down on his head, spam on him with their finger, threw stones at him, and made him stand up in front of the house.
lunyoro: bamutera oruhi, nibamucwera amacwanta ha mutwe, nibateza amaju nibamuramya.

english: It was like this: the woman, who had taken the property away, hid it in three parts of the money and was sent away.
lunyoro: Nubusisana nkekitumbisa, omukazi ekiyakwasire yakisereka omu ndengo isatu ezensano, yatumbisibwa yona.

english: At that time many will not remember them, and they will be patient with one another and hate one another.
lunyoro: Omubiro ebi baingi balitabaijuka, abalihanganayo, abarrinobangana.

english: The city wall was adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation stone was jasper, the second sapphire, the third emerald,
lunyoro: Emisingi ya muhuruzi yorubuga ekasemezebwa namabale gona agomuhendo mwingi. Omuganda ogwokubanza yasepi, ogwakabiri safiro; ogwakasatu kalikedoni; ogwakana zumalidi;

english: I have come to you from the book and to the prostitutes with him, in great distress, before they repent of their sins.
lunyoro: Dora numunaga ha kitabu, nabo abasihana nauwe, omu kubonabona kwingi, obubataryegarukamu omu ngesoze.

english: the son of Joanan, the son in law of Rhesa, the father of Zerubbabel, the mother of Shealtiel, the brother of Neri,
lunyoro: owa Yoseka, owa Yoda, owa Yohanani, owa Lesa, owa Zerubaberi, owa Sealityeri owa Neri,

english: The woman was clothed with purple and scarlet, and had gold ornaments and precious stones and pearls. She had a gold coin full of such evil things as sexual immorality.
lunyoro: Omukazi akaba ajwaire ebirukunanata nebirukutukura, kandi atoire ebya zabu, namabale agomuhendo, neruru, ayina omu mukonogwe empwahwa ya zabu ijuire ebinugwa, nibyo byobusihanibwe ebitasemire.

english: The sky was removed like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
lunyoro: iguru ryaihwaho nkomuzingo gwekitabu okuguzingwa; nensozi zona namazinga gona byaihibwaho omu biikaro byabyo.

english: Let us not become upset with them in any way, so that our service to them will not be condemned.
lunyoro: kandi tuleke okuleta ekitababaijura omu kigambo kyona, nukwo okuhereza kwaitu kutahanwa;

english: You know that you were not redeemed by the things you received from your ancestors,
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu mutacungurwe nebintu ebiruga omu ngeso zanyu ezimwahairwe baisenkuru inywe:

english: We know that he who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us up with Jesus, and he will rule with you.
lunyoro: Obutuboine ngu ogu ayahumbuire Mukama waitu Yesu, naitwe alituhumbura hamu na Yesu, kandi alituranga hamu nainywe.

english: We are weak, but not weak; we are made weak in the world, but we are not made weak.
lunyoro: twahukanizibwe, baitu titurukuhemukirwa; tunagirwe hansi, baitu tituisirwe;

english: They wrote this, and so they put it in their hands: “The apostles and the elders of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia, and we greeted them.
lunyoro: kandi bakahandika bati, nibagikwasa omu mikono yabu ngu Abakwenda na bene baitu abakuru hali bene baitu abomu Bamahanga, omu Antyokia na Busuli na Kirikiya, tubaramukize:

english: The next day we left and went on a trip to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes and Patara.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika obutwamazire okwahukana nabo, nokuhanika amaberu, twarugayo, twakwata omuhanda oguterekerire okuhika Kosi, kandi ha kiro ekyakabiri twahika Rodo. twarugamu Patara:

english: He led them out by the power of his miracles and wonders in Egypt, and forty years of darkness.
lunyoro: Ogu akabaihayo obuyamazire okukora ebyamahano nobwokuro'raho omu Misiri, nomu irungu emyaka amakumi ana.

english: As we have already told you, who have kept their eyes and have been able to obey the message from the beginning, and I have kept watch over everything that has happened to me from the very beginning.
lunyoro: nkokubatutebebize itwe, abaikaraga bakaiso, nabahereza bekigambo okuruga kara, na nyowe obunahe'ranizaga mali byona okuruga karanakara,

english: When the Jews arrived, they took the people from their homes and gathered the crowd together and attacked the city. They attacked the house of Jason and tried to bring them to the people.
lunyoro: Baitu Abayudaya, obubakwasirwe ihali, batwara abantu ababi bomu bairu, basoroza ekitebe, baimukiriza orubuga; kandi bagota enju ya Yasoni, nibase'ra okubaleta hali abantu.

english: He denied it, saying, “I am not the Messiah!”
lunyoro: Yagamba, atarukwehakana, nagamba ati nyowe tindi Kristo.

english: The soldiers cut the robe off and put it on his head. They put a purple robe on him.
lunyoro: Baserikale baruka ekondo yamahwa, bagimitweka ha mutwe, bamuiweka orugoye orurukutukura;

english: He is the one who was made in all creation; everything in heaven and on earth was created, what is seen and unseen, whether by human rulers or by rulers or authorities or by God's authority, and everything was made subject to him and for him.
lunyoro: hati omuzigaijo omuli ebihangirwe byona; baitu omwagu ebintu byona numwo byahangirwe, omu iguru na hansi, ebirukurorwa nebitarukurorwa, rundi ebitebe byobukama, rundabusobozi, nobusobozi; ebintu byona bikahangwa uwe, kandi habwe:

english: How happy they are when when their king comes and finds them asleep! I tell you, he will take care of them and send them away.
lunyoro: Babyiba omugisa abairu aborubale, omukama wabu obwaliija abalisanga nibarora; mananukwo nimbagambira nti Aryetega omunda, alibahereza.

english: But when they deliver you up, do not be troubled at first by what you are going to say. For at that time you will say everything you are told. For you do not speak, but you will speak.
lunyoro: Baitu obubalibahayo, mutalibanza okutuntu'ra ebimuligamba: baitu ekimurahebwaga kyona omu kasumi ako, nikyo muragambaga: baitu tali inywe mugamba, baitu

english: There was a garden in the place where Jesus had been crucified, and in the garden was a new tomb where no one had ever been buried.
lunyoro: Kandi omu kiikaro ekiyabambirwemu ha muti hakaba harumu orugonjo: kandi omu rugonjo: nihali harumu ekituro ekihyaka ekitakazikwamuga muntu.

english: When the sun was setting, it was red, and because of the lack of the power of the Bride, it dried up.
lunyoro: izoba oburyajwire yahotoka, kandi obwokutaba na Mihama, yayoma.

english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him and I will raise him up at the last day.
lunyoro: Busaho muntu asobora okuija namberendi, Isenyowe ayantumire obwatamucundar nanyowe ndimuimukya ha kiro kya hampero

english: I beg you, for the sake of my Son, who was born in my chains.
lunyoro: ninkwesengereza habwomwana wange ounazaire omu nsengo zange,

english: He did not give him any food or drink or any anything else. He refused to put it on him and his children after him, because he had not yet had children.
lunyoro: Kandi atamuhe bugwetwa munu, nobuhokuba hokulibatira ekigere: yayanga okubita uwe nabanabe hanyumaye, obwakaba atakazaire mwana.

english: On the Sabbath we went out of the street to the other side of the lake, where we thought there was a place to pray. We sat down and told the women who had been sitting there.
lunyoro: Kandi ha kiro ekya Sabiti, tukaturuka omu irembo aheru, okugenda ha musa ogwekyambu, nambere twatekerize ngu haroho ekiikaro ekyokusabiramu; twaika'ra hansi, twagambira abakazi abagomere hamu.

english: I tell you that even if he will not get up and give him everything he needs, he will get up first and give everything he wants.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Nobwaraba atarukwenda kuimuka okumuha obwokuba enganjaniye, baitu obwokumugadya araimuka namuha byona ebyarususe'ra.

english: This is the message that was preached to you.
lunyoro: Ekigambo kinu nikyo kigambirwe hali inywe.

english: And this is not the only work that our light will shine on. It is also the temple of the great goddess Artemis, who lives in all the province of Asia and in all over the world.
lunyoro: Kandi tikiri kinu kyonka omulimo gwaitu oku'sana okuyagibwa; baitu neyekaru ya Atemi omucwezimukazi omukuru obwokuforwa ekintu ekitarumu, nogo obwokwakwa ekitinisakye, arukuramibwa Asiya yona nensi zona.

english: For there are many who are called gods, heaven or earth, just as there are several gods, kings, and many kings.
lunyoro: Baitu nobubaraba baroho baingi abararukwetwa baruhanga, rundi haiguru, randi hansi; nkokubali baruhangi baingi nabakama baingi nababukama baingi;

english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, do what is right.” Then they came up and arrested Jesus.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Mutahi wange, kora ekyoizirire. Nubwo baija bamutaho Yesu emikono, bamukwata.

english: Do not be afraid, for you do not believe, and do not lose your faith.
lunyoro: Kandi nimbagambira nti Oketwa oli muiru rubale? Atatuntura, baitu tina.

english: Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Son of David! Have mercy on me!
lunyoro: Yateza amaju, yayamio'ra haiguru nagamba ati Yesu, Omwana

english: But Jesus was deeply upset and knew that he was sick.
lunyoro: baitu akabatuntu'ra naganya muno, obumwahulire ngu akarwara:

lunyoro: kandi akarahira, namuraganiza okumuha kyona kyona ekyarasaba.

english: You have already passed judgment on yourselves. Why, then, do you not pass judgment on yourself? Why, do not even pass judgment upon yourselves? Why should you be condemned only?
lunyoro: kai? Nangwa, baitu nuwko mumazire muti okubaho omusango mali, okutongana inywenka. Kandi nainywenka timurukugasa? Mara kiki okutagobezebwa kwonka?

english: He will wipe away all tears from their eyes, and death will no longer be master over them; neither will there ever be mourning nor crying; the old things have passed away.
lunyoro: Kandi alisusura amaizi gona ha maiso gabu: kandi tihakiroho okufa; nobukwakuba oku'ra, nobkwakuba okusasa tibikiroho:ebyokubanza bihoireho.

english: You are trying to convince me that Christ speaks in my presence, not in your presence.
lunyoro: Baitu numuse'ra ekirukumanyisa ngu Kristo nagambira omuli nyowe, atali wobugara halinywe:

english: They threw dust on their heads and cried out in a loud voice, “How terrible for that great and wealthy city! All who had ships sailing the seas for her great wealth! For in one hour it has fallen!”
lunyoro: Basesa ecucu ha mitwe yabu, niba'ra, nibatera empamo, nibagamba ngu Ziruboine, ziriboine orubuga orukuru orwatungisize obuguda, bona abakaba bayina amato gabu ha nyanja, obwebintubye ebyomuhendo omwingi! baitu omu saha emu ruhwerekerire.

english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of the way until you have paid the last penny.
lunyoro: Nkugambira nti toliruga omu, okuhikya obwolirihira kimu na senti eyahampero.

english: None of those who were sitting at the table understood what Jesus was talking about.

english: But when they deliver you up, do not be afraid of what you will say or do, for at that very day you will be given what you shall say.

english: So Moses fled from that land and lived as a foreigner in the land of Midian, where he had two sons.

english: But he was angry and would not go in, so his father went out and begged him to go in.
lunyoro: Baitu akabihirwa yayanga okutahamu: ise yaturuka yamwesengereza.

english: But someone will say, “The dead will be raised to life, and where will they come from?”

english: When they came to him, they said, “Teacher, we know that you are a clever man, and you do not care about anyone's status. You don't judge people, but teach them God's way in truth. Is it against our Law to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor or not?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubaizire, bamugambira ngu omwegesa, tumanyire iwe oli wamananu, kandi ebigambo ebyomuntu wena tobitaho mutima; baitu tosorora omubantu, baitu oyegesa omuhanda gwa Ruhanga omu mananu: kirungi okuziniraga Kaisali ebintu, nandiki tikirikyo?

english: Others said, “A man who has a demon can open the eyes of the blind.”
lunyoro: Abandi nibagamba ngu ebigambo binuna tibiri byomuntu aroho muzimu. Muzimu nugusobora okuigura amaiso gabafu bamaiso?

english: Another one said, “I have bought five pairs of oxen and am going to follow them. Please let me go!”
lunyoro: Ndi yagamba ati Nguzire enki'li zente itano, ningenda okuzirenga: nkwesengerize, ndeka.

english: Remember, then, where you have fallen, and turn from your sins, and do the first things of the past. If you do not, I will come to you, and I will take your lampstand out of its place, but you will not repent.
lunyoro: Nukwo oijuke nambere warugire okugwa, kandi oyegarukemu, kandi okole emirimo eyokubanza; obwotalikora oti ndiija namberoli, kandi ndiihaho etabaza yawe omu kiikaro kyayo, obwotaryegarukamu.

english: You yourselves know that it is right for you to follow our own way, but we will not go against you.
lunyoro: Baitu inywenka mumanyire okukibasemerire okuhondera omulingo gwaitu: baitu itwe tutagende kubi omulinywe;

english: If you, then, are wicked people, know how to give good gifts to your children. How much more, then," the Father in heaven gives the Holy Spirit to those who ask him for him!
lunyoro: Nukwo inywe ababihire, obumuraba mumanyire okubaha abana banyu ebisembo ebisemire, Isenyowe anyakuli omu iguru talikira muno okubaha Omwoyo Ogurukwera abanyakumusaba?

english: What, then, is your reason for boasting? I tell you, then: if it were possible, you would have set your eyes on me and let me go.
lunyoro: Kandi okwesima kwanyu kuraha? Baitu ndi kaiso wanyu nti kuba kikaba nikisoboka, mwakuihiremu amaiso ganyu okugaha nyowe.

english: As he has appointed you to be his faithful servant in union with Christ for us,
lunyoro: Nkokumwayegire hali Ruhanga okuba muhereza owokwesiga owa Kristo habwaitu,

english: On the Passover Day in Jerusalem, many believed in his name, and they saw that he performed miracles.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakabali yerusalemu ha Kuhingurwaho, omu biro byabugenyi, baingi bakaikiriza ibararye, obubaboine obwokuro'rahobwe obuyakozire.

english: After he has put them all out, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him.
lunyoro: obwamara okusetura eze zona, azebembere, netama zimukuratira:

english: They will be punished with evil as a result of their lack of faith. Those who think that they are good will be glad when they hear the evil things that happen in the light, both in their outward appearance and in their physical appearance, and when they feast with you, they will be angry with you.
lunyoro: kandi balikorwa kubi nkempera eyokusisa kwabu; abantu abakitekereza okuba kyokusemererwa okuzana kubi nyamusana, rundi obutonyezi nobumogo, omu bugenyi bwokugonzagana obubarya hamu nainywe;

english: For those who obey the Law are not righteous in God's sight, but are the ones who obey it.
lunyoro: baitu abahu'ra kwonka ebiragiro tibali bahikirire omu maiso ga Ruhanga, baitu abarukukora ebiragiro nibo balihwaho omusango:

english: isn't the work of the Spirit much more important than the glory of God?
lunyoro: okuhereza okwomwoyo tikukira muno okuba kwekitinisa?

english: After saying this, Jesus left and went to the Jews and said to them, “I cannot find any reason to condemn him.”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba eki yagaruka naturuka, yagenda hali Abayudaya, yabagambira ati Tindukubona musango haruwe.

english: For I tell you that there is something here greater than the Temple.”
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira nti Hanu haroho arukukira yekaru obukuru.

english: They offered him some food to eat. Martha got well, because Lazarus was one of those who were with her in the dish.
lunyoro: Kandi bamucumbirayo ebyokurya ebyorwebagyo: Maliza yaherza; baitu Razaro akabali omu hali abo abakaba baikalire nauwe ha byokurya.

english: That is why I was so eager to tell you, my friends, that I should first come to you and prepare your gift, which you have given me, in order that the gift may be ready, as a gift that is ready, not only to be poured out on.
lunyoro: Nikyo natekererize okugambi'ra bene baitu, banyebembere okuija namberemuli, batekanize ekisembo kyanyu ekimwaragire ira, nukwo ekisembo eki kisangwe kitekanize, nkekintu ekyembabazi, kunu tikiri kyokuhambirizibwa.

english: It is not written for the sake of him alone, that his righteousness has been clearly seen by him.
lunyoro: Kandi kitahandikwe habwogu wenka ngu okuhiki'ra kukamutekerezebwaho,

english: Do not be jealous of the Jews, nor of the Gentiles, nor about the church of God.
lunyoro: Mutaletera enkonge Abayudaya, nobubakuba Abayonani, nobwekuba ekanisa ya Ruhanga:

english: They told him that they had told him the secret, so I took him to you at once. I order those who should not accuse him of doing so in your presence.
lunyoro: Kandi obubanyolekere ngu bamugambiraine ensita omusaija ogu, ahonaho namutweka haliwe, kandi nindagira abamulegere okumulega omu maiso gawe.

english: who do not keep account of the evil and speak evil of the good, but instead of the things that are being blessed by the others. For this reason you have been called a blessing from God.
lunyoro: abatarukugaru'rangana obubi obwobubi, nobukwakuba okujuma obwokujuma; baitu okundi nkabanyakusabira omugisa; baitu nikyo mwayetirwe mugwetwe omugisa.

english: So then, take what is necessary to repent.
lunyoro: Kandi mwane ebyana ebisemerire okwegarukamu:

english: They drew lots to come to Matthias, and he was chosen with the eleven disciples.
lunyoro: Babatomera, kwahika ha Matiya; yaba'rarwa hamu nabakwenda ikumi nomu.

english: When it was time, Jesus called his disciples together and chose twelve of them whom he named apostles:
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukire, yayeta abegeswabe; yakoma omulibo ikumi nababiri abayayesere abakwenda,

english: He measured the city with the length of each gate, according to its length. He measured it with the measuring stick, the length, the height, and the height of each street were twenty thousand.
lunyoro: Urubuga nuruinganaingana embaju zona, obuhango bwarwo nkokugaliha. Yalengesa orubuga omuseke ati Esitadyo kakumi mwenkumi ibiri, oburaiha nokugaliha nokuraiha byona biingaine.

english: For if this takes away the old clothes and these mortals put on immortality, then what the scripture says will come true: “Death is swallowed up forever.”
lunyoro: Baitu okujunda kunu obukulikajwara okutajunda, nebyokufa binu obubirijwara obutalifa, nukwo kirihiki'ra ekigambo ekyahandikirwe ngu Okufa kumizirwe okusingura.

english: But you have rejected the merciful. They are not the ones who insult you and condemn you to be put to death.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe mwagaya owamsege.Tinibo baguda abarukubahiga, nibabacunda harukucwerwa omusango?

english: When he heard that the crowd was passing by, he asked, “What is this?”
lunyoro: kandi obuyahulire ekitebe nikihinguraho yakaguza ati Kiki eki?

english: If the whole body were blind, where would the hearing be? Or if the ear were hearing, where could the rest be?”
lunyoro: Kakuba omubiri gwona guli eriso, okukehura kwakubaire nkaha? Rundi kakuba gubaire okuhu'ra, obukwakubaire buli hara?

english: If your foot causes you to stumble and to be broken, how much more ought you to enter life which will be destroyed! It is better for you to have two feet thrown into hell, than to have one foot thrown into it.
lunyoro: Kandi ekigere kyawe obukirikutabaijura, okucwehoga, hakire iwe aokutaha omu bwomezi obuzirweho okuguru, okukira okunagwa omu Gehena oyina amaguru gombi.

english: I do everything in the Lord's service with all humility, with all my heart, with tears in my eyes, and with all the troubles that the Jews have brought me.
lunyoro: nkora Mukama waitu nobuculezi bwona, namaizi omu maiso, nemihito eyambaireho obwensita Zabayudaya:

english: But those who have lost their faith in these things will lose their sight, and they will see only things that are far away and be forgotten for their past sins.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakubuzirweho ebigambo ebi buli afire amaiso, narora ebiri haihi byonka, ayeberwe okuyasemezibweho ebibibye ebyaira.

english: They drew near to him and were very afraid to grow up because of what he had said, “They will no longer see him.” So they made plans to get on the ship.
lunyoro: kandi bamunywegera, baganyire muno okukura byona obwekigambo ekiyagambire ati tibalibona amaisoge obundi. Kandi bamusenderezaho okuhika ha kyombo.

english: A good person brings good out of his treasure of good things, but a bad person brings bad out of the treasure of bad things.
lunyoro: Omuntu asemire, aiha ebisemire omu ryahu'rorye erisemire: omuntu omubi aiha ebibihire omu yahuro eribihire.

english: No one can hand me over to them, but I myself can give it. I am able to take it back, and I can take it away from you. This commandment has been given to me by the Father.
lunyoro: Busaho abunyihaho, baitu nyowe nyenka mbuhayo. Ninsobora okubuhayo, kandi ninsobora okugugarukamu. Ekiragiro eki nkakihebwa hali Isenyowe.

english: For human sake, I will boast about myself, but not about myself but about my weaknesses.
lunyoro: Habwomuntu ali ati ndayenyumiza: baitu habwange nyenka tindukwenyumiza, rundi omu byobugara byange.

english: Jesus was greatly upset and said, “Why do the people of this day look for you? I tell you, they will not be given a witness against you.”
lunyoro: Yasinda muno omu mutimagwe, nagamba ati Abobusinge bunu nibaseru'ra ki akokuroraho? Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Abobisinge bunu tibalihebwa kokuro'raho.

english: When his accusers arrived, they did not bring charges against him, as I thought they would.
lunyoro: kandi abamulegere obubamukire, batalete musango ogwebibi nkokunkaba nintekereza:

english: But now we do not know what he is looking for, and he opened his eyes to us, yet we donot know him.
lunyoro: Baitu okwarukuhweza hati bunu titurukumanya: kandi ayaiguire amaiso titumanyire wenka.

english: When he comes back in the second or third pillar, and finds them, he is happy about them.
lunyoro: Kandi obwaliija omu kisisimuka ekyakabiri, rundi ekyakasatu, nabasanga bali bati, banyina omugisa abo.

english: “Don't be afraid,” the angel said to them. “I have brought you good news of great joy to all the people.
lunyoro: Marakaika yabagambira ati Mutatina; baitu dora, mbaletire ebigambo ebirungi ebyokusemererwa okwingi okuliba hali abantu bona:

english: They left others on rocky ground, others on some of the ship's equipment. So it was that everyone came to life at the gate.
lunyoro: abandi ha byase, abandi ha bintu ebyomu kyombo. Kandi nukwo bona bahikire bati ha musa bomire.

english: For many have become defiled by the disobedience of the one man, so that by the obedience of the others many will be put right with God.
lunyoro: baitu nkabaingi okubafokere abasisi obwokutahu'ra okwomuntu omu, nukwo obwokuhura okwomu abaingi balifoka bati abahikirire.

english: But because he could not keep watch, the master ordered him to be sold, his wife, his children, and all that he had, and to pay him.
lunyoro: Baitu obwakaba atanyina kyokumuma'ra, mukamawe yaragira okumugura, na mukaziwe, nabanabe, nebintu byona ebyakabayinabyo, nokumara ibanja.

english: If the foot were to say, “Because I am not a hand, I am no part of the body.”
lunyoro: Ruguru obweraba nirigamba ngu Nyowe tindi omukono, nukwo ntali ekicweka kyomubiri,,

english: He answered, “command these two sons of mine to sit down at your right and at your left in your Kingdom.”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda ki? Yamugambira ati Ragira abana bange banu babiri baika'le, ondi ha Mukono gwawe ogwoburyo, nondi h Mukono Gwawe ogwemoso, omu bukama bwawe.

english: But the servant who listens to the one who does not. He is like a man who built his house on earth without a brother in law, and the man who holds it back. At once he fell down, and there was a lot of fall on that house.
lunyoro: Kandi ogu ahu'ra atarukukora, nasisana nkomuntu ayayombekere enju ha itaka nambere omuganda gutali, kandi omugenzi gukagitera; ahonaho yagwa; nokugwa kwenju egi kukaba kuli kwingi.

english: It is not like this, but Satan makes an angel of light.
lunyoro: Na Setani wenka ayefora maraika womusana.

english: Do not be afraid, but be in good health for those who are God's promised blessings through faith and courage.
lunyoro: mutaturumuka, baitu mukuratirege omulingo gwabo abagwetwa emirago obwokuikiriza nokuguma.

english: Those who forgive sins will be forgiven, and those who forgive them will be taken away from them.
lunyoro: Abo abamuliihaho ebibi, bibaihwaho; nabo abamulibohera ebibi bibaboherwa.

english: Fathers will be against their children, and sons against their fathers; mothers against their daughters-in-law against their mothers-in christians; mothers-law is against their own children, children against their parents.
lunyoro: . Balibaganizibwamu ise nomwanawe, nomwana na ise; nyina nomuisikiwe, nomuisiki na nyina; nyinazara na mukaziwe, na mukomwana na nyinazara.

english: The woman died. Which one of the seven will you be when you rise from death?”
lunyoro: Nukwo, omu kuhumbuka, aliba mukoha hali abo musanju?

english: As you have already said, I am telling you this very thing now: if anyone should preach to you the Good News which is not according to your faith,
lunyoro: Nkokutwagambire kara, nukwo ngarukire hati bunu okugamba nti rundi omuntu wena obwalibatebeza enjiri eteri nkeyimwaikirize akyenwe.

english: They all grabbed Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue, and beat him in front of the court. But Gallio did not pay attention to these things at all.
lunyoro: Kandi bona bakwata Sosene, omukuru wisoro'kaniro, bamutera omu maiso gekitebe ekicwerwaho emisango. Kandi Galio atabiteho omutima ebigambo ebi nekimu.

english: And hope does not disappoint us, but God's love is poured out into our hearts by the power of the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.
lunyoro: kandi okunihira tikurukukwasa ensoni: baitu okugonza kwa Ruhanga kuseserwe omu mitima yaitu Habwomwoyo Ogurukwera outwahairwe.

english: I am like a slave who is one who is taught what you did not do, and others have done what you wanted to do,and you have shared in their work.
lunyoro: nyowe nkabantuma okugesa ekimutarakolire mirimo: abandi bakakora emirimo, nainyowe mutahire omu mirimo yabu.

english: They are talking with the power of fire, they are fighting with greater power than the sword; they are defeated by the dark, and they are stronger than the nations.
lunyoro: barukubaza amani gomu'ro, nibakira obwogi bwempirima, nibafoka emanzi omu kurwana, nibasinga amahe gabamahanga.

english: In order to bring into being the righteousness of God's people by the work they do, in order to build up the body of Christ.
lunyoro: habwokuhikiriza abarukwera hali emirimo yokuhereza, okwombeka omubiri gwa Kristo:

english: While Paul was waiting for Athens, his heart was filled with fear, and he saw the city full of idols.
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro obwakaba nabategereza Asene, omutimagwe tukamusa'ra, obuyaboine orubuga ruijuire ebisisani.

english: They insulted the people who said, “We have heard him speak blasphemy against Moses and against God!”
lunyoro: Bakasemba abantu abagambire ngu Tukamuhu'ra nagamba ebigambo ebyokujuma Musa na Ruhanga.

english: They begged him to let them go to Jerusalem and stop him from killing him on the road.
lunyoro: kandi bamwesengereza, nibamusaba ekigambo kyabu haruwe, amwete okuija Yerusalemu: nibamwesereke'ra okumuita omu muhanda.

english: So then, as children, we were slaves of the first human race.
lunyoro: nukwo naitwe obutukaba tuli bato, twalemwaga nkabairu rubale ebyokubanza byomunsi:

english: He came and found them asleep. “Simon,” he said to Peter, “doesn't it? You haven't been able to watch one hour?”
lunyoro: Yaija, yabasanga bagwihagire, yagambira Petero ati Simoni, Ogwijagire? Obaire otanyina amani kurora nesaha emu?

english: So then, when we see that some people are sitting in the same way, and some of the first ones to be told the good news will come in because of the disobedience of the others.
lunyoro: Nukwo obutuboine ngu kiikaire kiti abamu okutahamu, kandi abo ababandize okutebezebwa ebigambo ebirungi, bakatahamu obwokutahu'ra,

english: I answered, “It is not Roman custom to hand over a prisoner to a Roman citizen before the accusers face to face, and not to see how quickly he or she is being tried for what they accuse him of.
lunyoro: Nabagarukamu nti Teri engeso ya Barumi okuhayo omuntu wena anyakulegerwe, atakabaire omu maiso gabarukumulega, kandi atakaboine kasumi kokwetongani'ramu obwebigambo ebibamulega.

english: Pray that it will not happen in the winter.
lunyoro: Musabe bitahikira omu biro ebyembeho

english: I have fought the good fight, I have finished my mission, I hope to win the faith.
lunyoro: murwani ogwoburyo, mpikize orugendo rwange, ndinzire okuikiriza:

english: He believed, and the evil spirits went out of him and entered the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the side of the cliff into the lake, which was about two thousand men.
lunyoro: Aha mizimu emibi yarugamu, netaha omu mpunu: igana ryajumutuka nirisirimuka omukihanga, nirirtaha omu nyanja, zikaba ziri nkenkumi ibiri

english: I took the book out of the angel's hand and ate it up. I heard it as if it were a snake's mouth, but after I had eaten it, it stopped.
lunyoro: Naiha akatabu omu mukono gwa maraika nakamira; kandi kanulira omu kanwa kange nkobwoki bwenjoki: baitu obunamazire okukamira enda yange yasa'ra.

english: When the sun was setting, all the sick who had been sick with various diseases and diseases came to him, and he placed his hands on them all, and healed them all.
lunyoro: izoba obulikaba nirigwa abo bona abakaba barwaire endwara ezindi nezindi babaleta namberali; yabataho emikono bona bona bona, nabakiza.

english: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz was the son of Obed by Ruth. Obed was the mother of Jesse.
lunyoro: Sarumoni akazara Boazi omu Rahabu; Boazi akazara Obeda omu Rusi; Obeda akazara Yese;

english: Don't you know that those who are joined to idols belong to the same body? But he says, “The two will become one body.”
lunyoro: Kara timumanyire ngu Anyakuteranizibwa nomusihani nugwo mubiri gumu? Baitu agamba ati Bombi baliba mubiri gumu.

english: In the same way, I tell you, it is better for you who are first to begin not only to do but also to do what you want to do.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo, ncwire nti, baitu kinu kibasemerire inywe abamazire omwaka gumu numubanza okutandika, okutakora kwonka baitu okukora numugonza.

english: And be kind to one another, compassionate, and freely forgive one another just as God also by Christ freely forgave you.
lunyoro: kandi mukoranganege kurungi inywenka nemitima yembabazi, numuganyirangana, kandi nka Ruhanga omu Kristo okuyaganyire inywe.

english: Do you know that those who work in the Temple and eat from the things that are offered to the priests and the altar fight against the altar?
lunyoro: Timumanyire ngu abarukukora emirimo eyemu yekaru, barya ha byomu yekaru? Nabo abahereza ekyoto babagana nekyoto?

english: That is why we were encouraged, and we were greatly encouraged by the joy that Titus gave us, because his heart was made firm in you all.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyatuhumuize: kandi omu kuhumuzibwa kwaitu tukakira muno okusemererwa, okwokusemererwa kwa Tito, baitu omutimagwe gukagumibwa inywe inywena.

english: But whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself shall be made great.”
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena anyakwenyumiza wenka nuwe anyakwebundazibwa; nanyakwezinga wenka alinyumizibwa.

english: There will be great earthquakes that have not yet taken place on the Sabbath, and there will be no more famines.
lunyoro: Hasigaireho omihito omwingi ogutakabahoga ensi ekaba kubaho nokuhikya hati, kandi tigulibaho obwokabiri.

english: It was better for us to join one another in sending greetings to the people and send them to you, together with the believers who love Barnabas and Paul.
lunyoro: kikaba kisemeri omu maiso gaitu obutwateraine nomutima gumu, okukomamu abantu, nokubatuma namberemuli, hamu nabarukugonzebwa baitu Baranaba na Pauro,

english: They said to him, “We have not received any letters from Judea about you, nor have any of the believers come here and tell us anything or anything that has happened to us.”
lunyoro: kandi bamugambira ngu itwe titukahebwaga baruha ezebigambo byawe okuraga Buyadaya, kunu busaho hali bene baitu ayaizire hanu natutebeza, nobukwakuba okutugambira ekigambo ekibi

english: Or if he has planted seeds that cannot bear, and cannot bear fruit, all who follow him will receive him first.
lunyoro: Rundi obwaliba amazire okusimba emiganda, atarukusobora kurumara, bona abasunga balibanza

english: The sisters sent him away and said, “Lord, your dear friend is sick.”
lunyoro: Kandi banyina abo bamutumira, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu dora,oworukugonza arwaire.

english: I have many things to say and condemn you, but the one who sent me is truthful; and I have told the world what I have heard from him.
lunyoro: Munyina bingi ebyokubagambaho nokubacwera omusango: baitu ogu ayantumire nuwe wa mananu; nanyowe ebinahulire hali nibyo ngambire ensi.

english: Festus answered, “Paul is waiting for Caesarea, and he himself was about to leave.
lunyoro: Baitu Fesita yagarukamu ati Pauro akalindirwa Kaisaliya, nauwe wenka akaba na'sana okugendayo mpora.

english: But you say, ‘I am rich, and I have riches, but I am rich. I have nothing.’ But you do not know that you are miserable, poor, blind, and blind.
lunyoro: Baitu ogambire ngu Ndi muguda, kandi ntungire bingi, kunu tindoho ekindukusega; kandi tomanyire ngu oli munaku, kandi wobujune, kandi wamasege, kandi omufu wamaiso, kandi oli kwonka:

english: You know that while you were among the Gentiles, you were handed over to idols which you did not speak; you were like them everywhere.
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu Obumukaba muli Bamahanga, mwahabiraga hali ebisisani ebitarukugamba, nkokumwahabiraga hona.

english: But I am telling you, my friends, that the Good News that I preached is not for human approval.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbamanyisa, bene baitu,enjiri eyinatebize nti terinkeyomuntu.

english: For from inside, out of the hearts of people, evil thoughts spring up.
lunyoro: Baitu omunda omu mitima yabantu nuho harugamu ebitekerezo ebibihire,

english: But bring those enemies of mine who did not want me to be their king, and take them here and kill them in my presence.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abanyanzigwa bange, abatarayenzire nyowe okubalema, mubaleta hanu, mubaitire omu maiso gange.

english: Your riches are corrupted, and your clothes are moths.
lunyoro: Itungo ryanyu lijunzire, nebyokujwara byanyu birirwe enyenje.

english: I did not find any consolation in my heart, because I could not find Titus my brother. But when I had told you this, you went to Macedonia.
