lunyoro: Rundi eriso ryawe eryoburyo liraba nirikutabaijura, olihemu, okinage hara, baitu nikyo kurukukira oburungi ekicweka kyawe ekimu okubura, omubiri gwawe gwona gutanagwa omu Gehena.

english: and said, “The things you see will happen to you when the sun will set here on the stone which will be rolled up on the earth.”
lunyoro: hati bunu ebimurukurora, ebiro biriija obuhatalisigwa hanu ibale erinyakuli ha ibale eritalinagwa hansi.

english: They will take up snakes, and if they drink any poison, they will not be harmed at all; they will place their hands on the sick, and they will get well.
lunyoro: balita enjoka, kandi obubaliba nibanywa ekirukuita kyona, tikiribarwaza na kake;balitaho emikono yabu ha barwaire, nabo balikira.

english: I was hungry, but you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, but You gave me drink; I was a stranger, and you took me in.
lunyoro: baire nyine enjara, nainywe mukampa ebyokurya; nkaba nyine iroho nainyowe mukanywisa; kabandi munyaihanga nainye mukangonyesa;

english: But Philip found him in Azotus, and he went through the city and preached the Good News to all the towns as far as Caesarea.
lunyoro: Baitu Firipo akazokera Azoto: yahingura natebeza enjiri omu mbuga zona okuhika Kaisaliya.

english: In this way you were a sign for all who believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
lunyoro: nukwo mwafokere muti ekyokuro'raho hali bona abarukuikiriza, omu Makedoni nomu Akaya.

english: For everything in the world, the desire of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life, does not come from the Father, but from the world.
lunyoro: Baitu byona eebinyakuli omunsi, okwegomba okwomubiri, nokwegomba okwamaiso, nokwenyumiza okwobwomezi okutarumu, tibiruga omuli Isitwe, baitu biruga hali ensi.

english: The Kingdom, authority, power, and the Kingdom are all the things that are told about, not only in this world but also in that which is to come.
lunyoro: obulemi bwona, nobusobozi, namani, nobukama, nibara ryona erinyakugambwa, tihali omu businge bunu bwonka, baitu nomuli obu oburukugenda kuija:

english: “We played wedding music for you, but you wouldn't dance! We sang funeral songs for you and you wouldn`t cry!” they said.
lunyoro: baitu tukabate'ra enyamulere, timwazina: tukatera empamo, timwara.

english: Give thanks to the Lord for what he has done.
lunyoro: musime eki ekirukuseme'ra Mukama waitu:

english: A voice came to him, “Get up, Peter; kill and eat!”
lunyoro: Rundi hakaija iraka haruwe liti Imuka Petero ita orye.

english: I tell you, then, that anyone who divorces his wife for any cause other than sexual immorality, and marries another commits adultery with her.
lunyoro: Nanyowe nimbagambira nti Wena obwalibiga mukaziwe, rundi okumujunaniza obwobusihani: nauwe anyakuswera ogu abingirwe, buli asihaine.

english: But now you must finish the work and finish it as soon as you can, and finish the job as you possibly can.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu muhikirize nokukora, nkokumwagondeze bwango okukora, nukwo nokuhikiriza kubeho kuti, nkokumurukusobora.

english: But to wait for God's judgment, with fear and the dread of the burning anger, will add to the adversaries.
lunyoro: baitu okutegereza omusango, hamu nokutina nekiniga ekyomu'ro ekirugenda okwokeza kimu abanyanzigwa.

english: They brought the boats back to land, left everything, and followed him.
lunyoro: Kandi obukalesere amato gabu ha musa, basiga byona, bamukuratira.

english: In the same way, what you write is that a man should not touch his wife.
lunyoro: Kandi ebimwahandikire nibyo binu; nti omusaija aleke okukwatira omukazi:

english: Jesus said to the vinedresser, “For three years I will come looking for figs on this fig tree, but I will not see them. Be on your feet. Why, then, do you look at the fig tree?”
lunyoro: yagambira omulimi wemizabibu ati Dora, emyaka enu esatu nyija okuse'ra ebyana ha mutini gunu, ntarukubiboba; guteme; nugwema'raho ki ekibanja?

english: He removed him and raised David to be their king. He concluded, “I have seen David son of Jesse, a man like me who will do all that I have to do.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamuihireho ogu, yaimukya Daudi, okuba omukama wabu; ouyarangire nagamba ati Mboine Daudi omwana wa Yese, omuntu ali nka nyowe okundukwenda, alikora ebingonza byona.

english: Aren't they the ones who make a name for the glory that you profess?
lunyoro: Tinibo abarukujuma ibara eyekitinisa erimwayetirwemu?

english: For he has heard the voice of those who know him from the beginning, just as he did of his Son, so that they may be one in union with many of his friends.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abayamanyire ira, nibo yayahuire ira omu kisisani kyomwanawe, nukwo abe omuzigaijo omu bagenzibe abaingi:

english: Or if I take you to court for anything that my body has to say, then I will save some of them.
lunyoro: kandi obundibakwasa ihali obwekigambo kyona abomubiri gwange, rundi ndijuna abamu omubo.

english: In love, then, be united. In honor, be at peace with one another.
lunyoro: Mu kugonzangana muganjane hamu: omu kitinisa munyumizangane nabene banyu;

english: They wandered in deserts, mountains, and caves, and the holes in the ground.
lunyoro: bahambaga omu irungu, nensozi nobuingira, nomu biina biitaka.

english: After they had stayed a long time without food, Paul stood up in front of them and said, “Men, you should have listened to me and not have left Crete without seeing this crash and the loss of life.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaikaireho muno okutarya, nubwo Pauro yayemerire hagati yabu, nagamba ati Abasaija, kikabahiki'ra okuhu'ra nyowe, okutahanika amaberu okuruga Kerete, okutabona okusisikara kunu nokuferwa.

english: The police officers reported these words to the Roman officials, and when they heard this, they were afraid that they were Roman citizens.
lunyoro: Abairu rubale babagambira abacwi bemisango ebigambo ebi: batina obubahulire bali Barumi;

english: They said to him, “You were born in sin and teach us?” They expelled him from the synagogue.
lunyoro: Bagarukamu nibamugambira ngu Iwe okazarwa mali omu bibi, kandi notwegesa itwe? Bamubingira aheru.

english: Father, I want you to know that there is great joy in you and in those in Laodicea and in all those who have not seen me.
lunyoro: Baitu ningonza inywe okumanya okwekamba okuli kwingi okunyina habwanyu na habwabo abomu Raodikiya, na bona abatakabonaga amaiso ga

english: So then, I am glad that I am weak, that I have done evil, that i may cry, that my sorrow and anguish may come upon him, that he may cry for help and that I may cry when I cry for him.
lunyoro: Nukwo nsemerirwe omu byobugara, omu kukorwa kubi, omu kuhingwa, omu bujune, habwa ndimugara, habwokusalirwa kwange nyenka.

english: Pilate went back outside and said to them, “Look, I bring you out to see if you can find out that I find no reason to condemn him.”
lunyoro: Pirato yagaruka naturuka aheru yabagambira ati Dora, ni'muturukya aheru namberemuli, mumanye ngu timboine musango haruwe.

english: Happy are all the people for their good deeds. If he had children, he would have been hospitable to the guests, would have washed their feet, would had healed the sick, and had followed every good deed.
lunyoro: asimirwe abantu bona obwemirimo emirungi, araba yalezere abana, araba yakunire abagenyi, araba yambisize abarukwera ebigere, araba yakonyire abobujune,akuba yakuratire emirimo yona emirungi.

english: But let your words always be “Yes” and “No” and "No” because these are the very things that come from the Evil One.
lunyoro: Baitu ebigambo byanyu biikalege biti Ego ego, nangwa nangwa, baitu ebikira ebi nibyo biruga hali omubi.

english: It was the day of the Passover Festival, about six o'clock in the morning. He said to the Jews, “Look!
lunyoro: Kikaba liri kiro kya Kutekaniza Okuhingurwaho: zikaba ziri nkesaha omukaga. Yagambira Abayudaya ati Dora, Omukama wanyu!

english: Why did you go out into the desert to weep? A man dressed in fancy clothes? Look! The rich in palaces are sitting in the marketplaces.
lunyoro: baitu mukagenderayo ki omu irungu okurra? Omusaija ajwaire engoye ezirukworoba? Dora abaguda baikara omu maju gabakama.

english: He healed many people who were sick with various diseases and drove out many demons. But he would not let the demons speak, because he knew him.
lunyoro: Yakiza baingi abakaba barwaire endwara ezindi nezindi, nabinga emizimu mingi: kandi ataikirize mizimu okugamba, baitu ekamumanya.

english: The one who is God hears the words of God. So do not listen, because you are not God's children.
lunyoro: Owa Ruhanga ahu'ra ebigambo bya Ruhanga: nikyo mutarukuhuli'ra baitu timuli ba ruhanga.

english: He heard his voice, and they went away. Those who have done good will be raised to life, and those who have seen evil will rise to life; those who do evil will be brought back to life.
lunyoro: ahulire irararye, kandi balirugamu; abo abakozire okurungi hali okuhumbuka okwobwomezi; nabo abakolire okubi hali oku humbuka okwomusango; nabo abakukozire okubi hali okwenyuma.

english: “All the people were first given to drinking the good wine,” he said. “When the people drank from it, they did not repent, and they didnot repent. You have kept watch over them until now.”
lunyoro: kandi yagamba ati Abantu bona babanza okutaho amarwa amarungi: kandi abantu obubaiguta, bagaruka nibataho agabihire: iwe oyahuire amarungi okuhika hati bunu.

english: Mary Magdalene, John, and Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them told these things to the apostles.
lunyoro: Maryamu Magasalene, na Yoana, na Maryamu nyina Yakobo: nabakazi abandi abakaba balinabo, bakatebeza abakwenda ebigambo ebi.

english: “What do you marvel at? I will tell you the secret meaning of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has seven heads and ten horns.
lunyoro: Kiki ekirukukutangaza? nyowe ndakutebeza ekyensita ekyomukazi, nekisoro ekyatembere, ekinyina emitwe musanju namahembe ikumi.

english: At that very moment there were shepherds sitting in the field, taking care of their flocks by night.
lunyoro: Kandi omusni egi hakaba harumu abalisa abaikaire omu bwe'le nibalinda igana ryabu ekiro.

english: For those who want riches fall into temptation and are caught in the trap of harmful habits, in order to make people lose their faith and give up.
lunyoro: baitu abanyakugonza okutunga itungo bagwa omu kwohebwa nendubatira nokwegomba kwingi okwobutami okwakabi okurukusisa, okuibika abantu omu kubura nokuhwereke'ra.

english: But they insisted more strongly that he was teaching the people and teaching all over Judea and that he had started in Galilee to this very day.
lunyoro: Baitu bagarukira muno okugamba ngu Ayemeseze abantu, nayegesa omu Buyudaya bwona, akabandiza Galiraya okuhika na hanu.

english: But Jesus turned around and said, “Who are the servants who will get my Father's hired workers and give me enough food to feed me? I am dying here.”
lunyoro: Baituobuyayegarukiremu yagamba ati Abairu baingaha abakolereza empera aba isenyowe abaiguta ebyokurya nibibalema, kunu nyowe ninfera hanu enjara?

english: Near that place was the island of Publius, who kept us close by, and for three days we were welcomed.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho haihi nekiikaro eki engonjo ezomuntu omukuru wizinga, ibararye Pubulio; ogu akatuiriza haihi, naturanira ebiro bisatu nembabazi.

english: “Sir,” he answered, “Have you come to the house where I was without clothes?” He went off and hid himself.
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Mutahi wange, otahire ota hanu otanyina kyokujwara ekyobugenyi? Yaculera kwonka.

english: Five times I was whipped by the Jewish authorities, and thirty-nine prisoners were put to death.
lunyoro: Ha Baguda emirundi etano nkaterwa enkoba amakumi asatu mumwenda.

english: The crowd gathered around them, and the judges put on their cloaks and ordered them to be crucified.
lunyoro: kandi ekitebe kikabaimuki'ra ahamu:kandi abacwi bemisango batemu'ra ebyokujwara byabu, nibaragira okubatera nemiigo.

english: There he met a man named Aeneas who had been dead for eight years, because he was still alive.
lunyoro: Hazo akasanga omuntu omu, ibararye Ainea, ayamazire ha kitabukye emyaka munana; baitu akaba azingamire.

english: We show great respect for the parts of our body which seem to be weaker, and the parts which do not have the same beauty do not fit in.
lunyoro: kandi ebicweka ebyomubiri ebirukutekerezebwa okuburaho ekitinisa, nibyo tutaho ekitiniisa ekingi: nebicweka byaitu ebitali birungi, nibyo bikira okuba noburungi:

english: God will not answer his people, who cry out to him day and night, yet he will not listen to them. Will he not be slow to forgive them?
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga taliramu'ra bakomebe, abamwami'ra anyamusana nekiro, kandi abagumisiriza muno?

english: A wise man has his weapons and keeps his own bread safe, so that his belongings will be safe.
lunyoro: Omusaija owemanzi obwayina ebyokurwanisabye nalinda ezigatiye wenka, ebintubye nubwo biikaraho nobusinge:

english: Then he sent two of his disciples out to the other disciples and said to them, “Push out into the city, and let the man in the water be made clean.
lunyoro: Yatuma babiri hali abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mutahe omu rubuga, nuho muratangana omusaija ayetwekere omunaga gwamaizi:

english: Have we ever seen you a stranger or naked, and clothe you?
lunyoro: Rundi tukakuroradi omunyaihanga, ntu ku gonyesa? rundi oli busa ntukujweka?

english: They appeared with great fear and spoke about the way he was going to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: babonekera, nibatina, nibabaza ha kufakwe okwakaba nagenda okuhikiririza Yerusalemu.

english: He sent me to you for this purpose, so that you will know what I am going to say and how he has encouraged you.
lunyoro: oyantumire namberemuli obwekigambo kinu, nukwo mumanye ebigambo byange, kandi ahumuze emitima yanyu.

english: and all the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate them one from another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
lunyoro: amahanga goona galisorozebwa omu maisoge; nauwe alibacwanganizamu, nko mulisa okwa cwanganiza entaama ne mbura buzi;

english: He was sitting there, as if it were a jasper stone and a jasper, clear as crystal. The darkness around the throne was like crystal.
lunyoro: kandi ogu akaba aikalire nasisana nkibale erya yasepi nerya sadio okurorwa: nomuhanganzima gukaba gwehingulirize ekitebe kyobukama, ogukaba nugusisana nkendo'rwamu:

english: The soldiers took him into the house in the place of the commander, who is called the Barthelios. They gathered all the way together.
lunyoro: Soda bamutwara omu nju, erukwetwa Peraitolio; basoroza hamu ekihanda kyona.

english: As many people have done, they have not begun to write a report about what has happened to us.
lunyoro: Nkokubaroho baingi abatandikire okuhandika amakuru gebigambo ebi ebyahikizibwe omulitwe.

english: The angel said to him, “Take your mat and put on your sandals.” He did so. “ Take your cloak and follow me,” he told him.
lunyoro: Na maraika yamugambira ati Wetege, ojwale enkaito zawe. Yakora ati. Yamugambira kandi ati Jwara ekyokujwara kyawe, onkuratire.

english: Suddenly in the middle of the night there was a cry, “Here is the bridegroom! Come and meet him!”
lunyoro: Baitu ekiro omu itumbi haroho obwogo ngu Dora omuswezi naija muturuke okumutangi'ra

english: But if you proclaim God's message to all people, and a person who does not believe or does not understand what you are reading, you will be punished everyone and be put right with everyone.
lunyoro: Baitu bona obubatebeza, kandi omuntu atarukuikiriza rundi atamanyire okusoma obwatahamu, alihanwa bona, kandi alicwerwa bona omusango:

english: They were pleased with him, saying, “These last men have worked only one hour, and we have agreed with you, who have been made perfect in this way. The light will shine on you.”
lunyoro: bamuramya, nibagamba ngu banu abenyuma bakozire esaha emu yonka, nabainganainganiza naitwe abaruhire omuihangwe, nomusana nugutwokya.

english: A certain man named Ananias and Sapphira sold their property as a slave.
lunyoro: Omuntu omu, ibararye Ananiya, na Safira, mukaziwe, akagura obutakabwe,

english: The Gentiles and the Jews, together with their leaders, wanted to make fun of them.
lunyoro: Abamahanga Nabayudaya hamu nabalemi babu, obubasesire okubagiza,

english: If there is no longer any grace, then there is nothing that will happen to you. But if there is not, then you will have no mercy.
lunyoro: Kandi obukuraba kuli kwembabazi, tikukiri kwemimo: kuba kitalikyo, embabazi tizakubaire embabazi.

english: He saw a fig tree by the side of the road, and when he came to it, he found nothing on it but leaves. “Don't eat anything at all,” he said. At once the fig tree dried up.
lunyoro: Yabona omutini gumu ha muhanda rubaju, yaguhikaho nasanga busaho kintu,rundi amababi masa:yagugambira ati Otaryana byana ebiro nebiro. Ahonaho omutini gwayoma.

english: He went everywhere, from village to village, from town to village. They treated the sick in the streets and begged him to touch only the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.
lunyoro: Kandi nambere yagendaga hona, rundi omu bika, runyumaye omu mbuga nomu maka, babyamisaga abarwaire omu butale, nibamwesengereza bakole kwonka ha mukugiro gwekyokujwarakye: kandi bona abakorahoga bakira.

english: So he left the food and filled it with his clothes. He took a cup and gave thanks to God.
lunyoro: yasigire ha byokurya, yajura ebyokujwarabye: yakwata ekikoba,yayetega omunda.

english: But when the sun is setting, it will shine on you, just as on you on the top of a cloud, and on you down on the other side of the sky. And so the Son of Man will be in his power.”
lunyoro: Baitu izoba oburyaliju'ra okuruga ha rubaju orumu orwiguru nkokulisisirwa okuruga hali rubajurwe orundi orwebigere, nukwo Omwana womuntu aliba ati hakirokye.

english: Keep on holding to the word of life, and on the day of Christ I will be able to boast about it. I have not done it without faith.
lunyoro: magamba ekigambo kyobwomezi; nyowe ntunge ekyokwenyumirizaho omu kiro kya kristo ngu ntairukire busa, kunu ntako'le busa.

english: They brought the donkey and the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks over them, and he sat at them.
lunyoro: baleta enkaina nomwana gwayo, bazitaho ebyokujwara byabu; yabiika'raho.

english: Do not be fooled by evil, but by the evil of good.
lunyoro: Otasingwa obubi, baitu singura obubi obwomurungi.

english: So Jesus took him aside, threw him out of the vineyard, and buried him in a tomb that had been dug out of solid rock before anyone could put it to death.
lunyoro: Yaguhanura, yagukuba omu rugonjo orwemizabibu, yamuta omu kituro ekyalimirwe omu mwandara, ekitakatebwamuga muntu.

english: For the sake of the chosen ones, then, the time will come when all these things will be destroyed.
lunyoro: Baitu habwa abakome, ebiro ebi biricwibwaho.

english: But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fancy clothes? Look! Those who dress like that and eat the good food are sitting in the king's house.
lunyoro: baitu mukagenderayo ki okurora? Omusaija ajwaire engoye ezirukworoba? Dora abo abajwara engoye ezekirokworoba, nibarya ebyokurya ebirungi, baikara omu zigati ezabakama.

english: Are they serving Christ? I am speaking as a messenger of God, and I am even more bold. I am much more bold in going into prison, even more than I have many times before, in prison.
lunyoro: Bali bahereza ba Kristo? (ningamba nkomuguiraro), nyowe nimbakira; om,u kutalibana nimbakira, omu kubohebwa omu nju zenkomo nimbakira bingi, omu kuterwa enkoba nimbakira muno, omu kufa emirundi nyingi.

english: Aram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the son of Nahshon. Nahshon was the king of Solomon.
lunyoro: Ramu akazara Aminadabu; Amidabu akazara Nasoni; Nasoni akazara Sarumoni;

english: For many who are first will be last, and many who have been last will be first.”
lunyoro: Baitu baingi abotabanza abaliba abenyuma; nabenyuma abaliba benyuma.

english: They said to me, “You must speak again to many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
lunyoro: Kandi bakangambira ngu Kikuhikirire okugaruka okuragura hali abantu, namahanga, nendimi, nabakama baingi.

english: For I am not the least of all the seeds that fell on your head.
lunyoro: Baitu nisoke erya ha mutwe gwawe libazirwe ryona.

english: While I was with them, I kept them safe in your name. I beg you, then, that you would not kill any of them except the Son of Man, and the Scriptures will come true.
lunyoro: obunkabandi nabo, nyowe nkabalinda omu ibara ryawe abawampaire: nimbasemba tihakaburaga muntu hali bo, rundi omwana owokuhwereke'ra; ebyahandikirwe bihiki'le.

english: The one who wants to be great is watching over all things. Those who do what is right are being given a sweet-smelling fragrance, because we are the real wine.
lunyoro: Kandi ogu anyakwekamba ayetanga omu byona.Kandi abo bakora bahabwe ekondo erukuhoka, baitu itwe ekyoto ekitarumu.

english: The people who saw it could not see what had happened to that man, who had demons and birds.
lunyoro: Abo abakiboine babasobo'ra ebyamubaireho ogu akabaroho emizimu, kandi nebyempunu.

english: When Jesus heard this, he was surprised and said to the people who were with him, “Surely I tell you, I have never found anyone in Israel with faith like this.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyahulire, yahuni'ra, yabagambira abakaba nibagenda nauwe ati Mazimakwo nimbagambira nti Tinkabonaga kuiziriza kwingi nka kunu, nobuhokuba omu Isareri.

english: When there was a violent argument, the commander was afraid that Paul would be torn to pieces, so he ordered the soldiers to go down and take Paul down with him and bring him into the fort.
lunyoro: Kandi obuhabaireho okukungana kwingi, engabwa enkuru obuyatinire rundi barataguratagura Pauro, yaragira abaserikale okusirimuka nokumuihamu hagati yabu namani, nokumuleta omu rukomero.

english: be very dry, be cramped, tingle (e.g. dirt), be cramped (e.”e. g. dirt, dirt, etc.)
lunyoro: (a) ensoni zikira muno kulengesebwa rundi zikira kuzoo/oka

english: At three o'clock Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Elo Is the Lion! He is the chief of the dragons! Why are you persecuting me, Lord?
lunyoro: Kandi omu saha eyomwenda Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto ati Eroi Eroi, rama sabakasani? Ekimanisibwa ngu Ruhanga wange Ruhanga waitu, kiki ekikundekeseze/

english: In the same way, wives should be faithful to their husbands, who are faithful in everything they say.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo nabakazi kibahikirire okuba tatamira, abokwesiga omu bigambo byona.

english: The other one fell on good ground, and he and his children ate a hundred grains. When he had said this, he cried out in a loud voice, “Whoever has ears to hear has ears!”

lunyoro: Muijuke ekigambo ekinabagambire nti Omuiru rubale takira mukamawe. Baraba bahigire nyowe, nainywe balibahiga; baraba bakwasire ekigambo kyange, nekyanyu balikikwata.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He who was in the likeness of God did not think of himself as a thing of the past.
lunyoro: anu obwakaba ali omu kisisani kya Ruhanga, atakitekereze ekitu ekinyakuterwa enkintu obwokuterana okuingana na Ruhanga;

english: [GENERAL] Death and the breath of the Spirit were thrown into the lake of fire. The second death was the lake of fire.
lunyoro: okufa nokuzimu byanagwa omunyanja yomu'ro. Kunu nukwo kufa okwakabiri, niyo nyanja yomuro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And so we know that if we obey his commands, we do not know them.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo turukumanyira ngu timumanyire, obuturaba ntukwata ebiragirobye.

english: [GENERAL] After we had been saved, we realized that the island was called the island of Malta.
lunyoro: Kandi obutwamazire okujunwa, nubwo twamanyire ngu izinga niryetwa Merita.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For by means of his grace they have been set free from sin by means of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu baihibwaho omusango omu mbabazize kwonka, obwokucungurwa okuli omu Kristo Yesu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Nor do you ask for more, but ask for more than you ask for, and you will have no need to do so.
lunyoro: sabira kandi timurukuhabwa, baitu musaba kubi, okubikoza okwegomba kwanyu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the good things that we have do not need, but the God who made us together with the body together with the one who gave us all the more honor.
lunyoro: baitu ebicweka byaitu ebirungi tibirukutaga: baitu Ruhanga akateraniza hamu omubiri naha ekitinisa ekingi hali ekicweka ekibuzirweho;

english: [RELIGIOUS] But you reject the Holy One, who is righteous and pray that God will give you the victory.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe mukehakana ogu Arukwera, Ahikirire, numusaba okuhebwa omuzinzi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] I have told you this because I have pity on you, not because I have told you the truth, but because I have done good to you and have sent you to the Lord without fault.
lunyoro: Kandi eki nkigambire obwokubagasira inywenka; tibuli obwokubanagira ekisuli, baitu obwebirungi, nainywe muherezege Mukama waitu mutarukutabatabana.

english: [GENERAL] For what I am doing I will do, so that I will not give up on those who want to spend time with me. In the same way, they will do to us in the way they please me.
lunyoro: Baitu ekindukukora nikyo ndikora, ntabaha omwanya abase'ra omwanya; nukwo barorwe nka itwe omu kigambo ekibenyumirizamu.

english: [GENERAL] But they said, “It is not the day of the feast, and there is no riot among the people.”
lunyoro: Baitu bakagamba ngu Kitaba ha kiro kyobugenyi, hatabaho okuimuki'ra omu bantu.

english: [GENERAL] The dragon saw a vision in heaven, and a woman who had a name written on her forehead, dressed in white, and wearing twelve stars on her head.
lunyoro: Darakoni akokuro'raho akakoto kakarorwa omu iguru; omukazi ajwaire izoba, nokwezi omunda yebigerebye, kandi ha mutwegwe ekondo yenyunyuzi ikumi naibiri;

english: [GENERAL] Those who hear this and obey it will go on walking, being led astray by the desires, riches, and pleasures of this life, and will not achieve anything good.
lunyoro: Kandi abahu'ra basirimuka, batangwa habwokutabana, nitungo nebyokwesemeza ebyomubwomezi bunu, kandi tibahikiriza byana ebirungi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So he left the territory of Galilee and asked them, “Sir, I want to see Jesus.”
lunyoro: yamukaguza, nagamba ati Tata, ntwenda okurora Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He sent them to preach the Kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
lunyoro: Yabatuma okutebeza obukama bwa Ruhanga, nokukiza abarwaaire.

english: [GENERAL] After spending a long time there, we reached Cnidus, where the wind was not coming on us, and we crossed over on the island of Crete in front of Salmon.
lunyoro: Lino, obutwamazire okuraba omu nyanja ebiro bingi, tuhikire namani omu maiso ga Kinido, nomuyaga gututangire okuhikayo, twahingura ha rubaju rwa Kerete omu malembo ga Saramone;

english: [RELIGIOUS] At about nine o'clock Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloiro, Eloi! Why are you persecuting me, my God!
lunyoro: Kandi omu saha eyomwenda Yesu yayamuza iraka likoto ati Eroi Eroi, rama sabakasani? Ekimanisibwa ngu Ruhanga wange Ruhhanga wange, kiki ekikundekeseze/

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to the twelve, “Do you want to go also?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagambira ikumi nababiri ati Kandi nainywe nimwenda okwegendera?

english: [RELIGIOUS] We live in the flesh at all times, because the death of Jesus has been made manifest in our bodies.
lunyoro: ebiro byona tuhimbira omu mubiri okufa kwa Yesu bwolekwe omu mubiri gwaitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The chief priests took some of the money and said, “This is not against the Law to put it in the Temple of God, but to put it in the Most Holy Place.
lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru batwara ebicweka ebyefeza, nibagamba ngu Tikiri kyebiragiro okubita omu ryahu'ro rya Ruhanga, baitu muhendo gwesagama.

english: [GENERAL] While Jesus was still in the house, Melchizedek met him.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba akiri omu nju, Merekizedeka obuyamuitiraine.

english: [GENERAL] While Agrippa said to Paul, “You must speak on your own behalf.” Then Paul stretched out his hand and began to speak up.
lunyoro: Agulipa yagambira Pauro ati Nyikirize iwe okwegambira wenka. Nubwo Pauro yago'ra omukonogwe, nayetonganira ati:

english: [GENERAL] The beast that was, and is not, is the eighth king and is one of seven, and he goes out to fight.
lunyoro: Ekisoro ekikaba kiroho,kandi tikiroho, nuwe mukama owomunana kandi ali omu hali abo omusanju, nauwe agenda omu kuhwereke'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For if these things are yours and you live, they will not be yours; but if they do bear children, they will know only the truth about our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ebigambo ebi obubiraba biri byanyu kandi nibasaga, bibafora okuba abatali bagara, baitu abanyakwana ebyana hali okumanyira kimu Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Some of you have done this to others, but you have done it, because you have been put right with God through the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
lunyoro: Kandi abamu omulinywe nukwo mwasisaine muti: baitu mukoga, baitu mukezebwa, baitu mukaihibwaho omusango omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, nomu Mwoyo ogwa Ruhanga waitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And God will exalt him by his own power, and he will bow down to him at once.
lunyoro: kandi Ruhanga alimunyumiza omuruwe wenka, kandi bwango aramunumiza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, if anyone is in union with Christ, let him be in a new creation. The old things have passed away. Look! new things have passed away.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wena araba ali omu Kristo, buli afokere ekihangirwe ekihyaka: ebyaira bihoireho, dora, byona bihyaka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus said to him, “Who is my neighbor?”
lunyoro: Baitu ogu akaba nayenda okweyihaho omusango, yagambira Yesu ati Kandi omutahi wange araha?

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the Spirit who raised Jesus from death must remain in you, who raised Jesus Christ from death and gave life to your mortal bodies by means of his Spirit who lives in you.
lunyoro: Baitu omwoyo gwogu ayahumbuire Yesu omu bafu guraba guikaire omulinywe ogu ayahumbuuire Kristo Yesu omubafu aliha obwomezi emibiri yanyu erukufa, Obwomwoyogwe oguikara omulinywa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For just as you have not heard God's voice, so now you have been given mercy because of their disobedience.
lunyoro: baitu nka inywe obumutarahulire ira Ruhanga, baitu hati bunu muhairwe okuganyirwa obwokutahu'ra kwabu,

english: [RELIGIOUS] He was greatly troubled by the pain of his thorn bush, and he fell down from heaven on people. The people worshiped God because of the pain of the rock, but his pain was so great.
lunyoro: ekisoro eki ekikooto, obwoki bwenjoka enkoto, kikagwa okuruga omu iguru ha bantu: abantu nibajuma Ruhanga habwokubonabonesebwakwe: baitu okusasa kwakiboine kuti.ekisisoro ekikaba kiri kingi muno

english: [RELIGIOUS] It is enough for you that you will be like his disciples, and that you will be like his master. If you call out to his father in law at Beelzebul, how will they not answer him?
lunyoro: Kikumara omwegeswa abe nkomwegesawe. Obubaraba besere nyineka Beerezebuli, tibalikizaho abo abali omunju?

english: [GENERAL] After a few days, the young child gathered all his belongings and went to a nearby country, where he ended up doing what was bad.
lunyoro: Kandi hanyuma yebiro ebitali bingi, ogu omwana omuto, akasoroza ebye byona, yagenda omu nsi ya hara; yararangiza oku ebintubye omu ngeso ezibihire.

english: [GENERAL] They must be quiet, but they must be quiet; they must go into houses and teach what is not right in their own sight.
lunyoro: kandi basemerire kuboha akanwa; baitu nibo bajumikira kimu amaju, nibegesa ebitahikirire obwamagoba go

english: [RELIGIOUS] They told him by love that they had seen that I had not done anything wrong with the gospel.
lunyoro: abo nibatebeza obwokugonza, baboine ngu ntaireho okutonganira enjiri:

english: [RELIGIOUS] And so we will do if God wishes.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo tulikora Ruhanga obwaligonza.

english: [GENERAL] For we want to hear you think about it, because we know that this part of us is everywhere.
lunyoro: baitu ntugonza okuhu'ra namberoli ekyorukutekereza: baitu ekicweka eki tumanyire nikijumwa hona hona.

english: [GENERAL] We are saved from the ignorant and the wicked, but faith is not a possession of all people.
lunyoro: kandi tujunwe hali abantu abatanyina amagezi, ababi: baitu okuikiriza tikuli na bona.

english: [GENERAL] They had a scarlet robe, and their hair was like a robe.
lunyoro: kandi zikaba ziyina isoke nkisoke ryabakazi, namaino gazo gali nketale.

english: [GENERAL] He did not try to force anyone to tell him about the things that happened to him, but he himself knew what was in human beings.
lunyoro: kandi atase'le muntu wena okumumanyisa ebyabantu; baitu uwe wenka akamanya ebikaba biri omu Bantu.

english: [GENERAL] So then, be patient with him before you think you will answer him.
lunyoro: Nikyo mukigumize omu mitima yanyu okutabanzaga okutekereza okumuragarukamu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Give to the one who is sinning against the body of the Lord Jesus, so that the Spirit may be saved by the Day of our Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: okuhayo ogu arukusisa ati hali Ruhanga omubiri gughwereke'le, nukwo omwoyo gujunwe ha kiro kya Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] So then, do not look at one another in your own words, but at the same time look at one another.
lunyoro: nukwo mutarora omu ha bigambo byanyu inywenka, baitu inywena murole nebyabandi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus Christ himself gave himself for us, in order that he might redeem us from all sin and make us his own people, which is the means by which he has called you to do good.
lunyoro: Yesu Kristo ayayehaireyo wenka habwaitu nukwo atucungule omu kutahiki'ra kwona kandi ayesemereze wenka ihanga okuba rye wenka, erirukwekambira engeso enungi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For if we have become partners in union with Christ, we are sure that we will remain in union with him until the end.
lunyoro: baitu turaba tugwire obugwetwa omu Kristo, tutekerize ngu ntugumangana okkuhikya ha mpero:

english: [GENERAL] They went back to the mountains, where the birds came up and did not come up or go in, to take anything out of their houses.
lunyoro: Kandi obubagarukayo omu nsozi, nambere enyonyi ezahagati zitalimuka, nobukwakuba okutahamu, okuihamu ekintu omu nju yabu.

english: [GENERAL] So then, he makes it clear to you that you are going to be sorry, and he makes it clear to you who are going to be sorry.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo aganyira ati owayenda okuganyira, kandi agumanganiza owagumanganiza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When we see that no one is judged by the deeds of the Law, but by the faith of Christ Jesus, we are put right with God by faith in Christ Jesus, and we are made by the deeds of the Law. For no one is condemned by the deeds of the Law.
lunyoro: baitu obutuboine ngu omuntu taihibwaho omusango obwemirimo yebiragiro, bitu obwokuikiriza Kristo Yesu, tuihibweho omusango obwokuiriza Kristo, kunu tubuli obwengeso zebiragiro: baitu omuntu wean atalihibwaaho omusango obwebiragiro.

english: [GENERAL] The king will reply, ‘I tell you, just as you did among my younger brothers, so you have done to me.’
lunyoro: Omukama aligarukamu alibagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambiranti nkoku mwakolire omu hali abo bagenzi bange abarukukira obuto, buli mukakikoora nyowe.

english: [GENERAL] For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and by these means the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
lunyoro: Baitu nikirema omuntu okufera nowokuhiki'ra: baitu habwebi byona haroho emyehembo.

english: [GENERAL] Let us, then, be on our guard against being deceived by the outward appearance of this world.
lunyoro: Kandi twekambege tutahe omu kuhumura oku, omuntu wena atagwa omu kutahu'ra okwomulingo ogu.

english: [GENERAL] Why should you buy these oil for three hundred silver coins to be sold to the poor?
lunyoro: Kiki ekihinzire okugura amagita ganu okugaihamu edinali bikumu bisatu, okugabira abamasege?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Moses was faithful in all his house, as he was willing to speak, and he was faithful in all his house.
lunyoro: Kandi Musa akabali owokwesiga mali omu njuye yona nkomukozi owakaba ali owokusobo'ra ebikaba nibigenda okugambwa.

english: [GENERAL] He poured out his bowl into the cup, mixed the wine with oil, and gave thanks to God, broke it, and gave him to God, and took him into his house. He healed him.
lunyoro: kandi yasemba emputaze nasesemu amagita nomubazi; yamutembya ensoroye wenka, yamuleta omu nju yabagonyi, yamurwaza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said, “The Jews joined him in requesting that Paul be brought before the Council the next day, just as he wanted to ask him to speak on his behalf again.
lunyoro: Yagamba at Abayudaya bateraine hamu okukwesengereza okusirimura Pauro nyenkya hali orukurato, nosisana noyenda okugaruka okumukaguza amananu agebigambobye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But many of the crowd believed in him, saying, “When the Messiah comes, he will perform more miracles than this man has done!”
lunyoro: Baitu baingi abomukitebe bakamuikiriza; nibagamba ngu Kristo obwaliija alikora ebyamahano bingi okukira ogu ebyakozire?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave them to the people, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set them before the people.
lunyoro: Yakwata emigati etano nencu ibiri, yarora haiguru omu iguru, yabisimira; yabicwamu, yaha abegeswa okubita omu maiso gekitebe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He who has seen it has seen it, and he also has seen it with his own eyes. He knows that he speaks with his mind, and you believe.
lunyoro: Gamba ati Ogu ayaboine akakora, nainywe mukwateho: kandi amanyire agamba amananu, naiwe muikirize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They begged him to do the same to him, because they were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: kandi bamwesengereza rundi bakoleho kwonka ha mukugiro ogwenkasenzuye:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Again Jesus went away and prayed, “My Father, if this little while you can't take away from me, what you want will happen to me.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okurugayo, yasaba, nagamba ati Ai bambi Isenyowe, kinu kiraba kitarukusobora kundugaho rundi, nyowe nkinywe, ekyorukugonza nikyo kikorwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Suddenly the spirit seized him, and he began to speak with a loud voice. He cried with a loud cry, but he did not hear.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, omuzimu gumukwata, ahonaho ayamuza, nakunga muno, kandi atarukuhu'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For by means of the great and glorious blood of Christ, you have been redeemed, as though you were a lamb without a shepherd.
lunyoro: baitu mukacungurwa nesagama eyomuhendo mwingi nkeyomwana gwentama ogutaroho bulema nobukakuba akamogo, niyo ya Kristo:

english: [RELIGIOUS] But whoever has the world's means for peace and sexual immorality and has kept himself safe from God's wrath.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena obwaba anyina ebyomunsi namugonza, kandi nasihana, kandi nayesereka ayomire wenka hali okubihirwa okwingi,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I tell you that no one has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Busaho muntu ayasigire enju, rundi mukazi, Rundi bene babu, runyoro nambere abamuzaire barumu abana, habwobukama bwa Ruhanga,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I have seen many good things that have happened to you from my Father. What work do you do to stone me?”
lunyoro: Yesu yabarugakamu ati Emirimo mingi esemire eyarugire hali Isenyowe nkagiboleka inywe; mulimo ki hali egi ogurukubanteza amabale?

english: [GENERAL] Let us consider first the love that God has for one another and the love that is good for one another.
lunyoro: kandi tutekerezege okwakambi okwehambisangana okugonzangana, nokukora engeso ezisemire;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Look at my hands and my feet, and I am the only one. Keep watch and see! The spirit doesn't have flesh and bones, as you see I have.
lunyoro: Murole engaro zange nebigere byange, ninyowomu nyenka: mukwateho, murole; baitu omuzimu tiguyina nyama namagufa nkokumuboine nyowe okunyina.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You said to the servant whom my Father has chosen to send into the world, ‘You have chosen, but I have said that I am the Son of God.’
lunyoro: mubagambire muta ogu Isenyowe ouyayereze namutuma omu nsi ngu Ojumire; baitu ngambire nti Ninyowe Mwana wa Ruhanga?

english: [GENERAL] I have gone through the religion of the Jews more than many of my own people, and I have a greater share in the deeds that my ancestors performed.
lunyoro: kandi nkahingurana omu dini Yabayudaya okukira baingi abomu ihanga ryange abanakuzire nabo, nyina ihali erirukukira obwingi habwengeso ezinahairwe baisenkuru nyowe.

english: [GENERAL] Afterward I went to Syria and Cilicia.
lunyoro: Hanyuma nkagenda omu nsi eza Busuli neza Kirikiya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they left, they asked for these things on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaturukire, bayesengereza ebigambo binu bibagambirwe ha Sabiti eyakabiri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] If David were to call him Lord, how could he not be called your son?
lunyoro: Nukwo Daudi obwaraba na mweta Mukamawe aba ata mwanawe?

english: [GENERAL] The next day Jesus went back to them and walked on the beach.
lunyoro: Kandi omu kisissimuka ekyakana akaija namberebali, nagendera ha nyanja.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Even though I wrote this, I did not write it for the sake of the one who sinned or for the one who was made weak, but for the one who was made perfect in God's sight.
lunyoro: Nobahandikire nobwakubaire nsisire, kunu tali habwogu ayasisire, nobukyakuba obwomuntu ayasisirwe, baitu okwolekwa kwanyu habwaitu kwolekwe omulinywe omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So the spirit came down from many people and said to him, “You are the Son of God,” and he did not believe, because he knew that he was the Messiah.
lunyoro: Emizimu nayo ekaruga omu baingi, neyamuza negamba ngu Baitu niwe Mwana wa Ruhanga. Yagitanga atarukugiikiriza okugamba, baitu ekamumanya nuwe Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus heard that they had put him out of the way, and he found him and asked, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”
lunyoro: Yesu yahu'ra bamubingire aheru; yamuzora nagamba ati Iwe noikiriza Omwana wa ruhanga?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus knew everything that was going to happen to him, so he left and asked them, “Who are you looking for?”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamanyire ebigambo byona ebiramubaho, yarugayo nabagambira ati Nimuse'ra oha?

english: [GENERAL] All our righteousness is sin, and there is a sin that does not lead to death.
lunyoro: Obutuhiki'ra byona kiba kibi; kandi haroho ekibi ekitali ekyokufa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For it is God who makes us, together with you, by means of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nuwe agumya itwe hamu nainywe omu Kristo,

english: [RELIGIOUS] The crowds said, “This is the prophet Jesus, who came from Nazareth in Galilee.”
lunyoro: Ebitebe byagamba ngu Ogu nuwe nabi, Yesu ayarugire omu Nazaresi eya Galiraya.

english: [GENERAL] No one puts on a new coat of clothing, but what is put on it is covered with a new coat, and the ear can be healed.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu abazira ekiremu ekikyaka oku kyokujwara ekikkuzire, baitu eki ekibazirwemu kitemura ekyokubazirwemu, nekihuru kiukanya okugaliha.

english: [GENERAL] But if I make you sad, who will make you glad, or who will make you sad?
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nimbatuntuza, noha arukunsemeza, rundi ogu arukufuntizibwa nyowe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] They came to him and woke him up and said, “Save us, Lord!”
lunyoro: Baija namberali nibamusisimura, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu, juna, twafa.

english: [GENERAL] Now I beg you, woman, not to write a new commandment, but to love one another.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu nkwesengerize mukazi, tikuli okukuhandikira ekiragiro ekihyaka, baitu rundi ekiragiro ekirundi ekimu, ngu Tugonzanganege.

english: [GENERAL] Then you will sit down at the right side of the tree, where its branches will be broken and its branches will be broken to pieces, and you will know that the summer is near.
lunyoro: Kandi mwegere hali omutini orufumo rwagwo; itagi ryagwo obulinyeta, amababi nigarokera, buli mumanyire omwaka guli haihi;

english: [GOVERNMENT] If he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because there were priests who offered sacrifices according to the Law.
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba ali hansi, tiyakubaire nyakatagara na kake, baitu haroho abahonga ebisembo nkebiragiro okubiragira;

english: [GENERAL] So then, go on walking in a good way toward the outside, so that you will not be discouraged at all.
lunyoro: mugendege kurungi abanyakuli aheru, mutabuzirweho na kake.

english: [GENERAL] How terrible for the world to see you because of what you do not know! It will not let you go, but it will see the man who brings you into the world and does not forgive you!

english: [RELIGIOUS] Greetings to the church in their homes. Greetings to Epaphroditus, my dear friend, who is the first in Asia for Christ.
lunyoro: kandi muramukye nekanisa eyomu nju yabu. Muramukye Epaineto, oundukugonza, nuwe kyana ekyokubanza ekyomu Asiya hali Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “Have you seen this great and glorious work? It will not be left here until the stone is rolled up and thrown down.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Oboine okwombekwa kunu okwingi? Tihalisigara hanu ibale erinyakuli ha ibale, eritalinagwa hansi.

english: [GENERAL] While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, Peter, John, and Andrew asked him,
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba aikalire ha rusozi orwa Zeituni nalisirimuka, Petero na Yohana na Andereya bakamukaguza

english: [GENERAL] And if I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Blessed be God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga asimwe arukutusinguza omu Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They began to reject him and said, “We found this man misleading our people, and he is trying to gain favor with the Emperor. He claims to be the Messiah, the King!”
lunyoro: Babanza okumulega nibagamba ngu Tukarora omuntu onu nahabisa ihanga ryaitu: nabatanga okuzinira Kaisali, nayegamba wenka okuba Kristo, Omukama.

english: [RELIGIOUS] In the same way, what God has joined together cannot be divided.
lunyoro: nukwo ruhanga ekiyateranize hamu, omuntu atali baganizamu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Father Abraham,” he cried out, “I have a drink of water, and I am going to send Lazarus to dip his finger in the water and cool my tongue, because I am in this fire.
lunyoro: Yayami'ra nagamba ati Tata Iburahimu, nganyira, otume Razaro, aibike ensonga yorukumurwe omu maizi, afukirize orulimi rwange; baitu nimpu'rwa omu mu'ro gunu.

english: [GENERAL] I tell you the truth about human weakness, but just as you have put away your parts of shame and anger from you, so you must now give your bodies to the people for the sake of righteousness and of holiness.
lunyoro: Ngamba habwobugara obwomubiri gwange: baitu nkokumwahayoga ebicweka byanyu hali ebyensoni, nokwema hali okwena, nukwo hati bunu mweheyo kicweka kyanyu okuba bairu hali okuhiki'ra nokwezebwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “What is your name,” he answered, “and I am a liar, because we have many things in common.”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Ibara ryawe niwoha? Yamugambira ati Niwe kaiso wange, baitu tuli naingi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For who knew the mind of the Lord, that he might instruct him? For we have the mind of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu noha akaba amanyire amagezi ga Mukama, okumwegesa? Baitu itwe tuyina amagezi ga Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He will not be afraid of God on Jacob.
lunyoro: Ataliterana na Ruhanga ha Yakobo:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus told them many other things, and he said to them, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation.”
lunyoro: Kandi akabatebeza omu bigambo bindi ebingi, nabagambi'ra ati Mwejune omu businge bunu obuhabire.

english: [GENERAL] They threw themselves down at the feet of the apostles, and at their feet they gave the same thing to each other.
lunyoro: babita ha bigere byabakwenda; babagabira omuomu nkokubasegere.

english: [GENERAL] If I speak in the languages of men and of angels, but do not have love, then I will become like a licentious plant that grows up and becomes like a branch that does not bear fruit.
lunyoro: Obundaba ningamba nendimi zabantu neza bamaraika, kunu ntanyina kugonza, buli nfokere nkomulinga ogugamba, nenjogera ezisara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] May Christ remain in your hearts by means of your faith. If you have your hearts full of love,
lunyoro: Kristo aikalege omu mitima yanyu obwokuikiriza: inywe obumunyina emihama yanyu, kandi obumugumibwa muno omu kugonza,

english: [GENERAL] For our weak state, now that we are weak, is stronger than the moment we are made perfect in the hope of eternal glory.
lunyoro: Baitu omuhito gwaitu ogwa hati ogutalemera muno nugugarukira obutosa okutuko'ra ekitinisa kingi ekyebiro nebiro:

english: [GENERAL] You can see that the time has not yet come for me to build Jerusalem a place of worship.
lunyoro: musobole okumanya ngu ebiro tibikahinguireho ikumi na bibiri nkaba kutemba Yerusalemu okuramya:

english: [GENERAL] The roof was broken down, the rivers gushed out, the wind blew down, and that house was broken down. The roof was broken down, and the roof was broken down.
lunyoro: kandi nenjuye yagwa, nemigezi yagera, nekiyaga kyatera, nibitera enju egi: nokugwa kwayo kukaba kuli kwingi.

english: [GENERAL] For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil and evil. For the love of good is a root of all kinds of evil.
lunyoro: Baitu nikirema omuntu okufera nowokuhiki'ra: baitu habwomurungi rundi omuntu yakugumire okumufera.

english: [GENERAL] He wanted to gather the wheat into his barn, but no one gave him anything.
lunyoro: yagondeze okusara ebisunga byebisajwa omu nguliye; baitu busaho muntu ayamuhaga.

english: [GENERAL] The man must give to the woman what is good for her, and the woman must also give to the man.
lunyoro: Omusaija amuhege mukazi ekimusemerire: nukwo nomukazi amuhe ati omusaija.

english: [GENERAL] That is why I asked you to see me and talk to me, because I am happy because of the hope that the people of Israel have.
lunyoro: Nikyo mbesengererize inywe okundora nokubaza na nyowe; baitu obwokunihira okwa Isareri nikyo mbohirwe

english: [RELIGIOUS] That is why I went to Jerusalem and took many of the holy ones into prison, where I was given authority over the chief priests and when they were put to death, I also believed in killing them.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo nakolire Yerusalemu, kandi naboha omu nju zenkomo abarukwera baingi,obunahairwe obusobozi hali banyakatagara abakuru, kandi obubaisirwe, nanyowe nkaikiriza okubaita.

english: [GENERAL] He went out about twelve o'clock in the morning and found others standing there. “What are you doing here,” he asked them. “Don't you know what you are doing?”
lunyoro: Yaturuka esaha zihikire ikumi nemu, yasanga abandi bemerire; yabagambira ati Kikyekibemerize hanu okiza obuire, mutaroho ekimurukukora?

english: [GENERAL] and think of yourself as a blind man.
lunyoro: kandi oyetekerize wenka okuba omumuiruma,

english: [GENERAL] For we have seen a man who is a very wicked man, misleading everyone in all the world, and misleading the Jewish people of the rest of the world.
lunyoro: Baitu tukabona omusaija omu mubi muno, kandi owokwemesa Abayudaya bona abali omunsi zona, kandi omukuru owekicweka kya Banazalesi:

english: [GENERAL] He was amazed, and all who were with him, at the many fish that they had caught.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba ahunirire, na bona abakaba bali nauwe, obwencu enyingi ezibakwasire;

english: [RELIGIOUS] And I said, ‘The Lord himself knows that I am going to prison and will go into prison with all the churches who believe in you.’
lunyoro: Nagamba nti Mukama wange nuwe amanyire wenka ngu nyowe nabataga omu nju zenkomo, kandi nabateraga omu maso'rokaniro gona abakuikirize:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “The Sabbath was made for the people, and not for the people on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Sabiti ekabaho habwabantu, kandi tibali Bantu habwa Sabiti:

english: [GENERAL] He believed and looked for someone who was not a believer.
lunyoro: Yaikiriza, yase'ra akabali, ha kitebe kitali.

english: [GENERAL] They have respect for you and speak well of you, so that whoever opposes you will be ashamed of you and have no excuse for sin.
lunyoro: nukwo ogu anyakuharana naiwe akwatwe ensoni, atanyina ekigambo ekibi oku

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus looked up and said, “I make people look like trees walking on me.”
lunyoro: Yabona haiguru nagamba ati Nimpweza abantu; baitu nindora nibasisana nkemiti nibagenda.

english: [GENERAL] They heard that it was good in the future, so that they might keep alive now and live.
lunyoro: nibahu'ra bonka ekyokweme'raho ekirungi obwebiro ebirukugenda okuija, nukwo bakwate obwomezi obu, nubwo bwomezi obu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from my Father, the Spirit of wisdom, who comes from my Father, he will reveal my things.
lunyoro: Baitu Omuhumuza obwaliija oundibatumira okuruga hali Isenyowe, Omwoyo owamananu, arukuruga hali Isenywe, ogu alimanyisa ebyange,

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus left, two blind men followed him. They shouted, “Son of David! We have sinned!”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyarugireyo, abafu bamaiso babiri bakamukuratira. Nibatokera haiguru, nibagamba ngu Tuganyire. iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: [GENERAL] It was not like the idols of this world, nor the merchants, nor the greedy, nor the drunkards, nor the prostitutes, who practiced sexual immorality. It was right for you to have one of these things come into the world.
lunyoro: wakuba abaramya ebisisani ebyensi enu, rundi abakuhyangya ebisuba: rundi abegombi, ebaruha, ebisisaniza, abasuma, nabasisi: baitu kyakubahikirire kiti okurugira kimu omu nsi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Some Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, but he does not keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such miracles?” There was a division among them.
lunyoro: Abefalisayo abamu bagamba ngu Omuntu ogu tali wa Ruhanga, baitu takwata Sabiti. Baitu abandi bagamba ngu omuntu omusisi nasobora ata okukora obwokuro'raho obuingaine aho? Kandi hakabaho wmpaka halibo.

english: [GENERAL] For what will it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his life?
lunyoro: Baitu nikimugasira ki omuntu, okutunga ensi yona nokuburwa obwomezibwe?

english: [GENERAL] When he saw the fig tree afar off, he came to it, or he saw something. When he came, he did not see it at all, but only at the right time.
lunyoro: obuyarozire hara omutini ogunyakuroho amababi, yaguhikaho, rundi azoleho kintu: kandi obuyaguhikireho, tiyabona kantu, baitu ebiro byahinguraho kwonka; baitu bitakaizire na kake.

english: [GENERAL] When I had eaten the seven thousand men, how many baskets full of fish did you take out of the jar?” They said to him, “Get up!”
lunyoro: Kandi obunacwerire enkumi ina omusanju, mwakoma ebigega bingaha ebiijuire oburagalika? Bamugambira ngu Musanju.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Men of Israel,” Jesus told them, “Watch out for yourselves what you are about to do with these people.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, mwerinde inywenka hali abantu banu ekimugenda okukora.

english: [GENERAL] If you know these things, how happy you will be to do them!
lunyoro: Obumuraba mubimanyire ebi, muyina omugisa obumubikora.

english: [GENERAL] For I do not want to see my own glory, but someone seeks and judges.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe tinse'ra kitinisa kyange nyenka: haroho ase'ra kandi acwa omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For while we were still weak, Christ died for ungodly people by the power of God.
lunyoro: Baitu obutukabatukyali abagara, omu mpikoze Kristo akafera abatarukutina Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] In union with Christ you too must be built up as God's throne by the Spirit.
lunyoro: nainywe omuruwe mwombekerwe hamu okkuba ekiikaro ekyokuikaramu ekya Ruhanga omu Mwoyo.

english: [GENERAL] Show him the money coin.” They brought the money to him.
lunyoro: Mwoleke efeza eyomusoro. Bamuletera edunali.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And this was not the only thing that the church was instructed to do with us in this letter of grace, which we send to the glory of our Lord and to show our faith.
lunyoro: kandi tikiri eki kyonka, baitu akasomwamu ekanisa okugenda naitwe omu kigambo kinu ekyembabazi, itwe ekiturukuhereza hali ekitinisa ekya Mukama waitu, nokwoleka okwekamba kwaitu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus stood up with him and began to teach him, and he left him. At once he got up and sent them away.
lunyoro: Yayeme'ra namberali, yacomera omusaija; gwamurugaho: ahonaho yaimuka yabahereza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Jesus stretched out his hand toward his disciples and said, “Look! Here is my mother and my brothers!
lunyoro: Yago'ra omukonogwe hali abegeswabe nagamba ati Dora, mau nagagenzi bange.

english: [GENERAL] So then, if you do not forgive each other from the heart, my Father in heaven will forgive you.
lunyoro: Nukwo ati Isenyowe ali omu Iguru, alibakora inywe, obumuraba mutarukuganyira inywena omu mitima bene banye.

english: [GENERAL] It is not like Moses, who hid his face, that the people of Israel should not look far to see the end of the age.
lunyoro: kandi tikuli nka Musa okuyaswekerire amaisoge, abana ba Isaleri baleke okuhweza muno emperor yeki ekihwaho:

english: [GENERAL] When he opened the second seal, he heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
lunyoro: Obuyasumuruire emanyikirizo eyakabiri nahu'ra ekyomezi ekyakabiri nikigamba ngu Ija.

english: [GENERAL] Just as the Word is in the world, so are the things that are in the world. Just as the heavens are in the world, they are the things that are in the world.
lunyoro: Nkokubali owomunsi, nukwo bali bati abomu iguru; nkokwali owomwiguru, nukw bali bati abanyakuli omunsi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For they were about five thousand men. Jesus said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
lunyoro: Baitu bakaba bali basaija nkenkumi itano. Yagambambira abegeswabe ati Mubaikalize hansi omu nka'ra ezamakumi atano.

english: [GENERAL] He deceived our people and led them out of the way, so that their children would not be able to stand up.
lunyoro: Ogu akagobeza ihanga ryaitu nayendereza abana babu abakyali bato, okubatanga okwemera.

english: [GENERAL] But when they had sailed from Perga, they went to Antioch in Pisidia, and on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and prayed.
lunyoro: Baitu bo, obubarabire okuruga Perega, bahika Antyokiya orwa Pisidia; kandi bakataha omu iso'rokaniro ha kiro kya Sabiti, baika'ra.

english: [GENERAL] For what will it profit a man to eat the world and die for his life?
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu kirimugasira ki okurya ensi yona kandi aferirwe obwomezibwe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] He has appeared to us and saved us, not by the good deeds that we ourselves have done, but by the mercy that he has performed since the birth of the second child, and by the new birth of the Spirit.
lunyoro: hati yolekerwe, akatujuna, tibuli obwengeso zokuhiki'ra ezitwakozire itwe baitu obwokuganyirakwe obwokwogibwa obwo kuzarwa omurundi ogwakabiri, nokuforwa abahyaka omumwoyo.

english: [GENERAL] Every tribe in heaven and on earth is named after its name.
lunyoro: abo abomu ruganda rwona, oubarukwetwa amabara, omu iguru na hansi,

english: [RELIGIOUS] “What do you want us to do with you, Son of God? Have you come here to punish us before the time comes?” they shouted.
lunyoro: Nabo batokera haiguru ngu Tujunaine ki, itwe naiwe, Iwe Omwana wa Ruhanga? Oizire hanu okutucanza akasumi kaitu katakahikire?

english: [GENERAL] But they did not give up, and they gave themselves over to selfish desires.
lunyoro: baitu abo bakalekayo okusalirwa, bayehayo bonka halitasemire omu kwegomba.

english: [GENERAL] Happy is he who reads and those who hear the words of this prophecy and obey the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.
lunyoro: Ayina omugisa anyakusomamu, nabo abanyakuhu'ra ebigambo ebyokuragura kunu, nibakwata ebigambo ebihandikirwemu:baitu akasumi kali haihi.

english: [GENERAL] This wisdom is not that comes down from heaven, but from the earth, which is the world, the Devil's children.
lunyoro: Amagezi ganu tigali ago agarukuruga haiguru, baitu ga hansi, gokuzarwa kwonka, ga Setani.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He begged Jesus to send them to the synagogues in Damascus to see the people there, both men and women, who had come to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: kandi yamusaba ebaruha ezokugenda Damasiko, hali amaso'rokaniro, obwalibonayo abantu Abomuhanda ogu, rundi abasaija, kandi abakazi, ababoine abalete Yerusalemu.

english: [GENERAL] But this son of mine was dead and has been raised to life, and he was lost, and he is asleep.
lunyoro: baitu omwana wange onu akaba afire, ahumbukire; akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But if a person is persecuted as a Christian, let him not be ashamed of him, because he serves God in his own name.
lunyoro: baitu omuntu obwabonabonesebwa nka Mukristayo aleke okukwatwa ensoni; baitu akugize Ruhanga omu ibara eri.

english: [GENERAL] We do not commit adultery, but we belong to one another, and in the same way, we are guilty of sin and are put to death by the power of two thousand three hundred.”
lunyoro: Tusisaine, baitu tukanabana, kandi nkabarukwera abatanyina amani, kandi abatarukutina Ruhanga bahwerekerezebwa okuhikya akasumi kakumi mwenkumi isatu.

english: [GENERAL] But Paul said, “I have never been in a better place than Festus, because I am telling you the truth and proving it by what you say.”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Tingwire iraro, Fesito omurungi muno; baitu ningamba ebigambo ebyamananu nokwekenga.

english: [GENERAL] When Zechariah saw him, he was greatly troubled.
lunyoro: Zekaria obuyamuboine yatuntura, okutina kwingi kwamukwata.

english: [GENERAL] Don't you remember that I was still with you when I told you these things?
lunyoro: Ibaijukya ngu nobunkaba nkyali nainywe nkabatebeza ebi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Think about the difficult conditions you are going to suffer, not to give up, nor to teach, but to have no need for tears or hands. God feeds you. Are you not worth much more than birds?
lunyoro: Mutekereze ebingora okubitasiga nobukwakuba okugesa; abitanyina mbiso nobwekuba enguli; kandi Ruhanga abirisa: inywe timurukukira muno omuhendo enyonyi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] I am sending you to the prophets, wise men, and teachers of the Law. Some of them you will kill, others you will stone, others you will stone in your synagogues, and others you will stone in every town.
lunyoro: Baitu dora nikyo mbatwekera banabi, nabamagezi, nabahandiki: nabandi hali abo mulibaita, mulibabamba ha miti: nabandi mulibatera enkoba mumaso'rokaniro ganyu, nabandi murribahiiga omu mbuga zoona;

english: [RELIGIOUS] And everything you ask for in prayer and in faith will be given to you.
lunyoro: Na byona byona ebimurase'raga numusaba numuikiriza, mulibihebwa.

english: [GENERAL] In this way husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. Those who love their wives as their own bodies love them.
lunyoro: nukwo kihikirire kiti, abasaija okugonzaga abakazi babu nkemibiri yabu bonka. Anyakugonza mukaziwe buli ayegondeze wenka:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Yes, and all the prophets who had come back from Samuel and all those who have told them about it have told me today.
lunyoro: Ego, nabanabi bona okuruga ha Samuiri, nabo abagarukire, bona abagambire, batebezaga ha biro binu.

english: [GENERAL] If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sinned, but now they have no excuse for their sin.
lunyoro: Kakuba ntaraizire nibanza nabo, tibakubaire nekibi: baitu hati bununa tibaroho kyokutongana habwekibi kyabu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, we do not know anyone in the body from now on. Even though we know Christ in the body, we do not know him at this very moment.
lunyoro: Nukwo okuruga hati bunu titukyamanya omuntu wena omu mubiri: kandi nobuturaba twamanyire Kristo omu mubiri, hati titukyamumanya tuti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For he who is eager to see me is aware of the mind of the Spirit, because he is speaking to the holy ones according to God's will.
lunyoro: baitu arukurora muno emitima amanyire amagezi Gomwoyo okugali, baitu natonganira abarukwera nka Ruhanga okwagonza.

english: [GENERAL] Be angry, and do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your sins.
lunyoro: Mubihirwe, kunu mutalikora kubi: izoba litagwa ha kubihirwa kwanyu:

english: [GENERAL] For I tell you that even some of the apostles who were still alive should remain like me.
lunyoro: Baitu ningambira batakaswire nabarakati nti kibasemerire okuikara nka nyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Be on your guard, then, and be on your guard that the Lord's coming is near.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe mugumege; mugumye emitima yanyu: baitu okuija kwa Mukama kuli haihi.

english: [GENERAL] The other one fell on good ground, and the one owed him a hundred times as much. When he had said this, he cried out in a loud voice, “Whoever has ears to hear has ears to hear!”
lunyoro: Nendi yagwa ha itaka erisemire, yamera neyana ebyana emirundi kikumi. Obuyagambire ebigambo ebi yagambira haiguru ati Anyakuina amatu agokuhu'ra ahu'le.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All those who want to please the above are the ones who have been forced to marry; they do not fight because of the cross of Christ.
lunyoro: Bona abarukugonza okusemeza ebyaharuguru nibo babahambiriza okusarwa;;kyonka batahiganizibwa habwomuti gwa Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All the scriptures that are kept under the power of God's Spirit are of great value in the teaching, in the preaching, and in the speaking of the truth.
lunyoro: Ebihandikirwe byona ebiterekerezebwa Omwoyo gwa Ruhanga nibigasa obwokwegesa, nobwokuhana, nobwegesa,

english: [GENERAL] There is a division among you and among you, so that those who want to be from here to you cannot be able to go through, and that has not happened to us.”
lunyoro: kandi hagati yaitu nainywe haroho ekinongoro ekikoto kitairweho, abo abanyakwenda okuruga hanu okuhika namberemuli batasobora, kandi batahinguraho nomu okuruga oku oku okuhika halitwe.

english: [GENERAL] But you do not believe, because you are not my sheep.
lunyoro: Baitu timurukuikiriza, obwokuutaba bomu ntama zange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] As Jesus got into the boat, a man who had an evil spirit came out of the tombs and touched him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyarurugire omu bwato, ahonaho omuntu aroho omuzimu omubi ayarugire omu bituro yamuitirana;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “The enemy has done this. The servants asked him, “Do you want us to go and gather some weeds there?”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Omunyanzigwa nuwe yakozire kinu. Abairu rubale bamugambira ngu Noyenda tugende tuzomberemu?

english: [GENERAL] Be ready, then, for the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not think about him.”
lunyoro: Nukwo naiinywe mwetekanizege: baitu omu kasumi akamutatekereza, niko Omwana womuntu aliiziramu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They came to John and said to him, “Teacher, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan River spoke about this and was baptized, and all the people came to him.”
lunyoro: Baija hali Yohana bamugambira ngu Rabi, ogu akabali hamu naiwe nseri ya Yorudani, ouwagambireho, dora ogu nabatiza, abantu bona nibaija namberali.

english: [GENERAL] I will tell you all their sins and all their blasphemy.

lunyoro: nagamba ati Omu rubuga hakaba harumu omucwi wemisango ataratinaga Ruhanga, nobukwakuba okuhu'ra abantu;

english: [GENERAL] and said to them, “Whoever believes in me among these little ones also has come to believe in me, but whoever believes in me has not believed in me, because he sent me.”
lunyoro: nabagambira ati Omuntu wena aliikiriza omu hali abana abato abarukusisana nkonu, omu ibara ryange, buli aikirize nyowe; nomuntu wena arukuikiriza nyowe taikiriza nyowe, baitu ogu ayantumire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They wanted to learn the message and sold themselves into their homes, but it was shameful for a woman to speak in the church.
lunyoro: Kandi baraba nibagonza okumanya ekigambo, babiguramu omu maka gabu bonka: baitu kyensoni omukazi okugamba omu kanisa.

english: [GENERAL] “I will not lie to him,” he said, “but will not give up on him, nor will he give him anything he has to go out of the way?”
lunyoro: Akagamba ati tindimubihiza, baitu talisobora okumuhayo, nobukwakuba okumuha ekintu ekyomuhendo?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said, “Father, you know what they are doing, but they do not know what they are doing.” So they cut off his clothes and threw him out.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagamba ati Isenyowe obaganyire; baitu tibamanyire ekibarukukora. Kandi bakabagana ebyokujwarabye, nibatoma.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They cried out in a loud voice, “How long, then, will you be the Holy One, the one who is truthful and true, to judge the people on earth by our blood?
lunyoro: Basima niraka erihango nibagamba ngu Olihikya nkaha Mukuru waitu, arukwera, owamazima okutacwa omusango nokuhora enzigu obwesagama yaitu hali abo abarukuikara hansi?

english: [GENERAL] and said to the mountains and to the rocks, ‘Fall on us, then, and let us set the eyes of the one who sits on the throne of the Kingdom and of the Lamb.’
lunyoro: nibagambira ensozi namabale ngu Tugwere,tusereke hali amaiso gogu anyakuikalire ha kitebe ekyobukama na hali ekiniga Ekyomwana Gwentama;

english: [RELIGIOUS] But when Jesus came to the entrance of the gate, another girl saw him and said to the people there, “He was with Jesus the Nazarene!”
lunyoro: Baitu obuyaturukire okuhika omu kiti kyomuryango, Omuisiki ondi yamubona, nagambira abantu abakaba baroho ati Nonu akabali hamu na Yesu Munazarayo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He has poured out his own blood on us by means of his own blood, in order that our sins may be forgiven according to the riches of his grace.
lunyoro: we ayatuhaisize okucungurwa kwaitu obwesagamaye, nukwo kuihibwaho ebyokusisa byaitu, nkobuguda obwembabazize okubuli,

english: [GENERAL] I can do everything for the one who gives me power.
lunyoro: Ninsobora okukora byona habwogu arukumpa amani.

english: [GENERAL] The baptism of John was from heaven or from human beings? Turn away from your sins.
lunyoro: Okubatiza kwa Yohana kukaruga omu iguru, nandiki omu Bantu? Mungarukemu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] This is how God indicated that God gave us eternal life, and this life is in union with his Son.
lunyoro: Kandi kunu nukwo kumanyisa ngu Ruhanga akatuha obwomezi obutahwaho. Nobwomezi obuli obubuli omu Mwanawe.

english: [GENERAL] They will not lift up sword, nor will their place in heaven be taken away.
lunyoro: Kandi tibasingura, kandi nekiikaro kyabu tikikyarorwa omu iguru.

english: [GENERAL] There is, then, a good deed that has been kept secret, and the things that are harmful cannot be hid from him.
lunyoro: Nukwo haroho engeso enungi ezirwa bwerebwere, kandi ebi ebirukusisa kundi tibisobora okuserekwa.

english: [GENERAL] For I tell you these things, so that your hearts may be filled with pity.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe obwokubagambira ebigambo ebi, emitima yanyu ijuire okuganya.

english: [GENERAL] He showed by his power that the only King of kings and Lord of lords is the only one who is respected.
lunyoro: okumanyisa obwomezi oburukunyumizibwa, Omukama owobusobozi omu wenka arukusimwa, omukama wabakam, omulemi wa Banyoro;

english: [GENERAL] Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek to be reconciled to one another. Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek a wife.
lunyoro: Ukaba ohandikirwe nomukazi? Otase'ra okubaganizibwamu. Okaba onyina omukazi? Otalimuse'ra mukazi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And Satan himself will be destroyed when his kingdom is divided against itself. You say that I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul.
lunyoro: Kandi Setani nauwe obwabaganizibwamu wenka, obukamabwe buliikaraho buta Baitu inywe numugamba ngu Nyowe mbinga emizimu habwa Beerezebuli.

english: [GENERAL] So he went to the second, and said the same thing to them. Again Jesus said, “Go away, Father,” but he did not go.
lunyoro: Yaija hali owakabiri yagamba kimu na kiri. Nauwe yagarukamu nagamba ati kangende tata: baitu atagende.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For you have been given the task of Christ, not only because you believed in him, but also because you were persecuted for his sake.
lunyoro: baitu inywe mukahabwa habwa Kristo, tikuli kumuikiriza kwonka, baitu nokusalirwa habwe:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘The good workers.’
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Abakama ababamahanga babalema; nabo ababatunga betwa Abakora okurungi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The people were so angry that they gave up the name of God, who has authority over these plagues. But they did not turn from their sins and give him glory.
lunyoro: Ibantu bayokebwa okwokya kwingi: bajuma ibara rya Ruhanga anyakuina obusobozi ha mihito enu; baitu nategarukemu, okumuha ekitinisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The disciples said to him, “Teacher, how did the Jews try to stone you, and you turn around?”
lunyoro: Abegeswa bamugambira ngu Rabi, Abayudaya bakaba nibase'ra okukutera amabale; kandi nogarukayo?

english: [GENERAL] Or does a potter have authority over the clay to make one part of another into another, to make another part a dishonor or a dishonor? What, then, is it?
lunyoro: Rundi omubumbi tanyina obusobozi hali ibumba, omu kitonge ekimu okukora ekibindi ekimu ekyekitinisa, rundi nekindi ekyensoni? Kiki?

english: [GENERAL] Those who look for their own life will lose it, and those who despise their own life for my sake will find it.
lunyoro: Anyakuzora obwomezibwe bulimuburaho; nauwe alibuza obwemezibwe habwange alibuzora.

english: [GENERAL] When he came into the house, he did not allow anyone to go in with him, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and the mother of the child.
lunyoro: Yataha omu nju, ataikirize muntu wena okutahamu nauwe, rundi Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo na ise omuisiki na nyina.

english: [GENERAL] They sat down all the way to the house, and as they walked, they saw that Jesus was passing by.
lunyoro: Kandi bakai'ra haihi nekika, hakaba nibagenda: obubaikaireho babona Yesu nahinguraho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And we pray that you will not do the same thing, because we are not the ones who were made perfect by God, but because you are doing what is good and without our sins.
lunyoro: Kandi ntusaba Ruhanga inywe mutakora kibi nekimu; tibuli itwe obwokurtorwa nkabarukusimwa, baitu inywe obwebi obwokukora, baitu ekirungi, nobutusisaine nkabatarukusisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And he made out of all the nations of the earth to dwell on all the mountains, and he gave them the command to gather together for the time and to gather the grapes of their tents.
lunyoro: kandi akakora okuruga hali omu amahanga gona agabantu okuikara hansi embaju zona, obuyaragire okubateraho ebiro, nemitano eyebiikaro byabu;

english: [GENERAL] In Jerusalem there was a pool called Besseda, which is in Hebrew.
lunyoro: Kandi omu yerusalemu hali irembo ryona haroho ekijongo, ekibeta omu Ruheburaniya ngu Beseseda, ekiroho obuju butano.

english: [GENERAL] And so you will be able to answer me, ‘I tell my children.’
lunyoro: Kandi nainywe obwokungaru'ra muti (ningambira abana bange) mugalihe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I saw that woman, whose blood had not been poured out, was purified by the blood of the holy ones and by the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. When I saw her, I was completely amazed.
lunyoro: Kandi nkarora omukazi ogu atamire esagama yabarukwera, nesagama yabakaiso ba Yesu. Obunamuboine natangara nokutangara okwingi.

english: [GENERAL] Wisdom is judged by all these children.
lunyoro: Kandi amagezi gaihwaho omusango obwabana bago bona.

english: [GENERAL] The Kingdom of heaven is like this. It was like a man who was a king who wanted to count him and his servants by his money.
lunyoro: Obukama obwomu iguru nukwo burukusisana nkomuntu akabali omukama ayagondeze okubara omuhendo nabairube rubale.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Look! Your house has been abandoned to you, and I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Praise to the King who comes in the name of the Lord!’
lunyoro: Dora, enju yanyu abasigirwe kifuka, kandi nimbagambira nti Timulindora, okuhikya obumuligamba ngu Ahairwe omugida arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama.

english: [GENERAL] If the Son of Man is to be handed over to this world, your peace will remain with him. But if not, it will turn away from you.
lunyoro: Kandi omwana wobusinge obwalibali oku, obusinge bwanyu buliikara nauwe: baitu obukiriba kitalikyo, bulibagarukira inywe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the promise of God to be made must come true by means of the one who made it.
lunyoro: Baitu nambere hali ekiragano ekyobugwetwa, hahikirire okubaho okufa kwogu ayakiraganize.

english: [GENERAL] For first of all, he must feed himself on his own food, and then someone else will be hungry and thirsty.
lunyoro: baitu wena abanza omutahiwe okukwata ha byokuryabye wenka omu kurya kwanyu: kandi ondi arumwa enjara nondi atamira.

english: [GENERAL] I write these things to you, so that I may come to you soon.
lunyoro: Nkuhandikire binu ninihira okuija mpora namberoli:

english: [EDUCATION] When a man comes to you and brings you this teaching, do not go into your homes or greet him.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaraijaga namberemuli, atrukuleta okwegesa kunu, Mutalimuiriza omu nju yanyu, kunu mutalimuramukta:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who believe in him will never be saved, but will not see the Son, because God's grace has been poured out on him.
lunyoro: Anyakuikiriza obutahwaho; baitu ataikirize Mwana talibona bwomezi, baitu ekiniga kya Ruhanga kiikaire haruwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered them, “I have told you, but you have not heard. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples?
lunyoro: Yabagarukamu ati Mazire okubagambira baitu timuhulire: kiki ekibagondeseze okuhu'ra obwakabiri? Kandi nainywe nimwenda okufoka abegeswabe?

english: [GENERAL] They will bring you down to the ground with your children within you, and they will not leave a stone in you to stone you, because you did not know the time when you would be made well.
lunyoro: Zakutera hansi nabana bawe bawe omunda yawe; tibalisiga ibale erinyakuliha ibale; baitu otamanye ebiro ebyokubungirwa kwawe.

english: [GENERAL] They sold their possessions and goods and gave them to everyone according to the needs of the group.
lunyoro: bagura ebyobuguda byabu nebintu byabu nibabigabira bona nkokubasegere omuomu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For just as Christ suffered for us, so our consolation in union with Christ has been shaken.
lunyoro: Baitu nkokubonabona kwa Kristo okukwasagire muno halitwe, nukwo nokuhumuzibwa kwaitu omu Kristo kwasagire kuti.

english: [GENERAL] He came to the gate of the city, and behold, the dead body of the city was outside, and the only son who was born to the woman was outside. Many people in that city were with him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyairire haihi nirembo ryorubuga, dora, omusuija akabali aheru, omwana ayazairwe omu wenka nyina, nogu akabali mufakati: kandi abantu baingi abomu rubuga bakaba bali nauwe.
