english: [RELIGIOUS] Ananias went into the house and placed his hands on him and said, “Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road where you came from, has sent him back and has sent him back to you, and he has come back with the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Ananiya yagenda yataha omu nju; kandi obuyamutaireho emikono yagamba ati Mwene waitu Sauro, Mukama waitu, nuwe Yesu, ayakubonekire omu muhanda ogwoturukiremu, antumire oiguke, oijule Omwoyo Ogurukwara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When he arrived, he came to him and said, “Teacher,” and kissed him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyahikire, ahonaho yaija nambereli nagamba ati Rabi,yamunywegera muno.

english: [GENERAL] For I know that what I am doing in my body is not good, but what I want is what I do, but what I do in what I do in what I do in what is good.
lunyoro: Baitu manyire nti omuli nyowe, omu mubiri gwange, tiharumu ekirungi: baitu okugonza kuroho namberendi, baitu okukora ekirungi tikuroho.

english: [GENERAL] For he must rule until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
lunyoro: Baitu kirimuhiki'ra okulema okuhikya obwalimara okuta abanyanzigwabe bona hansi yebigerebye.

english: [GENERAL] For the ruler of this world has already been put right with God.
lunyoro: baitu omulemi wensi enu amazire okucwerwa omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they arrived in Iconium, they went together into the synagogue and believed in Greek.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika omu Ikonio, bakataha hamu omu iso'rokaniro Ryabayudaya Nabayonani baikiriza.

english: [GENERAL] When the time came for the feast, he sent his servant to tell the invited guests, ‘Come,’ because all these things are ready.
lunyoro: Kandi akasumi akobugenyi obukahikire yatuma omuiruwe rubale okugambira abayeserwe ngu Muije; baitu bunu byona bitekanize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, when you receive the gifts of the Spirit, you too must work hard to build up the church.
lunyoro: Nukwo nainywe, obumwegombere ebisembo ebyomwoyo, muse'lege okusagya obwokwombeka ekanisa.

english: [GENERAL] And what you have heard from me in many ways is that you have reached out to faithful people, who will be able to teach others.
lunyoro: Kandi ebi ebiwahulire namberendi omu bakaiso baingi, nibyo oyahuze abantu abokwesiga, abalisobora okwegesa abandi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] We have brought glory to God by means of Christ, who through Christ has given us the hope of salvation.
lunyoro: nitugumiza Ruhanga omuruwe, ayatuhaisize okunihira kwona omu Kristo:

english: [GENERAL] You who say, ‘Do not commit adultery, and do not commit adultery? Do you steal from the marketplaces?’
lunyoro: Iwe anyakugamba ngu Otalisihana, osihana, oiba ebyomu mabandiro?

english: [GENERAL] The sun will say, ‘Out of the way evil things happen, because the sky is red and dark.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.

lunyoro: Kandi haroho emiringo nyingi eyokuhereza, baitu Mukama ali omu.

english: [GENERAL] Pilate again asked them, “What shall I do with this man, whom you call the King of the Jews?”
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato Yagaruka okubagambira ati Mara kiki ekindakora ogu oumurukweta omukama wa Bayudaya?

english: [GENERAL] His mother, Simon, was sick and suffering from a dreaded skin disease. At once they told him,
lunyoro: Kandi nyinazara Simoni akaba abyamire, arwaire omusuija; ahonaho bamutebeza okwali:

english: [GENERAL] This also became evident in all the world.
lunyoro: Nebigambo binu bikaranganwa omu nsi ezi zona.

english: [GENERAL] The work you do is not easy, nor is it by someone you say so much.
lunyoro: Omulimo ogumutalikiriza na kake, nobwaraba omuntu abagambire muno.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Suddenly there was a violent earthquake, but an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and rolled the stone away and sat down.
lunyoro: ehonaho hakaba haroho omusisa omukoto: baitu maraika wa Mukama akaruga omu iguru yaija yakumbya ibale okuliihaho, yaliika'raho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But many of them were possessed by demons, and he expelled them and began to proclaim the Good News to the people. Many of the people were healed by the power of the Roman authorities.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi halibo, abakaba baroho emizimu emibi, ekabarugaho, neyamuza ekigambo ekirungi: kandi baingi abakaba bazingamire nabalema bakira.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You know this first, that no prophecy of the scripture ever comes true by itself.
lunyoro: mumanyire kinu okubanza ngu busaho kigambo ekyabanabi ekyahandikirwe ekirukumanyisibwa omuntu wenka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You too are with them, and you are called to belong to Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: kandi nainywe muli hamu nabo, mweserwe okuba ba Yesu Kristo:

english: [GENERAL] Do you not agree among yourselves, so that you will be judges of the evil thoughts?
lunyoro: timwebaganizemu omulinywe inywenka, numufoka abacwi bemisango abebitekerezo ebihihire?

english: [GENERAL] The Jewish authorities said to one another, “Where is he who wants to go, and where do we not find him? He wants to go to those who do not belong to the Greek Empire and teach the Greeks?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagambirangana ngu Ogu nayenda kugenda nkaha, itwe nambere tutalimubona? Nayenda kugenda hali abo abatabanire omu bayonani, ayegese Abayonani?

english: [RELIGIOUS] He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
lunyoro: Anyakuina okutu, ahu're Omwoyo ekyagambira ekanisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I will give you whatever you ask me to, even if it is part of my Kingdom.
lunyoro: yamuraganiza ati Kyona kyona ekyoransaba, ndakikuha, nobukiraba ekicweka kyobukama bwange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] What I say is not what I say in the Lord, but what I say in order to boast about myself.
lunyoro: Ekindukugamba tingambire omu Mukama waitu, baitu rundi omu butami, omu kuguma kunu okwokwenyumiza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where that man came from.
lunyoro: Itwe tumanyire Ruhanga akabaza na Musa: baitu omuntu ogu titumanyire nambere yarugire.

english: [GENERAL] They will look at my work for forty years.
lunyoro: Nibarora emirimo yange emyaka amakumi ana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For what will we give thanks to God for you? All the joy we have in you before our God!
lunyoro: Baitu tuligaru'ra Ruhanga okusima ki habwanyu? Obwokusemererwa kwona okutunyina habwanyu omu maiso ga Ruhanga waitu;

english: [GENERAL] At that time the decree came from Emperor Augustus, to be written in all the world.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika omu biro ebi, ekiragiro kikaruga hali Kaisali Augusito, abensi zona okuhandikwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The man went to Pilate and prayed for Jesus' body.
lunyoro: omuntu ogu akagenda hali Pirato, yasaba omutumbi gwa Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] For we are happy when we are weak and you are strong. And that is why we ask you one question.
lunyoro: Baitu tusemererwa itwe obutufoka abobugara, inywe mubebamani: kandi nikyo turukusaba inywe muku'le kimu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “How can the children of the bridegroom be without a wedding feast, and where will the bridegroom be with them? But when the bridegroom is taken away from them, at that time they will fast.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Abana abobugenyi obwobugole basobora bata okusiba, omuswezi obwabalinabo? Baitu ebiro biriija omugole obwalibaihwaho, omu biro ebi numwo balisibira.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus answered, “Whoever welcomes me receives him and says to me, ‘Take your mat and walk!’
lunyoro: Baitu yabagarukamu ati Ogu ankirize, nuwe angambire ati Wetweka ekirago kyawe ogende.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “The children are free, then.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yamugambira ati Nukwo abana nibo bobugabe.

english: [GENERAL] The servants asked him, “What shall we do with this?”
lunyoro: Abahereza bamukaguza ngu Kandi turagira tuta?

english: [GENERAL] All of you, then, look for the best you can. And I will show you the best way in which you can go.
lunyoro: bantu bona nibaduma? Baitu muse'le ebisembo ebirukukira oburungi. Kandi nanyowe nomboleka omuhanda ogurukukira muno obukira obwingi.

english: [GENERAL] He took the cup and gave thanks to God, and said, “Take this and share it among yourselves.”
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, obuyamazire okusima yagamba ati Mukwate enu mugibagane inywenka.

english: [GENERAL] He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
lunyoro: Kandi akaita nempirima Yakobo, mugenzi wa Yohana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Many false prophets will come and deceive many people.
lunyoro: Nabanabi baingi abebisuba abalija, balihabisa baingi.

english: [GENERAL] They did not see it, and so many blind and lame people came to him. But two men later came to him.

lunyoro: Baitu akegesa abegeswabem, yabagambira ati Omwana womuntu yahebwayo omu mikono yabantu, balimuita; kandi obwalimara okuitwa, nebiro bisatu buhinguireho, alihumbuka.

lunyoro: nukwo nyowe okuhumuzibwa hamu nainywe itwembi habwokuikiriza okwanyu nokwange.

lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Mukama waitu amaiso gaitu gaiguke.

lunyoro: Baitu obwato bukaba gubaturukire omu maiso.

lunyoro: Baitu bakaturuka habwa Ibara, batarukuhabwa ekintu kyona Abamahanga.

lunyoro: Nukwo hati bunu numulengera ki Ruhanga, okuta orusengo omu bikya byageswa, baisenkuru itwe ekibatarasoboire okutwara, nobubakuba itwe?

lunyoro: orukugonza okunyita nyowe nkokuwaisire ijo Omumisiri?

lunyoro: Kandi obuyatahire omu nju, arugire omu kitebe, abegeswabe bamukaguza orufumo oru.

lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okutemba nokucwa omugati, nokurya, nokubaza nabo ekigambo ekyokurya, okukisa obuire, yarugayo.

lunyoro: baitu inywe mutaryetwa Rabi; baitu omwegesa wanyu ali omu,

lunyoro: ha muhanda, narora omusana ogwarugire ha iguru, okukira okwangasana kwa izoba, gugwire okunyehinguliriza nabo abakaba nibagenda nanyowe.

lunyoro: mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuntu obwakwata ekigambo kyange talibona kufa ebiro nebiro.

lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi ngondeze okugamba iwe, kandi hali ebi ningonza iwe okugumiza kimu, nukwo abo abaikirize Ruhanga baijukege okutaho emitima ha ngeso enungi.

english: [GENERAL] I know that his commandments are eternal life, just as the Father has told me.
lunyoro: Kandi manyire ebiragirobye nubwo bwomezi obutahwaho: ebigambo ebingamba nka Isenyowe okuyangambire, nukwo ngamba nti.

lunyoro: Orubuga orukuru rwabaganizibwamu omu bickweka bisatu, nembuga zamahanga zagwa: na Baburoni orukuru rwaijukirwa omu maiso ga Ruhanga, okuruha akatema akamarwa agekinigakye ekingi.

lunyoro: izoba oburyaturukire yahotoka, baitu ekaba etanyina mihama, yayoma.

lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati muyina emigati ingaha?

lunyoro: Iguru nensi birihwaho: baitu ebigambo byange tibirihwaho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You do not have his message in you, but you do not believe him who sent him.
lunyoro: Kandi timunyina ebigambobye ebiikara omulinywe; baitu ogu ouyatumire timurukumuikiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who believed his message were baptized, and that very day about three thousand people were added to them.

lunyoro: mwomezi, baitu tumanyirwe: nkabanyakufa, baitu dora, twomire; nkababonabonesebwa, baitu tituisirwe;

lunyoro: Abana bange abato abandukusali'rwa kandi, okuhikya Kristo obwalifokera omulinywe,

lunyoro: Kandi kyahika yaikarayo ebiro bingi omu Yopa, omu nju ya Simoni omuhazi wempu.

lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Genda, oyete baro, ogaruke oije hanu.

lunyoro: baitu banyakatagara abakuru bakacwa amagezii baite na Razaro;

lunyoro: Baitu ise yagambira abairube rubale ati Mulete bwango ekyokujwara ekirukukira oburungi, mukimujweke; nakoma mukamujweke omu rukumu, nenkaito omu bigere:

lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo akaikiriza okugambi'ra kwaitu; kandi obwakaba amalize okwombeka amaiso, akaimukya okugenda namberali.

lunyoro: naitwe tuli bakaiso abebigambo ebi: kandi Nomwoyo Ogurukwera Ruhanga ouyabahaire abanyakumworobera.

english: [GENERAL] Pilate said to him, “Don't you hear what these two men are saying to you?”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati Torukuhu'ra bigambo binu ebibakuhambirize okubiri?

english: [GENERAL] “He is your son,” they asked. “He was born blind!” they asked. “Do you now see?” they asked.
lunyoro: barukukukaguza nibagamba ngu Onu nuwe mwana wanyu oumwazairwe omufu wamaiso? Hati bunu nahweza ata?

english: [RELIGIOUS] If your eye causes you to lose sight of you, you will be able to see it. It is better for you to enter the Kingdom of God than for you to have one eye thrown into hell,
lunyoro: Kandi eriso ryawe obulikwesitaza, oliihemuga; hakire iwe okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga oyina eriso limu, okukira okunagwa omu Gehene, oyina amaiso gombi;

english: [GENERAL] From there we sailed around and arrived at Rhegium. The next day a south wind blew around, and on the next day we came to Puteoli.
lunyoro: Kandi okurugayo twayehinguliriza, twahika Legio: kandi ekiro kimu obukytahinguireho, embeho eyobukizi obwoburyo yatera, kandi na kiro ekyakabiri TWAHIKA Puteoli:

english: [GENERAL] The thief will not come, but steal, kill, and steal. I came that they may have life, and may have it in abundance.
lunyoro: Omusuma taija, rundi okuiba, nokuita, nokuhwerekereza: Nyowe nkaija zibe nobwomezi, kandi zibe nabwo obwingi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do not waste your time doing the work of God's servants because of food. All is well, because it is bad for the person to eat and to drink.
lunyoro: Otasisa omulimo gwa Ruhanga habwebyokurya. Byona bisemire; baitu kiba kibi hali ogu anyakurya nagarukyagurukya.

english: [GENERAL] There was also a document in his mouth that said, “He is the King of the Jews.”
lunyoro: kandi hakaba haroho nekihandiko ha ruguruwe ngu NUWONU MUKAMA WABAYUDAYA.

english: [GENERAL] I tell you that there are some here who will not die until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Haroho hali banu abemerire hanu abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhikya obubalirora Omwana womuntu naija omu bukamabwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus went into the house, he said to him first, “Simon, what do you think? The kings of the earth receive taxes or taxes from their children or from the Gentiles?”
lunyoro: yatahire omu nju, Yesu yamubanza okugamba ati Notekereza ota, Simoni? Abakama abensi nibahebwa ehozo rundi omusoro omu Bantu ki? omu bana babu, rundi omu banyaihanga?

english: [GENERAL] For I have sent you, my friends, so that our boasting about you has not been lost in this matter. Be ready, just as I have told you.
lunyoro: Baitu nkatuma bene baitu, okwenyumiza kwaitu habwanyu kutaba kwabusa omu kigambo kinu: nkokunagambire, inywe mwetekanizege:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For if Abraham were to be put to the test by works, he would have to boast about the things he did, because he did not have God's approval.
lunyoro: Kakuba Iburahimu yaihibweho omusango obwemirimo, yakubaireho ebyokukwenyumiza; baitu tanyinakyo hali Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] I tell you that all these things will happen to you because of this peace.
lunyoro: mazire okugamba nti Ebigambo binu byona biribahikaho habwobusinge bunu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, those who are not God's people reject anyone, but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Nukwo arukwanga, tayanga omuntu, baitu Ruhanga, arukubaha inywe Omwoyogwe Ogurukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And he commanded us to tell the people and to testify that he is the one whom God has appointed judge between the living and the dead.
lunyoro: Kandi akaturagira okutebeza abantu, nokub bakaiso ngu nuwogu Ruhanga ouyataireho okucwera omusango abomezi nabafu.

english: [GENERAL] The earth helped the woman, the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the wine that had been poured out of her mouth.
lunyoro: ensi yakonyera omukazi, ensi yayasama akanwa kayo, yanywa ekyambu ekijoka ekikyatanakire omu kanwa kakyo.

english: [GENERAL] The Son of Man will come in the same way as the Scriptures say he will, but how terrible for that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would have been better for that man if he had not been born!”
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu nagenda, nkokukyamuhandikirweho: baitu zirimubona omuntu ogu aragobeza Omwanawomuntu! kyakubaire kirungi hali ogu kuba atarazairwe.

english: [GENERAL] After spending some eight or ten days in Caesarea, Paul left, and the next day he sat down in the judgment hall and ordered Paul to be brought.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazireyo owabu ebiro ebitakizire munana rundi ikumi, yasirimuka Kaisaliya; kandi obuire obubwakire nyenkya yaika'ra ha kitebe ekicwerwaho emisango, yaragira okuleta pauro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I have been with the crowd for three days now, but they have not enough to eat.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Ninganyira ebitebe, baitu hati bunu ebiro bisatu baikaire nanyowe, kandi tibanyina byokurya:

english: [GENERAL] I tell you, that Day two will be in one book, one will be taken away and the other will be lost.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Ha kiro eki baliba babiri ha kitabu kimu; omu alitwarwa, ondi alisigwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Jewish authorities said to him, “Now we know that he has a demon, and Abraham died and the prophets. And you say that whoever obeys my teaching will never die.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bamugambira ngu Hati bunu twetegerize ngu aroho omuzimu, Iburahimu akafa nabanabi; naiwe nogamba oti omuntu obwakwata ekigambo kyange taliroza ha kufa ebiro nebiro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You are the ones who belong to Christ, the descendants of Abraham. You are the ones who are called by the promise to buy.
lunyoro: Kandi muraba muli ba Kristo, muli muijukuru wa Iburahimu, nabagwetwa nkomurago okuguli.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Now you are God's people, but you have not been forgiven, but now you have been forgiven.
lunyoro: Baitu ira mukaba mutaganyirwe, baitu hati bunu muli bantu ba Ruhanga:

english: [GENERAL] Even if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot last.
lunyoro: Obukiraba enju ebaganizibwemu yonka, enju egi tesobora kuikaraho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Watch out, and do not let anyone know this.”
lunyoro: Yabatere'ra muno ati Mwerinde, omuntu wena aleke kukimanya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He was sitting in Jesus' feet, just as he had been. “Who is my Lord?” he asked him.
lunyoro: Eriya, akaba abyamire omu kifuba kya Yesu nkokwakabali, yamugambira ati Mukama wange noha?

english: [GENERAL] Those who swear by the altar, swear by it, and do not swear by it, but by the gift that is in them.
lunyoro: kandi anyakurahira ekyoto, tikirikigambo; baitu anyakurahiza ekisembo ekiroho, buli agwerirwe omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Pay back to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor and to God.” They were very surprised at him.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muheyoga hali Kaisali ebya Kaisali, na Ruhanga ebya Ruhanga. Bamuhuni'ra muno.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He had a sister named Mary, who sat at the feet of the Lord and heard his message.
lunyoro: Kandi akabanyina owanyina ibararye Maryamu, ayaikalire ha bigere bya Mukama waitu, nahu'ra ekigambokye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But let the words of the youth come back to you, and you must seek righteousness, faith, love, and peace, with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
lunyoro: Baitu okwegamba okwomu busigazi okuirukege; baitu ohonderege okuhiki'ra, nokuikiriza, nokugonza, nobusinge, hamu nabo abakunga Mukama waitu omu mutima ogusemezibwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] A large crowd of people was eating on the hillside, and he begged Jesus to send them into the pigs. So he sent them away.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho igana ryempunu enyingi nizirya ha rusozi: kandi ekamwesengereza agyohereze okuzitahamu. Yagyohereza

english: [RELIGIOUS] I did not write to you any longer, because of the grace that God has given me.
lunyoro: Kandi nyeyongire kake okubahandikira nobumanzi, obwembabazi ezinahairwe Ruhanga,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Sarah's faith died, and she did not change her faith in God's promise.
lunyoro: okuikiriza kwa Sara kukaba kuli kufire, kandi omu murago gwa Ruhanga atagurukyagurukye,

english: [GENERAL] If anyone thinks he knows anything, he does not know it at all, just as he ought to know it.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaba nayetekereza amanyire ekigambo, tamanyire na kake, nkokukimusemerire okumanya;

english: [RELIGIOUS] With him we sent a brother who is highly respected in all the churches.
lunyoro: Kandi tukatuma hamu nauwe mwene waitu anyakusimwa omu kanisa zona;

english: [GENERAL] You have condemned and killed the righteous one, and he will not fight against you.
lunyoro: Mukacwa omusango, mwaita ogu ahikirire; tarukurwana nainywe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For through Christ Jesus you have become God's servants, who have been the ones who have become God's servants, the people who are righteous, the people who are made perfect, the people who are made alive, and the people who are being saved.
lunyoro: Baitu muli habwogu omu Kristo Yesu, ayafokere halitwe amagezi okuruga hali Ruhanga, nokuhiki'ra, nokusemezebwa, nokucungurwa:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For by his grace we all have been made perfect, and by his grace we have been brought into being.
lunyoro: Baitu okuijurakwe itwena nukwo twahairweho, nembabazi omu kiikaro kyembabazi.

english: [GENERAL] I speak with all my heart about you and about my great boasting about you. I am filled with comfort and am filled with joy because I have been filled with all our troubles.
lunyoro: Ningamba nobumanzi bwingi halinywe, nokwenyumiza kwange kwingi habwanyu: nyijuire okuhumuzibwa, nyijuirwe okusemererwa nsagire, omu mihito yaitu yona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Judas, do you persecute the Son of Man with insults?”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Yuda, nogobeza Omwana womuntu nokunywegera?

english: [GENERAL] For whoever has will be given away, and whoever has will be taken away away from him. But whoever has not seen, will be given away even what he has.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakuina alihebwa, kandi alisagisaho, baitu wena atanyina aliihwaho nekyanyinakyo.

english: [GENERAL] One of the elders said to me, “Don't cry! Look! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the descendant of David, has opened the scroll and its seven seals.
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abakuru yangambira ati Ota'ra, dora, entale eyomu ruganda rwa Yuda, ekikoro kya Daudi, akasuku'ra ekitabu nemanyikirizo zakyo omusanju.

english: [GENERAL] But if your eye causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away from you. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes thrown into the fire of hell.
lunyoro: Baitu eriso ryawe obuliriba nirikutabaijura, oliihemu, olinage hara: kikusemerire okutaha omu bwomezi onyina eriso limu, okukira okunagwa omu Gehena eyomu'ro namaiso abiri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Pilate spoke again to them, trying to stop Jesus.
lunyoro: Pirato yagaruka okubagambira, nayenda okulekera Yesu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] They stoned Stephen to death and prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
lunyoro: batera amabale Sitefano, uwe nasaba nagamba ati Mukama wange Yesu, twara omwoyo gwange.

english: [GENERAL] They were all filled with rage, and they ate a meal with them.
lunyoro: Kandi bona baguma emitima, nabo bakwata ha byokurya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.
lunyoro: Kandi Musa na Eriya bakababonekera nibabaza nauwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But even though the angels were stronger and more powerful, they did not appear to you before the Lord.
lunyoro: Baitu bamaraika nobubaraba nibakira amani nobusobozi tibarukubabiriki'ra omu maiso ga Mukama.

english: [GENERAL] Even though the loaves were all four thousand, how many baskets did you take up?
lunyoro: Kandi emigati hali abo enkumi ina, nebigega okubikaba biri ebimwasolize.?

english: [RELIGIOUS] For by the sufferings of Christ you will be glad, and you will be glad with great joy in the revelation of his glory.
lunyoro: baitu obwokuterana omu kubonabonesebwa kwa Kristo, nukwo musemererwe; kandi ha kusuku'rwa kwekitinisakye inywe musemere'rwe nokukyanganuka kwingi muno.

english: [GENERAL] How terrible for you, who are now hungry! How terrible for you who weep now! You will cry and cry!
lunyoro: Ziribabona inywe abaigusire hati bunu, baitu mulirumwa enjara. Ziribabona inywe abarukuseka hati bunu; baitu mubihirwa, muli'ra.

english: [GENERAL] There was a large crowd of people eating there.
lunyoro: Kandi hakaba haroho igana ryempunu lingi nizirya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] God, who knows what is in their hearts, was watching them when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he gave us.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga, arukumanya omutima, akabali kaiso wabu obuyabahaire Omwoyo Ogurukwera, nkokuyatuhaire naitwe;

english: [GENERAL] But if he divorces his wife, he cannot be free from her, nor can he go in to her. And a man must not divorce his wife.
lunyoro: baitu obwaryahukana aikalehoga okutaswerwa, rundi aterane niba; kandi omusaija atalireka mukaziwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] A man named Jairus, who was the leader of the synagogue, came to Jesus and begged him to go into his house.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaija omuntu, ibararye Yairo, akabali omukuru wiso'rokaniro: yainama ha bigere bya Yesu namwesengereza okutaha omu njuye;

english: [RELIGIOUS] And God, who by his grace has poured out his eternal glory into union with Christ, will bring you into being, he will make you firm, and strengthen you.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga owembabazi zona, ayabetire ekitinisakye ekyebiro nebiro omu Kristo, nuwe alibahikiriza, alibagumya, alibaha amani.

english: [GENERAL] The Jewish authorities said, “We have no right to kill anyone.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagamba ngu Kitaturagirwe kuita muntu wena.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But many of them did not welcome God, because they were kept safe in the desert.
lunyoro: Baitu baingi halibo Ruhanga atabasime: baitu bakahwerekerexebwa omu irungu.

english: [GENERAL] That is why I told you to send him, so that when you see him again, you will be glad and have no more reason to be sad.
lunyoro: Nikyo nyekambire okumutuma, inywe musemererwe obumuligaruka okumurora, nobujune bwange bundugeho kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] God was with them by means of a vision, visions, wonders, and the gifts of the Holy Spirit, just as he had promised.
lunyoro: Ruhanga nafoka kaiso hamu nabo omu bwokuro'raho, nebyamahano, nebyamani bingi, nomu bisembo Ebyomwoyo Ogurukwera nkokuyagondeze wenka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For we have no right to think any thing about ourselves, but our own authority comes from God.
lunyoro: baitu itwe titunyina busobozi okutekereza ekigambo kyona habwaitu itwenka; baitu obusobozi bwaitu nuburuga hali Ruhanga:

english: [GENERAL] The desires for this world, its passions, and its desires are clearly seen by the things in the world.
lunyoro: Kandi okwegomba okwomunsi, nokwegomba okundi, nibitangwa, binyoroza ebigambo ebinyakuli omunsi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] You fool! When you were made perfect by the Spirit, were you now made perfect by the Spirit?
lunyoro: Inywe abadomadoma muti. Obumwabandize omu Mwoyo, hati bunu numuhikirizigwa omu mubiri?

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Paul was very upset, and he turned around and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ I order you to come out of her!” At that very moment Paul left her.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro obuyabihirwa muno, yahinduka nagambira omuzimu ati Ninkuragira omu ibara rya Yesu Kristo murugeho. Kandi gwamurugaho omu kasumi ako.

english: [RELIGIOUS] This temptation did not come from the one who prayed.
lunyoro: Okuhambirizibwa kunu kutaruge hali ogu ayabesere.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, if we are given the Kingdom that cannot be shaken by God's will, we must obey him with reverence and awe
lunyoro: Nukwo obutuhabwa obukama obutarukusobora okutulisobo ramuhu'ra Ruhanga nkokwagonza omu kwerinda nokutina

english: [GENERAL] Do not boast about the things you boast about, but be boast about them; instead, be proud, but be proud, not on your own authority, but on your own authority.
lunyoro: Muleke okwenyumiza omu bigambo ebyekitinisa, baitu hakire muhabwe omu bigambo byanyu:mutaba abemyehembo omu kigambo kyanyu, baitu mukuratire Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They left the tomb in fear and with great joy, and ran to tell the disciples.
lunyoro: Baruga bwango ha kituro nokutina nokusemererwa okwingi, bairuka okutebeza abegeswabe.

english: [GENERAL] While he was saying this, a man came to the commander of the synagogue and said, “Your daughter is dead.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba nakigamba, hakaija omu anyakurgire omba omukuru wiso'rokaniro nagamba ati Omuisiki wawe afire;

english: [EDUCATION] In what way can all of you be helped? The disciple is not above his master's authority, but only in his own proper order.
lunyoro: Omwegeswa takira obukuru omwegesawe, baitu wena obwalikahiki'ra, alisisana nomwegesawe.

english: [GENERAL] After reading this, Jesus asked his mother, “Do you know that she is a Galilean?”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okusigisoma, yakaguza isazarye okuliri, obuyamumanyire okuba Omunyakirikiya, yagamba ati

english: [GENERAL] Some of them started to argue, “I am not going to come to you.”
lunyoro: kandi abamu nibehemba nibatekereza ngu nyowe tindukugenda okuija namberemuli:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “How good it is to do evil on the Sabbath! To save lives or to kill?” But they did not give up.
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Kisemire ha kiro kya Sabiti okukora okubi? Okukiza obwomezi, nandiki okuita? Baitu bahuna kwanka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The disciples said to him, “It is not right to marry unless the man and his wife first say the same thing.
lunyoro: Abegeswa bamugambira ngu Ebigambo ebyomusaija na mukaziwe biraha biri biti, tikiri kirungi okuswera.

english: [GENERAL] I came to set fire to you on the earth, and if it is already kindled, what do I want?’
lunyoro: Nkaija okubaga omu'ro hansi; kandi obuguraba gwakire hati nyowe ninyenda ki?

english: [RELIGIOUS] If we died with Christ, we believe also that we shall also live with him.
lunyoro: Kandi turaba twafire hamu na Kristo, tuikirize kandi ngu Kristo, Kristo, kandi turyomera hamu nauwe:

english: [GENERAL] A tree of life will bear fruit, and a tree that bears figs will bear fruit every month.
lunyoro: Kandi orubaju norubaju orwekyambu omuti ogwobwomezi, ogwana ebyana byagwo amezi gona: namababi agomuti gokwera.

english: [GENERAL] In your endurance you have increased your lives.
lunyoro: Omu kuguma kwanyu numwo murakizaga obwomezi bwanyu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For just as the Father has life in himself, he gave him life in himself.
lunyoro: baitu nka Isenyowe okwanyina obwomezi omuruwe, nukwo yamuhaire ati Omwana okuba nobwemezi omwogu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the promise is to you, to your children and to all who are far away, all who are looking to the Lord our God.
lunyoro: Baitu omurago guli halinywe ha hali abana banyu na hali bona abali hara muno, nibo bona Mukama Ruhanga waitu abarayetaga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Jesus said to them, “Pay back, then, to the Emperor what belongs to God.”
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Nukwo muheyoga hali Kaisali ebya Kaisali, na hali Ruhanga ebya Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] He who says he remains in union with him is righteous also by himself to go as he has.
lunyoro: anyakugamba ati aikaire omuruwe kumuhikirire nauwe wenka okugendaga nkogu okuyagendaga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Mary came to Jesus and saw him, she fell at his feet and said to him, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
lunyoro: Kandi Maryamu obuyaizire Yesu namberali namubona, yagwa hansi ha bigerebye, namugambira ati Mukama wange, kakuba okaboli hanu munyany nyowe tiyakufire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Philip opened his mouth and began to teach Jesus.
lunyoro: Firipo yayasamya akanwake, yabandiza ha kyahandikirwe kinu, namutebeza Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And that is why he saved them. I will tell you the things that I have told you, whether you have obeyed me properly or not.
lunyoro: kandi niyo yabahasize okujunwa; nimbamanyisa ebigambo ebinabatebize, rundi obumubikwata kurungi rundi muraba mwaikiririze busa.

english: [GENERAL] While Gallio was a descendant of Achaia, the Jews stirred up Paul and brought him before the judgment court.
lunyoro: Baitu Galio obwakaba ali owisaza rya Akaya, Abayudaya baimuki'ra Pauro nomutima gumu, bamuleta hali ekitebe ekicwerwaho emisango,

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were the ones who told us about our coming to you, and when you turned from your sins to serve the living God,
lunyoro: Baitu nibo barukutebeza ebyaitu okutaha kwaitu namberemuli okukukaba kuli; kandi okumwahindukire Ruhanga numuleka ebisisani, okuko'raga Ruhanga omwomezi;

english: [GENERAL] But they did not understand the meaning of the loaves, and their hearts were dull.
lunyoro: baitu ebyemigati batabyetegereze, kandi emitima yabu ekaba egumangaine.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Paul wanted to go into the crowd, the disciples did not believe him.
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro obuyayenzire okutaha omu bantu, abegeswa batamuikirize.

english: [GENERAL] and the graves were opened, and many bodies of the righteous who had been crucified were raised to life.
lunyoro: nituro zakingurwa: emitumbi mingi eyabahikirire abakaba bagwijagire yahumburwa;

english: [RELIGIOUS] But the tax collector standing at a distance did not want to raise his eyes to heaven, but cried out in a loud voice, “God has made me clean!”
lunyoro: Kandi omuzinisa, ayemerire hara, atagonze kuimukya amaisoge haiguru, baitu aketeratera omu kifuba nagamba ati Ruhanga onganyire nyowe omusisi.

english: [GENERAL] On the third day they threw themselves into the boat's boat.
lunyoro: kandi ha kiro ekyakasatu banaga nemikono yabu bonka ebigendesa ekyombo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were all amazed and said to one another, “What is this? The new teaching!” He ordered power, the evil spirits, and they heard it.
lunyoro: bahuni'ra bona, nibakaguzangana ngu Kiki kinu? Okwegesa kuhyaka! Naragira nobusobozi nemizimu emibi, nemuhu'ra!

english: [GENERAL] “Sir,” they answered, “we remember that evil man who was alive said, “I will rise three days later.”
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Mukuru, tuijukire omubihi ogu akagamba, obwakaba ayomire, ati Ebiro obubirikahinguraho bisatu ndihumbuka.

english: [GENERAL] You will be blessed, because they have nothing to give to take away from you, but you will be repaid for the resurrection of the righteous.

english: [GENERAL] So then, you will say, ‘This is why the weeds are cut off, and I am made clean.’
lunyoro: Nukwo oragamba ngu Nikyo amatagi gacwerirweho, nyowe nsimbwemu.

english: [GENERAL] When he found one pearl of high value, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.
lunyoro: Obuyazoire eruru emu eyomuhendo omwingi, yagenda yagura ebyakabanyinabyo byona, yagigura.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The child grew up to be a very strong man, and he was filled with wisdom. The grace of God was upon him.
lunyoro: Kandi omwana akakura, yafoka wamani, yaijura amagezi: embabazi za Ruhanga niziikara haruwe.

english: [GENERAL] The word of it reached the ends of the world.
lunyoro: Iraka ryabyo likahikya ensi ha mpero yensi zabantu bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] These people were shown that they did not belong to themselves, but to you, and they sent out what you have now told them to preach the Good News through the Holy Spirit who was sent from heaven. These are the very things that the angels wanted to see.
lunyoro: Kandi nibo basukulirwe ngu tihali habwabu bonka,baitu habwanyu, bakahereza ebi ebimwagambirwe hati omuli ebo ababatebize enjiri omu Mwoyo Ogurukwera, ayatumirwe naruga omu iguru; nibyo bamaraika barukwegomba okuroramu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Fellow fools and weakhearted people do not believe everything the prophets said!
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe abatanyina magezi, abobugara omu mitima okutaikiriza byona banabi ebibagambire!

english: [RELIGIOUS] Their end will come, their God will be their share, and their glory will be in their shame, and they will think about the things on earth.
lunyoro: Ha mpero yabu ruhanga wabu niyo enda yabu, nekitinisa kyabu kirir omu nsoni zabu, nibo barukutekereza ebya hansi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] In this way his body, which is the means by which he is the one who makes all things perfect.
lunyoro: kandi nugwo mubirigwe, okuhiki'ra kwogu arukuhikiriza byona omu byona.

english: [GENERAL] Judah was the father of Perez by Hezron, and Hezron was the father of Aram.
lunyoro: Yuda akazara Perezi akazara herezoni; Herezoni akazara Ramu;

english: [GENERAL] No one has ever saved me from my first trials, but they have all left me. I beg you, then, not to save me from this.
lunyoro: Omu kwetonganira kwange okwokubanza busaho ayankonyire, baitu bona bakampemukaho: ninsaba baleke okujunwa eki.

english: [AGRICULTURE] Even now the tree is cut down to the ground, so that it will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: hati bunu ebdyamiti etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana emiti, bagutema, bagunaga omu mu'ro.

english: [GENERAL] So be glad and rejoice, you heavens and all you that are in them! How terrible for the earth and the sea! The Devil has come down to you, because he knows that you have only a little time left!
lunyoro: Nukwo musemererwa iguru nabarukuikaramu. Ziribabona ensi nenyanja: baitu Diaboro asirimukire halinywe ayina ekiniga kingi, baitu abaoine ngu ayina akacu kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After Jesus left, he said, “Now the Son of Man has been made great, and God has been glorified through him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okuturuka Yesu yagamba ati Hati bunu Omwana womuntu anyumizibwe, na Ruhanga anyumizibwe omuruwe;

english: [RELIGIOUS] and the repentance and the forgiveness of sins were preached in his name to all the nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
lunyoro: kandi okwegarukamu nokuihibwaho ebibi btebezebwe omu ibararye hali amahanga gona, okubandiza Yerusalemu.

english: [GENERAL] For we know that all creation keeps under control and continues to this very day.
lunyoro: Baitu tumanyire ngu ebihangirwe byona nibisinda nibisasira hamu okuhikya na hati.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, if the whole church is united, and everyone speaks in strange tongues, and people who do not believe or who do not believe in the gospel enter it, will not say, “You have been crucified!”
lunyoro: Nukwo ekanisa yona obweba eso'rokaine hamu, kandi bona nibagamba endimi, kandi abantu abatamanyire, rundi abatarukuikiriza obubaliba nibatahamu, tibaligamba ngu Mugwire iraro?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The High Priest said to him, “I publicly praise God the living God, who told us that you are the Messiah, the Son of God!”
lunyoro: nyakatagara omukuru wabu yamugambira ati Ninkurahiza Ruhanga omowmezi, otugambire obworaba ali Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the two blind men who had been sitting on the cross heard that Jesus was passing by, they fell down before him and said, “Son of David, have mercy on us, Lord!”
lunyoro: Kandi abafu bamaiso babiri abakaba baikalire ha muhanda rubaju, obubahulire ngu Yesu nahinguraho, batokera ha iguru, nibagamba ngu Mukama waitu otuganyire, iwe Omwana wa Daudi.

english: [GENERAL] and the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever; they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and its image, and all those who believe in the image of the beast.
lunyoro: nomuika ogwokubonabonesebwa kwabu nugucuka ebiro nebiro, kunu tibayina okuhumura nyamusana nekiro, abaramya ekisoro nekisisani kyakyo, na bona abaikiriza enkojo yibara ryakyo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For you were bought with a price. In the same way you were made with God in your body.
lunyoro: baitu mukagurwa nomuhendo: nukwo mukugize Ruhanga omu mubiri gwanyu.

english: [GENERAL] They had come back to that country and had told them to go back home.
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba babaire nibaijuka ensi egi nambere barugire, bibagarukiremu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They sang a new song, saying, “You must take the book and expose its meaning; you have killed and redeemed God's people from every tribe, language, and nation.
lunyoro: kandi bazina ekizina ekihyaka, nibagamba ngu Osemerire okutwara ekitabu, nokusumu'ra emanyikirizo zakyo: baitu okaitwa, kandi wabagu'ra Ruhanga obwesagama yawe omu ruganda rwona, norulimi, nabantu, nihanga,

english: [GENERAL] I am coming to Zion for a very precious stone, and those who believe in him will not be disappointed.
lunyoro: Dora ninta omu Sayuni ibale erikomerwemu, eryomuhendo mwingi: Kandi arukumuikiriza talikwatwa ensoni.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the disciples heard this, they went away and took the body away and buried it.
lunyoro: Kandi abegeswabe obubahulire, baija, batwara omutumbigwe, baguta omu kituro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Whoever is born of God does not continue to do it, but remains in him; and whoever is born of God cannot sin.
lunyoro: abo abazairwe Ruhanga tibakora ki, baitu embiboye ikara omuruwe; kandi tasobora okukora kibi, baitu akazarwa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All of us, together with our uncovered eyes, are changed from glory to glory by the Spirit, just as the Lord is with us.
lunyoro: Naitwe itwena namaiso agataswekerirwe, obutwangasana nkendolerwamu ekitinisa kya Mukama waitu, tuhindurwa okusisanizibwa tuti okuruga omu kitinisa okuhika omu kitinisakye, nka habwa Omwoyo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I have done one work, and you are all amazed.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nkakora omulimu gumu, nanywe inywena mwahuni'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the gift of God's grace and of his free will is beyond compare.
lunyoro: Baitu ebisembo ebyembabazi nokweta ebya Ruhanga tibirukuhindurwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] and said, “Look! The heavens are opened up, and the Son of Man is seated at the right side of God.”
lunyoro: nagamba ati Dora, mboine iguru lisukuirwe, Nomwana womuntu ayemerire ha mukono ogwoburyo ogwa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the truth is that you say, ‘Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: [RELIGIOUS] He did not spare the ancient world, but saved Noah and the seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of ungodly people.
lunyoro: kandi ataganyire ensi eyaira, baitu akakiza Nuha nabandi omusanju, omudumi wokuhiki'ra, obuyalesere okusandara kwamaizi ha nsi eyabatarukutina Ruhanga;

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus saw the crowd rushing in with him, he said to him, “You dumb and deaf spirit, I have told you, and you will never give up.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyaboine ekitebe nikiiruka nikigoma namberali hamu, yacomera omu maisoge ati Iwe omuzimu ogutarukugamba, omufu wamatu, nyowe nkuragire otaculera na kake?

english: [GENERAL] We have become like Sodom, and we have been like Gomorrah.
lunyoro: Twakufokere nka Sodomu, twakusiaine nka Gomora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All who heard it heard him and said in their hearts, “What will this child be?” But the hand of the Lord stayed with him.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ababihulire bakabyeyahu'ra omu mitima yabu, nibagamba ngu Mara, omwana ogu aliba ki? Baitu omukono gwa Mukama gwaikaraga hamu nauwe.

english: [GENERAL] And now you know what it is that is happening, so that it may be revealed by your deeds.
lunyoro: kandi hati bunu ekirukutanga mukimanyire, nukwo asuku'rwe omu mpikoze.

english: [GENERAL] In this way we will know that we are truthful and that we will establish our hearts straight ahead.
lunyoro: ha nukwo turukumanyira ngu tuli bamazima, kandi tuligumyaho omutima gwaitu omu maisoge,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus left them and saw them following, and he said to them, “What are you looking for?” They answered, “Teacher,” (which means “Teacher”).
lunyoro: Yesu yakubutuka yabarora nibakuratira, yabagambira ati Nimuse'ra ki? banugambira ngu Rabi, ( amakuru gakyo obukimanyisibwa ngu Omwegesa), Orara nkaha?

english: [GENERAL] But consider this man, who was highly respected by the father of Abraham, who had ten hundred coins on his altar of self-control.
lunyoro: Baitu mutekereze omuntu ogu okwali omukuru muno, Iburahimu isenkuru ouyahaire ebicweka biikumi ha munyago ogwokwegomboza.

english: [GENERAL] They had taken many spears and had them thrown into prison and ordered the jailer to keep them safe.
lunyoro: Obubabatire emiigo nyingi, babacumiriza omu nju yenkomo, nibaragira omulinzi okubalinda muno:

english: [GENERAL] I will send the younger ones to you, and they will have children. They will build houses and have no need for the Kingdom of Heaven.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukwendera abakyali abato basame, bazale abana, baleme enju zabu, baleke okulema obukama obwomu iguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I am afraid that, as the serpent deceived Eve in his lie, your minds will never be corrupted from the truth and the sacred things of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu ntinire, nkenjoka okuyabihihire Hawa omu budupebwe, rundi ebitekerezo byanyu bitasisikara okuruga omu mazima nokwera ebiri hali Kristo.

english: [GENERAL] For we have heard that some among you who do not do what is right do not only what they do but also what others do.
lunyoro: Baitu tuhulire ngu haroho abamu abatarukugenda kurungi omulinywe, kunu tibakora emirimo yabu bonka, baitu nibakora eyabandi.

english: [GENERAL] Just as a man who left his house and lived in a foreign country, when he ordered his servants to build a tower, he ordered them to look straight ahead.
lunyoro: Kisisana nkomuntu ayasigire enjuye,narara omu nsi endi, amazire okuragira abairube rubale, nokubaha omwanya ogwokuhweza;

english: [GENERAL] Others said, “Let us see whether Elijah will come to save him.”
lunyoro: Baitu abandi bagamba ngu Leka; turole rundi Eriya araija okumujuna.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “What do you want?” they asked. “The Lord is looking for,” they answered.
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Mukama waitu naguse'ra.

english: [GENERAL] But if anyone does not provide for himself and for his own family, he will not believe. And even worse is the evil one who does not believe.
lunyoro: baitu omuntu wena obwatalisa abe wenka, nokukira muno abomu njuye, buli ayehakaine okuikiriza. Nakira obubi atarukuikiriza.

english: [GENERAL] These things happened to them as examples, but they were written for a warning to us who have died to the ends of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi binu bikabaho abo okuba ekyokuro'raho; baitu bikahandikwa obwokutuhabura itwe abaizirwe emperor zensi.

english: [GENERAL] He got into the boat with them, and the wind came up, and they were very amazed among themselves.
lunyoro: Yatemba omu bwato nambere bali, omuyaga gwayamuka: bahuni'ra muno omunda yabu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Go and get the vineyard, and I will pay you what is right.”
lunyoro: kandi yabagambira ati Nainywe mugende omu rugonjo orwemizabibu, nanyowe ndabahera ekiraseme'ra.

english: [GENERAL] The fourteenth day of the same time we were driven across the lake of Aduliya, where false teachers thought that they were about to come down from the cross.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro kya ikumi na bina obukyahikire, obutwabingabingirwe honahona omu nyanja ya Aduliya, omu itumbi abalimba bakatekereza ngu bamalize okui'ra haihi nensi:

english: [GENERAL] They will fool you with lies and lies. Their judgment will not last long, and they will not escape.
lunyoro: Kandi omu kwegomba balibasagisamu amagoba nebigambo byokwefora: omusango gwabu okuruga ira tigurukukuikara, nokuhwereke'ra kwabu tigurukuhungira.

english: [GENERAL] I will come quickly, and you will have to obey me, so that everyone will not take your coat away from me.
lunyoro: Nkaija bwango: kwatira kimu ekyoyinakyo, omuntu wena aleke okunyaga ekondo yawe.

english: [GENERAL] Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is weak, and I am not weak?
lunyoro: Omuntu ki afoka omugara, nanyowe ntarukufoka omugara? Omuntu ki atabaijuka, Nanyowe tindukubihirwa?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Pray, then, that the Father in heaven will give you whatever you ask.
lunyoro: Nukwo musabege muti, Isitwe ali omu iguru,

english: [GENERAL] The words of his Son, who was born among David's descendants, are the words of the flesh.
lunyoro: ebigambo Byomwanawe ayazairwe omu baijukuru ba Daudi, omu mubiri:

english: [GENERAL] If I go to Spain, I will be glad to see you again and be persecuted for the sake of you to this very day, or else I will see you again and give you a little more time to live.
lunyoro: obundiba ningenda Sapaniya, (baitu ninihira okubarora obundihinguraho, nokusengekerezebwa inywe okumpikya oku, rundi obundikamara okubarorayo nokubanihaho kake):-

english: [GENERAL] In this way I will tell you the Good News about the Roman Empire as much as I can.
lunyoro: kandi nukwo ngondeze okutebeza enjiri hali inywe abomu Rumi nkokunsobora.

english: [GENERAL] “Turn away from your sins,” he said, “for the Kingdom of heaven has already come.
lunyoro: yagamba ati Mwegarukemu; baitu obukama obwomu iguru bumalize okuhika.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He got up and prayed, went to the disciples, and found them asleep because they were asleep.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaimukire omu kusabakwe, yaija hali abegeswa, yabasanga bagwijagire obwokuganya,

english: [GENERAL] He listened to the crowd, and when his wife recognized him, he took a piece of wood and put it on the other servants' feet.
lunyoro: Yatega omutima ha kitebe, na mukaziwe nauwe akimanyire, yaletaho ekicweka kyagwo, yakita ha bigere byabakwenda.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Through him all the power of God's Spirit was made subject to him, without the use of his hands, to the full measure of the body, which is the measure of Christ's life.
lunyoro: hati omuruwe harumu okulema kwona okurukwera, hataroho okukora okwemikono, okujura omubiri ogwenyama, okurukuingana nobwomezi obwa Kristo:

english: [GENERAL] With Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that has happened to you.
lunyoro: hamu na Onesimo mwene waitu owokwesiga kandi arukugonzebwa, owowanyu. Balibamanisa byona bya munuka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, when the end comes, he will give the Kingdom to God and the Father, and he will put an end to all power and all authority and power.
lunyoro: Nukwo emperor ehika, obwalihayo obukama hali Ruhanga, kandi Isitwe; obwalimaraho okulema kwona, nobusobozi bwona, namani gona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For now we live, if you stand firm in the Lord.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu tuli bomezi, inywe obumuraba nimweme'ra omu Mukama waitu.

english: [GENERAL] How terrible for us! We who have died to sin, how could we live to sin?
lunyoro: Mahano! Itw abafire hali ekibi, ntukyasobora tuta okwome'ra omu kibi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus asked him many things, but he did not answer him.
lunyoro: yamukaguza ebigambo bingi: baitu uwe atagarukemu kigambo.

english: [GENERAL] They wanted to throw him out of the boat, and the boat was going on.
lunyoro: Kandi bagonza okumutahya omu bwato: ahonaho obwoto bwaija.

english: [GENERAL] Hagar is Mount Sinai, in Arabia, and she is like Jerusalem today, because she is pregnant with her children.
lunyoro: Hagara ogu nurwo rusozo Sinai omu nsi ya Bwarabu,nainganaingana na Yerusalemu orwebiro binu: baitu ali omu buiru hamu nabanabe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And because of the raising of the dead, you did not read what God had said to you,
lunyoro: Kandi ebyokuhumbuka okwabafu, timukasomaga Ruhanga eki Ekiyabagambire inywe ati

english: [GENERAL] They said to him, “We will go with you.” So they went off and got into the boat, but that night they did not catch anything.”
lunyoro: bamugambira ngu Naitwe ntugenda naiwe. Bagenda nibagwe'ra omu bwato; kandi ha kiro eki batakwate kintu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The waiting God will fill you with all joy and peace by means of your faith, and you will be filled with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga owokunihira alibaijuza inywe okusemererwa kwona nobusinge bwona omu kuikiriza, inywe musaganege omu kunihira, omu mani Agomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For this is why we do not work together, but we worship the living God, who is the Savior of all people, and above all others who believe.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo tuko'ra emirimo ntutalibana, baitu tukanihira Ruhanga omwomezi, nuwe Mujuni wabantu bona, nokukira muno wabo abaikiriza.

english: [GENERAL] The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look! A friend of tax collectors and prostitutes!’
lunyoro: Omwana womuntu akaija narya nanywa, nainywe mugamba ngu Dora omuntu omukoizi, omutamizi enganjani yabazinisa nabasisi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The message he preached to the people of Israel was the Good News of peace through Jesus Christ, the Lord of all things.
lunyoro: Ekigambo ekiyatwekire abana ba Isaleri, natebeza enjiri eyobusinge habwa Yesu Kristo (nuwe Mukama wa byona,)

english: [RELIGIOUS] For whoever will receive the Holy Spirit without being condemned forever.
lunyoro: Baitu wena alijuma Omwoyo Ourukwera tanyina kuganyirirwe omusango ogwekibi ekyebiro nebiro:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Come and eat.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who do you think you are?” They knew that he was the Lord.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muije murye. Kandi busaho hali abegeswa ayasoboire okumukaguza ati Niwoha? Bamanyire nuwe Mukama waitu.

english: [GENERAL] Many will come in my name, and they will say, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many people.
lunyoro: Baingi abaliija omu ibara ryange, nibagamba ngu Ninyowogu; kandi balihabisa baingi.

english: [GENERAL] When they heard this, they were filled with pity and cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
lunyoro: Obubahulire ebi, baijura ekiniga, batokera haiguru, nibagamba ngu Atemi Wabefeso mukuru.

english: [GENERAL] Do not be drunk with wine, in which there is no room to drink, where is the wine that never goes into the cup; instead, the wine that does not pour into the new wine will burst, and all will be ruined.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu talisagika amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga enkuru; kuba bakora bati, endyanga ziba zitemuka, namarwa gaseseka, nendyanga zisisikara; baitu omutarukukora ati, amarwa gakutema hansi endyanga empyaka, byona byomera.

english: [GENERAL] He looked around and saw the linen cloths lying there.
lunyoro: yataho amaiso, yarora engoye zekitani zitairwe aho;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Come to the Lord, then, if we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
lunyoro: Kandi obutusisimuka, rundi obutuliifa, tuliba Mukama waitu.

english: [GENERAL] But you, woman, do you know whether you will save your husband? Or do you know whether you will save your wife?
lunyoro: Baitu iwe omukazi, omanyire ota rundi olijuna omusaija wawe? Rundi iwe omusaija, omanye ota runyina mukazi wawe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with different tongues, just as the Spirit had told them.
lunyoro: Bona baijura Omwoyo Ogurukwera, nibabanza okubaza engambo ezindi nezindi, Nkomwoyo okuyabahaire okuzigamba.

english: [GENERAL] But I will warn you whom you will fear. Be afraid of him who has the power to drive out of hell. Yes, I tell you, be afraid of him.
lunyoro: Baitu ndabahabura oumuratinaga: mutinege ogu obwamara okuita, ayina obusobozi okunaga omu Gehena; ego, nimbagambira nti Mutinege ogu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For those who do good reap much more than the usual harvesters, because they have a good harvest in themselves by faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abamara okuhereza kurungi betungira bonka obukuru oburungi, nobumanzi bwingi omu kuikiriza okuli omu kristo Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] For he will be handed over to the Gentiles, and they will make fun of him, insult him, and spit on him.
lunyoro: Baitu alihebwayo hali abamahanga; balimute'ra enaku, balimugiza ensoni, balimucwera amacwanta:

english: [GENERAL] In all these things love one another, because love is the root of all these things.
lunyoro: hati byona mujwale nokugonzangana, baitu nukwo kurukugumya okuhiki'ra kwona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Large crowds followed him, and he told them this.
lunyoro: ebitebe bingi nibimukuratira; yabakiriza oku.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Death and the demon brought the dead to life, and they were judged according to their deeds.
lunyoro: Kandi okufa nokuzimu byaleta abafu abakaba barumu: bacwerwa omusango omu omu nkengeso zabu okuzikaba ziri.

english: [GENERAL] When he arrived in Galilee, the people there welcomed him and saw everything he had done in Jerusalem for the Passover Festival.
lunyoro: Nukwo obuyaizire Galiraya, Abagaliraya bamutangi'ra obubaboine ebigambo byona ebiyakolire Yerusalemu ha bugenyi: baitu nabo bakagenda ha Bugenyi.

english: [GENERAL] and the older women as mothers, and the younger women as sisters with all purity.
lunyoro: nabakazi abakuru nka nyoko; nabaisiki nkabanyoko omu kusemera kwona.

english: [GENERAL] But get up and go with them, and do not be afraid; for I am with you.
lunyoro: Baitu imuka, osirimuke ogende nabo, otarukugurukyagurukya: baitu ninyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] In order that God and his Father may establish your hearts to be holy, without blame for the coming of the Lord Jesus with all his followers.
lunyoro: nukwo agumye emitima yanyu omu kwera okutahanwa omu maiso ga Ruhanga waitu kandi Isitwe, omu kuija kwa Mukama waitu Yesu hamu nabarukwerabe bona.

english: [GENERAL] The children of your Spirit will be taken away from you, and you will be given over to all the good and evil things that are going on in you. They will never see it again.
lunyoro: Abo abana bomwoyo gwawe baliihwaho, nebintu byona ebinura nebirungi birihwaho, kunu tibakyabibona na kake.

english: [GENERAL] Do not be afraid of those who belong to their masters, but of your own brothers. Instead, do what is right for them, because they are the ones who share the blessing with you in the faith and love. Teach them to do the same.
lunyoro: Kandi abo abanyina bakama babu abarukuikiriza baleke okubagaya, baitu bene banyu; baitu hakire babako'lege, baitu abaterana omu mugisa nibaikiriza kandi nibagonzebwa.Yegesege okubako'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After Jesus had said this, he breathed his last on them and said to them, “You have received the Holy Spirit!
lunyoro: Obuyamazire kugamba ebi yabaikiza orwoya, nabagambira ati Muhebwa Omwoyo Ogurukwera:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do not be afraid of the enemy in all that you do, but of the one who opposes you, who is the one who has the mark of your salvation, which belongs to God.
lunyoro: mutarukukangwa abanyanzigwa omu kigambo kyona, baitu abanyakuko'ra empera nibo muketo, baitu halinywe okujunwa, nukwo kurugire hali Ruhanga:

english: [RELIGIOUS] I order you by the Lord to teach these things to all the people.
lunyoro: Nimbarahiza Mukama waitu okusomesa baruha enu bene baitu bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The hand of the Lord was revealed to whom?
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwa Mukama gukasuku'rwa oha?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who believe in him will not be judged, but will believe that he has been judged, because they do not believe in the name of the Son of God, who was born on their own behalf.
lunyoro: Anyakumuikiriza tacwerwa musango, baitu aturukuikiriza amazire okucwerwa, baitu taikirize ibara Ryomwana wa Ruhanga ayazairwe omu wenka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He opened the way for Moses and for all the prophets, and he explained to them in all the Scriptures the truth about himself.
lunyoro: Yabandiza ha Musa na banabi bona, yabasobo'ra omu byahandikirwe byona ebyamuhandikirwe wenka.

english: [GENERAL] If we confess our sins to him, he is faithful and must forgive us our sins and take away all our sins.
lunyoro: Bitu obutuyatura ebibibi byaitu nuwe wokwesiga, kandi ahikirire okutuganyira ebibi byaitu,nokutwogyaho ebyokutahiki'ra byona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the Lord, who is faithful, will strengthen them and keep them from the wicked.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu wokwesiga, alibagumya kandi alibalinda hali omubi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do you have houses to live and drink? Do you despise God's church, and do you dishonor those who do not have houses? What shall I tell you? Why should I give thanks to you? I will not give thanks to you.
lunyoro: Rundi timunyina enju zokuliramu nokunyweramu? Rundi numugaya ekanisa ya Ruhanga, kandi numukwasa ensoni abatanyina enju? Ndabagambira ki? Ndabasima habweki? Tindukubasima.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those whom he has judged as righteous are the ones he has judged, and those whom he has judged he has given honor to.
lunyoro: kandi abayayahuire ira, nibo yayesere: kandi abayayesere, nibo yaihireho omusango: kandi abamuhikirize, nibo yataireho ekitinisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When he came out, he went to a place where no one could find him. The crowds came to him and began looking for him, but he would not leave them.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obubwakire yarugayo, yagenda omu kiikaro nambere hatarumu bantu: abebitebe bamuse'ra, nibaija namberali, nibenda okumutanga, atabarugaho.

english: [GENERAL] And I will tell you that you have a lot of money left over for many years. Get up, eat, and be satisfied.
lunyoro: Kandi ndigambira obwomezi bwange nti Obwomezi, oyina itungo lingi ryahuirwe eryokumara emyaka mingi; humura, orye, onywe, osemererwe;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Some time later Felix went with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jew. He called Paul and listened to him about the faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebimu obubyahinguireho Ferikisi yaija na mukaziwe Durusira, akabali Omuyudaya, yayeta Pauro, yamuhu'ra ebyokuikiriza okuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. The blind are seeing, the lame are walking, the dumb are hearing, the dead are being raised to life, the poor are being told the good things.
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati Mwegendere, mutebeze Yohana ebimuboine nebimuhulire; abafu bamaiso nibarora, abaramaire nibagenda, abagenge basemezibwe, abafire bahumbuirwe, abasege batebezibwe ebigambo ebirungi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But they had some arguments about him about their own religion, and about the man who died for Jesus, whom Paul spoke about, was alive.
lunyoro: baine haruwe empaka ezimu ezedini yabu bonka, kandi hali omuntu Yesu ayafire, Pauro ouyagambireho ayomire.

english: [GENERAL] For the truth that remains in us, and it remains in us forever.
lunyoro: habwamazima agaikara omulitwe, kandi garaikaraga naitwe ebiro byona:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I will give him to you the cross.” He took it and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Oundakoleza entonge ningimuha nuwogu. Obuyakoleze entonge yahikwata yagimuha Yuda omwana wa Simoni Isikaryota.

english: [GENERAL] Nazareth, a descendant of David's son Mary, a descendant of David.
lunyoro: a Nazalesi, hali omuisiki ataramanyire musaija, akaba ajumbirwe omusaija ibararye Yusufu, owomu nju ya Daudi; nibara ryomuisiki Maryamu.

english: [GENERAL] The next day we opened the gates and saw Chios, and the next day we came to Samos, and the next day we reached Miletus.
lunyoro: Kandi twahanika amaberu okurugayo, ha kiro ekyakabiri twahika okurole'ra Kio, kandi ha kyakana twataha Samo; ha kyakasatu twaija Mireto.

english: [GENERAL] Do not be afraid of them, for you have filled the earth with violence.
lunyoro: mutabihangana inywenka; baitu mukaijuza ensi ebyokusisa

english: [RELIGIOUS] There will be no more night, and they will not light the sun and the moon, but the Lord God will give them light, and they will shine forever and ever.
lunyoro: Takulibayo ekiro bwakabiri; kunu tibataga omusana gwetabaza, nomusana gwizoba, baitu Mukama Ruhanga alibaha omusana: kandi baliremera ebiro nebiro.

english: [GENERAL] All perform miracles? All have the gift of healing; all have the same gift. All speak in strange tongues.
lunyoro: bubona bakora ebyamahano? Bona banyina ekisembo okukiza endwara? Bona nibagamba endimi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] “What do you say?” Jesus answered.
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda nkukole ki? Yabagambira ati Nikyo ekimugambire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The disciples realized that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.
lunyoro: Nubwo abegeswa bayetegereza ngu akabaza nabo ebya Yohana Omubatizi.

english: [GENERAL] He left the city in a basket of unrolled figs, and he sat down and gave up the sign, so that he would not deceive the nations until the thousand years were over. After that he must be released for a little while.
lunyoro: kamunaga omu kina ekitanyina hokugarukira, yakiiga'ra, yakitaho emanyikirizo, aleke okubihabiha amahanga okuhikya emyaka orukumi obwerikahwaho; hanyuma yegi alihiki'ra okuboho'rwa akacu kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I am so sorry that you have turned away from the grace of Christ and have gone away to me
lunyoro: Nimpuni'ra baitu mufurukire bwango ogu ayabwesere omu mbabazi za Kristo, numugenda hali nyowe

english: [RELIGIOUS] A man who had an evil spirit had led them out of the way, led them both into the way, and led them out of the way. So they ran away from that house and hid themselves.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akaba aroho omuzimu omubi yabagurukira, yabakira bombi, yabasingura: nukwo bairuka bus omunju egi, kandi bahutaire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus went out and began to proclaim the Good News until this very day. But Jesus could not go back to that town, but he stayed outside in the desert. They came to him and told him everywhere.
lunyoro: Baitu yaturuka, yabanza okutebeza muno nokuhikya ekiihuro, kandi Yesu atasobole kugaruka omu rubuga bwerebwere, baitu yaikaraga aheru omu irungu: baijaga namberali, barugire hona hona.

english: [GENERAL] I wanted to know the meaning of what they had given me and to bring him back to their council.
lunyoro: Kandi obunagondeze okumanya ebigambo ebibamulegeseze namusirimura hali orukurato rwabu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For those who wanted me to be put right with Christ for my sake, my friends, who belong to my body.
lunyoro: Baitu naba ngondeze nyowe nyenka okuiibwaho omusango gwa Kristo habwa bagenzi bange, abomu ruganda rwange omu mubiri:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Some of the disciples said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Jesus said to them, “If you look at the birds of heaven and throw them out of his side, they will not believe.
lunyoro: Abegeswa abandi bamugambira ngu Tukarora Mukama waitu. Baitu yabagambira ati Obundaraba omu biganjabye, nomanyirra omunda yebigonyobye, tindikamuikiriza na kake.

english: [GENERAL] But not all of you suffer as a murderer or a thief or a busybody in other people's affairs.
lunyoro: Baitu hataba wena omulinywe abonabonesebwa nkomuisi, nobukwakuba nkomusuma, nobuhokuba nkomumutasi omu byabandi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For this reason, we pray for you today, that our God will make sure that you have his approval, and that you will have the full strength to do what is good and to do what is good.
lunyoro: Nikyo tusabira ebiro byano habwanyu, nukwo Ruhanga waitu abatekereze musemerire okwetakwe, kandi ahikirize namani kyona ekimugonza ekyoburungi nomulimo ogwokuikiriza;

english: [RELIGIOUS] He is not a single nation, but a group of God's chosen people.
lunyoro: kandi tiririr ihanga eri ryonka, baitu asoroza ahamu abana ba Ruhanga abatabaine.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When he saw this, he spoke ahead of time about the raising of Christ from death, not of the dead, nor of the living.
lunyoro: akuro'raho kara yagamba ha kuhumbuka kwa Krsito okwatalisigwa okuzimu, nobukwakuba omubirigwe okubona okunda.

english: [GENERAL] I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and the books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to the Scriptures, according to what they had done. The sea brought those who were dead to life.
lunyoro: Kandi narora abafu, abakuru nabato, bemerire omu maiso gekitebe ekyobukama: nebitabu byasuku'rwa: nekitabu ekindi kyasukusurwa, nikyo kyobwomezi: abafu bacwerwa omusango obwebi ebyahandikirwe omu bitabu nkengeso zabu okuzikaba ziri. Nenyanja yaleta abafu abakaba barumu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For God, who raised him from death, did not see sleep.
lunyoro: baitu ogu Ruhanga ouyahimbuire, atabone okujunda.

english: [GENERAL] They ate, drank, and were drunk. So they got up, and went away until the day Noah entered the ship, where the flood was about to come and told them all.
lunyoro: baryaga, banywaga, basweraga, bagabukaga, okuhikya ha kiro Nuha ekiyatahiremu omu bwato, okusandara kwamaizi nukuija nukubahwerekereza bona.

english: [GENERAL] But to those who are convinced and do not obey the truth, who hear what is not evil, will be given a hearing ear, and they will be filled with pity.
lunyoro: baitu hali abo abempaka, kandi abatarukuhu'ra amazima, baitu nibahura ebyokutahiki'ra, aliga'ra; hali abo alikuha ekiniga kingi,

english: [GENERAL] Do not be quick to take advantage of anyone, do not be quick to take advantage of anyone; instead, be quick to take offense at him.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena aleke okutabatabana, kunu aleke okugobeza omuntu wena, okwarasima:

english: [GENERAL] Which of you, then, would want to build a tower, and not sit down to finish its work?
lunyoro: Baitu araha omulinywe obwaba nagonza okwombeka orukomera, atabanza okuika'ra nabali'ra ebyemirimo yarwo, okwayina ebyokurumara?

english: [GENERAL] But when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?
lunyoro: Baitu omukama worugonjo orwemizabibu obwaliija alibakora ki abalimi abo?

english: [GENERAL] Do not be afraid to walk on the rock.
lunyoro: Otatina okubata ekigere kyawe ha ibale.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you do not know me.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Mananukwo ninkugambira nti ha kiro kinu enkoko etakakokere emirundi ebiri, oranyehakana emirundi esatu.

english: [GENERAL] His parents answered, “We know that he is our son, and he was born blind.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire bagarukamu nibagamba ngu Tumanyire onu nuwe mwana waitu, kandi akazarwa omufu wamaiso:

english: [RELIGIOUS] I did not know the churches of Judea in union with Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi nkaba ntamanyirwe ekanisa eza Buyudaya ezomu Kristo:

english: [RELIGIOUS] I wrote a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, who likes to honor others, does not welcome us.
lunyoro: Nkahandikira ekanisa ebigambo: baitu Diyoterefe, arukugonza okweha obukuru omubo, tarukutuiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For this reason I tell you, every one of you says, ‘I follow Paul,’ ‘I follow Apollos,’ ‘I follow Cephas,’ ‘I follow Christ.’
lunyoro: Kambanu nikyo ngambire nti omuntu wena omulinywe agamba ati Nyowe wa Pauro: kandi nyowe wa Aporo: kandi Nyowe owa Kefa: Kandi nyowe owa Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] In the sixth month of the year the angel Gabriel was sent to the city of Galilee, whose name was “The Word of God.”
lunyoro: Kandi omu kwezi okwomukaga maraika Gabiryeri akatumibwa Ruhanga hali orubuga orwomu Galiraya, ibara ryarwo

english: [GENERAL] Josiah was the father of Jechoniah and the people of Nineveh at the time of the exile in Babylon.
lunyoro: Yosiya akazara Yekoniya nabenebabu, omu biro ebyokutwarwa Baburoni.

english: [GENERAL] Moses said, ‘Respect your father and your mother,’ and ‘Whoever curses your father or your mother will be put to death.’
lunyoro: Baitu Musa akagamba ati So na nyoko obatinege: kandi ati Anyakugeya ise rundi nyina bamuitege mali:

english: [RELIGIOUS] The spirit came down upon them, and they did not believe that Jesus had been raised from death.
lunyoro: Kandi omuzimu obugwamunagire ha maisoge, gwamurugaho gutamukozire kabi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “If they had not listened to Moses and the prophets, they would not have heard that someone had been raised from death.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Obubaraba batarukuhu'ra Musa na banabi, tibalihu'raga nobwakubaire omuntu ahumbukire omu bafu.

english: [GENERAL] Suppose a man who has one hundred sheep and one of them gets lost and loses one of them is going to the mountains and seek out the lost one.
lunyoro: "Muntu ki anyakuina entamaze kikumi, nentahi yazo emu ebuzire, tasiga ziri ekyenda mu mwenda, nagenda ha nsozi, nase'ra egi enyakubuzire?

english: [GENERAL] In this hope I was hoping to come to you in the future, so that you may be blessed a second time.
lunyoro: Kandi omu kunihira kunu nkatekereza okuija namberemuli kara, nukwo muhabwe omugisa obwakabiri;

english: [GENERAL] It says, ‘I will go back to my house, where I have come from.’ When he comes in, he finds only one, one, one, one.
lunyoro: Kandi, gugamba ngu Ndagarukayo omu nju ya nge nambre narugire. Obugutahamu gugisanga kwonka, esingolirwe, esemezibwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] That the Gentiles should be persecuted together with one another, and that they should share in the work of the gospel in union with Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Kuko Abamahanga okuba abagwetwa hamu,kandi abomubiri gumu, kandi abateraine ha bwomurago omu Kristo Yesu obwenjiri,

english: [GENERAL] It was not like Cain, who was a liar and killed his brother. Why did Cain kill him? His actions were bad, and his brother was good.
lunyoro: Tukaba nka Kaini okwakaba ali womubi, kandi akaita mugenziwe.Kandi kiki ekyamuisize? baitu emirimoye ekaba eri mibi, kandi oyomugenziwe ekaba ehikirire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I always pray with joy that my prayers for you will last.”
lunyoro: Mu kusaba kwange kwona habwanyu ninsaba nokusemererwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, my friends, keep your minds fixed on the things which belong to the Lord, because you know that your work in the Lord is not in vain.
lunyoro: Nukwo bagenzi bange abarukugonzebwa, mugume okutatabana, mwekambege omu mirimo ya Mukama, baitu mumanyire ngu Omulimo gwanyu tiguli gwa busa omu Mukama waitu.

english: [GENERAL] So he got up and took the child with him by night and went to Egypt.
lunyoro: Yaimuka, yatwara omwana na nyina ekiro, yagenda Misiri;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus took the bread and gave thanks to God, and he gave it to the people who had sit down. This is how you want it to be.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yakoma emigati; obuyamazire okusima yagigabira bali abaikalire; nukwo bagane nkokubagondeze.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The next day they threw themselves out of the Temple and ate their food with joy and with a pure heart, and praised God, and they were all filled with joy.
lunyoro: Kandi obukyabukya bayekambaga nomutima gumu omu yekaru nibacwaho ebyokurya byabu nokusemererwa nomutima ogutayina bugobya, nibakugiza Ruhanga, basimirwe abantu bona.

english: [GENERAL] Speak with your heart, for your words are truthful.
lunyoro: Gamba omu mananu: ekigambo kyawe nigo mananu.

english: [GENERAL] I think it is better for me to be proud than to be proud of you.
lunyoro: Nitekereza nti obunyikara omu nkande zinu, kirungi okwenyumiza oku habwanyu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Philip went down to the town of Samaria and proclaimed Christ to them.
lunyoro: Firipo yasirimuka omu rubuga rwa Samaliya, yabadumira Kristo.

english: [GENERAL] But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or feeding sheep and going out of the field, will say to him, ‘Come and sit down at the table’?
lunyoro: Baitu araha omulinywe, anyakuina omuiru rubale nalima, rundi nalisa entama, obwalitahamu arugire omu misiri, alimugambira ati Ija bwango oka'ra ha byokurya?

english: [GENERAL] But who met you? What did you have that you did not receive? Why, then, do you boast as though you had not received it?
lunyoro: Baitu noha yakwahurainebo? Kandi onyina kintu ki ekyotarahairwe? Kandi oraba wahairwe, kiki oyenyumiza nkotahairweho?

english: [GENERAL] For your obedience has come to all people. I am happy about you. I want you to be wise for what is good, and to be blind for what is bad.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhu'ra kwanyu kukahika hali abantu bona. Nikyo nsemererirwe halinywe: kandi ningonza inywe okuba bamagezi hali ekisemire, kandi abadomadoma hali ekibihire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the weapons of our warfare are not fleshly, but powerful by God to break into pieces.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyokurwanisa ebyokulemu bwaitu tibiri byomubiri, baitu byamani omu Ruhanga okusesa enkomera:

english: [GENERAL] I am happy about you, and you will think about the same thing, because you love one another, and you will think about one another.
lunyoro: muhikirize okusemererwa kwange, kandi inywe mutekereze ekigambo kimu, munyina okugonza kumu, omutima gumu, numutekereza ebimu;

english: [GENERAL] But now I am going to the one who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu nigenda hali ogu ayantumire; kandi busaho halinywe arukunkaguza ati Nogenda nkaha?

english: [GENERAL] They did not find me in the Temple, nor in the city, nor in the town, nor in the public square nor in the city.
lunyoro: Kandi batasange omu yekaru nimpakana nomuntu wena, nobukwakuba nomuntu ali haihi nomuntu, nobuhokuba omu rubuga, nobuzakuba omu katale, nobugwakuba omu rubuga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] As they were eating, Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, how good it is that we are here! We have three tents here, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” But he did not know what he was talking about.
lunyoro: Kandi kyahika, obubakaba nibamuraga, Petero yagambira Yesu ati Mukama wange, kisemire itwe okuikara hanu: twombeke obiju busatu; akamu kawe, akndi ka Musa, nakandi ka Eriya: atamanyire ekyarukugamba.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I know that you have not the love of God in you.
lunyoro: Baitu mbamanyire inywe, timunyina kugonza kwa Ruhanga omulinywe.

english: [GENERAL] gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and all kinds of precious wood, pearls, and all kinds of precious stones, pearls, and all kinds of most precious stones, pearls, and all kinds of most precious stones, pearls, and all kinds of most precious stones.
lunyoro: ezabu, nefeza, namabale agomuhendo,neruru, na bafuta enungi, norugoye orurukugajuka, na sadio, noruro, nesahani, nomuti gwona ogwomuhendo mwingi, neruru, nebintu byona ebyomuti ogwomuhe'le, nebyomunda emu, nebirukutagata okuruga ha rubaju orwa buru, na ha ibale erirukwangasana;

english: [GENERAL] I tell you, then, that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous people who do not want to repent.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Nukwo halibaho okusemererwa omu iguru obwomusisi omu anyakwegarakamu, okukira abahikirire kyenda mu mwenda abatase'ra okwegarukamu.

english: [GENERAL] For he who gives himself to joy is dead even though he lives.
lunyoro: baitu anyakwehayo okwesemeza wenka buli afire nobwaba ali omwomezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus thought that he was going to Achaia, his brothers made fun of him, and wrote letters to the disciples to welcome him. When he arrived, he healed the sick who had been sick.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyatekerize okwambuka okuhika Akaya, bene babu bamwekambisa, nibahandikira abegeswa okumutangi'ra: obuyahikire yabakonyera muno abakaba bayina endwara ezirukubatuntuza;

english: [RELIGIOUS] And walk in love, just as Christ loved you and gave himself for us as a sacrifice and a sacrifice to God for a good sacrifice.
lunyoro: kandi mugendege omu kugonzangana, nka Kristo nauwe okuyagondeze inywe, kandi yayehayo wenka habwaitu, nkekihongwa nekyonzira hali Ruhanga okuba ekisorokoko ekirungi.
