lunyoro: Nukwo abasaija, mugume emitima yanyu: baitu nyikirize Ruhanga nti kiriba nkokukyangambirwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus went and told the people who had stayed with him, as they were weeping and wailing.
lunyoro: Yagenda yatebeza abaikaraga ohamu nauwe, bakaba nibaganya niba'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] John answered them all, “I am the one who did not need to see you, and he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
lunyoro: Yohana yagarukamu nabagambira bona ati Mananukwo nyowe, orukoba rwenkaitoze tinsukuseme'ra okuruboho'ra; ogu alibabatiza Nomwyo Ogurukwera nomu'ro:

english: [GENERAL] Leave them alone, because they are blind leaders of the blind. When the blind see the blind, both will fall into a pit.
lunyoro: Mubaleke; bali bebembezi abafire amaiso. Baitu omufu wa maiso obwananata omufu wamaiso, bombi baligwa omukoina.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I am telling you the truth: no one can enter the Kingdom of God without being born of water and the Spirit.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Mali mali ninkugambira nti Omuntu obwatazarwa amaizi Nomwoyo, tasobora okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] God chose the weak things of the world to be ashamed of them, and he chose the weak things of the world, the glory of the heavenly bodies, and of the heavenly bodies, so that he might bring to nothing the living.
lunyoro: kandi ebyobugara ebyensi Ruhanga akabikomamu, akwase ensoni ebyamani: kandi nebitali byekitinisa ebyensiya nebigayibwa Ruhanga akabikwataho, kandi nebitaroho, nukwo aburanganize ebiroho:

english: [GENERAL] He who grows up does not know anything, but wants to remain in union with him, and he is full of anger, jealousy, and selfishness.
lunyoro: omuntu atamanyire na kake, kyonka nayegomba ebyempaka, aijuire ihali ryona, nokukungana, nebyokujuma, nebitekerezo ebibi

english: [RELIGIOUS] Speak the word, speak at the right time and at the right time; be obedient, ready, ready to pray, and eager to teach.
lunyoro: hatebeza ekigambo: ogambi'lege omu biro ebisemeriremu nebitasemeriremu; otere'lege, ohanege, oyesengerezege omu kugumisiriza kwona nokwegesa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] If you stand firm in the faith and do not be divided, and do not be discouraged by the hope you have heard from me, which was proclaimed in all creation that is under heaven, I Paul, who was made a apostle.
lunyoro: (baitu muraba numuikara omu kuikiriza, mugumire kandi mutarukutabatabana, kandi mutaganye omu kunihira okwenjiri eyimwahulire, eyatebezibwe omuli ebyahangirwe byona hansi yiguru, nyowe Pauro eyinafolirwe omuhereza wayo.)

english: [GENERAL] The woman said to him, ‘Sir, you have no water, and the flood has already come. Where is that drinking water?”
lunyoro: Omukazi yamugambira ati, Tata, tonyina kyokutaha, kandi Iziba lihamire: noiha nkaha amaizi ago agomire?

english: [GENERAL] Be on your guard! Look! I have told you everything that happened before it happened.
lunyoro: Baitu mwerindege inywe: dora, mbagambire byona bitakabaireho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] As soon as they saw it, they did not see anyone else, but only Jesus with them.
lunyoro: Obubahindukire bwango okurora, tibabona muntu kandi, rundi Yesu wenka hamu nabo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus called them to him and said, “Let the little children come to me and do not try to stop them, because the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabeta namberali nagamba ati Muikirize abana abato baija namberendi, mutabatanga, baitu abanyakuli nkabo obukama bwa Ruhanga bwabu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But those who lived in Jerusalem and their rulers did not know that this man or that the angels of the prophets were read every Sabbath, so they judged him.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abaikara Yerusalemu, nabalemi babu, obwokutamanya ogu nobugakuba amaraika ga banabi agasomwa Sabiti zona, nikyo bagahikiririze obubamucwerire omusango.

english: [GENERAL] You men of Athens, I see that in all things you are highly respected by the people of Asia.
lunyoro: Inywe abasaija Abasene, mboine omu byona numutina muno abacwezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] This secret is of no use; I speak about Christ and the church.
lunyoro: Ekyensita kinu kikoto mali: baitu ningamba ha Kristo nekanisa.

english: [GENERAL] For when the Son of Man comes, he will call the people, because the time has come for them to teach the people.
lunyoro: Baitu ebyana obubyera, ahonaho aleta orugeso, baitu okugesa kuhikire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For two things that cannot be broken, which cannot be broken, God has not given us the power to do it, so that we, who are ready to obey, may have the hope set before us.
lunyoro: Obwebigambo bibiri ebitarukusobora okutabatabana, Ruhanga ebyatasobora okusibika, itwe tutunge ekigambo ekyokugumiraho, nukwo tutunge okunihira okututairweho omu maiso gaitu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered him, “Before the rooster crows, you will sit down and see me.”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda nkukole ki? Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Ntusobora kuikara hansi okundora.

english: [GENERAL] He came to me, stood by me, and said to me, ‘Brother Saul, repent!’ At that very moment I saw him.
lunyoro: aizire hali nyowe, yayeme'ra namberendi, nangambira ati Mwene waitu Sauro, iguka. Kandi omu kasumi ako nubwo nahwereze okumurora.

english: [GENERAL] I baptized the house of Stephanas, but I did not know whether I baptized anyone else.
lunyoro: Nabatiza nenju ya Sitefano: kandi timanyire rundi nkabatiza omuntu wena ondi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For as the truth of Christ remains in me, no one will look down on my glory in all the world of Achaia.
lunyoro: Nkamazima ga Kristo okugali omuli nyowe, omuntu wena atalintanga okwenyumiza kwange kunu omu nsi zona eza Akaya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] and love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.
lunyoro: kandi ogonzege Mukama Ruhanga wawe numutima gwawe gwona, nobwomezi bwawe bwona, namagezi gawe gona, namani gawe gona.

english: [GENERAL] The commander heard the commander and the commander of the ship more than Paul said.
lunyoro: Baitu omunyakihanda yahu'ra omugoyi nomukama wekyombo okukira Pauro ebiyagambire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For God is my witness, and I know that I love you very much in the Kingdom of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga niwe kaiso wange, amanyire okundikubagonza muno omu kuganja kwa Kristo Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I am John, your brother, and my brother, who is with you in the matter of miracles, Kingdom, and obedience to Jesus. I am with you on the island of Patmos for the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
lunyoro: nyowe Yohana, nwene wanyu, kandi aterana nainywe omu muhito, nobukama, nokuguisiriza omu Yesu, nkabandi omu izinga eryetwa Patimo, obwekambo kya Ruhanga nobwokumanyisa Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] Your ancestor Abraham was glad to see me on the night, and he was glad to see me.
lunyoro: Iburahimu isekuru inywe akasemererwa okurora ekiro kyange; kandi akakirora nasemererwa,

english: [GENERAL] Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens.
lunyoro: Hakire akamu nyowe nditengesa teri ensi yonka,, baitu nuguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He revealed the secret of the evil things that he wanted, just as he had promised through his Son, in order that he might be the one who will rule with me for the rest of the age.
lunyoro: obwakaiso, obuyatumanyisize ensita zebi ebiyagondeze, nkokuyasimire wenka, obwobuketo o bwempiko zebiro,

english: [GENERAL] In the same way, we are truthful.
lunyoro: Kandi obwekigambo kinu tugambaga amazima:

english: [GENERAL] But Jesus denied it before them all, saying, “I don't know what you are talking about.”
lunyoro: baitu akehakana omu maiso ga bona,nagamba ati Ekyogambire tinkimanyire.

english: [GENERAL] The men who had been taking care of him went out of the city and told him the things that had happened to him. They came and saw what had happened to him.
lunyoro: Nabalisa, bagenda nibagambira omu rubuga, nebigambo byona ebibaireho. Baija okurora ebyabaireho okubiri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For God, who is rich in mercy, has loved us for his great love.
lunyoro: baitu Ruhanga anyakuli owobuguda omu mbabazi, obwokugonzakwe kwingi okuyatugondeze itwe,

english: [GENERAL] But some of them did not recognize him.
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abamu abataramanyire

english: [RELIGIOUS] All the people saw him walking and praising God,
lunyoro: Abantu bona bakamurora nagenda nakugiza Ruhanga:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For we have come to a knowledge of the unseen things, but we do not walk in error or in a way that makes God's word crooked. For we make ourselves known to the people by bearing witness to the truth, and we live in a way that makes us pure in the sight of God.
lunyoro: baitu tukafuruka ebyensoni ebiserekerwe, kunu titurukugendera omu bugobya, nobukwakuba okuhabisa ekigambo kya Ruhanga; baitu obwokwoleka amazima, ntwesimisa intwenka hali emitima yona eyabantu omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Go quickly and tell his disciples that he has been raised from death, and now he is going ahead of you to Galilee. There you will see him, and now I have told you.
lunyoro: Mugaende bwango, mutebeze abegeswabe ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu; kandi dora, nabebembera okugeda Galiraya; nuho mulimuro'ra: dora mbagambire.

english: [GENERAL] My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
lunyoro: Entama zange zihu'ra iraka ryange, nanyowe nzimanya, nazo zinkuratira:

english: [GENERAL] The woman learns in all her ways and obeys all her orders.
lunyoro: Omukazi ayegege omu buculezi nomu kuhu'ra kwona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus said, “A man did this to me, but I have authority to tell him.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yagamba ati Omuntu ankozireho: baitu mpulirege amani nigandugamu.

english: [GENERAL] The crowd was sitting around him, and they said to him, “Look! Your father and your brothers are outside looking for you!”
lunyoro: Nekitebe kikaba kiikalire bamwehingulirize;bamugambira ngu Dora, nyoko na bene banyu bali aheru, nibakuse'ra.

english: [GENERAL] After this we came to a place called the Good News about Jesus, which is far away in the city of Lasea.
lunyoro: kandi obutwahinguireyo namani twahika omu kiikaro ekimu, ekyetwa Emyogo Emirungi, ekiherire orubuga Rasaya.

english: [GENERAL] I came from the Father, and I am coming into the world. And the world hates me, because I am going to the Father.
lunyoro: Nkaruga hali Isenyowe, ninyija omu nsi. Kandi ensi ningirugamu, ningenda hali Isitwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] That is why I make you commit a sin by being put right with God by being put right with me.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndukukuijikiza okucumamu ekisembo ekya Ruhanga obwokubonabonesebwa omuli nyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And this is how it will save you today from the real punishment of sin, so that your baptism will not take away your physical body; it will bring you back to life with a good conscience before God through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi nigo garukubajunisa inywe hati bunu omu kisisani ekyamazima, nukwo kubatizibwa, tikuli kwogaho iko ryomubiri, baitu okukaguza okwomutima omurungi hali Ruhanga obwokuhumbuka kwa Yesu Kristo:

english: [GENERAL] These are the deeds that are lawful only for bodily exercise, eating, drinking, and the like. These are the rules that apply to the new age.
lunyoro: ebihandiko byonka, rundi ebyokurya, ebyokunywa, nebindi nkebi, nibyo biragiro ebiragirwa okuhikya ebiro ebyokusemerezamu obuhyaka.

english: [GENERAL] But some of the teachers of the Law were sitting there, thinking in their hearts,
lunyoro: Baitu hakaba haroho abahandiki abamu baikalire, nibatekereza omu mitima yabu

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them the third time, “I know what sin this man has committed. I do not see in his case the penalty for death is death. I will go ahead and kill him!”
lunyoro: Abagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuruwe musango ogwokufa: nikyo ndamute'ra, 'mulekere.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I told Titus, and I sent my brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Didn't we go on walking by the same Spirit? Didn't we go on on these feet?
lunyoro: Nkagambi'ra Tito. Kandi nkatuma mwene waitu hamu nauwe. Rundi Tito akabasagisamu amagoba? Tutagendere omu Mwoyo omu? Tutagendere omu bigere binu?

english: [GENERAL] The seven had no children, and the seven had no children. Last of all the woman died also.
lunyoro: kandi bona omusanju batasigeho bana. Hanyuma bona bahoireho, nomukazi yafa.

english: [GENERAL] As they traveled along the road, they came to a place where water was kept. The official said, “Look, why are you baptized?”
lunyoro: Kandi oubakaba nibagenda omu muhanda bakahika nambere omu maizi; omukonwa yagamba ati Dora amaizi; kiki ekirukuntanga okubatizibwa?

english: [GENERAL] They all ate and had enough, and they gathered the twelve baskets full of what was left over.
lunyoro: Kandi barya nibaguta bona: kandi basoroza oburagalika obwasigaireho, ebigega ikumi na bibiri ebiijuire.

english: [GENERAL] But some who were standing there and heard him say, “He is calling for Elijah!”
lunyoro: Baitu abandi abakaba bemirerireho, obubakihulire, bagamba ngu Onu nayeta Eriya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus said, “How happy are those who hear the word of God and obey it!”
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ati Okukira, banyina omugisa abarukuhu'ra ekigambo kya Ruhanga nibakikwata.

english: [GENERAL] and he saved him out of all his troubles and gave him wisdom and understanding in the sight of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. He made him king over Egypt and all his house.
lunyoro: yamujuna omu bujunebwe bwona, yamuha okuganja namagezi omu maiso ga Faraho, omuka wa Misiri; yamufora omulemi omu Misiri nomunjuye yona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees came to him and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” They asked him.
lunyoro: Kandi Abafalisayo bakaija namberali, bamukaguza ngu Kyebiragiro omuntu okubinga mukaziwe? nibamulenga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The disciples said to him, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will get well.”
lunyoro: Abegeswa bamugambira ngu Mukama waitu, obwaraba agwijagire arakira.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The apostles and the rest of them were all witnesses to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and many grace was shown to them all.
lunyoro: Abakwenda bakatebeza muno, bali bakaiso bokuhumbuka kwa Mukama waitu Yesu: nembabazi nyingi zaikaraga halibo bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were looking for Jesus and said to one another, “What do you think? He will not come to the festival?”
lunyoro: Kandi base'ra Yesu nibagambiragana, bemerire omu yekaru ngu Nimutekereza muta? Tarukuija ha bugenyi?

english: [GENERAL] If the stars fall from heaven, and the powers that are in heaven will be shaken.
lunyoro: nyunyuzi ziriba nizigwa okuruga omu iguru, nobusobozi obunyakuli haiguru bulitengesebwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Judas and Silas, who were also prophets, encouraged the believers with many words and strengthened them.
lunyoro: Kandi Yuda na Sira, baitu nabo bakaba bali banabi, bakekambisa bene babu nebigambo bingi, nibabagumya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After Jesus had said this, he went up to the mountain to pray.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire kubaraga, yagenda ga rusozi okusaba.

english: [GENERAL] After their resurrection, they went to the land of Gennesaret,
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okwambuka, baija omu nsi ya genesalesi,

english: [RELIGIOUS] He went into the synagogue and began to reject the Jewish authorities and the Jewish authorities and the Jewish authorities, and to eat the Passover meal with the people who were with him.
lunyoro: Kandi yahakanaga omu iso'rokaniro hamu Nabayudaya nabantu abekengi, kandi nomu katale obukyabukya, nabo abamuitiraine.

english: [GENERAL] They stripped off the dust, and loved the best places at feasts and the best places at feasts.
lunyoro: kandi nibaraihya ebitutu, nibagonza ebikaro ebyahagati ha bugenyi, nentebe ezekitinisa omu maso'rokaniro

english: [GENERAL] For we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, not to please ourselves.
lunyoro: Kandi itwe abamani kutuhikirire okwetweka obugara bwabatanyina amani, okutesemeza itwenka.

english: [GENERAL] Mary stayed with him for three months, and she turned back to them.
lunyoro: Kandi Maryamu akaikara nauwe amezi asatu, yagarukayo owabu.

english: [GENERAL] For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; but whether I preach the Good News, I myself will receive it, because I tell it not.
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nintebeza enjiri, tinyina kyokwenyumiza nyenka; baitu okukyenwa nukunkonyera, baitu okuhambirizibwa kundi nyowe:

english: [GENERAL] We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that has been made by my hands, and three days later I will build another made without hands.’
lunyoro: Itwe tukamuhu'ra nagamba ati Ndisesa yekaru enu enyakukozirwe nemikono, kandi ebiro bisatu numwo ndyombekeramu endi etarukukorwa nemikooto.

english: [GENERAL] For I tell you, anyone who sins against his brother will be put to death; and whoever says to his brother, ‘Fellow down and be thrown into the fire!’
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nimbagagambira nti Omuntu wena anyakubihi'rwa mwene wabu, aligwe'rwaho omusango; nauwe anyakugambira mwene wabu ati Mugwagwa, buli amalize kunagwa omu Gehena eyomu'ro.

english: [GENERAL] Do not boast about the deeds of others, which are much more important than ours. Instead, we hope that when your faith grows, we will be proud of you just as we were about to buy and then cross.
lunyoro: tukwenyumiza emirimo yabandi, nukwo kukira ha rulengo rwaitu; baitu ntunihira ngu okuikiriza kwanyu obukulikanya, itwe tulinyumizibwa omulinywe nkomutano gwaitu okuguli nokuhingurana,

english: [RELIGIOUS] No one, however, has ever received this privilege of service, but has received God's approval, just as Aaron did.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu ayetungira wenka ekitinisa eki, rundi ayeserwe Ruhanga nka Aroni kandi.

english: [GENERAL] They were sad, but we are glad, because we are glad. I have pity on them, but we have many things to give to the rich. I have nothing, but all things.
lunyoro: baitu tubihirwa, baitu ntusemererwa; nyowe ntuntu'ra, baitu tufora baingi abaguda; okutanyina kintu, baitu tunyina byona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I must go on my own trip day and night, because it is impossible for a prophet to go outside Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu kimpikirire okwegendera nyenka nyamusana nekiro: baitu tikisoboka nabi okuhwereke'ra aheru ya Yerusalemu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Lord said to him, “Put the belt on your feet, because the place where you stand stands stands is holy.”
lunyoro: Kandi Mukama yamugambira ati Jura enkaito omu bigere byawe; baitu ekiikaro hoyemerire noho harukwera.

english: [GENERAL] It is true that the scripture says, “Is this true?”
lunyoro: Kandi birahiki'ra bita ebyahandikirwe ngu Kisemire okuba kiti?

english: [GENERAL] But Paul said, “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of a city not circumcised; and I beg you, then, let me tell the people.”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya, owa Taruso orwa Kirikiya, owomu rubuga orutali rwokugayibwa: kandi nkwesengerize leka ngambire abantu.

english: [GENERAL] They were taken to Shechem, where they were buried in the tomb which Abraham had promised them to pay for the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
lunyoro: batwarwa Sekemu, bazikwa omu kituro Iburahimu ekiyaguzire omu muhendo ogwefeza hali abana ba Hamora omu Sekemu.

english: [GENERAL] For if the message that was spoken through angels had proved true, and the punishment for sin and disobedience had been given to them, they would have received a just reward.
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo ekyagambirwe bamaraika obukiraba kyagumireho, kandi nekyokusisa kyona nobutahu'ra bwona biraba byahairwe empera yoburyo;

english: [RELIGIOUS] “What do you want me to do with you? Don't you know that I must remain in the Father's word?” he asked them.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mukanseru'ra ki? Mutamanye ngu kimpikirire okuikara omu bigambo bya Isenyowe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Lord said, “Who is this faithful and wise slave, whom his master will appoint over his household to give them their food at the proper time?”
lunyoro: Mukama waitu yagamba ati Araha ogu omuketo owokwesiga owamagezi, omukamawe ouyasigire abomukaye, okubaha ebyokurya byabu omu kasumi kabu?

english: [GENERAL] The third part of the living creatures that were made by the sea died, and the third part of the ships was destroyed.
lunyoro: kandi ekicweka ekyakasatu kyebinyakuhangirwe ebiri omu nyanja, ebiyina obwomezi, kyafa; nekicwakasatu ekyamato kyahwerekerezebwa.

english: [GENERAL] You insult the one who put on the cross, and you say, ‘Stand on my feet!’
lunyoro: nainywe numutangi'ra ogu ajwaire ebyokwecuma, numugamba nu Iwe yeme'ra kuli, rundi ngu Ika'ra hansi yakatebe kebigere byange;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus loved Martha, his mother, and Lazarus.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akagonza Maliza nomanyina na Razaro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus reached out and touched him, and he said, “I want to. Be made clean.” At once the fever left him.
lunyoro: Yago'ra omukonogwe yamukoraho, nagamba ati Ningonza: semezebwa. Ahonaho ebigenge byamurugaho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Was Christ divided? Was Paul divided over you? Or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
lunyoro: Rundi Kristo abaganizibwemu? Rundi Pauro akabaganizibwa ha muti habwanyu? rundi mukabatizibwa okutaha omu ibara rya Pauro?

english: [GENERAL] When evening came, they left the horsemen to go with him and went back to the tombs.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire obuwakire nyenkya baleka abahambarasi okugenda nauwe bo bagarukayo omu rukomero:

english: [RELIGIOUS] I am telling you, then, that the Law that God made four hundred and thirty years ago will not allow or cause to break a covenant.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndukugamba nti Ekiragano Ruhanga ekiyagumize kara, ebiragiro ebyakurutire emyaka bikumi bina mwasatu ehinguireho, tibikiihaho amani, nobukwakuba okuburanganiza omurago.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I want you to be with me, so that I may pray in your presence in the gospel's gospel.
lunyoro: kandi obunagondeze okuikara nanyowe, ampereze omu kiikaro kyawe omu nsengo zenjiri:

english: [GENERAL] He who speaks on his own authority is truthful, but he who looks for the good in him who sent him is truthful, and his sin does not lead to sin.
lunyoro: Arukugamba omu magezige wenka:baitu anyakuse'ra ekirinisa kyogu ayamutumire, nuwe wa mananu, kandi obutahiki'ra busamu omuruwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] That very day some Pharisees came to him and said, “Go away! Herod is trying to kill you!”
lunyoro: Omu kasumi ako nubwo baizire Abafalisayo abamu, nibamugambira ngu Ruga hanu oyegendere: baitu Herode nase'ra okukuita.

english: [GENERAL] They stood up in fear of his punishment, and said, “How terrible for that great city, Babylon! For in one hour your judgment has come!”

lunyoro: kandi akamuha ekiragano ekyokusara: kandi Iburahimu yazara Isaka, yamusara ha kiro ekyomunana, na Isaka akazara Yakobo, na Yakobo akazara baisenkuru itwe ikumi nababiri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And this is the wisdom that we have with him: if we ask for anything he wishes, he will hear us.
lunyoro: Kandi bunu nubwo bumanzi obutunyina namberali ngu obutusaba ekintu kyona nkokwagonza atuhu'ra;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For this reason I believe that I am going to buy you a piece of meat, and then I will obey the God of our ancestors, and I will obey all that is written in the Law and in the writings of the prophets.
lunyoro: Kandi kinu ninkiikiriza namberoli nti Nkomuhanda okuguli bo ogubeta ekicweka, nukwo nko'ra Ruhanga wa baisenkuru itwe, ninyikiriza byona ebyaragirwe omu biragiro, kandi ebyahandikirwe omu banabi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, the blessing of Abraham was given to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, and we are given the promise of the Holy Spirit by faith.
lunyoro: nukwo omugisa gwa Iburahimu guhike hali Abamahanga omu Kristo Yesu, naitwe tuhabwe omurago Ogwomwoyo obwokuikiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And God raised the Lord from death, and he will raise us from death.
lunyoro: kandi Ruhanga akahumbura Mukama waitu, kandi alihumbura naitwe omu manige.

english: [GENERAL] He has sat at my right side.
lunyoro: Aikalire ha mukono gwange ogwoburyo,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus looked around at them and said, “Peace be with you!” They came at him, arrested him, and treated him shamefully.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabaitirana, nagamba ati Mirembe! Baija bamukwata emikono, nibamuramya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered them, “Did Moses command you this?”
lunyoro: Nauwe yagarukamu nabagambira ati Musa akabaragira ata?

english: [GENERAL] They brought the boy in alive, and they were filled with joy.
lunyoro: Kandi baleta omwojo ayomire, basemererwa muno.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, those who believe are blessed with faith, together with Abraham.
lunyoro: Nukwo nabokkuikiriza bahairwe omugisa hamu na Iburahimu owokuikiriza.

english: [GENERAL] Pilate asked him again, “Do you want to hear the word? Look at the two commandments you are trying to obey!”
lunyoro: Kandi Pirato yagaruka okumukaguza ati Torukwanukuea na Kigambo? Dora ebigambo okubiri ebingi ebibarukukuhambiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The tax collectors who had been crucified with Jesus also made fun of him.
lunyoro: Nabasisi abakaba babambirwe nauwe ha miti, nabo nukwo bamujumire bati.

english: [GENERAL] For there was no one who was willing to join them, but the people honored them.
lunyoro: Baitu hali abandi busaho nomu ayagumire okuterana nabo: baitu abantu bakabanyumiza;

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus said to them, “The tomb was kept for a day until the next day, so that his disciples would not come and steal him. Then he said to the people, ‘He has been raised from death,’ and the last stone was worse than the first.”
lunyoro: Nukwo oragire balindire kimu ekituro, okuhika ha kiro ekyakasatu, abegeswabe, rundi baleke kuija okumuiba, nibagambira abantu ngu Ahumbukire omu bafu: kandi omuhaba okwenyuma kulikira obubi okwokubanza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “Now this salvation has come to this house, because he is the son of Abraham.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Hati okujunwa nubwo kuizire omu nju enu, baitu nauwe mwana wa Iburahimu.

english: [GENERAL] They did not look for you by faith, but by doing what they did. They did not look for you on the basis of a stone that will never be destroyed.
lunyoro: Kandi batakuse'le omu kuikiriza, baitu omu mirimo. Bakatabaijuka ha ibale eririkutabaijurwaho;

english: [GENERAL] It would be better for the children who are upset to settle down on their own.
lunyoro: Kikaba kiri kirungi abana abarukutuntura bahukanemu bonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the disciples saw him walking on the water, they were filled with fear, and they were filled with fear.
lunyoro: Abegeswa obubamuboine nage ndera ha nyanja, batuntura, nibagamba ngu Muzimu! Byanuza obwokutina

english: [RELIGIOUS] You too must be poured out into the power of the holy one, and you will know everything.
lunyoro: Nainywe muyina okuseswaho amagita hali ogu arukwera, kandi mumanyire byona.

english: [GENERAL] For if we have food and clothing, we will be hungry.
lunyoro: baitu obutunyina ebyokurya nebyokujwara, ebi bitumale.

english: [GENERAL] So then, if the language is too small for me, I will boast about it even more. Look! Many trees are burned by fire!
lunyoro: Nukwo norulimi kiba kicweka kike, nurwenyumiza ebigambo ebikuru. Dora, emiti emingi okwekwatirizibw nomu'ro muke!

english: [GENERAL] I have not done this to you, but he has not done it to me and has not kept my feet from being broken.
lunyoro: Tinakukozire kinu, baitu ogu mabaire kutahamutakalekere okunywegerea muno ebugere byange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to her, “Don't be afraid, for I have not yet come to the Father in heaven; instead, go to your brothers, and say to them, ‘I am going up to my Father in heaven, and your Father, and to my God, and your God.’
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Otankwataho; baitu tinkatembere omu iguru hali Isenyowe: baitu genda hali bene baitu obagambire ngu Nintamba omu Iguru hali isenyowe, kandi Isinywe, hali Ruhanga wange, kandi Ruhanga wanyu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees, “Is it not against the Law to heal on the Sabbath?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagambira abebiragiro Nabafalisayo ati Kyebiragiro okukiza ha Sabiti nandiki tikirikyo?

english: [GENERAL] All things have been made clean and have been made clean.
lunyoro: Baitu byona bikorwege kurungi, kandi bihe'ranizibwege.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish gave it to them.
lunyoro: Yesu yaija, yakwata omugati, yabaha, nencu ati.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I hope in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
lunyoro: Kandi ninihira omu Mukama waitu nti nanyowe nyenka ndiija mpora.

english: [GENERAL] Again they shouted, “Crucify him!”
lunyoro: Baitu yagaruka okutoka muno ati Mubambe ha muti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to the paralyzed man, “Go your way. As you have decided, so it will be with you.” The servant was well that day.
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Irokogende: nkokwoikireze, nukwo kibe kiti namberoli. Omuiru akakira omu kasumi ako.

english: [GENERAL] And if you think that you should die for the sake of the people, then you should not be put to death by any people.
lunyoro: kandi oyetekerize ngu Kibasemerire omuntu omu afe habwa bant, ihanga ryona lireke okuhwereke'ra.

english: [GENERAL] How terrible for you, Chorazin! How terrible for you, Bethsaida! For the miracles that had happened in Tyre and Sidon! They have turned away from their sins and have turned away from their sins.
lunyoro: Ziribabona iwe Korazani, ziribabonawe iwe Betesaida, baitu ebyamani ebyakolirwe omu Turo na Sidoni. Bakwegarukiremu ira omu bitengo nomu iju.

english: [GENERAL] The world knows that I love the Father and that I have the Father who sent me. Get up, let us go from here.
lunyoro: kandi ensi emanye ningonza Isenyowe, kandi nak Isenwo okuyandagire, nukwo nkora nti. Muimuke, turuge hanu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the men came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, “He must do this.
lunyoro: Abo obubaizire hali Yesu bamwesengereza muno ngu Asemerire okuko'rwa kinu:

english: [GENERAL] For we are no longer slaves to sin by sinning, but to the faith that is by means of the salvation of life.
lunyoro: Baitu tituli bokwehinya enyuma omu kuhwereke'ra; baitu tuli bokuikiriza obwokujuna obwomezi.

english: [GENERAL] Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James, and Simon, who was called the Zealot,
lunyoro: Batoromayo, na Matayo na Tomasi, na Yakobo owa Antyokiya, na Simoni ayayetwaga Zerote,

english: [GENERAL] The commander's officer came to him and arrested him, ordered him to be bound with two chains. “Who is this man, and what has he done?” he asked.
lunyoro: Obuyaizire, engabwa enkuru yai'ra haihi, yamukwata, naragira okumutamu enjegere ibiri, nakaguza ati Noha, kandi ekyakozire kiki?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Let us not pray to the Lord, as some of them did to the apostles, and these evil spirits killed them.
lunyoro: Kandi tutalenga Mukama waitu, nkabamu halibo okubalengere, kandi ebi byakubaita.

english: [GENERAL] and the reserved seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts.
lunyoro: nentebe eza hagati omu maso'rokaniro, nebiikaro ebyekitinisa omu bugenyi:

english: [GENERAL] It was said to him, ‘Your mother and your brothers are standing outside looking for you.’
lunyoro: Kyamugambirwa ngu Nyoko nabagenzi bawe bemerire aheru, nibase'ra okukurora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The disciples went and did just as Jesus had told them,
lunyoro: Abegeswa bagenda bakora Yesu nkokuyabaragire,

english: [RELIGIOUS] All of you, then, must be saved and come to an end without fear of God and of the desires of the world, so that you may be able to live in the present system of things, in order to keep yourselves safe and sound in the fear of God.
lunyoro: nibo bona okujunwa, niziugmbi'ra okwanga obutatina Ruhanga nokwegomba okwomunsi, nukwo tube bomezi mubusinge bwa hati bunu mukwerinda nokuhiki'ra nokutina Ruhnaga;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For God has said, ‘Out of the darkness the light will shine, and he has shone on our hearts to bring the light of the glory of God in the presence of Jesus Christ.’
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nuwe yagambire ati Omusana gulijwa omu muirima, kandi nuwe yajwire omu mitima yaitu, okuleta omusana owokumnaya ekitinisa kya Ruhanga omu maiso ga Yesu Kristo.

english: [GENERAL] There is no one in heaven or on earth or on earth who can open the scroll or see it.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omu iguru, nobuhokuba hansi, nobubakuba hansi yensi, ayasoboire okusuku'ra ekitabu nobukwakuba okukiroraho.

english: [GENERAL] You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
lunyoro: Kandi iwe olitunga okusemererwa nokuhi'ra; kandi baingi abalisemere'rwa okuzarwakwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] God is faithful, who has called you into the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
lunyoro: Ruhanga wokwesiga, ayabeseze okutaha omu kuterana Okwomwanawe Yesu Kristo Mukama waitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But since the time of the burning anger of Moses, Moses has been read in every town, where he is being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.
lunyoro: Baitu okuruga obusinge obwaira Musa ayina omu rubuga rwona abamugambaho, obwasomebwa omu maso'rokaniro Sabiti zona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He was very upset and prayed fervently, and his sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
lunyoro: kandi akaba nahu'rwa nayekamba muno okusaba: nempitaze nisisana nkobutonyezi obwesagama obukoto mubugwa hansi.

english: [GENERAL] For he was taken along with us and given to us by the authority of this one.
lunyoro: Baitu akaba'rwa hamu naitwe, nahebwa omugabo ogwokuhereza kunu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For we, the Spirit, wait for God to hear us.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe Obwomwoyo ntutegereze omu kunihira okuhu'ra.

english: [GENERAL] I have given you milk, which is not yours to eat; but you have not been able to do it, and no longer can you do it.
lunyoro: Nkabanywisa amata, kunu tibiribyokurya: baitu mukaba mutasoboire: na hati hona timurukusobora:

english: [GENERAL] The rich are the poor who have nothing.
lunyoro: Abaguuda baba bantu abatanyina kintu.

english: [GENERAL] If their error were to make the world rich, how much more will their lack of faith make them rich? How much more, then, will their lack of faith add to their lack of faith!
lunyoro: Kandi rundi okusisa kwabu kuraba kwafokere obuguda obwensi, kandi okusobwa kwabu nukubasagika: okuhikirizibwa kwabu tikurukukira muno?

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, you are no longer foreigners and foreigners, but are members of the same holy group, and you are God's children.
lunyoro: Nukwo timukyali banyaihanga nabahinguzi, baitu muli boruganda rumu babarukwera, kandi muli bomungu ya Ruhanga,

english: [GENERAL] So then, take away from yourselves every kind of evil and evil.
lunyoro: Nukwo muiheho ekinugwa kyona nobubi obusagire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I tell you, no one can come to me unless the Father gives him back to me.”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nikyo mbagambirire nti Busaho arukusobora okuija namberendi, rundi akihairwe Isenyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of your love for all the holy ones.
lunyoro: baitu tukahu'ra okuikiriza kwanyu omu Kristo Yesu, kandi okugonza okumunyinakwo hali abarukwera bona,

english: [GENERAL] For we were with you in the past, and we told you beforehand that we will be persecuted, and that is exactly what you know.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo obutukaba tuli hamu nainywe, tukabatebeza kara ngu ntugende okusalizibwa; kandi nukwo kihikirire kiti nkokumumanyire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “Simon, blessed are you, my Father! No flesh and blood has ever seen this, but my Father in heaven.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Oyina omugisa Simono Wayona, baitu omubiri nesagama tibikusukulire eki, rundi Isenyowe ali omu iguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And I said, ‘My grace is enough, because my power is being made perfect in weakness.’ And so I will be very happy to boast about my health, so that the power of Christ may be with me.
lunyoro: Kandi yangambira ati Embabazi zange nizikumara: baitu amani gange nigahiki'ra omu bagara. Nukwo nokusemererwa kwingi ndayenyumiriza ebyobugara bwange, amani ga Kristo gaikale hali nyowe.

english: [GENERAL] After they had put them in the middle of the meal, they asked, “What is this name or name that will do to them?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubamazire okubata hagati, bakaguza ngu Mani ki, rundi ibara ki, alibakoleze eki?

english: [GENERAL] For we have heard that some people who came from us have troubled you with words and driven you away from your hearts.
lunyoro: baitu tuhulire ngu abantu abarugire omulitwe bakabatuntuza nebigambo, nibaga'ra enyuma emitima yanyu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the overseer must be a source of encouragement to you, just as God is a source of encouragement. He is not slow, slow to anger, slow to anger, and abundant in wine, and without spot from the fire.
lunyoro: Baitu omurolerezi kimuhikirire kubataho ekyokuhanwa, nkomukeeto wa Ruhanga; atali wobwereme, atali wekiniga, atarukukunganira ha marwa, atatera atali mwegombi wamagoba,

english: [GENERAL] He spat on the wine and threw it out of the Temple with the sheep and the goats; and he broke down the silver coins that were being sold and rolled up their feet.
lunyoro: Yataho omuguha ogwobuguha, yabinga zona omu yekaru, nentama nente; yasesa efeza ezabakaba nizbazihingisa, yajumika ebyase byabu;

english: [GENERAL] He has a name written on his garment and on his thigh: “King of kings and Lord of lords.”
lunyoro: Ha kyokujwarakye na ha kiberokye ayina ibara erihandikirwe liti OMUKAMA WABAKAMA KANDI MULEMI WABANYORO.

english: [GENERAL] Some began to spit on him, and some of them began to spit on him, and some of them began to spit on him, and they said to him, “Crucify him!” The messengers took him and beat him.
lunyoro: Kandi abamu babanza okumucwera amacwanta, nokumusweke'ra amaiso, noku mutera, nokumugambira ngu Rugura: nabahereza bamutwara nibamutera empi.

english: [GENERAL] Just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him your husband, so you will be his children if you do what is good and do not be afraid of anything that will save you.
lunyoro: nka Sara okuyahu'raga Iburahimu namweta mukamwawe: nainywe muli banabe obumuraba numukora kurungi, kandi mutarukutinisibwa enkize yyona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, whoever of you wants to become my disciple will not be my disciple.
lunyoro: nukwo omuntu wena halinywe atasiga byona ebyayinabyo, tasobora kuba mwegeswa wange.

english: [GENERAL] The next day they began to throw things overboard.
lunyoro: Kandi obutwarwaine muno nihunga, ha kiro ekyakabiri, babanza okunaga ebintu omu nyanja;

english: [GENERAL] You have done well in my task to help me.
lunyoro: Baitu mukakora kurungi okuterana nanyowe omu muhito gwange.

english: [GENERAL] Those who hear my words and do not obey them will not be judged by me, but will save the world.
lunyoro: Kandi anyakuhu'ra ebigambo byange atarukubikwata, nyowe timucwera omusango: baitu okujuna ensi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Your love and your faith in the Lord Jesus and in all the holy ones.
lunyoro: Obumpu'ra okugonza kwawe nokuikiriza kwawe okwonyinakwo hali Mukama waitu Yesu, na hali abarukwera bona;

english: [GENERAL] They were told that you were the one who taught the Jews to reject Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or to walk in these customs.
lunyoro: kandi bakagambirwa ebigambobyawe nguiwe oyegese Abayudayabonabali omu Bamahanga okulekayo Musa, nobagambira baleke okusara abana babu, nobukwakuba okugenda omu ngeso ezi.

english: [AGRICULTURE] It is much less than any plant, but it is smaller than the world of all creation. It becomes a tree, and the birds of the sky stay in its branches.
lunyoro: nukwo kake okukira embibo yona, baituobukanyeta kaba kakoto okukira obunyansi bwona, kafoka omuti, enyonyi ezomu mwanya ziija ziikara omu matagi gagwo.

english: [GENERAL] His feet were like drops of water in a flood, and he was tossed up by the fire, and his sweat was as drops of water.
lunyoro: Ibigerebye nibisisana nkomulinga gwomuhe'le, ogusemezibwe omu mu'ro; nirakarye liri nkiraka ryamaizi amaingi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Blessed be God, who makes us perfect in union with Christ and shows us the way to know him at all times.
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga asimwe, arukutusinguza obutosa omu Kristo, nayoleka omulitwe ekisorokoko ekyokumanya uwe omu biikaro byona.

english: [GENERAL] The jailer went out and saw that the prisoners had been broken to pieces, and he saw his sword come down on him, and he wanted to kill him, and he thought that the prisoners had escaped.
lunyoro: Kandi omulinzi owenju yenkomo, obuyasisimukire, yabona enyingi zenju zenkomo zikingukire, yasomora empirimaye nayenda okweyita, atekerize abanyankommo bacwire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus got up and followed him. While he was eating in that house, many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and the disciples, because there were many who had followed him.
lunyoro: Yeme'ra, yamukuratira.Kandi obwakaba aikalire omu nju yogu narya, abahoza baingi nabasisi baika'ra hamu na Yesu nabegeswade; baitu bakaba bali baingi abamukuratire.

english: [GENERAL] A woman who had been sick for eighteen years was sick, and could not go to bed.
lunyoro: Kandi omukazi akabayina endwara emyaka ikumi nomunana; akaba aramaire, atarukusobora okwego'ra.

english: [GENERAL] It is not a burden, then, when his messengers are put right with him, and their end is according to their deeds.
lunyoro: Nukwo tikiri kigambo kikoto abaherezabe obubafora nkabahereza abokuhiki'ra; kandi emperor yabu eriba nkemirimo yabu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] On the night of the Passover meal, and at the tomb, they crucified Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi ekiro obwokuba kya Kutekaniza kwabayudaya, kandi ekituro obwokuba haihi, nuho bamutaire Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the apostles and the other believers in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
lunyoro: Kandi abakwenda na bene babu abakaba bali omu Buyudaya, bakahu'ra ngu Abamahanga nabo bakahebwa ekigambo kya Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] The servant saw him and began to say to the people who were standing there, “This is one of them!”
lunyoro: Kandi omuzana ogu yamurora, yabanza okugambira abakaba bemerireho ati Onu wowabu.

english: [GENERAL] Why, then, do you look at the speck in your brother's eye, but don't consider the log in your own eye?
lunyoro: Kandi noro'ra ki akantu akali ha liso erya mutahi wawe, baitu torukutekereza enyomyoeri ha liso ryawe?

english: [GENERAL] He is a guest in his house, and he will not go back to work.
lunyoro: Alikiro'ra omu njuye, ataligaruka okutwara

english: [GENERAL] I am reminded of the sincere faith that you have—the faith that is without hypocrisy—and this was the very beginning of the creation of the one who was once with you—the faith that was once alive among you. And I am sure that it is with you.
lunyoro: obunaijukizibwe okuikiriza okutali kwobugobya okuliomuliwe, kandi nukwo kwabandize ira omu Bisaleri, nomu Bisareri: kandi nyeteherize mali nti kuli nomuliwe.

english: [GENERAL] Who is going to weep and gnash his teeth? Who ate the bread of grapes, but did not eat the same bread? Who will feed the crowd, but not drink the wine of the crowd?”
lunyoro: Noha agenda okuramaga naramagya ebye wenka? Noha akaba abyaire orugonjo rwemizabibu, kunu tarya ha byana byomu? Kandi noha alias igana, kunu tanywa ha mata gigana?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to his disciples, “There is nothing that will make you sad, but you will find the one who will betray you!
lunyoro: Yagambira abegeswabe ati Tikisoboka ebitabaijura okutaija: baitu dora, arukugobeza nuwogu.

english: [GENERAL] But I do not want you to be silent again, so I beg you to give us some information about your mercy.
lunyoro: Baitu ndeke okugarukira kwokukujwahya ninkwesengereza okutuhu'ra ebigambo bike obwembabazi zawe.

english: [GENERAL] I myself am sure that you will be able to help one another, because you are full of goodness and full of all knowledge.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe nyetegerize mali ebyanyu, nti inywe muijuire oburungi, muijule okumanya kwona, numusobora okutegekerangana amagezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I baptized you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: nyowe nkababatiza namaizi; baitu ogu alibabatiza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then we, the rest of us, will be taken with them into exile, to serve the Lord with all humility. And so we will be with the Lord in all ways.
lunyoro: kandi naitwe abomezi abasigaraho tulitwarwa hamu nabo omu kisombera, okutangi'ra Mukama waitu omu butami: kandi nukwo tuliikara tuti na mukama waitu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the chosen ones, who also have the hope of being saved through the eternal glory of Christ Jesus.

lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga waitu Isitwe ahabwege ekitinisa ebiro nebiro Amina.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For this reason you were called, because Christ also suffered for you and left you a model for you to follow his steps.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo mwayetirwe: baitu na Kristo nauwe akabonabonesebwa habwanyu, nabasigira ekyokuro'raho, nukwo mukuratire omu bigerebye:

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus healed many people, and all who were sick followed him.
lunyoro: baitu akakiza baingi; kandi abarwaire bamugote'ra bamukoleho, bona abakaba bayina endwara.

english: [GENERAL] So then, you should be glad to hear, not only because of your sadness, but also because of your heart's sadness.
lunyoro: nukwo kibahikirire okuhu'ra, tibuli obwekiniga kyonka, baitu obwokukenga okwomu mutima nakwo.

english: [GENERAL] For we are saying that he will save Israel. And so it is with all these things, that the third time these things happened.
lunyoro: baitu itwe tukanihira ngu Nuwe alicungura Isaleri. Nukwo na ha binu byona, hati nikyo kyakasatu, ebigambo binu bikaba kubaho.

english: [GENERAL] But if a person goes to night, he does not remember them, because the light is not in him.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu obwagenda ekiro atabaijuka, baitu omusana tiguli omuruwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He went on his way through the city with the teaching and went to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Kandi akagenda omu muhandagwe omu mbuga nomu makanayegesa, nagenda hali Yerusalemu.

english: [GENERAL] Watch yourself and obey your teaching. Keep yourself safe in these things, because when you do these things, you will save yourself and those who listen to you.
lunyoro: Werindege wenka nokwegesa kwawe. Oikalege omu bigambo binu; baitu obwokora binu oryejuna wenka, kandi oliijuna nabo abakuhu'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The sight was so terrible that Moses said, “I am so afraid that I will cry to you.”
lunyoro: kandi nebyarozirwe bikaba biri byokutinisa biti, Musa akagamba ati Ntinire muno nintukumira.

english: [GENERAL] Just as the Father sent me, even so I live because of the Father. Whoever wants to live only for me will live for me.
lunyoro: Nk'Isenyowe okkuyantumire, nanyowe nkokundukwomera habwa Isenyowe; nukwo ati anyakundya, nuwe aryomera habwange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Through the power of the Spirit to obey and to be purified by the blood of Jesus Christ, grace and peace has been poured out on you.
lunyoro: hati omu kwezebwa Okwomwoyo hali okuhu'ra nokumisirwa okwesagama ya Yesu Kristo: embabazi nobusinge bikanyizibwe halinywe.

english: [GENERAL] That is why I write this, so that when I come, I will not be troubled by those who are right to me, but by your faith I will be able to share my joy with all of you.
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo mpandikire, nukwo obundiija ndeke okuba nobujune hali abo abakihikirire okunsemeza, baitu ninyesiga inywe inywena nukwo okusemererwa kwange nukwo kwanyu inywena.

english: [GENERAL] In your heart there is nothing that can be eaten, nor eaten, nor taken away, nor did a piece of bread or a piece of wood or a piece of wood, but a man who does what he does should be given his food.
lunyoro: (le) omu myeko yanyu; nobwekuba endyanga, nobubyakuba ebyesomeko bibiri, nobuzakuba nkaito, nobugwakuba omuigo, baitu anyakukora emirimo naseme'ra okuhebwa ebyokuryabye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Where do you get the bread? Go and see.” When they knew it, they said, “Five, and two fish!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati muyina emigati ingaha? Mugende murole. Obubamanyire bagamba ngu Etano, nencu ibiri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, whoever gives to you the Holy Spirit and gives you the power to do what the Law requires, does it by obeying the Law?
lunyoro: Nukwo ogu anyakubaha Omwoyo nako'ra omulinywe ebyamani, abikora obwemirimo yebiragiro? Rundi obwokkuhu'ra okwokuikiriza?

english: [RELIGIOUS] You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the dish, and then you inside the inside.
lunyoro: we omufalisayo afire amaiso, banza oyogye omunda yakatema norucuba, haruguru naho hasemere.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, do not be afraid of anything that will happen, until the Lord comes he will reveal to you the secrets of the darkness and reveal the thoughts of the heart. Then they will be given thanks to God.
lunyoro: Nukwo mutacwa kigambo kyona ahonaho, okuhika Mukama waitu obwaliija alimulikya ensita ezomuirima, kandi aryoleka okutekereza okwomu mitima: nubwo balihabwa okusimwa omuomu hali Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went to meet him, because Mary stayed at home.
lunyoro: Nukwo, Maliza obuyahulire ati Yesu naija, yagenda okumutangi'ra: baitu Maryamu yaikara omu nju.

english: [GENERAL] But whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again; and whoever drinks from the water that I will give him will by no means drink from the water that I will give him will never again drink from the water that I will give him to drink from the water of life eternal.
lunyoro: Baitu wena anyakunywa ha maizi agandimuha talikwatwa iroho ebiro Kwahumbura abafu nabaha obwomezi, nukwo Nomwana abaha ati obwomezi abayenda okuha. Nebiro; baitu amaizi agandikuha galifoka omundaye iziba ryamaizi nigadubuka hali obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: [GENERAL] They cannot now bear witness to what they have already done.
lunyoro: Kandi tibarukusobora okugumya omu maiso gawe ebigambo ebibarukundega hati bunu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said, “He indicated by what death he was about to die to honor God.” At the same time he said to him, “I will follow you.”
lunyoro: Akagamba ati, nayoleka okufa okwagenda kufa okunyumiza Ruhanga.obuyamazire okugama ati yamugambira ati Nkuratira.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I tell you, then, that the Holy Spirit will teach you what you must say.
lunyoro: Baitu Omwoyo Ogurukwera nubwo alibegesa ekibasemerire okugamba.

english: [GENERAL] But if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Even tax collectors do the same.
lunyoro: Baitu obumuraba numugonza abo abanyakubagonza, muyina empera ki? Nabazinisa tinukwo bakora bati?

english: [GENERAL] The next day we left and went to Caesarea. We went to the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the seven of them, and stayed with him.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri twarugayo, twahika Kaisaliya: twataha onu nju ya Firipo omugambizi owenjiri omu hali abo omusanju, twaikara nauwe.

english: [GENERAL] He called everyone to him, and when he was about to be taken away by his master, he said to the first one, ‘What do you want, sir?’
lunyoro: Yayeta namberali wena akaba natongwa mukamawe, yagambira owokubanza ati Mukama wange nakutonga ki?

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the disciples heard this, they were terrified and became afraid.
lunyoro: Abegeswa obubahulire, bagwa bajumaire, batinire muno.

english: [GENERAL] Which Jew is there who is not a Jew who does not get a blessing? Or what profit is there in being circumcised?
lunyoro: NUKWO Omuyudaya nakiza ata omugisa? Rundi okusarwa nukugasa ki?

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said to them, “Any kingdom divided against itself falls apart, and every house divided against itself falls apart.”
lunyoro: baitu uwe yakenga ebitekerezo byabu, yabagambira ati Obukama bwona obububaganizibwamu bwonka buhwereke'ra; nenju obwebaganizibwa yonka egwa.

english: [GENERAL] Those who do evil will be thrown into the fiery furnace, where they will cry and gnash their teeth.
lunyoro: kandi abanyakukora obubi balibanaga omu komi eyomu'ro; nambere halibamu oku'ra nokunema ensaya.

english: [GENERAL] And if that which is left of you is not left to the body which will come, but only to the seeds, the weeds, and the other evil things.
lunyoro: kandi egi eyosiga, tosiga omubiri ogulibaho, baitu embibo kwonka, rundi eyengano rundi embibi endi:

english: [GENERAL] As they traveled, he got into a boat, and the wind came down on the lake. The boat was about to sink, and they were in danger.
lunyoro: Baitu obubakaba nibagenda yagwijagira; kandi ihunga likatera ha nyanja; obwato bwa'sana okuijura amaizi,, nabo bakaba bali omu kabi.

english: [GENERAL] He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. When he had washed his eyes, placed his hands on him, and asked him, “Do you see anything?”
lunyoro: Yakwata omufu wamaiso ha Mukono, yamuturukya aheru yekika; obuyamucwerire amacwanta ha maiso, namutaho engaro, yamukaguza ati Nohweza kantu?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The crowd with him was so large that he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from death, and they began to proclaim the Good News.
lunyoro: Kandi ekitebe ekikaba kiri nauwe, obuyayesere Razaro okuruga omu kituro, namuhumbura omu bafu, batebeza.

english: [GENERAL] But Paul said to them, “Before the Roman authorities could find out, we were put in prison and now we have been put in prison. How can we be kept under guard? No, they did not. Instead, they came to us and told us the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Nangwa, mananukwo; baitu baije bonka batuturukye.

english: [GENERAL] For just as the Father raised the dead from death and gave them life, so the Son also gives life to those who want to live.
lunyoro: Baitu nka insenyowe okwahumbura abafu nabaha obwomezi, nukwo Nomwana abaha ati obwomezi abayenda okuha.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He did not fail to notice that he was doing well and told them to come down from heaven and gather food for you, and he poured out your hearts to the hungry and the thirsty for joy.
lunyoro: Baitu atebuzeho kaiso, baitu akakora kurungi, nabanagira enjura okuruga omu iguru, nebiro ebyokwerezamu ebyokurya, naigusa emitima yanyu engeso enungi nokusemererwa.

english: [GENERAL] I write this not to make you sad, but to make you sad, as my dear children.
lunyoro: Tindukuhandika ebigambo binu okubaswaza, baitu okubahabura nkabana bange abarukugonzebwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus said to them, “I am he,” they went back and fell to the ground.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyabagambire ati Ninyowonu, bagarukayo enyuma, bagwa hansi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] At once his disciples came to him and were amazed, because he was talking with the woman. But no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “What are you talking with her?”
lunyoro: Ahonaho abegeswabe baija; bahuni'ra baitu akab nabaza nomukazi; baitu busaho muntu ayagambire ati Nose'ra ki/ rundi ngu Kiki obaza nauwe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, look for the good and the hard work of God's people, which he has given you to do. But if you remain in his goodness, you too will be saved.
lunyoro: Nukwo orole oburungi nokugumangana ebya Ruhanga: hali abo abagwire okugumangana: baitu haliwe obwoliba noikara omu burungibwe, nukwo orajunwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For if you love God, you know that he knows you.
lunyoro: baitu wena obwaba nagonza Ruhanga, nuwe amanyirwe ogu.

english: [GENERAL] Nor is it by him that the hands of human beings are placed on you as though they were nothing. He is the only one who gives life, life, the breath, and all things.
lunyoro: nobukwakuba, okuherezebwa emikono yabantu, nkanyakuburaho ekintu, baitu nuwe wenka abaha bona obwomezi, nokuikya orwoya, nebintu byona;

english: [GENERAL] Who is this faithful servant, whom his master has appointed over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?
lunyoro: Araha omwiru ogu rubale owokwesiga, omukamawe ouyasigire abomukaye, okubaha ebyokurya byabu omu kasumi kabu?

english: [RELIGIOUS] You know that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ was rich, and he became poor for you, so that you might become rich because of his grace.
lunyoro: Baitu mumanyire embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo ngu akabali omuguda, yafoka omunaku habwanyu, nukwo inywe mufoke abaguda obwembabazize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For whoever asks receives, and whoever seeks finds, finds; and whoever knocks on it will find it.
lunyoro: Baitu wena asaba nuwe ahebwa; nanyakuse'ra nuwe azora: nanyakweranga nuwe alikingu'rwaho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the offering of this service not only meets the physical needs of the holy ones but also brings great joy to each other because of the offerings made by God.
lunyoro: Baitu okugaba okwokuhereza oku tikurukuijuza kwonka ekirengo kyamasege gabarukwera, baitu nukuhingurana obwebyokusima bingi hali Ruhanga;

english: [GENERAL] When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write a letter. I heard him say, ‘You must not write down the seven thunders that he has said.’
lunyoro: Kandi ebihinda omusanju obubyagambire, nkaba ningenda okuhandika: nahu'ra gamba ngu Bohesa emanyikirizo ebi ebihinda Omusanju ebibigambire; otabihandika.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Paul and Barnabas spoke boldly and said to them, “It is right for us to speak to you first of all the things that God has said to you. But if you have sinned against him, and are trying to make sure that we do not deserve eternal life, then we will turn to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro na Baranaba bagamba nobumanzi ngu Kikaniki'ra okubanza okubagambira inywe ekigambo kya Ruhanga. Baitu muraba mukicumire kuli nimwetegereza okutaseme'ra obwomezi obutahwaho, dora, ntuhindukira Abamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] But what do you say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart. It is the word of faith that we preach.
lunyoro: Baitu nukugamba kuta? Ngu Ekigambo kiri haihi naiwe, omu kanwa kawe, kandi omu mutima gwawe: nikyo kigambo kyokuikiriza ekituru kutebeza:

english: [RELIGIOUS] And so you were raised to life with him through faith in the power of God who raised him from death.
lunyoro: kandi mukazibwa, kandi nukwo mwahumbuirwe hamu nauwe obwokuikiriza okukora kwa Ruhanga ayamuhumbuire omu bafu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus did not trust himself, but knew everyone.
lunyoro: baitu Yesu atabesige wenka, baitu akamanya abantu bona,

english: [GENERAL] Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Canaanite,
lunyoro: na Andereya na Firipo, na Batoromayo na Matayo, na Tomasi, na Yakobo omwana wa Alifayo, na Sadayo na Simoni Omukananayo,

english: [GENERAL] For just as death came through a man, in the same way the dead came back to life.
lunyoro: Baitu nkokufa okukwaizire obwomuntu, nukwo obwokomuntu okuhumbuka kwabafu kwaizire kuti.

english: [GENERAL] They were all amazed and began to ask, “Isn't all these Galileans?
lunyoro: Bona bahuni'ra nibatangara nibagamba ngu Dora, banu bona abarukugamba tibali Bagaliraya?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Your faith has made you rich, and you have put yourself in God's presence. Happy is the one who does not judge you by what you should do.
lunyoro: Okwikiriza kwawe okwonyinakwo, oikale nakwo wenka omu maiso ga Ruhanga. Ayina omugisa ogu atarukwecwera omusango omweki ekyarusima.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He healed them all. The people were so amazed that they saw the dead speaking, the sick and the crippled, the blind seeing, and the blind seeing. They praised the God of Israel.
lunyoro: aize: nukwo nebitebe okuhuni'ra byahuni'raga, obubaboine abafu bakanwa nibabza, nabaramaire bomire, nabafu bamaiso nibarora: bakugiza Ruhanga wa Isaleri.

english: [GENERAL] The commander ordered him to be brought into the judgment hall and be kept under guard, so that he might know what they had done to him.
lunyoro: engabwa enkuru yaragira okumuleta omu rukiko, nagamba okumukaguliriza nenkoba, nukwo amanye amakuru gebigambo ebibamucwerire.

english: [GENERAL] I tell you that the punishment suffered by Sodom will be more terrible that day than that of this city.
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Okubonabonesebwa okwa Sodomu kuliba nokuganyirwa ha kiro eki okukira okworubuga oru.

english: [GENERAL] But their hearts were far away.
lunyoro: baitu emitima yabu endi hara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I tell you, there are some here who will not die until they see the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira mali nti Haroho omuli abo abemerire hanu abataliroza ha kufa na kake, okuhika obubalirira obukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Did you not know that the Scriptures say that Jesus is the power of God?”
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Tinikyo muhabira, okutamanya Ebyahandikirwe, nobugakuba amani ga Ruhanga?

english: [GENERAL] Nicodemus answered him, “What do these things mean?”
lunyoro: Nikodemo yagarukamu namugambira ati Ebigambo ebi bisoboka bita?

english: [GENERAL] So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
lunyoro: Nukwo mfokere omunyanzigwa wanyu obwokubagambira amazima?

english: [RELIGIOUS] We believe and know that you are the Holy One of God.
lunyoro: Naitwe tuikirize, tumanyire ngu niwe arukwera wa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, draw near to the Lord with all your heart, and be filled with the joy of those who do wrong.
lunyoro: Nukwo mumulize haihi omu Mukama waitu nokusemererwa kwingi, kandi abanyakusisa bati mubatinege:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then he ordered the disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.
lunyoro: Nubwo yatere'ra abegeswa batagambiraho muntu wena ngu nuwe Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus stood still and called them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
lunyoro: Yesu yayeme'ra nabeta, yabagambira ati Nimwenda mbakole ki?

english: [GENERAL] You are my friends if you do what I am commanded.
lunyoro: Inywe muli nganjani zange, obumukora ebimbaragire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Get out of here,” he said to me, “because I will send you away to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Yangambira ati Ruga hanu; baitu nyowe ndikutuma hara hali Abamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] Pilate said to them, “Do you want me to crucify you?” The chief priests answered, “There is no other king but the Emperor!”
lunyoro: Pirato yabagambira ati Ndabamba ha muti omukama wanyu? Banyakatagara abakuru bagarukamu ngu, Titinyina omukama rundi Kaisali.

english: [GENERAL] I persecuted the people of this city and persecuted them. I was put in prison for the sake of the Gentiles, both men and women.
lunyoro: kandi nahiganaga Abomuhanda gunu nokubaisa, nimbaboha nimbata omu nju zenkomo, abasaija nabakazi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I have told you from the beginning.”
lunyoro: Nauwe yagamba ati Nkaha Mukama wange? Yesu yabagambira ati Nkokunabagambire okuruga kara na kara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Be ready to pray, for I hope that you will be given the opportunity to see me when I pray.
lunyoro: Kandi ontekanirize hokurara: baitu ninihira nti obwokusaba kwanyu mulihabwa okumbona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] This became clear to all the crowd. Stephanas was a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Porchora, Nicanole, Timon, Phoenicia, and Nicolaus, a Gentile named Tychicus.
lunyoro: Ekigambo eki kyasemera hali ekitebe kyona: bakomamu Sitefano omuntu aijuire okuikiriza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera, na Firipo, na Porokoro, na Nikanoli, na Timoni, na Pamena, na Nikodemo omuhinduki owa Antyokiya:

english: [GENERAL] How happy I was when my friends arrived and made known your truth as you walk in the truth!
lunyoro: Baitu nkasemererwa muno bene baitu, obubaizire nibamanyisa amazima gawe nkokworukugendera omu mazima.

english: [GENERAL] Again he sent another servant to be his servant. So they beat him and treated him shamefully and insulted him without a thing.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okutuma omuiru rubale ondi: nogu bakamutera, nibamugiza ensoni, nibamujuma atakwasire kintu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] As the scripture says, “Whoever exalts himself will be humbled before the Lord.”
lunyoro: Nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Anyakwenyumiza, ayeyumirizege omu Mukama.

english: [GENERAL] When it was late in the morning, the twelve men who had come with him came to him and said, “Send the crowd away, and let them go to the villages and farms around the lake and gather food, because we are all here in the desert.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba nubu'sana kuira; ikumi nababiri bakaija, nibamugambira ngu Yohereza abekitebe, bagende omu maka nensi enyakuhe'raine bagonye, basake ebyokurya; baitu hanu tuli omu irungu kwonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “You yourselves know what it is like for a Jew to join a Gentile or to come to him. But God has shown me that I do not want to call anyone who is a Gentile or a Gentile.
lunyoro: yabatebeza, yabagambira ati Inywe mumanyire kyomuziro omuntu Omuyudaya okuterana nomunyaihanga, nobukwakuba okuija namberali; baitu Ruhanga akanyoleka ndeke okweta omuntu wena owomunda, nobwakuba omubi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] You are eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the inner prison.
lunyoro: mugondeze muno okuhumiza obumu Obwomwoyo omu nsengo zobusinge.

english: [GENERAL] We are ready to obey the sound of your cry for help whenever you hear it.
lunyoro: kandi twetekanize okuhu'ra niraka eryokwetonganira obutulikahuraga bwona.

english: [GENERAL] For a drunkard does not fight, but wants nothing.
lunyoro: Baitu omuculezi atarwana, ategomba ebintu:

english: [GENERAL] I am happy that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come to you, because they have done what they have done for you.
lunyoro: Nsemerirwe obwakuija kwa Sitefana na Forutunata na Akaiko: baitu ebyabuzireho habwanyu nibo babihikize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the Law was given through Moses, and grace and knowledge were given through Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Gamba ngu ebiragiro bikahebwa habwa Musa; embabazi namananu bikaba biroho habwa Yesu Kristo.

english: [GENERAL] This is the judgment that has come into the world, and people love the darkness rather than the light, because their deeds were evil.
lunyoro: Kandi gunu nugwo musango, omusana guizire omu Nsi, abantu nibagonza omuirima okukira omusana; baitu engeso zabu Zikaba zibihire.

english: [GENERAL] When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors the first time.
lunyoro: Kandi Yakobo obuyahulire ngu haroho ebyokurya ebyomere omu Misiri, yatuma baisenkuru itwe omurundi ogwokubanza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He promised in his own name through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures,
lunyoro: eyiyaraganize ira omu banabibe omu Byahandikirwe ebirukwera,

english: [GENERAL] So Paul went out and fell at him and touched him. “Don't be afraid,” he said, “because his life is in him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yasirimuka, yamugwera namubumbatira nagamba ati Mutatera empamo; baitu obwomezibwe burumu omunda.

english: [GENERAL] So then, take your feet off the cramped path, and let those who have been led by it not be led astray, and they will not find fault with you.
lunyoro: kandi muhendere ebigere byanyu empenda eziterekerire, anyakusenjura aleke okuhabisibwa, bai

english: [RELIGIOUS] and said, “I am the Lord who was raised from death,
lunyoro: nibagamba ngu Mananukwo Mukama waitu ahumbukire.

english: [GENERAL] At that time they saw the children, and they brought the child to the idol, and they were glad to do the work of their hands.
