english: [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisee stood up and prayed in front of him, “God, I thank you that I am not like everyone else—a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector, a tax collector.
lunyoro: Omufalisayo akeme'ra nasaba omundaye ati Ruhanga, ninkusima nyowe okutasisana nkabantu abandi, abakatuzi, abasezi, abasihani, nobwakubaire nkomuzinisa onu.

english: [GENERAL] Festus said in a loud voice, “Paul, you are asleep! Your great learning has made you well.”
lunyoro: Yagamba niraka erihango ati Pauro, ogwire iraro; okusoma kwawe okwingi kwakugwisa iraro.

english: [GENERAL] For the scripture says to Pharaoh, “I have raised you up to show you my power, and my name will be proclaimed throughout the whole world.”
lunyoro: Baitu ebyahandikirwe bagambira Faraho ngu Nikyo nakuimukize iwe, okwolekera omuliwe amani gange, kandi ibara ryange ligambirwe omu nsi zona.

english: [GENERAL] They did not believe in him, and they did not want to put a spell on him, but to put it on him now, and more than all the rest in the house.
lunyoro: Kandi batakiikirize, kunu tibakigonza okusibika orugonjo orwemizabibu ha kyambu, baitu okumusibika hati bunu, okukira bona abali omunju.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And if we are children, we are his children; they are his children in union with Christ; and if we suffer together, we are his children, and so are his children.
lunyoro: Kandi obuturaba tuli bana, tuli bagwetwa; abagwetwa hamu na Kristo; rundi obutuliba ntubonabona hamu, nukwo tuherwe hamu ekitinisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After the believers had been led by the churches, they lived in Phoenicia and Samaria and were able to repent of the Gentiles. They were all filled with joy.
lunyoro: Nukwo abo obubamazire okusendekerezebwa abekanisa, baraba omu Foiniki na Samaliya, nibasobo'ra okuhinduka Kwabahanga: kandi bakasemereza okusemererwa kwingi bene babu bona.

english: [GENERAL] Tell us, then, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to the Roman Emperor or not?
lunyoro: Nukwo otugambire, notekereza ota? Kisemire okuzinira kaisali omusoro, rundi tikirikyo?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Paul took the men with him, and on the next day he met them and took them into the Temple and told them the holy writings until the offering was offered for all of them.
lunyoro: Nubwo Pauro yatwara abasaija, kandi ha kiro ekyakabiri yayeyeza hamu nabo, yataho omu yekaru, namanyisa empiko ezebiro ebyokwezebwamu okuziri, okuhikya ekihongwa obukirihongwa habwabu bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I do not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘You will see the Spirit come down upon him and remain on him, and he will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
lunyoro: Nanyowe ntamumanye; baitu ogu ayantumire okubatiza namaizi nuwe yangambire ati Owolirora Omwoyo nasirimika haruwe, namuikaraho, nuwe abatiza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [GENERAL] When you were set free from sin, you became slaves of righteousness.
lunyoro: kandi obumwahairwe obugabe okuruga omu kibi, mukafoka abairu abokuhiki'ra.

english: [GENERAL] You have not yet resisted to the blood and have battled with sin.
lunyoro: Timukahakaine okuhikya esagama numurwana nekibi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, by your faith you are able to win the prize of eternal life, which will be destroyed and thrown into the fire, to the glory and honor of the revelation of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo kulengwa kwokuikiriza kwanyu okurukukira okusemera, obukulikahwa omu mu'ro, kuzoke hali okukugiza nekitinisa nokunyumizibwa ha kusuku'rwa kwa Yesu Kristo:

english: [GENERAL] After Jesus had been put out of the way, he left, and it was already late.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okuhebwa orugonjo orwemizabibu, yarugayo: obuire bukaba buizire.

english: [GENERAL] He told us that he saw an angel standing in his house, and he said, “Send him to Joppa, and call him Simon, whose name is Peter.
lunyoro: Kandi yatugambira okuyaboine maraika ayemerire omu njuye, nagamba ati Otume Yopa, oyeteyo Simoni ibararye eryakabiri Petero;

english: [GENERAL] But I have told you these things, and when the time comes to gather the grapes, you will remember what I told you.” And I have not told you these things before, but I have been with you all.
lunyoro: Leki nikyo mbagambirire, Kandi akasumi obukalikahika, muliijuka nyowe nkabagambira. Kandi ebi ntabibagambire kara, baitu bkabandi hamu nainywe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The angel answered the women, “Don't be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
lunyoro: Kandi maraika yagarukamu nagambira abakazi ngu Inywe mutatina: baitu manyire numuse'ra Yesu ayabambirwe ha muti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He is the Spirit who makes known to us the things that are God's children.
lunyoro: Nuwe Mwoyo ogu arukumanyisa nemyoyo yaitu okutuli abana ba Ruhanga:

english: [GENERAL] As on the day when the sun is setting in the desert,
lunyoro: Nka ha kiro ekyokwohebwa omu irungu

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were silent and told no one at the time what they had seen.
lunyoro: kandi bakaculera kwonka, okutagambiraho muntu omu biro ebi ekigambo kyona ekibaboine.

english: [RELIGIOUS] If God is one, he will judge those who are judged by faith, not by faith.
lunyoro: Ruhanga obwaraba ali omu, alibaihaho omusango abokusarwa omu kuikiriza, nabatali bokusarwa obwokuikiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the secrets of God are made known to them, because God made known to them.
lunyoro: Baitu ebirukumanywa bya Ruhanga nibimanyisibwa omulibo: baitu Ruhanga akabimanyisa bo.

english: [GENERAL] But if they do these things in the world, how can they do so unless they live in the world?
lunyoro: Baitu obubaraba nibakora binu omuti mubisi, balikora bata omuti gwomere?

english: [GENERAL] For when they speak evil of the worthless things of the nations, they deceive themselves by the desires of the flesh and by the desires of the house, by the same as by the power of the light from the darkness of the day.
lunyoro: Baitu obubagamba ebigambo ebikoto ebihanga ebitarumu, babihabiha omu kwegomba kwomubiri, omu rwanju, abo aba'sana okubairuka abarukugenda omu kuhaba;

english: [GENERAL] But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its coming is near.
lunyoro: baitu obumulikarora Yerusalemu amahe gagyehingulirize, nubwo mumanye ngu okuhwereke'ra kwayo kumalize okuhika.

english: [GENERAL] On that very day Herod and Pilate became friends with each other.
lunyoro: Kandi ha kiro eki Herode na Pirato nuho baganjagaine kara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They poured out many demons, poured oil on many sick people, and healed them.
lunyoro: Babinga emizimu mingi, basiga amagita ha barwaire baingi, babakiza.

english: [GENERAL] We tried to teach you in this name, and you came to Jerusalem with your teaching, and you wanted to present to us the blood of that man.
lunyoro: Tukabatanga muno okutegesa omu ibara eri: kandi dora, muijuze Yerusalemu okwegesa kwanyu, nimwenda okuleta halitwe esagama eyomuntu ogu.

english: [GENERAL] Why, then, do you say, ‘I am not the eye, but the body?’ because of the weakness of the flesh.
lunyoro: Rundi ekigambo ekirukugamba ngu Nyowe tindi eriso, nukwo ntali ekicweka kyomubiri, kiki tikirukuhu'ra enyuma yakyo?

english: [RELIGIOUS] And that is why I will bless you with increase in your love and pray in your knowledge
lunyoro: Kandi nikyo ndikusabanti okugonza kwanyu kweyongereyo ngerege okusaba omu kumanya

english: [RELIGIOUS] But many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
lunyoro: baitu habwe baingi hali Abayaudaya bakagenda baikiriza Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Why are you so afraid, you hypocrites? Then he got up and began to throw dust and the sea into the sea, and it was too late.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Kikyekibatinisa, inywe abagobya? Nubwo yaimuka yacomera embeho nenyanja: byaculera muno.

english: [GENERAL] All things that are made plain by the light are made known, but all things that are made by the light are made plain.
lunyoro: Baitu byona ebirukuhanwa omusana nibimanyisibwa: baitu kyona ekikumanyisibwamu guba musana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Are you a Galilean?” they answered. “ Look,” they answered. “He is not a prophet from Galilee.”
lunyoro: Bagarukamu Nibamugambira ngu Naiwe oli wa Galiraya? Se'ra orole nabi taruga omu Galiraya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels the power to become God's children, who live forever.
lunyoro: Ekicweka ekimu hali ebyomezi ebina kyaha bakaraika omusanju obusobozi okufoka abana ba Ruhanga anyakwomera ebiro nebiro.

english: [GENERAL] I have given them your word, and the world has hated them, because they are no part of the world, just as I am no part of the world.
lunyoro: Mbahaire ekigambokyawe, kandi ensi ekabobaba, baitu tibuli bensi, nka nyowe okuntali wensi.

english: [GENERAL] So then, they left the Council and were glad that they had been judged worthy to be put to shame by the Way.
lunyoro: Nukwo baruga omu maiso gorukurato basemerirwe obwokutekerezebwa basemerire okugizibwa ensoni Habwibara.

english: [GENERAL] But he shook the chaff into the fire, and it was not dangerous.
lunyoro: Baitu yankunkumu'ra ekyeku'ra omu mu'ro, tiyabaho kabi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The teachers of the Law and the Pharisees saw that Jesus was healed on the Sabbath, and they saw that he was healed.
lunyoro: Abahandiki Nabafalisayo bakamurole'ra obwarakiza ha kiro kya Sabiti; barole okubaramulega.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The disciples were able to give some of the money to the believers who lived in Judea.
lunyoro: Nabegeswa, nkokubasoboize okutwekera ebyokugaba bene babu abakaba baikaire Buyudaya:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Well, then, pay back to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, to the Emperor, and to God.
lunyoro: Nauwe yabagambira ati Nukwo muheyoga hali Kaisali ebya Kaisali, na hali Kaisali ebya Kaisi, na halinywe ebya Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son.
lunyoro: Baitu na Isenyowe tacwera muntu omusango, baitu akamuha Omwana okucwa omusango gwona;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to her, “My daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed from your sickness.”
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Omuisiki, okuikiriza kwawe nukwo kukukirize; oyegendere nobusinge, oki'le kimu endwara yawe.

english: [GENERAL] Everything in heaven and on earth, on earth, on the earth, and on the sea, and everything in them, I heard them saying, “Praise and honor and power will be to the one who sits on the throne forever and ever.”
lunyoro: Kandi ekinyakuhangirwe kyona ekyomu iguru, nekya hansi, nekyomu nsi, na ha nyanja, ebinyakurumu byona, nkabihu'ra nibigamba ngu Okusimwa, nokutinwa, nekitinisa, nobusobozi bibe hali ogu anyakuikalire ha kitebe kyobukama, okuhikya ebiro nebiro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were filled with pity and said to him, “Yes, but you have not read that you must give thanks to God for his abundant grace.
lunyoro: bamuganyira, nibamugambira ati Ego: timukasomaga ngu Omu kanwa ka bana abato nabenkerembe ohikirize okukugiza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Suddenly a man came to him and worshiped him. “Sir,” he said, “if you want to, you can make me clean.”
lunyoro: Kandi, dora, hakaija namberali omugenge, yamuramya nagamba ati Mukama wange, obworaba nogonza, nosobora okunsemeza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All of us have been given grace through the free gift of Christ.
lunyoro: Naitwe itwena tukahabwa embabazi nkendengo eyekisembo kya Kristo okweri.

english: [GENERAL] Those who make a vow to God will change it for a second time; those who take away your bed and your bed will not be able to pay attention to it.
lunyoro: Anyakukutonganiza omuhindu'lege obwakabiri: anyakukutwara ekitabu kyawe nobwomezi bwawe otalikimuima.

english: [GENERAL] It is not because of your lack of faith that you are working with one another in your joy, but because of your lack of faith that you are able to do.
lunyoro: Tibuli obwokulema okuikiriza kwanyu, baitu tuli bakozi batahi banyu, omu kusemererwa kwanyu: baitu okuikiriza nukwo kubemerize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus stood still and told them to bring him to him. When he arrived, he said,
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yayeme'ra nartagira bamulete namberali: obuyairire yagamba ati

english: [RELIGIOUS] You know that you will receive the reward of the inheritance, because you belong to the Lord.
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu mulihabwa Mukama waitu empera yobugwetwa: muli bomukama waitu Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
lunyoro: Narora bamaraika musanju abeme'ra omu maiso ga Ruhanga; kandi bahabwa engwara musanju.

english: [RELIGIOUS] There is no difference between you and me about this matter, but your heart is not right in God's sight.
lunyoro: Tunyina mugabo nobukwakuba okubagana omu kigambo kinu: baitu omutima gwawe tiguto'rokere omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] Greetings to you, Pudens, Linus, Claudius, and all the rest of the believers.
lunyoro: Muramukye Pudente, na Lino, na Karaudio, na bene baitu bona.

english: [GENERAL] For our ancestors ate manna in the desert, just as the scripture says, “He gave them bread from heaven.”
lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe bakary7a emanu omu irungu; nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Akabaha ebyokurya ebyarugire omu iguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Much more, then, since we have been put right with God through his blood, we will be saved through his grace.
lunyoro: nukwo okukira muno, hati bunu obutuihibweho omusango omusagamaye, tuliijunwa hali ekiniga habwe.

english: [GENERAL] After spending some time in Troas, we arrived in Ptolemais, where we greeted the believers and stayed with them for a day.
lunyoro: Naitwe obutwamazire orugendo rwaitu okuruga Turo, twahika Potolemai, kandi twaramukya bene baitu, twaikara nabo ekiro kimu.

english: [GENERAL] But we, young people, keep on guard and put on the breastplate of faith and love and of a helmet to be saved.
lunyoro: baitu itwe abanyamasana twerindege, tujwaire ekya ha kifuba ekyokuikiriza ekyokugonza, nenkofira eyokunihira okujunwa.

english: [GENERAL] Let us not now judge one another, for God has judged us, so that anyone should not accuse another, be guilty of a crime or of a crime against another, and be put to death.
lunyoro: Nukwo tuleke hati okucwerangana omusango: baitu haroho omusango ogumwacwerire, omuntu wena aleke okuletera enkonge mugenziwe, rundi enkongo mugenzagwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But when Jesus heard it, he said to him, “Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
lunyoro: baitu Yesu obuyahulire yamugarukamu ati Otatina: ikiriza kwonka, arakizibwa.

english: One of the teachers of the Law met with Jesus and asked him,
lunyoro: omu hali abegesa ebiragiro, yamukaguza

english: [RELIGIOUS] And every spirit that does not confess that Jesus is not of God, and the spirit that remains of the enemy of Christ has not yet come into the world.
lunyoro: Kandi omwoyo gona ogutayatura Yesu tiguli gwa Ruhanga: kandi nugwo mwoyo gomunyanzigwa wa Kristo ogwamara okuija, na hati gumazire kuhika omu nsi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus heard these things, he was amazed and turned around and said to the crowd who had followed him, “I tell you, I have never seen anyone in Israel before.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyahukrire ebi yamutanga'ra, yahinduka yagambira abekitebe abamuhondire ati Nimbagambira nti Tinkabonaga kuikiriza kwingi kuti, nobuhokuba omu Isareri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Jesus came a third time and said to them, “Get up, and rest! The hour has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to the power of sinners.”
lunyoro: Yagaruka okuija obwakasatu, yabagambira ati Mugwijagire hati bunu, muhumule: kiramara; akasumi kahikire; dora, Omwana womuntu tahebwayo omu Mukono yabasisis.

english: [GENERAL] You fools! You can stop speaking what is good. For what is in your heart is what the mouth speaks.
lunyoro: Inywe abana benjoka, numusobora muta muihire okugamba ebugambo ebisemire. Baitu ebiijura omu mutima, akanwa nibyo kagamba.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The High Priest stood up in front of them and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? Why are you trying to stop me?”
lunyoro: Nyakatagara omukuru wabu yayeme'ra hagati nakaguza Yesu nagamba ati Torukwanukura na kake? Kiki ekibarukukuhambiriza?

english: [GENERAL] When I come into the world, I am the light of the world.
lunyoro: Obunyikara omu nsi, ninyowe musana gwensi.

english: [GENERAL] He rolled a scroll out of the way, and it was against us; and he rolled it up from the cross.
lunyoro: hati omu muhito ogukaba gutangirwe: kandi ogu akabali omunyanzigwa waitu narugamu, kandi yagubinga ha muti.

english: [GENERAL] When the official heard this, he gave him the body to Joseph.
lunyoro: kandi obuyakihulire hali omunyakihanda, yaha Yusufu omutumbi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the book was given, four living creatures and twelve elders fell down before the Lamb, each with his finger full of incense and the other with the words of the prayers of the holy ones.
lunyoro: Obuyahairwe ekitabu, ebyomezi ebina nabakuru amakumi abiri mu bana bakainama hansi omu maiso Gomwana Gwentama, bayina enanga omu omu, ibiri ijuire ebirukuboya, nibyo byokusaba byabarukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they arrived, they gathered the church together and told them all that God had done with them, and he opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
lunyoro: kandi obubaizire, nibesoroza abekanisa, babatebeza byona Ruhanga ebiyakozire hamu nabo, kandi okuyabakingulireho oruigi orwokuikiriza hali abamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] For the gift given to him is not given by itself, but by his own free gift.
lunyoro: Baitu ekyahairwe ekitnisa kitakihabwe omu kigambo kinu, obwekitinisa ekirukukira.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the mediator is not a human being, but God is one.
lunyoro: Baitu omuteranizi tali habwomuntu omu; baitu Ruhanga ali omu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] so that you will obey the word of God by your conduct, which you have been taught. And you will do many other things like this.
lunyoro: mumaraho ekigambo kya Ruhanga obwengeso zanyu, ezimwayegeseze inywe: kandi mukora ebindi bingi nkebi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus went with them. While he was not far from the house, the official sent a message to the man who had been with him, “Don't bother to come in, my Lord!” But I don't deserve to go in to the tomb.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagenda nabo. Kandi obwakaba atagiri hara enju, omunyoro owekihanda yatuma enganjanize namberali, nibamugambira ngu Mukama wange otegadya okuija: baitu tindukuseme'ra iwe okutaha omunda yorusurwange:

english: [RELIGIOUS] The God of these people of Israel chose our ancestors and exalted the people when they lived in Egypt, and he destroyed them with a mighty hand.
lunyoro: Ruhanga wabantu banu aba Isaleri akakomamu baisenkuru itwe, kandi yanyumiza abantu obubaikaireyo omu nsi ya Misiri, kandi yabaihayo nomukono ogunyumizibwa.

english: [GENERAL] The Jews answered, “Do you want to call me? But he said, “Where I am going, you cannot go.”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bagamaba ngu Nayenda kweyita? Baitu nagamba ati nambere ndukugenda timulisobora kuijayo.

english: [GENERAL] There will be earthquakes, and then the time will come when the dead will be raised to life, and the powers that are in heaven will be shaken.
lunyoro: kandi halibaho emisisa emikoto, nebihe norufu biribaho ahandi nahandi; halibaho nebinyakukanga nobusobozi oburuga haiguru.

english: [GENERAL] If you call out to your Father, who judges people, and does not gather them together, just as everyone else does, then you will spend your days in fear.
lunyoro: Kandi obumuraba nimweta Isinywe ogu anyakucwa omusango hatali okusororamu abantu, nkomulimo gwomuntu wena okuguli, mumale ebiro byanyu obumugonya hansi omu kutina:

english: [RELIGIOUS] And now, Lord, see how they are doing, and let your servants speak your word.
lunyoro: Kandi, hati bunu Mukama, dora okukanga kwabu,obahe abairu bawe okugamba ekigambo kyawe

english: [RELIGIOUS] We have kept our hope sure and do not be shaken by it, because we are the ones who have promised that we will be faithful.
lunyoro: tukwatire kimu okwatura okunihira kwaitu, kuleke okutengetatengeta; baitu ayaraganize nuwe wokwesiga:

english: [GENERAL] What he saw and heard was what he said, and no one believed his words.
lunyoro: Ekyaboine nekiyahulire nikyo agamba; kandi busaho muntu aikiriza ebigambobye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “If you knew what God had given you, and who it was who said to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would ask him, and he would give you a well of water.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Kakuba omunyire ekisembo ekya Ruhanga, nogu arukukugambisa ati Apa nywe; iwe wakumusabire, nauwe yakukuhaire amaizi agomire.

english: [GENERAL] For we have the hope of the truth without any hypocrisy and without hypocrisy.
lunyoro: nuho tuyina okunihira okwamazima okutarukwangasana, okutatengeta tengeta:

english: [RELIGIOUS] That is why he has given us the very clothes that make us very rich, and so that we may be his share in the work of God's service, in order to keep us from the desires of the world.
lunyoro: eki nikyo yatuheriremu emiragoye eyomuhendo mwingi, nukwo obututerana omu mulingo gwa Ruhanga, obutwihaho omu kwegomba okuli omunsi:

english: [GENERAL] The commander took him by the hand and met him and asked the commander, “What do you have to tell me?”
lunyoro: Omunyakihanda yamukwata ha Mukono, yayesorora yamukaguza omubihwa ati Kigambo ki ebyonyina okuntebeza?

english: [RELIGIOUS] He told them many things and told them the good news.
lunyoro: kandi yabagambi'raga ebindi bingi, natebeza abantu ebigambo ebirungi;

english: [GENERAL] For just as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so he did not see it.
lunyoro: Baitu nka Yona okuyafokere akokuro'raho hali Abanineve, nukwo

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Jesus said to the servants who had seen the stone, “The Passover meal is ready, but the invited guests are not happy.”
lunyoro: Nubwo yagambira abairune rubale ati Obugenyi butekanize, baitu abayeserwe batasemere.

english: [GENERAL] After Jesus had finished doing all, there was a violent earthquake in that country, and he began to pray.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazireho byona, hakabaho ekihe kingi omu nsi egi; yabanza okusega.

lunyoro: Baitu abandi bakatera enaku nibagamba ngu Baijuire amarwa agomutara'ra.

lunyoro: Kandi eki obukyakozirwe, nabandi abarwaire abomuuizinga baija, bakizibwa: kandi abo batuha ekitinisa kingi;

lunyoro: Okubandiza ha sagama ya Aberi, okuhika ha saga ya Zakaliya, ayaferire hagati yekyoto na yekaru: ego, nimbagambira nti erijunanizibwa abobusinge bunu.

lunyoro: Baitu Pauro na Baranaba bakaikarayo omu Antyokiya, nibegesa, nibatebeza ekigambo kya Mukama waitu, hamu nabandi baingi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “If I tell you evil, forgive me; for what do you want me to do?”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugarukamu ati Obundaba ngambire kubi, onyomereze ekibi: baitu kiraba kiri kirungi nonte'ra ki?

lunyoro: Yesu obuyaboine okuikiriza kwabu yagambira anyakuzingamire ati Mwana wange, ebibi byawe bikuihirweho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He took the cup, gave thanks to God, and gave thanks to them, and gave it to them. They all drank from it.
lunyoro: Yakwata empwahwa, kandi obuyamazire okusima, yabaha: baginywaho bona.

english: [GENERAL] I am the light. Those who enter into me will be saved, and they will pass away and come out of me, and I will see the light.
lunyoro: Ninyowe irembo: omuntu obwataha amuli nyowe alijunwa, alihingura, alituruka, alibona irisizo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, spend the rest of your time in the body, not in human desires, but in God's will.
lunyoro: nukwo mumale ebiro byanyu ebisigaireho mukyali omu mubiri, hatali omu kwegomba kwabantu, baitu omwebi Ruhanga ebyagonza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But to this very day, when Moses was read everything, the veil was placed in their hearts.
lunyoro: Baitu okuhikya hati, Musa obwasomebwa bwona, ekyokwesweke'ra kiikaire ha mutima gwabu.

english: [GENERAL] He took the child by the hand and said to her, “Don't touch the hand,” and her name was indicating, “Son, I tell you, get up!”
lunyoro: Yamukwata ha Mukono nagamba ati Talisa kumi; okumanyisibwa kwakyo ngu Omuisiki, ninkugambira nti Imuka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to Peter, “Put your sword back in its place. The sword that my Father has given me is not what you have given me.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagambira Petero ati Ga'ramu empirima omu kirweyo kyayo: empwahwa isenyowe eyiyampaire tinginywe?

english: [GENERAL] Two of them were married, Joseph called Barabad, who was the father of Judas and Matthias.
lunyoro: Kandi bakakomamu babiri, Yusufu arukwetwa Barabasa, ibararye erindi Yusito, na Matiya,

english: [RELIGIOUS] For just as God was faithful, our message to you is not true.
lunyoro: Baitu nka Ruhanga okwali wokwesiga, ekigambo kyaitu halinywe tikiri ego na nangwa.

lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira nti ha kiro kyomusango ensi ya Sodomu okubonabonesebwa kwayo kuliba nokuganyirwa okukira okwawe.

english: [GENERAL] For I have the baptism to be baptized with, and I am glad that it is already time for me to be baptized.
lunyoro: Baitu nyina okubatizibwa okudibatizibwamu; nanyowe nsalirwa okuhika obukulikahiki'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You Philippians know that when I left Macedonia, there was no church with me in the matter of circumcision, but you yourselves.
lunyoro: Kandi mumanyire inywe Abafiripi ngu omu kubanza kwenkiri, obunarugire Makedoni, busaho kanisa eyateraine nanyowe omu kigambo kyokugaba nokuhabwa, rundi inywe inywenka;

english: [GENERAL] It is better to be concerned with the good things that are being done at all times, and not only with you.
lunyoro: Kirungi okutinaga omu bigambo ebirungi ebiro byona, kandi tibuli bwonka obunyikara nainywe.

english: [GENERAL] In the same way that you have richly blessed them, their joy and their prosperity have been tested by the richness of their generosity.
lunyoro: hati omu muhito ogwabalengere muno, okusemererwa kwabu okwingi muno, namasege gabu amaingi, bikasagi'ra hali obuguda obwokugaba kwab.

english: [GENERAL] So then, if we have hope, we speak with all boldness.
lunyoro: Kandi obutunyina okunihira okwinaine abo, ntubaza nobumanzi bwingi,

english: [GENERAL] For I used to make my body unclean, and I came to be unclean; and when I preached to others, I would not be acceptable to them.
lunyoro: baitu nyesaliza nyenka omubiri gwange, ningulema, rundi obundikamara okutebeza abandi, nyowe nyenka ntaba atarukusimwa.

english: [GENERAL] And I beg you, then, to do this more quickly for me.
lunyoro: kandi okukora muno nimbesengereza okukira muti, nukwo nga'rwe bwango namberemuli.

english: [GENERAL] For the Son of Man goes, just as it is written about him. How good it would have been for that man if he had not been born!”
lunyoro: Baitu Omwana womuntu nagenda, nkokukyamuhandikirweho: baitu kyakubaire kirungi hali omuntu ogu kakuba atarazairwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to the servants who had bought the water, “Take these things away from here! Stop making my Father's house a marketplace!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira abakaba nibagura amaiba ati Muiheho binu; mutafora enju ya Isenyowe enju yokuhingisamu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do not be deceived by the outward appearance, but by the outward appearance of the heart, and by the outward appearance of the heart, you will be made unclean by God.
lunyoro: Mutalibihirwa ebisuba; Ruhanga taterwa enaku:

english: [GENERAL] For we ourselves were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, and carried out our desires and pleasures over many trials, and we were made slaves of sin and of sin.
lunyoro: baitu naitwe tukaba tuli abadomadoma kara, abatarukuhu'ra, ababihibwa, nituhereza okwegomba nokwesemeza okwemiringo nyingi, kandi tukaba nituikara omuitima ni'hali abokunoba Kandi ntu

english: [GENERAL] They went out over the other side of the lake, and when they had gone over to the other side of the lake, an angel came out of him and led them out by the same side of the lake. At once an angel came out of him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubahinguire ha balinzi abokubanza nabakabiri, bahika ha ruigi orwekyoma, orurukabakingukiraho rwonka; kandi baturuka, bahingura omu ikute erimu; ahonaho maraika yamurugaho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They will proclaim the Good News to the people without a messenger. As the scripture says, “How good is their feet! They proclaim the Good News!”
lunyoro: Kandi balitebeza bata obubatatumwa? Nkokukyahandikirwe ngu Ebigere kyabu ka birungi abarukutebeza enjiri eyebirungi!

english: [GENERAL] But they did not understand the scripture, ‘He must rise from death.’
lunyoro: baitu bakaba bataketegerize ekyahandikirwe ngu Kimuhikirire okuhumbuka omu bafu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And God, who is patient with you, who is the one who is the one who is the one who is the one who is the one who will bring you into being by means of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga owokugumisiriza abahe inywe okuterana hamu omu kutekereza kwanyu okurukwera omu mulingo gwa Kristo Yesu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the time had come for all the people in Asia to hear the word of the Lord, both Jews and Gentiles.
lunyoro: Ibyo bikamara emyaka mingi. Kandi bona abakaba nibaikara Asiya bakahu'ra ekigambo kya Mukama waitu, Abayudaya Nabayonani.

english: [GENERAL] I did not look for the good, and I found great joy in the harvest, and I found that the harvesters had called me to their mother.
lunyoro: Ntaireho emikono emirungi, ntaireho okusemererwa okwingi;taije hali abakwenda okunyeta nyina.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Jewish authorities made fun of him and said to him, “How long will you be trying to convince us that you are the Messiah?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bamwehinguliriza nibamugambira ngu Olihikya nkaha okutugurukizagurukiza/ Okworaboli Kristo, otugambire mali.

english: [GENERAL] We told Titus, as he had in the past, that he was faithful to the promise that these blessings will be upon you.
lunyoro: Kandi naitwe tukagambi'ra Tito nkokuyabandize kara, nukwo ahikirize ati embabazi ezi omulinywe.

english: [GENERAL] If you hear his voice now,
lunyoro: hati bunu obumuraba numuhu'ra irakarye,

english: [RELIGIOUS] I appeal to the Lord to help him, and I urge him to think about the Lord with all my heart.
lunyoro: Ndamwesengereza kandi numunihira omu Mukama waitu okutatekereza kimu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “Didn't I make twelve of you, and one of you is a devil?”
lunyoro: Yesu yabagarukamu ati Tininyowe nabekomure inywe ikumi nababiri, kandi omu halinywe wa Setani?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus reached out and touched him, and he said, “I want to. Be made clean.” At once his feet were healed.
lunyoro: Yago'ra omukonogwe yamukoraho, nagamba ati Ningonza: semezebwa. Ahonaho ebigengebye bikasemezebwa.

english: [GENERAL] And do we hear him speaking in our own language?
lunyoro: kandi itwe ntuhu'ra tuta omuomu omu ngambo zowaitu nambere twazairwe?

english: But if there are disputes about words, names, and commands, then you must examine yourselves. I do not want to be a judge of these matters.
lunyoro: baitu obuharaba haroho empaka ezebigambo namabara nebiragiro byanyu inywenka, murole inywe; nyowe tindukwenda okuba omucwi wemisango obwebigambo ebi.

english: [GENERAL] Simon answered, “I want to see him, who has given me so much more.” He said to him, “You are well.”
lunyoro: Simon yagarukamu nagamba ati Nindenge'ra ogu ouyalekerire ebingi. Yamugambira ati Ocwire kurungi.

english: [GENERAL] Some of them were sitting in the marketplace, and as they heard the message,
lunyoro: Kandi abandi nibo basigirwe nambere ahali a mahwa; abo obubahu'ra ekigambo,

english: [RELIGIOUS] “What do you people in Galilee see in heaven,” they asked. “Jesus, who was taken up to be in heaven, will come down and go to heaven, just as he had seen him.”
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Inywe, abantu Abagaliraya numuro'ra ki haiguru? Yesu ogu abaihirweho okutwara omu iguru, nukwo aliija ati nkokumurozire nagenda omu Iguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the Jew is a free man, and the circumcision of the heart is that of the Spirit, not of a letter only. His grace comes not from human beings, but from God.
lunyoro: baitu owomunda nuwe Muyudaya: kandi okusarwa okwomutima omu mwoyo nukwo kusarwa, okutali omunyuguta zonka: nekisembo tikiruga hali abantu, baitu hali Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do not be fooled by the Holy Spirit, who was poured out on you on the day of your being saved.
lunyoro: Kandi mutaganyisa Omwoyo Ogurukwera Ruhanga, oumwatererweho akokuro'raho hali ekiro ekyokucungurwa.

english: [GENERAL] You have ears, don't you hear? Don't you remember?
lunyoro: Munyina amatu, timurukuhu'ra? Kandi timurukuijuka?

english: [GENERAL] You were like sheep, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Shepherd of your souls.
lunyoro: Baitu mukaba numuhaba nkentama, baitu hati bunu mugarukire hali Omulisa kandi Omurolerezi owobwomezi bwanyu.

english: [GENERAL] to be quiet, do your own work, and do your own work with your hands, as we told you.
lunyoro: kandi mukorre ebyanyu inywenka, nokukora emirimo nemikono yanyu, nkokutwabaragire;

lunyoro: Abegeswa barorangana nibagurukyagurukya ouyagambireho okwali.

lunyoro: kandi obubacwireho ebinyakusibika, babisiga omu nyanja, kandi nubwo baboho'ra emiguha eyengahi erungika: kandi bahanikira embeho eberu eyahamutwe gwekyombo, nibase'ra okutaha ha musa.

lunyoro: Rundi nyowe mpike hali okuhumbuka omu bafu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugambira ati Mukama waitu otwoleke Isitwe, nukwo kiratumara.

lunyoro: ekiragiro ekihyaka ninkibahandikira ekiri kyamazima omuruwe onomulinywe; baitu omuirima gwahwaho, nomusana gwamazima gubandize hati okujwa.

english: [EDUCATION] One of the crowd said, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali ekitebe aka mugambira ati Omwegesa gambira mugenzi wange abagane nanyowe obugwetwa bwaitu.

lunyoro: Kandi nikyo twekambira, rundi tuli hanu rundi nturoho, okusemera omu maisoge.

lunyoro: Kandi mugambira Arakipo ngu Werinde okuhereza okuwahairwe omu Mukama waitu okukuhikiriza.

lunyoro: Kiki ekibahinzire okumanya ebingambire? Baitu timusobora kuhu'ra bigambo byange.

english: [GENERAL] For if this thing is told by the king, we will see him, and you will be put to death.
lunyoro: baitu ekigambo kinu obukiraba nikigambirwa omulemi, turamusobo'ra, nainywe turabaihaho omusango.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus went up into the mountain and sat down with his disciples.
lunyoro: Yesu yatemba ha rusozi yaika'rayo hamu nabegeswabe.

lunyoro: Baitu wena aryetweka omutwarogwe wenka.

lunyoro: Nanyowe obundihanukwa ha nsi, ndicundira namberendi bona.

lunyoro: Baitu mananukwo ntu'sana okulengwa obwokujaga'ra kwa hati, baitu kwa busa: baitu busaho kigambo ekitulisobora okutongana obwokuso'rokana kunu.

lunyoro: bamukaguza ngu Omwegesa, Musa akagamba ati Omuntu obwafa, atazaire bana,omugenziwe aswere mukaziwe,

english: [GENERAL] For just as he promised, we are waiting for a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness is to dwell.
lunyoro: baitu nkomuragogwe okuguli, itwe ntutegereza iguru erihyaka nensi empyaka, nambere haikara okuhiki'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He will not fail to have a father. You have obeyed God's command because of your good deeds.
lunyoro: talireka okutina ise. Mukaihaho ekigambo ekya Ruhanga obwengeso zanyu ezimwahairwe.

english: [GENERAL] So then, let the Devil not deceive us, because we are not ignorant of his plans.
lunyoro: nukwo Setani aleke okutusingura: baitu tituli nkabatakumanya ebyamagezige.

english: [GENERAL] “He has saved others,” they answered. “He is the King of Israel alone, and we will believe in him now.”
lunyoro: bagamba ngu Akajuna abandi; tarukusobora kwejuna wenka, Nuwe Mukama wa Isareri; aruge hati bunu ha muti, naitwe turamuikiriza.

english: [GENERAL] If the Kingdom divides only, then the Kingdom cannot last.
lunyoro: Obukama obuburaba bubaganizibwemu bwonka, obukama obu tibusobora kuikaraho.

english: [GENERAL] The people answered, “The blood of Jesus has been poured out for us for the sake of our children.”
lunyoro: Abantu bona bagarukamu, nibagamba ngu Esagamaye ikale halitwena ha bana baitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All of you, together with all the people of Israel, know that by means of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, you have been made a sign that God raised him from death, because he lives here before you.
lunyoro: Manya inywena, nabantu bona aba Isaleri ngu Omu ibara rya Yesu Kristo owa Nazalesi, ayatucwerire inywe ha muti, Ruhanga ouyahumbuire omubafu, habwogu onu ayemerire omu bafu, habwanyu onu ayemerize hanu omu maiso ganyu ayomire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Many priests were killed, but death made them live.
lunyoro: Kandi abo bakaforwa banyakatagara baingi. baitu okufa kukabatanga okuikaraho:

english: [GENERAL] and have put on the new man, who will be made new in the likeness of the one who created him.
lunyoro: kandi mujwaire omuhyaka arukuforwa omuhya obwokumanya omu kisisani kyogu ayamuhangire:

english: [RELIGIOUS] You have followed our teaching, and you have received the Lord's message with great joy by means of the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi mwakuratira omulingo gwaitu, kandi ogwa Mukama waitu, obumwahairwe ekigambo hamu nokusemererwa Okwomwoyo Ogurukwera;

english: [GENERAL] So then, those who are married to each other do well, but those who do not marry should do better.
lunyoro: Nukwo anyakusweza omuharawe akora kurungi, baitu ogu atamusweza akira okukora kurungi.

english: [GENERAL] But as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to the Jews, “It was right for me to have you circumcised, you Jews.
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro obwakaba nagenda okwasamya akanwake, Galio yagambira Abayudaya, kyakubaireho amananu ekigambo ekyokusobeza, rundi okusisa okusisa okubi, inywe Abayudayani, kyakuhikirire nyowe okubacwera omusango:

english: [RELIGIOUS] They called out to him, “Do not speak at all or teach in the name of Jesus.”
lunyoro: Kandi babeta nibabatere'ra baleke okugamba na kake, nobukwakuba okwegesa omu ibara rya Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He knows that the Law has not been given to a righteous person, but to the wicked and the good and the defiled and the defiled and the defiled and the murderers of their fathers and their mothers.

lunyoro: kandi baraba barugire omu ruganda rwabu bonka, omu kuikiriza okwa isenkuru itwe Iburahimu okwakaba ayinakwo omu kutasarwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus rebuked them not to speak to anyone, because he had added this too much to them.
lunyoro: kandi yabatere'ra batagambirago muntu: baitu nkokuyayeyongire bati muno muno okukirangana.

english: [GENERAL] But when I saw that they did not walk in the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter in front of all of them, “If you are a Jew, you are a Gentile, why do you try to force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?”
lunyoro: Baitu obunaboine nti tibagendera omu mazima agenjiri, nkagambira Kefa omu maiso gabu bona nti Iwe Omuyudaya obwaraba nokkuratira engeso zabamahanga ezitali Zabayudaya, kiki iwe ohambiriza Abamahanga okukuratira engeso Zabayonani?

english: [RELIGIOUS] I am telling the truth in union with Christ, and I do not lie to you, and my conscience tells me that I am truthful.
lunyoro: NINGAMBA amazima omu Kristo, tindukubiha, nomutima gwange nugu'manyisa omu

english: [GENERAL] I saw that in this vision the horses and their riders were caught with their riders like torches, and the heads of horses were like the heads of lions. Fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of them.
lunyoro: Nukwo naboine nti embarasi omu kwolekwa kunu, nabo abaziikalireho, bajwaire ebyahakifua nkebyomu'ro, nebya huakinso nekiberiti: nemitwe yembarasi nkemitwe yentale: nomu minwa yazo harugamu omu'ro nomuika, nekibiriti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu nikirahuka engamira okuraba omu kanyindo kenkinzo, okukira omuguda okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] so that you will be without fault, and so that you will be safe and sound in the sight of God, the children of God, who are without spot from the world, in the darkness of the world.
lunyoro: nukwo muikale mutaroho ekyokuhanwa, mutanyina itima, abana ba Ruhanga abatanyina kamogo, hagati omu businge obuhabire oburukwanga, nambere murukuikara numutasarwa omunsi,

english: [RELIGIOUS] After saying this, Jesus said to the sky, “Lazarus, come on out and let us go!”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagambira haiguru ati Razaro, turuka oije.

english: [GENERAL] He did not take advantage of us there, and he made their hearts glad by their faith.
lunyoro: kandi atasorole itwe naho, nasemeza emitima yabu obwokuiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For just as you have prayed for purity, so you must be holy in all your conduct.
lunyoro: baitu nkogu ayabesere okwarukwera, nukwo nainywe mube abarukwera omu ngeso zona;

english: [GENERAL] You little children, I am with you a little while longer. You will seek me, just as I said to the Jews, ‘You cannot go where I am going,’ and so I tell you now.
lunyoro: Abana abato, ekicu kike nkiri hamu nainywe. Mulinse'ra: kandi nkokonagambire Abayudaya nti Handukugenda, inywe timusobora kuijayo; kandi na inywe nukwo ndukubagambira hati bunu.

english: [GENERAL] They have a king who is an angel of the abyss. He is a member of the Jewish party, a member of the party, and a member of the party is a Gentile.
lunyoro: Ziyina omukama wazo, maraika owekina ekitayina hokugarukira: ibararye Ruhanga Omuyudaya owa baheburaniya, kandi Omuhangi owekitinisa.

english: [GENERAL] But I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me. If you tell the man, ‘Go,’ he will go; or if, ‘Come,’ you will go,’ then my servant will say, ‘Do this,’ and ‘Do this as you say.’
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe ndi muntu mulemwa, nyina abaserikale abandukulema: obungambira ogu nti Genda, agenda: nondi nti Ija, aija: nomuirui wange nti Gira oti, nukwo agira ati.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “Before the rooster crows, the rooster crows.
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Omulinywe nukwo mwogibwe.

english: [GENERAL] Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming in which all those in the graves will hear it.
lunyoro: Mutahuni'ra eki: baitu akasumi nikaija, bona abali omu bituro

english: [GENERAL] The cloth that had been on his head was not put in a cloth with a cloth around his waist, but was rolled up by itself.
lunyoro: ekikoba ekikaba kiri ha mutwegwe kitatairwe hamu nengoge zekitani, baitu kitairwe hawakyo kyonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I tell you that in the last days there will be mockers, who will carry their own desires out without fear of God.
lunyoro: babagambire inywe ngu Omu biro byenyuma halibaho abasekerezi, nibakuratira okwegomba kwabu bonka okutarukutina Ruhanga:

english: [GENERAL] He ordered the officer to be kept watch over him and to give him time to wait on him, so that he would not be able to see anyone with him.
lunyoro: Kandi yaragira omunyakihanda okumulinda, kandi amuhe omwanya; nokutaganga enganjaniye wena okumurora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] If someone asks you, ‘What are you doing here?’ say, ‘The Lord is looking for him, and at once he will answer you.’
lunyoro: Omuntu obwaraba nabagambira ati Nimuko'ra ki kinu? Inywe mugambe ngu Mukama waitu naguse'ra; ahonaho araguga'ra kunu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And this scripture says, “Believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that you will believe in him for a whole month in his Law.”
lunyoro: Kandi bunu bukahandikwa, muikirize ngu Yesu nuwe Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga, kandi obumuikiriza mube nobwo mezi omu ibararye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But when Jesus heard this, he said, “This sickness is not about killing itself, but about the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified by it.”
lunyoro: baitu Yesu obutahulire yagamba ati Oburwaire bunu tibuli bwokumuita, rundi habwekitinisa kya Ruhanga, omwana wa Ruhanga anyumizibwe obwobu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to her, “Believe me, woman, the time has come for a man to honor his Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati omukazi, ikiriza nyowe, akasumi nikaija, akamutaliramizamuga Isitwe ha rusozi runu nobuhokuba Yerusalemu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, the Law has become our teaching to bring us into union with Christ, and we are put right with God by faith.
lunyoro: nukwo ebiragiro byafokere biti nkomwegesa waitu okutuleta hali Kristo, tuihibweho omusango obwokuikiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I am accusing you, then, that you should not be upset with those who have come from the Gentiles to turn to God.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukucwera omusango nti tuleke okubatuntuza abarugire omu Bamahanga okuhindukira Ruhanga;

english: [RELIGIOUS] He ordered the crowd to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves and gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before them, and they placed them before the crowd.
lunyoro: Yaragira ekitebe okuika'ra hansi: yakwata emigati musanju yasima, yacwamu, yaha abegeswabe okugita omu maiso gabu: bagita omu maju gekitebe.

english: [GENERAL] raise your head, and look straight ahead of you. Let the people see the secret, but do not see the light of the truth. Those who look at you in the darkness will be punished by the Father.
lunyoro: Rora omu maiso gabantu, oyerange bwerebwere, kyonka otahe'le omusana:nukwo'So anyakurora omu nsita alikuha empera.

english: [GENERAL] So they left the prison and went into Lydia's house. When they saw the believers, they were so encouraged and left.
lunyoro: Kandi baturuka omu nju yenkomo, bataha omu nju ya Rudiya: kandi obubaboine bene babu, babahumuza, barugayo.

english: [GENERAL] He was hungry and wanted to eat, but while they were asleep, his heart was made well.
lunyoro: kandi yarumwa enjara, yayenda okurya: baitu obubakaba nibaihura, omutimagwe gwahingisibwa;

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Peter was standing outside. The other disciple, known as the High Priest, came out and spoke to the servant girl and took Peter away.
lunyoro: baitu Petero akaba ayemerire aheru ha ruigi. Kandi omwegeswa ogu ondi akaba amanyirwe nyakatagara omukuru wabu, yaturuka yabaza nomuisiki ogu omukumirizi, yatahyamu Petero.

english: [GENERAL] They did not take any oil, but the wise ones took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
lunyoro: baitu abagezi bakatwara amagita omunsale zabu hamu netabaza zabu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the sake of kings and all the elders, so that we may be clothed with peace and peace, and may be refreshed by the fear of God and by the obedience of our lives.
lunyoro: habwabakama nabakuru bona; nukwo tuikalege nobusinge nokuhumura omu hiro byaitu, omu kutina Ruhanga kwona nomu kwerinda.

english: [GENERAL] For the road is cramped by the path that leads to life, and the path that leads to life is cramped by the path that leads to life.
lunyoro: Baitu irembo lifunzire nomuhanda ogutaha omu bwomezi muke, nabo abaguzora bake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus looked around at him and said, “What is it, sir?” He answered, “Your prayers and your words are like sweet-smelling incense in God's presence.
lunyoro: Yamuleta namberali nagamba ati Kikim Mukama wange? Yamugambira ati Okusaba kwawe nokugamba kwawe bitembere nkekijukyo omu maiso ga Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “The secrets of the Kingdom of God have been given to you, but they are outside, and everything is written in parables.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Inywe mukahebwa ensita ezobukama bwa Ruhanga: baitu bali abaheru, byona bibacwerwa omu nfumo:

english: [GENERAL] Let us, then, go back to him outside the camp and bury his own body.
lunyoro: Nukwo itwe tuturuke okugenda namberali aheru yorukande, twetwekere ekijumukye.

english: [GENERAL] For the time will come when your enemies will build around you a fort and will surround you and shake you on every side.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro birikuizira abanyanzigwa bawe obubalikwombekeraho orukomera, nibakwehinguliriza, nibakufunza embaju zona.;

english: [GENERAL] Asia, Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, and the regions of Libya around Cyrene, the leading citizens of Rome, Jews, and Gentiles.
lunyoro: hati omu Asiya, omu Furugiya nomu Pamfuliya, omu Misiri nomu nsi eza Libiya ezinyakuhe'raine Kulene, Abarumi abagonyi, Abayudaya nabahinduki,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Christ, the King of Israel, has been raised from death. We see and believe.” The believers who were with him also heard him.
lunyoro: Kristo, Omukama wa Isaleri, aruge hati bunu ha Muti. Itwe turole, tuikirize.kandi ababambirwe ahamu nauwe nabo bakamujuma.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Which one of you, then, will go to him in a large room and say, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
lunyoro: Kandi akabagambira ati Araha omulinywe anyina enganjaniye, aligenda namberali omu itumbi, namugambira ati Enganjani yange, nyohoza emigati esatu;

english: [GENERAL] Or there are many different kinds of angels in the world, and none of them has the right to be destroyed.
lunyoro: Rundi haroho omunsi emiringo nyingi eyamaraka, kandi busaho eritanyina okusobo'rwa.

english: [GENERAL] After they had taken the ship, they took the ship aboard and sailed away. They were afraid that they would fall on the island of Libya, so they lowered the ship's sail and lowered the ship's sail.
lunyoro: kandi obubamazire okubihimba, batwara emiguha, nibagizingiza ha kyombo; kandi obubatinire okunagwa ha Suruti, baihayo ebyahaiguru, nukwo batwara kwonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus went back into the village and said to Jesus, “Who are you?” But Jesus would not answer him.
lunyoro: yataha omu kibira, yagambira Yesu ati Oli wa Nkaha?Baitu Yesu atamugarukemu.

english: [GENERAL] This is the stone that was set at nought of you builders, which has become the head of the corner.
lunyoro: Ogu niryo ibale eryagayirwe inywe abombeki, niryo ryafokere erikuru erya ha karugu.

english: [GENERAL] After they had put him to death, Paul said to the jailer who was standing by him, “Is it lawful for you to accuse a Roman citizen before being tried?”
lunyoro: Obubakaba bamazire okumubonesa enkoba, Pauro yagambira omunyaihanda akaba ayemerire haihi ati Kyebiragiro inywe okuteza enkoba omuntu Omurumi atakacwerirwe omusango?

english: [RELIGIOUS] It was necessary for Christ to be revealed, and he was the first one to be raised from death, to tell the light to the people and to the Gentiles.
lunyoro: Kristo okukihikirie okuhururwa, kandi okwalibanza omu kuhumbuka kwabafu, okutebeza omusana hali abantu na hali Abamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] He saw a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him.
lunyoro: kandi aboine omuntu, ibararye Ananiya, nataha namutaho emikono aiguke.

english: [RELIGIOUS] so that they will not be divided about you in your minds or about you in your hearts; that they may not be troubled by your troubles, but by the power of the Lord's day, or by the power of the message or by the power of the revelation that has already come upon you.
lunyoro: hakiri baleke okutabatabana omu magezi ganyu, nobukwakuba okutuntuzibwa, nobubwakuba obwomwoyo, nobwekuba obwekigambo, nobubyakuba ebyokutebeza, rundi obwekiro kya Mukama waitu;

english: [GENERAL] But I have given them what you have given me. They believe in it and know that I am the one who sent you.
lunyoro: baitu ebigambo ebiwampaire mbibahaire: babiikiriza, nibamanya mananukwo nkaruga haliwe, nibaikiriza niwe wantumire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And by the power of the eye and by the power of the Spirit, by the power of the Spirit, and by the power of the Spirit; so that I may go from Jerusalem and from there into the Good News about Christ.
lunyoro: kandi omu ngeso, omu mani gobwakuro'raho nomu mani Agomwoyo Ogurukwera; nukwo okuruga Yerusalemu nokwehinguliriza okuhika Iruliko, nkahikya enjiri ya Kristo;

english: [RELIGIOUS] It is not among all people that we are the ones who ate and drank with him after he had been raised from death.
lunyoro: tali omu bantu bona, baitu hali abaisiki abandi, nitwe abalire, kandi abanywire hamu nauwe obuyamazire okuhumbuka omu bafu.

english: [GENERAL] In this way we know that we love him, because he gave us life. And so we must give our life to our brothers.
lunyoro: Nuho turukumanyira okugonza, baitu nuwe yahaireyo obwomezi ha bwaitu: naitwe kituhikirire okuhayo obwomezi bwaitu habwa bene baitu.

english: [GENERAL] But you are the one who will keep me safe in the day of the promise to come into all the world to destroy the world of those who live on the earth.
lunyoro: Baitu iwe okalinda nanyowe omu kasumi kokwehebwa, akarukugenda okuija hali ensi zona ezabantu, okulenga abarukuikara ha nsi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I will sing praises to you in the middle of the church.
lunyoro: Hagati omu kanisa nuho ndizina okukugiza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Whoever swears by heaven swears by God, and whoever sits on it.
lunyoro: Nogu anyakurahira iguru buli arahire entebe ya Ruhanga, nogu arukwika'raho.

english: [GENERAL] For you bring new words into our ears, and we want you to know the meaning of these words.
lunyoro: Baitu noleta ebigambo ebihyaka omu matu gaitu: nikyo turukwendera okumanya amakuru gebigambo binu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He who testifies these things says, ‘Yes, I will come quickly.’ Amen! Come, Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: Arukumanyisa ebigambo binu nagamba ati Nukwo; ninyija bwango. Amina: ija Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For now it is seen by the miracles of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who gave up death and brought life and immortality to the gospel.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu nibyolekwa obwokwolekwa okwomujuni waitu Kristo Yesu, ayaihireho okufa, namulikya obwomezi nokutafa omu njiri,

english: [RELIGIOUS] After Judas had been handed over to the chief priests and the Pharisees, he went there with chains, chains, and chains.
lunyoro: Yuda, abuyamazire okuhebwa ekihanda kya baserikale nabakuru babu hali banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo, yaijayo, ayina entuha namacumu.

english: [GENERAL] For our message is not of legends or of legends or of legends or of legends.
lunyoro: Baitu okugambi'ra kwaitu tikuli kwebisuba, nobuhokuba omu kugobya:

english: [RELIGIOUS] But some of the disciples went into the boat, not far away, but by the hands of the one who was about two hundred men, and they lowered the net and threw it away.
lunyoro: Baitu abegeswa abandi baija omu bwato obuke ( baitu bakaba batali hara nomusa, rundi emikono nkebikumi bibiri), nibacunda ekisoha ekirumu ebisoha.

english: [GENERAL] To this very day we are hungry, but we are thirsty; we are thirsty, but we are thirsty, and we have no food.
lunyoro: Na hati hona nturumwa enjara, ntukwatwa iroho, tuli kwonka, titunyina owaitu:

english: [GENERAL] But some of them said, “He is a demon in the name of Beelzebul, the chief of the demons.”
lunyoro: Baitu abamu bakagamba ngu Abinga emizimu habwa Beerezebuli omukuru wemizimu.

english: [GENERAL] While Jesus was sitting in the judgment hall, his wife sent him a message: “Do not be afraid of him, for I have been very sad for him now.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuyaikalire ha ntebe eyomusango, mukaziwe yamutumira nagamba ati Omutu ogu ahikirire; baitu hati nsalirwe muno omu kiroto hali uwe.

english: [GENERAL] When Jesus was in the middle of the courtyard, he sat by himself.
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba buli omu nziha hagati, uwe aikaire wenka ha mugongo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I heard the angel of the waters say, “You are righteous, and you are holy, because you have judged this way.
lunyoro: Kandi nahu'ra maraika owamaizi nagamba ati Ohikirire iwe anyakuroho, kandi owaira, baitu okacwa omusango oti:

english: [GENERAL] But you are still weak, yet you are still weak. Do you not live as human beings only?
lunyoro: baitu mukyali abomubiri: baitu obuharumu omulinywe ihali nempaka, timukyali bomubiri? Timurukugenda nkabantu kwonka?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “There is nothing that will make you sad, but you will give me food.”
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Busaho ekirikubabinga; inywe mubahe ebyokurya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But many deceivers have gone out of the world, and they do not claim that Jesus Christ is alive in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Enemy of Christ.
lunyoro: baitu abagobya baingi bakaturukira omu nsi, nibo batarukwatura ngu Yesu Kristo aizira omu mubiri. Ogu nuwe nugobya noomunyanzigwa wa Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then the twelve disciples called the crowd to him and said, “It is not right for us to stop speaking the word of God and go on doing good.”
lunyoro: Kandi ikumi nababiri baketa namberebali ekitebe ekyabegeswa, nibagamba ntu Tikisemera itwe okuleka ekigambo kya Ruhanga okuhereza emeza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “My children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the Kingdom of God!
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yagarukamu, nabagambira ati Abana, nikiremera abanyakwesiga itungo okutaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga!

english: [RELIGIOUS] He went a little farther down the cliff and prayed, as soon as possible, leaving.
lunyoro: Yagendaho hake, yainama hansi, nasaba, kiraba nikisoboka, akacu kamurugeho.

english: [GENERAL] If some of those who do not believe invite you to go with them, and you want to go with them, eat with them all that is set before you, without asking questions about the truth.
lunyoro: Kandi omu hali abo abtarukuikiriza obwaba nabeta, nainywe obumwenda okugenda, kandi obumuragonza okugenda, murye byona ebitairwe omu maiso ganyu, mutarukukaguza ekigambo obwomutima.

english: [GENERAL] The one who had received two thousand coins came and said, ‘Sir, I have left two thousand coins. Here I have lost two thousand other coins.’
lunyoro: Nogu owuyahairwe etaranta ibiri yaija nagamba ati Mukama wange okansigira etaranta bibiri; dora nkagobamu etaranta zibiri ezindi.

english: [GENERAL] All those to whom the Father gives me will come to me; and whoever comes to me I will by no means throw him out of the way.
lunyoro: Bwona Isenyowe abampa baliija namberendi; anyakuija nambera nyowe tindimubingira aheru na kake.

english: [GENERAL] For this reason a woman should have authority over her head because of the angels.
lunyoro: habwa kinu kisemerire omukazi okuba nakokuro'raho akamani ha mutwe habwa bamaraika.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees heard this and said to one another, “The chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bahu'ra ebye, bagambirangana ngu Banyakatagara abakuru Nabafalisayo batuma abaduma okumukwata.

english: [RELIGIOUS] From your youth on, you have come to know the holy writings, which can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: kandi okuruga omu buto okamanya ebyahandikirwe ebirukwera, ebirukusobora okukuhaisa amagezi hali okujunwa, obwokuikiriza okuli omu Kristo Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] We are going to Jerusalem, where the Son of Man will be handed over to the chief priests and the teachers of the Law, and they will condemn him to death.
lunyoro: ntutemba hali Yerusalemu; Omwana womuntu alihebwayo hali banyakatagara abakuru nabahandiki; nabo balimucwera omusango okumuita,

english: [RELIGIOUS] They threw a crown on his head, and a crown was placed on him by his right hand. They threw the stone at him and made fun of him, saying, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: Baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: [GENERAL] The rooster crowed and said in a loud voice, “Surely not! I will do it, because my master has come to sow seed! I am ashamed to beg you!”
lunyoro: Yesengerize omundaye nagamba ati Ndakora nta, baitu omukama wange anyakire obuketo? Kandi nkwatwa ensoni okulega.

english: [RELIGIOUS] and said, “Praise be to God, Lord Almighty, who lives and who lives forever! For he has made you strong, mighty!”
lunyoro: kandi nibagamba ngu Ntukusima iwe Mukama Ruhanga Owobusobozi bwona, anyakuroho, kandi ayabaireho; baitu okwasire amani gawe amaingi, nolema.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Even though you have ten teachers in Christ, you have few fathers. For in union with Christ Jesus you have few children.
lunyoro: Noba muyina abesegesa kakumi omu Kristo, timunyina baisinywe baingi: baitu ninyowe nabazaire omu Kristo Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] But if I boast about him in all I do, I am not ashamed of him. For as we have told you all the truth, so our boasting in Titus was about the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu obunayenyumize omu kigambo kyona habwanyu haruwe, ntakwate ensoni; baitu nkokutwabagambire inywe byona omu mazima, nukwo nokwenyumiza kwaitu hali Tito kukaba kuli kwa mazima.

english: [GENERAL] But not one of these little ones who believe in me should have taken him to the beach and thrown him out of the lake.
lunyoro: baitu wena alitabaijura omu hali banu abato abarukunyikiriza, hakire bamubohe omu bikya orubengo orukoto, bamunage omu nziha yenyanja.

english: [GENERAL] Two women will be grinding at the hand mill, one will be taken away and the other will be taken away.
lunyoro: Abakazi baliba babiri nibasahamu; omu alitwarwa, ondi alisingwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees said to one another, “Look how weak he is! Look! The whole world is following him!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bagambirangana ngu Murole okumutarukusobora na kake; dora, ensi yona nemukuratira.

english: [GENERAL] I have sent you to Crete to finish what I had left behind, and to appoint elders in all the cities.
lunyoro: Nikyo nakulekire omu Kulete osemeze ebyasigalire, kandi oteho abakuru omu mbuga zoona,

english: [GENERAL] The priest of Zeus was in front of the city, and he brought oxen and oxen to the gates, and tried to kill the people with the sword.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara wa Zeu akaba ali omu maiso gorubuga, akaleta ente nemikako eyebyakyo ha malembo nayenda okusara ekyonzira hamu nebitebe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I am not afraid to tell you all the wisdom of God.
lunyoro: Baitu ntatine okubagambira amagezi gona aga Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] They were about to gather, and they saw what they had found twelve men, and at the right time they went back to the tomb and saw the fifteenth parts of it.
lunyoro: kandi balenga okuhama nibarora ebifuna amakumi abiri: kandi obwahinguireho kakaito bagaruka okutunga okuhama, nokurora ebifuba ikumi na bitano.

english: [GENERAL] But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and ordered him to be kept under guard until I could send him to the Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: [GENERAL] So then, do not let your good be saved.
lunyoro: Nukwo ekirungi kyanyu kireke okujunwa:

english: [GENERAL] But you know that afterward he wanted to be blessed by his own mouth, because he did not see it coming back to him, and he had seen it coming and drinking water.
lunyoro: Baitu mu manyire ngu hanyuma obuyagondeze okugwetwa omugisa akangwe, ( baitu atabone hokwegarukiramu) nobuyaguseruire noku'ra amazi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He first found his brother Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (that is, the Messiah)
lunyoro: Abanza okuzora mugenziwe Simoni, yamugambira ati Tuzoire Masiya ( nukwo kugamba obukimanyisibwa ngu Kristo)

english: [GENERAL] Leave all my belongings to the poor, and go to the streets. On the day of teaching I will say to the teachers of the Law, ‘Take the bread first and throw it to the dogs, because you are the ones who will get it.’
lunyoro: Muleke binyete byona, bihike ha magesa: omu biro ebyokugesa ndigambira abagesi nti Mubanze musoroze emberya, muzibohe enganda bazokye: baitu oburo mubuhunike oku maguli gange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “My soul is deeply troubled, and it will be very hot for me. Stay here and watch.”
lunyoro: Yabatebeza ati Omutima gwange gunyina obujune bwingi, bibuija okunyita: muikalege hanu, murole.

english: [GENERAL] These have the power to tear down the sky, so that the rain does not fall on them in the same way at the same time. They have the power to pour out blood on the water, and to make the earth and all the things in it come to an end, just as I wish.
lunyoro: Banu bayina obusobozi okuiga'ra iguru, enjura ereke okugwa omu biro byabu: kandi bayinaobusobozi ha maizi okugafora esagama, nokutuntuza ensi nemihito yona, emirundi mingi nkokubaragonzaga.

english: [GENERAL] We have many things to say to you, and you have many things to say, but you have become dull of hearing.
lunyoro: Tunyina bingi okumugambaho, kandi ebirukulemera okubimanyisa, baitu inywe mufokere abafu bamatu.

english: [GENERAL] He had been seen for a long time by those who were with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now witnesses to the people.
lunyoro: kandi yarorwa ebiro bingi abo abatembere nauwe, okuruga Galiraya okuhika Yerusalemu,nibo bakaisobe hati bunu hali abantu.

english: [GENERAL] But some of the churches there stirred up discussions with Stephen.
lunyoro: baitu hakaimuka abamu abomu iso'rokaniro erinyakwetwa Eryabalibetini Nabakulene Nabalegezanderiya, Neryabakirikiya, naba Asiya, batera empaka na Sitefano.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I do not stop thanking you, and I remember you in my prayers.
lunyoro: sikara nokusima habwanyu, nimbaijuka omu kusaba kwange:

english: [GENERAL] So then, if I do judge, my judgment is based on my own conscience, because I am not one, but with the Father who sent me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nobundaba nincwa omusango, okucwa kwange kwa mananu; baitu nyowe tindi omu, baitu ndi hamu na Isenyowe ayantumire.

english: [GENERAL] “How, then, did your eyes look?” they asked him.
lunyoro: Kandi bamugambira ngu Nukwo amaiso gawe gakaiguka gata?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said, “Go!” Peter got out of the boat and went on to Jesus.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Ija. Petero yaruga omu bwato, yagendera ha maizi, okugenda hali Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus asked him, “What is this under the Law?”
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Kikahansikwa kita omubiragiro?

english: [RELIGIOUS] That is why I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce children.
lunyoro: Nikyo ndukubagambi'ra nti Obukama obwa ruhanga buryakwa inywe, bulihebwa ihanga erinyakwana ebyana byabwo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Holy spirit, knowledge, and strength, grace, and the love of money;
lunyoro: hati omu Mwoyo Ogurukwera nomu kumanya nomu mani nomu mbabazi nomu kugonza

english: [GENERAL] For that is why you have to follow the example of the Nicolaitans, who belong to me.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo oyinakyo, onobere engeso za Banikoraiti, ezi'noba nyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So he left the man who had been thrown into prison for murder and murder, and prayed for him, because Jesus had given him over to them to do the same to them.
lunyoro: Yaleka ogu ayanagirwe omu nju yenkomo obwokwema nokuita, oubasabire; baitu Yesu akamuhayo halibo okumukora nkokubayenzire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus was going to Solomon's gate.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu akaba nagenda omu kitikyomuryango ekyo Sulemani.

english: [RELIGIOUS] That is why Moses called you to serve him (as Moses was, but as your ancestors were your ancestors). On the Sabbath you made a vow to a man.
lunyoro: Moses nikyo yabaherire okusara ( tukuli kwa Musa, baitu nukwo kwa baisenkuru inywe); kandi ha Sabiti musara omuntu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] While Jesus was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife, because she is in the Holy Spirit.
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba natekereza ebi, dora, maraika wa Mukama Yamubonekera omu kiroto, nagamba ati Yusufu, omwana wa Daudi, otatina okutwara Maryamu mukazi wawe, baitu ekiri omundaye Kyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [GENERAL] Believe me, then, that I am in the Father and the Father in me; and believe me only because of what I do.
lunyoro: Mundikirize ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, na isenyowe omuli nyowe: rundi Munyikirize habwemirimo yonka.

english: [GENERAL] It gives me proof of what I am doing, and I don't want to come to you to have life.
lunyoro: Ibyo bimanyisa ebyange; kandi timurukwenda kuija namberendi mube nobwomezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Now we know that you know everything, and you do not want anyone to ask you. We believe you, then, and believe from God.
lunyoro: hati bunu tumanyire ngu omanyire byona, kandi torukuse'ra muntu wena okukukaguza; nikyo tuikiririze iwe; eki tukikirize okuruga hali Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You Capernaum, who are highly respected by you? You will be raised to life by the Spirit.
lunyoro: Naiwe Kaperenaumu, olinyumizibwa haiguru muno? Olisirimurwa okuhika okuzimu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Because of the hardness of your hearts, he wrote you this commandment.
lunyoro: Baitu Yesu yabagambira ati Obwokugumangana okwemitima yanyu, nikyo yabahandikirire ekiragiro eki.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave thanks to God, broke the loaves, and gave thanks to God, and gave them to his disciples to sit down before them, and he gave thanks to them all.
lunyoro: Yakwata emigati etano nencu ibiri, yarora haiguru omu iguru, nasima, nacwamu emigati; yaha abegeswabe bagite omu maiso gabali; nencu ebbiri yazibagabira bona.

english: [GENERAL] The next day they left for Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, waiting for them to gather the apostles and the other disciples.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri bataha Kaisaliya. Kandi Koruneryo akaba nabategereza, amazire okusoroza abegeswabe abandi.

english: [GENERAL] Some of our women, who had recently come to the tomb, made fun of us.
lunyoro: Kandi abakazi abamu abowaitu batubihiza, abazindukire okugenda hali ekituro;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Suddenly Jesus stood up in front of them and took what was lying on his feet and went home and praised God.
lunyoro: Ahonaho yaimuka omu maiso gabu, yahimba ekyakaba abyamireho, yagenda omukaye, nakugiza Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the Lord will make his word come true on earth and make it come true and last.
lunyoro: baitu Mukama alihikya ekigambokye hali ensi, nakihikiriza kandi nakimara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] It is good to give glory, honor, and power to you, Lord our God. You have created all things, and just as you wanted them to be, they existed and were given as you wanted them to.
lunyoro: Osemire, ai Mukama Ruhanga waitu, okuhabwa ekitinisa nokutinwa nobusobozi: baitu niwe wahangire byona, kandi nkokuwagondeze bikabaho, kandi bikahangwa.

english: [GENERAL] He heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?”
lunyoro: yahu'ra iraka nirimugambira liti Sauro,Sauro, nompiganira ki?

english: [GENERAL] Pray that you will enter the closed door, but I tell you that many will not be able to enter it.
lunyoro: Mwekambe okutaha omu irembo erifunzire: baitu nimbagambira nti Baingi abalise'ra okutahamu, tibalisobora.

english: [GENERAL] But you were merciful to those in prison, and you endured with joy over your belongings. You know that you have a better and more permanent life.
lunyoro: Baitu mukaganyira abo abakaba bali omu nkomo, kandi mukagumisiriza nokusemererwa okunyagwaho ebiitungo ryanyu, mumanyire ngu inywe munyina itungo erirukukira oburungi, kandi erirukuikaraho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Pharisees answered, “How did he deceive you?
lunyoro: Abafalisayo babagarukamu ngu Kandi ahabisize nainywe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who said to you and to those who followed you spoke up, “Praise God! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
lunyoro: abo abakaba bebembire, nabali abakuratire, bagambire nabali abakaba bahe'ra, bagambira haiguru ngu Hosana; Ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I tell you, then, that the Gentiles are more important than the Gentiles, because they do not belong to God. And I do not want you to be like foreigners.
lunyoro: Baitu ningamba nti ebi Abamahanga ebibahonga, bibahingisa, kunu tihali Ruhanga: kandi tindukugonza inywe okuterana nabacwezi.

english: [GENERAL] For whoever has will be given away, but whoever has not, also what he has will be taken away from him.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuina, nuwe arihebwa: akandi atanyina, aliihibwaho nakyo ekyanyinakyo.

english: [GENERAL] Suddenly there was a man who was sick with a fever.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, hakaba haroho omu maisoge omuntu akaba arwaire okuzimba.

english: [GENERAL] These are the things that are like these in our time. They have increased the sacrifices and the sacrifices that cannot be made to serve the one who serves the one who gives them what is in their hearts.
lunyoro: eki nikyo kisisani omu biro bya hati bunu: nikyo bahongera ebisembo nebyonzira ebitarukusobora okuhikiriza arukuramya omu bigambo ebyomu mutima, baitu

english: [RELIGIOUS] Didn't Christ have to suffer all these things and to enter into his glory?
lunyoro: Kitikimusemerire Kristo okusalirwa ebi byona, nokutaha omu kitinisakye?

english: [RELIGIOUS] But they did not recognize him, so he put on his clothes and said to them, “You must put your own blood on your own heads. I am not guilty. At first I will go to the Gentiles.”
lunyoro: Kandi obubamutangire nibajuma, yakunkumura ebyokujwarabye, nabagambira ati Esagama yanyu ikale ha mitwe yanyu enywenka; nyowe tindoho musango: okubanza hati ndagendaga hali Abamahanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I was so happy about the Lord that now you have thought about me, and you have lost all time.
lunyoro: Baitu nkasemererwa muno omu Mukama waitu, baitu hata bunu mugarukire okutekereza mukatekereza mali, kyonka mubuzirweho omwanya.

english: [GENERAL] The night is almost over, and the day is almost over. Let us, then, be full of the evil deeds of the darkness, and let us take up the weapons of the light.
lunyoro: Ekiro kihinguire muno, obuire nubu'sa okukya: nukwo tujule engeso ezomuirima, tujwale ebyokurwanisa ebyomusana.

english: [GENERAL] That is why you must pay back my money to the poor, and I will pay back my debt and my taxes.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyakuhikirire okuha abaguzi efeza yange, nanyowe obunakuizire nakuhairwe eyange namagoba gayo.

english: [GENERAL] When we heard this, we and the people in that place begged him not to go to Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Itwe obutwahulire ebi, itwe nabantu abomu kiikaro eki, twamwesengereza aleke okutemba Yerusalemu.

english: [GENERAL] You see, then, that these things cannot be done, but you must be quiet and do nothing by doing what you are willing to do.
lunyoro: Nukwo muboine ebi tibisoboka okwangwa, kibahikirire inywe okuculera, okutakora kintu nimwanguhiriza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He sent me this because of his will: ‘Do not be afraid of anything that he has told me to do, because I am coming to you on the last day.’
lunyoro: Gambire ebyagonza ngu Ha kyona ekyampaire haleke okuburaho na kake, baitu nkije namberoli ha kiro kya hampero.

english: [GENERAL] Simon Peter went in and went into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there,
lunyoro: baitu atatahemu. Kandi na Simoni Petero, yaija omukuratire, yataha omu kituro; yarora engoye zekitani zitairwe aho,

english: [GENERAL] Pilate said to them, “Take him down and crucify him, because I find no reason to condemn him!”
lunyoro: Pirato yabagambira ati Mumutwale inywe, mumubambe hamuti: baitu nyowe timboine musango haruwe.

english: [GENERAL] As he has given him authority over all flesh, he gave him eternal life.
lunyoro: nkokuwamuhaire obusobozi ha banyakuina omubiri bona, abahe obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: [GENERAL] In this way we will celebrate the Passover, not with a conscience or with an evil conscience, but with the truth.
lunyoro: nukwo tucumbe obugenyi, hatali nekititumbisa ekiitima nobubi, baitu nebitatumbisibwa ebyobutagobya namazima:

english: [RELIGIOUS] He poured out water into the prophets and began to teach them the good news about the Kingdom of God.
lunyoro: Yataho amaizi omu mbaju zabanabi, yabandiza nabatangisa ebigere,

english: [GENERAL] They were all filled with pity for the people who were in the synagogue.
lunyoro: Kandi baijura bona ekiniga abakaba bali omu iso'rokaniro,

english: [GENERAL] Luke, the highly respected teacher of the Law, and Demas, who was a good example for them.
lunyoro: Ruka, omufumu arukugonzebwa, na Dema babaramukize.

english: [GENERAL] But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
lunyoro: baitu omusigazi obuyahulire ekigambo eki, yagenda atuntuire: baitu akabanyina itungo lingi.

english: [GENERAL] He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all his house.
lunyoro: Akabali wokwesiga hali ogu ayamutaireho, nka Musa okwakabali owokwesigwa omu njuye yona.

english: [GENERAL] I pray for them, not for the world, but for those who have given me.
lunyoro: Nsaba abo: tindukusabira nsi, rundi abo abawampaire

english: [GENERAL] The king praised that dishonest accusation, but he was wise. For the children of this world are wiser than the children of the light in their own order.
lunyoro: Kandi mukamawe akanyumiza omuketo ogu atali wokuhiki'ra, baitu akagira amagezi: baitu abana abensi enu, omu businge bwabu, nibakira amagezi abana abomusana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] and the power of God. He is at the right and the left,
lunyoro: na mani ga Ruhanga: obwebyokurwanisa ebyokuhiki'ra ha mukono ogwoburyo, nomukono ogwemoso,

english: [RELIGIOUS] The more believers in the Lord, the more bold they were to speak the word of God without fear.
lunyoro: kandi abo abakira obwingi omu Mukama waitu bakatunga obumanzi obwensengo zange, nibeyongera okuguma muno okugamba ekigambo kya Ruhanga okutatina.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus looked around at them with pity, so that he was filled with pity for them, because they were so stubborn that he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and it became well.
lunyoro: Obuyababungizemu amaiso nekiniga, abihirwe obwokugumangana kwemitima yabu, yagambira omuntu ati Go'ra omukono gwawe. Yagugo'ra: omukonogwe gwakira.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For now in union with Christ Jesus you who were far away have come to me through the blood of Christ.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu omu Kristo Yesu, inywe abakaba bali hara ira muirizibwe haihi omu sagama ya Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But if you have said in your heart that Jesus is the Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from death, you will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu obworaba oyatuire omu kanwa kawe ngu Yesu nuwe Mukama, kandi oraba oikirize omu mutima gwawe ngu Ruhanga akamuhumbura omu bafu, olijunwa:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Barnabas took him along and brought him to the apostles. He saw them on the road and said, “He spoke to him, just as he had said to Damascus in the name of Jesus.”
lunyoro: Baitu Baranaba yamutwara, yamuleta hali abakwenda, yabasobo'ra okuyaboine omu muhanda, kandi ngu akagamba nauwe, kandi nkokuyagambire Damasiko nobumanzi omu ibara rya Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from death, where you crucified him.
lunyoro: Ruhanga owa baisenkuru itwe akahumbura Yesu, oumwaisire, inywe numumuhanika ha muti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The peace of God, which is greater than all knowledge, will guard your hearts and your mental powers by means of Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi nobusinge bwa Ruhanga oburukukira okumanywa kwona bulirinda emitima yanyu nebitekarazo bayanyu omu Kristo Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] It is not right for you to forgive your brother, just as I have forgiven you.
