lunyoro: kikimuhikirire okuganyira omuiru omutahi wawe, nka nyowe okunakuganyire iwe?

english: [GENERAL] the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel,
lunyoro: owa Mesusera owa Enoka, owa Yaleda, owa Maharaleri,

english: [GENERAL] He believed him, and Paul stood up at the gates and began to speak to the people with a loud cry. After the uproar had subsided, he spoke in Hebrew to them,
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamuikirize, Pauro yayeme'ra ha matembero, yabaza nabantu niraka erihango: obubamazire okuculera muno yabagambira omu rulimi Oruheburaniya nagamba ati.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They were in Thessalonica, where they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews. They were with John, who was their apostle.
lunyoro: Obubakaba bali Saramini, batebeza ekigambo kya Ruhanga omu maso'rokaniro Gabayudaya: kandi bakaba bali na Yohana, omuhereza wabu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] and said, “If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have been with them in the blood of the prophets.”
lunyoro: mugamba ngu Kuba tukaba turoho omubiro bya baisenkuruitwe, titwakuteraine hamu nabo omu sagama eya banabi.

english: [GENERAL] They will not do this, because they have taken away the broken and broken pieces and have put the people in chains, because they do not want to tear them down and throw them to pieces.
lunyoro: Baitu mananukwo bakora bati? Baitu baboha enketo ezirukulemera,ezitetweka, ba zitweka abantu omu nkomo: baitu bo tibenda kuzitengesa ne kyara kyabu.

english: [GENERAL] The foolish, the foolish, and the foolish, each other, do not love one another, and do not despise one another.
lunyoro: (Abafakati, abasisa ebi baragana, abatarukugonzangana, abatayina kuganyira):

english: [RELIGIOUS] The whole church was filled with fear, and all who heard these things.
lunyoro: Nokutina kwingi kukakwata ekanisa yona na bona abahulire ebi.

english: [GENERAL] But if you believed Moses, you would also believe me, because he wrote me.
lunyoro: Kakuba muikirize Musa, nanyowe mwakunyikirize; baitu akahandikira nyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They will run away from the trap of the Devil, who has followed them in doing what he has wanted them to do.
lunyoro: baliruga omu ndubatira ya Setani, ogu obuyamazire okubahamba okukora nkoli okuyagondeze.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He remembered what the Lord had said, “I am John the Baptist, but you will be baptized by the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Kandi naijuka ekigambo kya Mukama waitu nkokuyagambire ati Mananukwo Yohana akabatiza nomu Mwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [GENERAL] So he left and went to Tarsus to look for Saul. When he saw him, he took him to Antioch.
lunyoro: Kandi yarugayo okugenda Taruso, okuse'ra Sauro: obuyamuboine, yamuleta Antyokiya.

english: [GENERAL] You are our witnesses, the one who knows what is being read.
lunyoro: Ninywe baruha yaitu, erukumanywa erukusomwa abantu bona;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For at that time it will be just as when a human being was born, and you have been born as a spiritual being, just as it is now.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro biri nkogu ayazairwe omubiri okuyahigire oli ayazalirwe obwomwoyo, nukwo nukwo na hati bunu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The voice answered me the second time from heaven, ‘What God has promised, do not commit adultery.’
lunyoro: Baitu iraka ryangarukamu omurundi ogwakabiri, niriruga omu iguru liti Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora ebyomuziro iwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus saw her, he loved her, and said to her, “Go and sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyamurozire yamugonza, yamugambira ati Gura byona ebyokuyinabyo, ogabire abasege, kandi iwe olitunga itungao omu iguru:

english: [RELIGIOUS] For a man must not cover his head, but he is a copy of God's glory. For a woman is a man's glory.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimakwo omusaija tikimusemerire okwesweke'ra omutwe, baitu nuwe kisisani nekitinisa kya Ruhanga: baitu omukazi kiba kitinisa kyomusaija.

english: [RELIGIOUS] And so it is with us, who are the ones who have the spiritual beginning, not only in us, but also with us, who hope to be children, in order to be free from our human nature.
lunyoro: Kandi tikuli nukwo kwonka, baitu naitwe abanyina ebyokubanza Ebyomwoyo, ntusinda omunda yaitu, ntutegereza okuforwa abana, nukwo kucungurwa kwomubiri gwaitu.

english: [GENERAL] All who live on earth will be made clean, and everyone who lives on earth will be clean, because the book of the living which was written in the Lamb's book of life has been lost since the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abaikara hansi balikiramya, wena atahandikirwe ibararyeomukitabu kyobwomezi Ekyokwana Gwentama ayaisirwe okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi.

english: [GENERAL] The servants of the house started to meet him and said, “Sir, didn't you place a good stone in your vineyard, and at once you would have a field ready for harvesting?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale banyineka baija nibamugambira ngu Tata, otasige mbibo esemire omu ruharo rwawe, baitu ekaba etanyina byana?

english: [GENERAL] What shall I say? Is the thing that the image is made up of nothing or of something?
lunyoro: Nukwo ngambire ki? Nti ekinyakuhongirwe ekisisani kiba kyekintu? rundi ekinyakuroho?

english: [GENERAL] The owner of the vineyard said, ‘No, I will do it! I will send my own son, and they will respect him.’
lunyoro: Omukama worugonjo yagamba ati Ndagira nta? Ndituma omwana wange oundukugonza; rundi balimutina.

english: [GENERAL] They tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
lunyoro: Base'ra okumukwata, baitu busaho muntu ayamutaireho omukonogwe, baitu akasumike kakaba katakahikire.

english: [GENERAL] Which one, then, will be the curse? If you say, ‘Get up,’ you will have your sins forgiven,’ or ‘Get up and walk’?
lunyoro: Baitu ekirahuka kiraha? Okugamba nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho, rundi okkugamba nti Imuka ogende?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Where did this come from, my mother, my Lord?
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe ekigambo kinu kyaruga nkaha, nyina Mukama wange okuija namberendi?

english: [GENERAL] He will not go into anything that is not good, nor will he go into anything that is unclean; instead, those who are dead will be written in the Lamb's book of life.
lunyoro: hamu na kake ekintu kyona ekitali kisemeri, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyomuziro nebisuba: rundi abo bonka bahandikwa omu kitabu ekyobwomezi Ekyomwana Gwentama.

english: [GENERAL] So then, every good tree bears good fruit, but every rotten tree bears worthless fruit.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuti gwona ogusemire gwana byana ebisemire, baitu omuti ogubiole gwana ebyana ebibihire.

english: [GENERAL] Out of the mouth come forth blessing and cursing. My friends, these things ought not to happen to you.
lunyoro: Omu kanwa kamu numwo harugamu okukugia nokukyena. Bene baitu ebi tibisemerire okuikara biti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “If I were to boast about myself, my glory would not be destroyed. It is my Father who makes me great. You have said that I am your God, and you do not know him.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu ati Obundaba ninyenyumiza nyenka, okwenyumiza kwange kubakwa busa: Isenyowe nuwe a'nyumiza: inywe oumugambire ngu nuwe Ruhanga wanyu kandi timukamumanyaga,

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Apollos was in Corinth, Paul went to Ephesus and found some disciples.
lunyoro: KANDI kyahika Aporo obwakaba ali Kolinso, Pauro obuyarabire omunsi ezeruguru yahika Efeso, nasanga abegeswa abamu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] The official answered, “I beg you, whom did the prophet say these things? About himself or about someone else?”
lunyoro: Omukonwa yagarukamu Firipo nagamba ati Nkwesengerize, nabi akagamba hali oha ebigambo binu? bye wenka, rundi byomuntu ondi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] always give thanks to God the Father, through our Lord Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: musima ebiro byona obwa byona, omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo hali Ruhanga, kansi Isitwe;

english: [GENERAL] They refuse to give up, but they themselves are slaves of sin; but the person who has been redeemed is slaves of sin.
lunyoro: nibaraganiza okubaha obugabe, baitu bo bonka bali abairu rubale abokujunda; baitu omuntu ekyasingurwa, nikyo aba muiru rugabo wakyo.

english: [GENERAL] “So you say,” answered Jesus.
lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Noyenda nta? Yamugambira ati Nukwo ogambire.

english: [GENERAL] Philip answered him, “He did not give you the bread of two hundred silver coins, but gave you all the money.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ali Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus left and saw a great crowd, healed them, and healed their sick.
lunyoro: Yarugayo, yarora ekitebe kingi, yabaganyira, nakiza abarwaire babu,

english: [RELIGIOUS] The voice that came to us from heaven we heard when we were with him on the holy mountain.
lunyoro: kandi iraka eri itwe tukalihu'ra niriruga omu iguru, obutukaba tuli hamu nauwe harusozi orurukwera.

english: [GENERAL] For each one will carry out his own work, and then he will have his own glory, because he is no more.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena ayerengere omulimogwe wenka, kandi nukwo abe nokwenyumizakwe habwe wenkaga, kunu tihali habwondi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] to open their eyes to the blind, to turn from the power of Satan to God, and to turn from their sins and to be put right with God by those who are his people because of my faith.
lunyoro: kubaigura amaiso, baruge omu munaga gwa Setani okuhindukira Ruhanga, bahebwe okuihibwaho ebibi, nobuwetwa omuli abo abanyakwezibwe obwokuikiriza nyowe.

english: [GENERAL] These things we write down for our own good.
lunyoro: nebbigambo binu itwe tubihandikire okusemererwa kwaitu kuhiki'le.

english: [GENERAL] For this is what God has promised: ‘At the right time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.’
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nugwo murago ngu Nkebiro binu okubiri, nubwo ndiija, kandi Sara aliba nomwana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The prophets preached two or three or more messages, and others listened.
lunyoro: Nabanabi batebezege rundi babiri rundi basatu, nabandi bategereze.

english: [GENERAL] But they did not dare to ask him any more questions.
lunyoro: Baitu batagume kumukaguza kigambo kindi kyona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I want to be with you before the Passover Festival is over.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nokwegomba nyegombere okulira hamu nainywe Okuhingurwaho kunu ntakasalizibwe:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do not be fooled by the many new and strange teachings. It is good to be filled with pity and compassion. This is not because of the food that has not been eaten by those who have not followed them.
lunyoro: Mutahabisibwa ebyokwegesa ebyemitingo nyingi ebihyaka: Baitu kirungi omutima okugamibwa nembabazi: okunu okutagumibwa nengeso ezokurya ezitarangasire abo abazigendiremu,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Last night he came to Jesus and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a teacher sent by God, but no one can perform miracles unless God lives with him.”
lunyoro: ogu akaija namberali ekiro, namugambira ati Rabi, tumanyire iwoli mwegesa ayarugire hali Ruhanga: baitu busaho muntu asobora okukora obwokuro'raho obwokora, rundi Ruhanga obwaikara nauwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
lunyoro: Yakwata ekijoka, enjoka eyaira, nuwe Diaboro kandi Setani, yamuboha okuhikya emyaka rukumi,

english: [GENERAL] The world cannot hate them, but it hates me, because I tell it that its deeds are evil.
lunyoro: Ensi tesobora kubanoba; baitu enobere nyowe, baitu nyowe nimanyisa ebyayo nti emirimo yayo ebihire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After saying this, Jesus went away and called Mary, who had the secret, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”
lunyoro: Obuyamazire okugamba ati, yagenda nayeta Maryamu owanyina omunsita, nagamba ati Omwegesa aizire, nakweta.

english: [GENERAL] This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in all the world for a witness to all the nations, and then the end will come.
lunyoro: Enjiri enu eyobukama eritebezebwa omu nsi zona,okuba kaiso hali amahanga gona; nubwo empero erihika.

english: [GENERAL] His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews, but they had already decided that if anyone told him that he was the Messiah, he would be put right with the Council.
lunyoro: Abamuzaire nikyo bagambire ebi obwokutina Abayudaya:baitu Abayuuda bakaba bamazire kuhanura ngu Omuntu wena obwaramugambagambaga ati nuwe Kristo abingi bwege omu iso'rokaniro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I do not show mercy to you, but by means of the Law Christ died for you.
lunyoro: Tindukuburanganiza embabazi za Ruhanga: baitu kuba okuhiki'ra kwabaireho obwebiragiro, Kristo yakuferire busa.

english: [GENERAL] He who calls him faithful will do it.
lunyoro: arukubeta wokwesiga, kandi nuwe alikora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They did not see his body, and came to him and said, “He is alive!”
lunyoro: kandi obubatazoire mutumbigwe, baija nibagamba ngu baboine nokwolekwa okwa bamaraika abagambire ngu Ayomire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “The ten were not happy, but where are the eight?”
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Ikumi tibasemezibwege? Baitu omwenda bali nkaha?

english: [GENERAL] After they had broken the stone, they dragged him out of the book and led him away.
lunyoro: Bamara okugisesa, bamusirirmu'ra ha kitabu ekyakaba abyamireho anyakuzingamire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the angel went in with him, he called two of his family members to him and appointed a jailer over those who sent him to be the one who was in need.
lunyoro: Kandi maraika ayabalize nauwe obuyagenzire, yayeta abairube babiri abomu nju, na muserukale omwerinzi hali abo abamuherezaga obutosa;

english: [GENERAL] For you are our glory and our joy.
lunyoro: Baitu ninywe kitinisa kyaitu nokusemererwa kwaitu.

english: [GENERAL] Our ancestors ate on this mountain, and you say, ‘It is a good thing for people to celebrate in Jerusalem.’
lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe baryaga ha rusozi runu; nainywe mugamba ngu Ha Yerusalemu nuho Kisemereire abantu okuramizaga.

english: [GENERAL] I did not think it proper for me to speak on my own behalf, but rather that my voice should be heard.
lunyoro: Nikyo ntayetekererize nyenka okuseme'ra okwegambira nyenka, baitu okukira ira ekigambo kyange kiikaire kiti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Who will separate us from the love of Christ? Salvation, trouble, persecution, poverty, or hunger or only poverty or danger?
lunyoro: Araha alitubaganiza omu kugonza kwa Kristo? Bujune? Rundi emihito? rundi okuhiganizibwa? rndi enjara? randi okuba kwonka? rundu akabi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Sir,” she answered, “I believe,” and she worshiped him.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Mukama wange ninyikiriza. Yamuramya.

english: [GENERAL] Teach them to obey all that I have commanded you. And now I am with you forever, until the present age of peace will come to an end.
lunyoro: mugese okukwata byona ebinabaragire; kandi dora, nyowe ndi hamu nainywe ebiro byona, okuhikya obusinge bunu obubulihwaho.

english: [GENERAL] He called him and said to him, “What do you want me to do with you? Wait for the price of your coat, because you can't stay in the sack any longer!”
lunyoro: kamweta, yamugambira ati Kiki kinu ekindukuhu'ra haliwe? Bara omuhendo ogwobuketo bwawe; baitu tokyasobora kuikara omuketo.

english: [GENERAL] For I tell you the Gentiles, that I am the least of the Gentiles, and that I may boast about my own will.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe Abamahanga. Nukwo nyowe obumba ndi omukwenda hali Abamahanga, ninyumiza obukwenda bwange:

english: [GENERAL] But you, my friends, don't let them do good to you.
lunyoro: Baitu inywe bene baitu mutajwaha okukora kurungi.

english: [GENERAL] He went down to his feet and thanked him, and he was also a Samaritan.
lunyoro: yayeme'ra ha bigerebye, namusima: nogu akabali Musamaliya.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who dream about the night and think about the Lord, and those who eat the Lord's bread and drink the Lord's cup, do not eat the Lord's cup; those who do not eat the Lord's cup, and those who do not eat the Lord's cup, do not eat the Lord's cup.
lunyoro: Anyakutekereza ekiro, akitekereza habwa Mukama waitu. Kandi anyakurya, arya habwa mukama waitu, nukwo asima ati habwa mugenzi waitu: kandi atarukurya, tarya habwe.(Omukama waitu)

english: [GENERAL] Before the throne of the kingdom of heaven was a sea of glass like crystal, and between the throne and the four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
lunyoro: kandi omu maiso gekitebe kyobukama enyanja yendo'rwamu erukusisana nka kurusitaro; na hagati yekitebe ekyobukama ebyomezi bina ebiijuire amaiso omu buso nenyuma.

english: [GENERAL] Here the dead are given a tenth of all, but there are those who are told that they are alive.
lunyoro: Kandi hanu abantu abafa bahabwa ebicweka biikumi, baitu kuli abihabwa arukumanyisibwa ngu ali mwomezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the name of God is being declared among the Gentiles because of you, just as the scripture says.
lunyoro: baitu ibara rya Ruhanga niriswazibwa omu Bamahanga habwanyu nkokukyahandikirwe

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubahulire eki, babatizibwa okutaha omu ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] So they went off and found a young donkey tied up in the back of the colt, and as they were untying it.
lunyoro: bagenda, basanga omwana gwenkaina bagusibikire ha irembo aheru omu ikute; bagusibura.

english: [GENERAL] When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to collect his share of the harvest. The tenants beat him and beat him without a thing.
lunyoro: Kandi omwaka obugukaba guhikire yatuma omuiru rubale hali abalimi bamuhe ha byana ebyorugonjo rwemizabibu: baitu abalimi bakamutera, bamubinga atakwasire kintu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “Do you believe, sir?
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange araba muikiriza?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The gospel is like this, but not the gospel; it is not the gospel that others are trying to make you sad, but the gospel of Christ is what they want to change.
lunyoro: Enjiri endi terukusisana okundi; baitu teri enjiri endi, rundi haroho abandi abarukubatuntuza,nibagonza okuhindura kubi enjiri ya Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Lord said to Paul on the night of the vision, “Don't be afraid, but be silent;
lunyoro: Mukama waitu akagambira Pauro ekiro omu kwolekwa ati Otatina, baitu gamba, otaculera:

english: [GENERAL] For we do not want to boast about you, but for you we gave you the chance to boast about ourselves, so that you may have an answer for those who boast about things that are above, but not on your heart.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukugaruka okwenyumiza itwenka halinywe, baitu tubahaire inywe omwanya gwokwenyumiza habwaitu, nukwo mube nekyokugarukamu abo abanyakwenyumiriza ebyaharuguru, kunu tihali omu mutima.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I thank God that I am the best of all of you.
lunyoro: Nkasiima Ruhanga, nimbakira inywena okukira inywena;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “Watch out and do not tell anyone; then come back and show the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a witness to them.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Werinde, oleke kugambiraho muntu; kandi garukayo, weyoleke hali nyakatagara, ohouge ekisembo Musa ekiyaragire, kibe kaiso habali.

english: [GENERAL] He is loved and faithful in all his work in behalf of his friends and guests.
lunyoro: Arukugonzebwa nokora omulimo ogwokwesiga omu byona ebyokora habwabu bene baitu kandi abagenyi:

english: [GENERAL] “No one of your brothers is called by that name,” they answered.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Busaho omuli bene banyu ayetwa ibara eri.

english: [GENERAL] How happy and happy it must have been to hear that your brother was dead, and he was alive! He was lost, and now he has been raised to life.
lunyoro: Baitu okukyanganuka nokusemererwa kisemire: baitu mugenzi wawe ogu akaba afire, kandi ayomire, akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: [GENERAL] But bring these people to me, who have not defiled the courts or defiled the widow's house.
lunyoro: Baitu mulete namberali abantu banu abatarasisire ebyomu mabandiro, nobukwakuba okujuma omufakati webisuba.

english: [GENERAL] But to everyone who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
lunyoro: baitu okusimwa nekitinisa nobusinge hali wena arukukora okurungi okubanza Omuyudaya kandi Nomuyonani:

english: [GENERAL] I am telling you the truth: a slave is not greater than his master, and a slave is not greater than his master.
lunyoro: Mali mali nimbagambira nti Omuiru takira obukuru mukamawe, kandi omukwenda takira obwingi ogu ayamutumire.

english: [GENERAL] But what you have heard from the beginning remains in you, and you will remain in the Son and the Father.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara obukiraba nikiikara omulinywe, nakyo ekimwahulirire okuruga kara na kara biraba kiikaire omuli inywe.Kandi obumuikara omu Mwana nomu Isitwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] There is nothing that has happened to you that has not happened to you of all people, but to the God of hope, who will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. Instead, he will take away everything you have, so that you may be able to endure.
lunyoro: Tinkabaho okwohebwa kwindi halinywe, okutarukusobora abantu bona; baitu Ruhanga wokwesiga, atalibaleka okwohwebwa okukira ekimusobora; baitu hamu nokwohebwa alitaho hokuirukira, nukwo musobole okuguma.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Why are you frightened? You have not yet found faith!”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubatinisa? Timukatungire kuikiriza?

english: [GENERAL] So Joseph left Galilee and did not go to Nazareth. He went to Judea to the town of Judas, which belongs to Bethlehem, because he was a guest in the house.
lunyoro: Yusufu akaruga omu Galiya natabara, arugire omu rubuga rwa Nazalesi, nataha omu Buyudaya hali orubuga rwa Baudi orwetwa Beterehemu, baitu akaba ali womu nju, kandi

english: [RELIGIOUS] I tell you, whoever does not believe in the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it.
lunyoro: Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Wena ataliikiriza obukama bwa Ruhanga nkomwana omuto, atalibutahamu na kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I tell you that soon the Son of Man will come and destroy them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Alibaramu'ra bwango. Baitu Omwana womuntu obwaliija alisanga okuikiriza hansi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Show yourselves thankful to God, a servant of God who is not ashamed of him, who is able to speak the truth with all his heart.
lunyoro: Wekambe okweyoleka osimirwe hali Ruhanga, omukozi atarukukwatwa ensoni, anyakusobo'ra kurungi ekigambo kyamazima.

english: [AGRICULTURE] But now the weeds are gathered into the barn, and every tree that does not bear good fruit will be burned up and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Na hati bunu empango etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire guratemwa, guranagwa omu mu'ro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus began to say to the crowds about John, “What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed shaken by the wind?”
lunyoro: Yabanza okugambira ebitebe ha Yohana ati Mukagenderayo ki omu irungu okurora? Orubingo orurukutengesebwa embeho?

english: [GENERAL] No one puts the wine out of the skins, and no one tells it, ‘The wine that does not remain in the cup has been poured out for you.’
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga ezikuzire; kakuba agira ati amarwa amarungi agasemire, nendyanga zisisikire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its roar, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. In this way you will say, ‘Whoever is born of the Spirit.’
lunyoro: Embeho ehuha nambere egonza, naiwe ohu'ra okuhi'ra kwayo, baitu tomanya nambere eruga, nobuhokuba nambere egenda; nukwo aba ati wena anyakuzarwa Omwoyo.

english: [GENERAL] But they did not recognize him, because their eyes had seen Jerusalem.
lunyoro: Baitu batamutangi'le baitu amaisoge gakaba garozire Yerusalemu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Publius, whose father was sick, was sick with a fever. Paul went in to him, prayed, placed his hands on him, and buried him.
lunyoro: Kandi ise Pubulio akaba abyamire arwaire omusuija nensese: Pauro yataha nemberali, yasaba, namutaho emikonoye, yamuzika.

english: [GENERAL] But you always have them, because you don't always have me.
lunyoro: Baitu basege munyinabo ebiro byona; baitu timunyina nyowe ebiro byona.

english: [GENERAL] Do not be like the foolish ones, who do not know what you are doing.
lunyoro: Kandi nkabana abokuhu'ra mutarukwesaniza nkokumumanyire, omu kutamanya kwanyu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus said, “Let those who have authority among you go away with me, and if this man is a sinner, let him go ahead and kill him.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagamba ati; Abayina obusobozi omulinywe, basirimuke nanyowe, kandi obwaraba omusaija ogu aroho ekibi kyona, bamulege.

english: [GENERAL] He was changed in front of them, and his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became like the light.
lunyoro: yahindurwa omu maiso gabu: amaisoge nigamulikana nkizoba, nebyokujwarabye nibyera nkomusana.

english: [GENERAL] He is the only one who comes from the cross.
lunyoro: Juna wenka, oruge ha muti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When you are purified from your sins, you will know the hope that God has set before you, the hope that is placed before you, and the glorious riches that are brought into the presence of the holy ones.
lunyoro: obumuraba numumanyire okunihira okwokwetakwe okukuli, nobuguda obwekitinisa ekyobugwetwa omuli abarukwera

english: [RELIGIOUS] When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea, he went to Galilee and begged him to heal his son, because he was about to die.
lunyoro: Obuyahulire ngu Yesu arugire omu Buyudaya, aizire galiraya yagenda namberali, yamwesengereza asirimuke, akize omwanawe; baitu akaba amalize okufa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they saw the wisdom of Peter and John, they recognized that they were ordinary people who did not know the truth and did not understand what they were learning, and they were surprised to know that they were with Jesus.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine obumanzi bwa Petero na Yohana, babamanyire okuba bantu abatamanyire okusoma, kandi abatakegesebwaga, batangara; babamanyi'ra nibo baikaraga na Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] But if you have poured this perfume out of my body, you have done it because of the burial.
lunyoro: Baitu obwaseserege amagita ganu ga mubiri gwange, akikozire obwokuzika.

english: [GENERAL] There was a man named Zacchaeus, who was rich and rich.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, hakaba haroho omusaija ibararye Zakayo; akabali omuhoza omukuru, kandi omuguda.

english: [RELIGIOUS] A man who was lame from his mother's womb had been healed, and the next day they threw him out of the Temple treasury, which is called the Holy Place, to tell those who had come into the Temple to be punished.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akabali omulema okuruga omu nda ya nyina akaba bamuhimbire, oubabyamyaga obukyabukya ha ruigi orwa yekaru orurukwetwa Orurungi, okulega ebyokuganyira hali abo atahaga omu yekaru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I was in Joppa praying, and my heart was made ready to see something coming up, like a dove coming down from heaven.
lunyoro: ndi omu harubuga Yopa ninsaba: omutima gwange gukahingisibwa, narora omu kwolekwa ekintu nikisirimuka, ekisisana nkorugoye orukoto orutebwa okuruga haiguru,

english: [RELIGIOUS] Peter said, “Lord, why are you trying to trap us all?
lunyoro: Petero yagamba ati Mukama waitu orufumo runu norutucwera itwe, nandiki bona?

english: [RELIGIOUS] They said to him, “Lord, give us this bread and this water.”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Mukama waitu otuhege obutosa ebyokurya ebi.

english: [GENERAL] You will be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a witness to them and to the nations.
lunyoro: Baitu habwibara ryange mulihebwayo hali abalemi nabakama, okuba bakaiso hali abo, na hali abamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] For the poor always have with them what they have, but the always do not have with me.
lunyoro: Baitu abamasege nibo munyinabo ebiro byona; baitu timunyina nyowe ebiro byona

english: [GENERAL] Which one of you, then, will I raise to life?
lunyoro: Kandi kiikaro ki nambere ndihumu'ra?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus knew that they were going to ask him, “Why did you ask one of them, ‘ Why did you say that there is only a little while, and you will not see me, and then a little while later you will see me?”
lunyoro: Yesu yamanya nibenda okumukaguza, yabagambira ati Nimukaguzangana inywenka habweki ekingambire nti Hasigaireho akacu kake, timundole, kandi halibaho akacu kike, mulindora?

english: [RELIGIOUS] If we have put you in prison by means of the Spirit, how can we rob you of your material riches?
lunyoro: Obuturaba itwe twabasigiremu ebyomwoyo, kyamahano obutuligesa ebyanyu ebyomubiri?

english: [RELIGIOUS] “The time has come for the Kingdom of God to come upon you,” he said. “Turn away, and believe in the Good News.”
lunyoro: yagamba ati Akasumi kahikira, obukamabwa Ruhanga bumalize okuhika: mwegarukemu, muikirirze enjiri.

english: [GENERAL] For there are some who are saved by the power of their mothers, and others who have been saved by the power of the Kingdom of heaven. Those who can believe and believe in it will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu haroho abakonerwe abazairwe bai okuruga omu nda za banyinabo: haroho abakuonerwe abayekonere bonka obwobukama obwomu iguru. Anyakusobora okukiikiriza, akiikirize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ,” they answered, “and you will be saved, you and your family.”
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Ikiiriza Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, nukwo orajunwa iwe nenju yawe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] We ourselves boast about you in the churches of God, because you endure with endurance and faith, in all your trials and sufferings.
lunyoro: nitwenyumiriza omulinywe omu kanisa za ruhanga, obwokugumisiriza kwanyu nokuikiriza, omu kuhigwa kwanyu kwona nomuhito ebimucule'ra:

english: [RELIGIOUS] He was in the desert with the angel who talked with him on Mount Sinai, and with our ancestors. He was given the living words to give to us.
lunyoro: Nuwe ogu akabali omu kanisa omu irungu, hamu namaraika eyabalize nauwe ha rusozi Sinai, kandi hamu na baisenkuru itwe: ayahairwe ebigambo ebyobwomezi okutuha itwe;

english: [RELIGIOUS] And you say, ‘Whoever tells his father or mother, ‘All that God has given him will be of no use to you.’
lunyoro: Kandi inywe mugamba ngu Wena obwaligambira ise rundi nyina ati Kyona ekinakukuhaire okukugasira nkihongire Ruhanga,

english: [GENERAL] When they saw that a man was healed, they stood still with them, but they could not answer him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine omuntu akizibwege, ayemerire hamu nabo, batasobole kugarukamu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I planted, Apollos watered, but God made it grow.
lunyoro: nyowe nkabyara, Aporo akaiti'ra amaizi: baitu Ruhanga nuwe yayanisize.

english: [GENERAL] I tell you that many will come from the east and the west and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of heaven.
lunyoro: Nanyowe nimbagambira nti Baingi abaliruga burugaizoba na bugwaizoba, baliika'ra hamu na Iburahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, omu bukama obwomu iguru:

english: [GENERAL] In the same way, now they too have been forgiven for their sin, and so have they been forgiven.
lunyoro: nukwo nabo hati bunu kuganyirwa okumwahairwe inywe, bo bahebwe okuganyirwa

english: [RELIGIOUS] In the same way, in the past, God's holy women who were waiting for God made fun of him and saw their own children.
lunyoro: Baitu omu biro byaira nukwo nabakazi abarukwera abanihiraga Ruhanga bayecumaga bati, nibarobera abaibabu bonka:

english: [GENERAL] Whoever has this hope in him will be happy just as he is pleased.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena anyakuina okunihira oku haruwe ayesemeza nkauwe okwasemezibwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus came in, he said to them, “What do you want me to do for you? The child is not dead, but only asleep.”
lunyoro: kandi obuyatahiremu yabagambira ati Kiki ekirukubanziza nekirukubaliza? Omuisiki tafire, agwijagire kwonka.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They took counsel together to trap Jesus and kill him.
lunyoro: baganiza ahamu okukwasa Yesu anamagezi, Bamuite.

english: [GENERAL] We found a ship sailing back to Phoenicia, where we sailed and got on.
lunyoro: kandi obutwasangire ekyombo. nikyambuka okugenda Foiniki, twakigwe'ramu, twahanika amaberu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who sent you.
lunyoro: Baitu tabali inywe mubaza, baitu Omwoyo ogwa Isinywe nuwe abaliza omulinywe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You call me Teacher and Lord, and you do well to speak, because that is what I am.
lunyoro: Inywe munyeta Mwegesa kandi Mukama wanyu: kandi mugamba kurungi: baitu nukwo ndi.

english: [GENERAL] For I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife or marries another commits adultery; and whoever marries a woman commits adultery.
lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti omuntu wena anyakubinga omukaziwe, rundi obwokusihana, buli amusihanize: nogu anyakumuswera abingirwe, buli asihaine.

english: [GENERAL] Was it? Was it because he was in circumcision? Or was it in uncircumcision? Was it in circumcision, but in circumcision.
lunyoro: Kukatekerezebwa kuta? Obwakaba ali omu kusarwa? Nandiki omu kutasarwa? Obwakasarwa, baitu omu kutusarwa:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus had no excuse for not having a share in the harvest, so he left them both. Which one of them should love him?
lunyoro: Obubakaba batanyina kyokumara ibanja, yabalekera bombi. Noha hali abo alikira okumugonza?

english: [GENERAL] For I do not speak of myself; but the Father who sent me has given me a commandment to tell and to speak.
lunyoro: baitu ntagambe habwange, rundi Isenyowe ayanyumire, nuwe yandagire okungamba, kandi okumbaza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For Christ has not entered a holy place made with hands, which is a copy of the truth; but into heaven itself, now to appear before God for us.
lunyoro: Baitu Kristo atatahe omu kiikaro ekirukwera ekyakozirwe nemikono, ekirukusisana nkeki ekyamazima; baitu omu iguru honyini, okwolekwa hati bunu omu maiso ga Ruhanga habwaitu;

english: [RELIGIOUS] And if I have repented afterward, my heart will not be glad in him.
lunyoro: Kandi obwayehinya enyuma, omutima gwange tigurukusemererwa omuruwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in union with Christ. We are weak, but you are strong in glory, because we are weak.
lunyoro: Itwe tuli badomadoma habwa Kristo, baitu inywe muli bamagezi omu Kristo: itwetuli bagara, baitu ninywe bamani bekitinisa, baitu itwe tuli bokugayibwa.

english: [GENERAL] They did not dare to speak to anyone about him.
lunyoro: Kandi batagume okugambiraho muntu haruwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So then, fulfill the promise made by your ancestors.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu muhikirize okuraganiza kwa baisenkuru inywe.

english: [GENERAL] Those who believe in me, as the scripture says, will come out of her, and she will drink of the boiling water.
lunyoro: Anyakuikiriza nyowe, nkekyahandikire okukugamba, omundaye nuho halituruka ebyambu ebyamaizi agomire.

english: [GENERAL] Or will you say to your brother, ‘Please take away the speck out of your eye, and look at the speck out of your eye?’
lunyoro: rundi, olimugambira ota mutahi wawe ngu Kanyiheho akantu akali haliso ryawe; kandi, dora enyomyo ikaire ha liso ryawe?

english: [GENERAL] Then you will say, ‘What does he do to him again?’ But who is willing to do what he wants?
lunyoro: Nukwo oragambira oti Kiki ekirukumuhanisa kandi? Baitu noha ayemera ebyagonza?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Look! The reward of those who work hard for the things that you did not work for them is that you stood up and told them about them; and their reward is great in the eyes of the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth.
lunyoro: Dora, empera yabakozi abatemere emisiri yanyu, eyimwabaimire negambira haiguru: nempamo yabu abagesere etahire omu matu Mukama owamahe.

english: [GENERAL] They learned to be self-controlled, but to be self-controlled, they went ahead and told others what they should not do.
lunyoro: Kandi bega okugira obugara bwonka, baitu bafoka abagambisibwa nakajanja, nibabaza ebitabasemerire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But now they want something better for themselves than for heaven. God will not be ashamed of them to be called their God, because he has prepared for them a city.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu nibegomba erukukira oburungi, niyo yomuiguru: nikyo Ruhanga alekera okubakwatirwa ensoni okwetwa Ruhanga wabu: baitu akabatekaniriza orubuga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They have refreshed my spirit and yours. You have put faith in those who are like them.
lunyoro: Baitu bakahumuza omwoyo gwange nogwanyu: omwoyo mubaikirize abanyakuli nkabo.

english: [GENERAL] There is no one who is righteous, no one who is righteous.
lunyoro: Tihiga omu: busaho ahikirire, busaho nomu:

english: [RELIGIOUS] The hand of the Lord was with them, and the whole crowd believed and turned to the Lord.
lunyoro: Omukonogwe gwa Mukama waitu gukaba guli nabo; nekitebe kingi ekyabaikirize bahindukira Mukama waetu.

english: [GENERAL] I wept bitterly, but no one could find any reason to open the book or to see it.
lunyoro: Kandi nka'ra muno, baitu busaho ayazokere asemerire okusuku'ra ekitabu, nobukwakuba okukiroraho.

english: [GENERAL] But the wise ones answered, “If you don't, we will all go with you. You should go where they will buy food for yourselves.”
lunyoro: Baitu abamagezi bagarukamu nibagamba ngu Rundi tigatumale, itwena nainywe: hakire mugende haliabarukugura mwe gu'le

english: [GENERAL] For I have given you an example, just as I also did to you.
lunyoro: Baitu mbahaire ekyokuro'raho, kandi nkokumbakozire nyowe, nukwo nainywe mukolege muti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Let us draw near to God with all our heart and with all our faith, with all our heart, and with all our soul, and with all our mind, and with all our strength, we have been filled with good water.
lunyoro: tui'le haihi nomutima ogwamazima, omu kuikiriza kwona, tuyina emitima yaitu emisirweho okuihamu omwoyo omubi, kandi nomubiri gwaitu gwogibwe amaizi amarungi:

english: [GENERAL] For just as the lightning from the east will happen, so the coming of the Son of Man will be.
lunyoro: Baitu nkenkuba okweruga burugaizoba; nukwo nukwo kuliba kuti okwija kwomwana

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Lord answered him, “Martha, Martha, you are deeply troubled and troubled by many things.
lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yagarukamu namugambira ati Maliza, Maliza iwe otuntuire notabana obwebigambo bingi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] God gave them the right to be ashamed of them, because their wives had purified themselves from the sexual immorality that belongs to them.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruhanga akabahayo hali okukwatwa okwensoni: baitu abakazi babu bakahingisa eki omubiri ekiguzalirwa omu eki ekitanyina amani,

english: [GENERAL] They found a stone rolled away from the tomb.
lunyoro: Basanga ibale likumbisibwe okuruga ha kituro.

english: [GENERAL] But if you have authority over others, you will be servants of God.
lunyoro: baitu anyakuba kira obukuru, nuwe aliba muhereza wanyu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The man came to us and took Paul's belt, tied it up with his own hands, and said, “This is what the Holy Spirit says: ‘The Jews in Jerusalem will arrest the man who owns this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
lunyoro: Ogu akaija nambetuli, yakwata omweko gwa Pauro, yayeboha ebigerebye nemikonoye wenka, nagamba ati Nukwo agambire Omwoyo Ogurukwera ati Abayudaya abomu Yerusalemu nukwo baliboha bati omusaija mukama womweko gunu, balimuhayo omu mikono Yabamahanga.

english: [GENERAL] They called the wise men fools,
lunyoro: Obubakaba nibeyeta abamagezi bafoka abadomadoma,

english: [GENERAL] The harvest of righteousness is sown in peace for those who do it.
lunyoro: Kandi ekyana ekyokuhiki'ra kibyarwa omu businge hali abo abarukuleta obusinge.

english: [GENERAL] Send now to Joppa and call for one Simon, whose name is Peter.
lunyoro: Kandi nati bunu otume abantu Yopa, oyeteyo omuntu Simoni ibararye eryakabiri Petero:

english: [RELIGIOUS] He raised us up together with him and seated us together in the heavenly places in union with Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: yatuhumbura hamu nauwe, yatuikaliza hamu omu biikaro ebyomu iguru omu Kristo Yesu:

english: [GENERAL] The younger one said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of the property where you belong.’
lunyoro: kandi omuto akagambira ise ati Tata mpa omugabo ogwebintu ogusemerire.

english: [GENERAL] But now I no longer work in this world, and for many years I wanted to come to you.
lunyoro: Baitu hati bunu tinkyanyina mulimo omu nsi zinu, kandi okuruga omu myaka mingi nkaba ningoza okuija namberemuli;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “Lord, I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who comes into the world.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Nukwo, Mukama wange, nyikirize niwe Kristo, omwana wa Ruhanga, aija omu nsi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus gave a parable to them, saying, “There was once a man who was one on the road, and he was one who was holy.
lunyoro: Kandi akabacwera orufumo ati Hakaba haroho omuntu omu emisirye neyera bingi:

english: [GENERAL] They did this and were handed over to the chief priests by Barnabas and Saul.
lunyoro: kandi nukwo bakozire bati, nibabitwekera abakuru omu mukono gwa Baranaba na Sauro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Look! Today I drive out demons and heal people, and the third day I am coming back to you.’
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mugende mugambire eboha egi muti Dora, hati na ijo nimbinga emizimu, ninkiza abantu, kandi ha kiro kyakasatu nimpiki'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For we are the chosen ones who worship God in spirit and rejoice in Christ Jesus, who does not rely only on human nature.
lunyoro: baitu itwe tuli bokusarwa abarukuramya Ruhanga omu Mwoyo, kandi abarukwenyumiriza omu Kristo Yesu, abatarukwesiga omubiri kwonka:

english: [GENERAL] Yes, Father, for so it was well with you.
lunyoro: Ego, isenyowe baitu nukwo kyasemire kiti omu maiso gawe.

english: [GENERAL] The first came to him and said, ‘Sir, your gold earned ten thousand silver coins.’
lunyoro: Owokubanza akaija namberali nagamba ati Mukama wange, erateri yawe ekasagisamu erateri ikumi ezindi.

english: [GENERAL] You are the ones who are the ones who are the ones who belong to the world. And do not call anyone your father on earth, for one is your Father, the Creator of heaven and earth.
lunyoro: kandi inywe mutaryeta muntu hansi isinywe; baitwe isinye ali omu,

english: [RELIGIOUS] There is difference between a wife and her husband. The unmarried woman is anxious for the things of the Lord, so that she may be physically and spiritually married. But the married woman is anxious for the things of the world, so that she may please her husband.
lunyoro: Kandi haroho okubaganizamu omukazi aswirwe nomuhara. Omukazi ataswirwe atuntu'ra ebya Mukama waitu, nukwo ayerege nomu mubiri nomu mwoyo: baitu anyakuswirwe ahanga ebya hansi, okwarasemezaga omusaijawe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Father, into your hands I entrust my spirit!” At the same time he said this and gave me life.
lunyoro: Nauwe yagamba ati Isenyowe, omu mikono yawe mpaireyo omwoyo gwange. Obuyamazire okugamba eki yahayo obwomezi.

english: [GENERAL] Let each one keep seeking, not his own advantage, but that of others.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena aleke okuse'ra ebye wenka, baitu ase'le ebyabandi.

english: [GENERAL] I have made your name known to them, and I will make it known. The love you have for me will be in them, and I will be in them.
lunyoro: Kandi nkabamanyisa ibara ryawe, kandi ndirimanyisa; okugonza okuwagondeze nyowe kuikale omubo, nanyowe omubo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Lydda and Joppa heard that Peter was there, the disciples sent two men to ask him not to stay with us.
lunyoro: Kandi Ruda, obwokuba haihi na Yopa, abegeswa obubahulire Petero aliyo, bamutumira abantu babiri nibamwesengereza ngu Otaikara, otahi're halitwe.

english: [GENERAL] and said, “You went in to the uncircumcised, and you ate with them.”
lunyoro: nibagamba ngu Okataha omu bantu abatasazirwe, kandi okarya nabo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] In this way he brings himself to the church for the sake of glory. He has no excuse, no pity, no pity, no shame, for nothing is like this. He must be holy, without being condemned.
lunyoro: nukwo agyeretere wenka ekanisa eyekitinisa, etanyina kamogo, nobugwakuba omugonya, nobukyakuba ekintu kyona ekirukusisana kiti, baitu ikalege erukwera etaroho musango.

english: [GENERAL] If I drive out demons by means of Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Then they will judge them.
lunyoro: Kandi nyowe obundaba nimbinga emizimu habwa beerezebuli, abana banyu biginga habwoha? Nukwo balibacwera omusango.

english: [GENERAL] Have I ever been generous to those who sent me to you?
lunyoro: Nkaba ntungisize wena hali abo abanabatumiraga amagoba omulinywe?

english: [GENERAL] For there is no one who has a conscience like that of Moses, who will understand your words.
lunyoro: Baitu tinyina ondi nomu anyina omutima okuingana nogu, alitaho omutima ebigambo byanyu.

english: [GENERAL] I tell you, then, that many of his sins have been forgiven by him, because he has been forgiven by God for his abundant love, but only a little while has been forgiven by him.
lunyoro: Nikyo nkugambirire nti Ebibibye ebingi bimuihirweho; baitu okugonzakwe kwingi, baitu anyakuihwaho ebike, nuwe agonza kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He became a strong man of faith, giving thanks to God, and he knew that what he was about to do was what he had told him to do.
lunyoro: baitu akafoka wamani obwokuikiriza, nakugiza Ruhanga, kandi amanyire kimu ati ekiyaragire nikyo asobora okukora.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I am sure that all things are dead, so that I may know the truth about Christ Jesus, my Lord. I know that I have died for all, and that I may pray for him.
lunyoro: Baitu mazimkwo nintekereza byona bifire, obwoburungi obwingi obwokumanya Kristo Yesu Mukama wange: ounaferirwe byona, kandi nimbitekereza okuba nkesabu,

english: [GENERAL] Many of those who heard the message gathered their books together and burned them before all the people. They counted the price of them and saw the money they owed to the five kings.
lunyoro: Kandi baingi hali abo abahoraga ebyokuragura bakasoroza ahamu ebitabu byabu, babyokeza, omu maiso gabantu bona: kandi babara omuhendo gwabyo, bagurora bicweka byefeza bukumi butano.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus we will be saved, and so will they.
lunyoro: Baitu itwe tuikirize ngu tulijunwa obwembabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu, kandi nabo nukwo bati.

english: [GENERAL] For if I live in the flesh, I do not know what I want.
lunyoro: baitu okwemera omu mubiri, -kiraba nikyo kyana kyemirimo yange, nyowe timanyire ekindayegomboza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Large crowds gathered around him, but they could not find one or the other at the door. He told them the message.
lunyoro: Baso'rokana baingi, kandi bakaba batarukusobora kuhikamu, nobuhokuba omu muryango: yabatebeza ekigambo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For he has given all those who believe in him authority to become God's children, if they believe in him.
lunyoro: Baitu bona abamukirize, akabaha obusobozi okufoka abana baruhanga,niba barukuikiriza ibararye:

english: [GENERAL] All of you can speak with one another, so that all may understand.
lunyoro: Baitu inywena numusobora okutebeza omu omu, nukwo bona betegereze,

english: [GENERAL] He stayed with them and worked with them, because they were workers in the Temple.
lunyoro: Kandi uwe obwokuba owomulimo ogumu nogwabu, yaikara nabo, nibakora omulimo; baitu omulimo gwabu bakaba bali bakozi behema.

english: [GENERAL] The servant, who knows what his master wants him to do, is not ready to do what he wants.
lunyoro: Omwiru ogu rubale, ayamanyire mukamawe ebyagondeze, kandi atetekanize, nobukwakuba okukora nkoku yagondeze;

english: [RELIGIOUS] They handed him over to be tried by God, as he had instructed them. You crucified him with the power of the Evil One and killed him.
lunyoro: ogu obubamuhaireyo, nka Ruhanga okuyabandize okuhanura nokumanya, inywe mukamubamba ha muti nemikono yabantu ababi, mwamuita:

english: [GENERAL] They spread out around the whole world and surrounded the camp of the holy ones and the city that belongs to them. fire came down from heaven and destroyed them all.
lunyoro: Baramaga okuhikya ensi zona, bayehinguliriza orukande orwabarukwera norubuga orurukogonzebwa: kandi omu'ro gwagwa okuruga omu iguru gwabokeza kimu.

english: [GENERAL] When he found himself in fashion as a human being, he humbled himself and fell asleep in death, just as the death of a cross was.
lunyoro: kandi obuyazokere okusisana nomuntu yayebundaza wenka, naculera okuhikya ha kufa, nukwo kufa kwa ha muti.

english: [RELIGIOUS] May God's peace come upon you, when you are put right with one another in the same way, and be made alive.

lunyoro: Sarumoni akazara Boazi omu Rahabu; Boazi akazara Obeda omu Rusi; Obeda akazara Yese;

lunyoro: nangwa, nobwakuba Herode: baitu uwe amugaruirehoga hali itwe; kandi dora, takozire kintu ekisemerire okumuisa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery; and whoever marries another commits adultery against her commits adultery against her.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Omuntu wena wena alibinga mukaziwe, naswera ondi, buli asihaine okumusisa; nauwe wenka obwaryanga iba,

lunyoro: baitu ebigambo ebitarumu ebyatarukutina Ruhanga obitantalege, baitu nikyo kiragiro.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I have said that we are wise and think that it is better for us not to be in the body but to be in the Lord.
lunyoro: kandi ngambire nti tunyina obumanzi, tutekerize ngu nikyo kirukukira oburungi okutaba omu mubiri, baitu okubaho hali Mukama waitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus told them this parable, but they did not understand what he was talking about.
lunyoro: Yesu akabagambira orufumo oru, baitu bo batetegereze bigambo okubiri ebiyabagambire.

english: [GENERAL] If anyone is hungry, let him eat at home; so that you will not judge. And the rest will be glad when I come.
lunyoro: Omuntu wena obwaba arumirwe enjara, aryege omukaye: nukwo muleke okwesoroleza omusango. Kandi ebindi ebisigaireho ndibisemeza obunsikaija.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus said, “What human beings cannot do is for God.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagamba ati Ebi ebitarukusoboka omu bantu, nibisoboka hali Ruhanga.

english: [GENERAL] But when Peter arrived in Antioch, I met him face-to-face, because he had been judged.
lunyoro: Baitu Kefa obuyaizire Antyokiya nkamutanga omu maisoge, baitu akaba agwerirwe omusango.

english: [GENERAL] In the same way, I tell you, now that you are ready to begin not only to do but also to do what you want to do.
lunyoro: Kandi nukwo, ncwire nti, baitu kinu kibasemerire inywe abamazire omwaka gumu numubanza okutandika, okutakora kwonka baitu okukora numugonza.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Be kind to one another, compassionate, and freely forgive one another, just as God through Christ freely forgave you.
lunyoro: kandi mukoranganege kurungi inywenka nemitima yembabazi, numuganyirangana, kandi nka Ruhanga omu Kristo okuyaganyire inywe.

english: [GENERAL] You were running well. Who appointed you to see the truth?
lunyoro: Mukaba numuiruka kurungi; noha yabatangire okutorobera amazima?

english: [RELIGIOUS] But when evening came, Jesus stood still, because the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
lunyoro: Baitu obubukaba nubukya, Yesu yayeme'ra ha musa: baitu abegeswa batamanye nuwe Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I hope in God for you personally, so that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
lunyoro: yina okunihira hali Ruhanga okubanihira bonka, ngu halibaho okuhumbuka okwabahikirire nabatahikirire.

english: [GENERAL] If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
lunyoro: Obutugamba ngu titunyina bibi twebihabiha, kunu namazima tigali omulitwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Mary said, “Look! I am the descendant of the Lord, just as the angel had told me.” The angel left her.
lunyoro: Maryamu yagamba ati Dora nyowe, omuzana wa Mukama; kibe hali nyowe nkokwogambire. Kandi maraika yaruga namberali.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They said to themselves, “If we say, ‘From where did you not believe in him?’
lunyoro: Bakaguzangana bonka, nibagamba ngu Obuturaba ntugamba ngu Kukaruga omu ekibatangire okumuikiriza?

english: [RELIGIOUS] But a woman who is a sinner is waiting for God, and she is eager to pray and pray day and night.
lunyoro: Kandi omufakati mali kandi anyakulekerwe anihira Ruhanga, kandi ayekamba omu kwesengereza nokusaba ekiro na nyamusana.

english: [GENERAL] Do you know that those who work in the Temple and eat the bread from the altar will also be persecuted?
lunyoro: mumanyire ngu abarukukora emirimo eyemu yekaru, barya ha byomu yekaru? Nabo abahereza ekyoto babagana nekyoto?

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I am ready today to be an angel of God, who will give me whatever I need.
lunyoro: Baitu hayemerirege namberendi ekiro kinu maraika wa Ruhanga, arukukutunga kandi oumpereza.

english: [GENERAL] That is why we were encouraged, and we were filled with joy by the joy that Titus gave us, because his heart was made firm in you all.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyatuhumuize: kandi omu kuhumuzibwa kwaitu tukakira muno okusemererwa, okwokusemererwa kwa Tito, baitu omutimagwe gukagumibwa inywe inywena.

english: [GENERAL] Do not go along the paths of the nations, nor go into any town.
lunyoro: Mutaligenda omu mihanda eyabamahanga, nobukwakuba okutaha omu rubuga rwona

english: [GENERAL] For you tolerate fools with joy, but you are wise.
lunyoro: Baitu numugumisiriza abadomadoma nokusemererwa, baitu inywe muli bamagezi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] God, who raised his Son from death, sent him to bless you and to turn you all from your sins.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe Ruhanga, obuyamazire okuhumbura Omwanawe, yamutuma okubaha omugisa, nabahindura inywena okuruga omu bibi byanyu.

english: [GENERAL] When they saw it, they did not understand it, and when they heard it, they did not repent. But they did not repent and turn around from their sins.
lunyoro: babona, batetegereza; kandi obubahu'ra bahu'le, batahwituka; rundi batagaruka okuhinduka, nokuganyirwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the people of Macedonia and Achaia were happy to have some of the holy ones in Jerusalem.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus rebuked him, and the spirit came out of him, and the spirit came out of him that day.
lunyoro: Yesu yamucomera; omuzimu gwamurugaho: omwojo akaira okuruga omu kasumi ako.

english: [GENERAL] There will be great earthquakes that have not yet taken place on the Sabbath, and in those days there will be no more famine.
lunyoro: hobwoku••halibaho omihito omwingi ogutakabahoga ensi ekaba kubaho nokuhikya hati, kandi tigulibaho obwokabiri.

english: [GENERAL] My mother has many things to say and condemn, but the one who sent me is truthful; and I have told the world what I have heard from him.

english: [GENERAL] Festus answered, “Paul was waiting for Caesarea, and he himself had the chance to go ahead of him.”

lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Munyanyako nagenda oku humbuka.

lunyoro: Nebigambo ebyensoni nebigambo ebyokutasemera nebisuba nobubyakuba ebyokuseka ebitali birungi, baitu hakire musimege.

lunyoro: kandi abo obubahikire Kaisaliya, bamuha omulemi ebaruha, kandi bamurangira Pauro.

lunyoro: babanyakatagara abakuru nabakuru nukwo bamuterire enaku, nibamubamba ha muti.

lunyoro: Baitu yabagambira ati Ekisisani kinu kiraha? Bamugambira ngu Bya kaisali.

lunyoro: Kandi obunabonabonesaga emirundi mingi omu maso'rokaniro gona, nabahambirizaga okuhika omu mbuga zabanyaihanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Do not be afraid of the things that belong to me, but of the things that belong to me, which you believe, as an angel of God, in union with Christ Jesus.
lunyoro: kandi okwohebwa kwanyu okwomu mubiri gwange mutakugaye, kunu mutakunuge; baitu mukanuikiriza nka maraika wa Ruhanga, nka Kristo Yesu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When the crowds saw it, they were terrified and praised God, who had given such authority to the people.
lunyoro: Baitu ebitebe obubyaboine byatina, banyumiza Ruhanga ayahaire abantu obusobozi obuingaine aho.

english: [GENERAL] Every good gift and every perfect present comes down from heaven, from the Father of the celestial lights, who cannot change or change.
lunyoro: Ibisi ryona erisemire, nekisembo kyona ekihikirire kiruga haiguru nikisirimuka okuruga hali Isit we owebinyakujwa, atarukusobora okuba nokuhindukahinduka, nobukyakuba ekiituru ekiretwa okuhingura.

english: [GENERAL] The vision appeared to Paul on the night. There was a man in Macedonia who was sitting there begging him, “Get up and come and help us!”

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to her, “Go your way; your son lives.” The man believed what Jesus had told him, and he left.

lunyoro: Nsemerirwe, baitu omu byona ninguma omutima omulinywe.

lunyoro: Kandi ogu asigirwe ha myandara nuwogu anyakuhu'ra ekigambo, ahonaho akiikiriza nokusemererwa;

english: [RELIGIOUS] If you remember these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, a preacher of the Good News and a preacher of the Good News which you have followed to this very day.
lunyoro: Obwoliijukya bene banyu ebigambo binu oliba muhereza murungi owa Kristo Yesu, noku'ra omu bigambo byokuikiriza nebyokwegesa okurungi okuwakuratire okuhikya hati:

english: [RELIGIOUS] We sent Timothy, our brother, and God's messenger in the Good News about Christ, who will strengthen you and comfort you in your faith.
lunyoro: kandi twatuma Timuseo mwene waitu, kandi omuhereza wa Ruhanga omu njiri ya Kristo, okubagumya nokubahumuza omu byakuikiriza kwanyu;

english: [GENERAL] They know him, but they do not follow him; they only run away from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers.
lunyoro: Kandi zimumanya iraka; Ondi tizirimukuratira, zirimuiruka kwonka: baitu tizimanyire iraka ryondi.

english: [GENERAL] Or if your right eye causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away from you. It is better for you to lose one of your body than to have your whole body thrown into hell.
lunyoro: Rundi eriso ryawe eryoburyo liraba nirikutabaijura, olihemu, okinage hara, baitu nikyo kurukukira oburungi ekicweka kyawe ekimu okubura, omubiri gwawe gwona gutanagwa omu Gehena.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said, “The things you see will happen to you when the sun will set here on the stone which will be rolled up.
lunyoro: yagamba ati Ebintu binu ebimurukurora, ebiro biriija obuhatalisigwa hanu ibale erinyakuli ha ibale eritalinagwa hansi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said, “Go to the city to meet me and tell him, ‘Teacher, when my time is up, I will wait for the Passover meal with my disciples at your house.’
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Mugende ha rubuga ombananka, mumugambire ngu Omwegesa nagamba ati Akasumi kange kamalize kuija; omu nju yawe nuho ndalira Okuhingurwaho hamu nabegeswa bange.

english: [GENERAL] They will take the sword, and if they drink any deadly thing, it will not hurt them at all; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be healed.
lunyoro: balita empirima, kandi obubaliba nibanywa ekirukuita kyona, tikiribarwaza na kake; balitaho emikono yabu ha barwaire, nabo balikira.

english: [GENERAL] So then, whoever welcomes me in front of men will be faithful to me in the presence of my Father in heaven.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wena alinkyikiriza omu maiso gabantu, uwe ndimuikiriza omu Maiso ga Isenyowe ali mu iguru.

english: [GENERAL] After the uproar had subsided, Paul said to the crowd, “Fellow Ephesians, who does not know that the city of Ephesus is the city that belongs to the Temple of the great goddess Artemis and to the image that fell down from heaven from heaven?”
lunyoro: Entu bene baitu, muntu ki atarukumanya ngu orubuga rwa Efeso nurwo rulinda yekaru ya Atemi omukuru, nekisisani ekyaragaire hansi okuruga hali Zeu?

english: [GENERAL] For I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me food to drink; I was a stranger, and you took me in.
lunyoro: Baitu nkaba nyine enjara, nainywe mukampa ebyokurya; nkaba ndi nyine iroho nainye mukanywisa; kabandi munyaihanga, nainyowe mukangonyesa;

english: [GENERAL] To him be the eternal inheritance, the eternal life, which he has promised, and the eternal life which he has promised in heaven.
lunyoro: Hali obugwetwa obutarukujunda, obutasisikaire obutalihwaho, obunyakwahulirwe omu iguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power that is in heaven will be shaken. And this is what the Holy Spirit says.
lunyoro: Maraika yagarukamu namugambira ati Omwoyo Ogurukwera alikuizira, namani gogu anyakuli haiguru muno galikusirikiriza: kandi eki ekirizarwa nikyo kiryeterwa Ekirukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his clothes and put on him and put a four-legged soldiers under guard. He and his guard were thrown out of heaven.
lunyoro: Kandi baserikale abubamazire okubamba Yesu ha muti, batwara ebyokujwarabye nibateka emiteko ena, serikale omuteko na serikale womuteko: nekanzuye, baitu ekarukibwa okuruga eruguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For the love of Christ compels us, because we believe that one man died for all, and so all died.
lunyoro: Baitu okugonza kwa Kristo nukutuhambiriza, baitu tutekerize kinu ngu omu akafa habwa bona, nukwo bona bafire bati;

english: [GENERAL] In this way you became a sign for all who believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
lunyoro: nukwo mwafokere muti ekyokuro'raho hali bona abarukuikiriza, omu Makedoni nomu Akaya.

english: [GENERAL] For everything in the world, the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life, does not come from the Father, but from the world.
lunyoro: Baitu byona eebinyakuli omunsi, okwegomba okwomubiri, nokwegomba okwamaiso, nokwenyumiza okwobwomezi okutarumu, tibiruga omuli Isitwe, baitu biruga hali ensi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “If you have two loaves, give them to the one you do not have, and if you have enough to eat, do so.”
lunyoro: Yagarukamu nabagambira ati Anyakuina ebyesomeko bibiri, amuheho ogu atanyinakyo; nanyakunyina ebyokurya, nukwo agire ati.

english: [GENERAL] The Kingdom, power, and authority are all the things that are told about, not only in this world but also in that which is to come.
lunyoro: okukira okulema kwona, nobusobozi, namani, nobukama, nibara ryona erinyakugambwa, tihali omu businge bunu bwonka, baitu nomuli obu oburukugenda kuija:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus knew what they were saying, and he said to them, “Why are you arguing with one another about lack of bread? Don't you know or understand? Your hearts are deeply troubled?”
lunyoro: Yesu obuyamanyire yabagambira ati Nimukaguzanganira ki obwokutaba nemigati? Timukamanyire, nobukwakuba okwetegereza? Emitima yanyu egumangaine?

english: [RELIGIOUS] If the Lord turned from his sins, the secret matters will be removed.
lunyoro: Kandi obugulikahindukira Mukama waitu ekyokwesweke'ra kiriihibwaho.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Get up and stand in the middle of the courtyard.” He got up and stood there.
lunyoro: baitu akamanya ebitekerezo byabu: yagambira omuntu akabanyina omukono gwomere ati Imuka, oyeme'le hagati aho. Yaimuka yayeme'ra aho

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I tell you that this poor widow gave more than all the other poor people.
lunyoro: Yagamba ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omufakati onu omusege anagiremu bingi okubakira bona:

english: [GENERAL] Moses was taught all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was mighty in his words and deeds.
lunyoro: Kandi Musa akegesebwa amagezi gona Agabamisiri, akabali wamani omu bigambobye nomu ngesoze.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Watch out for yourselves as you go into the city, and there will meet you a man who has a jar of water, and you will follow him into the house where he enters.
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Murole obumurakataha ha rubuga, harabatangana omusaija ayetwekere omunaga gwamaizi; mumukuratire okutaha omu nju eyarakatahamu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Does their lack of faith prove that they are faithful to God?
lunyoro: Okutaikiriza kwabu nukuburanganiza okwesigwa kwa Ruhanga?

english: [GENERAL] They arrived at the official's house, and he noticed that the people were crying and making a lot of noise.
lunyoro: Bahika ha nju yomukuru wiso'rokaniro: yarora okwanzira, nabakaba niba'ra nibatera empamo nyingi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For God wants you to be filled with the ignorant knowledge of foolish people by doing good.
lunyoro: Baitu nukwo Ruhanga agonza ati inywe obwokukora kurungi muculeze obutamanya bwabantu abadomadoma:

english: [RELIGIOUS] His fame spread everywhere in Judea and in all its forms.
lunyoro: Nebigambo binu bikaranganwa omu Buyudaya bwona, nesni yona ehe'raine.

english: [GENERAL] But stop the false stories that will not be taught, and you will know that they lead to destruction.
lunyoro: Baitu enganikyo ezitali zedini ezobutami ozireke, omanyire ngu nizireta okukungana.

english: [GENERAL] For the things that are done by those who are in secret are shameful words.
lunyoro: Baitu ebi ebirukukorwa abo omu nsita, kyensoni okubigambaho kwonka.

english: [GENERAL] “We played the flute for you, but you wouldn't dance,” they said. “We sang the tambourine for you, but you wouldn't cry.”
lunyoro: baitu tukabate'ra enyamulere, timwazina: tukatera empamo, timwara.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then the one who is the one who is the one who will be revealed by the Spirit of the Lord Jesus will be revealed by means of the Good News about his coming.
lunyoro: Kandi nubwo ogu owobwemi alisuku'rwa, Mukama waitu Yesu owalihwerekereza norwoya orwakanwake, namuburanganiza obwokumanyisa okwokuijakwe;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For he had healed the Jews by means of power and publicly proving through the Scriptures that Jesus was the Messiah.
lunyoro: baitu akasingura Abayudaya namani, kandi omu maiso gabantu, namanyisa omu Byahandikirwe ngu Yesu nuwe Kristo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Give thanks to the Lord for his goodness.
lunyoro: musime eki ekirukuseme'ra Mukama waitu;

lunyoro: Baitu nintekereza nyenka okuba omwekitinisa, okutamanyisa omusango ogusagire haruwe.

english: [GENERAL] So then show yourselves to them as children
lunyoro: Nukwo muti mweyoleka intwenka ninywe bana ba

lunyoro: Emyaka amakumi ana omu irungu, inywe abenju ya Isaleri?

english: [GENERAL] And I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife for any cause other than sexual immorality, and marries another commits adultery with her.
lunyoro: Nanyowe nimbagambira nti Wena obwalibiga mukaziwe, rundi okumujunaniza obwobusihani: nauwe anyakuswera ogu abingirwe, buli asihaine.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who proclaim your love in the presence of the church. If you arrest them in their way, as God wants you to, you will do well.
lunyoro: abo abamanyisize okugonza kwawe omu maiso gekanisa: abo obwolibabohe'ra omu rugendo rwabu, nkokukisemera hali Ruhanga, olikora kurungi:

english: [RELIGIOUS] He went into the synagogue every Sabbath and encouraged the Jews and the Greeks.
lunyoro: Kandi yahakanaga omu iso'rokaniro Sabiti zona nayomereza Abayudaya Nabayonani.

english: [GENERAL] But now you have done what you wanted to, and now you have done what you wanted to do, and you have kept it as much as you can.
lunyoro: baitu hati bunu muhikirize nokukora, nkokumwagondeze bwango okukora, nukwo nokuhikiriza kubeho kuti, nkokumurukusobora.

english: [GENERAL] But to wait for God's judgment, with fear and the dread of the burning anger, will be added to the adversaries.
lunyoro: baitu okutegereza omusango, hamu nokutina nekiniga ekyomu'ro ekirugenda okwokeza kimu abanyanzigwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Jesus took the boats back to land and left everything and followed him.
lunyoro: Kandi obukalesere amato gabu ha musa, basiga byona, bamukuratira.

lunyoro: Baitu Maliza akaba natalibana obwokuhereza okwingi; yaija namberali namugambira ati Mukama wange, torukukitaho mutima, baitu owanyina nyowe ansigirege okuhereza nyenka? Nukwo ngambira ankonyere.

lunyoro: Baitu tindukutekereza bwomezi bwange nkekintu kyona ekyomuhendo hali nyowe, rundi mpikirize orugendo rwange, nokuhereza okunahairwe hali Mukama waitu Yesu, okumanyisa enjiri eyembabazi eza Ruhanga

english: [GENERAL] For people will be selfish, greedy, boastful, and conceited, and will be disobedient to parents, ungrateful, and defiled.
lunyoro: Baitu abantu baliba abegonza bonka, nabagonza erupiya, nabemyehembo, nabekuniki, naba tarukuhu'ra ababazaire, nabatarukusima, nabasisi:

lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga nuwe kaiso wange, ounko'ra omu mwoyo gwange omu njiri Yomwanawe, okungamba halinywe okutaikya,

lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Anyakwogibwe taroho ekyase'ra, rundi okunabisibwa ebigere byonka, baitu asemerezibwe kimu: nainywe timuli byona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They said they knew God, but they did not obey him, because they were angry and did not obey him and were ungrateful to him for their good deeds.
lunyoro: bagamba okumanya Ruhanga; baitu omungeso zabu bamwehakana, baitu bali bokunugwa, nabatarukuhu'ra nabatarukusimwa omu muliimo gwona omu rungi.

lunyoro: Kandi ebi ebimwahandikire, kiruni omusaija okutakwataga ha mukazi:

lunyoro: Yagambira omulimi wemizabibu ati Dora, emyaka enu esatu nyija okuse'ra ebyana ha mutini gunu, ntarukubiboba; guteme; nugwema'raho ki ekibanja?

lunyoro: Kandi yamutwara yamuleta hali engabwa enkuru, nagamba ati Pauro omunyankomo anyesere namberali, yanyesengereza okukuletara omusigazi onu, anyina ekyokukutebeza.

lunyoro: Baitu ebyabafire, nokuhumburwa kwabu, timukasomaga omu kitabu kya Musa ha Rusaka, Ruhanga obuyamugambire, nagamba ati Ninyowe Ruhanga wa Ibarahimu, Ruhana wa Isaka, Ruhanaga wa Yakobo?

lunyoro: Kandi obuyamuihireho ogu, yaimukya Daudi, okuba omukama wabu; ouyarangire nagamba ati Mboine Daudi omwana wa Yese, omuntu ali nka nyowe okundukwenda, alikora ebingonza byona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He poured out his own blood on them, just as God had poured out his own blood on them.
lunyoro: hayo ekyonzira ekyesagamaye wenka hali bona, nka Ruhanga okuyagondeze ati.

english: [GENERAL] Aren't you the ones who make you the name of the glory that you have given me?
lunyoro: Tinibo abarukujuma ibara eyekitinisa erimwayetirwemu?

english: [GENERAL] Uzziah his son Jotham his son Ahaz his son Hezekiah his son
lunyoro: Uziya akazara Yosamu; Yosamu akazara Ahazi; Ahazi akazara Hezekiya;

english: [RELIGIOUS] For he has heard the voice of those who know him and have seen him as he is, in order that they may be one in union with him among many of his friends.
lunyoro: Baitu abo abamumanyire ira, nibo yayahuire, okusisanizibwa nomulingo Gwomwanawe, nukwo abe omuzigaijo omu bagenzibe abaingi:

english: [GENERAL] Or if I take you to court by means of my own body, I will save some of them.
lunyoro: Rundi obundibakwasa ihali obwekigambo kyona abomubiri gwange, rundi ndijuna abamu omubo.

english: [GENERAL] We have a prisoner in the Temple, who is not allowed to go into the Temple.
lunyoro: Tunyina ekyoto abo abahereza ebyomu hema ekibatararagirwe okuliraho:

english: [RELIGIOUS] I was given a different church, so that I might be a servant to you.
lunyoro: Nkaiba ekanisa ezindi nimpabwa empera, empereze inywe:

english: [GENERAL] But they did not understand, and they did not understand, and they did not walk in the truth, in order to deceive others, and in his error.
lunyoro: baitu batakiteho mutima, nibegendera omu makage, omu buguzibwe:

english: [RELIGIOUS] But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you. You will be witnesses of me both in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria and to the ends of the earth.
lunyoro: Baitu mulihebwa amani Omwoyo Ogurukwera obwaliikamara okubaizira: nainywe muraikaraga bakaiso bange omu Yerusalemu, na Buyudaya bwona, nomu Samaliya nokuhikya empero zensi.

english: [GENERAL] They wandered through the desert, the mountains, the hills, and the springs.
lunyoro: bahambaga omu irungu, nensozi nobuingira, nomu biina biitaka.

lunyoro: Firipo yamugambira ati Ija orole.

lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagambira haiguru niraka likoto, nagamba ati Otekora kubi: baitu itwena tuli hanu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Keep the Law without spot, without spot from it, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lunyoro: Arukwehakana ngu Yesu tali Kristo nuwe munyanzigwa wa Kristo; ogu nuwe aikana Isitwe Nomwana.

lunyoro: Baitu ebyokuhabisa tibirireka okubaho omulinywe, nukwo abasemire bamanyisibwe omulinywenka.

lunyoro: Yabona omutini gumu ha muhanda rubaju, yaguhikaho nasanga busaho kintu,rundi amababi masa:yagugambira ati Otaryana byana ebiro nebiro. Ahonaho omutini gwayoma.

lunyoro: Baitu omubiro ebya kara Syuda akaimuka nayegamba okuba mukuru; nabantu baingi bakaterana nauwe: ogu akaitwa; na bona abamuhulire bakararanga nibaburangana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Leave the outer garments that are outside of the Temple, and do not touch them. The holy city will be destroyed for forty-two months.

lunyoro: Kandi nambere yagendaga hona, rundi omu bika, ruli omu mbuga, runyumaye, babyamisaga abarwaire omu butale, nibamwesengereza bakole kwonka ha mukugiro gwekyokujwarakye: kandi bona abakorahoga bakira.

lunyoro: Baitu nkokuruga omu bugwaizooba okuhika ha rubaju orwekyambu, nukwo nukwo kiriba kiti nambereri. Omwana womuntu nukwo aliba ati hakirokye.

lunyoro: Ibyo byona mukorwege omu kugonzangana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So God exalted him to a superior position and gave him the name that is above every other name.
lunyoro: Kokwo Ruhanga yamunyumize haiguru muno, kandi akamuha ibara eri erirukukira amabara gona:

lunyoro: Amahanga gona agabanobere ibara ryange.,

lunyoro: Baitu kibahikirire okugamba ngu Mukama waitu obwaligonza tuliba bomezi, kandi tulikora tuti, rundi tuti.

lunyoro: Ruhanga Ise Mukama waitu Yesu, arukusimwa ebiro byona, amanyire tindukubiha.
