lunyoro: Nuwogu arukuija enyuma yange norukoba rwenkaitoye tindukuseme'ra okurubiho'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I have told this man that he will deceive the people. And now I have brought him to you before you all, and I will not find any fault with the man who made you suffer.
lunyoro: yabagambira ati Mundetirege omuntu onu ngu Ahabisa abantu: kandi dora nyowe obu'mukagulirizege muno omu maiso ganyu, timboine musango ha muntu onu omwebi ebimumulegere:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “Unless you see miracles and wonders, you will not believe.”
lunyoro: Yesu yamugambira ati Obumutabona obwokuro'raho nebyamahano timuliikiriza na kake.

english: [GENERAL] The blind man said, “What do we hear? Which one of these things will happen to you? Which one of you, then, will tell me exactly the right time?”
lunyoro: Kandi kaiso ki arukumanyisa akasumi aka ebigambo binu okubiri'sana okuhiki'ra?

english: [GENERAL] For I have five brothers, who will be able to see with their eyes, and not come to this great meeting to be heard.
lunyoro: baitu nyina bagenzi bange batano; abe kaiso nambere bali, nabo bataija omu kiikaro kinu ekinyakurumu okuhu'rwa.

english: [GENERAL] When we leave him, everyone will believe in him. The Romans will come and take away our country.
lunyoro: Obuturamulekaho tuti, bona baramuikiriza: Abarumi baliija, balituihaho ensi yaitu nihanga ryaitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For he has set a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by a man whom he has chosen, just as he had promised to believe in him when he raised him from death.
lunyoro: baitu akataho ekiro, ekyalicweramu omusango ogwoburyo ogwensi zona, omu muntu ouyakomeremu; nkokuyahaire bona ekyokuikirizisa, obuyamuhumbuire omu bafu.

english: [GENERAL] So he turned around and said to Simon, “Do you have this woman? I have not come into your house and have no water for my feet; but she has washed my feet with her tears and wiped them with the tears, and I have put her under her feet.”
lunyoro: Yayegarukamu nagambira Simoni ati Obine omukazi onu? Ntahirege omu nju yawe, tompaire maizi agebigere byange: baitu ogu anabisize ebigere Byange namaizi agomumaiso, nabisisiriza nisokerye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] “Jesus of Nazareth,” he cried out in a loud voice, “What do you want us to do with you? Jesus of Nazareth! Have you come to destroy you? I know that you are the Holy One of God!”
lunyoro: yagamba ati Mawe, tujunaine ki itwe naiwe, iwe Yesu owa Nazalesi? Oizire okutihwerekereza? Nkumanyire okwoli, niwe arukwera wa Ruhanga.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “I also will ask you one question, and I will answer you one by one, and I will tell you what this means.
lunyoro: Nauwe yabagambira ati Nanyowe ndabakaguza inywe ekigambo kimu, mungarukemu, nanyowe mbagambire inywe obusobozi okubuli oburukunkoza binu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up, and go on to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to the desert.”
lunyoro: Baitu maraika wa Mukama akagambira Firipo ati Imuka, ogende obukizi obwoburyo okuhika omu muhanda ogusirimuka, okuruga Yerusalemu okuhika Gaza: ogu irungu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Then Jesus said to them, “Lazarus is dead.”
lunyoro: Nubwo Yesu yabagambire bwa ati Razaro afire.

english: [RELIGIOUS] You yourselves know that from the very beginning God made his message come true for you. The Gentiles have heard the Good News from my mouth, and they have believed.
lunyoro: Bene baitu, inywe mumanyire ngu okuruga omu biro byaira, Ruhanga akakomamu halinywe, Abamahanga bahu'le omuk kanwa kange ekigambo ekyenjiri, kandi baikirize.

english: [GENERAL] The traitor looked straight at him, and he said to them, “You are the one I have chosen; arrest him!”
lunyoro: Ogu akaba namugobeza akabaha akokuro'raho, nabagambira ati Oundanywegera, nuwogu; mumukwate.

english: [RELIGIOUS] It is written in the Law, ‘I will speak to these people in strange tongues, but they will not understand me,’ says the Lord.
lunyoro: Kikahandikwa omu biragiro ngu Omu ndimi ezindi nomu minwa yabandi ndigambira abantu banu; kandi tibalimpu'ra, nukwo Mukama agambire ati.

english: [GENERAL] The word of the scripture reached the ends of the world.
lunyoro: iragirobye kikahika ensi ha mpero yensi zabantu bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] After Jesus left, he said, “Now the Son of Man has been made great, and God has been glorified in him.
lunyoro: Kandi obuyamazire okuturuka Yesu yagamba ati Hati bunu Omwana womuntu anyumizibwe, na Ruhanga anyumizibwe omuruwe;

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “I have done one work, and you all are amazed!
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Nkakora omulimu gumu, nanywe inywena mwahuni'ra.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But the righteousness that is of righteousness says to you, ‘Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down from death.)
lunyoro: Baitu okuhiki'ra okwokuikirirza nukugamba kuti Otagamba omu mutima gwawe oti Oha alitemba omu iguru? (nukwo kusirimura Kristo hansi:)

english: [RELIGIOUS] All who heard it heard him and said in their hearts, “What will this child be?” But the Lord's power stayed with him.
lunyoro: Kandi bona ababihulire bakabyeyahu'ra omu mitima yabu, nibagamba ngu Mara, omwana ogu aliba ki? Baitu omukono gwa Mukama gwaikaraga hamu nauwe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus left them and saw them following, and he said to them, “What do you want?” They answered, “Teacher,” (which means “Teacher”).
lunyoro: Nauwe yabarora nibakuratira, yabagambira ati Nimuse'ra ki? banugambira ngu Rabi, ( amakuru gakyo obukimanyisibwa ngu Omwegesa), Orara nkaha?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Come and eat with him.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who do you think you are?” They knew that he was the Lord.
lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Muije murye. Kandi busaho hali abegeswa ayasoboire okumukaguza ati Niwoha? Bamanyire nuwe Mukama waitu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Peter said to them, “Turn away from your sins, and receive the gift of the Holy Spirit, in the name of Jesus Christ.
lunyoro: Petero yabagambira ati Mwegarukemu, mu ibara rya Yesu Kristo, okuihwaho ebibi byanyu, kandi mulehebwa ekisembo Ekyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [GENERAL] The servant's servant answered, ‘Sir, I do not want you to go into my house and just say the word, so that my master will do the same.’
lunyoro: Omunyoro owekihanda Omurumi yagarukamu nagamba ati Mukama wange, tindukusememe'ra iwe okutaha omunda yorusurwange, baitu gamba ekigambo kyonka, omuiru wange nukwo arakira.

english: [GENERAL] The Jews were looking for him at the Passover and asked, “Who is this man?”
lunyoro: Abayudaya bamuse'ra ha bugenyi, nibagamba ngu Ogu alinkaha?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho and fell among robbers, who stripped him of his cloak, and led him out to death.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu nagamba ati Omuntu omu akaba arugire Yerusalemu nasirimuka Yerisko yagwa omu bazinzi abamujuire ebyokujwara, bamutera, barugayo bamusigire na'sana okufa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus answered, “You will not see all these things. I tell you, there will no longer be a stone here on the stone which will not be thrown down.”
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Timurukurora binu byona? Mananukwo nimbagambiranti Tiharliikaraho hanu ibale erinyakuli heruguru ha ibale, eri talinagwa hansi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The hand of the Lord has been revealed to whom?
lunyoro: Kandi omukono gwa Mukama gukasuku'rwa oha?

english: [GENERAL] And I will tell you that you have a great and glorious life for many years. Take your ease and enjoy yourself.
lunyoro: Kandi ndigambira obwomezi bwange nti Obwomezi, oyina itungo lingi ryahuirwe eryokumara emyaka mingi; humura, osemererwe,

english: [RELIGIOUS] He will give birth to a son, and you will come to know that Jesus was raised from death. For he will save his people from their sins.
lunyoro: . Kandi alizara Omwana omwojo; kandi olimuruka ibararye Yesu; baitu nuwe alijuna abantube omu bibi byabu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For I tell you that each one of you says, ‘I belong to Paul,’ ‘I belong to Apollos,’ ‘I belong to Cephas,’ ‘I belong to Christ.’
lunyoro: Baitu eki nikyo ngambire nti omuntu wena omulinywe agamba ati Nyowe wa Pauro: kandi nyowe wa Aporo: kandi Nyowe owa Kefa: Kandi nyowe owa Kristo.

english: [GENERAL] Suppose a man who has one hundred sheep and one of them gets lost and loses one of them is going to the mountains and looks for the lost one.
lunyoro: "Muntu ki anyakuina entamaze kikumi, nentahi yazo emu ebuzire, tasiga ziri ekyenda mu mwenda, nagenda ha nsozi, nase'ra egi enyakubuzire?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to him, “Put your money back in the bank, and sit down and write fifty.”
lunyoro: Yamugambira ati Kwata orupapura rwawe, oika're bwango, ohandike amakumi atano.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice came from heaven and said, “This is my Son, the one I want, with whom I am pleased.
lunyoro: Baitu akahabwa Ruhanga Isitwe ekitnisa nokutinwa, iraka oburyamuizire okuruga omu kitinisa ekirukwangasana, nirigamba ngu Onu nuwe Mwana wange oundukugonza, ounsemererirwe muno:

english: [RELIGIOUS] Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said to them, “Listen! All of you, and understand. Nothing is beyond human beings.
lunyoro: Yagaruka okweta ekitebe namberali, yabagambira ati Mumpu're inywena, mwetegereze; busaho kintu ekyaheru yomuntu

english: [RELIGIOUS] So Jesus said to them again, “The bridegroom is already dead, but I am going to kill him.”
lunyoro: Nukwo yagambire ati: yagaruka nabagambira ati Omugole naija, baitu ningenda okumusisimura.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Pilate said to him, “Are you the king?” Jesus answered, “You said that, because I am the king. I was born, and I came into the world, and I understand. Whoever hears my voice obeys me.”
lunyoro: Pirato yamugambira ati kandi iwe oli omukama? Yesu yagarukamu ati Nukwo ogambire, baitu nyowe ndi omukama. Nyowe nikyo nazalirwe, nikyo naizire omu nsi, ndange amananu. Owamananu wena ahu'ra iraka ryange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them the third time, “I know what sin this man has done. I do not see in him the penalty for death. I will rebuke him and let him go.”
lunyoro: Kale yabagambira obwakasatu ati Mara ekibi kiraha ekyakozire omuntu onu? Timboine omuruwe musango ogwokufa: nikyo ndamute'ra, 'mulekere.

english: [GENERAL] But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of a city that is not circumcised; and I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yagamba ati Nyowe ndi Muyudaya, owa Taruso orwa Kirikiya, owomu rubuga orutali rwokugayibwa: kandi nkwesengerize leka ngambire abantu.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Lord said, “Who is this faithful and wise slave, whom his master will appoint over his household, to give them their food at the proper time?”
lunyoro: Mukama waitu yagamba ati Araha ogu omuketo owokwesiga owamagezi, omukamawe ouyasigire abomukaye, okubaha ebyokurya byabu omu kasumi kabu?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
lunyoro: Omwohi yaija yamugambira ati Obworaboli Mwana wa Ruhanga, gambira amabale ganu gafoke ebyokurya.

english: [GENERAL] Paul said to the commander and to the soldiers, “Unless you are in the boat, you will not be able to be saved.”
lunyoro: Pauro yagambira omunyakihanda nabaserikale ati Abo obubataikale omu kyombo, inywe timusobole okujunwa.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Peter saw it, he said to the people, “What did you men of Israel not want? Why did you make us think that our own power or the worship of our God has made you unclean?”
lunyoro: Kandi Petero obuyaboine yagarukamu abantu ati Inywe abasaija aba Isareri, kiki ekibatangalize omuna? Rundi numutugumizaho ki amaiso okutekereza ngu amani gaitu itwenka, rundi okutina Ruhanga okwaitu, nibyo bimugendeseze ogu?

english: [GENERAL] His elder son was in the field. When he came home, he heard what had happened to him and how he had been crying.
lunyoro: Mutabaniwe omukuru akabali omu misiri; obuyaizire nai'ra haihi nenju, akahu'ra enyamulere nokuzina.

english: [GENERAL] They all denied him, and were amazed at the gracious words that came out of his mouth. “Isn't this Joseph's son?” they asked.
lunyoro: Na bona bakamuranga, nibahuni'ra obwebigambo bye mbabazi ebyarugire omu kanwake: nibagamba ngu Tinu onu mwana wa Yusufu?

english: [GENERAL] You will rest, but you will not be able to speak until the day that these things happen, because you do not believe my words, which will happen in their proper order.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, oliculera, okutasobora okugamba, okuhika ha kiro eki ebigambo binu obubirikahiki'ra, baitu toikirize bigambo byange, ebirihiki'rwa omu mpiko zabyo.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus called his disciples to him and said to them, “I tell you that this poor widow gave more than all the other poor who were going to the marketplace.
lunyoro: Kandi yayeta abegeswabe, nabagambira ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti Omufakati onu owamasege anagiremu bingi okukira bona abarukunaga omu ryahu'ro;

english: [GENERAL] I cannot do what I want, can't you? Your eye is evil, but I am good.
lunyoro: Sirukusobora kukora ebyange nkokundukugonza? Rundi eriso ryawe libi, baitu nyowe ndi murungi?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Holy Spirit came down upon him in bodily form like a dove, and a voice came out of the cloud, “You are my Son, the one I want you to love me with. How happy I am!”
lunyoro: Roho Ogurukwera yasirimuka haruwe omu kisisani kyomubiri nkeriba, niraka ryaruga omu irungu ngu Niwe mwana wange oundukugonza; nkusemererirwe muno.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus asked them, “What is your faith? The people were amazed and said to one another, “Who is this man? He commands the winds and the water to obey him?”
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Okuikiriza kwanyu kuraha? Batina nibahuni'ra bagambirangana bonka ngu Mara ogu noha, baitu aragira nomuyaga namaizi, bimuhu'ra?

english: [GENERAL] My son is sick, but he is suffering terribly, because many tears have been poured out by the fire, and many tears have been poured out by the water.
lunyoro: Omwana wange akwasirwe endwara, emucanza muno: baitu enkanjaiga enyingi agwa omu mu'ro, kandi emirundi nyingi agwa omu maizi.

english: [GENERAL] They did not look for you by faith, but by doing what they did. They did not look for you on the stone that will not be destroyed.
lunyoro: Kandi batakuse'le omu kuikiriza, baitu omu mirimo. Bakatabaijuka ha ibale eririkutabaijurwaho;

english: [GENERAL] And if you think that you should die for the sake of the people, then you should not let anyone go.
lunyoro: kandi obumuraba numutekereza ngu Kibasemerire omuntu omu afe habwa bant, hakire omuntu wena aleke okufa.

english: [GENERAL] Some began to spit on him, and some of them began to spit on him, and they would spit on him, and said, “Crucify him!” The guards took him and beat him.
lunyoro: Nabandi bakabanza okumucwera amacwanta, nokumusweke'ra amaiso, noku mutera, nokumugambira ngu Rugura: nabahereza bamutwara nibamutera empi.

english: [GENERAL] But if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink; but if he is thirsty, give him a drink; for by doing this you will heap fire on his head.
lunyoro: Baitu omunyanzigwa wawe obwarumwa enjara, omulise: obwakwatwa iroho, omunywise; baitu obwokora oti, buli omukumire Amanda gomu'ro ha mutwe.

english: [GENERAL] What did he say? ‘I will look for him, but you will not find him,’ and ‘I will not be able to go to him?’
lunyoro: Kinu kiki ekyagambire ati Mulinse'ra timulimbona: kandi ati namberendi inywe timusobora kuijayo?

english: [GENERAL] I beg you, then, to eat the bread; for this is why you will be saved, because you have not lost the piece of bread on your head and on your head.
lunyoro: Nikyo mbesengererize okurya ha byokurya; baitu nikyo kirabajuna: baitu tihabulie kasoke kamu ha mitwe yanyu nomu.

english: [GENERAL] Whenever you go to a town or village to look for someone who is good, then you will wait for him until he comes from there.
lunyoro: Orubuga rwona nambere murakatahamuga, rundi ekika kyona, muse'rege noha omuli abo asemera; nuho mulira'ra okuhikya obumulirugayo.

english: [GENERAL] In their hearts they said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will follow us.’ But we do not know what happened to this Moses, who led us out of Egypt.
lunyoro: bagambira Aroni omu mitima yabu ngu Otuko'le baruhanga abalitwebembera: baitu Musa ogu, ayatuihire omu nsi ya Misiri, titumanyire okwabaire.

english: [EDUCATION] “Teacher, Moses wrote this to us: ‘A man's brother must die and leave his wife for his children, and the brother's brother must marry his wife and raise children for his brother.’
lunyoro: bamukaguza ngu Omwegesa, Musa akatuhandikira ati Omugenzi womuntu obwafa nasiga mukaziwe atakazaire bana, mugenziwe aswerege mukaziwe aza'rege mugengaye abana.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said to them, “Any kingdom divided against itself falls, and every house divided against itself falls apart.”
lunyoro: baitu uwe yakenga ebitekerezo byabu, yabagambira ati Obukama bwona obunyakubaganizibwamu bwonka buhwereke'ra; nenju obwenyakubaganizibwa yonka egwa.

english: [GENERAL] But Paul said to them, “Before being tried by the Roman authorities, we were put in prison and now we are put in prison. How can we be kept under guard? No, but they have come to us and have crucified us!”
lunyoro: Baitu Pauro yabagambira ati Batutire omu maiso gabantu, tutakacwerirwe omusango itwe abasaija Abarumi, kandi batucumirize omu nju yenkomo; na hati bunu nibatuihamu omu nsita? Nangwa, mananukwo; baitu baije bonka batuturukye.

english: [RELIGIOUS] He did not fail to notice that he was doing well and told them to come down from heaven and gather food for you, and he poured out your hearts to the hungry and happy.
lunyoro: Baitu atebuzeho kaiso, baitu akakora kurungi, nabanagira enjura okuruga omu iguru, nebiro ebyokwerezamu ebyokurya, naigusa emitima yanyu ebyokurumwa nokusemererwa.

english: [GENERAL] When it was late in the morning, the twelve men who had come with him came to him and said, “Send the crowd away, and let them go into the villages and farms around the lake and buy food for themselves, because we are here in the desert.”
lunyoro: Kandi obuire bukaba nubu'sana kuira; ikumi nababiri bakaija, nibamugambira ngu Yohereza abekitebe, bagende omu maka nensi enyakuhe'raine bagonye, basake ebyokurya; baitu hanu tuli omu irungu kwonka.

english: [GENERAL] So Paul went up and fell at him and touched him. “Don't be afraid,” he said, “because his life is in him.”
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro yasirimuka, yamugwera namubumbatira nagamba ati Mutatera empamo; baitu obwomezibwe burumu omunda.

english: [RELIGIOUS] But God said to him, “You fool! This night they will kill you, and whose riches you have heard will they give you?
lunyoro: Baitu Ruhanga akamugambira ati Iwe mudomadoma ekiro kinu nubwo barakuihaho obwomezi bwawe; nitungo eriwayahuire liriba ryoha?

english: [GENERAL] Or perhaps he will say to him, ‘Take your meal and sit down and eat; then you will have enough to eat and drink; and afterward you will be yours.’
lunyoro: Rundi talimugambira ati Ihura ebyokurya, oyetege, ompereze, obundakamara okurya nokunywa; kandi hanyuma nubwo orye onywe?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The Lord said, “Listen to the judge who does not speak.”
lunyoro: Kandi Mukama waitu akagamba ati Muhu're omucwi wemisango owokutahikir'a okwagamba.

english: [GENERAL] I am the vine, and you are the branches. Those who remain in me and I in him are the ones who will bear much fruit, but you will not be able to do anything for me.
lunyoro: Ninyowe muzabibu, ninywe matagi: anyakuikara omuli nyowe, nanyowe omuruwe, nuwe ayana bingi: baitu ha nyowe ntali timuroho ekimurukusobora okukora.

english: [GENERAL] Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, why are you trying to reveal yourself to us, not to the world?”
lunyoro: Yuda ( atili Isikaryota) yamugambira ati mukama waitu, kibaire kita, iwe okweyoleka halitwe, kandi tihali ensi?

english: [GENERAL] You have obeyed your commands, and you have been condemned.
lunyoro: Ohiki'le omu bigambo byawe, Kandi okire obwocwerwa omusango.

english: [GENERAL] This is not because they are Abraham's descendants, but because they are all children. In Isaac are your descendants, and by means of him you will be called.
lunyoro: Kandi tibuli obwokuba baijukuru ba Iburahimu, nukwo bali bana bona: baitu ngu Omu Isaka numwo baijakwe baryeterwa.

english: [GENERAL] “Let us go and buy two hundred silver coins for them,” they answered.
lunyoro: Baitu yagarukamu nabagambira ati Inywe mubahe ebyokurya. Bamugambira ngu Tugende tugule emigati eyedinali bibiri tugibahe barye?

english: [RELIGIOUS] I do not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘You will see the Spirit come down upon you, and you will remain over him, who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
lunyoro: Nanyowe ntamumanye; baitu ogu ayantumire okubatiza namaizi nuwe yangambire ati Owolirora Omwoyo nasirimika haruwe, namuikaraho, nuwe abatiza Nomwoyo Ogurukwera.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and turned around and said to the crowd who had followed him, “I tell you, I have never seen anyone in Israel before.”
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu obuyahuklire ebi yamutanga'ra, yahinduka yagambira abekitebe abamuhondire ati Nimbagambira nti Tinkabonaga kuikiriza kwingi kuti, nobuhokuba omu Isareri.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus went with them. While he was not far from the house, the official sent a message to the man who had been with him, “Don't bother to come in, my Lord!” But I don't deserve to be in my house.
lunyoro: Kandi Yesu yagenda nabo. Kandi obwakaba atagiri hara enju, omunyoro owekihanda yatuma enganjanize namberali, nibamugambira ngu Mukama wange otegadya okuija: baitu tindukuseme'ra iwe okutaha omunda yorusurwange:

english: [GENERAL] He followed Paul and us and cried out in a loud voice, “These men have told you the way to go!”
lunyoro: Ogu akakuratira Pauro naitwe, nagambira haiguru muno, ababatebeza omuhanda ogwokujwa.

english: [GENERAL] I did not know him, but he was revealed to Israel by means of the water.
lunyoro: Nanyowe ntamumanye; baitu uwe asuku'rwe omu Isaleri, ninyeremeza omu maizi.

english: [GENERAL] The chief priests and the elders came to Paul and said, “We have decided to set a trap for you not to consider this matter until you have killed Paul.”

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “Believe now, because it is right for us to do this.” So he believed in him.
lunyoro: Yesu yagarukamu namugambira ati Ikiriza hati bunu, baitu nukwo kituseme'ra kiti okuhikiriza okuhiki'ra kwona. Nubwo yamuikirize.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they had gathered around him, Pilate said to them, “Who is this man who wants you to arrest him? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called the Messiah?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubayesoroize, Pirato yabagambira ati Araha oumurukwenda, 'mubaleke'le? Baraba, rundi Yesu ayetwa kristo?

english: [GENERAL] His fellow servant fell to the ground and begged him, “I want to, and you will get well.”
lunyoro: Kandi omuiru mutahiwe yagwa ahansi, namwesengereza, nagamba ati Ntonga mpora, nanyowe ndikumara.

lunyoro: kandi yabarora, nabagambira ati Wena aliikiriza omwana onu omuto omu ibara rya nge buli aikirize nyowe: nawena aliikiriza nyowe; nawena alisiriza nyowe, buli aikirize ogu ayantumire: baitu anyakuli omuto omulinywe, nuwe mukuru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] When they heard this, they lifted up their voices to God with one voice and said, “Lord, you have made heaven, earth, sea, and all that is in them!

lunyoro: Yamukaguza ati Rabi, niwe Mwana wa Isareri.

lunyoro: kandi hakaba haroho omufakati omu rubuga oru; ogu yaijaga hali emirundi mingi, nagamba ati Ndamura nomunyanzigwa wange.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus answered, “You don't know me or my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.
lunyoro: Kandi Bamugambira ngu 'So araha? Yesu yagarukamu ati Inywe timumanyire nyowe, nobwakuba Isenyowe: kakuba mumunyire, mwakumanyire na isenyowe.

english: [RELIGIOUS] All the prophets had witness against him that if he believed in him, sin would be forgiven.
lunyoro: Hali ogu banabi bona bakaba bali bakaiso ngu obwibararye wena anyakumuikiriza araihwahoga ebibi.

english: [RELIGIOUS] Jesus said to them, “Don't be amazed; you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has been raised from death. He is not here. Look! The place where they crucified him!
lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Mutahuni'ra: numuse'ra Yesu, Omunyanazalesi, ayabambirwe ha muti: ahumbukire: tali hanu: dora, ekiikaro nambere bamutaire.

english: [GENERAL] I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
lunyoro: Nagwa hansi, nahu'ra iraka niringambira ngu Sauro, Sauro. Nonhiga ki?

english: [RELIGIOUS] Those who eat at the houses of widows and cry out with all their heart, and they will be judged more correctly than those who do.
lunyoro: abarya enju ezabafakati, nibagobya omu kusaba okwingi: abo balikira okucwerwa omusango.

english: [GENERAL] Then he will reply, ‘I tell you, whenever you did not do what I did not, you did not do it to me.’
lunyoro: Nubwo ali bagarukamu ati Mananukwo nimbagambira nti nkokumutarakolire omu hali abo abarukukira obuto, Buli mutakiko're nyowe.

english: [GENERAL] They have a king who is an angel of the abyss. He who sits in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek is a pool.
lunyoro: Ziyina omukama wazo, maraika owekina ekitayina hokugarukira: ibararye omu Ruheburaniya nuwe Abadoni, kandi omu Ruyonani nuwe Aporuoni.

english: [GENERAL] This is the stone that was set at nought of you builders, which has become the chief priests of the Law.
lunyoro: Ogu niryo ibale eryagayirwe inywe abombeki, niryo ryafokere erikuru erya ha karugu.

english: [GENERAL] He saw a man named Ananias come in and lay his hands on him and change his mind.
lunyoro: kandi aboine omuntu, ibararye Ananiya, nataha namutaho emikono aiguke.

english: [RELIGIOUS] They threw a purple robe on Jesus, threw a crown on his head, and put a crown on him. They threw their hands on him and said, “Long live the King of the Jews!”
lunyoro: Baruka ekondo eyamabwa, bagita ha mutwegwe, nengoro omu mukonogwe ogwoburyo: bateza amaju omu maisoge, nibamute'ra enaku, nibagamba ngu Mirembe, Mukama wa bayudaya.

english: [GENERAL] But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and to keep him under guard until I make him king over the Roman Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: [RELIGIOUS] While Jesus was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife, because what is in her is the Holy Spirit.”
lunyoro: Kandi obwakaba natekereza ebi, dora, maraika wa Mukama Yamubonekera omu kiroto, nagamba ati Yusufu, omwana wa Daudi, otatina okutwara Maryamu mukazi wawe, baitu ekiri omundaye Kyomwoyo Ogurukwera.

lunyoro: yahu'ra iraka nirimugambira liti Sauro,Sauro, nompiganira ki?

english: [RELIGIOUS] The apostles and the others who followed them said to the apostles and them who had followed them, “Praise the name of the Lord! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
lunyoro: Kandi abakaba bebembire, nabali abakuratire, bagambira haiguru ngu Hosana; Ahairwe omugisa arukuija omu ibara rya Mukama:

english: [RELIGIOUS] The voice answered again and again, “What God has promised, do not commit adultery!”
lunyoro: kandi iraka ryangarukamu omurundi ogwakabiri liti Ruhanga ebiyasemize otalibifora iwe ebyomuziro.

english: [GENERAL] Philip answered him, “The bread that you gave me is the two hundred silver coins, and he did not let them go, all of them at once.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ari Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: [RELIGIOUS] There is no gospel except the Good News about Christ, and there are some who make you sad and want to change the gospel of Christ.

lunyoro: Yesu yabagambira ati Musobora okusibisa abana bobugole, omuswezi obwaba aroho nabo?

lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena obwahu'ra ebigambo byange binu atarukubikora, alisisana nomuntu omudomadoma ayayombekere enjuye ha musenyi:

lunyoro: Kandi kitahandikwe habwogu wenka ngu okuhiki'ra kukamutekerezebwaho,

lunyoro: Baitu nagonza ihanga ryaitu, nogu ayatutaire.

lunyoro: Baitu Mukama waitu yamugambira ati Genda: baitu ogu kibindi ekikomemu namberendi, okutwara ibara ryange omu maiso Gabamahanga nabakama nabana Baisareri:

english: [GENERAL] I heard a voice saying, “Get up, Peter! Here is the one you are!
lunyoro: Kandi nahu'ra iraka nirigamba liti Imuka Petero; ita orye.

lunyoro: Yabagambira ati Nimwenda mbako'le ki?

lunyoro: Kandi nimbagambira nti obubaliba babiri halinywe nibaterana hamu hansi obwekigambo kyona ekibalisaba, kiribako'rwa isenyowe ali omu iguru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] For in him we live and move and remain. As Jesus said to you, ‘We are his children, too.’
lunyoro: baitu omuruwe ntwomera, ntugenda, ntuikaraho; nkabamu abowanyu okubagambire ngu Baitu naitwe tuli banabe.

lunyoro: Nubwo Pauro yagarukamu ati Nimugira ki, oku'ra nokusaliza omutima gwange? Baitu nyowe tinye tegekere okubohebwa kwonka, kandi ibara rya Mukama waitu Yesu.

english: [GENERAL] For they speak with authority, but if he is alive, he also speaks with authority.

english: [GENerAL] I have gone beyond the Jewish religion, far beyond the many Jews who lived in my own country, and I have received much more than this because of the traditions that my ancestors handed me.
lunyoro: Kandi nkahingurana omu dini Yabayudaya okukira baingi abomu ihanga ryange abanakuzire nabo, nyina ihali erirukukira obwingi habwengeso ezinahairwe baisenkuru nyowe.

english: [GENerAL] Afterward, I went to Syria and Cilicia.
lunyoro: Hanyuma nkagenda omu nsi eza Busuli neza Kirikiya.

english: [GENerAL] When they left, they asked them if this had been told to them on the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaturukire, bayesengereza ebigambo binu bibagambirwe ha Sabiti eyakabiri.

english: [GENerAL] All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin which does not lead to death.
lunyoro: Obutuhiki'ra byona kiba kibi; kandi haroho ekibi ekitali ekyokufa.

english: [GENerAL] No one takes a piece of new cloth out of old cloth, but what is put in it will be covered with a cloth, and the skins will be broken to pieces.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho muntu abazira ekiremu ekikyaka oku kyokujwara ekikkuzire, baitu eki ekibazirwemu kitemura ekyokubazire, nekihuru kiukanya okugaliha.

english: [GENerAL] But if I make you sad, who will make me glad, or who will take notice of me?
lunyoro: Baitu obundaba nimbatuntuza, noha arukunsemeza, rundi ogu arukufuntizibwa nyowe?

english: [GENerAL] And now I beg you, dear woman, not to write a new commandment, but the one that was given us from the beginning, ‘Love one another.’
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu nkwesengerize mukazi, tikuli okukuhandikira ekiragiro ekihyaka, baitu rundi eki ekitwahairwe okuruga karanakara, ngu Tugonzanganege.

english: [GENerAL] Then you will sit down at the right side of the tree, where its branches will be broken and its branches fall down, and you will know that the summer is near.
lunyoro: Kandi mwegere hali omutini orufumo rwagwo; itagi ryagwo obulinyeta, amababi nigarokera, buli mumanyire omwaka guli haihi;

english: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because there were priests who offered sacrifices according to the Law.
lunyoro: Kandi kakuba ali hansi, tiyakubaire nyakatagara na kake, baitu haroho abahonga ebisembo nkebiragiro okubiragira;

english: [GENerAL] so that you will live a good life in the sight of the people of this day, and not lose anything.
lunyoro: mugenderege Omu ngeso enungi hali abaheru, mutabuzirweho na kake.

english: [GENerAL] How terrible for the world to talk about things that will not happen to you! But how terrible for that person who causes nothing!
lunyoro: Ziribabona ensi obwebigambo ebyokutabaijura, baitu tibirireka okuija; baitu zirimubona omuntu ogu anyakubinga ekintu!

english: [GENerAL] What did you gain back at that time when you were now ashamed of what you have said? The result of sin is death.
lunyoro: Zintu ebi ebimukaba muyinabyo omu biro ebi ebyebigambo ebirukubabakwasa ensoni hati bunu? Baitu emperor yebi kufa.

english: [GENerAL] The owner of that vineyard will come tomorrow, but he will not wait for it, and he will wait for a long time.
lunyoro: Omukama womwiru ogu rubale alija hakiro ekya tategerezamu, nakasumi

english: [GENerAL] For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people have been led astray from the faith and have turned away from their sins with many sorrows.
lunyoro: Baitu okwegomba erupiya nikyo kikoro ekyobubi bwona: haroho abantu abakunukirire ebi, kandi bahabisibwa okuruga omu kuikiriza, kandi nibecumita bonka nobujune bwingi.

english: [GENerAL] But some men joined him and believed. Among them was Dionysius, a member of the council, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
lunyoro: Baitu abasaija abamu bakehikya haruwe nibaikiriza: hali abo Dionusiyo Omunyaleopago, nomukazi ibararye Damali, nabandi hamu nabo.

english: [GENerAL] You blind fools! Which is the greatest, the most holy and the most sacred gift you can offer?
lunyoro: Inywe abafu bamaiso; baitu ekirukukira obukuru kiraha? Ekisembo, rundi ekyoto ekibohoire ekisembo?

english: [GENerAL] But because of the unfair living conditions in the winter, many others have said good-bye to move from there to Phoenicia, which is a harbor in Crete. They will look at you between the south and the south, and between the north and the west.
lunyoro: Baitu omwogo obwokutaseme'ra okuikaramu omu biro ebyembeho, abandi baingi bagamba okurugayo, rundi balisobora okuhika Foiniki, okuikarayo omu biro ebyobujune, oguli irembo rya Kerete, erirukurora hagati yobukizi obwemoso noburugaizoba, na hagati yabobukizi obwoburyo nobugwaizoba.

english: [GENerAL] But afterward he sent his own son to them and said, “My son will be respected.”
lunyoro: Baitu hanyuma yabatumira omwanawe, nagamba ati Balitina omwana wange.

english: [GENerAL] There was a man named Barabbas, who was bound with those who had committed murder in the riot.
lunyoro: kandi hakaba baroho omu ayetwa Baraba, aboherwe ahamu nabo abaimukirire, abakaba baisire abantu omu kuimuki'ra oku.

english: [GENerAL] But when they recognized that he was a Jew, they also shouted at him for two hours: “Great is Artemis of Ephesus!”
lunyoro: Baitu obubamumanyirire ali Muyudaya, bo na batokera haiguru niraka limu nkesaha ibiri ngu Atemi Wabafeso mukuru.

english: [GENerAL] But the officials who were taking the trip did not find him in prison.
lunyoro: Kandi abanyakihanda abagenzire batasange omu nju yenkomo;

english: [GENerAL] Everyone who fears the Son as the Father does. Whoever does not honor the Son does not respect the Father who sent him.
lunyoro: Omwana wena amutinege, nkokkuyatinire Isenyowe. Aturukutina Mwana tarukutina Isitwe ayamutumire.

english: [GENerAL] It is much better for the angels to receive a better name than for themselves.
lunyoro: nukwo yakira ati bamaraika obwekugwetwa ibara erirungi okukira bo.

english: [GENerAL] For I have something to say to you, because you did not choose your own love at first.
lunyoro: Baitu nyina ekigambo haliwe, baitu okaleka okugonza kwawe okwokubanza.

english: [GENerAL] Onesimus was not happy with you for a long time, but now I am happy with him and with me.
lunyoro: Onesimo, akaba atarukukugasira ira, baitu hati bunu nakugasira iwe nanyowe:

english: [GENerAL] You are witnesses, then, and believe in the deeds of your ancestors. They have killed them, and you build their tombs.
lunyoro: Nukwo muli bakaiso, numuikiriza engeso zabasenkuru inywe: baitu nibo babaisire, nainywe mwombeka ebituro byabu.

english: [GENerAL] But if he does not know it, he will be a murderer and will give him back to his master and to the traitors, and there he will cry and gnash his teeth.
lunyoro: kandi obwalireka atamanyire alimucwamu habiri, alimuha omugabogwe hamu nabagobya; nuho haliba oku'ra nokunena ensaya.

english: [GENerAL] And your brother Elizabeth is also the father of a son in law among his ancestors. And so his sixth son was called the firstborn.
lunyoro: Kandi dora, Erisabesi mwene wanyu, nauwe ali nenda yomwana omwojo omu bakaikurubwe: kandi kunu nukwo kwezikwe okwomukaga ayayetwaga engumba.

english: [GENerAL] But they kept shouting, “Crucify him!”
lunyoro: baitu bayeyongera muno okutoka nibagamba ngu Abambwe.

english: [GENerAL] Will the owner of the vineyard do anything? He will come and destroy the tenants, and the owner from the vineyard will give the vineyard to others.
lunyoro: Nukwo mukama worugonjo rwemizabibu aligira ata? Aliija alihwerekereza abalimi, orugonjo orwemizabibu aliruha abandi.

english: [GENerAL] He left Nazareth and went to live in Capernaum, on the other side of the lake.
lunyoro: yaruga Nazalesi, yaija yaikara Kaperenaumu, enyakuli ha nyanja, omu mutano eya

english: [GENerAL] What I tell you, then, is what I tell ya: keep watch.
lunyoro: Kandi ekindukubagambira inywe nikyo mbagambirabona nti, Murolege.

english: [GENerAL] Love one another, and this is what you have done to all your friends in Macedonia. We beg you, my friends, to increase and increase.
lunyoro: gonzangana; kandi nukwo mukozire mali halibene banyu bona abomu Makedoni yona. Baitu tubesengerize bene baitu okweyongera nokusaga;

english: [GENerAL] He went down with them and came to Nazareth. He looked straight at them, and his mother kept all these things in her heart.
lunyoro: Kandi akasirimuka hamu nabo, yaija Nazalesi; yabacule'ra: nyina yayerinda ebigambo ebi byona omu mutimagwe.

english: [GENerAL] They answered, “We don't have any more than five loaves and two fish, and we will go and buy food for all these people.”
lunyoro: Bagamba ngu Titunyinabyo, rundi emigati etano nencu ibiri; rundi turagenda tugu'le ebyokurya abantu banu bona.

english: [RELIGIOUS] So after he had endured, he was given a vow.
lunyoro: Nukwo obuyamazire okugumisiriza yahabwa omurago.

english: [GENerAL] They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their teaching. They did not want their lives to be destroyed.

english: [GENerAL] offer your gift in front of the altar, and come back and make peace with your brother, and offer your offering again.
lunyoro: oti oiheyo ekihongwa kyawe omu maiso gekyoto, ogarukeyo, obanze omale okuteraana na mwene wanyu, ogaru'le ohonge ekihonga kyawe.

english: [GENerAL] He could not perform all the miracles, but placed his hands on a few sick people.
lunyoro: kandi atasobole kuko'ra oku ekyamani kyona, rundi akataho emikonoye ha barwaire bake,

english: [GENerAL] Every tree that grows in me will bear fruit; every tree that bears figs will make it grow and bear fruit.
lunyoro: Itini ryona eriri omuli nyowe eritana byana aliriihaho: na itagi ryona erinyakwana ebyana, alisemeza, likanye okwana.

english: [GENerAL] Remember that our brother Timothy has been set free. But if he comes soon, I will see you with him.
lunyoro: Mumanye nga mugenzi waitu Timiseo akalekerwa: rundi obwaliija mpora, nanyowe ndi borora hamu nauwe.

english: [GENerAL] So then, do not let anyone boast in human beings. Instead, be content with everything you have.
lunyoro: Nukwo omuntu wena aleke okwenyumiriza omu bantu. Baitu byona byanyu:

english: [GENerAL] Be glad, then, if you are sad for a little while now in the race for life, then you should all be like them.
lunyoro: Inu numusemererwa muno, nobumuraba numubihirwa hati bunu akacu kake omu bwohebwa okwemiringo nyingi, kiriba kibasemerire kiti

english: [GENerAL] But when the righteous man stayed among them, he saw and heard them and saw and had compassion on them all day long because of their wicked deeds.
lunyoro: Baitu omusaija ogu ahikirire obuyaikaraga omulibo narora nahu'ra yabonabonaga obukyabukya omu mutimagwe oguhikirire obwengeso zabu ezokwema.

english: [GENerAL] In the past we have been tempted in doing what the Gentiles want to do, in order to live immorally, in the habit of drinking wine, in love, in sexual immorality, and in the worship of idols.
lunyoro: Baitu ebiro ebyahinguitrho nibisobora okutumara okukora Abamahanga ebibagonza, nokugendera omu busihani, nokwegomba, nokusomasoma amarwa, nebyokubandwa, nobutamizi, nokuramya ebisisani okurukunugwa:

english: [GENerAL] Which one of you, then, will give him the stone if he asks for bread?
lunyoro: Rundi muntu ki omulinywe, omwanawe obwalimusaba omugati alimuha ibale?

english: [GENerAL] But if the ox were to call out in a loud voice, would it not be ready to fight?
lunyoro: Baitu nengwaea obwereta iraka eritegeka okurwana?

english: [GENerAL] But you must obey my teaching, my conduct, my teaching. My faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.

english: [GENerAL] It would have been better for that servant to have a large millstone tied around his neck and be thrown into the sea, than for him to have one of these little ones thrown into it.
lunyoro: hakire ogu okubohwa orubengo ha bikya nokunagwa omu nyanja, okukira okutabaijura omu omuli abo abato.

english: [GENerAL] It was the Sabbath and the Sabbath.
lunyoro: Kandi kikaba kiri kiro Kyokutekaniza, Sabiti ne'sana okukya.

english: [GENerAL] For he who did the same thing in Peter's case among the people of the circumcision, the same one who did it with me, the one who was not circumcised.
lunyoro: baitu ogu ayakolire omu Petero obukwenda hali abokkusarwa, nuwe yakolire omuli nyowe obukwenda halli abokutasarwa.

english: [GENerAL] When they had finished speaking, James spoke up and said,
lunyoro: Kandi obubaculire, Yakobo yagarukamu nagamba ati

english: [GENerAL] But I tell you, do not keep on looking at the evil; instead, go to the right and be on the left.

english: [GENerAL] On the day of his resurrection, whose wife will she be? All seven of them had married her.”
lunyoro: Nukwo, omu kuhumbuka, alika muka oha hali abo? Baitu bona omusanju bakamuswera.

english: [GENerAL] Asaph was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the son of Joram.
lunyoro: Asa akazara Yehosafati; Yrhosafati akazara Yoramu;

english: [GENerAL] For what will it profit a man if he loses his whole world but loses or loses his own life?
lunyoro: Baitu kirimugasira ki omuntu obwalitunga ensi yona, nauwe abuzire, rundi ahwerekerire wenka.

english: [GENerAL] This happened in Bethany on the other side of the Jordan River, where John was baptizing.
lunyoro: Ebigambo ebi bikakorwa Besaniya nseri ya Yorudani,Yohana nambere akaba nabatiza.

english: [GENerAL] That is why I said, ‘The man who first came after me has come after me, because he was the one who was the first with me.’

english: [GENerAL] He did not do all the work because of their lack of faith.

lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu tali nyowe ndukukora eki, baitu ekibi ekirukuikara omuli nyowe.

english: [GENerAL] For the one who was told these things by another tribe did not come from where anyone would work at the altar.
lunyoro: Baitu ogu ayagambirweho ebigambo ebi woruganda orundi, nambere hatarugiremu omuntu okuhereza ha kyoto.

english: [GENerAL] The Jews joined in the accusation against him and believed that this was true.
lunyoro: Nabayudaya bakaterana hamu okumulega, nibaikiriza ngu nukwo biri biti.

english: [GENerAL] You tolerate anyone who looks down on you like a fool, looks down at you, looks at you as if you were a fool; you reap what you did not plant, you reap the harvest, you gather the grapes, you plant the grapes for yourselves, you boast about it, you look at it,

english: [GENerAL] You lived in the world and enjoyed yourselves. You made yourselves fat in the day of slaughter.
lunyoro: Mukarara omu nsi, mukesemeza; mukaiguta emitima yanyu omu kiro kyokuita.

english: [GENerAL] But if any of you think that you haven't treated your husband properly, because you are too old and in good health, then you must do what you want without paying attention to him.

english: [GENerAL] Another servant came and said, ‘Sir, here is your gold coin I have kept ready for the exchange.
lunyoro: Ndi akaija nagamba ati Mukama wange kanginu erateri yawe, eyinayahuire ekubirwe omu kikoba:

english: [GENerAL] When the master of the house comes up, knocks the door, and you begin to stand outside and knock at the door. ‘Open the door for us,’ you will say, ‘our Lord!’ and he will answer you, ‘I don't know where you come from.’
lunyoro: Mukama wenju obwalikamara okuimuka, nokukingaho oruigi, nainywe numubanza okweme'ra aheru, nokweranga ha ruigi, numugamba ngu Mukama waitu otukingu'leho; nauwe aligarukamu nabagambira ati Timbamanyire, nambere murugire;

english: [GENerAL] Festus wanted to gain favor with the Jews, so he asked Paul, “Do you want to go to Jerusalem and be tried in the presence of four witnesses for these things?”
lunyoro: Baitu Fesito obuyagondeze okusimwa Abayudaya, yagarukamu Pauro nagamba ati Noyenda okutemba Yerusalemu ocwerweyo omusango owebigambo binu omu maiso gane?

lunyoro: Simon petero yamusima ogu namugambira ati Tugambire owagambireho okwali.

english: [GENerAL] Can a fig tree, my friends, bear olive branches or a vine figs? Even if a spring bears figs, it can't bear figs.

english: [GENerAL] I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread that I will give is my flesh, because the world is alive.”
lunyoro: Ninyowe byokurya ebyomire ebyarugire omu iguru: omuntu wena obwarya ha byokuryaga ebi, aryomera ebiro nebiro: ego, nebyokurya ebindihayo nugwo mubiri gwange, obwobwomezi Bwensi.

english: [GENerAL] Pilate was surprised when he died. He called the officer and asked him if he had been dead before.
lunyoro: Pirato yahuni'ra okwafire bwango: yayeta nambereri omunyakihanda, yamukaguza okwafirege kara.

english: [GENerAL] After their resurrection, they arrived at the place called Gennesaret.
lunyoro: Obubamazire okwambuka, bahika ha mugongo ogwa Genezalesi.

english: [GENerAL] Let no one rob you of your prize by boasting about what you have seen and boasting about the angels; instead, be proud of what you see and do not boast about what your bodies have seen.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena aleke okubanyanga empera yanyu omu kwebundaza okwayenzire wenka, nokuramya bamaraika, aikaire omwebi ebyaboine, nayenyumirirza busa omu magezi gomubirigwe,

english: [GENerAL] For the tax collectors do the same thing.
lunyoro: Baitu nabasisi nukwo bakora bati.

english: [RELIGIOUS] The crowd was filled with pity, and Jesus said to them, “Get out of the way, because the girl has not died, but is asleep.” They made fun of him.
lunyoro: kandi abekitebe nibatera empamo, yabagambira ati Murugeho, baitu omuisiki tafire, agwijagire. Bamusekereza muno.

english: [GENerAL] the son of Boaz, the son in law of Salmon, the father of Obed, the mother of Boaz.
lunyoro: owa Boazi, owa Salimoni, owa Obeda,

english: [GENerAL] No soldier has a belt around his waist to protect him from the edge of the sword. Happy is the one who wrote you as a soldier.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho murwani obwaramaga ayetaba nebigambo byobwomezi bunu; nukwo asimwe ogu anyamuhandikire okuba omurwani.

english: [GENerAL] I should have the same concern for you all, because I myself am with you in my darkness, and you are all with me in my grace, in my trials, and in the preaching of the Good News and building up yourselves.
lunyoro: nkokukihikirire nyowe okutekereza nti habwanyu inywena, baitu ndi nainywe omu tima gwange, kandi nainywena numuterana nanyowe omu mbabazi, omu nsengo zange nomu kutonganira njiri nokugigumya.

english: [GENerAL] For in Jerusalem is the free gift that comes down from God, our Father.
lunyoro: Baitu Yerusalemu orwomu iguru rwobugabe, nuwe nyina itwe.

english: [GENerAL] There was much whispering about him in the crowd. Some people said, “He is a good man,” others said, "No, he is not a good person.
lunyoro: Hakabaho empaka nyingi omu bitebe haruwe: abandi nibagamba ngu Murungi; abandi nibagaya ngu Nangwa,

english: [GENerAL] If we say that we have fellowship with him, we are walking in the darkness and do not do the truth,
lunyoro: Obutugamba ngu ntuterana nauwe ntugendera omu muirima,tubiha ebisuba, kunu titurukukora mazima:

english: [GENerAL] As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, “Why are you untyling it?”
lunyoro: Kandi obubakaba nibasibu'ra omwana gwenkaina, bakama bagwo babagambira ngu Nimuiburu'ra ki omwana gwendo?

english: [GENerAL] The women who had followed him from Galilee saw the tomb and the body taken away.
lunyoro: Nabakazi abarugire Galiraya hamu nauwe bakuratira enyuma, barora ekituro nomutumbi okugwatairweho.

english: [GENerAL] “What miracle do you perform, then, that we may see how you are doing?” they asked him.
lunyoro: Kandi bamugambira ngu Nukwo, kokkuro'raho ki iwe akokora, itwe turole tukkuikirize?

lunyoro: Yaija nogu ayahairwe etaranta ibiri, yagamba ati Mukama wange okansigira etaranta bibiri; dora nkagobamu etaranta zibiri ezindi.

english: [GENerAL] All those whom the Father gives me will come to me; and whoever comes to me I will never put anyone out of you.”
lunyoro: Bwona Isenyowe abampa baliija namberendi; anyakuija nambera nyowe tindimubingira aheru na kake.

english: [GENerAL] But Peter said, “Man, I don't know what you are talking about.” At once a rooster crowed.
lunyoro: Baitu Petero yagamba ati Omusaija, ti'manyire ekyorukugamba. Ahonaho obwakaba nakigamba enkoko yakoka.

english: [GENerAL] But when I boast about him in all I do, I am not ashamed of him. As we have told you all the truth, so our boasting in Titus was about the truth.
lunyoro: Baitu obunayenyumize omu kigambo kyona habwanyu haruwe, ntakwate ensoni; baitu nkokutwabagambire inywe byona omu mazima, nukwo nokwenyumiza kwaitu hali Tito kukaba kuli kwa mazima.

english: [GENerAL] The Pharisees said to one another, “Look how weak he is! He is not good at all! Look! The whole world is following him!”
lunyoro: Abafalisayo bagambirangana ngu Murole okumutarukusobora na kake; dora, ensi yona nemukuratira.

english: [GENerAL] That is why I left you in Crete, so that you might make everything else beautiful and appoint elders in every town.
lunyoro: Ekyo nakulekire omu Kulete osemeze ebyasigalire, kandi oteho abakuru omu mbuga zoona,

english: [GENerAL] The priest of Zeus was in front of the city, and he brought oxen and oxen on the gates, and tried to kill the people with the sword.
lunyoro: Kandi nyakatagara wa Zeu akaba ali omu maiso gorubuga, akaleta ente nemikako eyebyakyo ha malembo nayenda okusara ekyonzira hamu nebitebe.

english: [GENerAL] They tried to find out what had happened to the twelve apostles, but soon afterward they returned and found about five thousand men.
lunyoro: kandi balenga okuhama nibarora ebifuna amakumi abiri: kandi obwahinguireho kakaito bagaruka okulenga okuhamu ebifuba ikumi na bitano.

english: [GENerAL] But Paul appealed to the Emperor to be kept under guard and to keep him under guard until I could send him to the Roman Emperor.
lunyoro: baitu Pauro obuyajulire okulindwa okucwerwa omusango hali Augusito, naragira okumulinda okuhikya obundikamutweka hali Kaisali.

english: [GENerAL] But you know that afterward he wanted to receive a blessing from God, because he did not see him repent and turn away from drinking water.
lunyoro: Baitu mu manyire ngu hanyuma obuyagondeze okugwetwa omugisa akangwe, ( baitu atabone hokwegarukiramu) nobuyaguseruire noku'ra amazi.

english: [GENerAL] Leave all my belongings to the poor, and go to the streets. During the time of harvest I will tell the teachers of the Law, ‘Take the bread first and throw it to the dogs, because you are the ones who will get it.’
lunyoro: Muleke binyete byona, bihike ha magesa: omu biro ebyokugesa ndigambira abagesi nti Mubanze musoroze emberya, muzibohe enganda bazokye: baitu oburo mubuhunike oku maguli gange.

english: [GENerAL] They have authority to shut up the sky so that no rain can come down during the time of their preaching. They have power over the springs of water to turn the earth into blood, and to make the earth and all the heavenly bodies suffer, as often as they wish.
lunyoro: Banu bayina obusobozi okuiga'ra iguru, enjura ereke okugwa omu biro byokugamba kwabu: kandi bayinaobusobozi ha maizi okugafora esagama, nokutuntuza ensi nemihito yona, emirundi mingi nkokubaragonzaga.

english: [GENerAL] We have many things to say to you, and you have many difficult things to tell you, but you have become dull of hearing.
lunyoro: Tunyina ebigambo bingi okumugambaho, kandi ebirukulemera okubimanyisa, baitu inywe mufokere abafu bamatu.

english: [GENerAL] So then, if I do judge, my judgment is true, because I am not alone, but with the Father who sent me.
lunyoro: Nukwo, nobundaba nincwa omusango, okucwa kwange kwa mananu; baitu nyowe tindi omu, baitu ndi hamu na Isenyowe ayantumire.

english: [GENerAL] “How, then, did you change your mind?” they asked him.
lunyoro: Kandi bamugambira ngu Nukwo amaiso gawe gakaiguka gata?

english: [GENerAL] That is why you have to follow the example of the Nicolaitans, who belong to me.
lunyoro: Baitu nikyo oyinakyo, onobere engeso za Banikoraiti, ezi'noba nyowe.

english: [GENerAL] That is why Moses ordered you to circumcise a boy, not Moses, but your ancestors; and on the Sabbath you circumcise a human being.
lunyoro: Moses nikyo yabaherire okusara ( tukuli kwa Musa, baitu nukwo kwa baisenkuru inywe); kandi ha Sabiti musara omuntu.

english: [GENerAL] Believe me, then, that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; and you believe me only because of what I do.
lunyoro: Muikirize ngu nyowe ndi omuli Isenyowe, na isenyowe omuli nyowe: rundi Munyikirize habwemirimo yonka.

english: [GENerAL] It gives me proof of what I am doing, and I do not want to come to you to have life.
lunyoro: Ibyo bimanyisa ebyange; kandi timurukwenda kuija namberendi mube nobwomezi.

english: [GENerAL] The next day Cornelius was waiting for them, so he gathered his relatives and his friends and friends together.
lunyoro: Ha kiro ekyakabiri Koruneryo akaba nabategereza, amazire okusoroza aborugandarwe nabakaba abri enganjanize.

english: [GENerAL] Try to enter the closed door, because many people will try to enter, but they will not be able.
lunyoro: Mwekambe okutaha omu irembo erifunzire: baitu nimbagambira nti Baingi abalise'ra okutahamu, tibalisobora.

english: [GENerAL] But you have been merciful to those in prison, and you endured with joy the loss of your riches. You know that you have a better and eternal life.
lunyoro: Baitu mukaganyira abo abakaba bali omu nkomo, kandi mukagumisiriza nokusemererwa okunyagwaho ebiitungo ryanyu, mumanyire ngu inywe munyina itungo erirukukira oburungi, kandi erirukuikaraho.

english: [GENerAL] For those who have something will be given more, and those who don't have will have more than they have, and all that they have will be taken away from them.
lunyoro: Baitu anyakuina, nuwe arihebwa: akandi atanyina, aliihibwaho nakyo ekyanyinakyo.

english: [GENerAL] These are the things that are like these in these modern times. They have increased the sacrifices and the sacrifices that cannot be made to serve the one who serves the one whose heart is pure, but who boasts of what is in their hearts.
lunyoro: eki nikyo kisisani omu biro bya hati bunu: nikyo bahongera ebisembo nebyonzira ebitarukusobora okuhikiriza arukuramya omu bigambo ebyomu mutima, baitu

english: [GENerAL] The night is almost over, and the day is almost here. Let us, then, be full of practices that please the darkness, and let us take up weapons for the light.
lunyoro: Ekiro kihinguire muno, obuire nubu'sa okukya: nukwo tujule engeso ezomuirima, tujwale ebyokurwanisa ebyomusana.

english: [GENerAL] That is why you must give to the poor my money, and when I come, I will receive it back with interest.
lunyoro: Nikyo kyakuhikirire okuha abaguzi efeza yange, nanyowe obunakuizire nakuhairwe eyange namagoba gayo.

english: [GENerAL] See, then, that these things cannot be hid from you; you must be quiet and do nothing while you wait for me.
lunyoro: Nukwo muboine ebi tibisoboka okwangwa, kibahikirire inywe okuculera, okutakora kintu nimwanguhiriza.

english: [GENerAL] The one who sent me is what he wanted: ‘Do not lose anything he has given me, but I will raise him to life on the last day.’”
lunyoro: Ayantumire ekyagonza nikyo kinu ngu Ha kyona ekyampaire haleke okuburaho na kake, baitu nkiimukye ha kiro kya hampero.

english: [GENerAL] Simon Peter went in and went into the tomb, where he saw the linen cloths lying.
lunyoro: baitu atatahemu. Kandi na Simoni Petero, yaija omukuratire, yataha omu kituro; yarora engoye zekitani zitairwe aho,

english: [GENerAL] Pilate said to them, “Take him down and crucify him, because I find no reason to condemn him.”
lunyoro: Pirato yabagambira ati Mumutwale inywe, mumubambe hamuti: baitu nyowe timboine musango haruwe.

english: [GENerAL] As you have given him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all those you have handed him.
lunyoro: nkokumuhaire obusobozi ha banyakuina omubiri bona, bona abawamuhaire, abahe obwomezi obutahwaho.

english: [GENerAL] In this way we will celebrate the Passover, not with a conscience or with an evil conscience, but with things that are not based on legends and legends.
lunyoro: nukwo tucumbe obugenyi, hatali nekititumbisa ekiitima nobubi, baitu nebitatumbisibwa ebyobutagobya namazima.

english: [GENerAL] The king praised that dishonest accusation, but he was wise. The people of this world are much more shrewd than the people of the day in their own order.
lunyoro: Kandi mukamawe akanyumiza omuketo ogu atali wokuhiki'ra, baitu akagira amagezi: baitu abana abensi enu, omu businge bwabu, nibakira amagezi abana abomusana.

english: [GENerAL] You should not have pity on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you.
lunyoro: obwokunyesengereza naiwe tikikusemerire okuganyira omuiru omutahi wawe, nka nyowe okunakuganyire iwe?

english: [GENerAL] Paul stood up at the gates and defended the people with his hand. After the uproar had subsided, he spoke in Hebrew to them,
lunyoro: Kandi Pauro obuyayemerire ha matembero yagambira abantu nomukono, obubamazire okuculera muno yabagambira omu rulimi Oruheburaniya nagamba ati.

english: [GENerAL] But they did not do it, because they put heavy loads on their shoulders and put them on the shoulders, but did not want to put them to the test by themselves.
lunyoro: Baitu baboha; baitu baboha enketo ezirukulemera,ezitetweka, ba zitweka abantu ha mabega; baitu bo tibenda kuzitengesa ne kyara kyabu.

english: [GENerAL] Blind people and those who are foolish do not love one another, and do not despise one another.
lunyoro: (Abafu bamaiso, abasisa ebi baragana, abatagonzangana, abatayina kuganyira):

english: [GENerAL] They will run away from the Devil's trap, after which he will lead you into doing what he wants you to do.
lunyoro: kandi balitami'ruka okuruga omu ndubatira ya Setani, ogu obuyamazire okubahamba okukora nkoli okuyagondeze.

english: [GENerAL] You are our letter, which is known to everyone.
lunyoro: Ninywe baruha yaitu, erukumanywa erukusomwa abantu bona;

english: [GENerAL] For the first time he must suffer much and be rejected by the people of this world.
lunyoro: Baitu okubanza kimuhikirire okusalizibwa bingi nokuhakanwa abobusinge bunu.

english: [GENerAL] All those who live on earth will worship him, because the book of the living which was written in the Lamb's book of life has been lost since the creation of the world.
lunyoro: Kandi bona abaikara hansi balikiramya, wena atahandikirwe ibararyeomukitabu kyobwomezi Ekyokwana Gwentama ayaisirwe okuruga ha kuhangwa kwensi.

english: [GENerAL] The servants were so angry that they came to him and said, “Sir, don't you put a fine robe in your name, because it wasn't right for us to have any bread?”
lunyoro: Abairu rubale banyineka baija nibamugambira ngu Tata, otasige mbibo esemire omu ruharo rwawe, baitu ekaba eta okubamu emberya?

english: I do not order you by the Law, but by the will of others, to be truthful in your love.
lunyoro: Tindukuragira ekiragiro, baitu obwokwekamba kwa bandi, nindenga amazima agokugonza kwanyu.

english: [GENerAL] The owner of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my own dear son; they will not fear him.’
lunyoro: Omukama worugonjo yagamba ati Ndagira nta? Ndituma omwana wange oundukugonza; rundi balimutina.

english: [GENerAL] But what does it mean to say that your sins have been forgiven or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
lunyoro: Baitu ekirahuka kiraha? Okugamba nti ebibi byawe bikuihirweho, rundi okkugamba nti Imuka ogende?

english: [GENerAL] He will not go into anything that is not good, nor will he go into the house of a thief or a robber. Instead, they will be written in the Lamb's book of the living.
lunyoro: kandi tihalitahamu na kake ekintu kyona ekitali kisemeri, nobwakuba anyakukora ebyomuziro nebisuba: rundi abo bonka bahandikwa omu kitabu ekyobwomezi Ekyomwana Gwentama.

english: [GENerAL] Out of the mouth come forth cursing and cursing. My friends, these things ought not to happen to you.
lunyoro: Omu kanwa kamu numwo harugamu okukugia nokukyena. Bene baitu ebi tibisemerire okuikara biti.

english: [GENerAL] They refuse to give up, because they themselves are slaves of sin; but the person who has been redeemed is slaves of that slave.
lunyoro: nibaraganiza okubaha obugabe, baitu bo bonka bali abairu rubale abokujunda; baitu omuntu ekyasingurwa, nikyo aba mukwenda wakyo.

english: [GENerAL] Philip answered him, “For two hundred silver coins he did not need to pay you, and for a little while we all did.”
lunyoro: Firipo yamugarukamu ali Emigati eyomuhendo edinali bikumi bibiri teyakubaigusize, bona okukomaho kake.

english: [GENerAL] He has entrusted us with everything that he has entrusted to us in all his wisdom and insight.
lunyoro: eziyasigisize namberetuli omu magezi gona nokwetegereza kwona,

english: [GENerAL] For each one will prove himself faithful to his own work, and then he will have his own glory, not only for himself.
lunyoro: Baitu omuntu wena ayerengere omulimogwe wenka, kandi nukwo abe nokwenyumizakwe habwe, kunu tihali habwondi.

english: [GENerAL] And these things we write down for our own good.
lunyoro: nebbigambo binu itwe tubihandikire okusemererwa kwaitu kuhiki'le.

english: [GENerAL] For this is what God has promised: ‘At the right time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.’”
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nugwo murago ngu Nkebiro binu okubiri, nubwo ndiija, kandi Sara aliba nomwana.

english: [GENerAL] The world cannot hate you, but it hates me, because I tell it that its ways are evil.
lunyoro: Ensi tesobora kubanoba; baitu enobere nyowe, baitu nyowe nimanyisa ebyayo nti emirimo yayo ebihire.

english: [GENerAL] He who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
lunyoro: Ogu anyakubeta wokwesiga, kandi nuwe alikora.

english: [GENerAL] When the angel went in with him, he called two of his family members to him and appointed a jailer over those who sent him to be the one who was in need.
lunyoro: Kandi maraika ayabalize nauwe obuyagenzire, yayeta abairube babiri abomu nju, na muserukale omwerinzi hali abo abamuherezaga obutosa;

english: [GENerAL] You are our glory and our joy.
lunyoro: Baitu ninywe kitinisa kyaitu nokusemererwa kwaitu.

english: [GENerAL] Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where people should worship.
lunyoro: Baisenkuru itwe baramyaga ha rusozi runu; nainywe mugamba ngu Ha Yerusalemu nuho Kisemereire abantu okuramizaga.

english: [GENerAL] That is why I did not think it proper for me to speak on my own behalf, so that my servant will get well.
lunyoro: ndi nikyo ntayetekererize nyenka okuseme'ra okugamba ebyange nyenka, omwojo wange arakira.

english: [GENerAL] Teach them to obey all that I have commanded you. And I am with you always, to the end of the age.
lunyoro: nimubegesa okukwata byona ebinabaragire; kandi dora, nyowe ndi hamu nainywe ebiro byona, okuhikya obusinge bunu obubulihwaho.

english: [GENerAL] He called him and said to him, “What do you want me to do with you? Turn from your sins, because you cannot remain in the judgment any longer!”
lunyoro: kamweta, yamugambira ati Kiki kinu ekindukuhu'ra haliwe? Bara omuhendo ogwobuketo bwawe; baitu tokyasobora kuikara omuketo.

english: [GENerAL] For I tell you the Gentiles. As long as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I honor my own self-will.
lunyoro: Baitu nimbagambira inywe Abamahanga. Nukwo nyowe obumba ndi omukwenda hali Abamahanga, ninyumiza obukwenda bwange:

english: [RELIGIOUS] He threw himself down at Jesus' feet and thanked him, and he was a Samaritan.
lunyoro: ahansi ha bigerebye, namusima: nogu akabali Musamaliya.

english: [GENerAL] before the throne of the kingdom of heaven, which is like a jasper, and between the throne and the four living creatures full of eyes, both before and behind.
lunyoro: kandi omu maiso gekitebe kyobukama enyanja yendo'rwamu erukusisana nka kurusitaro; na hagati yekitebe ekyobukama ebyomezi bina ebiijuire amaiso omu buso nenyuma.

english: [GENerAL] I know him, the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings. I am like him who died.
lunyoro: nuwe 'mumanye ogu, namani agokuhumbukakwe, nokuterana kwomu kubonabonakwe, ninsisanizibwa nokufakwe:

english: [GENerAL] So they went off and found a donkey tied up in the back of the colt, and as they walked on, they forgot to sleep.
lunyoro: bagenda, basanga omwana gwenkaina bagusibikire ha irembo aheru omu ikute; bagusibura.

english: [GENerAL] For we are no longer proud of you, but we have given you a chance to boast about ourselves, so that you may have an answer for those who boast about things that are above, but not on your heart.
lunyoro: Baitu titurukugaruka okwenyumiza itwenka halinywe, baitu tubahaire inywe omwanya gwokwenyumiza habwaitu, nukwo mube nekyokugarukamu abo abanyakwenyumiriza ebyaharuguru, kunu tihali omu mutima.

english: [GENerAL] He is loved and works faithful in all he does for the believers and the guests.
lunyoro: Arukugonzebwa nokora omulimo ogwokwesiga omu byona ebyokora habwabu bene baitu kandi abagenyi:

english: [GENerAL] “No one in your group is called by that name,” they answered.
lunyoro: Bamugambira ngu Busaho omuli bene banyu ayetwa ibara eri.

english: [GENerAL] How happy and happy it must have been to hear this! Your brother was dead, but now he is alive; he was lost, but asleep.
lunyoro: Baitu okukyanganuka nokusemererwa kisemire: baitu mugenzi wawe ogu akaba afire, kandi ayomire, akaba azahire, azahukire.

english: [GENerAL] But you have brought these men here who have not broken the walls or robbed our master's wife.
lunyoro: Baitu mulesere abantu banu, abatanyagire ebyomu mabandiro, nobukwakuba okujuma omucwezi waitu omukazi.

english: [GENerAL] But to those who do what is good, praise and glory, honor and peace, it is the first time that a Jew or a Gentile is circumcised.
lunyoro: baitu okusimwa nekitinisa nobusinge hali wena arukukora okurungi, okubanza Omuyudaya, kandi Nomuyonani:

english: [GENerAL] But what you have heard from the beginning must remain in you. The things you have seen from the very beginning will remain in your hearts, and you will remain with the Son and the Father.
lunyoro: Kandi inywe ekimwahulire okuruga karanakara, nikyo kiikalege omulinywe. Ekimwahulirese okuruga kara karakara obukiraba nikiikara omulinyWE, nainywe muraikaraga omu Mwana nomu Isitwe.

english: [GENerAL] So then, the overseer must be without fault, as a husband who is not his wife; he must be a husband without a husband; he should be a humble and hospitable; he will be a good shepherd; he cannot be a drunkard or a glutton;
lunyoro: Nukwo kihikirire omurolerezi okutabaho ekyokuhanwa, abe musaija womukazi omu, atali mutamizi, omwerinzi, akunira abagenyi, wamagezi okwegesa; atakunganira amarwa, atatera;

english: [GENerAL] I tell you that soon the Son of Man will come and destroy them. But when the Son Of Man comes, will he find faith on earth?”
lunyoro: Nimbagambira nti Alibaramu'ra bwango. Baitu Omwana womuntu obwaliija alisanga okuikiriza hansi?

english: [GENerAL] And now the weeds are gathered at the roots of the trees. So every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
lunyoro: Kandi hati bunu empango etairwe ha kikoro kyemiti: nukwo omuti gwona ogutarukwana byana ebisemire guratemwa, guranagwa omu mu'ro.

english: [GENerAL] Nor does anyone pour new wine into old wineskins, because the wine will burst the skins, and the skins will be ruined.
lunyoro: Kandi busaho omuntu ata amarwa agomutara'ra omu ndyanga ezikuzire; kakuba agira ati amarwa agarukumara gakutemuire endyanga zakusisikaire.

english: [GENerAL] He was changed in front of them, and his face shone like the sun, and all his clothes became like the light.
lunyoro: yayehindurwa omu maiso gabu: amaisoge nigamulikana nkizoba, nebyokujwarabye nibyera nkomusana.

english: [GENerAL] But if you have poured this perfume on my body, you have used it as a perfume.
lunyoro: Baitui obwaseserege amagita ganu ga mubiri gwange, akikozire obwokuzika.

english: [GENerAL] A man who was lame from birth had been carried by his mother, and the next day they threw him out of the Temple treasury, which is called the Holy Place, to tell those who had come into the Temple to be punished.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu akabali omulema okuruga omu nda ya nyina akaba bamuhimbire, oubabyamyaga obukyabukya ha ruigi orwa yekaru orurukwetwa Orurungi, okulega ebyokuganyira hali abo atahaga omu yekaru.

english: [RELIGIOUS] I was in Joppa praying, and I saw something coming down that looked like a large sheet being lowered from heaven and coming down to me.
lunyoro: Nkaba ndi omu harubuga Yopa ninsaba: omutima gwange gukahingisibwa, narora omu kwolekwa ekintu nikisirimuka, ekisisana nkorugoye orukoto orutebwa okuruga haiguru, kandi kyaizira nyowe:

english: [GENerAL] What place do I have to be raised to life?
lunyoro: Rundi kiikaro ki nambere ndihumu'ra?

english: [GENerAL] For there are some who are saved by the power of their mothers, and others who have been saved by God's power through the Kingdom of heaven. Those who can believe and believe in it will be saved.
lunyoro: Baitu haroho abakonerwe abazairwe bai okuruga omu nda za banyinabo: haroho abakuonerwe abayekonere bonka obwobukama obwomu iguru. Anyakusobora okukiikiriza akiikirize.

english: [GENerAL] For the saying is true, ‘Someone will leave and others will praise you.’
lunyoro: Baitu ekigambo kinu nukwo kya mananu ngu Ondi asiga, Ondi agesa.

english: [GENerAL] When they saw a man who was healed standing there with them, they could not answer him.
lunyoro: Kandi obubaboine omuntu akizibwege, ayemerire hamu nabo, batasobole kugarukamu.

english: [GENerAL] Whoever has this hope in him will be glad just as he is happy.
lunyoro: Kandi omuntu wena anyakuina okunihira oku haruwe ayesemeza nkauwe okwasemezibwe.

english: [GENerAL] For I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife or marries another Christian commits adultery; and whoever marries a woman commits adultery against her commits adultery.

english: [GENerAL] But let your words always be “Yes” and “No” and "No” because these are the very things that come from the Evil One.

english: [GENerAL] He also sprinkled the blood on the Tent and on all the things that were offered to him.

english: For the woman who has been put to death is bound by the law of her husband to be put to the test; but the man who has died has been set free from the law.

lunyoro: Baitu ebyokutahikira tibirukuhanwa omu maiso ga Ruhanga; Ruhanga taterwa enaku obwokutetanga.

lunyoro: Kandi omusni egi hakaba harumu abalisa abaikaire omu bwe'le nibalinda igana ryabu ekiro.

lunyoro: Kandi omuisiki omu obuyamuboine aikalire nambere omu'ro gwakire, yamugumiza amaiso, nagamba ati Nonu abaire ali nauwe.

english: [GENerAL] Near that place was the island of Publius, who kept us close by, and for three days we were welcomed.

english: [GENerAL] They called out and asked, “Is there a guest here named Simon Peter?”
lunyoro: nibeta nibakaguza rundi Simoni, ibararye eryakabiri Petero, agonyere omu.

english: [GENerAL] “Sir,” he answered, “Have you come to the house where I was without clothes?” He went off and hid himself.
lunyoro: yamugambira ati Mutahi wange, otahire ota hanu otanyina kyokujwara ekyobugenyi? Yaculera kwonka.

english: [GENerAL] Five times I was whipped by the Jewish authorities, and thirty-nine prisoners were put to death.

english: [GENerAL] The crowd gathered around them, and the judges put on their cloaks and ordered them to be crucified.
lunyoro: kandi ekitebe kikabaimuki'ra ahamu:kandi abacwi bemisango batemu'ra ebyokujwara byabu, nibaragira okubatera nemiigo.

english: [GENerAL] There he met a man named Aeneas who had been dead for eight years, because he was still alive.
lunyoro: Hazo akasanga omuntu omu, ibararye Ainea, ayamazire ha kitabukye emyaka munana; baitu akaba azingamire.

english: [GENerAL] We show great respect for the parts of our body which seem to be weaker, and the parts which do not have the same beauty do not fit in.

english: [GENerAL] A wise man has his weapons and keeps his own bread safe, so that his belongings will be safe.

english: [GENerAL] The foreigners treated us unkindly, because they kindled a fire and burned us all, because we all drank from the hot sun and were scattered.
lunyoro: Nabanyaihanga bakatukora embabazi ezitali zabantu bona: baitu bakahemba omu'ro batuiriza haihi itwena, obwenjura eyagwire, nobwembeho.

english: [GENerAL] They appeared with great fear and spoke about the way he was going to Jerusalem.

english: [GENerAL] and all the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate them one from another, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
lunyoro: amahanga goona galisorozebwa omu maisoge; nauwe alibacwanganizamu, nko mulisa okwa cwanganiza entaama ne mbura buzi;

english: [GENerAL] But they shook the dust off their feet and came to Iconium.
lunyoro: Baitu abo bakabakunkumu'ra ecucu eyomu bigere byabu, baija Ikonio.

english: [GENerAL] He was sitting there, as if it were a jasper stone and a jasper, clear as crystal. The darkness around the throne was like crystal.
lunyoro: kandi ogu akaba aikalire nasisana nkibale erya yasepi nerya sadio okurorwa: nomuhanganzima gukaba gwehingulirize ekitebe kyobukama, ogukaba nugusisana nka kurusitaro.

english: [GENerAL] The soldiers took him into the house in the place of the commander, who is called the Barthelios. They gathered all the way together.
lunyoro: Kandi baserikale bamutwara omu nju, erukwetwa Peraitolio; basoroza hamu ekihanda kyona.

english: [GENerAL] As many people have done, they have not begun to write a report about what has happened to us.

english: [GENerAL] For you and my mother are mine, and I am their glory.

english: [GENerAL] The angel said to him, “Take your mat and put on your sandals.” He did so. “ Take your cloak and follow me,” he told him.

english: [GENerAL] Suddenly in the middle of the night there was a cry, “Here is the bridegroom! Come and meet him!”
lunyoro: Baitu ekiro omu itumbi haroho obwogo ngu Dora omuswezi naija muturuke okumutangi'ra.

english: [GENerAL] But if you proclaim God's message to all people, and a person who does not believe or does not understand what you are reading, you will be punished everyone and be put right with everyone.
lunyoro: Baitu bona obubatebeza, kandi omuntu atarukuikiriza rundi atamanyire okusoma obwatahamu, alihanwa bona, kandi alicwerwa bona omusango:

english: [GENerAL] They were pleased with him, saying, “These last men have worked only one hour, and we have agreed with you, who have been made perfect in this way. The light will shine on you.”

english: [GENerAL] The Gentiles and the Jews, together with their leaders, wanted to make fun of them.

english: [GENerAL] But what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fancy clothes? Look! Those who dress like that and eat the good food are sitting in the king's house.

english: [GENerAL] They said to me, “You must speak again to many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
lunyoro: Kandi bakangambira ngu Kikuhikirire okugaruka okuragura hali abantu, namahanga, nendimi, nabakama baingi.

english: [GENerAL] For I am not the least of all the seeds that fell on your head.
lunyoro: baitu nisoke erya ha mutwe gwawe libazirwe ryona.

english: [GENerAL] While I was with them, I kept them safe in your name. I beg you, then, that you would not kill any of them except the Son of Man, and the Scriptures will come true.
lunyoro: obunkabandi nabo, nyowe nkabalinda omu ibara ryawe abawampaire: nimbasemba tihakaburaga muntu hali bo, rundi omwana owokuhwereke'ra; ebyahandikirwe bihiki'le.

english: [GENerAL] The one who wants to be great is watching over all things. Those who do what is right are being given a sweet-smelling fragrance, because we are the real wine.

lunyoro: Baitu nyowe nimbagambira nti Omuntu wena anyakubihi'rwa mwene wabu, aligwe'rwaho omusango; nauwe anyakugambira mwene wabu ati Mugwagwa, buli amalize kunagwa omu Gehena eyomu'ro.

english: [GENerAL] The world knows that I love the Father and that I have the Father who sent me. Get up, let us go from here!
lunyoro: kandi ensi emanye ningonza Isenyowe, kandi nak Isenwo akantuma, nukwo nkora nti. Muimuke, turuge hanu.

english: [GENerAL] and cried out in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed has been worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, and honor!”
lunyoro: kandi nibagamba niraka erihango ngu Omwana Gwentama ayaisirwe asemerire okuhabwa obusobozi, nobuguda, namagezi, namani, nokutinwa, nekitinisa, nokusimwa.

english: [GENerAL] When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, Herod and those who were with him were pleased to eat with her. The king said to the young woman, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

lunyoro: Yabinganiza hali ekitebe ekicwerwaho emisango.

lunyoro: Kristo, obwomezi bwaitu, obwaryolekwa, nubwo nainywe hamu nauwe mulimanyisibwa omu kitinisa.
